hymns.title: HYMN I. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: I Laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice,The hotar, lavishest of wealth. Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers.He shall bring hitherward the Gods. Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing day by day,Most rich in heroes, glorious. Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest aboutVerily goeth to the Gods. May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great,The God, come hither with the Gods. Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper,That, Aṅgiras, is indeed thy truth. To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayerBringing thee reverence, we come Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One,Increasing in thine own abode. Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son:Agni, be with us for our weal.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजं ।होतारं रत्नधातमं ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ īḷe ǀ puráḥ-hitam ǀ yajñásya ǀ devám ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀhótāram ǀ ratna-dhā́tamam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I Laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice, The hotar, lavishest of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify Agni, the high priest of the sacrifice, the divine, the ministrant, who presents the oblation (to the gods), and is the possessor of great wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: I Laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice, The hotar, lavishest of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः पूर्वेभिर्ऋषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत ।स देवाँ एह वक्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ pū́rvebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ nū́tanaiḥ ǀ utá ǀsáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vakṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers. He shall bring hitherward the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May that Agniwho is to be celebrated by both ancient and modern sages conduct the gods hither.
verses.griffith_verse: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers. He shall bring hitherward the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निना रयिमश्नवत्पोषमेव दिवेदिवे ।यशसं वीरवत्तमं ॥
verses.transliteration: agnínā ǀ rayím ǀ aśnavat ǀ póṣam ǀ evá ǀ divé-dive ǀyaśásam ǀ vīrávat-tamam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing day by day, Most rich in heroes, glorious.
verses.wilson_translation: Through Agnithe worshipper obtains that affluence which increases day by day, which is the source of fame and multiplier of mankind.
verses.griffith_verse: Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing day by day, Most rich in heroes, glorious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि ।स इद्देवेषु गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yám ǀ yajñám ǀ adhvarám ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ ási ǀsáḥ ǀ ít ǀ devéṣu ǀ gacchati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about Verily goeth to the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the unobstructed sacrifice of which you are on every side the protector, assuredly reaches the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about Verily goeth to the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः ।देवो देवेभिरा गमत् ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǀ satyáḥ ǀ citráśravaḥ-tamaḥ ǀdeváḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great, The God, come hither with the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, the presenter of oblations, the attainer of knowledge, he who is true, renowned, and divine, come hither with the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great, The God, come hither with the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यदंग दाशुषे त्वमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि ।तवेत्तत्सत्यमंगिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ aṅgá ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ tvám ǀ ágne ǀ bhadrám ǀ kariṣyási ǀtáva ǀ ít ǀ tát ǀ satyám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper, That, Aṅgiras, is indeed thy truth.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever good you may,Agni, bestow upon the giver (of the oblation), that verily,Aṅgirasshall revert to you.
verses.griffith_verse: Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper, That, Aṅgiras, is indeed thy truth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयं ।नमो भरंत एमसि ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ agne ǀ divé-dive ǀ dóṣā-vastaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ vayám ǀnámaḥ ǀ bhárantaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ imasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer Bringing thee reverence, we come
verses.wilson_translation: We approach you,Agni, with reverential homage in our thoughts, daily, both morning and evening.
verses.griffith_verse: To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer Bringing thee reverence, we come
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: राजंतमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविं ।वर्धमानं स्वे दमे ॥
verses.transliteration: rā́jantam ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ gopā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dī́divim ǀvárdhamānam ǀ své ǀ dáme ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One, Increasing in thine own abode.
verses.wilson_translation: You, the radiant, the protector of sacrifice, the constant illuminator of truth, increasing in your own dwelling.
verses.griffith_verse: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One, Increasing in thine own abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पितेव सूनवेऽग्ने सूपायनो भव ।सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ sūnáve ǀ ágne ǀ su-upāyanáḥ ǀ bhava ǀsácasva ǀ naḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son: Agni, be with us for our weal.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, be to us easy of access, as is a father to his son; be ever present with us for our good.
verses.griffith_verse: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son: Agni, be with us for our weal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN II. Vāyu.
hymns.anukramani: ९ मधुच्छन्दा वैश्वामित्रः। १-३ वायुः, ४-६ इन्द्र-वायु, ७-९ मित्रा-वरुणौ। गायत्री।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: BEAUTIFUL Vāyu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared:Drink of them, hearken to our call. Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorifyThee, Vāyu, with their hymns of praise. Vāyu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper,Far-spreading for the Soma draught. These, Indra-Vāyu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties’ sake:The drops are yearning for you both. Well do ye mark libations, ye Vāyu and Indra, rich in spoil!So come ye swiftly hitherward. Vāyu and Indra, come to what the Soma-presser hath prepared:Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer. Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuṇa,Who make the oil-fed rite complete. Mitra and Varuṇa, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law,Have ye obtained your might power Our Sages, Mitra-Varuṇa, wide dominion, strong by birth,Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.

verses.sanskrit: वायवा याहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंकृताः ।तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ darśata ǀ imé ǀ sómāḥ ǀ áram-kṛtāḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ pāhi ǀ śrudhí ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: BEAUTIFUL Vāyu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared: Drink of them, hearken to our call.
verses.wilson_translation: Vāyu, plural asant to behold, approach; these libations are prepared for you drink of them; hear our invocation.
verses.griffith_verse: BEAUTIFUL Vāyu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared: Drink of them, hearken to our call.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वाय उक्थेभिर्जरंते त्वामच्छा जरितारः ।सुतसोमा अहर्विदः ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ jarante ǀ tvā́m ǀ áccha ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀsutá-somāḥ ǀ ahaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify Thee, Vāyu, with their hymns of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Vāyu, your praisers praise you with holy praises having poured out Somajuice, and knowing the (fit) season.
verses.griffith_verse: Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify Thee, Vāyu, with their hymns of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वायो तव प्रपृंचती धेना जिगाति दाशुषे ।उरूची सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ táva ǀ pra-pṛñcatī́ ǀ dhénā ǀ jigāti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀurūcī́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vāyu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper, Far-spreading for the Soma draught.
verses.wilson_translation: Vāyu, your approving speech comes to the giver (of the libation), and to many (others who invite you) to drink of the Somajuice.
verses.griffith_verse: Vāyu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper, Far-spreading for the Soma draught.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरा गतं ।इंदवो वामुशंति हि ॥
verses.transliteration: índravāyū íti ǀ imé ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ práyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀíndavaḥ ǀ vām ǀ uśánti ǀ hí ǁ
verses.english_translation: These, Indra-Vāyu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties’ sake: The drops are yearning for you both.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Vāyu, these libations are poured out (for you); come hither with food (for us); verily the drops (of the Somajuice) await you both.
verses.griffith_verse: These, Indra-Vāyu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties’ sake: The drops are yearning for you both.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वायविंद्रश्च चेतथः सुतानां वाजिनीवसू ।तावा यातमुप द्रवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ cetathaḥ ǀ sutā́nām ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀtáu ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ dravát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Well do ye mark libations, ye Vāyu and Indra, rich in spoil! So come ye swiftly hitherward.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Vāyu, abiding in the sacrificial rite, you are aware of these libations; come both (then) quickly hither.
verses.griffith_verse: Well do ye mark libations, ye Vāyu and Indra, rich in spoil! So come ye swiftly hitherward.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वायविंद्रश्च सुन्वत आ यातमुप निष्कृतं ।मक्ष्वित्था धिया नरा ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀmakṣú ǀ itthā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ narā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vāyu and Indra, come to what the Soma-presser hath prepared: Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.
verses.wilson_translation: Vāyuand Indra, come to the rite of the sacrificer, for thus, men, will completion be speedily (attained) by the ceremony.
verses.griffith_verse: Vāyu and Indra, come to what the Soma-presser hath prepared: Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसं ।धियं घृताचीं साधंता ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrám ǀ huve ǀ pūtá-dakṣam ǀ váruṇam ǀ ca ǀ riśā́dasam ǀdhíyam ǀ ghṛtā́cīm ǀ sā́dhantā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuṇa, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke Mitra, of pure vigour, and Varuṇa, the devourer of foes; the joint accomplishers of the act bestowing water (on the earth).
verses.griffith_verse: Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuṇa, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा ।क्रतुं बृहंतमाशाथे ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ ṛta-vṛdhau ǀ ṛta-spṛśā ǀkrátum ǀ bṛhántam ǀ āśāthe íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra and Varuṇa, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law, Have ye obtained your might power
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, augmenters of water, dispensers of water, you connect this perfect rite with its true (reward).
verses.griffith_verse: Mitra and Varuṇa, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law, Have ye obtained your might power
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया ।दक्षं दधाते अपसं ॥
verses.transliteration: kavī́ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ tuvi-jātáu ǀ uru-kṣáyā ǀdákṣam ǀ dadhāte íti ǀ apásam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our Sages, Mitra-Varuṇa, wide dominion, strong by birth, Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.
verses.wilson_translation: Sapient Mitraand Varuṇa, prosper our sacrifice and increase our strength; you are born for the benefit of many, you are the refuge of multitudes.
verses.griffith_verse: Our Sages, Mitra-Varuṇa, wide dominion, strong by birth, Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN III. Aśvins
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: YE Aśvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands,Accept the sacrificial food. Ye Aśvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise,Accept our songs with mighty thought. Nāsatyas, wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass:Come ye whose paths are red with flame. O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee,Thus by fine fingers purified. Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers,Of the libation-pouring priest. Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers.In our libation take delight. Ye Viśvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approachYour worshipper's drink-offering. Ye Viśvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught,As milch-kine hasten to their stalls. The Viśvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile,Bearers, accept the sacred draught Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may brightSarasvatīdesire,With eager love, our sacrifice. Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer of all gracious thought,Sarasvatī accept our rite Sarasvatī, the mighty flood,—she with her light illuminates,She brightens every pious thought.

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना यज्वरीरिषो द्रवत्पाणी शुभस्पती ।पुरुभुजा चनस्यतं ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ yájvarīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ drávatpāṇī íti drávat-pāṇī ǀ śúbhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀpúru-bhujā ǀ canasyátam ǁ
verses.english_translation: YE Aśvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands, Accept the sacrificial food.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, cherishers of pious acts, long-armed, accept with outstretchedhandsthe sacrificial viands.
verses.griffith_verse: YE Aśvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands, Accept the sacrificial food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना पुरुदंससा नरा शवीरया धिया ।धिष्ण्या वनतं गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ púru-daṃsasā ǀ nárā ǀ śávīrayā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀdhíṣṇyā ǀ vánatam ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ye Aśvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise, Accept our songs with mighty thought.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, abounding in mighty acts, guides (of devotion), endowed with fortitude, listen with unaverted minds to our praises.
verses.griffith_verse: Ye Aśvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise, Accept our songs with mighty thought.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वृक्तबर्हिषः ।आ यातं रुद्रवर्तनी ॥
verses.transliteration: dásrā ǀ yuvā́kavaḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ rudravartanī íti rudra-vartanī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Nāsatyas, wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass: Come ye whose paths are red with flame.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, destroyers of foes, exempt from untruth, leaders in the van of heroes, come to the mixed libations sprinkled on the lopped sacred grass.
verses.griffith_verse: Nāsatyas, wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass: Come ye whose paths are red with flame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः ।अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ citrabhāno íti citra-bhāno ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ tvā-yávaḥ ǀáṇvībhiḥ ǀ tánā ǀ pūtā́saḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by fine fingers purified.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, of wonderful splendour, come hither; these libations, ever pure, expressed by the fingers (of the priests) are desirous of you.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by fine fingers purified.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः ।उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ vípra-jūtaḥ ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀúpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vāghátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers, Of the libation-pouring priest.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, apprehended by the understanding and appreciated by the wise, approach and accept the prayers of the priest as he offers the libation.
verses.griffith_verse: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers, Of the libation-pouring priest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः ।सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́tujānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀsuté ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ naḥ ǀ cánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers. In our libation take delight.
verses.wilson_translation: Fleet Indrawith the tawny coursers, come hither to the prayer (of the priest), and in this libation accept our (proffered) food.
verses.griffith_verse: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers. In our libation take delight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो विश्वे देवास आ गत ।दाश्वांसो दाशुषः सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ómāsaḥ ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛtaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀdāśvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ye Viśvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering.
verses.wilson_translation: Universal Gods, protectors and supporters of men, bestowers (of rewards) come to the libation of the worshipper.
verses.griffith_verse: Ye Viśvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे देवासो अप्तुरः सुतमा गंत तूर्णयः ।उस्रा इव स्वसराणि ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ap-túraḥ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ ganta ǀ tū́rṇayaḥ ǀusrā́ḥ-iva ǀ svásarāṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ye Viśvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught, As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.
verses.wilson_translation: May the swift-moving universal Gods, the shedders of rain, come to the libation, as the solar rays come diligently tot he days.
verses.griffith_verse: Ye Viśvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught, As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे देवासो अस्रिध एहिमायासो अद्रुहः ।मेधं जुषंत वह्नयः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ asrídhaḥ ǀ éhi-māyāsaḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀmédham ǀ juṣanta ǀ váhnayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Viśvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile, Bearers, accept the sacred draught
verses.wilson_translation: May the universal Gods, who are exempt from decay, omniscient, devoid of malice, and bearers of (riches), accept the sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: The Viśvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile, Bearers, accept the sacred draught
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती ।यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pāvakā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ vājínī-vatī ǀyajñám ǀ vaṣṭu ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright Sarasvatī desire, With eager love, our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May Sarasvatī, the purifier, the bestower of food, the recompenser of worship with wealth, be attracted by our offered viands to our rite.
verses.griffith_verse: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright Sarasvatī desire, With eager love, our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: चोदयित्री सूनृतानां चेतंती सुमतीनां ।यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती ॥
verses.transliteration: codayitrī́ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ cétantī ǀ su-matīnā́m ǀyajñám ǀ dadhe ǀ sárasvatī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer of all gracious thought, Sarasvatī accept our rite
verses.wilson_translation: Sarasvatī, the inspirer of those who delight in truth, the instrumental uctress of the right-minded, has accepted our sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer of all gracious thought, Sarasvatī accept our rite
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: महो अर्णः सरस्वती प्र चेतयति केतुना ।धियो विश्वा वि राजति ॥
verses.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ prá ǀ cetayati ǀ ketúnā ǀdhíyaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sarasvatī, the mighty flood,—she with her light illuminates, She brightens every pious thought.
verses.wilson_translation: Sarasvatī, makes manifest by her acts a mighty river, and (in her own form) enlightens all understandings.
verses.griffith_verse: Sarasvatī, the mighty flood,—she with her light illuminates, She brightens every pious thought.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN IV. Indra
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds,To our assistance day by day. Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou!The rich One's rapture giveth kine. So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence:Neglect us not, come hitherward. Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song,Him who is better than thy friends. Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place,Ye who serve Indra and none else; Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest,Still may we dwell in Indra's care. Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice,That to the Friend gives wings and joy. Thou, Śatakratu, drankest this and wast the Vṛtras’ slayer; thouHelpest the warrior in the fray. We strengthen, Śatakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight,That, Indra, we may win us wealth. To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend of him who pours the juice,Yea, to this Indra sing your song.

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे ।जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
verses.transliteration: surūpa-kṛtnúm ǀ ūtáye ǀ sudúghām-iva ǀ go-dúhe ǀjuhūmási ǀ dyávi-dyavi ǁ
verses.english_translation: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds, To our assistance day by day.
verses.wilson_translation: Day by day we invoke the doer of good works for our protection, as a good cow for the milking (is called by the milker).
verses.griffith_verse: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds, To our assistance day by day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब ।गोदा इद्रेवतो मदः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ sómasya ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ piba ǀgo-dā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ revátaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.
verses.wilson_translation: Drinker of the Somajuice, come to our (daily) rites, and drink of the libation; the satisfaction of (you who are) the bestower of riches, is verily (the cause of) the gift of cattle.
verses.griffith_verse: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अथा ते अंतमानां विद्याम सुमतीनां ।मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: átha ǀ te ǀ ántamānām ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ su-matīnā́m ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áti ǀ khyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.
verses.wilson_translation: We recognize you in the midst of the right-minded, who are nearest to you; come to us; pass us not by to reveal (yourself to others).
verses.griffith_verse: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: परेहि विग्रमस्तृतमिंद्रं पृच्छा विपश्चितं ।यस्ते सखिभ्य आ वरं ॥
verses.transliteration: párā ǀ ihi ǀ vígram ǀ ástṛtam ǀ índram ǀ pṛccha ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀyáḥ ǀ te ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.
verses.wilson_translation: Go, worshipper, to the wise and uninjured Indra, who bestows the best (of blessings) on your friends, and ask him of the (fitness of the) learned (priest who recites his praise).
verses.griffith_verse: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उत ब्रुवंतु नो निदो निरन्यतश्चिदारत ।दधाना इंद्र इद्दुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ bruvantu ǀ naḥ ǀ nídaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ anyátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ārata ǀdádhānāḥ ǀ índre ǀ ít ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, Ye who serve Indra and none else;
verses.wilson_translation: Let our ministers, earnestly performing his worship, exclaim, Depart your revilers from hence and every other plural ce (where he is adored).
verses.griffith_verse: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, Ye who serve Indra and none else;
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उत नः सुभगाँ अरिर्वोचेयुर्दस्म कृष्टयः ।स्यामेदिंद्रस्य शर्मणि ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ su-bhágān ǀ aríḥ ǀ vocéyuḥ ǀ dasma ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀsyā́ma ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ śármaṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroyer of foes, let our enemies say we are prosperous; let men (congratulate us); may we ever abide, in the felicity (derived from the favour) of Indra.
verses.griffith_verse: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एमाशुमाशवे भर यज्ञश्रियं नृमादनं ।पतयन्मंदयत्सखं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ īm ǀ āśúm ǀ āśáve ǀ bhara ǀ yajña-śríyam ǀ nṛ-mā́danam ǀpatayát ǀ mandayát-sakham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice, That to the Friend gives wings and joy.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer to Indra, the pervader (of every rite of libation), the juice that is present (at the three ceremonies), the grace of the sacrifice, the exhilarator of mankind, the perfecter of the act, the favourite of (that Indra) who gives happiness (to the offerer).
verses.griffith_verse: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice, That to the Friend gives wings and joy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा शतक्रतो घनो वृत्राणामभवः ।प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनं ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ pītvā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ ghanáḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇām ǀ abhavaḥ ǀprá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vājínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, Śatakratu, drankest this and wast the Vṛtras’ slayer; thou Helpest the warrior in the fray.
verses.wilson_translation: Having drunk,Śatakratu, of this (Somajuice), you became the slayer of the Vṛtras; you defend the warrior in battle.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, Śatakratu, drankest this and wast the Vṛtras’ slayer; thou Helpest the warrior in the fray.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा वाजेषु वाजिनं वाजयामः शतक्रतो ।धनानामिंद्र सातये ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vājínam ǀ vājáyāmaḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀdhánānām ǀ indra ǀ sātáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We strengthen, Śatakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We offer to you,Śatakratu, the mighty in battle, (sacrificial) food for the acquisition,Indra, of riches.
verses.griffith_verse: We strengthen, Śatakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यो रायोवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा ।तस्मा इंद्राय गायत ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ avániḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ su-pāráḥ ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀtásmai ǀ índrāya ǀ gāyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend of him who pours the juice, Yea, to this Indra sing your song.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing unto that Indrawho is the protector of wealth, the mighty, the accomplisher of good deeds, the friend of the offerer of the libation.
verses.griffith_verse: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend of him who pours the juice, Yea, to this Indra sing your song.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN V. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: O COME ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song,companions, bringing hymns of praise. To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent,Indra, with Soma juice outpoured. May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth:May he come nigh us with his strength. Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not:To him, to Indra sing your song. Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops,The Somas mingled with the curd. Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice,Strong Indra, for preëminence. O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee:May they bring bliss to thee the Sage. Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Śatakratu, and our laudsSo strengthen thee the songs we sing. Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold,Wherein all manly powers abide. O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keepSlaughter far from us, for thou canst.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेंद्रमभि प्र गायत ।सखायः स्तोमवाहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ ā́ ǀ ita ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǀ índram ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ stóma-vāhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O COME ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten hither, friends, offering praises; sit down, and sing repeatedly the praises of Indra.
verses.griffith_verse: O COME ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणां ।इंद्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
verses.transliteration: puru-támam ǀ purūṇā́m ǀ ī́śānam ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀíndram ǀ sóme ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, with Soma juice outpoured.
verses.wilson_translation: When the libation is poured forth, respectively praise Indra, the discomfiter of many enemies, the lord of many blessings.
verses.griffith_verse: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, with Soma juice outpoured.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स घा नो योग आ भुवत्स राये स पुरंध्यां ।गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ naḥ ǀ yóge ǀ ā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ sáḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ sáḥ ǀ púram-dhyām ǀgámat ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: May he come nigh us with his strength.
verses.wilson_translation: May he be to us for the attainment of our objects; may he be to us for the acquisition of riches; may he be to us for the acquisition of knowledge; may he come to us with food.
verses.griffith_verse: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: May he come nigh us with his strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य संस्थे न वृण्वते हरी समत्सु शत्रवः ।तस्मा इंद्राय गायत ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ sam-sthé ǀ ná ǀ vṛṇváte ǀ hárī íti ǀ samát-su ǀ śátravaḥ ǀtásmai ǀ índrāya ǀ gāyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra sing your song.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing to that Indra, whose enemies in combat await not his coursers harnessed in his car.
verses.griffith_verse: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra sing your song.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सुतपाव्ने सुता इमे शुचयो यंति वीतये ।सोमासो दध्याशिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: suta-pā́vne ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ vītáye ǀsómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.
verses.wilson_translation: These pure Somajuices, mixed with curds, are poured out for the satisfaction of the drinker of the libations.
verses.griffith_verse: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सुतस्य पीतये सद्यो वृद्धो अजायथाः ।इंद्र ज्यैष्ठ्याय सुक्रतो ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ vṛddháḥ ǀ ajāyathāḥ ǀíndra ǀ jyáiṣṭhyāya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, Strong Indra, for preëminence.
verses.wilson_translation: Your,Indra, performer of good works, has suddenly become of augmented vigour for the sake of drinking the libation, and (maintaining) seniority (among the gods).
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, Strong Indra, for preëminence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा विशंत्वाशवः सोमास इंद्र गिर्वणः ।शं ते संतु प्रचेतसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ viśantu ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀśám ǀ te ǀ santu ǀ prá-cetase ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are the object of praises, may these pervading Somajuices enter into you; may they be propitious for your (attainment of) superior intelligence.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां स्तोमा अवीवृधन्त्वामुक्था शतक्रतो ।त्वां वर्धंतु नो गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ stómāḥ ǀ avīvṛdhan ǀ tvā́m ǀ ukthā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀtvā́m ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Śatakratu, and our lauds So strengthen thee the songs we sing.
verses.wilson_translation: The chants (of the Soma) have magnified you,Śatakratu, the hymns (of the Ṛk) have magnified you; may our praises magnify you.
verses.griffith_verse: Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Śatakratu, and our lauds So strengthen thee the songs we sing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अक्षितोतिः सनेदिमं वाजमिंद्रः सहस्रिणं ।यस्मिन्विश्वानि पौंस्या ॥
verses.transliteration: ákṣita-ūtiḥ ǀ sanet ǀ imám ǀ vā́jam ǀ índraḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǀyásmin ǀ víśvāni ǀ páuṃsyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold, Wherein all manly powers abide.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, the unobstructed protector, enjoy these manifold (sacrificial) viands, in which all manly properties abide.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold, Wherein all manly powers abide.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो मर्ता अभि द्रुहन्तनूनामिंद्र गिर्वणः ।ईशानो यवया वधं ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mártāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ druhan ǀ tanū́nām ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀī́śānaḥ ǀ yavaya ǀ vadhám ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are the object of praises, let no men do injury to our person ns; you are mighty, keep off violence.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN VI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १० मधुच्छन्दा वैश्वामित्रः। १-३ इन्द्रः, ४,६,८,९ मरुतः, ५,७ मरुत इन्द्रश्च, १० इन्द्रः। गायत्री।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy SteedThe lights are shining in the sky. On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him,Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief. Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not,Wast born together with the Dawns. Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn,Assuming sacrificial names. Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm,Foundest the kine even in the cave. Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth,The far-renowned, the mighty One. Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side:Both joyous, equal in your sheen. With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven,The sacrificer cries aloud. Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven:Our songs of praise all yearn for this. Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth,Or from the spacious firmament.

verses.sanskrit: युंजंति ब्रध्नमरु��ं चरंतं परि तस्थुषः ।रोचंते रोचना दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjánti ǀ bradhnám ǀ aruṣám ǀ cárantam ǀ pári ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀrócante ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed The lights are shining in the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: The circumstationed (inhabitants of thethree worlds) associate with (Indra), the mighty (Sun), the indestructive (fire), the moving (wind), and the lights that shine in the sky.
verses.griffith_verse: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed The lights are shining in the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युंजंत्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे ।शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjánti ǀ asya ǀ kā́myā ǀ hárī íti ǀ ví-pakṣasā ǀ ráthe ǀśóṇā ǀ dhṛṣṇū́ íti ǀ nṛ-vā́hasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.
verses.wilson_translation: They (the charioteers) harness to his car his two desirable coursers, plural ced on eitherhand, bay coloured, high-spirited, chief-bearing.
verses.griffith_verse: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे ।समुषद्भिरजायथाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ketúm ǀ kṛṇván ǀ aketáve ǀ péśaḥ ǀ maryāḥ ǀ apeśáse ǀsám ǀ uṣát-bhiḥ ǀ ajāyathāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
verses.wilson_translation: Mortals, you owe your (daily) birth (to such an Indra), who with the rays of the morning gives sense to the senseless, and to the formless form.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे ।दधाना नाम यज्ञियं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ áha ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ánu ǀ púnaḥ ǀ garbha-tvám ǀ ā-īriré ǀdádhānāḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ yajñíyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial names.
verses.wilson_translation: Thereafter verily those who bear names invoked in holy rites (the Maruts) having seen the rain (about to be engendered), instrumental gated him to resume his embryo condition (in the clouds).
verses.griffith_verse: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial names.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वीळु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिंद्र वह्निभिः ।अविंद उस्रिया अनु ॥
verses.transliteration: vīḷú ǀ cit ǀ ārujatnú-bhiḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ váhni-bhiḥ ǀávindaḥ ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ ánu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm, Foundest the kine even in the cave.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated with the conveying Maruts, the traversers of plural ces difficult of access, your Indra, have discovered the cows hidden in the cave.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm, Foundest the kine even in the cave.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: देवयंतो यथा मतिमच्छा विदद्वसुं गिरः ।महामनूषत श्रुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: deva-yántaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ matím ǀ áccha ǀ vidát-vasum ǀ gíraḥ ǀmahā́m ǀ anūṣata ǀ śrutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One.
verses.wilson_translation: The reciters of praises praise the mighty (troop of Maruts), who are celebrated, and conscious of the power of bestowing wealth, in like manner as they (glorify) the counsellor (Indra).
verses.griffith_verse: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा ।मंदू समानवर्चसा ॥
verses.transliteration: índreṇa ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ dṛ́kṣase ǀ sam-jagmānáḥ ǀ ábibhyuṣā ǀmandū́ íti ǀ samāná-varcasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous, equal in your sheen.
verses.wilson_translation: May you be seen,Maruts, accompanied by the undaunted Indra; (both) rejoicing, and of equal splendour.
verses.griffith_verse: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous, equal in your sheen.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अनवद्यैरभिद्युभिर्मखः सहस्वदर्चति ।गणैरिंद्रस्य काम्यैः ॥
verses.transliteration: anavadyáiḥ ǀ abhídyu-bhiḥ ǀ makháḥ ǀ sáhasvat ǀ arcati ǀgaṇáiḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myaiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.
verses.wilson_translation: This right is performed in adoration of the powerful Indra, along with the irreproachable, heavenward- tending, and amiable bands (of the Maruts).
verses.griffith_verse: With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अतः परिज्मन्ना गहि दिवो वा रोचनादधि ।समस्मिन्नृंजते गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ pari-jman ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǀsám ǀ asmin ǀ ṛñjate ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven: Our songs of praise all yearn for this.
verses.wilson_translation: Therefore, circumambient (troop of Maruts), come hither, whether from the region of the sky or from the solar sphere; for in this rite (the priest) fully recites your praises.
verses.griffith_verse: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven: Our songs of praise all yearn for this.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि ।इंद्रं महो वा रजसः ॥
verses.transliteration: itáḥ ǀ vā ǀ sātím ǀ ī́mahe ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ pā́rthivāt ǀ ádhi ǀíndram ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā ǀ rájasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke,Indra, whether he come from this earthly region, or from the heaven above, or from the vast firmament; that he may give (us) wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN VII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds,Indra the choirs have glorified. Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car,Indra the golden, thunder-armed. Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar:He burst the mountain for the kine. Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained,With awful aids, O awful One. In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight,The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends. Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud,For us, thou irresistible. Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise:I find no laud worthy of him. Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might,The Ruler irresistible: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold raceOf those who dwell upon the earth. For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men:Ours, and none others’, may he be.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिंद्रमर्केभिरर्किणः ।इंद्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ ít ǀ gāthínaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ índram ǀ arkébhiḥ ǀ arkíṇaḥ ǀíndram ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
verses.wilson_translation: The chanters (of the Soma) extol Indrawith songs, the reciters of the Ṛk with prayers, the priests of the Yajuṣ, with texts.
verses.griffith_verse: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र इद्धर्योः सचा संमिश्ल आ वचोयुजा ।इंद्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ít ǀ háryoḥ ǀ sácā ǀ sám-miślaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀíndraḥ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the blender of all things, comes verily with his steeds that are harnessed at his word; Indra, the richly-decorated, the wielder of the thunderbolt.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद्दिवि ।वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ dīrghā́ya ǀ cákṣase ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ rohayat ǀ diví ǀví ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ airayat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, to render all things visible, elevated the sun in the sky, and charged the cloud with (abundant) waters.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च ।उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ ava ǀ sahásra-pradhaneṣu ǀ ca ǀugráḥ ǀ ugrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One.
verses.wilson_translation: Invincible Indra, protect us in battles abounding in spoil, with insuperable defenceṣ
verses.griffith_verse: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वयं महाधन इंद्रमर्भे हवामहे ।युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ vayám ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ índram ǀ árbhe ǀ havāmahe ǀyújam ǀ vṛtréṣu ǀ vajríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke Indrafor great affluence, Indra for limited wealth; (our) ally, and wielder of the thunder-bolt against (our) enemies.
verses.griffith_verse: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि ।अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣan ǀ amúm ǀ carúm ǀ sátrā-dāvan ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǀasmábhyam ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible.
verses.wilson_translation: Shedder of rain, granter of all desires, set open this cloud. You are never uncompliant with our (requests).
verses.griffith_verse: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तुंजेतुंजे य उत्तरे स्तोमा इंद्रस्य वज्रिणः ।न विंधे अस्य सुष्टुतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: tuñjé-tuñje ǀ yé ǀ út-tare ǀ stómāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ vajríṇaḥ ǀná ǀ vindhe ǀ asya ǀ su-stutím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever excellent praises are given to other dignities, they are (also the due) of Indrathe thunderer; I do not know his fitting praise.
verses.griffith_verse: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा यूथेव वंसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा ।ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ iyarti ǀ ójasā ǀī́śānaḥ ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The Ruler irresistible:
verses.wilson_translation: The shedder of rain, the mighty lord, the always compliant, invests men with his strength, as a bull (defends) a herd of kine.
verses.griffith_verse: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The Ruler irresistible:
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: य एकश्चर्षणीनां वसूनामिरज्यति ।इंद्रः पंच क्षितीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ vásūnām ǀ irajyáti ǀíndraḥ ǀ páñca ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race Of those who dwell upon the earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who alone rules over men, over riches, and over the five (classes) of the dwellers on earth.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race Of those who dwell upon the earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः ।अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ vaḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ hávāmahe ǀ jánebhyaḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ kévalaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others’, may he be.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke for you,Indra, who is everywhere among men; may he be exclusively our own.
verses.griffith_verse: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others’, may he be.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth,Most excellent, to be our aid; By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand,By thee assisted with the car. Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt,And conquer all our foes in fight. With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, mayWe conquer our embattled foes. Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer:Wide as the heaven extends his power Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight,Or singers loving holy thoughts. His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells,Like wide streams from the cope of heaven. So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, likeA ripe branch to the worshipper. For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at onceUnto a worshipper like me. So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung,That he may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sanskrit: एंद्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहं ।वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ sānasím ǀ rayím ǀ sa-jítvānam ǀ sadā-sáham ǀvárṣiṣṭham ǀ ūtáye ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, bring for our protection riches, most abundant, enjoyable, the source of victory, the humbler of our foes. [
verses.griffith_verse: INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नि येन मुष्टिहत्यया नि वृत्रा रुणधामहै ।त्वोतासो न्यर्वता ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ yéna ǀ muṣṭi-hatyáyā ǀ ní ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ ruṇádhāmahai ǀtvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ ní ǀ árvatā ǁ
verses.english_translation: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand, By thee assisted with the car.
verses.wilson_translation: By which we may repel our enemies, whether (encountering them)handto hand, or on horse-back; ever protected by you. (muṣṭihatyayā = muṣṭiprahāreṇa) = lit. by striking with the fist; on horseback = with a horse (a reference to infantry and cavalry)].
verses.griffith_verse: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand, By thee assisted with the car.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र त्वोतास आ वयं वज्रं घना ददीमहि ।जयेम सं युधि स्पृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ tvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vayám ǀ vájram ǀ ghanā́ ǀ dadīmahi ǀjáyema ǀ sám ǀ yudhí ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight.
verses.wilson_translation: Defended by you,Indra, we possess a ponderous weapon, wherewith we may entirely conquer our opponents.
verses.griffith_verse: Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वयं शूरेभिरस्तृभिरिंद्र त्वया युजा वयं ।सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ śū́rebhiḥ ǀ ástṛ-bhiḥ ǀ índra ǀ tváyā ǀ yujā́ ǀ vayám ǀsasahyā́ma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may We conquer our embattled foes.
verses.wilson_translation: With you for our ally,Indra, and (aided by) missile-hurling heroes, we are able to overcome (our foes) arrayed in hosts.
verses.griffith_verse: With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may We conquer our embattled foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: महाँ इंद्रः परश्च नु महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे ।द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ paráḥ ǀ ca ǀ nú ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ astu ǀ vajríṇe ǀdyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ prathinā́ ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer: Wide as the heaven extends his power
verses.wilson_translation: Mighty is Indra, and supreme; may magnitude ever (belong) to the bearer of the thunderbolt; may his strong (armies) be ever vast as the heavens.
verses.griffith_verse: Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer: Wide as the heaven extends his power
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: समोहे वा य आशत नरस्तोकस्य सनितौ ।विप्रासो वा धियायवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-ohé ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ā́śata ǀ náraḥ ǀ tokásya ǀ sánitau ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ vā ǀ dhiyā-yávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever men have recourse to Indrain battle, or for the acquisition of offspring, and the wise who are desirous of understanding (obtain their desires).
verses.griffith_verse: Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यः कुक्षिः सोमपातमः समुद्र इव पिन्वते ।उर्वीरापो न काकुदः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ kukṣíḥ ǀ soma-pā́tamaḥ ǀ samudráḥ-iva ǀ pínvate ǀurvī́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ kākúdaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The belly of Indra, which quaffs the Somajuice abundantly, swells like the ocean, (and is ever) moist, like the ample fluids of the palate.
verses.griffith_verse: His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा ह्यस्य सूनृता विरप्शी गोमती मही ।पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ vi-rapśī́ ǀ gó-matī ǀ mahī́ ǀpakvā́ ǀ śā́khā ǀ ná ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily the words of Indrato his worshipper are true, manifold, cow- conferring, and to be held in honour; (they are) like a branch (loaded with) ripe (fruit).
verses.griffith_verse: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इंद्र मावते ।सद्यश्चित्संति दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ ví-bhūtayaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mā́-vate ǀsadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ sánti ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily,Indra, your glories are at all times the protectors of every such worshipper as I am.
verses.griffith_verse: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा ह्यस्य काम्या स्तोम उक्थं च शंस्या ।इंद्राय सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ kā́myā ǀ stómaḥ ǀ ukthám ǀ ca ǀ śáṃsyā ǀíndrāya ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung, That he may drink the Soma juice.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily his chanted and recited praises are to be desired and repeated to Indra, that he may drink the Somajuice.
verses.griffith_verse: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung, That he may drink the Soma juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts,Protector, mighty in thy strength. To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to himThe gladdening, omnific God. O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds,Present at these drink-offerings. Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord,And raised themselves unsatisfied. Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of our wish,For power supreme is only thine. O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth,And glorious, O most splendid One. Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength,Lasting our life-time, failing not. Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, thoseFair fruits of earth borne home in wains. Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we callIndra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth. To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious manSings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रेहि मत्स्यंधसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः ।महाँ अभिष्टिरोजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ mátsi ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ somapárva-bhiḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ abhiṣṭíḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Indra, and be regaled with all viands libations, and thence, mighty in strength, be victorious (over your foes).
verses.griffith_verse: COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एमेनं सृजता सुते मंदिमिंद्राय मंदिने ।चक्रिं विश्वानि चक्रये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ īm ǀ enam ǀ sṛjata ǀ suté ǀ mandím ǀ índrāya ǀ mandíne ǀcákrim ǀ víśvāni ǀ cákraye ǁ
verses.english_translation: To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to him The gladdening, omnific God.
verses.wilson_translation: The libation being prepared, present the exhilaratina and efficacious (draught) to the rejoicing Indra, the accomplisher of all things.
verses.griffith_verse: To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to him The gladdening, omnific God.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र मंदिभिः स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणे ।सचैषु सवनेष्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: mátsva ǀ su-śipra ǀ mandí-bhiḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǀsácā ǀ eṣú ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds, Present at these drink-offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrawith the handsome chin, be plural ased with these animating praises; do your, who are to be reverenced by all mankind, (come) to these rites (with the gods).
verses.griffith_verse: O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds, Present at these drink-offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: असृग्रमिंद्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत ।अजोषा वृषभं पतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ásṛgram ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ gíraḥ ǀ práti ǀ tvā́m ǀ út ǀ ahāsata ǀájoṣāḥ ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ pátim ǁ
verses.english_translation: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And raised themselves unsatisfied.
verses.wilson_translation: I have addressed to you,Indra, the showerer (of blessings), the protector (of your worshipers), praises which have reached you, and of which you have approved.
verses.griffith_verse: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And raised themselves unsatisfied.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सं चोदय चित्रमर्वाग्राध इंद्र वरेण्यं ।असदित्ते विभु प्रभु ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ codaya ǀ citrám ǀ arvā́k ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ indra ǀ váreṇyam ǀásat ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ vi-bhú ǀ pra-bhú ǁ
verses.english_translation: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of our wish, For power supreme is only thine.
verses.wilson_translation: plural ce before us,Indra, precious and multiform riches, for enough and more than enough are assuredly yours.
verses.griffith_verse: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of our wish, For power supreme is only thine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान्त्सु तत्र चोदयेंद्र राये रभस्वतः ।तुविद्युम्न यशस्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ sú ǀ tátra ǀ codaya ǀ índra ǀ rāyé ǀ rábhasvataḥ ǀtúvi-dyumna ǀ yáśasvataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth, And glorious, O most splendid One.
verses.wilson_translation: Opulent Indra, encourage us in this rite for the acquirement of wealth, for we are diligent and renowned.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth, And glorious, O most splendid One.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सं गोमदिंद्र वाजवदस्मे पृथु श्रवो बृहत् ।विश्वायुर्धेह्यक्षितं ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ gó-mat ǀ indra ǀ vā́ja-vat ǀ asmé íti ǀ pṛthú ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀviśvá-āyuḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ ákṣitam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength, Lasting our life-time, failing not.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us,Indra, wealth beyond measure or calculation, inexhaustible, the source of cattle, of food, of all life.
verses.griffith_verse: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength, Lasting our life-time, failing not.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहद्द्युम्नं सहस्रसातमं ।इंद्र ता रथिनीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ dyumnám ǀ sahasra-sā́tamam ǀíndra ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ rathínīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, grant us great renown and wealth acquired in a thousand ways, and those (articles) of food (which are brought from the field) in carts.
verses.griffith_verse: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वसोरिंद्रं वसुपतिं गीर्भिर्गृणंत ऋग्मियं ।होम गंतारमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: vásoḥ ǀ índram ǀ vásu-patim ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀhóma ǀ gántāram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke for the preservation of our property,Indra, the lord of wealth, the object of sacred verses, the repairer (to the plural ce of sacrifice), praising him with our praises.
verses.griffith_verse: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सुतेसुते न्योकसे बृहद्बृहत एदरिः ।इंद्राय शूषमर्चति ॥
verses.transliteration: suté-sute ǀ ní-okase ǀ bṛhát ǀ bṛhaté ǀ ā́ ǀ ít ǀ aríḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ śūṣám ǀ arcati ǁ
verses.english_translation: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.
verses.wilson_translation: With libations repeatedly effused, the sacrificer glorifies the vast prowess of Indra, the mighty, the dweller in (an eternal mansion).
verses.griffith_verse: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee.The priests have raised thee up on high, O Śatakratu, like a pole. As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task,Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop. Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths,And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise. Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud.Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice. To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives,That Śakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings. Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might.For Indra, he is Śakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth. Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee.Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood.Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly. Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songsO Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend. We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry.Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold. O Indra, Son of Kuśika, drink our libation with delight.Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts. Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee:Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.

verses.sanskrit: गायंति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चंत्यर्कमर्किणः ।ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वंशमिव येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: gā́yanti ǀ tvā ǀ gāyatríṇaḥ ǀ árcanti ǀ arkám ǀ arkíṇaḥ ǀbrahmā́ṇaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ út ǀ vaṃśám-iva ǀ yemire ǁ
verses.english_translation: THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee. The priests have raised thee up on high, O Śatakratu, like a pole.
verses.wilson_translation: The chanters (of the Soma) hymn you,Śatakratu; the reciters of the Ṛk praise you, who are worthy of praise; the Bra-hmaṇas raise you aloft, like a bamboo pole.
verses.griffith_verse: THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee. The priests have raised thee up on high, O Śatakratu, like a pole.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यत्सानोः सानुमारुहद्भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्वं ।तदिंद्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ sā́noḥ ǀ sā́num ǀ ā́ ǀ áruhat ǀ bhū́ri ǀ áspaṣṭa ǀ kártvam ǀtát ǀ índraḥ ǀ ártham ǀ cetati ǀ yūthéna ǀ vṛṣṇíḥ ǀ ejati ǁ
verses.english_translation: As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task, Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the showever (of blessings), knows the object (of his worshipper), who has performed many acts of worship (with the Somagathered) on the ridges of the mountain, and (therefore) comes with the troop (of Maruts).
verses.griffith_verse: As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task, Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा ।अथा न इंद्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ keśínā ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ kakṣya-prā́ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ girā́m ǀ úpa-śrutim ǀ cara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, drinker of the Soma, having put to your long-maned, vigorous, and well-conditioned steeds, come nigh to hear our praises.
verses.griffith_verse: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एहि स्तोमाँ अभि स्वराभि गृणीह्या रुव ।ब्रह्म च नो वसो सचेंद्र यज्ञं च वर्धय ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ stómān ǀ abhí ǀ svara ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ ā́ ǀ ruva ǀbráhma ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ sácā ǀ índra ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ vardhaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud. Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Vasu, (to this our rite); reply to our hymns, answer (to our praises), respond to (our prayers); be propitious,Indra, to our sacrifice, and (bestow upon us abundant) food.
verses.griffith_verse: Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud. Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उक्थमिंद्राय शंस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिष्षिधे ।शक्रो यथा सुतेषु णो रारणत्सख्येषु च ॥
verses.transliteration: ukthám ǀ índrāya ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ várdhanam ǀ puruniḥ-sídhe ǀśakráḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ sutéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ raráṇat ǀ sakhyéṣu ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives, That Śakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: The hymn, the cause of increase, is to be repeated to Indra, the repeller of many foes, thatŚakramay speak (with kindness) to our sons and to our friends.
verses.griffith_verse: To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives, That Śakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तमित्सखित्व ईमहे तं राये तं सुवीर्ये ।स शक्र उत नः शकदिंद्रो वसु दयमानः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ sakhi-tvé ǀ īmahe ǀ tám ǀ rāyé ǀ tám ǀ su-vī́rye ǀsáḥ ǀ śakráḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ śakat ǀ índraḥ ǀ vásu ǀ dáyamānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might. For Indra, he is Śakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We have recourse to Indrafor his friendship, for wealth, for perfect might; for he, the powerful Indra, conferring wealth, is able (to protect us).
verses.griffith_verse: Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might. For Indra, he is Śakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सुविवृतं सुनिरजमिंद्र त्वादातमिद्यशः ।गवामप व्रजं वृधि कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-vivṛ́tam ǀ suniḥ-ájam ǀ índra ǀ tvā́-dātam ǀ ít ǀ yáśaḥ ǀgávām ǀ ápa ǀ vrajám ǀ vṛdhi ǀ kṛṇuṣvá ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee. Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, by you is food (rendered) everywhere abundant, easy of attainment, and assuredly perfect; wielder of the thunderbolt, set open the cow-pastures, and provide (ample) wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee. Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नहि त्वा रोदसी उभे ऋघायमाणमिन्वतः ।जेषः स्वर्वतीरपः सं गा अस्मभ्यं धूनुहि ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ tvā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ṛghāyámāṇam ǀ ínvataḥ ǀjéṣaḥ ǀ sváḥ-vatīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dhūnuhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood. Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.
verses.wilson_translation: Heaven and earth are unable to sustain you when destroying your enemies; you may command the waters of heaven; send us lberally kine.
verses.griffith_verse: The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood. Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आश्रुत्कर्ण श्रुधी हवं नू चिद्दधिष्व मे गिरः ।इंद्र स्तोममिमं मम कृष्वा युजश्चिदंतरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́śrut-karṇa ǀ śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ me ǀ gíraḥ ǀíndra ǀ stómam ǀ imám ǀ máma ǀ kṛṣvá ǀ yujáḥ ǀ cit ǀ ántaram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.
verses.wilson_translation: Oh! your whose ears hear all things, listen quickly to my invocation; hold in your heart my praises; keep near to you this my hymn, as it were (the words of) a friend.
verses.griffith_verse: Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा वृषंतमं वाजेषु हवनश्रुतं ।वृषंतमस्य हूमह ऊतिं सहस्रसातमां ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ vṛ́ṣan-tamam ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ havana-śrútam ǀvṛ́ṣan-tamasya ǀ hūmahe ǀ ūtím ǀ sahasra-sā́tamām ǁ
verses.english_translation: We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry. Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.
verses.wilson_translation: We know you, liberal rainer (of blessings), the hearer of our call in battles; we invoke the thousand-fold profitable protection of you, the showerer (of bounties).
verses.griffith_verse: We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry. Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न इंद्र कौशिक मंदसानः सुतं पिब ।नव्यमायुः प्र सू तिर कृधी सहस्रसामृषिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ kauśika ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǀnávyam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ prá ǀ sú ǀ tira ǀ kṛdhí ǀ sahasra-sā́m ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra, Son of Kuśika, drink our libation with delight. Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.
verses.wilson_translation: Come quickly,Indra, sone of Kuśika, delighted drink the libation; prolong the life that merits commendation; make me, who am a Ṛṣi abundantly endowed (with possessions).
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra, Son of Kuśika, drink our libation with delight. Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवंतु विश्वतः ।वृद्धायुमनु वृद्धयो जुष्टा भवंतु जुष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ tvā ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀvṛddhá-āyum ǀ ánu ǀ vṛ́ddhayaḥ ǀ júṣṭāḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ júṣṭayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee: Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.
verses.wilson_translation: May these our praises be on all occasions around you, deserver of praise; may they augment the power of you, who are long-lived, and being agreeable to you, may they yield delight (to us).
verses.griffith_verse: Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee: Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XI. Indra.
