hymns.griffith_hymn_text: ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea,The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength. Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear.We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror. The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours, never fail,When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine. Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he bornSustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled. Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows.The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee, I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee.Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof. The wily Śuṣṇa, Indra! thou o’erthrewest with thy wondrous powers.The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies. Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might,Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः ।रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ avīvṛdhan ǀ samudrá-vyacasam ǀ gíraḥ ǀrathí-tamam ǀ rathínām ǀ vā́jānām ǀ sát-patim ǀ pátim ǁ
verses.english_translation: ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: All our praises magnify Indra, expansive as the ocean, the most valiant of warriors who fight in chariots, the lord of food, the protector of the virtuous.
verses.griffith_verse: ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सख्ये त इंद्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते ।त्वामभि प्र णोनुमो जेतारमपराजितं ॥
verses.transliteration: sakhyé ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ bhema ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀtvā́m ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ jétāram ǀ áparā-jitam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear. We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.
verses.wilson_translation: Supported by your friendship,Indra, cherisher of strength, we have no fear, but glorify you, the conqueror, the unconquered.
verses.griffith_verse: Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear. We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वीरिंद्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यंत्यूतयः ।यदी वाजस्य गोमतः स्तोतृभ्यो मंहते मघं ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvī́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ dasyanti ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀyádi ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ máṃhate ǀ maghám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours, never fail, When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.
verses.wilson_translation: The ancient liberalities of Indra, his protections, will not be wanting to him who presents to the reciters of the hymns, wealth of food and cattle.
verses.griffith_verse: The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours, never fail, When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पुरां भिंदुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत ।इंद्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: purā́m ǀ bhindúḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ámita-ojāḥ ǀ ajāyata ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ kármaṇaḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrawas born the destroyer of cities, ever young, ever wise, of unbounded strength, the sustainer of all pious acts, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the many-praised.
verses.griffith_verse: Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वलस्य गोमतोऽपावरद्रिवो बिलं ।त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ valásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ ápa ǀ avaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ bílam ǀtvā́m ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ábibhyuṣaḥ ǀ tujyámānāsaḥ ǀ āviṣuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,
verses.wilson_translation: Your, wielder of the thunderbolt, did open the cave of Vala, who had there concealed the cattle; and the gods whom he had oppressed, no longer feared when they had obtained you (for their ally).
verses.griffith_verse: Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तवाहं शूर रातिभिः प्रत्यायं सिंधुमावदन् ।उपातिष्ठंत गिर्वणो विदुष्टे तस्य कारवः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ahám ǀ śūra ǀ rātí-bhiḥ ǀ práti ǀ āyam ǀ síndhum ǀ ā-vádan ǀúpa ǀ atiṣṭhanta ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ vidúḥ ǀ te ǀ tásya ǀ kārávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee. Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.
verses.wilson_translation: (Attracted) by your bounties, I again come, Hero, to you, celebrating (your liberality) while offering this libation; the performers of the rite approach you, who are worthy of praise, for they have known your (munificence).
verses.griffith_verse: I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee. Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मायाभिरिंद्र मायिनं त्वं शुष्णमवातिरः ।विदुष्टे तस्य मेधिरास्तेषां श्रवांस्युत्तिर ॥
verses.transliteration: māyā́bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ māyínam ǀ tvám ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ áva ǀ atiraḥ ǀvidúḥ ǀ te ǀ tásya ǀ médhirāḥ ǀ téṣām ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ út ǀ tira ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wily Śuṣṇa, Indra! thou o’erthrewest with thy wondrous powers. The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.
verses.wilson_translation: Your slewest,Indra, by stratagems, the wilyŚuṣṇa; the wise have known of this your (greatness); bestow upon them (abundant) food.
verses.griffith_verse: The wily Śuṣṇa, Indra! thou o’erthrewest with thy wondrous powers. The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमा अनूषत ।सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा संति भूयसीः ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ ī́śānam ǀ ójasā ǀ abhí ǀ stómāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀsahásram ǀ yásya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ sánti ǀ bhū́yasīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might, Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.
verses.wilson_translation: The reciters of sacred hymns praise with all their might,Indra, the ruler of the world, whose bounties are (computed) by thousands or even more.
verses.griffith_verse: Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might, Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: १२ मेधातिथिः काण्वः। अग्निः,६ प्रथमपादस्य (निर्मथ्याहवनीयौ) अग्नी। गायत्री।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth,Well skilled in this our sacrifice. With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House,Oblation-bearer, much beloved. Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass:Thou art our herald, meet for praise. Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage:Sit on the sacred grass with Gods. O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn upOur enemies whom fiends protect. By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bearsThe gift: the ladle is his mouth. Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true,The God who driveth grief away. God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts,Worshippeth thee the messenger. Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods,O Purifier, favour him. Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice,To our oblation bring the Gods. So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us,And food, with heroes for our sons. O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods,Show pleasure in this laud of ours.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसं ।अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुं ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ dūtám ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ hótāram ǀ viśvá-vedasam ǀasyá ǀ yajñásya ǀ su-krátum ǁ
verses.english_translation: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: We select Agni, the messenger of the gods, their invoker, the possessor of all riches, the perfecter of this rite.
verses.griffith_verse: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवंत विश्पतिं ।हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: agním-agnim ǀ hávīma-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ havanta ǀ viśpátim ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ puru-priyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.
verses.wilson_translation: (The offerers of oblations) invoke with their invocations,Agni, Agni, the lord of men, the bearer of offerings, the beloved of many.
verses.griffith_verse: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे ।असि होता न ईड्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣe ǀási ǀ hótā ǀ naḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, genitive rated (by attrition), bring hither the gods to the clipped sacred grass; you are their invoker for us, and are to be adored.
verses.griffith_verse: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ताँ उशतो वि बोधय यदग्ने यासि दूत्यं ।देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́n ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ bodhaya ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ yā́si ǀ dūtyám ǀdeváiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage: Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: As you discharge the duty of messenger, arouse them desirous of the oblation; sit down with them on the sacred grass.
verses.griffith_verse: Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage: Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: घृताहवन दीदिवः प्रति ष्म रिषतो दह ।अग्ने त्वं रक्षस्विनः ॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛ́ta-āhavana ǀ dīdi-vaḥ ǀ práti ǀ sma ǀ ríṣataḥ ǀ daha ǀágne ǀ tvám ǀ rakṣasvínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up Our enemies whom fiends protect.
verses.wilson_translation: Resplendent Agni, invoked by oblations of clarified butter, consume our adversaries, who are defended by evil spirits.
verses.griffith_verse: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up Our enemies whom fiends protect.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ।हव्यवाड् जुह्वास्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: agnínā ǀ agníḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyate ǀ kavíḥ ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ yúvā ǀhavya-vā́ṭ ǀ juhú-āsyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears The gift: the ladle is his mouth.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the ever young and wise, the guardian of the dwelling (of the sacrificer), the bearer of offerings, whose mouth is (the vehicle) of oblations, is kindled by Agni.
verses.griffith_verse: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears The gift: the ladle is his mouth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: कविमग्निमुप स्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे ।देवममीवचातनं ॥
verses.transliteration: kavím ǀ agním ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ satyá-dharmāṇam ǀ adhvaré ǀdevám ǀ amīva-cā́tanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true, The God who driveth grief away.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise in the sacrifice,Agni, be the protector of that offerr of oblations who worships you, the messenger of the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true, The God who driveth grief away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति ।तस्य स्म प्राविता भव ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ havíḥ-patiḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ deva ǀ saparyáti ǀtásya ǀ sma ǀ pra-avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts, Worshippeth thee the messenger.
verses.wilson_translation: Resplendent Agni, be the protector of that offerr of oblations who worships you, the messenger of the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts, Worshippeth thee the messenger.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माँ आविवासति ।तस्मै पावक मृळय ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agním ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ havíṣmān ǀ ā-vívāsati ǀtásmai ǀ pāvaka ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods, O Purifier, favour him.
verses.wilson_translation: Be propitious,Pāvaka, to him, who, presenting oblations for the gratification of the celestials, approaches Agni.
verses.griffith_verse: Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods, O Purifier, favour him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पावक दीदिवोऽग्ने देवाँ इहा वह ।उप यज्ञं हविश्च नः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ dīdi-vaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀúpa ǀ yajñám ǀ havíḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the bright, the purifier, bring hither the gods to our sacrifice, to our oblations.
verses.griffith_verse: Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स नः स्तवान आ भर गायत्रेण नवीयसा ।रयिं वीरवतीमिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ gāyatréṇa ǀ návīyasā ǀrayím ǀ vīrá-vatīm ǀ íṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us, And food, with heroes for our sons.
verses.wilson_translation: Praised with our newest hymn, bestow upon us riches and food, the source of progeny.
verses.griffith_verse: So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us, And food, with heroes for our sons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा विश्वाभिर्देवहूतिभिः ।इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ deváhūti-bhiḥ ǀimám ǀ stómam ǀ juṣasva ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods, Show pleasure in this laud of ours.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, shining with pure radiance, and charged with all the invocations of the gods, be plural ased by this our praise.
verses.griffith_verse: O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods, Show pleasure in this laud of ours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Agni
hymns.anukramani: १२ मेधातिथिः काण्वः।(आप्रीसूक्तं, अग्निरूपा देवता देवताः) १ इध्मः समिद्धोऽग्निर्वा, २ तनूनपात्, ३
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts.Worship them, Purifier, Priest. Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today.Sweet to the taste, that they may feast. Dear Narāśaṁsa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, IInvoke to this our sacrifice. Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods:Manu appointed thee as Priest. Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due,Where the Immortal is beheld. Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite,For sacrifice this day and now. I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grassAt this our solemn sacrifice. The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue,To celebrate this our sacrifice. Iḷā, Sarasvatī, Mahī, three Goddesses who bring delight,Be seated, peaceful, on the grass. Tvaṣṭar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will:May he be ours and ours alone. God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods,And let the giver be renowned. With Svāhā pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house:Thither I call the Deities.

verses.sanskrit: सुसमिद्धो न आ वह देवाँ अग्ने हविष्मते ।होतः पावक यक्षि च ॥
verses.transliteration: sú-samiddhaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devā́n ǀ agne ǀ havíṣmate ǀhótaríti ǀ pāvaka ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts. Worship them, Purifier, Priest.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who are Susamiddha, invoker, purifier, bring hither the gods to the offerers of our oblation, and do your sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts. Worship them, Purifier, Priest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मधुमंतं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे ।अद्या कृणुहि वीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhu-mantam �� tanū-napāt ǀ yajñám ǀ devéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ kave ǀadyá ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ vītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today. Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.
verses.wilson_translation: Wise (Agni) who are Tanūnapāt(= devourer of clarified butter), present this day our well-favoured sacrifice to the gods for their food.
verses.griffith_verse: Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today. Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नराशंसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये ।मधुजिह्वं हविष्कृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: nárāśáṃsam ǀ ihá ǀ priyám ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀmádhu-jihvam ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́tam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Dear Narāśaṁsa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke the beloved Narāśamśa, the sweet-tongued, the offere of oblations, to this sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: Dear Narāśaṁsa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाँ ईळित आ वह ।असि होता मनुर्हितः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ sukhá-tame ǀ ráthe ǀ devā́n ǀ īḷitáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀási ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods: Manu appointed thee as Priest.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, (who are) Īḷita (= worshipped), bring hither the gods in an easy-moving chariot, for you are the invoker instrumental tuted by men.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods: Manu appointed thee as Priest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्तृणीत बर्हिरानुषग्घृतपृष्ठं मनीषिणः ।यत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं ॥
verses.transliteration: stṛṇītá ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭham ǀ manīṣiṇaḥ ǀyátra ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cákṣaṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due, Where the Immortal is beheld.
verses.wilson_translation: Strew, learned priests, the sacred grass, well bound together (in bundles), and sprinkled with clarified butter, the semblance of ambrosia.
verses.griffith_verse: Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due, Where the Immortal is beheld.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वि श्रयंतामृतावृधो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः ।अद्या नूनं च यष्टवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ śrayantām ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ dvā́raḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀadyá ǀ nūnám ǀ ca ǀ yáṣṭave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite, For sacrifice this day and now.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the bright doors, the augmenters of sacrifice, (hitherto) unentered, be set open, for certainly today is the sacrifice to be made.
verses.griffith_verse: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite, For sacrifice this day and now.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नक्तोषासा सुपेशसास्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये ।इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.transliteration: náktoṣásā ǀ su-péśasā ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀidám ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǁ
verses.english_translation: I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass At this our solemn sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke the lovely night and dawn to sit upon the sacred grass, at this our sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass At this our solemn sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ता सुजिह्वा उप ह्वये होतारा दैव्या कवी ।यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमं ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ su-jihváu ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀ hótārā ǀ dáivyā ǀ kavī́ íti ǀyajñám ǀ naḥ ǀ yakṣatām ǀ imám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue, To celebrate this our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: I call the two eloquent divine and sage invokers (of the gods), that they may celebrate this our sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue, To celebrate this our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः ।बर्हिः सीदंत्वस्रिधः ॥
verses.transliteration: íḷā ǀ sárasvatī ǀ mahī́ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀbarhíḥ ǀ sīdantu ǀ asrídhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Iḷā, Sarasvatī, Mahī, three Goddesses who bring delight, Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.
verses.wilson_translation: May the three undecaying goddesses, givers of delight, Iḷā,Sarasvatī, and Mahī(=Bhāratī), sit down upon the sacred grass.
verses.griffith_verse: Iḷā, Sarasvatī, Mahī, three Goddesses who bring delight, Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इह त्वष्टारमग्रियं विश्वरूपमुप ह्वये ।अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ tváṣṭāram ǀ agriyám ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀasmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ kévalaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Tvaṣṭar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will: May he be ours and ours alone.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke the chief and multiform Tvaṣṭṛ(=Viśvakarmā); may he be solely ours.
verses.griffith_verse: Tvaṣṭar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will: May he be ours and ours alone.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अव सृजा वनस्पते देव देवेभ्यो हविः ।प्र दातुरस्तु चेतनं ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ sṛja ǀ vanaspate ǀ déva ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀprá ǀ dātúḥ ǀ astu ǀ cétanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods, And let the giver be renowned.
verses.wilson_translation: Present, divine Vanaspati(= lord of the woods), our oblation to the gods, and may true knowledge be (the reward) of the giver.
verses.griffith_verse: God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods, And let the giver be renowned.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहा यज्ञं कृणोतनेंद्राय यज्वनो गृहे ।तत्र देवाँ उप ह्वये ॥
verses.transliteration: svā́hā ǀ yajñám ǀ kṛṇotana ǀ índrāya ǀ yájvanaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀtátra ǀ devā́n ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: With Svāhā pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house: Thither I call the Deities.
verses.wilson_translation: Perform the sacrifice conveyed through Svāhā(= an exclamation used in pouring the oblation on the fire) to Indra, in the house of the worshipper; therefore I call the gods hither.
verses.griffith_verse: With Svāhā pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house: Thither I call the Deities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XIV. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १२ मेधातिथिः काण्वः। विश्वे देवाः (विश्वैर्देवैः सहितोऽग्निः),  ३ इन्द्रवायुबृहस्पतिमित्राग्निपूषभगादित्यमरुद्गणाः, १० विश्वदेवाग्नीन्द्रवायुमित्रधामानि, ११ अग्निः। गायत्री।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs.With all these Gods; and worship them. The Kaṇvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praiseAgni, come hither with the Gods; Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pūṣan, Bhaga,Ādityas, and the Marut host. For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate,The meath-drops resting in the cup. The sons of Kaṇva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass,With offerings and all things prepared. Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil,Bring the Gods to the Soma draught. Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames:Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue. Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongueThe meath in solemn sacrifice. Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bringAll Gods awaking with the dawn. With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vāyu, and Mitra's splendours, drink,Agni, the pleasant Soma juice. Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite:Hallow thou this our sacrifice. Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones:With those bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: ऐभिरग्ने दुवो गिरो विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ।देवेभिर्याहि यक्षि च ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs. With all these Gods; and worship them.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Agni, to our adoration, and to our praises, with all these gods, to drink the Somajuice; and (do you) offer sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs. With all these Gods; and worship them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा कण्वा अहूषत गृणंति विप्र ते धियः ।देवेभिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ ahūṣata ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ vipra ǀ te ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Kaṇvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise Agni, come hither with the Gods;
verses.wilson_translation: The kaṇvās (=medhāvinaḥ or sages; ṛtvija or officiating priests) invoke you, sapient Agni, and extol your deeds; come, Agni, Agni, with the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: The Kaṇvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise Agni, come hither with the Gods;
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रवायू बृहस्पतिं मित्राग्निं पूषणं भगं ।आदित्यान्मारुतं गणं ॥
verses.transliteration: indravāyū́ íti ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ mitrā́ ǀ agním ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ bhágam ǀādityā́n ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pūṣan, Bhaga, Ādityas, and the Marut host.
verses.wilson_translation: Sacrifice (Agni), to Indra,Vāyu,Bṛhaspati,Mitra, Agni,Pūṣanand Bhaga, theĀdityas, and the troop of Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pūṣan, Bhaga, Ādityas, and the Marut host.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो भ्रियंत इंदवो मत्सरा मादयिष्णवः ।द्रप्सा मध्वश्चमूषदः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ bhriyante ǀ índavaḥ ǀ matsarā́ḥ ǀ mādayiṣṇávaḥ ǀdrapsā́ḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ camū-sádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate, The meath-drops resting in the cup.
verses.wilson_translation: For all of you are poured out these juices, satisfying, exhilarating, sweet, falling in drops, or gathered in ladles.
verses.griffith_verse: For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate, The meath-drops resting in the cup.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ईळते त्वामवस्यवः कण्वासो वृक्तबर्हिषः ।हविष्मंतो अरंकृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ī́ḷate ǀ tvā́m ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ káṇvāsaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀhavíṣmantaḥ ǀ aram-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sons of Kaṇva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass, With offerings and all things prepared.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise priests desirous of the protection (of the gods) having spread the sacred grass, presenting oblations, and offering ornaments, praise you.
verses.griffith_verse: The sons of Kaṇva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass, With offerings and all things prepared.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: घृतपृष्ठा मनोयुजो ये त्वा वहंति वह्नयः ।आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛtá-pṛṣṭhāḥ ǀ manaḥ-yújaḥ ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ váhanti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil, Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the coursers who convey you, glossy-backed, and harnessed at will, bring the gods to drink the Somajuice.
verses.griffith_verse: Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil, Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तान्यजत्राँ ऋतावृधोऽग्ने पत्नीवतस्कृधि ।मध्वः सुजिह्व पायय ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́n ǀ yájatrān ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ pátnī-vataḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ su-jihva ǀ pāyaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames: Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, make those objects of veneration, augmenters of pious acts, (participant of the offering), together with their wives; give them, bright-tongued, to drink of the Somajuice.
verses.griffith_verse: Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames: Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ये यजत्रा य ईड्यास्ते ते पिबंतु जिह्वया ।मधोरग्ने वषट्कृति ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ yé ǀ ī́ḍyāḥ ǀ té ǀ te ǀ pibantu ǀ jihváyā ǀmádhoḥ ǀ agne ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue The meath in solemn sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Let those objects of veneration and of praise, drink with your tongue, of the Somajuice, at the moment of libation.
verses.griffith_verse: Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue The meath in solemn sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आकीं सूर्यस्य रोचनाद्विश्चान्देवाँ उषर्बुधः ।विप्रो होतेह वक्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́kīm ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ rocanā́t ǀ víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ uṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǀvípraḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ihá ǀ vakṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring All Gods awaking with the dawn.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the wise invoker (of the gods) bring hither from the shining (sphere) of the sun, all the divinities awaking with the dawn.
verses.griffith_verse: Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring All Gods awaking with the dawn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वग्न इंद्रेण वायुना ।पिबा मित्रस्य धामभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvebhiḥ ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀ ágne ǀ índreṇa ǀ vāyúnā ǀpíba ǀ mitrásya ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vāyu, and Mitra's splendours, drink, Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.
verses.wilson_translation: With all the gods, with Indra,Vāyuand the glories (rays) of Mitra(= various forms of Mitra), drink,Agnithe sweet Somajuice.
verses.griffith_verse: With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vāyu, and Mitra's splendours, drink, Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं होता मनुर्हितोऽग्ने यज्ञेषु सीदसि ।सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ sīdasi ǀsáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ yaja ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite: Hallow thou this our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Your,Agniappointed by man as the invoker (of the gods) are present at sacrifices; do you present this our oblation.
verses.griffith_verse: Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite: Hallow thou this our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा ह्यरुषी रथे हरितो देव रोहितः ।ताभिर्देवाँ इहा वह ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ harítaḥ ǀ deva ǀ rohítaḥ ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones: With those bring hitherward the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Yoke, divine Agni, your fleet and powerful mares, Rohits (tābhiḥ vaḍavābhiḥ = mares; rohit= red) to your chariott and by them hither bring the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones: With those bring hitherward the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XV. Ṛtu.
hymns.anukramani: १२ मेधातिथिः काण्वः। (प्रतिदैवतं ऋतुसहितम्), १ इन्द्रः, २ मरुतः, ३ त्वष्टा, ४ अग्निः, ५ इन्द्रः, ६
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Ṛtu; let the cheering dropsSink deep within, which settle there. Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Ṛtu; sanctifyThe rite, for ye give precious gifts. O Neṣṭar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with Ṛtu drink,For thou art he who giveth wealth. Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down:Surround them, and with Ṛtu drink. Drink Soma after the Ṛtus, from the Brāhmaṇa's bounty: undissolved,O Indra, is thy friendship's bond. Mitra, Varuṇa, ye whose ways are firm—a Power that none deceives—,With Ṛtu ye have reached the rite. The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite,In sacrifices praise the God. May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned.These things we gain, among the Gods. He with the Ṛtu fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Neṣṭar's bowl.Haste, give your offering, and depart. As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Ṛtus, beA Giver bountiful to us. Drink ye the meath, O Aśvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure, who withṚtus accept the sacrifice. With Ṛtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice:Worship the Gods for the pious man.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र सोमं पिब ऋतुना त्वा विशंत्विंदवः ।मत्सरासस्तदोकसः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ sómam ǀ píba ǀ ṛtúnā ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ viśantu ǀ índavaḥ ǀmatsarā́saḥ ǀ tát-okasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Ṛtu; let the cheering drops Sink deep within, which settle there.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, drink with Ṛtu (proper duty, also person nified divinity of a season) the Somajuice; let the satisfying drops entered into you, and there abide.
verses.griffith_verse: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Ṛtu; let the cheering drops Sink deep within, which settle there.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मरुतः पिबत ऋतुना पोत्राद्यज्ञं पुनीतन ।यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवः ॥
verses.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ píbata ǀ ṛtúnā ǀ potrā́t ǀ yajñám ǀ punītana ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Ṛtu; sanctify The rite, for ye give precious gifts.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, drink with Ṛtu from the sacrificial vase; consecrate the rite, for you are bountiful.
verses.griffith_verse: Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Ṛtu; sanctify The rite, for ye give precious gifts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अभि यज्ञं गृणीहि नो ग्नावो नेष्टः पिब ऋतुना ।त्वं हि रत्नधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ yajñám ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ naḥ ǀ gnā́vaḥ ǀ néṣṭaríti ǀ píba ǀ ṛtúnā ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ ási ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Neṣṭar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with Ṛtu drink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Neṣṭā(=Tvaṣṭā), with your spouse, commend our sacrifice to the gods; drink with Ṛtu, for you are possessed of riches.
verses.griffith_verse: O Neṣṭar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with Ṛtu drink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह सादया योनिषु त्रिषु ।परि भूष पिब ऋतुना ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sādáya ǀ yóniṣu ǀ triṣú ǀpári ǀ bhūṣa ǀ píba ǀ ṛtúnā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down: Surround them, and with Ṛtu drink.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, bring the gods hither, arrange them in three plural ces (Āhavanīya,Dakṣiṇaand Gārhapatya--three fires) decorate them; drink with Ṛtu.
verses.griffith_verse: Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down: Surround them, and with Ṛtu drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादिंद्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूँरनु ।तवेद्धि सख्यमस्तृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: brā́hmaṇāt ǀ indra ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ ánu ǀtáva ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ sakhyám ǀ ástṛtam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink Soma after the Ṛtus, from the Brāhmaṇa's bounty: undissolved, O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink the Somajuice,Indrafrom the precious vase of the Brāhmaṇa( = Brāhmanical wealth) after Ṛtu, for whom your friendship is uninterrupteḍ  brāhmaṇād-rādhasaḥ = lit. from brāhmanical wealth; explained as a costly or wealthy vessel: dhanabhūtāt pātrāt; brāhmaṇād =brāhmaṇācchaṃsi, one of the sixteen priests employed in sacrifices, who perhaps holds some ladle or vase in which the offering is presented: tasya sambandhyucchiṣṭascamasaḥ, the relation is the ladle that has the leavings].
verses.griffith_verse: Drink Soma after the Ṛtus, from the Brāhmaṇa's bounty: undissolved, O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युवं दक्षं धृतव्रत मित्रावरुण दूळभं ।ऋतुना यज्ञमाशाथे ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ dákṣam ǀ dhṛta-vratā ǀ mítrāvaruṇā ǀ duḥ-dábham ǀṛtúnā ǀ yajñám ǀ āśāthe íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra, Varuṇa, ye whose ways are firm—a Power that none deceives—, With Ṛtu ye have reached the rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, propitious to pious acts, be present with Ṛtu at our sacrifice, efficacious and undisturbed (by foes).
verses.griffith_verse: Mitra, Varuṇa, ye whose ways are firm—a Power that none deceives—, With Ṛtu ye have reached the rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: द्रविणोदा द्रविणसो ग्रावहस्तासो अध्वरे ।यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
verses.transliteration: draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ dráviṇasaḥ ǀ grā́va-hastāsaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀyajñéṣu ǀ devám ǀ īḷate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite, In sacrifices praise the God.
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests) desirous of wealth, holding stones in theirhands, praise the divine (Agni) Draviṇodas (= Agni, donor of wealth), both in the primary (e.g.Agniṣṭoma) and subsidiary (e.g.Ukthya) sacrifices.
verses.griffith_verse: The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite, In sacrifices praise the God.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: द्रविणोदा ददातु नो वसूनि यानि शृण्विरे ।देवेषु ता वनामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ dadātu ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ yā́ni ǀ śṛṇviré ǀdevéṣu ǀ tā́ ǀ vanāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned. These things we gain, among the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May Draviṇodas give us riches that may be heard of; we ask them for the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned. These things we gain, among the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: द्रविणोदाः पिपीषति जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत ।नेष्ट्रादृतुभिरिष्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ pipīṣati ǀ juhóta ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ tiṣṭhata ǀneṣṭrā́t ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ iṣyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: He with the Ṛtu fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Neṣṭar's bowl. Haste, give your offering, and depart.
verses.wilson_translation: Draviṇodas desires to drink with the Ṛtu from the cup of Neṣṭā(=tvaṣṭāor one of 16 officiating priests); hasten, (priest, to the hall of offering); present the oblation, and depart.
verses.griffith_verse: He with the Ṛtu fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Neṣṭar's bowl. Haste, give your offering, and depart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वा तुरीयमृतुभिर्द्रविणोदो यजामहे ।अध स्मा नो ददिर्भव ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ turī́yam ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ dráviṇaḥ-daḥ ǀ yájāmahe ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Ṛtus, be A Giver bountiful to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Since Draviṇodas, we adore you for the fourth time (i.e. in four ṛks) along with the Ṛtu; therefore be a benefactor unto us.
verses.griffith_verse: As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Ṛtus, be A Giver bountiful to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना पिबतं मधु दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता ।ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ píbatam ǀ mádhu ǀ dī́dyagnī íti dī́di-agnī ǀ śuci-vratā ǀṛtúnā ǀ yajña-vāhasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink ye the meath, O Aśvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure, who with Ṛtus accept the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, performers of pious acts, bright with sacrificial fires, acceptors, with the Ṛtus, of the sacrifice drink the sweet draught.
verses.griffith_verse: Drink ye the meath, O Aśvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure, who with Ṛtus accept the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: गार्हपत्येन संत्य ऋतुना यज्ञनीरसि ।देवान्देवयते यज ॥
verses.transliteration: gā́rha-patyena ǀ santya ǀ ṛtúnā ǀ yajña-nī́ḥ ǀ asi ǀdevā́n ǀ deva-yaté ǀ yaja ǁ
verses.english_translation: With Ṛtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice: Worship the Gods for the pious man.
verses.wilson_translation: Giver of rewards (Agni= santya, from san, to give), being identified with the household fire, and partaker with Ṛtu of the sacrifice, worship the gods on behalf of their adorer.
verses.griffith_verse: With Ṛtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice: Worship the Gods for the pious man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XVI. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught—Those, Indra, who are bright as suns. Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bringIndra upon his easiest car. Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice,Indra to drink the Soma juice. Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to he draught we pourWe call thee when the juice is shed. Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for theeDrink of it like a stag athirst. Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereofDrink, Indra, to increase thy might. Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent:Then drink the Soma juice expressed. To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vṛtra-slayer, comes,To drink the Soma for delight. Fulfil, O Śatakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine:With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा वहंतु हरयो वृषणं सोमपीतये ।इंद्र त्वा सूरचक्षसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vahantu ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀíndra ǀ tvā ǀ sū́ra-cakṣasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught— Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, let your coursers hither bring you, bestower of desires, to drink the Somajuice; may (the priests), radiant as the Sun, (make you manifest).
verses.griffith_verse: LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught— Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमा धाना घृतस्नुवो हरी इहोप वक्षतः ।इंद्रं सुखतमे रथे ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀ ghṛta-snúvaḥ ǀ hárī íti ǀ ihá ǀ úpa ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀíndram ǀ sukhá-tame ǀ ráthe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring Indra upon his easiest car.
verses.wilson_translation: Let his coursers convey Indrain an easy moving chariot hither, where these grains (of parched barley), steeped in clarified butter, are strewn (upon the altar).
verses.griffith_verse: Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring Indra upon his easiest car.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं प्रातर्हवामह इंद्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।इंद्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ prātáḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀ índram ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀíndram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice, Indra to drink the Soma juice.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke Indraat the morning rite, we invoke him at the succeeding sacrifice, we invoke Indra to drink the Somajuice.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice, Indra to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उप नः सुतमा गहि हरिभिरिंद्र केशिभिः ।सुते हि त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ keśí-bhiḥ ǀsuté ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ hávāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to he draught we pour We call thee when the juice is shed.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Indra, to our libation with our long-maned steeds; the libation being poured out, we invoke you.
verses.griffith_verse: Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to he draught we pour We call thee when the juice is shed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सेमं नः स्तोममा गह्युपेदं सवनं सुतं ।गौरो न तृषितः पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ úpa ǀ idám ǀ sávanam ǀ sutám ǀgauráḥ ǀ ná ǀ tṛṣitáḥ ǀ piba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee Drink of it like a stag athirst.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you accept this our praise, and come to this our sacrifice, for  which the libation is prepared; drink like a thirsty stag (gaura).
verses.griffith_verse: Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee Drink of it like a stag athirst.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमे सोमास इंदवः सुतासो अधि बर्हिषि ।ताँ इंद्र सहसे पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀtā́n ǀ indra ǀ sáhase ǀ piba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.
verses.wilson_translation: These dripping Somajuices are effused upon the sacred grass; drink them,Indra, (to recruit your) vigour.
verses.griffith_verse: Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अयं ते स्तोमो अग्रियो हृदिस्पृगस्तु शंतमः ।अथा सोमं सुतं पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ stómaḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ hṛdi-spṛ́k ǀ astu ǀ śám-tamaḥ ǀátha ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent: Then drink the Soma juice expressed.
verses.wilson_translation: May this our excellent hymn, touching your heart, be grateful to you, and thence drink the effused libation.
verses.griffith_verse: Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent: Then drink the Soma juice expressed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वमित्सवनं सुतमिंद्रो मदाय गच्छति ।वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvam ǀ ít ǀ sávanam ǀ sutám ǀ índraḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ gacchati ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vṛtra-slayer, comes, To drink the Soma for delight.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the destroyer of enemies, repairs assuredly to every ceremony where the libation is poured out, to drink the Somajuice for (his) exhilaration.
verses.griffith_verse: To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vṛtra-slayer, comes, To drink the Soma for delight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सेमं नः काममा पृण गोभिरश्वैः शतक्रतो ।स्तवाम त्वा स्वाध्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇa ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀstávāma ǀ tvā ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fulfil, O Śatakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine: With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Śatakratu, accomplish our desire with (the gift of) cattle and horse; profoundly meditating, we praise you.
verses.griffith_verse: Fulfil, O Śatakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine: With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XVII. Indra-Varuṇa
hymns.anukramani: ९ मेधातिथिः काण्वः। इन्द्रावरुणौ। गायत्री, ४-५ पादनिचृत् (५ ह्रसीयसी वा) गायत्री।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuṇa; may theyBoth favour one of us like me. Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the callOf every singer such as I. Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuṇa, with wealth:Fain would we have you nearest us. May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolenceOf you who give strength bounteously. Indra and Varuṇa, among givers of thousands, meet for praise,Are Powers who merit highest laud. Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it upEnough and still to spare, be ours. O Indra-Varuṇa, on you for wealth in many a form I call:Still keep ye us victorious. O Indra-Varuṇa, through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves,Give us at once your sheltering help. O Indra-Varuṇa, to you may fair praise which I offer come,Joint eulogy which ye dignify.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रावरुणयोरहं सम्राजोरव आ वृणे ।ता नो मृळात ईदृशे ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāváruṇayoḥ ǀ ahám ǀ sam-rā́joḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷātaḥ ǀ īdṛ́śe ǁ
verses.english_translation: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuṇa; may they Both favour one of us like me.
verses.wilson_translation: I seek the protection of the sovereign rulers (= possessed of extensive dominion or shining very brilliantly),Indraand Varuṇa; may they both favour us accordingly.
verses.griffith_verse: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuṇa; may they Both favour one of us like me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: गंतारा हि स्थोऽवसे हवं विप्रस्य मावतः ।धर्तारा चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: gántārā ǀ hí ǀ stháḥ ǀ ávase ǀ hávam ǀ víprasya ǀ mā́-vataḥ ǀdhartā́rā ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call Of every singer such as I.
verses.wilson_translation: For you are ever ready, guardians of mankind, to grant protection on the appeal of a minister such as I am.
verses.griffith_verse: Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call Of every singer such as I.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अनुकामं तर्पयेथामिंद्रावरुण राय आ ।ता वां नेदिष्ठमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: anu-kāmám ǀ tarpayethām ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀtā́ ǀ vām ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuṇa, with wealth: Fain would we have you nearest us.
verses.wilson_translation: Satisfy us with wealth,Indraand Varuṇa, according to our desires; we desire you ever near us.
verses.griffith_verse: Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuṇa, with wealth: Fain would we have you nearest us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युवाकु हि शचीनां युवाकु सुमतीनां ।भूयाम वाजदाव्नां ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvā́ku ǀ hí ǀ śácīnām ǀ yuvā́ku ǀ su-matīnā́m ǀbhūyā́ma ǀ vāja-dā́vnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence Of you who give strength bounteously.
verses.wilson_translation: The mingled (libations; yuvāku = mixture of curds andghee; śacīnām, mixture of butter milk, water and meal) of our pious rites, the mingled yuvāku sumatīnām = (laudations) of our right-minded (= sumatīnām, priests, are prepared); may we be (included) among the givers of food.
verses.griffith_verse: May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence Of you who give strength bounteously.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रः सहस्रदाव्नां वरुणः शंस्यानां ।क्रतुर्भवत्युक्थ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sahasra-dā́vnām ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ śáṃsyānām ǀkrátuḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra and Varuṇa, among givers of thousands, meet for praise, Are Powers who merit highest laud.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrais a giver among the givers of thousands;Varuṇais to be praised among those who are deserving of laudation.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra and Varuṇa, among givers of thousands, meet for praise, Are Powers who merit highest laud.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तयोरिदवसा वयं सनेम नि च धीमहि ।स्यादुत प्ररेचनं ॥
verses.transliteration: táyoḥ ǀ ít ǀ ávasā ǀ vayám ǀ sanéma ǀ ní ǀ ca ǀ dhīmahi ǀsyā́t ǀ utá ǀ pra-récanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up Enough and still to spare, be ours.
verses.wilson_translation: Through their protection, we enjoy (riches) and heap them up, and still there is abundance.
verses.griffith_verse: Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up Enough and still to spare, be ours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रावरुण वामहं हुवे चित्राय राधसे ।अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ vām ǀ ahám ǀ huvé ǀ citrā́ya ǀ rā́dhase ǀasmā́n ǀ sú ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀ kṛtam ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra-Varuṇa, on you for wealth in many a form I call: Still keep ye us victorious.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke you both,Indraand Varuṇa, quickly bestow happiness upon us, for our minds are devoted to you both.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra-Varuṇa, on you for wealth in many a form I call: Still keep ye us victorious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रावरुण नू नु ��ां सिषासंतीषु धीष्वा ।अस्मभ्यं शर्म यच्छतं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ nú ǀ nú ǀ vām ǀ sísāsantīṣu ǀ dhīṣú ǀ ā́ ǀasmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra-Varuṇa, through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves, Give us at once your sheltering help.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Varuṇa, quickly bestow happiness upon us, for our minds are devoted to you both.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra-Varuṇa, through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves, Give us at once your sheltering help.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वामश्नोतु सुष्टुतिरिंद्रावरुण यां हुवे ।यामृधाथे सधस्तुतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ aśnotu ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ yā́m ǀ huvé ǀyā́m ǀ ṛdhā́the íti ǀ sadhá-stutim ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra-Varuṇa, to you may fair praise which I offer come, Joint eulogy which ye dignify.
verses.wilson_translation: May the earnest priase which I offer to Indraand Varuṇareach you both--that conjoint praise which you (accepting), dignify.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra-Varuṇa, to you may fair praise which I offer come, Joint eulogy which ye dignify.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XVIII. Brahmaṇaspati.
hymns.anukramani: ९ मेधातिथिःकाण्वः। १-३ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः, ४ इन्द्रो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः सोमश्च, ५ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः  सोम इंद्रो,  दक्षिणा
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: O BRĀHMAṆASPATI, make him who presses Soma glorious,Even Kakṣīvān Auśija. The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store,The prompt,—may he be with us still. Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on usPreserve us, Brahmaṇaspati. Ne’er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmaṇaspati,And Soma graciously inspire. Do, thou, O Brahmaṇaspati, and Indra, Soma, Dakṣiṇā,Preserve that mortal from distress. To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who givesWisdom, have I drawn near in prayer. He without whom no sacrifice, e’en of the wise man, prospers; heStirs up the series of thoughts. He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice:Our voice of praise goes to the Gods. I have seen Narāśaṁsa, him most resolute, most widely famed,As ’twere the Household Priest of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सोमानं स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते ।कक्षीवंतं य औशिजः ॥
verses.transliteration: somā́nam ǀ sváraṇam ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀkakṣī́vantam ǀ yáḥ ǀ auśijáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O BRĀHMAṆASPATI, make him who presses Soma glorious, Even Kakṣīvān Auśija.
verses.wilson_translation: Brahmaṇaspati(=Agni, connected with prayer) make the offerer of the libation illustrious among the gods, like Kakṣīvat, the son of Uśij (and Dīrghatamas).
verses.griffith_verse: O BRĀHMAṆASPATI, make him who presses Soma glorious, Even Kakṣīvān Auśija.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यो रेवान्यो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्धनः ।स नः सिषक्तु यस्तुरः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ revā́n ǀ yáḥ ǀ amīva-hā́ ǀ vasu-vít ǀ puṣṭi-várdhanaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sisaktu ǀ yáḥ ǀ turáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store, The prompt,—may he be with us still.
verses.wilson_translation: May he who is opulent, the healer of disease, the acquirer of riches, the augmenter of nourishment, the prompt (bestower of rewards) be favourable to us.
verses.griffith_verse: The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store, The prompt,—may he be with us still.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मा नः शंसो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ्मर्त्यस्य ।रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्पते ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ dhūrtíḥ ǀ práṇak ǀ mártyasya ǀrákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us Preserve us, Brahmaṇaspati.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us,Brahmaṇaspati, so that no calumnious censure of a melevolent man may reach us.
verses.griffith_verse: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us Preserve us, Brahmaṇaspati.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स घा वीरो न रिष्यति यमिंद्रो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।सोमो हिनोति मर्त्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ vīráḥ ǀ ná ǀ riṣyati ǀ yám ǀ índraḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ hinóti ǀ mártyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ne’er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmaṇaspati, And Soma graciously inspire.
verses.wilson_translation: The liberal man, whom Indra,Brahmaṇaspati, and Somaprotect, never perishes.
verses.griffith_verse: Ne’er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmaṇaspati, And Soma graciously inspire.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तं ब्रह्मणस्पते सोम इंद्रश्च मर्त्यं ।दक्षिणा पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ mártyam ǀdákṣiṇā ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do, thou, O Brahmaṇaspati, and Indra, Soma, Dakṣiṇā, Preserve that mortal from distress.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Brahmaṇaspati, and do you,Soma,Indraand Dakṣiṇā(= present person nified as a feminine le divinity), protect that man from sin.
verses.griffith_verse: Do, thou, O Brahmaṇaspati, and Indra, Soma, Dakṣiṇā, Preserve that mortal from distress.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिंद्रस्य काम्यं ।सनिं मेधामयासिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: sádasaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ ádbhutam ǀ priyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myam ǀsaním ǀ medhā́m ǀ ayāsiṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.
verses.wilson_translation: I solicit understanding from Sadasaspati(=Agni, protector of the assembly), the wonderful, the friend of Indra, the desirable, the bountiful.
verses.griffith_verse: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादृते न सिध्यति यज्ञो विपश्चितश्चन ।स धीनां योगमिन्वति ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmāt ǀ ṛté ǀ ná ǀ sídhyati ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ caná ǀsáḥ ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ yógam ǀ invati ǁ
verses.english_translation: He without whom no sacrifice, e’en of the wise man, prospers; he Stirs up the series of thoughts.
verses.wilson_translation: Without whose aid the sacrifice even of the wise is not perfected; he pervades the association of our thoughts (or, the object of our pious acts; dhī =buddhi, understanding orkarma).
verses.griffith_verse: He without whom no sacrifice, e’en of the wise man, prospers; he Stirs up the series of thoughts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आदृध्नोति हविष्कृतिं प्रांचं कृणोत्यध्वरं ।होत्रा देवेषु गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ṛdhnoti ǀ havíḥ-kṛtim ǀ prā́ñcam ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ adhvarám ǀhótrā ǀ devéṣu ǀ gacchati ǁ
verses.english_translation: He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice: Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: He rewrds the presenter of the oblation; he brings the sacrifice to its conclusion; (through him) our invocation reaches the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice: Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नराशंसं सुधृष्टममपश्यं सप्रथस्तमं ।दिवो न सद्ममखसं ॥
verses.transliteration: nárāśáṃsam ǀ su-dhṛ́ṣṭamam ǀ ápaśyam ǀ sapráthaḥ-tamam ǀdiváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sádma-makhasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I have seen Narāśaṁsa, him most resolute, most widely famed, As ’twere the Household Priest of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: I have beheld Nārāśaṃsa (i.e.Agnior the person nifiedyajñaor sacrifice at which men praise the gods), the most resolute, the most renowned, and radiant as the heavens.
verses.griffith_verse: I have seen Narāśaṁsa, him most resolute, most widely famed, As ’twere the Household Priest of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XIX. Agni, Maruts.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked:O Agni, with the Maruts come. No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one:O Agni, with the Maruts come: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air:O Agni, with those Maruts come. The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might:O Agni, with those Maruts come. Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes:O Agni, with those Maruts come. Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere:O Agni, with those Maruts come. Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea:O Agni, with those Maruts come. Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their mightO Agni, with those Maruts come. For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath:O Agni, with the Maruts come.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ tyám ǀ cā́rum ǀ adhvarám ǀ go-pīthā́ya ǀ prá ǀ hūyase ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: Earnestly are you invoked to this perfect rite, to drink the Somajuice; come,Agni, with the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नहि देवो न मर्त्यो महस्तव क्रतुं परः ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ táva ǀ krátum ǀ paráḥ ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one: O Agni, with the Maruts come:
verses.wilson_translation: Nor god nor man has power over a rite (dedicated) to you, who are mighty; come,Agni, with the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one: O Agni, with the Maruts come:
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ये महो रजसो विदुर्विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ maháḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vidúḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: Who all are divine (devāsaḥ = dyotamānāḥ, shining) and devoid of malignity and who know (how to cause the descent) of great waters; come,Agni, with the (sapta-gaṇāor all seven troops of)Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: य उग्रा अर्कमानृचुरनाधृष्टास ओजसा ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǀ arkám ǀ ānṛcúḥ ǀ ánādhṛṣṭāsaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: Who are fierce, and send down rain (arka, from arc to worship; āpo vāarkaḥ(Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa10.6.5.2); hence, arka connotes water or rain), and are unsurpassed in strength; come,Agniwith the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ये शुभ्रा घोरवर्पसः सुक्षत्रासो रिशादसः ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ ghorá-varpasaḥ ǀ su-kṣatrā́saḥ ǀ riśā́dasaḥ ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: Who are brilliant, of terrific forms, who are possessors of great wealth, and are devourers of the malevolent; come,Agniwith the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि देवास आसते ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ nā́kasya ǀ ádhi ǀ rocané ǀ diví ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ā́sate ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: Who are divinities abiding in the radiant heaven above the sun; come,Agniwith the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: य ईंखयंति पर्वतान् तिरः समुद्रमर्णवं ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ īṅkháyanti ǀ párvatān ǀ tiráḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ arṇavám ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: Who scatter the clouds, and agitate the sea (with waves): come,Agniwith the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ ये तन्वंति रश्मिभिस्तिरः समुद्रमोजसा ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yé ǀ tanvánti ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ójasā ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: Who spread (through the firmament) along with the rays (of the sun) and with their strength agitate the ocean: come,Agni, with the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतये सृजामि सोम्यं मधु ।मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ pūrvá-pītaye ǀ sṛjā́mi ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
verses.wilson_translation: I pour out the sweet Somajuice for your drinking, (as) of old; come,Agniwith the Maruts.
verses.griffith_verse: For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XX. Ṛbhus.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishlyWas made by singers with their lips. They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word,Attained by works to sacrifice. They for the two Nāsatyas wrought a light car moving every way:They formed a nectar-yielding cow. The Ṛbhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, madeTheir Sire and Mother young again. Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt,With the Ādityas, with the Kings. The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvaṣṭar's hand—Four ladles have ye made thereof. Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to eachGive wealth, pleased with our eulogies. As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves,A share in sacrifice with Gods.

verses.sanskrit: अयं देवाय जन्मने स्तोमो विप्रेभिरासया ।अकारि रत्नधातमः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ devā́ya ǀ jánmane ǀ stómaḥ ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ āsayā́ ǀákāri ǀ ratna-dhā́tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly Was made by singers with their lips.
verses.wilson_translation: This hymn, the bestower of riches, has been addressed by the sages, with their own mouths, to the (class of) divinities having birth (lit. to the divine or brilliant birth; e.g.Ṛbhus--Ṛbhu,Vibhuand Vājawere pious men, who through penance became divinities).
verses.griffith_verse: FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly Was made by singers with their lips.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: य इंद्राय वचोयुजा ततक्षुर्मनसा हरी ।शमीभिर्यज्ञमाशत ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ índrāya ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀ tatakṣúḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ hárī íti ǀśámībhiḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ āśata ǁ
verses.english_translation: They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word, Attained by works to sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: They who created mentally for Indrathe horses that are harnessed (carved) at his words, have partaken of the sacrifice performed with holy acts. (śamībhiḥ = ceremonies; i.e. they have pervaded, appropriated or accepted the sacrifice peformed with tongs, ladles, and utensils; an intimation of the mechanical skills ofṚbhu).
verses.griffith_verse: They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word, Attained by works to sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तक्षन्नासत्याभ्यां परिज्मानं सुखं रथं ।तक्षन्धेनुं सबर्दुघां ॥
verses.transliteration: tákṣan ǀ nā́satyābhyām ǀ pári-jmānam ǀ su-khám ǀ rátham ǀtákṣan ǀ dhenúm ǀ sabaḥ-dúghām ǁ
verses.english_translation: They for the two Nāsatyas wrought a light car moving every way: They formed a nectar-yielding cow.
verses.wilson_translation: They constructed for the Nāsatyās, a universally-moving and easy car, and a cow yielding milk. (takṣan= atakṣan, lit. they (Ṛbhus) chipped or fabricated, mechanically, the appendages of Indraand Aśvin).
verses.griffith_verse: They for the two Nāsatyas wrought a light car moving every way: They formed a nectar-yielding cow.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युवाना पितरा पुनः सत्यमंत्रा ऋजूयवः ।ऋभवो विष्ट्यक्रत ॥
verses.transliteration: yúvānā ǀ pitárā ǀ púnaríti ǀ satyá-mantrāḥ ǀ ṛju-yávaḥ ǀṛbhávaḥ ǀ viṣṭī́ ǀ akrata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Ṛbhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made Their Sire and Mother young again.
verses.wilson_translation: TheṚbhus, uttering unfailing prayers, endowed with rectitude, and succeeding (in all pious acts;viṣṭī= vyāptiyuktaḥ, i.e. encountering no opposition in all acts), made their (aged) parents young.
verses.griffith_verse: The Ṛbhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made Their Sire and Mother young again.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सं वो मदासो अग्मतेंद्रेण च मरुत्वता ।आदित्येभिश्च राजभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǀ agmata ǀ índreṇa ǀ ca ǀ marútvatā ǀādityébhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt, With the Ādityas, with the Kings.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛbhus, the exhilarating juices are offered to you, along with Indra, attended by the Marutsand along with the brilliangĀdityas.
verses.griffith_verse: Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt, With the Ādityas, with the Kings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्यं चमसं नवं त्वष्टुर्देवस्य निष्कृतं ।अकर्त चतुरः पुनः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ camasám ǀ návam ǀ tváṣṭuḥ ǀ devásya ǀ níḥ-kṛtam ǀákarta ǀ catúraḥ ǀ púnaríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvaṣṭar's hand— Four ladles have ye made thereof.
verses.wilson_translation: TheṚbhushave divided unto four the new ladle, the work of the divine Tvaṣṭā(i.e. devasambandhiḥ takṣana.vyāpāraḥ= divinity whose duty in relations to gods is carpentry; cf. tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuḥśiṣyāḥṚbhavaḥ= Ṛbhus are the disciples of Tvaṣṭā; four ladles are an apparent reference to an innovation in the objects of libation for sharing).
verses.griffith_verse: The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvaṣṭar's hand— Four ladles have ye made thereof.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो रत्नानि धत्तन त्रिरा साप्तानि सुन्वते ।एकमेकं सुशस्तिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ rátnāni ǀ dhattana ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sā́ptāni ǀ sunvaté ǀékam-ekam ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.
verses.wilson_translation: May they, moved by our praises, give to the offere of the libation many precious things, and perfect the thrice seven sacrifices
verses.griffith_verse: Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अधारयंत वह्नयोऽभजंत सुकृत्यया ।भागं देवेषु यज्ञियं ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhārayanta ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ ábhajanta ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀbhāgám ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves, A share in sacrifice with Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Offerers (of sacrifices), they held (a moral existence); by their pious acts they obtained a share of sacrifices with the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves, A share in sacrifice with Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XXI. Indra-Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise:Chief Soma-drinkers are they both. Praise ye, O men, and glorify Indra-Agni in the holy rites:Sing praise to them in sacred songs. Indra and Agni we invite, the Soma-drinkers, for the fameOf Mitra, to the Soma-draught. Strong Gods, we bid them come to this libation that stands ready here:Indra and Agni, come to us. Indra and Agni, mighty Lords of our assembly, crush the fiends:Childless be the devouring ones. Watch ye, through this your truthfulness, there in the place of spacious viewIndra and Agni, send us bliss.

verses.sanskrit: इहेंद्राग्नी उप ह्वये तयोरित्स्तोममुश्मसि ।ता सोमं सोमपातमा ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀ táyoḥ ǀ ít ǀ stómam ǀ uśmasi ǀtā́ ǀ sómam ǀ soma-pā́tamā ǁ
verses.english_translation: INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise: Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.
verses.wilson_translation: Invoke hither Indraand Agni, to whom we desire to present our praise; let them, who are both copious drinkers of the Somajuice, (accept the libation).
verses.griffith_verse: INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise: Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ता यज्ञेषु प्र शंसतेंद्राग्नी शुंभता नरः ।ता गायत्रेषु गायत ॥
