May the tall tree be full of sweets for us, and full of sweets the Sun:May our milch-kine be sweet for us. Be Mitra gracious unto us, and Varuṇa and Aryaman:Indra, Bṛhaspati be kind, and Viṣṇu of the mighty stride.

verses.sanskrit: ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयतु विद्वान् ।अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛju-nītī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ nayatu ǀ vidvā́n ǀaryamā́ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: MAY Varuṇa with guidance straight, and Mitra lead us, he who knows, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May Varuṇaand the wise Mitralead us, by straight paths, (to our desires) and Aryaman, rejoicing with the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: MAY Varuṇa with guidance straight, and Mitra lead us, he who knows, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ते हि वस्वो वसवानास्ते अप्रमूरा महोभिः ।व्रता रक्षंते विश्वाहा ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ vásavānāḥ ǀ té ǀ ápra-mūrāḥ ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀvratā́ ǀ rakṣante ǀ viśvā́hā ǁ
verses.english_translation: For they are dealers forth of wealth, and, not deluded, with their might Guard evermore the holy laws.
verses.wilson_translation: For they are the distributors of wealth (over the world); and never heedless, discharge their functions every day.
verses.griffith_verse: For they are dealers forth of wealth, and, not deluded, with their might Guard evermore the holy laws.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ते अस्मभ्यं शर्म यंसन्नमृता मर्त्येभ्यः ।बाधमाना अप द्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ asmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsan ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mártyebhyaḥ ǀbā́dhamānāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Shelter may they vouchsafe to us, Immortal Gods to mortal men, Chasing our enemies away.
verses.wilson_translation: May they, who are immortal, bestow upon us mortals, happiness, annihilating our foes.
verses.griffith_verse: Shelter may they vouchsafe to us, Immortal Gods to mortal men, Chasing our enemies away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वि नः पथः सुविताय चियंत्विंद्रो मरुतः ।पूषा भगो वंद्यासः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ ciyántu ǀ índraḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀpūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ vándyāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May they mark out our paths to bliss, Indra, the Maruts, Pūṣan, and Bhaga, the Gods to be adored.
verses.wilson_translation: May the adorable Indra, the Maruts,Pūṣan, and Bhaga, so direct our paths, (that they may lead) to the attainment of good gifts.
verses.griffith_verse: May they mark out our paths to bliss, Indra, the Maruts, Pūṣan, and Bhaga, the Gods to be adored.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो धियो गोअग्राः पूषन्विष्णवेवयावः ।कर्ता नः स्वस्तिमतः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ gó-agrāḥ ǀ pū́ṣan ǀ víṣṇo íti ǀ éva-yāvaḥ ǀkárta ǀ naḥ ǀ svasti-mátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yea, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, ye who run your course, enrich our hymns with kine; Bless us with all prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: Pūṣan,Viṣṇu,Maruts, make our rites restorative of our cattle; make us prosperous
verses.griffith_verse: Yea, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, ye who run your course, enrich our hymns with kine; Bless us with all prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मधु वाता ऋतायते मधु क्षरंति सिंधवः ।माध्वीर्नः संत्वोषधीः ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhu ǀ vā́tāḥ ǀ ṛta-yaté ǀ mádhu ǀ kṣaranti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀmā́dhvīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ santu ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law So may the plants be sweet for us.
verses.wilson_translation: The winds bring sweet (rewards) to the sacrificer; the rivers bring sweet (waters); may the herbs yield sweetness to us.
verses.griffith_verse: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law So may the plants be sweet for us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मधु नक्तमुतोषसो मधुमत्पार्थिवं रजः ।मधु द्यौरस्तु नः पिता ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhu ǀ náktam ǀ utá ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rájaḥ ǀmádhu ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ astu ǀ naḥ ǀ pitā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere; Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.
verses.wilson_translation: May night and moring be sweet; may the region of the earth (lokā rajāṃsyucyate-Nirukta4.19) be full of sweetness; may the protecting heaven be sweet to us.
verses.griffith_verse: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere; Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मधुमान्नो वनस्पतिर्मधुमाँ अस्तु सूर्यः ।माध्वीर्गावो भवंतु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhu-mān ǀ naḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ astu ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀmā́dhvīḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.
verses.wilson_translation: May Vanaspatibe possessed of sweetness towards us; may the sun be imbued with sweetness; may the cattle be sweet to us.
verses.griffith_verse: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा ।शं न इंद्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ śám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ aryamā́ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ uru-kramáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be Mitra gracious unto us, and Varuṇa and Aryaman: Indra, Bṛhaspati be kind, and Viṣṇu of the mighty stride.
verses.wilson_translation: May Mitrabe propitious to us; may Varuṇa, may Aryaman, be propitious to us; may Indraand Bṛhaspatibe propitious to us; may the wide-stepping Viṣṇube propitious to us.
verses.griffith_verse: Be Mitra gracious unto us, and Varuṇa and Aryaman: Indra, Bṛhaspati be kind, and Viṣṇu of the mighty stride.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XCI. Soma.
hymns.anukramani: २३ गोतमो राहूगणः। सोमः। त्रिष्टुप्, ५-१६ गायत्री, १७ उष्णिक्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom; along the straightest path thou art our leader.Our wise forefathers by thy guidance, Indu, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure. Thou by thine insight art most wise, O Soma, strong by thine energies and all possessing,Mighty art thou by all thy powers and greatness, by glories art thou glorious, guide of mortals. Thine are King Varuṇa's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory.All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma. With all thy glories on the earth, in heaven, on mountains, in the plants, and in the waters,—With all of these, well-pleased and not in anger, accept, O royal Soma, our oblations. Thou, Soma, art the Lord of heroes, King, yea, Vṛtra-slayer thou:Thou art auspicious energy. And, Soma, let it be thy wish that we may live and may not die:Praise-loving Lord of plants art thou. To him who keeps the law, both old and young, thou givest happiness,And energy that he may live. Guard us, King Soma, on all sides from him who threatens us: never letThe friend of one like thee be harmed. With those delightful aids which thou hast, Soma, for the worshipper,—Even with those protect thou us. Accepting this our sacrifice and this our praise, O Soma, come,And be thou nigh to prosper us. Well-skilled in speech we magnify thee, Soma, with our sacred songs:Come thou to us, most gracious One. Enricher, healer of disease, wealth-finder, prospering our store,Be, Soma, a good Friend to us. Soma, be happy in our heart, as milch-kine in the grassy meads,As a young man in his own house. O Soma, God, the mortal man who in thy friendship hath delight,Him doth the mighty Sage befriend. Save us from slanderous reproach, keep us., O Soma, from distress:Be unto us a gracious Friend. Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee:Be in the gathering-place of strength. Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy rays of light, and beA Friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us. In thee be juicy nutriments united, and powers and mighty foe-subduing vigour,Waxing to immortality, O Soma: win highest glories for thyself in heaven. Such of thy glories as with poured oblations men honour, may they all invest our worship.Wealth-giver, furtherer with troops of heroes, sparing the brave, come, Soma, to our houses. To him who worships Soma gives the milch-cow, a fleet steed and a man of active knowledge,Skilled in home duties, meet for holy synod, for council meet, a glory to his father. Invincible in fight, saver in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water,Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee will we rejoice, O Soma. These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated.The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness. Do thou, God Soma, with thy Godlike spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches.Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for both sides in the fray for booty.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम प्र चिकितो मनीषा त्वं रजिष्ठमनु नेषि पंथां ।तव प्रणीती पितरो न इंदो देवेषु रत्नमभजंत धीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ prá ǀ cikitaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ tvám ǀ rájiṣṭham ǀ ánu ǀ neṣi ǀ pánthām ǀtáva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ devéṣu ǀ rátnam ǀ abhajanta ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom; along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our wise forefathers by thy guidance, Indu, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, are thoroughly apprehended by our understanding; you lead us along a straight path; by your guidance,Indra, our righteous fathers obtained wealth among the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom; along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our wise forefathers by thy guidance, Indu, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम क्रतुभिः सुक्रतुर्भूस्त्वं दक्षैः सुदक्षो विश्ववेदाः ।त्वं वृषा वृषत्वेभिर्महित्वा द्युम्नेभिर्द्युम्न्यभवो नृचक्षाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ tvám ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀtvám ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛṣa-tvébhiḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ dyumnébhiḥ ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou by thine insight art most wise, O Soma, strong by thine energies and all possessing, Mighty art thou by all thy powers and greatness, by glories art thou glorious, guide of mortals.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, are the doer of good by holy acts; you are powerful by your energies, and know all things; you are the showerer (of benefits) by your bounties, and (are great) by your greatness; you, the guide of men, has been well nourished by sacrificial offerings.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou by thine insight art most wise, O Soma, strong by thine energies and all possessing, Mighty art thou by all thy powers and greatness, by glories art thou glorious, guide of mortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञो नु ते वरुणस्य व्रतानि बृहद्गभीरं तव सोम धाम ।शुचिष्ट्वमसि प्रियो न मित्रो दक्षाय्यो अर्यमेवासि सोम ॥
verses.transliteration: rā́jñaḥ ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ bṛhát ǀ gabhīrám ǀ táva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma ǀśúciḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitráḥ ǀ dakṣā́yyaḥ ǀ aryamā́-iva ǀ asi ǀ soma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thine are King Varuṇa's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory. All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Your acts are (like those) of the royal Varuṇa; your glory,Soma, is great and profound; you are the purifier (of all), like the beloved Mitra; you are the augmenter of all, like Aryaman.
verses.griffith_verse: Thine are King Varuṇa's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory. All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: या ते धामानि दिवि या पृथिव्यां या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु ।तेभिर्नो विश्वैः सुमना अहेळन्राजन्त्सोम प्रति हव्या गृभाय ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ dhā́māni ǀ diví ǀ yā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ yā́ ǀ párvateṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀtébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvaiḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ áheḷan ǀ rā́jan ǀ soma ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ ǀ gṛbhāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: With all thy glories on the earth, in heaven, on mountains, in the plants, and in the waters,— With all of these, well-pleased and not in anger, accept, O royal Soma, our oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Endowed with all the glories (that are displayed) by you in heaven, on earth, in the mountains, in the plural nts, in the waters, do you, illustrious Soma, well-disposed towards us, and devoid of anger, accept our oblations.
verses.griffith_verse: With all thy glories on the earth, in heaven, on mountains, in the plants, and in the waters,— With all of these, well-pleased and not in anger, accept, O royal Soma, our oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोमासि सत्पतिस्त्वं राजोत वृत्रहा ।त्वं भद्रो असि क्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ asi ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ rā́jā ǀ utá ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀtvám ǀ bhadráḥ ǀ asi ǀ krátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, Soma, art the Lord of heroes, King, yea, Vṛtra-slayer thou: Thou art auspicious energy.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, are the protector, the soverign of the pious, or even the slayer of Vṛtra; you are holy sacrifice..
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, Soma, art the Lord of heroes, King, yea, Vṛtra-slayer thou: Thou art auspicious energy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं च सोम नो वशो जीवातुं न मरामहे ।प्रियस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ váśaḥ ǀ jīvā́tum ǀ ná ǀ marāmahe ǀpriyá-stotraḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: And, Soma, let it be thy wish that we may live and may not die: Praise-loving Lord of plants art thou.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, fond of praise, the lord of plural nts, are life to us; if you will, we shall not die.
verses.griffith_verse: And, Soma, let it be thy wish that we may live and may not die: Praise-loving Lord of plants art thou.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम महे भगं त्वं यून ऋतायते ।दक्षं दधासि जीवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ mahé ǀ bhágam ǀ tvám ǀ yū́ne ǀ ṛta-yaté ǀdákṣam ǀ dadhāsi ǀ jīváse ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him who keeps the law, both old and young, thou givest happiness, And energy that he may live.
verses.wilson_translation: You bestow,Soma, upon him who worships, you, whether old or young, wealth, what he may enjoy and live.
verses.griffith_verse: To him who keeps the law, both old and young, thou givest happiness, And energy that he may live.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो रक्षा राजन्नघायतः ।न रिष्येत्त्वावतः सखा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ rákṣa ǀ rājan ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀná ǀ riṣyet ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ sákhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Guard us, King Soma, on all sides from him who threatens us: never let The friend of one like thee be harmed.
verses.wilson_translation: Defend us, royal Soma, from every one seeking to harm us; the friend of one like you can never perish.
verses.griffith_verse: Guard us, King Soma, on all sides from him who threatens us: never let The friend of one like thee be harmed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सोम यास्ते मयोभुव ऊतयः संति दाशुषे ।ताभिर्नोऽविता भव ॥
verses.transliteration: sóma ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: With those delightful aids which thou hast, Soma, for the worshipper,— Even with those protect thou us.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, be our protector with those assistances which are sources of happiness to the donor (of oblations).
verses.griffith_verse: With those delightful aids which thou hast, Soma, for the worshipper,— Even with those protect thou us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि ।सोम त्वं नो वृधे भव ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ upa-ā́gahi ǀsóma ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accepting this our sacrifice and this our praise, O Soma, come, And be thou nigh to prosper us.
verses.wilson_translation: Accepting this our sacrifice, and this our praise, approach,Soma, and be to us as the augmenter of our rite.
verses.griffith_verse: Accepting this our sacrifice and this our praise, O Soma, come, And be thou nigh to prosper us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सोम गीर्भिष्ट्वा वयं वर्धयामो वचोविदः ।सुमृळीको न आ विश ॥
verses.transliteration: sóma ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ vardháyāmaḥ ǀ vacaḥ-vídaḥ ǀsu-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Well-skilled in speech we magnify thee, Soma, with our sacred songs: Come thou to us, most gracious One.
verses.wilson_translation: Acquainted with hymns, we elevate you with praises; do you, who are benignant, approach.
verses.griffith_verse: Well-skilled in speech we magnify thee, Soma, with our sacred songs: Come thou to us, most gracious One.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: गयस्फानो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्धनः ।सुमित्रः सोम नो भव ॥
verses.transliteration: gaya-sphā́naḥ ǀ amīva-hā́ ǀ vasu-vít ǀ puṣṭi-várdhanaḥ ǀsu-mitráḥ ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Enricher, healer of disease, wealth-finder, prospering our store, Be, Soma, a good Friend to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Be unto us,Soma, the bestower of wealth, the remover of disease, the cognizant of riches, the augmenter of nutriment, an excellent friend.
verses.griffith_verse: Enricher, healer of disease, wealth-finder, prospering our store, Be, Soma, a good Friend to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सोम रारंधि नो हृदि गावो न यवसेष्वा ।मर्य इव स्व ओक्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: sóma ǀ rarandhí ǀ naḥ ǀ hṛdí ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávaseṣu ǀ ā́ ǀmáryaḥ-iva ǀ své ǀ okyé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, be happy in our heart, as milch-kine in the grassy meads, As a young man in his own house.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, dwell happy in our hearts, like cattle in fresh pastures, like men in their own abodes.
verses.griffith_verse: Soma, be happy in our heart, as milch-kine in the grassy meads, As a young man in his own house.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यः सोम सख्ये तव रारणद्देव मर्त्यः ।तं दक्षः सचते कविः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ soma ǀ sakhyé ǀ táva ǀ raráṇat ǀ deva ǀ mártyaḥ ǀtám ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ sacate ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Soma, God, the mortal man who in thy friendship hath delight, Him doth the mighty Sage befriend.
verses.wilson_translation: The experienced sage commends the mortal who, through affection, divine Soma, praises you.
verses.griffith_verse: O Soma, God, the mortal man who in thy friendship hath delight, Him doth the mighty Sage befriend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उरुष्या णो अभिशस्तेः सोम नि पाह्यंहसः ।सखा सुशेव एधि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: uruṣyá ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ sóma ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀsákhā ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ edhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Save us from slanderous reproach, keep us., O Soma, from distress: Be unto us a gracious Friend.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us,Soma, from calumny, preserve us from sin; plural ased with our service, be our friend.
verses.griffith_verse: Save us from slanderous reproach, keep us., O Soma, from distress: Be unto us a gracious Friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यं ।भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pyāyasva ǀ sám ǀ etu ǀ te ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ soma ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀbháva ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sam-gathé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee: Be in the gathering-place of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Increase,Soma, may vigour come to you from every side; be diligent in the supply of food (to us).
verses.griffith_verse: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee: Be in the gathering-place of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ प्यायस्व मदिंतम सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः ।भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pyāyasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ sóma ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ aṃśú-bhiḥ ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ suśrávaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy rays of light, and be A Friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us. 16 In thee be juicy nutriments united, and powers and mighty foe-subduing vigour, Waxing to immortality, O Soma: win highest glories for thyself in heaven. 19 Such of thy glories as with poured oblations men honour, may they all invest our worship. Wealth-giver, furtherer with troops of heroes, sparing the brave, come, Soma, to our houses. 20 To him who worships Soma gives the milch-cow, a fleet steed and a man of active knowledge, Skilled in home duties, meet for holy synod, for council meet, a glory to his father. 21 Invincible in fight, saver in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water, Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee will we rejoice, O Soma. 22 These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated. The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness. 23 Do thou, God Soma, with thy Godlike spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches. Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for both sides in the fray for booty.
verses.wilson_translation: Exulting Soma, increase with all twining plural nts; be to us a friend; well supplied with food, we may prosper.
verses.griffith_verse: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy rays of light, and be A Friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us. 16 In thee be juicy nutriments united, and powers and mighty foe-subduing vigour, Waxing to immortality, O Soma: win highest glories for thyself in heaven. 19 Such of thy glories as with poured oblations men honour, may they all invest our worship. Wealth-giver, furtherer with troops of heroes, sparing the brave, come, Soma, to our houses. 20 To him who worships Soma gives the milch-cow, a fleet steed and a man of active knowledge, Skilled in home duties, meet for holy synod, for council meet, a glory to his father. 21 Invincible in fight, saver in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water, Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee will we rejoice, O Soma. 22 These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated. The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness. 23 Do thou, God Soma, with thy Godlike spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches. Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for both sides in the fray for booty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सं ते पयांसि समु यंतु वाजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्यभिमातिषाहः ।आप्यायमानो अमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवांस्युत्तमानि धिष्व ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ te ǀ páyāṃsi ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ yantu ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ sám ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ abhimāti-sáhaḥ ǀā-pyā́yamānaḥ ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ soma ǀ diví ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ ut-tamā́ni ǀ dhiṣva ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the milky juices flow around you; may sacrificial offerings and vigour be concentrated in the destroyer of foes; and, being fully nourished, do you provide,Soma, excellent viands in heaven for our immortality.
verses.wilson_translation: May the milky juices flow around you; may sacrificial offerings and vigour be concentrated in the destroyer of foes; and, being fully nourished, do you provide,Soma, excellent viands in heaven for our immortality.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या ते धामानि हविषा यजंति ता ते विश्वा परिभूरस्तु यज्ञं ।गयस्फानः प्रतरणः सुवीरोऽवीरहा प्र चरा सोम दुर्यान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ dhā́māni ǀ havíṣā ǀ yájanti ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ víśvā ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ yajñám ǀgaya-sphā́naḥ ǀ pra-táraṇaḥ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀ ávīra-hā ǀ prá ǀ cara ǀ soma ǀ dúryān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whichever of your glories (men) worship with oblations, may our sacrifice be invested with them all; come to our mansions,Soma, who are the bestower of wealth, the transporter (over difficulties); attended by valiant heroes, the non-destroyer of progeny.
verses.wilson_translation: Whichever of your glories (men) worship with oblations, may our sacrifice be invested with them all; come to our mansions,Soma, who are the bestower of wealth, the transporter (over difficulties); attended by valiant heroes, the non-destroyer of progeny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमो धेनुं सोमो अर्वंतमाशुं सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददाति ।सादन्यं विदथ्यं सभेयं पितृश्रवणं यो ददाशदस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ dhenúm ǀ sómaḥ ǀ árvantam ǀ āśúm ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vīrám ǀ karmaṇyám ǀ dadāti ǀsadanyám ǀ vidathyám ǀ sabhéyam ǀ pitṛ-śrávaṇam ǀ yáḥ ǀ dádāśat ǀ asmai ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him who present (offerings),Somagives a cow, a swift horse, and a son who is able in affairs, skilful in domestic concerns, assiduous in worship, eminent in society, and who is an honour to his father.
verses.wilson_translation: To him who present (offerings),Somagives a cow, a swift horse, and a son who is able in affairs, skilful in domestic concerns, assiduous in worship, eminent in society, and who is an honour to his father.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अषाळ्हं युत्सु पृतनासु पप्रिं स्वर्षामप्सां वृजनस्य गोपां ।भरेषुजां सुक्षितिं सुश्रवसं जयंतं त्वामनु मदेम सोम ॥
verses.transliteration: áṣāḷham ǀ yut-sú ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ páprim ǀ svaḥ-sā́m ǀ apsā́m ǀ vṛjánasya ǀ gopā́m ǀbhareṣu-jā́m ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ su-śrávasam ǀ jáyantam ǀ tvā́m ǀ ánu ǀ madema ǀ soma ǁ
verses.english_translation: We rejoice,Soma, contemplating you, invincible in battle, triumphant amongst hosts, the granter of heaven, the giver of rain, the preserver of strength, born amidst sacrifices, occupying a brilliant dwelling, renowned and victorious.
verses.wilson_translation: We rejoice,Soma, contemplating you, invincible in battle, triumphant amongst hosts, the granter of heaven, the giver of rain, the preserver of strength, born amidst sacrifices, occupying a brilliant dwelling, renowned and victorious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिमा ओषधीः सोम विश्वास्त्वमपो अजनयस्त्वं गाः ।त्वमा ततंथोर्वंतरिक्षं त्वं ज्योतिषा वि तमो ववर्थ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ soma ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ tvám ǀ apáḥ ǀ ajanayaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀtvám ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǀ tvám ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ ví ǀ támaḥ ǀ vavartha ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, have genitive rated all these herbs, the water and the kine; you have spread out the spacious firmament; you have scattered darkness with light.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, have genitive rated all these herbs, the water and the kine; you have spread out the spacious firmament; you have scattered darkness with light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवेन नो मनसा देव सोम रायो भागं सहसावन्नभि युध्य ।मा त्वा तनदीशिषे वीर्यस्योभयेभ्यः प्र चिकित्सा गविष्टौ ॥
verses.transliteration: devéna ǀ naḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ deva ǀ soma ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ sahasā-van ǀ abhí ǀ yudhya ǀmā́ ǀ tvā ǀ ā́ ǀ tanat ǀ ī́śiṣe ǀ vīryásya ǀ ubháyebhyaḥ ǀ prá ǀ cikitsa ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine and potent Soma, bestow upon us, with your brilliant mind, a portion of wealth; may no (adversary) annoy you; you are supreme over the valour of (any) two (mutual) opponents; defend us (from our enemies) in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine and potent Soma, bestow upon us, with your brilliant mind, a portion of wealth; may no (adversary) annoy you; you are supreme over the valour of (any) two (mutual) opponents; defend us (from our enemies) in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XCII. Dawn.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THESE Dawns have raised their banner; in the eastern half of the mid-air they spread abroad their shining light.Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the war, onward they come bright red in hue, the Mother Cows. Readily have the purple beams of light shot up; the Red Cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked.The Dawns have brought distinct perception as before: red-hued, they have attained their fulgent brilliancy. They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away,Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice. She, like a dancer, puts her broidered garments on: as a cow yields her udder so she bares her breast.Creating light for all the world of life, the Dawn hath laid the darkness open as the cows their stall. We have beheld the brightness of her shining; it spreads and drives away the darksome monster.Like tints that deck the Post at sacrifices, Heaven's Daughter hath attained her wondrous splendour. We have o’erpast the limit of this darkness; Dawn breaking forth again brings clear perception.She like a flatterer smiles in light for glory, and fair of face hath wakened to rejoice us. The Gotamas have praised Heaven's radiant Daughter, the leader of the charm of pleasant voices.Dawn, thou conferrest on us strength with offspring and men, conspicuous with kine and horses. O thou who shinest forth in wondrous glory, urged onward by thy strength, auspicious Lady,Dawn, may I gain that wealth, renowned and ample, in brave sons, troops of slaves, far-famed for horses. Bending her looks on all the world, the Goddess shines, widely spreading with her bright eye westward.Waking to motion every living creature, she understands the voice of each adorer. Ancient of days, again again born newly, decking her beauty with the self-same raiment.The Goddess wastes away the life of mortals, like a skilled hunter cutting birds in pieces. She hath appeared discovering heaven's borders: to the far distance she drives off her Sister.Diminishing the days of human creatures, the Lady shines with all her lover's splendour. The bright, the blessed One shines forth extending her rays like kine, as a flood rolls his waters.Never transgressing the divine commandments, she is beheld visible with the sunbeams. O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us the wondrous giftWherewith we may support children and children's sons. Thou radiant mover of sweet sounds, with wealth of horses and of kineShine thou on us this day, O Dawn auspiciously. O Dawn enriched with holy rites, yoke to thy car thy purple steeds,And then bring thou unto us all felicities. O Aśvins wonderful in act, do ye unanimous directYour chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold. Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to man,Do ye, O Aśvins, bring strength hither unto us. Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma both the GodsHealth-givers Wonder-Workers, borne on paths of gold.

verses.sanskrit: एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमंजते ।निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावोऽरुषीर्यंति मातरः ॥
verses.transliteration: etā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ketúm ǀ akrata ǀ pū́rve ǀ árdhe ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ bhānúm ǀ añjate ǀniḥ-kṛṇvānā́ḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni-iva ǀ dhṛṣṇávaḥ ǀ práti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ yanti ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: THESE Dawns have raised their banner; in the eastern half of the mid-air they spread abroad their shining light. Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the war, onward they come bright red in hue, the Mother Cows.
verses.wilson_translation: These divinities of the morning have spread light (over the world); they make manifest the light in the eastern portion of the firmament, brightening all things, like warriors burnishing their weapons; the radiant and progressing mothers (of the earth), they travel daily (on their course).
verses.griffith_verse: THESE Dawns have raised their banner; in the eastern half of the mid-air they spread abroad their shining light. Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the war, onward they come bright red in hue, the Mother Cows.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत ।अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशंतं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ apaptan ǀ aruṇā́ḥ ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ su-āyújaḥ ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ayukṣata ǀákran ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vayúnāni ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀ rúśantam ǀ bhānúm ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ aśiśrayuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Readily have the purple beams of light shot up; the Red Cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked. The Dawns have brought distinct perception as before: red-hued, they have attained their fulgent brilliancy.
verses.wilson_translation: Their purple rays have readily shot upwards; they have yoked the easily-yoked and ruddy kine (to their car); the deities of the dawn have restored, as of yore, the consciousness (of sentient creatures), and bright-rayed have attended upon the glorious sun.
verses.griffith_verse: Readily have the purple beams of light shot up; the Red Cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked. The Dawns have brought distinct perception as before: red-hued, they have attained their fulgent brilliancy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अर्चंति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः ।इषं वहंतीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: árcanti ǀ nā́rīḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ viṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ samānéna ǀ yójanena ǀ ā́ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀíṣam ǀ váhantīḥ ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ su-dā́nave ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ áha ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǁ
verses.english_translation: They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away, Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice.
verses.wilson_translation: The feminine le leaders (of the morning) illuminate with their inherent radiance the remotest parts (of the heaven), with a simultaneous effort, like warriors (with their shining arms in the van of battle), bringing every kind of food to the performer of good works, to the bountiful, and to the worshipper who presents libations.
verses.griffith_verse: They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away, Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अधि पेशांसि वपते नृतूरिवापोर्णुते वक्ष उस्रेव बर्जहं ।ज्योतिर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय कृण्वती गावो न व्रजं व्युषा आवर्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhi ǀ péśāṃsi ǀ vapate ǀ nṛtū́ḥ-iva ǀ ápa ǀ ūrṇute ǀ vákṣaḥ ǀ usrā́-iva ǀ bárjaham ǀjyótiḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ bhúvanāya ǀ kṛṇvatī́ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vrajám ǀ ví ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǀ támaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: She, like a dancer, puts her broidered garments on: as a cow yields her udder so she bares her breast. Creating light for all the world of life, the Dawn hath laid the darkness open as the cows their stall.
verses.wilson_translation: Uṣas cuts off the accusative ulated (glooms), as a barber (cuts off the hair); she bares her bosom as a cow yields her udder (to the milker); and, as cattle hasten to their pastures, she speeds to the east, and shedding light upon all the world, dissipates the darkness.
verses.griffith_verse: She, like a dancer, puts her broidered garments on: as a cow yields her udder so she bares her breast. Creating light for all the world of life, the Dawn hath laid the darkness open as the cows their stall.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यर्ची रुशदस्या अदर्शि वि तिष्ठते बाधते कृष्णमभ्वं ।स्वरुं न पेशो विदथेष्वंजञ्चित्रं दिवो दुहिता भानुमश्रेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ arcíḥ ǀ rúśat ǀ asyāḥ ǀ adarśi ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhate ǀ bā́dhate ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ ábhvam ǀsvárum ǀ ná ǀ péśaḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ añján ǀ citrám ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ bhānúm ǀ aśret ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have beheld the brightness of her shining; it spreads and drives away the darksome monster. Like tints that deck the Post at sacrifices, Heaven's Daughter hath attained her wondrous splendour.
verses.wilson_translation: Her brilliant light is first seen towards (the east); it spreads and disperses the thick darkness; she anoints her beauty as the priests anoint the sacrificial food in sacrifices; the daughter of the sky awaits the glorious sun.
verses.griffith_verse: We have beheld the brightness of her shining; it spreads and drives away the darksome monster. Like tints that deck the Post at sacrifices, Heaven's Daughter hath attained her wondrous splendour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्योषा उच्छंती वयुना कृणोति ।श्रिये छंदो न स्मयते विभाती सुप्रतीका सौमनसायाजीगः ॥
verses.transliteration: átāriṣma ǀ támasaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ asyá ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchántī ǀ vayúnā ǀ kṛṇoti ǀśriyé ǀ chándaḥ ǀ ná ǀ smayate ǀ vi-bhātī́ ǀ su-prátīkā ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have o’erpast the limit of this darkness; Dawn breaking forth again brings clear perception. She like a flatterer smiles in light for glory, and fair of face hath wakened to rejoice us.
verses.wilson_translation: We have crossed over the boundary of darkness. Uṣas restores the consciousness (of living beings); bright-shining, she smiles, like a flatterer to obtain favour, and, lovely in all her radiance, she has swallowed, for our delight the darkness.
verses.griffith_verse: We have o’erpast the limit of this darkness; Dawn breaking forth again brings clear perception. She like a flatterer smiles in light for glory, and fair of face hath wakened to rejoice us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: भास्वती नेत्री सूनृतानां दिवः स्तवे दुहिता गोतमेभिः ।प्रजावतो नृवतो अश्वबुध्यानुषो गोअग्राँ उप मासि वाजान् ॥
verses.transliteration: bhā́svatī ǀ netrī́ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ diváḥ ǀ stave ǀ duhitā́ ǀ gótamebhiḥ ǀprajā́-vataḥ ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ áśva-budhyān ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ gó-agrān ǀ úpa ǀ māsi ǀ vā́jān ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Gotamas have praised Heaven's radiant Daughter, the leader of the charm of pleasant voices. Dawn, thou conferrest on us strength with offspring and men, conspicuous with kine and horses.
verses.wilson_translation: The brilliant daughter of the sky, the exciter of plural asant voices, is praised by the descendants of Gotama. Uṣas, grant us food associated with progeny and dependants, and distinguished by horses and cattle.
verses.griffith_verse: The Gotamas have praised Heaven's radiant Daughter, the leader of the charm of pleasant voices. Dawn, thou conferrest on us strength with offspring and men, conspicuous with kine and horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उषस्तमश्यां यशसं सुवीरं दासप्रवर्गं रयिमश्वबुध्यं ।सुदंससा श्रवसा या विभासि वाजप्रसूता सुभगे बृहंतं ॥
verses.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ tám ǀ aśyām ǀ yaśásam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ dāsá-pravargam ǀ rayím ǀ áśva-budhyam ǀsu-dáṃsasā ǀ śrávasā ǀ yā́ ǀ vi-bhā́si ǀ vā́ja-prasūtā ǀ su-bhage ǀ bṛhántam ǁ
verses.english_translation: O thou who shinest forth in wondrous glory, urged onward by thy strength, auspicious Lady, Dawn, may I gain that wealth, renowned and ample, in brave sons, troops of slaves, far-famed for horses.
verses.wilson_translation: May I obtain, Uṣas, that ample wealth with confers fame, posterity, troops of slaves, and is characterized by horses; which you, who abount in riches and are the giver of food, display, (when gratified) by hymns and holy sacrifices.
verses.griffith_verse: O thou who shinest forth in wondrous glory, urged onward by thy strength, auspicious Lady, Dawn, may I gain that wealth, renowned and ample, in brave sons, troops of slaves, far-famed for horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानि देवी भुवनाभिचक्ष्या प्रतीची चक्षुरुर्विया वि भाति ।विश्वं जीवं चरसे बोधयंती विश्वस्य वाचमविदन्मनायोः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ devī́ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhi-cákṣya ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀvíśvam ǀ jīvám ǀ caráse ǀ bodháyantī ǀ víśvasya ǀ vā́cam ǀ avidat ǀ manāyóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bending her looks on all the world, the Goddess shines, widely spreading with her bright eye westward. Waking to motion every living creature, she understands the voice of each adorer.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine (Uṣas), having lighted up the whole world, spreads, expanding with her radiance, towards the west, arousing all living creatures to their labours; she hears the speech of all endowed with thought.
verses.griffith_verse: Bending her looks on all the world, the Goddess shines, widely spreading with her bright eye westward. Waking to motion every living creature, she understands the voice of each adorer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पुनःपुनर्जायमाना पुराणी समानं वर्णमभि शुंभमाना ।श्वघ्नीव कृत्नुर्विज आमिनाना मर्तस्य देवी जरयंत्यायुः ॥
verses.transliteration: púnaḥ-punaḥ ǀ jā́yamānā ǀ purāṇī́ ǀ samānám ǀ várṇam ǀ abhí ǀ śúmbhamānā ǀśvaghnī́-iva ǀ kṛtnúḥ ǀ víjaḥ ǀ ā-minānā́ ǀ mártasya ǀ devī́ ǀ jaráyantī ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ancient of days, again again born newly, decking her beauty with the self-same raiment. The Goddess wastes away the life of mortals, like a skilled hunter cutting birds in pieces.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine and ancient Uṣas, born again and again and bright with unchanging hues, wastes away the life of a mortal, like the wife of a hunter cutting up and dividing the birds.
verses.griffith_verse: Ancient of days, again again born newly, decking her beauty with the self-same raiment. The Goddess wastes away the life of mortals, like a skilled hunter cutting birds in pieces.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: व्यूर्ण्वती दिवो अंताँ अबोध्यप स्वसारं सनुतर्युयोति ।प्रमिनती मनुष्या युगानि योषा जारस्य चक्षसा वि भाति ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-ūrṇvatī́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántān ǀ abodhi ǀ ápa ǀ svásāram ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ yuyoti ǀpra-minatī́ ǀ manuṣyā́ ǀ yugā́ni ǀ yóṣā ǀ jārásya ǀ cákṣasā ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: She hath appeared discovering heaven's borders: to the far distance she drives off her Sister. Diminishing the days of human creatures, the Lady shines with all her lover's splendour.
verses.wilson_translation: She has been seen illuminating the boundaries of the sky, and driving into disappearance the spontaneously-retiring (night); wearing away the ages of the human race, she shines with light like the bride of the sun.
verses.griffith_verse: She hath appeared discovering heaven's borders: to the far distance she drives off her Sister. Diminishing the days of human creatures, the Lady shines with all her lover's splendour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पशून्न चित्रा सुभगा प्रथाना सिंधुर्न क्षोद उर्विया व्यश्वैत् ।अमिनती दैव्यानि व्रतानि सूर्यस्य चेति रश्मिभिर्दृशाना ॥
verses.transliteration: paśū́n ǀ ná ǀ citrā́ ǀ su-bhágā ǀ prathānā́ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ aśvait ǀáminatī ǀ dáivyāni ǀ vratā́ni ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ceti ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ dṛśānā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bright, the blessed One shines forth extending her rays like kine, as a flood rolls his waters. Never transgressing the divine commandments, she is beheld visible with the sunbeams.
verses.wilson_translation: The affluent and adorable Uṣas has sent her rays abroad, as (a cowherd drives) the cattle (to pasture), and spreads expansive, like flowing water; she is beheld associated with the rays of the sun, unimpeding sacred ceremonies.
verses.griffith_verse: The bright, the blessed One shines forth extending her rays like kine, as a flood rolls his waters. Never transgressing the divine commandments, she is beheld visible with the sunbeams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति ।येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ tát ǀ citrám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ asmábhyam ǀ vājinī-vati ǀyéna ǀ tokám ǀ ca ǀ tánayam ǀ ca ǀ dhā́mahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us the wondrous gift Wherewith we may support children and children's sons.
verses.wilson_translation: Uṣas, possessor of food, bring us that various wealth by which we may sustain sons and grandsons.
verses.griffith_verse: O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us the wondrous gift Wherewith we may support children and children's sons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि ।रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति ॥
verses.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ihá ǀ go-mati ǀ áśva-vati ǀ vibhā-vari ǀrevát ǀ asmé íti ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ sūnṛtā-vati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou radiant mover of sweet sounds, with wealth of horses and of kine Shine thou on us this day, O Dawn auspiciously.
verses.wilson_translation: Luminous Uṣas, possessor of cows and horses, true of speech, dawn here today upon this (ceremony), that is to bring us wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou radiant mover of sweet sounds, with wealth of horses and of kine Shine thou on us this day, O Dawn auspiciously.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वाँ अद्यारुणाँ उषः ।अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ vājinī-vati ǀ áśvān ǀ adyá ǀ aruṇā́n ǀ uṣaḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ sáubhagāni ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Dawn enriched with holy rites, yoke to thy car thy purple steeds, And then bring thou unto us all felicities.
verses.wilson_translation: Possessor of food, Uṣas, yoke, indeed, today your purple steeds and bring to us all good things.
verses.griffith_verse: O Dawn enriched with holy rites, yoke to thy car thy purple steeds, And then bring thou unto us all felicities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ।अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतं ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ vartíḥ ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ gó-mat ǀ dasrā ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀarvā́k ǀ rátham ǀ sá-manasā ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Aśvins wonderful in act, do ye unanimous direct Your chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, destroyers of foes, turn with favourable intentions your chariot towards our abode, which contains cattle and gold.
verses.griffith_verse: O Aśvins wonderful in act, do ye unanimous direct Your chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः ।आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवं ॥
verses.transliteration: yáu ǀ itthā́ ǀ ślókam ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ jánāya ǀ cakráthuḥ ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ vahatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to man, Do ye, O Aśvins, bring strength hither unto us.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, who have sent adorable light from heaven to man, bring us strength.
verses.griffith_verse: Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to man, Do ye, O Aśvins, bring strength hither unto us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी ।उषर्बुधो वहंतु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ devā́ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ dasrā́ ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀuṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma both the Gods Health-givers Wonder-Workers, borne on paths of gold.
verses.wilson_translation: May the steeds awakened at dawn bring hither, to drink the Soma, the divine Aśvins, who are the givers o fhappiness, the destroyers of foes, seated in a golden chariot.
verses.griffith_verse: Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma both the Gods Health-givers Wonder-Workers, borne on paths of gold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XCIII. Agni-Soma.
hymns.anukramani: १२ गोतमो राहूगणः। अग्निषोमौ। १-३ अनुष्टुप्, ४-७, १२ त्रिष्टुप्,  ८ जगती त्रिष्टुब्वा, ९-११ गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: AGNI and Soma, mighty Pair, graciously hearken to my call,Accept in friendly wise my hymn, and prosper him who offers gifts. The man who honours you to-day, Agni and Soma, with this hymn,Bestow on him heroic strength, increase of kine, and noble steeds. The man who offers holy oil and burnt oblations unto you,Agni and Soma, shall enjoy great strength, with offspring, all his life. Agni and Soma, famed is that your. prowess wherewith ye stole the kine, his food, from Paṇi.Ye caused the brood of Bṛsaya to perish; ye found the light, the single light for many. Agni and Soma, joined in operation ye have set up the shining lights in heaven.From curse and from reproach, Agni and Soma, ye freed the rivers that were bound in fetters. One of you Mātariśvan brought from heaven, the Falcon rent the other from the mountain.Strengthened by holy prayer Agni and Soma have made us ample room for sacrificing. Taste, Agni, Soma, this prepared oblation; accept it, Mighty Ones, and let it please you.Vouchsafe us good protection and kind favour: grant to the sacrificer health and riches. Whoso with oil and poured oblation honours, with God-devoted heart, Agni and Soma,—Protect his sacrifice, preserve him from distress, grant to the sacrificer great felicity. Invoked together, mates in wealth, Agni-Soma, accept our hymns:Together be among the Gods. Agni and Soma, unto him who worships you with holy oilShine forth an ample recompense. Agni and Soma, be ye pleased with these oblations brought to you,And come, together, nigh to us. Agni and Soma, cherish well our horses, and let our cows be fat who yield oblations.Grant power to us and to our wealthy patrons, and cause our holy rites to be successful.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमाविमं सु मे शृणुतं वृषणा हवं ।प्रति सूक्तानि हर्यतं भवतं दाशुषे मयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomau ǀ imám ǀ sú ǀ me ǀ śṛṇutám ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ hávam ǀpráti ǀ su-uktā́ni ǀ haryatam ǀ bhávatam ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ máyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: AGNI and Soma, mighty Pair, graciously hearken to my call, Accept in friendly wise my hymn, and prosper him who offers gifts.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, showerers (of desires), favourably hear this my invocation, graciously accept my hymns, and bestow felicity on the donor (of the oblation).
verses.griffith_verse: AGNI and Soma, mighty Pair, graciously hearken to my call, Accept in friendly wise my hymn, and prosper him who offers gifts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा यो अद्य वामिदं वचः सपर्यति ।तस्मै धत्तं सुवीर्यं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ yáḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vām ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ saparyáti ǀtásmai ǀ dhattam ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ gávām ǀ póṣam ǀ su-áśvyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man who honours you to-day, Agni and Soma, with this hymn, Bestow on him heroic strength, increase of kine, and noble steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, grant to him who addresses this prayer to you both, store of cattle with sound strength and good horses.
verses.griffith_verse: The man who honours you to-day, Agni and Soma, with this hymn, Bestow on him heroic strength, increase of kine, and noble steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा य आहुतिं यो वां दाशाद्धविष्कृतिं ।स प्रजया सुवीर्यं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ dā́śāt ǀ havíḥ-kṛtim ǀsáḥ ǀ pra-jáyā ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnavat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man who offers holy oil and burnt oblations unto you, Agni and Soma, shall enjoy great strength, with offspring, all his life.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, may he who offers you the oblation of clarified butter, enjoy sound strength, with progeny, through all his life.
verses.griffith_verse: The man who offers holy oil and burnt oblations unto you, Agni and Soma, shall enjoy great strength, with offspring, all his life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा चेति तद्वीर्यं वां यदमुष्णीतमवसं पणिं गाः ।अवातिरतं बृसयस्य शेषोऽविंदतं ज्योतिरेकं बहुभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ céti ǀ tát ǀ vīryám ǀ vām ǀ yát ǀ ámuṣṇītam ǀ avasám ǀ paṇím ǀ gā́ḥ ǀáva ǀ atiratam ǀ bṛ́sayasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀ ávindatam ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ékam ǀ bahú-bhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni and Soma, famed is that your. prowess wherewith ye stole the kine, his food, from Paṇi. Ye caused the brood of Bṛsaya to perish; ye found the light, the single light for many.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, that prowess of yours, by which you have carried off the cows that were the food of Paṇi, is (well) known to us; you have slain the offspring of Bṛsya and you have obtained the luminary (the sun), for the benefit of the many.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni and Soma, famed is that your. prowess wherewith ye stole the kine, his food, from Paṇi. Ye caused the brood of Bṛsaya to perish; ye found the light, the single light for many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: युवमेतानि दिवि रोचनान्यग्निश्च सोम सक्रतू अधत्तं ।युवं सिंधूँरभिशस्तेरवद्यादग्नीषोमावमुंचतं गृभीतान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ etā́ni ǀ diví ǀ rocanā́ni ǀ agníḥ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ sákratū íti sá-kratū ǀ adhattam ǀyuvám ǀ síndhūn ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ avadyā́t ǀ ágnīṣomau ǀ ámuñcatam ǀ gṛbhītā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni and Soma, joined in operation ye have set up the shining lights in heaven. From curse and from reproach, Agni and Soma, ye freed the rivers that were bound in fetters.
verses.wilson_translation: You two,Agniand Soma, acting together, have sustained these constallations in the sky; you have liberated the rivers that had been defiled from the notorious imputation.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni and Soma, joined in operation ye have set up the shining lights in heaven. From curse and from reproach, Agni and Soma, ye freed the rivers that were bound in fetters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आन्यं दिवो मातरिश्वा जभारामथ्नादन्यं परि श्येनो अद्रेः ।अग्नीषोमा ब्रह्मणा वावृधानोरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुरु लोकं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ anyám ǀ diváḥ ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ jabhāra ǀ ámathnāt ǀ anyám ǀ pári ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ádreḥ ǀágnīṣomā ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vavṛdhānā́ ǀ urúm ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
verses.english_translation: One of you Mātariśvan brought from heaven, the Falcon rent the other from the mountain. Strengthened by holy prayer Agni and Soma have made us ample room for sacrificing.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, the wind brought one of you from heaven, a hawk carried off the other by force from the summit of the mountain; growing vast by praise, you have made the world wide for (the performance of) sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: One of you Mātariśvan brought from heaven, the Falcon rent the other from the mountain. Strengthened by holy prayer Agni and Soma have made us ample room for sacrificing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा हविषः प्रस्थितस्य वीतं हर्यतं वृषणा जुषेथां ।सुशर्माणा स्ववसा हि भूतमथा धत्तं यजमानाय शं योः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ prá-sthitasya ǀ vītám ǀ háryatam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣéthām ǀsu-śármāṇā ǀ su-ávasā ǀ hí ǀ bhūtám ǀ átha ǀ dhattam ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Taste, Agni, Soma, this prepared oblation; accept it, Mighty Ones, and let it please you. Vouchsafe us good protection and kind favour: grant to the sacrificer health and riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, partake of the proffered oblation; be gracious to us; showerers (of desires), be plural ased; prosperous and diligent protectors, be propitious, and grant to the sacrificer health and exemption from illness.
verses.griffith_verse: Taste, Agni, Soma, this prepared oblation; accept it, Mighty Ones, and let it please you. Vouchsafe us good protection and kind favour: grant to the sacrificer health and riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यो अग्नीषोमा हविषा सपर्याद्देवद्रीचा मनसा यो घृतेन ।तस्य व्रतं रक्षतं पातमंहसो विशे जनाय महि शर्म यच्छतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agnī́ṣómā ǀ havíṣā ǀ saparyā́t ǀ devadrī́cā ǀ mánasā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀtásya ǀ vratám ǀ rakṣatam ǀ pātám ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ viśé ǀ jánāya ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whoso with oil and poured oblation honours, with God-devoted heart, Agni and Soma,— Protect his sacrifice, preserve him from distress, grant to the sacrificer great felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, protect his sacrifice and defend him from illness, who, with a mind devoted to the gods, worships you with clarified butter and oblations; grant to the man engaged (in devotion) extreme felicity.
verses.griffith_verse: Whoso with oil and poured oblation honours, with God-devoted heart, Agni and Soma,— Protect his sacrifice, preserve him from distress, grant to the sacrificer great felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा सवेदसा सहूती वनतं गिरः ।सं देवत्रा बभूवथुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ sá-vedasā ǀ sáhūtī íti sá-hūtī ǀ vanatam ǀ gíraḥ ǀsám ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ babhūvathuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invoked together, mates in wealth, Agni-Soma, accept our hymns: Together be among the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, endowed with the like wealth, and invoked by a common invocation, share our praises, for you have (ever) been the chief of the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Invoked together, mates in wealth, Agni-Soma, accept our hymns: Together be among the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमावनेन वां यो वां घृतेन दाशति ।तस्मै दीदयतं बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomau ǀ anéna ǀ vām ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ ghṛténa ǀ dā́śati ǀtásmai ǀ dīdayatam ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni and Soma, unto him who worships you with holy oil Shine forth an ample recompense.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, give ample (recompense) to him who presents to you both, this clarified butter.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni and Soma, unto him who worships you with holy oil Shine forth an ample recompense.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमाविमानि नो युवं हव्या जुजोषतं ।आ यातमुप नः सचा ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomau ǀ imā́ni ǀ naḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ havyā́ ǀ jujoṣatam ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sácā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni and Soma, be ye pleased with these oblations brought to you, And come, together, nigh to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, bepleased with these our oblations, come to us together.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni and Soma, be ye pleased with these oblations brought to you, And come, together, nigh to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा पिपृतमर्वतो न आ प्यायंतामुस्रिया हव्यसूदः ।अस्मे बलानि मघवत्सु धत्तं कृणुतं नो अध्वरं श्रुष्टिमंतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ pipṛtám ǀ árvataḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pyāyantām ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ havya-sū́daḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ bálāni ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dhattam ǀ kṛṇutám ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ śruṣṭi-mántam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni and Soma, cherish well our horses, and let our cows be fat who yield oblations. Grant power to us and to our wealthy patrons, and cause our holy rites to be successful.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniand Soma, cherish our horses, and may our cows, affordin g(milk that yields butter for) oblations, be well nourished; give to us, who are affluent, strength (to perform) religious rites, and make our sacrifice productive of wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni and Soma, cherish well our horses, and let our cows be fat who yield oblations. Grant power to us and to our wealthy patrons, and cause our holy rites to be successful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XCIV. Agni
hymns.anukramani: १६ कुत्स आङ्गिरसः। अग्निः(जातवेदाः), ८ (त्रयः पादाः) देवाः, १६ उत्तरार्धस्य अग्निः, मित्रवरुणादितिसिन्धु पृथिवीद्यावो वा। जगती, १५-१६ त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: FOR Jātavedas worthy of our praise will we frame with our mind this eulogy as ’twere a car.For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. The man for whom thou sacrificest prospereth, dwelleth without a foe, gaineth heroic might.He waxeth strong, distress never approacheth him. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. May we have power to kindle thee. Fulfil our thoughts. In thee the Gods eat the presented offering,Bring hither the Ādityas, for we long for them. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. We will bring fuel and prepare burnt offerings, reminding thee at each successive festival.Fulfil our thought that so we may prolong our lives. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. His ministers move forth, the guardians of the folk, protecting quadruped and biped with their rays.Mighty art thou, the wondrous herald of the Dawn. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. Thou art Presenter and the chief Invoker, thou Director, Purifier, great High Priest by birth.Knowing all priestly work thou perfectest it, Sage. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. Lovely of form art thou, alike on every side; though far, thou shinest brightly as if close at hand.O God, thou seest through even the dark of night. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. Gods, foremost be his car who pours libations out, and let our hymn prevail o’er evil-hearted men.Attend to this our speech and make it prosper well. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. Smite with thy weapons those of evil speech and thought, devouring demons, whether near or tar away.Then to the singer give free way for sacrifice. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. When to thy chariot thou hadst yoked two red steeds and two ruddy steeds, wind-sped, thy roar was like a bull's.Thou with smoke-bannered flame attackest forest trees. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. Then at thy roar the very birds are terrified, when, eating-up the grass, thy sparks fly forth abroad.Then is it easy for thee and thy car to pass. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. He hath the Power to soothe Mitra and Varuṇa: wonderful is the Maruts’ wrath when they descend.Be gracious; let their hearts he turned to us again. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. Thou art a God, thou art the wondrous Friend of Gods, the Vasu of the Vasus, fair in sacrifice.Under, thine own most wide protection may we dwell. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. This is thy grace that, kindled in thine own abode, invoked with Soma thou soundest forth most benign,Thou givest wealth and treasure to the worshipper. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm. To whom thou, Lord of goodly riches, grantest freedom from every sin with perfect wholeness,Whom with good strength thouquickenest, with children and wealth—may we be they, Eternal Being. Such, Agni, thou who knowest all good fortune, God, lengthen here the days of our existence.This prayer of ours may Varuṇa grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sanskrit: इमं स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया ।भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य संसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ stómam ǀ árhate ǀ jātá-vedase ǀ rátham-iva ǀ sám ǀ mahema ǀ manīṣáyā ǀbhadrā́ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ asya ǀ sam-sádi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: FOR Jātavedas worthy of our praise will we frame with our mind this eulogy as ’twere a car. For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: To him who is worthy of praise, and all-knowing, we construct, with our minds, this hymn, as (a workman makes) a car; happy is our understanding when engaged in his adoration; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: FOR Jātavedas worthy of our praise will we frame with our mind this eulogy as ’twere a car. For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मै त्वमायजसे स साधत्यनर्वा क्षेति दधते सुवीर्यं ।स तूताव नैनमश्नोत्यंहतिरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmai ǀ tvám ǀ ā-yájase ǀ sáḥ ǀ sādhati ǀ anarvā́ ǀ kṣeti ǀ dádhate ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀsáḥ ǀ tūtāva ǀ ná ǀ enam ǀ aśnoti ǀ aṃhatíḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man for whom thou sacrificest prospereth, dwelleth without a foe, gaineth heroic might. He waxeth strong, distress never approacheth him. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: He, for whom you sacrifice, accomplishes (his objects), abides free from aggression, and enjoys (wealth, the source of) strength; he prospers, and poverty never approaches him; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: The man for whom thou sacrificest prospereth, dwelleth without a foe, gaineth heroic might. He waxeth strong, distress never approacheth him. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: शकेम त्वा समिधं साधया धियस्त्वे देवा हविरदंत्याहुतं ।त्वमादित्याँ आ वह तान्ह्युश्मस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: śakéma ǀ tvā ǀ sam-ídham ǀ sādháya ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ tvé íti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ adanti ǀ ā́-hutam ǀtvám ǀ ādityā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ tā́n ǀ hí ǀ uśmási ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we have power to kindle thee. Fulfil our thoughts. In thee the Gods eat the presented offering, Bring hither the Ādityas, for we long for them. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: May we be able to kindle you; perfect the rite, for through you the gods partake of the offered oblations; bring hither theĀdityas, for we love them; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: May we have power to kindle thee. Fulfil our thoughts. In thee the Gods eat the presented offering, Bring hither the Ādityas, for we long for them. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: भरामेध्मं कृणवामा हवींषि ते चितयंतः पर्वणापर्वणा वयं ।जीवातवे प्रतरं साधया धियोऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: bhárāma ǀ idhmám ǀ kṛṇávāma ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ te ǀ citáyantaḥ ǀ párvaṇā-parvaṇā ǀ vayám ǀjīvā́tave ǀ pra-tarám ǀ sādhaya ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: We will bring fuel and prepare burnt offerings, reminding thee at each successive festival. Fulfil our thought that so we may prolong our lives. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: We bring fuel, we offer oblations, reminding you of the successive seasons (of worship); do you thoroughly complete the rite, in order to prolong our lives; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: We will bring fuel and prepare burnt offerings, reminding thee at each successive festival. Fulfil our thought that so we may prolong our lives. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विशां गोपा अस्य चरंति जंतवो द्विपच्च यदुत चतुष्पदक्तुभिः ।चित्रः प्रकेत उषसो महाँ अस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: viśā́m ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ caranti ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ dvi-pát ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ utá ǀ cátuḥ-pat ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀcitráḥ ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: His ministers move forth, the guardians of the folk, protecting quadruped and biped with their rays. Mighty art thou, the wondrous herald of the Dawn. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: His genitive al (flames), the preservers of mankind, spread around, and both bipeds and quadrupeds are enlivened by his rays; shining with various lustre, and illuminating (the world by night), you are superior to the dawn; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: His ministers move forth, the guardians of the folk, protecting quadruped and biped with their rays. Mighty art thou, the wondrous herald of the Dawn. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमध्वर्युरुत होतासि पूर्व्यः प्रशास्ता पोता जनुषा पुरोहितः ।विश्वा विद्वाँ आर्त्विज्या धीर पुष्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ utá ǀ hótā ǀ asi ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ pra-śāstā́ ǀ pótā ǀ janúṣā ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ā́rtvijyā ǀ dhīra ǀ puṣyasi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou art Presenter and the chief Invoker, thou Director, Purifier, great High Priest by birth. Knowing all priestly work thou perfectest it, Sage. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: You are the sacrificing or the invoking priest, you are the principal (presenter of the offering), the director (of the ceremonies), their performer, or by birth the family priest; thus conversant with all the priestly functions, you perform perfectly the rite; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou art Presenter and the chief Invoker, thou Director, Purifier, great High Priest by birth. Knowing all priestly work thou perfectest it, Sage. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यो विश्वतः सुप्रतीकः सदृङ्ङसि दूरे चित्संतळिदिवाति रोचसे ।रात्र्याश्चिदंधो अति देव पश्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ su-prátīkaḥ ǀ sa-dṛ́ṅ ǀ ási ǀ dūré ǀ cit ǀ sán ǀ taḷít-iva ǀ áti ǀ rocase ǀrā́tryāḥ ǀ cit ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ áti ǀ deva ǀ paśyasi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lovely of form art thou, alike on every side; though far, thou shinest brightly as if close at hand. O God, thou seest through even the dark of night. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: You are of graceful form, and alike on every side, and, although remote, shine as if nigh; you see, divine Agni, beyond the darkness of night; let us not, Agni suffer injury through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: Lovely of form art thou, alike on every side; though far, thou shinest brightly as if close at hand. O God, thou seest through even the dark of night. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वो देवा भवतु सुन्वतो रथोऽस्माकं शंसो अभ्यस्तु दूढ्यः ।तदा जानीतोत पुष्यता वचोऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: pū́rvaḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀtát ǀ ā́ ǀ jānīta ǀ utá ǀ puṣyata ǀ vácaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Gods, foremost be his car who pours libations out, and let our hymn prevail o’er evil-hearted men. Attend to this our speech and make it prosper well. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: Gods, let the chariot of the offerer of the libation be foremost; let our denunciations overwhelm the wicked; understand and fulfil my words let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: Gods, foremost be his car who pours libations out, and let our hymn prevail o’er evil-hearted men. Attend to this our speech and make it prosper well. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वधैर्दुःशंसाँ अप दूढ्यो जहि दूरे वा ये अंति वा के चिदत्रिणः ।अथा यज्ञाय गृणते सुगं कृध्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: vadháiḥ ǀ duḥ-śáṃsān ǀ ápa ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ jahi ǀ dūré ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ánti ǀ vā ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ atríṇaḥ ǀátha ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ su-gám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Smite with thy weapons those of evil speech and thought, devouring demons, whether near or tar away. Then to the singer give free way for sacrifice. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: Overcome with your fatal (weapons) the wicked and the impious, all who are enemies, whether distant or near; and then provide an easy (path) for the sacrificer who praises you; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: Smite with thy weapons those of evil speech and thought, devouring demons, whether near or tar away. Then to the singer give free way for sacrifice. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यदयुक्था अरुषा रोहिता रथे वातजूता वृषभस्येव ते रवः ।आदिन्वसि वनिनो धूमकेतुनाग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ áyukthāḥ ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ róhitā ǀ ráthe ǀ vā́ta-jūtā ǀ vṛṣabhásya-iva ǀ te ǀ rávaḥ ǀā́t ǀ invasi ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ dhūmá-ketunā ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: When to thy chariot thou hadst yoked two red steeds and two ruddy steeds, wind-sped, thy roar was like a bull's. Thou with smoke-bannered flame attackest forest trees. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: When you have yoked the bright red horses (ete vai devāśvāḥ:Taittirīya Saṃhitā1.7.4.3), swift as the wind, to your car, your roar is like that of a bull, and you enwrap the forest trees with a banner of smoke; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: When to thy chariot thou hadst yoked two red steeds and two ruddy steeds, wind-sped, thy roar was like a bull's. Thou with smoke-bannered flame attackest forest trees. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अध स्वनादुत बिभ्युः पतत्रिणो द्रप्सा यत्ते यवसादो व्यस्थिरन् ।सुगं तत्ते तावकेभ्यो रथेभ्योऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ svanā́t ǀ utá ǀ bibhyuḥ ǀ patatríṇaḥ ǀ drapsā́ḥ ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ yavasa-ádaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ásthiran ǀsu-gám ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ tāvakébhyaḥ ǀ rathebhyáḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then at thy roar the very birds are terrified, when, eating-up the grass, thy sparks fly forth abroad. Then is it easy for thee and thy car to pass. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: At your roaring, even the birds are terrified; when your flames consuming the grass, have spread in all directions, (the wood) is easy of access to you and to your chariots; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: Then at thy roar the very birds are terrified, when, eating-up the grass, thy sparks fly forth abroad. Then is it easy for thee and thy car to pass. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अयं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धायसेऽवयातां मरुतां हेळो अद्भुतः ।मृळा सु नो भूत्वेषां मनः पुनरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ ava-yātā́m ǀ marútām ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀmṛḷá ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ bhū́tu ǀ eṣām ǀ mánaḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: He hath the Power to soothe Mitra and Varuṇa: wonderful is the Maruts’ wrath when they descend. Be gracious; let their hearts he turned to us again. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: May this, (your adorer) enjoy the support of Mitraand of Varuṇa; wonderful is the fury of the Maruts; (dwellers in the region) below (the heavens), encourage us, and may their minds again (be gracious) to us; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: He hath the Power to soothe Mitra and Varuṇa: wonderful is the Maruts’ wrath when they descend. Be gracious; let their hearts he turned to us again. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: देवो देवानामसि मित्रो अद्भुतो वसुर्वसूनामसि चारुरध्वरे ।शर्मन्त्स्याम तव सप्रथस्तमेऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ asi ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ asi ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀśárman ǀ syāma ǀ táva ǀ sapráthaḥ-tame ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou art a God, thou art the wondrous Friend of Gods, the Vasu of the Vasus, fair in sacrifice. Under, thine own most wide protection may we dwell. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: You, brilliant (Agni), are the especial friend of the gods; you, who are graceful in the sacrifice are the confirmer of all riches; may we be present in your most spacious chamber of sacrifice; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou art a God, thou art the wondrous Friend of Gods, the Vasu of the Vasus, fair in sacrifice. Under, thine own most wide protection may we dwell. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तत्ते भद्रं यत्समिद्धः स्वे दमे सोमाहुतो जरसे मृळयत्तमः ।दधासि रत्नं द्रविणं च दाशुषेऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ te ǀ bhadrám ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ své ǀ dáme ǀ sóma-āhutaḥ ǀ járase ǀ mṛḷayát-tamaḥ ǀdádhāsi ǀ rátnam ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: This is thy grace that, kindled in thine own abode, invoked with Soma thou soundest forth most benign, Thou givest wealth and treasure to the worshipper. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
