verses.wilson_translation: An invoker (of the gods), our instrumental uctor and protector has been born for the preservation of our patrons; may we, possessed of (sacrificial) food, be able to acquire worshipful, conquerable, and manageable riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यस्मिन्त्सप्त रश्मयस्तता यज्ञस्य नेतरि ।मनुष्वद्दैव्यमष्टमं पोता विश्वं तदिन्वति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ saptá ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ tatā́ḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ netári ǀmanuṣvát ǀ dáivyam ǀ aṣṭamám ǀ pótā ǀ víśvam ǀ tát ǀ invati ǁ
verses.english_translation: In whom, as conductor of the sacrifice, the seven rays are manifested, and who, as a human Potā, officiate in the eighth plural ce to perfect every divine (rite).
verses.wilson_translation: In whom, as conductor of the sacrifice, the seven rays are manifested, and who, as a human Potā, officiate in the eighth plural ce to perfect every divine (rite).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद्ब्रह्माणि वेरु तत् ।परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: dadhanvé ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ ánu ǀ vócat ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ véḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tát ǀpári ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀ nemíḥ ǀ cakrám-iva ǀ abhavat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever (offerings the priest) presents, whatever prayers he recites, he, (Agni), knows them all; he comprehends all priestly acts, as the circumference (includes the spokes) of a wheel.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever (offerings the priest) presents, whatever prayers he recites, he, (Agni), knows them all; he comprehends all priestly acts, as the circumference (includes the spokes) of a wheel.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: साकं हि शुचिना शुचिः प्रशास्ता क्रतुनाजनि ।विद्वाँ अस्य व्रता ध्रुवा वया इवानु रोहते ॥
verses.transliteration: sākám ǀ hí ǀ śúcinā ǀ śúciḥ ǀ pra-śāstā́ ǀ krátunā ǀ ájani ǀvidvā́n ǀ asya ǀ vratā́ ǀ dhruvā́ ǀ vayā́ḥ-iva ǀ ánu ǀ rohate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure regulator (of the sacrifice) is born verily together with the holy act; the wise (worshipper) performs all his, (Agni's), prescribed rites in succession, as the branches spring (from a common stem).
verses.wilson_translation: The pure regulator (of the sacrifice) is born verily together with the holy act; the wise (worshipper) performs all his, (Agni's), prescribed rites in succession, as the branches spring (from a common stem).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता अस्य वर्णमायुवो नेष्टुः सचंत धेनवः ।कुवित्तिसृभ्य आ वरं स्वसारो या इदं ययुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ várṇam ǀ āyúvaḥ ǀ néṣṭuḥ ǀ sacanta ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ tisṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ idám ǀ yayúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sister fingers, which are the kine of the Neṣṭā, are those which accomplish him, (Agni's), worship; and in various ways are combined for this purpose through the three (sacred fires).
verses.wilson_translation: The sister fingers, which are the kine of the Neṣṭā, are those which accomplish him, (Agni's), worship; and in various ways are combined for this purpose through the three (sacred fires).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदी मातुरुप स्वसा घृतं भरंत्यस्थित ।तासामध्वर्युरागतौ यवो वृष्टीव मोदते ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ mātúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ svásā ǀ ghṛtám ǀ bhárantī ǀ ásthita ǀtā́sām ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ ā́-gatau ǀ yávaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭī́-iva ǀ modate ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the sister (vessel), bearing the clarified butter, is plural ced near the maternal (altar), the Adhvaryurejoices at their approach, like barley (at the fall of) rain.
verses.wilson_translation: When the sister (vessel), bearing the clarified butter, is plural ced near the maternal (altar), the Adhvaryurejoices at their approach, like barley (at the fall of) rain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वः स्वाय धायसे कृणुतामृत्विगृत्विजं ।स्तोमं यज्ञं चादरं वनेमा ररिमा वयं ॥
verses.transliteration: sváḥ ǀ svā́ya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ kṛṇutā́m ǀ ṛtvík ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀstómam ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ ā́t ǀ áram ǀ vanéma ǀ rarimá ǀ vayám ǁ
verses.english_translation: May he, the ministering priest, discharge the office of priest at his own ceremony; and may we worthily repeat (his) praise, and offer (him) sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May he, the ministering priest, discharge the office of priest at his own ceremony; and may we worthily repeat (his) praise, and offer (him) sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यथा विद्वाँ अरं करद्विश्वेभ्यो यजतेभ्यः ।अयमग्ने त्वे अपि यं यज्ञं चकृमा वयं ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ vidvā́n ǀ áram ǀ kárat ǀ víśvebhyaḥ ǀ yajatébhyaḥ ǀayám ǀ agne ǀ tvé íti ǀ ápi ǀ yám ǀ yajñám ǀ cakṛmá ǀ vayám ǁ
verses.english_translation: And do you,Agni, (grant), that this wise (worshipper) may worthily offer (worship) to all the adorable (divinities), and that the sacrifice which we offer may also be perfected in you.
verses.wilson_translation: And do you,Agni, (grant), that this wise (worshipper) may worthily offer (worship) to all the adorable (divinities), and that the sacrifice which we offer may also be perfected in you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, accept this flaming brand, this waiting with my prayer on thee:Hear graciously these songs of praise. With this hymn let us honour thee, seeker of horses, Son of Strength,With this fair hymn, thou nobly born. As such, lover of song, with songs, wealth-lover, giver of our wealth!With reverence let us worship thee. Be thou for us a liberal Prince, giver and Lord of precious things.Drive those who hate us far away. Such as thou art, give rain from heaven, give strength which no man may resist:Give food exceeding plentiful. To him who lauds thee, craving help, most youthful envoy! through our song,Most holy Herald! come thou nigh. Between both races, Agni, Sage, well skilled thou passest to and fro,As envoy friendly to mankind. Befriend us thou as knowing all. Sage, duly worship thou the Gods,And seat thee on this sacred grass.

verses.sanskrit: इमां मे अग्ने समिधमिमामुपसदं वनेः ।इमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́m ǀ me ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídham ǀ imā́m ǀ upa-sádam ǀ vaneríti vaneḥ ǀimā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ śrudhi ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, accept this my fuel, this my oblation; listen, well plural ased, to my praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, accept this my fuel, this my oblation; listen, well plural ased, to my praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया ते अग्ने विधेमोर्जो नपादश्वमिष्टे ।एना सूक्तेन सुजात ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ vidhema ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ áśvam-iṣṭe ǀenā́ ǀ su-ukténa ǀ su-jāta ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we propitiate you,Agni, by this (oblation), grandsonof strength, (who are) gratified by prompt sacrifice, (may we plural ase you), well-born, by this hymn.
verses.wilson_translation: May we propitiate you,Agni, by this (oblation), grandsonof strength, (who are) gratified by prompt sacrifice, (may we plural ase you), well-born, by this hymn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा गीर्भिर्गिर्वणसं द्रविणस्युं द्रविणोदः ।सपर्येम सपर्यवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gírvaṇasam ǀ draviṇasyúm ǀ draviṇaḥ-daḥ ǀsaparyéma ǀ saparyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Granter of riches, may we, your worshippers, propitiate you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) wealth, and deserving of laudation, by our praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Granter of riches, may we, your worshippers, propitiate you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) wealth, and deserving of laudation, by our praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स बोधि सूरिर्मघवा वसुपते वसुदावन् ।युयोध्यस्मद्द्वेषांसि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ sūríḥ ǀ maghávā ǀ vásu-pate ǀ vásu-dāvan ǀyuyodhí ǀ asmát ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of wealth, giver of wealth, possessor of riches, who are wise, understand (our prayers), and scatter our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of wealth, giver of wealth, possessor of riches, who are wise, understand (our prayers), and scatter our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि स नो वाजमनर्वाणं ।स नः सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasríṇīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (For you are) he (who gives) us rain from heaven; he (who gives) us undecaying strenght, he (who gives) us infinite (abundance of) food.
verses.wilson_translation: (For you are) he (who gives) us rain from heaven; he (who gives) us undecaying strenght, he (who gives) us infinite (abundance of) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईळानायावस्यवे यविष्ठ दूत नो गिरा ।यजिष्ठ होतरा गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ī́ḷānāya ǀ avasyáve ǀ yáviṣṭha ǀ dūta ǀ naḥ ǀ girā́ ǀyájiṣṭha ǀ hotaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Youngest (of the gods), their messenger, their invoker, most deserving of worship, come, upon our praise, to him who offers (you) adoration, and is desirous of (your) protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Youngest (of the gods), their messenger, their invoker, most deserving of worship, come, upon our praise, to him who offers (you) adoration, and is desirous of (your) protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंतर्ह्यग्न ईयसे विद्वांजन्मोभया कवे ।दूतो जन्येव मित्र्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: antáḥ ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ ī́yase ǀ vidvā́n ǀ jánma ǀ ubháyā ǀ kave ǀdūtáḥ ǀ jányā-iva ǀ mítryaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sage Agni, you penetrate the innermost (man), knowing the birth of both (the worshipper and the worshipped); like a messenger favourable to men, especially to his friends.
verses.wilson_translation: Sage Agni, you penetrate the innermost (man), knowing the birth of both (the worshipper and the worshipped); like a messenger favourable to men, especially to his friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स विद्वाँ आ च पिप्रयो यक्षि चिकित्व आनुषक् ।आ चास्मिन्त्सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ piprayaḥ ǀ yákṣi ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀā́ ǀ ca ǀ asmín ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Agni, who are all-wise, fulfil (our desire); do you, who are intelligent, worship (the gods) in order; and sit down on this sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Agni, who are all-wise, fulfil (our desire); do you, who are intelligent, worship (the gods) in order; and sit down on this sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . VASU, thou most youthful God, Bhārata, Agni, bring us wealth,Excellent, splendid, much-desired. Let no malignity prevail against us, either God's or man's.Save us from this and enmity. So through thy favour may we force through all our enemies a way,As ’twere through streaming water-floods. Thou, Purifier Agni, high shinest forth, bright, adorable,When worshipped with the sacred oil. Ours art thou, Agni, Bhārata, honoured by us with barren cows,With bullocks and with kine in calf Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent,The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं यविष्ठ भारताग्ने द्युमंतमा भर ।वसो पुरुस्पृहं रयिं ॥
verses.transliteration: śréṣṭham ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ bhārata ǀ ágne ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀváso íti ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ rayím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Youngest (of the gods),Agnidescendant of Bhārata, granter of dwellings, bring (to us) excellent, splendid and enviable riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Youngest (of the gods),Agnidescendant of Bhārata, granter of dwellings, bring (to us) excellent, splendid and enviable riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो अरातिरीशत देवस्य मर्त्यस्य च ।पर्षि तस्या उत द्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ árātiḥ ǀ īśata ǀ devásya ǀ mártyasya ǀ ca ǀpárṣi ǀ tásyāḥ ǀ utá ǀ dviṣáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let no enemy prevail against us, whether of god or man; protect us from both such foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Let no enemy prevail against us, whether of god or man; protect us from both such foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वा उत त्वया वयं धारा उदन्या इव ।अति गाहेमहि द्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvāḥ ǀ utá ǀ tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ udanyā́ḥ-iva ǀáti ǀ gāhemahi ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us, through your favour, overwhelm all our foes like torrents of water.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us, through your favour, overwhelm all our foes like torrents of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुचिः पावक वंद्योऽग्ने बृहद्वि रोचसे ।त्वं घृतेभिराहुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ vándyaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ bṛhát ǀ ví ǀ rocase ǀtvám ǀ ghṛtébhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purifier,Agni, holy, adorable, you shine exceedingly when (you are) worshipped with (oblations of) butter.
verses.wilson_translation: Purifier,Agni, holy, adorable, you shine exceedingly when (you are) worshipped with (oblations of) butter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो असि भारताग्ने वशाभिरुक्षभिः ।अष्टापदीभिराहुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asi ǀ bhārata ǀ ágne ǀ vaśā́bhiḥ ǀ ukṣá-bhiḥ ǀaṣṭā́-padībhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, descendantof Bharatā, you are entirely ours, when sacrificed to with pregnant kine, with barren cows, or bulls.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, descendantof Bharatā, you are entirely ours, when sacrificed to with pregnant kine, with barren cows, or bulls.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्र्वन्नः सर्पिरासुतिः प्रत्नो होता वरेण्यः ।सहसस्पुत्रो अद्भुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: drú-annaḥ ǀ sarpíḥ-āsutiḥ ǀ pratnáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀsáhasaḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Feeder upon fuel, to whom butter is offered (you are) the ancient, the invoker of the gods, the excellent son of strength, the wonderful.
verses.wilson_translation: Feeder upon fuel, to whom butter is offered (you are) the ancient, the invoker of the gods, the excellent son of strength, the wonderful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII.Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ६ गृत्समद (आङ्गिरसः शौनहोत्रः पश्चाद्) भार्गवः शौनकः। अग्निः।गायत्री, ६ अनुष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Now praise, as one who strives for strength, the harnessing of Agni's car,The liberal, the most splendid One; Who, guiding worshippers aright, withers, untouched by age, the foe:When worshipped fair to look upon; Who for his glory is extolled at eve and morning in our homes,Whose statute is inviolate; Who shines refulgent like the Sun, with brilliance and with fiery flame,Decked with imperishable sheen. Him Atri, Agni, have our songs Strengthened according to his sway:All glories hath he made his own. May we with Agni's, Indra's help, with Soma's, yea, of all the Gods,Uninjured dwell together still, and conquer those who fight with us.

verses.sanskrit: वाजयन्निव नू रथान्योगाँ अग्नेरुप स्तुहि ।यशस्तमस्य मीळ्हुषः ॥
verses.transliteration: vājayán-iva ǀ nú ǀ ráthān ǀ yógān ǀ agnéḥ ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀyaśáḥ-tamasya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise quickly the yoked chariot of the glorious and munificent Agni, like one who is desirous of food.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise quickly the yoked chariot of the glorious and munificent Agni, like one who is desirous of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः सुनीथो ददाशुषेऽजुर्यो जरयन्नरिं ।चारुप्रतीक आहुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ su-nītháḥ ǀ dadāśúṣe ǀ ajuryáḥ ǀ jaráyan ǀ arím ǀcā́ru-pratīkaḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who, sagacious, invincible, and of graceful gait destroys, when propitiated, his foe, for him who presents (offerings).
verses.wilson_translation: Who, sagacious, invincible, and of graceful gait destroys, when propitiated, his foe, for him who presents (offerings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य उ श्रिया दमेष्वा दोषोषसि प्रशस्यते ।यस्य व्रतं न मीयते ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śriyā́ ǀ dámeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ doṣā́ ǀ uṣási ǀ pra-śasyáte ǀyásya ǀ vratám ǀ ná ǀ mī́yate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who invested with radiance, is glorified, morning and evening, in (our) dwelling; whose worship is never neglected.
verses.wilson_translation: Who invested with radiance, is glorified, morning and evening, in (our) dwelling; whose worship is never neglected.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यः स्वर्ण भानुना चित्रो विभात्यर्चिषा ।अंजानो अजरैरभि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhānúnā ǀ citráḥ ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ arcíṣā ǀañjānáḥ ǀ ajáraiḥ ǀ abhí ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who, many-tinted, shines with radiance, like the sun with (his) lustre, spreading (light) over (all) by his imperishable (flames).
verses.wilson_translation: Who, many-tinted, shines with radiance, like the sun with (his) lustre, spreading (light) over (all) by his imperishable (flames).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्रिमनु स्वराज्यमग्निमुक्थानि वावृधुः ।विश्वा अधि श्रियो दधे ॥
verses.transliteration: átrim ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǀ agním ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our praises have increased the self-irradiating devouringn Agni; he is possessed of all glory.
verses.wilson_translation: Our praises have increased the self-irradiating devouringn Agni; he is possessed of all glory.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेरिंद्रस्य सोमस्य देवानामूतिभिर्वयं ।अरिष्यंतः सचेमह्यभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sómasya ǀ devā́nām ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ vayám ǀáriṣyantaḥ ǀ sacemahi ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, uninjured, be secure in the protection of Agni,Indra,Somaand the gods, and confident in battle overcome (our enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: May we, uninjured, be secure in the protection of Agni,Indra,Somaand the gods, and confident in battle overcome (our enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ६ गृत्समद (आङ्गिरसः शौनहोत्रः पश्चाद्) भार्गवः शौनकः। अग्निः। त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ACCUSTOMED to the Herald's place, the Herald hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty,Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni. Envoy art thou, protector from the foeman, strong God, thou leadest us to higher blessings.Refulgent, be an ever-heedful keeper, Agni, for us and for our seed offspring. May we adore thee in thy loftiest birthplace, and, with our praises, in thy lower station.The place whence thou issued forth I worship: to thee well kindled have they paid oblations. Agni, best Priest, pay worship with oblation; quickly commend the gift to be presented;For thou art Lord of gathered wealth and treasure. of the bright song of praise thou art inventor. The twofold opulence, O Wonder-Worker, of thee new-born each day never decreases.Enrich with food the man who lauds thee, Agni: make him the lord of wealth with noble offspring. May he, benevolent with this fair aspect, best sacrificer, bring the Gods to bless us.Sure guardian, our protector from the foemen, shine, Agni, with thine affluence and splendour.

verses.sanskrit: नि होता होतृषदने विदानस्त्वेषो दीदिवाँ असदत्सुदक्षः ।अदब्धव्रतप्रमतिर्वसिष्ठः सहस्रंभरः शुचिजिह्वो अग्निः ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ hótā ǀ hotṛ-sádane ǀ vídānaḥ ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ dīdi-vā́n ǀ asadat ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀádabdhavrata-pramatiḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sahasram-bharáḥ ǀ śúci-jihvaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the intelligent, the resplendent, the radiant, the very powerful; he who knows (how to maintain) his rites undisturbed; who is steady in (his own) plural ce, and is the cherisher of thousands, sit in the station of the invoking priest.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the intelligent, the resplendent, the radiant, the very powerful; he who knows (how to maintain) his rites undisturbed; who is steady in (his own) plural ce, and is the cherisher of thousands, sit in the station of the invoking priest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं दूतस्त्वमु नः परस्पास्त्वं वस्य आ वृषभ प्रणेता ।अग्ने तोकस्य नस्तने तनूनामप्रयुच्छंदीद्यद्बोधि गोपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ḥ ǀ tvám ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ pra-netā́ ǀágne ǀ tokásya ǀ naḥ ǀ táne ǀ tanū́nām ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀ dī́dyat ǀ bodhi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer (of benefits),Agni, be you our messenger (to the gods); our preserver from evil; the conveyer to us of wealth; the protector of our sons and grandsons, and of our person ns; understand (our prayer), ever heedful and resplendent.
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer (of benefits),Agni, be you our messenger (to the gods); our preserver from evil; the conveyer to us of wealth; the protector of our sons and grandsons, and of our person ns; understand (our prayer), ever heedful and resplendent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्नग्ने विधेम स्तोमैरवरे सधस्थे ।यस्माद्योनेरुदारिथा यजे तं प्र त्वे हवींषि जुहुरे समिद्धे ॥
verses.transliteration: vidhéma ǀ te ǀ paramé ǀ jánman ǀ agne ǀ vidhéma ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ ávare ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀyásmāt ǀ yóneḥ ǀ ut-ā́ritha ǀ yáje ǀ tám ǀ prá ǀ tvé íti ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ juhure ǀ sám-iddhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We adore you,Agni, in your loftiest birth-(plural ce), and with hymns in thine inferior station; I worship that seat whence you have issued; the priests have offered you, when kindled oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: We adore you,Agni, in your loftiest birth-(plural ce), and with hymns in thine inferior station; I worship that seat whence you have issued; the priests have offered you, when kindled oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने यजस्व हविषा यजीयांछ्रुष्टी देष्णमभि गृणीहि राधः ।त्वं ह्यसि रयिपती रयीणां त्वं शुक्रस्य वचसो मनोता ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yájasva ǀ havíṣā ǀ yájīyān ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ deṣṇám ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ rayi-pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ tvám ǀ śukrásya ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ manótā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who are the chief of sacrificers, worship (the gods) with the oblation, and earnestly commend to them the (sacrificial) food that is to be given (them); for you, indeed, are the soverign lord of riches; you are the appreciator of our pious prayer.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who are the chief of sacrificers, worship (the gods) with the oblation, and earnestly commend to them the (sacrificial) food that is to be given (them); for you, indeed, are the soverign lord of riches; you are the appreciator of our pious prayer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उभयं ते न क्षीयते वसव्यं दिवेदिवे जायमानस्य दस्म ।कृधि क्षुमंतं जरितारमग्ने कृधि पतिं स्वपत्यस्य रायः ॥
verses.transliteration: ubháyam ǀ te ǀ ná ǀ kṣīyate ǀ vasavyám ǀ divé-dive ǀ jā́yamānasya ǀ dasma ǀkṛdhí ǀ kṣu-mántam ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ agne ǀ kṛdhí ǀ pátim ǀ su-apatyásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Beautiful Agni, the two dwelling-plural ces (heaven and earth) of you, who are born day by day, never perish; confer upon him who praises you (abundant) food, and make him the master of riches, (supporting) virtuous offering.
verses.wilson_translation: Beautiful Agni, the two dwelling-plural ces (heaven and earth) of you, who are born day by day, never perish; confer upon him who praises you (abundant) food, and make him the master of riches, (supporting) virtuous offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सैनानीकेन सुविदत्रो अस्मे यष्टा देवाँ आयजिष्ठः स्वस्ति ।अदब्धो गोपा उत नः परस्पा अग्ने द्युमदुत रेवद्दिदीहि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ ánīkena ǀ su-vidátraḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ yáṣṭā ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́-yajiṣṭhaḥ ǀ svastí ǀádabdhaḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ḥ ǀ ágne ǀ dyu-mát ǀ utá ǀ revát ǀ didīhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you with this (your) host (of attendants), be of good promise to us; do you, the especial worshipper of the gods, their unassailable protector, as well as our preserver, light up (all) with shining and affluent well-being.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you with this (your) host (of attendants), be of good promise to us; do you, the especial worshipper of the gods, their unassailable protector, as well as our preserver, light up (all) with shining and affluent well-being.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ६ गृत्समद (आङ्गिरसः शौनहोत्रः पश्चाद्) भार्गवः शौनकः। अग्निः। त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, first, loudly calling, like a Father, kindled by man upon the seat of worship.Clothed in his glory, deathless, keen of insight, must be adorned by all, the Strong, the Famous. May Agni the resplendent hear my calling through all my songs, Immortal, keen of insight.Dark steeds or ruddy draw his car, or carried in sundry ways he makes them red of colour. On wood supine they got the well-formed Infant: a germ in various-fashioned plants was Agni;And in the night, not compassed round by darkness, he dwells exceeding wise, with rays of splendour. With oil and sacred gifts I sprinkle Agni who makes his home in front of all things living,Broad, vast, through vital power o’er all expanded, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds him. I pour to him who looks in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit.Agni with bridegroom's grace and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury. By choice victorious, recognize thy portion: with thee for envoy may we speak like Manu.Obtaining wealth, I call on perfect Agni who with an eloquent tongue dispenses sweetness.

verses.sanskrit: जोहूत्रो अग्निः प्रथमः पितेवेळस्पदे मनुषा यत्समिद्धः ।श्रियं वसानो अमृतो विचेता मर्मृजेन्यः श्रवस्यः स वाजी ॥
verses.transliteration: johū́traḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ padé ǀ mánuṣā ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀśríyam ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀ marmṛjényaḥ ǀ śravasyáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The adorable Agni, the first (of the gods) and their nourisher when kindled by man upon the altar; he who is clothed in radiance, is immortal, discriminating, food-bestowing, powerful; he is to be worshipped.
verses.wilson_translation: The adorable Agni, the first (of the gods) and their nourisher when kindled by man upon the altar; he who is clothed in radiance, is immortal, discriminating, food-bestowing, powerful; he is to be worshipped.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रूया अग्निश्चित्रभानुर्हवं मे विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरमृतो विचेताः ।श्यावा रथं वहतो रोहिता वोतारुषाह चक्रे विभृत्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: śruyā́ḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ citrá-bhānuḥ ǀ hávam ǀ me ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀśyāvā́ ǀ rátham ǀ vahataḥ ǀ róhitā ǀ vā ǀ utá ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ áha ǀ cakre ǀ ví-bhṛtraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, who is immortal, of manifold wisdom, and wonderful splendour, hear my invocation, (preferred) with all laudations; tawny, or red, or purple horses draw his car; he has been borne in various directions.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, who is immortal, of manifold wisdom, and wonderful splendour, hear my invocation, (preferred) with all laudations; tawny, or red, or purple horses draw his car; he has been borne in various directions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानायामजनयन्त्सुषूतं भुवदग्निः पुरुपेशासु गर्भः ।शिरिणायां चिदक्तुना महोभिरपरीवृतो वसति प्रचेताः ॥
verses.transliteration: uttānā́yām ǀ ajanayan ǀ sú-sūtam ǀ bhúvat ǀ agníḥ ǀ puru-péśāsu ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀśíriṇāyām ǀ cit ǀ aktúnā ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ápari-vṛtaḥ ǀ vasati ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They have genitive rated (Agni) when soundly sleeping on his upturned (couch); that Agni who is an embryo in many (vegetable) forms, and who, (rendered manifest) by the oblations, abides conscious in the night, unenveloped by darkness.
verses.wilson_translation: They have genitive rated (Agni) when soundly sleeping on his upturned (couch); that Agni who is an embryo in many (vegetable) forms, and who, (rendered manifest) by the oblations, abides conscious in the night, unenveloped by darkness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जिघर्म्यग्निं हविषा घृतेन प्रतिक्षियंतं भुवनानि विश्वा ।पृथुं तिरश्चा वयसा बृहंतं व्यचिष्ठमन्नै रभसं दृशानं ॥
verses.transliteration: jígharmi ǀ agním ǀ havíṣā ǀ ghṛténa ǀ prati-kṣiyántam ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǀpṛthúm ǀ tiraścā́ ǀ váyasā ǀ bṛhántam ǀ vyáciṣṭham ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀ rabhasám ǀ dṛ́śānam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer oblations with butter to Agni, who spreads through all regions, vast, expanding, with all-comprehending form, nourished (with sacrificial) food, powerful, conspicuous.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer oblations with butter to Agni, who spreads through all regions, vast, expanding, with all-comprehending form, nourished (with sacrificial) food, powerful, conspicuous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ विश्वतः प्रत्यंचं जिघर्म्यरक्षसा मनसा तज्जुषेत ।मर्यश्रीः स्पृहयद्वर्णो अग्निर्नाभिमृशे तन्वा जर्भुराणः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pratyáñcam ǀ jigharmi ǀ arakṣásā ǀ mánasā ǀ tát ǀ juṣeta ǀmárya-śrīḥ ǀ spṛhayát-varṇaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ abhi-mṛ́śe ǀ tanvā́ ǀ járbhurāṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer oblations to Agni, who is present at all (sacrifices); may he accept (them), offered with an unhesitating mind, (to him) who is the refuge of man, endowed with any form that may be desired, blazing with a radiance (that it is) not (possible) to endure.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer oblations to Agni, who is present at all (sacrifices); may he accept (them), offered with an unhesitating mind, (to him) who is the refuge of man, endowed with any form that may be desired, blazing with a radiance (that it is) not (possible) to endure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञेया भागं सहसानो वरेण त्वादूतासो मनुवद्वदेम ।अनूनमग्निं जुह्वा वचस्या मधुपृचं धनसा जोहवीमि ॥
verses.transliteration: jñeyā́ḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ sahasānáḥ ǀ váreṇa ǀ tvā́-dūtāsaḥ ǀ manu-vát ǀ vadema ǀánūnam ǀ agním ǀ juhvā́ ǀ vacasyā́ ǀ madhu-pṛ́cam ǀ dhana-sā́ḥ ǀ johavīmi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Overpowering (your foes) with lustre, may you recognize your portion; may we, having you for our messenger, recite (praise) like Manu; desiring wealth, I offer oblation with the sacrificial ladle and with praises, to that entire Agni, who rewards (the worshipper) with the sweet (fruit) of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Overpowering (your foes) with lustre, may you recognize your portion; may we, having you for our messenger, recite (praise) like Manu; desiring wealth, I offer oblation with the sacrificial ladle and with praises, to that entire Agni, who rewards (the worshipper) with the sweet (fruit) of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: २१ गृत्समद (आङ्गिरसः शौनहोत्रः पश्चाद्) भार्गवः शौनकः। इन्द्रः। विराट् स्थाना, २१ त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HEAR thou my call, O Indra; be not heedless: thine may we be for thee to give us treasures;For these presented viands, seeking riches, increase thy strength like streams of water flowing. Floods great and many, compassed by the Dragon, thou badest swell and settest free, O Hero.Strengthened by songs of praise thou rentest piecemeal the Dāsa, him who deemed himself immortal. For, Hero, in the lauds wherein thou joyedst, in hymns of praise, O Indra, songs of Rudras,These streams in which is thy delight approach thee, even as the brilliant ones draw near to Vāyu. We who add strength to thine own splendid vigour, laying within thine arms the splendid thunder—With us mayst thou, O Indra, waxen splendid, with Sūrya overcome the Dāsa races. Hero, thou slewest in thy valour Ahi concealed in depths, mysterious, great enchanter,Dwelling enveloped deep within the waters, him who checked heaven and stayed the floods from flowing. Indra, we laud thy great deeds wrought aforetime, we laud thine exploits later of achievement;We laud the bolt that in thine arms lies eager; we laud thy two Bay Steeds, heralds of Sūrya. Indra, thy Bay Steeds showing forth their vigour have sent a loud cry out that droppeth fatness.The earth hath spread herself in all her fulness: the cloud that was about to move hath rested. Down, never ceasing, hath the rain-cloud settled: bellowing, it hath wandered with the Mothers.Swelling the roar in the far distant limits, they have spread wide the blast sent forth by Indra. Indra hath hurled down the magician Vṛtra who lay beleaguering the mighty river.Then both the heaven and earth trembled in terror at the strong Hero's thunder when he bellowed. Loud roared the mighty Hero's bolt of thunder, when he, the Friend of man, burnt up the monster,And, having drunk his fill of flowing Soma, baffled the guileful Dānava's devices. Drink thou, O Hero Indra, drink the Soma; let the joy-giving juices make thee joyful.They, filling both thy flanks, shall swell thy vigour. The juice that satisfies hath helped Indra. Singers have we become with thee, O Indra: may we serve duly and prepare devotion.Seeking thy help we meditate thy praises: may we at once enjoy thy gift of riches. May we be thine, such by thy help, O Indra, as swell thy vigour while they seek thy favour.Give us, thou God, the riches that we long for, most powerful, with stare of noble children. Give us a friend, give us an habitation; Indra, give us the company of Maruts,And those whose minds accord with theirs, the Vāyus, who drink the first libation of the Soma. Let those enjoy in whom thou art delighted. Indra, drink Soma for thy strength and gladness.Thou hast exalted us to heaven, Preserver, in battles, through the lofty hymns that praise thee. Great, verily, are they, O thou Protector, who by their songs of praise have won the blessing.They who strew sacred grass to be thy dwelling, helped by thee have got them strength, O Indra. Upon the great Trikadruka days, Hero, rejoicing thee, O Indra, drink the Soma.Come with Bay Steeds to drink of libation, shaking the drops from out thy beard, contented. Hero, assume the might wherewith thou clavest Vṛtra piecemeal, the Dānava Aurṇavābha.Thou hast disclosed the light to light the Ārya: on thy left hand, O Indra, sank the Dasyu. May we gain wealth, subduing with thy succour and with the Ārya, all our foes, the Dasyus.Our gain was that to Tṛta of our party thou gavest up Tvaṣṭar's son Viśvarūpa. He cast down Arbuda what time his vigour was strengthened by libations poured by Tṛta.Indra sent forth his whirling wheel like Sūrya, and aided by the Aṅgirases rent Vala. Now let that wealthy Cow of thine, O Indra, yield in return a boon to him who lauds thee.Give to thy praisers: let not fortune fail us. Loud may we speak, with brave men, in the assembly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवमिंद्र मा रिषण्यः स्याम ते दावने वसूनां ।इमा हि त्वामूर्जो वर्धयंति वसूयवः सिंधवो न क्षरंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ indra ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣaṇyaḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ te ǀ dāváne ǀ vásūnām ǀimā́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ vardháyanti ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣárantaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hear (my) invocation; disregard it not; may we be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures; these oblations, designed to obtain wealth, flowing (abundantly) like rivers, bring to you augmented vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hear (my) invocation; disregard it not; may we be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures; these oblations, designed to obtain wealth, flowing (abundantly) like rivers, bring to you augmented vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सृजो महीरिंद्र या अपिन्वः परिष्ठिता अहिना शूर पूर्वीः ।अमर्त्यं चिद्दासं मन्यमानमवाभिनदुक्थैर्वावृधानः ॥
verses.transliteration: sṛjáḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ápinvaḥ ǀ pári-sthitāḥ ǀ áhinā ǀ śūra ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀámartyam ǀ cit ǀ dāsám ǀ mányamānam ǀ áva ǀ abhinat ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hero, you have set free the copious (waters) which were formerly arrested by Ahi, and which you have distributed; invogorated by hymns, you have cast down headlong the slave, conceiting himself immortal.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hero, you have set free the copious (waters) which were formerly arrested by Ahi, and which you have distributed; invogorated by hymns, you have cast down headlong the slave, conceiting himself immortal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उक्थेष्विन्नु शूर येषु चाकन्स्तोमेष्विंद्र रुद्रियेषु च ।तुभ्येदेता यासु मंदसानः प्र वायवे सिस्रते न शुभ्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: ukthéṣu ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ śūra ǀ yéṣu ǀ cākán ǀ stómeṣu ǀ indra ǀ rudríyeṣu ǀ ca ǀtúbhya ǀ ít ǀ etā́ḥ ǀ yā́su ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ prá ǀ vāyáve ǀ sisrate ǀ ná ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hero, these brilliant (laudations), in (the form of) hymns, in which you delight, and in (that of) the praises uttered by the worshipper by which you are gratified, are addressed to you, to bring you (to your sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hero, these brilliant (laudations), in (the form of) hymns, in which you delight, and in (that of) the praises uttered by the worshipper by which you are gratified, are addressed to you, to bring you (to your sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुभ्रं नु ते शुष्मं वर्धयंतः शुभ्रं वज्रं बाह्वोर्दधानाः ।शुभ्रस्त्वमिंद्र वावृधानो अस्मे दासीर्विशः सूर्येण सह्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: śubhrám ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ vardháyantaḥ ǀ śubhrám ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀśubhráḥ ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ sahyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We are invigorating your brilliant strength (by our praises), and plural cing the thunderbolt in yourhands; do you,Indra, radiant, increasing in strenght, and (encouraged) by the sun, overpower, for our (good), the servile people.
verses.wilson_translation: We are invigorating your brilliant strength (by our praises), and plural cing the thunderbolt in yourhands; do you,Indra, radiant, increasing in strenght, and (encouraged) by the sun, overpower, for our (good), the servile people.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्स्वपीवृतं मायिनं क्षियंतं ।उतो अपो द्यां तस्तभ्वांसमहन्नहिं शूर वीर्येण ॥
verses.transliteration: gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ gúhyam ǀ gūḷhám ǀ ap-sú ǀ ápi-vṛtam ǀ māyínam ǀ kṣiyántam ǀutó íti ǀ apáḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ tastabhvā́ṃsam ǀ áhan ǀ áhim ǀ śūra ǀ vīryéṇa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hero, you have slain by your prow the glorified Ahi, hidden privy in a cave, lurking in concealment, covered by the waters in which he was abiding, and arresting the rains in the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hero, you have slain by your prow the glorified Ahi, hidden privy in a cave, lurking in concealment, covered by the waters in which he was abiding, and arresting the rains in the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तवा नु त इंद्र पूर्व्या महान्युत स्तवाम नूतना कृतानि ।स्तवा वज्रं बाह्वोरुशंतं स्तवा हरी सूर्यस्य केतू ॥
verses.transliteration: stáva ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pūrvyā́ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ utá ǀ stavāma ǀ nū́tanā ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀstáva ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ uśántam ǀ stáva ǀ hárī íti ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ketū́ íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: We glorify,Indra, your mighty (deeds) of old; we glorify your (more) recent exploits; we praise the thunderbolt shining in your arms, and we celebrate the horses, the signs of (Indra as) the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: We glorify,Indra, your mighty (deeds) of old; we glorify your (more) recent exploits; we praise the thunderbolt shining in your arms, and we celebrate the horses, the signs of (Indra as) the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हरी नु त इंद्र वाजयंता घृतश्चुतं स्वारमस्वार्ष्टां ।वि समना भूमिरप्रथिष्टारंस्त पर्वतश्चित्सरिष्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration: hárī íti ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vājáyantā ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǀ svārám ǀ asvārṣṭām ǀví ǀ samanā́ ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ aprathiṣṭá ǀ áraṃsta ǀ párvataḥ ǀ cit ǀ sariṣyán ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your swift horses,Indra, have uttered a loud sound, announcing rain; the level earth anxiously expects its fall, as the gathering cloud has passed.
verses.wilson_translation: Your swift horses,Indra, have uttered a loud sound, announcing rain; the level earth anxiously expects its fall, as the gathering cloud has passed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि पर्वतः साद्यप्रयुच्छन्त्सं मातृभिर्वावशानो अक्रान् ।दूरे पारे वाणीं वर्धयंत इंद्रेषितां धमनिं पप्रथन्नि ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ párvataḥ ǀ sādi ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀ sám ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ akrān ǀdūré ǀ pāré ǀ vā́ṇīm ǀ vardháyantaḥ ǀ índra-iṣitām ǀ dhamánim ǀ paprathan ǀ ní ǁ
verses.english_translation: The cloud, not heedless (of its office), is suspended (in the sky); resonant with maternal (waters), it has spread about; (the winds), augmenting the sound in the distant horizon; have promulgated the voice uttered by Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The cloud, not heedless (of its office), is suspended (in the sky); resonant with maternal (waters), it has spread about; (the winds), augmenting the sound in the distant horizon; have promulgated the voice uttered by Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो महां सिंधुमाशयानं मायाविनं वृत्रमस्फुरन्निः ।अरेजेतां रोदसी भियाने कनिक्रदतो वृष्णो अस्य वज्रात् ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ síndhum ǀ ā-śáyānam ǀ māyā-vínam ǀ vṛtrám ǀ asphurat ǀ níḥ ǀárejetām ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bhiyāné íti ǀ kánikradataḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀ vájrāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty Indrahas shattered the guileful Vṛtrareposing in the cloud;heaven and earth shook, alarmed at the thundering bolt of the showerer.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty Indrahas shattered the guileful Vṛtrareposing in the cloud;heaven and earth shook, alarmed at the thundering bolt of the showerer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरोरवीद्वृष्णो अस्य वज्रोऽमानुषं यन्मानुषो निजूर्वात् ।नि मायिनो दानवस्य माया अपादयत्पपिवान्त्सुतस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: ároravīt ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ ámānuṣam ǀ yát ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀ ni-jū́rvāt ǀní ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ dānavásya ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ ápādayat ǀ papi-vā́n ǀ sutásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: The thunderbolt of the showerer roared aloud, when (Indra), the friend of man, sought to slay the enemy of mankind. Drinking the Soma, he (Indra), baffled the devices of the guileful Dānava.
verses.wilson_translation: The thunderbolt of the showerer roared aloud, when (Indra), the friend of man, sought to slay the enemy of mankind. Drinking the Soma, he (Indra), baffled the devices of the guileful Dānava.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबापिबेदिंद्र शूर सोमं मंदंतु त्वा मंदिनः सुतासः ।पृणंतस्ते कुक्षी वर्धयंत्वित्था सुतः पौर इंद्रमाव ॥
verses.transliteration: píba-piba ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ sómam ǀ mándantu ǀ tvā ǀ mandínaḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀpṛṇántaḥ ǀ te ǀ kukṣī́ íti ǀ vardhayantu ǀ itthā́ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pauráḥ ǀ índram ǀ āva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink, hero,Indra, drink the Soma;may the exhilarating juices delight you; may they, distending your flanks, augment (your prowess), and in this manner may the replenishing effused libation satisfy Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink, hero,Indra, drink the Soma;may the exhilarating juices delight you; may they, distending your flanks, augment (your prowess), and in this manner may the replenishing effused libation satisfy Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वे इंद्राप्यभूम विप्रा धियं वनेम ऋतया सपंतः ।अवस्यवो धीमहि प्रशस्तिं सद्यस्ते रायो दावने स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ indra ǀ ápi ǀ abhūma ǀ víprāḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ vanema ǀ ṛta-yā́ ǀ sápantaḥ ǀavasyávaḥ ǀ dhīmahi ǀ prá-śastim ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ te ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dāváne ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, your pious (worshipper), abide in you; approaching you with devotion, may we enjoy (the reward of) our adoration; desirous of protection, we meditate your glorification; may we ever be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, your pious (worshipper), abide in you; approaching you with devotion, may we enjoy (the reward of) our adoration; desirous of protection, we meditate your glorification; may we ever be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्याम ते त इंद्र ये त ऊती अवस्यव ऊर्जं वर्धयंतः ।शुष्मिंतमं यं चाकनाम देवास्मे रयिं रासि वीरवंतं ॥
verses.transliteration: syā́ma ǀ té ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ ūtī́ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ vardháyantaḥ ǀśuṣmín-tamam ǀ yám ǀ cākánāma ǀ deva ǀ asmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ rāsi ǀ vīrá-vantam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, (through) your (favour),Indra, be such as those are, who, desirous of your protection, augment (by their praises) your vigour; divine (Indra), you grant the wealth which we desire, (the source of) great power and of (numerous) progeny.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, (through) your (favour),Indra, be such as those are, who, desirous of your protection, augment (by their praises) your vigour; divine (Indra), you grant the wealth which we desire, (the source of) great power and of (numerous) progeny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रासि क्षयं रासि मित्रमस्मे रासि शर्ध इंद्र मारुतं नः ।सजोषसो ये च मंदसानाः प्र वायवः पांत्यग्रणीतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: rā́si ǀ kṣáyam ǀ rā́si ǀ mitrám ǀ asmé íti ǀ rā́si ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mā́rutam ǀ naḥ ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ vāyávaḥ ǀ pānti ǀ ágra-nītim ǁ
verses.english_translation: You grant a habitation; you grant friends; you grant us,Indra, the strength of the Maruts; the winds, who, propitious and exulting, drink copiously of the first offering (of the Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: You grant a habitation; you grant friends; you grant us,Indra, the strength of the Maruts; the winds, who, propitious and exulting, drink copiously of the first offering (of the Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्यंत्विन्नु येषु मंदसानस्तृपत्सोमं पाहि द्रह्यदिंद्र ।अस्मान्त्सु पृत्स्वा तरुत्रावर्धयो द्यां बृहद्भिरर्कैः ॥
verses.transliteration: vyántu ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ yéṣu ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ tṛpát ǀ sómam ǀ pāhi ǀ drahyát ǀ indra ǀasmā́n ǀ sú ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ tarutra ǀ ávardhayaḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ bṛhát-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let those in whom you are delighted repair (to the libation), and do you,Indra, confiding, drink the satiating Soma; liberator (from evil), associated with the mighty and adorable (Maruts), augment our prosperity, and (that of) heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Let those in whom you are delighted repair (to the libation), and do you,Indra, confiding, drink the satiating Soma; liberator (from evil), associated with the mighty and adorable (Maruts), augment our prosperity, and (that of) heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बृहंत इन्नु ये ते तरुत्रोक्थेभिर्वा सुम्नमाविवा���ान् ।स्तृणानासो बर्हिः पस्त्यावत्त्वोता इदिंद्र वाजमग्मन् ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhántaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ tarutra ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ sumnám ǀ ā-vívāsān ǀstṛṇānā́saḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ pastyá-vat ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ vā́jam ǀ agman ǁ
verses.english_translation: Liberator (from evil), they who worship you, the giver of happiness, with holy hymns, quickly become great; they who strew the sacred grass (in honour of you) are protected by you, and, together with their famiies, obtain (abundant) food.
verses.wilson_translation: Liberator (from evil), they who worship you, the giver of happiness, with holy hymns, quickly become great; they who strew the sacred grass (in honour of you) are protected by you, and, together with their famiies, obtain (abundant) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उग्रेष्विन्नु शूर मंदसानस्त्रिकद्रुकेषु पाहि सोममिंद्र ।प्रदोधुवच्छ्मश्रुषु प्रीणानो याहि हरिभ्यां सुतस्य पीतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ugréṣu ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ śūra ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ trí-kadrukeṣu ǀ pāhi ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀpra-dódhuvat ǀ śmáśruṣu ǀ prīṇānáḥ ǀ yāhí ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ sutásya ǀ pītím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hero, exulting in the solemn Trikadruka rites quaff the Soma, and repeatedly shaking it from your beard, repair, well plural ased with your steeds, to the drinking of the effused libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hero, exulting in the solemn Trikadruka rites quaff the Soma, and repeatedly shaking it from your beard, repair, well plural ased with your steeds, to the drinking of the effused libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धिष्वा शवः शूर येन वृत्रमवाभिनद्दानुमौर्णवाभं ।अपावृणोर्ज्योतिरार्याय नि सव्यतः सादि दस्युरिंद्र ॥
verses.transliteration: dhiṣvá ǀ śávaḥ ǀ śūra ǀ yéna ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ava-ábhinat ǀ dā́num ǀ aurṇa-vābhám ǀápa ǀ avṛṇoḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ā́ryāya ǀ ní ǀ savyatáḥ ǀ sādi ǀ dásyuḥ ǀ indra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hero, keep up the strength wherewith you have crushed Vṛtra, the spider-like son of Dānu, and let open the light to theĀrya; the Dasyuhas been set aside on your lefthand.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hero, keep up the strength wherewith you have crushed Vṛtra, the spider-like son of Dānu, and let open the light to theĀrya; the Dasyuhas been set aside on your lefthand.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनेम ये त ऊतिभिस्तरंतो विश्वाः स्पृध आर्येण दस्यून् ।अस्मभ्यं तत्त्वाष्ट्रं विश्वरूपमरंधयः साख्यस्य त्रिताय ॥
verses.transliteration: sánema ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ tárantaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ā́ryeṇa ǀ dásyūn ǀasmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ tvāṣṭrám ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀ árandhayaḥ ǀ sākhyásya ǀ tritā́ya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us honour those men, who, through your protection, surpass all their rivals, as the Dasyus(are surpassed) by the Arya; this (have you wrought) for us; you have slain Viśvarūpa, the son of Tvaṣṭā, through friendship of Trita.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us honour those men, who, through your protection, surpass all their rivals, as the Dasyus(are surpassed) by the Arya; this (have you wrought) for us; you have slain Viśvarūpa, the son of Tvaṣṭā, through friendship of Trita.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य सुवानस्य मंदिनस्त्रितस्य न्यर्बुदं वावृधानो अस्तः ।अवर्तयत्सूर्यो न चक्रं भिनद्वलमिंद्रो अंगिरस्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ suvānásya ǀ mandínaḥ ǀ tritásya ǀ ní ǀ árbudam ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ astarítyastaḥ ǀávartayat ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakrám ǀ bhinát ǀ valám ǀ índraḥ ǀ áṅgirasvān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invigorated (by the libation) of the exulting Trita, offering you the Soma, you have annihilated Arbuda;Indra, aided by the Aṅgirasa, has whirled round his bolt, as the tun turns round his wheel, and slain Bala.
verses.wilson_translation: Invigorated (by the libation) of the exulting Trita, offering you the Soma, you have annihilated Arbuda;Indra, aided by the Aṅgirasa, has whirled round his bolt, as the tun turns round his wheel, and slain Bala.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिंद्र दक्षिणा मघोनी ।शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: That opulent donation, which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you the boon (which he desires); grant it to us, your prisers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard (our prayer); so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: That opulent donation, which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you the boon (which he desires); grant it to us, your prisers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard (our prayer); so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १५ गृत्समद (आङ्गिरसः शौनहोत्रः पश्चाद्) भार्गवः शौनकः। इन्द्रः। त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HE who, just born, chief God of lofty spirit by power and might became the Gods’ protector,Before whose breath through greatness of his valour the two worlds trembled, He, O men, is Indra. He who fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, and set at rest the agitated mountains,Who measured out the air's wide middle region and gave the heaven support, He, men, is Indra. Who slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, and drove the kine forth from the cave of Vala,Begat the fire between two stones, the spoiler in warriors’ battle, He, O men, is Indra. By whom this universe was made to tremble, who chased away the humbled brood of demons,Who, like a gambler gathering his winnings seized the foe's riches, He, O men, is Indra. Of whom, the Terrible, they ask, Where is He? or verily they say of him, He is not.He sweeps away, like birds, the foe's possessions. Have faith in him, for He, O men, is Indra. Stirrer to action of the poor and lowly, of priest, of suppliant who sings his praises;Who, fair-faced, favours him who presses Soma with stones made ready, He, O men, is Indra. He under whose supreme control are horses, all chariots, and the villages, and cattle;He who gave being to the Sun and Morning, who leads the waters, He, O men, is Indra. To whom two armies cry in close encounter, both enemies, the stronger and the weaker;Whom two invoke upon one chariot mounted, each for himself, He, O ye men, is Indra. Without whose help our people never conquer; whom, battling, they invoke to give them succour;He of whom all this world is but the copy, who shakes things moveless, He, O men, is Indra. He who hath smitten, ere they knew their danger, with his hurled weapon many grievous sinners;Who pardons not his boldness who provokes him, who slays the Dasyu, He, O men, is Indra. He who discovered in the fortieth autumn Śambara as he dwelt among the mountains;Who slew the Dragon putting forth his vigour, the demon lying there, He, men, is Indra. Who with seven guiding reins, the Bull, the Mighty, set free the Seven great Floods to flow at pleasure;Who, thunder-armed, rent Rauhiṇa in pieces when scaling heaven, He, O ye men, is Indra. Even the Heaven and Earth bow down before him, before his very breath the mountains tremble.Known as the Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, who wields the bolt, He, O ye men, is Indra. Who aids with favour him who pours the Soma and him who brews it, sacrificer, singer.Whom prayer exalts, and pouring forth of Soma, and this our gift, He, O ye men, Is Indra. Thou verily art fierce and true who sendest strength to the man who brews and pours libation.So may we evermore, thy friends, O Indra, speak loudly to the synod with our heroes.

verses.sanskrit: यो जात एव प्रथमो मनस्वांदेवो देवान्क्रतुना पर्यभूषत् ।यस्य शुष्माद्रोदसी अभ्यसेतां नृम्णस्य मह्ना स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ evá ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ mánasvān ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ krátunā ǀ pari-ábhūṣat ǀyásya ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ábhyasetām ǀ nṛmṇásya ǀ mahnā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, who as soon as born,is the first (of the deities); who has done honour to the gods by his exploits; he, at whose might heaven and earth are alarmed, and (who is known) by the greatness of his strength, he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, who as soon as born,is the first (of the deities); who has done honour to the gods by his exploits; he, at whose might heaven and earth are alarmed, and (who is known) by the greatness of his strength, he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः पृथिवीं व्यथमानामदृंहद्यः पर्वतान्प्रकुपिताँ अरम्णात् ।यो अंतरिक्षं विममे वरीयो यो द्यामस्तभ्नात्स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ vyáthamānām ǀ ádṛṃhat ǀ yáḥ ǀ párvatān ǀ prá-kupitān ǀ áramṇāt ǀyáḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ vi-mamé ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ ástabhnāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, who fixed firm the moving earth; who tranquilized the incensed mountains; who spread the spacious firmament; who consolidated the heaven; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, who fixed firm the moving earth; who tranquilized the incensed mountains; who spread the spacious firmament; who consolidated the heaven; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो हत्वाहिमरिणात्सप्त सिंधून्यो गा उदाजदपधा वलस्य ।यो अश्मनोरंतरग्निं जजान संवृक्समत्सु स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ hatvā́ ǀ áhim ǀ áriṇāt ǀ saptá ǀ síndhūn ǀ yáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ut-ā́jat ǀ apa-dhā́ ǀ valásya ǀyáḥ ǀ áśmanoḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ agním ǀ jajā́na ǀ sam-vṛ́k ǀ samát-su ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, who having destroyed Ahi, set free the seven rivers; who recovered the cows detained by Bala; who genitive rated fire in the clouds; who is invincible in battle; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, who having destroyed Ahi, set free the seven rivers; who recovered the cows detained by Bala; who genitive rated fire in the clouds; who is invincible in battle; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येनेमा विश्वा च्यवना कृतानि यो दासं वर्णमधरं गुहाकः ।श्वघ्नीव यो जिगीवां लक्षमाददर्यः पुष्टानि स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ imā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ cyávanā ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ yáḥ ǀ dā́sam ǀ várṇam ǀ ádharam ǀ gúhā ǀ ákarítyakaḥ ǀśvaghnī́-iva ǀ yáḥ ǀ jigīvā́n ǀ lakṣám ǀ ā́dat ǀ aryáḥ ǀ puṣṭā́ni ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, by whom all these perishable (regions) have been made; who consigned the base servile tribe to the cavern; who seizes triumphant the cherished (tresures) of the enemy, as a hunter (strikes) his prey; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, by whom all these perishable (regions) have been made; who consigned the base servile tribe to the cavern; who seizes triumphant the cherished (tresures) of the enemy, as a hunter (strikes) his prey; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं स्मा पृच्छंति कुह सेति घोरमुतेमाहुर्नैषो अस्तीत्येनं ।सो अर्यः पुष्टीर्विज इवा मिनाति श्रदस्मै धत्त स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ sma ǀ pṛcchánti ǀ kúha ǀ sáḥ ǀ íti ǀ ghorám ǀ utá ǀ īm ǀ āhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ asti ǀ íti ǀ enam ǀsáḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ puṣṭī́ḥ ǀ víjaḥ-iva ǀ ā́ ǀ mināti ǀ śrát ǀ asmai ǀ dhatta ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, whom, terrible, they ask for, (saying), Where is he? or, verily, they say of him, he is not (in any one plural ce); but who, inflicting (chastisement), destroys the cherisshed (treasures) of the enemy; in him have faith; for he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, whom, terrible, they ask for, (saying), Where is he? or, verily, they say of him, he is not (in any one plural ce); but who, inflicting (chastisement), destroys the cherisshed (treasures) of the enemy; in him have faith; for he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो रध्रस्य चोदिता यः कृशस्य यो ब्रह्मणो नाधमानस्य कीरेः ।युक्तग्राव्णो योऽविता सुशिप्रः सुतसोमस्य स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ radhrásya ǀ coditā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ kṛśásya ǀ yáḥ ǀ brahmáṇaḥ ǀ nā́dhamānasya ǀ kīréḥ ǀyuktá-grāvṇaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ su-śipráḥ ǀ sutá-somasya ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, who is the encourager of the rich, and of the poor, and of the priest, who recites his praise, and is a suppliant; who, of goodly features, is the protector of him, who, with ready stones, expresses the Somajuice; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, who is the encourager of the rich, and of the poor, and of the priest, who recites his praise, and is a suppliant; who, of goodly features, is the protector of him, who, with ready stones, expresses the Somajuice; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्याश्वासः प्रदिशि यस्य गावो यस्य ग्रामा यस्य विश्वे रथासः ।यः सूर्यं य उषसं जजान यो अपां नेता स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ pra-díśi ǀ yásya ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ grā́māḥ ǀ yásya ǀ víśve ǀ ráthāsaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ yáḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ jajā́na ǀ yáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ netā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, under whose control are horses and cattle, and villages, and all chariots; he who gave birth to the sun and to the dawn; and who is the leader of the waters; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, under whose control are horses and cattle, and villages, and all chariots; he who gave birth to the sun and to the dawn; and who is the leader of the waters; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं क्रंदसी संयती विह्वयेते परेऽवर उभया अमित्राः ।समानं चिद्रथमातस्थिवांसा नाना हवेते स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ krándasī íti ǀ saṃyatī́ íti sam-yatī́ ǀ vihváyete íti vi-hváyete ǀ páre ǀ ávare ǀ ubháyāḥ ǀ amítrāḥ ǀsamānám ǀ cit ǀ rátham ǀ ātasthi-vā́ṃsā ǀ nā́nā ǀ havete íti ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whom (two hosts), calling and mutually encountering, call upon; whom both adversaries, high and low, (appeal to); whom two (charioteers), standing in the same car, severally invoke; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Whom (two hosts), calling and mutually encountering, call upon; whom both adversaries, high and low, (appeal to); whom two (charioteers), standing in the same car, severally invoke; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्न ऋते विजयंते जनासो यं युध्यमाना अवसे हवंते ।यो विश्वस्य प्रतिमानं बभूव यो अच्युतच्युत्स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmāt ǀ ná ǀ ṛté ǀ vi-jáyante ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ yám ǀ yúdhyamānāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ hávante ǀyáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ babhū́va ǀ yáḥ ǀ acyuta-cyút ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Without whom men do not conquer; whom, when engaged in conflict, they invoke for succour; he, who is the prototype of the universe and the caster down of the unyielding; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Without whom men do not conquer; whom, when engaged in conflict, they invoke for succour; he, who is the prototype of the universe and the caster down of the unyielding; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः शश्वतो मह्येनो दधानानमन्यमानांछर्वा जघान ।यः शर्धते नानुददाति शृध्यां यो दस्योर्हंता स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ máhi ǀ énaḥ ǀ dádhānān ǀ ámanyamānān ǀ śárvā ǀ jaghā́na ǀyáḥ ǀ śárdhate ǀ ná ǀ anu-dádāti ǀ śṛdhyā́m ǀ yáḥ ǀ dásyoḥ ǀ hantā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, who with the thunderbolt has destroyed many committing great sin, and offering (him) no homage; who grants not success to the confident; who is the slayer of the Dasyus; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, who with the thunderbolt has destroyed many committing great sin, and offering (him) no homage; who grants not success to the confident; who is the slayer of the Dasyus; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः शंबरं पर्वतेषु क्षियंतं चत्वारिंश्यां शरद्यन्वविंदत् ।ओजायमानं यो अहिं जघान दानुं शयानं स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śámbaram ǀ párvateṣu ǀ kṣiyántam ǀ catvāriṃśyā́m ǀ śarádi ǀ anu-ávindat ǀojāyámānam ǀ yáḥ ǀ áhim ǀ jaghā́na ǀ dā́num ǀ śáyānam ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, who discoveredŚambaradwelling in the mountains for forty years; who slew Ahi, growing in strength, and the sleeping son of Dānu; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, who discoveredŚambaradwelling in the mountains for forty years; who slew Ahi, growing in strength, and the sleeping son of Dānu; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः सप्तरश्मिर्वृषभस्तुविष्मानवासृजत्सर्तवे सप्त सिंधून् ।यो रौहिणमस्फुरद्वज्रबाहुर्द्यामारोहंतं स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ saptá-raśmiḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀ ava-ásṛjat ǀ sártave ǀ saptá ǀ síndhūn ǀyáḥ ǀ rauhiṇám ǀ ásphurat ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ ā-róhantam ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the seven-rayed, the showerer, the powerful, who let loose the seven rivers to flow; who, armed with the thunderbolt, crushed Rauhiṇawhen scaling heaven; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the seven-rayed, the showerer, the powerful, who let loose the seven rivers to flow; who, armed with the thunderbolt, crushed Rauhiṇawhen scaling heaven; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्यावा चिदस्मै पृथिवी नमेते शुष्माच्चिदस्य पर्वता भयंते ।यः सोमपा निचितो वज्रबाहुर्यो वज्रहस्तः स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: dyā́vā ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ namete íti ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ bhayante ǀyáḥ ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ ni-citáḥ ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vájra-hastaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, to whom heaven and earth bow down; he, at whose might the mountains are appalled; he, who is the drinker of the Soma, the firm (of frame), the adamant-armed, the wielder of the thunderbolt; he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, to whom heaven and earth bow down; he, at whose might the mountains are appalled; he, who is the drinker of the Soma, the firm (of frame), the adamant-armed, the wielder of the thunderbolt; he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः सुन्वंतमवति यः पचंतं यः शंसंतं यः शशमानमूती ।यस्य ब्रह्म वर्धनं यस्य सोमो यस्येदं राधः स जनास इंद्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sunvántam ǀ ávati ǀ yáḥ ǀ pácantam ǀ yáḥ ǀ śáṃsantam ǀ yáḥ ǀ śaśamānám ǀ ūtī́ ǀyásya ǀ bráhma ǀ várdhanam ǀ yásya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ idám ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, who protects (the worshipper) offering the libation, or preparing (the mixed curds and butter), repeating his praise and soliciting his assistance, he, of whom the sacred prayer, the (offered)Soma, the (presented sacrificial) food, augment (the vigour); he, men, is Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He, who protects (the worshipper) offering the libation, or preparing (the mixed curds and butter), repeating his praise and soliciting his assistance, he, of whom the sacred prayer, the (offered)Soma, the (presented sacrificial) food, augment (the vigour); he, men, is Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः सुन्वते पचते दुध्र आ चिद्वाजं दर्दर्षि स किलासि सत्यः ।वयं त इंद्र विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ pácate ǀ dudhráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀ vā́jam ǀ dárdarṣi ǀ sáḥ ǀ kíla ǀ asi ǀ satyáḥ ǀvayám ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ viśváha ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ vidátham ǀ ā́ ǀ vadema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are difficult of approach; you, verily, are a true (benefactor), who bestows (abundant) food upon him who offers the libation, who prepares (the mixed curds and butter); may we, enjoying your favour, blessed with progeny, daily repeat (your praises) at the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are difficult of approach; you, verily, are a true (benefactor), who bestows (abundant) food upon him who offers the libation, who prepares (the mixed curds and butter); may we, enjoying your favour, blessed with progeny, daily repeat (your praises) at the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १३ गृत्समद (आङ्गिरसः शौनहोत्रः पश्चाद्) भार्गवः शौनकः। इन्द्रः। जगती, १३ त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Season was the parent, and when born therefrom it entered rapidly the floods wherein it grows.Thence was it full of sap, streaming with milky juice: the milk of the plant's stalk is chief and meet for lauds. They come trooping together bearing milk to him, and bring him sustenance who gives support to all.The way is common for the downward streams to flow. Thou who didst these things first art worthy of our lauds. One priest announces what the institutor gives: one, altering the forms, zealously plies his task,The third corrects the imperfections left by each. Thou who didst these things first art worthy of our lauds. Dealing out food unto their people there they sit, like wealth to him who comes, more than the back can bear.Greedily with his teeth he eats the master's food. Thou who didst these things first art worthy of our lauds. Thou hast created earth to look upon the sky: thou, slaying Ahi, settest free the river's paths.Thee, such, a God, the Gods have quickened with their lauds, even as a steed with waters: meet for praise art thou. Thou givest increase, thou dealest to us our food: thou milkest from the moist the dry, the rich in sweets.Thou by the worshipper layest thy precious store: thou art sole Lord of all. Meet for our praise art thou. Thou who hast spread abroad the streams by stablished law, and in the field the plants that blossom and bear seed;Thou who hast made the matchless lightnings of the sky,—vast, compassing vast realms, meet for our praise art thou. Who broughtest Nārmara with all his wealth, for sake of food, to slay him that the fiends might be destroyed,Broughtest the face unclouded of the strengthening one, performing much even now, worthy art thou of praise. Thou boundest up the Dāsa's hundred friends and ten, when, at one's hearing, thou helpest thy worshipper.Thou for Dabhīti boundest Dasyus not with cords; Thou wast a mighty help. Worthy of lauds art thou. All banks of rivers yielded to his manly might; to him they gave, to him, the Strong, gave up their wealth.The six directions hast thou fixed, a five-fold view: thy victories reached afar. Worthy of lauds art thou. Meet for high praise, O Hero, is thy power, that with thy single wisdom thou obtainest wealth,The life-support of conquering Jātūṣṭhira. Indra, for all thy deeds, worthy of lauds art thou. Thou for Turvīti heldest still the flowing floods, the river-stream for Vayya easily to passDidst raise the outcast from the depths, and gavest fame unto the halt and blind. Worthy of lauds art thou. Prepare thyself to grant us that great bounty, O Vasu, for abundant is thy treasure.Snatch up the wonderful, O Indra, daily. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुर्जनित्री तस्या अपस्परि मक्षू जात आविशद्यासु वर्धते ।तदाहना अभवत्पिप्युषी पयोऽंशोः पीयूषं प्रथमं तदुक्थ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtúḥ ǀ jánitrī ǀ tásyāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ pári ǀ makṣú ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aviśat ǀ yā́su ǀ várdhate ǀtát ǀ āhanā́ḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ pipyúṣī ǀ páyaḥ ǀ aṃśóḥ ǀ pīyúṣam ǀ prathamám ǀ tát ǀ ukthyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The season (of the rains) is the parent (of the Soma), which, as soon as born of her, enters into the waters in which it grows; thence it is fit for expression, as concentrating (the essence of the) water, and the juice of the Soma is especially to be praised (as the libation proper for Indra).
verses.wilson_translation: The season (of the rains) is the parent (of the Soma), which, as soon as born of her, enters into the waters in which it grows; thence it is fit for expression, as concentrating (the essence of the) water, and the juice of the Soma is especially to be praised (as the libation proper for Indra).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सध्रीमा यंति परि बिभ्रतीः पयो विश्वप्स्न्याय प्र भरंत भोजनं ।समानो अध्वा प्रवतामनुष्यदे यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sadhrī́ ǀ īm ǀ ā́ ǀ yanti ǀ pári ǀ bíbhratīḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ viśvá-psnyāya ǀ prá ǀ bharanta ǀ bhójanam ǀsamānáḥ ǀ ádhvā ǀ pra-vátām ǀ anu-syáde ǀ yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The aggregated (streams) come, bearing everywhere the water, and conveying it as sustenance for the asylum of all rivers, (the ocean); the samepath is (assigned) to all the descending (currents) to follow; and as he, who has (assigned) them (their course), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.
verses.wilson_translation: The aggregated (streams) come, bearing everywhere the water, and conveying it as sustenance for the asylum of all rivers, (the ocean); the samepath is (assigned) to all the descending (currents) to follow; and as he, who has (assigned) them (their course), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अन्वेको वदति यद्ददाति तद्रूपा मिनंतदपा एक ईयते ।विश्वा एकस्य विनुदस्तितिक्षते यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vadati ǀ yát ǀ dádāti ǀ tát ǀ rūpā́ ǀ minán ǀ tát-apāḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ īyate ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ékasya ǀ vi-núdaḥ ǀ titikṣate ǀ yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (priest) announces (the offering) that he, (the instrumental tutor of the rite) presents; another performs the act that apportions the limbs (of the victim); a third corrects all the deficiencies of either, and as he, who has enjoyed these (functions), your, (Indra), are especially to be praised.
verses.wilson_translation: One (priest) announces (the offering) that he, (the instrumental tutor of the rite) presents; another performs the act that apportions the limbs (of the victim); a third corrects all the deficiencies of either, and as he, who has enjoyed these (functions), your, (Indra), are especially to be praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाभ्यः पुष्टिं विभजंत आसते रयिमिव पृष्ठं प्रभवंतमायते ।असिन्वंदंष्ट्रैः पितुरत्ति भोजनं यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-jā́bhyaḥ ǀ puṣṭím ǀ vi-bhájantaḥ ǀ āsate ǀ rayím-iva ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ pra-bhávantam ǀ ā-yaté ǀásinvan ǀ dáṃṣṭraiḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ atti ǀ bhójanam ǀ yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Distributing nourishment to their progeny, they, (the householders), abide (in their dwellings), as if offering ample and sustaining wealth to a guest; constructing (useful works, a man) eats with his teeth the food (given him) by (his) protector and as he, who has enjoined these (things to be done), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.
verses.wilson_translation: Distributing nourishment to their progeny, they, (the householders), abide (in their dwellings), as if offering ample and sustaining wealth to a guest; constructing (useful works, a man) eats with his teeth the food (given him) by (his) protector and as he, who has enjoined these (things to be done), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधाकृणोः पृथिवीं संदृशे दिवे यो धौतीनामहिहन्नारिणक्पथः ।तं त्वा स्तोमेभिरुदभिर्न वाजिनं देवं देवा अजनन्त्सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ sam-dṛ́śe ǀ divé ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhautīnā́m ǀ ahi-han ǀ áriṇak ǀ patháḥ ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ udá-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājínam ǀ devám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ajanan ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch as you have rendered earth visible to heaven, and have set open the path of the rivers by slaying Ahi; therefore the gods have rendered you divine by praises, as (men) invigorate a horse by water; (and) you are, (Indra), to be praised.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch as you have rendered earth visible to heaven, and have set open the path of the rivers by slaying Ahi; therefore the gods have rendered you divine by praises, as (men) invigorate a horse by water; (and) you are, (Indra), to be praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो भोजनं च दयसे च वर्धनमार्द्रादा शुष्कं मधुमद्दुदोहिथ ।स शेवधिं नि दधिषे विवस्वति विश्वस्यैक ईशिषे सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ bhójanam ǀ ca ǀ dáyase ǀ ca ǀ várdhanam ǀ ārdrā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ śúṣkam ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ dudóhitha ǀsáḥ ǀ śeva-dhím ǀ ní ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ vivásvati ǀ víśvasya ǀ ékaḥ ǀ īśiṣe ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You are he) who bestows both food and increase, and milk the dry nutritious (grain) from out of the humid stalk; he, who gives wealth to the worshipper, and are sole sovereign of the universe you are he, (Indra), who is to be praised.
