verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ hótā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ utá ǀ párvatānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, when kindled, is Mitra; and, as Mitra, is the invoker (of the gods);Varuṇais Jātavedas; Mitra is the ministering priest; Damunas is the agitator (Vāyu); Mitra (is the associate) of rivers and mountains.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, when kindled, is Mitra; and, as Mitra, is the invoker (of the gods);Varuṇais Jātavedas; Mitra is the ministering priest; Damunas is the agitator (Vāyu); Mitra (is the associate) of rivers and mountains.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पाति प्रियं रिपो अग्रं पदं वेः पाति यह्वश्चरणं सूर्यस्य ।पाति नाभा सप्तशीर्षाणमग्निः पाति देवानामुपमादमृष्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: pā́ti ǀ priyám ǀ ripáḥ ǀ ágram ǀ padám ǀ véḥ ǀ pā́ti ǀ yahváḥ ǀ cáraṇam ǀ sū́ryasya ǀpā́ti ǀ nā́bhā ǀ saptá-śīrṣāṇam ǀ agníḥ ǀ pā́ti ǀ devā́nām ǀ upa-mā́dam ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The graceful (Agni) protects the primary station of the moving earth; mighty, he protects the path of the sun; he protects the seven-headed (troop of the Maruts) in the centre between heaven and earth; he protects the exhilarating (oblations) of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The graceful (Agni) protects the primary station of the moving earth; mighty, he protects the path of the sun; he protects the seven-headed (troop of the Maruts) in the centre between heaven and earth; he protects the exhilarating (oblations) of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुश्चक्र ईड्यं चारु नाम विश्वानि देवो वयुनानि विद्वान् ।ससस्य चर्म घृतवत्पदं वेस्तदिदग्नी रक्षत्यप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ cakre ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀ víśvāni ǀ deváḥ ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀsasásya ǀ cárma ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ padám ǀ véḥ ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ rakṣati ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty, divine Agniknowing all (things) that are to be known, made the commendable and beautiful water, the glossy skin, the station of the diffused slumbering (Agni), and, ever vigilant preserves it.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty, divine Agniknowing all (things) that are to be known, made the commendable and beautiful water, the glossy skin, the station of the diffused slumbering (Agni), and, ever vigilant preserves it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ योनिमग्निर्घृतवंतमस्थात्पृथुप्रगाणमुशंतमुशानः ।दीद्यानः शुचिर्ऋष्वः पावकः पुनःपुनर्मातरा नव्यसी कः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yónim ǀ agníḥ ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ asthāt ǀ pṛthú-pragānam ǀ uśántam ǀ uśānáḥ ǀdī́dyānaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ púnaḥ-punaḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ návyasī íti ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnihas taken his station in an asylum, brilliant, much-lauded, and as desirous (of receiving him) as he is (torepair to it); radiant, pure, vast and purifying, he repeatedly renovates his parents, (Heaven and Earth).
verses.wilson_translation: Agnihas taken his station in an asylum, brilliant, much-lauded, and as desirous (of receiving him) as he is (torepair to it); radiant, pure, vast and purifying, he repeatedly renovates his parents, (Heaven and Earth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सद्यो जात ओषधीभिर्ववक्षे यदी वर्धंति प्रस्वो घृतेन ।आप इव प्रवता शुंभमाना उरुष्यदग्निः पित्रोरुपस्थे ॥
verses.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ vavakṣe ǀ yádi ǀ várdhanti ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀā́paḥ-iva ǀ pra-vátā ǀ śúmbhamānāḥ ǀ uruṣyát ǀ agníḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǁ
verses.english_translation: As soon as genitive rated he is borne aloft by the plural nts, which grow flourishing by moisture, as the beautifying waters descend; may he, in the bosom of his parents, protect us.
verses.wilson_translation: As soon as genitive rated he is borne aloft by the plural nts, which grow flourishing by moisture, as the beautifying waters descend; may he, in the bosom of his parents, protect us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु ष्टुतः समिधा यह्वो अद्यौद्वर्ष्मंदिवो अधि नाभा पृथिव्याः ।मित्रो अग्निरीड्यो मातरिश्वा दूतो वक्षद्यजथाय देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stutáḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ yahváḥ ǀ adyaut ǀ várṣman ǀ diváḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ ā́ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ vakṣat ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praised and (nourished) by fuel, the mighty Agni, stationed on the (altar the) navel of the earth, in the form of the firmament, has shone (brightly); may the friendly and adorable Agni who respires in the mid-heaven, the messenger (of the gods), bring them to the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Praised and (nourished) by fuel, the mighty Agni, stationed on the (altar the) navel of the earth, in the form of the firmament, has shone (brightly); may the friendly and adorable Agni who respires in the mid-heaven, the messenger (of the gods), bring them to the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदस्तंभीत्समिधा नाकमृष्वोऽग्निर्भवन्नुत्तमो रोचनानां ।यदी भृगुभ्यः परि मातरिश्वा गुहा संतं हव्यवाहं समीधे ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ astambhīt ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ nā́kam ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ bhávan ǀ ut-tamáḥ ǀ rocanā́nām ǀyádi ǀ bhṛ́gu-bhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ gúhā ǀ sántam ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ sam-īdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty Agni, being the best of the heavenly luminaries, sustained the heaven with radiance, when the wind kindled the bearer of oblations, (till then concealed) in a cave from the Bhṛgus.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty Agni, being the best of the heavenly luminaries, sustained the heaven with radiance, when the wind kindled the bearer of oblations, (till then concealed) in a cave from the Bhṛgus.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may your good-will ever be upon us.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may your good-will ever be upon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . URGED on by deep devotion, O ye singers, bring, pious ones, the God-approaching ladle.Borne onward to the right it travels eastward, and, filled with oil, to Agni bears oblation. Thou at thy birth didst fill both earth and heaven, yea, Most Adorable, thou didst exceed them.Even through the heaven's and through the earth's expanses let thy swift seventongued flames roll on, O Agni. Both Heaven and Earth and Gods who should be worshipped establish thee as Priest for every dwelling,Whenever human families, God-devoted, bringing oblations; laud thy splendid lustre. Firm in the Gods’ home is the Mighty seated, between vast Heaven and Earth the well-beloved-Those Cows who yield, unharmed, their nectar, Spouses of the Far-Strider, everyoung, united. Great are the deeds of thee, the Great, O Agni: thou by thy power hast spread out earth and heaven.As soon as thou wast born thou wast an envoy, thou, Mighty One, was Leader of the people. Bind to the pole with cords of holy Order the long-maned ruddy steeds who sprinkle fatness.Bring hithier, O thou God, all Gods together: provide them noble worship, Jātavedas. Even from the sky thy brilliant lights shone hither: still hast thou beamed through many a radiant morning,That the Gods praised their joyous Herald's labour eagerly burning, Agni, in the forests. The Gods who take delight in air's wide region, or those the dwellers in heaven's realm of brightness,Or those, the Holy, prompt to hear, our helpers, who, carborne, turn their horses hither, Agni—- With these, borne on one ear, Agni, approach us, or borne on many, for thy steeds are able.Bring, witb their Dames, the Gods, the Three and-Thirty, after thy Godlike nature, and be joyful. He is the Priest at whose repeated worship even wide Heaven and Earth sing out for increase.They fair and true and holy coming forward stand at his sacrifice who springs from Order. As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to usward.

verses.sanskrit: प्र कारवो मनना वच्यमाना देवद्रीचीं नयत देवयंतः ।दक्षिणावाड्वाजिनी प्राच्येति हविर्भरंत्यग्नये घृताची ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ kāravaḥ ǀ mananā́ ǀ vacyámānāḥ ǀ devadrī́cīn ǀ nayata ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀdakṣiṇā-vā́ṭ ǀ vājínī ǀ prā́cī ǀ eti ǀ havíḥ ǀ bhárantī ǀ agnáye ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devout ministrants, who are to be inspired by prayer, bring forth (the ladle) destined for the worship of the gods, which is to be conveyed to the south (of the fire-altar), and which, charged with (sacrificial) food, pointed to the east, containing the oblation, and, filled with liquefied butter, proceeds to Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: Devout ministrants, who are to be inspired by prayer, bring forth (the ladle) destined for the worship of the gods, which is to be conveyed to the south (of the fire-altar), and which, charged with (sacrificial) food, pointed to the east, containing the oblation, and, filled with liquefied butter, proceeds to Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ रोदसी अपृणा जायमान उत प्र रिक्था अध नु प्रयज्यो ।दिवश्चिदग्ने महिना पृथिव्या वच्यंतां ते वह्नयः सप्तजिह्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ utá ǀ prá ǀ rikthāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ nú ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǀdeváḥ ǀ cit ǀ agne ǀ mahinā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ vacyántām ǀ te ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ saptá-jihvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, as soon as born, occupy both heaven and earth; for you, to whom sacrifice is to be offered, exceed in magnitude the firmament and the earth; may your seven-tongued fires be glorified.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, as soon as born, occupy both heaven and earth; for you, to whom sacrifice is to be offered, exceed in magnitude the firmament and the earth; may your seven-tongued fires be glorified.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्यौश्च त्वा पृथिवी यज्ञियासो नि होतारं सादयंते दमाय ।यदी विशो मानुषीर्देवयंतीः प्रयस्वतीरीळते शुक्रमर्चिः ॥
verses.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ ca ǀ tvā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀ ní ǀ hótāram ǀ sādayante ǀ dámāya ǀyádi ǀ víśaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ práyasvatīḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀ śukrám ǀ arcíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The firmament and the earth and the adorable (gods) propitiate you their invoker, for the (completion of the) sacrifice, whenever the descendants of Manu, pious, and bearing oblations, glorify your radiant flame.
verses.wilson_translation: The firmament and the earth and the adorable (gods) propitiate you their invoker, for the (completion of the) sacrifice, whenever the descendants of Manu, pious, and bearing oblations, glorify your radiant flame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महान्त्सधस्थे ध्र��व आ निषत्तोऽंतर्द्यावा माहिने हर्यमाणः ।आस्क्रे सपत्नी अजरे अमृक्ते सबर्दुघे उरुगायस्य धेनू ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ dhruváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ dyā́vā ǀ mā́hine íti ǀ háryamāṇaḥ ǀā́skre íti ǀ sapátnī íti sa-pátnī ǀ ajáre íti ǀ ámṛkte íti ǀ sabardúghe íti sabaḥ-dúghe ǀ uru-gāyásya ǀ dhenū́ íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The great and adorable Agniis firm seated on his spacious throne between heaven and earth; and the powerful fellow-brides (of the sun), the imperishable uninjurable (heaven and earth) are the two milk-yielding cows of the wide-extending (Agni).
verses.wilson_translation: The great and adorable Agniis firm seated on his spacious throne between heaven and earth; and the powerful fellow-brides (of the sun), the imperishable uninjurable (heaven and earth) are the two milk-yielding cows of the wide-extending (Agni).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्रता ते अग्ने महतो महानि तव क्रत्वा रोदसी आ ततंथ ।त्वं दूतो अभवो जायमानस्त्वं नेता वृषभ चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: vratā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀtvám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ netā́ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Great,Agni, are the deeds of you the mighty one; you have spread abroad by your power the heaven and earth; you have been the messenger (of the gods); as soon as begotten you have become the leader of men.
verses.wilson_translation: Great,Agni, are the deeds of you the mighty one; you have spread abroad by your power the heaven and earth; you have been the messenger (of the gods); as soon as begotten you have become the leader of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतस्य वा केशिना योग्याभिर्घृतस्नुवा रोहिता धुरि धिष्व ।अथा वह देवांदेव विश्वान्त्स्वध्वरा कृणुहि जातवेदः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ vā ǀ keśínā ǀ yogyā́bhiḥ ǀ ghṛta-snúvā ǀ róhitā ǀ dhurí ǀ dhiṣva ǀátha ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devā́n ǀ deva ǀ víśvān ǀ su-adhvarā́ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Harness with traces, to your car, your long-maned, ruddy (steeds, to come) to the sacrifice; bring hither, divine Jātavedas, all the gods, and make them propitious to the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Harness with traces, to your car, your long-maned, ruddy (steeds, to come) to the sacrifice; bring hither, divine Jātavedas, all the gods, and make them propitious to the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवश्चिदा ते रुचयंत रोका उषो विभातीरनु भासि पूर्वीः ।अपो यदग्न उशधग्वनेषु होतुर्मंद्रस्य पनयंत देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ rucayanta ǀ rokā́ḥ ǀ uṣáḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ bhāsi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ uśádhak ǀ váneṣu ǀ hótuḥ ǀ mandrásya ǀ panáyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Agni, you abide in the woods, consuming the waters at your plural asure, then your rays illuminate the heavens, and you shine like many former radiant dawns; the gods themselves commend (the brilliancy) of their praise-meriting invoker.
verses.wilson_translation: When,Agni, you abide in the woods, consuming the waters at your plural asure, then your rays illuminate the heavens, and you shine like many former radiant dawns; the gods themselves commend (the brilliancy) of their praise-meriting invoker.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरौ वा ये अंतरिक्षे मदंति दिवो वा ये रोचने संति देवाः ।ऊमा वा ये सुहवासो यजत्रा आयेमिरे रथ्यो अग्ने अश्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: uráu ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ antárikṣe ǀ mádanti ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ rocané ǀ sánti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀū́māḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ su-hávāsaḥ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ ā-yemiré ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ agne ǀ áśvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The deities who sport in the spacious (firmament); those who are in the luminous sphere of heaven; the adorable Umas, who come when worthily invoked; the horses,Agni, that are fit for your car.
verses.wilson_translation: The deities who sport in the spacious (firmament); those who are in the luminous sphere of heaven; the adorable Umas, who come when worthily invoked; the horses,Agni, that are fit for your car.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऐभिरग्ने सरथं याह्यर्वाङ् नानारथं वा विभवो ह्यश्वाः ।पत्नीवतस्त्रिंशतं त्रींश्च देवाननुष्वधमा वह मादयस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ nānā-rathám ǀ vā ǀ vi-bhávaḥ ǀ hí ǀ áśvāḥ ǀpátnī-vataḥ ǀ triṃśátam ǀ trī́n ǀ ca ǀ devā́n ǀ anu-svadhám ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ mādáyasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: With all these in one chariot,Agni, or in many (chariots), come to our presence, for your horses are able; bring the three and thirty divinities with their wives, for the sake of (the sacrificial) food, and exhilarate them (all with the Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: With all these in one chariot,Agni, or in many (chariots), come to our presence, for your horses are able; bring the three and thirty divinities with their wives, for the sake of (the sacrificial) food, and exhilarate them (all with the Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स होता यस्य रोदसी चिदुर्वी यज्ञंयज्ञमभि वृधे गृणीतः ।प्राची अध्वरेव तस्थतुः सुमेके ऋतावरी ऋतजातस्य सत्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ yásya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ yajñám-yajñam ǀ abhí ǀ vṛdhé ǀ gṛṇītáḥ ǀprā́cī íti ǀ adhvarā́-iva ǀ tasthatuḥ ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀ ṛtávarī ítyṛtá-varī ǀ ṛtá-jātasya ǀ satyé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: He is the invoker (of the gods), whom the spacious heaven and earth glorify, for the sake of increase, at repeated sacrifices; charged with water, they await like holy rites, propitious to the real presence of him who is born of truth.
verses.wilson_translation: He is the invoker (of the gods), whom the spacious heaven and earth glorify, for the sake of increase, at repeated sacrifices; charged with water, they await like holy rites, propitious to the real presence of him who is born of truth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may our good-will ever be upon us.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may our good-will ever be upon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VII.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE seven tones risen from the whitebacked viand have made their way between the pair of Mothers.Both circumjacent Parents come together to yield us length of days they hasten forward. The Male who dwells in heaven hath Mares and Milchkine: he came to Goddesses who bring sweet treasure.To thee safe resting in the seat of Order the Cow alone upon her way proceedeth. Wise Master, wealthy finder-out of riches, he mounted those who may with case be guided.He, dark-backed, manifold with varied aspect, hath made them burst forth from their food the brush-wood. Strength-giving streams bear hither him eternal, fain to support the mighty work. of Tvaṣṭar.He, flashing in his home with all his members, hath entered both the worlds as they were single. They know the red Bull's blessing, and are joyful under the flaming-coloured Lord's dominion:They who give shine from heavenwith fair effulgence, whose lofty song like Iḷā must be honoured. Yea, by tradition from the ancient sages they brought great strength from the two mighty Parents,To where the singer's Bull, the night's dispeller, after his proper law hath waxen stronger. Seven holy singers guard with five Adhvaryus the Bird's beloved firmly-settled station.The willing Bulls, untouched by old, rejoice them: as Gods themselves the ways of Gods they follow. I crave the grace of heaven's two chief Invokers: the seven swift steeds joy in their wonted manner.These speak of truth, praising the Truth Eternal, thinking on Order as the guards of Order. The many seek the great Steed as a stallion: the reins obey the Lord of varied colour.O heavenly Priest, most pleasant, full of wisdom, bring the great Gods to us, and Earth and Heaven. Rich Lord, the Mornings have gleamed forth in splendour, fair-rayed, fair-speaking, worshipped with all viands,Yea, with the glory of the earth, O Agni. Forgive us, for our weal, e’en sin cornmitted. As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker, give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.To us be born a son, and spreading offspring Agni, be this thy gracious will to usward.

verses.sanskrit: प्र य आरुः शितिपृष्ठस्य धासेरा मातरा विविशुः सप्त वाणीः ।परिक्षिता पितरा सं चरेते प्र सर्स्राते दीर्घमायुः प्रयक्षे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ ārúḥ ǀ śiti-pṛṣṭhásya ǀ dhāséḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mātárā ǀ viviśuḥ ǀ saptá ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀpari-kṣítā ǀ pitárā ǀ sám ǀ carete íti ǀ prá ǀ sarsrāte íti ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-yákṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: The (rays) of the blackbacked, all-sustaining (Agni) have arisen, and pervaded the parents (earth and heaven) and the flowing rivers; the surrounding parents co-operate with him, and bestow long life for the sake of assiduous worship.
verses.wilson_translation: The (rays) of the blackbacked, all-sustaining (Agni) have arisen, and pervaded the parents (earth and heaven) and the flowing rivers; the surrounding parents co-operate with him, and bestow long life for the sake of assiduous worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवक्षसो धेनवो वृष्णो अश्वा देवीरा तस्थौ मधुमद्वहंतीः ।ऋतस्य त्वा सदसि क्षेमयंतं पर्येका चरति वर्तनिं गौः ॥
verses.transliteration: divákṣasaḥ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tasthau ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ váhantīḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ tvā ǀ sádasi ǀ kṣema-yántam ǀ pári ǀ ékā ǀ carati ǀ vartaním ǀ gáuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sky-traversing steeds of the showerer (of benefits) are the kine (of Agni); as he attains the divine (rivers), bearers of sweet (water). One sacred soudn glorifies you (Agni), who are desirous of repose, pacifying your flames) in the abode of the water (the firmament).
verses.wilson_translation: The sky-traversing steeds of the showerer (of benefits) are the kine (of Agni); as he attains the divine (rivers), bearers of sweet (water). One sacred soudn glorifies you (Agni), who are desirous of repose, pacifying your flames) in the abode of the water (the firmament).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सीमरोहत्सुयमा भवंतीः पतिश्चिकित्वान्रयिविद्रयीणां ।प्र नीलपृष्ठो अतसस्य धासेस्ता अवासयत्पुरुधप्रतीकः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sīm ǀ arohat ǀ su-yámāḥ ǀ bhávantīḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ rayi-vít ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀprá ǀ nī́la-pṛṣṭhaḥ ǀ atasásya ǀ dhāséḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ avāsayat ǀ purudhá-pratīkaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Their lord has mounted on his well-trained mares the sagacious selector of treasures, the blackbacked, many-limbed (Agni) has granted them a plural ce of rest for the cherishing of (their) rapid speed.
verses.wilson_translation: Their lord has mounted on his well-trained mares the sagacious selector of treasures, the blackbacked, many-limbed (Agni) has granted them a plural ce of rest for the cherishing of (their) rapid speed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महि त्वाष्ट्रमूर्जयंतीरजुर्यं स्तभूयमानं वहतो वहंति ।व्यंगेभिर्दिद्युतानः सधस्थ एकामिव रोदसी आ विवेश ॥
verses.transliteration: máhi ǀ tvāṣṭrám ǀ ūrjáyantīḥ ǀ ajuryám ǀ stabhu-yámānam ǀ vahátaḥ ǀ vahanti ǀví ǀ áṅgebhiḥ ǀ didyutānáḥ ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ékām-iva ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: The flowing (rivers) invigorating him, bear along the great son of Tvaṣṭā, the undecaying upholder (of the world), radiant with various forms in the vicinity (of the firmament);Agniis associated with heaven and earth, as (a husband with) one only wife.
verses.wilson_translation: The flowing (rivers) invigorating him, bear along the great son of Tvaṣṭā, the undecaying upholder (of the world), radiant with various forms in the vicinity (of the firmament);Agniis associated with heaven and earth, as (a husband with) one only wife.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जानंति वृष्णो अरुषस्य शेवमुत ब्रध्नस्य शासने रणंति ।दिवोरुचः सुरुचो रोचमाना इळा येषां गण्या माहिना गीः ॥
verses.transliteration: jānánti ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ aruṣásya ǀ śévam ǀ utá ǀ bradhnásya ǀ śā́sane ǀ raṇanti ǀdivaḥ-rúcaḥ ǀ su-rúcaḥ ǀ rócamānāḥ ǀ íḷā ǀ yéṣām ǀ gáṇyā ǀ mā́hinā ǀ gī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men comprehend the service of the uninjurable showerer (of benefits), and exult in the commands of the mighty (Agni); their frequent and earnest hymns of praise, bright and radiant, are illuminating heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Men comprehend the service of the uninjurable showerer (of benefits), and exult in the commands of the mighty (Agni); their frequent and earnest hymns of praise, bright and radiant, are illuminating heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतो पितृभ्यां प्रविदानु घोषं महो महद्भ्यामनयंत शूषं ।उक्षा ह यत्र परि धानमक्तोरनु स्वं धाम जरितुर्ववक्ष ॥
verses.transliteration: utó íti ǀ pitṛ́-bhyām ǀ pra-vídā ǀ ánu ǀ ghóṣam ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahát-bhyām ǀ anayanta ǀ śūṣám ǀukṣā́ ǀ ha ǀ yátra ǀ pári ǀ dhā́nam ǀ aktóḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svám ǀ dhā́ma ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ vavákṣa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily (men) bring great delight to Agniby glorifying aloud the mighty parents (heaven and earth), when the shedder of rain approximates his own radiance to the worshipper, (wherewith) to invest the night.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily (men) bring great delight to Agniby glorifying aloud the mighty parents (heaven and earth), when the shedder of rain approximates his own radiance to the worshipper, (wherewith) to invest the night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध्वर्युभिः पंचभिः सप्त विप्राः प्रियं रक्षंते निहितं पदं वेः ।प्रांचो मदंत्युक्षणो अजुर्या देवा देवानामनु हि व्रता गुः ॥
verses.transliteration: adhvaryú-bhiḥ ǀ pañcá-bhiḥ ǀ saptá ǀ víprāḥ ǀ priyám ǀ rakṣante ǀ ní-hitam ǀ padám ǀ véríti véḥ ǀprā́ñcaḥ ǀ madanti ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ ajuryā́ḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ánu ǀ hí ǀ vratā́ ǀ gúríti gúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Seven sages with five ministering priests attend the station that is prepared for the rapid (Agni); the undecaying divine (sages), with their faces to the east, sprinkling (the libations), rejoice as they celebrate the worship of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Seven sages with five ministering priests attend the station that is prepared for the rapid (Agni); the undecaying divine (sages), with their faces to the east, sprinkling (the libations), rejoice as they celebrate the worship of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा न्यृंजे सप्त पृक्षासः स्वधया मदंति ।ऋतं शंसंत ऋतमित्त आहुरनु व्रतं व्रतपा दीध्यानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: dáivyā ǀ hótārā ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ní ǀ ṛñje ǀ saptá ǀ pṛkṣā́saḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ madanti ǀṛtám ǀ śáṃsantaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ té ǀ āhuḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I propitiate the two first divine offerers of sacrifices; the seven (priests) rejoice with the libation; the illustrious celebrators of holy worship, reciting (his) praises, have called Agnithe true (object) of every rite.
verses.wilson_translation: I propitiate the two first divine offerers of sacrifices; the seven (priests) rejoice with the libation; the illustrious celebrators of holy worship, reciting (his) praises, have called Agnithe true (object) of every rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषायंते महे अत्याय पूर्वीर्वृष्णे चित्राय रश्मयः सुयामाः ।देव होतर्मंद्रतरश्चिकित्वान्महो देवान्रोदसी एह वक्षि ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣa-yánte ǀ mahé ǀ átyāya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ citrā́ya ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ su-yāmā́ḥ ǀdéva ǀ hotaḥ ǀ mandrá-taraḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ maháḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vakṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine invoker of the gods, the vast and widespreading rays shed (moisture) for you, the mighty, the victorius, the wonderful, the showerer (of benefits); do you who are all knowing, joy-bestowing, bring hither the great gods, and heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine invoker of the gods, the vast and widespreading rays shed (moisture) for you, the mighty, the victorius, the wonderful, the showerer (of benefits); do you who are all knowing, joy-bestowing, bring hither the great gods, and heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पृक्षप्रयजो द्रविणः सुवाचः सुकेतव उषसो रेवदूषुः ।उतो चिदग्ने महिना पृथिव्याः कृतं चिदेनः सं महे दशस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛkṣá-prayajaḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ ǀ su-vā́caḥ ǀ su-ketávaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ revát ǀ ūṣuḥ ǀutó íti ǀ cit ǀ agne ǀ mahinā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ kṛtám ǀ cit ǀ énaḥ ǀ sám ǀ mahé ǀ daśasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ever-moving (Agni) may the mornings rise for us, abounding with oblations, with pious prayers, and with auspicious signs, and conferring wealth; and do you with the might of your (diffusive flame), consume all sin on behalf of your respectable (worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: Ever-moving (Agni) may the mornings rise for us, abounding with oblations, with pious prayers, and with auspicious signs, and conferring wealth; and do you with the might of your (diffusive flame), consume all sin on behalf of your respectable (worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites), such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your good-will ever be upon us (productive of benefit to us).
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites), such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your good-will ever be upon us (productive of benefit to us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII Sacrificial Post.
hymns.anukramani: ११ गाथिनो विश्वामित्रः। यूपः, ६-१० यूपाः, ८ विश्वे देवा वा, ११ व्रश्चनः । त्रिष्टुप्, ३, ७ अनुष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GOD-SERVING men, O Sovran of the Forest, with heavenly meath at sacrifice anoint thee.Grant wealth to us when thou art standing upright as when reposing on this Mother's bosom. Set up to eastward of the fire enkindled, accepting prayer that wastes not, rich in hero.Driving far from us poverty and famine, lift thyself up to bring us great good fortune. Lord of the Forest, raise. thyself up on the loftiest spot of earth.Give splendour, fixt and measured well, to him who brings the sacrifice. Well-robed, enveloped he is come, the youthful: springing to life his glory waxeth greater.Contemplative in mind and God-adoring, sages of high intelligence upraise him. Sprung up he rises in the days' fair weather, increasing in the men-frequented synod.With song the wise and skilful consecrate him: his voice the God-adoring singer utters., Ye whom religious men have firmly planted; thou Forest Sovran whom the axe hath fashioned,—Let those the Stakes divine which here are standing be fain to grant us wealth with store of children. O men who lift the ladles up, these hewn and planted in the ground,Bringing a blessing to the field, shall bear our precious gift to Gods. Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, careful leaders, Earth, Heaven, and Prthivi and Air's mid-region,Accordant Deities shall bless our worship and make our sacrifice's ensign lofty. Like swan's that flee in lengthened line, the Pillars have come to us arrayed in brilliant coIour.They, lifted up on high, by sages, eastward, go forth as Gods to the God's dwelling-places. Those Stakes upon the earth with rings that deck them seem to the eye like horns of horned creatures;Or, as upraised by priests in invocation, let them assist us in the rush to battle. Lord of the Wood, rise with a hundred branches. with thousand branches may we rise to greatness,Tlou whom this hatchct, with an edge well whetted for great felicity, hath brought before us.

verses.sanskrit: अंजंति त्वामध्वरे देवयंतो वनस्पते मधुना दैव्येन ।यदूर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा द्रविणेह धत्ताद्यद्वा क्षयो मातुरस्या उपस्थे ॥
verses.transliteration: añjánti ǀ tvā́m ǀ adhvaré ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ vánaspate ǀ mádhunā ǀ dáivyena ǀyát ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ tíṣṭhāḥ ǀ dráviṇā ǀ ihá ǀ dhattāt ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ mātúḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vanaspati, the devout anoint you with sacred butter at the sacrifice; and whether you stand erect, or your abode be on the lap of this your mother (earth), grant us riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Vanaspati, the devout anoint you with sacred butter at the sacrifice; and whether you stand erect, or your abode be on the lap of this your mother (earth), grant us riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समिद्धस्य श्रयमाणः पुरस्ताद्ब्रह्म वन्वानो अजरं सुवीरं ।आरे अस्मदमतिं बाधमान उच्छ्रयस्व महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.transliteration: sám-iddhasya ǀ śráyamāṇaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ bráhma ǀ vanvānáḥ ǀ ajáram ǀ su-vī́ram ǀāré ǀ asmát ǀ ámatim ǀ bā́dhamānaḥ ǀ út ǀ śrayasva ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Standing on the east of the kindled (fire), dispensing food (as the source) of undecaying (health) and excellent progeny, keeping off our enemy at a distance, stand up for great auspiciousness.
verses.wilson_translation: Standing on the east of the kindled (fire), dispensing food (as the source) of undecaying (health) and excellent progeny, keeping off our enemy at a distance, stand up for great auspiciousness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्रयस्व वनस्पते वर्ष्मन्पृथिव्या अधि ।सुमिती मीयमानो वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसे ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ śrayasva ǀ vanaspate ǀ várṣman ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀsú-mitī ǀ mīyámānaḥ ǀ várcaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ yajñá-vāhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be exalted,Vanaspatiupon this sacred spot of earth, being measured with careful measurement, and bestow food upon the offerer of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Be exalted,Vanaspatiupon this sacred spot of earth, being measured with careful measurement, and bestow food upon the offerer of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवा सुवासाः परिवीत आगात्स उ श्रेयान्भवति जायमानः ।तं धीरासः कवय उन्नयंति स्वाध्यो मनसा देवयंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: yúvā ǀ su-vā́sāḥ ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śréyān ǀ bhavati ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀtám ǀ dhī́rāsaḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ út ǀ nayanti ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Well clad and hung with wreaths comes the youthful (pillar); most excellent it is as soon as genitive rated; steadfast and wise venerators of the gods, meditating piously in thei rminds, raise it up.
verses.wilson_translation: Well clad and hung with wreaths comes the youthful (pillar); most excellent it is as soon as genitive rated; steadfast and wise venerators of the gods, meditating piously in thei rminds, raise it up.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जातो जायते सुदिनत्वे अह्नां समर्य आ विदथे वर्धमानः ।पुनंति धीरा अपसो मनीषा देवया विप्र उदियर्ति वाचं ॥
verses.transliteration: jātáḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ sudina-tvé ǀ áhnām ǀ sa-maryé ǀ ā́ ǀ vidáthe ǀ várdhamānaḥ ǀpunánti ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ deva-yā́ḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ út ǀ iyarti ǀ vā́cam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Born (in the forest), and beautified in the sacrifice celebrated by men, it is (again) engendered for the sanctification of the days (of sacred rites); steadfast, active and intelligent (priests) consecrate it with intelligence, and the devout worshipper recites its praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Born (in the forest), and beautified in the sacrifice celebrated by men, it is (again) engendered for the sanctification of the days (of sacred rites); steadfast, active and intelligent (priests) consecrate it with intelligence, and the devout worshipper recites its praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यान्वो नरो देवयंतो निमिम्युर्वनस्पते स्वधितिर्वा ततक्ष ।ते देवासः स्वरवस्तस्थिवांसः प्रजावदस्मे दिधिषंतु रत्नं ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́n ǀ vaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ ni-mimyúḥ ǀ vánaspate ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ vā ǀ tatákṣa ǀté ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ sváravaḥ ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ prajā́-vat ǀ asmé íti ǀ didhiṣantu ǀ rátnam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those (posts) which devout men have cut down, or which,Vanaspati, the axe has trimmed, may they standing resplendent with all their parts (entire) bestow upon us wealth with progeny.
verses.wilson_translation: May those (posts) which devout men have cut down, or which,Vanaspati, the axe has trimmed, may they standing resplendent with all their parts (entire) bestow upon us wealth with progeny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये वृक्णासो अधि क्षमि निमितासो यतस्रुचः ।ते नो व्यंतु वार्यं देवत्रा क्षेत्रसाधसः ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ vṛkṇā́saḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀ ní-mitāsaḥ ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ vyantu ǀ vā́ryam ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ kṣetra-sā́dhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May thosepostswhich have been cut down upon the earth, and which have been fabricated by the priests, those which are the accomplishers of the sacrifice, convey our acceptable (offering) to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May thosepostswhich have been cut down upon the earth, and which have been fabricated by the priests, those which are the accomplishers of the sacrifice, convey our acceptable (offering) to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुनीथा द्यावाक्षामा पृथिवी अंतरिक्षं ।सजोषसो यज्ञमवंतु देवा ऊर्ध्वं कृण्वंत्वध्वरस्य केतुं ॥
verses.transliteration: ādityā́ḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ su-nīthā́ḥ ǀ dyā́vākṣā́mā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ antárikṣam ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ avantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ūrdhvám ǀ kṛṇvantu ǀ adhvarásya ǀ ketúm ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the leaders of the rite, the divineĀdityas,Rudras,Vasus, Heaven and Earth, the Earth, the firmament, well plural ased, protect our sacrifice; let them raise aloft the standard of the ceremony.
verses.wilson_translation: May the leaders of the rite, the divineĀdityas,Rudras,Vasus, Heaven and Earth, the Earth, the firmament, well plural ased, protect our sacrifice; let them raise aloft the standard of the ceremony.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हंसा इव श्रेणिशो यतानाः शुक्रा वसानाः स्वरवो न आगुः ।उन्नीयमानाः कविभिः पुरस्ताद्देवा देवानामपि यंति पाथः ॥
verses.transliteration: haṃsā́ḥ-iva ǀ śreṇi-śáḥ ǀ yátānāḥ ǀ śukrā́ ǀ vásānāḥ ǀ sváravaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aguḥ ǀut-nīyámānāḥ ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ yanti ǀ pā́thaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Arrayed in bright (garments), entire (in their parts), these pillars ranging in rows like swans, have come to us erected by pious sages on the east( of the fire); they proceed resplendent on the path of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Arrayed in bright (garments), entire (in their parts), these pillars ranging in rows like swans, have come to us erected by pious sages on the east( of the fire); they proceed resplendent on the path of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शृंगाणीवेच्छृंगिणां सं ददृश्रे चषालवंतः स्वरवः पृथिव्यां ।वाघद्भिर्वा विहवे श्रोषमाणा अस्माँ अवंतु पृतनाज्येषु ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛ́ṅgāṇi-iva ǀ ít ǀ śṛṅgíṇām ǀ sám ǀ dadṛśre ǀ caṣā́la-vantaḥ ǀ sváravaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀvāghát-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ vi-havé ǀ śróṣamāṇāḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ pṛtanā́jyeṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Entire in all parts and girded with rings, they appear upon the earth like the horns of horned cattle; hearing (their praises) by the priests; may they protect us in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: Entire in all parts and girded with rings, they appear upon the earth like the horns of horned cattle; hearing (their praises) by the priests; may they protect us in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वनस्पते शतवल्शो वि रोह सहस्रवल्शा वि वयं रुहेम ।यं त्वामयं स्वधितिस्तेजमानः प्रणिनाय महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.transliteration: vánaspate ǀ śatá-valśaḥ ǀ ví ǀ roha ǀ sahásra-valśāḥ ǀ ví ǀ vayám ǀ ruhema ǀyám ǀ tvā́m ǀ ayám ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ téjamānaḥ ǀ pra-ninā́ya ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vanaspati, mount upwith a hundred branches, that we may mount with a thousand, you whom the sharpened hatchet has brought for great auspiciousness.
verses.wilson_translation: Vanaspati, mount upwith a hundred branches, that we may mount with a thousand, you whom the sharpened hatchet has brought for great auspiciousness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help,The Waters’ Child, the blessed, the resplendent One, victorious and beyond compare. Since thou delighting in the woods hast gone unto thy mother streams,Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when from afar thou now art here. O'er pungent smoke host thou prevailed, and thus art thou benevolent.Some go before, and others round about thee sit, they in whose friendship thou hast place. Him who had passed beyond his foes, beyond continual pursuits, Him the unerring Ones, observant, found in floods, couched like a lion in his lair. Him wandering at his own free will, Agni here hidden from our view,Him Mātariśvan brought to us from far away produced by friction, from the Gods. O Bearer of Oblations, thus mortals received thee from the Gods,Whilst thou, the Friend of man, guardest each sacrifice with thine own power, Most Youthful One. Amid thy wonders this is good, yea, to the simple is it clear,When gathered round about thee, Agni, lie the herds where thou art kindled in the morn. Offer to him who knows fair rites, who burns with purifying glow,Swift envoy, active, ancient, and adorable: serve ye the God attentively. Three times a hundred Gods and thrice a thousand, and three times ten and nine have worshipped Agni,For him spread sacred grass, with oil bedewed him, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit: सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये ।अपां नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिं सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसं ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vavṛmahe ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀapā́m ǀ nápātam ǀ su-bhágam ǀ su-dī́ditim ǀ su-prátūrtim ǀ anehásam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, your mortal friends have recourse for our protection to you, the divine, the grandson of the waters, the auspicious, the resplendent, the accessible, the sinless.
verses.wilson_translation: We, your mortal friends have recourse for our protection to you, the divine, the grandson of the waters, the auspicious, the resplendent, the accessible, the sinless.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कायमानो वना त्वं यन्मातॄरजगन्नपः ।न तत्ते अग्ने प्रमृषे निवर्तनं यद्दूरे सन्निहाभवः ॥
verses.transliteration: kā́yamānaḥ ǀ vanā́ ǀ tvám ǀ yát ǀ mātṝ́ḥ ǀ ájagan ǀ apáḥ ǀná ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ pra-mṛ́ṣe ǀ ni-vártanam ǀ yát ǀ dūré ǀ sán ǀ ihá ǀ ábhavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous as you are of the forests since you have repaired to the maternal waters,Agni, your tarrying so far away is not to be endured; (in a moment) you are here with us.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous as you are of the forests since you have repaired to the maternal waters,Agni, your tarrying so far away is not to be endured; (in a moment) you are here with us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अति तृष्टं ववक्षिथाथैव सुमना असि ।प्रप्रान्ये यंति पर्यन्य आसते येषां सख्ये असि श्रितः ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ tṛṣṭám ǀ vavakṣitha ǀ átha ǀ evá ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ asi ǀprá-pra ǀ anyé ǀ yánti ǀ pári ǀ anyé ǀ āsate ǀ yéṣām ǀ sakhyé ǀ ási ǀ śritáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You wish exceedingly to convey satisfaction (to your worshippers) and are thereto well-disposed; of those in whose friendship you are cherished, some precede while others sit around.
verses.wilson_translation: You wish exceedingly to convey satisfaction (to your worshippers) and are thereto well-disposed; of those in whose friendship you are cherished, some precede while others sit around.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईयिवांसमति स्रिधः शश्वतीरति सश्चतः ।अन्वीमविंदन्निचिरासो अद्रुहोऽप्सु सिंहमिव श्रितं ॥
verses.transliteration: īyi-vā́ṃsam ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǀ śáśvatīḥ ǀ áti ǀ saścátaḥ ǀánu ǀ īm ǀ avindan ǀ ni-cirā́saḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ siṃhám-iva ǀ śritám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The benignant and long-lived deities have discovered you,Agni, when required to go against their constant and assembled foes, hidden in the waters like a lion (in a cave).
verses.wilson_translation: The benignant and long-lived deities have discovered you,Agni, when required to go against their constant and assembled foes, hidden in the waters like a lion (in a cave).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ससृवांसमिव त्मनाग्निमित्था तिरोहितं ।ऐनं नयन्मातरिश्वा परावतो देवेभ्यो मथितं परि ॥
verses.transliteration: sasṛvā́ṃsam-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ agním ǀ itthā́ ǀ tiráḥ-hitam ǀā́ ǀ enam ǀ nayat ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mathitám ǀ pári ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mātariśvantherefore brought for the gods from afar,Agni, hiding of himself, and genitive rated by attrition, as (a father brings back) a fugitive (son).
verses.wilson_translation: Mātariśvantherefore brought for the gods from afar,Agni, hiding of himself, and genitive rated by attrition, as (a father brings back) a fugitive (son).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा मर्ता अगृभ्णत देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन ।विश्वान्यद्यज्ञाँ अभिपासि मानुष तव क्रत्वा यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ mártāḥ ǀ agṛbhṇata ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havya-vāhana ǀvíśvān ǀ yát ǀ yajñā́n ǀ abhi-pā́si ǀ mānuṣa ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bearer of oblations,men apprehend you (thus concealed) for the service of the gods, and that you youngest (of the deities) and friendly to manking, may recompense by your acts all their pious rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearer of oblations,men apprehend you (thus concealed) for the service of the gods, and that you youngest (of the deities) and friendly to manking, may recompense by your acts all their pious rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तद्भद्रं तव दंसना पाकाय चिच्छदयति ।त्वां यदग्ने पशवः समासते समिद्धमपिशर्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ bhadrám ǀ táva ǀ daṃsánā ǀ pā́kāya ǀ cit ǀ chadayati ǀtvā́m ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ paśávaḥ ǀ sam-ā́sate ǀ sám-iddham ǀ api-śarvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: Auspicious is your worship for it prospers the ignorant (worshipper), wherefore animals reverence, you Agni, kindled in the beginning of the night.
verses.wilson_translation: Auspicious is your worship for it prospers the ignorant (worshipper), wherefore animals reverence, you Agni, kindled in the beginning of the night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ जुहोता स्वध्वरं शीरं पावकशोचिषं ।आशुं दूतमजिरं प्रत्नमीड्यं श्रुष्टी देवं सपर्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ juhota ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ śīrám ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀāśúm ǀ dūtám ǀ ajirám ǀ pratnám ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ devám ǀ saparyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer oblations to the object of holy sacrifice, the brilliant purifier, who is dormant (in fuel); worship quietly the pervader (of the rite), the messenger (of the gods), the rapid, the ancient deity who is entitled to laudation.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer oblations to the object of holy sacrifice, the brilliant purifier, who is dormant (in fuel); worship quietly the pervader (of the rite), the messenger (of the gods), the rapid, the ancient deity who is entitled to laudation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन् ।औक्षन्घृतैरस्तृणन्बर्हिरस्मा आदिद्धोतारं न्यसादयंत ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ śatā́ ǀ trī́ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ agním ǀ triṃśát ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ náva ǀ ca ǀ asaparyan ǀáukṣan ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ ástṛṇan ǀ barhíḥ ǀ asmai ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ hótāram ǀ ní ǀ asādayanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Three thousand three hundred and thirty-nine divinities have worshipped Agni; they have sprinkled him with melted butter; they have spread for him the sacred grass; and have seated him upon it as their ministrant priest.
verses.wilson_translation: Three thousand three hundred and thirty-nine divinities have worshipped Agni; they have sprinkled him with melted butter; they have spread for him the sacred grass; and have seated him upon it as their ministrant priest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THEE Agni, God, Imperial Lord of all mankind, do mortal menWith understanding kindle at the sacrifice. They laud thee in their solemn rites, Agni, as Minister and Priest,Shine forth in thine own home as guardian of the Law. He, verily, who honours thee with fuel, Knower of all life,He, Agni! wins heroic might, he prospers well. Ensign of sacrifices, he, Agni, with Gods is come to us,Decked by the seven priests, to him who bringeth gifts. To Agni, the Invoking Priest, offer your best, your lofty speech,To him Ordainer-like who brings the light of songs. Let these our hymns make Agni grow, whence, meet for laud, he springs to life,To mighty strength and great possession, fair to see. Best Sacrificer, bring the Gods, O Agni, to the pious man:A joyful Priest, thy splendour drive our foes afar As such, O Purifier, shine on us heroic glorious might:Be nearest Friend to those who laud thee, for their weal. So, wakeful, versed in sacred hymns, the holy singers kindly thee.Oblation-bearer, deathless, cherisher of strength.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने मनीषिणः सम्राजं चर्षणीनां ।देवं मर्तास इंधते समध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ sam-rā́jam ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀdevám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ indhate ǀ sám ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, the king of men;Agni, the divine; prudent mortals kindle you at the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: You, the king of men;Agni, the divine; prudent mortals kindle you at the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञेष्वृत्विजमग्ने होतारमीळते ।गोपा ऋतस्य दीदिहि स्वे दमे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀ ágne ǀ hótāram ǀ īḷate ǀgopā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dīdihi ǀ své ǀ dáme ǁ
verses.english_translation: They praise you as the priest, the invoker (of the gods) at sacrifice; shine forth the protector of the pious rite in your own abode.
verses.wilson_translation: They praise you as the priest, the invoker (of the gods) at sacrifice; shine forth the protector of the pious rite in your own abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स घा यस्ते ददाशति समिधा जातवेदसे ।सो अग्ने धत्ते सुवीर्यं स पुष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ dádāśati ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ jātá-vedase ǀsáḥ ǀ agne ǀ dhatte ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ sáḥ ǀ puṣyati ǁ
verses.english_translation: He verily who presents oblations to you, the knower of all things, he acquires (Agni) excellent progeny; he prospers.
verses.wilson_translation: He verily who presents oblations to you, the knower of all things, he acquires (Agni) excellent progeny; he prospers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स केतुरध्वराणामग्निर्देवेभिरा गमत् ।अंजानः सप्त होतृभिर्हविष्मते ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ketúḥ ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ agníḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀañjānáḥ ǀ saptá ǀ hótṛ-bhiḥ ǀ havíṣmate ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (Agni), the banner (flag) of sacrifices, offering oblations on the part of the worshiper through (the ministry of) the seven offering priests, come hither with the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May (Agni), the banner (flag) of sacrifices, offering oblations on the part of the worshiper through (the ministry of) the seven offering priests, come hither with the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र होत्रे पूर्व्यं वचोऽग्नये भरता बृहत् ।विपां ज्योतींषि बिभ्रते न वेधसे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ hótre ǀ pūrvyám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ bharata ǀ bṛhát ǀvipā́m ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ bíbhrate ǀ ná ǀ vedháse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer to the ministering Agnias if to the Creator (of the world), the great praise recited of old, for the sake of animating the energies of the pious (worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: Offer to the ministering Agnias if to the Creator (of the world), the great praise recited of old, for the sake of animating the energies of the pious (worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं वर्धंतु नो गिरो यतो जायत उक्थ्यः ।महे वाजाय द्रविणाय दर्शतः ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ jā́yate ǀ ukthyáḥ ǀmahé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ dráviṇāya ǀ darśatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May ourhymns exalt Agni, so that he may be born more worthy of praise, and may become manifest for the purpose of (bestowing) abundant food and riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May ourhymns exalt Agni, so that he may be born more worthy of praise, and may become manifest for the purpose of (bestowing) abundant food and riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने यजिष्ठो अध्वरे देवांदेवयते यज ।होता मंद्रो वि राजस्यति स्रिधः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ devā́n ǀ deva-yaté ǀ yaja ǀhótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, you are to be especially worshipped at the sacrifice; worship the gods (on behalf of) the devout (worshiper); you shine the invoker (of the gods) the exhilarator (of the pious) overcoming your foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, you are to be especially worshipped at the sacrifice; worship the gods (on behalf of) the devout (worshiper); you shine the invoker (of the gods) the exhilarator (of the pious) overcoming your foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पावक दीदिहि द्युमदस्मे सुवीर्यं ।भवा स्तोतृभ्यो अंतमः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ dīdihi ǀ dyu-mát ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀbháva ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ántamaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, our purifier, light up for us a brilliant progeny; be ever nigh to those who praise you for their well-being.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, our purifier, light up for us a brilliant progeny; be ever nigh to those who praise you for their well-being.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा विप्रा विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिंधते ।हव्यवाहममर्त्यं सहोवृधं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀ jāgṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ sám ǀ indhate ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ ámartyam ǀ sahaḥ-vṛ́dham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise, intelligent, and vigilant (worshipers) kindle you, such as you (have been described), the bearer of oblations, the immortal, genitive rated by strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise, intelligent, and vigilant (worshipers) kindle you, such as you (have been described), the bearer of oblations, the immortal, genitive rated by strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN Xl. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI is Priest, the great High Priest of sacrifice, most swift in act:He knows the rite in constant course. Oblation-bearer, deathless, well inclined, an eager messenger,Agni comes nigh us with the thought. Ensign of sacrifice from of old, Agni well knoweth with his thoughtTo prosper this man's aim and hope. Agni, illustrious from old time, the Son of Strength who knows all life,The Gods have made to their Priest. Infallible is Agni, he who goes before the tribes of men,A chariot swift and ever new. Strength of the Gods which none may harm, subduing all his enemies,Agni is mightiest in fame. By offering sacred food to him the mortal worshipper obtains.A home from him whose light makes pure. From Agni, by our hymns, may we gain all things that bring happiness,Singers of him who knows all life. O Agni, in our deeds of might may we obtain all precious things:Tle Gods are centred all in thee.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता पुरोहितोऽध्वरस्य विचर्षणिः ।स वेद यज्ञमानुषक् ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ veda ǀ yajñám ǀ ānuṣák ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the invoker of the gods, the minister (of the gods), the supervisor of the sacrifice, understands the solemn rite in its due course.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the invoker of the gods, the minister (of the gods), the supervisor of the sacrifice, understands the solemn rite in its due course.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हव्यवाळमर्त्य उशिग्दूतश्चनोहितः ।अग्निर्धिया समृण्वति ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ uśík ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ cánaḥ-hitaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sám ǀ ṛṇvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: That Agni, who is the bearer of oblations, the immortal, the desirer (of offerings), the messenger (of the gods), and is the receiver of sacrificial viands, is associated with understanding.
verses.wilson_translation: That Agni, who is the bearer of oblations, the immortal, the desirer (of offerings), the messenger (of the gods), and is the receiver of sacrificial viands, is associated with understanding.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्धिया स चेतति केतुर्यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ।अर्थं ह्यस्य तरणि ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ cetati ǀ ketúḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀártham ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ taráṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the ancient banner (flag) of sacrifice, knows (all things) through understanding; his radiance traverses (the darkness).
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the ancient banner (flag) of sacrifice, knows (all things) through understanding; his radiance traverses (the darkness).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं सूनुं सनश्रुतं सहसो जातवेदसं ।वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ sūnúm ǀ sána-śrutam ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀváhnim ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods have made Agni, who is the son of strength, the eternally-renowned, the knower of all that is born, the bearer (of oblations).
verses.wilson_translation: The gods have made Agni, who is the son of strength, the eternally-renowned, the knower of all that is born, the bearer (of oblations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणां ।तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádābhyaḥ ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ viśā́m ǀ agníḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀtū́rṇiḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ návaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the preceder of human beings, (ever) alert, the vehicle of their offerings, is ever new, is unsusceptible of harm.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the preceder of human beings, (ever) alert, the vehicle of their offerings, is ever new, is unsusceptible of harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: साह्वान्विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः ।अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: sahvā́n ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ krátuḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ámṛktaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tuvíśravaḥ-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the most liberal contributor of food, is able to resist all assailants unharmed, the nourisher of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the most liberal contributor of food, is able to resist all assailants unharmed, the nourisher of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रयांसि वाहसा दाश्वाँ अश्नोति मर्त्यः ।क्षयं पावकशोचिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ vā́hasā ǀ dāśvā́n ǀ aśnoti ǀ mártyaḥ ǀkṣáyam ǀ pāvaká-śociṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: From Agniof purifying radiance the mortal presenter (of offerings) obtains by his conveyance (of them to the gods) abundant viands and a dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: From Agniof purifying radiance the mortal presenter (of offerings) obtains by his conveyance (of them to the gods) abundant viands and a dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि विश्वानि सुधिताग्नेरश्याम मन्मभिः ।विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ víśvāni ǀ sú-dhitā ǀ agnéḥ ǀ aśyāma ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, endowed with intelligence, obtain all good things by our praises of Agni, to whom all is known.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, endowed with intelligence, obtain all good things by our praises of Agni, to whom all is known.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने विश्वानि वार्या वाजेषु सनिषामहे ।त्वे देवास एरिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ saniṣāmahe ǀtvé íti ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we obtain,Agni, all precious things (as booty) in battles, since the gods are concentrated in you.
verses.wilson_translation: May we obtain,Agni, all precious things (as booty) in battles, since the gods are concentrated in you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Indra-Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MOVED, Indra-Agni, by our hymn, come to the juice, the precious dew:Drink ye thereof, impelled by song. O Indra-Agni, with the man who lauds you comes the wakening rite:So drink ye both this juice assured. Through force of sacrifice I choose Indra-Agni who love the wise:With Soma let these sate them here. Indra and Agni I invoke, joint-victors, bounteous, unsubdued,Foe-slayers, best to win the spoil. Indra and Agni, singers skilled in melody hymn you, bringing lauds:I choose you for the sacred food. Indra and Agni, ye cast down the ninety forts which Dāsas held,Together, with one mighty deed. To Indra-Agni reverent thoughts go forward from the holy taskAlong the path of sacred Law. O Indra-Agni, powers are yours, and dwellings and delightful foodGood is your readiness to act. Indra and Agni, in your deeds of might ye deck heaven's lucid realms:Famed is that hero strength of yours.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी आ गतं सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यं ।अस्य पातं धियेषिता ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ sutám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǀasyá ǀ pātam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ iṣitā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Agni, come to this acceptable libation, (brought) by our praises from heaven, and induced by (our) devotion to drink of it.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Agni, come to this acceptable libation, (brought) by our praises from heaven, and induced by (our) devotion to drink of it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी जरितुः सचा यज्ञो जिगाति चेतनः ।अया पातमिमं सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ jaritu��ḥ ǀ sácā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ jigāti ǀ cétanaḥ ǀayā́ ǀ pātam ǀ imám ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Agni, the conscious sacrifice associated with the worshipper proceeds to you; (summoned) by this (invocation) drink the libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Agni, the conscious sacrifice associated with the worshipper proceeds to you; (summoned) by this (invocation) drink the libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रमग्निं कविच्छदा यज्ञस्य जूत्या वृणे ।ता सोमस्येह तृंपतां ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ agním ǀ kavi-chádā ǀ yajñásya ǀ jūtyā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǀtā́ ǀ sómasya ǀ ihá ǀ tṛmpatām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Urged by the energy of the sacrifice, I have recourse to Indraand Agni, the protectors of the pious; may they be satiated with the Somahere presented.
verses.wilson_translation: Urged by the energy of the sacrifice, I have recourse to Indraand Agni, the protectors of the pious; may they be satiated with the Somahere presented.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता ।इंद्राग्नी वाजसातमा ॥
verses.transliteration: tośā́ ǀ vṛtra-hánā ǀ huve ǀ sa-jítvānā ǀ áparā-jitā ǀindrāgnī́ íti ǀ vāja-sā́tamā ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke Indraand Agni, the discomfiters of foes, the destroyers of Vṛtra, the victorious, the invincible, the bestowers of most abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke Indraand Agni, the discomfiters of foes, the destroyers of Vṛtra, the victorious, the invincible, the bestowers of most abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वामर्चंत्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः ।इंद्राग्नी इष आ वृणे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ arcanti ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀ nītha-vídaḥ ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǁ
verses.english_translation: The reciters of prayers, the repeaters of praise, who are skilled in sacred song, worship you both; I have recourse to Indraand Agnifor food.
verses.wilson_translation: The reciters of prayers, the repeaters of praise, who are skilled in sacred song, worship you both; I have recourse to Indraand Agnifor food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतं ।साकमेकेन कर्मणा ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ navatím ǀ púraḥ ǀ dāsá-patnīḥ ǀ adhūnutam ǀsākám ǀ ékena ǀ kármaṇā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Agni, with one united effort you over-threw ninety cities ruled over by (your) foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Agni, with one united effort you over-threw ninety cities ruled over by (your) foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यंति धीतयः ।ऋतस्य पथ्या अनु ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ ápasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ úpa ǀ prá ǀ yanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Agnithe pious ministers, are present at our holy rite, according to the wave of worship.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Agnithe pious ministers, are present at our holy rite, according to the wave of worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी तविषाणि वां सधस्थानि प्रयांसि च ।युवोरप्तूर्यं हितं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ taviṣā́ṇi ǀ vām ǀ sadhá-sthāni ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ ca ǀyuvóḥ ǀ ap-tū́ryam ǀ hitám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Agni, in you, vigour and food are abiding together, and therefore in you is deposited the dispensing of water.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Agni, in you, vigour and food are abiding together, and therefore in you is deposited the dispensing of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः ।तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ bhūṣathaḥ ǀtát ǀ vām ǀ ceti ǀ prá ǀ vīryám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Agni, illuminators of heaven, be ever graced (with victory) in battles, for such your prowess proclaims.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Agni, illuminators of heaven, be ever graced (with victory) in battles, for such your prowess proclaims.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Agni, to this God of yours I sing aloud with utmost power.May he come to us with the Gods, and sit, best Offerer, on the grass. The Holy, whose are earth and heaven, and succour waits upon his strength;Him men who bring oblations laud, and they who wish to gain, for grace. He is the Sage who guides these men, Leader of sacred rites is he.Him your own Agni, serve ye well, who winneth and bestoweth wealth. So may the gracious Agni grant most goodly shelter for our use;Whence in the heavens or in the floods he shall pour wealth upon our lands. The singers kindle him, the Priest, Agni the Lord of tribes of men,Resplendent and without a peer through his own excellent designs. Help us, thou Brahman, best of all invokers of the Gods in song.Beam, Friend of Maruts, bliss on us, O Agni, a most liberal God. Yea, grant us treasure thousandfold with children and with nourishment,And, Agni, splendid hero strength, exalted, wasting not away.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो देवायाग्नये बर्हिष्ठमर्चास्मै ।गमद्देवेभिरा स नो यजिष्ठो बर्हिरा सदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ devā́ya ǀ agnáye ǀ bárhiṣṭham ǀ arca ǀ asmai ǀgámat ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Priests) utter devout (praises) to this your divine Agni, that so glorified he may come to us with gods, and sit down on the sacrificial grass.
verses.wilson_translation: (Priests) utter devout (praises) to this your divine Agni, that so glorified he may come to us with gods, and sit down on the sacrificial grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावा यस्य रोदसी दक्षं सचंत ऊतयः ।हविष्मंतस्तमीळते तं सनिष्यंतोऽवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtá-vā ǀ yásya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dákṣam ǀ sácante ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀhavíṣmantaḥ ǀ tám ǀ īḷate ǀ tám ǀ saniṣyántaḥ ǀ ávase ǁ
verses.english_translation: The observer of truth, of whom (are) heaven and earth, and whose vigour the protecting (deities) assist; him, the offerers of oblations adore, and those desirous of riches (have recourse) to him for protection.
verses.wilson_translation: The observer of truth, of whom (are) heaven and earth, and whose vigour the protecting (deities) assist; him, the offerers of oblations adore, and those desirous of riches (have recourse) to him for protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स यंता विप्र एषां स यज्ञानामथा हि षः ।अग्निं तं वो दुवस्यत दाता यो वनिता मघं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yantā́ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ sáḥ ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ átha ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǀagním ǀ tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ duvasyata ǀ dā́tā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vánitā ǀ maghám ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the sage, is the director of those (who sacrifice), he is (the regulator) of sacrifices; worship him you (benefactor), the donor, who is the bestower of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the sage, is the director of those (who sacrifice), he is (the regulator) of sacrifices; worship him you (benefactor), the donor, who is the bestower of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः शर्माणि वीतयेऽग्निर्यच्छतु शंतमा ।यतो नः प्रुष्णवद्वसु दिवि क्षितिभ्यो अप्स्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śármāṇi ǀ vītáye ǀ agníḥ ǀ yacchatu ǀ śám-tamā ǀyátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pruṣṇávat ǀ vásu ǀ diví ǀ kṣití-bhyaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that Agnibestow upon us prosperous dwellings for our maintenance, so that from him infinite wealth, whether it may be in heaven or from earth, or in the waters (may come to us).
verses.wilson_translation: May that Agnibestow upon us prosperous dwellings for our maintenance, so that from him infinite wealth, whether it may be in heaven or from earth, or in the waters (may come to us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दीदिवांसमपूर्व्यं वस्वीभिरस्य धीतिभिः ।ऋक्वाणो अग्निमिंधते होतारं विश्पतिं विशां ॥
verses.transliteration: dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ ápūrvyam ǀ vásvībhiḥ ǀ asya ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀṛ́kvāṇaḥ ǀ agním ǀ indhate ǀ hótāram ǀ viśpátim ǀ viśā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: The devout kindle (the fire) with his wealth-obtaining rites, (to worship) the radiant, unpreceded Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the protector of men.
verses.wilson_translation: The devout kindle (the fire) with his wealth-obtaining rites, (to worship) the radiant, unpreceded Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the protector of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो ब्रह्मन्नविष उक्थेषु देवहूतमः ।शं नः शोचा मरुद्वृधोऽग्ने सहस्रसातमः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ bráhman ǀ aviṣaḥ ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ deva-hū́tamaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ śoca ǀ marút-vṛdhaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sahasra-sā́tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Perfect our prayer, invoker of the gods, as well as our hymns;Agni, who increases with the winds and the giver of thousands, augment our felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: Perfect our prayer, invoker of the gods, as well as our hymns;Agni, who increases with the winds and the giver of thousands, augment our felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू नो रास्व सहस्रवत्तोकवत्पुष्टिमद्वसु ।द्युमदग्ने सुवीर्यं वर्षिष्ठमनुपक्षितं ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ sahásra-vat ǀ toká-vat ǀ puṣṭi-mát ǀ vásu ǀdyu-mát ǀ agne ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ ánupa-kṣitam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us indeed,Agni, wealth (that may be counted) by thousands, and comprising offspring, nourishment, brilliant treasure, and vigour, and be infinite and inexhaustible.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us indeed,Agni, wealth (that may be counted) by thousands, and comprising offspring, nourishment, brilliant treasure, and vigour, and be infinite and inexhaustible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: THE pleasant Priest is come into the synod, true, skilled in sacrifice, most wise, Ordainer.Agni, the Son of Strength, whose car is lightning, whose hair is flame, hath shown on earth his lustre. To thee I offer reverent speech: accept it: to thee who markest it, victorious, faithful!Bring, thou who knowest, those who know, and seat thee amid the sacred grass, for help, O Holy. The Two who show their vigour, Night and Morning, by the wind's paths shall haste to thee O Agni.When men adorn the Ancient with oblations, these seek, as on two chariot-seats, the dwelling. To thee, strong Agni! Varuṇa and Mitra and all the Maruts sang a song of triumph,What time unto the people's lands thou camest, spreading them as the Sun of men, with lustre. Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing.Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit, a Priest with no unfriendly thought, O Agni. For, Son of Strength, from thee come many succours, and powers abundant that a God possesses.Agni, to us with speech that hath no falsehood grant riches, real, to be told in thousands. Whatever, God, in sacrifice we mortals have wrought is all for thee, strong, wise of purpose!Be thou the Friend of each good chariot's master. All this enjoy thou here, immortal Agni.

verses.sanskrit: आ होता मंद्रो विदथान्यस्थात्सत्यो यज्वा कवितमः स वेधाः ।विद्युद्रथः सहसस्पुत्रो अग्निः शोचिष्केशः पृथिव्यां पाजो अश्रेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ vidáthāni ǀ asthāt ǀ satyáḥ ǀ yájvā ǀ kaví-tamaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀvidyút-rathaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ śocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ aśret ǁ
verses.english_translation: The invoker (of the gods), the exhilarator (of his worshippers), the true, the offerer of sacrifice, the most wise, the creator, is present at our sacred rites.Agni, the son of strength, whose chariot is the lightning, whose hair is flame, manifests his glory on the earth.
verses.wilson_translation: The invoker (of the gods), the exhilarator (of his worshippers), the true, the offerer of sacrifice, the most wise, the creator, is present at our sacred rites.Agni, the son of strength, whose chariot is the lightning, whose hair is flame, manifests his glory on the earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयामि ते नमउक्तिं जुषस्व ऋतावस्तुभ्यं चेतते सहस्वः ।विद्वाँ आ वक्षि विदुषो नि षत्सि मध्य आ बर्हिरूतये यजत्र ॥
verses.transliteration: áyāmi ǀ te ǀ námaḥ-uktim ǀ juṣasva ǀ ṛ́ta-vaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ cétate ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀvidvā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ vidúṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ satsi ǀ mádhye ǀ ā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ yajatra ǁ
verses.english_translation: I utter to you the words of adoration, be plural ased by them observer of truth; endowed with strength, (they are addressed) to you who are the expounder (of sacred rites); wise (as you are), bring (hither) the wise; object of sacrifice, sit down in the midst upon the sacred grass for our protection.
verses.wilson_translation: I utter to you the words of adoration, be plural ased by them observer of truth; endowed with strength, (they are addressed) to you who are the expounder (of sacred rites); wise (as you are), bring (hither) the wise; object of sacrifice, sit down in the midst upon the sacred grass for our protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्रवतां त उषसा वाजयंती अग्ने वातस्य पथ्याभिरच्छ ।यत्सीमंजंति पूर्व्यं हविर्भिरा वंधुरेव तस्थतुर्दुरोणे ॥
verses.transliteration: drávatām ǀ te ǀ uṣásā ǀ vājáyantī íti ǀ agne ǀ vā́tasya ǀ pathyā́bhiḥ ǀ áccha ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ añjánti ǀ pūrvyám ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vandhúrā-iva ǀ tasthatuḥ ǀ duroṇé ǁ
