verses.english_translation: May the good-bestowing day and night hasten to you while you,Agnimeet them on the paths of the wind; since (the priests) ever worship you preceding (them) with oblations, whilst they (united) like the pole (and the yoke of a wagon), abide successively in our dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: May the good-bestowing day and night hasten to you while you,Agnimeet them on the paths of the wind; since (the priests) ever worship you preceding (them) with oblations, whilst they (united) like the pole (and the yoke of a wagon), abide successively in our dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रश्च तुभ्यं वरुणः सहस्वोऽग्ने विश्वे मरुतः सुम्नमर्चन् ।यच्छोचिषा सहसस्पुत्र तिष्ठा अभि क्षितीः प्रथयंत्सूर्यो नॄन् ॥
verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ túbhyam ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ arcan ǀyát ǀ śocíṣā ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ tíṣṭhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ pratháyan ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vigorous Agni, you Mitraand Varuṇa, and all the Maruts, offer praise; since, son of strength, you stand a sun, shedding your rays with lustre on manking.
verses.wilson_translation: Vigorous Agni, you Mitraand Varuṇa, and all the Maruts, offer praise; since, son of strength, you stand a sun, shedding your rays with lustre on manking.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं ते अद्य ररिमा हि काममुत्तानहस्ता नमसोपसद्य ।यजिष्ठेन मनसा यक्षि देवानस्रेधता मन्मना विप्रो अग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ rarimá ǀ hí ǀ kā́mam ǀ uttāná-hastāḥ ǀ námasā ǀ upa-sádya ǀyájiṣṭhena ǀ mánasā ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ ásredhatā ǀ mánmanā ǀ vípraḥ ǀ agne ǁ
verses.english_translation: With upliftedhands, approaching you with reverence we present you today our oblation do you who are wise, worship the gods with most devout mind and with unwearied praise.
verses.wilson_translation: With upliftedhands, approaching you with reverence we present you today our oblation do you who are wise, worship the gods with most devout mind and with unwearied praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्धि पुत्र सहसो वि पूर्वीर्देवस्य यंत्यूतयो वि वाजाः ।त्वं देहि सहस्रिणं रयिं नोऽद्रोघेण वचसा सत्यमग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration: tvát ǀ hí ǀ putra ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ devásya ǀ yánti ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀtvám ǀ dehi ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǀ adroghéṇa ǀ vácasā ǀ satyám ǀ agne ǁ
verses.english_translation: From you, verily, son of strength, many and various benefactions and various kinds of food devolve upon the devout (worshipper) do you grant us,Agni, infinite wealth, and (a son) observant of truth, with speech devoid of guile.
verses.wilson_translation: From you, verily, son of strength, many and various benefactions and various kinds of food devolve upon the devout (worshipper) do you grant us,Agni, infinite wealth, and (a son) observant of truth, with speech devoid of guile.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं दक्ष कविक्रतो यानीमा देव मर्तासो अध्वरे अकर्म ।���्वं विश्वस्य सुरथस्य बोधि सर्वं तदग्ने अमृत स्वदेह ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ dakṣa ǀ kavikrato íti kavi-krato ǀ yā́ni ǀ imā́ ǀ déva ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ ákarma ǀtvám ǀ víśvasya ǀ su-ráthasya ǀ bodhi ǀ sárvam ǀ tát ǀ agne ǀ amṛta ǀ svada ǀ ihá ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine (Agni), mighty and omniscient, these (are the offerings) which we mortals present to you in the sacrifice; do you be cognizant of every respectable worshipper, and partake, immortal of all (his offerings) on this occasion.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine (Agni), mighty and omniscient, these (are the offerings) which we mortals present to you in the sacrifice; do you be cognizant of every respectable worshipper, and partake, immortal of all (his offerings) on this occasion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . RESPLENDENT with thy wide-extending lustre, dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate usMay lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, the easily-invoked, the good Protector. Be thou To us, while now the morn is breaking, be thou a guardian when the Sun hath mounted..Accept, as men accept a true-born infant, my laud, O Agni nobly born in body. Bull, who beholdest men, through many mornings, among the dark ones shine forth red, O Agni.Lead us, good Lord, and bear us over trouble: Help us who long, Most Youthful God, to riches. Shine forth, a Bull invincible, O Agni, winning by conquest all the forts and treasures,Thou Jātavedas who art skilled in guiding, the chief high saving sacrifice's Leader. Lighting Gods hither, Agni, wisest Singer, bring thou to us many and flawless shelters.Bring vigour, like a car that gathers booty: bring us, O Agni, beauteous Earth and Heaven. Swell, O thou Bull and give those powers an impulse, e’en Earth and Heaven who yield their milk in plenty,Shining, O God, with Gods in clear effulgence. Let not a mortal's evil will obstruct us. Agni, as holy food to thine invoker, give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sanskrit: वि पाजसा पृथुना शोशुचानो बाधस्व द्विषो रक्षसो अमीवाः ।सुशर्मणो बृहतः शर्मणि स्यामग्नेरहं सुहवस्य प्रणीतौ ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ pā́jasā ǀ pṛthúnā ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ bā́dhasva ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀsu-śármaṇaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ śármaṇi ǀ syām ǀ agnéḥ ǀ ahám ǀ su-hávasya ǀ prá-nītau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Radiant with great glory, repel the hostilerākṣasasandpiśācas; may I be in (the enjoyment) of the favour of the great (Agni), the giver of prosperity, and in the service of (him who is) easily invoked.
verses.wilson_translation: Radiant with great glory, repel the hostilerākṣasasandpiśācas; may I be in (the enjoyment) of the favour of the great (Agni), the giver of prosperity, and in the service of (him who is) easily invoked.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ त्वं सूर उदिते बोधि गोपाः ।जन्मेव नित्यं तनयं जुषस्व स्तोमं मे अग्ने तन्वा सुजात ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ tvám ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ bodhi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀjánma-iva ǀ nítyam ǀ tánayam ǀ juṣasva ǀ stómam ǀ me ǀ agne ǀ tanvā́ ǀ su-jāta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Consider yourself our protector at the breaking of the dawn today and when the sun has risen;Agni, who is engendered with (embodied) form, be plural ased with my constant praise, as a father (is plural ased with) his son.
verses.wilson_translation: Consider yourself our protector at the breaking of the dawn today and when the sun has risen;Agni, who is engendered with (embodied) form, be plural ased with my constant praise, as a father (is plural ased with) his son.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नृचक्षा वृषभानु पूर्वीः कृष्णास्वग्ने अरुषो वि भाहि ।वसो नेषि च पर्षि चात्यंहः कृधी नो राय उशिजो यविष्ठ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ ánu ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ kṛṣṇā́su ǀ agne ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀváso íti ǀ néṣi ǀ ca ǀ párṣi ǀ ca ǀ áti ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ kṛdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer (of benefits),beholder of men, radiant amid darkness, shine,Agni, with abundant (rays) in due order; granter of dwellings, conduct us (to good), keep off all ill, and youngest (of all the gods), gratify our desires for wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer (of benefits),beholder of men, radiant amid darkness, shine,Agni, with abundant (rays) in due order; granter of dwellings, conduct us (to good), keep off all ill, and youngest (of all the gods), gratify our desires for wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अषाळ्हो अग्ने वृषभो दिदीहि पुरो विश्वाः सौभगा संजिगीवान् ।यज्ञस्य नेता प्रथमस्य पायोर्जातवेदो बृहतः सुप्रणीते ॥
verses.transliteration: áṣāḷhaḥ ǀ agne ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ didīhi ǀ púraḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sáubhagā ǀ sam-jigīvā́n ǀyajñásya ǀ netā́ ǀ prathamásya ǀ pāyóḥ ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ su-pranīte ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who is irresistible and the showerer (of benefits), consume victorious all the cities (of the foe) and (all their) precious things; do you, the duly worshipped, the knower of all that is born, (be for us) the conductor of the first great preserving sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who is irresistible and the showerer (of benefits), consume victorious all the cities (of the foe) and (all their) precious things; do you, the duly worshipped, the knower of all that is born, (be for us) the conductor of the first great preserving sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छिद्रा शर्म जरितः पुरूणि देवाँ अच्छा दीद्यानः सुमेधाः ।रथो न सस्निरभि वक्षि वाजमग्ने त्वं रोदसी नः सुमेके ॥
verses.transliteration: ácchidrā ǀ śárma ǀ jaritaríti ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ dī́dyānaḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sásniḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vakṣi ǀ vā́jam ǀ agne ǀ tvám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroyer (of the world), do you who is endowed with intelligence and radiance celebrate many faultless sacred rites in honour of the gods, and restraining (your impatience), convey to them like a wagon our (sacrificial) food; illume (with your rays) the beautiful heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroyer (of the world), do you who is endowed with intelligence and radiance celebrate many faultless sacred rites in honour of the gods, and restraining (your impatience), convey to them like a wagon our (sacrificial) food; illume (with your rays) the beautiful heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र पीपय वृषभ जिन्व वाजानग्ने त्वं रोदसी नः सुदोघे ।देवेभिर्देव सुरुचा रुचानो मा नो मर्तस्य दुर्मतिः परि ष्ठात् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ pīpaya ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ jínva ǀ vā́jān ǀ ágne ǀ tvám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ sudóghe íti su-dóghe ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ deva ǀ su-rúcā ǀ rucānáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ duḥ-matíḥ ǀ pári ǀ sthāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be propitious, showerer (of benefits); grant (abundant) food,Agni; (make) heaven and earth yield us milk; divine (Agni), associated with the gods, shining with bright radiance, let not the ill-will of any mortal prevail against us.
verses.wilson_translation: Be propitious, showerer (of benefits); grant (abundant) food,Agni; (make) heaven and earth yield us milk; divine (Agni), associated with the gods, shining with bright radiance, let not the ill-will of any mortal prevail against us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, earth the giver of cattle the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, earth the giver of cattle the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVI. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ६ कात्य उत्कीलः। अग्निः। प्रगाथः(१, ३, ५ बृहती, २, ४, ६ सतो बृहती)।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS Agni is the Lord of great felicity and hero Strength;Lord of wealth in herds of kine; Lord of the battles with the foe. Wait, Maruts, Heroes, upon him the Prosperer in whom is bliss-increasing wealth;Who in fights ever conquer evil-hearted men, who overcome the enemy. As such, O Agni, deal us wealth and hero might, O Bounteous One!Most lofty, very glorious, rich in progeny, free from disease and full of power. He who made all that lives, who passes all in might, who orders service to the Gods,He works among the Gods, he works in hero strength, yea, also in the praise of men. Give us not up to indigence, Agni, nor want of hero sons,Nor, Son of Strength, to lack of cattle, nor to blame. Drive. thou our enemies away. Help us to strength, blest Agni! rich in progeny, abundant, in our sacrifice.Flood us with riches yet more plenteous, bringing weal, with high renown, most Glorious One!

verses.sanskrit: अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे महः सौभगस्य ।राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानां ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ ī́śe ǀ maháḥ ǀ sáubhagasya ǀrāyáḥ ǀ īśe ǀ su-apatyásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ vṛtra-háthānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Agni, is the lord of heroism and of great good fortune; he is the lord of wealth comprising progeny and cattle; he is the lord of the slayers of Vṛtra;
verses.wilson_translation: This Agni, is the lord of heroism and of great good fortune; he is the lord of wealth comprising progeny and cattle; he is the lord of the slayers of Vṛtra;
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमं नरो मरुतः सश्चता वृधं यस्मिन्रायः शेवृधासः ।अभि ये संति पृतनासु दूढ्यो विश्वाहा शत्रुमादभुः ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ naraḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ saścata ǀ vṛ́dham ǀ yásmin ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ śé-vṛdhāsaḥ ǀabhí ǀ yé ǀ sánti ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ śátrum ǀ ā-dabhúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, leaders (of rites), associate with this augmenter (of our prosperity), in whom (abide) riches contributing to felicity, you who (are victorious) over (your) enemies in battle, who daily humble (your) foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, leaders (of rites), associate with this augmenter (of our prosperity), in whom (abide) riches contributing to felicity, you who (are victorious) over (your) enemies in battle, who daily humble (your) foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं नो रायः शिशीहि मीढ्वो अग्ने सुवीर्यस्य ।तुविद्युम्न वर्षिष्ठस्य प्रजावतोऽनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ śiśīhi ǀ mī́ḍhvaḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀtúvi-dyumna ǀ várṣiṣṭhasya ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ anamīvásya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, opulent Agni, showerer (of benefits), prosper us with riches comprising vigour, numerous progeny health, and happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, opulent Agni, showerer (of benefits), prosper us with riches comprising vigour, numerous progeny health, and happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चक्रिर्यो विश्वा भुवनाभि सासहिश्चक्रिर्देवेष्वा दुवः ।आ देवेषु यतत आ सुवीर्य आ शंस उत नृणां ॥
verses.transliteration: cákriḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ cákriḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ dúvaḥ ǀā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yátate ǀ ā́ ǀ su-vī́rye ǀ ā́ ǀ śáṃse ǀ utá ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is the maker pevades all worlds; he the enduring maker (of all) bears our offerings to the gods; he is present with the devout (worshippers) and amidst th eheroism and the devotions of men.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is the maker pevades all worlds; he the enduring maker (of all) bears our offerings to the gods; he is present with the devout (worshippers) and amidst th eheroism and the devotions of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो अग्नेऽमतये मावीरतायै रीरधः ।मागोतायै सहसस्पुत्र मा निदेऽप द्वेषांस्या कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ámataye ǀ mā́ ǀ avī́ratāyai ǀ rīradhaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ agótāyai ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ mā́ ǀ nidé ǀ ápa ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Consign us not,Agnito malignity; (doom) us not to the absence of posterity; nor, son of strength, to the want of cattle, nor to reproach; drive away (all) animosities.
verses.wilson_translation: Consign us not,Agnito malignity; (doom) us not to the absence of posterity; nor, son of strength, to the want of cattle, nor to reproach; drive away (all) animosities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शग्धि वाजस्य सुभग प्रजावतोऽग्ने बृहतो अध्वरे ।सं राया भूयसा सृज मयोभुना तुविद्युम्न यशस्वता ॥
verses.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ vā́jasya ǀ su-bhaga ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ ágne ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀsám ǀ rāyā́ ǀ bhū́yasā ǀ sṛja ǀ mayaḥ-bhúnā ǀ túvi-dyumna ǀ yáśasvatā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Auspicious Agni, bestow (upon us) at the rite, food (the source of) happiness and renown.
verses.wilson_translation: Auspicious Agni, bestow (upon us) at the rite, food (the source of) happiness and renown.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . DULY enkindled after ancient customs, bringing all treasures, he is balmed with unguents,—Flame-haired, oil-clad, the purifying Agni, skilled in fair rites, to bring the Gods for worship. As thou, O Agni, skilful Jātavedas, hast sacrificed as Priest of Earth, of Heaven,So with this offering bring the Gods, and prosper this sacrifice today as erst for Manu. Three are thy times of life, O Jātavedas, and the three mornings are thy births, O Agni.With these, well-knowing, grant the Gods’ kind favour, and help in stir and stress the man who worships. Agni most bright and fair with song we honour, yea, the adorable, O Jātavedas.Thee, envoy, messenger, oblation-bearer, the Gods have made centre of life eternal. That Priest before thee, yet more skilled in worship, stablished of old, health-giver by his nature,—After his custom offer, thou who knowest, and lay our sacrifice where Gods may taste it.

verses.sanskrit: समिध्यमानः प्रथमानु धर्मा समक्तुभिरज्यते विश्ववारः ।शोचिष्केशो घृतनिर्णिक्पावकः सुयज्ञो अग्निर्यजथाय देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-idhyámānaḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǀ sám ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ viśvá-vāraḥ ǀśocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-nirnik ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ su-yajñáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: The righteous (Agni) when first kindled on the several (altars) the object of adoration by all, whose hair is flame, and who is cleansed with butter, the purifier, the worthy-worshipped, is sprinkled with oblations for the worship of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The righteous (Agni) when first kindled on the several (altars) the object of adoration by all, whose hair is flame, and who is cleansed with butter, the purifier, the worthy-worshipped, is sprinkled with oblations for the worship of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यथायजो होत्रमग्ने पृथिव्या यथा दिवो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ।एवानेन हविषा यक्षि देवान्मनुष्वद्यज्ञं प्र तिरेममद्य ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ áyajaḥ ǀ hotrám ǀ agne ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ diváḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀevá ǀ anéna ǀ havíṣā ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ manuṣvát ǀ yajñám ǀ prá ǀ tira ǀ imám ǀ adyá ǁ
verses.english_translation: As you did offer the burnt-offering,Agni, (on behalf of) earth; as you,Jātavedas, who are cognizant (of sacred rites, did offer sacrifice on behalf) of heaven; so with this oblation worship the gods, and perfect this rite today (as you did) that of Manu.
verses.wilson_translation: As you did offer the burnt-offering,Agni, (on behalf of) earth; as you,Jātavedas, who are cognizant (of sacred rites, did offer sacrifice on behalf) of heaven; so with this oblation worship the gods, and perfect this rite today (as you did) that of Manu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रीण्यायूंषि तव जातवेदस्तिस्र आजानीरुषसस्ते अग्ने ।ताभिर्देवानामवो यक्षि विद्वानथा भव यजमानाय शं योः ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ táva ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ā-jā́nīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ávaḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ átha ǀ bhava ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Three are your existences Jātavedas; three,Agni, are your parent dawns; with them offer the oblation of the gods, the knowing (his wishes) be the bestower of happiness on the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Three are your existences Jātavedas; three,Agni, are your parent dawns; with them offer the oblation of the gods, the knowing (his wishes) be the bestower of happiness on the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं सुदीतिं सुदृशं गृणंतो नमस्यामस्त्वेड्यं जातवेदः ।त्वां दूतमरतिं हव्यवाहं देवा अकृण्वन्नमृतस्य नाभिं ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ su-dītím ǀ su-dṛ́śam ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ namasyā́maḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ dūtám ǀ aratím ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhim ǁ
verses.english_translation: Jātavedas, we venerate you, glorifying the brilliant, beautiful, adorable Agni; the gods have made you their messenger, the disinterested bearer of oblations, the centre of ambrosia.
verses.wilson_translation: Jātavedas, we venerate you, glorifying the brilliant, beautiful, adorable Agni; the gods have made you their messenger, the disinterested bearer of oblations, the centre of ambrosia.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वद्धोता पूर्वो अग्ने यजीयांद्विता च सत्ता स्वधया च शंभुः ।तस्यानु धर्म प्र यजा चिकित्वोऽथ नो धा अध्वरं देववीतौ ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvát ǀ hótā ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ agne ǀ yájīyān ǀ dvitā́ ǀ ca ǀ sáttā ǀ svadháyā ǀ ca ǀ śam-bhúḥ ǀtásya ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǀ prá ǀ yaja ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ átha ǀ naḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ devá-vītau ǁ
verses.english_translation: He is the most diligent offerer of worship who is the presenter of oblations before you are and who in two plural ces (the middling and the best) seated with the sacrificial food is (the source of) happiness (to the worshippers); do you cognizant (of the objects of devotion), officiate in accordance with his piety, and thus render our rite acceptable to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: He is the most diligent offerer of worship who is the presenter of oblations before you are and who in two plural ces (the middling and the best) seated with the sacrificial food is (the source of) happiness (to the worshippers); do you cognizant (of the objects of devotion), officiate in accordance with his piety, and thus render our rite acceptable to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, be kind to us when we approach thee good as a friend to friend, as sire and mother.The races of mankind are great oppressors burn up malignity that strives against us. Agni, burn up the unfriendly who are near us, burn thou the foeman's curse who pays no worship.Burn, Vasu, thou who markest well, the foolish: let thine eternal nimble beams surround thee. With fuel, Agni, and with oil, desirous, mine offering I present for strength and conquest,With prayer, so far as I have power, adoring-this hymn divine to gain a hundred treasures. Give with thy glow, thou Son of Strength, when lauded, great vital power to those who toil to serve thee.Give richly, Agni, to the Viśvāmitras in rest and stir. Oft have we decked thy body. Give us, O liberal Lord, great store of riches, for, Agni, such art thou when duly kindled.Thou in the happy singer's home bestowest, amply with arms extended, things of beauty.

verses.sanskrit: भवा नो अग्ने सुमना उपेतौ सखेव सख्ये पितरेव साधुः ।पुरुद्रुहो हि क्षितयो जनानां प्रति प्रतीचीर्दहतादरातीः ॥
verses.transliteration: bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ úpa-itau ǀ sákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ pitárā-iva ǀ sādhúḥ ǀpuru-drúhaḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ práti ǀ pratīcī́ḥ ǀ dahatāt ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be favourably disposed Agni, on approaching us (at this rite); be the fulfiller (of our objects) like a friend (to a friend) or parents (to a child); since men are the grievous oppressors of men, do you consume the foes who come against us.
verses.wilson_translation: Be favourably disposed Agni, on approaching us (at this rite); be the fulfiller (of our objects) like a friend (to a friend) or parents (to a child); since men are the grievous oppressors of men, do you consume the foes who come against us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तपो ष्वग्ने अंतराँ अमित्राँ तपा शंसमररुषः परस्य ।तपो वसो चिकितानो अचित्तान्वि ते तिष्ठंतामजरा अयासः ॥
verses.transliteration: tápo íti ǀ sú ǀ agne ǀ ántarān ǀ amítrān ǀ tápa ǀ śáṃsam ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ párasya ǀtápo íti ǀ vaso íti ǀ cikitānáḥ ǀ acíttān ǀ ví ǀ te ǀ tiṣṭhantām ǀ ajárāḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vex thoroughly,Agni, our assailing enemies, disappoint the purpose of the adversary who offers not worship; giver of dwellings, who are cognizant (of sacred rites), vex those who have no thought (of pious acts) so that your undecaying, all-pervading (rays), may ever abide.
verses.wilson_translation: Vex thoroughly,Agni, our assailing enemies, disappoint the purpose of the adversary who offers not worship; giver of dwellings, who are cognizant (of sacred rites), vex those who have no thought (of pious acts) so that your undecaying, all-pervading (rays), may ever abide.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इध्मेनाग्न इच्छमानो घृतेन जुहोमि हव्यं तरसे बलाय ।यावदीशे ब्रह्मणा वंदमान इमां धियं शतसेयाय देवीं ॥
verses.transliteration: idhména ǀ agne ǀ icchámānaḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀ juhómi ǀ havyám ǀ tárase ǀ bálāya ǀyā́vat ǀ ī́śe ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ śata-séyāya ǀ devī́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous (of wealth) I offer to you Agni, an oblation with butter and with fuel for your speed and invigoration, praising you with a holy prayer as much as I am able; I propitiate you that you may render this praise resplendent with infinite treasure.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous (of wealth) I offer to you Agni, an oblation with butter and with fuel for your speed and invigoration, praising you with a holy prayer as much as I am able; I propitiate you that you may render this praise resplendent with infinite treasure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उच्छोचिषा सहसस्पुत्र स्तुतो बृहद्वयः शशमानेषु धेहि ।रेवदग्ने विश्वामित्रेषु शं योर्मर्मृज्मा ते तन्वंभूरि कृत्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ śocíṣā ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ stutáḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ śaśamānéṣu ǀ dhehi ǀrevát ǀ agne ǀ viśvā́mitreṣu ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ marmṛjmá ǀ te ǀ tanvám ǀ bhū́ri ǀ kṛ́tvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rise up, son of strength, with your splendour when hymned, and bestow abundant food and wealth,Agni, upon the descendants of Viśvāmitracelebrating your praise; and grant them exemption from sickness and danger; encourager of pious works (Agni), we repeatedly sprinkle your substance (with milk and butter).
verses.wilson_translation: Rise up, son of strength, with your splendour when hymned, and bestow abundant food and wealth,Agni, upon the descendants of Viśvāmitracelebrating your praise; and grant them exemption from sickness and danger; encourager of pious works (Agni), we repeatedly sprinkle your substance (with milk and butter).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कृधि रत्नं सुसनितर्धनानां स घेदग्ने भवसि यत्समिद्धः ।स्तोतुर्दुरोणे सुभगस्य रेवत्सृप्रा करस्ना दधिषे वपूंषि ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛdhí ǀ rátnam ǀ su-sanitaḥ ǀ dhánānām ǀ sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ bhavasi ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀstotúḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ su-bhágasya ǀ revát ǀ sṛprā́ ǀ karásnā ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ vápūṃṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Liberal donor (of riches) bestow upon us the most precious of treasures, for therefore is it,Agni, that you are kindled; you have aims promptly stretched forth, whose (radiant) forms (bestow) wealth on the dwelling of your fortunate adorer.
verses.wilson_translation: Liberal donor (of riches) bestow upon us the most precious of treasures, for therefore is it,Agni, that you are kindled; you have aims promptly stretched forth, whose (radiant) forms (bestow) wealth on the dwelling of your fortunate adorer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIX. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, quick, sage, infallible, all-knowing, I choose to be our Priest at this oblation.In our Gods’ service he, best skilled, shall worship: may he obtain us boons for strength and riches. Agni, to thee I lift the oil-fed ladle, bright, with an offering, bearing our oblation.From the right hand, choosing the Gods’ attendance, he with rich presents hath arranged the worship. Of keenest spirit is the man thou aidest give us good offspring, thou who givest freely.In power of wealth most rich in men. O Agni, of thee, the Good, may we sing forth fair praises. Men as they worship thee the God, O Agni, have set on thee full many a brilliant, aspect.So bring Most Youthful One, the Gods’ assembly, the Heavenly Host which thou to-day shalt honour. When Gods anoint thee Priest at their oblation, and seat thee for thy task as Sacrificer,O Agni, be thou here our kind defender, and to ourselves vouchsafe the gift of glory.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं होतारं प्र वृणे मियेधे गृत्सं कविं विश्वविदममूरं ।स नो यक्षद्देवताता यजीयान्राये वाजाय वनते मघानि ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ hótāram ǀ prá ǀ vṛṇe ǀ miyédhe ǀ gṛ́tsam ǀ kavím ǀ viśva-vídam ǀ ámūram ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yakṣat ǀ devá-tātā ǀ yájīyān ǀ rāyé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ vanate ǀ maghā́ni ǁ
verses.english_translation: I have recourse in this sacrifice to Agni, the invoker and praiser (of the gods), theintelligent, the all-knowing the unbeguiled; may he, the adorable, sacrificer for us to the gods, (and) accept the precious (offerings) we make for food and riches.
verses.wilson_translation: I have recourse in this sacrifice to Agni, the invoker and praiser (of the gods), theintelligent, the all-knowing the unbeguiled; may he, the adorable, sacrificer for us to the gods, (and) accept the precious (offerings) we make for food and riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते अग्ने हविष्मतीमियर्म्यच्छा सुद्युम्नां रातिनीं घृताचीं ।प्रदक्षिणिद्देवतातिमुराणः सं रातिभिर्वसुभिर्यज्ञमश्रेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ havíṣmatīm ǀ iyarmi ǀ áccha ǀ su-dyumnā́m ǀ rātínīm ǀ ghṛtā́cīm ǀpra-dakṣiṇít ǀ devá-tātim ǀ urāṇáḥ ǀ sám ǀ rātí-bhiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ aśret ǁ
verses.english_translation: Reverencing the gods, I plural ce before you Agni, the brilliant oblation-yielding, food-bestowing, butter-charged (offering); may you (propitiated) by the present wealth, sanctify (this) sacrifice by your circumambulation.
verses.wilson_translation: Reverencing the gods, I plural ce before you Agni, the brilliant oblation-yielding, food-bestowing, butter-charged (offering); may you (propitiated) by the present wealth, sanctify (this) sacrifice by your circumambulation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स तेजीयसा मनसा त्वोत उत शिक्ष स्वपत्यस्य शिक्षोः ।अग्ने रायो नृतमस्य प्रभूतौ भूयाम ते सुष्टुतयश्च वस्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ téjīyasā ǀ mánasā ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǀ utá ǀ śikṣa ǀ su-apatyásya ǀ śikṣóḥ ǀágne ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamasya ǀ prá-bhūtau ǀ bhūyā́ma ǀ te ǀ su-stutáyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vásvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who isprotected,Agni, by you, becomes endowed with a most luminous mind; bestow upon him excellent progeny; may we ever be under the power of you who is the willing dispenser of riches; glorifying you (may we be) the receptacles of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: He who isprotected,Agni, by you, becomes endowed with a most luminous mind; bestow upon him excellent progeny; may we ever be under the power of you who is the willing dispenser of riches; glorifying you (may we be) the receptacles of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भूरीणि हि त्वे दधिरे अनीकाग्ने देवस्य यज्यवो जनासः ।स आ वह देवतातिं यविष्ठ शर्धो यदद्य दिव्यं यजासि ॥
verses.transliteration: bhū́rīṇi ǀ hí ǀ tvé íti ǀ dadhiré ǀ ánīkā ǀ ágne ǀ devásya ǀ yájyavaḥ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devá-tātim ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ yát ǀ adyá ǀ divyám ǀ yájāsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ministering priests have concentrated in you Agni, who are divine, many hosts (of flames); do you bring hither the gods, youngest (of the deities), that you may worship today the divine effulgence.
verses.wilson_translation: The ministering priests have concentrated in you Agni, who are divine, many hosts (of flames); do you bring hither the gods, youngest (of the deities), that you may worship today the divine effulgence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वा होतारमनजन्मियेधे निषादयंतो यजथाय देवाः ।स त्वं नो अग्नेऽवितेह बोध्यधि श्रवांसि धेहि नस्तनूषु ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ hótāram ǀ anájan ǀ miyédhe ǀ ni-sādáyantaḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avitā́ ǀ ihá ǀ bodhi ǀ ádhi ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ dhehi ǀ naḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch as the attendant divine (priests) anoint you as the invoker of the gods to offer worship in the sacrifice, therefore do you assent to be our protector on this occasion, and grant abundant food to our descendants.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch as the attendant divine (priests) anoint you as the invoker of the gods to offer worship in the sacrifice, therefore do you assent to be our protector on this occasion, and grant abundant food to our descendants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XX Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ५ गाथी कौशिकः। अग्निः, १, ५ विश्वे देवाः। त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH lauds at break of morn the priest invoketh Agni, Dawn, Dadhikrās, and both the Aśvins.With one consent the Gods whose light is splendid, longing to taste our sacrifice, shall hear us. Three are thy powers, O Agni, three thy stations, three are thy tongues, yea, many, Child of Order!Three bodies hast thou which the Gods delight in: with these protect our hymns with care unceasing. O Agni, many are the names thou bearest, immortal, God, Divine, and Jātavedas.And many charms of charmers, All-Inspirer! have they laid in thee, Lord of true attendants! Agni, like Bhaga, leads the godly people, he who is true to Law and guards the seasons.Ancient, all-knowing, he the Vṛtra-slayer shall bear the singer safe through every trouble. I call on Savitar the God, on Morning, Bṛhaspati, and Dadhikrās, and Agni,On Varuṇa and Mitra, on the Aśvins, Bhaga, the Vasus, Rudras and Ādityas.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमुषसमश्विना दधिक्रां व्युष्टिषु हवते वह्निरुक्थैः ।सुज्योतिषो नः शृण्वंतु देवाः सजोषसो अध्वरं वावशानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ uṣásam ǀ aśvínā ǀ dadhi-krā́m ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀ havate ǀ váhniḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀsu-jyótiṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇvantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bearer (of the oblation) invokes with praises at the break of day,Agni, the dawn, the Aśvins, and Dadhikra); may the resplendent divinities, desirous of our sacrifice, hear in unison (the invocation).
verses.wilson_translation: The bearer (of the oblation) invokes with praises at the break of day,Agni, the dawn, the Aśvins, and Dadhikra); may the resplendent divinities, desirous of our sacrifice, hear in unison (the invocation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने त्री ते वाजिना त्री षधस्था तिस्रस्ते जिह्वा ऋतजात पूर्वीः ।तिस्र उ ते तन्वो देववातास्ताभिर्नः पाहि गिरो अप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ trī́ ǀ te ǀ vājínā ǀ trī́ ǀ sadhá-sthā ǀ tisráḥ ǀ te ǀ jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-jāta ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀtisráḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ tanváḥ ǀ devá-vātāḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, born of sacrifice, three are your viands; three your abiding plural ces, three the tongue satisfying (thegods); three verily are your forms acceptable to the deities, and with them never heedless (of our wishes), bepropitious to our praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, born of sacrifice, three are your viands; three your abiding plural ces, three the tongue satisfying (thegods); three verily are your forms acceptable to the deities, and with them never heedless (of our wishes), bepropitious to our praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने भूरीणि तव जातवेदो देव स्वधावोऽमृतस्य नाम ।याश्च माया मायिनां विश्वमिन्व त्वे पूर्वीः संदधुः पृष्टबंधो ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ bhū́rīṇi ǀ táva ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ déva ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́ma ǀyā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ māyā́ ǀ māyínām ǀ viśvam-inva ǀ tvé íti ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ sam-dadhúḥ ǀ pṛṣṭabandho íti pṛṣṭa-bandho ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, knowing all that exists and distributor of food, many are the names of you who are immortal satisffier of all men, friend of the suppliant, the gods have deposited in you whatever are the delusions of the deluding (rākṣasas).
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, knowing all that exists and distributor of food, many are the names of you who are immortal satisffier of all men, friend of the suppliant, the gods have deposited in you whatever are the delusions of the deluding (rākṣasas).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्नेता भग इव क्षितीनां दैवीनां देव ऋतुपा ऋतावा ।स वृत्रहा सनयो विश्ववेदाः पर्षद्विश्वाति दुरिता गृणंतं ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ netā́ ǀ bhágaḥ-iva ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ dáivīnām ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtu-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀsáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ sanáyaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀ párṣat ǀ víśvā ǀ áti ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ gṛṇántam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine Agniis the guide of devout men, as the sun is the regulator of the seasons; may he, the observer of truth, the slayer of Vṛtra, the ancient, the omniscient convey his adorer (safe) over all difficulties.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine Agniis the guide of devout men, as the sun is the regulator of the seasons; may he, the observer of truth, the slayer of Vṛtra, the ancient, the omniscient convey his adorer (safe) over all difficulties.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीं बृहस्पतिं सवितारं च देवं ।अश्विना मित्रावरुणा भगं च वसून्रुद्राँ आदित्याँ इह हुवे ॥
verses.transliteration: dadhi-krā́m ǀ agním ǀ uṣásam ǀ ca ǀ devī́m ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ savitā́ram ǀ ca ǀ devám ǀaśvínā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ bhágam ǀ ca ǀ vásūn ǀ rudrā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ ihá ǀ huve ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke to this rite, Dadhikrā,Agni, the divine Uṣas,Bṛhaspati, the divine Savitā, the Aśvins,Mitraand Varuṇa,Bhaga, the Vasus, the Rudras, andĀdityas.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke to this rite, Dadhikrā,Agni, the divine Uṣas,Bṛhaspati, the divine Savitā, the Aśvins,Mitraand Varuṇa,Bhaga, the Vasus, the Rudras, andĀdityas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXI. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ५ गाथी कौशिकः। अग्निः,। १त्रिष्टुप्, २-३ अनुष्टुप्, ४ विराड् रूपा, ५ सतोबृहती।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SET this our sacrifice among the Immortals: be pleased with these our presents, Jātavedas.O Priest, O Agni, sit thee down before us, and first enjoy the drops of oil and fatness. For thee, O Purifier, flow the drops of fatness rich in oil.After thy wont vouchsafe to us the choicest boon that Gods may feast. Agni, Most Excellent! for thee the Sage are drops that drip with oil.Thou art enkindled as the best of Seers. Help thou the sacrifice. To thee, O Agni, mighty and resistless, to thee stream forth the drops of oil and fatness.With great light art thou come, O praised by poets! Accept our offering, O thou Sage. Fatness exceeding rich, extracted from the midst,—this as our gift we offer thee.Excellent God, the drops run down upon thy skin. Deal them to each among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: इमं नो यज्ञममृतेषु धेहीमा हव्या जातवेदो जुषस��व ।स्तोकानामग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य होतः प्राशान प्रथमो निषद्य ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ dhehi ǀ imā́ ǀ havyā́ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀstokā́nām ǀ agne ǀ médasaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ hótaríti ǀ prá ǀ aśāna ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ni-sádya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Convey our sacrifice,Jātavedas, to the immortals and do you accept these oblations;Agni, invoker (of the gods) seated (on the altar) first partake of the drops of the marrow and of the butter.
verses.wilson_translation: Convey our sacrifice,Jātavedas, to the immortals and do you accept these oblations;Agni, invoker (of the gods) seated (on the altar) first partake of the drops of the marrow and of the butter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: घृतवंतः पावक ते स्तोकाः श्चोतंति मेदसः ।स्वधर्मंदेववीतये श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛtá-vantaḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ te ǀ stokā́ḥ ǀ ścotanti ǀ médasaḥ ǀsvá-dharman ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ naḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The drops of the marrow charged with butter fall, purifier, to you, at your own rite, for the food of the gods; therefore grant us excellent affluence.
verses.wilson_translation: The drops of the marrow charged with butter fall, purifier, to you, at your own rite, for the food of the gods; therefore grant us excellent affluence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं स्तोका घृतश्चुतोऽग्ने विप्राय संत्य ।ऋषिः श्रेष्ठः समिध्यसे यज्ञस्य प्राविता भव ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ stokā́ḥ ǀ ghṛta-ścútaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ víprāya ǀ santya ǀṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ yajñásya ǀ pra-avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: The drops (of the marrow) dripping with butter are offered,Agni, to you who are wise; you the most excellent ṛṣi are kindled; be the protector of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The drops (of the marrow) dripping with butter are offered,Agni, to you who are wise; you the most excellent ṛṣi are kindled; be the protector of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं श्चोतंत्यध्रिगो शचीवः स्तोकासो अग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य ।कविशस्तो बृहता भानुनागा हव्या जुषस्व मेधिर ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ ścotanti ǀ adhrigo ítyadhri-go ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ stokā́saḥ ǀ agne ǀ médasaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀkavi-śastáḥ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ juṣasva ǀ medhira ǁ
verses.english_translation: Irrepressible and powerful,Agni, the drops of marrow and of butter distil for you; therefore you, who are praised by sages, come with great splendour, and be plural ased ever intelligent Agni, with our oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Irrepressible and powerful,Agni, the drops of marrow and of butter distil for you; therefore you, who are praised by sages, come with great splendour, and be plural ased ever intelligent Agni, with our oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ओजिष्ठं ते मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतं प्र ते वयं ददामहे ।श्चोतंति ते वसो स्तोका अधि त्वचि प्रति तांदेवशो विहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ójiṣṭham ǀ te ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ médaḥ ǀ út-bhṛtam ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ dadāmahe ǀścótanti ǀ te ǀ vaso-íti ǀ stokā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀ práti ǀ tā́n ǀ deva-śáḥ ǀ vihi ǁ
verses.english_translation: We present to you the densest marrow that has been extracted for you from the interior (of the victim); grant of dwellings, the drops fall for you upon the skin; distribute them amongst the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: We present to you the densest marrow that has been extracted for you from the interior (of the victim); grant of dwellings, the drops fall for you upon the skin; distribute them amongst the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXII. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ५ गाथी कौशिकः। अग्निः, ४ पुरीष्या अग्नयः । त्रिष्टुप्, ४ अनुष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: THIS is that Agni whence the longing Indra took the pressed Soma deep within his body.Winner of spoils in thousands, like a courser, with praise art thou exalted, Jātavedas. That light of thine in heaven and earth, O Agni, in plants, O Holy One, and in the waters,Wherewith thou hast spread wide the air's mid-region-bright is that splendour, wavy, man-beholding. O Agni, to the sea of heaven thou goest: thou hast called hither Gods beheld in spirit.The waters, too, come hither, those up yonder in the Sun's realm of light, and those beneath it. Let fires that dwell in mist, combined with those that have their home in floods,Guileless accept our sacrifice, great viands free from all disease. Agni, as holy food to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sanskrit: अयं सो अग्निर्यस्मिन्त्सोममिंद्रः सुतं दधे जठरे वावशानः ।सहस्रिणं वाजमत्यं न सप्तिं ससवान्त्सन्त्स्तूयसे जातवेदः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ sómam ǀ índraḥ ǀ sutám ǀ dadhé ǀ jaṭháre ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀsahasríṇam ǀ vā́jam ǀ átyam ǀ ná ǀ sáptim ǀ sasa-vā́n ǀ sán ǀ stūyase ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This is that Agniin whom Indra, desirous (of the oblation), plural ced the effused Somafor (his own) belly; you are praised by us,Jātavedas, enjoying the sacrificial food of many sorts like a rapid courser (enjoying many plural asures in battle).
verses.wilson_translation: This is that Agniin whom Indra, desirous (of the oblation), plural ced the effused Somafor (his own) belly; you are praised by us,Jātavedas, enjoying the sacrificial food of many sorts like a rapid courser (enjoying many plural asures in battle).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने यत्ते दिवि वर्चः पृथिव्यां यदोषधीष्वप्स्वा यजत्र ।येनांतरिक्षमुर्वाततंथ त्वेषः स भानुरर्णवो नृचक्षाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ diví ǀ várcaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ yát ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ yajatra ǀyéna ǀ antárikṣam ǀ urú ǀ ā-tatántha ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable Agni, your radiance that is in the heaven, on the earth, in the plural nts, in the waters and wherewith you overspread the firmament, that is shining and resplendent, overlooking man (vast as) the ocean.
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable Agni, your radiance that is in the heaven, on the earth, in the plural nts, in the waters and wherewith you overspread the firmament, that is shining and resplendent, overlooking man (vast as) the ocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने दिवो अर्णमच्छा जिगास्यच्छा देवाँ ऊचिषे धिष्ण्या ये ।या रोचने परस्तात्सूर्यस्य याश्चावस्तादुपतिष्ठंत आपः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ diváḥ ǀ árṇam ǀ áccha ǀ jigāsi ǀ áccha ǀ devā́n ǀ ūciṣe ǀ dhíṣṇyāḥ ǀ yé ǀyā́ḥ ǀ rocané ǀ parástāt ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ avástāt ǀ upa-tíṣṭhante ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You move,Agni, to the vapour in heaven; you congregate the divinities who are the vital airs (of the body); you animate the waters in the bright region above the sun, as well as those that are in the firmament beneath.
verses.wilson_translation: You move,Agni, to the vapour in heaven; you congregate the divinities who are the vital airs (of the body); you animate the waters in the bright region above the sun, as well as those that are in the firmament beneath.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरीष्यासो अग्नयः प्रावणेभिः सजोषसः ।जुषंतां यज्ञमद्रुहोऽनमीवा इषो महीः ॥
verses.transliteration: purīṣyā́saḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ pravaṇébhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀjuṣántām ǀ yajñám ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ anamīvā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the benignant fires termed puriṣyās, together with the instrumental uments (that have dug the pits in which they are plural ced) combined, accept the sacrifice (and grant us) salutary and abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: May the benignant fires termed puriṣyās, together with the instrumental uments (that have dug the pits in which they are plural ced) combined, accept the sacrifice (and grant us) salutary and abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred ries, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred ries, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . RUBBED into life, well stablished in the dwelling, Leader of sacrifice, the Sage, the youthful,Here in the wasting fuel Jātavedas, eternal, hath assumed immortal being. Both Bharatas, Devaśravas, Devāvata, have strongly rubbed to life effectual Agni.O Agni, look thou forth with ample riches: be, every day, bearer of food to feed us. Him nobly born of old the fingers ten produced, him whom his Mothers counted dear.Praise Devāvata's Agni, thou Devaśravas, him who shall be the people's Lord. He set thee in the earth's most lovely station, in Iḷā's place, in days of fair bright weather.On man, on Āpayā, Agni! on the rivers Dṛṣadvati, Sarasvatī, shine richly. Agni, as holy food to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.To us be born a son and spreading offspring Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward

verses.sanskrit: निर्मथितः सुधित आ सधस्थे युवा कविरध्वरस्य प्रणेता ।जूर्यत्स्वग्निरजरो वनेष्वत्रा दधे अमृतं जातवेदाः ॥
verses.transliteration: níḥ-mathitaḥ ǀ sú-dhitaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ yúvā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ pra-netā́ ǀjū́ryat-su ǀ agníḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ átra ǀ dadhe ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Churned (by the friction of the sticks), duly plural ced in the sacrificial chamber, the young and sage leader of the rite,Jātavedas, the imperishable Agni, (blazing) amidst consuming forests, grants us on this occasion ambrosial (food).
verses.wilson_translation: Churned (by the friction of the sticks), duly plural ced in the sacrificial chamber, the young and sage leader of the rite,Jātavedas, the imperishable Agni, (blazing) amidst consuming forests, grants us on this occasion ambrosial (food).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमंथिष्टां भारता रेवदग्निं देवश्रवा देववातः सुदक्षं ।अग्ने वि पश्य बृहताभि रायेषां नो नेता भवतादनु द्यून् ॥
verses.transliteration: ámanthiṣṭām ǀ bhā́ratā ǀ revát ǀ agním ǀ devá-śravāḥ ǀ devá-vātaḥ ǀ su-dákṣam ǀágne ǀ ví ǀ paśya ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ abhí ǀ rāyā́ ǀ iṣā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ netā́ ǀ bhavatāt ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: The two sons of Bharata,Devaśravasand Devavāta, have churned the very powerful and wealth-bestowing Agni; look upon us, Agni, with vast riches, and be the bringer of food (to us) every day.
verses.wilson_translation: The two sons of Bharata,Devaśravasand Devavāta, have churned the very powerful and wealth-bestowing Agni; look upon us, Agni, with vast riches, and be the bringer of food (to us) every day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दश क्षिपः पूर्व्यं सीमजीजनन्त्सुजातं मातृषु प्रियं ।अग्निं स्तुहि दैववातं देवश्रवो यो जनानामसद्वशी ॥
verses.transliteration: dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ sīm ǀ ajījanan ǀ sú-jātam ǀ mātṛ́ṣu ǀ priyám ǀagním ǀ stuhi ǀ daiva-vātám ǀ deva-śravaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ásat ǀ vaśī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers have genitive rated this ancient (Agni); praise,Devaśravas, this well-born, beloved (son) of his parents, genitive rated by Devavāta, Agni, who is the servant of men.
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers have genitive rated this ancient (Agni); praise,Devaśravas, this well-born, beloved (son) of his parents, genitive rated by Devavāta, Agni, who is the servant of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि त्वा दधे वर आ पृथिव्या इळायास्पदे सुदिनत्वे अह्नां ।दृषद्वत्यां मानुष आपयायां सरस्वत्यां रेवदग्ने दिदीहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ dadhe ǀ váre ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ íḷāyāḥ ǀ padé ǀ sudina-tvé ǀ áhnām ǀdṛṣát-vatyām ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ āpayā́yām ǀ sárasvatyām ǀ revát ǀ agne ǀ didīhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: I plural ce you in an excellent spot of earth on an auspicious day of days; do you,Agni, shine on the frequent (banks) of the Dṛṣadvati,Āpayāand Sarasvatīrivers.
verses.wilson_translation: I plural ce you in an excellent spot of earth on an auspicious day of days; do you,Agni, shine on the frequent (banks) of the Dṛṣadvati,Āpayāand Sarasvatīrivers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, subdue opposing bands, and drive our enemies away.Invincible, slay godless foes: give splendour to the worshipper. Lit with libation, Agni, thou, deathless, who callest Gods to feast,Accept our sacrifice with joy. With splendour, Agni, Son of Strength, thou who art worshipped, wakeful One.Seat thee on this my sacred grass. With all thy fires, with all the Gods, Agni, exalt the songs we sing.And living men in holy rites. Grant, Agni, to the worshipper wealth rich in heroes, plenteous store,Make thou us rich with many sons.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने सहस्व पृतना अभिमातीरपास्य ।दुष्टरस्तरन्नरातीर्वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ sáhasva ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ ápa ǀ asya ǀdustáraḥ ǀ táran ǀ árātīḥ ǀ várcaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ yajñá-vāhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Repel,Agni, (hostile) hosts; drive away (all) assailants; insuperable, foe-surpassing, give food to the instrumental tutor of this sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Repel,Agni, (hostile) hosts; drive away (all) assailants; insuperable, foe-surpassing, give food to the instrumental tutor of this sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्न इळा समिध्यसे वीतिहोत्रो अमर्त्यः ।जुषस्व सू नो अध्वरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ iḷā́ ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ vītí-hotraḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀjuṣásva ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni(who is) immortal and who is gratified by oblations, you are kindled upon the altar; be plural ased by this our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni(who is) immortal and who is gratified by oblations, you are kindled upon the altar; be plural ased by this our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने द्युम्नेन जागृवे सहसः सूनवाहुत ।एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ dyumnéna ǀ jāgṛve ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ ā-huta ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǀ máma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, son of strength, vigilant (in the exercise of) your energy, take your seat when invoked on the sacred grass (strewn at) my (sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, son of strength, vigilant (in the exercise of) your energy, take your seat when invoked on the sacred grass (strewn at) my (sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने विश्वेभिरग्निभिर्देवेभिर्महया गिरः ।यज्ञेषु य उ चायवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ mahaya ǀ gíraḥ ǀyajñéṣu ǀ yé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ cāyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, with all the divine fires, respect the praises of those who in (their) sacrifices are (your especial) worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, with all the divine fires, respect the praises of those who in (their) sacrifices are (your especial) worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने दा दाशुषे रयिं वीरवंतं प��ीणसं ।शिशीहि नः सूनुमतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ rayím ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ párīṇasam ǀśiśīhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnu-mátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, ample wealth and progeny to the donor (of the oblation); make us prosperous, possessed of offspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, ample wealth and progeny to the donor (of the oblation); make us prosperous, possessed of offspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU art the sapient Son of Dyaus, O Agni, yes and the Child of Earth, who knowest all things.Bring the Gods specially, thou Sage, for worship.. Agni the wise bestows the might of heroes grants strengthening food, preparing it for nectar.Thou who art rich in food bring the Gods hither. Agni, infallible, lights Earth and Heaven, immortal Goddesses gracious to all men,—Lord through his strength, splendid through adorations. Come to the sacrifice, Agni and Indra come to the offerer's house who hath the Soma.Come, friendly-minded, Gods, to drink the Soma. In the floods' home art thou enkindled, Agni, O Jātavedas, Son of Strength, eternal,Exalting with thine help the gathering-places.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने दिवः सूनुरसि प्रचेतास्तना पृथिव्या उत विश्ववेदाः ।ऋधग्देवाँ इह यजा चिकित्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ diváḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ asi ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ tánā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀṛ́dhak ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ yaja ǀ cikitvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who is omniscient, and the discriminator (of acts), you are the son of heaven or the son of earth; do you who is intelligent worship severally the gods on this occasion.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who is omniscient, and the discriminator (of acts), you are the son of heaven or the son of earth; do you who is intelligent worship severally the gods on this occasion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः सनोति वीर्याणि विद्वान्त्सनोति वाजममृताय भूषन् ।स नो देवाँ एह वहा पुरुक्षो ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ sanoti ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sanóti ǀ vā́jam ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ bhū́ṣan ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vaha ǀ purukṣo íti puru-kṣo ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise Agnibestows faculties (securing prosperity and descendants); adorning (the world with lustre) he gives (sacrificial food) to the immortals; Agni, (to whom) many oblations (are offered), bring hither to us the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise Agnibestows faculties (securing prosperity and descendants); adorning (the world with lustre) he gives (sacrificial food) to the immortals; Agni, (to whom) many oblations (are offered), bring hither to us the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्द्यावापृथिवी विश्वजन्ये आ भाति देवी अमृते अमूरः ।क्षयन्वाजैः पुरुश्चंद्रो नमोभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ viśvájanye íti viśvá-janye ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ devī́ íti ǀ amṛ́te íti ǀ ámūraḥ ǀkṣáyan ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ puru-candráḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the unbewildered, the ruler (of the world), the radiant, associated with vigour and food, illumines the divine immortal parents of all things, heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the unbewildered, the ruler (of the world), the radiant, associated with vigour and food, illumines the divine immortal parents of all things, heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्न इंद्रश्च दाशुषो दुरोणे सुतावतो यज्ञमिहोप यातं ।अमर्धंता सोमपेयाय देवा ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ihá ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀámardhantā ǀ soma-péyāya ǀ devā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, do you and Indra, gods disdaining not (our rite), come to the sacrifice in the dwelling of the offerer of the libation to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, do you and Indra, gods disdaining not (our rite), come to the sacrifice in the dwelling of the offerer of the libation to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने अपां समिध्यसे दुरोणे नित्यः सूनो सहसो जातवेदः ।सधस्थानि महयमान ऊती ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ apā́m ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ duroṇé ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀsadhá-sthāni ǀ maháyamānaḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, son of strength,Jātavedasthe eternal traversing the inhabited regions with your protection, you are kindled in the dwelling of the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, son of strength,Jātavedasthe eternal traversing the inhabited regions with your protection, you are kindled in the dwelling of the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVI. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ९ गाथिनो विश्वामित्रः, ७ आत्मा। १-३ वैश्वानरोऽग्निः, ४-६ मरुतः, ७-८ आत्मा (अग्निर्वा), ९ विश्वामित्रोपध्यायः।१-६ जगती, ७-९ त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . REVERING in our heart Agni Vaiśvānara, the finder of the light, whose promises are true,The liberal, gladsome, car-borne God we Kuśikas invoke him with oblation, seeking wealth with songs. That Agni, bright, Vaiśvānara, we invoke for help, and Mātariśvan worthy of the song of praise;Bṛhaspati for man's observance of the Gods, the Singer prompt to hear, the swiftly-moving guest. Age after age Vaiśvānara, neighing like a horse, is kindled with the women by the Kuśikas.May Agni, he who wakes among Immortal Gods, grant us heroic strength and wealth in noble steeds. Let them go forth, the strong, as flames of fire with might. Gathered for victory they have yoked their spotted deer.Pourers of floods, the Maruts, Masters of all wealth, they who can ne’er be conquered, make the mountains shake. The Maruts, Friends of men, are glorious as the fire: their mighty and resplendent succour we implore.Those storming Sons of Rudra clothed in robes of rain, boon-givers of good gifts, roar as the lions roar. We, band on band and troop following troop, entreat with fair lauds Agni's splendour and the Maruts’ might,With spotted deer for steeds, with wealth that never fails, they, wise Ones, come to sacrifice at our gatherings. Agni am I who know, by birth, all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar.I am light threefold, measurer of the region exhaustless heat am I, named burnt-oblation. Bearing in mind a thought with light accordant, he purified the Sun with three refinings;By his own nature gained the highest treasure, and looked abroad over the earth and heaven. The Spring that fails not with a hundred streamlets, Father inspired of prayers that men should utter,The Sparkler, joyous in his Parents' bosorn, -him, the Truth-speaker, sate ye, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरं मनसाग्निं निचाय्या हविष्मंतो अनुषत्यं स्वर्विदं ।सुदानुं देवं रथिरं वसूयवो गीर्भी रण्वं कुशिकासो हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānarám ǀ mánasā ǀ agním ǀ ni-cā́yya ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ anu-satyám ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀsu-dā́num ǀ devám ǀ rathirám ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ raṇvám ǀ kuśikā́saḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We of the race of Kuśikaoffering oblations, desirous of wealth, having contemplated him in our minds, invoke with praises the divine Vaiśvānara, the observer of truth, the cognizant of heaven, the bountiful, the charioteer, the frequenter (of sacrifices).
verses.wilson_translation: We of the race of Kuśikaoffering oblations, desirous of wealth, having contemplated him in our minds, invoke with praises the divine Vaiśvānara, the observer of truth, the cognizant of heaven, the bountiful, the charioteer, the frequenter (of sacrifices).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं शुभ्रमग्निमवसे हवामहे वैश्वानरं मातरिश्वानमुक्थ्यं ।बृहस्पतिं मनुषो देवतातये विप्रं श्रोतारमतिथिं रघुष्यदं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ śubhrám ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ mātaríśvānam ǀ ukthyám ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ vípram ǀ śrótāram ǀ átithim ǀ raghu-syádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke you for our own protection and for the devotions of mankind, the radiant Agni,Vaiśvānara, the illuminator of the firmament, the adorable lord of sacred rites, the wise, the hearer (of supplications), the guest (of man), the quick-moving.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke you for our own protection and for the devotions of mankind, the radiant Agni,Vaiśvānara, the illuminator of the firmament, the adorable lord of sacred rites, the wise, the hearer (of supplications), the guest (of man), the quick-moving.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वो न क्रंदंजनिभिः समिध्यते वैश्वानरः कुशिकेभिर्युगेयुगे ।स नो अग्निः सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं दधातु रत्नममृतेषु जागृविः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ krándan ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyate ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ kuśikébhiḥ ǀ yugé-yuge ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ su-áśvyam ǀ dádhātu ǀ rátnam ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vaiśvānarais kindled in every age by the Kuśikasas a neighing foal (is nourished) by its mother; may that Agni, vigilant among the immortals, give us wealth with excellent offspring and good horses.
verses.wilson_translation: Vaiśvānarais kindled in every age by the Kuśikasas a neighing foal (is nourished) by its mother; may that Agni, vigilant among the immortals, give us wealth with excellent offspring and good horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र यंतु वाजास्तविषीभिरग्नयः शुभे सम्मिश्लाः पृषतीरयुक्षत ।बृहदुक्षो मरुतो विश्ववेदसः प्र वेपयंति पर्वताँ अदाभ्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yantu ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ śubhé ǀ sám-miślāḥ ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ ayukṣata ǀbṛhat-úkṣaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ prá ǀ vepayanti ǀ párvatān ǀ ádābhyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the swift fires combined with the vigorous winds proceed to the pure (region of the water), uniting the drops (of rain); the Marutsirresistible, all-knowing, agitate the copious-shedding clouds.
verses.wilson_translation: May the swift fires combined with the vigorous winds proceed to the pure (region of the water), uniting the drops (of rain); the Marutsirresistible, all-knowing, agitate the copious-shedding clouds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निश्रियो मरुतो विश्वकृष्टय आ त्वेषमुग्रमव ईमहे वयं ।ते स्वानिनो रुद्रिया वर्षनिर्णिजः सिंहा न हेषक्रतवः सुदानवः ॥
verses.transliteration: agni-śríyaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ viśvá-kṛṣṭayaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tveṣám ǀ ugrám ǀ ávaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ vayám ǀté ǀ svānínaḥ ǀ rudríyāḥ ǀ varṣá-nirnijaḥ ǀ siṃhā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ heṣá-kratavaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fire-beautified, all-agitating Maruts; we seek their fierce radiance for protection; they, the sons of Rudra, the bountiful Maruts, whose form is the rain, are loudlike roaring lions.
verses.wilson_translation: The fire-beautified, all-agitating Maruts; we seek their fierce radiance for protection; they, the sons of Rudra, the bountiful Maruts, whose form is the rain, are loudlike roaring lions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्रातंव्रातं गणंगणं सुशस्तिभिरग्नेर्भामं मरुतामोज ईमहे ।पृषदश्वासो अनवभ्रराधसो गंतारो यज्ञं विदथेषु धीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: vrā́tam-vrātam ǀ gaṇám-gaṇam ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ bhā́mam ǀ marútām ǀ ójaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀpṛ́ṣat-aśvāsaḥ ǀ anavabhrá-rādhasaḥ ǀ gántāraḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit the might of the Maruts, the irradiation of Agniwith solemn prayers in every assembly and company (of worshippers); those Maruts who ahve partly-coloured steeds, who are dispensers of unfailing wealth, firm (of purpose), and frequenters of sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit the might of the Maruts, the irradiation of Agniwith solemn prayers in every assembly and company (of worshippers); those Maruts who ahve partly-coloured steeds, who are dispensers of unfailing wealth, firm (of purpose), and frequenters of sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरस्मि जन्मना जातवेदा घृतं मे चक्षुरमृतं म आसन् ।अर्कस्त्रिधातू रजसो विमानोऽजस्रो घर्मो हविरस्मि नाम ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ asmi ǀ jánmanā ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ me ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ me ǀ āsán ǀarkáḥ ǀ tri-dhā́tuḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-mā́naḥ ǀ ájasraḥ ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ asmi ǀ nā́ma ǁ
verses.english_translation: I,Agni, am by birth endowed with knowledge of all that exists; clarified butter is my eye; ambrosia is my mouth; I am the living breath of threefold nature, the measure of the firmament, eternal warmth; I am also the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: I,Agni, am by birth endowed with knowledge of all that exists; clarified butter is my eye; ambrosia is my mouth; I am the living breath of threefold nature, the measure of the firmament, eternal warmth; I am also the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिः पवित्रैरपुपोद्ध्यर्कं हृदा मतिं ज्योतिरनु प्रजानन् ।वर्षिष्ठं रत्नमकृत स्वधाभिरादिद्द्यावापृथिवी पर्यपश्यत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tri-bhíḥ ǀ pavítraiḥ ǀ ápupot ǀ hí ǀ arkám ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ matím ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pra-jānán ǀvárṣiṣṭham ǀ rátnam ǀ akṛta ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ pári ǀ apaśyat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, thoroughly comprehending the light that is to be understod by the heart, has purified himself (by the three) purifying (forms); he has made himself most excellent treasure by (these) self-manifestations, and has thence contemplated heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, thoroughly comprehending the light that is to be understod by the heart, has purified himself (by the three) purifying (forms); he has made himself most excellent treasure by (these) self-manifestations, and has thence contemplated heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतधारमुत्समक्षीयमाणं विपश्चितं पितरं वक्त्वानां ।मेळिं मदंतं पित्रोरुपस्थे तं रोदसी पिपृतं सत्यवाचं ॥
verses.transliteration: śatá-dhāram ǀ útsam ǀ ákṣīyamāṇam ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ pitáram ǀ váktvānām ǀmeḷím ǀ mádantam ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ tám ǀ rodasī íti ǀ pipṛtam ǀ satya-vā́cam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Heaven and earth be kind to that stage who is as it were a many-cahnneled and inexhaustible stream (of knowledge); the parent (of his disciples), the collater of holy texts, rejoicing on the lap of his parents,, whose words are truth.
verses.wilson_translation: Heaven and earth be kind to that stage who is as it were a many-cahnneled and inexhaustible stream (of knowledge); the parent (of his disciples), the collater of holy texts, rejoicing on the lap of his parents,, whose words are truth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVII. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: १५ गाथिनो विश्वामित्रः। अग्निः, १ ऋतवो वा। गायत्री।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . IN ladle dropping oil your food goes in oblation up to heaven,Goes to the Gods in search of bliss. Agni I laud, the Sage inspired, crowner of sacrifice through song,Who listens and gives bounteous gifts. O Agni, if we might obtain control of thee the potent God,Then should we overcome our foes. Kindled at sacrifices he is Agni, hallower, meet for praise,With flame for hair: to him we seek. Immortal Agni, shining far, enrobed with oil, well worshipped, bearsThe gifts of sacrifice away. The priests with ladles lifted up, worshipping here with holy thought,Have brought this Agni for our aid. Immortal, Sacrificer, God, with wondrous power he leads the way,Urging the great assembly on. Strong, he is set on deeds ofstrength. In sacrifices led in front,As Singer he completes the rite. Excellent, he was made by thought. The Germ of beings have I gained,Yea, and die Sire of active strength. Thee have I stablished, Excellent, O strengthened by the sage's prayer,Thee, Agni, longing, nobly bright. Agni, the swift and active One, singers, at time of sacrifice,Eagerly kindle with their food. Agni the Son of Strength who shines up to the heaven in solemn rites,The wise of heart, I glorify. Meet to be lauded and adored, showing in beauty through the dark,Agni, the Strong, is kindled well. Agni is kindled as a bull, like a horsebearer of the Gods:Men with oblations worship him. Thee will we kindle as a bull, we who are Bulls ourselves, O Bull.Thee, Agni, shining mightily.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो वाजा अभिद्यवो हविष्मंतो घृताच्या ।देवांजिगाति सुम्नयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ abhí-dyavaḥ ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ ghṛtā́cyā ǀdevā́n ǀ jigāti ǀ sumnayúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The months, the half months, (the gods) who are the receivers of oblations, with the butter-yielding kine, preside over your rite; the sacrificer, desirous of prosperity, worships the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The months, the half months, (the gods) who are the receivers of oblations, with the butter-yielding kine, preside over your rite; the sacrificer, desirous of prosperity, worships the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईळे अग्निं विपश्चितं गिरा यज्ञस्य साधनं ।श्रुष्टीवानं धितावानं ॥
verses.transliteration: ī́ḷe ǀ agním ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ girā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀśruṣṭī-vā́nam ǀ dhitá-vānam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I worship with praise the wise Agni, the accomplisher of sacrifice, the possessor of happiness, the repository of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: I worship with praise the wise Agni, the accomplisher of sacrifice, the possessor of happiness, the repository of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने शकेम ते वयं यमं देवस्य वाजिनः ।अति द्वेषांसि तरेम ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ śakéma ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ yámam ǀ devásya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀáti ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ tarema ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we offering oblations effect the detention of you is divine (until the completion of the rite), and may we (thereby) overcome all animosities.
verses.wilson_translation: May we offering oblations effect the detention of you is divine (until the completion of the rite), and may we (thereby) overcome all animosities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समिध्यमानो अध्वरेऽग्निः पावक ईड्यः ।शोचिष्केशस्तमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-idhyámānaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ agníḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀśocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ tám ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit that Agni, who is being kindled at the sacrifice, the purifier, the adorable, whose hair is flame.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit that Agni, who is being kindled at the sacrifice, the purifier, the adorable, whose hair is flame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पृथुपाजा अमर्त्यो घृतनिर्णिक्स्वाहुतः ।अग्निर्यज्ञस्य हव्यवाट् ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthu-pā́jāḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-nirnik ǀ sú-āhutaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the bright-shining, the immortal, the cleanser with clarified butter, the fitly-involved, the bearer of the oblation in the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the bright-shining, the immortal, the cleanser with clarified butter, the fitly-involved, the bearer of the oblation in the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं सबाधो यतस्रुच इत्था धिया यज्ञवंतः ।आ चक्रुरग्निमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ yajñá-vantaḥ ǀā́ ǀ cakruḥ ǀ agním ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The exorcisers (of the demons), lifting up their ladles, and offering sacrifice, have called upon Agniby this ceremony for their protection.
verses.wilson_translation: The exorcisers (of the demons), lifting up their ladles, and offering sacrifice, have called upon Agniby this ceremony for their protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: होता देवो अमर्त्यः पुरस्तादेति मायया ।विदथानि प्रचोदयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: hótā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ eti ǀ māyáyā ǀvidáthāni ǀ pra-codáyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: The offerer of the oblation, the divine, immortal,Agni, comes first (at the ceremony) directing solemnities by his experiences.
verses.wilson_translation: The offerer of the oblation, the divine, immortal,Agni, comes first (at the ceremony) directing solemnities by his experiences.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाजी वाजेषु धीयतेऽध्वरेषु प्र णीयते ।विप्रो यज्ञस्य साधनः ॥
verses.transliteration: vājī́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ dhīyate ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ prá ǀ nīyate ǀvípraḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty Agniis plural ced (foremost by the gods) in battle; he is brought forward reverently at holy rites; for he is the sage fulfiller of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty Agniis plural ced (foremost by the gods) in battle; he is brought forward reverently at holy rites; for he is the sage fulfiller of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धिया चक्रे वरेण्यो भूतानां गर्भमा दधे ।दक्षस्य पितरं तना ॥
verses.transliteration: dhiyā́ ǀ cakre ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ bhūtā́nām ǀ gárbham ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhe ǀdákṣasya ǀ pitáram ǀ tánā ǁ
