verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये ते शुष्मं ये तविषीमवर्धन्नर्चंत इंद्र मरुतस्त ओजः ।माध्यंदिने सवने वज्रहस्त पिबा रुद्रेभिः सगणः सुशिप्र ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ yé ǀ táviṣīm ǀ ávardhan ǀ árcantaḥ ǀ indra ǀ marútaḥ ǀ te ǀ ójaḥ ǀmā́dhyandine ǀ sávane ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ píba ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ sá-gaṇaḥ ǀ su-śipra ǁ
verses.english_translation: These are the Maruts,Indra, who, worshipping your prowess, augment your withering force (by their aid); attended by the Rudras, drink, wielder of the thunder-bolt, and handsome-chinned, at the noon-day sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: These are the Maruts,Indra, who, worshipping your prowess, augment your withering force (by their aid); attended by the Rudras, drink, wielder of the thunder-bolt, and handsome-chinned, at the noon-day sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त इन्न्वस्य मधुमद्विविप्र इंद्रस्य शर्धो मरुतो य आसन् ।येभिर्वृत्रस्येषितो विवेदामर्मणो मन्यमानस्य मर्म ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ vivipre ǀ índrasya ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ā́san ǀyébhiḥ ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ vivéda ǀ amarmáṇaḥ ǀ mányamānasya ǀ márma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those were the Marutswho were the strength of Indra, and genitive ly encouraged him; animated by whom he pierced the vital part of Vṛtra, fancying himself vulnerable.
verses.wilson_translation: Those were the Marutswho were the strength of Indra, and genitive ly encouraged him; animated by whom he pierced the vital part of Vṛtra, fancying himself vulnerable.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्वदिंद्र सवनं जुषाणः पिबा सोमं शश्वते वीर्याय ।स आ ववृत्स्व हर्यश्व यज्ञैः सरण्युभिरपो अर्णा सिसर्षि ॥
verses.transliteration: manuṣvát ǀ indra ǀ sávanam ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ śáśvate ǀ vīryā́ya ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ hari-aśva ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ saraṇyú-bhiḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ árṇā ǀ sisarṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Phased with the sacrifice, as if it was that of Manu, drink,Indra, the Soma, for the sake of perpetual vigour; come, lord of the tawny steeds, with the adorable Maruts, and with the traversers (of the air); send down the waters (of the firmament) to (blend with) the waters of the earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Phased with the sacrifice, as if it was that of Manu, drink,Indra, the Soma, for the sake of perpetual vigour; come, lord of the tawny steeds, with the adorable Maruts, and with the traversers (of the air); send down the waters (of the firmament) to (blend with) the waters of the earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमपो यद्ध वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अत्याँ इव प्रासृजः सर्तवाजौ ।शयानमिंद्र चरता वधेन वव्रिवांसं परि देवीरदेवं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ apáḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ átyān-iva ǀ prá ǀ ásṛjaḥ ǀ sártavái ǀ ājáu ǀśáyānam ǀ indra ǀ cáratā ǀ vadhéna ǀ vavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ pári ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ádevam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch as you have slain with active strife the slumbering, darking, water-investing Vṛtra, you have let forth the bright waters like horses (rushing) into battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch as you have slain with active strife the slumbering, darking, water-investing Vṛtra, you have let forth the bright waters like horses (rushing) into battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यजाम इन्नमसा वृद्धमिंद्रं बृहंतमृष्वमजरं युवानं ।यस्य प्रिये ममतुर्यज्ञियस्य न रोदसी महिमानं ममाते ॥
verses.transliteration: yájāmaḥ ǀ ít ǀ námasā ǀ vṛddhám ǀ índram ǀ bṛhántam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ajáram ǀ yúvānam ǀyásya ǀ priyé íti ǀ mamátuḥ ǀ yajñíyasya ǀ ná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ mamā́te íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Therefore we sacrifice with reverence to the vast and mighty Indra, who is adorable, undecaying, young; whose magnitude the unbounded heaven and earth have not measures, nor can measure.
verses.wilson_translation: Therefore we sacrifice with reverence to the vast and mighty Indra, who is adorable, undecaying, young; whose magnitude the unbounded heaven and earth have not measures, nor can measure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्य कर्म सुकृता पुरूणि व्रतानि देवा न मिनंति विश्वे ।दाधार यः पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां जजान सूर्यमुषसं सुदंसाः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrasya ǀ kárma ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ vratā́ni ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ víśve ǀdādhā́ra ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ utá ǀ imā́m ǀ jajā́na ǀ sū́ryam ǀ uṣásam ǀ su-dáṃsāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the gods cannot detract from the many glorious exploits, and pious works of Indra; he who has upheld earth, and heaven, and the firmament, and who, the performer of great deeds, has engendered the sun and the dawn.
verses.wilson_translation: All the gods cannot detract from the many glorious exploits, and pious works of Indra; he who has upheld earth, and heaven, and the firmament, and who, the performer of great deeds, has engendered the sun and the dawn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अद्रोघ सत्यं तव तन्महित्वं सद्यो यज्जातो अपिबो ह सोमं ।न द्याव इंद्र तवसस्त ओजो नाहा न मासाः शरदो वरंत ॥
verses.transliteration: ádrogha ǀ satyám ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ yát ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ ha ǀ sómam ǀná ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ indra ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ te ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ná ǀ áhā ǀ ná ǀ mā́sāḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ varanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Doer of no wrong, such was your true greatness, that as soon as born, you have quaffed the Soma; neither the heavens, nor days, nor months, nor years, resist the force of you who is mighty.
verses.wilson_translation: Doer of no wrong, such was your true greatness, that as soon as born, you have quaffed the Soma; neither the heavens, nor days, nor months, nor years, resist the force of you who is mighty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सद्यो अपिबो जात इंद्र मदाय सोमं परमे व्योमन् ।यद्ध द्यावापृथिवी आविवेशीरथाभवः पूर्व्यः कारुधायाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ apibaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ indra ǀ mádāya ǀ sómam ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ā́ ǀ áviveśīḥ ǀ átha ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ kārú-dhāyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As soon as born in the highest heaven, you have quaffed,Indra, the Somafor your exhilaration; and when you had pervaded the heaven and earth, you became the primary artificer (of creation).
verses.wilson_translation: As soon as born in the highest heaven, you have quaffed,Indra, the Somafor your exhilaration; and when you had pervaded the heaven and earth, you became the primary artificer (of creation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहन्नहिं परिशयानमर्ण ओजायमानं तुविजात तव्यान् ।न ते महित्वमनु भूदध द्यौर्यदन्यया स्फिग्याक्षामवस्थाः ॥
verses.transliteration: áhan ǀ áhim ǀ pari-śáyānam ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ ojāyámānam ǀ tuvi-jāta ǀ távyān ǀná ǀ te ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ ánu ǀ bhūt ǀ ádha ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ yát ǀ anyáyā ǀ sphigyā́ ǀ kṣā́m ǀ ávasthāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, from whom many are born; you who is vigorous have slain Ahi, enveloping the slumbering water and confiding in his prowess; yet the heaven apprehended not your greatness as you remained concealing the earth by on eof your flames.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, from whom many are born; you who is vigorous have slain Ahi, enveloping the slumbering water and confiding in his prowess; yet the heaven apprehended not your greatness as you remained concealing the earth by on eof your flames.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञो हि त इंद्र वर्धनो भूदुत प्रियः सुतसोमो मियेधः ।यज्ञेन यज्ञमव यज्ञियः सन्यज्ञस्ते वज्रमहिहत्य आवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñáḥ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ várdhanaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ utá ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sutá-somaḥ ǀ miyédhaḥ ǀyajñéna ǀ yajñám ǀ ava ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ sán ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ te ǀ vájram ǀ ahi-hátye ǀ āvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: This our sacrifice,Indra, is your augmentation, for the rite in which the Somais effused is acceptable to you do you who is deserving of worship protect the worshipper by (the efficacy of) the worship, and may this sacrifice strengthen your thunderbolt for the slaying of Ahi.
verses.wilson_translation: This our sacrifice,Indra, is your augmentation, for the rite in which the Somais effused is acceptable to you do you who is deserving of worship protect the worshipper by (the efficacy of) the worship, and may this sacrifice strengthen your thunderbolt for the slaying of Ahi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेनेंद्रमवसा चक्रे अर्वागैनं सुम्नाय नव्यसे ववृत्यां ।यः स्तोमेभिर्वावृधे पूर्व्येभिर्यो मध्य���ेभिरुत नूतनेभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñéna ǀ índram ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ cakre ǀ arvā́k ǀ ā́ ǀ enam ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ návyase ǀ vavṛtyām ǀyáḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ pūrvyébhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ madhyamébhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ nū́tanebhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The worshipper, by his conservatory sacrifice, has made Indrapresent; may Ibring him to my presence to obtain new wealth, him who has been exalted by praise, whether ancient, medieval, or recent.
verses.wilson_translation: The worshipper, by his conservatory sacrifice, has made Indrapresent; may Ibring him to my presence to obtain new wealth, him who has been exalted by praise, whether ancient, medieval, or recent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विवेष यन्मा धिषणा जजान स्तवै पुरा पार्यादिंद्रमह्नः ।अंहसो यत्र पीपरद्यथा नो नावेव यांतमुभये हवंते ॥
verses.transliteration: vivéṣa ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ jajā́na ǀ stávai ǀ purā́ ǀ pā́ryāt ǀ índram ǀ áhnaḥ ǀáṃhasaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ pīpárat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ nāvā́-iva ǀ yā́ntam ǀ ubháye ǀ havante ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the thought of glorifying Indraentered my mind, then I gave birth (to his praises); may I laud him before encountering distant (evil) days, whereby he may guide us beyond sin; for those on both sides of us invoke him, as (those on either bank of a river hail) a passenger in a boat.
verses.wilson_translation: When the thought of glorifying Indraentered my mind, then I gave birth (to his praises); may I laud him before encountering distant (evil) days, whereby he may guide us beyond sin; for those on both sides of us invoke him, as (those on either bank of a river hail) a passenger in a boat.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्णो अस्य कलशः स्वाहा सेक्तेव कोशं सिसिचे पिबध्यै ।समु प्रिया आववृत्रन्मदाय प्रदक्षिणिदभि सोमास इंद्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́-pūrṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀ kaláśaḥ ǀ svā́hā ǀ séktā-iva ǀ kóśam ǀ sisice ǀ píbadhyai ǀsám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ avavṛtran ǀ mádāya ǀ pra-dakṣiṇít ǀ abhí ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índram ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vase is filled for him (with Soma); welcome Indra; I pour it out for you to drink, as a water-carrier (pours water) from his bag; may the grateful Soma flow in reverence round Indra for his exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: The vase is filled for him (with Soma); welcome Indra; I pour it out for you to drink, as a water-carrier (pours water) from his bag; may the grateful Soma flow in reverence round Indra for his exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा गभीरः पुरुहूत सिंधुर्नाद्रयः परि षंतो वरंत ।इत्था सखिभ्य इषितो यदिंद्रा दृळ्हं चिदरुजो गव्यमूर्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ gabhīráḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sántaḥ ǀ varanta ǀitthā́ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ dṛḷhám ǀ cit ǀ árujaḥ ǀ gávyam ǀ ūrvám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invoked of many, the deep ocean arrests you not, nor do the accompanying mountains (stay you); and therefore, summoned by your friends, you have repressed the strong flame abiding in the abyss.
verses.wilson_translation: Invoked of many, the deep ocean arrests you not, nor do the accompanying mountains (stay you); and therefore, summoned by your friends, you have repressed the strong flame abiding in the abyss.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिंद्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।शृण्वंतमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नंतं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानां ॥
verses.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FORTH from the bosom of the mountains, eager as two swift mares with loosened rein contending,Like two bright mother cows who lick their youngling, Vipāś and Sutudri speed down their waters. Impelled by Indra whom ye pray to urge you, ye move as ’twere on chariots to the ocean.Flowing together, swelling with your billows, O lucid Streams, each of you seeks the other. I have attained the most maternal River, we have approached Vipāś, the broad, the blessed.Licking as ’twere their calf the pair of Mothers flow onward to their common home together. We two who rise and swell with billowy waters move forward to the home which Gods have made us.Our flood may not be stayed when urged to motion. What would the singer, calling to the Rivers? Linger a little at my friendly bidding rest, Holy Ones, a moment in your journey.With hymn sublime soliciting your favour Kuśika's son hath called unto the River. Indra who wields the thunder dug our channels: he smote down Vṛtra, him who stayed our currents.Savitar, God, the lovely-handed, led us, and at his sending forth we flow expanded. That hero deed of Indra must be lauded for ever that he rent Ahi in pieces.He smote away the obstructors with his thunder, and eager for their course forth flowed the waters. Never forget this word of thine, O singer, which future generations shall reecho.In hymns, O bard, show us thy loving kindness. Humble us not mid men. To thee be honour! List quickly, Sisters, to the bard who cometh to you from far away with car and wagon.Bow lowly down; be easy to be traversed stay, Rivers, with your floods below our axles. Yea, we will listen to thy words, O singer. With wain and car from far away thou comest.Low, like a nursing mother, will I bend me, and yield me as a maiden to her lover. Soon as the Bharatas have fared across thee, the warrior band, urged on and sped by Indra,Then let your streams flow on in rapid motion. I crave your favour who deserve our worship. The warrior host, the Bharatas, fared over the singer won the favour of the Rivers.Swell with your billows, hasting, pouring riches. Fill full your channels, and roll swiftly onward. So let your wave bear up the pins, and ye, O Waters, spare the thongs;And never may the pair of Bulls, harmless and sinless, waste away.

verses.sanskrit: प्र पर्वतानामुशती उपस्थादश्वे इव विषिते हासमाने ।गावेव शुभ्रे मातरा रिहाणे विपाट्छुतुद्री पयसा जवेते ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ párvatānām ǀ uśatī́ íti ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ áśve ivétyáśve-iva ǀ vísite íti ví-site ǀ hā́samāne íti ǀgā́vā-iva ǀ śubhré íti ǀ mātárā ǀ rihāṇé íti ǀ ví-pāṭ ǀ śutudrī́ ǀ páyasā ǀ javete íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rushing from the flanks of the mountains, eager (to reach the sea) like two mares with loosened reins contending (with each other in speed), like two fair mother cows (hastening) to caress (their calves), the Vipās' andŚutudri, flow readily with (united) waterṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Rushing from the flanks of the mountains, eager (to reach the sea) like two mares with loosened reins contending (with each other in speed), like two fair mother cows (hastening) to caress (their calves), the Vipās' andŚutudri, flow readily with (united) waterṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रेषिते प्रसवं भिक्षमाणे अच्छा समुद्रं रथ्येव याथः ।समाराणे ऊर्मिभिः पिन्वमाने अन्या वामन्यामप्येति शुभ्रे ॥
verses.transliteration: índreṣite ítīndra-iṣite ǀ pra-savám ǀ bhíkṣamāṇe íti ǀ áccha ǀ samudrám ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ yāthaḥ ǀsamārāṇé íti sam-ārāṇé ǀ ūrmí-bhiḥ ǀ pínvamāne íti ǀ anyā́ ǀ vām ǀ anyā́m ǀ ápi ǀ eti ǀ śubhre íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Impelled by Indra, soliciting (his commands), you go to the ocean like charioteers (to their goal); flowing together, and swelling with (your) waves, bright (rivers) one of you proceeds to the other.
verses.wilson_translation: Impelled by Indra, soliciting (his commands), you go to the ocean like charioteers (to their goal); flowing together, and swelling with (your) waves, bright (rivers) one of you proceeds to the other.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा सिंधुं मातृतमामयासं विपाशमुर्वीं सुभगामगन्म ।वत्समिव मातरा संरिहाणे समानं योनिमनु संचरंती ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ síndhum ǀ mātṛ́-tamām ǀ ayāsam ǀ ví-pāśam ǀ urvī́m ǀ su-bhágām ǀ aganma ǀvatsám-iva ǀ mātárā ǀ saṃrihāṇé íti sam-rihāṇé ǀ samānám ǀ yónim ǀ ánu ǀ sañcárantī íti sam-cárantī ǁ
verses.english_translation: I repaired to the most material river; I went to the wide auspicious Vipās', flowing together to a common receptacle, like parent cows (hastening to) caress the calf.
verses.wilson_translation: I repaired to the most material river; I went to the wide auspicious Vipās', flowing together to a common receptacle, like parent cows (hastening to) caress the calf.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एना वयं पयसा पिन्वमाना अनु योनिं देवकृतं चरंतीः ।न वर्तवे प्रसवः सर्गतक्तः किंयुर्विप्रो नद्यो जोहवीति ॥
verses.transliteration: enā́ ǀ vayám ǀ páyasā ǀ pínvamānāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ yónim ǀ devá-kṛtam ǀ cárantīḥ ǀná ǀ vártave ǀ pra-saváḥ ǀ sárga-taktaḥ ǀ kim-yúḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ johavīti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The rivers speak: Fertilizing (the land) with this (our) current, we are flowing to the receptacle which has been appointed by the deity (Indra); the course appointed for our going (permits) not of delay; of what is the sage desirious, that he addresses the rivers?
verses.wilson_translation: The rivers speak: Fertilizing (the land) with this (our) current, we are flowing to the receptacle which has been appointed by the deity (Indra); the course appointed for our going (permits) not of delay; of what is the sage desirious, that he addresses the rivers?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रमध्वं मे वचसे सोम्याय ऋतावरीरुप मुहूर्तमेवैः ।प्र सिंधुमच्छा बृहती मनीषावस्युरह्वे कुशिकस्य सूनुः ॥
verses.transliteration: rámadhvam ǀ me ǀ vácase ǀ somyā́ya ǀ ṛ́ta-varīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ muhūrtám ǀ évaiḥ ǀprá ǀ síndhum ǀ áccha ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ ahve ǀ kuśikásya ǀ sūnúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: Rivers, charged with water, rest a moment from your course at my request, who go to gather the Soma; I, the son of Kuśika, desirous of protection, address with earnest prayer especially the river before me.
verses.wilson_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: Rivers, charged with water, rest a moment from your course at my request, who go to gather the Soma; I, the son of Kuśika, desirous of protection, address with earnest prayer especially the river before me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो अस्माँ अरदद्वज्रबाहुरपाहन्वृत्रं परिधिं नदीनां ।देवोऽनयत्सविता सुपाणिस्तस्य वयं प्रसवे याम उर्वीः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ aradat ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ahan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ pari-dhím ǀ nadī́nām ǀdeváḥ ǀ anayat ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-pāṇíḥ ǀ tásya ǀ vayám ǀ pra-savé ǀ yāmaḥ ǀ urvī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The rivers speak;Indra, the wielder of the thunder-bolt, dug our channels when he slew Ahi the blocker-up of rivers; the divine and well-handed Savitāhas led us (on our path), and obedient tohis commands we flow (as) ample (streams).
verses.wilson_translation: The rivers speak;Indra, the wielder of the thunder-bolt, dug our channels when he slew Ahi the blocker-up of rivers; the divine and well-handed Savitāhas led us (on our path), and obedient tohis commands we flow (as) ample (streams).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रवाच्यं शश्वधा वीर्यं तदिंद्रस्य कर्म यदहिं विवृश्चत् ।वि वज्रेण परिषदो जघानायन्नापोऽयनमिच्छमानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-vā́cyam ǀ śaśvadhā́ ǀ vīryám ǀ tát ǀ índrasya ǀ kárma ǀ yát ǀ áhim ǀ vi-vṛścát ǀví ǀ vájreṇa ǀ pari-sádaḥ ǀ jaghāna ǀ ā́yan ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ áyanam ǀ icchámānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: Ever is that heroic exploit of Indrato be celebrated when he cut Ahi to pieces, and with his thunderbolt destroyed the surrounding (obstructors of the rain), whence the waters proceed in the direction they desire.
verses.wilson_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: Ever is that heroic exploit of Indrato be celebrated when he cut Ahi to pieces, and with his thunderbolt destroyed the surrounding (obstructors of the rain), whence the waters proceed in the direction they desire.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वचो जरितर्मापि मृष्ठा आ यत्ते घोषानुत्तरा युगानि ।उक्थेषु कारो प्रति नो जुषस्व मा नो नि कः पुरुषत्रा नमस्ते ॥
verses.transliteration: etát ǀ vácaḥ ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápi ǀ mṛṣṭhāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ghóṣān ǀ út-tarā ǀ yugā́ni ǀukthéṣu ǀ kāro íti ǀ práti ǀ naḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ní ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀ puruṣa-trā́ ǀ námaḥ ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: The rivers speak: Praiser of Indra, forget not this speech, nor the worlds that (you have addressed to us) for future ages (to reverence); celebrator (of holy rites), be favourable to us in solemn prayers; treat us not after the (arrogant fashion) of men; salutation be to you!
verses.wilson_translation: The rivers speak: Praiser of Indra, forget not this speech, nor the worlds that (you have addressed to us) for future ages (to reverence); celebrator (of holy rites), be favourable to us in solemn prayers; treat us not after the (arrogant fashion) of men; salutation be to you!
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ओ षु स्वसारः कारवे शृणोत ययौ वो दूरादनसा रथेन ।नि षू नमध्वं भवता सुपारा अधोअक्षाः सिंधवः स्रोत्याभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ svasāraḥ ǀ kāráve ǀ śṛṇota ǀ yayáu ǀ vaḥ ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ánasā ǀ ráthena ǀní ǀ sú ǀ namadhvam ǀ bhávata ǀ su-pārā́ḥ ǀ adhaḥ-akṣā́ḥ ǀ sindhavaḥ ǀ srotyā́bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: Listen, sister (streams), kindly to him who praises you; who has come from afar with a waggon and chariot; bow down lowly; become easily fordable; remain, rivers, lower than the axle (of the wheel) with your currents.
verses.wilson_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: Listen, sister (streams), kindly to him who praises you; who has come from afar with a waggon and chariot; bow down lowly; become easily fordable; remain, rivers, lower than the axle (of the wheel) with your currents.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते कारो शृणवामा वचांसि ययाथ दूरादनसा रथेन ।नि ते नंसै पीप्यानेव योषा मर्यायेव कन्या शश्वचै ते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ kāro íti ǀ śṛṇavāma ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ yayā́tha ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ánasā ǀ ráthena ǀní ǀ te ǀ naṃsai ǀ pīpyānā́-iva ǀ yóṣā ǀ máryāya-iva ǀ kanyā́ ǀ śaśvacái ǀ ta íti te ǁ
verses.english_translation: The rivers speak: Hymner, we hear your words, that you have come from afar with a wagon and chariot; we bow down before you; like a woman nursing (her child), like a maiden bending to embrace a man, (so will we do) for you.
verses.wilson_translation: The rivers speak: Hymner, we hear your words, that you have come from afar with a wagon and chariot; we bow down before you; like a woman nursing (her child), like a maiden bending to embrace a man, (so will we do) for you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदंग त्वा भरताः संतरेयुर्गव्यन्ग्राम इषित इंद्रजूतः ।अर्षादह प्रसवः सर्गतक्त आ वो वृणे सुमतिं यज्ञियानां ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ aṅgá ǀ tvā ǀ bharatā́ḥ ǀ sam-táreyuḥ ǀ gavyán ǀ grā́maḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ índra-jūtaḥ ǀárṣāt ǀ áha ǀ pra-saváḥ ǀ sárga-taktaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛṇe ǀ su-matím ǀ yajñíyānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: (Since), rivers, (you have allowed me to cross), so may the Bharataspass over (your united stream); may the troop desiring to cross the water, permitted (by you), and impelled by Indra, pass; then let the course appinted for your going (be resumed); I have recourse to the favour of you who are worthy of adoration.
verses.wilson_translation: Viśvāmitraspeaks: (Since), rivers, (you have allowed me to cross), so may the Bharataspass over (your united stream); may the troop desiring to cross the water, permitted (by you), and impelled by Indra, pass; then let the course appinted for your going (be resumed); I have recourse to the favour of you who are worthy of adoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतारिषुर्भरता गव्यवः समभक्त विप्रः सुमतिं नदीनां ।प्र पिन्वध्वमिषयंतीः सुराधा आ वक्षणाः पृणध्वं यात शीभं ॥
verses.transliteration: átāriṣuḥ ǀ bharatā́ḥ ǀ gavyávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ábhakta ǀ vípraḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ nadī́nām ǀprá ǀ pinvadhvam ǀ iṣáyantīḥ ǀ su-rā́dhāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣáṇāḥ ǀ pṛṇádhvam ǀ yātá ǀ śī́bham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Bharatāsseeking cattle passed over; the sage enjoyed the favour of the rivers; streams dispensing food, productive of wealth, spread abundance, fill (your beds), flow swiftly.
verses.wilson_translation: The Bharatāsseeking cattle passed over; the sage enjoyed the favour of the rivers; streams dispensing food, productive of wealth, spread abundance, fill (your beds), flow swiftly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उद्व ऊर्मिः शम्या हंत्वापो योक्त्राणि मुंचत ।मादुष्कृतौ व्येनसाघ्न्यौ शूनमारतां ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ śámyāḥ ǀ hantu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ yóktrāṇi ǀ muñcata ǀmā́ ǀ áduḥ-kṛtau ǀ ví-enasā ǀ aghnyáu ǀ śū́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ aratām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let your waves (rivers) so flow that the pin of the yoke may be above (their) waters; leave the traces full, and may (the two streams), exempt from misfortune or defect, and uncensured, exhibit no (present) increase.
verses.wilson_translation: Let your waves (rivers) so flow that the pin of the yoke may be above (their) waters; leave the traces full, and may (the two streams), exempt from misfortune or defect, and uncensured, exhibit no (present) increase.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FORT-RENDER, Lord of Wealth, dispelling foemen, Indra with lightnings hath o’ercome the Dāsa.Impelled by prayer and waxen great in body, he hath filled earth and heaven, the Bounteous Giver. I stimulate thy zeal, the Strong, the Hero decking my song of praise forth; Immortal.O Indra, thou art equally the Leader of heavenly hosts and human generations. Leading, his band Indra encompassed Vṛtra; weak grew the wily leader of enchanters.He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyaṁsa, and made the Milch-kine of the nights apparent. Indra, light-winner, days' Creator, conquered, victorious, hostile bands with those who loved him.For man the days' bright ensign he illumined, and found the light for his joy and gladness. Forward to fiercely falling blows pressed Indra, herolike doing many hero exploits.These holy songs he taught the bard who gaised him, and widely spread these Dawns' resplendent colour. They laud the mighty acts of him the Mighty, the many glorious deeds performed by Indra.He in his strength, with all-surpassing prowess, through wondrous arts crushed the malignant Dasyus. Lord of the brave, Indra who rules the people gave freedom to the Gods by might and battle.Wise singers glorify with chanted praises these his achievements in Vivasvān's dwelling. Excellent, Conqueror, the victory-giver, the winner of the light and Godlike Waters,He who hath won this broad earth and this heaven, -in Indra they rejoice who love devotions. He gained possession of the Sun and Horses, Indra obtained the Cow who feedeth many.Treasure of gold he won; he smote the Dasyus, and gave protection to the Āryan colour. He took the plants and days for his possession; he gained the forest trees and air's mid-region.Vala he cleft, and chased away opponents: thus was he tamer of the overweening. Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vṛtras, wins and gathers treasures.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रः पूर्भिदातिरद्दासमर्कैर्विदद्वसुर्दयमानो वि शत्रून् ।ब्रह्मजूतस्तन्वा वावृधानो भूरिदात्र आपृणद्रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ pūḥ-bhít ǀ ā́ ǀ atirat ǀ dā́sam ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ vidát-vasuḥ ǀ dáyamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ śátrūn ǀbráhma-jūtaḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ bhū́ri-dātraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ apṛṇat ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the destroyer of cities, possessed of wealth manifesting (his greatness), merciless to his enemies has overspread the day with his radiance; attracted by prayer, increasing in bulk, and armed with many weapons, he has delighted both heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the destroyer of cities, possessed of wealth manifesting (his greatness), merciless to his enemies has overspread the day with his radiance; attracted by prayer, increasing in bulk, and armed with many weapons, he has delighted both heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मखस्य ते तविषस्य प्र जूतिमियर्मि वाचममृताय भूषन् ।इंद्र क्षितीनामसि मानुषीणां विशां दैवीनामुत पूर्वयावा ॥
verses.transliteration: makhásya ǀ te ǀ taviṣásya ǀ prá ǀ jūtím ǀ íyarmi ǀ vā́cam ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ bhū́ṣan ǀíndra ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ asi ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ viśā́m ǀ dáivīnām ǀ utá ǀ pūrva-yā́vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Decorating you, I address sincere prayers to you who are adorable and mighty, for the sake of (obtaining) food; you,Indraare the preceder of men the descendants ofmanu, and of the descendants of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Decorating you, I address sincere prayers to you who are adorable and mighty, for the sake of (obtaining) food; you,Indraare the preceder of men the descendants ofmanu, and of the descendants of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो वृत्रमवृणोच्छर्धनीतिः प्र मायिनाममिनाद्वर्पणीतिः ।अहन्व्यंसमुशधग्वनेष्वाविर्धेना अकृणोद्राम्याणां ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ avṛṇot ǀ śárdha-nītiḥ ǀ prá ǀ māyínām ǀ amināt ǀ várpa-nītiḥ ǀáhan ǀ ví-aṃsam ǀ uśádhak ǀ váneṣu ǀ āvíḥ ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ akṛṇot ǀ rāmyā́ṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, of glorious deeds, destroyed Vṛtra; resistless in combat, he has overcome the deceivers resolved to consume him; he slew the mutilated (demon lurking) in the woods, and made manifest the (stolen) kine (that had been hidden) in the night.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, of glorious deeds, destroyed Vṛtra; resistless in combat, he has overcome the deceivers resolved to consume him; he slew the mutilated (demon lurking) in the woods, and made manifest the (stolen) kine (that had been hidden) in the night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रः स्वर्षा जनयन्नहानि जिगायोशिग्भिः पृतना अभिष्टिः ।प्रारोचयन्मनवे केतुमह्नामविंदज्ज्योतिर्बृहते रणाय ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ svaḥ-sā́ḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ áhāni ǀ jigā́ya ǀ uśík-bhiḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhiṣṭíḥ ǀprá ǀ arocayat ǀ mánave ǀ ketúm ǀ áhnām ǀ ávindat ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ bṛhaté ǀ ráṇāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the giver ofsvarga, genitive rating the days, has subdued victorious with the eager (aṅgirasas) the hostile hosts, and illuminingfor man the banner of the days, he obtained light for the great conflict.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the giver ofsvarga, genitive rating the days, has subdued victorious with the eager (aṅgirasas) the hostile hosts, and illuminingfor man the banner of the days, he obtained light for the great conflict.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्तुजो बर्हणा आ विवेश नृवद्दधानो नर्या पुरूणि ।अचेतयद्धिय इमा जरित्रे प्रेमं वर्णमतिरच्छुक्रमासां ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ tújaḥ ǀ barháṇāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ náryā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀácetayat ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ jaritré ǀ prá ǀ imám ǀ várṇam ǀ atirat ǀ śukrám ǀ āsām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraentered the confiding hostile (hosts) like a man distributing many (gifts) to (his) leaders; he has animated these dawns for the worshipper, and heightened their bright radiance (by his own).
verses.wilson_translation: Indraentered the confiding hostile (hosts) like a man distributing many (gifts) to (his) leaders; he has animated these dawns for the worshipper, and heightened their bright radiance (by his own).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महो महानि पनयंत्यस्येंद्रस्य कर्म सुकृता पुरूणि ।वृजनेन वृजिनान्त्सं पिपेष मायाभिर्दस्यूँरभिभूत्योजाः ॥
verses.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ panayanti ǀ asya ǀ índrasya ǀ kárma ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀvṛjánena ǀ vṛjinā́n ǀ sám ǀ pipeṣa ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ abhíbhūti-ojāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They celebrate many great and glorious exploits of this mighty Indra; he crushed the strong by his strength, and, of overpowering prowess, he overcame thedasyusby delusions.
verses.wilson_translation: They celebrate many great and glorious exploits of this mighty Indra; he crushed the strong by his strength, and, of overpowering prowess, he overcame thedasyusby delusions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युधेंद्रो मह्ना वरिवश्चकार देवेभ्यः सत्पतिश्चर्षणिप्राः ।विवस्वतः सदने अस्य तानि विप्रा उक्थेभिः कवयो गृणंति ॥
verses.transliteration: yudhā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ cakāra ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǀvivásvataḥ ǀ sádane ǀ asya ǀ tā́ni ǀ víprāḥ ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ gṛṇanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of the virtuous, fulfiller of the wishes of men, he gave to the gods the wealth (that had been won) in fierce battle, and therefore far-seeing sages glorify those his exploits with praises in the dwelling of the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of the virtuous, fulfiller of the wishes of men, he gave to the gods the wealth (that had been won) in fierce battle, and therefore far-seeing sages glorify those his exploits with praises in the dwelling of the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्रासाहं वरेण्यं सहोदां ससवांसं स्वरपश्च देवीः ।ससान यः पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामिंद्रं मदंत्यनु धीरणासः ॥
verses.transliteration: satrā-sáham ǀ váreṇyam ǀ sahaḥ-dā́m ǀ sasavā́ṃsam ǀ sváḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǀ devī́ḥ ǀsasā́na ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ utá ǀ imā́m ǀ índram ǀ madanti ǀ ánu ǀ dhī́-raṇāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devout worshippers propitiate Indra, the victorious, the excellent, the bestower of strength, the enjoyer of heaven and the divine waters, and who was the giver of the earth and heaven and this (firmament to their inhabitants).
verses.wilson_translation: Devout worshippers propitiate Indra, the victorious, the excellent, the bestower of strength, the enjoyer of heaven and the divine waters, and who was the giver of the earth and heaven and this (firmament to their inhabitants).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ससानात्याँ उत सूर्यं ससानेंद्रः ससान पुरुभोजसं गां ।हिरण्ययमुत भोगं ससान हत्वी दस्यून्प्रार्यं वर्णमावत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sasā́na ǀ átyān ǀ utá ǀ sū́ryam ǀ sasāna ǀ índraḥ ǀ sasāna ǀ puru-bhójasam ǀ gā́m ǀhiraṇyáyam ǀ utá ǀ bhógam ǀ sasāna ǀ hatvī́ ǀ dásyūn ǀ prá ǀ ā́ryam ǀ várṇam ǀ āvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: He gave horses, he gave also the sun, and Indragave also the many-nourishing cow; he gave golden treasure, and having destroyed thedasyus, he protected theāryatribe.
verses.wilson_translation: He gave horses, he gave also the sun, and Indragave also the many-nourishing cow; he gave golden treasure, and having destroyed thedasyus, he protected theāryatribe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र ओषधीरसनोदहानि वनस्पतीँरसनोदंतरिक्षं ।बिभेद वलं नुनुदे विवाचोऽथाभवद्दमिताभिक्रतूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ asanot ǀ áhāni ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ asanot ǀ antárikṣam ǀbibhéda ǀ valám ǀ nunudé ǀ ví-vācaḥ ǀ átha ǀ abhavat ǀ damitā́ ǀ abhí-kratūnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indrabestowed plural nts and days, he gave trees and the firmament,he divided the cloud, he scattered opponents, he was the tamer of adversaries.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrabestowed plural nts and days, he gave trees and the firmament,he divided the cloud, he scattered opponents, he was the tamer of adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिंद्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।शृण्वंतमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नंतं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानां ॥
verses.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXV Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MOUNT the Bay Horses to thy chariot harnessed, and come to us like Vāyu with his coursers.Thou, hastening to us, shalt drink the Soma. Hail, Indra. We have poured it for thy rapture. For him, the God who is invoked by many, the two swift Bay Steeds to the pole I harness,That they in fleet course may bring Indra hither, e’en to this sacrifice arranged completely. Bring the strong Steeds who drink the warm libation, and, Bull of Godlike nature, be thou gracious.Let thy Steeds eat; set free thy Tawny Horses, and roasted grain like this consume thou daily. Those who are yoked by prayer I harness, fleet friendly Bays who take their joy together.Mounting thy firm and easy car, O Indra, wise and all-knowing come thou to the Soma. No other worshippers must stay beside them thy Bays, thy vigorous and smooth-backed Coursers.Pass by them all and hasten onward hither: with Soma pressed we will prepare to feast thee. Thine is this Soma: hasten to approach it. Drink thou thereof, benevolent, and cease not.Sit on the sacred grass at this our worship, and take these drops into thy belly, Indra. The grass is strewn for thee, pressed is the Soma; the grain is ready for thy Bays to feed on.To thee who lovest them, the very mighty, strong, girt by Maruts, are these gifts presented. This the sweet draught, with cows, the men, the mountains, the waters, Indra, have for thee made ready.Come, drink thereof, Sublime One, friendly-minded, foreseeing, knowing well the ways thou goest. The Maruts, they with whom thou sharedst Soma, Indra, who made thee strong and were thine army,—With these accordant, eagerly desirous drink thou this Soma with the tongue of Agni. Drink, Indra, of the juice by thine own nature, or by the tongue of Agni, O thou Holy.Accept the sacrificial gift, O Śakra, from the Adhvaryu's hand or from the Hotar's. Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,The Strong, who listens, who.gives aid in battles, who slays the Vṛtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठा हरी रथ आ युज्यमाना याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छ ।पिबास्यंधो अभिसृष्टो अस्मे इंद्र स्वाहा ररिमा ते मदाय ॥
verses.transliteration: tíṣṭha ǀ hárī íti ǀ ráthe ǀ ā́ ǀ yujyámānā ǀ yāhí ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀpíbāsi ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ abhí-sṛṣṭaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ índra ǀ svā́hā ǀ rarimá ǀ te ǀ mádāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Stay,Indra, having yoked the horses to the car, as Vāyustops when he has put to his steds, and come to our presence; solicited by us to drink of the Soma, which with reverence we offer for your exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Stay,Indra, having yoked the horses to the car, as Vāyustops when he has put to his steds, and come to our presence; solicited by us to drink of the Soma, which with reverence we offer for your exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उपाजिरा पुरुहूताय सप्ती हरी रथस्य धूर्ष्वा युनज्मि ।द्रवद्यथा संभृतं विश्वतश्चिदुपेमं यज्ञमा वहात इंद्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ ajirā́ ǀ puru-hūtā́ya ǀ sáptī íti ǀ hárī íti ǀ ráthasya ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ yunajmi ǀdravát ǀ yáthā ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ úpa ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ vahātaḥ ǀ índram ǁ
verses.english_translation: I harness for you, who is invoked by many, the swift gliding horses to the shafts of the car, that they may bear Indrato this sacrifice that is prepared with all (that is required).
verses.wilson_translation: I harness for you, who is invoked by many, the swift gliding horses to the shafts of the car, that they may bear Indrato this sacrifice that is prepared with all (that is required).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उपो नयस्व वृषणा तपुष्पोतेमव त्वं वृषभ स्वधावः ।ग्रसेतामश्वा वि मुचेह शोणा दिवेदिवे सदृशीरद्धि धानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ nayasva ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ tapuḥ-pā́ ǀ utá ǀ īm ǀ ava ǀ tvám ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀgrásetām ǀ áśvā ǀ ví ǀ muca ǀ ihá ǀ śóṇā ǀ divé-dive ǀ sa-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ addhi ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer (of benefits), giver of food, guide hither your vigorous horses, defending (us) against foes, and protect (your worshippers); here unharness the bay steeds, and give them fodder, and you eat daily suitable food.
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer (of benefits), giver of food, guide hither your vigorous horses, defending (us) against foes, and protect (your worshippers); here unharness the bay steeds, and give them fodder, and you eat daily suitable food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा ते ब्रह्मयुजा युनज्मि हरी सखाया सधमाद आशू ।स्थिरं रथं सुखमिंद्राधितिष्ठन्प्रजानन्विद्वाँ उप याहि सोमं ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhmaṇā ǀ te ǀ brahma-yújā ǀ yunajmi ǀ hárī íti ǀ sákhāyā ǀ sadha-mā́de ǀ āśū́ íti ǀsthirám ǀ rátham ǀ su-khám ǀ indra ǀ adhi-tíṣṭhan ǀ pra-jānán ǀ vidvā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ sómam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I harness with prayer your horses, who are to be harnessed with prayer, who are allies and swift-paced in battle; arise, and all-knowing Indra, mounting on your firm and easy chariot, come to the libation.
verses.wilson_translation: I harness with prayer your horses, who are to be harnessed with prayer, who are allies and swift-paced in battle; arise, and all-knowing Indra, mounting on your firm and easy chariot, come to the libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा ते हरी वृषणा वीतपृष्ठा नि रीरमन्यजमानासो अन्ये ।अत्यायाहि शश्वतो वयं तेऽरं सुतेभिः कृणवाम सोमैः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ vītá-pṛṣṭhā ǀ ní ǀ rīraman ǀ yájamānāsaḥ ǀ anyé ǀati-ā́yāhi ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ vayám ǀ te ǀ áram ǀ sutébhiḥ ǀ kṛṇavāma ǀ sómaiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not other sacrifices attract your vigorous and smooth-backed steeds; disregarding others, come perpetually hither, that we may propitiate you sufficiently with effused Somalibations.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not other sacrifices attract your vigorous and smooth-backed steeds; disregarding others, come perpetually hither, that we may propitiate you sufficiently with effused Somalibations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवायं सोमस्त्वमेह्यर्वाङ् शश्वत्तमं सुमना अस्य पाहि ।अस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिष्या निषद्या दधिष्वेमं जठर इंदुमिंद्र ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pāhi ǀasmín ǀ yajñé ǀ barhíṣi ǀ ā́ ǀ ni-sádya ǀ dadhiṣvá ǀ imám ǀ jaṭháre ǀ índum ǀ indra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thissomalibation is for you; come down, and well disposed, drink of it unceasingly; seated on the grass at this sacrifice, take Indra, this (libation) into your belly.
verses.wilson_translation: Thissomalibation is for you; come down, and well disposed, drink of it unceasingly; seated on the grass at this sacrifice, take Indra, this (libation) into your belly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तीर्णं ते बर्हिः सुत इंद्र सोमः कृता धाना अत्तवे ते हरिभ्यां ।तदोकसे पुरुशाकाय वृष्णे मरुत्वते तुभ्यं राता हवींषि ॥
verses.transliteration: stīrṇám ǀ te ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kṛtā́ḥ ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀ áttave ǀ te ǀ hári-bhyām ǀtát-okase ǀ puru-śā́kāya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ marútvate ǀ túbhyam ǀ rātā́ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sacred grass is strewn for you; the Soma,Indra, is poured forth; the grain wherewith to feed your horses is prepared; the oblations are offered to you abiding on the sacred grass, who is praised of many, and is the showerer (of benefits), attended by the Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: The sacred grass is strewn for you; the Soma,Indra, is poured forth; the grain wherewith to feed your horses is prepared; the oblations are offered to you abiding on the sacred grass, who is praised of many, and is the showerer (of benefits), attended by the Maruts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमं नरः पर्वतास्तुभ्यमापः समिंद्र गोभिर्मधुमंतमक्रन् ।तस्यागत्या सुमना ऋष्व पाहि प्रजानन्विद्वान्पथ्या अनु स्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ náraḥ ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ sám ǀ indra ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ akran ǀtásya ǀ ā-gátya ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ṛṣva ǀ pāhi ǀ pra-jānán ǀ vidvā́n ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The leaders (of the ceremony) have prepared for you,Indra, this (libation), sweetened with milk, the stones, the water; beautiful Indra, who is favourably disposed, and who is wise, knowing well (the worship) that is according to your peculiar paths, come and drink of this libation.
verses.wilson_translation: The leaders (of the ceremony) have prepared for you,Indra, this (libation), sweetened with milk, the stones, the water; beautiful Indra, who is favourably disposed, and who is wise, knowing well (the worship) that is according to your peculiar paths, come and drink of this libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: याँ आभजो मरुत इंद्र सोमे ये त्वामवर्धन्नभवन्गणस्ते ।तेभिरेतं सजोषा वावशानोऽग्नेः पिब जिह्वया सोममिंद्र ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ábhajaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sóme ǀ yé ǀ tvā́m ǀ ávardhan ǀ ábhavan ǀ gaṇáḥ ǀ te ǀtébhiḥ ǀ etám ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ piba ǀ jihváyā ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated,Indra, with those Marutswith whom you have shared in the libation, who encouraged you (in battle), and are your attendant troop, drink, desirous of the Soma, along with them, with the tongue of Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated,Indra, with those Marutswith whom you have shared in the libation, who encouraged you (in battle), and are your attendant troop, drink, desirous of the Soma, along with them, with the tongue of Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र पिब स्वधया चित्सुतस्याग्नेर्वा पाहि जिह्वया यजत्र ।अध्वर्योर्वा प्रयतं शक्र हस्ताद्धोतुर्वा यज्ञं हविषो जुषस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ píba ǀ svadháyā ǀ cit ǀ sutásya ǀ agnéḥ ǀ vā ǀ pāhi ǀ jihváyā ǀ yajatra ǀadhvaryóḥ ǀ vā ǀ prá-yatam ǀ śakra ǀ hástāt ǀ hótuḥ ǀ vā ǀ yajñám ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ juṣasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable Indra, drink of the effused libation, either by your own effort, or through the tongue of Agni; drink it,Śakra, offered by thehandof theadhvaryu, or accept the presentation of the oblation (from the hand) of the Hotā.
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable Indra, drink of the effused libation, either by your own effort, or through the tongue of Agni; drink it,Śakra, offered by thehandof theadhvaryu, or accept the presentation of the oblation (from the hand) of the Hotā.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिंद्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।शृण्वंतमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नंतं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानां ॥
verses.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indradistinguished in this combat; the leader in the food bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indradistinguished in this combat; the leader in the food bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ११ गाथिनो विश्वामित्रः, १० घोर आङ्गिरसः। इन्द्रः। त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH constant succours, fain thyself to share it, make this oblation which we bring effective.Grown great through strengthening gifts at each libation, he hath become renowned by mighty exploits. For Indra were the Somas erst- discovered, whereby he grew strong-jointed, vast, and skilful.Indra , take quickly these presented juices: drink of the strong, that which the strong have shaken. Drink and wax great. Thine are the juices, Indra, both Somas of old time and these we bring thee.Even as thou drankest, Indra, earlier Somas, so drink to-day, a new guest, meet for praises. Great and impetuous, mighty-voiced in battle, surpassing power is his, and strength resistless.Him the broad earth hath never comprehended when Somas cheered the Lord of Tawny Coursers. Mighty and strong he waxed for hero exploit: the Bull was furnished a Sage's wisdom.Indra is our kind Lord; his steers have vigour; his cows are many with abundant offspring. As floods according to their stream flow onward, so to the sea, as borne on cars, the waters.Vaster is Indra even than his dwelling, what time the stalk milked out, the Soma, fills him. Eager to mingle with the sea, the rivers carry the well-pressed Soma juice to Indra.They drain the stalk out with their arms, quick-banded, and cleanse it with a stream of mead and filters. Like lakes appear his flanks filled full with Soma: yea, he contains libations in abundance.When Indra had consumed the first sweet viands, he, after slaying Vṛtra, claimed the Soma. Then bring thou hither, and let none prevent it: we know thee well, the Lord of wealth and treasure.That splendid gift which is thine own, O Indra, vouchsafe to us, Lord of the Tawny Coursers. O Indra, Maghavan, impetuous mover, grant us abundant wealth that brings all blessings.Give us a hundred autumns for our lifetime: give us, O fair-checked Indra, store of heroes. Call we on Indra, Maghavan, auspicious, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vṛtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sanskrit: इमामू षु प्रभृतिं सातये धाः शश्वच्छश्वदूतिभिर्यादमानः ।सुतेसुते वावृधे वर्धनेभिर्यः कर्मभिर्महद्भिः सुश्रुतो भूत् ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ prá-bhṛtim ǀ sātáye ǀ dhāḥ ǀ śáśvat-śaśvat ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ yā́damānaḥ ǀsuté-sute ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ várdhanebhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ kárma-bhiḥ ǀ mahát-bhiḥ ǀ sú-śrutaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who is constantly seeking (association) with your allies (the Maruts) accept this, our offering (made) for the grant (from you of riches); for you are one who grows with augmenting energies, through reiterated libations, and has been renowned for glorious deeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who is constantly seeking (association) with your allies (the Maruts) accept this, our offering (made) for the grant (from you of riches); for you are one who grows with augmenting energies, through reiterated libations, and has been renowned for glorious deeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय सोमाः प्रदिवो विदाना ऋभुर्येभिर्वृषपर्वा विहायाः ।प्रयम्यमानान्प्रति षू गृभायेंद्र पिब वृषधूतस्य वृष्णः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ sómāḥ ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ vídānāḥ ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-parvā ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀpra-yamyámānān ǀ práti ǀ sú ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ índra ǀ píba ǀ vṛ́ṣa-dhūtasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To Indrahave libations been presented in the days of old, whereby he has become illustrious, the regulator of time, the granter of desires; accept, Indra, these prescribed (offerings), and drink of this auspicous (Soma), expressed by the stones.
verses.wilson_translation: To Indrahave libations been presented in the days of old, whereby he has become illustrious, the regulator of time, the granter of desires; accept, Indra, these prescribed (offerings), and drink of this auspicous (Soma), expressed by the stones.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबा वर्धस्व तव घा सुतास इंद्र सोमासः प्रथमा उतेमे ।यथापिबः पूर्व्याँ इंद्र सोमाँ एवा पाहि पन्यो अद्या नवीयान् ॥
verses.transliteration: píba ǀ várdhasva ǀ táva ǀ gha ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ índra ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ imé ǀyáthā ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ pūrvyā́n ǀ indra ǀ sómān ǀ evá ǀ pāhi ǀ pányaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ návīyān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink,Indra, and thrive; yours are these (present) libations, as were the primitive libations; you who is adorable, drink today the recent libations, as you drank those of old.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink,Indra, and thrive; yours are these (present) libations, as were the primitive libations; you who is adorable, drink today the recent libations, as you drank those of old.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महाँ अमत्रो वृजने विरप्श्युग्रं शवः पत्यते धृष्ण्वोजः ।नाह विव्याच पृथिवी चनैनं यत्सोमासो हर्यश्वममंदन् ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ ámatraḥ ǀ vṛjáne ǀ vi-rapśī́ ǀ ugrám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ patyate ǀ dhṛṣṇú ǀ ójaḥ ǀná ǀ áha ǀ vivyāca ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ caná ǀ enam ǀ yát ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ hári-aśvam ǀ ámandan ǁ
verses.english_translation: The great Indra, the victorious in battle, the defier of foes; his fierce strength and resolute vigour are exerted; verily the earth does not contain him, neither (does the heaven), when the Somalibations exhilarate the lord of the tawny steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: The great Indra, the victorious in battle, the defier of foes; his fierce strength and resolute vigour are exerted; verily the earth does not contain him, neither (does the heaven), when the Somalibations exhilarate the lord of the tawny steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महाँ उग्रो वावृधे वीर्याय समाचक्रे वृषभः काव्येन ।इंद्रो भगो वाजदा अस्य गावः प्र जायंते दक्षिणा अस्य पूर्वीः ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ ugráḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ sam-ā́cakre ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ kā́vyena ǀíndraḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ vāja-dā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ prá ǀ jāyante ǀ dákṣiṇāḥ ǀ asya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty, fierce, auspicious Indra, the showerer (of benefits), augments (in power) as he is animated for heroic (acts) by praise; his cattle are genitive rated givers of food; many are his donations.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty, fierce, auspicious Indra, the showerer (of benefits), augments (in power) as he is animated for heroic (acts) by praise; his cattle are genitive rated givers of food; many are his donations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र यत्सिंधवः प्रसवं यथायन्नापः समुद्रं रथ्येव जग्मुः ।अतश्चिदिंद्रः सदसो वरीयान्यदीं सोमः पृणति दुग्धो अंशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pra-savám ǀ yáthā ǀ ā́yan ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ jagmuḥ ǀátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ índraḥ ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ várīyān ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pṛṇáti ǀ dugdháḥ ǀ aṃśúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the rivers pursue their course, the waters rush to the ocean like the drivers of cars (to a goal), so the vast Indra(hastens) from his dwelling (in the firmament), when the humble Som alibation propitiates him.
verses.wilson_translation: As the rivers pursue their course, the waters rush to the ocean like the drivers of cars (to a goal), so the vast Indra(hastens) from his dwelling (in the firmament), when the humble Som alibation propitiates him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रेण सिंधवो यादमाना इंद्राय सोमं सुषुतं भरंतः ।अंशुं दुहंति हस्तिनो भरित्रैर्मध्वः पुनंति धारया पवित्रैः ॥
verses.transliteration: samudréṇa ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ yā́damānāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ sú-sutam ǀ bhárantaḥ ǀaṃśúm ǀ duhanti ǀ hastínaḥ ǀ bharítraiḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ punanti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pavítraiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the rivers are solicitious (to mix) with the ocean, so (are the priests) bearing the efficient libation to Indra; holding in theirhandsthey milk the Soma, and purify the sweet Soma (as they fall) indrops through the purifying filters.
verses.wilson_translation: As the rivers are solicitious (to mix) with the ocean, so (are the priests) bearing the efficient libation to Indra; holding in theirhandsthey milk the Soma, and purify the sweet Soma (as they fall) indrops through the purifying filters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ह्रदा इव कुक्षयः सोमधानाः समी विव्याच सवना पुरूणि ।अन्ना यदिंद्रः प्रथमा व्याश वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अवृणीत सोमं ॥
verses.transliteration: hradā́ḥ-iva ǀ kukṣáyaḥ ǀ soma-dhā́nāḥ ǀ sám ǀ īmíti ǀ vivyāca ǀ sávanā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀánnā ǀ yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ví ǀ ā́śa ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ sómam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The stomach of Indra(is) as capacious (a receptacle) of Soma, as a lake, for he has partaken of it at many sacrifices; and inasmuch as he has eaten the first (sacrificial) viands, he has been the slayer of Vṛtra, and has shared the Soma (with the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: The stomach of Indra(is) as capacious (a receptacle) of Soma, as a lake, for he has partaken of it at many sacrifices; and inasmuch as he has eaten the first (sacrificial) viands, he has been the slayer of Vṛtra, and has shared the Soma (with the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ तू भर माकिरेतत्परि ष्ठाद्विद्मा हि त्वा वसुपतिं वसूनां ।इंद्र यत्ते माहिनं दत्रमस्त्यस्मभ्यं तद्धर्यश्व प्र यंधि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ bhara ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ etát ǀ pári ǀ sthāt ǀ vidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ vásu-patim ǀ vásūnām ǀíndra ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ mā́hinam ǀ dátram ǀ ásti ǀ asmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ hari-aśva ǀ prá ǀ yandhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Quickly,Indra, bring (wealth); let no one impede you, for we know you to be the lord of wealth, of all treasures; and since, Indra, your greatness is munificence, therefore, lord of the tawny steeds, grant us (riches).
verses.wilson_translation: Quickly,Indra, bring (wealth); let no one impede you, for we know you to be the lord of wealth, of all treasures; and since, Indra, your greatness is munificence, therefore, lord of the tawny steeds, grant us (riches).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे प्र यंधि मघवन्नृजीषिन्निंद्र रायो विश्ववारस्य भूरेः ।अस्मे शतं शरदो जीवसे धा अस्मे वीरांछश्वत इंद्र शिप्रिन् ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ prá ǀ yandhi ǀ magha-van ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀ índra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ viśvá-vārasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ śatám ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ dhāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ vīrā́n ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ indra ǀ śiprin ǁ
verses.english_translation: Opulent Indra, receiver of the spiritless Soma, give to us riches in universally desired quantity; grant us to live a hundred years; bestow upon us, Indra wiht the handsome chin, numerous posterity.
verses.wilson_translation: Opulent Indra, receiver of the spiritless Soma, give to us riches in universally desired quantity; grant us to live a hundred years; bestow upon us, Indra wiht the handsome chin, numerous posterity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिंद्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।शृण्वंतमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नंतं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानां ॥
verses.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat; the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat; the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O INDRA, for the strength that slays Vṛtra and conquers in the fight,We turn thee hitherward to us. O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, may those who praise thee hitherward.Direct thy spirit and thine eye. O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, with all our songs we invocateThy names for triumph over foes. We strive for glory through the powers immense of him whom many praise,Of Indra who supports mankind. For Vṛtra's slaughter I address Indra whom many invocate,To win us booty in the wars. In battles be victorious. We seek thee, Lord of Hundred Powers,Indra, that Vṛtra may be slain. In splendid combats of the hosts, in glories where the fight is won.Indra, be victor over foes. Drink thou the Soma for our help, bright, vigilant, exceeding strong,O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers. O Śatakratu, powers which thou mid the Five Races hast displayed-These, Indra, do I claim of thee. Indra, great glory hast thou gained. Win splendid fame which none may marWe make thy might perpetual. Come to us either from anear, Or, Śakra, come from far away.Indra, wherever be thy home, come to us thence, O Thunder-armed.

verses.sanskrit: वार्त्रहत्याय शवसे पृतनाषाह्याय च ।इंद्र त्वा वर्तयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́rtra-hatyāya ǀ śávase ǀ pṛtanā-sáhyāya ǀ ca ǀíndra ǀ tvā ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: We excite you,Indra, to exert the strength that destroys Vṛtra, and overpowers hostile armies.
verses.wilson_translation: We excite you,Indra, to exert the strength that destroys Vṛtra, and overpowers hostile armies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाचीनं सु ते मन उत चक्षुः शतक्रतो ।इंद्र कृण्वंतु वाघतः ॥
verses.transliteration: arvācī́nam ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ utá ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀíndra ǀ kṛṇvántu ǀ vāghátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your praisers,Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, direct your mind and your eyes towards us.
verses.wilson_translation: May your praisers,Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, direct your mind and your eyes towards us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नामानि ते शतक्रतो विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरीमहे ।इंद्राभिमातिषाह्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: nā́māni ǀ te ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ īmahe ǀíndra ǀ abhimāti-sáhye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We recite,Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, (your many) names in all our hymns for strength to resist our foes.
verses.wilson_translation: We recite,Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, (your many) names in all our hymns for strength to resist our foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरुष्टुतस्य धामभिः शतेन महयामसि ।इंद्रस्य चर्षणीधृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: puru-stutásya ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ śaténa ǀ mahayāmasi ǀíndrasya ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́taḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We repeat the praise of the many-lauded Indrathe supporter of man, invested with a hundred glories.
verses.wilson_translation: We repeat the praise of the many-lauded Indrathe supporter of man, invested with a hundred glories.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वृत्राय हंतवे पुरुहूतमुप ब्रुवे ।भरेषु वाजसातये ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀbháreṣu ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke you,Indra, who is invoked of many for the slaying of Vṛtra, and the granting of food (as the spoil) of battle.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke you,Indra, who is invoked of many for the slaying of Vṛtra, and the granting of food (as the spoil) of battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाजेषु सासहिर्भव त्वामीमहे शतक्रतो ।इंद्र वृत्राय हंतवे ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́jeṣu ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ bhava ǀ tvā́m ǀ īmahe ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀíndra ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be victorious,Indra, in battles; we solicit you, object of many rites, to destroy Vṛtra.
verses.wilson_translation: Be victorious,Indra, in battles; we solicit you, object of many rites, to destroy Vṛtra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्युम्नेषु पृतनाज्ये पृत्सुतूर्षु श्रवःसु च ।इंद्र साक्ष्वाभिमातिषु ॥
verses.transliteration: dyumnéṣu ǀ pṛtanā́jye ǀ pṛtsutū́rṣu ǀ śrávaḥ-su ǀ ca ǀíndra ǀ sā́kṣva ǀ abhí-mātiṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Overcome,Indra, those who are adverse to us in riches, in battle, in hostile hosts, in strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Overcome,Indra, those who are adverse to us in riches, in battle, in hostile hosts, in strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुष्मिंतमं न ऊतये द्युम्निनं पाहि जागृविं ।इंद्र सोमं शतक्रतो ॥
verses.transliteration: śuṣmín-tamam ǀ ná ǀ ūtáye ǀ dyumnínam ǀ pāhi ǀ jā́gṛvim ǀíndra ǀ sómam ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink,Indra, object of many rites, for our preservation, the most invigorating, fame-conferring, sleep-dispelling,Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink,Indra, object of many rites, for our preservation, the most invigorating, fame-conferring, sleep-dispelling,Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रियाणि शतक्रतो या ते जनेषु पंचसु ।इंद्र तानि त आ वृणे ॥
verses.transliteration: indriyā́ṇi ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ jáneṣu ǀ pañcá-su ǀíndra ǀ tā́ni ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, object of many rites, I regard the organs of sense, that exist in the five races (of beings dependent) on you as yours.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, object of many rites, I regard the organs of sense, that exist in the five races (of beings dependent) on you as yours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अगन्निंद्र श्रवो बृहद्द्युम्नं दधिष्व दुष्टरं ।उत्ते शुष्मं तिरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ágan ǀ indra ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ dyumnám ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ dustáram ǀút ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ tirāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the abundant (sacrificial) food (we offer) reach you,Indra; grant us wealth that may not easily be surpassed; we augment your vigour (by our offerings).
verses.wilson_translation: May the abundant (sacrificial) food (we offer) reach you,Indra; grant us wealth that may not easily be surpassed; we augment your vigour (by our offerings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्वावतो न आ गह्यथो शक्र परावतः ।उ लोको यस्ते अद्रिव इंद्रेह तत आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: arvā-vátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ átho íti ǀ śakra ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀūṃ íti ǀ lokáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ índra ǀ ihá ǀ tátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: COme to usŚakra, whether from afar or nigh; whatever,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, be your region, come from thence hither.
verses.wilson_translation: COme to usŚakra, whether from afar or nigh; whatever,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, be your region, come from thence hither.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVIII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १० प्रजापतिर्वैश्वामित्रः, प्रजापतिर्वाच्यो वा, तावुभावपि वा गाथिनो विश्वामित्रो वा। इन्द्रः। त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HASTING like some strong courser good at drawing, a thought have I imagined like a workman.Pondering what is dearest and most noble, I long to see the sages full of wisdom. Ask of the sages' mighty generations firm-minded and devout they framed the heaven.These are thy heart-sought strengthening directions, and they have come to be sky's upholders. Assuming in this world mysterious natures, they decked the heaven and earth for high dominion,Measured with measures, fixed their broad expanses, set the great worlds apart held firm for safety. Even as he mounted up they all adorned him: self-luminous he travels clothed in splendour.That is the Bull's, the Asura's mighty figure: he, omniform, hath reached the eternal waters. First the more ancient Bull engendered offspring; these are his many draughts that lent him vigour.From days of old ye Kings, two Sons of Heaven, by hymns of sacrifice have won dominion. Three seats ye Sovrans, in the Holy synod, many, yea, all, ye honour with your presence.There saw I, going thither in the spirit, Gandharvas in their course with wind-blown tresses. That same companionship of her, the Milch-cow, here with the strong Bull's divers forms they stablished.Enduing still some new celestial figure, the skilful workers shaped a form around him. Let no one here debar me from enjoying the golden light which Savitar diffuses.He covers both all-fostering worlds with praises even as a woman cherishes her children. Fulfil, ye twain, his work, the Great, the Ancient: as heavenly blessing keep your guard around us.All the wise Gods behold his varied actions who stands erect, whose voice is like a herdsman's. Call we on Indra, Maghavan, auspicious, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vṛtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sanskrit: अभि तष्टेव दीधया मनीषामत्यो न वाजी सुधुरो जिहानः ।अभि प्रियाणि मर्मृशत्पराणि कवीँरिच्छामि संदृशे सुमेधाः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ táṣṭā-iva ǀ dīdhaya ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ su-dhúraḥ ǀ jíhānaḥ ǀabhí ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ mármṛśat ǀ párāṇi ǀ kavī́n ǀ icchāmi ǀ sam-dṛ́śe ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Repeat (to Indra) pious praise, as a carpenter (plural nes the wood), and engaging (zealously in sacred rites), as a quick horse bearing well his burden; endowed with intelligence, and refllecting upon the future acts acceptable (to Indra), I desire to behold the sages (whohave gone to heaven).
verses.wilson_translation: Repeat (to Indra) pious praise, as a carpenter (plural nes the wood), and engaging (zealously in sacred rites), as a quick horse bearing well his burden; endowed with intelligence, and refllecting upon the future acts acceptable (to Indra), I desire to behold the sages (whohave gone to heaven).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इनोत पृच्छ जनिमा कवीनां मनोधृतः सुकृतस्तक्षत द्यां ।इमा उ ते प्रण्यो वर्धमाना मनोवाता अध नु धर्मणि ग्मन् ॥
verses.transliteration: inā́ ǀ utá ǀ pṛccha ǀ jánima ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ manaḥ-dhṛ́taḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ takṣata ǀ dyā́m ǀimā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ pra-nyáḥ ǀ várdhamānāḥ ǀ mánaḥ-vātāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ nú ǀ dhármaṇi ǀ gman ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ask of the lords (of earth, the holy teachers), the birth of those deified sages, who with well-governed minds, and diligent in sacred rites, fabricated the heavens; and may these propitiatory (praises), augmenting (your power) and rapid as the wind, reach you at this solemn rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Ask of the lords (of earth, the holy teachers), the birth of those deified sages, who with well-governed minds, and diligent in sacred rites, fabricated the heavens; and may these propitiatory (praises), augmenting (your power) and rapid as the wind, reach you at this solemn rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि षीमिदत्र गुह्या दधाना उत क्षत्राय रोदसी समंजन् ।सं मात्राभिर्ममिरे येमुरुर्वी अंतर्मही समृते धायसे धुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ sīm ǀ ít ǀ átra ǀ gúhyā ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ sám ǀ añjan ǀsám ǀ mā́trābhiḥ ǀ mamiré ǀ yemúḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ sámṛte íti sám-ṛte ǀ dhā́yase ǀ dhuríti dhuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Comprehending hidden (mysteries) here on earth, they have, through their power, made manifest (the things of) heaven and earth; they have set limits to themby their elements; they connected them both mutually united, wide-spread and vast, and fixed the intermediate (firmament) to sustain them.
verses.wilson_translation: Comprehending hidden (mysteries) here on earth, they have, through their power, made manifest (the things of) heaven and earth; they have set limits to themby their elements; they connected them both mutually united, wide-spread and vast, and fixed the intermediate (firmament) to sustain them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आतिष्ठंतं परि विश्वे अभूषंछ्रियो वसानश्चरति स्वरोचिः ।महत्तद्वृष्णो असुरस्य नामा विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ ॥
verses.transliteration: ā-tíṣṭhantam ǀ pári ǀ víśve ǀ abhūṣan ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ carati ǀ svá-rociḥ ǀmahát ǀ tát ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ nā́ma ǀ ā́ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀ amṛ́tāni ǀ tasthau ǁ
verses.english_translation: They all ornamented (Indra) standing (in his car) and, clothed in beauty, he proceeds self-radiant; wonderful are the acts of that showerer (of benefits), the influencer (of consciences), who omniform, presides over the ambrosial (waters).
verses.wilson_translation: They all ornamented (Indra) standing (in his car) and, clothed in beauty, he proceeds self-radiant; wonderful are the acts of that showerer (of benefits), the influencer (of consciences), who omniform, presides over the ambrosial (waters).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असूत पूर्वो वृषभो ज्यायानिमा अस्य शुरुधः संति पूर्वीः ।दिवो नपाता विदथस्य धीभिः क्षत्रं राजाना प्रदिवो दधाथे ॥
verses.transliteration: ásūta ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ jyā́yān ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ santi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀdívaḥ ǀ napātā ǀ vidáthasya ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ kṣatrám ǀ rājānā ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ dadhāthe íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer (of benefits), the preceder and elder (of the gods), genitive rated (the waters); they are the abundant allayers of his thirst; sovereign Indraand Varuṇa, grandsons of heaven, you possess the wealth (that is to be acquired) by the rites of the splendid sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of benefits), the preceder and elder (of the gods), genitive rated (the waters); they are the abundant allayers of his thirst; sovereign Indraand Varuṇa, grandsons of heaven, you possess the wealth (that is to be acquired) by the rites of the splendid sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि राजाना विदथे पुरूणि परि विश्वानि भूषथः सदांसि ।अपश्यमत्र मनसा जगन्वान्व्रते गंधर्वाँ अपि वायुकेशान् ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ rājānā ǀ vidáthe ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ pári ǀ víśvāni ǀ bhūṣathaḥ ǀ sádāṃsi ǀápaśyam ǀ átra ǀ mánasā ǀ jaganvā́n ǀ vraté ǀ gandharvā́n ǀ ápi ǀ vāyú-keśān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Royal Indraand Varuṇa, embellish the three universal sacrifices (and make them) full (of all requisites) for this celebration; you have gone to the rite, for I have beheld in my mind, at this solemnity, thegandharvaswith hair (waving) in the wind.
verses.wilson_translation: Royal Indraand Varuṇa, embellish the three universal sacrifices (and make them) full (of all requisites) for this celebration; you have gone to the rite, for I have beheld in my mind, at this solemnity, thegandharvaswith hair (waving) in the wind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदिन्न्वस्य वृषभस्य धेनोरा नामभिर्ममिरे सक्म्यं गोः ।अन्यदन्यदसुर्यं वसाना नि मायिनो ममिरे रूपमस्मिन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ dhenóḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ mamire ǀ sákmyam ǀ góḥ ǀanyát-anyat ǀ asuryám ǀ vásānāḥ ǀ ní ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ mamire ǀ rūpám ǀ asmin ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those who, for (the sake of) the showerer (of benefits), milk the agreeable (produce) of the cow, (who is known) by (many) names, they invested with the diversified strength (of theasuras) and practising delusive art have deposited their own nature in him.
verses.wilson_translation: Those who, for (the sake of) the showerer (of benefits), milk the agreeable (produce) of the cow, (who is known) by (many) names, they invested with the diversified strength (of theasuras) and practising delusive art have deposited their own nature in him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदिन्न्वस्य सवितुर्नकिर्मे हिरण्ययीममतिं यामशिश्रेत् ।आ सुष्टुती रोदसी विश्वमिन्वे अपीव योषा जनिमानि वव्रे ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ me ǀ hiraṇyáyīm ǀ amátim ǀ yā́m ǀ áśiśret ǀā́ ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viśvaminvé íti viśvam-invé ǀ ápi-iva ǀ yóṣā ǀ jánimāni ǀ vavre ǁ
verses.english_translation: No one (distinguishes) my golden lustre from that of this Savitā, in which (lustre) he has taken refuge; gratified by pious praise, he cherishes the all-fostering heaven and earth as a woman cherishes her offspring.
