verses.english_translation: Like two (distinguishing) impressions, they (day and night) are plural ced visible in the midst (between heaven and earth), one hidden, one manifest; the path (of both) is common, and that is universal (for good and evil) great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Like two (distinguishing) impressions, they (day and night) are plural ced visible in the midst (between heaven and earth), one hidden, one manifest; the path (of both) is common, and that is universal (for good and evil) great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ धेनवो धुनयंतामशिश्वीः सबर्दुघाः शशया अप्रदुग्धाः ।नव्यानव्या युवतयो भवंतीर्महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ dhunayantām ǀ áśiśvīḥ ǀ sabaḥ-dúghāḥ ǀ śaśayā́ḥ ǀ ápra-dugdhāḥ ǀnávyāḥ-navyāḥ ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ bhávantīḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the kine without their young, abiding (in the heaven), and though unmilked, yet yielding milk and ever fresh and youthfu,l be shaken (so as to perform their functions); great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May the kine without their young, abiding (in the heaven), and though unmilked, yet yielding milk and ever fresh and youthfu,l be shaken (so as to perform their functions); great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदन्यासु वृषभो रोरवीति सो अन्यस्मिन्यूथे नि दधाति रेतः ।स हि क्षपावान्त्स भगः स राजा महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ anyā́su ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ róravīti ǀ sáḥ ǀ anyásmin ǀ yūthé ǀ ní ǀ dadhāti ǀ rétaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣápā-vān ǀ sáḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the showerer roars in other (regions) he sends down the rain upon a different herd, for he is the victor, the auspicious, the sovereign; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: When the showerer roars in other (regions) he sends down the rain upon a different herd, for he is the victor, the auspicious, the sovereign; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वीरस्य नु स्वश्व्यं जनासः प्र नु वोचाम विदुरस्य देवाः ।षोळ्हा युक्ताः पंचपंचा वहंति महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकं ॥
verses.transliteration: vīrásya ǀ nú ǀ su-áśvyam ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ prá ǀ nú ǀ vocāma ǀ vidúḥ ǀ asya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀṣoḷhā́ ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ páñca-pañca ǀ ā́ ǀ vahanti ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We proclaim, people, the wealth of the hero, (Indra), in horses; the gods know his (affluence); six, or five and five, harnessed to his car, convey him; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: We proclaim, people, the wealth of the hero, (Indra), in horses; the gods know his (affluence); six, or five and five, harnessed to his car, convey him; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः पुपोष प्रजाः पुरुधा जजान ।इमा च विश्वा भुवनान्यस्य महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकं ॥
verses.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ savitā́ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀ pupóṣa ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ purudhā́ ǀ jajāna ǀimā́ ǀ ca ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ asya ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine Tvaṣṭāthe impeller (of all), the multiform, has begotten and nourished a numerous progeny, for all these worlds are of him; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine Tvaṣṭāthe impeller (of all), the multiform, has begotten and nourished a numerous progeny, for all these worlds are of him; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मही समैरच्चम्वा समीची उभे ते अस्य वसुना न्यृष्टे ।शृण्वे वीरो विंदमानो वसूनि महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकं ॥
verses.transliteration: mahī́ íti ǀ sám ǀ airat ǀ camvā́ ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ té íti ǀ asya ǀ vásunā ǀ nyṛ́ṣṭe íti ní-ṛṣṭe ǀśṛṇvé ǀ vīráḥ ǀ vindámānaḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He has filled the two vast receptacles (heaven and earth) united (with creatures); they are both penetrated by his lustre; the hero spoiling the treasures (of the foe) is renowned; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: He has filled the two vast receptacles (heaven and earth) united (with creatures); they are both penetrated by his lustre; the hero spoiling the treasures (of the foe) is renowned; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमां च नः पृथिवीं विश्वधाया उप क्षेति हितमित्रो न राजा ।पुरःसदः शर्मसदो न वीरा महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकं ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́m ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ viśvá-dhāyāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ kṣeti ǀ hitá-mitraḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́jā ǀpuraḥ-sádaḥ ǀ śarma-sádaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our king, the nourisher of all, abides (in the firmament) nearest to this earthlike a benevolent friend; the valiant (Maruts) precede him (when abroad), and dwell in his mansion; great and unequalles is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Our king, the nourisher of all, abides (in the firmament) nearest to this earthlike a benevolent friend; the valiant (Maruts) precede him (when abroad), and dwell in his mansion; great and unequalles is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निष्षिध्वरीस्त ओषधीरुतापो रयिं त इंद्र पृथिवी बिभर्ति ।सखायस्ते वामभाजः स्याम महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकं ॥
verses.transliteration: niḥ-sídhvarīḥ ǀ te ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ utá ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ rayím ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ bibharti ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ te ǀ vāma-bhā́jaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The plural nts,Indra, come to perfection by you; from you the waters (flow); earth bears her treasures for you; may we, your friends, be sharers of these blessings; great unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The plural nts,Indra, come to perfection by you; from you the waters (flow); earth bears her treasures for you; may we, your friends, be sharers of these blessings; great unequalled is the might of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVI. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: ८ प्रजापतिर्वैश्वामित्रः, प्रजापतिर्वाच्यो वा। विश्वे देवाः। त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . NOT men of magic skill, not men of wisdom impair the Gods’ first steadfast ordinances.Ne’er may the earth and heaven which know not malice, nor the fixed hills, be bowed by sage devices. One, moving not away, supports six burthens: the Cows proceed to him the true, the Highest.Near stand three Mighty Ones who travel swiftly: two are concealed from sight, one is apparent. The Bull who wears all shapes, the triple-breasted, three-uddered, with a brood in many places,Ruleth majestic with his triple aspect, the Bull, the Everlasting Ones' impregner. When nigh them, as their tracer he observed them: he called aloud the dear name of Ādityas.The Goddesses, the Waters, stayed to meet him: they who were wandering separate enclosed him. Streams! the wise Gods have thrice three habitations. Child of three Mothers, he is Lord in synods.Three are the holy Ladies of the Waters, thrice here from heaven supreme in our assembly. Do thou, O Savitar, from heaven thrice hither, three times a day, send down thy blessings daily.Send us, O Bhaga, triple wealth and treasure; cause the two worlds to prosper us, Preserver! Savitar thrice from heaven pours down abundance, and the fair-handed Kings Varuṇa, Mitra;And spacious Heaven and Earth, yea, and the Waters, solicit wealth that Savitar may send us. Three are the bright realms, best, beyond attainment, and three, the Asura's Heroes, rule as Sovrans,Holy and vigorous, never to be injured. Thrice may the Gods from heaven attend our synod.

verses.sanskrit: न ता मिनंति मायिनो न धीरा व्रता देवानां प्रथमा ध्रुवाणि ।न रोदसी अद्रुहा वेद्याभिर्न पर्वता निनमे तस्थिवांसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tā́ ǀ minanti ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ vratā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ prathamā́ ǀ dhruvā́ṇi ǀná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ adrúhā ǀ vedyā́bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ ni-náme ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Neither the deceptive nor the resolute interrupt the primitive and permanent operations of the gods, nor do the innocuous heaven and earth (interrupt them), nor are the mountains standing (on the earth) to be bowed down.
verses.wilson_translation: Neither the deceptive nor the resolute interrupt the primitive and permanent operations of the gods, nor do the innocuous heaven and earth (interrupt them), nor are the mountains standing (on the earth) to be bowed down.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: षड्भाराँ एको अचरन्बिभर्त्यृतं वर्षिष्ठमुप गाव आगुः ।तिस्रो महीरुपरास्तस्थुरत्या गुहा द्वे निहिते दर्श्येका ॥
verses.transliteration: ṣáṭ ǀ bhārā́n ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ácaran ǀ bibharti ǀ ṛtám ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ úpa ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aguḥ ǀtisráḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ úparāḥ ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ átyāḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ dvé íti ǀ níhite íti ní-hite ǀ dárśi ǀ ékā ǁ
verses.english_translation: One stationary (year) sustains six burdens (in the season); the (solar) rays spread through that true and extensive (term); three revolving spheres are severally above, two of which are plural ced in secret, and one is visible.
verses.wilson_translation: One stationary (year) sustains six burdens (in the season); the (solar) rays spread through that true and extensive (term); three revolving spheres are severally above, two of which are plural ced in secret, and one is visible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपाजस्यो वृषभो विश्वरूप उत त्र्युधा पुरुध प्रजावान् ।त्र्यनीकः पत्यते माहिनावान्त्स रेतोधा वृषभः शश्वतीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: tri-pājasyáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀ utá ǀ tri-udhā́ ǀ purudhá ǀ prajā́-vān ǀtri-anīkáḥ ǀ patyate ǀ mā́hina-vān ǀ sáḥ ǀ retaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ śáśvatīnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: The tree-breasted, the showerer (of rain), the omniform, the three-uddered, the parent of multiform progeny, the possessor of magnitude, followed by three hosts (the year), advances, the vigorous impregnator of the perpetual plural nts.
verses.wilson_translation: The tree-breasted, the showerer (of rain), the omniform, the three-uddered, the parent of multiform progeny, the possessor of magnitude, followed by three hosts (the year), advances, the vigorous impregnator of the perpetual plural nts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभीक आसां पदवीरबोध्यादित्यानामह्वे चारु नाम ।आपश्चिदस्मा अरमंत देवीः पृथग्व्रजंतीः परि षीमवृंजन् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhī́ke ǀ āsām ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ abodhi ǀ ādityā́nām ǀ ahve ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ aramanta ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ pṛ́thak ǀ vrájantīḥ ǀ pári ǀ sīm ǀ avṛñjan ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The year) is awake, the path in the vicinity of those (plural nts); I call upon the beautiful name of theĀdityas; the divine waters wandering severally (now) give it delight, and (now) depart from it.
verses.wilson_translation: (The year) is awake, the path in the vicinity of those (plural nts); I call upon the beautiful name of theĀdityas; the divine waters wandering severally (now) give it delight, and (now) depart from it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्री षधस्था सिंधवस्त्रिः कवीनामुत त्रिमाता विदथेषु सम्राट् ।ऋतावरीर्योषणास्तिस्रो अप्यास्त्रिरा दिवो विदथे पत्यमानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ ǀ sadhá-sthā ǀ sindhavaḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ utá ǀ tri-mātā́ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀṛtá-varīḥ ǀ yóṣaṇāḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ pátyamānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rivers, the dwelling-plural ces of the intelligent gods are thrice three; the measurer of the three (worlds) is the sovereign at sacrifices; three feminine le (divinities) of the waters charged with the rains descend from heaven at the thrice (repeated) solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: Rivers, the dwelling-plural ces of the intelligent gods are thrice three; the measurer of the three (worlds) is the sovereign at sacrifices; three feminine le (divinities) of the waters charged with the rains descend from heaven at the thrice (repeated) solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरा दिवः सवितर्वार्याणि दिवेदिव आ सुव त्रिर्नो अह्नः ।त्रिधातु राय आ सुवा वसूनि भग त्रातर्धिषणे सातये धाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ savitaḥ ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ divé-dive ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǀ tríḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀtri-dhā́tu ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǀ vásūni ǀ bhága ǀ trātaḥ ǀ dhiṣaṇe ǀ sātáye ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Savitā, descended from heaven, bestow upon us blessings thrice everyday;Bhaga, saviour, grant us thrice a day riches of three elements;Dhiṣaṇaenable us to acquire (wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: Savitā, descended from heaven, bestow upon us blessings thrice everyday;Bhaga, saviour, grant us thrice a day riches of three elements;Dhiṣaṇaenable us to acquire (wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरा दिवः सविता सोषवीति राजाना मित्रावरुणा सुपाणी ।आपश्चिदस्य रोदसी चिदुर्वी रत्नं भिक्षंत सवितुः सवाय ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ sosavīti ǀ rā́jānā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ supāṇī́ íti su-pāṇī́ ǀā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ rátnam ǀ bhikṣanta ǀ savitúḥ ǀ savā́ya ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Savitābestow upon us wealth at the (three periods) of the day, for the well-handed Mitraand Varuṇa, the waters, the vast heaven and earth, solicit precious things from the liberality of Savitā.
verses.wilson_translation: May Savitābestow upon us wealth at the (three periods) of the day, for the well-handed Mitraand Varuṇa, the waters, the vast heaven and earth, solicit precious things from the liberality of Savitā.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरुत्तमा दूणशा रोचनानि त्रयो राजंत्यसुरस्य वीराः ।ऋतावान इषिरा दूळभासस्त्रिरा दिवो विदथे संतु देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ ut-tamā́ ǀ duḥ-náśā ǀ rocanā́ni ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ rājanti ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ iṣirā́ḥ ǀ duḥ-dábhāsaḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ santu ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Three are the excellent  uninjurable bright regions, three scions of the powerful (year) are shining; practisers of truth, quick moving, of surpassing radiance; may the deities be present thrice daily at the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Three are the excellent  uninjurable bright regions, three scions of the powerful (year) are shining; practisers of truth, quick moving, of surpassing radiance; may the deities be present thrice daily at the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MY thought with fine discernment hath discovered the Cow who wanders free without a herdsman,Her who hath straightway poured me food in plenty: Indra and Agni therefore are her praisers. Indra and Pūṣan, deft of hand and mighty, well-pleased have drained the heaven's exhaustless udder.As in this praise the Gods have all delighted, may I win blessing here from you, O Vasus. Fain to lend vigour to the Bull, the siste.. with reverence recognize the germ within him.The Cows come lowing hither to the Youngling, to him endued with great and wondrous beauties. Fixing with thought, at sacrifice, the press-stones, I bid the well-formed Heaven and Earth come hither;For these thy flames, which give men boons in plenty, rise up on high, the beautiful, the holy. Agni, thy meath-sweet tongue that tastes fair viands, which among Gods is called the far-extended,—Therewith make all the Holy Odes be seated here for our help, and feed them with sweet juices. Let thy stream give us drink, O God, O Agni, wonderful and exhaustless like the rain-clouds.Thus care for us, O Vasu Jātavedas, show us thy loving-kindness, reaching all men.

verses.sanskrit: प्र मे विविक्वाँ अविदन्मनीषां धेनुं चरंतीं प्रयुतामगोपां ।सद्यश्चिद्या दुदुहे भूरि धासेरिंद्रस्तदग्निः पनितारो अस्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ me ǀ vivikvā́n ǀ avidat ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ dhenúm ǀ cárantīm ǀ prá-yutām ǀ ágopām ǀsadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yā́ ǀ duduhé ǀ bhū́ri ǀ dhāséḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ tát ǀ agníḥ ǀ panitā́raḥ ǀ asyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the discriminating Indraapprehend my glorification (of the gods), which is (free) as a cow, grazing alone, without a cowherd, one who is readily milked, yielding abundant nourishment, and of whom Agniand Indra (and we), are the commenders.
verses.wilson_translation: May the discriminating Indraapprehend my glorification (of the gods), which is (free) as a cow, grazing alone, without a cowherd, one who is readily milked, yielding abundant nourishment, and of whom Agniand Indra (and we), are the commenders.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रः सु पूषा वृषणा सुहस्ता दिवो न प्रीताः शशयं दुदुह्रे ।विश्वे यदस्यां रणयंत देवाः प्र वोऽत्र वसवः सुम्नमश्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sú ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ su-hástā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ prītā́ḥ ǀ śaśayám ǀ duduhre ǀvíśve ǀ yát ǀ asyām ǀ raṇáyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ átra ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ aśyām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Pūṣan, the showerers (of benefits) and happy-handed Aśvins, well affected towards us, have milked the (cloud) reposing in heaven, wherefore,Vasus, universal deities, sporting on this (altar), may I here obtain the happiness derived from you.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Pūṣan, the showerers (of benefits) and happy-handed Aśvins, well affected towards us, have milked the (cloud) reposing in heaven, wherefore,Vasus, universal deities, sporting on this (altar), may I here obtain the happiness derived from you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या जामयो वृष्ण इच्छंति शक्तिं नमस्यंतीर्जानते गर्भमस्मिन् ।अच्छा पुत्रं धेनवो वावशाना महश्चरंति बिभ्रतं वपूंषि ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ icchánti ǀ śaktím ǀ namasyántīḥ ǀ jānate ǀ gárbham ǀ asmin ǀáccha ǀ putrám ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ caranti ǀ bíbhratam ǀ vápūṃṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The plural nts that desire for the showerer (Indra) the power (of sending rain) appreciate, when manifest, the embryo (blossom) deposited in him; the kine desirous of reward come to the presence of the calf, invested with many forms.
verses.wilson_translation: The plural nts that desire for the showerer (Indra) the power (of sending rain) appreciate, when manifest, the embryo (blossom) deposited in him; the kine desirous of reward come to the presence of the calf, invested with many forms.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा विवक्मि रोदसी सुमेके ग्राव्णो युजानो अध्वरे मनीषा ।इमा उ ते मनवे भूरिवारा ऊर्ध्वा भवंति दर्शता यजत्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ vivakmi ǀ ródasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀ grā́vṇaḥ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ manīṣā́ ǀimā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ mánave ǀ bhū́ri-vārāḥ ǀ ūrdhvā́ḥ ǀ bhavanti ǀ darśatā́ḥ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify with praise the beautiful heaven and earth, taking inhandthe stones (to express the libation) at the sacrifice, as these your graceful, adorable, and many-blessing rays (Agni) mount up for the good of man.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify with praise the beautiful heaven and earth, taking inhandthe stones (to express the libation) at the sacrifice, as these your graceful, adorable, and many-blessing rays (Agni) mount up for the good of man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या ते जिह्वा मधुमती सुमेधा अग्ने देवेषूच्यत उरूची ।तयेह विश्वाँ अवसे यजत्राना सादय पायया चा मधूनि ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ jihvā́ ǀ mádhu-matī ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ ágne ǀ devéṣu ǀ ucyáte ǀ urūcī́ ǀtáyā ǀ ihá ǀ víśvān ǀ ávase ǀ yájatrān ǀ ā́ ǀ sādaya ǀ pāyáya ǀ ca ǀ mádhūni ǁ
verses.english_translation: With your wide-spreading tongue,Agni, sweet and intelligent, which is renowned amongst the gods, bring hither all the adorable deities for our protection, and give them to drink of the sweet (libations).
verses.wilson_translation: With your wide-spreading tongue,Agni, sweet and intelligent, which is renowned amongst the gods, bring hither all the adorable deities for our protection, and give them to drink of the sweet (libations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या ते अग्ने पर्वतस्येव धारासश्चंती पीपयद्देव चित्रा ।तामस्मभ्यं प्रमतिं जातवेदो वसो रास्व सुमतिं विश्वजन्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ párvatasya-iva ǀ dhā́rā ǀ ásaścantī ǀ pīpáyat ǀ deva ǀ citrā́ ǀtā́m ǀ asmábhyam ǀ prá-matim ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ váso íti ǀ rā́sva ǀ su-matím ǀ viśvá-janyām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, giver of dwellings, knower of all that exists, extend to us that benevolence which, unshared by others, cherishes us like the showers of the rain-cloud; that kindness which is beneficent for all mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, giver of dwellings, knower of all that exists, extend to us that benevolence which, unshared by others, cherishes us like the showers of the rain-cloud; that kindness which is beneficent for all mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVIII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Ancient's Milch-cow yields the things we long for: the Son of Dakṣiṇā travels between them.She with the splendid chariot brings refulgence. The praise of Uṣas hath awoke the Aśvins. They bear you hither by well-orderd statute: our sacred offerings rise as if to parents.Destroy in us the counsel of the niggard come hitherward, for we have shown you favour. With lightly-rolling car and well-yoked horses hear this, the press-stone's song, ye Wonder-Workers.Have not the sages of old time, ye Aśvins, called you most prompt to come and stay misfortune? Remember us, and come to us, for ever men, as their wont is, invocate the Aśvins.Friends as it were have offered you these juices, sweet, blent with milk at the first break of morning. Even through many regions, O ye Aśvins high praise is yours among mankind, ye Mighty-Come, helpers, on the paths which Gods have travelled: here your libations of sweet meath are ready. Ancient your home, auspicious is your friendship: Heroes, your wealth is with the house of Jahnu.Forming again with you auspicious friendship, let us rejoice with draughts of meath together. O Aśvins, Very Mighty ones, with Vāyu and with his steeds, one-minded, ever-youthful,Nāsatyas, joying in the third day's Soma, drink it, not hostile, Very Bounteous Givers. Aśvins, to you are brought abundant viands in rivalry with sacred songs, unceasing.Sprung from high Law your car, urged on by press-stones, goes round the earth and heaven in one brief moment. Aśvins, your Soma sheds delicious sweetness: drink ye thereof and come unto our dwelling.Your car, assuming many a shape, most often goes to the Soma-presser's place of meeting.

verses.sanskrit: धेनुः प्रत्नस्य काम्यं दुहानांतः पुत्रश्चरति दक्षिणायाः ।आ द्योतनिं वहति शुभ्रयामोषसः स्तोमो अश्विनावजीगः ॥
verses.transliteration: dhenúḥ ǀ pratnásya ǀ kā́myam ǀ dúhānā ǀ antáríti ǀ putráḥ ǀ carati ǀ dákṣiṇāyāḥ ǀā́ ǀ dyotaním ǀ vahati ǀ śubhrá-yāmā ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ aśvínau ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The cow (the dawn) yields the desired milk to the ancient (Agni); the son of the south passes within (the firmament); the bright-houred (day) brings the illuminative (sun); the praiser awakes (to glorify) the Aśvinspreceding the dawn.
verses.wilson_translation: The cow (the dawn) yields the desired milk to the ancient (Agni); the son of the south passes within (the firmament); the bright-houred (day) brings the illuminative (sun); the praiser awakes (to glorify) the Aśvinspreceding the dawn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुयुग्वहंति प्रति वामृतेनोर्ध्वा भवंति पितरेव मेधाः ।जरेथामस्मद्वि पणेर्मनीषां युवोरवश्चकृमा यातमर्वाक् ॥
verses.transliteration: su-yúk ǀ vahanti ǀ práti ǀ vām ǀ ṛténa ǀ ūrdhvā́ḥ ǀ bhavanti ǀ pitárā-iva ǀ médhāḥ ǀjárethām ǀ asmát ǀ ví ǀ paṇéḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ cakṛma ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǁ
verses.english_translation: The well-yoked (horses) bear you both in your truth (preserving car); the offerings proceed towards you as (children to their parents); discard from us the disposition of the niggard; we have made ready for you our offering; come to our presence.
verses.wilson_translation: The well-yoked (horses) bear you both in your truth (preserving car); the offerings proceed towards you as (children to their parents); discard from us the disposition of the niggard; we have made ready for you our offering; come to our presence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुयुग्भिरश्वैः सुवृता रथेन दस्राविमं शृणुतं श्लोकमद्रेः ।किमंग वां प्रत्यवर्तिं गमिष्ठाहुर्विप्रासो अश्विना पुराजाः ॥
verses.transliteration: suyúk-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ su-vṛ́tā ǀ ráthena ǀ dásrau ǀ imám ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ ślókam ǀ ádreḥ ǀkím ǀ aṅgá ǀ vām ǀ práti ǀ ávartim ǀ gámiṣṭhā ǀ āhúḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Dasras, with well-yoked horses and well-constructed car, hear this praise of the worshipper, for have not the ancient sages declared you,Aśvins, to be most ready to come to the aid of the destitute?
verses.wilson_translation: Dasras, with well-yoked horses and well-constructed car, hear this praise of the worshipper, for have not the ancient sages declared you,Aśvins, to be most ready to come to the aid of the destitute?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ मन्येथामा गतं कच्चिदेवैर्विश्वे जनासो अश्विना हवंते ।इमा हि वां गोऋजीका मधूनि प्र मित्रासो न ददुरुस्रो अग्रे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ manyethām ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ évaiḥ ǀ víśve ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ havante ǀimā́ ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ gó-ṛjīkā ǀ mádhūni ǀ prá ǀ mitrā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ dadúḥ ǀ usráḥ ǀ ágre ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify with praise the beautiful heaven and earth taking inhandthe stones (to express the libation) at the sweet (Soma) juice mixed with milk, as friends (give gifts to friends); the sun is in advance, (therefore come to this rite).
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify with praise the beautiful heaven and earth taking inhandthe stones (to express the libation) at the sweet (Soma) juice mixed with milk, as friends (give gifts to friends); the sun is in advance, (therefore come to this rite).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तिरः पुरू चिदश्विना रजांस्यांगूषो वां मघवाना जनेषु ।एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्दस्राविमे वां निधयो मधूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: tiráḥ ǀ purú ǀ cit ǀ aśvinā ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ āṅgūṣáḥ ǀ vām ǀ magha-vānā ǀ jáneṣu ǀā́ ǀ ihá ǀ yātam ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǀ dásrau ǀ imé ǀ vām ǀ ni-dháyaḥ ǀ mádhūnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Eclipsing (by your splendour) many regions,Aśvins, (come hither); loud priase awaits you opulent (Aśvins) among men; come to this rite by the paths traversed by the gods; here,Dasras, are ample stores of the exhilarating (Soma) juices.
verses.wilson_translation: Eclipsing (by your splendour) many regions,Aśvins, (come hither); loud priase awaits you opulent (Aśvins) among men; come to this rite by the paths traversed by the gods; here,Dasras, are ample stores of the exhilarating (Soma) juices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुराणमोकः सख्यं शिवं वां युवोर्नरा द्रविणं जह्नाव्यां ।पुनः कृण्वानाः सख्या शिवानि मध्वा मदेम सह नू समानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: purāṇám ǀ ókaḥ ǀ sakhyám ǀ śivám ǀ vām ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ narā ǀ dráviṇam ǀ jahnā́vyām ǀpúnaríti ǀ kṛṇvānā́ḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ śivā́ni ǀ mádhvā ǀ madema ǀ sahá ǀ nú ǀ samānā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your ancient friendship is desirable and auspicious; your wealth, leaders (of rites), is in the family of Jahnu; renewing that auspicious friendship, may we, your associates, delight you with the sweet (Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: Your ancient friendship is desirable and auspicious; your wealth, leaders (of rites), is in the family of Jahnu; renewing that auspicious friendship, may we, your associates, delight you with the sweet (Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना वायुना युवं सुदक्षा नियुद्भिष्च सजोषसा युवाना ।नासत्या तिरोअह्न्यं जुषाणा सोमं पिबतमस्रिधा सुदानू ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ vāyúnā ǀ yuvám ǀ su-dakṣā ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ yuvānā ǀnā́satyā ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ asrídhā ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, endowed with power, ever young, in whom is no untruth, unwearied, munificent, accepters (of libations), drink with Vāyuand your steeds, rejoicing together, of the Somalibation offered at the close of day.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, endowed with power, ever young, in whom is no untruth, unwearied, munificent, accepters (of libations), drink with Vāyuand your steeds, rejoicing together, of the Somalibation offered at the close of day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना परि वामिषः पुरूचीरीयुर्गीर्भिर्यतमाना अमृध्राः ।रथो ह वामृतजा अद्रिजूतः परि द्यावापृथिवी याति सद्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ pári ǀ vām ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ purūcī́ḥ ǀ īyúḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yátamānāḥ ǀ ámṛdhrāḥ ǀráthaḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ ṛta-jā́ḥ ǀ ádri-jūtaḥ ǀ pári ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ yāti ǀ sadyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, abundant (sacrificial) viands are presented to you, and blameless worshippers (salute you) with praises; your water-shedding car, attracted by the sacrificers, quickly compasses earth and heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, abundant (sacrificial) viands are presented to you, and blameless worshippers (salute you) with praises; your water-shedding car, attracted by the sacrificers, quickly compasses earth and heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना मधुषुत्तमो युवाकुः सोमस्तं पातमा गतं दुरोणे ।रथो ह वां भूरि वर्पः करिक्रत्सुतावतो निष्कृतमागमिष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ madhusút-tamaḥ ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ tám ǀ pātam ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ duroṇé ǀráthaḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ bhū́ri ǀ várpaḥ ǀ kárikrat ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, this most sweet Somais mixed; drink it; come to (our) dwelling; your car, repeatedly bestowing wealth, is coming to the appointed plural ce of the offerer of the libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, this most sweet Somais mixed; drink it; come to (our) dwelling; your car, repeatedly bestowing wealth, is coming to the appointed plural ce of the offerer of the libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LIX. Mitra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MITRA, when speaking, stirreth men to labour: Mitra sustaineth both the earth and heaven.Mitra beholdeth men with eyes that close not. To Mitra bring, with holy oil, oblation. Foremost be he who brings thee food, O Mitra, who strives to keep thy sacred Law, Āditya.He whom thou helpest ne’er is slain or conquered, on him, from near or far, falls no affliction. joying in sacred food and free from sickness, with knees bent lowly on the earth's broad surface,Following closely the Āditya's statute, may we remain in Mitra's gracious favour. Auspicious and adorable, this Mitra was born with fair dominion, King, Disposer.May we enjoy the grace of him the Holy, yea, rest in his propitious loving-kindness. The great Āditya, to be served with wor. ship, who stirreth men, is gracious to the singer.To Mitra, him most highly to be lauded, offer in fire oblation that he loveth. The gainful grace of Mitra,. God, supporter of the race of man,Gives splendour of most.glorious fame. Mitra whose glory spreads afar, he who in might surpasses heaven,Surpasses earth in his renown. All the Five Races have repaired to Mitra, ever strong to aid,For he sustaineth all the Gods. Mitra to Gods, to living men, to him who strews the holy grass,Gives food fulfilling sacred Law.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रो जनान्यातयति ब्रुवाणो मित्रो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्यां ।मित्रः कृष्टीरनिमिषाभि चष्टे मित्राय हव्यं घृतवज्जुहोत ॥
verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ jánān ǀ yātayati ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀmitráḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ áni-miṣā ǀ abhí ǀ caṣṭe ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ havyám ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ juhota ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra, when praised, animates men to exertion;Indrasustains both the earth and heaven; Mitra looks upon men with unclosing eyes; offer to Mitra the oblations of clarified butter.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitra, when praised, animates men to exertion;Indrasustains both the earth and heaven; Mitra looks upon men with unclosing eyes; offer to Mitra the oblations of clarified butter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र स मित्र मर्तो अस्तु प्रयस्वान्यस्त आदित्य शिक्षति व्रतेन ।न हन्यते न जीयते त्वोतो नैनमंहो अश्नोत्यंतितो न दूरात् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sáḥ ǀ mitra ǀ mártaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práyasvān ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ āditya ǀ śíkṣati ǀ vraténa ǀná ǀ hanyate ǀ ná ǀ jīyate ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǀ ná ǀ enam ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ aśnoti ǀ ántitaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dūrā́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that mortal enjoy abundance,Mitra, who presents you,Āditya, (with offerings) at the sacred rite; protected by you he is not harmed; he is not overcome by any one; son reaches him not, either from afar or nigh.
verses.wilson_translation: May that mortal enjoy abundance,Mitra, who presents you,Āditya, (with offerings) at the sacred rite; protected by you he is not harmed; he is not overcome by any one; son reaches him not, either from afar or nigh.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनमीवास इळया मदंतो मितज्ञवो वरिमन्ना पृथिव्याः ।आदित्यस्य व्रतमुपक्षियंतो वयं मित्रस्य सुमतौ स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: anamīvā́saḥ ǀ íḷayā ǀ mádantaḥ ǀ mitá-jñavaḥ ǀ váriman ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀādityásya ǀ vratám ǀ upa-kṣiyántaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ mitrásya ǀ su-matáu ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, exempt from disease, rejoicing in (abundant) food, roaming free over the wide (expanse) of the earth, diligent in the worship ofĀditya, ever be in the good favour of Mitra.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, exempt from disease, rejoicing in (abundant) food, roaming free over the wide (expanse) of the earth, diligent in the worship ofĀditya, ever be in the good favour of Mitra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं मित्रो नमस्यः सुशेवो राजा सुक्षत्रो अजनिष्ट वेधाः ।तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ mitráḥ ǀ namasyáḥ ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ su-kṣatráḥ ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀtásya ǀ vayám ǀ su-matáu ǀ yajñíyasya ǀ ápi ǀ bhadré ǀ saumanasé ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Mitrahas been engendered adorable and to be served, the sovereign (over all), endowed with vigour, the creator (of the universe); may we ever be in the good favour, in the auspicious approbation, of this adorable (Āditya).
verses.wilson_translation: This Mitrahas been engendered adorable and to be served, the sovereign (over all), endowed with vigour, the creator (of the universe); may we ever be in the good favour, in the auspicious approbation, of this adorable (Āditya).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महाँ आदित्यो नमसोपसद्यो यातयज्जनो गृणते सुशेवः ।तस्मा एतत्पन्यतमाय जुष्टमग्नौ मित्राय हविरा जुहोत ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ námasā ǀ upa-sádyaḥ ǀ yātayát-janaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀtásmai ǀ etát ǀ pánya-tamāya ǀ júṣṭam ǀ agnáu ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ havíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ juhota ǁ
verses.english_translation: The greatĀditya, the animator of men to exertion, is to be approached with reverence; he is the giver of happiness to him who praises him; offer with fire the acceptable libation to that most glorifiable Mitra.
verses.wilson_translation: The greatĀditya, the animator of men to exertion, is to be approached with reverence; he is the giver of happiness to him who praises him; offer with fire the acceptable libation to that most glorifiable Mitra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतोऽवो देवस्य सानसि ।द्युम्नं चित्रश्रवस्तमं ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrásya ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́taḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ sānasí ǀdyumnám ǀ citráśravaḥ-tamam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirable food and most renowned wealth are (the gifts) of the divine Mitra, the supporter of man.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirable food and most renowned wealth are (the gifts) of the divine Mitra, the supporter of man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि यो महिना दिवं मित्रो बभूव सप्रथाः ।अभि श्रवोभिः पृथिवीं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ dívam ǀ mitráḥ ǀ babhū́va ǀ sa-práthāḥ ǀabhí ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: The renowned Mitra, who by his might presides over heaven, is he who presides over the earth by (the gift of) food.
verses.wilson_translation: The renowned Mitra, who by his might presides over heaven, is he who presides over the earth by (the gift of) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्राय पंच येमिरे जना अभिष्टिशवसे ।स देवान्विश्वान्बिभर्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrā́ya ǀ páñca ǀ yemire ǀ jánāḥ ǀ abhíṣṭi-śavase ǀsáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ víśvān ǀ bibharti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The five classes of men have repaired to the victorious Mitra, for he supports all the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The five classes of men have repaired to the victorious Mitra, for he supports all the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रो देवेष्वायुषु जनाय वृक्तबर्हिषे ।इष इष्टव्रता अकः ॥
verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ āyúṣu ǀ jánāya ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣe ǀíṣaḥ ǀ iṣṭá-vratāḥ ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitrais he who among tods and men bestows food as the reward of pious acts upon the man who has prepared (for him) the lopped sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitrais he who among tods and men bestows food as the reward of pious acts upon the man who has prepared (for him) the lopped sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LX. Ṛbhus.
hymns.anukramani: ७ गाथिनो विश्वामित्रः। ऋभवः, ५-७ इन्द्र ऋभवश्च । जगती।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HERE is your ghostly kinship, here, O Men: they came desirous to these holy rites with store of wealth,With wondrous arts, whereby, with schemes to meet each need, Ye gained, Sudhanvan's Sons! your share in sacrifice. The mighty powers wherewith. ye formed the chalices, the thought by which ye drew the cow from out the hide,The intellect wherewith ye wrought the two Bay Steeds,—through these, O Ṛbhus, ye attained divinity. Friendship with Indra have the Ṛbhus, fully gained: grandsons of Manu, they skilfully urged the work.Sudhanvan's Children won them everlasting life, serving with holy rites, pious with noble acts.:In company with Indra come ye to the juice, then gloriously shall your wishes be fulfilled.Not to be paragoned, ye Priests, are your good deeds, nor your heroic acts, Ṛbhus, Sudhanvan's Sons. O Indra, with the Ṛbhus, Mighty Ones, pour down the Soma juice effused, well-blent, from both thy hands.Maghalan, urged by song, in the drink-offerer's house rejoice thee with the Heroes, with Sudhanvan's Sons. With Ṛbhu near, and Vāja, Indra, here exult, with Saci, praised of many, in the juice we pour.These homes wherein we dwell have turned themselves to thee, -devotions to the Gods, as laws of men ordain. Come with the mighty Ṛbhus, Indra, come to us, strengthening with thy help the singer's holy praise;At hundred eager calls come to the living man, with thousand arts attend the act of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इहेह वो मनसा बंधुता नर उशिजो जग्मुरभि तानि वेदसा ।याभिर्मायाभिः प्रतिजूतिवर्पसः सौधन्वना यज्ञियं भागमानश ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá-iha ǀ vaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ bandhútā ǀ naraḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ abhí ǀ tā́ni ǀ védasā ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ prátijūti-varpasaḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ yajñíyam ǀ bhagám ǀ ānaśá ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your connection (with the consequences of acts)ṛbhusis here (acknowledged) by the minds of all; desiring their share (of the sacrifice), oḥ men, they have come with a knowledge (of their claims) to these (rites); the sons of Sudhanvan, with the devices by which they are victorious over foes, you have accepted the share of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Your connection (with the consequences of acts)ṛbhusis here (acknowledged) by the minds of all; desiring their share (of the sacrifice), oḥ men, they have come with a knowledge (of their claims) to these (rites); the sons of Sudhanvan, with the devices by which they are victorious over foes, you have accepted the share of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: याभिः शचीभिश्चमसाँ अपिंशत यया धिया गामरिणीत चर्मणः ।येन हरी मनसा निरतक्षत तेन देवत्वमृभवः समानश ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ camasā́n ǀ ápiṃśata ǀ yáyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ gā́m ǀ áriṇīta ǀ cármaṇaḥ ǀyéna ǀ hárī íti ǀ mánasā ǀ niḥ-átakṣata ǀ téna ǀ deva-tvám ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ānaśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: With those faculties by which you have divided the ladles; with that intelligence wherewith you have covered the (dead) cow with skin; with that will by which you have fabricated the two horses (of Indra); with those (means),ṛbhus, you have attained divinity.
verses.wilson_translation: With those faculties by which you have divided the ladles; with that intelligence wherewith you have covered the (dead) cow with skin; with that will by which you have fabricated the two horses (of Indra); with those (means),ṛbhus, you have attained divinity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्य सख्यमृभवः समानशुर्मनोर्नपातो अपसो दधन्विरे ।सौधन्वनासो अमृतत्वमेरिरे विष्ट्वी शमीभिः सुकृतः सुकृत्यया ॥
verses.transliteration: índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀ mánoḥ ǀ nápātaḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ dadhanvire ǀsaudhanvanā́saḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǀ viṣṭvī́ ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Theṛbhus, the performers of (good) works, the grandsons of a man, have attained the friendship of Indra, they have perpetuated (existence); the sons of Sudhanvanhave attained immortality; performers of pious acts influencing (the result), through their devotion (they have attained divinity) by their works.
verses.wilson_translation: Theṛbhus, the performers of (good) works, the grandsons of a man, have attained the friendship of Indra, they have perpetuated (existence); the sons of Sudhanvanhave attained immortality; performers of pious acts influencing (the result), through their devotion (they have attained divinity) by their works.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रेण याथ सरथं सुते सचाँ अथो वशानां भवथा सह श्रिया ।न वः प्रतिमै सुकृतानि वाघतः सौधन्वना ऋभवो वीर्याणि च ॥
verses.transliteration: índreṇa ǀ yātha ǀ sa-rátham ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ átho íti ǀ váśānām ǀ bhavatha ǀ sahá ǀ śriyā́ ǀná ǀ vaḥ ǀ prati-mái ǀ su-kṛtā́ni ǀ vāghataḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Go with Indrain his chariot when the libation is poured out, and be (welcomed) with honour by the (worshipper) desiring (your favour);ṛbhus, sons of Sudhanvan, bestowers (of the rewards of pious acts), your virtuous deeds, your great faculties, arenot to be mesured.
verses.wilson_translation: Go with Indrain his chariot when the libation is poured out, and be (welcomed) with honour by the (worshipper) desiring (your favour);ṛbhus, sons of Sudhanvan, bestowers (of the rewards of pious acts), your virtuous deeds, your great faculties, arenot to be mesured.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र ऋभुभिर्वाजवद्भिः समुक्षितं सुतं सोममा वृषस्वा गभस्त्योः ।धियेषितो मघवंदाशुषो गृहे सौधन्वनेभिः सह मत्स्वा नृभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ vā́javat-bhiḥ ǀ sám-ukṣitam ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀdhiyā́ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀ saudhanvanébhiḥ ǀ sahá ǀ matsva ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, along with the food-bestowingṛbhus, accept with bothhandsthe (cup of the) effused Somalibation; excited Maghavan, by worship, rejoice with the human sons of Sudhanvanin the dwelling of the donor (of the offering).
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, along with the food-bestowingṛbhus, accept with bothhandsthe (cup of the) effused Somalibation; excited Maghavan, by worship, rejoice with the human sons of Sudhanvanin the dwelling of the donor (of the offering).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र ऋभुमान्वाजवान्मत्स्वेह नोऽस्मिन्त्सवने शच्या पुरुष्टुत ।इमानि तुभ्यं स्वसराणि येमिरे व्रता देवानां मनुषश्च धर्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ ṛbhu-mā́n ǀ vā́ja-vān ǀ matsva ǀ ihá ǀ naḥ ǀ asmín ǀ sávane ǀ śácyā ǀ puru-stuta ǀimā́ni ǀ túbhyam ǀ svásarāṇi ǀ yemire ǀ vratā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the praised of many, associated withṚbhu, and with Vāja, exult withŚaci, at this our sacrifice; these self-revolving (days) are devoted to you, as well as the ceremonies (addressed) to the gods, and the virtuous acts of man.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the praised of many, associated withṚbhu, and with Vāja, exult withŚaci, at this our sacrifice; these self-revolving (days) are devoted to you, as well as the ceremonies (addressed) to the gods, and the virtuous acts of man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र ऋभुभिर्वाजिभिर्वाजयन्निह स्तोमं जरितुरुप याहि यज्ञियं ।शतं केतेभिरिषिरेभिरायवे सहस्रणीथो अध्वरस्य होमनि ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ vājí-bhiḥ ǀ vājáyan ǀ ihá ǀ stómam ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ yajñíyam ǀśatám ǀ kétebhiḥ ǀ iṣirébhiḥ ǀ āyáve ǀ sahásra-nīthaḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ hómani ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, with the food-bestowingṚbhusrewarding (worship) with food, come hither to (receive) the reverential praise of the adorer, with a hundred quick-going steeds, the indications (of the Maruts); come to the burnt offering of the sacrifice, yielding a thousand blessings to the sacrificer.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, with the food-bestowingṚbhusrewarding (worship) with food, come hither to (receive) the reverential praise of the adorer, with a hundred quick-going steeds, the indications (of the Maruts); come to the burnt offering of the sacrifice, yielding a thousand blessings to the sacrificer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXI. Uṣas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O Uṣas, strong with strength, endowed witli knowledge, accept the singer's praise, O wealthy Lady.Thou, Goddess, ancient, young, and full of wisdom, movest, all-bounteous! as the Law ordaineth. Shine forth, O Morning, thou auspicious Goddess, on thy bright car awaking pleasant voices.Let docile horses of far-reaching splendour convey thee hitherward, the goldencoloured. Thou, Morning, turning thee to every creature, standest on high as ensign of the Immortal,To one same goal ever and ever wending now, like a wheel, O newly-born, roll hi ther. Letting her reins drop downward, Morning cometh, the wealthy Dame, the Lady of the dwelling;Bringing forth light, the Wonderful, the Blessed hath spread her from the bounds of earth and heaven. Hither invoke the radiant Goddess Morning, and bring with reverence your hymn to praise her.She, dropping sweets, hath set in heaven her brightness, and, fair to look on, hath beamed forth her splendour. From heaven, with hymns, the Holy One was wakened: brightly to both worlds came the wealthy Lady.To Morning, Agni, when she comes refulgent, thou goest forth soliciting fair riches. On Law's firm base the speeder of the Mornings, the Bull, hath entered mighty earth and heaven.Great is the power of Varuṇa and Mitra, which, bright, hath spread in every place its splendour.

verses.sanskrit: उषो वाजेन वाजिनि प्रचेताः स्तोमं जुषस्व गृणतो मघोनि ।पुराणी देवि युवतिः पुरंधिरनु व्रतं चरसि विश्ववारे ॥
verses.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ vā́jena ǀ vājini ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ stómam ǀ juṣasva ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ maghoni ǀpurāṇī́ ǀ devi ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ carasi ǀ viśva-vāre ǁ
verses.english_translation: Affluent Uṣas, giver of sustenance, possessed of intelligence, be propitiated by the praise of him who lauds you, (and worships) with (sacrificial) food; divine Uṣas, adored by all, who (though) ancient are (still) young, the object of manifold worship, you are present at the recurring (morning) rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Affluent Uṣas, giver of sustenance, possessed of intelligence, be propitiated by the praise of him who lauds you, (and worships) with (sacrificial) food; divine Uṣas, adored by all, who (though) ancient are (still) young, the object of manifold worship, you are present at the recurring (morning) rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उषो देव्यमर्त्या वि भाहि चंद्ररथा सूनृता ईरयंती ।आ त्वा वहंतु सुयमासो अश्वा हिरण्यवर्णां पृथुपाजसो ये ॥
verses.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ devi ǀ ámartyā ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀ candrá-rathā ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ īráyantī ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vahantu ǀ su-yámāsaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ híraṇya-varṇām ǀ pṛthu-pā́jasaḥ ǀ yé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Uṣas, who are divine and immortal, mounted in a golden chariot, do you shine radiant causing to be head the sounds of truth; may your vigorous and well-trained horses bring you, who are golden-haired, (hither).
verses.wilson_translation: Uṣas, who are divine and immortal, mounted in a golden chariot, do you shine radiant causing to be head the sounds of truth; may your vigorous and well-trained horses bring you, who are golden-haired, (hither).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उषः प्रतीची भुवनानि विश्वोर्ध्वा तिष्ठस्यमृतस्य केतुः ।समानमर्थं चरणीयमाना चक्रमिव नव्यस्या ववृत्स्व ॥
verses.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǀ ūrdhvā́ ǀ tiṣṭhasi ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ ketúḥ ǀsamānám ǀ ártham ǀ caraṇīyámānā ǀ cakrám-iva ǀ navyasi ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Uṣas, who spread over all the regions, you abide on high, the ensign of the immortal (sun), purposing to travel the same road, repeatedly turn back over new, (revolving) like a wheel.
verses.wilson_translation: Uṣas, who spread over all the regions, you abide on high, the ensign of the immortal (sun), purposing to travel the same road, repeatedly turn back over new, (revolving) like a wheel.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव स्यूमेव चिन्वती मघोन्युषा याति स्वसरस्य पत्नी ।स्वर्जनंती सुभगा सुदंसा आंताद्दिवः पप्रथ आ पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ syū́ma-iva ǀ cinvatī́ ǀ maghónī ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ yāti ǀ svásarasya ǀ pátnī ǀsváḥ ǀ jánantī ǀ su-bhágā ǀ su-dáṃsāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ántāt ǀ diváḥ ǀ paprathe ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The opulent Uṣas, the bride of the far-darting (sun), throwing off (darkness) like a garment, proceeds; diffusing her own (lustre), auspicious, promoting sacred acts, she is renowned to the ends, she is renowned to the ends of the heaven and of the earth.
verses.wilson_translation: The opulent Uṣas, the bride of the far-darting (sun), throwing off (darkness) like a garment, proceeds; diffusing her own (lustre), auspicious, promoting sacred acts, she is renowned to the ends, she is renowned to the ends of the heaven and of the earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा वो देवीमुषसं विभातीं प्र वो भरध्वं नमसा सुवृक्तिं ।ऊर्ध्वं मधुधा दिवि पाजो अश्रेत्प्र रोचना रुरुचे रण्वसंदृक् ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ vaḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ uṣásam ǀ vi-bhātī́m ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ bharadhvam ǀ námasā ǀ su-vṛktím ǀūrdhvám ǀ madhudhā́ ǀ diví ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ aśret ǀ prá ǀ rocanā́ ǀ ruruce ǀ raṇvá-sandṛk ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer, with your prostrations, due praise to the divine Uṣas, shining upon yoou; the repository of sweetness manifests her brightness aloft in the sky, and radiant and lovely lights the regions.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer, with your prostrations, due praise to the divine Uṣas, shining upon yoou; the repository of sweetness manifests her brightness aloft in the sky, and radiant and lovely lights the regions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावरी दिवो अर्कैरबोध्या रेवती रोदसी चित्रमस्थात् ।आयतीमग्न उषसं विभातीं वाममेषि द्रविणं भिक्षमाणः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtá-varī ǀ diváḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ abodhi ǀ ā́ ǀ revátī ǀ ródasī íti ǀ citrám ǀ asthāt ǀā-yatī́m ǀ agne ǀ uṣásam ǀ vi-bhātī́m ǀ vāmám ǀ eṣi ǀ dráviṇam ǀ bhíkṣamāṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The possessor of truth is recognized in the sky by her rays; the possessor of wealth has taken a marvellous station in earth and heaven;Agni, soliciting alms of the radiant advancing Uṣas, you obtain your desired treasure (of oblations).
verses.wilson_translation: The possessor of truth is recognized in the sky by her rays; the possessor of wealth has taken a marvellous station in earth and heaven;Agni, soliciting alms of the radiant advancing Uṣas, you obtain your desired treasure (of oblations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतस्य बुध्न उषसामिषण्यन्वृषा मही रोदसी आ विवेश ।मही मित्रस्य वरुणस्य माया चंद्रेव भानुं वि दधे पुरुत्रा ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ budhné ǀ uṣásām ǀ iṣaṇyán ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀmahī́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ māyā́ ǀ candrā́-iva ǀ bhānúm ǀ ví ǀ dadhe ǀ puru-trā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer (of rain, the sun), urging on the lawn, at the root of the truthful (day) has pervaded the vast heaven and earth; the mighty Uṣas, the golden light, as it were, of Mitraand Varuṇa, diffuses her lustre in different directions.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of rain, the sun), urging on the lawn, at the root of the truthful (day) has pervaded the vast heaven and earth; the mighty Uṣas, the golden light, as it were, of Mitraand Varuṇa, diffuses her lustre in different directions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXII. Indra and Others.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YOUR well-known prompt activities aforetime needed no impulse from your faithful servant.Where, Indra-Varuṇa, is now that glory wherewith ye brought support to those who loved you? This man, most diligent, seeking after riches, incessantly invokes you for your favour.Accordant, Indra-Varuṇa, with Maruts, with Heaven and Earth, hear ye mine invocation. O Indra-Varuṇa, ours be this treasure ours be wealth, Maruts, with full store of heroes.May the Varūtrīs with their shelter aid us, and Bhāratī and Hotrā with the Mornings. Be pleased! with our oblations, thou loved of all Gods, Bṛhaspati:Give wealth to him who brings thee gifts. At sacrifices, with your hymns worship the pure Bṛhaspati—I pray for power which none may bend— The Bull of men, whom none deceive, the wearer of each shape at will,Bṛhaspati Most Excellent. Divine, resplendent Pūṣan, this our newest hymn of eulogy,By us is chanted forth to thee. Accept with favour this my song, be gracious to the earnest thought,Even as a bridegroom to his bride. May he who sees all living things, see, them together at a glance,—May he, may Pūṣan be our help. May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God:So May he stimulate our prayers. With understanding, earnestly, of Savitar the God we craveOur portion of prosperity. Men, singers worship Savitar the God with hymn and holy rites,Urged by the impulse of their thoughts. Soma who gives success goes forth, goes to the gathering place of Gods,To seat him at the seat of Law. To us and to our cattle may Soma give salutary food,To biped and to quadruped. May Soma, strengthening our power of life, and conquering our foes,In our assembly take his seat. May Mitra-Varuṇa, sapient Pair, bedew our pasturage with oil,With meatb the regions of the air. Far-ruling, joyful when adored, ye reign through majesty of might,With pure laws everlastingly. Lauded by Jamadagni's song, sit in the place of holy Law:

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ वां भृमयो मन्यमाना युवावते न तुज्या अभूवन् ।क्व त्यदिंद्रावरुणा यशो वां येन स्मा सिनं भरथः सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ bhṛmáyaḥ ǀ mányamānāḥ ǀ yuvā́-vate ǀ ná ǀ tújyāḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀkvá ǀ tyát ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ vām ǀ yéna ǀ sma ǀ sínam ǀ bhárathaḥ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Varuṇa, may these people who are relying upon you, and wandering about (in alarm), sustain no injury from a youthful (adversary); for where is that reputation (you enjoy) on account that you bestow sustenance on your friends.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Varuṇa, may these people who are relying upon you, and wandering about (in alarm), sustain no injury from a youthful (adversary); for where is that reputation (you enjoy) on account that you bestow sustenance on your friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयमु वां पुरुतमो रयीयंछश्वत्तममवसे जोहवीति ।सजोषाविंद्रावरुणा मरुद्भिर्दिवा पृथिव्या शृणुतं हवं मे ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ puru-támaḥ ǀ rayi-yán ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ ávase ǀ johavīti ǀsa-jóṣau ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ divā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávam ǀ me ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most diligent (in pious rites) this (your worshipper),Indraand Varuṇa, desirous of wealth, incessantly invokes, you for protection; associated with the Maruts, with heaven and earth, hear my invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: Most diligent (in pious rites) this (your worshipper),Indraand Varuṇa, desirous of wealth, incessantly invokes, you for protection; associated with the Maruts, with heaven and earth, hear my invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे तदिंद्रावरुणा वसु ष्यादस्मे रयिर्मरुतः सर्ववीरः ।अस्मान्वरूत्रीः शरणैरवंत्वस्मान्होत्रा भारती दक्षिणाभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ tát ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ vásu ǀ syāt ǀ asmé íti ǀ rayíḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sárva-vīraḥ ǀasmā́n ǀ várūtrīḥ ǀ śaraṇáiḥ ǀ avantu ǀ asmā́n ǀ hótrā ǀ bhā́ratī ǀ dákṣiṇābhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May there be to us,Indraand Varuṇa, such wealth (as we covet); may there be,Maruts, to us wealth( of cattle) and numerous descendants; may the delightful (wives of the gods) shelter us with dwellings; may Hotāand Bhāratī(enrich) us with gifts.
verses.wilson_translation: May there be to us,Indraand Varuṇa, such wealth (as we covet); may there be,Maruts, to us wealth( of cattle) and numerous descendants; may the delightful (wives of the gods) shelter us with dwellings; may Hotāand Bhāratī(enrich) us with gifts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पते जुषस्व नो हव्यानि विश्वदेव्य ।रास्व रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ juṣásva ǀ naḥ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ viśva-devya ǀrā́sva ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bṛhaspati, friend of all the gods, accept our oblations; grant precious treasures to the offerer.
verses.wilson_translation: Bṛhaspati, friend of all the gods, accept our oblations; grant precious treasures to the offerer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुचिमर्कैर्बृहस्पतिमध्वरेषु नमस्यत ।अनाम्योज आ चके ॥
verses.transliteration: śúcim ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ namasyata ǀánāmi ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adore the pure Bṛhaspatiat sacrifices with hymns; I solicit of him unsurpassable strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Adore the pure Bṛhaspatiat sacrifices with hymns; I solicit of him unsurpassable strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषभं चर्षणीनां विश्वरूपमदाभ्यं ।बृहस्पतिं वरेण्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣabhám ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀ ádābhyam ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ váreṇyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer (of benefits) on men, the omniform, the irreproachable, the excellent Bṛhaspati.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of benefits) on men, the omniform, the irreproachable, the excellent Bṛhaspati.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं ते पूषन्नाघृणे सुष्टुतिर्देव नव्यसी ।अस्माभिस्तुभ्यं शस्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ te ǀ pūṣan ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ deva ǀ návyasī ǀasmā́bhiḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ śasyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine, resplendent,Pūṣan, this, your most recent laudation, is uttered by us to you.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine, resplendent,Pūṣan, this, your most recent laudation, is uttered by us to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तां जुषस्व गिरं मम वाजयंतीमवा धियं ।वधूयुरिव योषणां ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́m ǀ juṣasva ǀ gíram ǀ máma ǀ vāja-yántīm ǀ ava ǀ dhíyam ǀvadhūyúḥ-iva ǀ yóṣaṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be plural ased by this my praise, and incline to this food-supplicating laudation as an excessively submissive (husband) to his wife.
verses.wilson_translation: Be plural ased by this my praise, and incline to this food-supplicating laudation as an excessively submissive (husband) to his wife.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति ।स नः पूषाविता भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ abhí ǀ vi-páśyati ǀ bhúvanā ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ páśyati ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that Pūṣan, who looks upon all the worlds, who thoroughly contemplates them, be our protector.
verses.wilson_translation: May that Pūṣan, who looks upon all the worlds, who thoroughly contemplates them, be our protector.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि ।धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ savitúḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǀ bhárgaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ dhīmahi ǀdhíyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-codáyāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: We meditate on that desirable light of the divine Savitā, who influences our pious rites.
verses.wilson_translation: We meditate on that desirable light of the divine Savitā, who influences our pious rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य सवितुर्वयं वाजयंतः पुरंध्या ।भगस्य रातिमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ vayám ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ púram-dhyā ǀbhágasya ǀ rātím ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous of food, we solicit with praise of the divine Savitā, the gift of affluence.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of food, we solicit with praise of the divine Savitā, the gift of affluence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवं नरः सवितारं विप्रा यज्ञैः सुवृक्तिभिः ।नमस्यंति धियेषिताः ॥
verses.transliteration: devám ǀ náraḥ ǀ savitā́ram ǀ víprāḥ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀnamasyánti ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ iṣitā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devout and wise men, impelled by intelligence, adore the divine Savitāwith sacrifices and sacred hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Devout and wise men, impelled by intelligence, adore the divine Savitāwith sacrifices and sacred hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमो जिगाति गातुविद्देवानामेति निष्कृतं ।ऋतस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ jigāti ǀ gātu-vít ǀ devā́nām ǀ eti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, knowing the right path, proceeds (by it); he goes to the excellent seat of the gods, the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, knowing the right path, proceeds (by it); he goes to the excellent seat of the gods, the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमो अस्मभ्यं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे च पशवे ।अनमीवा इषस्करत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dvi-páde ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǀ ca ǀ paśáve ǀanamīvā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ karat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Somagrant to us and to (our) biped and quadruped animals, wholesome food.
verses.wilson_translation: May Somagrant to us and to (our) biped and quadruped animals, wholesome food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमायुर्वर्धयन्नभिमातीः सहमानः ।सोमः सधस्थमासदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ vardháyan ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ sáhamānaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Soma, prolonging our lives and overcoming our adversaries, sit down in our plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May Soma, prolonging our lives and overcoming our adversaries, sit down in our plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतं ।मध्वा रजांसि सुक्रतू ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ukṣatam ǀmádhvā ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ sukratū íti su-kratū ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, sprinkle our cow-stalls with butter; performers of good works, (sprinkle) the worlds with honey.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, sprinkle our cow-stalls with butter; performers of good works, (sprinkle) the worlds with honey.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरुशंसा नमोवृधा मह्ना दक्षस्य राजथः ।द्राघिष्ठाभिः शुचिव्रता ॥
verses.transliteration: uru-śáṃsā ǀ namaḥ-vṛ́dhā ǀ mahnā́ ǀ dákṣasya ǀ rājathaḥ ǀdrā́ghiṣṭhābhiḥ ǀ śuci-vratā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Performers of pure rites, glorified by many, exalted by adoration, (celebrated) by prolonged praises, you reign by the greatness of (your) strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Performers of pure rites, glorified by many, exalted by adoration, (celebrated) by prolonged praises, you reign by the greatness of (your) strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गृणाना जमदग्निना योनावृतस्य सीदतं ।पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
verses.transliteration: gṛṇānā́ ǀ jamát-agninā ǀ yónau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdatam ǀpātám ǀ sómam ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorified by Jamadagni, sit down in the plural ce of sacrifice (the altar); drink, augmenters (of the reward) of sacrifice, the Somalibation.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorified by Jamadagni, sit down in the plural ce of sacrifice (the altar); drink, augmenters (of the reward) of sacrifice, the Somalibation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN I. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: २० वामदेवो गौतमः। अग्निः, २-५ अग्नीवरुणौ वा। त्रिष्टुप्, १ अग्निः, २ अतिजगती, ३ धृतिः।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: , THEE Agni, have the Gods, ever of one accord, sent hither down, a God, appointed messenger, yea, with their wisdom sent thee down.The Immortal, O thou Holy One, mid mortal men, the God-devoted God, the wise, have they brought forth, brought forth the omnipresent God-devoted Sage. As such, O Agni, bring with favour to the Gods thy Brother Varuṇa who loveth sacrifice,True to the Law, the Āditya who supporteth men, the King, supporter of mankind. Do thou, O Friend, turn hither him who is our Friend, swift as a wheel, like two car-steeds in rapid course, Wondrous! to us in rapid course.O Agni, find thou grace for us with Varuṇa, with Maruts who illumine all.Bless us, thou Radiant One, for seed and progeny, yea, bless us, O thou Wondrous God. Do thou who knowest Varuṇa, O Agni, put far away from us the God's displeasure.Best Sacrificer, brightest One, refulgent remove thou far from us all those who hate us. Be thou, O Agni, nearest us with succour, our closest Friend while now this Morn is breaking.Reconcile to us Varuṇa, be bounteous enjoy the gracious juice; be swift to hear us. Excellent is the glance, of brightest splendour, which the auspicious God bestows on mortals-The God's glance, longed-for even as the butter, pure, heated, of the cow, the milch-cow's bounty. Three are those births, the true, the most exalted, eagerly longed-for, of the God, of Agni.He came invested in the boundless region, pure, radiant, friendly, mightily resplendent. This envoy joyeth in all seats of worship, borne on his golden car, sweet-tongued Invoker:Lovely to look on, with red steeds, effulgent, like a feast rich in food, joyous for ever. Allied by worship, let him give man knowledge: by an extended cord they lead him onward.He stays, effectual in this mortal's dwelling, and the God wins a share in his possessions. Let Agni -for he knows the way- conduct us to all that he enjoys of God-sent riches,What all the Immortals have prepared with wisdom, Dyaus, Sire, Begetter, raining down true blessings. In houses first he sprang into existence, at great heaven's base, and in this region's bosom;Footless and headless, both his ends concealing, in his Bull's lair drawing himself together. Wondrously first he rose aloft, defiant, in the Bull's lair, the homeof holy Order,Longed-for, young, beautiful, and far-resplendent: and sevendear frieuds sprang up unto the Mighty. Here did our human fathers take their places, fain to fulfil the sacred Law of worship.Forth drave they, with loud call, Dawn's teeming Milch-kine bid in the mountainstable, in the cavern. Splendid were they when they had rent the mountain: others, around, shall tell forth this their exploit.They sang their song, prepared to free the cattle: they found the light; with holy hymns they worshipped. Eager, with thought intent upon the booty, the men with their celestial speech threw open,The solid mountain firm, compact, enclosing, confining Cows, the stable full of cattle. The Milch-cow's earliest name they comprehended: they found the Mother's thrice-seven noblest titles.This the bands knew, and sent forth acclamation:with the Bull's sheen the Red One was apparent. The turbid darkness fled, the heaven was sp, endid! up rose the bright beam of celestial Morning.Sūrya ascended to the wide expanses, beholding deeds of men both good and evil. Then, afterwards they looked around, awakened, when first they held that Heaven allotted treasure.Now all the Gods abide in all their dwellings. Varuṇa, Mitra, be the prayer effective. I will call hither brightly-beaming Agni, the Herald, all-supporting, best at worship.He hath disclosed, like the milch cows' pure udder, the Sorria's juice when cleansed and poured from beakers. The freest God of all who should be worshipped, the guest who is received in all men's houses,Agni who hath secured the Gods’ high favour,—may he be gracious, to us Jātavedas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां ह्यग्ने सदमित्समन्यवो देवासो देवमरतिं न्येरिर इति क्रत्वा न्येरिरे ।अमर्त्यं यजत मर्त्येष्वा देवमादेवं जनत प्रचेतसं विश्वमादेवं जनत प्रचेतसं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ sa-manyávaḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ devám ǀ aratím ǀ ni-eriré ǀ íti ǀ krátvā ǀ ni-eriré ǀámartyam ǀ yajata ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ devám ǀ ā́-devam ǀ janata ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́-devam ǀ janata ǀ prá-cetasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since the emulous gods ever excite you,Agni, who are a deity swift of motion, (to contest), therefore do (your worshippers) urge you by their devotions (to bring the deities to their sacrifices); adorable Agni, they (the deities), have genitive rated you, immortal, divine, all-wise, as the present divinity among men; they have genitive rated you as the all-present and all-wise deity.
verses.wilson_translation: Since the emulous gods ever excite you,Agni, who are a deity swift of motion, (to contest), therefore do (your worshippers) urge you by their devotions (to bring the deities to their sacrifices); adorable Agni, they (the deities), have genitive rated you, immortal, divine, all-wise, as the present divinity among men; they have genitive rated you as the all-present and all-wise deity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स भ्रातरं वरुणमग्न आ ववृत्स्व देवाँ अच्छा सुमती यज्ञवनसं ज्येष्ठं यज्ञवनसं ।ऋतावानमादित्यं चर्षणीधृतं राजानं चर्षणीधृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ bhrā́taram ǀ váruṇam ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ su-matī́ ǀ yajñá-vanasam ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ yajñá-vanasam ǀṛtá-vānam ǀ ādityám ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́tam ǀ rā́jānam ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́tam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to the presence of the worshippers,Agni, your brother Varuṇa, as a participator fo the sacrifice, with a willing mind, the elder participator of the sacrifice; the ruler of the water, theĀditya, the supporter of men the sovereign venerated by mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to the presence of the worshippers,Agni, your brother Varuṇa, as a participator fo the sacrifice, with a willing mind, the elder participator of the sacrifice; the ruler of the water, theĀditya, the supporter of men the sovereign venerated by mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सखे सखायमभ्या ववृत्स्वाशुं न चक्रं रथ्येव रंह्यास्मभ्यं दस्म रंह्या ।अग्ने मृळीकं वरुणे सचा विदो मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ।तोकाय तुजे शुशुचान शं कृध्यस्मभ्यं दस्म शं कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhe ǀ sákhāyam ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ āśúm ǀ ná ǀ cakrám ǀ ráthyā-iva ǀ ráṃhyā ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dasma ǀ ráṃhyā ǀágne ǀ mṛḷīkám ǀ váruṇe ǀ sácā ǀ vidaḥ ǀ marút-su ǀ viśvá-bhānuṣu ǀtokā́ya ǀ tujé ǀ śuśucāna ǀ śám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dasma ǀ śám ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Friendly and beautiful (Agni), bring your friend (Varruṇa) to our presence, as two strong horses convey the swift chariot along the road to its goal; you receive, Agni, the gratifying (oblation) together with Varuṇa, and with the all-illuminig Maruts; grant, brilliant Agni, happiness to our sons and grandsons; grant, beautiful Agni, happiness to ourselves.
verses.wilson_translation: Friendly and beautiful (Agni), bring your friend (Varruṇa) to our presence, as two strong horses convey the swift chariot along the road to its goal; you receive, Agni, the gratifying (oblation) together with Varuṇa, and with the all-illuminig Maruts; grant, brilliant Agni, happiness to our sons and grandsons; grant, beautiful Agni, happiness to ourselves.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने वरुणस्य विद्वांदेवस्य हेळोऽव यासिसीष्ठाः ।यजिष्ठो वह्नितमः शोशुचानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ devásya ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ áva ǀ yāsisīṣṭhāḥ ǀyájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ váhni-tamaḥ ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ prá ǀ mumugdhi ǀ asmát ǁ
verses.english_translation: May you Agni, who are wise, avert from us the wrath of the divine Varuṇa; do you, who are the most frequent sacrificer, the most diligent bearer (of oblations), the most resplendent liberate us from all animosities.
verses.wilson_translation: May you Agni, who are wise, avert from us the wrath of the divine Varuṇa; do you, who are the most frequent sacrificer, the most diligent bearer (of oblations), the most resplendent liberate us from all animosities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं नो अग्नेऽवमो भवोती नेदिष्ठो अस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ ।अव यक्ष्व नो वरुणं रराणो वीहि मृळीकं सुहवो न एधि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avamáḥ ǀ bhava ǀ ūtī́ ǀ nédiṣṭhaḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀáva ǀ yakṣva ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇam ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀ vīhí ǀ mṛḷīkám ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ edhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you Agniour preserver bemost nigh to us with your protection at the breaking of this dawn; deprecate Varuṇafor us and propitiated (by our praise) feed upon the grateful (oblation), and be to us of auspicious invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you Agniour preserver bemost nigh to us with your protection at the breaking of this dawn; deprecate Varuṇafor us and propitiated (by our praise) feed upon the grateful (oblation), and be to us of auspicious invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य श्रेष्ठा सुभगस्य संदृग्देवस्य चित्रतमा मर्त्येषु ।शुचि घृतं न तप्तमघ्न्यायाः स्पार्हा देवस्य मंहनेव धेनोः ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ śréṣṭhā ǀ su-bhágasya ǀ sam-dṛ́k ǀ devásya ǀ citrá-tamā ǀ mártyeṣu ǀśúci ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ taptám ǀ ághnyāyāḥ ǀ spārhā́ ǀ devásya ǀ maṃhánā-iva ǀ dhenóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The glance of this auspicious deity, directed towards men, is most excellent, most wonderful, acceptable (to all) as the pure warm butter (from the milk) of the cow (is acceptable) to the deity; as the gift of a cow (is to a man).
verses.wilson_translation: The glance of this auspicious deity, directed towards men, is most excellent, most wonderful, acceptable (to all) as the pure warm butter (from the milk) of the cow (is acceptable) to the deity; as the gift of a cow (is to a man).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरस्य ता परमा संति सत्या स्पार्हा देवस्य जनिमान्यग्नेः ।अनंते अंतः परिवीत आगाच्छुचिः शुक्रो अर्यो रोरुचानः ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ asya ǀ tā́ ǀ paramā́ ǀ santi ǀ satyā́ ǀ spārhā́ ǀ devásya ǀ jánimāni ǀ agnéḥ ǀananté ǀ antáríti ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ śúciḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ rórucānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These are the supreme, true, and desirable births of this divine Agni, invested (with radiance) in the unbounded (firmament); pure, bright, radiant lord (of all), may he come (to our) sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: These are the supreme, true, and desirable births of this divine Agni, invested (with radiance) in the unbounded (firmament); pure, bright, radiant lord (of all), may he come (to our) sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स दूतो विश्वेदभि वष्टि सद्मा होता हिरण्यरथो रंसुजिह्वः ।रोहिदश्वो वपुष्यो विभावा सदा रण्वः पितुमतीव संसत् ॥
