verses.english_translation: Slayer of Vṛtrayou have restored the (one who was) blind, the (other who was) lame, both abandoned by their kin); (it is not possible) to exceed the happiness what is given by you.
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of Vṛtrayou have restored the (one who was) blind, the (other who was) lame, both abandoned by their kin); (it is not possible) to exceed the happiness what is given by you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Indrahas overturned a hundred stone-built cities for Divodās, the donor of oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrahas overturned a hundred stone-built cities for Divodās, the donor of oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: He put to sleep, by delusion, with his destructive (weapons), thirty thousand of the servile (races), for the sake of Dabhīti.
verses.wilson_translation: He put to sleep, by delusion, with his destructive (weapons), thirty thousand of the servile (races), for the sake of Dabhīti.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the same to all your worshippers, the lord of cattle, who cast down all these (your enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the same to all your worshippers, the lord of cattle, who cast down all these (your enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: When, indeed,Indra, you excite your vigorous manhood, there is no one at the present time who may resist it.
verses.wilson_translation: When, indeed,Indra, you excite your vigorous manhood, there is no one at the present time who may resist it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Destroyer of foes, may the divine Aryamandistribute your precious wealth; (may)Pūṣa(bestow it), (may),Bhaga(bestow it); may the toothless deity bestow the desired wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroyer of foes, may the divine Aryamandistribute your precious wealth; (may)Pūṣa(bestow it), (may),Bhaga(bestow it); may the toothless deity bestow the desired wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXX. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: २४ वामदेवो गौतमः। इन्द्रः, ९-११ इन्द्रोषसो। गायत्री, ८-२४ अनुष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O INDRA, Vṛtra-slayer, none is better, mightier than thou:Verily there is none like thee. Like chariot-wheels these people all together follow after thee:Thou ever art renowned as Great. Not even all the gathered Gods conquered thee, Indra, in the war,When thou didst lengthen days by night. When for the sake of those oppressed, and Kutsa as he battled,Thou stolest away the Sun's car-wheel. When, fighting singly, Indra. thou o’ercamest all the furious Gods, thou slewest those who strove with thee. When also for a mortal man, Indra, thou speddest forth the Sun,And holpest Etaśa with might. What? Vṛtra-slayer, art not thou, Maghavan, fiercest in thy wrath?So hast thou quelled the demon too. And this heroic deed of might thou, Indra, also hast achieved,That thou didst smite to death the Dame, Heaven's Daughter, meditating ill. Thou, Indra, Mighty One, didst crush Uṣas, though Daughter of the Sky.When lifting up herself in pride. Then from her chariot Uṣas fled, affrighted, from her ruined car.When the strong God had shattered it. So there this car of Uṣas lay, broken to pieces, in Vipāś,And she herself fled far away. Thou, Indra, didst. with magic power resist the overflowing streamWho spread her waters o’er the land. Valiantly didst thou seize and take the store which Śuṣṇa had amassed,When thou didst crush his fortresses. Thou, Indra, also smotest down Kulitara's son Śambara,The Dāsa, from the lofty hill. Of Dāsa Varcin's thou didst slay the hundred thousand and the five,Crushed like the fellies, of a car. So Indra, Lord of Heroes, Powers, caused the unwedded damsel's son,The castaway, to share the lauds. So sapient Indra, Lord of Might, brought Turvaśa and Yadu, thoseWho feared the flood, in safety o’er. Arṇa and Citraratha, both Āryas, thou, Indra, slewest swift,On yonder side of Sarayu, Thou, Vṛtra-slayer, didst conduct those two forlorn, the blind, the lame.None may attain this bliss of thine. For Divodāsa, him who brought oblations, Indra overthrewA hundred fortresses of stone. The thirty thousand Dāsas he with magic power and weapons sentTo slumber, for Dabhīti's sake. As such, O Vṛtra-slayer, thou art general Lord of kine for all,Thou Shaker of all things that be. Indra, whatever deed of might thou hast this day to execute,None be there now to hinder it. O Watchful One, may Aryaman the God give thee all goodly things.May Pūṣan, Bhaga, and the God Karūḷatī give all things fair.

verses.sanskrit: नकिरिंद्र त्वदुत्तरो न ज्यायाँ अस्ति वृत्रहन् ।नकिरेवा यथा त्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ indra ǀ tvát ǀ út-taraḥ ǀ ná ǀ jyā́yān ǀ asti ǀ vṛtra-han ǀnákiḥ ǀ evá ǀ yáthā ǀ tvám ǁ
verses.english_translation: There is no one,Indra, superior to you; no one more excellent (than you); slayer of Vṛtrathere is no one, verily, such as you are.
verses.wilson_translation: There is no one,Indra, superior to you; no one more excellent (than you); slayer of Vṛtrathere is no one, verily, such as you are.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्रा ते अनु कृष्टयो विश्वा चक्रेव वावृतुः ।सत्रा महाँ असि श्रुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: satrā́ ǀ te ǀ ánu ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ cakrā́-iva ǀ vavṛtuḥ ǀsatrā́ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ śrutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily men are attached to you as are all the wheels (to the body of the wagon); in truth you are great and renowned.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily men are attached to you as are all the wheels (to the body of the wagon); in truth you are great and renowned.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे चनेदना त्वा देवास इंद्र युयुधुः ।यदहा नक्तमातिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ caná ǀ ít ǀ anā́ ǀ tvā ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ indra ǀ yuyudhuḥ ǀyát ǀ áhā ǀ náktam ǀ ā́ ǀ átiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily all the gods, with you (for) their strength, have warred (with theasuras); wherefore you have destroyed by day and by night.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily all the gods, with you (for) their strength, have warred (with theasuras); wherefore you have destroyed by day and by night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्रोत बाधितेभ्यश्चक्रं कुत्साय युध्यते ।मुषाय इंद्र सूर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ utá ǀ bādhitébhyaḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ kútsāya ǀ yúdhyate ǀmuṣāyáḥ ǀ indra ǀ sū́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: In wihc (contests), for the sake of Kutsaand his allies, you hae stolen,Indra, the (wheel of the car) of the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: In wihc (contests), for the sake of Kutsaand his allies, you hae stolen,Indra, the (wheel of the car) of the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्र देवाँ ऋघायतो विश्वाँ अयुध्य एक इत् ।त्वमिंद्र वनूँरहन् ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛghāyatáḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ áyudhyaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀtvám ǀ indra ǀ vanū́n ǀ áhan ǁ
verses.english_translation: In which (contest) you singly indeed have warred with all those opposing the gods; you,Indra, have slain the malignant.
verses.wilson_translation: In which (contest) you singly indeed have warred with all those opposing the gods; you,Indra, have slain the malignant.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्रोत मर्त्याय कमरिणा इंद्र सूर्यं ।प्रावः शचीभिरेतशं ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ utá ǀ mártyāya ǀ kám ǀ áriṇāḥ ǀ indra ǀ sū́ryam ǀprá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ étaśam ǁ
verses.english_translation: In which (contests),Indrayou have, for the sake of a mortal, discomfited the sun, and have protected Etaśaby (your) exploits.
verses.wilson_translation: In which (contests),Indrayou have, for the sake of a mortal, discomfited the sun, and have protected Etaśaby (your) exploits.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: किमादुतासि वृत्रहन्मघवन्मन्युमत्तमः ।अत्राह दानुमातिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: kím ǀ ā́t ǀ utá ǀ asi ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ mágha-van ǀ manyumát-tamaḥ ǀátra ǀ áha ǀ dā́num ǀ ā́ ǀ atiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wherefore, slayer of Vṛtra, opulent Indra, have you thereupon become most incensed, and in consequence, have slain the son of Danu(Vṛtra) in this firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Wherefore, slayer of Vṛtra, opulent Indra, have you thereupon become most incensed, and in consequence, have slain the son of Danu(Vṛtra) in this firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतद्घेदुत वीर्यमिंद्र चकर्थ पौंस्यं ।स्त्रियं यद्दुर्हणायुवं वधीर्दुहितरं दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: etát ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ utá ǀ vīryám ǀ índra ǀ cakártha ǀ páuṃsyam ǀstríyam ǀ yát ǀ duḥ-hanāyúvam ǀ vádhīḥ ǀ duhitáram ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch,Indra, as you have displayed such manly prowess, you have slain the woman, the daughter of the sky, when meditating mischief.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch,Indra, as you have displayed such manly prowess, you have slain the woman, the daughter of the sky, when meditating mischief.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवश्चिद्घा दुहितरं महान्महीयमानां ।उषासमिंद्र सं पिणक् ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ duhitáram ǀ mahā́n ǀ mahīyámānām ǀuṣásam ǀ indra ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǁ
verses.english_translation: You Indra, who are mighty, have enriched glorious dawn, the daughter of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: You Indra, who are mighty, have enriched glorious dawn, the daughter of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपोषा अनसः सरत्संपिष्टादह बिभ्युषी ।नि यत्सीं शिश्नथद्वृषा ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ánasaḥ ǀ sarat ǀ sám-piṣṭāt ǀ áha ǀ bibhyúṣī ǀní ǀ yát ǀ sīm ǀ śiśnáthat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The terrified Uṣas descended from the broken wagon when the (showerer of benefits) had smashed it.
verses.wilson_translation: The terrified Uṣas descended from the broken wagon when the (showerer of benefits) had smashed it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतदस्या अनः शये सुसंपिष्टं विपाश्या ।ससार सीं परावतः ॥
verses.transliteration: etát ǀ asyāḥ ǀ ánaḥ ǀ śaye ǀ sú-sampiṣṭam ǀ ví-pāśi ǀ ā́ ǀsasā́ra ǀ sīm ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then her shattered wagon reposed (on the bank) of the Vipās' (river), and she departed from afar.
verses.wilson_translation: Then her shattered wagon reposed (on the bank) of the Vipās' (river), and she departed from afar.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत सिंधुं विबाल्यं वितस्थानामधि क्षमि ।परि ष्ठा इंद्र मायया ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ síndhum ǀ vi-bālyám ǀ vi-tasthānā́m ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀpári ǀ sthāḥ ǀ indra ǀ māyáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have spread abroad upon the earth, by your contrivance, the swollen Sindhuwhen arrested (on its course).
verses.wilson_translation: You have spread abroad upon the earth, by your contrivance, the swollen Sindhuwhen arrested (on its course).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत शुष्णस्य धृष्णुया प्र मृक्षो अभि वेदनं ।पुरो यदस्य संपिणक् ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ prá ǀ mṛkṣaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ védanam ǀpúraḥ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ sam-piṇák ǁ
verses.english_translation: By valour you have carried off the wealth ofŚuṣṇa, when you had demolished his cities.
verses.wilson_translation: By valour you have carried off the wealth ofŚuṣṇa, when you had demolished his cities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत दासं कौलितरं बृहतः पर्वतादधि ।अवाहन्निंद्र शंबरं ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ dāsám ǀ kauli-tarám ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ párvatāt ǀ ádhi ǀáva ǀ ahan ǀ indra ǀ śámbaram ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have slain the slaveŚambara, the son Kulitara hurling him off the huge mountain.
verses.wilson_translation: You have slain the slaveŚambara, the son Kulitara hurling him off the huge mountain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत दासस्य वर्चिनः सहस्राणि शतावधीः ।अधि पंच प्रधीँरिव ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ dāsásya ǀ varcínaḥ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ śatā́ ǀ avadhīḥ ǀádhi ǀ páñca ǀ pradhī́n-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have slain the five hundreds and thousands (of the followers) of the slave Varin, (surrounding) him like the fellies (round the spokes of the wheel).
verses.wilson_translation: You have slain the five hundreds and thousands (of the followers) of the slave Varin, (surrounding) him like the fellies (round the spokes of the wheel).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्यं पुत्रमग्रुवः परावृक्तं शतक्रतुः ।उक्थेष्विंद्र आभजत् ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ putrám ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ párā-vṛktam ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀukthéṣu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abhajat ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, who areŚatakratu, have made Parāvṛj, the son of Agru, participant in sacred hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, who areŚatakratu, have made Parāvṛj, the son of Agru, participant in sacred hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्या तुर्वशायदू अस्नातारा शचीपतिः ।इंद्रो विद्वाँ अपारयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ turváśāyádū íti ǀ asnātā́rā ǀ śacī́-pátiḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ apārayat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The lord of acts, the wise Indra, has borne across (their difficulties),Turvaśasand Yadu, when denied inauguration.
verses.wilson_translation: The lord of acts, the wise Indra, has borne across (their difficulties),Turvaśasand Yadu, when denied inauguration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्या सद्य आर्या सरयोरिंद्र पारतः ।अर्णाचित्ररथावधीः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ā́ryā ǀ saráyoḥ ǀ indra ǀ pārátaḥ ǀárṇācitrárathā ǀ avadhīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have slain at once those twoĀryas,Arṇaand Citraratha, (dwellig) on the opposite (bank) of the Sarayu.
verses.wilson_translation: You have slain at once those twoĀryas,Arṇaand Citraratha, (dwellig) on the opposite (bank) of the Sarayu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु द्वा जहिता नयोऽंधं श्रोणं च वृत्रहन् ।न तत्ते सुम्नमष्टवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ dvā́ ǀ jahitā́ ǀ nayaḥ ǀ andhám ǀ śroṇám ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀná ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ áṣṭave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Slayer of Vṛtrayou have restored the (one who was) blind, the (other who was) lame, both abandoned by their kin); (it is not possible) to exceed the happiness what is given by you.
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of Vṛtrayou have restored the (one who was) blind, the (other who was) lame, both abandoned by their kin); (it is not possible) to exceed the happiness what is given by you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतमश्मन्मयीनां पुरामिंद्रो व्यास्यत् ।दिवोदासाय दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: śatám ǀ aśman-máyīnām ǀ purā́m ǀ índraḥ ǀ ví ǀ āsyat ǀdívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indrahas overturned a hundred stone-built cities for Divodās, the donor of oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrahas overturned a hundred stone-built cities for Divodās, the donor of oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्वापयद्दभीतये सहस्रा त्रिंशतं हथैः ।दासानामिंद्रो मायया ॥
verses.transliteration: ásvāpayat ǀ dabhī́taye ǀ sahásrā ǀ triṃśátam ǀ háthaiḥ ǀdāsā́nām ǀ índraḥ ǀ māyáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: He put to sleep, by delusion, with his destructive (weapons), thirty thousand of the servile (races), for the sake of Dabhīti.
verses.wilson_translation: He put to sleep, by delusion, with his destructive (weapons), thirty thousand of the servile (races), for the sake of Dabhīti.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स घेदुतासि वृत्रहन्त्समान इंद्र गोपतिः ।यस्ता विश्वानि चिच्युषे ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ utá ǀ asi ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ samānáḥ ǀ indra ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ cicyuṣé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the same to all your worshippers, the lord of cattle, who cast down all these (your enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the same to all your worshippers, the lord of cattle, who cast down all these (your enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नूनं यदिंद्रियं करिष्या इंद्र पौंस्यं ।अद्या नकिष्टदा मिनत् ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ nūnám ǀ yát ǀ indriyám ǀ kariṣyā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǀadyá ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ minat ǁ
verses.english_translation: When, indeed,Indra, you excite your vigorous manhood, there is no one at the present time who may resist it.
verses.wilson_translation: When, indeed,Indra, you excite your vigorous manhood, there is no one at the present time who may resist it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वामंवामं त आदुरे देवो ददात्वर्यमा ।वामं पूषा वामं भगो वामं देवः करूळती ॥
verses.transliteration: vamám-vāmam ǀ te ǀ ā-dure ǀ deváḥ ǀ dadātu ǀ aryamā́ ǀvāmám ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ vāmám ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ vāmám ǀ deváḥ ǀ kárūḷatī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroyer of foes, may the divine Aryamandistribute your precious wealth; (may)Pūṣa(bestow it), (may),Bhaga(bestow it); may the toothless deity bestow the desired wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroyer of foes, may the divine Aryamandistribute your precious wealth; (may)Pūṣa(bestow it), (may),Bhaga(bestow it); may the toothless deity bestow the desired wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १५ वामदेवो गौतमः। इन्द्रः। गायत्री, ३ पाद निचृत्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing Friend;With what most mighty company? What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burstOpen e’en strongly-guarded wealth? Do thou who art Protector of us thy friends who praise theeWith hundred aids approach us. Like as a courser's circling wheel, so turn thee hitherward to us,Attracted by the hymns of men. Thou seekest as it were thine own stations with swift descent of powers:I share thee even with the Sun. What time thy courage and his wheels together, Indra, run their courseWith thee and with the Sun alike, So even, Lord of Power and Might, the people call thee Maghavan,Giver, who pauses not to think. And verily to him who toils and presses Soma juice for theeThou quickly givest ample wealth. No, not a hundred hinderers can check thy gracious bounty's flow,Nor thy great deeds when thou wilt act. May thine assistance keep us safe, thy hundred and thy thousand aids:May all thy favours strengthen us. Do thou elect us this place for friendship and prosperity,And great celestial opulence. Favour us, Indra, evermore with overflowing store of wealth:With all thy succours aid thou us. With new protections, Indra, like an archer, open thou for usThe stables that are filled with kine. Our chariot, Indra, boldly moves endued with splendour, ne’er repulsed,Winning for us both kine and steeds. O Sūrya, make our fame to be most excellent among the Gods,Most lofty as the heaven on high.

verses.sanskrit: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा ।कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥
verses.transliteration: káyā ǀ naḥ ǀ citráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ ūtī́ ǀ sadā́-vṛdhaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀkáyā ǀ śáciṣṭhayā ǀ vṛtā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By what means may he who is ever augmenting, who is wonderful, who is our friend, be present with us, by what most effective rite?
verses.wilson_translation: By what means may he who is ever augmenting, who is wonderful, who is our friend, be present with us, by what most effective rite?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदंधसः ।दृळ्हा चिदारुजे वसु ॥
verses.transliteration: káḥ ǀ tvā ǀ satyáḥ ǀ mádānām ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ matsat ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀdṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ ā-rúje ǀ vásu ǁ
verses.english_translation: What genitive ine and most esteemed of the exhilarating juies of the (sacriiial) beverage may delight you to demolish the substantial treasures (of the foe)?
verses.wilson_translation: What genitive ine and most esteemed of the exhilarating juies of the (sacriiial) beverage may delight you to demolish the substantial treasures (of the foe)?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणां ।शतं भवास्यूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ sákhīnām ǀ avitā́ ǀ jaritṝṇā́m ǀśatám ǀ bhavāsi ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, the protector of us your friends and praisers, be present with a hundred protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, the protector of us your friends and praisers, be present with a hundred protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभी न आ ववृत्स्व चक्रं न वृत्तमर्वतः ।नियुद्भिश्चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ cakrám ǀ ná ǀ vṛttám ǀ árvataḥ ǀniyút-bhiḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Induced) by the praise of men, return like a revolving wheel to us, dependent (upon your favour).
verses.wilson_translation: (Induced) by the praise of men, return like a revolving wheel to us, dependent (upon your favour).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रवता हि क्रतूनामा हा पदेव गच्छसि ।अभक्षि सूर्ये सचा ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-vátā ǀ hí ǀ krátūnām ǀ ā́ ǀ ha ǀ padā́-iva ǀ gácchasi ǀábhakṣi ǀ sū́rye ǀ sácā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You come in a downward (direction) to sacfred rites, as if to your own station; I glorify you together with the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: You come in a downward (direction) to sacfred rites, as if to your own station; I glorify you together with the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सं यत्त इंद्र मन्यवः सं चक्राणि दधन्विरे ।अध त्वे अध सूर्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ manyávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ cakrā́ṇi ǀ dadhanviré ǀádha ǀ tvé íti ǀ ádha ǀ sū́rye ǁ
verses.english_translation: When you praises, and these sacred rites,Indra, are addressed to you, they first belong to you and next to Sūrya.
verses.wilson_translation: When you praises, and these sacred rites,Indra, are addressed to you, they first belong to you and next to Sūrya.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्मा हि त्वामाहुरिन्मघवानं शचीपते ।दातारमविदीधयुं ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ āhúḥ ǀ ít ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ śacī-pate ǀdā́tāram ǀ ávi-dīdhayum ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of holy acts, they call you Maghavan, the munificent, the resplendent.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of holy acts, they call you Maghavan, the munificent, the resplendent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्मा सद्य इत्परि शशमानाय सुन्वते ।पुरू चिन्मंहसे वसु ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ít ǀ pári ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ sunvaté ǀpurú ǀ cit ǀ maṃhase ǀ vásu ǁ
verses.english_translation: And verily you give promptly abundant wealth to him who praises you and offers you libations.
verses.wilson_translation: And verily you give promptly abundant wealth to him who praises you and offers you libations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि ष्मा ते शतं चन राधो वरंत आमुरः ।न च्यौत्नानि करिष्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ sma ǀ te ǀ śatám ǀ caná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ várante ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀná ǀ cyautnā́ni ǀ kariṣyatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adversaries diminish not your hundred-fold opulence nor resist the energies of you opposing (them).
verses.wilson_translation: Adversaries diminish not your hundred-fold opulence nor resist the energies of you opposing (them).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माँ अवंतु ते शतमस्मान्त्सहस्रमूतयः ।अस्मान्विश्वा अभिष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ te ǀ śatám ǀ asmā́n ǀ sahásram ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀasmā́n ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhíṣṭayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your hundred, your thousand, protections preserve us; may all (your) desires (be for our defence).
verses.wilson_translation: May your hundred, your thousand, protections preserve us; may all (your) desires (be for our defence).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माँ इहा वृणीष्व सख्याय स्वस्तये ।महो राये दिवित्मते ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ ihá ǀ vṛṇīṣva ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ svastáye ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ divítmate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Select us,Indra, on this occasion, for your friendship, for (our) welfare, for vast and splendid riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Select us,Indra, on this occasion, for your friendship, for (our) welfare, for vast and splendid riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माँ अविड्ढि विश्वहेंद्र राया परीणसा ।अस्मान्विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ aviḍḍhi ǀ viśváhā ǀ índra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ párīṇasā ǀasmā́n ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Favour us,Indra, daily with infinite riches (protect) us with all protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Favour us,Indra, daily with infinite riches (protect) us with all protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं ताँ अपा वृधि व्रजाँ अस्तेव गोमतः ।नवाभिरिंद्रोतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ tā́n ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǀ vrajā́n ǀ ástā-iva ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀnávābhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With fresh protections,Indra, like a warrior, open for us those pastures filled with cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: With fresh protections,Indra, like a warrior, open for us those pastures filled with cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं धृष्णुया रथो द्युमाँ इंद्रानपच्युतः ।गव्युरश्वयुरीयते ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ indra ǀ ánapa-cyutaḥ ǀgavyúḥ ǀ aśva-yúḥ ǀ īyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our chariot,Indra, foe-repelling, brilliant unfailing, proceed (everywhere), possessing us of cattle and of horses.
verses.wilson_translation: May our chariot,Indra, foe-repelling, brilliant unfailing, proceed (everywhere), possessing us of cattle and of horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमुत्तमं कृधि श्रवो देवेषु सूर्य ।वर्षिष्ठं द्यामिवोपरि ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ ut-tamám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ sūrya ǀvárṣiṣṭham ǀ dyā́m-iva ǀ upári ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sūrya, make our fame exalted among the gods, as (you have plural ced) the sky, the shedder of most copious rain, above (all other regions).
verses.wilson_translation: Sūrya, make our fame exalted among the gods, as (you have plural ced) the sky, the shedder of most copious rain, above (all other regions).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O THOU who slewest Vṛtra, come, O Indra, hither to our side,Mighty One with thy mighty aids. Swift and impetuous art thou, wondrous amid the well-dressed folk:Thou doest marvels for our help. Even with the weak thou smitest down himwho is stronger, with thy strengthThe mighty, with the Friends thou hast. O Indra, we are close to thee; to thee we sing aloud our songs:Help and defend us, even us. As such, O Caster of the Stone, come with thy succours wonderful,Blameless, and irresistible. May we be friends of one like thee, O Indra, with the wealth of kine,Comrades for lively energy. For thou, O Indra, art alone the Lord of strength that comes from kineSo grant thou us abundant food. They turn thee not another way, when, lauded, Lover of the Song,Thou wilt give wealth to those who praise. The Gotamas have sung their song of praise to thee that thou mayst give,Indra, for lively energy. We will declare thy hero deeds, what Dāsa forts thou brakest down,Attacking them in rapturous joy. The sages sing those manly deeds which, Indra, Lover of the Song,Thou wroughtest when the Soma flowed. Indra, the Gotamas who bring thee praises have grown strong by thee.Give them renown with hero sons. For, Indra, verily thou art the general treasure even of all .Thee, therefore, do we invocate. Excellent Indra, turn to us: glad thee among us with the juiceOf Somas, Soma-drinker thou. May praise from us who think Qn thee, O Indra, bring thee near to us.Turn thy two Bay Steeds hitherward. Eat of our sacrificial cake: rejoice thee in the songs we sing.Even as a lover in his bride. To India for a thousand steeds well-trained and fleet of foot we pray,And hundred jars of Soma juice. We make a hundred of thy kine, yea, and a thousand, hasten nigh:So let thy bounty come to us. We have obtained, a gift from thee, ten water-ewers wrought of gold:Thou, Vṛtra-slayer, givest much. A bounteous Giver, give us much, bring much and not a trifling gift:Much, Indra, wilt thou fain bestow. O Vṛtra-slayer, thou art famed in many a place as bountifulHero, thy bounty let us share. I praise thy pair of Tawny Steeds, wise Son of him who giveth kineTerrify not the cows with these. Like two slight images of girls, unrobed, upon a new-wrought post,So shine the Bay Steeds in their course. For me the Bays are ready when I start, or start not, with the dawn, Innocuous in the ways they take.

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न इंद्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि ।महान्महीभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ardhám ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀmahā́n ǀ mahī́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, come to us quickly; you, who are mighty, (come) with mighty protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, come to us quickly; you, who are mighty, (come) with mighty protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भृमिश्चिद्घासि तूतुजिरा चित्र चित्रिणीष्वा ।चित्रं कृणोष्यूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: bhṛ́miḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ asi ǀ tū́tujiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ citra ǀ citríṇīṣu ǀ ā́ ǀcitrám ǀ kṛṇoṣi ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wonderful Indra, wanderer at times (through space), you are verily the granter of (our) desires, and do what is marvellous for the protection (of those who are engaged) in wondrous works.
verses.wilson_translation: Wonderful Indra, wanderer at times (through space), you are verily the granter of (our) desires, and do what is marvellous for the protection (of those who are engaged) in wondrous works.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दभ्रेभिश्चिच्छशीयांसं हंसि व्राधंतमोजसा ।सखिभिर्ये त्वे सचा ॥
verses.transliteration: dabhrébhiḥ ǀ cit ǀ śáśīyāṃsam ǀ háṃsi ǀ vrā́dhantam ǀ ójasā ǀsákhi-bhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ tvé íti ǀ sácā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You destroy by your might the fierce assailing foe, associated with the humble friends who are along with you.
verses.wilson_translation: You destroy by your might the fierce assailing foe, associated with the humble friends who are along with you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयमिंद्र त्वे सचा वयं त्वाभि नोनुमः ।अस्माँअस्माँ इदुदव ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ indra ǀ tvé íti ǀ sácā ǀ vayám ǀ tvā ǀ abhí ǀ nonumaḥ ǀasmā́n-asmān ǀ ít ǀ út ǀ ava ǁ
verses.english_translation: We,Indra, are along with you; we zealously glorify you; do verily protect us all.
verses.wilson_translation: We,Indra, are along with you; we zealously glorify you; do verily protect us all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नश्चित्राभिरद्रिवोऽनवद्याभिरूतिभिः ।अनाधृष्टाभिरा गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ anavadyā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀánādhṛṣṭābhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wielder of the thunderbolt, do you come to us with wondrous, irreproachable, irresistible protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Wielder of the thunderbolt, do you come to us with wondrous, irreproachable, irresistible protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भूयामो षु त्वावतः सखाय इंद्र गोमतः ।युजो वाजाय घृष्वये ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūyā́mo íti ǀ sú ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀyújaḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we,Indra, be the friends of one like you, possessed of cattle, allied (to him) for (the sake of) abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: May we,Indra, be the friends of one like you, possessed of cattle, allied (to him) for (the sake of) abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह्येक ईशिष इंद्र वाजस्य गोमतः ।स नो यंधि महीमिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ī́śiṣe ǀ índra ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yandhi ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you alone,Indra, are lord over food combined with cattle; therefore do you grant us ample food.
verses.wilson_translation: For you alone,Indra, are lord over food combined with cattle; therefore do you grant us ample food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा वरंते अन्यथा यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघं ।स्तोतृभ्य इंद्र गिर्वणः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ varante ǀ anyáthā ǀ yát ǀ dítsasi ǀ stutáḥ ǀ maghám ǀstotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: None change your purpose,Indra, object of laudation, when, being praised, you desire to bestow wealth upon the praisers.
verses.wilson_translation: None change your purpose,Indra, object of laudation, when, being praised, you desire to bestow wealth upon the praisers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा गोतमा गिरानूषत प्र दावने ।इंद्र वाजाय घृष्वये ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ gótamāḥ ǀ girā́ ǀ ánūṣata ǀ prá ǀ dāváne ǀíndra ǀ vā́jāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Gotamasglorify you,Indra, with praise, that you may grant wealth, and for the sake of abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: The Gotamasglorify you,Indra, with praise, that you may grant wealth, and for the sake of abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते वोचाम वीर्या या मंदसान आरुजः ।पुरो दासीरभीत्य ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ vocāma ǀ vīryā́ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ árujaḥ ǀpúraḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ abhi-ítya ǁ
verses.english_translation: We proclaim your prowess, whereby exhilarated (by the Soma), and having gone against them, you have demolished the servile cities.
verses.wilson_translation: We proclaim your prowess, whereby exhilarated (by the Soma), and having gone against them, you have demolished the servile cities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता ते गृणंति वेधसो यानि चकर्थ पौंस्या ।सुतेष्विंद्र गिर्वणः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ te ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ yā́ni ǀ cakártha ǀ páuṃsyā ǀsutéṣu ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pious celebrate your manly exploits,Indra, object of laudation, when the juices (of the Soma) are effused.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious celebrate your manly exploits,Indra, object of laudation, when the juices (of the Soma) are effused.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवीवृधंत गोतमा इंद्र त्वे स्तोमवाहसः ।ऐषु धा वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.transliteration: ávīvṛdhanta ǀ gótamāḥ ǀ índra ǀ tvé íti ǀ stóma-vāhasaḥ ǀā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ dhāḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Gotamas, offerers of praise, exalt you,Indra; bestow upon them food and prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: The Gotamas, offerers of praise, exalt you,Indra; bestow upon them food and prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसींद्र साधारणस्त्वं ।तं त्वा वयं हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatām ǀ ási ǀ índra ǀ sā́dhāraṇaḥ ǀ tvám ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Although,Indra, you are the common property of (all) worshippers, we invoke you (such) as your are (for ourselves).
verses.wilson_translation: Although,Indra, you are the common property of (all) worshippers, we invoke you (such) as your are (for ourselves).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाचीनो वसो भवास्मे सु मत्स्वांधसः ।सोमानामिंद्र सोमपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: arvācīnáḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ bhava ǀ asmé íti ǀ sú ǀ matsva ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀsómānām ǀ indra ǀ soma-pāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Giver of dwellings, be present with us; drinker of the Soma, be exhilarated by the beverage of the juices.
verses.wilson_translation: Giver of dwellings, be present with us; drinker of the Soma, be exhilarated by the beverage of the juices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं त्वा मतीनामा स्तोम इंद्र यच्छतु ।अर्वागा वर्तया हरी ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ tvā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ yacchatu ǀarvā́k ǀ ā́ ǀ vartaya ǀ hárī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the praise (of us) who are devoted (to you),Indra, give you to us; guide your horses towards us.
verses.wilson_translation: May the praise (of us) who are devoted (to you),Indra, give you to us; guide your horses towards us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं च नो घसो जोषयासे गिरश्च नः ।वधूयुरिव योषणां ॥
verses.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ghásaḥ ǀ joṣáyāse ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀvadhūyúḥ-iva ǀ yóṣaṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Eat (Indra) our cakes and butter; be plural ased by our praises as a libertine (by the caresses) of a woman.
verses.wilson_translation: Eat (Indra) our cakes and butter; be plural ased by our praises as a libertine (by the caresses) of a woman.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं व्यतीनां युक्तानामिंद्रमीमहे ।शतं सोमस्य खार्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásram ǀ vyátīnām ǀ yuktā́nām ǀ índram ǀ īmahe ǀśatám ǀ sómasya ǀ khāryáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit,Indrafor a thousand well-trained, swift-going horses, for a hundred jars of Somajuice.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit,Indrafor a thousand well-trained, swift-going horses, for a hundred jars of Somajuice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रा ते शता वयं गवामा च्यावयामसि ।अस्मत्रा राध एतु ते ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásrā ǀ te ǀ śatā́ ǀ vayám ǀ gávām ǀ ā́ ǀ cyavayāmasi ǀasma-trā́ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ etu ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: We seek to bring down from you thousands and hundreds of cattle; may riches come to us from you.
verses.wilson_translation: We seek to bring down from you thousands and hundreds of cattle; may riches come to us from you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दश ते कलशानां हिरण्यानामधीमहि ।भूरिदा असि वृत्रहन् ॥
verses.transliteration: dáśa ǀ te ǀ kaláśānām ǀ híraṇyānām ǀ adhīmahi ǀbhūri-dā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ vṛtra-han ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we obtain from you, ten golden ewers, for you, slayer of Vṛtra, are a bountiful giver.
verses.wilson_translation: May we obtain from you, ten golden ewers, for you, slayer of Vṛtra, are a bountiful giver.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भूरिदा भूरि देहि नो मा दभ्रं भूर्या भर ।भूरि घेदिंद्र दित्ससि ॥
verses.transliteration: bhū́ri-dāḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ dehi ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ dabhrám ǀ bhū́ri ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀbhū́ri ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ ditsasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: A bountiful giver are you,Indra; give bountifully to us; (give) not little; bring much; for verily you desire to give much.
verses.wilson_translation: A bountiful giver are you,Indra; give bountifully to us; (give) not little; bring much; for verily you desire to give much.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भूरिदा ह्यसि श्रुतः पुरुत्रा शूर वृत्रहन् ।आ नो भजस्व राधसि ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūri-dā́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ śūra ǀ vṛtra-han ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhajasva ǀ rā́dhasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily you are renowned among many as a bountiful giver, hero, slayer of Vṛtra, make us sharers in wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily you are renowned among many as a bountiful giver, hero, slayer of Vṛtra, make us sharers in wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते बभ्रू विचक्षण शंसामि गोषणो नपात् ।माभ्यां गा अनु शिश्रथः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ babhrū́ íti ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǀ śáṃsāmi ǀ go-sanaḥ ǀ napāt ǀmā́ ǀ ābhyām ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ śiśrathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise Indra, I praise your brown (horses); bestower of kine, (who are) not regardless (of your worshippers); with those two steeds terrify not our cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Wise Indra, I praise your brown (horses); bestower of kine, (who are) not regardless (of your worshippers); with those two steeds terrify not our cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कनीनकेव विद्रधे नवे द्रुपदे अर्भके ।बभ्रू यामेषु शोभेते ॥
verses.transliteration: kanīnakā́-iva ǀ vidradhé ǀ náve ǀ dru-padé ǀ arbhaké ǀbabhrū́ íti ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ śobhete íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like two puppets on an arranged, new and slender stage, your two brown (steeds) are brilliant at sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Like two puppets on an arranged, new and slender stage, your two brown (steeds) are brilliant at sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरं म उस्रयाम्णेऽरमनुस्रयाम्णे ।बभ्रू यामेष्वस्रिधा ॥
verses.transliteration: áram ǀ me ǀ usrá-yāmne ǀ áram ǀ ánusra-yāmne ǀbabhrū́ íti ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ asrídhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your two innocuous brown (steeds) are sufficient at sacrifices for me, whether going (to them) in (a wagon drawn by) oxen, or going without (such) a conveyance.
verses.wilson_translation: Your two innocuous brown (steeds) are sufficient at sacrifices for me, whether going (to them) in (a wagon drawn by) oxen, or going without (such) a conveyance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIII. Ṛbhus.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I SEND my voice as herald to the Ṛbhus; I crave the white cow for the overspreading.Wind-sped, the Skillful Ones in rapid motion have in an instant compassed round the heaven. What time the Rbus had with care and marvels done proper service to assist their Parents,They won the friendship of the Gods; the Sages carried away the fruit of their devotion. May they who made their Parents, who were lying like posts that moulder, young again for ever,—May Vāja, Vibhvan, Ṛbhu, joined with Indra , protect our sacrifice, the Soma-lovers. As for a year the Ṛbhus kept the Milch-cow, throughout a year fashioned and formed her body,And through a year's space still sustained her brightness, through these their labours they were made immortal. Two beakers let us make,—thus said the eldest. Let us make three,—this was the younger's sentence.Four beakers let us make,—thus spoke the youngest. Tvaṣṭar approved this rede of yours, O Ṛbhus. The men spake truth and even so they acted: this Godlike way of theirs the Ṛbhus followed.And Tvaṣṭar, when he looked on the four beakers resplendent as the day, was moved with envy. When for twelve days the Ṛbhus joyed reposing as guests of him who never may be hidden,They made fair fertile fields, they brought the rivers. Plants spread o’er deserts, waters filled the hollows. May they who formed the swift car, bearing Heroes, and the Cow omniform and all-impelling,Even may they form wealth for us,—the Ṛbhus, dexterous-handed, deft in work and gracious. So in their work the Gods had satisfaction, pondering it with thought and mental insight.The Gods’ expert artificer was Vāja, Indra's Ṛbhukṣan, Varuṇa's was Vibhvan. They who made glad with sacrifice and praises, wrought the two Bays, his docile Steeds, for Indra,—Ṛbhus, as those who wish a friend to prosper, bestow upon us gear and growth of riches. This day have they set gladdening drink before you. Not without toil are Gods inclined to friendship.Therefore do ye who are so great, O Ṛbhus, vouchsafe us treasures at this third libation.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ऋभुभ्यो दूतमिव वाचमिष्य उपस्तिरे श्वैतरीं धेनुमीळे ।ये वातजूतास्तरणिभिरेवैः परि द्यां सद्यो अपसो बभूवुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ ṛbhú-bhyaḥ ǀ dūtám-iva ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣye ǀ upa-stíre ǀ śváitarīm ǀ dhenúm ǀ īḷe ǀyé ǀ vā́ta-jūtāḥ ǀ taráṇi-bhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ pári ǀ dyā́m ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ babhūvúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I send my prayer as a messenger to theṛbhus; I solicit (of them) the cow, the yielder of the white milk, for the dilution (of the Somalibation); for they, as swift as the wind, the doers of good works, were borne quickly across the firmament by rapid steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: I send my prayer as a messenger to theṛbhus; I solicit (of them) the cow, the yielder of the white milk, for the dilution (of the Somalibation); for they, as swift as the wind, the doers of good works, were borne quickly across the firmament by rapid steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदारमक्रन्नृभवः पितृभ्यां परिविष्टी वेषणा दंसनाभिः ।आदिद्देवानामुप सख्यमायंधीरासः पुष्टिमवहन्मनायै ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ áram ǀ ákran ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ pitṛ́-bhyām ǀ pári-viṣṭī ǀ veṣáṇā ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ devā́nām ǀ úpa ǀ sakhyám ǀ āyan ǀ dhī́rāsaḥ ǀ puṣṭím ǀ avahan ǀ manā́yai ǁ
verses.english_translation: When theṛbhus, by honouring their parents with renovated (youth), and by other works, had achieved enough, they thereupon proceeded to the society of the gods, and, considerate, they bring nourishment to the devout (worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: When theṛbhus, by honouring their parents with renovated (youth), and by other works, had achieved enough, they thereupon proceeded to the society of the gods, and, considerate, they bring nourishment to the devout (worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्ये चक्रुः पितरा युवाना सना यूपेव जरणा शयाना ।ते वाजो विभ्वाँ ऋभुरिंद्रवंतो मधुप्सरसो नोऽवंतु यज्ञं ॥
verses.transliteration: púnaḥ ǀ yé ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ pitárā ǀ yúvānā ǀ sánā ǀ yū́pā-iva ǀ jaraṇā́ ǀ śáyānā ǀté ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ índra-vantaḥ ǀ mádhu-psarasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avantu ǀ yajñám ǁ
verses.english_translation: May they who rendered their decrepid and dropsy parents, when, like two dryposts, again perpetually young,Vāja, Vibhavan, andṚbhuassociated with Indra, drinkers of the Somajuice, protect our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May they who rendered their decrepid and dropsy parents, when, like two dryposts, again perpetually young,Vāja, Vibhavan, andṚbhuassociated with Indra, drinkers of the Somajuice, protect our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्संवत्समृभवो गामरक्षन्यत्संवत्समृभवो मा अपिंशन् ।यत्संवत्समभरन्भासो अस्यास्ता��िः शमीभिरमृतत्वमाशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ sam-vátsam ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ árakṣan ǀ yát ǀ sam-vátsam ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ mā́ḥ ǀ ápiṃśan ǀyát ǀ sam-vátsam ǀ abháran ǀ bhā́saḥ ǀ asyāḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ āśuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch as for a year theṚbhuspreserved the (dead) cow, inasmuch as for a year they invested it with flesh, inasmuch as for a year they continued its beauty they obtained by their acts of immortality.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch as for a year theṚbhuspreserved the (dead) cow, inasmuch as for a year they invested it with flesh, inasmuch as for a year they continued its beauty they obtained by their acts of immortality.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठ आह चमसा द्वा करेति कनीयांत्रीन्कृणवामेत्याह ।कनिष्ठ आह चतुरस्करेति त्वष्ट ऋभवस्तत्पनयद्वचो वः ॥
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭháḥ ǀ āha ǀ camasā́ ǀ dvā́ ǀ kara ǀ íti ǀ kánīyān ǀ trī́n ǀ kṛṇavāma ǀ íti ǀ āha ǀkaniṣṭháḥ ǀ āha ǀ catúraḥ ǀ kara ǀ íti ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ tát ǀ panayat ǀ vácaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The eldest said, let us make two ladles; the younger said, let us make three:Tvaṣṭā,Ṛbhus, has applauded your proposal.
verses.wilson_translation: The eldest said, let us make two ladles; the younger said, let us make three:Tvaṣṭā,Ṛbhus, has applauded your proposal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमूचुर्नर एवा हि चक्रुरनु स्वधामृभवो जग्मुरेतां ।विभ्राजमानांश्चमसाँ अहेवावेनत्त्वष्टा चतुरो ददृश्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: satyám ǀ ūcuḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ evá ǀ hí ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ etā́m ǀvi-bhrā́jamānān ǀ camasā́n ǀ áhā-iva ǀ ávenat ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ catúraḥ ǀ dadṛśvā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: The men, (theṚbhus), spoke the truth, for such (ladles) they made, and thereupon the Ṛbhus partook of that libation;Tvaṣṭā, beholding the four ladles, brilliant as day, was content.
verses.wilson_translation: The men, (theṚbhus), spoke the truth, for such (ladles) they made, and thereupon the Ṛbhus partook of that libation;Tvaṣṭā, beholding the four ladles, brilliant as day, was content.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश द्यून्यदगोह्यस्यातिथ्ये रणन्नृभवः ससंतः ।सुक्षेत्राकृण्वन्ननयंत सिंधूंधन्वातिष्ठन्नोषधीर्निम्नमापः ॥
verses.transliteration: dvā́daśa ǀ dyū́n ǀ yát ǀ ágohyasya ǀ ātithyé ǀ ráṇan ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ sasántaḥ ǀsu-kṣétrā ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ ánayanta ǀ síndhūn ǀ dhánva ǀ ā́ ǀ atiṣṭhan ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ nimnám ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When theṚbhus, reposing for twelve days, remained in the hospitality of the uncealable (sun) they rendered the fields fertile, they led forth the rivers, plural nts sprung upon the waste, and waters (spread over) the low (plural ces).
verses.wilson_translation: When theṚbhus, reposing for twelve days, remained in the hospitality of the uncealable (sun) they rendered the fields fertile, they led forth the rivers, plural nts sprung upon the waste, and waters (spread over) the low (plural ces).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं नरेष्ठां ये धेनुं विश्वजुवं विश्वरूपां ।त आ तक्षंत्वृभवो रयिं नः स्ववसः स्वपसः सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: rátham ǀ yé ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ su-vṛ́tam ǀ nare-sthā́m ǀ yé ǀ dhenúm ǀ viśva-júvam ǀ viśvá-rūpām ǀté ǀ ā́ ǀ takṣantu ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǀ su-ávasaḥ ǀ su-ápasaḥ ǀ su-hástāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May thoseṚbhuswho constructed the firm-abiding wheel-conducting car; who formed the all-impelling multiform cow; they who are the bestowers of food, the doers of great deeds, and dexterous ofhand, fabricate our riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May thoseṚbhuswho constructed the firm-abiding wheel-conducting car; who formed the all-impelling multiform cow; they who are the bestowers of food, the doers of great deeds, and dexterous ofhand, fabricate our riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपो ह्येषामजुषंत देवा अभि क्रत्वा मनसा दीध्यानाः ।वाजो देवानामभवत्सुकर्मेंद्रस्य ऋभुक्षा वरुणस्य विभ्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: ápaḥ ǀ hí ǀ eṣām ǀ ájuṣanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ krátvā ǀ mánasā ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǀvā́jaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavat ǀ su-kármā ǀ índrasya ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ ví-bhvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods were plural ased by their works, illustrious in act and in thought;Vājawas the artificer of the gods,Ṛbhukṣinof Indra, Vibhavan of Varuṇa.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods were plural ased by their works, illustrious in act and in thought;Vājawas the artificer of the gods,Ṛbhukṣinof Indra, Vibhavan of Varuṇa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये हरी मेधयोक्था मदंत इंद्राय चक्रुः सुयुजा ये अश्वा ।ते रायस्पोषं द्रविणान्यस्मे धत्त ऋभवः क्षेमयंतो न मित्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ hárī íti ǀ medháyā ǀ ukthā́ ǀ mádantaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ su-yújā ǀ yé ǀ áśvā ǀté ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ asmé íti ǀ dhattá ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ kṣema-yántaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitrám ǁ
verses.english_translation: May thoseṚbhuswho gratified the horses (of Indra) by pious praise, who constructed for Indra his two docile steeds, bestow upon us satiety of riches, and wealth (of cattle), like those who devise prosperity for a friend.
verses.wilson_translation: May thoseṚbhuswho gratified the horses (of Indra) by pious praise, who constructed for Indra his two docile steeds, bestow upon us satiety of riches, and wealth (of cattle), like those who devise prosperity for a friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इदाह्नः पीतिमुत वो मदं धुर्न ऋते श्रांतस्य सख्याय देवाः ।ते नूनमस्मे ऋभवो वसूनि तृतीये अस्मिन्त्सवने दधात ॥
verses.transliteration: idā́ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ pītím ǀ utá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádam ǀ dhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ ṛté ǀ śrāntásya ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀté ǀ nūnám ǀ asmé íti ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ tṛtī́ye ǀ asmín ǀ sávane ǀ dadhāta ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods verily have given you the beverage at the (third sacrifice of the) day, and its exhilarqation, not through regard, but (as the gift of one) wearied out (by penance);Ṛbhus, who are so (eminent), grant us, verily, wealth at this third (diurnal) sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods verily have given you the beverage at the (third sacrifice of the) day, and its exhilarqation, not through regard, but (as the gift of one) wearied out (by penance);Ṛbhus, who are so (eminent), grant us, verily, wealth at this third (diurnal) sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIV. Ṛbhus.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To this our sacrifice come Ṛbhu, Vibhvan, Vāja, and Indra with the gift of riches,Because this day hath Dhiṣaṇā the Goddess set drink for you: the gladdening draughts have reached you. Knowing your birth and rich in gathered treasure, Ṛbhus, rejoice together with the Ṛtus.The gladdening draughts and wisdom have approached you: send ye us riches with good store of heroes. For you was made this sacrifice, O Ṛbhus, which ye, like men, won for yourselves aforetime.To you come all who find in you their pleasure: ye all were—even the two elder—Vājas. Now for the mortal worshipper, O Heroes, for him who served you, was the gift of riches.Drink, Vājas, Ṛbhus! unto you is offered, to gladden you, the third and great libation. Come to us, Heroes, Vājas and Ṛbhukṣans, glorified for the sake of mighty treasure.These draughts approach you as the day is closing, as cows, whose calves are newly-born, their stable. Come to this sacrifice of ours, ye Children of Strength, invoked with humble adoration.Drink of this meath, Wealth-givers, joined with Indra with whom ye are in full accord, ye Princes. Close knit with Varuṇa drink the Soma, Indra; close-knit, Hymn-lover! with the Maruts drink it:Close-knit with drinkers first, who drink in season; close-knit with heavenly Dames who give us treasures. Rejoice in full accord with the Ādityas, in concord with the Parvatas, O Ṛbhus;In full accord with Savitar, Divine One; in full accord with floods that pour forth riches. Ṛbhus, who helped their Parents and the Aśvins, who formed the Milch-cow and the pair of horses,Made armour, set the heaven and earth asunder,—far- reaching Heroes, they have made good offspring. Ye who have wealth in cattle and in booty, in heroes, in rich sustenance and treasure,Such, O ye Ṛbhus, first to drink, rejoicing, give unto us and those who laud our present. Ye were not far: we have not left you thirsting, blameless in this our sacrifice, O Ṛbhus.Rejoice you with the Maruts and with Indra, with the Kings, Gods! that ye may give us riches.

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुर्विभ्वा वाज इंद्रो नो अच्छेमं यज्ञं रत्नधेयोप यात ।इदा हि वो धिषणा देव्यह्नामधात्पीतिं सं मदा अग्मता वः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ ratna-dhéyā ǀ úpa ǀ yāta ǀidā́ ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ devī́ ǀ áhnām ǀ ádhāt ǀ pītím ǀ sám ǀ mádāḥ ǀ agmata ǀ vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṛbhu, Vibhvan,Vājaand Indra, do you come to this our sacrifice, to distribute the precious things, for the divine work has indeed now desired the drinking (of the Soma) on the (appointed hours of the) days; therefore the exhilarating draughts are collected for you.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛbhu, Vibhvan,Vājaand Indra, do you come to this our sacrifice, to distribute the precious things, for the divine work has indeed now desired the drinking (of the Soma) on the (appointed hours of the) days; therefore the exhilarating draughts are collected for you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विदानासो जन्मनो वाजरत्ना उत ऋतुभिर्ऋभवो मादयध्वं ।सं वो मदा अग्मत सं पुरंधिः सुवीरामस्मे रयिमेरयध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: vidānā́saḥ ǀ jánmanaḥ ǀ vāja-ratnāḥ ǀ utá ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mādayadhvam ǀsám ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāḥ ǀ ágmata ǀ sám ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ su-vī́rām ǀ asmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ ā́ ǀ īrayadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Resplendent with (sacrificial) food, prescient of your (celestial) birth, be exhilarated,Ṛbhusalong with the Ṛtus; the inebriating draughts are collected for you as well as pious praise; do you confer upon us riches with excellent posterity.
verses.wilson_translation: Resplendent with (sacrificial) food, prescient of your (celestial) birth, be exhilarated,Ṛbhusalong with the Ṛtus; the inebriating draughts are collected for you as well as pious praise; do you confer upon us riches with excellent posterity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं वो यज्ञ ऋभवोऽकारि यमा मनुष्वत्प्रदिवो दधिध्वे ।प्र वोऽच्छा जुजुषाणासो अस्थुरभूत विश्वे अग्रियोत वाजाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ vaḥ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ akāri ǀ yám ǀ ā́ ǀ manuṣvát ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ dadhidhvé ǀprá ǀ vaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ jujuṣāṇā́saḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ ábhūta ǀ víśve ǀ agriyā́ ǀ utá ǀ vājāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This sacrifice,Ṛbhus, has been instrumental tuted for you, who are eminently resplendent, which you have accepted after the manner of men; before you have the propitiatory (libations) been plural ced, for Vājas, you are all entitled to precedence.
verses.wilson_translation: This sacrifice,Ṛbhus, has been instrumental tuted for you, who are eminently resplendent, which you have accepted after the manner of men; before you have the propitiatory (libations) been plural ced, for Vājas, you are all entitled to precedence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभूदु वो विधते रत्नधेयमिदा नरो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।पिबत वाजा ऋभवो ददे वो महि तृतीयं सवनं मदाय ॥
verses.transliteration: ábhūt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ vidhaté ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ idā́ ǀ naraḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀpíbata ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ dadé ǀ vaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ sávanam ǀ mádāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Now, leaders (of rites), the treasure that ought to be presented is to be given to the mortqal performing (the sacred rite), the offerer (of the libation); drink,Vājas(drink),Ṛbhus; I present it to you at the third solemn (diurnal) ceremony for your exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Now, leaders (of rites), the treasure that ought to be presented is to be given to the mortqal performing (the sacred rite), the offerer (of the libation); drink,Vājas(drink),Ṛbhus; I present it to you at the third solemn (diurnal) ceremony for your exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वाजा यातोप न ऋभुक्षा महो नरो द्रविणसो गृणानाः ।आ वः पीतयोऽभिपित्वे अह्नामिमा अस्तं नवस्व इव ग्मन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ yāta ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣāḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ naraḥ ǀ dráviṇasaḥ ǀ gṛṇānā́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ pītáyaḥ ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ áhnām ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ástam ǀ navasváḥ-iva ǀ gman ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vājas, Ṛbhukṣans, leaders (of rites), come to us eulogizing exceeding wealth; these draughts (of Soma) proceed to you at the decline of day, like newly-delivered cows to their stalls.
verses.wilson_translation: Vājas, Ṛbhukṣans, leaders (of rites), come to us eulogizing exceeding wealth; these draughts (of Soma) proceed to you at the decline of day, like newly-delivered cows to their stalls.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नपातः शवसो यातनोपेमं यज्ञं नमसा हूयमानाः ।सजोषसः सूरयो यस्य च स्थ मध्वः पात रत्नधा इंद्रवंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ napātaḥ ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ yātana ǀ úpa ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ námasā ǀ hūyámānāḥ ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ sūrayaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ ca ǀ sthá ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pāta ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ índra-vantaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sons of strength, come to this sacrifice, invoked with veneration; givers of precious things, associated with Indra, with whom you are intelligent, participate in being gratified (by the libation), drink ofthe sweet Somajuice.
verses.wilson_translation: Sons of strength, come to this sacrifice, invoked with veneration; givers of precious things, associated with Indra, with whom you are intelligent, participate in being gratified (by the libation), drink ofthe sweet Somajuice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सजोषा इंद्र वरुणेन सोमं सजोषाः पाहि गिर्वणो मरुद्भिः ।अग्रेपाभिर्ऋतुपाभिः सजोषा ग्नास्पत्नीभी रत्नधाभिः सजोषाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ indra ǀ váruṇena ǀ sómam ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀagre-pā́bhiḥ ǀ ṛtu-pā́bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ gnā́ḥpátnībhiḥ ǀ ratna-dhā́bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sympathizing in satisfaction with Varuṇa, drink,Indra, the Somajuice; drink it, you who are entitled to praise, sympathizing with the Maruts; drink, sympathizing with the first drinkers, with the drinkers (at the sacriices) of the Ṛtus; sympathizing with the protectresses of the wives (of the gods), the giver of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Sympathizing in satisfaction with Varuṇa, drink,Indra, the Somajuice; drink it, you who are entitled to praise, sympathizing with the Maruts; drink, sympathizing with the first drinkers, with the drinkers (at the sacriices) of the Ṛtus; sympathizing with the protectresses of the wives (of the gods), the giver of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सजोषस आदित्यैर्मादयध्वं सजोषस ऋभवः पर्वतेभिः ।सजोषसो दैव्येना सवित्रा सजोषसः सिंधुभी रत्नधेभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ mādayadhvam ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ párvatebhiḥ ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ dáivyena ǀ savitrā́ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ síndhu-bhiḥ ǀ ratna-dhébhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṛbhus, be exhilarated, sympathizing with theĀdityas, sympathizing with the Parvatas, sympathizing with the divine Savitā, sympathizing with the wealth-bestowing (deities of the) rivers.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛbhus, be exhilarated, sympathizing with theĀdityas, sympathizing with the Parvatas, sympathizing with the divine Savitā, sympathizing with the wealth-bestowing (deities of the) rivers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये अश्विना ये पितरा य ऊती धेनुं ततक्षुर्ऋभवो ये अश्वा ।ये अंसत्रा य ऋधग्रोदसी ये विभ्वो नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ aśvínā ǀ yé ǀ pitárā ǀ yé ǀ ūtī́ ǀ dhenúm ǀ tatakṣúḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ yé ǀ áśvā ǀyé ǀ áṃsatrā ǀ yé ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ ródasī íti ǀ yé ǀ ví-bhvaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ su-apatyā́ni ǀ cakrúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṛbhus, who by your assistance (gratiied) the Aśvins, who (renovated your) parents, who (restored) the cow, who fabricated the horses, who made armour (for the gods), who separated earth and heaven, and who, the all-pervading leaders (of rites), accomplished (acts productive of) good results.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛbhus, who by your assistance (gratiied) the Aśvins, who (renovated your) parents, who (restored) the cow, who fabricated the horses, who made armour (for the gods), who separated earth and heaven, and who, the all-pervading leaders (of rites), accomplished (acts productive of) good results.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये गोमंतं वाजवंतं सुवीरं रयिं धत्थ वसुमंतं पुरुक्षुं ।ते अग्रेपा ऋभवो मंदसाना अस्मे धत्त ये च रातिं गृणंति ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ gó-mantam ǀ vā́ja-vantam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ rayím ǀ dhatthá ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀté ǀ agre-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ dhatta ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ rātím ǀ gṛṇánti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṛbhus, who posses wealth, comprising cattle, food, progeny, dwellings, and abundant sustenance, do you, who are the first drinkers (of the Soma), bestow upon us, when exhilarated, (that wealth and upon those) who laud your liberality.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛbhus, who posses wealth, comprising cattle, food, progeny, dwellings, and abundant sustenance, do you, who are the first drinkers (of the Soma), bestow upon us, when exhilarated, (that wealth and upon those) who laud your liberality.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नापाभूत न वोऽतीतृषामानिःशस्ता ऋभवो यज्ञे अस्मिन् ।समिंद्रेण मदथ सं मरुद्भिः सं राजभी रत्नधेयाय देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ ápa ǀ abhūta ǀ ná ǀ vaḥ ǀ atītṛṣāma ǀ ániḥ-śastāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǀsám ǀ índreṇa ǀ mádatha ǀ sám ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ ratna-dhéyāya ǀ devāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṛbhus, go not away; let us not leave you (thirsting); (be present) unreproached at this sacrifice; be exhilarated, deities, along with Indra, with the Maruts, and with (other) brilliant (divinities), for the distribution of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛbhus, go not away; let us not leave you (thirsting); (be present) unreproached at this sacrifice; be exhilarated, deities, along with Indra, with the Maruts, and with (other) brilliant (divinities), for the distribution of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXV. Ṛbhus.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Come hither, O ye Sons of Strength, ye Ṛbhus; stay not afar, ye Children of Sudhanvan.At this libation is your gift of treasure. Let gladdening draughts approach you after Indra's. Hither is come the Ṛbhus' gift of riches; here was the drinking of the well-pressed Soma,Since by dexterity and skill as craftsmen ye made the single chalice to be fourfold Ye made fourfold the chalice that wag single: ye spake these words and said, O Friend, assist us;Then, Vājas! gained the path of life eternal, deft-handed Ṛbhus, to the Gods’ assembly. Out of what substance was that chalice fashioned which ye made fourfold by your art and wisdom?Now for the gladdening draught press out the liquor, and drink, O Ṛbhus, of die meath of Soma. Ye with your cunning made your Parents youthful; the cup, for Gods to drink, ye formed with cunning;With cunning, Ṛbhus, rich in treasure, fashioned the two swift Tawny Steeds who carry Indra. Whoso pours out for you, when days are closing, the sharp libation for your joy, O Vājas,For him, O mighty Ṛbhus, ye, rejoicing, have fashioned wealth with plenteous store of heroes. Lord of Bay Steeds, at dawn the juice thou drankest: thine, only thine, is the noonday libation.Now drink thou with the wealth-bestowing Ṛbhus, whom for their skill thou madest friends, O Indra. Ye, whom your artist skill hath raised to Godhead have set you down above in heaven like falcons.So give us riches, Children of Sudhanvan, O Sons of Strength; ye have become immortal. The third libation, that bestoweth treasure, which ye have won by skill, ye dexterous-handed,—This drink hath been effused for you, O Ṛbhus . drink it with high delight, with joy like Indra's.

verses.sanskrit: इहोप यात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना ऋभवो माप भूत ।अस्मिन्हि वः सवने रत्नधेयं गमंत्विंद्रमनु वो मदासः ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ úpa ǀ yāta ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ napātaḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápa ǀ bhūta ǀasmín ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ sávane ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ gámantu ǀ índram ǀ ánu ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come hither, sons of strength, sons of Sudhanvan;Ṛbhus, keep not away; may the exhilarating juices proceed to you at this sacrifice, after the munificent Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Come hither, sons of strength, sons of Sudhanvan;Ṛbhus, keep not away; may the exhilarating juices proceed to you at this sacrifice, after the munificent Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आगन्नृभूणामिह रत्नधेयमभूत्सोमस्य सुषुतस्य पीतिः ।सुकृत्यया यत्स्वपस्यया चँ एकं विचक्र चमसं चतुर्धा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agan ǀ ṛbhūṇā́m ǀ ihá ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ ábhūt ǀ sómasya ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ pītíḥ ǀsu-kṛtyáyā ǀ yát ǀ su-apasyáyā ǀ ca ǀ ékam ǀ vi-cakrá ǀ camasám ǀ catuḥ-dhā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The munificene of theṚbhuscome to me on this occasion, (since) there has been the drinking of the effused Soma, in consequence of one ladle having been made fourfold by their dexterous and excellent work.
verses.wilson_translation: The munificene of theṚbhuscome to me on this occasion, (since) there has been the drinking of the effused Soma, in consequence of one ladle having been made fourfold by their dexterous and excellent work.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्यकृणोत चमसं चतुर्धा सखे वि शिक्षेत्यब्रवीत ।अथैत वाजा अमृतस्य पंथां गणं देवानामृभवः सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ akṛṇota ǀ camasám ǀ catuḥ-dhā́ ǀ sákhe ǀ ví ǀ śikṣa ǀ íti ǀ abravīta ǀátha ǀ aita ǀ vājāḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ pánthām ǀ gaṇám ǀ devā́nām ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ su-hastāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have made the ladle fourfold, and have said (to Agni), assent (to the division); therefore have you gone,Vājas, the path of the immortals; dexterous-handedṚbhus(you have joined) the company of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: You have made the ladle fourfold, and have said (to Agni), assent (to the division); therefore have you gone,Vājas, the path of the immortals; dexterous-handedṚbhus(you have joined) the company of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: किम्मयः स्विच्चमस एष आस यं काव्येन चतुरो विचक्र ।अथा सुनुध्वं सवनं मदाय पात ऋभवो मधुनः सोम्यस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: kim-máyaḥ ǀ svit ǀ camasáḥ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ āsa ǀ yám ǀ kā́vyena ǀ catúraḥ ǀ vi-cakrá ǀátha ǀ sunudhvam ǀ sávanam ǀ mádāya ǀ pātá ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ somyásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: What sort of ladle was that which by skill you have made four? now pour forth the Somafor their exhilaration; drink,Ṛbhus, of the sweet Soma libation.
verses.wilson_translation: What sort of ladle was that which by skill you have made four? now pour forth the Somafor their exhilaration; drink,Ṛbhus, of the sweet Soma libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शच्याकर्त पितरा युवाना शच्याकर्त चमसं देवपानं ।शच्या हरी धनुतरावतष्टेंद्रवाहावृभवो वाजरत्नाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śácyā ǀ akarta ǀ pitárā ǀ yúvānā ǀ śácyā ǀ akarta ǀ camasám ǀ deva-pā́nam ǀśácyā ǀ hárī íti ǀ dhánu-tarau ǀ ataṣṭa ǀ indra-vā́hau ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ vāja-ratnāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By your (marvellous) deeds you have made your parents youg; by your deeds you have made the ladle (fit) for the drinking of the gods; by your deeds you have made the two horses, the bearers of Indra, swifter than (an arrow from) a bow,Ṛbhus, who are rich in (sacrificial) food.
verses.wilson_translation: By your (marvellous) deeds you have made your parents youg; by your deeds you have made the ladle (fit) for the drinking of the gods; by your deeds you have made the two horses, the bearers of Indra, swifter than (an arrow from) a bow,Ṛbhus, who are rich in (sacrificial) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वः सुनोत्यभिपित्वे अह्नां तीव्रं वाजासः सवनं मदाय ।तस्मै रयिमृभवः सर्ववीरमा तक्षत वृषणो मंदसानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ sunóti ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ áhnām ǀ tīvrám ǀ vājāsaḥ ǀ sávanam ǀ mádāya ǀtásmai ǀ rayím ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ ā́ ǀ takṣata ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Distributors of food,Ṛbhus, showerers (of benefits), exhilarated (by the Somadraught), fabricated wealth, comprising all posterity for him who pours out for your exhilaration, the acrid libation at the deline of day.
verses.wilson_translation: Distributors of food,Ṛbhus, showerers (of benefits), exhilarated (by the Somadraught), fabricated wealth, comprising all posterity for him who pours out for your exhilaration, the acrid libation at the deline of day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः सुतमपिबो हर्यश्व माध्यंदिनं सवनं केवलं ते ।समृभुभिः पिबस्व रत्नधेभिः सखीँर्याँ इंद्र चकृषे सुकृत्या ॥
verses.transliteration: prātáríti ǀ sutám ǀ apibaḥ ǀ hari-aśva ǀ mā́dhyandinam ǀ sávanam ǀ kévalam ǀ te ǀsám ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ pibasva ǀ ratna-dhébhiḥ ǀ sákhīn ǀ yā́n ǀ indra ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ su-kṛtyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink, lord of horses,Indra, the libation offered at dawn; the noon-day libation is alone for you; but (in the evening) drink with the munificentṚbhus, whom, Indra, you have made your friends by good deeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink, lord of horses,Indra, the libation offered at dawn; the noon-day libation is alone for you; but (in the evening) drink with the munificentṚbhus, whom, Indra, you have made your friends by good deeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये देवासो अभवता सुकृत्या श्येना इवेदधि दिवि निषेद ।ते रत्नं धात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना अभवतामृतासः ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ábhavata ǀ su-kṛtyā́ ǀ śyenā́ḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ ádhi ǀ diví ǀ ni-sedá ǀté ǀ rátnam ǀ dhāta ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ napātaḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ ábhavata ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, sons of strength, who have become gods by (your) good deeds, soaring aloft in the sky like falcons, bestow upon us riches; sons of Sudhanvan, you have become immortals.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, sons of strength, who have become gods by (your) good deeds, soaring aloft in the sky like falcons, bestow upon us riches; sons of Sudhanvan, you have become immortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्तृतीयं सवनं रत्नधेयमकृणुध्वं स्वपस्या सुहस्ताः ।तदृभवः परिषिक्तं व एतत्सं मदेभिरिंद्रियेभिः पिबध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ sávanam ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ ákṛṇudhvam ǀ su-apasyā́ ǀ su-hastāḥ ǀtát ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ pári-siktam ǀ vaḥ ǀ etát ǀ sám ǀ mádebhiḥ ǀ indriyébhiḥ ǀ pibadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Dexterous-handed, since you have instrumental tuted, through desire of good works, the third sacrifice, which is the bestower of wealth, therefore,Ṛbhus, drink this effused Somawith exhilarated senseṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Dexterous-handed, since you have instrumental tuted, through desire of good works, the third sacrifice, which is the bestower of wealth, therefore,Ṛbhus, drink this effused Somawith exhilarated senseṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVI. Ṛbhus.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE car that was not made for horses or for reins, three-wheeled, worthy of lauds, rolls round the firmament.That is the great announcement of your Deity, that, O ye Ṛbhus, ye sustain the earth and heaven. Ye Sapient Ones who made the lightly-rolling car out of your mind, by thought, the car that never errs,You, being such, to drink of this drink-offering, you, O ye Vājas, and ye Ṛbhus, we invoke. O Vājas, Ṛbhus, reaching far, among the Gods this was your exaltation gloriously declared,In that your aged Parents, worn with length of days, ye wrought again to youth so that they moved at will. The chalice that wag single ye have made fourfold, and by your wisdom brought the Cow forth from the hide.So quickly, mid the Gods, ye gained immortal life. Vājas and Ṛbhus, your great work must be extolled. Wealth from the Ṛbhus is most glorious in renown, that which the Heroes, famed for vigour, have produced.In synods must be sung the car which Vibhvan wrought: that which ye favour, Gods! is famed among mankind. Strong is the steed, the man a sage in eloquence, the bowman is a hero hard to beat in fight,Great store of wealth and manly power hath he obtained whom Vāja, Vibhvan, Ṛbhus have looked kindly on. To you hath been assigned the fairest ornament, the hymn of praise: Vājas and Ṛbhus, joy therein;For ye have lore and wisdom and poetic skill: as such, with this our prayer we call on you to come. According to the wishes of our hearts may ye, who have full knowledge of all the delights of men,Fashion for us, O Ṛbhus, power and splendid wealth, rich in high courage, excellent, and vital strength. Bestowing on us here riches and offspring, here fashion fame for us befitting heroes.Vouchsafe us wealth of splendid sort, O Ṛbhus, that we may make us more renowned than others.

verses.sanskrit: अनश्वो जातो अनभीशुरुक्थ्यो रथस्त्रिचक्रः परि वर्तते रजः ।महत्तद्वो देव्यस्य प्रवाचनं द्यामृभवः पृथिवीं यच्च पुष्यथ ॥
verses.transliteration: anaśváḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ anabhīśúḥ ǀ ukthyáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ tri-cakráḥ ǀ pári ǀ vartate ǀ rájaḥ ǀmahát ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ devyásya ǀ pra-vā́canam ǀ dyā́m ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ púṣyatha ǁ
verses.english_translation: The glorious three-wheeled car (of the Aśvinsmade,Ṛbhusby you) traverses the firmament without horses, without reins; great was that proclamation of your divine (power), by which, Ṛbhus, you cherish heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: The glorious three-wheeled car (of the Aśvinsmade,Ṛbhusby you) traverses the firmament without horses, without reins; great was that proclamation of your divine (power), by which, Ṛbhus, you cherish heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं सुचेतसोऽविह्वरंतं मनसस्परि ध्यया ।ताँ ऊ न्वस्य सवनस्य पीतय आ वो वाजा ऋभवो वेदयामसि ॥
