verses.english_translation: To you, radiant Agni, lord of light, giver of plural asure, destroyer (of foes), protector of man, the bearer of oblations, to you the oblation is offered with the sacred verse; do you bring to your adorers.
verses.wilson_translation: To you, radiant Agni, lord of light, giver of plural asure, destroyer (of foes), protector of man, the bearer of oblations, to you the oblation is offered with the sacred verse; do you bring to your adorers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रो त्ये अग्नयोऽग्निषु विश्वं पुष्यंति वार्यं ।ते हिन्विरे त इन्विरे त इषण्यंत्यानुषगिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: pró íti ǀ tyé ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ agníṣu ǀ víśvam ǀ puṣyanti ǀ vā́ryam ǀté ǀ hinvire ǀ té ǀ invire ǀ té ǀ iṣaṇyanti ǀ ānuṣák ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: These fires cherish all that is precious in the fires (of sacrifice); they give delight; they spread abroad; they crave perpetually (sacrificial) food; bring,Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.wilson_translation: These fires cherish all that is precious in the fires (of sacrifice); they give delight; they spread abroad; they crave perpetually (sacrificial) food; bring,Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव त्ये अग्ने अर्चयो महि व्राधंत वाजिनः ।ये पत्वभिः शफानां व्रजा भुरंत गोनामिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ agne ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ vrādhanta ǀ vājínaḥ ǀyé ǀ pátva-bhiḥ ǀ śaphā́nām ǀ vrajā́ ǀ bhuránta ǀ gónām ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: These your flames Agni, fed with abundant food, increase, as, by their descent, they seek the pastures of the hoofed cattle; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.wilson_translation: These your flames Agni, fed with abundant food, increase, as, by their descent, they seek the pastures of the hoofed cattle; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नवा नो अग्न आ भर स्तोतृभ्यः सुक्षितीरिषः ।ते स्याम य आनृचुस्त्वादूतासो दमेदम इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: návāḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ su-kṣitī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀté ǀ syāma ǀ yé ǀ ānṛcúḥ ǀ tvā́-dūtāsaḥ ǀ dáme-dame ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to us who praise you, new dwellings, and (abundant) food; may we be those who worship you having you for a messenger (to the gods) in every house; bring Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to us who praise you, new dwellings, and (abundant) food; may we be those who worship you having you for a messenger (to the gods) in every house; bring Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उभे सुश्चंद्र सर्पिषो दर्वी श्रीणीष आसनि ।उतो न उत्पुपूर्या उक्थेषु शवसस्पत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ su-candra ǀ sarpíṣaḥ ǀ dárvī íti ǀ śrīṇīṣe ǀ āsáni ǀutó íti ǀ naḥ ǀ út ǀ pupūryāḥ ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Giver of delight, you receive into your mouth the two ladles (full) of butter; so may you fulfil (our desires), lord of strength, at our solemn rites; bring,Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.wilson_translation: Giver of delight, you receive into your mouth the two ladles (full) of butter; so may you fulfil (our desires), lord of strength, at our solemn rites; bring,Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवाँ अग्निमजुर्यमुर्गीर्भिर्यज्ञेभिरानुषक् ।दधदस्मे सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यमिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ agním ǀ ajuryamuḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀdádhat ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ utá ǀ tyát ǀ āśu-áśvyam ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus have they repaired to Agniwith praises and with sacrifices successively, and have established (the manner of his worship); and he has given usmaledescendants, and wealth of fleet horses; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.wilson_translation: Thus have they repaired to Agniwith praises and with sacrifices successively, and have established (the manner of his worship); and he has given usmaledescendants, and wealth of fleet horses; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . OFFER to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly praise;To him supremest o’er the folk, the Son of Strength, the mighty Lord: Him in whose presence, when they meet in full assembly, men rejoice;Even him whom worthy ones inflame, and living creatures bring to life. When we present to him the food and sacrificial gifts of men,He by the might of splendour grasps the holy Ordinance's rein. He gives a signal in the night even to him who is afar,When he, the Bright, unchanged by eld, consumes the sovrans of the wood. He in whose service on the ways they offer up their drops of sweat,On him is their high kin have they mounted, as ridges on the earth. Whom, sought of many, mortal man hath found to be the Stay of all;He who gives flavour to our food, the home of every man that lives. Even as a herd that crops the grass he shears the field and wilderness,With flashing teeth and beard of gold, deft with his unabated might. For him, to whom, bright as an axe he, as to Atri, hath flashed forth,Hath the well-bearing Mother borne, producing when her time is come. Agni to whom the oil is shed by him thou lovest to support,Bestow upon these mortals fame and splendour and intelligence. Such zeal hath he, resistless one: he gained the cattle given by thee.Agni, may Atri overcome the Dasyus who bestow no gifts, subdue the men who give no food.

verses.sanskrit: सखायः सं वः सम्यंचमिषं स्तोमं चाग्नये ।वर्षिष्ठाय क्षितीनामूर्जो नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ vaḥ ǀ samyáñcam ǀ íṣam ǀ stómam ǀ ca ǀ agnáye ǀvárṣiṣṭhāya ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ náptre ǀ sáhasvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Friends, offer fitting praise and food to Agni, the most liberal benefactor of men, the powerful son of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Friends, offer fitting praise and food to Agni, the most liberal benefactor of men, the powerful son of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कुत्रा चिद्यस्य समृतौ रण्वा नरो नृषदने ।अर्हंतश्चिद्यमिंधते संजनयंति जंतवः ॥
verses.transliteration: kútra ǀ cit ǀ yásya ǀ sám-ṛtau ǀ raṇvā́ḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ nṛ-sádane ǀárhantaḥ ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ indhaté ǀ sam-janáyanti ǀ jantávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where is (the deity) upon whose presence the rejoicing conductors (of the ceremony) are offering homage in the hall of sacrifice, (he) whom they kindle, and living beings genitive rate.
verses.wilson_translation: Where is (the deity) upon whose presence the rejoicing conductors (of the ceremony) are offering homage in the hall of sacrifice, (he) whom they kindle, and living beings genitive rate.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सं यदिषो वनामहे सं हव्या मानुषाणां ।उत द्युम्नस्य शवस ऋतस्य रश्मिमा ददे ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ vánāmahe ǀ sám ǀ havyā́ ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀutá ǀ dyumnásya ǀ śávasā ǀ ṛtásya ǀ raśmím ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
verses.english_translation: When we present to him (sacrificial food), when (he accepts) the oblations of men, then the power of the brilliant (viands), he assumes the radiance of the rite.
verses.wilson_translation: When we present to him (sacrificial food), when (he accepts) the oblations of men, then the power of the brilliant (viands), he assumes the radiance of the rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स स्मा कृणोति केतुमा नक्तं चिद्दूर आ सते ।पावको यद्वनस्पतीन्प्र स्मा मिनात्यजरः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sma ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ ketúm ǀ ā́ ǀ náktam ǀ cit ǀ dūré ǀ ā́ ǀ saté ǀpāvakáḥ ǀ yát ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ prá ǀ sma ǀ minā́ti ǀ ajáraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily he gives a signal by night to one who is far off, when he, the purifier, the undecaying, consumes the forest lords.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily he gives a signal by night to one who is far off, when he, the purifier, the undecaying, consumes the forest lords.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव स्म यस्य वेषणे स्वेदं पथिषु जुह्वति ।अभीमह स्वजेन्यं भूमा पृष्ठेव रुरुहुः ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ sma ǀ yásya ǀ véṣaṇe ǀ svédam ǀ pathíṣu ǀ júhvati ǀabhí ǀ īm ǀ áha ǀ svá-jenyam ǀ bhū́ma ǀ pṛṣṭhā́-iva ǀ ruruhuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: At whose worship (the priests) pour the dripping (butter) upon the flames, and (the drops) mount upon the fire as if they were its own numerous offspring, as (boys ride) upon the back (of a father).
verses.wilson_translation: At whose worship (the priests) pour the dripping (butter) upon the flames, and (the drops) mount upon the fire as if they were its own numerous offspring, as (boys ride) upon the back (of a father).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं मर्त्यः पुरुस्पृहं विदद्विश्वस्य धायसे ।प्र स्वादनं पितूनामस्ततातिं चिदायवे ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ vidát ǀ víśvasya ǀ dhā́yase ǀprá ǀ svā́danam ǀ pitūnā́m ǀ ásta-tātim ǀ cit ǀ āyáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him who is the desired of many, the (devout) man recognizes as the sustainer of all, the flavour of food, the provider of dwellings for men.
verses.wilson_translation: Him who is the desired of many, the (devout) man recognizes as the sustainer of all, the flavour of food, the provider of dwellings for men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा धन्वाक्षितं दाता न दात्या पशुः ।हिरिश्मश्रुः शुचिदन्नृभुरनिभृष्टतविषिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ dhánva ǀ ā́-kṣitam ǀ dā́tā ǀ ná ǀ dā́ti ǀ ā́ ǀ paśúḥ ǀhíri-śmaśruḥ ǀ śúci-dan ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ ánibhṛṣṭa-taviṣiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He crops the dry ground strewn (with grass and wood), like an animal grazing; he with a golden beard, with shining teeth, vast, and of irresistible strength.
verses.wilson_translation: He crops the dry ground strewn (with grass and wood), like an animal grazing; he with a golden beard, with shining teeth, vast, and of irresistible strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुचिः ष्म यस्मा अत्रिवत्प्र स्वधितीव रीयते ।सुषूरसूत माता क्राणा यदानशे भगं ॥
verses.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ sma ǀ yásmai ǀ atri-vát ǀ prá ǀ svádhitiḥ-iva ǀ rī́yate ǀsu-sū́ḥ ǀ asūta ǀ mātā́ ǀ krāṇā́ ǀ yát ǀ ānaśé ǀ bhágam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bright as an axe is he to whom the (worshipper), like Atri, proceeds (to offer worship); he whom his prolific mother has brought forth, bestowing (a benefactor on the world), when (Agni) obtains (sacrificial) food.
verses.wilson_translation: Bright as an axe is he to whom the (worshipper), like Atri, proceeds (to offer worship); he whom his prolific mother has brought forth, bestowing (a benefactor on the world), when (Agni) obtains (sacrificial) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यस्ते सर्पिरासुतेऽग्ने शमस्ति धायसे ।ऐषु द्युम्नमुत श्रव आ चित्तं मर्त्येषु धाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sarpiḥ-āsute ǀ ágne ǀ śám ǀ ásti ǀ dhā́yase ǀā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ dyumnám ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cittám ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To you,Agni, the accepter of the oblation, the upholder (of all), there is plural asure (from our praise); do you bestow upon these your worshippers wealth, and food and a heart (grateful for your favour).
verses.wilson_translation: To you,Agni, the accepter of the oblation, the upholder (of all), there is plural asure (from our praise); do you bestow upon these your worshippers wealth, and food and a heart (grateful for your favour).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इति चिन्मन्युमध्रिजस्त्वादातमा पशुं ददे ।आदग्ने अपृणतोऽत्रिः सासह्याद्दस्यूनिषः सासह्यान्नॄन् ॥
verses.transliteration: íti ǀ cit ǀ manyúm ǀ adhríjaḥ ǀ tvā́-dātam ǀ ā́ ǀ paśúm ǀ dade ǀā́t ǀ agne ǀ ápṛṇataḥ ǀ átriḥ ǀ sasahyāt ǀ dásyūn ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ sasahyāt ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the sage who is in this manner the offerer of exclusive praise (Agni, to you), accept the cattle which are to be given to you; and thereupon may Atriovercome (hostile) men.
verses.wilson_translation: May the sage who is in this manner the offerer of exclusive praise (Agni, to you), accept the cattle which are to be given to you; and thereupon may Atriovercome (hostile) men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O AGNI urged to strength, the men of old who loved the Law enkindled thee,the Ancient, for their aid,Thee very bright, and holy, nourisher of all, most excellent, the Friend and Master of the home. Thee, Agni, men have stablished as their guest of old, as Master of the household, thee, with hair of flame;High-bannered, multiform, distributor of wealth, kind helper, good protector, drier of the floods. The tribes of men praise thee, Agni, who knowest well burnt offerings, the Discerner, lavishest of wealth,Dwelling in secret, Blest One! visible to all, loud-roaring, skilled in worship, glorified with oil. Ever to thee, O Agni, as exceeding strong have we drawn nigh with songs and reverence singing hymns.So be thou pleased with us, Aṅgiras! as a God enkindled by the noble with man's goodly light. Thou, Agni! multiform, God who art lauded much! givest in every house subsistence as of old.Thou rulest by thy might o’er food of many a sort: that light of thine when blazing may not be opposed. The Gods, Most Youthful Agni, have made thee, inflamed, the bearer of oblations and the messenger.Thee, widely-reaching, homed in sacred oil, invoked, effulgent, have they made the Eye that stirs the thought. Men seeking joy have lit thee worshipped from of old, O Agni, with good fuel and with sacred oil.So thou, bedewed and waxing mighty by the plants, spreadest thyself abroad over the realms of earth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्न ऋतायवः समीधिरे प्रत्नं प्रत्नास ऊतये सहस्कृत ।पुरुश्चंद्रं यजतं विश्वधायसं दमूनसं गृहपतिं वरेण्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ ṛta-yávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀ pratnám ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǀpuru-candrám ǀ yajatám ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǀ dámūnasam ǀ gṛhá-patim ǀ váreṇyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Manifest of strength,Agni, ancient worshippers have kindled you of old for their preservation; you, the delighter of many, the adorable, the all-sustaining, the lowly-minded, the lord of the house, the excellent.
verses.wilson_translation: Manifest of strength,Agni, ancient worshippers have kindled you of old for their preservation; you, the delighter of many, the adorable, the all-sustaining, the lowly-minded, the lord of the house, the excellent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने अतिथिं पूर्व्यं विशः शोचिष्केशं गृहपतिं नि षेदिरे ।बृहत्केतुं पुरुरूपं धनस्पृतं सुशर्माणं स्ववसं जरद्विषं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ átithim ǀ pūrvyám ǀ víśaḥ ǀ śocíḥ-keśam ǀ gṛhá-patim ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǀbṛhát-ketum ǀ puru-rū́pam ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ su-śármāṇam ǀ su-ávasam ǀ jarat-víṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men have established you, (Agni), their ancient guest, as the lord of the house; (you), the blazing-haired, the vast bannered, the multiform, the dispenser of wealth, the bestower of happiness, the kind protector, the destruction of decaying (trees).
verses.wilson_translation: Men have established you, (Agni), their ancient guest, as the lord of the house; (you), the blazing-haired, the vast bannered, the multiform, the dispenser of wealth, the bestower of happiness, the kind protector, the destruction of decaying (trees).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने मानुषीरीळते विशो होत्राविदं विविचिं रत्नधातमं ।गुहा संतं सुभग विश्वदर्शतं तुविष्वणसं सुयजं घृतश्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ víśaḥ ǀ hotrā-vídam ǀ vívicim ǀ ratna-dhā́tamam ǀgúhā ǀ sántam ǀ su-bhaga ǀ viśvá-darśatam ǀ tuvi-svanásam ǀ su-yájam ǀ ghṛta-śríyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Human beings glorify you,Agni, the appreciator burnt-offerings, the discriminator (of truth), the main liberal giver of precious (things), abiding (awhile), auspicious one, in secret, (at other times) visible to all, loud sounding, offering worship, thriving upon clarified butter.
verses.wilson_translation: Human beings glorify you,Agni, the appreciator burnt-offerings, the discriminator (of truth), the main liberal giver of precious (things), abiding (awhile), auspicious one, in secret, (at other times) visible to all, loud sounding, offering worship, thriving upon clarified butter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने धर्णसिं विश्वधा वयं गीर्भिर्गृणंतो नमसोप सेदिम ।स नो जुषस्व समिधानो अंगिरो देवो मर्तस्य यशसा सुदीतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ dharṇasím ǀ viśvádhā ǀ vayám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ úpa ǀ sedima ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ yaśásā ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We approach you, all-sustaining Agni, adoring you in many ways with hymns and with prostrations; do you,Aṅgiras, when kindled, be propitious to us; may the divine (Agni be plural ased) by the (sacrificial) food (offered by the) worshippers, and by the bright flames (of his sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: We approach you, all-sustaining Agni, adoring you in many ways with hymns and with prostrations; do you,Aṅgiras, when kindled, be propitious to us; may the divine (Agni be plural ased) by the (sacrificial) food (offered by the) worshippers, and by the bright flames (of his sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने पुरुरूपो विशेविशे वयो दधासि प्रत्नथा पुरुष्टुत ।पुरूण्यन्ना सहसा वि राजसि त्विषिः सा ते तित्विषाणस्य नाधृषे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ puru-rū́paḥ ǀ viśé-viśe ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhāsi ǀ pratná-thā ǀ puru-stuta ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ ánnā ǀ sáhasā ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǀ tvíṣiḥ ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ titviṣāṇásya ǀ ná ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the praised of many, you who are multiform, giver of old food to every mortal; you reign with strength over the various (sacrificial) viands; the splendour of you when blazing brightly is not rivalled (by any).
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the praised of many, you who are multiform, giver of old food to every mortal; you reign with strength over the various (sacrificial) viands; the splendour of you when blazing brightly is not rivalled (by any).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने समिधानं यविष्ठ्य देवा दूतं चक्रिरे हव्यवाहनं ।उरुज्रयसं घृतयोनिमाहुतं त्वेषं चक्षुर्दधिरे चोदयन्मति ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānám ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ cakrire ǀ havya-vā́hanam ǀuru-jráyasam ǀ ghṛtá-yonim ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ tveṣám ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ codayát-mati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, young (of the deities), the gods have made you, when kindled, their messenger, the bearer of oblations; you, who are rapid in movement, and of whom butter is the source, they have made, when invoked, the brilliant eye (of the universe), instrumental gated by the understanding.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, young (of the deities), the gods have made you, when kindled, their messenger, the bearer of oblations; you, who are rapid in movement, and of whom butter is the source, they have made, when invoked, the brilliant eye (of the universe), instrumental gated by the understanding.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने प्रदिव आहुतं घृतैः सुम्नायवः सुषमिधा समीधिरे ।स वावृधान ओषधीभिरुक्षितोऽभि ज्रयांसि पार्थिवा वि तिष्ठसे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ sumna-yávaḥ ǀ su-samídhā ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀsáḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ ukṣitáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ jráyāṃsi ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ancient seekers after happiness hav ekindled you,Agni, when invoked, (and fed you) with abundant fuel; and you (thereby) increasing, and supplied with shrubs, are dominat over all terrestrial viands.
verses.wilson_translation: The ancient seekers after happiness hav ekindled you,Agni, when invoked, (and fed you) with abundant fuel; and you (thereby) increasing, and supplied with shrubs, are dominat over all terrestrial viands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BEARING; oblations mortal men, O Agni, worship thee the God.I deem thee Jātavedas: bear our offerings, thou, unceasingly. In the man's home who offers gifts, where grass is trimmed, Agni is Priest,To whom all sacrifices come and strengthenings that win renown. Whom, as an infant newly-born, the kindling-sticks have brought to life,Sustainer of the tribes of men, skilled in well-ordered sacrifice. Yea, very hard art thou to grasp, like offspring of the wriggling snakes,When thou consumest many woods like an ox, Agni, in the mead. Whose flames, when thou art sending forth the smoke, completely reach the mark,When Tṛta in the height of heaven, like as a smelter fanneth thee, e’en as a smelter sharpeneth thee. O Agni, by thy succour and by Mitra's friendly furtherance,May we, averting hate,subduethe wickedness of mortal men. O Agni, to our heroes bring such riches, thou victorious God.May he protect and nourish us, and help in gaining strength: be thou near us in fight for our success.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने हविष्मंतो देवं मर्तास ईळते ।मन्ये त्वा जातवेदसं स हव्या वक्ष्यानुषक् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ īḷate ǀmánye ǀ tvā ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ sáḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ ānuṣák ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mortals bearing oblations glorify you,Agni, the divine; I praise you,Jātavedas, for that you convey successively oblations (to the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Mortals bearing oblations glorify you,Agni, the divine; I praise you,Jātavedas, for that you convey successively oblations (to the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता दास्वतः क्षयस्य वृक्तबर्हिषः ।सं यज्ञासश्चरंति यं सं वाजासः श्रवस्यवः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ dā́svataḥ ǀ kṣáyasya ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀsám ǀ yajñā́saḥ ǀ cáranti ǀ yám ǀ sám ǀ vā́jāsaḥ ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, is the invoker of the gods (on behalf of) him, the donor (of the oblation), the abode (of the fruit of good works), by whom the sacred grass has been strewn; (he) in whom congregate all sacrifices securing food and fame.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, is the invoker of the gods (on behalf of) him, the donor (of the oblation), the abode (of the fruit of good works), by whom the sacred grass has been strewn; (he) in whom congregate all sacrifices securing food and fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्म यं शिशुं यथा नवं जनिष्टारणी ।धर्तारं मानुषीणां विशामग्निं स्वध्वरं ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ yám ǀ śíśum ǀ yathā ǀ návam ǀ jániṣṭa ǀ aráṇī íti ǀdhartā́ram ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ viśā́m ǀ agním ǀ su-adhvarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: He (it is) whom the two sticks have engendered like a new-born babe; the supporter of men and descendants of Manu, the fit object of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: He (it is) whom the two sticks have engendered like a new-born babe; the supporter of men and descendants of Manu, the fit object of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्म दुर्गृभीयसे पुत्रो न ह्वार्याणां ।पुरू यो दग्धासि वनाग्ने पशुर्न यवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ duḥ-gṛbhīyase ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ hvāryā́ṇām ǀpurú ǀ yáḥ ǀ dágdhā ǀ ási ǀ vánā ǀ ágne ǀ paśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are laid hold of with difficulty like the young of tortuously-twining (snakes); you who are the consumer of many forests, as an animal is of fodder.
verses.wilson_translation: You are laid hold of with difficulty like the young of tortuously-twining (snakes); you who are the consumer of many forests, as an animal is of fodder.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध स्म यस्यार्चयः सम्यक्संयंति धूमिनः ।यदीमह त्रितो दिव्युप ध्मातेव धमति शिशीते ध्मातरी यथा ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ yásya ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ samyák ǀ sam-yánti ǀ dhūmínaḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ áha ǀ tritáḥ ǀ diví ǀ úpa ǀ dhmā́tā-iva ǀ dhámati ǀ śíśīte ǀ dhmātári ǀ yathā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Of whom smoke-emitting, the flames intensely collect; then, when diffused in the three regions,Agniinflates himself in the firmament, like the blower of a bellows, and sharpens (his flames), as (the fire blazes from the blast) of the blower.
verses.wilson_translation: Of whom smoke-emitting, the flames intensely collect; then, when diffused in the three regions,Agniinflates himself in the firmament, like the blower of a bellows, and sharpens (his flames), as (the fire blazes from the blast) of the blower.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्मित्रस्य च प्रशस्तिभिः ।द्वेषोयुतो न दुरिता तुर्याम मर्त्यानां ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ahám ǀ agne ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ mitrásya ǀ ca ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀdveṣaḥ-yútaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ turyā́ma ǀ mártyānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: By the protections of you,Agni, the friend (of all), and by our praises (of you), may we pass safe from the evil acts of men, as if from malignant (enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: By the protections of you,Agni, the friend (of all), and by our praises (of you), may we pass safe from the evil acts of men, as if from malignant (enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं नो अग्ने अभी नरो रयिं सहस्व आ भर ।स क्षेपयत्स पोषयद्भुवद्वाजस्य सातय उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ abhí ǀ náraḥ ǀ rayím ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀsáḥ ǀ kṣepayat ǀ sáḥ ǀ poṣayat ǀ bhúvat ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáye ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Powerful Agni, bestow upon us the instrumental tutors (of pious rites), that wealth (which we desire); may he discomfit (our foes); may he cherish us; may he ever ready to bestow upon us food; and do you, Agni, be present in battles for our succesṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Powerful Agni, bestow upon us the instrumental tutors (of pious rites), that wealth (which we desire); may he discomfit (our foes); may he cherish us; may he ever ready to bestow upon us food; and do you, Agni, be present in battles for our succesṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BRING us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way.With overflowing store of wealth mark out for us a path to strength. Ours art thou, wondrous Agni, by wisdom and bounteousness of power.The might of Asuras rests on thee, like Mitra worshipful in act. Agni, increase our means of life, increase the house and home of these,The men, the princes who have won great riches through our hymns of praise. Bright Agni, they who deck their songs for thee have horses as their meed.The men are mighty in their might, they whose high laud, as that of heaven, awakes thee of its own accord. O Agni, those resplendent flames of thine go valorously forth,Like lightnings flashing round us, like a rattling car that seeks the spoil. Now, Agni, come to succour us; let priests draw nigh to offer gifts;And let the patrons of our rites subdue all regions of the earth. Bring to us, Agni, Aṅgiras, lauded of old and lauded now,Invoker! wealth to quell the strong, that singers may extol thee. Be near us in fight for our success.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो ।प्र नो राया परीणसा रत्सि वाजाय पंथां ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ dyumnám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ adhrigo ítyadhri-go ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ párīṇasā ǀ rátsi ǀ vā́jāya ǀ pánthām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, of irresistible prowess, bring to us most powerful treasure; (invest us) with surrounding wealth; mark out the paths to abundance.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, of irresistible prowess, bring to us most powerful treasure; (invest us) with surrounding wealth; mark out the paths to abundance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अद्भुत क्रत्वा दक्षस्य मंहना ।त्वे असुर्यमारुहत्क्राणा मित्रो न यज्ञियः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ adbhuta ǀ krátvā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ maṃhánā ǀtvé íti ǀ asuryám ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhat ǀ krāṇā́ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Marvellous Agni, (gratified) by our acts, (produce) in us greatness of vigour; in you abides the strength destroying evil spirits; you who are to be worshipped like Mitra, are the doer (of great deeds).
verses.wilson_translation: Marvellous Agni, (gratified) by our acts, (produce) in us greatness of vigour; in you abides the strength destroying evil spirits; you who are to be worshipped like Mitra, are the doer (of great deeds).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्न एषां गयं पुष्टिं च वर्धय ।ये स्तोमेभिः प्र सूरयो नरो मघान्यानशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ eṣām ǀ gáyam ǀ puṣṭím ǀ ca ǀ vardhaya ǀyé ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀ ānaśúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Augment,Agni, our dwelling and prosperity, for the devout men (who have propitiated you) by their praises have acquired riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Augment,Agni, our dwelling and prosperity, for the devout men (who have propitiated you) by their praises have acquired riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये अग्ने चंद्र ते गिरः शुंभंत्यश्वराधसः ।शुष्मेभिः शुष्मिणो नरो दिवश्चिद्येषां बृहत्सुकीर्तिर्बोधति त्मना ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ agne ǀ candra ǀ te ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śumbhánti ǀ áśva-rādhasaḥ ǀśúṣmebhiḥ ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ yéṣām ǀ bṛhát ǀ su-kīrtíḥ ǀ bódhati ǀ tmánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Delightful Agni, those men who glorify you with hymns become rich in horses, and are invigorated with (foe-destroying) energies; and their great renown, spread through the firmament arouses (you) of your own accord.
verses.wilson_translation: Delightful Agni, those men who glorify you with hymns become rich in horses, and are invigorated with (foe-destroying) energies; and their great renown, spread through the firmament arouses (you) of your own accord.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव त्ये अग्ने अर्चयो भ्राजंतो यंति धृष्णुया ।परिज्मानो न विद्युतः स्वानो रथो न वाजयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ agne ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ bhrā́jantaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀpári-jmānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ svānáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These your bright and fierce flames,Agni, spread around like the circumambient lightning, and are like a rattling chariot rushing (into battle) for booty.
verses.wilson_translation: These your bright and fierce flames,Agni, spread around like the circumambient lightning, and are like a rattling chariot rushing (into battle) for booty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू नो अग्न ऊतये सबाधसश्च रातये ।अस्माकासश्च सूरयो विश्वा आशास्तरीषणि ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ūtáye ǀ sa-bā́dhasaḥ ǀ ca ǀ rātáye ǀasmā́kāsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ā́śāḥ ǀ tarīṣáṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be prompt,Agni, for our protection, and for the gift of poverty-repelling (riches); and may our pious descendants be able to compass all their desires.
verses.wilson_translation: Be prompt,Agni, for our protection, and for the gift of poverty-repelling (riches); and may our pious descendants be able to compass all their desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अंगिरः स्तुतः स्तवान आ भर ।होतर्विभ्वासहं रयिं स्तोतृभ्यः स्तवसे च न उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀhótaḥ ǀ vibhva-sáham ǀ rayím ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ stávase ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who are Aṅgiras, glorified in the past, glorified (at present), invoker (of the gods), bring unto us riches (enabling us) to overcome the mighty; give to your praisers (ability) to praise you, and be (athand) for our success in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who are Aṅgiras, glorified in the past, glorified (at present), invoker (of the gods), bring unto us riches (enabling us) to overcome the mighty; give to your praisers (ability) to praise you, and be (athand) for our success in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni, the very strong, for fresh prosperity.With oil upon his face, with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure, for the Bharatas. Ensign of sacrifice, the earliest Household-Priest, the men have kindled Agni in his threefold seat,With Indra and the Gods together on the grass let the wise Priest sit to complete the sacrifice. Pure , unadorned, from thy two Mothers art thou born: thou camest from Vivasvān as a charming Sage.With oil they strengthened thee, O Agni, worshipped God: thy banner was the smoke that mounted to the sky. May Agni graciously come to our sacrifice. The men bear Agni here and there in every house.He hath become an envoy, bearer of our gifts: electing Agni, men choose one exceeding wise. For thee, O Agni, is this sweetest prayer of mine: dear to thy spirit be this product of my thought.As great streams fill the river so our song of praise fill thee, and make thee yet more mighty in thy strength. O Agni, the Aṅgirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood.Thou by attrition art produced as conquering might, and men, O Aṅgiras, call thee the Son of Strength.

verses.sanskrit: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे ।घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृशा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः ॥
verses.transliteration: jánasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ návyase ǀghṛtá-pratīkaḥ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ divi-spṛ́śā ǀ dyu-mát ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ bharatébhyaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vigilant, the powerful Agni, the protector of man, has been engendered for the present prosperity (of the world); fed with butter, (blazing) with intense (radiance) reaching to the sky, the pure Agni shines brilliantly for the Bharatas.
verses.wilson_translation: The vigilant, the powerful Agni, the protector of man, has been engendered for the present prosperity (of the world); fed with butter, (blazing) with intense (radiance) reaching to the sky, the pure Agni shines brilliantly for the Bharatas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समीधिरे ।इंद्रेण देवैः सरथं स बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ prathamám ǀ puráḥ-hitam ǀ agním ǀ náraḥ ǀ tri-sadhasthé ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀíndreṇa ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ sáḥ ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sī́dat ǀ ní ǀ hótā ǀ yajáthāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests have first kindled, in three plural ces,Agni, the banner of sacrifice, the family priests, (riding) in the same car with Indraand the gods; he, the performer of pious acts, the invoker (of the gods), has sat down on the sacred grass for the (celebration of the) rite.
verses.wilson_translation: The priests have first kindled, in three plural ces,Agni, the banner of sacrifice, the family priests, (riding) in the same car with Indraand the gods; he, the performer of pious acts, the invoker (of the gods), has sat down on the sacred grass for the (celebration of the) rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असम्मृष्टो जायसे मात्रोः शुचिर्मंद्रः कविरुदतिष्ठो विवस्वतः ।घृतेन त्वावर्धयन्नग्न आहुत धूमस्ते केतुरभवद्दिवि श्रितः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásam-mṛṣṭaḥ ǀ jāyase ǀ mātróḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ út ǀ atiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀghṛténa ǀ tvā ǀ avardhayan ǀ agne ǀ ā-huta ǀ dhūmáḥ ǀ te ǀ ketúḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ diví ǀ śritáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are born unobstructed of two mothers; pure, adorable, wise, you have sprung up from (the devotion of) the householder; they have augmented you with butter;Agni, to whom burnt-offerings are made, the smoke is your banner spread abroad in the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: You are born unobstructed of two mothers; pure, adorable, wise, you have sprung up from (the devotion of) the householder; they have augmented you with butter;Agni, to whom burnt-offerings are made, the smoke is your banner spread abroad in the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्नो यज्ञमुप वेतु साधुयाग्निं नरो वि भरंते गृहेगृहे ।अग्निर्दूतो अभवद्धव्यवाहनोऽग्निं वृणाना वृणते कविक्रतुं ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ úpa ǀ vetu ǀ sādhu-yā́ ǀ agním ǀ náraḥ ǀ ví ǀ bharante ǀ gṛhé-gṛhe ǀagníḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǀ agním ǀ vṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ vṛṇate ǀ kaví-kratum ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, the fulfiller (of all desires) come to our sacrifice; men cherish Agni in every dwelling; Agni, the bearer of oblations, has become the messenger (of the gods); those adoring Agni adore him as the accomplisher of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, the fulfiller (of all desires) come to our sacrifice; men cherish Agni in every dwelling; Agni, the bearer of oblations, has become the messenger (of the gods); those adoring Agni adore him as the accomplisher of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्येदमग्ने मधुमत्तमं वचस्तुभ्यं मनीषा इयमस्तु शं हृदे ।त्वां गिरः सिंधुमिवावनीर्महीरा पृणंति शवसा वर्धयंति च ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhya ǀ idám ǀ agne ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ iyám ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ hṛdé ǀtvā́m ǀ gíraḥ ǀ síndhum-iva ǀ avánīḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇanti ǀ śávasā ǀ vardháyanti ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: To you,Agni, this most sweet speech (is addressed) may this praise be gratification of your heart; pious hymns fill you, and augment you with vigour, as large rivers (replenish) the sea.
verses.wilson_translation: To you,Agni, this most sweet speech (is addressed) may this praise be gratification of your heart; pious hymns fill you, and augment you with vigour, as large rivers (replenish) the sea.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने अंगिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविंदंछिश्रियाणं वनेवने ।स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्त्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमंगिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ ánu ǀ avindan ǀ śiśriyāṇám ǀ váne-vane ǀsáḥ ǀ jāyase ǀ mathyámānaḥ ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ mahát ǀ tvā́m ǀ āhuḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ putrám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Aṅgirasasdiscovered you,Agni, hidden in secret, and taking refuge from wood to wood; you are genitive rated, being churned with great force; therefore they have called you,Aṅgiras, the son of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The Aṅgirasasdiscovered you,Agni, hidden in secret, and taking refuge from wood to wood; you are genitive rated, being churned with great force; therefore they have called you,Aṅgiras, the son of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Agni, lofty Asura, meet for worship, Steer of eternal Law, my prayer I offer;I bring my song directed to the Mighty like pure oil for his mouth at sacrifices. Mark the Law, thou who knowest, yea, observe it: send forth the full streams of eternal Order.I use no sorcery with might or falsehood the sacred Law of the Red Steer I follow. How hast thou, follower of the Law eternal, become the knower of a new song, Agni?The God, the Guardian of the seasons, knows me: the Lord of him who won this wealth I know not. Who, Agni, in alliance with thy foeman, what splendid helpers won for them their riches?Agni, who guard the dwelling-place of falsehood? Who are protectors of the speech of liars? Agni, those friends of thine have turned them from thee: gracious of old, they have become ungracious.They have deceived themselves by their own speeches, uttering wicked words against the righteous. He who pays sacrifice to thee with homage, O Agni, keeps the Red Steer's Law eternal;Wide is his dwelling. May the noble offspring of Nahuṣa who wandered forth come hither.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्नये बृहते यज्ञियाय ऋतस्य वृष्णे असुराय मन्म ।घृतं न यज्ञ आस्ये सुपूतं गिरं भरे वृषभाय प्रतीचीं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ agnáye ǀ bṛhaté ǀ yajñíyāya ǀ ṛtásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ ásurāya ǀ mánma ǀghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ yajñé ǀ āsyé ǀ sú-pūtam ǀ gíram ǀ bhare ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ pratīcī́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer to the great, the adorable Agni, the rain of water, the vigorous, the showerer (of benefits), the present acceptable praise, like well-purified butter (poured) at sacrifices into his mouth.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer to the great, the adorable Agni, the rain of water, the vigorous, the showerer (of benefits), the present acceptable praise, like well-purified butter (poured) at sacrifices into his mouth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतं चिकित्व ऋतमिच्चिकिद्ध्यृतस्य धारा अनु तृंधि पूर्वीः ।नाहं यातुं सहसा न द्वयेन ऋतं सपाम्यरुषस्य वृष्णः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ cikiddhi ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ tṛndhi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀná ǀ ahám ǀ yātúm ǀ sáhasā ǀ ná ǀ dvayéna ǀ ṛtám ǀ sapāmi ǀ aruṣásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who know (the purpose of) the sacrifice, assent to this rite; be favourable to the copious showers of water; (endowed) with strength, (I undertake) not (to obstruct) sacred acts, nor adjure the rite with both (truth and untruth), but (repeate the praise) of the resplendent showerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who know (the purpose of) the sacrifice, assent to this rite; be favourable to the copious showers of water; (endowed) with strength, (I undertake) not (to obstruct) sacred acts, nor adjure the rite with both (truth and untruth), but (repeate the praise) of the resplendent showerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कया नो अग्न ऋतयन्नृतेन भुवो नवेदा उचथस्य नव्यः ।वेदा मे देव ऋतुपा ऋतूनां नाहं पतिं सनितुरस्य रायः ॥
verses.transliteration: káyā ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ṛtáyan ǀ ṛténa ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ návedāḥ ǀ ucáthasya ǀ návyaḥ ǀvéda ǀ me ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtu-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛtūnā́m ǀ ná ǀ ahám ǀ pátim ǀ sanitúḥ ǀ asyá ǀ rāyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, bestower of water, by what (act of) truth may you, who are adorable, be cognizant of our adoration; may the divine Agni, the guardian of the seasons, recognize me; (I know) him not (yet) as the lord of the riches of which I am the possessor.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, bestower of water, by what (act of) truth may you, who are adorable, be cognizant of our adoration; may the divine Agni, the guardian of the seasons, recognize me; (I know) him not (yet) as the lord of the riches of which I am the possessor.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: के ते अग्ने रिपवे बंधनासः के पायवः सनिषंत द्युमंतः ।के धासिमग्ने अनृतस्य पांति क आसतो वचसः संति गोपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ké ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ripáve ǀ bándhanāsaḥ ǀ ké ǀ pāyávaḥ ǀ saniṣanta ǀ dyu-mántaḥ ǀké ǀ dhāsím ǀ agne ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ pānti ǀ ké ǀ ásataḥ ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ santi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who,Agni, among your (followers) are the imprisoners of foes? who among them are the protectors (of men) the splendid distributors of gifts? who among them defend the asserters of untruth? who are the encouragers of evil deeds?
verses.wilson_translation: Who,Agni, among your (followers) are the imprisoners of foes? who among them are the protectors (of men) the splendid distributors of gifts? who among them defend the asserters of untruth? who are the encouragers of evil deeds?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सखायस्ते विषुणा अग्न एते शिवासः संतो अशिवा अभूवन् ।अधूर्षत स्वयमेते वचोभिर्ऋजूयते वृजिनानि ब्रुवंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ te ǀ víṣuṇāḥ ǀ agne ǀ eté ǀ śivā́saḥ ǀ sántaḥ ǀ áśivāḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀádhūrṣata ǀ svayám ǀ eté ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ṛju-yaté ǀ vṛjinā́ni ǀ bruvántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These your friends,Agni, everywhere dispersed, were formerly unhappy (in abandoning your worship), but are again fortunate (by its renewal); may they who, with (censorious) words, impute fraudulent (practices) to me who pursue a straight path, bring eveil upon themselves.
verses.wilson_translation: These your friends,Agni, everywhere dispersed, were formerly unhappy (in abandoning your worship), but are again fortunate (by its renewal); may they who, with (censorious) words, impute fraudulent (practices) to me who pursue a straight path, bring eveil upon themselves.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते अग्ने नमसा यज्ञमीट्ट ऋतं स पात्यरुषस्य वृष्णः ।तस्य क्षयः पृथुरा साधुरेतु प्रसर्स्राणस्य नहुषस्य शेषः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ námasā ǀ yajñám ǀ ī́ṭṭe ǀ ṛtám ǀ sáḥ ǀ pāti ǀ aruṣásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀtásya ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ etu ǀ pra-sársrāṇasya ǀ náhuṣasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the dwelling of him,Agni, who celebrate your worship with reverence, of him who protects the sacrifice (offered) to the resplendent showerer (of benefits), be well stored; and may a virtuous successor of the man who diligently worships you come in his plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: May the dwelling of him,Agni, who celebrate your worship with reverence, of him who protects the sacrifice (offered) to the resplendent showerer (of benefits), be well stored; and may a virtuous successor of the man who diligently worships you come in his plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH songs of praise we call on thee, we kindle thee with songs of praise,Agni, with songs of praise, for help. Eager for wealth, we meditate Agni's effectual praise to-day,Praise of the God who touches heaven. May Agni, Priest among mankind, take pleasure in our songs of praise,And worship the Celestial Folk. Thou, Agni, art spread widely forth, Priest dear and excellent; through theeMen make the sacrifice complete. Singers exalt thee, Agni, well lauded, best giver of our strength:So grant thou us heroic might. Thou Agni, as the felly rings the spokes, encompassest the Gods.I yearn for bounty manifold.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चंतस्त्वा हवामहेऽर्चंतः समिधीमहि ।अग्ने अर्चंत ऊतये ॥
verses.transliteration: árcantaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǀ árcantaḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǀágne ǀ árcantaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adoring you,Agni, we invoke you, adoring you we kindle you, adoring you for protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Adoring you,Agni, we invoke you, adoring you we kindle you, adoring you for protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेः स्तोमं मनामहे सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशः ।देवस्य द्रविणस्यवः ॥
verses.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ stómam ǀ manāmahe ǀ sidhrám ǀ adyá ǀ divi-spṛ́śaḥ ǀdevásya ǀ draviṇasyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous of wealth, we recite today the effectual praise of the divine Agni, (whose radiance) reaches the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of wealth, we recite today the effectual praise of the divine Agni, (whose radiance) reaches the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्जुषत नो गिरो होता यो मानुषेष्वा ।स यक्षद्दैव्यं जनं ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ juṣata ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ hótā ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀsáḥ ǀ yakṣat ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, who among men is the invoker of the gods, accept our praises; may he offer sacrifice to the divine beings.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, who among men is the invoker of the gods, accept our praises; may he offer sacrifice to the divine beings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः ।त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ sa-práthāḥ ǀ asi ǀ júṣṭaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀtváyā ǀ yajñám ǀ ví ǀ tanvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, are mighty and gracious, the (ministrant) priest, the desired (of all) through your worshippers complete the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, are mighty and gracious, the (ministrant) priest, the desired (of all) through your worshippers complete the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने वाजसातमं विप्रा वर्धंति सुष्टुतं ।स नो रास्व सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ vāja-sā́tamam ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vardhanti ǀ sú-stutam ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise worshippers exalt you,Agni, the bountiful giver of food, the deservedly lauded; do you bestow upon us excellent strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Wise worshippers exalt you,Agni, the bountiful giver of food, the deservedly lauded; do you bestow upon us excellent strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने नेमिरराँ इव देवांस्त्वं परिभूरसि ।आ राधश्चित्रमृंजसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ nemíḥ ǀ arā́n-iva ǀ devā́n ǀ tvám ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀā́ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ citrám ǀ ṛñjase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, you encompass the gods as the circumference (surrounds) the spokes (of a wheel); bestow manifold wealth upon us.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, you encompass the gods as the circumference (surrounds) the spokes (of a wheel); bestow manifold wealth upon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ENKINDLING the Immortal, wake Agni with song of praise: may he bear our oblations to the Gods. At high solemnities mortal men glorify him the Immortal, bestAt sacrifice among mankind. That he may bear their gifts to heaven, all glorify him Agni, God,With ladle that distilleth oil. Agni shone bright when born, with light killing the Dasyus and the dark:He found the Kine, the Floods, the Sun. Serve Agni, God adorable, the Sage whose back is balmed with oil:Let him approach, and hear my call. They have exalted Agni, God of all mankind, with oil and hymnsOf praise, devout and eloquent.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं स्तोमेन बोधय समिधानो अमर्त्यं ।हव्या देवेषु नो दधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ stómena ǀ bodhaya ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ámartyam ǀhavyā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ dadhat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Waken the immortal Agniwith praise, that, being kindled, he may bear our oblations to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Waken the immortal Agniwith praise, that, being kindled, he may bear our oblations to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमध्वरेष्वीळते देवं मर्ता अमर्त्यं ।यजिष्ठं मानुषे जने ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ īḷate ǀ devám ǀ mártāḥ ǀ ámartyam ǀyájiṣṭham ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mortals worship him, an immortal divinity, at their sacrifices, most adorable among the human race.
verses.wilson_translation: Mortals worship him, an immortal divinity, at their sacrifices, most adorable among the human race.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं हि शश्वंत ईळते स्रुचा देवं घृतश्चुता ।अग्निं हव्याय वोळ्हवे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ hí ǀ śáśvantaḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀ srucā́ ǀ devám ǀ ghṛta-ścútā ǀagním ǀ havyā́ya ǀ vóḷhave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Numerous (worshippers), pouring out butter from the (sacrificial) ladle, glorify him the divine Agni, that he may convey their oblation (to the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Numerous (worshippers), pouring out butter from the (sacrificial) ladle, glorify him the divine Agni, that he may convey their oblation (to the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्जातो अरोचत घ्नंदस्यूंज्योतिषा तमः ।अविंदद्गा अपः स्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ arocata ǀ ghnán ǀ dásyūn ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támaḥ ǀávindat ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, as soon as born, blazes brightly, destroying thedasyus, and (dispersing) the darkness by his lustre; he has discovered the cows, the waters, the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, as soon as born, blazes brightly, destroying thedasyus, and (dispersing) the darkness by his lustre; he has discovered the cows, the waters, the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमीळेन्यं कविं घृतपृष्ठं सपर्यत ।वेतु मे शृणवद्धवं ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ īḷényam ǀ kavím ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭham ǀ saparyata ǀvétu ǀ me ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worship the adorable Agni, the sage, whose summit blazes with butter; may he hear and comprehend my invocations.
verses.wilson_translation: Worship the adorable Agni, the sage, whose summit blazes with butter; may he hear and comprehend my invocations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं घृतेन वावृ���ुः स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणिं ।स्वाधीभिर्वचस्युभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ ghṛténa ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇim ǀsu-ādhī́bhiḥ ǀ vacasyú-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They have augmented,Agni, the beholder of all, with oblations and with praises, along with the gods, the objects of pious meditation, desirous of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: They have augmented,Agni, the beholder of all, with oblations and with praises, along with the gods, the objects of pious meditation, desirous of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To him, the far-renowned, the wise Ordainer, ancient and glorious, a song I offer.Enthroned in oil, the Asura, bliss-giver, is Agni, firm support of noble, riches. By holy Law they kept supporting Order, by help of sacrifice, in loftiest heaven,—They who attained with born men to the unborn, men seated on that stay, heaven's firm sustainer. Averting woe, they labour hard to bring him, the ancient, plenteous food as power resistless.May he, born newly, conquer his assailants: round him they stand as round an angry lion. When, like a mother, spreading forth to nourish, to cherish and regard each man that liveth,—Consuming all the strength that thou hast gotten, thou wanderest round, thyself, in varied fashion. May strength preserve the compass of thy vigour, God! that broad stream of thine that beareth riches.Thou, like a thief who keeps his refuge secret, hast holpen Atri to great wealth, by teaching.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वेधसे कवये वेद्याय गिरं भरे यशसे पूर्व्याय ।घृतप्रसत्तो असुरः सुशेवो रायो धर्ता धरुणो वस्वो अग्निः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vedháse ǀ kaváye ǀ védyāya ǀ gíram ǀ bhare ǀ yaśáse ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀghṛtá-prasattaḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer praise to Agni, the creator, the far-seeing, the adorable, the renowned, the first (of the gods); he who is propitiated by oblations, the strong, the giver of happiness, the possessor of riches, the receiver of oblations, the bestower of oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer praise to Agni, the creator, the far-seeing, the adorable, the renowned, the first (of the gods); he who is propitiated by oblations, the strong, the giver of happiness, the possessor of riches, the receiver of oblations, the bestower of oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतेन ऋतं धरुणं धारयंत यज्ञस्य शाके परमे व्योमन् ।दिवो धर्मंधरुणे सेदुषो नॄंजातैरजाताँ अभि ये ननक्षुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ ṛtám ǀ dharúṇam ǀ dhārayanta ǀ yajñásya ǀ śāké ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀdiváḥ ǀ dhárman ǀ dharúṇe ǀ sedúṣaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ jātáiḥ ǀ ájātān ǀ abhí ǀ yé ǀ nanakṣúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They are detaining by sacrifice the true recipient (of offerings) in the most eminent plural ce of the ceremony, who brings together the leaders (of the rite), the unborn with the born, (or gods and men), as seated at the solemnity which is the stay of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: They are detaining by sacrifice the true recipient (of offerings) in the most eminent plural ce of the ceremony, who brings together the leaders (of the rite), the unborn with the born, (or gods and men), as seated at the solemnity which is the stay of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंहोयुवस्तन्वस्तन्वते वि वयो महद्दुष्टरं पूर्व्याय ।स संवतो नवजातस्तुतुर्यात्सिंहं न क्रुद्धमभितः परि ष्ठुः ॥
verses.transliteration: aṃhaḥ-yúvaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ tanvate ǀ ví ǀ váyaḥ ǀ mahát ǀ dustáram ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀsáḥ ǀ sam-vátaḥ ǀ náva-jātaḥ ǀ tuturyāt ǀ siṃhám ǀ ná ǀ kruddhám ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sthuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They who (present) to the chief (of the gods) the great food (of sacrifice), unattainable (by therākṣasas), enjoy forms exempt from defect; may that new-born Agniscatter assembled (hosts); let them stand from around me as (deer avoid) an angry lion.
verses.wilson_translation: They who (present) to the chief (of the gods) the great food (of sacrifice), unattainable (by therākṣasas), enjoy forms exempt from defect; may that new-born Agniscatter assembled (hosts); let them stand from around me as (deer avoid) an angry lion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मातेव यद्भरसे पप्रथानो जनंजनं धायसे चक्षसे च ।वयोवयो जरसे यद्दधानः परि त्मना विषुरूपो जिगासि ॥
verses.transliteration: mātā́-iva ǀ yát ǀ bhárase ǀ paprathānáḥ ǀ jánam-janam ǀ dhā́yase ǀ cákṣase ǀ ca ǀváyaḥ-vayaḥ ǀ jarase ǀ yát ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ tmánā ǀ víṣu-rūpaḥ ǀ jigāsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: When, everywhere predominating, you cherish all men like a mother, and (are implored by all) to behold and to support them; and when, being detained, you mature every kind of food, then, multiform (Agni), you comprise (all beings) in yourself.
verses.wilson_translation: When, everywhere predominating, you cherish all men like a mother, and (are implored by all) to behold and to support them; and when, being detained, you mature every kind of food, then, multiform (Agni), you comprise (all beings) in yourself.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाजो नु ते शवसस्पात्वंतमुरुं दोघं धरुणं देव रायः ।पदं न तायुर्गुहा दधानो महो राये चितयन्नत्रिमस्पः ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́jaḥ ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ pātu ǀ ántam ǀ urúm ǀ dógham ǀ dharúṇam ǀ deva ǀ rāyáḥ ǀpadám ǀ ná ǀ tāyúḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ citáyan ǀ átrim ǀ asparítyaspaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine,Agni, may the (sacrificial) food, the vast yielder (of benefits to men), the sustainer of riches, support the utmost of your vigour; and do you considering (the means of acquiring) great riches, like a thief keeping concealed the article (he has stolen), be propitious to Atri.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine,Agni, may the (sacrificial) food, the vast yielder (of benefits to men), the sustainer of riches, support the utmost of your vigour; and do you considering (the means of acquiring) great riches, like a thief keeping concealed the article (he has stolen), be propitious to Atri.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GREAT power is in the beam of light, sing praise to, Agni, to the GodWhom men have set in foremost place like Mitra with their eulogies. He by the splendour of his arms is Priest of every able man.Agni conveys oblation straight, and deals, as Bhaga deals, his boons. All rests upon the laud and love of him the rich, high-flaming God,On whom, loud-roaring, men have laid great strength as on a faithful friend. So, Agni, be the Friend of these with liberal gift of hero strength.Yea, Heaven and Earth have not surpassed this Youthful One in glorious fame. O Agni, quickly come to us, and, glorified, bring precious wealth.So we and these our princes will assemble for the good of all. Be near in fight to prosper us.

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्वयो हि भानवेऽर्चा देवायाग्नये ।यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तिभिर्मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ bhānáve ǀ árca ǀ devā́ya ǀ agnáye ǀyám ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ puráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer abundant (sacrificial) food to the brilliant divine Agni, whom mortals have plural ced before them by praises as a friend.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer abundant (sacrificial) food to the brilliant divine Agni, whom mortals have plural ced before them by praises as a friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि द्युभिर्जनानां होता दक्षस्य बाह्वोः ।वि हव्यमग्निरानुषग्भगो न वारमृण्वति ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ hótā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀví ǀ havyám ǀ agníḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́ram ǀ ṛṇvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: For that Agni, (endowed) with the lustre of the strength of his arms, is the ministrant priest of mortals, who (presents) the oblation to the gods in succession, and like Bhagadistributes desirable wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: For that Agni, (endowed) with the lustre of the strength of his arms, is the ministrant priest of mortals, who (presents) the oblation to the gods in succession, and like Bhagadistributes desirable wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य स्तोमे मघोनः सख्ये वृद्धशोचिषः ।विश्वा यस्मिंतुविष्वणि समर्ये शुष्ममादधुः ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ stóme ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ sakhyé ǀ vṛddhá-śociṣaḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ yásmin ǀ tuvi-sváni ǀ sám ǀ aryé ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ā-dadhúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (May we be assiduous) in the praise, (and cherished) in the friendship of that very radiant possessor of wealth, on whom, loud-sounding and all-ruling, (his) universal (worshippers) have conferred vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: (May we be assiduous) in the praise, (and cherished) in the friendship of that very radiant possessor of wealth, on whom, loud-sounding and all-ruling, (his) universal (worshippers) have conferred vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा ह्यग्न एषां सुवीर्यस्य मंहना ।तमिद्यह्वं न रोदसी परि श्रवो बभूवतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ eṣām ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ maṃhánā ǀtám ǀ ít ǀ yahvám ǀ ná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pári ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ babhūvatuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Now verily,Agni, (be disposed) for bestowing excellent strength on these (your worshippers); heaven and earth have invested him with glory like the vast (sun).
verses.wilson_translation: Now verily,Agni, (be disposed) for bestowing excellent strength on these (your worshippers); heaven and earth have invested him with glory like the vast (sun).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू न एहि वार्यमग्ने गृणान आ भर ।ये वयं ये च सूरयः स्वस्ति धामहे सचोतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ vā́ryam ǀ ágne ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀyé ǀ vayám ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ svastí ǀ dhā́mahe ǀ sácā ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorified by us,Agni, come quickly, and bring us desirable wealth; we who (are your worshippers) we (who are your) adorers, offer you welcome together with oblations; be you favourable to us; be (our) success in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorified by us,Agni, come quickly, and bring us desirable wealth; we who (are your worshippers) we (who are your) adorers, offer you welcome together with oblations; be you favourable to us; be (our) success in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GOD, may a mortal call the Strong hither, with solemn rites, to aid,A man call Agni to protect when sacrifice is well prepared. Near him thou seemest mightier still in native glory, set to holdApart yon flame-hued vault of heaven, lovely beyond the thought of man. Yea, this is by the light of him whom powerful song hath bound to act,Whose beams of splendour flash on high as though they sprang from heavenly seed. Wealth loads the Wonder-Worker's car through his, the very wise One's power.Then, meet to be invoked among all tribes, is Agni glorified. Now, too, the princes shall obtain excellent riches by our lips.Protect us for our welfare: lend thy succour, O thou Son of Strength. Be near in fight to prosper us.

verses.sanskrit: आ यज्ञैर्देव मर्त्य इत्था तव्यांसमूतये ।अग्निं कृते स्वध्वरे पूरुरीळीतावसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ deva ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ távyāṃsam ǀ ūtáye ǀagním ǀ kṛté ǀ su-adhvaré ǀ pūrúḥ ǀ īḷīta ǀ ávase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, a mortal thus with sacrifices (calls upon you) who are endowed with lustre for protection;Puruadores Agni for protection when the sacred rite is solemnized.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, a mortal thus with sacrifices (calls upon you) who are endowed with lustre for protection;Puruadores Agni for protection when the sacred rite is solemnized.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य हि स्वयशस्तर आसा विधर्मन्मन्यसे ।तं नाकं चित्रशोचिषं मंद्रं परो मनीषया ॥
verses.transliteration: ásya ǀ hí ǀ sváyaśaḥ-taraḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ vi-dharman ǀ mányase ǀtám ǀ nā́kam ǀ citrá-śociṣam ǀ mandrám ǀ paráḥ ǀ manīṣáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Performer of various functions, who are deservedly renowned, you praise by your words that Agni, who is possessed of wonderful splendour, who is exempt from pain, who is adorable and supreme in understanding.
verses.wilson_translation: Performer of various functions, who are deservedly renowned, you praise by your words that Agni, who is possessed of wonderful splendour, who is exempt from pain, who is adorable and supreme in understanding.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य वासा उ अर्चिषा य आयुक्त तुजा गिरा ।दिवो न यस्य रेतसा बृहच्छोचंत्यर्चयः ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ vái ǀ asáu ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ arcíṣā ǀ yáḥ ǀ áyukta ǀ tujā́ ǀ girā́ ǀdiváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ rétasā ǀ bṛhát ǀ śócanti ǀ arcáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is endowed with vigour, is (glorified) by praise, and by whose radiance, like that of the sky, the rays of light shine brightly; by his lustre, verily, (the sun is luminous).
verses.wilson_translation: He who is endowed with vigour, is (glorified) by praise, and by whose radiance, like that of the sky, the rays of light shine brightly; by his lustre, verily, (the sun is luminous).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य क्रत्वा विचेतसो दस्मस्य वसु रथ आ ।अधा विश्वासु हव्योऽग्निर्विक्षु प्र शस्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ krátvā ǀ ví-cetasaḥ ǀ dasmásya ǀ vásu ǀ ráthe ǀ ā́ ǀádha ǀ víśvāsu ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ prá ǀ śasyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: By the worship of him who is plural asing of aspect, the provident (heap) wealth in their cars;Agni, to whom oblations are due, is then glorified by all people.
verses.wilson_translation: By the worship of him who is plural asing of aspect, the provident (heap) wealth in their cars;Agni, to whom oblations are due, is then glorified by all people.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू न इद्धि वार्यमासा सचंत सूरयः ।ऊर्जो नपादभिष्टये पाहि शग्धि स्वस्तय उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ vā́ryam ǀ āsā́ ǀ sacanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ pāhí ǀ śagdhí ǀ svastáye ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Quickly, (Agni, give us) desirable (wealth), such as the devout, combining with (pious) praise, (obtain); son of strength (be favourable) to (my) desires; protect us (from calamity); be alert for our prosperity; come for our success in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: Quickly, (Agni, give us) desirable (wealth), such as the devout, combining with (pious) praise, (obtain); son of strength (be favourable) to (my) desires; protect us (from calamity); be alert for our prosperity; come for our success in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVIII. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ५ द्वितो मृक्तवाहा आत्रेयः। अग्निः। अनुष्टुप्, ५ पंक्तिः।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AT dawn let Agni, much-beloved guest of the house, be glorified;Immortal who delights in all oblations brought by mortal men. For Dvita who receives through wealth of native strength maimed offerings,Thy praiser even gains at once the Soma-drops, Immortal Gods! Nobles, with song I call that car of yours that shines with lengthened life,For, God who givest steeds! that car hither and thither goes unharmed. They who have varied ways of thought, who guard the lauds within their lips,And strew the grass before the light, have decked themselves with high renown. Immortal Agni, give the chiefs, heroes who institute the rite,Heroes’ illustrious, lofty fame, who at the synod met for praise presented me with fifty steeds.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विशः स्तवेतातिथिः ।विश्वानि यो अमर्त्यो हव्या मर्तेषु रण्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: prātáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ puru-priyáḥ ǀ viśáḥ ǀ staveta ǀ átithiḥ ǀvíśvāni ǀ yáḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ márteṣu ǀ ráṇyati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let Agni, the beloved of many, the guest of man, be present at dawn; he who, immortal, desires the oblations of mortalṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Let Agni, the beloved of many, the guest of man, be present at dawn; he who, immortal, desires the oblations of mortalṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्विताय मृक्तवाहसे स्वस्य दक्षस्य मंहना ।इंदुं स धत्त आनुषक्स्तोता चित्ते अमर्त्य ॥
verses.transliteration: dvitā́ya ǀ mṛktá-vāhase ǀ svásya ǀ dákṣasya ǀ maṃhánā ǀíndum ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ ānuṣák ǀ stotā́ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ amartya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be (willing to make) a grant of your own strength to Dvita, the bearer of the pure oblations; for he, immortal Agni, your diligent praiser, brings to you continually the Somajuice.
verses.wilson_translation: Be (willing to make) a grant of your own strength to Dvita, the bearer of the pure oblations; for he, immortal Agni, your diligent praiser, brings to you continually the Somajuice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं वो दीर्घायुशोचिषं गिरा हुवे मघोनां ।अरिष्टो येषां रथो व्यश्वदावन्नीयते ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ dīrghā́yu-śociṣam ǀ girā́ ǀ huve ǀ maghónām ǀáriṣṭaḥ ǀ yéṣām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśva-dāvan ǀ ī́yate ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke you bright-shining, through a long life, with praise, (for the benefit) of the affluent, that their chariot, giver of horses, may proceed unimpeded.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke you bright-shining, through a long life, with praise, (for the benefit) of the affluent, that their chariot, giver of horses, may proceed unimpeded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चित्रा वा येषु दीधितिरासन्नुक्था पांति ये ।स्तीर्णं बर्हिः स्वर्णरे श्रवांसि दधिरे परि ॥
verses.transliteration: citrā́ ǀ vā ǀ yéṣu ǀ dī́dhitiḥ ǀ āsán ǀ ukthā́ ǀ pā́nti ǀ yé ǀstīrṇám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sváḥ-nare ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ dadhire ǀ pári ǁ
verses.english_translation: Among whom the ceremonial of many kinds is observed; who perpetuate the sacred hymns by their recital; by them the sacrificial viands are plural ced upon the strewn grass (at the sacrifice which) leads (the worshipper) to heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Among whom the ceremonial of many kinds is observed; who perpetuate the sacred hymns by their recital; by them the sacrificial viands are plural ced upon the strewn grass (at the sacrifice which) leads (the worshipper) to heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये मे पंचाशतं ददुरश्वानां सधस्तुति ।द्युमदग्ने महि श्रवो बृहत्कृधि मघोनां नृवदमृत नृणां ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ me ǀ pañcāśátam ǀ dadúḥ ǀ áśvānām ǀ sadhá-stuti ǀdyu-mát ǀ agne ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ kṛdhi ǀ maghónām ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ amṛta ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Immortal Agni, bestow upon those opulent men, who, upon (my) praise (of you), gave to me fifty horses, and brilliang, ample, and abundant food, (supporting numerous) dependants.
verses.wilson_translation: Immortal Agni, bestow upon those opulent men, who, upon (my) praise (of you), gave to me fifty horses, and brilliang, ample, and abundant food, (supporting numerous) dependants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIX. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ५ वव्रिरात्रेयः। अग्निः। गायत्री, ३-४ अनुष्टुप्, ५ विराड् रूपा।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ONE state begets another state: husk is made visible from husk:Within his Mother's side he speaks. Discerning, have they offered gifts: they guard the strength that never wastes.To a strong fort have they pressed in. Śvaitreya's people, all his men, have gloriously increased in might.A gold chain Bṛhaduktha wears, as, through this Soma, seeking spoil. I bring, as ’twere, the longed-for milk, the dear milk of the Sister-Pair.Like to a caldron filled with food is he, unconquered, conquering all. Beam of light, come to us in sportive fashion, finding thyself close to the wind that fans thee.These flames of his are wasting flames, like arrows keen-pointed, sharpened, on his breast.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यवस्थाः प्र जायंते प्र वव्रेर्वव्रिश्चिकेत ।उपस्थे मातुर्वि चष्टे ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ ava-sthā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ jāyante ǀ prá ǀ vavréḥ ǀ vavríḥ ǀ ciketa ǀupá-sthe ǀ mātúḥ ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unprosperous circumstances affect Vavri; may the accepter (of oblations) become cognizant (of them), as, reclining on the lap of his mother, he beholds all things.
verses.wilson_translation: Unprosperous circumstances affect Vavri; may the accepter (of oblations) become cognizant (of them), as, reclining on the lap of his mother, he beholds all things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुहुरे वि चितयंतोऽनिमिषं नृम्णं पांति ।आ दृळ्हां पुरं विविशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: juhuré ǀ ví ǀ citáyantaḥ ǀ áni-miṣam ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ pānti ǀā́ ǀ dṛḷhā́m ǀ púram ǀ viviśuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They who know (your power) invoke you incessantly and nourish (your) strength (by oblations); they dwell in an impregnable city.
verses.wilson_translation: They who know (your power) invoke you incessantly and nourish (your) strength (by oblations); they dwell in an impregnable city.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ श्वैत्रेयस्य जंतवो द्युमद्वर्धंत कृष्टयः ।निष्कग्रीवो बृहदुक्थ एना मध्वा न वाजयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śvaitreyásya ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ dyu-mát ǀ vardhanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀniṣká-grīvaḥ ǀ bṛhát-ukthaḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ mádhvā ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Living men, with collars of gold, earnest in praise, desirous of food, augment by this laudation the vigour of you abiding in the white firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Living men, with collars of gold, earnest in praise, desirous of food, augment by this laudation the vigour of you abiding in the white firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रियं दुग्धं न काम्यमजामि जाम्योः सचा ।घर्मो न वाजजठरोऽदब्धः शश्वतो दभः ॥
verses.transliteration: priyám ǀ dugdhám ǀ ná ǀ kā́myam ǀ ájāmi ǀ jāmyóḥ ǀ sácā ǀgharmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́ja-jaṭharaḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ dábhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (Agni) with his two relatives, (heaven and earth), hear this faultless (praise), acceptable as milk; he who, like the mixed oblation, is filled with food, and unsubsdued, is ever the subduer of his foes.
verses.wilson_translation: May (Agni) with his two relatives, (heaven and earth), hear this faultless (praise), acceptable as milk; he who, like the mixed oblation, is filled with food, and unsubsdued, is ever the subduer of his foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रीळन्नो रश्म आ भुवः सं भस्मना वायुना वेविदानः ।ता अस्य संधृषजो न तिग्माः सुसंशिता वक्ष्यो वक्षणेस्थाः ॥
verses.transliteration: krī́ḷan ǀ naḥ ǀ raśme ǀ ā́ ǀ bhuvaḥ ǀ sám ǀ bhásmanā ǀ vāyúnā ǀ vévidānaḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ san ǀ dhṛṣájaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tigmā́ḥ ǀ sú-saṃśitāḥ ǀ vakṣyáḥ ǀ vakṣaṇe-sthā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Radiant (Agni), who are made manifest by the wind and are sporting amidst theashes(of the forest), be present with us; and may the fierce fiery flames, destructive of foes, be genitive le to this your worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Radiant (Agni), who are made manifest by the wind and are sporting amidst theashes(of the forest), be present with us; and may the fierce fiery flames, destructive of foes, be genitive le to this your worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XX. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, best winner of the spoil, cause us to praise before the GodsAs our associate meet for lauds, wealth which thou verily deemest wealth. Agni, the great who ward not off the anger of thy power and mightStir up the wrath and hatred due to one who holds an alien creed.
