Celestial and terrestrial generations, and Waters will I summon to the feasting.May days with bright dawns cause my songs to prosper, and may the conquered streams increase their waters. Duly to each one hath my laud been offered. Strong be Varūtrī with her powers to succour.May the great Mother Rasā here befriend us, straight-handed, with the princes, striving forward. How may we serve the Liberal Ones with worship, the Maruts swift of course in invocation, the Maruts far-renowned in invocation?Let not the Dragon of the Deep annoy us, and gladly may he welcome our addresses. Thus thinking, O ye Gods, the mortal wins you to give him increase of his herds of cattle: the mortal wins him, O ye Gods, your favour.Here he wins wholesome food to feed this body: as for mine old age, Nirrti consume it O Gods, may we obtain from you this favour, strengthening food through the Cow's praise, ye Vasus.May she who gives good gifts, the gracious Goddes. s, come speeding nigh to us for our well-being. May Iḷā, Mother of the herds of cattle, and Urvasi with all the streams accept us;May Urvasi in lofty heaven accepting, as she partakes the oblation of the living, Visit us while she shares Urjavya's food.

verses.sanskrit: को नु वां मित्रावरुणावृतायंदिवो वा महः पार्थिवस्य वा दे ।ऋतस्य वा सदसि त्रासीथां नो यज्ञायते वा पशुषो न वाजान् ॥
verses.transliteration: káḥ ǀ nú ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ ṛta-yán ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ maháḥ ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ vā ǀ dé ǀṛtásya ǀ vā ǀ sádasi ǀ trā́sīthām ǀ naḥ ǀ yajña-yaté ǀ vā ǀ paśu-sáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́jān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who,Mitraand Varuṇa, desiring to sacrifice to you, (is able to do so)? do you, whether (abiding) in the region of heaven, or of the vast earth, or of the firmament, protect us, and give to the donor (of the oblation), and to the sacrificer, cattle and food.
verses.wilson_translation: Who,Mitraand Varuṇa, desiring to sacrifice to you, (is able to do so)? do you, whether (abiding) in the region of heaven, or of the vast earth, or of the firmament, protect us, and give to the donor (of the oblation), and to the sacrificer, cattle and food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमायुरिंद्र ऋभुक्षा मरुतो जुषंत ।नमोभिर्वा ये दधते सुवृक्तिं स्तोमं रुद्राय मीळ्हुषे सजोषाः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ āyúḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀnámaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ dádhate ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ stómam ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those divinities,Mitraand Varuṇa,Aryaman, Āyu,Indra,Ṛbhukṣin, the Marutswho accept pious praise, be plural ased by our adorations, partaking of the gratification afforded to Rudra, the showerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: May those divinities,Mitraand Varuṇa,Aryaman, Āyu,Indra,Ṛbhukṣin, the Marutswho accept pious praise, be plural ased by our adorations, partaking of the gratification afforded to Rudra, the showerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां येष्ठाश्विना हुवध्यै वातस्य पत्मन्रथ्यस्य पुष्टौ ।उत वा दिवो असुराय मन्म प्रांधांसीव यज्यवे भरध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ yéṣṭhā ǀ aśvinā ǀ huvádhyai ǀ vā́tasya ǀ pátman ǀ ráthyasya ǀ puṣṭáu ǀutá ǀ vā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ásurāya ǀ mánma ǀ prá ǀ ándhāṃsi-iva ǀ yájyave ǀ bharadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke you,Aśvins, the restrainers (of desire), for the acceleration ofyour chariot with the swiftness of the wind; (priests) offer praise and oblations to the celestial destroyer of life, to the accmplisher of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke you,Aśvins, the restrainers (of desire), for the acceleration ofyour chariot with the swiftness of the wind; (priests) offer praise and oblations to the celestial destroyer of life, to the accmplisher of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सक्षणो दिव्यः कण्वहोता त्रितो दिवः सजोषा वातो अग्निः ।पूषा भगः प्रभृथे विश्वभोजा आजिं न जग्मुराश्वश्वतमाः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sakṣáṇaḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ káṇva-hotā ǀ tritáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀpūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ pra-bhṛthé ǀ viśvá-bhojāḥ ǀ ājím ǀ ná ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ āśváśva-tamāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine accepter of sacrifice, of whom the Kaṇvasare the priests,Tṛta,Vāyuand Agni, concurring in satisfaction with (the ruler of) heaven, or (Sūryaand)Pūṣanand Bhaga, and they who are the protectors of the universe, (come quickly) to the sacrifice, as the fleet course rush to battle.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine accepter of sacrifice, of whom the Kaṇvasare the priests,Tṛta,Vāyuand Agni, concurring in satisfaction with (the ruler of) heaven, or (Sūryaand)Pūṣanand Bhaga, and they who are the protectors of the universe, (come quickly) to the sacrifice, as the fleet course rush to battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो रयिं युक्ताश्वं भरध्वं राय एषेऽवसे दधीत धीः ।सुशेव एवैरौशिजस्य होता ये व एवा मरुतस्तुराणां ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ yuktá-aśvam ǀ bharadhvam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ éṣe ǀ ávase ǀ dadhīta ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀsu-śévaḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ auśijásya ǀ hótā ǀ yé ǀ vaḥ ǀ évāḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ turā́ṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, do you bring wealth comprising horses; to acquire and preserve riches the wise man offers you praise; may the ministrant priest, (Atri), of the son of Uśij (Kakṣīvat), be made happy by those swift-going (horses) which are the swift-going (horses), Maruts, of you who are rapid in motion.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, do you bring wealth comprising horses; to acquire and preserve riches the wise man offers you praise; may the ministrant priest, (Atri), of the son of Uśij (Kakṣīvat), be made happy by those swift-going (horses) which are the swift-going (horses), Maruts, of you who are rapid in motion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो वायुं रथयुजं कृणुध्वं प्र देवं विप्रं पनितारमर्कैः ।इषुध्यव ऋतसापः पुरंधीर्वस्वीर्नो अत्र पत्नीरा धिये धुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ ratha-yújam ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ prá ǀ devám ǀ vípram ǀ panitā́ram ǀ arkáiḥ ǀiṣudhyávaḥ ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ vásvīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhiyé ǀ dhuríti dhuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Prevail, (priests), by your prayers, on Vāyu, the divine, the fulfiller of desires, the adorable, to harness his chariot; may the light-moving accepters of sacrifice, the lovely and excellent wives (of the gods), come hither to our rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Prevail, (priests), by your prayers, on Vāyu, the divine, the fulfiller of desires, the adorable, to harness his chariot; may the light-moving accepters of sacrifice, the lovely and excellent wives (of the gods), come hither to our rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप व एषे वंद्येभिः शूषैः प्र यह्वी दिवश्चितयद्भिरर्कैः ।उषासानक्ता विदुषीव विश्वमा हा वहतो मर्त्याय यज्ञं ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ éṣe ǀ vándyebhiḥ ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ prá ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ diváḥ ǀ citáyat-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀuṣásānáktā ǀ vidúṣī ivéti vidúṣī-iva ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ ha ǀ vahataḥ ǀ mártyāya ǀ yajñám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mighty Day and Night, to you, along with the adorable (deities) of heaven, I present (the oblation) with prayers delighting and explicit; knowing, like two sages, all (that is required), do you bring (it) to the worshipper for his sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Mighty Day and Night, to you, along with the adorable (deities) of heaven, I present (the oblation) with prayers delighting and explicit; knowing, like two sages, all (that is required), do you bring (it) to the worshipper for his sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वो अर्चे पोष्यावतो नॄन्वास्तोष्पतिं त्वष्टारं रराणः ।धन्या सजोषा धिषणा नमोभिर्वनस्पतीँरोषधी राय एषे ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ arce ǀ poṣyā́-vataḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ vā́stoḥ ǀ pátim ǀ tváṣṭāram ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀdhányā ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ éṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify you, leaders (of rites), cherishers (of many), gratifying (with oblation, you)Tvaṣṭāthe lord of foundations, and the goddess of speech, bestower of opulence, and share in the satisfaction (of the other divinities); also the lords of the forest, and the herbs, that I may obtain riches.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify you, leaders (of rites), cherishers (of many), gratifying (with oblation, you)Tvaṣṭāthe lord of foundations, and the goddess of speech, bestower of opulence, and share in the satisfaction (of the other divinities); also the lords of the forest, and the herbs, that I may obtain riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुजे नस्तने पर्वताः संतु स्वैतवो ये वसवो न वीराः ।पनित आप्त्यो यजतः सदा नो वर्धान्नः शंसं नर्यो अभिष्टौ ॥
verses.transliteration: tujé ǀ naḥ ǀ táne ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ santu ǀ svá-etavaḥ ǀ yé ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀpanitáḥ ǀ āptyáḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǀ várdhāt ǀ naḥ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ náryaḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Parvatasbe (bountiful) to us in liberal donations; may they be favourable (to us) who are the establishers (of the world) like heroes; may the adored and adorable (deity), who is accessible (to all), who is friendly to man, ever grant us increase, being propitiated by our praise.
verses.wilson_translation: May the Parvatasbe (bountiful) to us in liberal donations; may they be favourable (to us) who are the establishers (of the world) like heroes; may the adored and adorable (deity), who is accessible (to all), who is friendly to man, ever grant us increase, being propitiated by our praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृष्णो अस्तोषि भूम्यस्य गर्भं त्रितो नपातमपां सुवृक्ति ।गृणीते अग्निरेतरी न शूषैः शोचिष्केशो नि रिणाति वना ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ astoṣi ǀ bhūmyásya ǀ gárbham ǀ tritáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ apā́m ǀ su-vṛktí ǀgṛṇīté ǀ agníḥ ǀ etári ǀ ná ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ śocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ ní ǀ riṇāti ǀ vánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify with unqualified praise the embryo of the earth-fertilizing rain, the grandson of the waters,Agni, who is threefold, who rages (upon me) not, when travelling with (his) withering rays, but, bright-haired consumes the forests.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify with unqualified praise the embryo of the earth-fertilizing rain, the grandson of the waters,Agni, who is threefold, who rages (upon me) not, when travelling with (his) withering rays, but, bright-haired consumes the forests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कथा महे रुद्रियाय ब्रवाम कद्राये चिकितुषे भगाय ।आप ओषधीरुत नोऽवंतु द्यौर्वना गिरयो वृक्षकेशाः ॥
verses.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ mahé ǀ rudríyāya ǀ bravāma ǀ kát ǀ rāyé ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ bhágāya ǀā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ avantu ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ vánā ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ vṛkṣá-keśāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Howcan we offer (fit praise) to the mighty posterity of Rudra, or to the all-knowing Bhaga, for (the sake of obtaining) riches; may the waters, may the plural nts, protect us, and the heaven, the woods, and the mountains, whose tresses are trees.
verses.wilson_translation: Howcan we offer (fit praise) to the mighty posterity of Rudra, or to the all-knowing Bhaga, for (the sake of obtaining) riches; may the waters, may the plural nts, protect us, and the heaven, the woods, and the mountains, whose tresses are trees.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शृणोतु न ऊर्जां पतिर्गिरः स नभस्तरीयाँ इषिरः परिज्मा ।शृण्वंत्वापः पुरो न शुभ्राः परि स्रुचो बबृहाणस्याद्रेः ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjā́m ǀ pátiḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ tárīyān ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀśṛṇvántu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ pári ǀ srúcaḥ ǀ babṛhāṇásya ǀ ádreḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the lord of vigour, (Vāyu), hear our prayers, he who traverses the firmament, the circumambient; may the waters hear, bright as cities, flowing round the towering mountains.
verses.wilson_translation: May the lord of vigour, (Vāyu), hear our prayers, he who traverses the firmament, the circumambient; may the waters hear, bright as cities, flowing round the towering mountains.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विदा चिन्नु महांतो ये व एवा ब्रवाम दस्मा वार्यं दधानाः ।वयश्चन सुभ्व आव यंति क्षुभा मर्तमनुयतं वधस्नैः ॥
verses.transliteration: vidá ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ mahāntaḥ ǀ yé ǀ vaḥ ǀ évāḥ ǀ brávāma ǀ dasmāḥ ǀ vā́ryam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀváyaḥ ǀ caná ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ áva ǀ yanti ǀ kṣubhā́ ǀ mártam ǀ ánu-yatam ǀ vadha-snáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mighty Maruts, of goodly aspect, quickly hear (the praises) that we who repair to you repeat, offering acceptable (oblations); (the Maruts) coming hither, well disposed, come down to us, (destroying) with their weapons the mortals opposed to them, (overcome) by agitation.
verses.wilson_translation: Mighty Maruts, of goodly aspect, quickly hear (the praises) that we who repair to you repeat, offering acceptable (oblations); (the Maruts) coming hither, well disposed, come down to us, (destroying) with their weapons the mortals opposed to them, (overcome) by agitation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ दैव्यानि पार्थिवानि जन्मापश्चाच्छा सुमखाय वोचं ।वर्धंतां द्यावो गिरश्चंद्राग्रा उदा वर्धंतामभिषाता अर्णाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dáivyāni ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ jánma ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǀ áccha ǀ sú-makhāya ǀ vocam ǀvárdhantām ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ candrá-agrāḥ ǀ udā́ ǀ vardhantām ǀ abhí-sātāḥ ǀ árṇāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer adoration to the company of the Marutsdeserving of sacred sacrifice, to obtain the waters, whether born of heaven or earth; may my praises prosper; may the joy-bestowing heavens (flourish); may the rivers cherished (by the Maruts) be filled with water.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer adoration to the company of the Marutsdeserving of sacred sacrifice, to obtain the waters, whether born of heaven or earth; may my praises prosper; may the joy-bestowing heavens (flourish); may the rivers cherished (by the Maruts) be filled with water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पदेपदे मे जरिमा नि धायि वरूत्री वा शक्रा या पायुभिश्च ।सिषक्तु माता मही रसा नः स्मत्सूरिभिर्ऋजुहस्त ऋजुवनिः ॥
verses.transliteration: padé-pade ǀ me ǀ jarimā́ ǀ ní ǀ dhāyi ǀ várūtrī ǀ vā ǀ śakrā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀsísaktu ǀ mātā́ ǀ mahī́ ǀ rasā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ smát ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ ṛju-hástā ǀ ṛju-vániḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: My praise has been continually proffered as a protectress, powerful with (the means of) preservation; may the maternal and venerable earth accept our (praises), and, (plural ased) with her pious (worshippers) be (to us) straight-handed, and the giver of good.
verses.wilson_translation: My praise has been continually proffered as a protectress, powerful with (the means of) preservation; may the maternal and venerable earth accept our (praises), and, (plural ased) with her pious (worshippers) be (to us) straight-handed, and the giver of good.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कथा दाशेम नमसा सुदानूनेवया मरुतो अच्छोक्तौ प्रश्रवसो मरुतो अच्छोक्तौ ।मा नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो रिषे धादस्माकं भूदुपमातिवनिः ॥
verses.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ dāśema ǀ námasā ǀ su-dā́nūn ǀ eva-yā́ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áccha-uktau ǀ prá-śravasaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áccha-uktau ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ riṣé ǀ dhāt ǀ asmā́kam ǀ bhūt ǀ upamāti-vániḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: How may we (duly) worship the liberal (Maruts) with praise, how adore the Maruts with present praise in a fitting manner, the glorious Maruts with present praise? may Ahirbudhnyacontrive nor for our harm; may he be the destroyer (of our enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: How may we (duly) worship the liberal (Maruts) with praise, how adore the Maruts with present praise in a fitting manner, the glorious Maruts with present praise? may Ahirbudhnyacontrive nor for our harm; may he be the destroyer (of our enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इति चिन्नु प्रजायै पशुमत्यै देवासो वनते मर्त्यो व आ देवासो वनते मर्त्यो वः ।अत्रा शिवां तन्वो धासिमस्या जरां चिन्मे निर्ऋतिर्जग्रसीत ॥
verses.transliteration: íti ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ paśu-mátyai ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ vánate ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ vanate ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀátra ǀ śivā́m ǀ tanváḥ ǀ dhāsím ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ jarā́m ǀ cit ǀ me ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ jagrasīta ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mortal (sacrificer) worships you, gods, at all times for progeny and cattle; verily, gods, the mortal worships you; may Nirṛti, on this occasion, sustain my body with salutary food, and keep off decay.
verses.wilson_translation: The mortal (sacrificer) worships you, gods, at all times for progeny and cattle; verily, gods, the mortal worships you; may Nirṛti, on this occasion, sustain my body with salutary food, and keep off decay.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तां वो देवाः सुमतिमूर्जयंतीमिषमश्याम वसवः शसा गोः ।सा नः सुदानुर्मृळयंती देवी प्रति द्रवंती सुविताय गम्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́m ǀ vaḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ūrjáyantīm ǀ íṣam ǀ aśyāma ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ śásā ǀ góḥ ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǀ mṛḷáyantī ǀ devī́ ǀ práti ǀ drávantī ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ gamyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Vasus, may we obtain from the adorable cow invigorating and mind-sustaining food; may that liberal and benignant goddess, hastening (I, her), come for our felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Vasus, may we obtain from the adorable cow invigorating and mind-sustaining food; may that liberal and benignant goddess, hastening (I, her), come for our felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि न इळा यूथस्य माता स्मन्नदीभिरुर्वशी वा गृणातु ।उर्वशी वा बृहद्दिवा गृणानाभ्यूर्ण्वाना प्रभृथस्यायोः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ íḷā ǀ yūthásya ǀ mātā́ ǀ smát ǀ nadī́bhiḥ ǀ urváśī ǀ vā ǀ gṛṇātu ǀurváśī ǀ vā ǀ bṛhat-divā́ ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀ abhi-ūrṇvānā́ ǀ pra-bhṛthásya ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Iḷā, the mother of the herd, and Urvaśīwith the rivers, be favourable to us; may the bright-shining Urvaśī (come), commanding our devotion, and investing the worshipper with light.
verses.wilson_translation: May Iḷā, the mother of the herd, and Urvaśīwith the rivers, be favourable to us; may the bright-shining Urvaśī (come), commanding our devotion, and investing the worshipper with light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सिषक्तु न ऊर्जव्यस्य पुष्टेः ॥
verses.transliteration: sísaktu ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjavyásya ǀ puṣṭéḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May she cherish us (as the servants) of our patron Ūrjavya.
verses.wilson_translation: May she cherish us (as the servants) of our patron Ūrjavya.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १८ भौमोऽत्रिः। विश्वे देवाः, ११ रुद्रः। त्रिष्टुप्, १७ एकपदा विराट्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Now may our sweetest song with deep devotion reach Varuṇa, Mitra, Aditi, and Bhaga.May the Five Priests' Lord, dwelling in oblations, bliss-giving Asura, hear, whose paths are open. May Aditi welcome, even as a mother her dear heart-gladdening son, my song that lauds her.The prayer they love, bliss-giving, God-appointed, I offer unto Varuṇa and Mitra. In spirit him, the Sagest of the Sages; with sacrificial oil and meath bedew himSo then let him, God Savitar, provide us excellent, ready, and resplendent treasures. With willing mind, Indra, vouchsafe us cattle, prosperity, Lord of Bays! and pious patrons;And, with the sacred prayer by Gods appointed, give us the holy Deities' lovingkindness. God Bhaga, Savitar who deals forth riches, Indra, and they who conquer Vṛtra's treasures,And Vāja and Ṛbhukṣan and Purandhi, the Mighty and Immortal Ones, protect us! Let us declare his deeds, the undecaying unrivalled Victor whom the Maruts follow.None of old times, O Maghavan, nor later, none of these days hath reached thy hero prowess. Praise him the Chief who gives the boon of riches, Bṛhaspati distributor of treasures,Who, blessing most the man who sings and praises, comes with abundant wealth to his invoker. Tended, Bṛhaspati, with thy protections, the princes are unharmed and girt by heroes.Wealth that brings bliss is found among the givers of horses and of cattle and of raiment. Make their wealth flee who, through our hymns enjoying their riches, yield us not an ample guerdon.Far from the sun keep those who hate devotion, the godless, prospering in their vocation. With wheelless chariots drive down him, O Maruts, who at the feasts of Gods regards the demons.May he, though bathed in sweat, form empty wishes, who blames his sacred rite who toils to serve you. Praise him whose bow is strong and sure his arrow, him who is Lord of every balm that bealeth.Worship thou Rudra for his great good favour: adore the Asura, God, with salutations. May the House-friends, the cunning-handed Artists, may the Steer's Wives, the streams carved out by Vibhvan,And may the fair Ones honour and befriend us, Sarasvatī, Brhaddiva, and Rākā. My newest song, thought that now springs within me, I offer to the Great, the Sure Protector,Who made for us this All, in fond love laying each varied form within his Daughter's bosom. Now, even now, may thy fair praise, O Singer, attain Idaspati who roars and thunders,Who, rich in clouds and waters with his lightning speeds forth bedewing both the earth and heaven. May this my laud attain the troop of Maruts, those who are youths in act, the Sons of Rudra.The wish calls me to riches and well-being: praise the unwearied Ones whose steeds are dappled. May this my laud reach earth and air's mid-region, and forest trees and plants to win me riches.May every Deity be swift to listen, and Mother Earth with no ill thought regard me. Gods, may we dwell in free untroubled bliss. May we obtain the Aśvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance.Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sanskrit: प्र शंतमा वरुणं दीधिती गीर्मित्रं भगमदितिं नूनमश्याः ।पृषद्योनिः पंचहोता शृणोत्वतूर्तपंथा असुरो मयोभुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ śám-tamā ǀ váruṇam ǀ dī́dhitī ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ mitrám ǀ bhágam ǀ áditim ǀ nūnám ǀ aśyāḥ ǀpṛ́ṣat-yoniḥ ǀ páñca-hotā ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ átūrta-panthāḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our most animating praise, together with our offerings, successfully attain Varuṇa,Mitra,Bhagaand Aditi; may the ministrant of the five (vital airs,Vāyu), the dweller in the dappled (firmament), he whose path is unimpeded, who is the giver of life, the bestower of happiness, hear.
verses.wilson_translation: May our most animating praise, together with our offerings, successfully attain Varuṇa,Mitra,Bhagaand Aditi; may the ministrant of the five (vital airs,Vāyu), the dweller in the dappled (firmament), he whose path is unimpeded, who is the giver of life, the bestower of happiness, hear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रति मे स्तोममदितिर्जगृभ्यात्सूनुं न माता हृद्यं सुशेवं ।ब्रह्म प्रियं देवहितं यदस्त्यहं मित्रे वरुणे यन्मयोभु ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ me ǀ stómam ǀ áditiḥ ǀ jagṛbhyāt ǀ sūnúm ǀ ná ǀ mātā́ ǀ hṛ́dyam ǀ su-śévam ǀbráhma ǀ priyám ǀ devá-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ásti ǀ ahám ǀ mitré ǀ váruṇe ǀ yát ǀ mayaḥ-bhúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Aditiaccept my affectionate and devoted praise, as a mother (the endearments of) a son; the plural asing, delightful prayer that is approved of by the gods I address to Varuṇaand Mitra.
verses.wilson_translation: May Aditiaccept my affectionate and devoted praise, as a mother (the endearments of) a son; the plural asing, delightful prayer that is approved of by the gods I address to Varuṇaand Mitra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदीरय कवितमं कवीनामुनत्तैनमभि मध्वा घृतेन ।स नो वसूनि प्रयता हितानि चंद्राणि देवः सविता सुवाति ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ īraya ǀ kaví-tamam ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ unátta ǀ enam ǀ abhí ǀ mádhvā ǀ ghṛténa ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ prá-yatā ǀ hitā́ni ǀ candrā́ṇi ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ suvāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Celebrate, (priests), the most prophetic of the prophets; imbue him with the sweet libation, and may the divine Savitābestow upon us ample, beneficial and delightful riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Celebrate, (priests), the most prophetic of the prophets; imbue him with the sweet libation, and may the divine Savitābestow upon us ample, beneficial and delightful riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समिंद्र णो मनसा नेषि गोभिः सं सूरिभिर्हरिवः सं स्वस्ति ।सं ब्रह्मणा देवहितं यदस्ति सं देवानां सुमत्या यज्ञियानां ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ neṣi ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ sám ǀ svastí ǀsám ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ devá-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ásti ǀ sám ǀ devā́nām ǀ su-matyā́ ǀ yajñíyānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: With a (willing) mind,Indra, you associate us with cattle, with pious (priests) and, lord of steeds, with prosperity, with (sacrificial) food that is agreeable to the gods, and with the favour of the adorable deities.
verses.wilson_translation: With a (willing) mind,Indra, you associate us with cattle, with pious (priests) and, lord of steeds, with prosperity, with (sacrificial) food that is agreeable to the gods, and with the favour of the adorable deities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवो भगः सविता रायो अंश इंद्रो वृत्रस्य संजितो धनानां ।ऋभुक्षा वाज उत वा पुरंधिरवंतु नो अमृतासस्तुरासः ॥
verses.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ áṃśaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ sam-jítaḥ ǀ dhánānām ǀṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ ávantu ǀ naḥ ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ turā́saḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine Bhaga,Savitā, the lord of wealth,Aṃśa,Indra(the slayer) of Vṛtra, (all) the conquerors of riches,Ṛbhukṣin,Vājaand also Purandhi, immortals, hastening (to our sacrifice) preserve us.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine Bhaga,Savitā, the lord of wealth,Aṃśa,Indra(the slayer) of Vṛtra, (all) the conquerors of riches,Ṛbhukṣin,Vājaand also Purandhi, immortals, hastening (to our sacrifice) preserve us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वतो अप्रतीतस्य जिष्णोरजूर्यतः प्र ब्रवामा कृतानि ।न ते पूर्वे मघवन्नापरासो न वीर्यं नूतनः कश्चनाप ॥
verses.transliteration: marútvataḥ ǀ áprati-itasya ǀ jiṣṇóḥ ǀ ájūryataḥ ǀ prá ǀ bravāma ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀná ǀ te ǀ pū́rve ǀ magha-van ǀ ná ǀ áparāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīryám ǀ nū́tanaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ āpa ǁ
verses.english_translation: We celebrate the exploits of Marutvat, the unrecoiling, the victorious, the undecaying; neither the ancients,Maghavan, nor their successors, have attained your prowess, nor has any one recent attained it.
verses.wilson_translation: We celebrate the exploits of Marutvat, the unrecoiling, the victorious, the undecaying; neither the ancients,Maghavan, nor their successors, have attained your prowess, nor has any one recent attained it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप स्तुहि प्रथमं रत्नधेयं बृहस्पतिं सनितारं धनानां ।यः शंसते स्तुवते शंभविष्ठः पुरूवसुरागमज्जोहुवानं ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ prathamám ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ sanitā́ram ǀ dhánānām ǀyáḥ ǀ śáṃsate ǀ stuvaté ǀ śám-bhaviṣṭhaḥ ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ ā-gámat ǀ jóhuvānam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorify the first donor of precious treasure,Bṛhaspati, the distributor of riches, the bestower of great happiness upon him who recites or chants (his praise), who comes laden with ample wealth to his invoker.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorify the first donor of precious treasure,Bṛhaspati, the distributor of riches, the bestower of great happiness upon him who recites or chants (his praise), who comes laden with ample wealth to his invoker.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवोतिभिः सचमाना अरिष्टा बृहस्पते मघवानः सुवीराः ।ये अश्वदा उत वा संति गोदा ये वस्त्रदाः सुभगास्तेषु रायः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ sácamānāḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǀyé ǀ aśva-dā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ sánti ǀ go-dā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ vastra-dā́ḥ ǀ su-bhágāḥ ǀ téṣu ǀ rā́yaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated,Bṛhaspati, with your protections, (men) are unharmed (by foes), and become opulent and blessed with descendants; may wealth devolve on those who are genitive rous, and givers of horses, of cows, of clothes.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated,Bṛhaspati, with your protections, (men) are unharmed (by foes), and become opulent and blessed with descendants; may wealth devolve on those who are genitive rous, and givers of horses, of cows, of clothes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विसर्माणं कृणुहि वित्तमेषां ये भुंजते अपृणंतो न उक्थैः ।अपव्रतान्प्रसवे वावृधानान्ब्रह्मद्विषः सूर्याद्यावयस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-sarmā́ṇam ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ vittám ǀ eṣām ǀ yé ǀ bhuñjáte ǀ ápṛṇantaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀápa-vratān ǀ pra-savé ǀ vavṛdhānā́n ǀ brahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ sū́ryāt ǀ yavayasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Render transitory the riches of those who partake of enjoyment without giving satisfaction (to those who are eminent) by holy hymns; put apart from the sun those who perform not sacred rites, and who, though prospering in their posterity, are the adversaries of prayer.
verses.wilson_translation: Render transitory the riches of those who partake of enjoyment without giving satisfaction (to those who are eminent) by holy hymns; put apart from the sun those who perform not sacred rites, and who, though prospering in their posterity, are the adversaries of prayer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य ओहते रक्षसो देववीतावचक्रेभिस्तं मरुतो नि यात ।यो वः शमीं शशमानस्य निंदात्तुच्छ्यान्कामान्करते सिष्विदानः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ óhate ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ devá-vītau ǀ acakrébhiḥ ǀ tám ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ní ǀ yāta ǀyáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śámīm ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ níndāt ǀ tucchyā́n ǀ kā́mān ǀ karate ǀ sisvidānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Send,Maruts, into darkness with (cars) devoid of wheels, the man who invites therākṣasasto the food of the gods; (him also) who reviles me when offering praise to you; while sweating, he toils (to realize) vain desires.
verses.wilson_translation: Send,Maruts, into darkness with (cars) devoid of wheels, the man who invites therākṣasasto the food of the gods; (him also) who reviles me when offering praise to you; while sweating, he toils (to realize) vain desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु ष्टुहि यः स्विषुः सुधन्वा यो विश्वस्य क्षयति भेषजस्य ।यक्ष्वा महे सौमनसाय रुद्रं नमोभिर्देवमसुरं दुवस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuhi ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-iṣúḥ ǀ su-dhánvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ kṣáyati ǀ bheṣajásya ǀyákṣva ǀ mahé ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ rudrám ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ devám ǀ ásuram ǀ duvasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise him who has the sure arrow, the strong bow, who presides over all sanitary drugs; worship Rudrafor a comprehensive and sound understanding; adore the powerful divinity with prostrations.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise him who has the sure arrow, the strong bow, who presides over all sanitary drugs; worship Rudrafor a comprehensive and sound understanding; adore the powerful divinity with prostrations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दमूनसो अपसो ये सुहस्ता वृष्णः पत्नीर्नद्यो विभ्वतष्टाः ।सरस्वती बृहद्दिवोत राका दशस्यंतीर्वरिवस्यंतु शुभ्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: dámūnasaḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ yé ǀ su-hástāḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ vibhva-taṣṭā́ḥ ǀsárasvatī ǀ bṛhat-divā́ ǀ utá ǀ rākā́ ǀ daśasyántīḥ ǀ varivasyantu ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the dexterous-handed, humble-minded artist (of the gods, theṚbhus); may the wives of the showerer (Indra); may the rivers carved out by Vibhu; may Sarasvatīand the brilliant Rākā, the illustrious granters of desires, be willing to grant us riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May the dexterous-handed, humble-minded artist (of the gods, theṚbhus); may the wives of the showerer (Indra); may the rivers carved out by Vibhu; may Sarasvatīand the brilliant Rākā, the illustrious granters of desires, be willing to grant us riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सू महे सुशरणाय मेधां गिरं भरे नव्यसीं जायमानां ।य आहना दुहितुर्वक्षणासु रूपा मिनानो अकृणोदिदं नः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ mahé ǀ su-śaraṇā́ya ǀ medhā́m ǀ gíram ǀ bhare ǀ návyasīm ǀ jā́yamānām ǀyáḥ ǀ āhanā́ḥ ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀ rūpā́ ǀ minānáḥ ǀ ákṛṇot ǀ idám ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To the great protector, (Indra), I offer devout pious praise, new and originated (at this time); to him, the showerer, who, for his daughter (earth), giving form to the rivers, has provided this water for our (use).
verses.wilson_translation: To the great protector, (Indra), I offer devout pious praise, new and originated (at this time); to him, the showerer, who, for his daughter (earth), giving form to the rivers, has provided this water for our (use).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सुष्टुतिः स्तनयंतं रुवंतमिळस्पतिं जरितर्नूनमश्याः ।यो अब्दिमाँ उदनिमाँ इयर्ति प्र विद्युता रोदसी उक्षमाणः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ stanáyantam ǀ ruvántam ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ pátim ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ aśyāḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ abdi-mā́n ǀ udani-mā́n ǀ íyarti ǀ prá ǀ vi-dyútā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ukṣámāṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your pious praise, oḥ worshipper, assuredly reach the thundering, roaring lord of Iḷā, who, impelling the clouds and distributing the rain, proceeds, illuminating the heaven and earth with lightning.
verses.wilson_translation: May your pious praise, oḥ worshipper, assuredly reach the thundering, roaring lord of Iḷā, who, impelling the clouds and distributing the rain, proceeds, illuminating the heaven and earth with lightning.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो मारुतं शर्धो अच्छा रुद्रस्य सूनूँर्युवन्यूँरुदश्याः ।कामो राये हवते मा स्वस्त्युप स्तुहि पृषदश्वाँ अयासः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnū́n ǀ yuvanyū́n ǀ út ǀ aśyāḥ ǀkā́maḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ havate ǀ mā ǀ svastí ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ pṛ́ṣat-aśvān ǀ ayā́saḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this hymn reach up to the presence of the might of the Marutsthe youthful sons of Rudra; the desire of riches incites me to holiness; glorify those who go to sacrifice on spotted steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: May this hymn reach up to the presence of the might of the Marutsthe youthful sons of Rudra; the desire of riches incites me to holiness; glorify those who go to sacrifice on spotted steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रैष स्तोमः पृथिवीमंतरिक्षं वनस्पतीँरोषधी राये अश्याः ।देवोदेवः सुहवो भूतु मह्यं मा नो माता पृथिवी दुर्मतौ धात् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ antárikṣam ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ aśyāḥ ǀdeváḥ-devaḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ máhyam ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ duḥ-matáu ǀ dhāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: {Text is missing}
verses.wilson_translation: {Text is missing}
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरौ देवा अनिबाधे स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: uráu ǀ devāḥ ǀ ani-bādhé ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we ever, gods, enjoy great and uninterrupted felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: May we ever, gods, enjoy great and uninterrupted felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ su-pránītī ǀ gamema ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ vīrā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ amṛtā ǀ sáubhagāni ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we ever be participant of the unprecedented, joy-conferring and well-guided protection of the Aśvins; bring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches,maleprogeny, and all good things.
verses.wilson_translation: May we ever be participant of the unprecedented, joy-conferring and well-guided protection of the Aśvins; bring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches,maleprogeny, and all good things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १७ भौमोऽत्रिः। विश्वे देवाः । त्रिष्टुप्, १६ एकपदा विराट् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY the Milch-cows who hasten to their object come harmless unto us with liquid sweetness.The Singer, lauding, calls, for ample riches, the Seven Mighty Ones who bring enjoyment. With reverence and fair praise will I bring hither, for sake of strength, exhaustless Earth and Heaven.Father and Mother, sweetof speech, fairhanded, may they, far-famed, in every fight protect us. Adhvaryus, make the sweet libations ready, and bring the beautiful bright juice to Vāyu.God, as our Priest, be thou the first to drink it: we give thee of the mead to make thee joyful. Two arms-the Soma's dexterous immo. lators-and the ten fingers set and fix the press-stone.The stalk hath poured, fair with its spreading branches, the mead's bright glittering juice that dwells on mountains. The Soma hath been pressed for thee, its lover, to give thee power and might and high enjoyment.Invoked, turn hither in thy car, O Indra, at need, thy two well-trained and dear Bay Horses. Bring by God-traversed paths, accordant, Agni, the great Aramati, Celestial Lady,Exalted, worshipped with our gifts and homage, who knoweth holy Law, to drink sweet Soma. As on his father's lap the son, the darling, so on the fire is set the sacred caldron,Which holy singers deck, as if extending and heating that which holds the fatty membrane. Hither, as herald to invite the Aśvins, come the great lofty song, most sweet and pleasant!Come in one car, joy-givers! to the banquet, like the bolt binding pole and nave, come hither. I have declared this speech of adoration to mightiest Pūṣan and victorious Vāyu,Who by their bounty are the hymns' inspirers, and of themselves give power as a possession. Invoked by us bring hither, jatavedas the Maruts all under their names and figures.Come to the sacrifice with aid all Maruts, all to the songs and praises of the singer! From high heaven may Sarasvatī the Holy visit our sacrifice, and from the mountain.Eager, propitious, may the balmy Goddess hear our effectual speech, our invocation. Set in his seat the God whose back is dusky, Bṛhaspati the lofty, the Disposer.Him let us worship, set within the dwelling, the red, the golden-hued, the allresplendent. May the Sustainer, high in heaven, come hither, the Bounteous One, invoked, with all his favours,Dweller with Dames divine, with plants, unwearied, the Steer with triple horn, the life-bestower. The tuneful eloquent priests of him who liveth have sought the Mother's bright and loftiest station.As living men, with offered gifts and homage they deck the most auspicious Child to clothe him. Agni, great vital power is thine, the mighty: pairs waxing old in their devotion seek thee.May every Deity be swift to listen, and Mother Earth with no ill thought regard me. Gods, may we dwell in free untroubled bliss. May we obtain the Aśvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance.Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sanskrit: आ धेनवः पयसा तूर्ण्यर्था अमर्धंतीरुप नो यंतु मध्वा ।महो राये बृहतीः सप्त विप्रो मयोभुवो जरिता जोहवीति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ tū́rṇi-arthāḥ ǀ ámardhantīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ yantu ǀ mádhvā ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ saptá ǀ vípraḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ jaritā́ ǀ johavīti ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the kine, quick-moving, doing no harm, come to us, (laden) with their sweet fluid; the wise worshipper invokes the seven vast and joy-diffusing (rivers) for the sake of ample riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May the kine, quick-moving, doing no harm, come to us, (laden) with their sweet fluid; the wise worshipper invokes the seven vast and joy-diffusing (rivers) for the sake of ample riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सुष्टुती नमसा वर्तयध्यै द्यावा वाजाय पृथिवी अमृध्रे ।पिता माता मधुवचाः सुहस्ता भरेभरे नो यशसावविष्टां ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ námasā ǀ vartayádhyai ǀ dyā́vā ǀ vā́jāya ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ ámṛdhre íti ǀpitā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ mádhu-vacāḥ ǀ su-hástā ǀ bháre-bhare ǀ naḥ ǀ yaśásau ǀ aviṣṭām ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I purpose) to approach with pious praise, and with oblations, for (the sake of) uninjured heaven and earth may the paternal (heaven), and the sweet-spoken, free-handed, maternal (earth), both enjoying renown, defens us in every battle.
verses.wilson_translation: (I purpose) to approach with pious praise, and with oblations, for (the sake of) uninjured heaven and earth may the paternal (heaven), and the sweet-spoken, free-handed, maternal (earth), both enjoying renown, defens us in every battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवश्चकृवांसो मधूनि प्र वायवे भरत चारु शुक्रं ।होतेव नः प्रथमः पाह्यस्य देव मध्वो ररिमा ते मदाय ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ cakṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ mádhūni ǀ prá ǀ vāyáve ǀ bharata ǀ cā́ru ǀ śukrám ǀhótā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ asyá ǀ déva ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ rarimá ǀ te ǀ mádāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Priests, who are preparing (the libation), first offer to Vāyuthe delightful and brilliant (Soma); and do you, divine Vāyu, like the Hotā, first drink of this sweet juice, which we offer for your exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Priests, who are preparing (the libation), first offer to Vāyuthe delightful and brilliant (Soma); and do you, divine Vāyu, like the Hotā, first drink of this sweet juice, which we offer for your exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दश क्षिपो युंजते बाहू अद्रिं सोमस्य या शमितारा सुहस्ता ।मध्वो रसं सुगभस्तिर्गिरिष्ठां चनिश्चदद्दुदुहे शुक्रमंशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ yuñjate ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ ádrim ǀ sómasya ǀ yā́ ǀ śamitā́rā ǀ su-hástā ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ rásam ǀ su-gábhastiḥ ǀ giri-sthā́m ǀ cániścadat ǀ duduhe ǀ śukrám ǀ aṃśúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten express of the juice, (the fingers), and the two arms of the priests, which are the dexterous immolators of the Soma, take hold of the stone; the exulting, skilful-fingered (priest) milks the mountain-born juice of the sweet Soma, and that Soma (yields its) pure juice.
verses.wilson_translation: The ten express of the juice, (the fingers), and the two arms of the priests, which are the dexterous immolators of the Soma, take hold of the stone; the exulting, skilful-fingered (priest) milks the mountain-born juice of the sweet Soma, and that Soma (yields its) pure juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असावि ते जुजुषाणाय सोमः क्रत्वे दक्षाय बृहते मदाय ।हरी रथे सुधुरा योगे अर्वागिंद्र प्रिया कृणुहि हूयमानः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásāvi ǀ te ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ bṛhaté ǀ mádāya ǀhárī íti ǀ ráthe ǀ su-dhúrā ǀ yóge ǀ arvā́k ǀ índra ǀ priyā́ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ hūyámānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somahas been effused, (Indra), for your gratification, for (giving you) strength in action, and for your great exhilaration; therefore Indra, when invoked by us, put to your two beloved, docile, well-trained horses in your car, and come down.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somahas been effused, (Indra), for your gratification, for (giving you) strength in action, and for your great exhilaration; therefore Indra, when invoked by us, put to your two beloved, docile, well-trained horses in your car, and come down.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो महीमरमतिं सजोषा ग्नां देवीं नमसा रातहव्यां ।मधोर्मदाय बृहतीमृतज्ञामाग्ने वह पथिभिर्देवयानैः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ arámatim ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ gnā́m ǀ devī́m ǀ námasā ǀ rātá-havyām ǀmádhoḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ bṛhatī́m ǀ ṛta-jñā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ agne ǀ vaha ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, being well plural asd with us, bring to us, by paths frequented by the gods, the divine (feminine le), Gnā, mighty and omnipresent, to whom oblations are offered with reverence, who is vast and cognizant of rites, to partake of the exhilaration of the sweet Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, being well plural asd with us, bring to us, by paths frequented by the gods, the divine (feminine le), Gnā, mighty and omnipresent, to whom oblations are offered with reverence, who is vast and cognizant of rites, to partake of the exhilaration of the sweet Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंजंति यं प्रथयंतो न विप्रा वपावंतं नाग्निना तपंतः ।पितुर्न पुत्र उपसि प्रेष्ठ आ घर्मो अग्निमृतयन्नसादि ॥
verses.transliteration: añjánti ǀ yám ǀ pratháyantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vapā́-vantam ǀ ná ǀ agnínā ǀ tápantaḥ ǀpitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ upási ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ agním ǀ ṛtáyan ǀ asādi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vessel which the priests, celebrating (it), supply with butter, as if roasting a marrow-yielding animal with fire, has been plural ced, desirous of the sacrifice, upon the fire, like a son upon the lap of his father.
verses.wilson_translation: The vessel which the priests, celebrating (it), supply with butter, as if roasting a marrow-yielding animal with fire, has been plural ced, desirous of the sacrifice, upon the fire, like a son upon the lap of his father.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा मही बृहती शंतमा गीर्दूतो न गंत्वश्विना हुवध्यै ।मयोभुवा सरथा यातमर्वाग्गंतं निधिं धुरमाणिर्न नाभिं ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ mahī́ ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ śám-tamā ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ná ǀ gantu ǀ aśvínā ǀ huvádhyai ǀmayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ sa-ráthā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ gantám ǀ ni-dhím ǀ dhúram ǀ āṇíḥ ǀ ná ǀ nā́bhim ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this adoring, earnest, and gratifying praise go like a messenger to summon the Aśvinshither; come, Aśvins, givers of happiness, riding in one chariot, come down to the deposited (Soma), as the bolt (is essential) to the axle of the wagon.
verses.wilson_translation: May this adoring, earnest, and gratifying praise go like a messenger to summon the Aśvinshither; come, Aśvins, givers of happiness, riding in one chariot, come down to the deposited (Soma), as the bolt (is essential) to the axle of the wagon.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र तव्यसो नमउक्तिं तुरस्याहं पूष्ण उत वायोरदिक्षि ।या राधसा चोदितारा मतीनां या वाजस्य द्रविणोदा उत त्मन् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ távyasaḥ ǀ námaḥ-uktim ǀ turásya ǀ ahám ǀ pūṣṇáḥ ǀ utá ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ adikṣi ǀyā́ ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ coditā́rā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ yā́ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ draviṇaḥ-dáu ǀ utá ǀ tmán ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer adoration to the powerful and rapid Pūṣaṇ, and to (the powerful and rapid)Vāyu, who are both instrumental gators of the desire of wealth and of food, (who are both) distributors of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer adoration to the powerful and rapid Pūṣaṇ, and to (the powerful and rapid)Vāyu, who are both instrumental gators of the desire of wealth and of food, (who are both) distributors of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नामभिर्मरुतो वक्षि विश्वाना रूपेभिर्जातवेदो हुवानः ।यज्ञं गिरो जरितुः सुष्टुतिं च विश्वे गंत मरुतो विश्व ऊती ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vakṣi ǀ víśvān ǀ ā́ ǀ rūpébhiḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ huvānáḥ ǀyajñám ǀ gíraḥ ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ su-stutím ǀ ca ǀ víśve ǀ ganta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring hither Jātavedas, who are invoked by us all, the Maruts, under their several names and forms; come all you Maruts, with all your protecting faculties, to the sacrifice, the paises, and the adoration of the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring hither Jātavedas, who are invoked by us all, the Maruts, under their several names and forms; come all you Maruts, with all your protecting faculties, to the sacrifice, the paises, and the adoration of the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो दिवो बृहतः पर्वतादा सरस्वती यजता गंतु यज्ञं ।हवं देवी जुजुषाणा घृताची शग्मां नो वाचमुशती शृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ párvatāt ǀ ā́ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ yajatā́ ǀ gantu ǀ yajñám ǀhávam ǀ devī́ ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀ śagmā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ uśatī́ ǀ śṛṇotu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the radiant Sarasvatīcome to the sacrifice from the heavens or the spacious firmament; may the goddess, the showerer of water, propitiated by our invocation, and desirous of our gratifying praises hear.
verses.wilson_translation: May the radiant Sarasvatīcome to the sacrifice from the heavens or the spacious firmament; may the goddess, the showerer of water, propitiated by our invocation, and desirous of our gratifying praises hear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वेधसं नीलपृष्ठं बृहंतं बृहस्पतिं सदने सादयध्वं ।सादद्योनिं दम आ दीदिवांसं हिरण्यवर्णमरुषं सपेम ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vedhásam ǀ nī́la-pṛṣṭham ǀ bṛhántam ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ sádane ǀ sādayadhvam ǀsādát-yonim ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ híraṇya-varṇam ǀ aruṣám ǀ sapema ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Priests) plural ce the mighty Bṛhaspati, the creator whose back is dark blue, in the chamber (of sacrifice); let us worship him who is seated in the interior of the mansion, everywhere shining, golden-hued, resplendent.
verses.wilson_translation: (Priests) plural ce the mighty Bṛhaspati, the creator whose back is dark blue, in the chamber (of sacrifice); let us worship him who is seated in the interior of the mansion, everywhere shining, golden-hued, resplendent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ धर्णसिर्बृहद्दिवो रराणो विश्वेभिर्गंत्वोमभिर्हुवानः ।ग्ना वसान ओषधीरमृध्रस्त्रिधातुशृंगो वृषभो वयोधाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀ bṛhát-divaḥ ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ gantu ǀ óma-bhiḥ ǀ huvānáḥ ǀgnā́ḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ ámṛdhraḥ ǀ tridhā́tu-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the sustainer of all, (Agni), the greatly radiant, the delighter, come, with all his protecting (faculties), when invoked; he who is clothed with flames and with plural nts; who is irresistible; who has horns of three colours, the showerer (of benefits), the accepter of oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: May the sustainer of all, (Agni), the greatly radiant, the delighter, come, with all his protecting (faculties), when invoked; he who is clothed with flames and with plural nts; who is irresistible; who has horns of three colours, the showerer (of benefits), the accepter of oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मातुष्पदे परमे शुक्र आयोर्विपन्यवो रास्पिरासो अग्मन् ।सुशेव्यं नमसा रातहव्याः शिशुं मृजंत्यायवो न वासे ॥
verses.transliteration: mātúḥ ǀ padé ǀ paramé ǀ śukré ǀ āyóḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀ rāspirā́saḥ ǀ agman ǀsu-śévyam ǀ námasā ǀ rātá-havyāḥ ǀ śíśum ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāsé ǁ
verses.english_translation: The holders of the (sacrificial) ladles, the ministrant priests of the man (who instrumental tutes the rite), have repaired to the bright and most excellent plural ce of the maternal (earth); offerers of the oblations, they foster the tender infant, (Agni), with worship, as people rub (the limbs of a child to promote his) existence.
verses.wilson_translation: The holders of the (sacrificial) ladles, the ministrant priests of the man (who instrumental tutes the rite), have repaired to the bright and most excellent plural ce of the maternal (earth); offerers of the oblations, they foster the tender infant, (Agni), with worship, as people rub (the limbs of a child to promote his) existence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्वयो बृहते तुभ्यमग्ने धियाजुरो मिथुनासः सचंत ।देवोदेवः सुहवो भूतु मह्यं मा नो माता पृथिवी दुर्मतौ धात् ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ bṛhaté ǀ túbhyam ǀ agne ǀ dhiyā-júraḥ ǀ mithunā́saḥ ǀ sacanta ǀdeváḥ-devaḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ máhyam ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ duḥ-matáu ǀ dhāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Married pairs, worn by devout rites; jointly offer abundant sacrificial food,Agni, to you who are mighty; may each individual divinity be successfully invoked by me; let them not take us into unfavourable thought.
verses.wilson_translation: Married pairs, worn by devout rites; jointly offer abundant sacrificial food,Agni, to you who are mighty; may each individual divinity be successfully invoked by me; let them not take us into unfavourable thought.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरौ देवा अनिबाधे स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: uráu ǀ devāḥ ǀ ani-bādhé ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: [16-17] May we ever be participant of the unprecedent joy-conferring, and well-guiding protection of the Aśvinsbring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches,maleprogeny, and all good things.
verses.wilson_translation: [16-17] May we ever be participant of the unprecedent joy-conferring, and well-guiding protection of the Aśvinsbring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches,maleprogeny, and all good things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ su-pránītī ǀ gamema ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ vīrā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ amṛtā ǀ sáubhagāni ǁ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIV. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १५ काश्यपोऽवत्सारः (१० क्षत्र-मनस-एवावद-यजत-सध्रि- अवत्साराः, ११ विश्ववार- यजत- मायी- अवत्साराः, १२ अवत्सरेण सह सदापृण- यजत- बाहुवृक्त- श्रुतवित्-तर्याः, १३ सुतंभरश्च)। विश्वे देवाः। जगती, १४-१५ त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . As in the first old times, as all were wont, as now, he draweth forth the power turned hitherward with song,The Princedom throned on holy grass, who findeth light, swift, conquering in the' plants wherein he waxeth strong. Shining to him who leaves heaven's regions undisturbed, which to his sheen who is beneath show fair in light,Good guardian art thou, not to be deceived, Most Wise! Far from deceits thy name dwelleth in holy Law. Truth waits upon oblation present and to come: naught checks him in his way, this vic tory- bringing Priest:The Mighty Child who glides along the sacred grass, the undecaying Youth set in the midst of plants. These come, well-yoked, to you for furtherance in the rite: down come the twinborn strengtheners of Law for him,With reins easily guided and commanding all. In the deep fall the hide stealeth away their names. Thou, moving beauteously in visibly pregnant ones, snatching with trees the branching plant that grasps the juice,Shinest, true Singer! mid the upholders of the voice. Increase thy Consorts thou, lively at sacrifice. Like as he is beheld such is he said to be.They with effectual splendour in the floods have madeEarth yield us room enough and amply wide extent, great might invincible, with store of hero sons. Sūrya the Sage, as if unwedded, with a Spouse, in battle-loving spirit moveth o’er the foes.May he, self-excellent, grant us a sheltering home, a house that wards the fierce heat off on every side. Thy name, sung forth by Ṛṣis in these hymns of ours, goes to the loftier One with this swift mover's light.By skill he wins the boon whereon his heart is set: he who bestirs himself shall bring the thing to pass. The chief and best of these abideth in the sea, nor doth libation fail wherein it is prolonged.The heart of him who praiseth trembleth not in fear there where the hymn is found connected with the pure. For it is he: with though to of Ksatra, Manasa, of Yajata, and Sadhri, and Evavada,With Avatsara's sweet songs will we strive to win the mightiest strength which even he who knows should gain. The Hawk is their full source, girth-stretching rapturous drink of Visvavara, of Mayin, and Yajata.They ever seek a fresh draught so that they may come, know when thy time to halt and drink thy fill is near. Sadaprna the holy, Tarya, Srutavit, and Bahuvrkta, joined with you, have slain the foes.He gains his wish in both the worlds and brightly shines-when he adores the host with well-advancing steeds. The worshipper's defender is Sutambhara, producer and uplifter of all holy thoughts.The milch-cow brought, sweet-flavoured milk was dealt around. Who speaks the bidding text knows this, not he who sleeps. The sacred hymns love him who wakes and watches: to him who watches come the Sāma verses.This Soma saith unto the man who watches, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship. Agni is watchful, and the gcas love him; Agni is watchful, Sāma verses seek him.Agni is watchful, to him saith this Soma, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship.

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रत्नथा पूर्वथा विश्वथेमथा ज्येष्ठतातिं बर्हिषदं स्वर्विदं ।प्रतीचीनं वृजनं दोहसे गिराशुं जयंतमनु यासु वर्धसे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ pratná-thā ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀ viśvá-thā ǀ imá-thā ǀ jyeṣṭhá-tātim ǀ barhi-sádam ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀpratīcīnám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ dohase ǀ girā́ ǀ āśúm ǀ jáyantam ǀ ánu ǀ yā́su ǀ várdhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: In like manneer as the ancient (sages), those our predecessors, as all sages, and those of the present period (have obtained their wishes by his praise), so do you by praise extract (my desires) from him who is the oldest and best (of the gods), who is seated on the sacred grass, who is cognizant of heaven, coming to our presence, vigorous, swift, victorious, for by such praises you exalt him.
verses.wilson_translation: In like manneer as the ancient (sages), those our predecessors, as all sages, and those of the present period (have obtained their wishes by his praise), so do you by praise extract (my desires) from him who is the oldest and best (of the gods), who is seated on the sacred grass, who is cognizant of heaven, coming to our presence, vigorous, swift, victorious, for by such praises you exalt him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रिये सुदृशीरुपरस्य याः स्वर्विरोचमानः ककुभामचोदते ।सुगोपा असि न दभाय सुक्रतो परो मायाभिर्ऋत आस नाम ते ॥
verses.transliteration: śriyé ǀ su-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ úparasya ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ vi-rócamānaḥ ǀ kakúbhām ǀ acodáte ǀsu-gopā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ ná ǀ dábhāya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ paráḥ ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ ṛté ǀ āsa ǀ nā́ma ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, (Indra), who are radiant in heaven, spread through the regions, for the good (of mankind), those the beautiful (waters) of the unyielding cloud; doer of good deeds, you are the preserver (of men), not (destined) for their detriment; you are superior to all delusions; you names abides in the world of truth.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, (Indra), who are radiant in heaven, spread through the regions, for the good (of mankind), those the beautiful (waters) of the unyielding cloud; doer of good deeds, you are the preserver (of men), not (destined) for their detriment; you are superior to all delusions; you names abides in the world of truth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्यं हविः सचते सच्च धातु चारिष्टगातुः स होता सहोभरिः ।प्रसर्स्राणो अनु बर्हिर्वृषा शिशुर्मध्ये युवाजरो विस्रुहा हितः ॥
verses.transliteration: átyam ǀ havíḥ ǀ sacate ǀ sát ǀ ca ǀ dhā́tu ǀ ca ǀ áriṣṭa-gātuḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ sahaḥ-bháriḥ ǀpra-sársrāṇaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ barhíḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ yúvā ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ vi-srúhā ǀ hitáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, (Agni), is associated with the perpetual oblation that is the true (source of good); the sustainer of all, he is of unrestricted movement, the offerer (of burnt-offerings), the cherisher of strength; gliding especially over the sacred grass, the showerer (of benefits); an infant, a youth, exempt from decay, whose plural ce is among plural nts.
verses.wilson_translation: He, (Agni), is associated with the perpetual oblation that is the true (source of good); the sustainer of all, he is of unrestricted movement, the offerer (of burnt-offerings), the cherisher of strength; gliding especially over the sacred grass, the showerer (of benefits); an infant, a youth, exempt from decay, whose plural ce is among plural nts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र व एते सुयुजो यामन्निष्टये नीचीरमुष्मै यम्य ऋतावृधः ।सुयंतुभिः सर्वशासैरभीशुभिः क्रिविर्नामानि प्रवणे मुषायति ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ eté ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀ amúṣmai ǀ yamyáḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀsuyántu-bhiḥ ǀ sarva-śāsáiḥ ǀ abhī́śu-bhiḥ ǀ kríviḥ ǀ nā́māni ǀ pravaṇé ǀ muṣāyati ǁ
verses.english_translation: These well-combined rays (of the sun) are descending with intent to proceed on the path (of the sacrifice), amplifiers of the ceremony for this (its instrumental tutor); operating with these swift-moving, all-regulating rays, he, (Āditya) steals the waters (that flow) in low plural ces.
verses.wilson_translation: These well-combined rays (of the sun) are descending with intent to proceed on the path (of the sacrifice), amplifiers of the ceremony for this (its instrumental tutor); operating with these swift-moving, all-regulating rays, he, (Āditya) steals the waters (that flow) in low plural ces.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: संजर्भुराणस्तरुभिः सुतेगृभं वयाकिनं चित्तगर्भासु सुस्वरुः ।धारवाकेष्वृजुगाथ शोभसे वर्धस्व पत्नीरभि जीवो अध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-járbhurāṇaḥ ǀ táru-bhiḥ ǀ sute-gṛ́bham ǀ vayākínam ǀ cittá-garbhāsu ǀ su-sváruḥ ǀdhāra-vākéṣu ǀ ṛju-gātha ǀ śobhase ǀ várdhasva ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ jīváḥ ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: Object of honest eulogies (Agni), you shine among the reciters of your praises when the Somais received at its effusion by the wooden (cups), and you accepting (the beverage), are animated by the heart-affecting (praises); giver of life, increase in the sacrifice your protecting flames.
verses.wilson_translation: Object of honest eulogies (Agni), you shine among the reciters of your praises when the Somais received at its effusion by the wooden (cups), and you accepting (the beverage), are animated by the heart-affecting (praises); giver of life, increase in the sacrifice your protecting flames.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यादृगेव ददृशे तादृगुच्यते सं छायया दधिरे सिध्रयाप्स्वा ।महीमस्मभ्यमुरुषामुरु ज्रयो बृहत्सुवीरमनपच्युतं सहः ॥
verses.transliteration: yādṛ́k ǀ evá ǀ dádṛśe ǀ tādṛ́k ǀ ucyate ǀ sám ǀ chāyáyā ǀ dadhire ǀ sidhráyā ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǀmahī́m ǀ asmábhyam ǀ uru-sā́m ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ ánapa-cyutam ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such as (the deity) is beheld, such is he said (to be); they abide with concentrated splendour in the waters; (may they bestow) upon us honourable and ample (riches) great energy, numerousmaleoffspring and undecaying vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Such as (the deity) is beheld, such is he said (to be); they abide with concentrated splendour in the waters; (may they bestow) upon us honourable and ample (riches) great energy, numerousmaleoffspring and undecaying vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वेत्यग्रुर्जनिवान्वा अति स्पृधः समर्यता मनसा सूर्यः कविः ।घ्रंसं रक्षंतं परि विश्वतो गयमस्माकं शर्म वनवत्स्वावसुः ॥
verses.transliteration: véti ǀ ágruḥ ǀ jáni-vān ǀ vái ǀ áti ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ sa-maryatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀghraṃsám ǀ rákṣantam ǀ pári ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ asmā́kam ǀ śárma ǀ vanavat ǀ svá-vasuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage Sūrya, advancing, accompanied by his bride, (the dawn), proceeds boldly, intent on combat with his enemies; may he on whom riches are dependent, secure our entire felicity, (and grant) a brilliant and everywhere protecting mansion.
verses.wilson_translation: The sage Sūrya, advancing, accompanied by his bride, (the dawn), proceeds boldly, intent on combat with his enemies; may he on whom riches are dependent, secure our entire felicity, (and grant) a brilliant and everywhere protecting mansion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ज्यायांसमस्य यतुनस्य केतुन ऋषिस्वरं चरति यासु नाम ते ।यादृश्मिंधायि तमपस्यया विदद्य उ स्वयं वहते सो अरं करत् ॥
verses.transliteration: jyā́yāṃsam ǀ asyá ǀ yatúnasya ǀ ketúnā ǀ ṛṣi-svarám ǀ carati ǀ yā́su ǀ nā́ma ǀ te ǀyādṛ́śmin ǀ dhā́yi ǀ tám ǀ apasyáyā ǀ vidat ǀ yáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svayám ǀ váhate ǀ sáḥ ǀ áram ǀ karat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The (pious man) proceeds to you, most excellent (of the gods, who are indicated) by the sign of this moving (revolution); who are hymned by the ṛṣis in whose praises youyr name (is glorified); he obtains that blessing by his devotion, on whatsoever (his desire) has been fixed; and he also, who of his own accord offers (worship) acquires abundant (reward).
verses.wilson_translation: The (pious man) proceeds to you, most excellent (of the gods, who are indicated) by the sign of this moving (revolution); who are hymned by the ṛṣis in whose praises youyr name (is glorified); he obtains that blessing by his devotion, on whatsoever (his desire) has been fixed; and he also, who of his own accord offers (worship) acquires abundant (reward).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रमासामव तस्थे अग्रिमा न रिष्यति सवनं यस्मिन्नायता ।अत्रा न हार्दि क्रवणस्य रेजते यत्रा मतिर्विद्यते पूतबंधनी ॥
verses.transliteration: samudrám ǀ āsām ǀ áva ǀ tasthe ǀ agrimā́ ǀ ná ǀ riṣyati ǀ sávanam ǀ yásmin ǀ ā́-yatā ǀátra ǀ ná ǀ hā́rdi ǀ kravaṇásya ǀ rejate ǀ yátra ǀ matíḥ ǀ vidyáte ǀ pūta-bándhanī ǁ
verses.english_translation: The chief of these (our praises) proceed to the ocean-like sun; that chamber of sacrifice fails not in which (his praises) are prolonged; there are heart's desire of the worshiper is not disappointed where the mind is known to be attached to the pure (sun).
verses.wilson_translation: The chief of these (our praises) proceed to the ocean-like sun; that chamber of sacrifice fails not in which (his praises) are prolonged; there are heart's desire of the worshiper is not disappointed where the mind is known to be attached to the pure (sun).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि क्षत्रस्य मनसस्य चित्तिभिरेवावदस्य यजतस्य सध्रेः ।अवत्सारस्य स्पृणवाम रण्वभिः शविष्ठं वाजं विदुषा चिदर्ध्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣatrásya ǀ manasásya ǀ cítti-bhiḥ ǀ eva-vadásya ǀ yajatásya ǀ sádhreḥ ǀava-tsārásya ǀ spṛṇavāma ǀ ráṇva-bhiḥ ǀ śáviṣṭham ǀ vā́jam ǀ vidúṣā ǀ cit ǀ árdhyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He verily (it to be glorified); let us, with the plural asant thoughts of Kṣatra,Manasa, Avada, Vajada, Sadhri and Avatsara, fill up the invigorating food (the portion) to be shared by the wise.
verses.wilson_translation: He verily (it to be glorified); let us, with the plural asant thoughts of Kṣatra,Manasa, Avada, Vajada, Sadhri and Avatsara, fill up the invigorating food (the portion) to be shared by the wise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्येन आसामदितिः कक्ष्यो मदो विश्ववारस्य यजतस्य मायिनः ।समन्यमन्यमर्थयंत्येतवे विदुर्विषाणं परिपानमंति ते ॥
verses.transliteration: śyenáḥ ǀ āsām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ kakṣyáḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ viśvá-vārasya ǀ yajatásya ǀ māyínaḥ ǀsám ǀ anyám-anyam ǀ arthayanti ǀ étave ǀ vidúḥ ǀ vi-sā́nam ǀ pari-pā́nam ǀ ánti ǀ té ǁ
verses.english_translation: Swift is the excessive and girth-distending inebriation of Viśvavārā,Yajataand Māyin; (by drinking) of these (juices) they urge one another to drink; they find the copious draught the prompt giver of intoxication.
verses.wilson_translation: Swift is the excessive and girth-distending inebriation of Viśvavārā,Yajataand Māyin; (by drinking) of these (juices) they urge one another to drink; they find the copious draught the prompt giver of intoxication.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सदापृणो यजतो वि द्विषो वधीद्बाहुवृक्तः श्रुतवित्तर्यो वः सचा ।उभा स वरा प्रत्येति भाति च यदीं गणं भजते सुप्रयावभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sadā-pṛṇáḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ vadhīt ǀ bāhu-vṛktáḥ ǀ śruta-vít ǀ táryaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ sácā ǀubhā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ várā ǀ práti ǀ eti ǀ bhā́ti ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ gaṇám ǀ bhájate ǀ suprayā́va-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Sadāpṛṇa,Yajata, Bahuvṛkta, Śrutavit,Tarya, associated with you, destoy, your foes; the ṛṣi obtains his desires in both (worlds), and shines brightly, whenever he adores with well-mingled (offerings and praises) the host (of heaven).
verses.wilson_translation: May Sadāpṛṇa,Yajata, Bahuvṛkta, Śrutavit,Tarya, associated with you, destoy, your foes; the ṛṣi obtains his desires in both (worlds), and shines brightly, whenever he adores with well-mingled (offerings and praises) the host (of heaven).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुतंभरो यजमानस्य सत्पतिर्विश्वासामूधः स धियामुदंचनः ।भरद्धेनू रसवच्छिश्रिये पयोऽनुब्रुवाणो अध्येति न स्वपन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sutam-bharáḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ víśvāsām ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhiyā́m ǀ ut-áñcanaḥ ǀbhárat ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ rása-vat ǀ śiśriye ǀ páyaḥ ǀ anu-bruvāṇáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ eti ǀ ná ǀ svapán ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sutambhara, is the ministrant priest of the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice, the causer of the upward ascent of all holy rites; the cow offers juicy (milk); the milk is distributed; announcing this in order (Avastāra) studies (the holy texts) without repose.
verses.wilson_translation: Sutambhara, is the ministrant priest of the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice, the causer of the upward ascent of all holy rites; the cow offers juicy (milk); the milk is distributed; announcing this in order (Avastāra) studies (the holy texts) without repose.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो जागार तमृचः कामयंते यो जागार तमु सामानि यंति ।यो जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ jāgā́ra ǀ tám ǀ ṛ́caḥ ǀ kāmayante ǀ yáḥ ǀ jāgā́ra ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sā́māni ǀ yanti ǀyáḥ ǀ jāgā́ra ǀ tám ǀ ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ āha ǀ táva ǀ ahám ǀ asmi ǀ sakhyé ǀ ní-okāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him who is ever vigilant, holy verses desire; to him who is ever vigilant sacred songs proceed; him who is ever vigilant the Somathus addresses, I am always abiding in your fellowship.
verses.wilson_translation: Him who is ever vigilant, holy verses desire; to him who is ever vigilant sacred songs proceed; him who is ever vigilant the Somathus addresses, I am always abiding in your fellowship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्जागार तमृचः कामयंतेऽग्निर्जागार तमु सामानि यंति ।अग्निर्जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jāgāra ǀ tám ǀ ṛ́caḥ ǀ kāmayante ǀ agníḥ ǀ jāgāra ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sā́māni ǀ yanti ǀagníḥ ǀ jāgāra ǀ tám ǀ ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ āha ǀ táva ǀ ahám ǀ asmi ǀ sakhyé ǀ ní-okāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agniis ever vigilant, and him holy verses desire; Agni is ever vigilant, and to him sacred songs proceed; Agni is ever vigilant, and him the Somaaddresses, I am ever abiding in your fellowship.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniis ever vigilant, and him holy verses desire; Agni is ever vigilant, and to him sacred songs proceed; Agni is ever vigilant, and him the Somaaddresses, I am ever abiding in your fellowship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLV. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: ११ सदापृणा आत्रेयः। विश्वे देवाः। त्रिष्टुप् ९ पुरस्ताज्ज्योतिः।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BARDS of approaching Dawn who know the heavens are come with hymns to throw the mountain open.The Sun hath risen and oped the stable portals: the doors of men, too, hath the God thrown open. Sūrya hath spread his light as splendour: hither came the Cows' Mother, conscious, from the stable,To streams that flow with biting waves to deserts; and heaven is stablished like a firm-set pillar. This laud hath won the burden of the mountain. To aid the ancient birth of mighty watersThe mountain parted, Heaven performed his office. The worshippers were worn with constant serving. With hymns and God-loved words will I invoke you, Indra and Agni, to obtain your favour,For verily sages, skilled in sacrificing, worship the Maruts and with lauds invite them. This day approach us: may our thoughts be holy, far from us let us cast away misfortune.Let us keep those who hate us at a distance, and haste to meet the man who sacrifices. Come, let us carry out, O friends, the purpose wherewith the Mother threw the Cow's stall open,That wherewith Manu conquered Visisipra, wherewith the wandering merchant gained heaven's water. Here, urged by hands, loudly hath rung the press-stone wherewith Navagvas through ten months sang praises.Saramā went aright and found the cattle. Aṅgiras gave effect to all their labours. When at the dawning of this mighty Goddess, Aṅgirases all sang forth with the cattle,—Their spring is in the loftiest place of meeting,—Saramā found the kine by Order's pathway. Borne by his Coursers Seven may Sūrya visit the field that spreadeth wide for his long journey.Down on the Soma swooped the rapid Falcon. Bright was the young Sage moving mid his cattle. Sūrya hath mounted to the shining ocean when he hath yoked his fair-backed Tawny Horses.The wise have drawn him like a ship through water: the floods obedient have descended hither. I lay upon the Floods your hymn, lightwinning, wherewith Navagvas their ten months completed.Through this our hymn may we have Gods to guard us: through this our hymn pass safe beyond affliction.

verses.english_translation: (Indra) recovered (the hidden cattle), hurling his thunderbolt from heaven at the prayers of the Aṅgirasas; the rays of the approaching dawn are spread around; the divine sun, scattering the clustered gloom, has risen and set open the doors of (the habitations of) men.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra) recovered (the hidden cattle), hurling his thunderbolt from heaven at the prayers of the Aṅgirasas; the rays of the approaching dawn are spread around; the divine sun, scattering the clustered gloom, has risen and set open the doors of (the habitations of) men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: The sun distributes his radiance as it was a substance; the parent of the rays of light, (the dawn), knowing his approach, comes from the spacious (firmament); the rivers with running waters flow, breaking down their banks; the heaven is stable like a well-constructed pillar.
verses.wilson_translation: The sun distributes his radiance as it was a substance; the parent of the rays of light, (the dawn), knowing his approach, comes from the spacious (firmament); the rivers with running waters flow, breaking down their banks; the heaven is stable like a well-constructed pillar.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: To me, when offering praise, as to an ancient author of sacred songs, the burden of the cloud (descends); the cloud parts (with its burden); the sky performs (its office); he assiduously worshipping Aṅgirasasare exhausted by much (adoration).
verses.wilson_translation: To me, when offering praise, as to an ancient author of sacred songs, the burden of the cloud (descends); the cloud parts (with its burden); the sky performs (its office); he assiduously worshipping Aṅgirasasare exhausted by much (adoration).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: IIndraand Agni, I invoke you for my salvation with well-uttered words, agreeable to the gods; for verily, sages excelling in sacrifice, and diligently adoring, worship you with sacred songs, prompt as the Maruts(in devotion).
verses.wilson_translation: IIndraand Agni, I invoke you for my salvation with well-uttered words, agreeable to the gods; for verily, sages excelling in sacrifice, and diligently adoring, worship you with sacred songs, prompt as the Maruts(in devotion).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Come today quickly; let us be engaged in pious acts; let us entirely annihilate the hostile; let us keep off all sacred enemies; let us hasten to the presence of the instrumental tutor of the rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Come today quickly; let us be engaged in pious acts; let us entirely annihilate the hostile; let us keep off all sacred enemies; let us hasten to the presence of the instrumental tutor of the rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Come, friends, let us celebrate that solemn rite which was effectual in setting open the (secret) stalls of the (stolen) cattle; by which Manuovercame Viśiśipra; by which the merchant, going to the wood (for it), obtained the water.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, friends, let us celebrate that solemn rite which was effectual in setting open the (secret) stalls of the (stolen) cattle; by which Manuovercame Viśiśipra; by which the merchant, going to the wood (for it), obtained the water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: At this sacrifice the stone (set in motion) by thehands(of the priests) makes a noise, whereby the nine-months ministrants celebrated the ten-months worship; when Saramā, going to the ceremony, discovered the cattle, and Aṅgirasrendered all the rites effective.
