verses.wilson_translation: Do you, who are destroyers of themaleviolent, abounding in wealth, and entitled to adoration, bestow upon us desirable riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतं मे स्तोममूर्म्ये दार्भ्याय परा वह ।गिरो देवि रथीरिव ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ me ǀ stómam ǀ ūrmye ǀ dārbhyā́ya ǀ párā ǀ vaha ǀgíraḥ ǀ devi ǀ rathī́ḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bear to Dārbhya, oḥ night, turning away (from me to him), this my eulogy (of the Maruts); convey my praises, goddess, as a charioteer (conveys the contents of his vehicle to their destination).
verses.wilson_translation: Bear to Dārbhya, oḥ night, turning away (from me to him), this my eulogy (of the Maruts); convey my praises, goddess, as a charioteer (conveys the contents of his vehicle to their destination).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत मे वोचतादिति सुतसोमे रथवीतौ ।न कामो अप वेति मे ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ me ǀ vocatāt ǀ íti ǀ sutá-some ǀ rátha-vītau ǀná ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ ápa ǀ veti ǀ me ǁ
verses.english_translation: And say on my behalf to Rathavīti, when the libation is poured out, my love (for your daughter) does not depart.
verses.wilson_translation: And say on my behalf to Rathavīti, when the libation is poured out, my love (for your daughter) does not depart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष क्षेति रथवीतिर्मघवा गोमतीरनु ।पर्वतेष्वपश्रितः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ kṣeti ǀ rátha-vītiḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ ánu ǀpárvateṣu ǀ ápa-śritaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This opulent Rathavītidwells upon the (banks of the)Gomatī(river), and has his home on (the skirts of) the (Himālaya) mountains.
verses.wilson_translation: This opulent Rathavītidwells upon the (banks of the)Gomatī(river), and has his home on (the skirts of) the (Himālaya) mountains.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXII. Mitra-Varuṇa
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BY your high Law firm order is established there where they loose for travel Sūrya's horses.Ten hundred stood together: there I looked on this the most marvellous Deities' one chief glory. This, Mitra-Varuṇa, is your special greatness: floods that stood there they with the days attracted.Ye cause to flow all voices of the cowpen: your single chariotfelly hath rolled hither. O Mitra-Varuṇa, ye by your greatness, both Kings, have firmly stablished earth and heaven,Ye caused the cows to stream, the plants to flourish, and, scattering swift drops, sent down the rain-flood. Let your well-harnessed horses bear you hither: hitherward let them come with reins drawn tightly.A covering cloud of sacred oil attends you, and your streams flow to us from days aforetime. To make the lustre wider and more famous, guarding the sacred grass with veneration,Ye, Mitra-Varuṇa, firm, strong, awe-inspiring, are seated on a throne amid oblations. With hands that shed no blood, guarding the pious, whom, Varuni, ye save amid oblations.Ye Twain, together, Kings of willing spirit, uphold dominion based on thousand pillars. Adorned with gold, its columns are of iron. in heaven it glitters like a whip for horses;Or stablished on a field deep-spoiled and fruitful. So may we share the meath that loads your car-seat. Ye mount your car gold-hued at break of morning, and iron-pillared when the Sun is setting,And from that place, O Varuṇa and Mitra, behold infinity and limit~tion. Bountiful guardians of the world! the shelter that is impenetrable, strongest, flawless,Aid us with that, O Varuṇa and Mitra, and when we long to win may we be victors.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतेन ऋतमपिहितं ध्रुवं वां सूर्यस्य यत्र विमुचंत्यश्वान् ।दश शता सह तस्थुस्तदेकं देवानां श्रेष्ठं वपुषामपश्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ ṛtám ǀ ápi-hitam ǀ dhruvám ǀ vām ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ yátra ǀ vi-mucánti ǀ áśvān ǀdáśa ǀ śatā́ ǀ sahá ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ tát ǀ ékam ǀ devā́nām ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ vápuṣām ǀ apaśyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I have beheld the permanent orb of the sun, your (dwelling plural ce), concealed by water, where (the hymns of the pious) liberate (his) steeds; where a thousand rays abide together; the one most excellent of the (embodied) forms of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: I have beheld the permanent orb of the sun, your (dwelling plural ce), concealed by water, where (the hymns of the pious) liberate (his) steeds; where a thousand rays abide together; the one most excellent of the (embodied) forms of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्सु वां मित्रावरुणा महित्वमीर्मा तस्थुषीरहभिर्दुदुह्रे ।विश्वाः पिन्वथः स्वसरस्य धेना अनु वामेकः पविरा ववर्त ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ īrmā́ ǀ tasthúṣīḥ ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ duduhre ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ pinvathaḥ ǀ svásarasya ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vām ǀ ékaḥ ǀ pavíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavarta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Exceeding is that your greatness,Mitraand Varuṇa, whereby the ever-moving sun has, through (succeeding) days, milked forth the stationary waters; you augment all the (world-illuming) rays of the self-revolving (sun); the one chariot of you two (perpetually) goes round.
verses.wilson_translation: Exceeding is that your greatness,Mitraand Varuṇa, whereby the ever-moving sun has, through (succeeding) days, milked forth the stationary waters; you augment all the (world-illuming) rays of the self-revolving (sun); the one chariot of you two (perpetually) goes round.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधारयतं पृथिवीमुत द्यां मित्रराजाना वरुणा महोभिः ।वर्धयतमोषधीः पिन्वतं गा अव वृष्टिं सृजतं जीरदानू ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhārayatam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀ mítra-rājānā ǀ varuṇā ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀvardháyatam ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ pínvatam ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ áva ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ sṛjatam ǀ jīradānū íti jīra-dānū ǁ
verses.english_translation: Royal Mitraand Varuṇa, you uphold, by your energies, earth and heaven; prompt benefactors, cause the plural nts to grow, give nourishment to the cattle, send down the rain.
verses.wilson_translation: Royal Mitraand Varuṇa, you uphold, by your energies, earth and heaven; prompt benefactors, cause the plural nts to grow, give nourishment to the cattle, send down the rain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वामश्वासः सुयुजो वहंतु यतरश्मय उप यंत्वर्वाक् ।घृतस्य निर्णिगनु वर्तते वामुप सिंधवः प्रदिवि क्षरंति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ yatá-raśmayaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yantu ǀ arvā́k ǀghṛtásya ǀ niḥ-ník ǀ ánu ǀ vartate ǀ vām ǀ úpa ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pra-dívi ǀ kṣaranti ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your easily-harnessed horses bear you both (hither), and with well-guided reins come down; the embodied form of water follows you, the rivers flow as of old.
verses.wilson_translation: May your easily-harnessed horses bear you both (hither), and with well-guided reins come down; the embodied form of water follows you, the rivers flow as of old.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु श्रुताममतिं वर्धदुर्वीं बर्हिरिव यजुषा रक्षमाणा ।नमस्वंता धृतदक्षाधि गर्ते मित्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ śrutā́m ǀ amátim ǀ várdhat ǀ urvī́m ǀ barhíḥ-iva ǀ yájuṣā ǀ rákṣamāṇā ǀnámasvantā ǀ dhṛta-dakṣā ǀ ádhi ǀ gárte ǀ mítra ǀ ā́sāthe íti ǀ varuṇa ǀ íḷāsu ǀ antáríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Augmenting the well-known and ample form (of man), in like manner as the sacred grass is preserved by prayer, do you,Mitraand Varuṇa, who are invigorated by (sacrificial) viands, and abound in food, ascend your car in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Augmenting the well-known and ample form (of man), in like manner as the sacred grass is preserved by prayer, do you,Mitraand Varuṇa, who are invigorated by (sacrificial) viands, and abound in food, ascend your car in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अक्रविहस्ता सुकृते परस्पा यं त्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वंतः ।राजाना क्षत्रमहृणीयमाना सहस्रस्थूणं बिभृथः सह द्वौ ॥
verses.transliteration: ákravi-hastā ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ paraḥ-pā́ ǀ yám ǀ trā́sāthe íti ǀ varuṇā ǀ íḷāsu ǀ antáríti ǀrā́jānā ǀ kṣatrám ǀ áhṛṇīyamānā ǀ sahásra-sthūṇam ǀ bibhṛthaḥ ǀ sahá ǀ dváu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be open-handed and benignant to the performer of pious acts, whom you protect in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice; for you two, who are soverigns, and free from wrath, uphold together a mansion of a thousand columns.
verses.wilson_translation: Be open-handed and benignant to the performer of pious acts, whom you protect in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice; for you two, who are soverigns, and free from wrath, uphold together a mansion of a thousand columns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यनिर्णिगयो अस्य स्थूणा वि भ्राजते दिव्यश्वाजनीव ।भद्रे क्षेत्रे निमिता तिल्विले वा सनेम मध्वो अधिगर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: híraṇya-nirnik ǀ áyaḥ ǀ asya ǀ sthū́ṇā ǀ ví ǀ bhrājate ǀ diví ǀ aśvā́janī-iva ǀbhadré ǀ kṣétre ǀ ní-mitā ǀ tílvile ǀ vā ǀ sanéma ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ádhi-gartyasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: The substance (of their chariot) is of gold; its pillars are of metal, and it shines in the firmament like lightning; may we load the vehicle with the libation in an auspicious plural ce, or in the sacrificial hall, (where the columns) are erected.
verses.wilson_translation: The substance (of their chariot) is of gold; its pillars are of metal, and it shines in the firmament like lightning; may we load the vehicle with the libation in an auspicious plural ce, or in the sacrificial hall, (where the columns) are erected.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यरूपमुषसो व्युष्टावयःस्थूणमुदिता सूर्यस्य ।आ रोहथो वरुण मित्र गर्तमतश्चक्षाथे अदितिं दितिं च ॥
verses.transliteration: híraṇya-rūpam ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ áyaḥ-sthūṇam ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀā́ ǀ rohathaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ gártam ǀ átaḥ ǀ cakṣāthe íti ǀ áditim ǀ dítim ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: At the break of dawn, at the rising of the sun, ascend Mitraand Varuṇa, your golden-bodied, metal-pillared car, and thence, behold the earth and its inhabitants.
verses.wilson_translation: At the break of dawn, at the rising of the sun, ascend Mitraand Varuṇa, your golden-bodied, metal-pillared car, and thence, behold the earth and its inhabitants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्बंहिष्ठं नातिविधे सुदानू अच्छिद्रं शर्म भुवनस्य गोपा ।तेन नो मित्रावरुणावविष्टं सिषासंतो जिगीवांसः स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ báṃhiṣṭham ǀ ná ǀ ati-vídhe ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀ ácchidram ǀ śárma ǀ bhuvanasya ǀ gopā ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ sísāsantaḥ ǀ jigīvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Munificent Mitraand Varuṇa, protectors of the universe, (it is yours to grant) exceeding and perfect felicity, such as it is impossible to disturb; bless us with that (felicity), and may we ever be (possessed) of the riches we desire, and be confident of vicotry (over our enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: Munificent Mitraand Varuṇa, protectors of the universe, (it is yours to grant) exceeding and perfect felicity, such as it is impossible to disturb; bless us with that (felicity), and may we ever be (possessed) of the riches we desire, and be confident of vicotry (over our enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIII. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GUARDIANS of Order, ye whose Laws are ever true, in the sublimest heaven your chariot ye ascend.O Mitra-Varuṇa whomsoe’er ye: favour, here, to him the rain with sweetness streameth down from heaven. This world's imperial Kings, O Mitra-Varuṇa, ye rule in holy synod, looking on the light.We pray for rain, your boon, and immortality. Through heaven and over earth the thunderers take their way. Imperial Kings, strong, Heroes, Lords of earth and heaven, Mitra and Varuṇa, ye ever active Ones,Ye wait on thunder with the many-tinted clouds, and by the Asura's magic power cause Heaven to rain. Your magic, Mitra-Varuṇa, resteth in the heaven. The Sun, the wondrous weapon, cometh forth as light.Ye hide him in the sky with cloud and flood of rain, and water-drops, Parjanya! full of sweetness flow. The Maruts yoke their easy car for victory, O Mitra-Varuṇa, as a hero in the wars.The thunderers roam through regions varied in their hues. Imperial Kings, bedew us with the milk of heaven. Refreshing is your voice, O Mitra-Varuṇa: Parjanya sendeth out a wondrous mighty voice.With magic power the Maruts clothe them with the clouds. Ye Two cause Heaven to rain, the red, the spotless One. Wise, with your Law and through the Asura's magic power ye guard the ordinances, Mitra-Varuṇa.Ye by eternal Order govern all the world. Ye set the Sun in heaven as a refulgent car.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतस्य गोपावधि तिष्ठथो रथं सत्यधर्माणा परमे व्योमनि ।यमत्र मित्रावरुणावथो युवं तस्मै वृष्टिर्मधुमत्पिन्वते दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛ́tasya ǀ gopau ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhathaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ sátya-dharmāṇā ǀ paramé ǀ ví-omani ǀyám ǀ átra ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ tásmai ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pinvate ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Guardians of water, observers of truth, you ascend your car in the highest heaven; to him whom you,Mitraand Varuṇa, protect, the rain sends down the sweet (shower) from the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Guardians of water, observers of truth, you ascend your car in the highest heaven; to him whom you,Mitraand Varuṇa, protect, the rain sends down the sweet (shower) from the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सम्राजावस्य भुवनस्य राजथो मित्रावरुणा विदथे स्वर्दृशा ।वृष्टिं वां राधो अमृतत्वमीमहे द्यावापृथिवी वि चरंति तन्यवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-rā́jau ǀ asyá ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rājathaḥ ǀ mítrāvaruṇā ǀ vidáthe ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śā ǀvṛṣṭím ǀ vām ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ īmahe ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ tanyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Imperial rulers of this world, you shine,Mitraand Varuṇa, at this sacrifice, the beholders of heaven; we ask of you the wealth (that is) rain, and immortality for your forms traverse earth and heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Imperial rulers of this world, you shine,Mitraand Varuṇa, at this sacrifice, the beholders of heaven; we ask of you the wealth (that is) rain, and immortality for your forms traverse earth and heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सम्राजा उग्रा वृषभा दिवस्पती पृथिव्या मित्रावरुणा विचर्षणी ।चित्रेभिरभ्रैरुप तिष्ठथो रवं द्यां वर्षयथो असुरस्य मायया ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-rā́jau ǀ ugrā́ ǀ vṛṣabhā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ vícarṣaṇī íti ví-carṣaṇī ǀcitrébhiḥ ǀ abhráiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tiṣṭhathaḥ ǀ rávam ǀ dyā́m ǀ varṣayathaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ māyáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Imperial and mighty showerers, lords of heaven and earth, beholders of the universe, you approach,Mitraand Varuṇa, with variegated clouds to hear the sound (of your praises), and cause the sky to (send down) rain by the power of the emitter of showers.
verses.wilson_translation: Imperial and mighty showerers, lords of heaven and earth, beholders of the universe, you approach,Mitraand Varuṇa, with variegated clouds to hear the sound (of your praises), and cause the sky to (send down) rain by the power of the emitter of showers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: माया वां मित्रावरुणा दिवि श्रिता सूर्यो ज्योतिश्चरति चित्रमायुधं ।तमभ्रेण वृष्ट्या गूहथो दिवि पर्जन्य द्रप्सा मधुमंत ईरते ॥
verses.transliteration: māyā́ ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ diví ǀ śritā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ carati ǀ citrám ǀ ā́yudham ǀtám ǀ abhréṇa ǀ vṛṣṭyā́ ǀ gūhathaḥ ǀ diví ǀ párjanya ǀ drapsā́ḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ īrate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your deevice,Mitraand Varuṇa, is manifested in heaven, when the light (that is) the sun, your wonderful weapon, moves (in the firmament); him you invest in the sky with the cloud (and) with rain; and (your) sweet drops,Parjanya, fall (at their desire).
verses.wilson_translation: Your deevice,Mitraand Varuṇa, is manifested in heaven, when the light (that is) the sun, your wonderful weapon, moves (in the firmament); him you invest in the sky with the cloud (and) with rain; and (your) sweet drops,Parjanya, fall (at their desire).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रथं युंजते मरुतः शुभे सुखं शूरो न मित्रावरुणा गविष्टिषु ।रजांसि चित्रा वि चरंति तन्यवो दिवः सम्राजा पयसा न उक्षतं ॥
verses.transliteration: rátham ǀ yuñjate ǀ marútaḥ ǀ śubhé ǀ su-khám ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǀrájāṃsi ǀ citrā́ ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ tanyávaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ sam-rājā ǀ páyasā ǀ naḥ ǀ ukṣatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Marutsharness their easy-going chariot,Mitraand Varuṇa, for (the emission of) water, as a hero (harnesses his war-car); their forms traverse the different spheres to distribute the rain; do you, therefore, supreme rulers, shed upon us water from heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The Marutsharness their easy-going chariot,Mitraand Varuṇa, for (the emission of) water, as a hero (harnesses his war-car); their forms traverse the different spheres to distribute the rain; do you, therefore, supreme rulers, shed upon us water from heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाच�� सु मित्रावरुणाविरावतीं पर्जन्यश्चित्रां वदति त्विषीमतीं ।अभ्रा वसत मरुतः सु मायया द्यां वर्षयतमरुणामरेपसं ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́cam ǀ sú ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ írā-vatīm ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ citrā́m ǀ vadati ǀ tvíṣi-matīm ǀabhrā́ ǀ vasata ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sú ǀ māyáyā ǀ dyā́m ǀ varṣayatam ǀ aruṇā́m ǀ arepásam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The cloud, (through your will),Mitraand Varuṇa, utters a wonderful sound, indicative of radiance, and announcing (abundant) food; the Marutsthoroughly invest the clouds with (their) devices, and, (along with them), you two cause the purple and faultless sky to send down rain.
verses.wilson_translation: The cloud, (through your will),Mitraand Varuṇa, utters a wonderful sound, indicative of radiance, and announcing (abundant) food; the Marutsthoroughly invest the clouds with (their) devices, and, (along with them), you two cause the purple and faultless sky to send down rain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धर्मणा मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता व्रता रक्षेथे असुरस्य मायया ।ऋतेन विश्वं भुवनं वि राजथः सूर्यमा धत्थो दिवि चित्र्यं रथं ॥
verses.transliteration: dhármaṇā ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ vipaḥ-citā ǀ vratā́ ǀ rakṣethe íti ǀ ásurasya ǀ māyáyā ǀṛténa ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ ví ǀ rājathaḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ā́ ǀ dhatthaḥ ǀ diví ǀ cítryam ǀ rátham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Discerning, sagacious,Mitraand Varuṇa, by your office you protect pious rites, through the power of the emitter of showers; you illumine the whole world with water; you sustain the sun, the adorable chariot in the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Discerning, sagacious,Mitraand Varuṇa, by your office you protect pious rites, through the power of the emitter of showers; you illumine the whole world with water; you sustain the sun, the adorable chariot in the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LX1V. Mitra-Varuṇa
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . You, foeman-slaying Varuṇa and Mitra, we invoke with song,Who, as with penfold of your arms, encompass round the realm of light. Stretch out your arms with favouring love unto this man who singeth hymns,For in all places is sung forth your evergracious friendliness. That I may gain a refuge now, may my steps be on Mitra's path.Men go protected in the charge of this dear Friend who harms us not. Mitra and Varuṇa, from you may I, by song, win noblest meed.That shall stir envy in the homes of wealthy chiefs and those who praise. With your fair splendours, Varuṇa and Mitra, to our gathering come,That in their homes the wealthy chiefs and they who are your friends may thrive. With those, moreover, among whom ye hold your high supremacy,Vouchsafe us room that we may win strength for prosperity and wealth. When morning flushes, Holy Ones! in the Gods’ realm where white Cows shine,Supporting Arcananas, speed, ye Heroes, with your active feet hither to my pressed Soma juice.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणं वो रिशादसमृचा मित्रं हवामहे ।परि व्रजेव बाह्वोर्जगन्वांसा स्वर्णरं ॥
verses.transliteration: váruṇam ǀ vaḥ ǀ riśā́dasam ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ mitrám ǀ havāmahe ǀpári ǀ vrajā́-iva ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ jaganvā́ṃsā ǀ sváḥ-naram ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke you,Mitraand Varuṇa, with this hymn; each the discomfiter of foes, the conductor to heaven, like (two herdsmen) driving, by (the strength of their) arms, the herds of cattle before them.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke you,Mitraand Varuṇa, with this hymn; each the discomfiter of foes, the conductor to heaven, like (two herdsmen) driving, by (the strength of their) arms, the herds of cattle before them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता बाहवा सुचेतुना प्र यंतमस्मा अर्चते ।शेवं हि जार्यं वां विश्वासु क्षासु जोगुवे ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ bāhávā ǀ su-cetúnā ǀ prá ǀ yantam ǀ asmai ǀ árcate ǀśévam ǀ hí ǀ jāryám ǀ vām ǀ víśvāsu ǀ kṣā́su ǀ jóguve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you two, with discriminatinghand, bestow upon me, your worshipper, (what I desire); for the desirable felicity (that is given by you) spreads through all lands.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you two, with discriminatinghand, bestow upon me, your worshipper, (what I desire); for the desirable felicity (that is given by you) spreads through all lands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यन्नूनमश्यां गतिं मित्रस्य यायां पथा ।अस्य प्रियस्य शर्मण्यहिंसानस्य सश्चिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ nūnám ǀ aśyā́m ǀ gátim ǀ mitrásya ǀ yāyām ǀ pathā́ ǀásya ǀ priyásya ǀ śármaṇi ǀ áhiṃsānasya ǀ saścire ǁ
verses.english_translation: That I may now pursue the (right) direction, may I proceed by the path of Mitra, for all (good things) are aggregated in the happiness, (the gift) of that beloved and benignant (deity).
verses.wilson_translation: That I may now pursue the (right) direction, may I proceed by the path of Mitra, for all (good things) are aggregated in the happiness, (the gift) of that beloved and benignant (deity).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवाभ्यां मित्रावरुणोपमं धेयामृचा ।यद्ध क्षये मघोनां स्तोतॄणां च स्पूर्धसे ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvā́bhyām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ upa-mám ǀ dheyām ǀ ṛcā́ ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ kṣáye ǀ maghónām ǀ stotṝṇā́m ǀ ca ǀ spūrdháse ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I obtain from you,Mitraand Varuṇa, by my praise, such  wealth as to excite envy in the dwellings of the rich and the devout.
verses.wilson_translation: May I obtain from you,Mitraand Varuṇa, by my praise, such  wealth as to excite envy in the dwellings of the rich and the devout.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो मित्र सुदीतिभिर्वरुणश्च सधस्थ आ ।स्वे क्षये मघोनां सखीनां च वृधसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitra ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǀsvé ǀ kṣáye ǀ maghónām ǀ sákhīnām ǀ ca ǀ vṛdháse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Mitra(come),Varuṇa, with your splendour to our assembly, and augment (the prosperity) of the affluent (worshipper), and of (those who are) your friends in their respective abodes.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Mitra(come),Varuṇa, with your splendour to our assembly, and augment (the prosperity) of the affluent (worshipper), and of (those who are) your friends in their respective abodes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं नो येषु वरुण क्षत्रं बृहच्च बिभृथः ।उरु णो वाजसातये कृतं राये स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ naḥ ǀ yéṣu ǀ varuṇā ǀ kṣatrám ǀ bṛhát ǀ ca ǀ bibhṛtháḥ ǀurú ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ kṛtám ǀ rāyé ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Mitraand Varuṇa, bring us strength and abundant (food) for (those praises) which (we offer); be largely bountiful to us in food, in riches, in prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Mitraand Varuṇa, bring us strength and abundant (food) for (those praises) which (we offer); be largely bountiful to us in food, in riches, in prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उच्छंत्यां मे यजता देवक्षत्रे रुशद्गवि ।सुतं सोमं न हस्तिभिरा पड्भिर्धावतं नरा बिभ्रतावर्चनानसं ॥
verses.transliteration: ucchántyām ǀ me ǀ yajatā́ ǀ devá-kṣatre ǀ rúśat-gavi ǀsutám ǀ sómam ǀ ná ǀ hastí-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ paṭ-bhíḥ ǀ dhāvatam ǀ narā ǀ bíbhratau ǀ arcanā́nasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deities who are to be worshipped at the sacrifice to the gods, at the (first) shining ray (of light) at dawn; behold my Somalibation poured out; hasten, with rapid steeds, leaders (of rites), propitious to Arcanānas.
verses.wilson_translation: Deities who are to be worshipped at the sacrifice to the gods, at the (first) shining ray (of light) at dawn; behold my Somalibation poured out; hasten, with rapid steeds, leaders (of rites), propitious to Arcanānas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXV Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FULL wise is he who hath discerned: let him speak to us of the Gods,—The man whose praise-songs Varuṇa the beautiful, or Mitra, loves. For they are Kings of noblest might, of glorious fame most widely spread;Lords of the brave, who strengthen Law, the Holy Ones with every race. Approaching you with prayer for aid, together I address you firstWe who have good steeds call on you, Most Sage, to give us strength besides. E’en out of misery Mitra gives a way to dwelling at our case,For he who worships hath the grace of Mitra, fighter in the van. ' In Mitra's shelter that extends to utmost distance may we dwell,Unmenaced, guarded by the care, ever as sons of Varuṇa. Ye, Mitra, urge this people on, and to one end direct their ways.Neglect not ye the wealthy chiefs, neglect not us the Ṛṣis: be our guardians when ye quaff the milk.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चिकेत स सुक्रतुर्देवत्रा स ब्रवीतु नः ।वरुणो यस्य दर्शतो मित्रो वा वनते गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ cikéta ǀ sáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ bravītu ǀ naḥ ǀváruṇaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ vā ǀ vánate ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who knows (how to honour you two) among the gods, is ghe performer of good works; let him, communicate (that knowledge) to us, he of whom the graceful Varuṇaor Mitraaccepts the laudation.
verses.wilson_translation: He who knows (how to honour you two) among the gods, is ghe performer of good works; let him, communicate (that knowledge) to us, he of whom the graceful Varuṇaor Mitraaccepts the laudation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता हि श्रेष्ठवर्चसा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा ।ता सत्पती ऋतावृध ऋतावाना जनेजने ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ śréṣṭha-varcasā ǀ rā́jānā ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamā ǀtā́ ǀ sátpatī íti sát-patī ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhā ǀ ṛtá-vānā ǀ jáne-jane ǁ
verses.english_translation: They two, verily excelling in radiance, royal (deities), who hear (invocations) from the greatest distance; lords of the virtuous, favourers of the sacrifice, are in movement (for the good of) each individual man.
verses.wilson_translation: They two, verily excelling in radiance, royal (deities), who hear (invocations) from the greatest distance; lords of the virtuous, favourers of the sacrifice, are in movement (for the good of) each individual man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता वामियानोऽवसे पूर्वा उप ब्रुवे सचा ।स्वश्वासः सु चेतुना वाजाँ अभि प्र दावने ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ iyānáḥ ǀ ávase ǀ pū́rvau ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ sácā ǀsu-áśvāsaḥ ǀ sú ǀ cetúnā ǀ vā́jān ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ dāváne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Approaching you, ancient (divinities), I invoke you together for protection; possessed of good steeds, (we praise you) who are provident to give us food.
verses.wilson_translation: Approaching you, ancient (divinities), I invoke you together for protection; possessed of good steeds, (we praise you) who are provident to give us food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रो अंहोश्चिदादुरु क्षयाय गातुं वनते ।मित्रस्य हि प्रतूर्वतः सुमतिरस्ति विधतः ॥
verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́t ǀ urú ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ gātúm ǀ vanate ǀmitrásya ǀ hí ǀ pra-tū́rvataḥ ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ ásti ǀ vidhatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitragrants even to the sinful (worshipper) the (means of) repairing to his spacious dwelling; the favour of Mitra, the destroyer fo foes, is (granted) to (his) adorer.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitragrants even to the sinful (worshipper) the (means of) repairing to his spacious dwelling; the favour of Mitra, the destroyer fo foes, is (granted) to (his) adorer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं मित्रस्यावसि स्याम सप्रथस्तमे ।अनेहसस्त्वोतयः सत्रा वरुणशेषसः ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ mitrásya ǀ ávasi ǀ syā́ma ǀ sapráthaḥ-tame ǀanehásaḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtayaḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ váruṇa-śeṣasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we ever be in the comprehensive guardianship of Mitra, and, free from sin, enjoy, (Mitra), your protection, being at the same time the children of Varuṇa
verses.wilson_translation: May we ever be in the comprehensive guardianship of Mitra, and, free from sin, enjoy, (Mitra), your protection, being at the same time the children of Varuṇa
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं मित्रेमं जनं यतथः सं च नयथः ।मा मघोनः परि ख्यतं मो अस्माकमृषीणां गोपीथे न उरुष्यतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ mitrā ǀ imám ǀ jánam ǀ yátathaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ nayathaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ pári ǀ khyatam ǀ mó íti ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ go-pīthé ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: You come,Mitraand Varuṇa, to this man, and guide him (to his desires); deny us not when we are rich (in offerings); (deny us not), who are (the sons) of ṛṣis protect us in the presenting of the libation.
verses.wilson_translation: You come,Mitraand Varuṇa, to this man, and guide him (to his desires); deny us not when we are rich (in offerings); (deny us not), who are (the sons) of ṛṣis protect us in the presenting of the libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVI. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O SAPIENT man, call the Two Gods, the very wise, who slay the foe.For Varuṇa, whose form is Law, place offerings for his great delight. For they have won unbroken sway in full perfection, power divine.And, like high laws, the world of man hath been made beautiful as light. Therefore we praise you that your cars may travel far in front of ours-You who accept the eulogy of Ratahavya with his hymns. And ye show wMom, Wondrous Gods with fulness of intellIgence.By men's discernment are Ve marked, O ye whose might is purified. This is the Law sublime, O Earth: to aid the Ṛṣis’ toil for fameThe Two, wide-spreading, are prepared. They come with ample overflow. Mitra, ye Gods with wandering eyes, would that the worshippers and weMight strive to reach the realm ye rule, most spacious and protected well,

verses.sanskrit: आ चिकितान सुक्रतू देवौ मर्त रिशादसा ।वरुणाय ऋतपेशसे दधीत प्रयसे महे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ cikitāna ǀ sukrátū íti su-krátū ǀ deváu ǀ marta ǀ riśā́dasā ǀváruṇāya ǀ ṛtá-peśase ǀ dadhītá ǀ práyase ǀ mahé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Man, endowed with intelligence, (adore) the two deities, the performers of good deeds, the destroyers of foes; offer (oblations) to the adorable accepter of (sacrificial) food, to Varuṇa, whose form is water.
verses.wilson_translation: Man, endowed with intelligence, (adore) the two deities, the performers of good deeds, the destroyers of foes; offer (oblations) to the adorable accepter of (sacrificial) food, to Varuṇa, whose form is water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता हि क्षत्रमविह्रुतं सम्यगसुर्यमाशाते ।अध व्रतेव मानुषं स्वर्ण धायि दर्शतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ávi-hrutam ǀ samyák ǀ asuryám ǀ ā́śāte íti ǀádha ǀ vratā́-iva ǀ mā́nuṣam ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhāyi ǀ darśatám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch as you two are possessed of irresistible andasura-subduing strength, therefore has holy sacrifice been established among men, as the sun (has been plural ced) in the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch as you two are possessed of irresistible andasura-subduing strength, therefore has holy sacrifice been established among men, as the sun (has been plural ced) in the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता वामेषे रथानामुर्वीं गव्यूतिमेषां ।रातहव्यस्य सुष्टुतिं दधृक्स्तोमैर्मनामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ éṣe ǀ ráthānām ǀ urvī́m ǀ gávyūtim ǀ eṣām ǀrātá-havyasya ǀ su-stutím ǀ dadhṛ́k ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ manāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We glorify you both, that your chariots may precede ours by a long distance; accepting the pious worship of Rātahavya with (his) praises.
verses.wilson_translation: We glorify you both, that your chariots may precede ours by a long distance; accepting the pious worship of Rātahavya with (his) praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा हि काव्या युवं दक्षस्य पूर्भिरद्भुता ।नि केतुना जनानां चिकेथे पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ kā́vyā ǀ yuvám ǀ dákṣasya ǀ pūḥ-bhíḥ ǀ adbhutā ǀní ǀ ketúnā ǀ jánānām ǀ cikéthe íti ǀ pūta-dakṣasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Now, adorable and wonderful deities, (propitiated) by the former (praises) of (me, your) worshipper; do you, who are of pure vigour, consider with approving minds (the adoration) of these men.
verses.wilson_translation: Now, adorable and wonderful deities, (propitiated) by the former (praises) of (me, your) worshipper; do you, who are of pure vigour, consider with approving minds (the adoration) of these men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदृतं पृथिवि बृहच्छ्रवएष ऋषीणां ।ज्रयसानावरं पृथ्वति क्षरंति यामभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ ṛtám ǀ pṛthivi ǀ bṛhát ǀ śravaḥ-eṣé ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀjrayasānáu ǀ áram ǀ pṛthú ǀ áti ǀ kṣaranti ǀ yā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Earth, in you is abundant water for the necessities of the Ṛṣis; the two active (deities) dispense by their movement sufficiently copious (rain).
verses.wilson_translation: Earth, in you is abundant water for the necessities of the Ṛṣis; the two active (deities) dispense by their movement sufficiently copious (rain).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यद्वामीयचक्षसा मित्र वयं च सूरयः ।व्यचिष्ठे बहुपाय्ये यतेमहि स्वराज्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ īya-cakṣasā ǀ mítrā ǀ vayám ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀvyáciṣṭhe ǀ bahu-pā́yye ǀ yátemahi ǀ sva-rā́jye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We and the devout (invoke) you,Mitraand Varuṇa, who are far-seeing; may we proceed to your spacious and much frequented kingdom.
verses.wilson_translation: We and the devout (invoke) you,Mitraand Varuṇa, who are far-seeing; may we proceed to your spacious and much frequented kingdom.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVII. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YE Gods, Ādityas, Varuṇa, Aryaman, Mitra, verilyHave here obtained supremest sway, high, holy, set apart for you. When, Varuṇa and Mitra, ye sit in your golden dwelling-place,Ye Twain, supporters of mankind, foeslayers, give felicity. All these, possessors of all wealth, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman,Follow their ways, as if with feet, and guard from injury mortal man. For they are true, they cleave to Law, held holy among every race,Good leaders, bounteous in their gifts, deliverers even from distress. Which of your persons, Varuṇa or Mitra, merits not our praise?Therefore our thought is turned to you, the Atris' thought is turned to you.

verses.sanskrit: बळित्था देव निष्कृतमादित्या यजतं बृहत् ।वरुण मित्रार्यमन्वर्षिष्ठं क्षत्रमाशाथे ॥
verses.transliteration: báṭ ǀ itthā́ ǀ devā ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ ā́dityā ǀ yajatám ǀ bṛhát ǀváruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ kṣatrám ǀ āśāthe íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine sons of Aditi,Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, verily you are possessed, at the present time, of perfect, adorable, vast, exceeding strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine sons of Aditi,Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, verily you are possessed, at the present time, of perfect, adorable, vast, exceeding strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययं वरुण मित्र सदथः ।धर्तारा चर्षणीनां यंतं सुम्नं रिशादसा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ yónim ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ sádathaḥ ǀdhartā́rā ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ yantám ǀ sumnám ǀ riśādasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: When you come,Varuṇaand Mitra, to the delightful plural ce of sacrifice, then, supporters of men, destroyers of foes, you bring felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: When you come,Varuṇaand Mitra, to the delightful plural ce of sacrifice, then, supporters of men, destroyers of foes, you bring felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे हि विश्ववेदसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।व्रता पदेव सश्चिरे पांति मर्त्यं रिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀvratā́ ǀ padā́-iva ǀ saścire ǀ pā́nti ǀ mártyam ǀ riṣáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, who are possessed of omniscience, are all associated at our rites, as if in (their respective) station, and protect the worshipper from the malignant.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, who are possessed of omniscience, are all associated at our rites, as if in (their respective) station, and protect the worshipper from the malignant.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते हि सत्या ऋतस्पृश ऋतावानो जनेजने ।सुनीथासः सुदानवोऽंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ jáne-jane ǀsu-nīthā́saḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ uru-cákrayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They verily are observers of truth, distributors of water, protectors of holy rites among men; guides in the right way, liberal donors, and benefactors even of the sinner (who worships them).
verses.wilson_translation: They verily are observers of truth, distributors of water, protectors of holy rites among men; guides in the right way, liberal donors, and benefactors even of the sinner (who worships them).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: को नु वां मित्रास्तुतो वरुणो वा तनूनां ।तत्सु वामेषते मतिरत्रिभ्य एषते मतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: káḥ ǀ nú ǀ vām ǀ mitra ǀ ástutaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ vā ǀ tanū́nām ǀtát ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǀ matíḥ ǀ átri-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǀ matíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Which of you,Mitraand Varuṇa, has not been celebrated in (our) praise, for therefore do our thoughts tend towards you; the thoughts of the lineage of Atritend towards you.
verses.wilson_translation: Which of you,Mitraand Varuṇa, has not been celebrated in (our) praise, for therefore do our thoughts tend towards you; the thoughts of the lineage of Atritend towards you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVIII. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING forth unto your Varuṇa and Mitra with a song inspired.They, Mighty Lords, are lofty Law Full springs of fatness, Sovran Kings, Mitra. and Varuṇa, the Twain,Gods glorified among the Gods. So help ye us to riches, great terrestrial and celestial wealth:Vast is your sway among the Gods. Carefully tending Law with Law they have attained their vigorous might.The two Gods wax devoid of guile. With rainy skies and streaming floods, Lords of the strength that bringeth gifts,A lofty seat have they attained.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो मित्राय गायत वरुणाय विपा गिरा ।महिक्षत्रावृतं बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ gāyata ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vipā́ ǀ girā́ ǀmáhi-kṣatrau ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing loud with lusty praise to Mitraand Varuṇa; (come), mighty deities, to the great sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing loud with lusty praise to Mitraand Varuṇa; (come), mighty deities, to the great sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सम्राजा या घृतयोनी मित्रश्चोभा वरुणश्च ।देवा देवेषु प्रशस्ता ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-rā́jā ǀ yā́ ǀ ghṛtáyonī íti ghṛtá-yonī ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ ubhā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀdevā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ pra-śastā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, who are both sovereign rulers, originators of the rain, eminent deities among the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, who are both sovereign rulers, originators of the rain, eminent deities among the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य ।महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śaktam ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ divyásya ǀmáhi ǀ vām ǀ kṣatrám ǀ devéṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: They two are able (to grant us) of great terrestrial and celestial riches; great is your might among the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: They two are able (to grant us) of great terrestrial and celestial riches; great is your might among the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतमृतेन सपंतेषिरं दक्षमाशाते ।अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ ṛténa ǀ sápantā ǀ iṣirám ǀ dákṣam ǀ āśāte íti ǀadrúhā ǀ deváu ǀ vardhete íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rewarding with rain the holy rite, they favour the zealous worshipper; benevolent deities, may you prosper.
verses.wilson_translation: Rewarding with rain the holy rite, they favour the zealous worshipper; benevolent deities, may you prosper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः ।बृहंतं गर्तमाशाते ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṭí-dyāvā ǀ rītí-āpā ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀ dā́nu-matyāḥ ǀbṛhántam ǀ gártam ǀ āśāte íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Senders of rain from heaven, granters of desires, lords of sustenance, suited to the liberal donors (of oblations), they ascend their spacious car.
verses.wilson_translation: Senders of rain from heaven, granters of desires, lords of sustenance, suited to the liberal donors (of oblations), they ascend their spacious car.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIX. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THREE spheres of light, O Varuṇa, three heavens, three firmaments ye comprehend, O Mitra:Waxed strong, ye keep the splendour of dominion, guarding the Ordinance that lasts for ever. Ye, Varuṇa, have kine who yield refreshment; Mitra, your floods pour water full of sweetness.There stand the Three Steers, splendid in their brightness, who fill the three world-bowls with genial moisture. I call at dawn on Aditi the Goddess, I call at noon and when the Sun is setting.I pray, O Mitra-Varuṇa, for safety, for wealth and progeny, in rest and trouble. Ye who uphold the region, sphere of brightness, ye who support earth's realm Divine Ādityas,The Immortal Gods, O Varuṇa and Mitra, never impair your everlasting statutes.

verses.sanskrit: त्री रोचना वरुण त्रीँरुत द्यूंत्रीणि मित्र धारयथो रजांसि ।वावृधानावमतिं क्षत्रियस्यानु व्रतं रक्षमाणावजुर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ varuṇa ǀ trī́n ǀ utá ǀ dyū́n ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ mitra ǀ dhārayathaḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀvavṛdhānáu ǀ amátim ǀ kṣatríyasya ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ rákṣamāṇau ǀ ajuryám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, you uphold the three realms of light, the three heavens, the three regions (of the earth), augmenting the force of the vigorous (indra) and protecting the imperishable rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, you uphold the three realms of light, the three heavens, the three regions (of the earth), augmenting the force of the vigorous (indra) and protecting the imperishable rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इरावतीर्वरुण धेनवो वां मधुमद्वां सिंधवो मित्र दुह्रे ।त्रयस्तस्थुर्वृषभासस्तिसृणां धिषणानां रेतोधा वि द्युमंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: írā-vatīḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vām ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ vām ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ mitra ǀ duhre ǀtráyaḥ ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ vṛṣabhā́saḥ ǀ tisṝṇā́m ǀ dhiṣáṇānām ǀ retaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ dyu-mántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, the cows are full o fmilk through your (command), and the rivers yield through your (will) sweet water; through you the three radiant receptacles and showerers of rain stand severally in their three spheres.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, the cows are full o fmilk through your (command), and the rivers yield through your (will) sweet water; through you the three radiant receptacles and showerers of rain stand severally in their three spheres.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रातर्देवीमदितिं जोहवीमि मध्यंदिन उदिता सूर्यस्य ।राये मित्रावरुणा सर्वतातेळे तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ॥
verses.transliteration: prātáḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ áditim ǀ johavīmi ǀ madhyándine ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀrāyé ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ ī́ḷe ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke the divine and bright Aditiat dawn, and at mid-day, when the sun is high; I worship you,Mitraand Varuṇa, at all seasons, for the sake of riches, for sons and grandsons, for prosperity and happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke the divine and bright Aditiat dawn, and at mid-day, when the sun is high; I worship you,Mitraand Varuṇa, at all seasons, for the sake of riches, for sons and grandsons, for prosperity and happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या धर्तारा रजसो रोचनस्योतादित्या दिव्या पार्थिवस्य ।न वां देवा अमृता आ मिनंति व्रतानि मित्रावरुणा ध्रुवाणि ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ dhartā́rā ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ rocanásya ǀ utá ǀ ādityā́ ǀ divyā́ ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀná ǀ vām ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ minanti ǀ vratā́ni ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ dhruvā́ṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: I worship you two, divineĀdityas, who are upholders of the celestial and terrestrial worlds; the immortal gods impair not,Mitraand Varuṇa, your eternal works.
verses.wilson_translation: I worship you two, divineĀdityas, who are upholders of the celestial and terrestrial worlds; the immortal gods impair not,Mitraand Varuṇa, your eternal works.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXX. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . EVEN far and wide, O Varuṇa and Mitra, doth your grace extend.May I obtain your kind good-will. From you, benignant Gods, may we gain fully food for sustenance.Such, O ye Rudras, my we be. Guard us, O Rudras. with your guar save us, ye skilled to save, my weSubdue the Dasyus, we ourselves, Or ne’er may we, O Wondrous Strong, enjoy another's solemn feast,Ourselves, our sons, or progeny.

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरुणा चिद्ध्यस्त्यवो नूनं वां वरुण ।मित्र वंसि वां सुमतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: puru-urúṇā ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ ásti ǀ ávaḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ vām ǀ varuṇa ǀmítra ǀ váṃsi ǀ vām ǀ su-matím ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I,Mitraand Varuṇa, enjoy your favour through which there is assuredly protection.
verses.wilson_translation: May I,Mitraand Varuṇa, enjoy your favour through which there is assuredly protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता वां सम्यगद्रुह्वाणेषमश्याम धायसे ।वयं ते रुद्रा स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ samyák ǀ adruhvāṇā ǀ íṣam ǀ aśyāma ǀ dhā́yase ǀvayám ǀ té ǀ rudrā ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Benignant (deities), may we obtain from you, (who are) such (deities), food for our sustenance; may we Rudras, be yours.
verses.wilson_translation: Benignant (deities), may we obtain from you, (who are) such (deities), food for our sustenance; may we Rudras, be yours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पातं नो रुद्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथां सुत्रात्रा ।तुर्याम दस्यूंतनूभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: pātám ǀ naḥ ǀ rudrā ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ trāyethām ǀ su-trātrā́ ǀturyā́ma ǀ dásyūn ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect us with your protections; preserve us with kind preservation; may we, with our descendants, overcome the Dasyus.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us with your protections; preserve us with kind preservation; may we, with our descendants, overcome the Dasyus.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा कस्याद्भुतक्रतू यक्षं भुजेमा तनूभिः ।मा शेषसा मा तनसा ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ kásya ǀ adbhutakratū ítyadbhuta-kratū ǀ yakṣám ǀ bhujema ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀmā́ ǀ śéṣasā ǀ mā́ ǀ tánasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Workers of wondrous deeds, let us not depend upon the bounty of any other (than you), either in our person ns, or with our sons and grandsons.
verses.wilson_translation: Workers of wondrous deeds, let us not depend upon the bounty of any other (than you), either in our person ns, or with our sons and grandsons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXI. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O Varuṇa and Mitra, ye who slay the foemen, come with mightTo this our goodly sacrifice. For, Varuṇa and Mitra, ye Sages are Rulers over all. Fill full our songs, for this ye can. Come to the juice that we have pressed. Varuṇa, Mitra, come to drinkThis Soma of the worshipper.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो गंतं रिशादसा वरुण मित्र बर्हणा ।उपेमं चारुमध्वरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ riśādasā ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ barháṇā ǀúpa ǀ imám ǀ cā́rum ǀ adhvarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, scatterers of foes, destroyers of enemies, come to this our accessible sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, scatterers of foes, destroyers of enemies, come to this our accessible sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्य हि प्रचेतसा वरुण मित्र राजथः ।ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvasya ǀ hí ǀ pra-cetasā ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ rā́jathaḥ ǀīśānā́ ǀ pipyatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sagacious Mitraand Varuṇa, you reign over all bestow fullness, lords, upon our ancient rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Sagacious Mitraand Varuṇa, you reign over all bestow fullness, lords, upon our ancient rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप नः सुतमा गतं वरुण मित्र दाशुषः ।अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Mitraand Varuṇa, to our effused libation to drink of the Somaof the offerer.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Mitraand Varuṇa, to our effused libation to drink of the Somaof the offerer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXII. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: To Varuṇa and Mitra we offer with songs, as Atri did. Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice. By Ordinance and Law ye dwell in peace secure, bestirring men.Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice. May Varuṇa and Mitra, for our help, accept the sacrifice.Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sanskrit: आ मित्रे वरुणे वयं गीर्भिर्जुहुमो अत्रिवत् ।नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mitré ǀ váruṇe ǀ vayám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ juhumaḥ ǀ atri-vát ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sadatam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke Mitraand Varuṇawith hymns, like (our progenitor)Atri; do you sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Somalibation.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke Mitraand Varuṇawith hymns, like (our progenitor)Atri; do you sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Somalibation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्रतेन स्थो ध्रुवक्षेमा धर्मणा यातयज्जना ।नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: vraténa ǀ sthaḥ ǀ dhruvá-kṣemā ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ yātayát-janā ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sadatam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Steady are you in your functions, whom men animate by (their) devotion; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Somalibation.
verses.wilson_translation: Steady are you in your functions, whom men animate by (their) devotion; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Somalibation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रश्च नो वरुणश्च जुषेतां यज्ञमिष्टये ।नि बर्हिषि सदतां सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ juṣétām ǀ yajñám ǀ iṣṭáye ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sadatam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Mitraand Varuṇa, accept wiht satisfaction our sacrifice; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Somalibation.
verses.wilson_translation: May Mitraand Varuṇa, accept wiht satisfaction our sacrifice; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Somalibation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXIII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHETHER, O Aśvins, ye this day be far remote or near at hand,In many spots or in mid-air, come hither, Lords of ample wealth. These here, who show o’er widest space, bringing full many a wondrous act,Resistless, lovingly I seek, I call the Mightiest to enjoy. Another beauteous wheel have ye fixed there to decorate your car.With others through the realms ye roam in might unto the neighbouring tribes. That deed of yours that is extolled, Visvas! hath all been done with this.Born otherwise, and spotless, ye have entered kinship's bonds with us. When Sūrya mounted on your car that rolls for ever rapidly,Birds of red hue were round about and burning splendours compassed you. Atri bethinks himself of you, O Heroes, with a friendly mind,What time, Nāsatyas, with his mouth he stirs the spotless flame for you. Strong is your swiftly moving steed, famed his exertion in the courseWhen by your great deeds, Aśvins, Chiefs, Atri is brought to us again. Lovers of sweetness, Rudras, she who streams with sweetness waits on you.When ye have travelled through the seas men bring you gifts of well-dressed food. Aśvins, with truth they call you Twain bestowers of felicity;At sacrifice most prompt to hear, most gracious ye at sacrifice. Most pleasing to the Aśvins be these prayers which magnify their might,Which we have fashioned, even as cars high reverence have we spoken forth.

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य स्थः परावति यदर्वावत्यश्विना ।यद्वा पुरू पुरुभुजा यदंतरिक्ष आ गतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ stháḥ ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ arvā-váti ǀ aśvinā ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ purú ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ yát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether,Aśvins, you are at present far, whether you are nigh, whether you are (straying) many plural ces, or whether you are in mid-air, do you, who partake of many offerings, come hither.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether,Aśvins, you are at present far, whether you are nigh, whether you are (straying) many plural ces, or whether you are in mid-air, do you, who partake of many offerings, come hither.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा पुरू दंसांसि बिभ्रता ।वरस्या याम्यध्रिगू हुवे तुविष्टमा भुजे ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ puru-bhū́tamā ǀ purú ǀ dáṃsāṃsi ǀ bíbhratā ǀvarasyā́ ǀ yāmi ǀ ádhrigū ítyadhri-gū ǀ huvé ǀ tuvíḥ-tamā ǀ bhujé ǁ
verses.english_translation: I approach you (to invite you) hither, you who are the encouragers of many; (who are) the achievers of many (great) exploits, most excellent and irresistible, I invoke you, who are most mighty, for protection.
verses.wilson_translation: I approach you (to invite you) hither, you who are the encouragers of many; (who are) the achievers of many (great) exploits, most excellent and irresistible, I invoke you, who are most mighty, for protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईर्मान्यद्वपुषे वपुश्चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः ।पर्यन्या नाहुषा युगा मह्ना रजांसि दीयथः ॥
verses.transliteration: īrmā́ ǀ anyát ǀ vápuṣe ǀ vápuḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ ráthasya ǀ yemathuḥ ǀpári ǀ anyā́ ǀ nā́huṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ dīyathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You hae arrested one luminous wheel of (your) car for illumining the form (of the sun), while with the other you traverse the spheres (to regulate) by your power the ages of mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: You hae arrested one luminous wheel of (your) car for illumining the form (of the sun), while with the other you traverse the spheres (to regulate) by your power the ages of mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदू षु वामेना कृतं विश्वा यद्वामनु ष्टवे ।नाना जातावरेपसा समस्मे बंधुमेयथुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ enā́ ǀ kṛtám ǀ víśvā ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ ánu ǀ stáve ǀnā́nā ǀ jātáu ǀ arepásā ǀ sám ǀ asmé íti ǀ bándhum ǀ ā́ ǀ īyathuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the praise, universal (deities), wherewith I laud you, be agreeable to you, as offered by this (your worshipper); and do yo, who are severally born, and free from blame bestow upon us food.
verses.wilson_translation: May the praise, universal (deities), wherewith I laud you, be agreeable to you, as offered by this (your worshipper); and do yo, who are severally born, and free from blame bestow upon us food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यद्वां सूर्या रथं तिष्ठद्रघुष्यदं सदा ।परि वामरुषा वयो घृणा वरंत आतपः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ sūryā́ ǀ rátham ǀ tíṣṭhat ǀ raghu-syádam ǀ sádā ǀpári ǀ vām ǀ aruṣā́ḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ghṛṇā́ ǀ varante ǀ ā-tápaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When Sūryahas ascended your ever easy-moving car, then bright-waving, resplendent rays (of light) encompass you.
verses.wilson_translation: When Sūryahas ascended your ever easy-moving car, then bright-waving, resplendent rays (of light) encompass you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवोरत्रिश्चिकेतति नरा सुम्नेन चेतसा ।घर्मं यद्वामरेपसं नासत्यास्ना भुरण्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ átriḥ ǀ ciketati ǀ nárā ǀ sumnéna ǀ cétasā ǀgharmám ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ arepásam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ āsnā́ ǀ bhuraṇyáti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders (of rites),Atrirecognized (your benevolence) with (a grateful) mind on account of the relief (you afforded him), when,Nāsatyās, through his praise of you, he found the (fiery) heat innocuous.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders (of rites),Atrirecognized (your benevolence) with (a grateful) mind on account of the relief (you afforded him), when,Nāsatyās, through his praise of you, he found the (fiery) heat innocuous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उग्रो वां ककुहो ययिः शृण्वे यामेषु संतनिः ।यद्वां दंसोभिरश्विनात्रिर्नराववर्तति ॥
verses.transliteration: ugráḥ ǀ vām ǀ kakuháḥ ǀ yayíḥ ǀ śṛṇvé ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ sam-taníḥ ǀyát ǀ vām ǀ dáṃsaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ átriḥ ǀ narā ǀ ā-vavártati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your strong, lofty, moving, ever-progressing (ear) has been renowned at sacrifices ever since;Aśvins, leaders (of rites),Atriwas rescued by your acts.
verses.wilson_translation: Your strong, lofty, moving, ever-progressing (ear) has been renowned at sacrifices ever since;Aśvins, leaders (of rites),Atriwas rescued by your acts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मध्व ऊ षु मधूयुवा रुद्रा सिषक्ति पिप्युषी ।यत्समुद्राति पर्षथः पक्वाः पृक्षो भरंत वां ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ madhu-yuvā ǀ rúdrā ǀ sísakti ǀ pipyúṣī ǀyát ǀ samudrā́ ǀ áti ǀ párṣathaḥ ǀ pakvā́ḥ ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ bharanta ǀ vām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mixers of the Somajuice,Rudras, (our) nutritious (adoration) bedews you will with the libation, when you traverse (the limits) of the firmament, and the prepared viands (of the sacrifice) support you.
verses.wilson_translation: Mixers of the Somajuice,Rudras, (our) nutritious (adoration) bedews you will with the libation, when you traverse (the limits) of the firmament, and the prepared viands (of the sacrifice) support you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमिद्वा उ अश्विना युवामाहुर्मयोभुवा ।ता यामन्यामहूतमा यामन्ना मृळयत्तमा ॥
verses.transliteration: satyám ǀ ít ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvā́m ǀ āhuḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀtā́ ǀ yā́man ǀ yāma-hū́tamā ǀ yā́man ǀ ā́ ǀ mṛḷayát-tamā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Truly have they called you,Aśvins, the bestowers of felicity; such may you be when earnestly invoked to our sacrifice; bountiful bestowers of felicity at our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Truly have they called you,Aśvins, the bestowers of felicity; such may you be when earnestly invoked to our sacrifice; bountiful bestowers of felicity at our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमा ब्रह्माणि वर्धनाश्विभ्यां संतु शंतमा ।या तक्षाम रथाँ इवावोचाम बृहन्नमः ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ várdhanā ǀ aśví-bhyām ǀ santu ǀ śám-tamā ǀyā́ ǀ tákṣāma ǀ ráthān-iva ǀ ávocāma ǀ bṛhát ǀ námaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May these praises exalting the Aśvinsbe productive of happiness, the praise that we fabricate as (a wheelwright) a car; we proclaim aloud fervent adoration.
verses.wilson_translation: May these praises exalting the Aśvinsbe productive of happiness, the praise that we fabricate as (a wheelwright) a car; we proclaim aloud fervent adoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXIV. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHERE in the heavens are ye to-day, Gods, Aśvins, rich in constancy?Hear this, ye excellent as Steers: Atri inviteth you to come. Where are they now? Where are the Twain, the famed Nāsatyas, Gods in heaven?Who is the man ye strive to reach? Who of your suppliants is with you? Whom do ye visit, whom approach? to whom direct your harnessed car?With whose devotions are ye pleased? We long for you to further us. Ye, Strengtheners, for Paura stir the filler swimming in the flood,Advancing to be captured like a lion to the ambuscade. Ye from cyavana worn with age removed his skin as ’twere a robe.So, when ye made him young again, he stirred the longing of a dame. Here is the man who lauds you both: to see your glory are we here.Now bear me, come with saving help, ye who are rich in store of wealth. Who among many mortal men this day hath won you to himself?What bard, accepters of the bard? Who, rich in wealth! with sacrifice? O Aśvins, may your car approach, most excellent of cars for speed.Through many regions may our praise pass onward among mortal men. May our laudation of you Twain, lovers of meath! be sweet to you.Fly hitherward, ye wise of heart, like falcons with your winged steeds. O Aśvins, when at any time ye listen to this call of mine,For you is dainty food prepared: they mix refreshing food for you.

verses.sanskrit: कूष्ठो देवावश्विनाद्या दिवो मनावसू ।तच्छ्रवथो वृषण्वसू अत्रिर्वामा विवासति ॥
verses.transliteration: kū́-sthaḥ ǀ devau ǀ aśvinā ǀ adyá ǀ diváḥ ǀ manāvasū íti ǀtát ǀ śravathaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ átriḥ ǀ vām ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: DivineĀdityas, affluent in praise, descended this day from heaven upon the earth, hear that (laudation), which, liberal showerers (of benefits),Atriever address to you.
verses.wilson_translation: DivineĀdityas, affluent in praise, descended this day from heaven upon the earth, hear that (laudation), which, liberal showerers (of benefits),Atriever address to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कुह त्या कुह नु श्रुता दिवि देवा नासत्या ।कस्मिन्ना यतथो जने को वां नदीनां सचा ॥
verses.transliteration: kúha ǀ tyā́ ǀ kúha ǀ nú ǀ śrutā́ ǀ diví ǀ devā́ ǀ nā́satyā ǀkásmin ǀ ā́ ǀ yatathaḥ ǀ jáne ǀ káḥ ǀ vām ǀ nadī́nām ǀ sácā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine Nāsatyās, where are they? where are they heard if in heaven? to what worshipper do you come? who may be the associate of your praises?
verses.wilson_translation: The divine Nāsatyās, where are they? where are they heard if in heaven? to what worshipper do you come? who may be the associate of your praises?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कं याथः कं ह गच्छथः कमच्छा युंजाथे रथं ।कस्य ब्रह्माणि रण्यथो वयं वामुश्मसीष्टये ॥
verses.transliteration: kám ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ kám ǀ ha ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ kám ǀ áccha ǀ yuñjāthe íti ǀ rátham ǀkásya ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ raṇyathaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ vām ǀ uśmasi ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: To whom do you proceed? to whom do you repair? to (go to) whose presence do you harness your car? by whose prayers are you gratified? We are anxious for your arrival.
verses.wilson_translation: To whom do you proceed? to whom do you repair? to (go to) whose presence do you harness your car? by whose prayers are you gratified? We are anxious for your arrival.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पौरं चिद्ध्युदप्रुतं पौर पौराय जिन्वथः ।यदीं गृभीततातये सिंहमिव द्रुहस्पदे ॥
verses.transliteration: paurám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ uda-prútam ǀ páura ǀ paurā́ya ǀ jínvathaḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ gṛbhītá-tātaye ǀ siṃhám-iva ǀ druháḥ ǀ padé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pauras, send to Paurathe rain-shedding cloud drive it to him who is engaged in sacrifice, as (hunters chase) a lion in a forest.
verses.wilson_translation: Pauras, send to Paurathe rain-shedding cloud drive it to him who is engaged in sacrifice, as (hunters chase) a lion in a forest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र च्यवानाज्जुजुरुषो वव्रिमत्कं न मुंचथः ।युवा यदी कृथः पुनरा काममृण्वे वध्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ cyávānāt ǀ jujurúṣaḥ ǀ vavrím ǀ átkam ǀ ná ǀ muñcathaḥ ǀyúvā ǀ yádi ǀ kṛtháḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ṛṇve ǀ vadhváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You stripped off (his aged form) like a cuirass ffrom the decrepit Cyavāna, so that, when you had rendered him again a youth, he attracted the desires of women.
verses.wilson_translation: You stripped off (his aged form) like a cuirass ffrom the decrepit Cyavāna, so that, when you had rendered him again a youth, he attracted the desires of women.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति हि वामिह स्तोता स्मसि वां संदृशि श्रिये ।नू श्रुतं म आ गतमवोभिर्वाजिनीवसू ॥
verses.transliteration: ásti ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ ihá ǀ stotā́ ǀ smási ǀ vām ǀ sam-dṛ́śi ǀ śriyé ǀnú ǀ śrutám ǀ me ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǁ
verses.english_translation: A glorifier of you both is here; may we be (retained) in your sight for the sake of prosperity; hear today (my invocation); come hither with your protections, you who are affluent in food.
verses.wilson_translation: A glorifier of you both is here; may we be (retained) in your sight for the sake of prosperity; hear today (my invocation); come hither with your protections, you who are affluent in food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: को वामद्य पुरूणामा वव्ने मर्त्यानां ।को विप्रो विप्रवाहसा को यज्ञैर्वाजिनीवसू ॥
verses.transliteration: káḥ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ purūṇā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ vavne ǀ mártyānām ǀkáḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vipra-vāhasā ǀ káḥ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who among many mortals has this day (best) propitiated you? what wise man (has best propitiated you) who are reverenced by the wise? what (worshipper has best propitiated you) by sacrifice, you who are affluent in food?
verses.wilson_translation: Who among many mortals has this day (best) propitiated you? what wise man (has best propitiated you) who are reverenced by the wise? what (worshipper has best propitiated you) by sacrifice, you who are affluent in food?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां रथो रथानां येष्ठो यात्वश्विना ।पुरू चिदस्मयुस्तिर आंगूषो मर्त्येष्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ráthānām ǀ yéṣṭhaḥ ǀ yātu ǀ aśvinā ǀpurú ǀ cit ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ āṅgūṣáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your car,Aśvins, the swiftest of the cars (of the gods), come hither well-disposed towards us, the discomfiter of numerous (foes), glorified among men.
verses.wilson_translation: May your car,Aśvins, the swiftest of the cars (of the gods), come hither well-disposed towards us, the discomfiter of numerous (foes), glorified among men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शमू षु वां मधूयुवास्माकमस्तु चर्कृतिः ।अर्वाचीना विचेतसा विभिः श्येनेव दीयतं ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ madhu-yuvā ǀ asmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ carkṛtíḥ ǀarvācīnā́ ǀ vi-cetasā ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ śyenā́-iva ǀ dīyatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our repeated adoration of you two, who are desirous of the libation, be productive of felicity; descending to our presence, and exceeding in wisdom, travel with rapid (steeds), swift as two falcons.
verses.wilson_translation: May our repeated adoration of you two, who are desirous of the libation, be productive of felicity; descending to our presence, and exceeding in wisdom, travel with rapid (steeds), swift as two falcons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना यद्ध कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवं ।वस्वीरू षु वां भुजः पृंचंति सु वां पृचः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ kárhi ǀ cit ǀ śuśruyā́tam ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀvásvīḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ bhújaḥ ǀ pṛñcánti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ pṛ́caḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, wherever you may be, hear this invocation; the excellent sacrificial offerings, longing for your proximity, reach you.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, wherever you may be, hear this invocation; the excellent sacrificial offerings, longing for your proximity, reach you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXV. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To meet your treasure-bringing car, the mighty car most dear to us,Aśvins, the Ṛṣi is prepared, your raiser, with his song of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call. Pass, O ye Aśvins, pass away beyond all tribes of selfish men,Wonderful, with your golden paths, most gracious, bringers of the flood. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call. Come to us, O ye Aśvin Pair, bringing your precious treasures, comeYe Rudras, on your paths of gold, rejoicing, rich in store of wealth. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call. O strong and Good, the voice of him who lauds you well cleaves to your car.And that great beast, your chariot-steed, fair, wonderful, makes dainty food. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call. Watchful in spirit, born on cars, impetuous, listing to his cry,Aśvins, with winged steeds ye speed down to cyavana void of guile. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call. Hither, O Heroes, let your steeds, of dappled hue, yoked at the thought,Your flying steeds, O Aśvins, bring you hitherward, with bliss, to drink. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call. O Aśvins, hither come to us; Nāsatyas, be not disinclined.Through longing for the pious turn out of the way to reach our home. Lovers of sweetness, bear my call. Ye Lords of Splendour, free from guile, come, stand at this our sacrifice.Beside the singer, Aśvins, who longs for your grace and lauds you both. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call. Dawn with her white herd hath appeared, and in due time hath fire been placed.Harnessed is your immortal car, O WonderWorkers, strong and kind. Lovers of sweetness, bear my call.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति प्रियतमं रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनं ।स्तोता वामश्विनावृषिः स्तोमेन प्रति भूषति माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ priyá-tamam ǀ rátham ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vasu-vā́hanam ǀstotā́ ǀ vām ǀ aśvinau ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ stómena ǀ práti ǀ bhūṣati ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ṛṣi, your worshipper,Aśvins, graces your beloved chariot, the showerer (of benefits), the vehicle of wealth, with praises; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: The ṛṣi, your worshipper,Aśvins, graces your beloved chariot, the showerer (of benefits), the vehicle of wealth, with praises; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहं सना ।दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी सुषुम्ना सिंधुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: ati-ā́yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ tiráḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ahám ǀ sánā ǀdásrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀ sú-sumnā ǀ síndhu-vāhasā ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Passing by (other worshippers), come,Aśvins, hither, so that I may ever overcome all (adversaries);Dasras, riding in a golden chariot distributors of wealth, propellers of rivers, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: Passing by (other worshippers), come,Aśvins, hither, so that I may ever overcome all (adversaries);Dasras, riding in a golden chariot distributors of wealth, propellers of rivers, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवं ।रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rátnāni ǀ bíbhratau ǀ áśvinā ǀ gácchatam ǀ yuvám ǀrúdrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Aśvins, bring for us precious treasures;Rudras, riding in a golden chariot, propitiated (by sacrifice), affluent with food, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocatioṇ
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Aśvins, bring for us precious treasures;Rudras, riding in a golden chariot, propitiated (by sacrifice), affluent with food, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocatioṇ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुष्टुभो वां वृषण्वसू रथे वाणीच्याहिता ।उत वां ककुहो मृगः पृक्षः कृणोति वापुषो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: su-stúbhaḥ ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ ráthe ǀ vā́ṇīcī ǀ ā́-hitā ǀutá ǀ vām ǀ kakuháḥ ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ vāpuṣáḥ ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer of wealth, the praise of your worshipper is addressed to your chariot; (to it), as well as to you, does this distinguished, devoted, embodied (adorer) offer sacrificial food; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer of wealth, the praise of your worshipper is addressed to your chariot; (to it), as well as to you, does this distinguished, devoted, embodied (adorer) offer sacrificial food; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बोधिन्मनसा रथ्येषिरा हवनश्रुता ।विभिश्च्यवानमश्विना नि याथो अद्वयाविनं माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: bodhít-manasā ǀ rathyā́ ǀ iṣirā́ ǀ havana-śrútā ǀví-bhiḥ ǀ cyávānam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ní ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ ádvayāvinam ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: With mind attentive (to praise), riding in cars, swift-moving, listening to invocations, you hastened with your steeds to the single-purposedcyavana; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: With mind attentive (to praise), riding in cars, swift-moving, listening to invocations, you hastened with your steeds to the single-purposedcyavana; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां नरा मनोयुजोऽश्वासः प्रुषितप्सवः ।वयो वहंतु पीतये सह सुम्नेभिरश्विना माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ manaḥ-yújaḥ ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ pruṣitá-psavaḥ ǀváyaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ pītáye ǀ sahá ǀ sumnébhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, leaders (of rites), may your horses, harnessed at will, of wondrous beauty, and of rapid course, bring you hither with good gifts to drink (of the proffered beverage); masters of mystic lore,hear my invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, leaders (of rites), may your horses, harnessed at will, of wondrous beauty, and of rapid course, bring you hither with good gifts to drink (of the proffered beverage); masters of mystic lore,hear my invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विनावेह गच्छतं नासत्या मा वि वेनतं ।तिरश्चिदर्यया परि वर्तिर्यातमदाभ्या माध्वी मम श्रुतं हव��� ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvinau ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gacchatam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ venatam ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ arya-yā́ ǀ pári ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ adābhyā ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, come hither;Nāsatyas, be not unpropitious; invincible lords, come from hidden (regions) to our sacrificial hall; maste of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, come hither;Nāsatyas, be not unpropitious; invincible lords, come from hidden (regions) to our sacrificial hall; maste of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्यज्ञे अदाभ्या जरितारं शुभस्पती ।अवस्युमश्विना युवं गृणंतमुप भूषथो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ adābhyā ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀavasyúm ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ úpa ǀ bhūṣathaḥ ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invincible Aśvins, lords of water, favour Avasyu, glorifying you at this sacrifice; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.
