verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वनो न वोऽमवान्रेजयद्वृषा त्वेषो ययिस्तविष एवयामरुत् ।येना सहंत ऋंजत स्वरोचिषः स्थारश्मानो हिरण्ययाः स्वायुधास इष्मिणः ॥
verses.transliteration: svanáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vaḥ ǀ áma-vān ǀ rejayat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ yayíḥ ǀ taviṣáḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀyéna ǀ sáhantaḥ ǀ ṛñjáta ǀ svá-rociṣaḥ ǀ sthā́ḥ-raśmānaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyāḥ ǀ su-āyudhā́saḥ ǀ iṣmíṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not the sound (of your approach,Maruts), which is mighty, the announcer of rain,t he shedder of light, diffusive, loud, alarm Evayāmarut; that sound wherewith, overcoming (your foes), you who are self-irradiating, lasting-rayed, ornamented with golden oranaments, self-weaponed, bestowing food, accomplish your functions.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not the sound (of your approach,Maruts), which is mighty, the announcer of rain,t he shedder of light, diffusive, loud, alarm Evayāmarut; that sound wherewith, overcoming (your foes), you who are self-irradiating, lasting-rayed, ornamented with golden oranaments, self-weaponed, bestowing food, accomplish your functions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपारो वो महिमा वृद्धशवसस्त्वेषं शवोऽवत्वेवयामरुत् ।स्थातारो हि प्रसितौ संदृशि स्थन ते न उरुष्यता निदः शुशुक्वांसो नाग्नयः ॥
verses.transliteration: apāráḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahimā́ ǀ vṛddha-śavasaḥ ǀ tveṣám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ avatu ǀ evayā́marut ǀsthā́tāraḥ ǀ hí ǀ prá-sitau ǀ sam-dṛ́śi ǀ sthána ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyata ǀ nidáḥ ǀ śuśukvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ agnáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Possessor of vast strength, may your unbounded greatness, your brilliant vigour, protect Evayāmarut; for you are the regulators for overseeing (what is fit for) the limits of the sacrifice; preserve us from those who revile us, you, who are like blazing fires.
verses.wilson_translation: Possessor of vast strength, may your unbounded greatness, your brilliant vigour, protect Evayāmarut; for you are the regulators for overseeing (what is fit for) the limits of the sacrifice; preserve us from those who revile us, you, who are like blazing fires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते रुद्रासः सुमखा अग्नयो यथा तुविद्युम्ना अवंत्वेवयामरुत् ।दीर्घं पृथु पप्रथे सद्म पार्थिवं येषामज्मेष्वा महः शर्धांस्यद्भुतैनसां ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ rudrā́saḥ ǀ sú-makhāḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ tuvi-dyumnā́ḥ ǀ avantu ǀ evayā́marut ǀdīrghám ǀ pṛthú ǀ paprathe ǀ sádma ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ yéṣām ǀ ájmeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ śárdhāṃsi ǀ ádbhuta-enasām ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those Rudras, the objects of worship, like resplendent fires, protect Evayāmarut; they, whose ethereal dwelling, extended and wide, has been made illustrious (by them), and of whom, exempt from blame, the mighty energies (are manifested) in their courses.
verses.wilson_translation: May those Rudras, the objects of worship, like resplendent fires, protect Evayāmarut; they, whose ethereal dwelling, extended and wide, has been made illustrious (by them), and of whom, exempt from blame, the mighty energies (are manifested) in their courses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अद्वेषो नो मरुतो गातुमेतन श्रोता हवं जरितुरेवयामरुत् ।विष्णोर्महः समन्यवो युयोतन स्मद्रथ्यो न दंसनाप द्वेषांसि सनुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: adveṣáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ ā́ ǀ itana ǀ śróta ǀ hávam ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀvíṣṇoḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǀ yuyotana ǀ smát ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ daṃsánā ǀ ápa ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ sanutáríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, devoid of enmity, come to our proffered praise, hear the invocation of your adorer, Evayāmarut; do you, who are associated in the worship of Viṣṇudrive away, as warriors (scatter their enemies), our secret foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, devoid of enmity, come to our proffered praise, hear the invocation of your adorer, Evayāmarut; do you, who are associated in the worship of Viṣṇudrive away, as warriors (scatter their enemies), our secret foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गंता नो यज्ञं यज्ञियाः सुशमि श्रोता हवमरक्ष एवयामरुत् ।ज्येष्ठासो न पर्वतासो व्योमनि यूयं तस्य प्रचेतसः स्यात दुर्धर्तवो निदः ॥
verses.transliteration: gánta ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ yajñiyāḥ ǀ su-śámi ǀ śróta ǀ hávam ǀ arakṣáḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀjyéṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ví-omani ǀ yūyám ǀ tásya ǀ pra-cetasaḥ ǀ syā́ta ǀ duḥ-dhártavaḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable Marutscome to our sacrifice, so that it may be prosperous; hear, undeterred byrākṣasas, the invocation of Evayāmarut; abiding like lofty mountains in mid-heaven, do you, who are profoundly wise, be ever intolerant of the reviler.
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable Marutscome to our sacrifice, so that it may be prosperous; hear, undeterred byrākṣasas, the invocation of Evayāmarut; abiding like lofty mountains in mid-heaven, do you, who are profoundly wise, be ever intolerant of the reviler.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN I. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU, first inventor of this prayer, O Agni, Worker of Marvels, hast become our Herald.Thou, Bull, hast made us strength which none may conquer, strength that shall overcome all other prowess. As Priest thou sattest at the seat of worship, furthering us, best Offerer, meet for honour.So first to thee have pious men resorted, turning thy mind to thoughts of ample riches. In thee, still watching, they have followed riches, who goest with much wealth as with an army,The radiant Agni, lofty, fair to look on, worshipped with marrow, evermore resplendent. They who approached the God's abode with homage, eager for glory, won them perfect glory:Yea, they gained even sacrificial titles, and found delight in thine auspicious aspect. On earth the people magnify thee greatly, thee their celestial and terrestrial riches.Thou, Helper, must be known as our Preserver, Father and Mother of mankind for ever. Dear priest among mankind, adorable Agni hath seated him, joy-giver, skilled in worship.Let us approach thee shining in thy dwelling, kneeling upon our knees, with adoration. Longing for bliss, pure-minded, God-devoted, Agni, we seek thee, such, meet to be lauded.Thou, Agni, leddest forth our men to battle, refulgent with the heaven's exalted splendour. Sage of mankind, all peoples' Lord and Master, the Bull of men, the sender down of blessings,Still pressing on, promoting, purifying, Agni the Holy One, the Lord of riches. Agni, the mortal who hath toiled and worshipped, brought thee oblations with his kindled fuel,And well knows sacrifice with adoration, gains every joy with thee to guard and help him. Mightily let us worship thee the Mighty, with reverence, Agni! fuel and oblations,With songs, O Son of Strength, with hymns, with altar: so may we strive for thine auspicious favour. Thou who hast covered heaven and earth with splendour and with thy glories, glorious and triumphant.Continue thou to shine on us, O Agni, with strength abundant, rich, and long enduring. Vouchsafe us ever, as man needs, O Vasu, abundant wealth of kine for son and offspring.Food noble, plenteous, far from sin and evil, he with us, and fair fame to make us happy. May I obtain much wealth in many places by love of thee and through thy grace, King Agni;For in thee Bounteous One, in thee the Sovran, Agni, are many boons for him who serves thee.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह्यग्ने प्रथमो मनोतास्या धियो अभवो दस्म होता ।त्वं सीं वृषन्नकृणोर्दुष्टरीतु सहो विश्वस्मै सहसे सहध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ manótā ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ ábhavaḥ ǀ dasma ǀ hótā ǀtvám ǀ sīm ǀ vṛṣan ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ dustárītu ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ sáhase ǀ sáhadhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: You Agni, are the first of the gods; a deity to whom their minds are devoted; plural asing of aspect, you are the invoker of the deities at this rite; showerer (of benefits), bestow upon us unsurpassable strength, where with to sustain all (hostile) prowess.
verses.wilson_translation: You Agni, are the first of the gods; a deity to whom their minds are devoted; plural asing of aspect, you are the invoker of the deities at this rite; showerer (of benefits), bestow upon us unsurpassable strength, where with to sustain all (hostile) prowess.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा होता न्यसीदो यजीयानिळस्पद इषयन्नीड्यः सन् ।तं त्वा नरः प्रथमं देवयंतो महो राये चितयंतो अनु ग्मन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ hótā ǀ ní ǀ asīdaḥ ǀ yájīyān ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ padé ǀ iṣáyan ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ sán ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ náraḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ citáyantaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offerer of the oblation, frequent celebrator of sacrifice, now sit down on the foot-m ark of Iḷā, accepting the (sacrirficial) food, and being glorified; devout men, expectant of great riches, have recourse to you as to the first (of the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Offerer of the oblation, frequent celebrator of sacrifice, now sit down on the foot-m ark of Iḷā, accepting the (sacrirficial) food, and being glorified; devout men, expectant of great riches, have recourse to you as to the first (of the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृतेव यंतं बहुभिर्वसव्यैस्त्वे रयिं जागृवांसो अनु ग्मन् ।रुशंतमग्निं दर्शतं बृहंतं वपावंतं विश्वहा दीदिवांसं ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛtā́-iva ǀ yántam ǀ bahú-bhiḥ ǀ vasavyáiḥ ǀ tvé íti ǀ rayím ǀ jāgṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǀrúśantam ǀ agním ǀ darśatám ǀ bṛhántam ǀ vapā́-vantam ǀ viśváhā ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those who are assiduous in (worshipping) you for riches follow you, going with many Vasusby the path (of the firmament); you, the radiant Agni, of goodly aspect, mighty, fed with burnt-offerings, and blazing every day.
verses.wilson_translation: Those who are assiduous in (worshipping) you for riches follow you, going with many Vasusby the path (of the firmament); you, the radiant Agni, of goodly aspect, mighty, fed with burnt-offerings, and blazing every day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पदं देवस्य नमसा व्यंतः श्रवस्यवः श्रव आपन्नमृक्तं ।नामानि चिद्दधिरे यज्ञियानि भद्रायां ते रणयंत संदृष्टौ ॥
verses.transliteration: padám ǀ devásya ǀ námasā ǀ vyántaḥ ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ āpan ǀ ámṛktam ǀnā́māni ǀ cit ǀ dadhire ǀ yajñíyāni ǀ bhadrā́yām ǀ te ǀ raṇayanta ǀ sám-dṛṣṭau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men desirous of food obtain abundance unopposed when repairing to the station of the divinity with oblations; and when delighting,Agni, in your auspicious presence, they repeat those your names which are to be uttered at sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Men desirous of food obtain abundance unopposed when repairing to the station of the divinity with oblations; and when delighting,Agni, in your auspicious presence, they repeat those your names which are to be uttered at sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां वर्धंति क्षितयः पृथिव्यां त्वां राय उभयासो जनानां ।त्वं त्राता तरणे चेत्यो भूः पिता माता सदमिन्मानुषाणां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ vardhanti ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ tvā́m ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ ubháyāsaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀtvám ǀ trātā́ ǀ taraṇe ǀ cétyaḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men exalt you upon earth; they exalt you for both kinds of affluence, (cattle and treasure, which you bestow upon) men; you who extricate (us from evil) are to be known as our preserver, as the unfailing father and mother of mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: Men exalt you upon earth; they exalt you for both kinds of affluence, (cattle and treasure, which you bestow upon) men; you who extricate (us from evil) are to be known as our preserver, as the unfailing father and mother of mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सपर्येण्यः स प्रियो विक्ष्वग्निर्होता मंद्रो नि षसादा यजीयान् ।तं त्वा वयं दम आ दीदिवांसमुप ज्ञुबाधो नमसा सदेम ॥
verses.transliteration: saparyéṇyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ priyáḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ ní ǀ sasāda ǀ yájīyān ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ úpa ǀ jñu-bā́dhaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ sadema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who is adorable, affectionate, the offerer of oblations among men, the giver of delight, the celebrator of worship, has sat down (upon the altar); let us approach you, kindled in our dwellings, on bended knees, with praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who is adorable, affectionate, the offerer of oblations among men, the giver of delight, the celebrator of worship, has sat down (upon the altar); let us approach you, kindled in our dwellings, on bended knees, with praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं सुध्यो नव्यमग्ने सुम्नायव ईमहे देवयंतः ।त्वं विशो अनयो दीद्यानो दिवो अग्ने बृहता रोचनेन ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ su-dhyáḥ ǀ návyam ǀ agne ǀ sumna-yávaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀtvám ǀ víśaḥ ǀ anayaḥ ǀ dī́dyānaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ agne ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ rocanéna ǁ
verses.english_translation: Intelligent, hoping for happiness, and devout, we glorify you, adorable Agni; do you, shining with exceeding lustre, lead men to heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Intelligent, hoping for happiness, and devout, we glorify you, adorable Agni; do you, shining with exceeding lustre, lead men to heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विशां कविं विश्पतिं शश्वतीनां नितोशनं वृषभं चर्षणीनां ।प्रेतीषणिमिषयंतं पावकं राजंतमग्निं यजतं रयीणां ॥
verses.transliteration: viśā́m ǀ kavím ǀ viśpátim ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ ni-tóśanam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀpréti-iṣaṇim ǀ iṣáyantam ǀ pāvakám ǀ rā́jantam ǀ agním ǀ yajatám ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We glorify) the lord of men of ever-existing men; the wise, the destroyer (of foes) the showerer (of benefits) on mankind, the moving, the bestower of food, the purifier, the resplendent,Agni, who is worshipped for (the sake of) riches.
verses.wilson_translation: (We glorify) the lord of men of ever-existing men; the wise, the destroyer (of foes) the showerer (of benefits) on mankind, the moving, the bestower of food, the purifier, the resplendent,Agni, who is worshipped for (the sake of) riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सो अग्न ईजे शशमे च मर्तो यस्त आनट् समिधा हव्यदातिं ।य आहुतिं परि वेदा नमोभिर्विश्वेत्स वामा दधते त्वोतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ agne ǀ īje ǀ śaśamé ǀ ca ǀ mártaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ havyá-dātim ǀyáḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ pári ǀ veda ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ vāmā́ ǀ dadhate ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man,Agni, who worships you, who praises you, who offers oblations to you with kindled fuel, who presents burnt-offerings to you with prostrations, he verily, protected by you, obtains all desired wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: The man,Agni, who worships you, who praises you, who offers oblations to you with kindled fuel, who presents burnt-offerings to you with prostrations, he verily, protected by you, obtains all desired wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मा उ ते महि महे विधेम नमोभिरग्ने समिधोत हव्यैः ।वेदी सूनो सहसो गीर्भिरुक्थैरा ते भद्रायां सुमतौ यतेम ॥
verses.transliteration: asmái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ máhi ǀ mahé ǀ vidhema ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ utá ǀ havyáiḥ ǀvédī ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ bhadrā́yām ǀ su-matáu ǀ yatema ǁ
verses.english_translation: To you, mighty Agni, we offer exceeding adoration with prostrations, with fuel, with oblations; (we glorify you) on the altar, son of strength, with hymns and with prayers; may we be successful in our efforts (to gain) you auspicious favour.
verses.wilson_translation: To you, mighty Agni, we offer exceeding adoration with prostrations, with fuel, with oblations; (we glorify you) on the altar, son of strength, with hymns and with prayers; may we be successful in our efforts (to gain) you auspicious favour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यस्ततंथ रोदसी वि भासा श्रवोभिश्च श्रवस्यस्तरुत्रः ।बृहद्भिर्वाजैः स्थविरेभिरस्मे रेवद्भिरग्ने वितरं वि भाहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ tatántha ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ví ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ śravasyáḥ ǀ tárutraḥ ǀbṛhát-bhiḥ ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ sthávirebhiḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ revát-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Agni, who have spread heaven and earth with light, who are the preserver (of man), and (who are) to be glorified with praises, shine brightly upon us with abundant food, and with substantial riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Agni, who have spread heaven and earth with light, who are the preserver (of man), and (who are) to be glorified with praises, shine brightly upon us with abundant food, and with substantial riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नृवद्वसो सदमिद्धेह्यस्मे भूरि तोकाय तनयाय पश्वः ।पूर्वीरिषो बृहतीरारेअघा अस्मे भद्रा सौश्रवसानि संतु ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛ-vát ǀ vaso íti ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhū́ri ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ paśváḥ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ āré-aghāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ sauśravasā́ni ǀ santu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Possessor of wealth, bestow upon us at all times opulence conjoined with dependants, and (grant) abundance of cattle to our sons and grandsons; may therefore be to us abundant food, satisfying our wishes, and free from blame; and may there be auspicious and reputable (means of subsistence).
verses.wilson_translation: Possessor of wealth, bestow upon us at all times opulence conjoined with dependants, and (grant) abundance of cattle to our sons and grandsons; may therefore be to us abundant food, satisfying our wishes, and free from blame; and may there be auspicious and reputable (means of subsistence).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरूण्यग्ने पुरुधा त्वाया वसूनि राजन्वसुता ते अश्यां ।पुरूणि हि त्वे पुरुवार संत्यग्ने वसु विधते राजनि त्वे ॥
verses.transliteration: purū́ṇi ǀ agne ǀ purudhā́ ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ rājan ǀ vasútā ǀ te ǀ aśyām ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ hí ǀ tvé íti ǀ puru-vāra ǀ sánti ǀ ágne ǀ vásu ǀ vidhaté ǀ rā́jani ǀ tvé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Royal Agni, may I obtain from you your many and various treasures whereby to be enriched; for, Agni, who are the desired of multitudes, infinite are the riches (aggregated) in you, fit, monarch, for your worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Royal Agni, may I obtain from you your many and various treasures whereby to be enriched; for, Agni, who are the desired of multitudes, infinite are the riches (aggregated) in you, fit, monarch, for your worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN II. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU, Agni, even as Mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own.Thou, active Vasu, makest fame increase like full prosperity. For, verily, men pray to thee with sacrifices and with songs.To thee the Friendly Courser, seen of all, comes speeding through the air. Of one accord men kindle thee Heaven's signal of the sacrifice,When, craving bliss, this race of man invites thee to the solemn rite. Let the man thrive who travails sore, in prayer, far thee the Bountiful.He with the help of lofty Dyaus comes safe through straits of enmity. The mortal who with fuel lights thy flame and offers unto thee,Supports a house with many a branch, Agni, to live a hundred years. Thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven.For, Purifier! like the Sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow. For in men's houses thou must be glorified as a well-loved guest,Gay like an elder in a fort, claiming protection like a son. Thou, Agni, like an able steed, art urged by wisdom in the wood.Thou art like wind; food, home art thou, like a young horse that runs astray. E’en things imperishable, thou, O Agni, like a gazing ox,Eatest, when hosts, Eternal One! of thee the Mighty rend the woods. Agni, thou enterest as Priest the home of men who sacrifice.Lord of the people, prosper them. Accept the ofrering, Aṅgiras! O Agni, God with Mitra's might, call hither the favour of the Gods from earth and heaven.Bring weal from heaven, that men may dwell securely. May we o’ercome the foe's malign oppressions, may we o’ercome them, through thy help o’ercome them.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि क्षैतवद्यशोऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे ।त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ kṣáita-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ pátyase ǀtvám ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ váso íti ǀ puṣṭím ǀ ná ǀ puṣyasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You alight,Agni, like Mitra, upon the oblation offered with the dry fuel; therefore, beholder of all, possessor of riches, you cherish us with food and nourishment.
verses.wilson_translation: You alight,Agni, like Mitra, upon the oblation offered with the dry fuel; therefore, beholder of all, possessor of riches, you cherish us with food and nourishment.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां हि ष्मा चर्षणयो यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिरीळते ।त्वां वाजी यात्यवृको रजस्तूर्विश्वचर्षणिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀtvā́m ǀ vājī́ ǀ yāti ǀ avṛkáḥ ǀ rajaḥ-tū́ḥ ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men verily worship you with sacrifice and with praises; the inoffensive sun, the sender of rain, the beholder of the universe, proceeds to you.
verses.wilson_translation: Men verily worship you with sacrifice and with praises; the inoffensive sun, the sender of rain, the beholder of the universe, proceeds to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सजोषस्त्वा दिवो नरो यज्ञस्य केतुमिंधते ।यद्ध स्य मानुषो जनः सुम्नायुर्जुह्वे अध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: sa-jóṣaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ diváḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ indhate ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ syáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǀ sumna-yúḥ ǀ juhvé ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: The offerers of praise, sympathizing in satisfaction, kindle you the banner of the sacrifice, when man, the descendant of Manu, desiring happiness, invokes you to the rite.
verses.wilson_translation: The offerers of praise, sympathizing in satisfaction, kindle you the banner of the sacrifice, when man, the descendant of Manu, desiring happiness, invokes you to the rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋधद्यस्ते सुदानवे धिया मर्तः शशमते ।ऊती ष बृहतो दिवो द्विषो अंहो न तरति ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛ́dhat ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ su-dā́nave ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ śaśámate ǀūtī́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tarati ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the mortal prosper who propitiates you (his) benefactor, by holy rites; through the protection of you who are resplendent, he overcomes those who hate him, as if they were mortal sins.
verses.wilson_translation: May the mortal prosper who propitiates you (his) benefactor, by holy rites; through the protection of you who are resplendent, he overcomes those who hate him, as if they were mortal sins.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समिधा यस्त आहुतिं निशितिं मर्त्यो नशत् ।वयावंतं स पुष्यति क्षयमग्ने शतायुषं ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-ídhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ ní-śitim ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ náśat ǀvayā́-vantam ǀ sáḥ ǀ puṣyati ǀ kṣáyam ǀ agne ǀ śatá-āyuṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mortal who feeds your consecrated burnt offering with fuel enjoys,Agni, a dwelling peopled with descendants, and a life of a hundred years.
verses.wilson_translation: The mortal who feeds your consecrated burnt offering with fuel enjoys,Agni, a dwelling peopled with descendants, and a life of a hundred years.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि षंछुक्र आततः ।सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे ॥
verses.transliteration: tveṣáḥ ǀ te ǀ dhūmáḥ ǀ ṛṇvati ǀ diví ǀ sán ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ā́-tataḥ ǀsū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ hí ǀ dyutā́ ǀ tvám ǀ kṛpā́ ǀ pāvaka ǀ rócase ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure smoke of you the resplendent spreads through the firmament, matures (in clouds), and you, the purifier, shine with radiance like the sun, when propitiated by praise.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure smoke of you the resplendent spreads through the firmament, matures (in clouds), and you, the purifier, shine with radiance like the sun, when propitiated by praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा हि विक्ष्वीड्योऽसि प्रियो नो अतिथिः ।रण्वः पुरीव जूर्यः सूनुर्न त्रययाय्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ vikṣú ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ ási ǀ priyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀraṇváḥ ǀ purí-iva ǀ jū́ryaḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ ná ǀ trayayā́yyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are now to be praised among the people, for you are our well beloved guest, venerated like an elder in the city, and to be cherished like a son.
verses.wilson_translation: You are now to be praised among the people, for you are our well beloved guest, venerated like an elder in the city, and to be cherished like a son.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रत्वा हि द्रोणे अज्यसेऽग्ने वाजी न कृत्व्यः ।परिज्मेव स्वधा गयोऽत्यो न ह्वार्यः शिशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: krátvā ǀ hí ǀ dróṇe ǀ ajyáse ǀ ágne ǀ vājī́ ǀ ná ǀ kṛ́tvyaḥ ǀpárijmā-iva ǀ svadhā́ ǀ gáyaḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hvāryáḥ ǀ śíśuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are manifested in the timber,Agni, by the act of attrition; you are the bearer (of the oblation) as a horse (is of his rider); you are like the circumsambient wind; you are food and dwelling; you are like a (newborn) babe, and variable (in movement) as a horse.
verses.wilson_translation: You are manifested in the timber,Agni, by the act of attrition; you are the bearer (of the oblation) as a horse (is of his rider); you are like the circumsambient wind; you are food and dwelling; you are like a (newborn) babe, and variable (in movement) as a horse.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं त्या चिदच्युताग्ने पशुर्न यवसे ।धामा ह यत्ते अजर वना वृश्चंति शिक्वसः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ tyā́ ǀ cit ǀ ácyutā ǀ ágne ǀ paśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǀdhā́ma ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ajara ǀ vánā ǀ vṛścánti ǀ śíkvasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You consume Agni, the unfallen (trees) as an animal (feeds) upon pasture, when, undecaying deity, the flames of you who are resplendent shear the forests.
verses.wilson_translation: You consume Agni, the unfallen (trees) as an animal (feeds) upon pasture, when, undecaying deity, the flames of you who are resplendent shear the forests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वेषि ह्यध्वरीयतामग्ने होता दमे विशां ।समृधो विश्पते कृणु जुषस्व हव्यमंगिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: véṣi ǀ hí ǀ adhvari-yatā́m ǀ ágne ǀ hótā ǀ dáme ǀ viśā́m ǀsam-ṛ́dhaḥ ǀ viśpate ǀ kṛṇu ǀ juṣásva ǀ havyám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You enter as the ministrant priest into the habitations of men who wish to perform sacrifice; render them prosperous, benefactor of mankind; be propitiated,aṅgiras, by the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: You enter as the ministrant priest into the habitations of men who wish to perform sacrifice; render them prosperous, benefactor of mankind; be propitiated,aṅgiras, by the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा नो मित्रमहो देव देवानग्ने वोचः सुमतिं रोदस्योः ।वीहि स्वस्तिं सुक्षितिं दिवो नॄंद्विषो अंहांसि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ ágne ǀ vócaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀvīhí ǀ svastím ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ áṃhāṃsi ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǀ tā́ ǀ tarema ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ tarema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, reverenced as a friend, who are abiding in heaven and earth, communicate our praise to the gods; conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity; and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome those (sins of a prior existence); may we overcome them by your protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, reverenced as a friend, who are abiding in heaven and earth, communicate our praise to the gods; conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity; and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome those (sins of a prior existence); may we overcome them by your protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN III. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . TRUE, guardian of the Law, thy faithful servant wins ample light and dwells in peace, O Agni,Whom thou, as Varuṇa in accord with Mitra, guardest, O God, by banishing his trouble. He hath paid sacrifices, toiled in worship, and offered gifts to wealth-increasing Agni.Him the displeasure of the famous moves not, outrage and scorn affect not such a mortal. Bright God, whose look is free from stain like Sūrya's, thou, swift, what time thou earnestly desirest,Hast gear to give us. Come with joy at evening, where, Child of Wood, thou mayest also tarry. Fierce is his gait and vast his wondrous body: he champeth like a horse with bit and bridle,And, darting forth his tongue, as ’twere a hatchet, burning the woods, smelteth them like a smelter. Archer-like, fain toshoot, he sets his arrow, and whets his splendour like the edge of iron:The messenger of night with brilliant pathway, like a tree-roosting bird of rapid pinion. In beams of morn he clothes him like the singer, and bright as Mitra with his splendour crackles.Red in the night, by day the men's possession: red, he belongs to men by day, Immortal. Like Heaven's when scattering beams his voice was uttered: among the plants the radiant Hero shouted,Who with his glow in rapid course came hither to fill both worlds, well-wedded Dames, with treasure. Who, with supporting streams and rays that suit him, hath flashed like lightning with his native vigour.Like the deft Maker of the band of Maruts, the bright impetuous One hath shone refulgent.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने स क्षेषदृतपा ऋतेजा उरु ज्योतिर्नशते देवयुष्टे ।यं त्वं मित्रेण वरुणः सजोषा देव पासि त्यजसा मर्तमंहः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣeṣat ǀ ṛta-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛte-jā́ḥ ǀ urú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ naśate ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ te ǀyám ǀ tvám ǀ mitréṇa ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ déva ǀ pā́si ǀ tyájasā ǀ mártam ǀ áṃhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The offerer of sacrifice, born for religious rites, who lives devoted,Agni, to you, obtains abundant light, and is a man whom you, sympathizing in satisfaction with Mitraand Varuṇa, protect by your shield from iniquity.
verses.wilson_translation: The offerer of sacrifice, born for religious rites, who lives devoted,Agni, to you, obtains abundant light, and is a man whom you, sympathizing in satisfaction with Mitraand Varuṇa, protect by your shield from iniquity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईजे यज्ञेभिः शशमे शमीभिर्ऋधद्वारायाग्नये ददाश ।एवा चन तं यशसामजुष्टिर्नांहो मर्तं नशते न प्रदृप्तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ījé ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ śaśamé ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ ṛdhát-vārāya ǀ agnáye ǀ dadāśa ǀevá ǀ caná ǀ tám ǀ yaśásām ǀ ájuṣṭiḥ ǀ ná ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ mártam ǀ naśate ǀ ná ǀ prá-dṛptiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who has presented (oblations) to Agni, the possessor of desired (wealth), sacrifices with (all) sacrifices, and is sanctified by (all) holy acts; him, the wand of excellent (posterity) does not afflict, nor does sin or pride affect a mortal.
verses.wilson_translation: He who has presented (oblations) to Agni, the possessor of desired (wealth), sacrifices with (all) sacrifices, and is sanctified by (all) holy acts; him, the wand of excellent (posterity) does not afflict, nor does sin or pride affect a mortal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सूरो न यस्य दृशतिररेपा भीमा यदेति शुचतस्त आ धीः ।हेषस्वतः शुरुधो नायमक्तोः कुत्रा चिद्रण्वो वसतिर्वनेजाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ dṛśatíḥ ǀ arepā́ḥ ǀ bhīmā́ ǀ yát ǀ éti ǀ śucatáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀhéṣasvataḥ ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ayám ǀ aktóḥ ǀ kútra ǀ cit ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ vasatíḥ ǀ vane-jā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the fearful flames of you, whose appearance is (as) faultless as (that of) the sun, spread on every side as (if they were) the lowing heifers of the night, then this Agni, the asylum of all, genitive rated in the woods, is everywhere beautiful.
verses.wilson_translation: When the fearful flames of you, whose appearance is (as) faultless as (that of) the sun, spread on every side as (if they were) the lowing heifers of the night, then this Agni, the asylum of all, genitive rated in the woods, is everywhere beautiful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तिग्मं चिदेम महि वर्पो अस्य भसदश्वो न यमसान आसा ।विजेहमानः परशुर्न जिह्वां द्रविर्न द्रावयति दारु धक्षत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tigmám ǀ cit ǀ éma ǀ máhi ǀ várpaḥ ǀ asya ǀ bhásat ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yamasānáḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀvi-jéhamānaḥ ǀ paraśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ jihvā́m ǀ dravíḥ ǀ ná ǀ dravayati ǀ dā́ru ǀ dhákṣat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sharp is his path, and his vast body shines like a horse champing fodder with his mouth, darting forth his tongue like a hatchet, and burning timber toashes, like a goldsmith who fuses (metal).
verses.wilson_translation: Sharp is his path, and his vast body shines like a horse champing fodder with his mouth, darting forth his tongue like a hatchet, and burning timber toashes, like a goldsmith who fuses (metal).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स इदस्तेव प्रति धादसिष्यंछिशीत तेजोऽयसो न धारां ।चित्रध्रजतिररतिर्यो अक्तोर्वेर्न द्रुषद्वा रघुपत्मजंहाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ástā-iva ǀ práti ǀ dhāt ǀ asiṣyán ǀ śíśīta ǀ téjaḥ ǀ áyasaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhā́rām ǀcitrá-dhrajatiḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ aktóḥ ǀ véḥ ǀ ná ǀ dru-sádvā ǀ raghupátma-jaṃhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He casts (afar his flames) as an archer (his arrows), and sharpens when about to dart his radiance, as (a warrior whets) the edge of his metal (weapons), he who, variously moving, passes through the night, like the light-falling foot of a bird perched upon a tree.
verses.wilson_translation: He casts (afar his flames) as an archer (his arrows), and sharpens when about to dart his radiance, as (a warrior whets) the edge of his metal (weapons), he who, variously moving, passes through the night, like the light-falling foot of a bird perched upon a tree.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स ईं रेभो न प्रति वस्त उस्राः शोचिषा रारपीति मित्रमहाः ।नक्तं य ईमरुषो यो दिवा नॄनमर्त्यो अरुषो यो दिवा नॄन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ rebháḥ ǀ ná ǀ práti ǀ vaste ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ rarapīti ǀ mitrá-mahāḥ ǀnáktam ǀ yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dívā ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dívā ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like the adorable sun, he clothes himself with brilliant (rays); diffusing friendly light, he crackles with (his fame); (he it is) who is luminous by night, and who lights men (to their work) by day; who is immortal and radiant; who lights men by day.
verses.wilson_translation: Like the adorable sun, he clothes himself with brilliant (rays); diffusing friendly light, he crackles with (his fame); (he it is) who is luminous by night, and who lights men (to their work) by day; who is immortal and radiant; who lights men by day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो न यस्य विधतो नवीनोद्वृषा रुक्ष ओषधीषु नूनोत् ।घृणा न यो ध्रजसा पत्मना यन्ना रोदसी वसुना दं सुपत्नी ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀ návīnot ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ rukṣáḥ ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ nūnot ǀghṛ́ṇā ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhrájasā ǀ pátmanā ǀ yán ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vásunā ǀ dám ǀ supátnī íti su-pátnī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Of whom a sound is heard when scattering his rays like (that) of the sun; the brilliant showerer (of benefits) clamours among the (burning) plural nts; he who, moving not with a shifting, variable motion, but, humbling (our foes), fills the well-wedded earth and heaven with wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Of whom a sound is heard when scattering his rays like (that) of the sun; the brilliant showerer (of benefits) clamours among the (burning) plural nts; he who, moving not with a shifting, variable motion, but, humbling (our foes), fills the well-wedded earth and heaven with wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धायोभिर्वा यो युज्येभिरर्कैर्विद्युन्न दविद्योत्स्वेभिः शुष्मैः ।शर्धो वा यो मरुतां ततक्ष ऋभुर्न त्वेषो रभसानो अद्यौत् ॥
verses.transliteration: dhā́yaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ yújyebhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ vi-dyút ǀ ná ǀ davidyot ǀ svébhiḥ ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀśárdhaḥ ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ marútām ǀ tatákṣa ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ ná ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ rabhasānáḥ ǀ adyaut ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who (goes) with sacred (rays), as if with self-harnessed, well-governed (steeds), who shines like lightning with his own scorching (flames), who impairs the vigour of the Maruts, he glows radiant and rapid as the wide-shining sun.
verses.wilson_translation: He who (goes) with sacred (rays), as if with self-harnessed, well-governed (steeds), who shines like lightning with his own scorching (flames), who impairs the vigour of the Maruts, he glows radiant and rapid as the wide-shining sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IV Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . As at man's service of the Gods, Invoker, thou, Son of Strength, dost sacrifice and worship,So bring for us to-day all Gods together, bring willingly the willing Gods, O Agni. May Agni, radiant Herald of the morning, meet to be known, accept our praise with favour.Dear to all life, mid mortal men Immortal, our guest, awake at dawn, is Jātavedas. Whose might the very heavens regard with wonder: bright as the Sun he clothes himself with lustre.He who sends forth,, Eternal Purifier, hath shattered e’en the ancient works of Aśna. Thou art a Singer, Son! our feast-companion: Agni at birth prepared his food and pathway.Therefore vouchsafe us strength, O Strength-bestower. Win like a King: foes trouble not thy dwelling. Even he who cats his firm hard food with swiftness,and overtakes the nights as Vāyu kingdoms.May we o’ercome those who resist thine orders, like a steed casting down the flying foemen. Like Sūrya with his fulgent rays, O Agni, thou overspreadest both the worlds with splendour.Decked with bright colour he dispels the darkness, like Auśija, with clear flame swifily flying. We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams' glow: hear our great laud, O Agni.The best men praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength, mid Gods, like Viyu in thy bounty. Now, Agni, on the tranquil paths of riches come to us for our weal: save us from sorrow.Grant chiefs and bard this boon. May we live happy, with hero children, through a hundred winters.

verses.sanskrit: यथा होतर्मनुषो देवताता यज्ञेभिः सूनो सहसो यजासि ।एवा नो अद्य समना समानानुशन्नग्न उशतो यक्षि देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ hotaḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ devá-tātā ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yájāsi ǀevá ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ samanā́ ǀ samānā́n ǀ uśán ǀ agne ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength, invoker (of the gods), in like manner as at the worship of the gods by Manu, you did offer worship with sacrifice; so now,Agni, with willing mind, worship for us the assenting deities, regarding them as your equals.
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength, invoker (of the gods), in like manner as at the worship of the gods by Manu, you did offer worship with sacrifice; so now,Agni, with willing mind, worship for us the assenting deities, regarding them as your equals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो विभावा चक्षणिर्न वस्तोरग्निर्वंदारु वेद्यश्चनो धात् ।विश्वायुर्यो अमृतो मर्त्येषूषर्भुद्भूदतिथिर्जातवेदाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ cakṣáṇiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vástoḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vandā́ru ǀ védyaḥ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāt ǀviśvá-āyuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ uṣaḥ-bhút ǀ bhū́t ǀ átithiḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that Agni, who, like the illuminator of the day, is resplendent and cognizable (by all), gran us commendable food; he who is the life of all, immortal, who knows all that exists, who is our guest, waking among men at dawn.
verses.wilson_translation: May that Agni, who, like the illuminator of the day, is resplendent and cognizable (by all), gran us commendable food; he who is the life of all, immortal, who knows all that exists, who is our guest, waking among men at dawn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्यावो न यस्य पनयंत्यभ्वं भासांसि वस्ते सूर्यो न शुक्रः ।वि य इनोत्यजरः पावकोऽश्नस्य चिच्छिश्नथत्पूर्व्याणि ॥
verses.transliteration: dyā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ panáyanti ǀ ábhvam ǀ bhā́sāṃsi ǀ vaste ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukráḥ ǀví ǀ yáḥ ǀ inóti ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ áśnasya ǀ cit ǀ śiśnathat ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose great deeds his worshipers now celebrate, who is clothed with light, radiant as the sun, exempt from decay, the purifier, he illumes (all things), and destroys the ancient cities of the dispersed (evil beings).
verses.wilson_translation: Whose great deeds his worshipers now celebrate, who is clothed with light, radiant as the sun, exempt from decay, the purifier, he illumes (all things), and destroys the ancient cities of the dispersed (evil beings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वद्मा हि सूनो अस्यद्मसद्वा चक्रे अग्निर्जनुषाज्मान्नं ।स त्वं न ऊर्जसन ऊर्जं धा राजेव जेरवृके क्षेष्यंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: vadmā́ ǀ hí ǀ sūno íti ǀ ási ǀ adma-sádvā ǀ cakré ǀ agníḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ ájma ǀ ánnam ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrja-sane ǀ ū́rjam ǀ dhāḥ ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ jeḥ ǀ avṛké ǀ kṣeṣi ǀ antáríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sons of strength, you are to be praised;Agni, sitting upon the (sacrificial) viands, has given (to his worshippers), from their birth, habitation and food giver of strength, bestow strength upon us; triumph like a prize, so that you may abide in our unassailed (dwelling).
verses.wilson_translation: Sons of strength, you are to be praised;Agni, sitting upon the (sacrificial) viands, has given (to his worshippers), from their birth, habitation and food giver of strength, bestow strength upon us; triumph like a prize, so that you may abide in our unassailed (dwelling).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नितिक्ति यो वारणमन्नमत्ति वायुर्न राष्ट्र्यत्येत्यक्तून् ।तुर्याम यस्त आदिशामरातीरत्यो न ह्रुतः पततः परिह्रुत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ní-tikti ǀ yáḥ ǀ vāraṇám ǀ ánnam ǀ átti ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́ṣṭrī ǀ áti ǀ eti ǀ aktū́n ǀturyā́ma ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā-díśām ǀ árātīḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hrútaḥ ǀ pátataḥ ǀ pari-hrút ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who whets his (gloom) dispersing (radiance), who eats the (offered) oblation, a soverign likevāyu, overcomes the nights; may we prevail (over him) who is not a donor of the oblations that are due; (Agni), to you, and do you, (swift) as a horse be the destroyer of the foes assailing (us).
verses.wilson_translation: He who whets his (gloom) dispersing (radiance), who eats the (offered) oblation, a soverign likevāyu, overcomes the nights; may we prevail (over him) who is not a donor of the oblations that are due; (Agni), to you, and do you, (swift) as a horse be the destroyer of the foes assailing (us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सूर्यो न भानुमद्भिरर्कैरग्ने ततंथ रोदसी वि भासा ।चित्रो नयत्परि तमांस्यक्तः शोचिषा पत्मन्नौशिजो न दीयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhānumát-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ ágne ǀ tatántha ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ví ǀ bhāsā́ ǀcitráḥ ǀ nayat ǀ pári ǀ támāṃsi ǀ aktáḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ pátman ǀ auśijáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dī́yan ǁ
verses.english_translation: You over spread,Agni, heaven and earth with radiance, like the sun with his lustrous rays; the wonderful Agni disperses the glooms like the adored (sun) moving on his path, imbued with light.
verses.wilson_translation: You over spread,Agni, heaven and earth with radiance, like the sun with his lustrous rays; the wonderful Agni disperses the glooms like the adored (sun) moving on his path, imbued with light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां हि मंद्रतममर्कशोकैर्ववृमहे महि नः श्रोष्यग्ने ।इंद्रं न त्वा शवसा देवता वायुं पृणंति राधसा नृतमाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ mandrá-tamam ǀ arka-śokáiḥ ǀ vavṛmáhe ǀ máhi ǀ naḥ ǀ śróṣi ǀ agne ǀíndram ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ śávasā ǀ devátā ǀ vāyúm ǀ pṛṇanti ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ nṛ́-tamāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We celebrate you, who are most adorable, with sacred praises; hear,Agni, our laudation; the leaders (of rites) earnestly honour you with offerings, you, who are divine like Indra, and likevāyuin strength.
verses.wilson_translation: We celebrate you, who are most adorable, with sacred praises; hear,Agni, our laudation; the leaders (of rites) earnestly honour you with offerings, you, who are divine like Indra, and likevāyuin strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू नो अग्नेऽवृकेभिः स्वस्ति वेषि रायः पथिभिः पर्ष्यंहः ।ता सूरिभ्यो गृणते रासि सुम्नं मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avṛkébhiḥ ǀ svastí ǀ véṣi ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ párṣi ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ rāsi ǀ sumnám ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Quickly conduct us,Agni, by unmolested paths, to riches and prosperity; (convey us) beyond sin; those delights which you give to your adorers (extend) to him who (now) glorifies you, and may we, living for a hundred winters, and blessed with excellent posterity, be happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Quickly conduct us,Agni, by unmolested paths, to riches and prosperity; (convey us) beyond sin; those delights which you give to your adorers (extend) to him who (now) glorifies you, and may we, living for a hundred winters, and blessed with excellent posterity, be happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN V. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I INVOCATE your Son of Strength, the Youthful, with hymns, the Youngest God, whose speech is guileless;Sage who sends wealth comprising every treasure, bringer of many boons, devoid of malice. At eve and morn thy pious servants bring thee their precious gifts, O Priest of many aspects,On whom, the Purifier, all things living as on firm. ground their happiness have stablished. Thou from of old hast dwelt among these people, by mental power the charioteer of blessings.Hence sendest thou, O sapient Jātavedas, to him who serves thee treasures in succession. Agni, whoever secretly attacks us, the neighbour, thou with Mitra's might! who harms us,Burn him with thine own Steers for ever youthful, burning with burning heat, thou fiercest burner. He who serves thee with sacrifice and fuel, with hymn, O Son of Strength, and chanted praises,Shines out, Immortal! in the midst of mortals, a sage, with wealth, with splendour and with glory. Do this, O Agni, when we urge thee, quickly, triumphant in thy might subdue our foemen.When thou art praised with words and decked with brightness, accept this chanted hymn, the singer's worship. Help us, that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches, Wealthy One! with store of heroes.Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.

verses.sanskrit: हुवे वः सूनुं सहसो युवानमद्रोघवाचं मतिभिर्यविष्ठं ।य इन्वति द्रविणानि प्रचेता विश्ववाराणि पुरुवारो अध्रुक् ॥
verses.transliteration: huvé ǀ vaḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ yúvānam ǀ ádrogha-vācam ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀyáḥ ǀ ínvati ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ viśvá-vārāṇi ǀ puru-vā́raḥ ǀ adhrúk ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke you,Agni, the son of strength, the youthful, the irreproachable, the very young; you who are wise, the sought of many, the merciful, who bestows treasures acceptable to all.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke you,Agni, the son of strength, the youthful, the irreproachable, the very young; you who are wise, the sought of many, the merciful, who bestows treasures acceptable to all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वे वसूनि पुर्वणीक होतर्दोषा वस्तोरेरिरे यज्ञियासः ।क्षामेव विश्वा भुवनानि यस्मिन्त्सं सौभगानि दधिरे पावके ॥
verses.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ vásūni ǀ puru-anīka ǀ hotaḥ ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀkṣā́ma-iva ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ yásmin ǀ sám ǀ sáubhagāni ǀ dadhiré ǀ pāvaké ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bright blazing Agni, invoker of the gods, to you the adorable deities have appropriated, by night and day, the riches (on the oblation); they have deposited in the purifer (Agni) all good things (agnau vāmamvasusam nyadadhata:Taittirīya Saṃhitā1.5.1.1), as they have plural ced all beings upon earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Bright blazing Agni, invoker of the gods, to you the adorable deities have appropriated, by night and day, the riches (on the oblation); they have deposited in the purifer (Agni) all good things (agnau vāmamvasusam nyadadhata:Taittirīya Saṃhitā1.5.1.1), as they have plural ced all beings upon earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं विक्षु प्रदिवः सीद आसु क्रत्वा रथीरभवो वार्याणां ।अत इनोषि विधते चिकित्वो व्यानुषग्जातवेदो वसूनि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ vikṣú ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ sīdaḥ ǀ āsú ǀ krátvā ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀátaḥ ǀ inoṣi ǀ vidhaté ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ānuṣák ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ vásūni ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, abide from of old in these people, and by your deeds have been (to them) the conveyer of good things; thence, sagejātavedas, you bestow continually wealth upon the sacrificer.
verses.wilson_translation: You, abide from of old in these people, and by your deeds have been (to them) the conveyer of good things; thence, sagejātavedas, you bestow continually wealth upon the sacrificer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो नः सनुत्यो अभिदासदग्ने यो अंतरो मित्रमहो वनुष्यात् ।तमजरेभिर्वृषभिस्तव स्वैस्तपा तपिष्ठ तपसा तपस्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sánutyaḥ ǀ abhi-dā́sat ǀ agne ǀ yáḥ ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ vanuṣyā́t ǀtám ǀ ajárebhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ sváiḥ ǀ tápa ǀ tapiṣṭha ǀ tápasā ǀ tápasvān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, protector of (your) friends, who are most resplendent, blazing with radiance, consume with your own imperishable flames him who injures us abiding in secret, or when near to us design us harm.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, protector of (your) friends, who are most resplendent, blazing with radiance, consume with your own imperishable flames him who injures us abiding in secret, or when near to us design us harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते यज्ञेन समिधा य उक्थैरर्केभिः सूनो सहसो ददाशत् ।स मर्त्येष्वमृत प्रचेता राया द्युम्नेन श्रवसा वि भाति ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ yajñéna ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ arkébhiḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ dádāśat ǀsáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ amṛta ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ dyumnéna ǀ śrávasā ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who propitiates you, son of strenght, with sacrifice, with fuel, with prayers, with praises, shines immortal amongst men, eminent in wisdom and possessed of splendid opulence and (abundant) food.
verses.wilson_translation: He who propitiates you, son of strenght, with sacrifice, with fuel, with prayers, with praises, shines immortal amongst men, eminent in wisdom and possessed of splendid opulence and (abundant) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स तत्कृधीषितस्तूयमग्ने स्पृधो बाधस्व सहसा सहस्वान् ।यच्छस्यसे द्युभिरक्तो वचोभिस्तज्जुषस्व जरितुर्घोषि मन्म ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tát ǀ kṛdhi ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ tū́yam ǀ agne ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ bādhasva ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhasvān ǀyát ǀ śasyáse ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ aktáḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ tát ǀ juṣasva ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ ghóṣi ǀ mánma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accomplish quickly,Agni, that for which you are solicited; endowed with strength, oppose by strength our adversaries; be plural ased, you are anointed with radiance, by loud vociferation of your worshipper, by whom you are adored with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Accomplish quickly,Agni, that for which you are solicited; endowed with strength, oppose by strength our adversaries; be plural ased, you are anointed with radiance, by loud vociferation of your worshipper, by whom you are adored with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्याम तं काममग्ने तवोती अश्याम रयिं रयिवः सुवीरं ।अश्याम वाजमभि वाजयंतोऽश्याम द्युम्नमजराजरं ते ॥
verses.transliteration: aśyā́ma ǀ tám ǀ kā́mam ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ ūtī́ ǀ aśyā́ma ǀ rayím ǀ rayi-vaḥ ǀ su-vī́ram ǀaśyā́ma ǀ vā́jam ǀ abhí ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀ aśyā́ma ǀ dyumnám ǀ ajara ǀ ajáram ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we obtain through your protection,Agni, that which we desire; giver of riches, may we obtain of your riches and descendants; desiring food, may we obtain food; may we obtain, imperishable Agni, imperishable fame (through you).
verses.wilson_translation: May we obtain through your protection,Agni, that which we desire; giver of riches, may we obtain of your riches and descendants; desiring food, may we obtain food; may we obtain, imperishable Agni, imperishable fame (through you).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HE who seeks furtherance and grace to help him goes to the Son of Strength with newest worship,Calling the heavenly Priest to share the banquet, who rends the wood, bright, with his blackened pathway. White-hued and thundering he dwells in splendour, Most Youthful, with the loudvoiced and eternal-Agni, most variform, the Purifier, who follows crunching many ample forests. Incited by the wind thy flames, O Agni, move onward, Pure One! pure, in all directions.Thy most destructive heavenly Navagvas break the woods down and devastate them boldly. Thy pure white horses from their bonds are loosened: O Radiant One, they shear the ground beneath them,And far and wide shines out thy flame, and flickers rapidly moving over earth's high ridges. Forth darts the Bull's tongue like the sharp stone weapon discharged by him who fights to win the cattle.Agni's fierce flame is like a hero's onset: dread and resistless he destroys the forests. Thou with the sunlight of the great Impeller hast boldly over-spread the earth's expanses.So drive away with conquering might all perils. fighting out foemen burn up those who harm us. Wondrous! of wondrous power! give to the singer wealth wondrous, marked, most wonderful, life-giving.Wealth bright, O Bright One, vast, with many heroes, give with thy bright flames to the man who lauds thee.

verses.sanskrit: प्र नव्यसा सहसः सूनुमच्छा यज्ञेन गातुमव इच्छमानः ।वृश्चद्वनं कृष्णयामं रुशंतं वीती होतारं दिव्यं जिगाति ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ návyasā ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ áccha ǀ yajñéna ǀ gātúm ǀ ávaḥ ǀ icchámānaḥ ǀvṛścát-vanam ǀ kṛṣṇáyāmam ǀ rúśantam ǀ vītī́ ǀ hótāram ǀ divyám ǀ jigāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is desirous of food has recourse with a new sacrifice, approachable son of strength (Agni), to you the consumer of forests, the dark-pathed, the bright shining, the ministrant (to the gods) of (sacrificial) food, the divine.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is desirous of food has recourse with a new sacrifice, approachable son of strength (Agni), to you the consumer of forests, the dark-pathed, the bright shining, the ministrant (to the gods) of (sacrificial) food, the divine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स श्वितानस्तन्यतू रोचनस्था अजरेभिर्नानदद्भिर्यविष्ठः ।यः पावकः पुरुतमः पुरूणि पृथून्यग्निरनुयाति भर्वन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ śvitānáḥ ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ rocana-sthā́ḥ ǀ ajárebhiḥ ǀ nā́nadat-bhiḥ ǀ yáviṣṭhaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ puru-támaḥ ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ pṛthū́ni ǀ agníḥ ǀ anu-yā́ti ǀ bhárvan ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You who are) white-hued, vociferous, abiding in the firmament, (associated) with the imperishable, resounding (winds), the youngest (of the gods),Agni, who, purifying and most vast, proceeds, feeding upon numerous and substantial (forests).
verses.wilson_translation: (You who are) white-hued, vociferous, abiding in the firmament, (associated) with the imperishable, resounding (winds), the youngest (of the gods),Agni, who, purifying and most vast, proceeds, feeding upon numerous and substantial (forests).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि ते विष्वग्वातजूतासो अग्ने भामासः शुचे शुचयश्चरंति ।तुविम्रक्षासो दिव्या नवग्वा वना वनंति धृषता रुजंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ te ǀ víṣvak ǀ vā́ta-jūtāsaḥ ǀ agne ǀ bhā́māsaḥ ǀ śuce ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ caranti ǀtuvi-mrakṣā́saḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ náva-gvāḥ ǀ vánā ǀ vananti ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ rujántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure Agni, your bright flames, fanned by the wind, spread wide in every diection, consuming abundant (fuel); divine, fresh-rising, they plural y upon the woods, enveloping them in lustre.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure Agni, your bright flames, fanned by the wind, spread wide in every diection, consuming abundant (fuel); divine, fresh-rising, they plural y upon the woods, enveloping them in lustre.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये ते शुक्रासः शुचयः शुचिष्मः क्षां वपंति विषितासो अश्वाः ।अध भ्रमस्त उर्विया वि भाति यातयमानो अधि सानु पृश्नेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ śuciṣmaḥ ǀ kṣā́m ǀ vápanti ǀ ví-sitāsaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀádha ǀ bhramáḥ ǀ te ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ yātáyamānaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nu ǀ pṛ́śneḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Resplendent Agni, your bright rays, horses let loose (from the rein), shear the earth; your (band of flame), mounting above the high-lands of the many-tinted (earth), blazes fiercely.
verses.wilson_translation: Resplendent Agni, your bright rays, horses let loose (from the rein), shear the earth; your (band of flame), mounting above the high-lands of the many-tinted (earth), blazes fiercely.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध जिह्वा पापतीति प्र वृष्णो गोषुयुधो नाशनिः सृजाना ।शूरस्येव प्रसितिः क्षातिरग्नेर्दुर्वर्तुर्भीमो दयते वनानि ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ jihvā́ ǀ pāpatīti ǀ prá ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ goṣu-yúdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ aśániḥ ǀ sṛjānā́ ǀśū́rasya-iva ǀ prá-sitiḥ ǀ kṣātíḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ duḥ-vártuḥ ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ dayate ǀ vánāni ǁ
verses.english_translation: The flame of the showerer (Agni), repeatedly descends like the hurled thunderbolt of the rescuer of the cattle; like the prowess of a hero is the destroying (energy) of Agni; irresistible and fearful, he consumes the forests.
verses.wilson_translation: The flame of the showerer (Agni), repeatedly descends like the hurled thunderbolt of the rescuer of the cattle; like the prowess of a hero is the destroying (energy) of Agni; irresistible and fearful, he consumes the forests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ भानुना पार्थिवानि ज्रयांसि महस्तोदस्य धृषता ततंथ ।स बाधस्वाप भया सहोभिः स्पृधो वनुष्यन्वनुषो नि जूर्व ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ jráyāṃsi ǀ maháḥ ǀ todásya ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ tatantha ǀsáḥ ǀ bādhasva ǀ ápa ǀ bhayā́ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ vanuṣyán ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ jūrva ǁ
verses.english_translation: You overspread the accessible plural ces of the earth with light by the energy of you powerful, exciting (influence); do you disperse all perils, and, baffing (our) adversaries by your mighty (powers), destroy (our) foes.
verses.wilson_translation: You overspread the accessible plural ces of the earth with light by the energy of you powerful, exciting (influence); do you disperse all perils, and, baffing (our) adversaries by your mighty (powers), destroy (our) foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स चित्र चित्रं चितयंतमस्मे चित्रक्षत्र चित्रतमं वयोधां ।चंद्रं रयिं पुरुवीरं बृहंतं चंद्र चंद्राभिर्गृणते युवस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ citra ǀ citrám ǀ citáyantam ǀ asmé íti ǀ cítra-kṣatra ǀ citrá-tamam ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́m ǀcandrám ǀ rayím ǀ puru-vī́ram ǀ bṛhántam ǀ cándra ǀ candrā́bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ yuvasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wonderful Agni, of wonderful strength, bestower of delight, grant to us, and to him who praises you with gratifying (praises), wonderful, most wonderful riches, conferring fame, supplying food, comprehendingmaledescendants,d electable and infinite.
verses.wilson_translation: Wonderful Agni, of wonderful strength, bestower of delight, grant to us, and to him who praises you with gratifying (praises), wonderful, most wonderful riches, conferring fame, supplying food, comprehendingmaledescendants,d electable and infinite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaiśvānara, born in holy Order,The Sage, the King, the guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated. Him have they praised, mid-point of sacrifices, great cistern of libations, seat of riches.Vaiśvānara, conveyer of oblations, ensign of worship, have the Gods engendered. From thee, O Agni, springs the mighty singer, from thee come heroes who subdue the foeman.O King, Vaiśvānara, bestow thou on us excellent treasures worthy to belonged fo r. To thee, Immortal! when to life thou springest, all the Gods sing for joy as to their infant.They by thy mental powers were made immortal, Vaiśvānara, when thou shonest from thy Parents. Agni Vaiśvānara, no one hath ever resisted these thy mighty ordinances,When thou, arising from thy Parents' bosom, foundest the light for days' appointed courses. The summits of the heaven are traversed through and through by the Immortal's light, Vaiśvānara's brilliancy.All creatures in existence rest upon his head. The Seven swift-flowing Streams have grown like branches forth, Vaiśvānara, who measured out the realms of air, Sage very wise who made the lucid spheres of heaven,The Undeceivable who spread out all the worlds, keeper is he and guard of immortality.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निं ।कविं सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्ना पात्रं जनयंत देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: mūrdhā́nam ǀ diváḥ ǀ aratím ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ ṛté ǀ ā́ ǀ jātám ǀ agním ǀkavím ǀ sam-rā́jam ǀ átithim ǀ jánānām ǀ āsán ǀ ā́ ǀ pā́tram ǀ janayanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods have genitive rated vaśvānara Agni, as the brow of heaven, the unceasing pervader of earth, born for (the celebration of) sacrifice, wise, imperial, the guest of men, in whose mouth (is) the vessel (that conveys the oblation to the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: The gods have genitive rated vaśvānara Agni, as the brow of heaven, the unceasing pervader of earth, born for (the celebration of) sacrifice, wise, imperial, the guest of men, in whose mouth (is) the vessel (that conveys the oblation to the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नाभिं यज्ञानां सदनं रयीणां महामाहावमभि सं नवंत ।वैश्वानरं रथ्यमध्वराणां यज्ञस्य केतुं जनयंत देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: nā́bhim ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ sádanam ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ mahā́m ǀ ā-hāvám ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ navanta ǀvaiśvānarám ǀ rathyám ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ janayanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The worshippers) glorify together, (Agni), the bond of sacrifices, the abode of riches, the great receptacle of burnt-offerings; the gods genitive rate vaśvānara, the conveyer of oblations, the emblem of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: (The worshippers) glorify together, (Agni), the bond of sacrifices, the abode of riches, the great receptacle of burnt-offerings; the gods genitive rate vaśvānara, the conveyer of oblations, the emblem of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्विप्रो जायते वाज्यग्ने त्वद्वीरासो अभिमातिषाहः ।वैश्वानर त्वमस्मासु धेहि वसूनि राजन्त्स्पृहयाय्याणि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvát ǀ vípraḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ vājī́ ǀ agne ǀ tvát ǀ vīrā́saḥ ǀ abhimāti-sáhaḥ ǀváiśvānara ǀ tvám ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhehi ǀ vásūni ǀ rājan ǀ spṛhayā́yyāṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The offerer of (sacrificial) food becomes wise,Agni, from you heroes become the vanquishers of foes; therefore, do you, royalvaiśvānara, bestow upon us enviable riches.
verses.wilson_translation: The offerer of (sacrificial) food becomes wise,Agni, from you heroes become the vanquishers of foes; therefore, do you, royalvaiśvānara, bestow upon us enviable riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां विश्वे अमृत जायमानं शिशुं न देवा अभि सं नवंते ।तव क्रतुभिरमृतत्वमायन्वैश्वानर यत्पित्रोरदीदेः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ víśve ǀ amṛta ǀ jā́yamānam ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ navante ǀtáva ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ āyan ǀ váiśvānara ǀ yát ǀ pitróḥ ǀ ádīdeḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the worshippers together praise you, immortal,Agni, when born like an infant; when you shinevaiśvānara, between the parental (heaven and earth) they obtain immortality through your (sacred) rites.
verses.wilson_translation: All the worshippers together praise you, immortal,Agni, when born like an infant; when you shinevaiśvānara, between the parental (heaven and earth) they obtain immortality through your (sacred) rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानर तव तानि व्रतानि महान्यग्ने नकिरा दधर्ष ।यज्जायमानः पित्रोरुपस्थेऽविंदः केतुं वयुनेष्वह्नां ॥
verses.transliteration: váiśvānara ǀ táva ǀ tā́ni ǀ vratā́ni ǀ mahā́ni ǀ agne ǀ nákiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣa ǀyát ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ ávindaḥ ǀ ketúm ǀ vayúneṣu ǀ áhnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni,vaiśvānara, these your mighty deeds no one can resist; when born on the lap of your parents, you have stationed the banner of the days on the paths of the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni,vaiśvānara, these your mighty deeds no one can resist; when born on the lap of your parents, you have stationed the banner of the days on the paths of the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरस्य विमितानि चक्षसा सानूनि दिवो अमृतस्य केतुना ।तस्येदु विश्वा भुवनाधि मूर्धनि वया इव रुरुहुः सप्त विस्रुहः ॥
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānarásya ǀ ví-mitāni ǀ cákṣasā ǀ sā́nūni ǀ diváḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ ketúnā ǀtásya ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ ádhi ǀ mūrdháni ǀ vayā́ḥ-iva ǀ ruruhuḥ ǀ saptá ǀ vi-srúhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The summits of the firmament are measured by the light ofvaiśvānara, the manifester of ambrosial (rain); all the regions are overspread (by the vapour) on his brow, and the seven gliding (streams) spring from thence like branches.
verses.wilson_translation: The summits of the firmament are measured by the light ofvaiśvānara, the manifester of ambrosial (rain); all the regions are overspread (by the vapour) on his brow, and the seven gliding (streams) spring from thence like branches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि यो रजांस्यमिमीत सुक्रतुर्वैश्वानरो वि दिवो रोचना कविः ।परि यो विश्वा भुवनानि पप्रथेऽदब्धो गोपा अमृतस्य रक्षिता ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ ámimīta ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ ví ǀ diváḥ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ kavíḥ ǀpári ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ paprathé ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ rakṣitā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vaiśvānara, the performer of sacred acts, is he who made the regions; foreseeing (he has made) the luminaries of heaven, and has spread throughout all worlds; the irresistibel guardian (of all), the protector of ambrosial (rain).
verses.wilson_translation: Vaiśvānara, the performer of sacred acts, is he who made the regions; foreseeing (he has made) the luminaries of heaven, and has spread throughout all worlds; the irresistibel guardian (of all), the protector of ambrosial (rain).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AT Jātavedas' holy gathering I will tell aloud the conquering might of the swift red-hued Steer.A pure and fresher hymn flows to Vaiśvānara, even as for Agni lovely Soma is made pure. That Agni, when in loftiest heaven he sprang to life, Guardian of Holy Laws, kept and observed them well.Exceeding wise, he measured out the firmament. Vaiśvānara attained to heaven by mightiness. Wonderful Mitra propped the heaven and earth apart, and covered and concealedthe darkness with his light.He made the two bowls part asunder like two skins. Vaiśvānara put forth all his creative power. The Migbty seized him in the bosom of the floods: the people waited on the King who should be praised.As envoy of Vivasvān MatariSvan brought Agni Vaiśvānara hither from far away. In every age bestow upon the singers wealth, worthy of holy synods, glorious, ever new.King, undecaying, as it were with sharpened bolt, smite down the sinner like a tree with lightning-flash. Do thou bestow, O Agni, on our wealthy chiefs, rule, with good heroes, undecaying, bending not.So may we win for us strength. O Vaiśvānara, hundredfold, thousandfold, O Agni, by thy help. O thou who dwellest in three places, Helper, keep with effective guards our princely patrons.Keep our band, Agni, who have brought thee presents. Lengthen their lives, Vaiśvānara, when lauded.

verses.sanskrit: पृक्षस्य वृष्णो अरुषस्य नू सहः प्र नु वोचं विदथा जातवेदसः ।वैश्वानराय मतिर्नव्यसी शुचिः सोम इव पवते चारुरग्नये ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛkṣásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ aruṣásya ǀ nú ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ prá ǀ nú ǀ vocam ǀ vidáthā ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǀvaiśvānarā́ya ǀ matíḥ ǀ návyasī ǀ śúciḥ ǀ sómaḥ-iva ǀ pavate ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ agnáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I commemorate promptly at the holy ceremony the might of the all-pervading jātavaedasa, the showerer, the radiant; new, pure, and graceful praise issues (from me) like thesomajuice (from the filter), to Agnivaiśvānara.
verses.wilson_translation: I commemorate promptly at the holy ceremony the might of the all-pervading jātavaedasa, the showerer, the radiant; new, pure, and graceful praise issues (from me) like thesomajuice (from the filter), to Agnivaiśvānara.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स जायमानः परमे व्योमनि व्रतान्यग्निर्व्रतपा अरक्षत ।व्यंतरिक्षममिमीत सुक्रतुर्वैश्वानरो महिना नाकमस्पृशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-omani ǀ vratā́ni ǀ agníḥ ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ arakṣata ǀví ǀ antárikṣam ǀ amimīta ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ nā́kam ǀ aspṛśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: That Agniwho, as soon as born in the highest heaven, the protector of sacred rites, protects the pious acts (of men), he has made he manifold firmament;vaiśvānara, the performer of good deeds, has attained heaven by his greatness.
verses.wilson_translation: That Agniwho, as soon as born in the highest heaven, the protector of sacred rites, protects the pious acts (of men), he has made he manifold firmament;vaiśvānara, the performer of good deeds, has attained heaven by his greatness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्यस्तभ्नाद्रोदसी मित्रो अद्भुतोऽंतर्वावदकृणोज्ज्योतिषा तमः ।वि चर्मणीव धिषणे अवर्तयद्वैश्वानरो विश्वमधत्त वृष्ण्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ astabhnāt ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀ antaḥ-vā́vat ǀ akṛṇot ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támaḥ ǀví ǀ cármaṇī ivéti cármaṇī-iva ǀ dhiṣáṇe íti ǀ avartayat ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ adhatta ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The friend (of all), the wonderful (agni), has upheld heaven and earth; he has hidden darkness within light; he has spread out the two sustaining (worlds, heaven and earth), like two skins;vaiśvānaracomprehends all (creaive) energy.
verses.wilson_translation: The friend (of all), the wonderful (agni), has upheld heaven and earth; he has hidden darkness within light; he has spread out the two sustaining (worlds, heaven and earth), like two skins;vaiśvānaracomprehends all (creaive) energy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपामुपस्थे महिषा अगृभ्णत विशो राजानमुप तस्थुर्ऋग्मियं ।आ दूतो अग्निमभरद्विवस्वतो वैश्वानरं मातरिश्वा परावतः ॥
verses.transliteration: apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ agṛbhṇata ǀ víśaḥ ǀ rā́jānam ǀ úpa ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀā́ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ agním ǀ abharat ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mightymarutshave seized upon him on the lap of the waters (in firmament), and men have acknowledged him as their adorable sovereign;mātariśvan, the messenger of the gods, has brought Agnivaiśvānara(hither) from the distant (sphere of the) sun.
verses.wilson_translation: The mightymarutshave seized upon him on the lap of the waters (in firmament), and men have acknowledged him as their adorable sovereign;mātariśvan, the messenger of the gods, has brought Agnivaiśvānara(hither) from the distant (sphere of the) sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युगेयुगे विदथ्यं गृणद्भ्योऽग्ने रयिं यशसं धेहि नव्यसीं ।पव्येव राजन्नघशंसमजर नीचा नि वृश्च वनिनं न तेजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: yugé-yuge ǀ vidathyám ǀ gṛṇát-bhyaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ rayím ǀ yaśásam ǀ dhehi ǀ návyasīm ǀpavyā́-iva ǀ rājan ǀ aghá-śaṃsam ǀ ajara ǀ nīcā́ ǀ ní ǀ vṛśca ǀ vanínam ǀ ná ǀ téjasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: To those,Agni, who repeat new (praises) to you, the object of their worship from age to age, grant riches and famous (posterity); strike don, undecaying, sovereign, the sinner with your blaze like the thunderbolt, as if he were a tree.
verses.wilson_translation: To those,Agni, who repeat new (praises) to you, the object of their worship from age to age, grant riches and famous (posterity); strike don, undecaying, sovereign, the sinner with your blaze like the thunderbolt, as if he were a tree.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमग्ने मघवत्सु धारयानामि क्षत्रमजरं सुवीर्यं ।वयं जयेम शतिनं सहस्रिणं वैश्वानर वाजमग्ने तवोतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ agne ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dhāraya ǀ ánāmi ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ajáram ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀvayám ǀ jayema ǀ śatínam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ váiśvānara ǀ vā́jam ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Agni, to us who are affluent in (offerings), wealth that cannot be taken away, that is exempt from decay, and that comprehends excellentmaledescendants may we obtain, Agnivaiśvānara, hundreds and thousands of viands through your protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Agni, to us who are affluent in (offerings), wealth that cannot be taken away, that is exempt from decay, and that comprehends excellentmaledescendants may we obtain, Agnivaiśvānara, hundreds and thousands of viands through your protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अदब्धेभिस्तव गोपाभिरिष्टेऽस्माकं पाहि त्रिषधस्थ सूरीन् ।रक्षा च नो ददुषां शर्धो अग्ने वैश्वानर प्र च तारीः स्तवानः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádabdhebhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ gopā́bhiḥ ǀ iṣṭe ǀ asmā́kam ǀ pāhi ǀ tri-sadhastha ǀ sūrī́n ǀrákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ dadúṣām ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ agne ǀ váiśvānara ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ tārīḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adored Agni, present in thethree worlds, protect your worshippers with your irresistible protections, preserve the strength of us who offer (oblations); glorified (by us), Agnivaiśvānara, transport us (beyond evil).
verses.wilson_translation: Adored Agni, present in thethree worlds, protect your worshippers with your irresistible protections, preserve the strength of us who offer (oblations); glorified (by us), Agnivaiśvānara, transport us (beyond evil).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ONE half of day is dark, and bright the other: both atmospheres move on by sage devices.Agni Vaiśvānara, when born as Sovran, hath with his lustre overcome the darkness. I know not either warp or woof, I know not the web they weave when moving to the contest.Whose son shall here speak words that must be spoken without assistance from the Father near him? For both the warp and woof he understandeth, and in due time shall speak what should be spoken,Who knoweth as the immortal world's Protector, descending, seeing with no aid from other. He is the Priest, the first of all: behold him. Mid mortal men he is the light immortal.Here was he born, firm-seated in his station Immortal, ever waxing in his body. A firm light hath been set for men to look on: among all things that fly the mind is swiftest.All Gods of one accord, with one intention, move unobstructed to a single purpose. Mine ears unclose to hear, mine eye to see him; the light that harbours in my spirit broadens.Far roams my mind whose thoughts are in the distance. What shall I speak, what shall I now imagine? All the Gods bowed them down in fear before thee, Agni, when thou wast dwelling in the darkness.Vaiśvānara be gracious to assist us, may the Immortal favour us and help us.

verses.sanskrit: अहश्च कृष्णमहरर्जुनं च वि वर्तेते रजसी वेद्याभिः ।वैश्वानरो जायमानो न राजावातिरज्ज्योतिषाग्निस्तमांसि ॥
verses.transliteration: áhaḥ ǀ ca ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ áhaḥ ǀ árjunam ǀ ca ǀ ví ǀ vartete íti ǀ rájasī íti ǀ vedyā́bhiḥ ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́jā ǀ áva ǀ atirat ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ agníḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The dark day and the light day revolve alternate, affecting (the world) by their recognizable (properties);Agnivaiśvānara, manifested like a prince, dispels darkness by his lustre.
verses.wilson_translation: The dark day and the light day revolve alternate, affecting (the world) by their recognizable (properties);Agnivaiśvānara, manifested like a prince, dispels darkness by his lustre.
