verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नाहं तंतुं न वि जानाम्योतुं न यं वयंति समरेऽतमानाः ।कस्य स्वित्पुत्र इह वक्त्वानि परो वदात्यवरेण पित्रा ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ ahám ǀ tántum ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ jānāmi ǀ ótum ǀ ná ǀ yám ǀ váyanti ǀ sam-aré ǀ átamānāḥ ǀkásya ǀ svit ǀ putráḥ ǀ ihá ǀ váktvāni ǀ paráḥ ǀ vadāti ǀ ávareṇa ǀ pitrā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I understand not the threads (of the warp), nor the threads of the woof, nor that (cloth) which those who are assiduous in united exertion weave; of what (man) may the son declare the words that are to be spoken in the next world, (instrumental ucted) by a father abiding below.
verses.wilson_translation: I understand not the threads (of the warp), nor the threads of the woof, nor that (cloth) which those who are assiduous in united exertion weave; of what (man) may the son declare the words that are to be spoken in the next world, (instrumental ucted) by a father abiding below.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स इत्तंतुं स वि जानात्योतुं स वक्त्वान्यृतुथा वदाति ।य ईं चिकेतदमृतस्य गोपा अवश्चरन्परो अन्येन पश्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ tántum ǀ sáḥ ǀ ví ǀ jānāti ǀ ótum ǀ sáḥ ǀ váktvāni ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ vadāti ǀyáḥ ǀ īm ǀ cíketat ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ aváḥ ǀ cáran ǀ paráḥ ǀ anyéna ǀ páśyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: He verily knows the threads of the warp and or the woof, he speaks in due season what is to be said, who comprehends all this (universe); who is the protector of ambrosial water, sojourning both above and below, and contemplating (the world) under a different (manifestation).
verses.wilson_translation: He verily knows the threads of the warp and or the woof, he speaks in due season what is to be said, who comprehends all this (universe); who is the protector of ambrosial water, sojourning both above and below, and contemplating (the world) under a different (manifestation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं होता प्रथमः पश्यतेममिदं ज्योतिरमृतं मर्त्येषु ।अयं स जज्ञे ध्रुव आ निषत्तोऽमर्त्यस्तन्वा वर्धमानः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ hótā ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ páśyata ǀ imám ǀ idám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ mártyeṣu ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ jajñe ǀ dhruváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ várdhamānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thisvaiśvānarais the first offerer of burnt offerings; behold him; this is the light immortal among mortals; he has been born in a bodily shape, immoveable, all-pervading, immortal, ever increasing.
verses.wilson_translation: Thisvaiśvānarais the first offerer of burnt offerings; behold him; this is the light immortal among mortals; he has been born in a bodily shape, immoveable, all-pervading, immortal, ever increasing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवं ज्योतिर्निहितं दृशये कं मनो जविष्ठं पतयत्स्वंतः ।विश्वे देवाः समनसः सकेता एकं क्रतुमभि वि यंति साधु ॥
verses.transliteration: dhruvám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ní-hitam ǀ dṛśáye ǀ kám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jáviṣṭham ǀ patáyat-su ǀ antáríti ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ sá-ketāḥ ǀ ékam ǀ krátum ǀ abhí ǀ ví ǀ yānti ǀ sādhú ǁ
verses.english_translation: A steady light, swifter than thought, stationed among moving beings to show (the way) to happiness all the gods being of one mind, and of like wisdom, proceed respectfully to the presence of the one (chief) agent (vaiśvānara).
verses.wilson_translation: A steady light, swifter than thought, stationed among moving beings to show (the way) to happiness all the gods being of one mind, and of like wisdom, proceed respectfully to the presence of the one (chief) agent (vaiśvānara).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि मे कर्णा पतयतो वि चक्षुर्वीदं ज्योतिर्हृदय आहितं यत् ।वि मे मनश्चरति दूरआधीः किं स्विद्वक्ष्यामि किमु नू मनिष्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ me ǀ kárṇā ǀ patayataḥ ǀ ví ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ ví ǀ idám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ hṛ́daye ǀ ā́-hitam ǀ yát ǀví ǀ me ǀ mánaḥ ǀ carati ǀ dūré-ādhīḥ ǀ kím ǀ svit ǀ vakṣyā́mi ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ maniṣye ǁ
verses.english_translation: My ears are turned (to hear him), my eyes (to behold him); this light that is plural ced in the heart (seeks to know him); my mind, the receptable of distant (objects) hastens (towards him); what shall I declare him? How shall I comprehend him?
verses.wilson_translation: My ears are turned (to hear him), my eyes (to behold him); this light that is plural ced in the heart (seeks to know him); my mind, the receptable of distant (objects) hastens (towards him); what shall I declare him? How shall I comprehend him?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे देवा अनमस्यन्भियानास्त्वामग्ने तमसि तस्थिवांसं ।वैश्वानरोऽवतूतये नोऽमर्त्योऽवतूतये नः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ anamasyan ǀ bhiyānā́ḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ támasi ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsam ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ avatu ǀ ūtáye ǀ naḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ avatu ǀ ūtáye ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the gods, alarmed, venerate you,Agni, abiding in darkness; mayvaiśvānarapreserve us with his protection; may the immortal Agni preserve us with his protection.
verses.wilson_translation: All the gods, alarmed, venerate you,Agni, abiding in darkness; mayvaiśvānarapreserve us with his protection; may the immortal Agni preserve us with his protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ७ बार्हस्पत्यो भरद्वाज: । अग्नि : । त्रिष्टुप् ; ७ द्विपदा विराट् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INSTALL at sacrifice, while the rite advances, your pleasant, heavenly Agni, meet for praises.With hymns-for he illumines us-install him. He, Jātavedas, makes our rites successful. Hear this laud, Radiant Priest of many aspects, O Agni with the fires of man enkindled,Laud which bards send forth pure as sacred butter, strength to this man, as ’twere for self-advantage. Mid mortal men that singer thrives in glory who offers gifts with hymns of praise to Agni,And the God, wondrous bright, with wondrous succours helps him to win a stable filled with cattle. He, at his birth, whose path is black behind him, filled heaven and earth with far-apparent splendour:And he himself hath been. through night's thick darkness, made manifest by light, the Purifier. With thy most mighty aid, confer, O Agni, wonderful wealth on us and on our princes,Who stand preeminent, surpassing others in liberal gifts, in fame, and hero virtues. Agni, accept this sacrifice with gladness, which, seated here, the worshipper presenteth.Fair hymns hadst thou among the Bharadvājas, and holpest them to gain abundant vigour. Scatter our foes, increase our store. May we he glad a hundred winters with brave sons.

verses.sanskrit: पुरो वो मंद्रं दिव्यं सुवृक्तिं प्रयति यज्ञे अग्निमध्वरे दधिध्वं ।पुर उक्थेभिः स हि नो विभावा स्वध्वरा करति जातवेदाः ॥
verses.transliteration: puráḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mandrám ǀ divyám ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ pra-yatí ǀ yajñé ǀ agním ǀ adhvaré ǀ dadhidhvam ǀpuráḥ ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ su-adhvarā́ ǀ karati ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: plural ce before you at the progressive, uninterrupted sacrifice, the divine, adorable, perfect Agni, with prayers; for he, the resplendentjātavedas, makes us prosperous in sacred rites.
verses.wilson_translation: plural ce before you at the progressive, uninterrupted sacrifice, the divine, adorable, perfect Agni, with prayers; for he, the resplendentjātavedas, makes us prosperous in sacred rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु द्युमः पुर्वणीक होतरग्ने अग्निभिर्मनुष इधानः ।स्तोमं यमस्मै ममतेव शूषं घृतं न शुचि मतयः पवंते ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dyu-maḥ ǀ puru-anīka ǀ hotaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀstómam ǀ yám ǀ asmai ǀ mamátā-iva ǀ śūṣám ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ śúci ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ pavante ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brilliant, may-rayed Agni, invoker of the gods, kindled with many fires, (hear) this (praise) of men; which delightful praise, pure as the clarified butter (that has been filtered), his worshippers offer unto him asmamatā(formerly offered it).
verses.wilson_translation: Brilliant, may-rayed Agni, invoker of the gods, kindled with many fires, (hear) this (praise) of men; which delightful praise, pure as the clarified butter (that has been filtered), his worshippers offer unto him asmamatā(formerly offered it).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पीपाय स श्रवसा मर्त्येषु यो अग्नये ददाश विप्र उक्थैः ।चित्राभिस्तमूतिभिश्चित्रशोचिर्व्रजस्य साता गोमतो दधाति ॥
verses.transliteration: pīpā́ya ǀ sáḥ ǀ śrávasā ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ yáḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ dadā́śa ǀ vípraḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀcitrā́bhiḥ ǀ tám ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ citrá-śociḥ ǀ vrajásya ǀ sātā́ ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ dadhāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: He thrives in abundance among men, who, pious, presents to Agni(oblations) with prayers; the wonderfully radian Agni plural ces him with marvellous protection in the enjoyment of pasturage full of herds of cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: He thrives in abundance among men, who, pious, presents to Agni(oblations) with prayers; the wonderfully radian Agni plural ces him with marvellous protection in the enjoyment of pasturage full of herds of cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यः पप्रौ जायमान उर्वी दूरेदृशा भासा कृष्णाध्वा ।अध बहु चित्तम ऊर्म्यायास्तिरः शोचिषा ददृशे पावकः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ papráu ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ dūre-dṛ́śā ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ kṛṣṇá-adhvā ǀádha ǀ bahú ǀ cit ǀ támaḥ ǀ ū́rmyāyāḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ dadṛśe ǀ pāvakáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The dark-pathed, as soon as genitive rated, filled with his afar-seen light the two spacious (worlds); he, the purifer, is now beheld dispersing with his radiance the thick glooms of night.
verses.wilson_translation: The dark-pathed, as soon as genitive rated, filled with his afar-seen light the two spacious (worlds); he, the purifer, is now beheld dispersing with his radiance the thick glooms of night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू नश्चित्रं पुरुवाजाभिरूती अग्ने रयिं मघवद्भ्यश्च धेहि ।ये राधसा श्रवसा चात्यन्यान्त्सुवीर्येभिश्चाभि संति जनान् ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ citrám ǀ puru-vā́jābhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ ágne ǀ rayím ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhehi ǀyé ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ śrávasā ǀ ca ǀ áti ǀ anyā́n ǀ su-vī́ryebhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ abhí ǀ sánti ǀ jánān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow quickly,Agni, upon us who are affluent (in oblations), wondrous wealth), with abundant viands and protections, such as enrich other men with wealth with food, and withmaledescendants.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow quickly,Agni, upon us who are affluent (in oblations), wondrous wealth), with abundant viands and protections, such as enrich other men with wealth with food, and withmaledescendants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमं यज्ञं चनो धा अग्न उशन्यं त आसानो जुहुते हविष्मान् ।भरद्वाजेषु दधिषे सुवृक्तिमवीर्वाजस्य गध्यस्य सातौ ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ agne ǀ uśán ǀ yám ǀ te ǀ āsānáḥ ǀ juhuté ǀ havíṣmān ǀbharát-vājeṣu ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ ávīḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gádhyasya ǀ sātáu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnidesirous (of the offering), accept this sacrifice, this food which the presenter (of the oblation), sitting down (before you), offers unto you; accept the blameless (praises) of thebhāradvāja(race), and favour them that they may obtain many sorts of food.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnidesirous (of the offering), accept this sacrifice, this food which the presenter (of the oblation), sitting down (before you), offers unto you; accept the blameless (praises) of thebhāradvāja(race), and favour them that they may obtain many sorts of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि द्वेषांसीनुहि वर्धयेळां मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ inuhí ǀ vardháya ǀ íḷām ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Scatter (our enemies); augment our abundance; and may we, blessed with virtuousmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.
verses.wilson_translation: Scatter (our enemies); augment our abundance; and may we, blessed with virtuousmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . EAGERLY Sacrifice thou, most skilful, Agni! Priest, pressing on as if the Maruts sent thee.To our oblation bring the two Nāsatyas, Mitra and Varuṇa and Earth and Heaven. Thou art our guileless, most delightful Herald, the God, among mankind, of holy synods.A Priest with purifying tongue, O Agni, sacrifice with thy mouth to thine own body. For even the blessed longing that is in thee would bring the Gods down to the singer's worship,When the Aṅgirases' sagest Sage, the Poet, sings the sweet measure at the solemn service. Bright hath he beamed, the wise, the far-refulgent. Worship the two widespreading Worlds, O Agni,Whom as the Living One rich in oblations the Five Tribes, bringing gifts, adorn with homage. When I with reverence clip the grass for Agni, when the trimmed ladle, fullof oil, is lifted,Firm on the seat of earth is based the altar: eye-like, the sacrifice is directed Sun-ward. Enrich us, O thou Priest of many aspects, with the Gods, Agni, with thy fires, enkindled.O Son of Strength, clad in the robe of riches, may we escape from woe as froma prison.

verses.sanskrit: यजस्व होतरिषितो यजीयानग्ने बाधो मरुतां न प्रयुक्ति ।आ नो मित्रावरुणा नासत्या द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी ववृत्याः ॥

verses.sanskrit: दशस्या नः पुर्वणीक होतर्देवेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिधानः ।रायः सूनो सहसो वावसाना अति स्रसेम वृजनं नांहः ॥
verses.transliteration: daśasyá ǀ naḥ ǀ puru-anīka ǀ hotaḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀrāyáḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vavasānā́ḥ ǀ áti ǀ srasema ǀ vṛjánam ǀ ná ǀ áṃhaḥ ǁ

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . KING of trimmed grass, Herald within the dwelling, may Agni worship the Impeller's World-halves.He, Son of Strength, the Holy, from a distance hath spread himself abroad with light like Sūrya. In thee, most wise, shall Dyaus, for full perfection, King! Holy One! pronounce the call to worship.Found in three places, like the Speeder's footstep, come to present men's riches as oblations! Whose blaze most splendid, sovran in the forest, shines waxing on his way like the - Impeller.He knows himself, like as a guileless smelter, not to be stayed among the plants, Immortal. Our friends extol him like a steed for vigour even Agni in the dwelling, jatave~as.Trce-fed, he fights with power as doth a champion, like Dawn's Sire to be praised with sacrifices. Men wonder at his shining glows when, paring the woods with case, o’er the broad earth he goeth,And, like a rushing flood, loosed quickly, burneth, swift as a guilty thief, o’er desert places. So mighty thou protectest us from slander, O Champion, Agni! with all fires enkindled.Bring opulence and drive away affliction. May brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये होता दुरोणे बर्हिषो राळग्निस्तोदस्य रोदसी यजध्यै ।अयं स सूनुः सहस ऋतावा दूरात्सूर्यो न शोचिषा ततान ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhye ǀ hótā ǀ duroṇé ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ rā́ṭ ǀ agníḥ ǀ todásya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ yájadhyai ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ dūrā́t ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śocíṣā ǀ tatāna ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the invoker of the gods, the lord of sacrifice, abides in the dwelling of the instrumental tutor of the rite, to offer sacrifice to heaven and earth; he, the son of strength, the observer of truth, has overspread (the world) from afar, like the sun, with light.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the invoker of the gods, the lord of sacrifice, abides in the dwelling of the instrumental tutor of the rite, to offer sacrifice to heaven and earth; he, the son of strength, the observer of truth, has overspread (the world) from afar, like the sun, with light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यस्मिंत्वे स्वपाके यजत्र यक्षद्राजन्त्सर्वतातेव नु द्यौः ।त्रिषधस्थस्ततरुषो न जंहो हव्या मघानि मानुषा यजध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ tvé íti ǀ sú ǀ ápāke ǀ yajatra ǀ yákṣat ǀ rājan ǀ sarvátātā-iva ǀ nú ǀ dyáuḥ ǀtri-sadhásthaḥ ǀ tatarúṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jáṃhaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ maghā́ni ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yájadhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable and resplendent Agni, to whom, mature in wisdom, the worshipper offers oblations at every sacred rite, do you, who are present in the three (worlds), move with the speed of the traverser (of the sky, the sun), to convey the valuable oblations of men (to the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable and resplendent Agni, to whom, mature in wisdom, the worshipper offers oblations at every sacred rite, do you, who are present in the three (worlds), move with the speed of the traverser (of the sky, the sun), to convey the valuable oblations of men (to the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तेजिष्ठा यस्यारतिर्वनेराट् तोदो अध्वन्न वृधसानो अद्यौत् ।अद्रोघो न द्रविता चेतति त्मन्नमर्त्योऽवर्त्र ओषधीषु ॥
verses.transliteration: téjiṣṭhā ǀ yásya ǀ aratíḥ ǀ vane-rā́ṭ ǀ todáḥ ǀ ádhvan ǀ ná ǀ vṛdhasānáḥ ǀ adyaut ǀadrogháḥ ǀ ná ǀ dravitā́ ǀ cetati ǀ tmán ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ avartráḥ ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, whose pure and spreading flame blazes in the forest, shines with increasing intensity, like the sun on his (celestial) path; rushing like the innoxious (wind) among the plural nts, immortal, unimpeded, he lights up (all things) by his own (lustre).
verses.wilson_translation: He, whose pure and spreading flame blazes in the forest, shines with increasing intensity, like the sun on his (celestial) path; rushing like the innoxious (wind) among the plural nts, immortal, unimpeded, he lights up (all things) by his own (lustre).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सास्माकेभिरेतरी न शूषैरग्निः ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः ।द्र्वन्नो वन्वन् क्रत्वा नार्वोस्रः पितेव जारयायि यज्ञैः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ asmā́kebhiḥ ǀ etári ǀ ná ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ stave ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀdrú-annaḥ ǀ vanván ǀ krátvā ǀ ná ǀ árvā ǀ usráḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ jārayā́yi ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who knows all that exists, is propitiated in our dwelling by our praises, like those gratifying (commendations which proceed) from one soliciting (a favour); feeder upon trees, consumer of forests, impetuous in act as the bull, the (progenitor of calves), he is glorified by the celebration of sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who knows all that exists, is propitiated in our dwelling by our praises, like those gratifying (commendations which proceed) from one soliciting (a favour); feeder upon trees, consumer of forests, impetuous in act as the bull, the (progenitor of calves), he is glorified by the celebration of sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध स्मास्य पनयंति भासो वृथा यत्तक्षदनुयाति पृथ्वीं ।सद्यो यः स्यंद्रो विषितो धवीयानृणो न तायुरति धन्वा राट् ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ asya ǀ panayanti ǀ bhā́saḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ yát ǀ tákṣat ǀ anu-yā́ti ǀ pṛthvī́m ǀsadyáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ syandráḥ ǀ ví-sitaḥ ǀ dhávīyān ǀ ṛṇáḥ ǀ ná ǀ tāyúḥ ǀ áti ǀ dhánva ǀ rā́ṭ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They glorify his flames in this world; when, easily thinning the woods, they spread over the earth; he, who glides along unarrested, and rapid in movement as a fast flying thief, shines over the desert.
verses.wilson_translation: They glorify his flames in this world; when, easily thinning the woods, they spread over the earth; he, who glides along unarrested, and rapid in movement as a fast flying thief, shines over the desert.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं नो अर्वन्निदाया विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिधानः ।वेषि रायो वि यासि दुच्छुना मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ arvan ǀ nídāyāḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀvéṣi ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ví ǀ yāsi ǀ ducchúnāḥ ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Quick-moving Agni, kindled with all (your) fires, (guard) us from reproach; you bestow rices, you scattered adversaries; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.
verses.wilson_translation: Quick-moving Agni, kindled with all (your) fires, (guard) us from reproach; you bestow rices, you scattered adversaries; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FROM thee, as branches from a tree, O Agni, from thee, Auspicious God! spring all our blessings-Wealth swiftly, strength in battle with our foemen, the rain besought of heaven, the flow of waters. Thou art our Bhaga to send wealth thou dwellest, like circumambient air, with wondrous splendour.Friend art thou of the lofty Law, like Mitra, Controller, Agni! God! of many a blessing. Agni! the hero slays with might his foeman; the singer bears away the Paṇi's booty-Even he whom thou, Sage, born in Law, incitest by wealth, accordant with the Child of Waters. The man who, Son of Strength  with sacrifices, hymns, lauds, attracts thy fervour to the altar,Enjoys each precious thing, O God, O Agni, gains wealth of corn and is the lord of treasures. Grant, Son of Strength, to men for their subsistence such things as bring high fame and hero children.For thou with might givest much food in cattle even to the wicked wolf when he is hungry. Eloquent, Son of Strength, Most Mighty, Agni, vouchsafe us seed and offspring, full of vigour.May I by all my songs obtain abundance. May brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्विश्वा सुभग सौभगान्यग्ने वि यंति वनिनो न वयाः ।श्रुष्टी रयिर्वाजो वृत्रतूर्ये दिवो वृष्टिरीड्यो रीतिरपां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvát ǀ víśvā ǀ su-bhaga ǀ sáubhagāni ǀ ágne ǀ ví ǀ yānti ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vayā́ḥ ǀśruṣṭī́ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀ diváḥ ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ rītíḥ ǀ apā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Auspicious Agni, all good things proceed from you like branches (from the trunk) of a tree, renowned rices, vigour for the destruction of foes, the rain of heaven; you are to be glorified the sender of the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Auspicious Agni, all good things proceed from you like branches (from the trunk) of a tree, renowned rices, vigour for the destruction of foes, the rain of heaven; you are to be glorified the sender of the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं भगो न आ हि रत्नमिषे परिज्मेव क्षयसि दस्मवर्चाः ।अग्ने मित्रो न बृहत ऋतस्यासि क्षत्ता वामस्य देव भूरेः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ rátnam ǀ iṣé ǀ párijmā-iva ǀ kṣayasi ǀ dasmá-varcāḥ ǀágne ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ ási ǀ kṣattā́ ǀ vāmásya ǀ deva ǀ bhū́reḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, who are adorable, bestow upon us precious wealth; beautiful with radiance, you pass (around) like the circumambient (wind); you, divine Agni, are likemitra, the giver of abundant water and ample wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, who are adorable, bestow upon us precious wealth; beautiful with radiance, you pass (around) like the circumambient (wind); you, divine Agni, are likemitra, the giver of abundant water and ample wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सत्पतिः शवसा हंति वृत्रमग्ने विप्रो वि पणेर्भर्ति वाजं ।यं त्वं प्रचेत ऋतजात राया सजोषा नप्त्रापां हिनोषि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ hanti ǀ vṛtrám ǀ agne ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ví ǀ paṇéḥ ǀ bharti ǀ vā́jam ǀyám ǀ tvám ǀ pra-cetaḥ ǀ ṛta-jāta ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ náptrā ǀ apā́m ǀ hinóṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: That man, the protector of the virtuous, destroys,Agni, his enemy by his strength, and baffles, intelligent, the might of (theasura)paṇi, whom you, the wise, the parent of the sacrifice, consentient with the grandson of the waters, encourage (in the hope of) riches.
verses.wilson_translation: That man, the protector of the virtuous, destroys,Agni, his enemy by his strength, and baffles, intelligent, the might of (theasura)paṇi, whom you, the wise, the parent of the sacrifice, consentient with the grandson of the waters, encourage (in the hope of) riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते सूनो सहसो गीर्भिरुक्थैर्यज्ञैर्मर्तो निशितिं वेद्यानट् ।विश्वं स देव प्रति वारमग्ने धत्ते धान्यं पत्यते वसव्यैः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ní-śitam ǀ vedyā́ ǀ ā́naṭ ǀvíśvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ deva ǀ práti ǀ vā́ram ǀ agne ǀ dhatté ǀ dhānyám ǀ pátyate ǀ vasavyáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mortal who by praise, by prayers, by sacrifices, attracts, son of strength, your heightened (radiance) to the altar, enjoys all-sufficiency and corn, and abounds in wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: The mortal who by praise, by prayers, by sacrifices, attracts, son of strength, your heightened (radiance) to the altar, enjoys all-sufficiency and corn, and abounds in wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता नृभ्य आ सौश्रवसा सुवीराग्ने सूनो सहसः पुष्यसे धाः ।कृणोषि यच्छवसा भूरि पश्वो वयो वृकायारये जसुरये ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sauśravasā́ ǀ su-vī́rā ǀ ágne ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ puṣyáse ǀ dhāḥ ǀkṛṇóṣi ǀ yát ǀ śávasā ǀ bhū́ri ǀ paśváḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vṛ́kāya ǀ aráye ǀ jásuraye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant, son of strength, to men (who praise you), those abundant viands and excellent descendants, (that may contribute) to their prosperity; grant also that copious sustenance from cattle, which by your strength you take away from a churlish and malignant adversary.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant, son of strength, to men (who praise you), those abundant viands and excellent descendants, (that may contribute) to their prosperity; grant also that copious sustenance from cattle, which by your strength you take away from a churlish and malignant adversary.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वद्मा सूनो सहसो नो विहाया अग्ने तोकं तनयं वाजि नो दाः ।विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरभि पूर्तिमश्यां मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: vadmā́ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀ ágne ǀ tokám ǀ tánayam ǀ vājí ǀ naḥ ǀ dāḥ ǀvíśvābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pūrtím ǀ aśyām ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, son of strength, do you who are mighty be our councillor; give us sons and grandsons, together with food; may I, by all my praises, obtain the fulfilment of my desires; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, son of strength, do you who are mighty be our councillor; give us sons and grandsons, together with food; may I, by all my praises, obtain the fulfilment of my desires; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHOSO to Agni hath endeared his thought and service by his hymns,That mortal cats before the rest, and finds sufficiency of food. Agni, in truth, is passing wise, most skilled in ordering, a Seer.At sacrifices Manus' sons glorify Agni as their Priest. The foeman's wealth in many a place, Agni, is emulous to help.Men fight the fiend, and seek by rites to overcome the riteless foe. Agni bestows the hero chief, winner of waters, firm in fray.Soon as they look upon his might his enemies tremble in alarm. For with his wisdom Agni, God, protects the mortal from reproach,Whose conquering wealth is never checked, is never checked in deeds of might. O Agni, God with Mitra's might call hither the favour of the Gods from earth and heaven.Bring weal from heaven that men may dwell securely. May we o’ercome the foe's malign oppressions, may we o’ercome them, through thy help o’ercome them.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ना यो मर्त्यो दुवो धियं जुजोष धीतिभिः ।भसन्नु ष प्र पूर्व्य इषं वुरीतावसे ॥
verses.transliteration: agnā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ jujóṣa ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀbhásat ǀ nú ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ vurīta ǀ ávase ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the mortal who propitiates Agniby devotion and worship, together with praises, quickly become distinguished as first (among men), and acquire ample food for the support (of his children).
verses.wilson_translation: May the mortal who propitiates Agniby devotion and worship, together with praises, quickly become distinguished as first (among men), and acquire ample food for the support (of his children).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरिद्धि प्रचेता अग्निर्वेधस्तम ऋषिः ।अग्निं होतारमीळते यज्ञेषु मनुषो विशः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vedháḥ-tamaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀagním ǀ hótāram ǀ īḷate ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agniverily is most wise; he is the chief performer of religious rites, a holy sage; the progeny of men glorify Agni as the invoker of the gods at sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniverily is most wise; he is the chief performer of religious rites, a holy sage; the progeny of men glorify Agni as the invoker of the gods at sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नाना ह्यग्नेऽवसे स्पर्धंते रायो अर्यः ।तूर्वंतो दस्युमायवो व्रतैः सीक्षंतो अव्रतं ॥
verses.transliteration: nā́nā ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ ávase ǀ spárdhante ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀtū́rvantaḥ ǀ dásyum ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ vratáiḥ ǀ sī́kṣantaḥ ǀ avratám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The manifold treasures of the enemy (detached from them) are emulous,Agni, for the preservation (of your worshippers); men who worship you, triumphing over the spoiler, seek to shame him who celebrates no sacred rite by (their) observances.
verses.wilson_translation: The manifold treasures of the enemy (detached from them) are emulous,Agni, for the preservation (of your worshippers); men who worship you, triumphing over the spoiler, seek to shame him who celebrates no sacred rite by (their) observances.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरप्सामृतीषहं वीरं ददाति सत्पतिं ।यस्य त्रसंति शवसः संचक्षि शत्रवो भिया ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ apsā́m ǀ ṛti-sáham ǀ vīrám ǀ dadāti ǀ sát-patim ǀyásya ǀ trásanti ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ sam-cákṣi ǀ śátravaḥ ǀ bhiyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnibestows (upon his worshippers) amaledescendant, (the performer of good) works, the subduer of foes, the protector of the virtuous, at whose appearance his enemies tremble through fear of his prowess.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnibestows (upon his worshippers) amaledescendant, (the performer of good) works, the subduer of foes, the protector of the virtuous, at whose appearance his enemies tremble through fear of his prowess.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि विद्मना निदो देवो मर्तमुरुष्यति ।सहावा यस्यावृतो रयिर्वाजेष्ववृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hí ǀ vidmánā ǀ nidáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártam ǀ uruṣyáti ǀsahá-vā ǀ yásya ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty and divine Agni, endowed with knowledge, protects the mortal from reproach whose rich (offerings) are unobstructed (by evil spirits), and unshared by other (offerers) at sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty and divine Agni, endowed with knowledge, protects the mortal from reproach whose rich (offerings) are unobstructed (by evil spirits), and unshared by other (offerers) at sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा नो मित्रमहो देव देवानग्ने वोचः सुमतिं रोदस्योः ।वीहि स्वस्तिं सुक्षितिं दिवो नॄंद्विषो अंहांसि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ ágne ǀ vócaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀvīhí ǀ svastím ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ áṃhāṃsi ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǀ tā́ ǀ tarema ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ tarema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, revered as a friend, who, abiding in heaven and earth, communicates our praise to the gods, conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity, and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome them by your protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, revered as a friend, who, abiding in heaven and earth, communicates our praise to the gods, conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity, and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome them by your protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH this my song I strive to reach this guest of yours, who wakes at early morn, the Lord of all the tribes.Each time he comes from heaven, the Pure One from of old: from ancient days the Child cats everlasting food. Whom, well-dis sed, the Blirgus stablished as a rriend, whom men must glorify, high-flaming in the wood.As such, most friendly, thou art every day extolled in lauds by Vitahavya, O thou wondrous God. Be thou the foeless helper of the skilful man, subduer of the enemy near or far away.Bestow a wealthy home on men, O Son of Strength. Give Vitahavya riches spreading far and wide, give Bharadvāja wide-spread wealth. Him, your refulgent guest, Agni who comes from heaven, the Herald of mankind, well-skilled in sacred rites,Who, like a holy singer, utters heavenly words, oblation-bearer, envoy, God, I seek with hymns. Who with his purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn;Who speeding on, as in the fight of Etaia, cometh, untouched by age, as one athirst in heat. Worship ye Agni, Agni, with your log of wood; praise your beloved, your beloved guest with songs.Invite ye the Immortal hither with your hymns. A God among the Gods, he loveth what is choice, loveth our service, God mid Gods. Agni inflamed with fuel in my song I sing, pure, Cleanser, steadlast, set in tront at sacrifice.Wise Jātavedas we implore with prayers for bliss the Priest, the holy Singer, bounteous, void of guile. Men, Agni, in each age have made thee, Deathiess One, their envoy, offering-bearer, guard adorable.With reverence Gods and mortals have established thee, the ever-watchful, omnipresent Household Lord. Thou, Agni, ordering the works and ways of both, as envoy of the Gods traversest both the worlds.When we lay claim to thy regard and gracious fare, be thou to us a thriceprotecting friendly guard. Him fair of face, rapid, and fair to look on, him very wise may we who know not follow.Let him who knows all rules invite for worship, Agru announce our offering to the Immortals. Him, Agni, thou deliverest and savest who brings him prayer to thee the Wise, O Hero,The end of sacrifice or its inception; yea, thou endowest him with power and riches. Guard us from him who would assail us, Agni; preserve us, O thou Victor, from dishonour.Here let the place of darkening come upon thee: may wealth be ours, desirable in thousands. Agni, the Priest, is King, Lord of the homestead, he, Jatayedas, knows all generations.Most skilful worshipper mid Gods and mortals, may he begin the sacrifice, the Holy. Whate’er to-day thou, bright-flamed Priest, enjoyest from the man's rite-for thou art sacrificer-Worship, for duly dost thou spread in greatness: bear off thine ofrerings of to-day, Most Youthful. Look thou upon the viands duly laid for thee. Fain would he set thee here to worship Heaven and,Earth.Help us, O liberal Agni, in the strife for spoil, so that we may o’ercome all things that trouble us, o’ercome, o’ercome them with thy help. Together with all Gods, O fair-faced Agni, be seated first upon the woollined altar,Nest-like, bedewed with oil. Bear this our worship to Savitar who sacrifices rightly. Here the arranging priests, as did Atharvan, rub this Agni forth,Whom, not bewildered, as he moved in winding ways, they brought from gloom. For the Gods’ banquet be thou born, for full perfection and for weal.Bring the Immortal Gods who strengthen holy Law: so let our sacrifice reach the Gods. O Agni, Lord and Master of men's homesteads, with kindled fuel we have made thee mighty.Let not our household gear be found defective. Sharpen us with thy penetrating splendour.

verses.sanskrit: इममू षु वो अतिथिमुषर्बुधं विश्वासां विशां पतिमृंजसे गिरा ।वेतीद्दिवो जनुषा कच्चिदा शुचिर्ज्योक्चिदत्ति गर्भो यदच्युतं ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ uṣaḥ-búdham ǀ víśvāsām ǀ viśā́m ǀ pátim ǀ ṛñjase ǀ girā́ ǀvéti ǀ ít ǀ diváḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ jyók ǀ cit ǀ atti ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ácyutam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Propitiate by praises this guest who wakes at dawn, the cherisher of all people, who on every occasion descends, pure of origin, from heaven, and, present as the embryo (in the wood of attrition), consumes immediately the offered (oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: Propitiate by praises this guest who wakes at dawn, the cherisher of all people, who on every occasion descends, pure of origin, from heaven, and, present as the embryo (in the wood of attrition), consumes immediately the offered (oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रं न यं सुधितं भृगवो दधुर्वनस्पतावीड्यमूर्ध्वशोचिषं ।स त्वं सुप्रीतो वीतहव्ये अद्भुत प्रशस्तिभिर्महयसे दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrám ǀ ná ǀ yám ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ vánaspátau ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ ūrdhvá-śociṣam ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ sú-prītaḥ ǀ vītá-havye ǀ adbhuta ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ mahayase ǀ divé-dive ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wonderful Agni, whom, adorable and upward flaming, thebhṛgusregard as a friend, deposited in the wood of (attrition), be plural ased withvītahavya, since you are glorified by (his) praise everyday.
verses.wilson_translation: Wonderful Agni, whom, adorable and upward flaming, thebhṛgusregard as a friend, deposited in the wood of (attrition), be plural ased withvītahavya, since you are glorified by (his) praise everyday.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं दक्षस्यावृको वृधो भूरर्यः परस्यांतरस्य तरुषः ।रायः सूनो सहसो मर्त्येष्वा छर्दिर्यच्छ वीतहव्याय सप्रथो भरद्वाजाय सप्रथः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ dákṣasya ǀ avṛkáḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ párasya ǀ ántarasya ǀ táruṣaḥ ǀrāyáḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ chardíḥ ǀ yaccha ǀ vītá-havyāya ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ bharát-vājāya ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, who are unresisted, become the benefactor of him who is skilled (in sacred rites), his defender against a near of distant enemy; son of strength, who are ever renowned, grant wealth and a dwelling tovītahavya, the offerer of the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, who are unresisted, become the benefactor of him who is skilled (in sacred rites), his defender against a near of distant enemy; son of strength, who are ever renowned, grant wealth and a dwelling tovītahavya, the offerer of the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्युतानं वो अतिथिं स्वर्णरमग्निं होतारं मनुषः स्वध्वरं ।विप्रं न द्युक्षवचसं सुवृक्तिभिर्हव्यवाहमरतिं देवमृंजसे ॥
verses.transliteration: dyutānám ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ sváḥ-naram ǀ agním ǀ hótāram ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ su-adhvarám ǀvípram ǀ ná ǀ dyukṣá-vacasam ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ aratím ǀ devám ǀ ṛñjase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Propitiate with pious praises the radiant Agni, your guest, the guide to heaven, the invoker of the gods( at the sacrifice) ofmanu, the celebrator of holy rites, the speaker of brilliant words like a learned sage, the bearer of oblations (to the gods), the lord, the divine.
verses.wilson_translation: Propitiate with pious praises the radiant Agni, your guest, the guide to heaven, the invoker of the gods( at the sacrifice) ofmanu, the celebrator of holy rites, the speaker of brilliant words like a learned sage, the bearer of oblations (to the gods), the lord, the divine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पावकया यश्चितयंत्या कृपा क्षामन्रुरुच उषसो न भानुना ।तूर्वन्न यामन्नेतशस्य नू रण आ यो घृणे न ततृषाणो अजरः ॥
verses.transliteration: pāvakáyā ǀ yáḥ ǀ citáyantyā ǀ kṛpā́ ǀ kṣā́man ǀ rurucé ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhānúnā ǀtū́rvan ǀ ná ǀ yā́man ǀ étaśasya ǀ nú ǀ ráṇe ǀ ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ghṛṇé ǀ ná ǀ tatṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Propitiate him) who shines upon the earth with purifying and enlightening lustre, as the dawns with ligt; him, who like (a warrior) discomfiting (his foes) quickly blazed forth in the contest in defence ofetaśa; him, who is satiated (with food), exempt from decay.
verses.wilson_translation: (Propitiate him) who shines upon the earth with purifying and enlightening lustre, as the dawns with ligt; him, who like (a warrior) discomfiting (his foes) quickly blazed forth in the contest in defence ofetaśa; him, who is satiated (with food), exempt from decay.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमग्निं वः समिधा दुवस्यत प्रियंप्रियं वो अतिथिं गृणीषणि ।उप वो गीर्भिरमृतं विवासत देवो देवेषु वनते हि वार्यं देवो देवेषु वनते हि नो दुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: agním-agnim ǀ vaḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ duvasyata ǀ priyám-priyam ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ gṛṇīṣáṇi ǀúpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ vivāsata ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ vánate ǀ hí ǀ vā́ryam ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ vánate ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worship repeatedly the adorable Agniwith fuel (him) who is ever your dear friend, your guest; approach the immortal Agni with praises, for he, a god among gods, accepts our homage.
verses.wilson_translation: Worship repeatedly the adorable Agniwith fuel (him) who is ever your dear friend, your guest; approach the immortal Agni with praises, for he, a god among gods, accepts our homage.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समिद्धमग्निं समिधा गिरा गृणे शुचिं पावकं पुरो अध्वरे ध्रुवं ।विप्रं होतारं पुरुवारमद्रुहं कविं सुम्नैरीमहे जातवेदसं ॥
verses.transliteration: sám-iddham ǀ agním ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ girā́ ǀ gṛṇe ǀ śúcim ǀ pāvakám ǀ puráḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ dhruvám ǀvípram ǀ hótāram ǀ puru-vā́ram ǀ adrúham ǀ kavím ǀ sumnáiḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ jātá-vedasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify with praise the kindled Agni, pure purifying, permanent, (plural ced) before (us) at the sacrifice; let us celebrate with plural asant (hymns) the wise Agni, the invoker of the gods, the adored of many, the benevolent, the far-seeing, him who knows all that exists.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify with praise the kindled Agni, pure purifying, permanent, (plural ced) before (us) at the sacrifice; let us celebrate with plural asant (hymns) the wise Agni, the invoker of the gods, the adored of many, the benevolent, the far-seeing, him who knows all that exists.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां दूतमग्ने अमृतं युगेयुगे हव्यवाहं दधिरे पायुमीड्यं ।देवासश्च मर्तासश्च जागृविं विभुं विश्पतिं नमसा नि षेदिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ dūtám ǀ agne ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ yugé-yuge ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ dadhire ǀ pāyúm ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ ca ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ jā́gṛvim ǀ vi-bhúm ǀ viśpátim ǀ námasā ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, have gods and men in every age retained as their messenger, immortal bearer of oblations, beneficent, adorable; they have plural ced him with reverence (upon the altar), vigilant, pervading, the protector of mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, have gods and men in every age retained as their messenger, immortal bearer of oblations, beneficent, adorable; they have plural ced him with reverence (upon the altar), vigilant, pervading, the protector of mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विभूषन्नग्न उभयाँ अनु व्रता दूतो देवानां रजसी समीयसे ।यत्ते धीतिं सुमतिमावृणीमहेऽध स्मा नस्त्रिवरूथः शिवो भव ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-bhū́ṣan ǀ agne ǀ ubháyān ǀ ánu ǀ vratā́ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ rájasī íti ǀ sám ǀ īyase ǀyát ǀ te ǀ dhītím ǀ su-matím ǀ ā-vṛṇīmáhe ǀ ádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ tri-várūthaḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showing grace,Agni, to both (gods and men), and at each sacred rite the messenger of the gods, you traverse earth and heaven; inasmuch as we offer you worship and praise, therefore do you, who are the guardian of the three (regions), be auspicious to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Showing grace,Agni, to both (gods and men), and at each sacred rite the messenger of the gods, you traverse earth and heaven; inasmuch as we offer you worship and praise, therefore do you, who are the guardian of the three (regions), be auspicious to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं सुप्रतीकं सुदृशं स्वंचमविद्वांसो विदुष्टरं सपेम ।स यक्षद्विश्वा वयुनानि विद्वान्प्र हव्यमग्निरमृतेषु वोचत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ su-prátīkam ǀ su-dṛ́śam ǀ su-áñcam ǀ ávidvāṃsaḥ ǀ vidúḥ-taram ǀ sapema ǀsáḥ ǀ yakṣat ǀ víśvā ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ prá ǀ havyám ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ vocat ǁ
verses.english_translation: We of little wisdom adore the most wise Agni, the well-formed, the well-looking the graceful-moving; may Agni, who knows all things that are to be known offer the sacrifice; may he announce the oblation to the immortals.
verses.wilson_translation: We of little wisdom adore the most wise Agni, the well-formed, the well-looking the graceful-moving; may Agni, who knows all things that are to be known offer the sacrifice; may he announce the oblation to the immortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमग्ने पास्युत तं पिपर्षि यस्त आनट्कवये शूर धीतिं ।यज्ञस्य वा निशितिं वोदितिं वा तमित्पृणक्षि शवसोत राया ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ agne ǀ pāsi ǀ utá ǀ tám ǀ piparṣi ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ kaváye ǀ śūra ǀ dhītím ǀyajñásya ǀ vā ǀ ní-śitim ǀ vā ǀ út-itim ǀ vā ǀ tám ǀ ít ǀ pṛṇakṣi ǀ śávasā ǀ utá ǀ rāyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You cherish, you protect,Agni, that may who offers worship, hero, to you, the far-seeing; you reward with strength and with riches him (who undertakes) the instrumental tution, (who effects) the accomplishments of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: You cherish, you protect,Agni, that may who offers worship, hero, to you, the far-seeing; you reward with strength and with riches him (who undertakes) the instrumental tution, (who effects) the accomplishments of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वनुष्यतो नि पाहि त्वमु नः सहसावन्नवद्यात् ।सं त्वा ध्वस्मन्वदभ्येतु पाथः सं रयिः स्पृहयाय्यः सहस्री ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ tvám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasā-van ǀ avadyā́t ǀsám ǀ tvā ǀ dhvasman-vát ǀ abhí ǀ etu ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ sám ǀ rayíḥ ǀ spṛhayā́yyaḥ ǀ sahasrī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect us,Agni, from the malignant, preserve us, mighty one, from wickedness; may the offering come to you free from defects; may desirable riches, by your sands, (reach us).
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us,Agni, from the malignant, preserve us, mighty one, from wickedness; may the offering come to you free from defects; may desirable riches, by your sands, (reach us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता गृहपतिः स राजा विश्वा वेद जनिमा जातवेदाः ।देवानामुत यो मर्त्यानां यजिष्ठः स प्र यजतामृतावा ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ víśvā ǀ veda ǀ jánima ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀdevā́nām ǀ utá ǀ yáḥ ǀ mártyānām ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ yajatām ǀ ṛtá-vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, is the invoker of the gods, the lord of the house, the ruler, who knows all that is, knows all existing beings; he is the mos assiduous worshipper among gods or men; let him who is observant of truth offer worship.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, is the invoker of the gods, the lord of the house, the ruler, who knows all that is, knows all existing beings; he is the mos assiduous worshipper among gods or men; let him who is observant of truth offer worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने यदद्य विशो अध्वरस्य होतः पावकशोचे वेष्ट्वं हि यज्वा ।ऋता यजासि महिना वि यद्भूर्हव्या वह यविष्ठ या ते अद्य ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yát ǀ adyá ǀ viśáḥ ǀ adhvarasya ǀ hotaríti ǀ pā́vaka-śoce ǀ véḥ ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ yájvā ǀṛtā́ ǀ yajāsi ǀ mahinā́ ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ bhū́ḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ vaha ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ adyá ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, minister of the sacrifice, bright wiht purifying lustre, approve of that (worship) which is this day celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite; you verily are the sacrificer, therefore address the worship (to the gods); and since by your greatness you are all-pervading, therefore, youngest (of the gods), accept the oblations which are today (presented) to you.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, minister of the sacrifice, bright wiht purifying lustre, approve of that (worship) which is this day celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite; you verily are the sacrificer, therefore address the worship (to the gods); and since by your greatness you are all-pervading, therefore, youngest (of the gods), accept the oblations which are today (presented) to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि हि ख्यो नि त्वा दधीत रोदसी यजध्यै ।अवा नो मघवन्वाजसातावग्ने विश्वानि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ sú-dhitāni ǀ hí ǀ khyáḥ ǀ ní ǀ tvā ǀ dadhīta ǀ ródasī íti ǀ yájadhyai ǀáva ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ ágne ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǀ tā́ ǀ tarema ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ tarema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Look,Agni, upon the (sacrificial) viands duly deposited (upon the altar); heaven and earth detain you to sacrifice (to the gods); opulent Agni, protect us in battle, whereby we may pass safe over all evils; may we pass over those of a prior existence; may we pass over them by your protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Look,Agni, upon the (sacrificial) viands duly deposited (upon the altar); heaven and earth detain you to sacrifice (to the gods); opulent Agni, protect us in battle, whereby we may pass safe over all evils; may we pass over those of a prior existence; may we pass over them by your protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने विश्वेभिः स्वनीक देवैरूर्णावंतं प्रथमः सीद योनिं ।कुलायिनं घृतवंतं सवित्रे यज्ञं नय यजमानाय साधु ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ su-anīka ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ū́rṇā-vantam ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ sīda ǀ yónim ǀkulāyínam ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ savitré ǀ yajñám ǀ naya ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sādhú ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bright-rayed Agni, sit down first with all the gods, upon the altar lined withwool, a nest (of perfumes) and suffused withghee, and rightly convey (to the deities) the sacrifice of the instrumental tutor of the rite, of the presenter of the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Bright-rayed Agni, sit down first with all the gods, upon the altar lined withwool, a nest (of perfumes) and suffused withghee, and rightly convey (to the deities) the sacrifice of the instrumental tutor of the rite, of the presenter of the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इममु त्यमथर्ववदग्निं मंथंति वेधसः ।यमंकूयंतमानयन्नमूरं श्याव्याभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ atharva-vát ǀ agním ǀ manthanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀyám ǀ aṅku-yántam ǀ ā́ ǀ ánayan ǀ ámūram ǀ śyāvyā́bhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests churn you,Agni, as was done byatharvan, and bring him from the glooms of night wandering deviously, but not bewildered.
verses.wilson_translation: The priests churn you,Agni, as was done byatharvan, and bring him from the glooms of night wandering deviously, but not bewildered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जनिष्वा देववीतये सर्वताता स्वस्तये ।आ देवान्वक्ष्यमृताँ ऋतावृधो यज्ञं देवेषु पिस्पृशः ॥
verses.transliteration: jániṣva ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ svastáye ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ vakṣi ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ devéṣu ǀ pispṛśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be born,Agni, at the sacrifice, for the welfare of the offerer (of oblation) to the gods; bring hither the immortal deities, the augmenters of the (sacred) rite present our sacrifice to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Be born,Agni, at the sacrifice, for the welfare of the offerer (of oblation) to the gods; bring hither the immortal deities, the augmenters of the (sacred) rite present our sacrifice to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा गृहपते जनानामग्ने अकर्म समिधा बृहंतं ।अस्थूरि नो गार्हपत्यानि संतु तिग्मेन नस्तेजसा सं शिशाधि ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ gṛha-pate ǀ janānām ǀ ágne ǀ ákarma ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ bṛhántam ǀasthūrí ǀ naḥ ǀ gā́rha-patyāni ǀ santu ǀ tigména ǀ naḥ ǀ téjasā ǀ sám ǀ śiśādhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of the house,Agni, we, among men, promote your increase bysomaor fuel; may our domestic fires be supplied with all that is essential; enliven us with brilliant radiance.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of the house,Agni, we, among men, promote your increase bysomaor fuel; may our domestic fires be supplied with all that is essential; enliven us with brilliant radiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVI. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ४८ बार्हस्पत्यो भरद्वाज: । अग्नि :।गायत्री; १, ६ वर्धमाना;२७, ४७ – ४८ अनुष्टुप् ; ४६ त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . PRIEST of all sacrifices hast thou been appointed by the Gods,Agni, amid the race of man. So with thy joyous tongues for us sacrifice nobly in this rite.Bring thou the Gods and worship them. For well, O God, Disposer, thou knowest, straight on, the paths and ways,Agni, most wise in sacrifice. Thee, too, hath Bhārata of old, with mighty men, implored for bliss.And worshipped thee the worshipful. Thou givest these abundant boons to Divodāsa pouring forth,To Bharadvāja offering gifts. Do thou, Immortal Messenger, bring hither the Celestial Folk;Hearing the singer's eulogy. Mortals with pious thought implore thee, Agni, God, at holy rites,To come unto the feast of Gods. I glorify thine aspect and the might of thee the Bountilul.All those who love shall joy in thee, Invoker placed by Manus, thou, Agni, art near, the wisest Priest:Pay worship to the Tribes of Heaven. Come, Agni, lauded, to the feast; come to the offering of the gifts.As Priest be seated on the grass. So, Aṅgiras, we make thee strong with fuel and with holy oil.Blaze high, thou youngest of the Gods. For us thou winnest, Agni, God, heroic strength exceeding great,Far-spreading and of high renown. Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth, by rubbing, from the lotus-flower,The head of Visva, of the Priest. Thee. Vṛtra's slayer, breaker down of castles, hath Atharvan's son,Dadhyac the Ṛṣi, lighted up. The hero Pathya kindled thee the Dasyus'. most destructive foe,Winner of spoil in every fight. Come, here, O Agni, will I sing verily other songs to thee,And with these drops shalt thou grow strong. Where’er thy mind applies itself, vigour preeminent hast thou:There wilt thou gain a dwelling-place. Not for a moment only lasts thy bounty, good to many a one!Our service therefore shalt thou gain. Agni, the Bhārata, hath been sought, the Vṛtra-slayer, marked of all,Yea, Divodāsa's Hero Lord. For he gave riches that surpass in greatness all the things of earth,Fighting untroubled, unsubdued. Thou, Agni, as in days of old, with recent glory, gathered light,Hast overspread the lofty heaven. Bring to your Agni, O my friends, boldly your laud and sacrifice:Give the Disposer praise and song. For as sagacious Herald he hath sat through every age of man,Oblation-bearing messenger. Bring those Two Kings whose ways are pure, Ādityas, and the Marut host,Excellent God! and Heaven and Earth. For strong and active mortal man, excellent, Agni, is the look Of thee Immortal, Son of Strength Rich through his wisdom, noblest be the giver serving thee to-day:The man hath brought his hymn of praise. These, Agni, these are helped by thee, who strong and active all their lives,O'ercome the malice of the foe, fight down the malice ofthe foe. May Agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiendMay Agni win us wealth by war. O active Jātavedas, bring riches with store of hero sons:Slay thou the demons, O Most Wise. Keep us, O Jātavedas, from the troubling of the man of sin:Guard us thou Sage who knowest prayer. Whatever sinner, Agni, brings oblations to procure our death,Save us from woe that he would work. Drive from us with thy tongue, O God, the man who doeth evil deeds,The mortal who would strike us dead. Give shelter reaching far and wide to Bharadvāja, conquering Lord!Agni, send wealth most excellent. May Agni slay the Vṛtras,—fain for riches, through the lord of song,Served with oblation, kindled, bright. His Father's Father, shining in his Mother's everlasting side,Set on the seat of holy Law. O active Jātavedas, bring devotion that wins progeny, Agni, that it may shine to heaven. O Child of Strength, to thee whose look is lovely we with dainty food,O Agni, have poured forth our songs. To thee for shelter are we come, as to the shade from fervent heatAgni, who glitterest like gold. Mighty as one who slays with shafts, or like a bull with sharpened horn,Agni, thou breakest down the forts. Whom, like an infant newly born, devourer, in their arms they bear,Men's Agni, skilled in holy rites. Bear to the banquet of the Gods the God best finder-out of wealth,Let him he seated in his place. In Jātavedas kindle ye the dear guest who hath now appearedIn a soft place, the homestead's Lord. Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent:They bear thee as thy spirit wills. Come hither, bring the Gods to us to taste the sacrificial feast,To drink the draught of Soma juice. O Agni of the Bharatas, blaze high with everlasting might,Shine forth and gleam, Eternal One. The mortal man who serves the God with banquet, and, bringing gifts at sacrifice, lauds Agni,May well attract, with prayer and hands uplifted, the Priest of Heaven and Earth, true Sacrificer. Agni, we bring thee, with our hymn, oblation fashioned in the heart.Let these be oxen unto thee, let these be bulls and kine to thee. The Gods enkindle Agni, best slayer of Vṛtra, first in rank,The Mighty, One who brings us wealth and crushes down the Rākṣasas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानां होता विश्वेषां हितः ।देवेभिर्मानुषे जने ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ hótā ǀ víśveṣām ǀ hitáḥ ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, have been appointed by the gods, the ministrant fo men, the descendants ofmanu, at all sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, have been appointed by the gods, the ministrant fo men, the descendants ofmanu, at all sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो मंद्राभिरध्वरे जिह्वाभिर्यजा महः ।आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mandrā́bhiḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ jihvā́bhiḥ ǀ yaja ǀ maháḥ ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ vakṣi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Therefore do you at our sacrifice offer oblations to the great deities with exhilarating flames; bring hither the gods; offer them worship.
verses.wilson_translation: Therefore do you at our sacrifice offer oblations to the great deities with exhilarating flames; bring hither the gods; offer them worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वेत्था हि वेधो अध्वनः पथश्च देवांजसा ।अग्ने यज्ञेषु सुक्रतो ॥
verses.transliteration: véttha ǀ hí ǀ vedhaḥ ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ ca ǀ deva ǀ áñjasā ǀágne ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, doere of great deeds, creator, you know (how to travel over) with speed (great) roads and (little) paths at sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, doere of great deeds, creator, you know (how to travel over) with speed (great) roads and (little) paths at sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामीळे अध द्विता भरतो वाजिभिः शुनं ।ईजे यज्ञेषु यज्ञियं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ īḷe ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǀ bharatáḥ ǀ vājí-bhiḥ ǀ śunám ǀījé ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ yajñíyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bharata, with the presenters of the oblation, has joyfully praised you in your (two-fold capacity), and has worshipped you, the adorable, with sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Bharata, with the presenters of the oblation, has joyfully praised you in your (two-fold capacity), and has worshipped you, the adorable, with sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिमा वार्या पुरु दिवोदासाय सुन्वते ।भरद्वाजाय दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ imā́ ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ sunvaté ǀbharát-vājāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: As you have conferred these many blessings upon Divodāsawhen presenting libations, (so now grant them) to the (actual) offerer,Bharadvāja.
verses.wilson_translation: As you have conferred these many blessings upon Divodāsawhen presenting libations, (so now grant them) to the (actual) offerer,Bharadvāja.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं दूतो अमर्त्य आ वहा दैव्यं जनं ।शृण्वन्विप्रस्य सुष्टुतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀśṛṇván ǀ víprasya ǀ su-stutím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hearing the adoration of the sage, do you, who are the immortal messenger, bring hither the celestial people.
verses.wilson_translation: Hearing the adoration of the sage, do you, who are the immortal messenger, bring hither the celestial people.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने स्वाध्यो मर्तासो देववीतये ।यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀyajñéṣu ǀ devám ǀ īḷate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pious mortals invoke you, divine Agni, at sacrifices, to convey their (sacrificial) food to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Pious mortals invoke you, divine Agni, at sacrifices, to convey their (sacrificial) food to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव प्र यक्षि संदृशमुत क्रतुं सुदानवः ।विश्वे जुषंत कामिनः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ prá ǀ yakṣi ǀ sam-dṛ́śam ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀvíśve ǀ juṣanta ǀ kāmínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify your splendour and the acts of you the liberal giver all who, (through your favour) enjoy their desires, glorify you.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify your splendour and the acts of you the liberal giver all who, (through your favour) enjoy their desires, glorify you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं होता मनुर्हितो वह्निरासा विदुष्टरः ।अग्ने यक्षि दिवो विशः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀágne ǀ yákṣi ǀ diváḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have been appointed bymanu, the invoker of the gods, the most wise bearer of oblations (to them) by your mouth; worship,Agni, the people of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: You have been appointed bymanu, the invoker of the gods, the most wise bearer of oblations (to them) by your mouth; worship,Agni, the people of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये ।नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ vītáye ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀní ǀ hótā ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Agni, to the (sacrificial) fod; being lauded, (come) to convey the oblation (to the gods); sit down as the ministrant priest upon the sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Agni, to the (sacrificial) fod; being lauded, (come) to convey the oblation (to the gods); sit down as the ministrant priest upon the sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा समिद्भिरंगिरो घृतेन वर्धयामसि ।बृहच्छोचा यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ samít-bhiḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀ vardhayāmasi ǀbṛhát ǀ śoca ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
verses.english_translation: We augment you,Aṅgiras, with fuel and with butter; blaze fiercely, youngest (of the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: We augment you,Aṅgiras, with fuel and with butter; blaze fiercely, youngest (of the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पृथु श्रवाय्यमच्छा देव विवाससि ।बृहदग्ने सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛthú ǀ śravā́yyam ǀ áccha ǀ deva ǀ vivāsasi ǀbṛhát ǀ agne ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, bestow upon us (wealth), excellent, great and (comprehending) worthymaledescendants.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, bestow upon us (wealth), excellent, great and (comprehending) worthymaledescendants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमंथत ।मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ púṣkarāt ǀ ádhi ǀ átharvā ǀ níḥ ǀ amanthata ǀmūrdhnáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ vāghátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage,Atharvan, extracted you from upon the lotus-leaf, the head, the support of the universe.
verses.wilson_translation: The sage,Atharvan, extracted you from upon the lotus-leaf, the head, the support of the universe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु त्वा दध्यङ्ङृषिः पुत्र ईधे अथर्वणः ।वृत्रहणं पुरंदरं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ dadhyáṅ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ īdhe ǀ átharvaṇaḥ ǀvṛtra-hánam ǀ puram-darám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ṛṣi, Dadhyañc, the son of Atharvan, kindled the slayer of Vṛtra, the destroyer of the cities of Asuras.
verses.wilson_translation: The ṛṣi, Dadhyañc, the son of Atharvan, kindled the slayer of Vṛtra, the destroyer of the cities of Asuras.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु त्वा पाथ्यो वृषा समीधे दस्युहंतमं ।धनंजयं रणेरणे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ pāthyáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sám ǀ īdhe ǀ dasyuhán-tamam ǀdhanam-jayám ǀ ráṇe-raṇe ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The ṛṣi)Pāthya, the showerer, kindled you the destroyer of the Dasyu, the winner of spoil in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: (The ṛṣi)Pāthya, the showerer, kindled you the destroyer of the Dasyu, the winner of spoil in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः ।एभिर्वर्धास इंदुभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ brávāṇi ǀ te ǀ ágne ǀ itthā́ ǀ ítarāḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀebhíḥ ǀ vardhāse ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Agni, that I may address to you other praises in this manner; augment with these libations.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Agni, that I may address to you other praises in this manner; augment with these libations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्र क्व च ते मनो दक्षं दधस उत्तरं ।तत्रा सदः कृणवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ kvá ǀ ca ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ dadhase ǀ út-taram ǀtátra ǀ sádaḥ ǀ kṛṇavase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wheresoever, and upon whatsoever your mind is directed, you bestow uncommon vigour, and there you make your abode.
verses.wilson_translation: Wheresoever, and upon whatsoever your mind is directed, you bestow uncommon vigour, and there you make your abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि ते पूर्तमक्षिपद्भुवन्नेमानां वसो ।अथा दुवो वनवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ te ǀ pūrtám ǀ akṣi-pát ǀ bhúvat ǀ nemānām ǀ vaso íti ǀátha ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ vanavase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not your full (blaze) be distressing to the eye, giver of dwellings to your humble votaries, and therefore accept our worship.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not your full (blaze) be distressing to the eye, giver of dwellings to your humble votaries, and therefore accept our worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आग्निरगामि भारतो वृत्रहा पुरुचेतनः ।दिवोदासस्य सत्पतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ agāmi ǀ bhā́rataḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ puru-cétanaḥ ǀdívaḥ-dāsasya ǀ sát-patiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the bearer, (of oblations), the destroyer of the enemies of Divopāsa, the cognizant of many, the protector of the good, has been brought hither (by our praises).
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the bearer, (of oblations), the destroyer of the enemies of Divopāsa, the cognizant of many, the protector of the good, has been brought hither (by our praises).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि विश्वाति पार्थिवा रयिं दाशन्महित्वना ।वन्वन्नवातो अस्तृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ víśvā ǀ áti ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ rayím ǀ dā́śat ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǀvanván ǀ ávātaḥ ǀ ástṛtaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Surpassing all earthly things, may he bestow upon us riches, destroying his enemies by his greatness, unresisted, unassailed.
verses.wilson_translation: Surpassing all earthly things, may he bestow upon us riches, destroying his enemies by his greatness, unresisted, unassailed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स प्रत्नवन्नवीयसाग्ने द्युम्नेन संयता ।बृहत्ततंथ भानुना ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pratna-vát ǀ návīyasā ǀ ágne ǀ dyumnéna ǀ sam-yátā ǀbṛhát ǀ tatantha ǀ bhānúnā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, have overspread,Agni, this vast (firmament) with radiant concentrated lustre, recent like that of old.
verses.wilson_translation: You, have overspread,Agni, this vast (firmament) with radiant concentrated lustre, recent like that of old.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वः सखायो अग्नये स्तोमं यज्ञं च धृष्णुया ।अर्च गाय च वेधसे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ stómam ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀárca ǀ gā́ya ǀ ca ǀ vedháse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing praise and offer sacrifice, my friends, to the foe-discomfiting, the creator,Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing praise and offer sacrifice, my friends, to the foe-discomfiting, the creator,Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि यो मानुषा युगा सीदद्धोता कविक्रतुः ।दूतश्च हव्यवाहनः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ sī́dat ǀ hótā ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǀdūtáḥ ǀ ca ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that Agniindeed sit down (at our sacrifice), who in every age of man has been the invoker of the gods, doer of wise deeds, the messenger of the gods, the bearer of oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: May that Agniindeed sit down (at our sacrifice), who in every age of man has been the invoker of the gods, doer of wise deeds, the messenger of the gods, the bearer of oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता राजाना शुचिव्रतादित्यान्मारुतं गणं ।वसो यक्षीह रोदसी ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ rā́jānā ǀ śúci-vratā ǀ ādityā́n ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǀváso íti ǀ yákṣi ǀ ihá ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Giver of dwellings, worship on this occasion, the two regal divinities,Mitraand Varuṇa, whose acts are holy, theĀdityas, the company of the Maruts, and heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Giver of dwellings, worship on this occasion, the two regal divinities,Mitraand Varuṇa, whose acts are holy, theĀdityas, the company of the Maruts, and heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वस्वी ते अग्ने संदृष्टिरिषयते मर्त्याय ।ऊर्जो नपादमृतस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: vásvī ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sám-dṛṣṭiḥ ǀ iṣa-yaté ǀ mártyāya ǀū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ amṛ́tasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength,Agni, the glorious radiance of you who are immortal, bestows food upon (your) mortal worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength,Agni, the glorious radiance of you who are immortal, bestows food upon (your) mortal worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रत्वा दा अस्तु श्रेष्ठोऽद्य त्वा वन्वन्त्सुरेक्णाः ।मर्त आनाश सुवृक्तिं ॥
verses.transliteration: krátvā ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ tvā ǀ vanván ǀ su-rékṇāḥ ǀmártaḥ ǀ ānāśa ǀ su-vṛktím ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the donor (of the oblation), propitiating you by his acts today, be exalted, and (rendered) very opulent; may (such) mortal be diligent in (your) praise.
verses.wilson_translation: May the donor (of the oblation), propitiating you by his acts today, be exalted, and (rendered) very opulent; may (such) mortal be diligent in (your) praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते ते अग्ने त्वोता इषयंतो विश्वमायुः ।तरंतो अर्यो अरातीर्वन्वंतो अर्यो अरातीः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǀ iṣáyantaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀtárantaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātīḥ ǀ vanvántaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those,Agni, who are protected by you, wishing for the whole (term of) life (obtain it), overcoming hostile assailants, destroying hostile assailants.
verses.wilson_translation: Those,Agni, who are protected by you, wishing for the whole (term of) life (obtain it), overcoming hostile assailants, destroying hostile assailants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यासद्विश्वं न्यत्रिणं ।अग्निर्नो वनते रयिं ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ tigména ǀ śocíṣā ǀ yā́sat ǀ víśvam ǀ ní ǀ atríṇam ǀagníḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vanate ǀ rayím ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, with his sharp flame, demolish the devourer (of the oblation); may Agni grant us riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, with his sharp flame, demolish the devourer (of the oblation); may Agni grant us riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुवीरं रयिमा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे ।जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो ॥
verses.transliteration: su-vī́ram ǀ rayím ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇe ǀjahí ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
verses.english_translation: Jātavedas, all-beholdeer, bring us wealth with good posterity; doer of good deeds, destroy therākṣasas.
verses.wilson_translation: Jātavedas, all-beholdeer, bring us wealth with good posterity; doer of good deeds, destroy therākṣasas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नः पाह्यंहसो जातवेदो अघायतः ।रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्कवे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀrákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ kave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Preserve us,Jātavedas, from sin; enunciator of prayer, protect us from the malevolent.
verses.wilson_translation: Preserve us,Jātavedas, from sin; enunciator of prayer, protect us from the malevolent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो नो अग्ने दुरेव आ मर्तो वधाय दाशति ।तस्मान्नः पाह्यंहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ duḥ-évaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ vadhā́ya ǀ dā́śati ǀtásmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The malevolent mortal who threatens us with murderous weapon; defend us from him, and also from sin.
verses.wilson_translation: The malevolent mortal who threatens us with murderous weapon; defend us from him, and also from sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तं देव जिह्वया परि बाधस्व दुष्कृतं ।मर्तो यो नो जिघांसति ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ deva ǀ jihváyā ǀ pári ǀ bādhasva ǀ duḥ-kṛ́tam ǀmártaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ jíghāṃsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Scatter, divine Agni, by your flame, that evil-doer, the man who seeks to kill us.
verses.wilson_translation: Scatter, divine Agni, by your flame, that evil-doer, the man who seeks to kill us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाजाय सप्रथः शर्म यच्छ सहंत्य ।अग्ने वरेण्यं वसु ॥
verses.transliteration: bharát-vājāya ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀ sahantya ǀágne ǀ váreṇyam ǀ vásu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Subduer of foes, grant to Bharadvājainfinite happiness and desirable wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Subduer of foes, grant to Bharadvājainfinite happiness and desirable wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जंघनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया ।समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jaṅghanat ǀ draviṇasyúḥ ǀ vipanyáyā ǀsám-iddhaḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, propitiated by praise, desirous of (sacrificial) affluence, kindled, bright, and fed with burnt-offerings, destroy all adversaries.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, propitiated by praise, desirous of (sacrificial) affluence, kindled, bright, and fed with burnt-offerings, destroy all adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गर्भे मातुः पितुष्पिता विदिद्युतानो अक्षरे ।सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.transliteration: gárbhe ǀ mātúḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ vi-didyutānáḥ ǀ akṣáre ǀsī́dan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Radiant in the embryo of the maternal (earth), on the imperishable (altar); the cherisher of the paternal (heaven), sitting on the seat of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Radiant in the embryo of the maternal (earth), on the imperishable (altar); the cherisher of the paternal (heaven), sitting on the seat of sacrifice.
