verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म प्रजावदा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे ।अग्ने यद्दीदयद्दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhma ǀ prajā́-vat ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇe ǀágne ǀ yát ǀ dīdáyat ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to us,Jātavedas, all-beholder, food with progeny; such (food) as is brilliant in heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to us,Jātavedas, all-beholder, food with progeny; such (food) as is brilliant in heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा रण्वसंदृशं प्रयस्वंतः सहस्कृत ।अग्ने ससृज्महे गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ raṇvá-sandṛśam ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǀágne ǀ sasṛjmáhe ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Strength-begotten Agni, we, offering (sacrificial) food, address praises to you who are of plural asing aspect.
verses.wilson_translation: Strength-begotten Agni, we, offering (sacrificial) food, address praises to you who are of plural asing aspect.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप छायामिव घृणेरगन्म शर्म ते वयं ।अग्ने हिरण्यसंदृशः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ chāyā́m-iva ǀ ghṛ́ṇeḥ ǀ áganma ǀ śárma ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀágne ǀ híraṇya-sandṛśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have recourse,Agni, to the shelter of you, the lustrous, the golden-feathered, as to the shade (of a tree).
verses.wilson_translation: We have recourse,Agni, to the shelter of you, the lustrous, the golden-feathered, as to the shade (of a tree).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य उग्र इव शर्यहा तिग्मशृंगो न वंसगः ।अग्ने पुरो रुरोजिथ ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ugráḥ-iva ǀ śarya-hā́ ǀ tigmá-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ ná ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǀágne ǀ púraḥ ǀ rurójitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, who are like a fierce archer, or like a sharp-horned bull, have destroyed the cities (of theasuras).
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, who are like a fierce archer, or like a sharp-horned bull, have destroyed the cities (of theasuras).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यं हस्ते न खादिनं शिशुं जातं न बिभ्रति ।विशामग्निं स्वध्वरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yám ǀ háste ǀ ná ǀ khādínam ǀ śíśum ǀ jātám ǀ ná ǀ bíbhrati ǀviśā́m ǀ agním ǀ su-adhvarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Worship) that Agniwhom (the priests) bear in theirhandslike a new-born babe; the devourer (of the oblation), the (conveyer of the) holy sacrifices of men.
verses.wilson_translation: (Worship) that Agniwhom (the priests) bear in theirhandslike a new-born babe; the devourer (of the oblation), the (conveyer of the) holy sacrifices of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र देवं देववीतये भरता वसुवित्तमं ।आ स्वे योनौ नि षीदतु ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ devám ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ bhárata ǀ vasuvít-tamam ǀā́ ǀ své ǀ yónau ǀ ní ǀ sīdatu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Conduct the divine (Agni), the bestower of infinite wealth, to (receive charge of) the food of the gods; let him sit down on his appropriate seat.
verses.wilson_translation: Conduct the divine (Agni), the bestower of infinite wealth, to (receive charge of) the food of the gods; let him sit down on his appropriate seat.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ जातं जातवेदसि प्रियं शिशीतातिथिं ।स्योन आ गृहपतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jātám ǀ jātá-vedasi ǀ priyám ǀ śiśīta ǀ átithim ǀsyoné ǀ ā́ ǀ gṛhá-patim ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Welcome him) as soon as born, like a beloved guest, and plural ce the lord of the mansion upon the sacred (altar) whence wisdom is derived.
verses.wilson_translation: (Welcome him) as soon as born, like a beloved guest, and plural ce the lord of the mansion upon the sacred (altar) whence wisdom is derived.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने युक्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः ।अरं वहंति मन्यवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ yé ǀ táva ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ deva ǀ sādhávaḥ ǀáram ǀ váhanti ǀ manyáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Harness, divine Agni, your well-trained horses, who bear you quickly to the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Harness, divine Agni, your well-trained horses, who bear you quickly to the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा नो याह्या वहाभि प्रयांसि वीतये ।आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ vītáye ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Agni, to our presence, bring hither the gods to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Agni, to our presence, bring hither the gods to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदग्ने भारत द्युमदजस्रेण दविद्युतत् ।शोचा वि भाह्यजर ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ agne ǀ bhārata ǀ dyu-mát ǀ ájasreṇa ǀ dávidyutat ǀśóca ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀ ajara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Blaze up,Agni, bearer of oblations; shine, undecaying Agni, radiant with undecaying lustre.
verses.wilson_translation: Blaze up,Agni, bearer of oblations; shine, undecaying Agni, radiant with undecaying lustre.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वीती यो देवं मर्तो दुवस्येदग्निमीळीताध्वरे हविष्मान् ।होतारं सत्ययजं रोदस्योरुत्तानहस्तो नमसा विवासेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: vītī́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ devám ǀ mártaḥ ǀ duvasyét ǀ agním ǀ īḷīta ǀ adhvaré ǀ havíṣmān ǀhótāram ǀ satya-yájam ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ uttāná-hastaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāset ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever mortal, offering oblations, worships a deity with (sacrificial) food, let him at the ceremony also worship Agni, the invoker of heaven and earth, the sacrificer with truth; let him adore (Agni) with upliftedhands.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever mortal, offering oblations, worships a deity with (sacrificial) food, let him at the ceremony also worship Agni, the invoker of heaven and earth, the sacrificer with truth; let him adore (Agni) with upliftedhands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविर्हृदा तष्टं भरामसि ।ते ते भवंतूक्षण ऋषभासो वशा उत ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ havíḥ ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ taṣṭám ǀ bharāmasi ǀté ǀ te ǀ bhavantu ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ ṛṣabhā́saḥ ǀ vaśā́ḥ ǀ utá ǁ
verses.english_translation: We offer to you,Agni, the oblation sanctified by the heart, and (identified) with the sacred verse may the vigorous bulls and the cows be (as such an oblation) to you.
verses.wilson_translation: We offer to you,Agni, the oblation sanctified by the heart, and (identified) with the sacred verse may the vigorous bulls and the cows be (as such an oblation) to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं देवासो अग्रियमिंधते वृत्रहंतमं ।येना वसून्याभृता तृळ्हा रक्षांसि वाजिना ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ agriyám ǀ indháte ǀ vṛtrahán-tamam ǀyéna ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́-bhṛtā ǀ tṛḷhā́ ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ vājínā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods kindle Agnias the chief (of them); as the especial desroyer of Vṛtra; by whom the treasures (of theasuras) are carried off; by whom therākṣasasare destroyed.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods kindle Agnias the chief (of them); as the especial desroyer of Vṛtra; by whom the treasures (of theasuras) are carried off; by whom therākṣasasare destroyed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . DRINK Soma, Mighty One, for which, when lauded, thou breakest through the cattle-stall, O Indra;Thou who, O Bold One, armed with thunder smotest Vṛtra with might, and every hostile being. Drink it thou God who art impetuous victor, Lord of our hymns, with beauteousjaws, the Hero,Render of kine-stalls, car-borne, thunder-wielding, so pierce thy way to wondrous strength, O Indra. Drink as of old, and let the draught delight thee. hear thou our prayer and let our songs exalt thee.Make the Sun visible, make food abundant, slaughter the foes, pierce through and free the cattle. These gladdening drops, O Indra, Self-sustainer, quaffed shall augment thee in thy mighty splendour.Yea, let the cheering drops delight thee greatly, great, perfect, strong, powerful, all-subduing. Gladdened whereby, bursting the firm enclosures, thou gavest splendour to the Sun and Morning.The mighty rock that compassed in the cattle, ne’er moved, thou shookest from its seat, O Indra. Thou with thy wisdom, power, and works of wonder, hast stored the ripe milk in the raw cows' uddersUnbarred the firm doors for the kine of Morning, and, with the Aṅgirases, set free the cattle. Thou hast spread out wide earth, a mighty marvel, and, high thyself, propped lofty heaven, O Indra.Both worlds, whose Sons are Gods, thou hast supported, young, Mothers from old time ofholy Order. Yea, Indra, all the Deities installed thee their one strong Champion in the van for battle.What time the godless was the Gods’ assailant, Indra they chose to win the light of heaven. Yea, e’en that heaven itself of old bent backward before thy bolt, in terror of its anger,When Indra, life of every living creature, smote down within his lair the assailing Dragon. Yea, Strong One! Tvaṣṭar turned for thee, the Mighty, the bolt with thousand spikes and hundred edges,Eager and prompt at will, wherewith thou crushedst the boasting Dragon, O impetuous Hero. He dressed a hundred buffaloes, O Indra, for thee whom all accordant Maruts strengthen.He, Pūṣan Viṣṇu, poured forth three great vessels to him, the juice that cheers, that slaughters Vṛtra. Thou settest free the rushing wave of waters, the floods' great swell encompassed and obstructed.Along steep slopes their course thou tumedst, Indra, directed downward, speeding to the ocean. So may our new prayer bring thee to protect us, thee well-armed Hero with thy bolt of thunder,Indra, who made these worlds, the Strong, the ty, who never groweth old, the victory-giver. So, Indra, form us brilliant holy singers for strength, for glory, and for food and riches.Give Bharadvāja hero patrons, Indra Indra, be ours upon the day of trial. With this may we obtain strength God-appointed, and brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sanskrit: पिबा सोममभि यमुग्र तर्द ऊर्वं गव्यं महि गृणान इंद्र ।वि यो धृष्णो वधिषो वज्रहस्त विश्वा वृत्रममित्रिया शवोभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: píba ǀ sómam ǀ abhí ǀ yám ǀ ugra ǀ tárdaḥ ǀ ūrvám ǀ gávyam ǀ máhi ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ indra ǀví ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ vádhiṣaḥ ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ víśvā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ amitríyā ǀ śávaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fierce Indra, glorified by us, drink of the Soma, (animated) by which you have discovered the vast herd of cattle (stolen by Paṇis), and, overcomer of enemies, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have slain, by your strength all opposing foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Fierce Indra, glorified by us, drink of the Soma, (animated) by which you have discovered the vast herd of cattle (stolen by Paṇis), and, overcomer of enemies, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have slain, by your strength all opposing foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स ईं पाहि य ऋजीषी तरुत्रो यः शिप्रवान्वृषभो यो मतीनां ।यो गोत्रभिद्वज्रभृद्यो हरिष्ठाः ��� इंद्र चित्राँ अभि तृंधि वाजान् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ pāhi ǀ yáḥ ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀ tárutraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ śípra-vān ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ matīnā́m ǀyáḥ ǀ gotra-bhít ǀ vajra-bhṛ́t ǀ yáḥ ǀ hari-sthā́ḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ indra ǀ citrā́n ǀ abhí ǀ tṛndhi ǀ vā́jān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink it,Indra, you who enjoy the flavourless Soma; you who are the preserver, the handsome-chinned, the showerer (of benefits) on those who praise you; who are the breaker of mountains, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the curber of steeds, do you bestow upon us various food.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink it,Indra, you who enjoy the flavourless Soma; you who are the preserver, the handsome-chinned, the showerer (of benefits) on those who praise you; who are the breaker of mountains, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the curber of steeds, do you bestow upon us various food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा पाहि प्रत्नथा मंदतु त्वा श्रुधि ब्रह्म वावृधस्वोत गीर्भिः ।आविः सूर्यं कृणुहि पीपिहीषो जहि शत्रूँरभि गा इंद्र तृंधि ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ pāhi ǀ pratná-thā ǀ mándatu ǀ tvā ǀ śrudhí ǀ bráhma ǀ vavṛdhásva ǀ utá ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀāvíḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ pīpihí ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ jahí ǀ śátrūn ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ tṛndhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink it as of old, and may it exhilarate ou; hear our prayer, and be exalted by our praises; make the sun visible, nourish us with food, destroy our enemies, rescue the cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink it as of old, and may it exhilarate ou; hear our prayer, and be exalted by our praises; make the sun visible, nourish us with food, destroy our enemies, rescue the cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते त्वा मदा बृहदिंद्र स्वधाव इमे पीता उक्षयंत द्युमंतं ।महामनूनं तवसं विभूतिं मत्सरासो जर्हृषंत प्रसाहं ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ tvā ǀ mádāḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ indra ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ imé ǀ pītā́ḥ ǀ ukṣayanta ǀ dyu-mántam ǀmahā́m ǀ ánūnam ǀ tavásam ǀ ví-bhūtim ǀ matsarā́saḥ ǀ jarhṛṣanta ǀ pra-sáham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Abounding in food,Indra, let these exhilarating draughts copiously bedew you, the resplendent; let the inebriating juices delight you who are mighty, deficient in no (excellence), powerful, manifold, the overcomer of foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Abounding in food,Indra, let these exhilarating draughts copiously bedew you, the resplendent; let the inebriating juices delight you who are mighty, deficient in no (excellence), powerful, manifold, the overcomer of foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येभिः सूर्यमुषसं मंदसानोऽवासयोऽप दृळ्हानि दर्द्रत् ।महामद्रिं परि गा इंद्र संतं नुत्था अच्युतं सदसः परि स्वात् ॥
verses.transliteration: yébhiḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ uṣásam ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ ávāsayaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dṛḷhā́ni ǀ dárdrat ǀmahā́m ǀ ádrim ǀ pári ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ sántam ǀ nutthā́ḥ ǀ ácyutam ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ svā́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: By which (juices) being exhilarated you have appointed the sun and the dawn (to their offices), driving away the solid (glooms); you have penetrated,Indra, the mountain, unmoved from its own seat, concealing the cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: By which (juices) being exhilarated you have appointed the sun and the dawn (to their offices), driving away the solid (glooms); you have penetrated,Indra, the mountain, unmoved from its own seat, concealing the cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा तव तद्दंसनाभिरामासु पक्वं शच्या नि दीधः ।और्णोर्दुर उस्रियाभ्यो वि दृळ्होदूर्वाद्गा असृजो अंगिरस्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ krátvā ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀ āmā́su ǀ pakvám ǀ śácyā ǀ ní ǀ dīdharíti dīdhaḥ ǀáurṇoḥ ǀ dúraḥ ǀ usríyābhyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ út ǀ ūrvā́t ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ áṅgirasvān ǁ
verses.english_translation: By your wisdom, by your deeds, through your power, you have developed the mature (milk) in the immature (udders), you have opened the strong doors for the cattle (to come forth); associated with Aṅgirasas, you have liberated the cows from their fold.
verses.wilson_translation: By your wisdom, by your deeds, through your power, you have developed the mature (milk) in the immature (udders), you have opened the strong doors for the cattle (to come forth); associated with Aṅgirasas, you have liberated the cows from their fold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पप्राथ क्षां महि दंसो व्युर्वीमुप द्यामृष्वो बृहदिंद्र स्तभायः ।अधारयो रोदसी देवपुत्रे प्रत्ने मातरा यह्वी ऋतस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: paprā́tha ǀ kṣā́m ǀ máhi ǀ dáṃsaḥ ǀ ví ǀ urvī́m ǀ úpa ǀ dyā́m ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ indra ǀ stabhāyaḥ ǀádhārayaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǀ pratné íti ǀ mātárā ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have filled the wide earth,Indra. With (the power of) your deeds; you, the mighty one, have propped up the vast heaven; you have sustained the heaven and earth, whose children are the gods, (and who are) the old and mighty parents of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: You have filled the wide earth,Indra. With (the power of) your deeds; you, the mighty one, have propped up the vast heaven; you have sustained the heaven and earth, whose children are the gods, (and who are) the old and mighty parents of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध त्वा विश्वे पुर इंद्र देवा एकं तवसं दधिरे भराय ।अदेवो यदभ्यौहिष्ट देवान्त्स्वर्षाता वृणत इंद्रमत्र ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ tvā ǀ víśve ǀ puráḥ ǀ indra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ékam ǀ tavásam ǀ dadhire ǀ bhárāya ǀádevaḥ ǀ yát ǀ abhí ǀ áuhiṣṭa ǀ devā́n ǀ sváḥ-sātā ǀ vṛṇate ǀ índram ǀ átra ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the gods then plural ced you,Indra, as their mighty chief in front for battle; when the impious (asuras) assailed the deities; the Marutssupported Indra in the conflict.
verses.wilson_translation: All the gods then plural ced you,Indra, as their mighty chief in front for battle; when the impious (asuras) assailed the deities; the Marutssupported Indra in the conflict.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध द्यौश्चित्ते अप सा नु वज्राद्द्वितानमद्भियसा स्वस्य मन्योः ।अहिं यदिंद्रो अभ्योहसानं नि चिद्विश्वायुः शयथे जघान ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ ápa ǀ sā́ ǀ nú ǀ vájrāt ǀ dvitā́ ǀ anamat ǀ bhiyásā ǀ svásya ǀ manyóḥ ǀáhim ǀ yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ abhí ǀ óhasānam ǀ ní ǀ cit ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ śayáthe ǀ jaghā́na ǁ
verses.english_translation: The heaven bowed down in the two-fold dread of your thunderbolt, and your individual wrath, when Indra, the giver of food, struck to the sleep (of death) the assailing Ahi.
verses.wilson_translation: The heaven bowed down in the two-fold dread of your thunderbolt, and your individual wrath, when Indra, the giver of food, struck to the sleep (of death) the assailing Ahi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध त्वष्टा ते मह उग्र वज्रं सहस्रभृष्टिं ववृतच्छताश्रिं ।निकाममरमणसं येन नवंतमहिं सं पिणगृजीषिन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ te ǀ maháḥ ǀ ugra ǀ vájram ǀ sahásra-bhṛṣṭim ǀ vavṛtat ǀ śatá-aśrim ǀní-kāmam ǀ ará-manasam ǀ yéna ǀ návantam ǀ áhim ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǀ ṛjīṣin ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fierce Indra,Tvaṣṭāconstructed for you, the mighty one, the thousand-edged, the hundred-angled thunderbolt, wherewith you have crushed the ambitious audacious, loud-shouting Ahi.
verses.wilson_translation: Fierce Indra,Tvaṣṭāconstructed for you, the mighty one, the thousand-edged, the hundred-angled thunderbolt, wherewith you have crushed the ambitious audacious, loud-shouting Ahi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वर्धान्यं विश्वे मरुतः सजोषाः पचच्छतं महिषाँ इंद्र तुभ्यं ।पूषा विष्णुस्त्रीणि सरांसि धावन्वृत्रहणं मदिरमंशुमस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration: várdhān ǀ yám ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ pácat ǀ śatám ǀ mahiṣā́n ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀpūṣā́ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ dhāvan ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ madirám ǀ aṃśúm ǀ asmai ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you,Indra, whom all the Maruts, alike plural ased, exalt, may Pūṣanand Viṣṇudress for you a hundred buffaloes, and to him may the three streams flow with the inebriating, foe-destroying Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: For you,Indra, whom all the Maruts, alike plural ased, exalt, may Pūṣanand Viṣṇudress for you a hundred buffaloes, and to him may the three streams flow with the inebriating, foe-destroying Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ क्षोदो महि वृतं नदीनां परिष्ठितमसृज ऊर्मिमपां ।तासामनु प्रवत इंद्र पंथां प्रार्दयो नीचीरपसः समुद्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ vṛtám ǀ nadī́nām ǀ pári-sthitam ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ ūrmím ǀ apā́m ǀtā́sām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ pánthām ǀ prá ǀ ārdayaḥ ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ samudrám ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have set free the greatly obstructed and arrested water of the rivers, the flux of the waters; you have directed them,Indra, upon their downward paths; you have sent them rapidly down to the ocean.
verses.wilson_translation: You have set free the greatly obstructed and arrested water of the rivers, the flux of the waters; you have directed them,Indra, upon their downward paths; you have sent them rapidly down to the ocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा ता विश्वा चकृवांसमिंद्रं महामुग्रमजुर्यं सहोदां ।सुवीरं त्वा स्वायुधं सुवज्रमा ब्रह्म नव्यमवसे ववृत्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ cakṛ-vā́ṃsam ǀ índram ǀ mahā́m ǀ ugrám ǀ ajuryám ǀ sahaḥ-dā́m ǀsu-vī́ram ǀ tvā ǀ su-āyudhám ǀ su-vájram ǀ ā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ ávase ǀ vavṛtyāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our new prayer bring to our protection you,Indra, who are the maker of all these (things that exist); who are mighty, fierce, undecaying, the giver of strength, having excellent descendants, the Maruts, well-armed, the bearer of the thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: May our new prayer bring to our protection you,Indra, who are the maker of all these (things that exist); who are mighty, fierce, undecaying, the giver of strength, having excellent descendants, the Maruts, well-armed, the bearer of the thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो वाजाय श्रवस इषे च राये धेहि द्युमत इंद्र विप्रान् ।भरद्वाजे नृवत इंद्र सूरींदिवि च स्मैधि पार्ये न इंद्र ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ śrávase ǀ iṣé ǀ ca ǀ rāyé ǀ dhehi ǀ dyu-mátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ víprān ǀbharát-vāje ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sūrī́n ǀ diví ǀ ca ǀ sma ǀ edhi ǀ pā́rye ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, resplendent Indra, uphold us who are devout, for (the obtaining of) food, of sustenance, of nourishment, of wealth; bestow upon Bharadvājapious posterity, with numerous attendants; be with us, Indra, every future day.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, resplendent Indra, uphold us who are devout, for (the obtaining of) food, of sustenance, of nourishment, of wealth; bestow upon Bharadvājapious posterity, with numerous attendants; be with us, Indra, every future day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ devá-hitam ǀ sanema ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, by this (praise), obtain food granted by the deity; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, be happy for a hundred winters.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, by this (praise), obtain food granted by the deity; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, be happy for a hundred winters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GLORIFY him whose might is all-surpassing, Indra the much-invoked who fights uninjured.Magnify with these songs the never-vanquished, the Strong, the Bull of men, the Mighty Victor. He, Champion, Hero, Warrior, Lord of battles, impetuous, loudly roaring, great destroyer,Who whirls the dust on high, alone, oerthrower, hath made all races of mankind his subjects. Thou, thou alone, hast tamed the Dasyus; singly thou hast subdued the people for the Ārya.In this, or is it not, thine hero exploit, Indra? Declare it at the proper season. For true, I deem, thy strength is, thine the Mighty, thine, O Most Potent, thine the Conquering Victor;Strong, of the strong, Most Mighty, of the mighty, thine, driver of the churl to acts of bounty. Be this our ancient bond of friendship with you and with Aṅgirases here who speak of Vala.Thou, Wondrous, Shaker of things firm, didst smite him in his fresh strength, and force his doors and castles. With holy thoughts must he be called, the Mighty, showing his power in the great fight with Vṛtra.He must be called to give us seed and offspring, the Thunderer must he moved and sped to battle. He in his might, with name that lives for ever, hath far surpassed all human generations.He, most heroic, hath his home with splendour, with glory and with riches and with valour. Stranger to guile, who ne’er was false or faithless, bearing a name that may be well remembered,Indra crushed Cumuri, Dhuni, Śambara, Pipru, and Śuṣṇa, that their castles fell in ruin. With saving might that must be praised and lauded, Indra, ascend thy car to smite down Vṛtra.In thy right hand hold fast thy bolt of thunder, and weaken, Bounteous Lord, his art and magic. As Agni, as the dart burns the dry forest, like the dread shaft burn down the fiends, O Indra;Thou who with high deep-reaching spear hast broken, hast covered over mischief and destroyed it. With wealth, by thousand paths come hither, Agni, paths that bring ample strength, O thou Most Splendid.Come, Son of Strength, o’er whom, Invoked of many! the godless hath no power to keep thee distant. From heaven, from earth is bruited forth the greatness of him the firm, the fiery, the resplendent.No foe hath he, no counterpart, no refuge is there from him the Conqueror full of wisdom This day the deed that thou hast done is famous, when thou, for him, with many thousand othersLaidest low Kutsa, Āyu, Atithigva, and boldly didst deliver Tūrvayāṇa. In thee, O God, the wisest of the Sages, all Gods were joyful when thou slewest Ahi.When lauded for thyself, thou gavest freedom to sore-afflicted Heaven and to the people. This power of thine both heaven and earth acknowledge, the deathless Gods acknowledge it, O Indra.Do what thou ne’er hast done, O Mighty Worker: beget a new hymn at thy sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: तमु ष्टुहि यो अभिभूत्योजा वन्वन्नवातः पुरुहूत इंद्रः ।अषाळ्हमुग्रं सहमानमाभिर्गीर्भिर्वर्ध वृषभं चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuhi ǀ yáḥ ǀ abhíbhūti-ojāḥ ǀ vanván ǀ ávātaḥ ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀáṣāḷham ǀ ugrám ǀ sáhamānam ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vardha ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise him who is Indra, the invoker of many, endowed with overpowering vigour, the destroyer (of foes), unharmed by them; exalt with these praises the irresistible, fierce, victorious Indra, the showerer (of benefits) upon mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise him who is Indra, the invoker of many, endowed with overpowering vigour, the destroyer (of foes), unharmed by them; exalt with these praises the irresistible, fierce, victorious Indra, the showerer (of benefits) upon mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स युध्मः सत्वा खजकृत्समद्वा तुविम्रक्षो नदनुमाँ ऋजीषी ।बृहद्रेणुश्च्यवनो मानुषीणामेकः कृष्टीनामभवत्सहावा ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yudhmáḥ ǀ sátvā ǀ khaja-kṛ́t ǀ samát-vā ǀ tuvi-mrakṣáḥ ǀ nadanu-mā́n ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀbṛhát-reṇuḥ ǀ cyávanaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ abhavat ǀ sahá-vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: He is ever the combatant, the donor, the engaged in battle, the sympathizer (with the sacrificer), the benefactor of many, the loud-sounding, the partaker of the stale libation, the stirrer up of dust (in strife), the chief protector of men the descendants of Manu, the endowed with strength.
verses.wilson_translation: He is ever the combatant, the donor, the engaged in battle, the sympathizer (with the sacrificer), the benefactor of many, the loud-sounding, the partaker of the stale libation, the stirrer up of dust (in strife), the chief protector of men the descendants of Manu, the endowed with strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह नु त्यददमायो दस्यूँरेकः कृष्टीरवनोरार्याय ।अस्ति स्विन्नु वीर्यं तत्त इंद्र न स्विदस्ति तदृतुथा वि वोचः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ nú ǀ tyát ǀ adamayaḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ avanoḥ ǀ ā́ryāya ǀásti ǀ svit ǀ nú ǀ vīryám ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ ná ǀ svit ǀ asti ǀ tát ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ ví ǀ vocaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are he who has quickly humbled the Dasyus; you are the chief one who has given posterity to the Arya;but,Indra, is not verily your power such? If it be not, then in due season confess.
verses.wilson_translation: You are he who has quickly humbled the Dasyus; you are the chief one who has given posterity to the Arya;but,Indra, is not verily your power such? If it be not, then in due season confess.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सदिद्धि ते तुविजातस्य मन्ये सहः सहिष्ठ तुरतस्तुरस्य ।उग्रमुग्रस्य तवसस��तवीयोऽरध्रस्य रध्रतुरो बभूव ॥
verses.transliteration: sát ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ tuvi-jātásya ǀ mánye ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ sahiṣṭha ǀ turatáḥ ǀ turásya ǀugrám ǀ ugrásya ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ távīyaḥ ǀ áradhrasya ǀ radhra-túraḥ ǀ babhūva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yet, most mighty one, I believe that powre is verily always in you, who are manifest at many rites, and are the enemy of (our) enemies; (the power) that is fierce in the fierce one, most mighty in the mighty one, most unassailable in the subduer (of foes).
verses.wilson_translation: Yet, most mighty one, I believe that powre is verily always in you, who are manifest at many rites, and are the enemy of (our) enemies; (the power) that is fierce in the fierce one, most mighty in the mighty one, most unassailable in the subduer (of foes).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तन्नः प्रत्नं सख्यमस्तु युष्मे इत्था वदद्भिर्वलमंगिरोभिः ।हन्नच्युतच्युद्दस्मेषयंतमृणोः पुरो वि दुरो अस्य विश्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ pratnám ǀ sakhyám ǀ astu ǀ yuṣmé íti ǀ itthā́ ǀ vádat-bhiḥ ǀ valám ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀhán ǀ acyuta-cyut ǀ dasma ǀ iṣáyantam ǀ ṛṇóḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ asya ǀ víśvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that our ancient friendship with you ever endure; as when, along with the Aṅgirasas, celebrating your praises, you, beautiful Indra, caster down of the immoveable (roks), did verily slay Bala, hurling (his darts against you), and force open his cities, and all his gates.
verses.wilson_translation: May that our ancient friendship with you ever endure; as when, along with the Aṅgirasas, celebrating your praises, you, beautiful Indra, caster down of the immoveable (roks), did verily slay Bala, hurling (his darts against you), and force open his cities, and all his gates.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि धीभिर्हव्यो अस्त्युग्र ईशानकृन्महति वृत्रतूर्ये ।स तोकसाता तनये स वज्री वितंतसाय्यो अभवत्समत्सु ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ ugráḥ ǀ īśāna-kṛ́t ǀ mahatí ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀsáḥ ǀ toká-sātā ǀ tánaye ǀ sáḥ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ vitantasā́yyaḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ samát-su ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fierce Indra, maker of rules you are he who is to be invoked with praise in a great conflict; you are he (who is to be invoked) for sons and grandsons, he, the wielder of the thunderbolt, who is to be especially glorified in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: Fierce Indra, maker of rules you are he who is to be invoked with praise in a great conflict; you are he (who is to be invoked) for sons and grandsons, he, the wielder of the thunderbolt, who is to be especially glorified in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मज्मना जनिम मानुषाणाममर्त्येन नाम्नाति प्र सर्स्रे ।स द्युम्नेन स शवसोत राया स वीर्येण नृतमः समोकाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ majmánā ǀ jánima ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ ámartyena ǀ nā́mnā ǀ áti ǀ prá ǀ sarsre ǀsáḥ ǀ dyumnéna ǀ sáḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ utá ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vīryéṇa ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ sám-okāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With immortal, foe-humiliating might he has promoted the (multiplied) birth of mankind; he, the chief of leaders, dwells in the same dwelling with fame, with strength, with riches, with heroism.
verses.wilson_translation: With immortal, foe-humiliating might he has promoted the (multiplied) birth of mankind; he, the chief of leaders, dwells in the same dwelling with fame, with strength, with riches, with heroism.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स यो न मुहे न मिथू जनो भूत्सुमंतुनामा चुमुरिं धुनिं च ।वृणक्पिप्रुं शंबरं शुष्णमिंद्रः पुरां च्यौत्नाय शयथाय नू चित् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ná ǀ muhé ǀ ná ǀ míthu ǀ jánaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ sumántu-nāmā ǀ cúmurim ǀ dhúnim ǀ ca ǀvṛṇák ǀ píprum ǀ śámbaram ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ índraḥ ǀ purā́m ǀ cyautnā́ya ǀ śayáthāya ǀ nú ǀ cit ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is never perplexed, who is no engenderer of that which is in vain, whose name is renowned, who promptly (exerts himself) for the overturning of the cities (of theasuras), and for the destruction (of his foes); you, (Indra), have indeed slain Cumuri,Dhuni, Pipru,Śambara, andŚuṣṇa.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is never perplexed, who is no engenderer of that which is in vain, whose name is renowned, who promptly (exerts himself) for the overturning of the cities (of theasuras), and for the destruction (of his foes); you, (Indra), have indeed slain Cumuri,Dhuni, Pipru,Śambara, andŚuṣṇa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदावता त्वक्षसा पन्यसा च वृत्रहत्याय रथमिंद्र तिष्ठ ।धिष्व वज्रं हस्त आ दक्षिणत्राभि प्र मंद पुरुदत्र मायाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ut-ávatā ǀ tvákṣasā ǀ pányasā ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-hátyāya ǀ rátham ǀ indra ǀ tiṣṭha ǀdhiṣvá ǀ vájram ǀ háste ǀ ā́ ǀ dakṣiṇa-trā́ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ manda ǀ puru-datra ǀ māyā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Endowed) with upward-rising, foe-thinning, and glorified (vigour), ascend your car for the destruction of Vṛtra; take the thunderbolt in your righthand, giver of wealth, baffle the devices (of theasuras).
verses.wilson_translation: (Endowed) with upward-rising, foe-thinning, and glorified (vigour), ascend your car for the destruction of Vṛtra; take the thunderbolt in your righthand, giver of wealth, baffle the devices (of theasuras).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्न शुष्कं वनमिंद्र हेती रक्षो नि धक्ष्यशनिर्न भीमा ।गंभीरय ऋष्वया यो रुरोजाध्वानयद्दुरिता दंभयच्च ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ śúṣkam ǀ vánam ǀ indra ǀ hetī́ḥ ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhakṣi ǀ aśániḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmā́ ǀgambhīráyā ǀ ṛṣváyā ǀ yáḥ ǀ rurója ǀ ádhvanayat ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ dambháyat ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: In like manner as Agniconsumes the dry forest, so,Indra, your weapon (destroys your enemies); as (formidable as you) fearful shaft, consume therākṣasas; you who have shouted aloud (in the combat) and demolished all evil things.
verses.wilson_translation: In like manner as Agniconsumes the dry forest, so,Indra, your weapon (destroys your enemies); as (formidable as you) fearful shaft, consume therākṣasas; you who have shouted aloud (in the combat) and demolished all evil things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सहस्रं पथिभिरिंद्र राया तुविद्युम्न तुविवाजेभिरर्वाक् ।याहि सूनो सहसो यस्य नू चिददेव ईशे पुरुहूत योतोः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sahásram ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ túvi-dyumna ǀ tuvi-vā́jebhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀyāhí ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ puru-hūta ǀ yótoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Opulent,Indra, son of strength, the invoker of many, whose union (with energy) the impious is unable to disjoint, come down to us with thousands of riches by very powerful conveyances.
verses.wilson_translation: Opulent,Indra, son of strength, the invoker of many, whose union (with energy) the impious is unable to disjoint, come down to us with thousands of riches by very powerful conveyances.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र तुविद्युम्नस्य स्थविरस्य घृष्वेर्दिवो ररप्शे महिमा पृथिव्याः ।नास्य शत्रुर्न प्रतिमानमस्ति न प्रतिष्ठिः पुरुमायस्य सह्योः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ tuvi-dyumnásya ǀ sthávirasya ǀ ghṛ́ṣveḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ rarapśe ǀ mahimā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀná ǀ asya ǀ śátruḥ ǀ ná ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ asti ǀ ná ǀ prati-sthíḥ ǀ puru-māyásya ǀ sáhyoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vastness of the affluent, ancient (Indra), the demolisher (of foes), exceeds that of the heaven and the earth; there is no antagonist, no counterpart, no recipient of him abounding in wisdom, victorious (in war).
verses.wilson_translation: The vastness of the affluent, ancient (Indra), the demolisher (of foes), exceeds that of the heaven and the earth; there is no antagonist, no counterpart, no recipient of him abounding in wisdom, victorious (in war).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र तत्ते अद्या करणं कृतं भूत्कुत्सं यदायुमतिथिग्वमस्मै ।पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशा अभि क्षामुत्तूर्वयाणं धृषता निनेथ ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ káraṇam ǀ kṛtám ǀ bhūt ǀ kútsam ǀ yát ǀ āyúm ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ asmai ǀpurú ǀ sahásrā ǀ ní ǀ śiśāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kṣā́m ǀ út ǀ tū́rvayāṇam ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ ninetha ǁ
verses.english_translation: That exploit is celebrated in the present day (which you have) achieved for Kutsa, for Āyu, for Atithigvave; to him you have given many thousands (of riches), and you have quickly elevated Turvayāṇa over the earth by your power.
verses.wilson_translation: That exploit is celebrated in the present day (which you have) achieved for Kutsa, for Āyu, for Atithigvave; to him you have given many thousands (of riches), and you have quickly elevated Turvayāṇa over the earth by your power.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु त्वाहिघ्ने अध देव देवा मदन्विश्वे कवितमं कवीनां ।करो यत्र वरिवो बाधिताय दिवे जनाय तन्वे गृणानः ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ tvā ǀ áhi-ghne ǀ ádha ǀ deva ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mádan ǀ víśve ǀ kaví-tamam ǀ kavīnā́m ǀkáraḥ ǀ yátra ǀ várivaḥ ǀ bādhitā́ya ǀ divé ǀ jánāya ǀ tanvé ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Indra, all the gods have glorified you, the wisest of the wise, for the destruction of Ahi; when propitiated, you have given wealth to the distressed worshipper, and to his posterity.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Indra, all the gods have glorified you, the wisest of the wise, for the destruction of Ahi; when propitiated, you have given wealth to the distressed worshipper, and to his posterity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु द्यावापृथिवी तत्त ओजोऽमर्त्या जिहत इंद्र देवाः ।कृष्वा कृत्नो अकृतं यत्ते अस्त्युक्थं नवीयो जनयस्व यज्ञैः ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ámartyāḥ ǀ jihate ǀ indra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀkṛṣvá ǀ kṛtno íti ǀ ákṛtam ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ ukthám ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ janayasva ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The heaven and earth, and the immortal gods, acknowledge your might; doer of many deeds, do that which is yet undone by you, give birth to a new hymn at (your) sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The heaven and earth, and the immortal gods, acknowledge your might; doer of many deeds, do that which is yet undone by you, give birth to a new hymn at (your) sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GREAT, hero-like controlling men is Indra, unwasting in his powers, doubled in vastness.He, turned to us, hath grown to hero vigour: broad, wide, he hath been decked by those who serve him. The bowl made Indra swift to gather booty, the High, the Lofty, Youthful, Undecaying,Him who hath waxed by strength which none may conquer, and even at once grown to complete perfection. Stretch out those hands of thine, extend to us-ward thy wide capacious arms, and grant us glory.Like as the household herdsman guards the cattle, so move thou round about us in the combat. Now, fain for strength, let us invite your Indra hither, who lieth hidden with his Heroes,—Free from all blame, without reproach, uninjured, e’en as were those who sang, of old, his praises. With steadfast laws, wealth-giver, strong through Soma, he hath much fair and precious food to feed us.In him unite all paths that lead to riches, like rivers that commingle with the ocean. Bring unto us the mightiest might, O Hero, strong and most potent force, thou great Subduer!All splendid vigorous powers of men vouchsafe us, Lord of Bay Steeds, that they may make us joyful. Bring us, grown mighty in its strength, O Indra, thy friendly rapturous joy that wins the battle,Wherewith by thee assisted and triumphant, we may laud thee in gaining seed and offspring. Indra, bestow on us the power heroic skilled and exceeding strong, that wins the booty,Wherewith, by thine assistance, we may conquer our foes in battle, be they kin or stranger. Let thine heroic strength come from behind us, before us, from above us or below us.From every side may it approach us, Indra. Give us the glory of the realm of splendour. With most heroic aid from thee, like heroes Indra, may we win wealth by deeds glory.Thou, King, art Lord of earthly, heavenly treasure: vouchsafe us riches vast, sublime, and lasting. The Bull, whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the Celestial Ruler,Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him let us call to grant us new protection. Give up the people who are high and haughty to these men and to me, O Thunder-wielder!Therefore upon the earth do we invoke thee, where heroes win, for sons and kine and waters. Through these thy friendships, God invoked of many! may we be victors over every foeman.Slaying both kinds of foe, may we, O Hero, be happy, helped by thee, with ample riches.

verses.sanskrit: महाँ इंद्रो नृवदा चर्षणिप्रा उत द्विबर्हा अमिनः सहोभिः ।अस्मद्र्यग्वावृधे वीर्यायोरुः पृथुः सुकृतः कर्तृभिर्भूत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ ā́ ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀ amináḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀasmadryák ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ urúḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǀ sú-kṛtaḥ ǀ kartṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the great Indra, who is as a monarch the fulfiller (of the desires) of men, come hither; may he who is mighty over the two (realms of space), uninjurable by (hostile) offers, increase (in capacity) for heroism in our presence; may he who is great (in body), eminent (in qualities), be honoured by the performers (of pious acts).
verses.wilson_translation: May the great Indra, who is as a monarch the fulfiller (of the desires) of men, come hither; may he who is mighty over the two (realms of space), uninjurable by (hostile) offers, increase (in capacity) for heroism in our presence; may he who is great (in body), eminent (in qualities), be honoured by the performers (of pious acts).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रमेव धिषणा सातये धाद्बृहंतमृष्वमजरं युवानं ।अषाळ्हेन शवसा शूशुवांसं सद्यश्चिद्यो वावृधे असामि ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ evá ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ sātáye ǀ dhāt ǀ bṛhántam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ajáram ǀ yúvānam ǀáṣāḷhena ǀ śávasā ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ ásāmi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our praise encourages Indrao munificence, the vast, quick-moving, undecaying, ever-youthful Indra, mighty with unsurpassable strength, who rapidly grows to greatness.
verses.wilson_translation: Our praise encourages Indrao munificence, the vast, quick-moving, undecaying, ever-youthful Indra, mighty with unsurpassable strength, who rapidly grows to greatness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पृथू करस्ना बहुला गभस्ती अस्मद्र्यक्सं मिमीहि श्रवांसि ।यूथेव पश्वः पशुपा दमूना अस्माँ इंद्राभ्या ववृत्स्वाजौ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthū́ íti ǀ karásnā ǀ bahulā́ ǀ gábhastī íti ǀ asmadryák ǀ sám ǀ mimīhi ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀyūthā́-iva ǀ paśváḥ ǀ paśu-pā́ḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ ājáu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Extend towards us your long, active, and bountifulhands, (to bring us) food; be abot us, lowly-minded Indra, in battle, as a herdsman (tends) the herds of cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Extend towards us your long, active, and bountifulhands, (to bring us) food; be abot us, lowly-minded Indra, in battle, as a herdsman (tends) the herds of cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं व इंद्रं चतिनमस्य शाकैरिह नूनं वाजयंतो हुवेम ।यथा चित्पूर्वे जरितार आसुरनेद्या अनवद्या अरिष्टाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ catínam ǀ asya ǀ śākáiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ nūnám ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ huvema ǀyáthā ǀ cit ǀ pū́rve ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ āsúḥ ǀ ánedyāḥ ǀ anavadyā́ḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desiring sustenance, we invoke you, the renowned Indra, on this occasion, the destroyer (of enemies), together with his powerful allies (the Maruts); as his ancient adorers have been, (may we be), exempt from blame, irreproachable, unharmed.
verses.wilson_translation: Desiring sustenance, we invoke you, the renowned Indra, on this occasion, the destroyer (of enemies), together with his powerful allies (the Maruts); as his ancient adorers have been, (may we be), exempt from blame, irreproachable, unharmed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धृतव्रतो धनदाः सोमवृद्धः स हि वामस्य वसुनः पुरुक्षुः ।सं जग्मिरे पथ्या रायो अस्मिन्त्समुद्रे न सिंधवो यादमानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ dhana-dā́ḥ ǀ sóma-vṛddhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ vāmásya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ puru-kṣúḥ ǀsám ǀ jagmire ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ asmin ǀ samudré ǀ ná ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ yā́damānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: In him who is observant of pious rites, who is a giver of wealth, who is exalted by the Soma, the (lord) of desirable riches, the distributor of food, (in him) the treasures fit (for his worshippers) congregate like rivers flowing into ocean.
verses.wilson_translation: In him who is observant of pious rites, who is a giver of wealth, who is exalted by the Soma, the (lord) of desirable riches, the distributor of food, (in him) the treasures fit (for his worshippers) congregate like rivers flowing into ocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शविष्ठं न आ भर शूर शव ओजिष्ठमोजो अभिभूत उग्रं ।विश्वा द्युम्ना वृष्ण्या मानुषाणामस्मभ्यं दा हरिवो मादयध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: śáviṣṭham ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ śūra ǀ śávaḥ ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ ójaḥ ǀ abhi-bhūte ǀ ugrám ǀvíśvā ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyā ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dāḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ mādayádhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us, hero Indra, most vigorous vigour; subduer (of enemies, bestow upon us) most energetic and fierce energy; grant, lord of steeds, all the bright and invigorating (treasures) fit for men, to make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us, hero Indra, most vigorous vigour; subduer (of enemies, bestow upon us) most energetic and fierce energy; grant, lord of steeds, all the bright and invigorating (treasures) fit for men, to make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते मदः पृतनाषाळमृध्र इंद्र तं न आ भर शूशुवांसं ।येन तोकस्य तनयस्य सातौ मंसीमहि जिगीवांसस्त्वोताः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀ pṛtanāṣā́ṭ ǀ ámṛdhraḥ ǀ índra ǀ tám ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀyéna ǀ tokásya ǀ tánayasya ǀ sātáu ǀ maṃsīmáhi ǀ jigīvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: вЂњImpart to us,Indra, that your invigorating exultatio which overcomes enemies, and is irresistible, where by, protected by you, triumphant we may glorify you for the sake of (obtaining) sons and grandsons.вЂќ
verses.wilson_translation: вЂњImpart to us,Indra, that your invigorating exultatio which overcomes enemies, and is irresistible, where by, protected by you, triumphant we may glorify you for the sake of (obtaining) sons and grandsons.вЂќ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो भर वृषणं शुष्ममिंद्र धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षं ।येन वंसाम पृतनासु शत्रूंतवोतिभिरुत जामीँरजामीन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ indra ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ su-dákṣam ǀyéna ǀ váṃsāma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ śátrūn ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ jāmī́n ǀ ájāmīn ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us,Indra, vigorous strenght, the realizer of wealth, great and propitious, wherewith, thorugh your protection, we may destroy our enemies in battles, whether they be kinsmen or strangers.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us,Indra, vigorous strenght, the realizer of wealth, great and propitious, wherewith, thorugh your protection, we may destroy our enemies in battles, whether they be kinsmen or strangers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते शुष्मो वृषभ एतु पश्चादोत्तरादधरादा पुरस्तात् ।आ विश्वतो अभि समेत्वर्वाङिंद्र द्युम्नं स्वर्वद्धेह्यस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ etu ǀ paścā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ uttarā́t ǀ adharā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ purástāt ǀā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ etu ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ índra ǀ dyumnám ǀ sváḥ-vat ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your invigorating srength come from the west, from the north, from the south, from the east; may it come to us from every quarter; grant us riches combined with felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: May your invigorating srength come from the west, from the north, from the south, from the east; may it come to us from every quarter; grant us riches combined with felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नृवत्त इंद्र नृतमाभिरूती वंसीमहि वामं श्रोमतेभिः ।ईक्षे हि वस्व उभयस्य राजंधा रत्नं महि स्थूरं बृहंतं ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛ-vát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ nṛ́-tamābhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ vaṃsīmáhi ǀ vāmám ǀ śrómatebhiḥ ǀī́kṣe ǀ hí ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ rājan ǀ dhā́ḥ ǀ rátnam ǀ máhi ǀ sthūrám ǀ bṛhántam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We enjoy,Indra, through your guiding protection, desirable affluence along with descendants and reputation; grant us, sovereign, who rule over (earthly and heavenly) riches, vast, desirable and infinite treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: We enjoy,Indra, through your guiding protection, desirable affluence along with descendants and reputation; grant us, sovereign, who rule over (earthly and heavenly) riches, vast, desirable and infinite treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वंतं वृषभं वावृधानमकवारिं दिव्यं शासमिंद्रं ।विश्वासाहमवसे नूतनायोग्रं सहोदामिह तं हुवेम ॥
verses.transliteration: marútvantam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ ákava-arim ǀ divyám ǀ śāsám ǀ índram ǀviśva-sáham ǀ ávase ǀ nū́tanāya ǀ ugrám ǀ sahaḥ-dā́m ǀ ihá ǀ tám ǀ huvema ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke on this occasion for his present protection, that Indrawho is attended by the Maruts; who is the showerer (of benefits); augmenting (in prowess); the unreviled of foes, radiant, ruling, all-subduing, fierce, the giver of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke on this occasion for his present protection, that Indrawho is attended by the Maruts; who is the showerer (of benefits); augmenting (in prowess); the unreviled of foes, radiant, ruling, all-subduing, fierce, the giver of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जनं वज्रिन्महि चिन्मन्यमानमेभ्यो नृभ्यो रंधया येष्वस्मि ।अधा हि त्वा पृथिव्यां शूरसातौ हवामहे तनये गोष्वप्सु ॥
verses.transliteration: jánam ǀ vajrin ǀ máhi ǀ cit ǀ mányamānam ǀ ebhyáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ randhaya ǀ yéṣu ǀ ásmi ǀádha ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀ hávāmahe ǀ tánaye ǀ góṣu ǀ ap-sú ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wielder of the thunderbolt, humble that man who looks upon himself as the greatest among those men of whom I am; we invoke you now to (ascend) upon the earth at the time of battle, and for (the sake of obtaining) sond and grandsons.
verses.wilson_translation: Wielder of the thunderbolt, humble that man who looks upon himself as the greatest among those men of whom I am; we invoke you now to (ascend) upon the earth at the time of battle, and for (the sake of obtaining) sond and grandsons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं त एभिः पुरुहूत सख्यैः शत्रोःशत्रोरुत्तर इत्स्याम ।घ्नंतो वृत्राण्युभयानि शूर राया मदेम बृहता त्वोताः ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ sakhyáiḥ ǀ śátroḥ-śatroḥ ǀ út-tare ǀ ít ǀ syāma ǀghnántaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ ubháyāni ǀ śūra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ madema ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invoked of many, may we, through these your friendly (praises), ever be superior to successive foes, destroying, oḥ hero, both (classes of) enemies, (kindred or unallied); and may we, protected by you, be happy with abundant riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Invoked of many, may we, through these your friendly (praises), ever be superior to successive foes, destroying, oḥ hero, both (classes of) enemies, (kindred or unallied); and may we, protected by you, be happy with abundant riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GIVE us wealth, Indra, that with might, as heaven o’ertops the earth, o’ercomes our foes in battleWealth that brings thousands and that wins the corn-lands, wealth, Son of Strength! that vanquishes the foeman. Even as the power of Dyaus, to thee, O Indra, all Asura sway was by the Gods entrusted,When thou, Impetuous! leagued with Viṣṇu, slewest Vṛtra the Dragon who enclosed the waters. Indra, Strong, Victor, Mightier than the mighty, addressed with prayer and perfect in his splendour,Lord of the bolt that breaketh forts in pieces, became the King of the sweet juice of Soma.. There, Indra, while the light was won, the Paṇis fed, 'neath a hundred blows, for wise Dasoni,And greedy Śuṣṇa's magical devices nor left he any of their food remaining. What time the thunder fell and Śuṣṇa perished, all life's support from the great Druh was taken.Indra made room for his car-drivcr Kutsa who sate beside him, when he gained the sunlight. As the Hawk rent for him the stalk that gladdens, he wrenched the head from Namuci the Dāsa.He guarded Nam, Sayya's son, in slumber, and sated him with food, success, and riches. Thou, thunder-armed, with thy great might hast shattered Pipru's strong forts who knew the wiles of serpents.Thou gavest to thy worshipper Ṛjiśvan imperishable Wealth, O Bounteous Giver. The crafty Vetasu, the swift Dasni, and Tugra speedily with all his servants,Hath Indra, gladdening with strong assistance, forced near as ’twere to glorify the Mother. Resistless, with the hosts he battles, bearing in both his arms the Vṛtra-slaying thunder.He mounts his Bays, as the car-seat an archer: yoked at a word they bear the lofty Indra. May we, O Indra, gain by thy new favour: so Parus laud thee, with their sacrifices,That thou hast wrecked seven autumn forts, their shelter, slain Dāsa tribes and aided Purukutsa. Favouring Uśanā the son of Kavi, thou wast his ancient strengthener, O Indra.Thou gavest Navavāstva. as a present, to the great father gavest back his grandson. Thou, roaring Indra, drovest on the waters that made a roaring sound like rushing rivers,What time, O Hero, o’er the sea thou broughtest, in safety broughtest Turvaśa and Yadu. This Indra, was thy work in war: thou sentest Dhuni and Cumuri to sleep and slumber.Dabhīti lit the flame for thee, and worshipped with fuel, hymns, poured Soma, dressed oblations.

verses.sanskrit: द्यौर्न य इंद्राभि भूमार्यस्तस्थौ रयिः शवसा पृत्सु जनान् ।तं नः सहस्रभरमुर्वरासां दद्धि सूनो सहसो वृत्रतुरं ॥
verses.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ bhū́ma ǀ aryáḥ ǀ tastháu ǀ rayíḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ jánān ǀtám ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásra-bharam ǀ urvarā-sā́m ǀ daddhí ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vṛtra-túram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, son of strength, grant us (a son), the possessor of thousands, the owner of cultivated lands, the usbduer of foes, the riches that may overcome men in battles by strength, as the radiant (sun) overspreads the earth by his rays.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, son of strength, grant us (a son), the possessor of thousands, the owner of cultivated lands, the usbduer of foes, the riches that may overcome men in battles by strength, as the radiant (sun) overspreads the earth by his rays.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो न तुभ्यमन्विंद्र सत्रासुर्यं देवेभिर्धायि विश्वं ।अहिं यद्वृत्रमपो वव्रिवांसं हन्नृजीषिन्विष्णुना सचानः ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ túbhyam ǀ ánu ǀ indra ǀ satrā́ ǀ asuryám ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ dhāyi ǀ víśvam ǀáhim ǀ yát ǀ vṛtrám ǀ apáḥ ǀ vavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ hán ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀ víṣṇunā ǀ sacānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To you,Indra, as to the sun, all strength has verily been given by the gods; so that, drinker of the stale Soma, associated with Viṣṇu, you mightiest slay the hostile Ahi obstructing the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: To you,Indra, as to the sun, all strength has verily been given by the gods; so that, drinker of the stale Soma, associated with Viṣṇu, you mightiest slay the hostile Ahi obstructing the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तूर्वन्नोजीयांतवसस्तवीयान्कृतब्रह्मेंद्रो वृद्धमहाः ।राजाभवन्मधुनः सोम्यस्य विश्वासां यत्पुरां दर्त्नुमावत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tū́rvan ǀ ójīyān ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ távīyān ǀ kṛtá-brahmā ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛddhá-mahāḥ ǀrā́jā ǀ abhavat ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ somyásya ǀ víśvāsām ǀ yát ǀ purā́m ǀ dartnúm ǀ ā́vat ǁ
verses.english_translation: When Indra, the destroyer, the most mighty, the strongest of the strong, the giver of food, the possessor of vast splendour, received (the thunderbolt), the shatterer of all the cities (of theasuras), he became the lord of the sweet Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: When Indra, the destroyer, the most mighty, the strongest of the strong, the giver of food, the possessor of vast splendour, received (the thunderbolt), the shatterer of all the cities (of theasuras), he became the lord of the sweet Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतैरपद्रन्पणय इंद्रात्र दशोणये कवयेऽर्कसातौ ।वधैः शुष्णस्याशुषस्य मायाः पित्वो नारिरेचीत्किं चन प्र ॥
verses.transliteration: śatáiḥ ǀ apadran ǀ paṇáyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ átra ǀ dáśa-oṇaye ǀ kaváye ǀ arká-sātau ǀvadháiḥ ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ aśúṣasya ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ pitváḥ ǀ ná ǀ arirecīt ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ prá ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Paṇis,Indra, fled, with hundres (ofasuras), from the sage, your worshipper (and ally) in battle; neither did e, (Indra), suffer the deceptions of the powerfulŚuṣṇato prevail over his weapons, nor did he (leave him) any of his sustenance.
verses.wilson_translation: The Paṇis,Indra, fled, with hundres (ofasuras), from the sage, your worshipper (and ally) in battle; neither did e, (Indra), suffer the deceptions of the powerfulŚuṣṇato prevail over his weapons, nor did he (leave him) any of his sustenance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महो द्रुहो अप विश्वायु धायि वज्रस्य यत्पतने पादि शुष्णः ।उरु ष सरथं सारथये करिंद्रः कुत्साय सूर्यस्य सातौ ॥
verses.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ druháḥ ǀ ápa ǀ viśvá-āyu ǀ dhāyi ǀ vájrasya ǀ yát ǀ pátane ǀ pā́di ǀ śúṣṇaḥ ǀurú ǀ sáḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ sā́rathaye ǀ kaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ kútsāya ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sātáu ǁ
verses.english_translation: WhenŚuṣṇapassed away upon the falling of the thunderbolt, then the universal strength of the great oppressor was annihilated, and Indraenlarged their common car for (the use of) his charioteer Kutsa, for (the sake of) the worship of the sn.
verses.wilson_translation: WhenŚuṣṇapassed away upon the falling of the thunderbolt, then the universal strength of the great oppressor was annihilated, and Indraenlarged their common car for (the use of) his charioteer Kutsa, for (the sake of) the worship of the sn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र श्येनो न मदिरमंशुमस्मै शिरो दासस्य नमुचेर्मथायन् ।प्रावन्नमीं साप्यं ससंतं पृणग्राया समिषा सं स्वस्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ madirám ǀ aṃśúm ǀ asmai ǀ śíraḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ námuceḥ ǀ mathāyán ǀprá ǀ āvat ǀ námīm ǀ sāpyám ǀ sasántam ǀ pṛṇák ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sám ǀ iṣā́ ǀ sám ǀ svastí ǁ
verses.english_translation: And the hawk bore to Indrathe exhilarating Soma, when, bruising the head of the oppressor Namuci, and protecting the slumbering Nami, the son of Sapya, he provided, for the weeell-being (of the sage), riches and food.
verses.wilson_translation: And the hawk bore to Indrathe exhilarating Soma, when, bruising the head of the oppressor Namuci, and protecting the slumbering Nami, the son of Sapya, he provided, for the weeell-being (of the sage), riches and food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि पिप्रोरहिमायस्य दृळ्हाः पुरो वज्रिंछवसा न दर्दः ।सुदामंतद्रेक्णो अप्रमृष्यमृजिश्वने दात्रं दाशुषे दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ píproḥ ǀ áhi-māyasya ǀ dṛḷhā́ḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ vajrin ǀ śávasā ǀ ná ǀ dardaríti dardaḥ ǀsú-dāman ǀ tát ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ apra-mṛṣyám ǀ ṛjíśvane ǀ dātrám ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have scatered by force, wielder of the thunderbolt, the strong cities of the deadly-deluding Pipru; you have given, bountiful Indra, uninjurable wealh to rijiṣvat, the donor of sacrificial gifts.
verses.wilson_translation: You have scatered by force, wielder of the thunderbolt, the strong cities of the deadly-deluding Pipru; you have given, bountiful Indra, uninjurable wealh to rijiṣvat, the donor of sacrificial gifts.

verses.sanskrit: स वेतसुं दशमायं दशोणिं तूतुजिमिंद्रः स्वभिष्टिसुम्नः ।आ तुग्रं शश्वदिभं द्योतनाय मातुर्न सीमुप सृजा इयध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vetasúm ǀ dáśa-māyam ǀ dáśa-oṇim ǀ tū́tujim ǀ índraḥ ǀ svabhiṣṭí-sumnaḥ ǀā́ ǀ túgram ǀ śáśvat ǀ íbham ǀ dyótanāya ǀ mātúḥ ǀ ná ǀ sīm ǀ úpa ǀ sṛja ǀ iyádhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the granter of wished-for felicity, compelled the many-fraudulent Etaśaand Dasoṇi, Tūtuji,Tugraand Ibha, always to come submissively to (therājā)Dyotana, as a son (comes before a mother).
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the granter of wished-for felicity, compelled the many-fraudulent Etaśaand Dasoṇi, Tūtuji,Tugraand Ibha, always to come submissively to (therājā)Dyotana, as a son (comes before a mother).

verses.sanskrit: स ईं स्पृधो वनते अप्रतीतो बिभ्रद्वज्रं वृत्रहणं गभस्तौ ।तिष्ठद्धरी अध्यस्तेव गर्ते वचोयुजा वहत इंद्रमृष्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ vanate ǀ áprati-itaḥ ǀ bíbhrat ǀ vájram ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ gábhastau ǀtíṣṭhat ǀ hárī íti ǀ ádhi ǀ ástā-iva ǀ gárte ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀ vahataḥ ǀ índram ǀ ṛṣvám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bearing in hishandthe foe-destroyig thunderbolt,Indra, unresisted, demolishing those his adversaries; he mounts his two-horse (car), as a warrior (ascends) his chariot; harnessed at a word, his steeds, convey the migty Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearing in hishandthe foe-destroyig thunderbolt,Indra, unresisted, demolishing those his adversaries; he mounts his two-horse (car), as a warrior (ascends) his chariot; harnessed at a word, his steeds, convey the migty Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनेम तेऽवसा नव्य इंद्र प्र पूरवः स्तवंत एना यज्ञैः ।सप्त यत्पुरः शर्म शारदीर्दर्द्धंदासीः पुरुकुत्साय शिक्षन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sanéma ǀ te ǀ ávasā ǀ návyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ prá ǀ pūrávaḥ ǀ stavante ǀ enā́ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀsaptá ǀ yát ǀ púraḥ ǀ śárma ǀ śā́radīḥ ǀ dárt ǀ hán ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ puru-kútsāya ǀ śíkṣan ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Favoured) by your proection,Indra, we solicit new (wealth); by this adoration men glorify you at sacrifices, for that you have shattered with your bolt the seven cities ofŚarat, killing the opponents (of sacred rites), killing the opponents (of sacred rites), and giving (their spoils) to Purukutsa.
verses.wilson_translation: (Favoured) by your proection,Indra, we solicit new (wealth); by this adoration men glorify you at sacrifices, for that you have shattered with your bolt the seven cities ofŚarat, killing the opponents (of sacred rites), killing the opponents (of sacred rites), and giving (their spoils) to Purukutsa.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वृध इंद्र पूर्व्यो भूर्वरिवस्यन्नुशने काव्याय ।परा नववास्त्वमनुदेयं महे पित्रे ददाथ स्वं नपातं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ indra ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ varivasyán ǀ uśáne ǀ kāvyā́ya ǀpárā ǀ náva-vāstvam ǀ anu-déyam ǀ mahé ǀ pitré ǀ dadātha ǀ svám ǀ nápātam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous of opulence, you,Indra, have been an ancient benefactor of Uśanas, the son of Kavi; having slain Navavāstva, you have given back his own grandson, who was (fit) to be restored o the grandfather.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of opulence, you,Indra, have been an ancient benefactor of Uśanas, the son of Kavi; having slain Navavāstva, you have given back his own grandson, who was (fit) to be restored o the grandfather.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं धुनिरिंद्र धुनिमतीर्ऋणोरपः सीरा न स्रवंतीः ।प्र यत्समुद्रमति शूर पर्षि पारया तुर्वशं यदुं स्वस्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ dhúniḥ ǀ indra ǀ dhúni-matīḥ ǀ ṛṇóḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sīrā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ srávantīḥ ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ samudrám ǀ áti ǀ śūra ǀ párṣi ǀ pāráya ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀ svastí ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, who make (your enemies) tremble, have caused the waters, detained by Dhuni, to flow like rushing rivers; so, hero, when, having crossed the ocean, you have reached the shore, you have brought over in safety Turvaśaand Yadu.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, who make (your enemies) tremble, have caused the waters, detained by Dhuni, to flow like rushing rivers; so, hero, when, having crossed the ocean, you have reached the shore, you have brought over in safety Turvaśaand Yadu.

verses.sanskrit: तव ह त्यदिंद्र विश्वमाजौ सस्तो धुनीचुमुरी या ह सिष्वप् ।दीदयदित्तुभ्यं सोमेभिः सुन्वंदभीतिरिध्मभृतिः पक्थ्यर्कैः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ indra ǀ víśvam ǀ ājáu ǀ sastáḥ ǀ dhúnīcúmurī íti ǀ yā́ ǀ ha ǀ sísvap ǀdīdáyat ǀ ít ǀ túbhyam ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ sunván ǀ dabhī́tiḥ ǀ idhmá-bhṛtiḥ ǀ pakthī́ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All this,Indra, has been your work in war; you have put to sleep, (in depth), the slumbering Dhunīand Cumurī; and thereupon Dabhīti, pouring the libation, preparing the oblation, and supplying the fuel, has glorified you with Somaofferings.
verses.wilson_translation: All this,Indra, has been your work in war; you have put to sleep, (in depth), the slumbering Dhunīand Cumurī; and thereupon Dabhīti, pouring the libation, preparing the oblation, and supplying the fuel, has glorified you with Somaofferings.

hymns.title: HYMN XXI. Indra. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THESE the most constant singer's invocations call thee who art to be invoked, O Hero;Hymns call anew the chariot-borne, Eternal: by eloquence men gain abundant riches. I praise that Indra, known to all men, honoured with songs, extolled with hymns at sacrifices,Whose majesty, rich in wondrous arts, surpasseth the magnitude of earth, and heaven in greatness. He hath made pathways, with the Sun to aid him, throughout the darkness that extended pathless.Mortals who yearn to worship ne’er dishonour, O Mighty God, thy Law who art Immortal. And he who did these things, where is that Indra? among what tribes? what people doth he visit?What sacrifice contents thy mind , and wishes? What priest among them all? what hymn, O Indra? Yea, here were they who, born of old, have served thee, thy friends of ancient time, thou active Worker.Bethink thee now of these, Invoked of many! the midmost and the recent, and the youngest. Inquiring after him, thy later servants, Indra, have gained thy former old traditions.Hero, to whom the prayer is brought, we praise thee as great for that wherein we know thee mighty. The demon's strength is gathered fast against thee: great as that strength hath grown, go forth to meet it.With thine own ancient friend and companion, the thunderbolt, brave Champion! drive it backward. Hear, too, the prayer of this thy present beadsman, O Indra, Hero, cherishing the singer.For thou wast aye our fathers' Friend aforetime, still swift to listen to their supplication. Bring to our help this day, for our protection, Varuṇa, Mitra , Indra, and the Maruts,Pūṣan and Viṣṇu, Agni and Purandhi, Savitar also, and the Plants and Mountains. The singers here exalt with hymns and praises thee who art very Mighty and Most Holy.Hear, when invoked, the invoker's invocation. Beside thee there is nonelike thee, Immortal! Now to my words come quickly thou who knowest, O Son of Strength, with all who claim our worship,Who visit sacred rites, whose tongue is Agni, Gods who made Manu stronger than the Dasyu. On good and evil ways be thou our Leader, thou who art known to all as Path-preparer.Bring power to us, O Indra, with thy Horses, Steeds that are best to draw, broad-backed, unwearied.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरुतमस्य कारोर्हव्यं वीर हव्या हवंते ।धियो रथेष्ठामजरं नवीयो रयिर्विभूतिरीयते वचस्या ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ puru-támasya ǀ kāróḥ ǀ hávyam ǀ vīra ǀ hávyāḥ ǀ havante ǀdhíyaḥ ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ ajáram ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ ví-bhūtiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ vacasyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These earnest adorations of the much-desiring worshipper glorify you, hero,Indra, who are adorable; mounted on your car, undecaying, ever new, and to whom the wealth (of sacrifice), the most excellent opulence, proceeds.
verses.wilson_translation: These earnest adorations of the much-desiring worshipper glorify you, hero,Indra, who are adorable; mounted on your car, undecaying, ever new, and to whom the wealth (of sacrifice), the most excellent opulence, proceeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु स्तुष इंद्रं यो विदानो गिर्वाहसं गीर्भिर्यज्ञवृद्धं ।यस्य दिवमति मह्ना पृथिव्याः पुरुमायस्य रिरिचे महित्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuṣe ǀ índram ǀ yáḥ ǀ vídānaḥ ǀ gírvāhasam ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yajñá-vṛddham ǀyásya ǀ dívam ǀ áti ǀ mahnā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ puru-māyásya ǀ riricé ǀ mahi-tvám ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorifyi that Indrawho is propitiated by praises, exalted by sacrifices, who knows all things; the magnitude of whom, the possessor of various wisdom, exceeds in vastness (that of) heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorifyi that Indrawho is propitiated by praises, exalted by sacrifices, who knows all things; the magnitude of whom, the possessor of various wisdom, exceeds in vastness (that of) heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स इत्तमोऽवयुनं ततन्वत्सूर्येण वयुनवच्चकार ।कदा ते मर्ता अमृतस्य धामेयक्षंतो न मिनंति स्वधावः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ támaḥ ǀ avayunám ǀ tatanvát ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ vayúna-vat ǀ cakāra ǀkadā́ ǀ te ǀ mártāḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ íyakṣantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who made the indistinct, wide-spreading darkness distinct with the sun; whenever, possessor of strength, mortals are seeking to adore the dwelling of you who are an immortal, they harm not (any living being).
verses.wilson_translation: He who made the indistinct, wide-spreading darkness distinct with the sun; whenever, possessor of strength, mortals are seeking to adore the dwelling of you who are an immortal, they harm not (any living being).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ता चकार स कुह स्विदिंद्रः कमा जनं चरति कासु विक्षु ।कस्ते यज्ञो मनसे शं वराय को अर्क इंद्र कतमः स होता ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ sáḥ ǀ kúha ǀ svit ǀ índraḥ ǀ kám ǀ ā́ ǀ jánam ǀ carati ǀ kā́su ǀ vikṣú ǀkáḥ ǀ te ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ mánase ǀ śám ǀ várāya ǀ káḥ ǀ arkáḥ ǀ indra ǀ katamáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hótā ǁ
verses.english_translation: What is he, the Indrawho has done these deeds? What region does he frequent? Amog what people (does he abide)? What worship, Indra, gives satisfaction to your mind? What praise is able to gratify you? Which of your invokers (is most acceptable to you)?
verses.wilson_translation: What is he, the Indrawho has done these deeds? What region does he frequent? Amog what people (does he abide)? What worship, Indra, gives satisfaction to your mind? What praise is able to gratify you? Which of your invokers (is most acceptable to you)?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इदा हि ते वेविषतः पुराजाः प्रत्नास आसुः पुरुकृत्सखायः ।ये मध्यमास उत नूतनास उतावमस्य पुरुहूत बोधि ॥
verses.transliteration: idā́ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ véviṣataḥ ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ āsúḥ ǀ puru-kṛt ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀyé ǀ madhyamā́saḥ ǀ utá ǀ nū́tanāsaḥ ǀ utá ǀ avamásya ǀ puru-hūta ǀ bodhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Doer of many deeds, these adders, born in former times, engaged in sacred rites, have been, as they are now, your friends; so have those of mediaeval and those of recent (date); therefore, invoked of many, take notice of your (present) humble (adorer).
verses.wilson_translation: Doer of many deeds, these adders, born in former times, engaged in sacred rites, have been, as they are now, your friends; so have those of mediaeval and those of recent (date); therefore, invoked of many, take notice of your (present) humble (adorer).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं पृच्छंतोऽवरासः पराणि प्रत्ना त इंद्र श्रुत्यानु येमुः ।अर्चामसि वीर ब्रह्मवाहो यादेव विद्म तात्त्वा महांतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ pṛcchántaḥ ǀ ávarāsaḥ ǀ párāṇi ǀ pratnā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ śrútyā ǀ ánu ǀ yemuḥ ǀárcāmasi ǀ vīra ǀ brahma-vāhaḥ ǀ yā́t ǀ evá ǀ vidmá ǀ tā́t ǀ tvā ǀ mahā́ntam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Humble (worshippers), adoring him, commemorate,Indra, your excellent, ancient, and glorious (deeds); so, hero, who are attracted by prayer, we praise you who are mighty, for those great actions with which we are acquained.
verses.wilson_translation: Humble (worshippers), adoring him, commemorate,Indra, your excellent, ancient, and glorious (deeds); so, hero, who are attracted by prayer, we praise you who are mighty, for those great actions with which we are acquained.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पाजो रक्षसो वि तस्थे महि जज्ञानमभि तत्सु तिष्ठ ।तव प्रत्नेन युज्येन सख्या वज्रेण धृष्णो अप ता नुदस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tasthe ǀ máhi ǀ jajñānám ǀ abhí ǀ tát ǀ sú ǀ tiṣṭha ǀtáva ǀ pratnéna ǀ yújyena ǀ sákhyā ǀ vájreṇa ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ápa ǀ tā́ ǀ nudasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: The strength of therākṣasasis concentrated against you; bear up well against that mighty manifested (effort); scatter them, valiant (Indra), with your old associate, your friend, the thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: The strength of therākṣasasis concentrated against you; bear up well against that mighty manifested (effort); scatter them, valiant (Indra), with your old associate, your friend, the thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स तु श्रुधींद्र नूतनस्य ब्रह्मण्यतो वीर कारुधायः ।त्वं ह्यापिः प्रदिवि पितॄणां शश्वद्बभूथ सुहव एष्टौ ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ śrudhi ǀ indra ǀ nū́tanasya ǀ brahmaṇyatáḥ ǀ vīra ǀ kāru-dhāyaḥ ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ āpíḥ ǀ pra-dívi ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀ śáśvat ǀ babhū́tha ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ ā́-iṣṭau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Supporter of (your) worshippers, hero,Indra, listen (to the praises) of your present adorer, for you have always attended to invocations at sacrifices in ancient times, as the kinsman of our forefather.
verses.wilson_translation: Supporter of (your) worshippers, hero,Indra, listen (to the praises) of your present adorer, for you have always attended to invocations at sacrifices in ancient times, as the kinsman of our forefather.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रोतये वरुणं मित्रमिंद्रं मरुतः कृष्वावसे नो अद्य ।प्र पूषणं विष्णुमग्निं पुरंधिं सवितारमोषधीः पर्वतांश्च ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ ūtáye ǀ váruṇam ǀ mitrám ǀ índram ǀ marútaḥ ǀ kṛṣva ǀ ávase ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀprá ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ víṣṇum ǀ agním ǀ púram-dhim ǀ savitā́ram ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ párvatān ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Propitiate today, for our protection and preservation,Varuṇa,Mitra,Indraand the Maruts,Pūṣan,Viṣṇu,Agni, of many rites,Savitā, the herbs, the mountains.
verses.wilson_translation: Propitiate today, for our protection and preservation,Varuṇa,Mitra,Indraand the Maruts,Pūṣan,Viṣṇu,Agni, of many rites,Savitā, the herbs, the mountains.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इम उ त्वा पुरुशाक प्रयज्यो जरितारो अभ्यर्चंत्यर्कैः ।श्रुधी हवमा हुवतो हुवानो न त्वावाँ अन्यो अमृत त्वदस्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ puru-śāka ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ arkáiḥ ǀśrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ huvatáḥ ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ ná ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ anyáḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ tvát ǀ asti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, of great power, and to be devoutly worshipped, these your adorers glorify you with hymns; do you, who are invoked, hear the invocation of (him) invoking you, for there is no other divinity than you, immortal (Indra), such as you are.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, of great power, and to be devoutly worshipped, these your adorers glorify you with hymns; do you, who are invoked, hear the invocation of (him) invoking you, for there is no other divinity than you, immortal (Indra), such as you are.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू म आ वाचमुप याहि विद्वान्विश्वेभिः सूनो सहसो यजत्रैः ।ये अग्निजिह्वा ऋतसाप आसुर्ये मनुं चक्रुरुपरं दसाय ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́cam ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yájatraiḥ ǀyé ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ āsúḥ ǀ yé ǀ mánum ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ úparam ǀ dásāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come quickly, son of strength, you who know (all things), upon my prayer; together with all the adorable (divinities); they who, with the tongue of Agni, are partakers of the sacrifice, who rendered Manu(victorious) over his adversaries.
