verses.wilson_translation: Come quickly, son of strength, you who know (all things), upon my prayer; together with all the adorable (divinities); they who, with the tongue of Agni, are partakers of the sacrifice, who rendered Manu(victorious) over his adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो बोधि पुरएता सुगेषूत दुर्गेषु पथिकृद्विदानः ।ये अश्रमास उरवो वहिष्ठास्तेभिर्न इंद्राभि वक्षि वाजं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ su-géṣu ǀ utá ǀ duḥ-géṣu ǀ pathi-kṛ́t ǀ vídānaḥ ǀyé ǀ áśramāsaḥ ǀ urávaḥ ǀ váhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ vakṣi ǀ vā́jam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Constructor of paths, who are cognizant (of all things), be our preceder, whether in easy or difficult (ways); bring to us food,Indra, with those your (steeds), who are unwearied, large, and bearers of great burdens.
verses.wilson_translation: Constructor of paths, who are cognizant (of all things), be our preceder, whether in easy or difficult (ways); bring to us food,Indra, with those your (steeds), who are unwearied, large, and bearers of great burdens.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH these my hymns I glorify that Indra who is alone to be invoked by mortals,The Lord, the Mighty One, of manly vigour, victorious, Hero, true, and full of wisdom. Our sires of old,. Navagvas, sages seven, while urging him to show his might, extolled him,Dwelling on heights, swift, smiting down opponents, guileless in word, and in his thoughts most mighty. We seek that Indra to obtain his riches that bring much food, and men, and store of heroes.Bring us, Lord of Bay Steeds, to make us joyful, celestial wealth, abundant, undecaying. Tell thou us this, if at thy hand aforetime the earlier singers have obtained good fortune,What is thy share and portion, Strong Subduer, Asura-slayer, rich, invoked of many? He who for car-borne Indra, armed with thunder, hath a hymn, craving, deeply-piercing, fluent,Who sends a song effectual, firmly-grasping, and strength-bestowing, he comes near the mighty. Strong of thyself, thou by this art hast shattered, with thought-swift Parvata, him who waxed against thee,And, Mightiest! roaring! boldly rent in pieces things that were firmly fixed and never shaken. Him will we fit for you with new devotion, the strongest Ancient One, in ancient manner.So may that Indra, boundless, faithful Leader, conduct us o’er all places hard to traverse. Thou for the people who oppress hast kindled the earthly firmament and that of heaven.With heat, O Bull, on every side consume them: heat earth and flood for him who hates devotion. Of all the Heavenly Folk, of earthly creatures thou art the King, O God of splendid aspect.In thy right hand, O Indra, grasp die thunder: Eternal! thou destroyest all enchantments. Give us confirmed prosperity, O Indra, vast and exhaustless for the foe's subduing.Strengthen therewith the Ārya's hate and Dāsa's, and let the arms of Nahusas be mighty. Come with thy team which brings all blessings hither, Disposer, much-invoked, exceeding holy.Thou whom no fiend, no God can stay or hinder, come swittly with these Steeds in my direction.

verses.sanskrit: य एक इद्धव्यश्चर्षणीनामिंद्रं तं गीर्भिरभ्यर्च आभिः ।यः पत्यते वृषभो वृष्ण्यावान्त्सत्यः सत्वा पुरुमायः सहस्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ índram ǀ tám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arce ǀ ābhíḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ pátyate ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇya-vān ǀ satyáḥ ǀ sátvā ǀ puru-māyáḥ ǀ sáhasvān ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify with these praises,Indra, who alone is to be invoked by man; who comes (to his worshippers) the showerer (of benefits), the vigorous, the observer of truth, the subduer of foes, the possessor of manifold knowledge, the mighty.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify with these praises,Indra, who alone is to be invoked by man; who comes (to his worshippers) the showerer (of benefits), the vigorous, the observer of truth, the subduer of foes, the possessor of manifold knowledge, the mighty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु नः पूर्वे पितरो नवग्वाः सप्त विप्रासो अभि वाजयंतः ।नक्षद्दाभं ततुरिं पर्वतेष्ठामद्रोघवाचं मतिभिः शविष्ठं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ náva-gvāḥ ǀ saptá ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀnakṣat-dābhám ǀ táturim ǀ parvate-sthā́m ǀ ádrogha-vācam ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ śáviṣṭham ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him the seven sages, our ancient progenitors, performing the nine days' rite, were offerers of (sacrificial) food, celebrating with hymns the very strong (Indra), the humiliator of foes, the traverser of the heavens, he dweller in the clouds, whose commands are not to be disobeyed.
verses.wilson_translation: To him the seven sages, our ancient progenitors, performing the nine days' rite, were offerers of (sacrificial) food, celebrating with hymns the very strong (Indra), the humiliator of foes, the traverser of the heavens, he dweller in the clouds, whose commands are not to be disobeyed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमीमह इंद्रमस्य रायः पुरुवीरस्य नृवतः पुरुक्षोः ।यो अस्कृधोयुरजरः स्वर्वांतमा भर हरिवो मादयध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ īmahe ǀ índram ǀ asya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ puru-vī́rasya ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ puru-kṣóḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ áskṛdhoyuḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ sváḥ-vān ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ mādayádhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit that Indrafor wealth, comprehending numerous descendants, followers and much cattle, and which is undisturbed, imperishable, and the source of felicity, such riches, lord of steeds, bestow upon us to make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit that Indrafor wealth, comprehending numerous descendants, followers and much cattle, and which is undisturbed, imperishable, and the source of felicity, such riches, lord of steeds, bestow upon us to make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तन्नो वि वोचो यदि ते पुरा चिज्जरितार आनशुः सुम्नमिंद्र ।कस्ते भागः किं वयो दुध्र खिद्वः पुरुहूत पुरूवसोऽसुरघ्नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ vocaḥ ǀ yádi ǀ te ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ ānaśúḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ indra ǀkáḥ ǀ te ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ kím ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dudhra ǀ khidvaḥ ǀ púru-hūta ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ asura-ghnáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: If,Indra, your worshippers have formerly obtained felicity, confer that also upon us; irresistible Indra, subduer of foes, invoked of many, abounding in wealth, what is the portion, what the offering (due) to you who are the slayer of theasuras?
verses.wilson_translation: If,Indra, your worshippers have formerly obtained felicity, confer that also upon us; irresistible Indra, subduer of foes, invoked of many, abounding in wealth, what is the portion, what the offering (due) to you who are the slayer of theasuras?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं पृच्छंती वज्रहस्तं रथेष्ठामिंद्रं वेपी वक्वरी यस्य नू गीः ।तुविग्राभं तुविकूर्मिं रभोदां गातुमिषे नक्षते तुम्रमच्छ ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ pṛcchántī ǀ vájra-hastam ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ índram ǀ vépī ǀ vákvarī ǀ yásya ǀ nú ǀ gī́ḥ ǀtuvi-grābhám ǀ tuvi-kūrmím ǀ rabhaḥ-dā́m ǀ gātúm ǀ iṣe ǀ nákṣate ǀ túmram ǀ áccha ǁ
verses.english_translation: He whose ceremonial and eulogistic hymn is commemorating Indra, the holder of the thunderbolt, seated in his car, the accepter of many, the doer of many great deeds, the bestower of strength, proceeds promptly to acquire happiness, and encounters (with confidence) the malevolent.
verses.wilson_translation: He whose ceremonial and eulogistic hymn is commemorating Indra, the holder of the thunderbolt, seated in his car, the accepter of many, the doer of many great deeds, the bestower of strength, proceeds promptly to acquire happiness, and encounters (with confidence) the malevolent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया ह त्यं मायया वावृधानं मनोजुवा स्वतवः पर्वतेन ।अच्युता चिद्वीळिता स्वोजो रुजो वि दृळ्हा धृषता विरप्शिन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ ha ǀ tyám ǀ māyáyā ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ manaḥ-júvā ǀ sva-tavaḥ ǀ párvatena ǀácyutā ǀ cit ǀ vīḷitā́ ǀ su-ojaḥ ǀ rujáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ vi-rapśin ǁ
verses.english_translation: Self-invigorated Indra, you have crushed by your knotted (thunderbolt), quick as thought, that Vṛtra, growing in strength by this cunning; very radiant and mighty (Indra), you have demolished by (your) irresistible (shaft) the unyielding, compact, and strong (cities of theasuras).
verses.wilson_translation: Self-invigorated Indra, you have crushed by your knotted (thunderbolt), quick as thought, that Vṛtra, growing in strength by this cunning; very radiant and mighty (Indra), you have demolished by (your) irresistible (shaft) the unyielding, compact, and strong (cities of theasuras).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं वो धिया नव्यस्या शविष्ठं प्रत्नं प्रत्नवत्परितंसयध्यै ।स नो वक्षदनिमानः सुवह्मेंद्रो विश्वान्यति दुर्गहाणि ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ návyasyā ǀ śáviṣṭham ǀ pratnám ǀ pratna-vát ǀ pari-taṃsayádhyai ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vakṣat ǀ ani-mānáḥ ǀ su-váhnā ǀ índraḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ áti ǀ duḥ-gáhāni ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I have undertaken) to spread around with a new hymn, as i was done of old, (the glory of) you, the ancient and most mighty (Indra); may that Indra, who is illimitable, and is a sure conveyance, bear us over all difficulties.
verses.wilson_translation: (I have undertaken) to spread around with a new hymn, as i was done of old, (the glory of) you, the ancient and most mighty (Indra); may that Indra, who is illimitable, and is a sure conveyance, bear us over all difficulties.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ जनाय द्रुह्वणे पार्थिवानि दिव्यानि दीपयोऽंतरिक्षा ।तपा वृषन्विश्वतः शोचिषा तान्ब्रह्मद्विषे शोचय क्षामपश्च ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jánāya ǀ drúhvaṇe ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ divyā́ni ǀ dīpayaḥ ǀ antárikṣā ǀtápa ǀ vṛṣan ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ tā́n ǀ brahma-dvíṣe ǀ śocaya ǀ kṣā́m ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Make hot the regions of earth, of heaven, of mid air, for the oppressive race (of therākṣasas); showerer (of benefits), consume them everywhere with your radiance, make the heaven and the firmament (too) hot for the impious.
verses.wilson_translation: Make hot the regions of earth, of heaven, of mid air, for the oppressive race (of therākṣasas); showerer (of benefits), consume them everywhere with your radiance, make the heaven and the firmament (too) hot for the impious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भुवो जनस्य दिव्यस्य राजा पार्थिवस्य जगतस्त्वेषसंदृक् ।धिष्व वज्रं दक्षिण इंद्र हस्ते विश्वा अजुर्य दयसे वि मायाः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhúvaḥ ǀ jánasya ǀ divyásya ǀ rā́jā ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ jágataḥ ǀ tveṣa-sandṛk ǀdhiṣvá ǀ vájram ǀ dákṣiṇe ǀ indra ǀ háste ǀ víśvā ǀ ajurya ǀ dayase ǀ ví ǀ māyā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bright-flaming Indra, you are the king of the people of heaven, and of the moving races of earth; grasp in your righthandthe thunderbolt, wherewith, Indra, who are beyond all praise, you baffle all the devices (of theasuras).
verses.wilson_translation: Bright-flaming Indra, you are the king of the people of heaven, and of the moving races of earth; grasp in your righthandthe thunderbolt, wherewith, Indra, who are beyond all praise, you baffle all the devices (of theasuras).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ संयतमिंद्र णः स्वस्तिं शत्रुतूर्याय बृहतीममृध्रां ।यया दासान्यार्याणि वृत्रा करो वज्रिन्त्सुतुका नाहुषाणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sam-yátam ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ svastím ǀ śatru-tū́ryāya ǀ bṛhatī́m ǀ ámṛdhrām ǀyáyā ǀ dā́sāni ǀ ā́ryāṇi ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ káraḥ ǀ vajrin ǀ su-túkā ǀ nā́huṣāṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brin to us,Indra, concentrated, vast and unassailable prosperity beyond the reach of enemies, and by which, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have rendered human enemies, whether DāsasorĀryas, easy to be overcome.
verses.wilson_translation: Brin to us,Indra, concentrated, vast and unassailable prosperity beyond the reach of enemies, and by which, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have rendered human enemies, whether DāsasorĀryas, easy to be overcome.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो नियुद्भिः पुरुहूत वेधो विश्ववाराभिरा गहि प्रयज्यो ।न या अदेवो वरते न देव आभिर्याहि तूयमा मद्र्यद्रिक् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vedhaḥ ǀ viśvá-vārābhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǀná ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ várate ǀ ná ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ābhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ madryadrík ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invoked of many, creator, object of sacrifices, come to us with your all-admired steeds, whom neitherasuranor deity arrests; come with them quickly to our presence.
verses.wilson_translation: Invoked of many, creator, object of sacrifices, come to us with your all-admired steeds, whom neitherasuranor deity arrests; come with them quickly to our presence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU art attached to pressed-out Soma, Indra, at laud, at prayer, and when the hymn is chanted;Or when with yoked Bays, Maghavan, thou comest, O Indra, bearing in thine arms the thunder. Or when on that decisive day thou holpest the presser of the juice at Vṛtra's slaughter;Or when thou, while the strong one feared, undaunted, gavest to death, Indra, the daring Dasyus. Let Indra drink the pressed-out Soma, Helper and mighty Guide of him who sings his praises.He gives the hero room who pours oblations, and treasure even to the lowly singer. E’en humble rites with his Bay steeds he visits: he wields the bolt, drinks Soma, gives us cattle.He makes the valiant rich in store of heroes, accepts our praise and hears the singer's calling. What he hath longed for we have brought to Indra, who from the days of old hath done us service.While Soma flows we will sing hymn, and laud him, so that our prayer may streng. then Indra's vigour. Thou hast made prayer the means of thine exalting, therefore we wait on thee with hymns, O Indra.May we, by the pressed Soma, Somadrinker! bring thee, with sacrifice, blissful sweet refreshment. Mark well our sacrificial cake, delighted Indra, drink Soma and the milk commingled.Here on the sacrificer's grass be seated: give ample room to thy devoted servant. O Mighty One, be joyful as thou willest. Let these our sacrifices reach and find thee;And may this hymn and these our invocations turn thee, whom many men invoke, to help us. Friends, when thejuices flow, replenish duly your own, your bounteous Indra with the Soma.Will it not aid him to support us? Indra. spares him who sheds the juice to win his favour. While Soma flowed, thus Indra hath been lauded, Ruler of nobles, mid the Bharadvājas,That Indra may become the singer's patron and give him wealth in every kind of treasure.

verses.sanskrit: सुत इत्त्वं निमिश्ल इंद्र सोमे स्तोमे ब्रह्मणि शस्यमान उक्थे ।यद्वा युक्ताभ्यां मघवन्हरिभ्यां बिभ्रद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिंद्र यासि ॥
verses.transliteration: suté ǀ ít ǀ tvám ǀ ní-miślaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sóme ǀ stóme ǀ bráhmaṇi ǀ śasyámāne ǀ ukthé ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ yuktā́bhyām ǀ magha-van ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ bíbhrat ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ indra ǀ yā́si ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, when the Somais being effused, the sacred hymn chanted, the prayer recited, be you prepared (to harness your horses), or,Maghavan, with your horses ready harnessed, come (hither), bearing the thunderbolt in yourhand.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, when the Somais being effused, the sacred hymn chanted, the prayer recited, be you prepared (to harness your horses), or,Maghavan, with your horses ready harnessed, come (hither), bearing the thunderbolt in yourhand.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा दिवि पार्ये सुष्विमिंद्र वृत्रहत्येऽवसि शूरसातौ ।यद्वा दक्षस्य बिभ्युषो अबिभ्यदरंधयः शर्धत इंद्र दस्यून् ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ diví ǀ pā́rye ǀ súsvim ǀ indra ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ ávasi ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ bibhyúṣaḥ ǀ ábibhyat ǀ árandhayaḥ ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀ indra ǀ dásyūn ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or as, although engaged in heaven in the hero-animating conflict with foes, you protect the offerer of the libation, and humblest, undaunted Indra, the Dasyus, the disturbers of the pious and terrified worshipper, (so do you come when thesomais effused.
verses.wilson_translation: Or as, although engaged in heaven in the hero-animating conflict with foes, you protect the offerer of the libation, and humblest, undaunted Indra, the Dasyus, the disturbers of the pious and terrified worshipper, (so do you come when thesomais effused.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पाता सुतमिंद्रो अस्तु सोमं प्रणेनीरुग्रो जरितारमूती ।कर्ता वीराय सुष्वय उ लोकं दाता वसु स्तुवते कीरये चित् ॥
verses.transliteration: pā́tā ǀ sutám ǀ índraḥ ǀ astu ǀ sómam ǀ pra-nenī́ḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ ūtī́ ǀkártā ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ súsvaye ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ dā́tā ǀ vásu ǀ stuvaté ǀ kīráye ǀ cit ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indrabe the drinker of the effusedsoma, he who is the fierce conductor of the worshipper to security; may he be the donor of the world to the presenter of the libation, the giver of wealth to the man who adores him.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indrabe the drinker of the effusedsoma, he who is the fierce conductor of the worshipper to security; may he be the donor of the world to the presenter of the libation, the giver of wealth to the man who adores him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गंतेयांति सवना हरिभ्यां बभ्रिर्वज्रं पपिः सोमं ददिर्गाः ।कर्ता वीरं नर्यं सर्ववीरं श्रोता हवं गृणतः स्तोमवाहाः ॥
verses.transliteration: gántā ǀ íyanti ǀ sávanā ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ babhríḥ ǀ vájram ǀ papíḥ ǀ sómam ǀ dadíḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀkártā ǀ vīrám ǀ náryam ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ śrótā ǀ hávam ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ stóma-vāhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra, with his steeds, come o us as many (daily) rites (as may be celebrated), bearing the thundeerbolt, drinking thesoma, bestowing cattle, granting manly and multiplied posterity, hearing the invocation of his adorer, and being the accenter of (our) praises.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, with his steeds, come o us as many (daily) rites (as may be celebrated), bearing the thundeerbolt, drinking thesoma, bestowing cattle, granting manly and multiplied posterity, hearing the invocation of his adorer, and being the accenter of (our) praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मै वयं यद्वावान तद्विविष्म इंद्राय यो नः प्रदिवो अपस्कः ।सुते सोमे स्तुमसि शंसदुक्थेंद्राय ब्रह्म वर्धनं यथासत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ásmai ǀ vayám ǀ yát ǀ vavā́na ǀ tát ǀ viviṣmaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ ápaḥ ǀ káríti káḥ ǀsuté ǀ sóme ǀ stumási ǀ śáṃsat ǀ ukthā́ ǀ índrāya ǀ bráhma ǀ várdhanam ǀ yáthā ǀ ásat ǁ
verses.english_translation: To that Indra, who of old has rendered us good offices, we address (the praise) that he is plural ased by; we celebrate him when thesomais effused, repeating the prayer that the (sacrificial) food (offered) to Indra may be for his augmentation.
verses.wilson_translation: To that Indra, who of old has rendered us good offices, we address (the praise) that he is plural ased by; we celebrate him when thesomais effused, repeating the prayer that the (sacrificial) food (offered) to Indra may be for his augmentation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणि हि चकृषे वर्धनानि तावत्त इंद्र मतिभिर्विविष्मः ।सुते सोमे सुतपाः शंतमानि रांद्र्या क्रियास्म वक्षणानि यज्ञैः ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhmāṇi ǀ hí ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ várdhanāni ǀ tā́vat ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ viviṣmaḥ ǀsuté ǀ sóme ǀ suta-pāḥ ǀ śám-tamāni ǀ rā́ndryā ǀ kriyāsma ǀ vákṣaṇāni ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since,Indra, you have made the (sacred) prayers (the means of) your augmentation, we address such to you, along with our praises; may we offer gratifying and acceptable eulogies to the drinker of the effused libation, with (our) sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Since,Indra, you have made the (sacred) prayers (the means of) your augmentation, we address such to you, along with our praises; may we offer gratifying and acceptable eulogies to the drinker of the effused libation, with (our) sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो बोधि पुरोळाशं रराणः पिबा तु सोमं गोऋजीकमिंद्र ।एदं बर्हिर्यजमानस्य सीदोरुं कृधि त्वायत उ लोकं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀ píba ǀ tú ǀ sómam ǀ gó-ṛjīkam ǀ indra ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sīda ǀ urúm ǀ kṛdhi ǀ tvā-yatáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accept,Indra, who are condescending, our cakes and butter; drink thesomamixed with curds; sit down upon this sacred grass (strewn by) the worshipper; grant ample possessions to him who depends on you.
verses.wilson_translation: Accept,Indra, who are condescending, our cakes and butter; drink thesomamixed with curds; sit down upon this sacred grass (strewn by) the worshipper; grant ample possessions to him who depends on you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मंदस्वा ह्यनु जोषमुग्र प्र त्वा यज्ञास इमे अश्नुवंतु ।प्रेमे हवासः पुरुहूतमस्मे आ त्वेयं धीरवस इंद्र यम्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mandasva ǀ hí ǀ ánu ǀ jóṣam ǀ ugra ǀ prá ǀ tvā ǀ yajñā́saḥ ǀ imé ǀ aśnuvantu ǀprá ǀ imé ǀ hávāsaḥ ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ asmé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ iyám ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ ávase ǀ indra ǀ yamyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rejoice, fierce Indra, according to your plural asure; let these libations reach you; invoked of many, may these our invocations ascend to you; may this praise influence you for our protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Rejoice, fierce Indra, according to your plural asure; let these libations reach you; invoked of many, may these our invocations ascend to you; may this praise influence you for our protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं वः सखायः सं यथा सुतेषु सोमेभिरीं पृणता भोजमिंद्रं ।कुवित्तस्मा असति नो भराय न सुष्विमिंद्रोऽवसे मृधाति ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ yáthā ǀ sutéṣu ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ īm ǀ pṛṇata ǀ bhojám ǀ índram ǀkuvít ǀ tásmai ǀ ásati ǀ naḥ ǀ bhárāya ǀ ná ǀ súsvim ǀ índraḥ ǀ ávase ǀ mṛdhāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Friends, when the libations are effused, do you satisfy that liberal Indrawith thesoma; let there be plural nty for him, that (he may provide) for our nourishmen; Indra never neglects the care of him who presents copious oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Friends, when the libations are effused, do you satisfy that liberal Indrawith thesoma; let there be plural nty for him, that (he may provide) for our nourishmen; Indra never neglects the care of him who presents copious oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवेदिंद्रः सुते अस्तावि सोमे भरद्वाजेषु क्षयदिन्मघोनः ।असद्यथा जरित्र उत सूरिरिंद्रो रायो विश्ववारस्य दाता ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ suté ǀ astāvi ǀ sóme ǀ bharát-vājeṣu ǀ kṣáyat ǀ ít ǀ maghónaḥ ǀásat ǀ yáthā ǀ jaritré ǀ utá ǀ sūríḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ viśvá-vārasya ǀ dātā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus has Indra, the lord of the opulent, been glorified by the Bhaāradvājas, upon the libation being effused, that he may be th director of his eulogist (to virtue), that Indra may be the giver of all desirable riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Thus has Indra, the lord of the opulent, been glorified by the Bhaāradvājas, upon the libation being effused, that he may be th director of his eulogist (to virtue), that Indra may be the giver of all desirable riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . STRONG rapturous joy, praise, glory are with Indra: impetuous God, he quaffs the juice of Soma:That Maghavan whom men must laud with singing, Heaven-dweller, King of songs, whose help is lasting. He, Friend of man, most wise, victorious Hero, hears, with far-reaching aid, the singer call him.Excellent, Praise of Men, the bard's Supporter, Strong, he gives strength, extolled in holy synod. The lofty axle of thy wheels, O Hero, is not surpassed by heaven and earth in greatness.Like branches of a tree, Invoked of many manifold aids spring forth from thee, O Indra. Strong Lord, thine energies, endowed with vigour, are like the paths of kine converging homeward.Like bonds of cord, Indra, that bind the younglings, no bonds are they, O thou of boundless bounty. One act to-day, another act tomorrow oft Indra makes what is not yet existeni.Here have we Mitra, Varuṇa, and Pūṣan to overcome the foeman's domination. By song and sacrifice men brought the waters from thee, as from a mountain's ridge, O Indra.Urging thy might, with these fair lauds they seek thee, O theme of song, as horses rush tobattle. That Indra whom nor months nor autumn seasons wither with age, nor fleeting days enfeeble,—Still may his body Wax, e’en now so mighty, glorified by the lauds and hymns that praise him. Extolled, he bends not to the strong, the steadfast, nor to the bold incited by the Dasyu.High mountains are as level plains to Indra: even in the deep he finds firm ground to rest on. Impetuous Speeder through all depth and distance, give strengthening food, thou drinker of the juices.Stand up erect to help us, unreluctant, what time the gloom of night brightens to morning. Hasting to help, come hither and protect him, keep him from harm when he is here, O Indra.At home, abroad, from injury preserve him. May brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sanskrit: वृषा मद इंद्रे श्लोक उक्था सचा सोमेषु सुतपा ऋजीषी ।अर्चत्र्यो मघवा नृभ्य उक्थैर्द्युक्षो राजा गिरामक्षितोतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǀ índre ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ sácā ǀ sómeṣu ǀ suta-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀarcatryáḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ dyukṣáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ girā́m ǀ ákṣita-ūtiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: At the rites at whichsoma(is offered) the exhilaration (produced) in Indrais a shower (of benefits to the offerer); so is the chanted hymn with the (recited) prayer, therefore the drinker of the soma, the partaker of the stale soma,Maghavan, is to be propitiated by men with praises; dweller in heaven, he is the lord of sacred songs, unwearied in the protection (of his votaries).
verses.wilson_translation: At the rites at whichsoma(is offered) the exhilaration (produced) in Indrais a shower (of benefits to the offerer); so is the chanted hymn with the (recited) prayer, therefore the drinker of the soma, the partaker of the stale soma,Maghavan, is to be propitiated by men with praises; dweller in heaven, he is the lord of sacred songs, unwearied in the protection (of his votaries).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ततुरिर्वीरो नर्यो विचेताः श्रोता हवं गृणत उर्व्यूतिः ।वसुः शंसो नरां कारुधाया वाजी स्तुतो विदथे दाति वाजं ॥
verses.transliteration: táturiḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀ śrótā ǀ hávam ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ urví-ūtiḥ ǀvásuḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ kārú-dhāyāḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ dāti ǀ vā́jam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The surpasser (of foes), a hero, the friend of man, the discriminator, the hearer of the invocation, the great protector of his adorers, the giver of dwelings, the ruler of men, the cherisher of his worshippers, the bestower of food, grants us, when glorified at the sacrifice, (abundant) sustenance.
verses.wilson_translation: The surpasser (of foes), a hero, the friend of man, the discriminator, the hearer of the invocation, the great protector of his adorers, the giver of dwelings, the ruler of men, the cherisher of his worshippers, the bestower of food, grants us, when glorified at the sacrifice, (abundant) sustenance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अक्षो न चक्र्योः शूर बृहन्प्र ते मह्ना रिरिचे रोदस्योः ।वृक्षस्य नु ते पुरुहूत वया व्यूतयो रुरुहुरिंद्र पूर्वीः ॥
verses.transliteration: ákṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakryóḥ ǀ śūra ǀ bṛhán ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ mahnā́ ǀ ririce ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀvṛkṣásya ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vayā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ ruruhuḥ ǀ indra ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mighty hero, by your magnitude, (the exten) of heaven and earth is exceeded, as the axle by the (circumerfence of the) wheels; invoked of many, your numerous benefits,Indra, spread out like the branches of a tree.
verses.wilson_translation: Mighty hero, by your magnitude, (the exten) of heaven and earth is exceeded, as the axle by the (circumerfence of the) wheels; invoked of many, your numerous benefits,Indra, spread out like the branches of a tree.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शचीवतस्ते पुरुशाक शाका गवामिव स्रुतयः संचरणीः ।वत्सानां न तंतयस्त इंद्र दामन्वंतो अदामानः सुदामन् ॥
verses.transliteration: śácī-vataḥ ǀ te ǀ puru-śāka ǀ śā́kāḥ ǀ gávām-iva ǀ srutáyaḥ ǀ sam-cáraṇīḥ ǀvatsā́nām ǀ ná ǀ tantáyaḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ dā́man-vantaḥ ǀ adāmā́naḥ ǀ su-dāman ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accomplisher of many acts, the energies of you who are (ever) active (congregate from all directions), like the converging tracks of cattle; they are the bonds (of foes), themselves unfettered, munificent Indra, like the tethers of (many) calves.
verses.wilson_translation: Accomplisher of many acts, the energies of you who are (ever) active (congregate from all directions), like the converging tracks of cattle; they are the bonds (of foes), themselves unfettered, munificent Indra, like the tethers of (many) calves.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अन्यदद्य कर्वरमन्यदु श्वोऽसच्च सन्मुहुराचक्रिरिंद्रः ।मित्रो नो अत्र वरुणश्च पूषार्यो वशस्य पर्येतास्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: anyát ǀ adyá ǀ kárvaram ǀ anyát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śváḥ ǀ ásat ǀ ca ǀ sát ǀ múhuḥ ǀ ā-cakríḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ váśasya ǀ pari-etā́ ǀ asti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraachieves one act today, another tomorrow, evil and good repeatedly; may he, and Mitra,Varuṇa,Pūṣan,Arya, be on this occasion promoters of the desired result.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraachieves one act today, another tomorrow, evil and good repeatedly; may he, and Mitra,Varuṇa,Pūṣan,Arya, be on this occasion promoters of the desired result.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरिंद्रानयंत यज्ञैः ।तं त्वाभिः सुष्टुतिभिर्वाजयंत आजिं न जग्मुर्गिर्वाहो अश्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ tvát ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatasya ǀ pṛṣṭhā́t ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ anayanta ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ sustutí-bhiḥ ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀ ājím ǀ ná ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ girvāhaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By praises and by sacrifices,Indra, (men) bring down (what they desire) from you, as the waters (descend) from the top of the mountain; desirous of food, they approach you, who are accessible to praise, with these their eulogies, as (eagerly as) coursers rush to battle.
verses.wilson_translation: By praises and by sacrifices,Indra, (men) bring down (what they desire) from you, as the waters (descend) from the top of the mountain; desirous of food, they approach you, who are accessible to praise, with these their eulogies, as (eagerly as) coursers rush to battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न यं जरंति शरदो न मासा न द्याव इंद्रमवकर्शयंति ।वृद्धस्य चिद्वर्धतामस्य तनूः स्तोमेभिरुक्थैश्च शस्यमाना ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ járanti ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mā́sāḥ ǀ ná ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ava-karśáyanti ǀvṛddhásya ǀ cit ǀ vardhatām ǀ asya ǀ tanū́ḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ca ǀ śasyámānā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the person n of that vast Indra, celebrated by praises and prayers, ever increase; Indra, whom neither years nor months make old, nor days enfeeble.
verses.wilson_translation: May the person n of that vast Indra, celebrated by praises and prayers, ever increase; Indra, whom neither years nor months make old, nor days enfeeble.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न वीळवे नमते न स्थिराय न शर्धते दस्युजूताय स्तवान् ।अज्रा इंद्रस्य गिरयश्चिदृष्वा गंभीरे चिद्भवति गाधमस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ vīḷáve ǀ námate ǀ ná ǀ sthirā́ya ǀ ná ǀ śárdhate ǀ dásyu-jūtāya ǀ stavā́n ǀájrāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ṛṣvā́ḥ ǀ gambhīré ǀ cit ǀ bhavati ǀ gādhám ǀ asmai ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorified by us, he bows not down to the robust, nor to the resolute, nor to the person vering (worshipper) who is instrumental gated by the (irreligious)Dasyus; the lofty mountains are easy of access o Indra; to him there is a bottom in the (lowest) deep.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorified by us, he bows not down to the robust, nor to the resolute, nor to the person vering (worshipper) who is instrumental gated by the (irreligious)Dasyus; the lofty mountains are easy of access o Indra; to him there is a bottom in the (lowest) deep.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गंभीरेण न उरुणामत्रिन्प्रेषो यंधि सुतपावन्वाजान् ।स्था ऊ षु ऊर्ध्व ऊती अरिषण्यन्नक्तोर्व्युष्टौ परितक्म्यायां ॥
verses.transliteration: gambhīréṇa ǀ naḥ ǀ urúṇā ǀ amatrin ǀ prá ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ yandhi ǀ suta-pāvan ǀ vā́jān ǀsthā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ áriṣaṇyan ǀ aktóḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Powerful Indra, drinker of thesoma, (actuated) by a profound and comprehensive (purpose), grant us food and strength; be ever diligent, benevolent Indra, for our protection by day and by night.
verses.wilson_translation: Powerful Indra, drinker of thesoma, (actuated) by a profound and comprehensive (purpose), grant us food and strength; be ever diligent, benevolent Indra, for our protection by day and by night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सचस्व नायमवसे अभीक इतो वा तमिंद्र पाहि रिषः ।अमा चैनमरण्ये पाहि रिषो मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: sácasva ǀ nāyám ǀ ávase ǀ abhī́ke ǀ itáḥ ǀ vā ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ pāhi ǀ riṣáḥ ǀamā́ ǀ ca ǀ enam ǀ áraṇye ǀ pāhi ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accompany,Indra, the leader in battle for his protection; defend him against a near (or distant) foe; protect him from an enemy, whether in (his) house or in a forest, and may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, be happy for a hundred winters.
verses.wilson_translation: Accompany,Indra, the leader in battle for his protection; defend him against a near (or distant) foe; protect him from an enemy, whether in (his) house or in a forest, and may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, be happy for a hundred winters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH thine assistance, O thou Mighty Indra, be it the least, the midmost, or the highest,—Great with those aids and by these powers support us, Strong God! in battle that subdues our foemen. With these discomfit hosts that fight against us, and check the opponent's wrath, thyself uninjured.With these chase all our foes to every quarter: subdue the tribes of Dāsas to the Ārya. Those who array themselves as foes to smite us, O Indra, be they kin or be they strangers,—Strike thou their manly strength that it be feeble, and drive in headlong flight our foemen backward. With strength of limb the hero slays the hero, when bright in arms they range them for the combat.When two opposing hosts contend in battle for seed and offspring, waters, kine, or corn-lands. Yet no strong man hath conquered thee, no hero, no brave, no warrior trusting in his valour.Not one of these is match for thee, O Indra. Thou far surpassest all these living creatures. He is the Lord of both these armies' valour when the commanders call them to the conflict:When with their ranks expanded they are fighting with a great foe or for a home with heroes. And when the people stir themselves for battle, be thou their saviour, Indra, and protector,And theirs, thy manliest of our friends, the pious, the chiefs who have installed us priests, O Indra. To thee for high dominion hath been for evermore, for slaughtering the Vṛtras,All lordly power and might, O Holy Indra, given by Gods for victory in battle. So urge our hosts together in the combats: yield up the godless bands that fight against us.Singing, at morn may we find thee with favour, yea, Indra, and e’en now, we Bharadvājas.

verses.sanskrit: या त ऊतिरवमा या परमा या मध्यमेंद्र शुष्मिन्नस्ति ।ताभिरू षु वृत्रहत्येऽवीर्न एभिश्च वाजैर्महान्न उग्र ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ avamā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ paramā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ madhyamā́ ǀ indra ǀ śuṣmin ǀ ásti ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ avīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ ca ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ naḥ ǀ ugra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Powerful Indra, with these (your protections), whether the protection be little, great or middlin, defend us for the destruction of our foes; supply us, fierce Indra, who are mighty, with those viands (that are needed).
verses.wilson_translation: Powerful Indra, with these (your protections), whether the protection be little, great or middlin, defend us for the destruction of our foes; supply us, fierce Indra, who are mighty, with those viands (that are needed).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आभिः स्पृधो मिथतीररिषण्यन्नमित्रस्य व्यथया मन्युमिंद्र ।आभिर्विश्वा अभियुजो विषूचीरार्याय विशोऽव तारीर्दासीः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́bhiḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ mithatī́ḥ ǀ áriṣaṇyan ǀ amítrasya ǀ vyathaya ǀ manyúm ǀ indra ǀā́bhiḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ víṣūcīḥ ǀ ā́ryāya ǀ víśaḥ ǀ áva ǀ tārīḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Induced) by these (praises), protecting our assailing host, baffle,Indra, the wrath of the enemy; (induced) by them, overthrow, on the part of theĀrya, all the servile people everywhere abiding.
verses.wilson_translation: (Induced) by these (praises), protecting our assailing host, baffle,Indra, the wrath of the enemy; (induced) by them, overthrow, on the part of theĀrya, all the servile people everywhere abiding.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र जामय उत येऽजामयोऽर्वाचीनासो वनुषो युयुज्रे ।त्वमेषां विथुरा शवांसि जहि वृष्ण्यानि कृणुही पराचः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ yé ǀ ájāmayaḥ ǀ arvācīnā́saḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ yuyujré ǀtvám ǀ eṣām ǀ vithurā́ ǀ śávāṃsi ǀ jahí ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ párācaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Annihilate,Indra, the strength of those who, whether kinsmen or unrelated, present themselves before us, exerting themselves as adversaries; enfeeble their prowess, put them to fight.
verses.wilson_translation: Annihilate,Indra, the strength of those who, whether kinsmen or unrelated, present themselves before us, exerting themselves as adversaries; enfeeble their prowess, put them to fight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शूरो वा शूरं वनते शरीरैस्तनूरुचा तरुषि यत्कृण्वैते ।तोके वा गोषु तनये यदप्सु वि क्रंदसी उर्वरासु ब्रवैते ॥
verses.transliteration: śū́raḥ ǀ vā ǀ śū́ram ǀ vanate ǀ śárīraiḥ ǀ tanū-rúcā ǀ táruṣi ǀ yát ǀ kṛṇváite íti ǀtoké ǀ vā ǀ góṣu ǀ tánaye ǀ yát ǀ ap-sú ǀ ví ǀ krándasī íti ǀ urvárāsu ǀ brávaite íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The hero, (favoured by you), assuredly slays the (hostile) hero by his bodily prowess, when, both excelling in person nal strength, they strive together in conflict, or when, clamorous, they dispute for (the sake of) sons, of grandson, of cattle, of water, of land.
verses.wilson_translation: The hero, (favoured by you), assuredly slays the (hostile) hero by his bodily prowess, when, both excelling in person nal strength, they strive together in conflict, or when, clamorous, they dispute for (the sake of) sons, of grandson, of cattle, of water, of land.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि त्वा शूरो न तुरो न धृष्णुर्न त्वा योधो मन्यमानो युयोध ।इंद्र नकिष्ट्वा प्रत्यस्त्येषां विश्वा जातान्यभ्यसि तानि ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ tvā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ turáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ yodháḥ ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ yuyódha ǀíndra ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ práti ǀ asti ǀ eṣām ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ abhí ǀ asi ǀ tā́ni ǁ
verses.english_translation: But you (no one) resists, neither the hero, nor the fleet runner, nor the resolute, nor the combatant confiding (in his valour); neither of these,Indra, is a match for you; you are superior to all these person ns.
verses.wilson_translation: But you (no one) resists, neither the hero, nor the fleet runner, nor the resolute, nor the combatant confiding (in his valour); neither of these,Indra, is a match for you; you are superior to all these person ns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पत्यत उभयोर्नृम्णमयोर्यदी वेधसः समिथे हवंते ।वृत्रे वा महो नृवति क्षये वा व्यचस्वंता यदि वितंतसैते ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ patyate ǀ ubháyoḥ ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ayóḥ ǀ yádi ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ sam-ithé ǀ hávante ǀvṛtré ǀ vā ǀ maháḥ ǀ nṛ-váti ǀ kṣáye ǀ vā ǀ vyácasvantā ǀ yádi ǀ vitantasáite íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Of both these (disputants), that one acquires wealth whose priests invoke (Indra) at the sacrifice, whether the conten emulous for (the overthrow of) a powerful enemy, or for a dwelling peopled with dependants.
verses.wilson_translation: Of both these (disputants), that one acquires wealth whose priests invoke (Indra) at the sacrifice, whether the conten emulous for (the overthrow of) a powerful enemy, or for a dwelling peopled with dependants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध स्मा ते चर्षणयो यदेजानिंद्र त्रातोत भवा वरूता ।अस्माकासो ये नृतमासो अर्य इंद्र सूरयो दधिरे पुरो नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ te ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ éjān ǀ índra ǀ trātā́ ǀ utá ǀ bhava ǀ varūtā́ ǀasmā́kāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ nṛ́-tamāsaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ índra ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ puráḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Therefore,Indra, when your people tremble (with fear), protect them; be to them a defender; may those who are our chief leaders be enjoyers (of your favour), as well as those (your) worshippers who have plural ced us foremost (to perform the sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Therefore,Indra, when your people tremble (with fear), protect them; be to them a defender; may those who are our chief leaders be enjoyers (of your favour), as well as those (your) worshippers who have plural ced us foremost (to perform the sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु ते दायि मह इंद्रियाय सत्रा ते विश्वमनु वृत्रहत्ये ।अनु क्षत्रमनु सहो यजत्रेंद्र देवेभिरनु ते नृषह्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ te ǀ dāyi ǀ mahé ǀ indriyā́ya ǀ satrā́ ǀ te ǀ víśvam ǀ ánu ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀánu ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ánu ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ yajatra ǀ índra ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ te ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǁ
verses.english_translation: All (power) has been successively conceded verily to you,Indra, who are mighty, for the destruction of the foe; suitable vigour, suitable strength in battle (has been given) to you, adorable Indra, by the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: All (power) has been successively conceded verily to you,Indra, who are mighty, for the destruction of the foe; suitable vigour, suitable strength in battle (has been given) to you, adorable Indra, by the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा नः स्पृधः समजा समत्स्विंद्र रारंधि मिथतीरदेवीः ।विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणंतो भरद्वाजा उत त इंद्र नूनं ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ aja ǀ samát-su ǀ índra ǀ rarandhí ǀ mithatī́ḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǀvidyā́ma ǀ vástoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ bharát-vājāḥ ǀ utá ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ nūnám ǁ
verses.english_translation: So (glorified by us),Indra, animate us (to overcome) our enemies in battle; overthrow our pious, malevolent (foes), and may we,Bhāradvājas, praising you, assuredly possess habitations, with (abundant) food.
verses.wilson_translation: So (glorified by us),Indra, animate us (to overcome) our enemies in battle; overthrow our pious, malevolent (foes), and may we,Bhāradvājas, praising you, assuredly possess habitations, with (abundant) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVI. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O INDRA, hear us. Raining down the Soma, we call on thee to win us mighty valour.Give us strong succour on the day of trial, when the tribes gather on the field of battle. The warrior, son of warrior sire, invokes thee, to gain great strength that may be won as booty:To thee, the brave man's Lord, the fiends' subduer, he looks when fighting hand to hand for cattle. Thou didst impel the sage to win the daylight, didst ruin Śuṣṇa for the pious Kutsa.The invulnerable demon's head thou clavest when thou wouldst win the praise of Atithigva. The lofty battle-car thou broughtest forward; thou holpest Dasadyu the strong when fighting.Along with Vetasu thou slewest Tugra, and madest Tuji strong, who praised thee, Indra. Thou madest good the laud, what time thou rentest a hundred thousand fighting foes, O Hero,Slewest the Dāsa Śambara of the mountain, and with strange aids didst succour Divodāsa. Made glad with Soma-draughts and faith, thou sentest Cumuri to his sleep, to please Dabhīti.Thou, kindly giving Raji to Pithinas, slewest with might, at once, the sixty thousand. May I too, with the liberal chiefs, O Indra, acquire thy blin supreme and domination,When, Mightiest! Hero-girt! Nahuṣa heroes boast them in thee, the triply-strong Defender. So may we he thy friends, thy best beloved, O Indra, at this holy invocation.Best be Pratardani, illustrious ruler, in slaying foemen and in gaining riches.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुधी न इंद्र ह्वयामसि त्वा महो वाजस्य सातौ वावृषाणाः ।सं यद्विशोऽयंत शूरसाता उग्रं नोऽवः पार्ये अहंदाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ hváyāmasi ǀ tvā ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáu ǀ vavṛṣāṇā́ḥ ǀsám ǀ yát ǀ víśaḥ ǀ áyanta ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀ ugrám ǀ naḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ pā́rye ǀ áhan ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hear us,Indra, when, offering libations, we call  upon you for obtaining abundant food; grant us decided protection when on a future day men are assembling for battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Hear us,Indra, when, offering libations, we call  upon you for obtaining abundant food; grant us decided protection when on a future day men are assembling for battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां वाजी हवते वाजिनेयो महो वाजस्य गध्यस्य सातौ ।त्वां वृत्रेष्विंद्र सत्पतिं तरुत्रं त्वां चष्टे मुष्टिहा गोषु युध्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ vājī́ ǀ havate ǀ vājineyáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gádhyasya ǀ sātáu ǀtvā́m ǀ vṛtréṣu ǀ indra ǀ sát-patim ǀ tárutram ǀ tvā́m ǀ caṣṭe ǀ muṣṭi-hā́ ǀ góṣu ǀ yúdhyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: The son of Vājini, (Bharadvāja), offering (sacrificial) viands, invokes you for (the sake of) acquiring obtainable and abundant food; (he invokes) you,Indra, the preserver of the good, the defender (from the wicked), when enemies (assail him); he depends upon you when, lifting up his fist, he is fighting for (his) cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: The son of Vājini, (Bharadvāja), offering (sacrificial) viands, invokes you for (the sake of) acquiring obtainable and abundant food; (he invokes) you,Indra, the preserver of the good, the defender (from the wicked), when enemies (assail him); he depends upon you when, lifting up his fist, he is fighting for (his) cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं कविं चोदयोऽर्कसातौ त्वं कुत्साय शुष्णं दाशुषे वर्क् ।त्वं शिरो अमर्मणः पराहन्नतिथिग्वाय शंस्यं करिष्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ kavím ǀ codayaḥ ǀ arká-sātau ǀ tvám ǀ kútsāya ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vark ǀtvám ǀ śíraḥ ǀ amarmáṇaḥ ǀ párā ǀ ahan ǀ atithi-gvā́ya ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ kariṣyán ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have animated the sage with (the hope of) obtaining food; you have cut to piecesŚuṣṇafor Kutsa, the donor of the oblation; you have struck off the head (ofŚambara), imagining himself invulnerable, intending to give plural asure to Atithigvan.
verses.wilson_translation: You have animated the sage with (the hope of) obtaining food; you have cut to piecesŚuṣṇafor Kutsa, the donor of the oblation; you have struck off the head (ofŚambara), imagining himself invulnerable, intending to give plural asure to Atithigvan.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं रथं प्र भरो योधमृष्वमावो युध्यंतं वृषभं दशद्युं ।त्वं तुग्रं वेतसवे सचाहंत्वं तुजिं गृणंतमिंद्र तूतोः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ rátham ǀ prá ǀ bharaḥ ǀ yodhám ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ yúdhyantam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ dáśa-dyum ǀtvám ǀ túgram ǀ vetasáve ǀ sácā ǀ ahan ǀ tvám ǀ tújim ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ indra ǀ tūtoríti tūtoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have brought to Vṛṣabhaa great war-chariot; you have protected him warring for ten days; you have slain Tugraalong with Vetasa; you have exalted Tuji glorifying you.
verses.wilson_translation: You have brought to Vṛṣabhaa great war-chariot; you have protected him warring for ten days; you have slain Tugraalong with Vetasa; you have exalted Tuji glorifying you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तदुक्थमिंद्र बर्हणा कः प्र यच्छता सहस्रा शूर दर्षि ।अव गिरेर्दासं शंबरं हन्प्रावो दिवोदासं चित्राभिरूती ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ tát ǀ ukthám ǀ indra ǀ barháṇā ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ śatā́ ǀ sahásrā ǀ śūra ǀ dárṣi ǀáva ǀ giréḥ ǀ dā́sam ǀ śámbaram ǀ han ǀ prá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ dívaḥ-dāsam ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are the subduer (of foes), you have achieved a glorious (deed), inasmuch as you have scatered, hero, the hundreds and thousands (of the host ofŚambara), have slain the slave Śambara (when issuing) from the mountain, and have protected Divodāsawith marvellous protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are the subduer (of foes), you have achieved a glorious (deed), inasmuch as you have scatered, hero, the hundreds and thousands (of the host ofŚambara), have slain the slave Śambara (when issuing) from the mountain, and have protected Divodāsawith marvellous protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं श्रद्धाभिर्मंदसानः सोमैर्दभीतये चुमुरिमिंद्र सिष्वप् ।त्वं रजिं पिठीनसे दशस्यन्षष्टिं सहस्रा शच्या सचाहन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ śraddhā́bhiḥ ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ dabhī́taye ǀ cúmurim ǀ indra ǀ sisvap ǀtvám ǀ rajím ǀ píṭhīnase ǀ daśasyán ǀ ṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ śácyā ǀ sácā ǀ ahan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Delighted by libations offered wiḥ faith, you have consigned Cumuri to the sleeop (of death) on behalf of Dabhīti, and bestowing (the maiden)Rajiupon Piṭhīnas, you have, by your contrivance, destroyed sixty thousand (warriors) at once.
verses.wilson_translation: Delighted by libations offered wiḥ faith, you have consigned Cumuri to the sleeop (of death) on behalf of Dabhīti, and bestowing (the maiden)Rajiupon Piṭhīnas, you have, by your contrivance, destroyed sixty thousand (warriors) at once.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहं चन तत्सूरिभिरानश्यां तव ज्याय इंद्र सुम्नमोजः ।त्वया यत्स्तवंते सधवीर वीरास्त्रिवरूथेन नहुषा शविष्ठ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ caná ǀ tát ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ ānaśyān ǀ táva ǀ jyā́yaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sumnám ǀ ójaḥ ǀtváyā ǀ yát ǀ stávante ǀ sadha-vīra ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ tri-várūthena ǀ náhuṣā ǀ śaviṣṭha ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I, with my fellow-worshippers, obtain that your most excellent felicity and vigour, which, most mighty Indra, associate of heroes, the pious celebrate (as bestowed) by you, who are the humiliator (of foes), the protector of the three (worlds).
verses.wilson_translation: May I, with my fellow-worshippers, obtain that your most excellent felicity and vigour, which, most mighty Indra, associate of heroes, the pious celebrate (as bestowed) by you, who are the humiliator (of foes), the protector of the three (worlds).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं ते अस्यामिंद्र द्युम्नहूतौ सखायः स्याम महिन प्रेष्ठाः ।प्रातर्दनिः क्षत्रश्रीरस्तु श्रेष्ठो घने वृत्राणां सनये धनानां ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ asyā́m ǀ indra ǀ dyumná-hūtau ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ mahina ǀ préṣṭhāḥ ǀprā́tardaniḥ ǀ kṣatra-śrī́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ ghané ǀ vṛtrā́ṇām ǀ sanáye ǀ dhánānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, adorable Indra, your friends, at this your worship, offered for (the acquisiiton of) wealth, be held most dear to you; may Kṣatraśrī, the son of Pratardana, (my patron), by most illustrious through the destruction of foes, and the attainment of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, adorable Indra, your friends, at this your worship, offered for (the acquisiiton of) wealth, be held most dear to you; may Kṣatraśrī, the son of Pratardana, (my patron), by most illustrious through the destruction of foes, and the attainment of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ८ बार्हस्पत्यो भरद्वाज: । इन्द्र:, ८ अभ्यावर्ती चायमान: [ दान: ] । त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: WHAT deed hath Indra done in the wild transport, in quaffing or in friendship with, the Soma?What joys have men of ancient times or recent obtained within the chamber of libation? In its wild joy Indra hath proved him faithful, faithful in quaffing, faithful in its friendship.His truth is the delight that in this chamber the men of old and recent times have tasted. All thy vast power, O Maghavan, we know not, know not the riches of thy full abundance.No one hath seen that might of thine, productive of bounty every day renewed, O Indra. This one great power of thine our eyes have witnessed, wherewith thou slewest Varasikha's children,When by the force of thy descending thunder, at the mere solund, their boldest was demolished. In aid of Abhyavartin Cayamana, Indra destroyed the seed of Varasikha.At Hariyupiya he smote the vanguard of the Vrcivans, and the rear fled frighted. Three thousand, mailed, in quest of fame, together, on the Yavyavati, O much-sought Indra,Vrcivan's sons, falling before the arrow, like bursting vessels went to their destruction. He, whose two red Steers, seeking goodly pasture, plying their tongues move on 'twixt earth and heaven,Gave Turvaśa to Sṛñjaya, and, to aid him, gave the Vrcivans up to Daivavata. Two wagon-teams, with damsels, twenty oxen, O Agni, Abhydvartin Cayamdna,The liberal Sovran, giveth me. This guerdon of Prthu's seed is hard to win from others.

verses.sanskrit: किमस्य मदे किम्वस्य पीताविंद्रः किमस्य सख्ये चकार ।रणा वा ये निषदि किं ते अस्य पुरा विविद्रे किमु नूतनासः ॥
verses.transliteration: kím ǀ asya ǀ máde ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ pītáu ǀ índraḥ ǀ kím ǀ asya ǀ sakhyé ǀ cakāra ǀráṇāḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ni-sádi ǀ kím ǀ té ǀ asya ǀ purā́ ǀ vividre ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nū́tanāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: What has Indradone in the exhilaration of this (Soma)? What has he done on quaffing this (libation)? What has he done in friendship for this (Soma)? What have former, what have recent adorers obtained from you in the chamber of this (libation)?
verses.wilson_translation: What has Indradone in the exhilaration of this (Soma)? What has he done on quaffing this (libation)? What has he done in friendship for this (Soma)? What have former, what have recent adorers obtained from you in the chamber of this (libation)?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सदस्य मदे सद्वस्य पीताविंद्रः सदस्य सख्ये चकार ।रणा वा ये निषदि सत्ते अस्य पुरा विविद्रे सदु नूतनासः ॥
verses.transliteration: sát ǀ asya ǀ máde ǀ sát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ pītáu ǀ índraḥ ǀ sát ǀ asya ǀ sakhyé ǀ cakāra ǀráṇāḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ni-sádi ǀ sát ǀ té ǀ asya ǀ purā́ ǀ vividre ǀ sát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nū́tanāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily, in the exhilaration of this (Soma)Indrahas done a good deed; on quaffing the libation (he has done) a good deed; (he has done) a good deed in friendship for this Soma; former as well as recent adorers have obtained good of you in the chamber (of the libation).
verses.wilson_translation: Verily, in the exhilaration of this (Soma)Indrahas done a good deed; on quaffing the libation (he has done) a good deed; (he has done) a good deed in friendship for this Soma; former as well as recent adorers have obtained good of you in the chamber (of the libation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि नु ते महिमनः समस्य न मघवन्म���वत्त्वस्य विद्म ।न राधसोराधसो नूतनस्येंद्र नकिर्ददृश इंद्रियं ते ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ mahimánaḥ ǀ samasya ǀ ná ǀ magha-van ǀ maghavat-tvásya ǀ vidmá ǀná ǀ rā́dhasaḥ-rādhasaḥ ǀ nū́tanasya ǀ índra ǀ nákiḥ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ indriyám ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: We acknowledge no one,Maghavan, of greatness equal to yours, nor one of like affluence, nor one of equally glorifiable riches, none has (such as) your power been ever seen (in any other).
verses.wilson_translation: We acknowledge no one,Maghavan, of greatness equal to yours, nor one of like affluence, nor one of equally glorifiable riches, none has (such as) your power been ever seen (in any other).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतत्त्यत्त इंद्रियमचेति येनावधीर्वरशिखस्य शेषः ।वज्रस्य यत्ते निहतस्य शुष्मात्स्वनाच्चिदिंद्र परमो ददार ॥
verses.transliteration: etát ǀ tyát ǀ te ǀ indriyám ǀ aceti ǀ yéna ǀ ávadhīḥ ǀ vará-śikhasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀvájrasya ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ní-hatasya ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ svanā́t ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ paramáḥ ǀ dadā́ra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such as your power (is) it has been comprehended (by us) as that wherewith you have slain the race of Varaśikha, when the boldest (of them) was demolished by the noise of your thunderbolt hurled with (all your) force.
verses.wilson_translation: Such as your power (is) it has been comprehended (by us) as that wherewith you have slain the race of Varaśikha, when the boldest (of them) was demolished by the noise of your thunderbolt hurled with (all your) force.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वधीदिंद्रो वरशिखस्य शेषोऽभ्यावर्तिने चायमानाय शिक्षन् ।वृचीवतो यद्धरियूपीयायां हन्पूर्वे अर्धे भियसापरो दर्त् ॥
verses.transliteration: vádhīt ǀ índraḥ ǀ vará-śikhasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀ abhi-āvartíne ǀ cāyamānā́ya ǀ śíkṣan ǀvṛcī́vataḥ ǀ yát ǀ hari-yūpī́yāyām ǀ hán ǀ pū́rve ǀ árdhe ǀ bhiyásā ǀ áparaḥ ǀ dárt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Favouring Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna,Indradestroyed the varaśikha (people), killng the descendants of Vṛcīvat, (who were stationed) on the Hariyūpīya, on the eastern part, while the western (troop) was scattered through fear.
verses.wilson_translation: Favouring Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna,Indradestroyed the varaśikha (people), killng the descendants of Vṛcīvat, (who were stationed) on the Hariyūpīya, on the eastern part, while the western (troop) was scattered through fear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशच्छतं वर्मिण इंद्र साकं यव्यावत्यां पुरुहूत श्रवस्या ।वृचीवंतः शरवे पत्यमानाः पात्रा भिंदाना न्यर्थान्यायन् ॥
verses.transliteration: triṃśát-śatam ǀ varmíṇaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sākám ǀ yavyā́-vatyām ǀ puru-hūta ǀ śravasyā́ ǀvṛcī́vantaḥ ǀ śárave ǀ pátyamānāḥ ǀ pā́trā ǀ bhindānā́ḥ ǀ ni-arthā́ni ǀ āyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the invoked of many, thirty hundred mailed warriors (were collected) together on the Yavyāvatī, to acquire glory, but the Vṛcīvats advancing in a hostile manner, and breaking the sacrificial vessels, went to (their own) annihilation.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the invoked of many, thirty hundred mailed warriors (were collected) together on the Yavyāvatī, to acquire glory, but the Vṛcīvats advancing in a hostile manner, and breaking the sacrificial vessels, went to (their own) annihilation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य गावावरुषा सूयवस्यू अंतरू षु चरतो रेरिहाणा ।स सृंजयाय तुर्वशं परादाद्वृचीवतो दैववाताय शिक्षन् ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ gā́vau ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ suyavasyū́ íti su-yavasyū́ ǀ antáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ cárataḥ ǀ rérihāṇā ǀsáḥ ǀ sṛ́ñjayāya ǀ turváśam ǀ párā ǀ adāt ǀ vṛcī́vataḥ ǀ daiva-vātā́ya ǀ śíkṣan ǁ
verses.english_translation: He whose bright prancing horses, delighted with choice fodder, proceed between (heaven and earth), gave up Turvaśato Sṛñjaya, subjecting the Vṛcīvats to the descendant of Devavāta (Abhyāvartin).
verses.wilson_translation: He whose bright prancing horses, delighted with choice fodder, proceed between (heaven and earth), gave up Turvaśato Sṛñjaya, subjecting the Vṛcīvats to the descendant of Devavāta (Abhyāvartin).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्वयाँ अग्ने रथिनो विंशतिं गा वधूमतो मघवा मह्यं संराट् ।अभ्यावर्ती चायमानो ददाति दूणाशेयं दक्षिणा पार्थवानां ॥
verses.transliteration: dvayā́n ǀ agne ǀ rathínaḥ ǀ viṃśatím ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ vadhū́-mataḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ máhyam ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀabhi-āvartī́ ǀ cāyamānáḥ ǀ dadāti ǀ duḥ-náśā ǀ iyám ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ pārthavā́nām ǁ
verses.english_translation: The opulent supreme sovereign Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna, presents,Agni, to me two damsels riding in cars, and twenty cows; this donation of the descendant of Pṛthucannot be desroyed.
verses.wilson_translation: The opulent supreme sovereign Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna, presents,Agni, to me two damsels riding in cars, and twenty cows; this donation of the descendant of Pṛthucannot be desroyed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVIII. Cows.
hymns.anukramani: ८ बार्हस्पत्यो भरद्वाज: । गाव:; २, ८  इन्द्रो गावो वा । त्रिष्टुप् , २ – ४ जगती, ८ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Kine have come and brought good fortune: let them rest in the cow-pen and be happy near us.Here let them stay prolific, many-coloured, and yield through many morns their milk for Indra. Indra aids him who offers sacrifice and gifts: he takes not what is his, and gives him more thereto.Increasing ever more and ever more his wealth, he makes the pious dwell within unbroken bounds. These are ne’er lost, no robber ever injures them: no evil-minded foe attempts to harass them.The master of the Kine lives many a year with these, the Cows whereby he pours his gifts and serves the Gods. The charger with his dusty brow o’ertakes them not, and never to the shambles do they take their way.These Cows, the cattle of the pious worshipper, roam over widespread pasture where no danger is. To me the Cows seem Bhaga, they seem Indra, they seem a portion of the first-poured Soma.These present Cows, they, O ye Indra. I long for Indra with my heart and spirit. O Cows, ye fatten e’en the worn and wasted, and make the unlovely beautiful tolook on.Prosper my house, ye with auspicious voices. Your power is glorified in our assemblies. Crop goodly pasturage and be prolific drink pure sweet water at good drinking places.Never be thief or sinful man your matter, and may the dart of Rudra still avoid you. Now let this close admixture be close intermigled with these Cows,Mixt with the Steer's prolific flow, and, Indra, with thy hero might.

verses.sanskrit: आ गावो अग्मन्नुत भद्रमक्रन्त्सीदंतु गोष्ठे रणयंत्वस्मे ।प्रजावतीः पुरुरूपा इह स्युरिंद्राय पूर्वीरुषसो दुहानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ agman ǀ utá ǀ bhadrám ǀ akran ǀ sī́dantu ǀ go-sthé ǀ raṇáyantu ǀ asmé íti ǀprajā́-vatīḥ ǀ puru-rū́pāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ syuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ dúhānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the cows come and bring good fortune; let them lie down in (our) stalls and be plural ased with us; may the many-coloured kine here be parboiled milk for Indraon many dawns.
verses.wilson_translation: May the cows come and bring good fortune; let them lie down in (our) stalls and be plural ased with us; may the many-coloured kine here be parboiled milk for Indraon many dawns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो यज्वने पृणते च शिक्षत्युपेद्ददाति न स्वं मुषायति ।भूयोभूयो रयिमिदस्य वर्धयन्नभिन्ने खिल्ये नि दधाति देवयुं ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ yájvane ǀ pṛṇaté ǀ ca ǀ śikṣati ǀ úpa ǀ ít ǀ dadāti ǀ ná ǀ svám ǀ muṣāyati ǀbhū́yaḥ-bhūyaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ vardháyan ǀ ábhinne ǀ khilyé ǀ ní ǀ dadhāti ǀ deva-yúm ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indragrants the desires of the man who offers to him sacrifice and praise; he ever bestows upon him wealth, and deprives him not of that which is his own; again and again increasing his riches, he plural ces the devout man in an inaccessible fortress.
verses.wilson_translation: Indragrants the desires of the man who offers to him sacrifice and praise; he ever bestows upon him wealth, and deprives him not of that which is his own; again and again increasing his riches, he plural ces the devout man in an inaccessible fortress.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न ता नशंति न दभाति तस्करो नासामामित्रो व्यथिरा दधर्षति ।देवांश्च याभिर्यजते ददाति च ज्योगित्ताभिः सचते गोपतिः सह ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ naśanti ǀ ná ǀ dabhāti ǀ táskaraḥ ǀ ná ǀ āsām ǀ āmitráḥ ǀ vyáthiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣati ǀdevā́n ǀ ca ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ yájate ǀ dádāti ǀ ca ǀ jyók ǀ ít ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ sacate ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ sahá ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not the cows be lost; let no thief carry them away; let no hostile weapon fall upon them; may the master of the cattle be long possessed of hose with which he sacrifices, and which he presents to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not the cows be lost; let no thief carry them away; let no hostile weapon fall upon them; may the master of the cattle be long possessed of hose with which he sacrifices, and which he presents to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न ता अर्वा रेणुककाटो अश्नुते न संस्कृतत्रमुप यंति ता अभि ।उरुगायमभयं तस्य ता अनु गावो मर्तस्य वि चरंति यज्वनः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ árvā ǀ reṇú-kakāṭaḥ ǀ aśnute ǀ ná ǀ saṃskṛta-trám ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀuru-gāyám ǀ ábhayam ǀ tásya ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ yájvanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not the dust-spurning (war) horse reach them nor let them fall in the way of sacrificial consecration let the cattle of the man who offers sacrifice wander about at large and without fear.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not the dust-spurning (war) horse reach them nor let them fall in the way of sacrificial consecration let the cattle of the man who offers sacrifice wander about at large and without fear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गावो भगो गाव इंद्रो मे अच्छान् गावः सोमस्य प्रथमस्य भक्षः ।इमा या गावः स जनास इंद्र इच्छामीद्धृदा मनसा चिदिंद्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ me ǀ acchān ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ prathamásya ǀ bhakṣáḥ ǀimā́ḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ icchā́mi ǀ ít ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ cit ǀ índram ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the cows be (for our) affluence; may Indragrant me cattle; may the cows yield the food of the first libation; these cows, oḥ men, are the Indra, the Indra whom I desire with heart and mins.
verses.wilson_translation: May the cows be (for our) affluence; may Indragrant me cattle; may the cows yield the food of the first libation; these cows, oḥ men, are the Indra, the Indra whom I desire with heart and mins.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यूयं गावो मेदयथा कृशं चिदश्रीरं चित्कृणुथा सुप्रतीकं ।भद्रं गृहं कृणुथ भद्रवाचो बृहद्वो वय उच्यते सभासु ॥
verses.transliteration: yūyám ǀ gāvaḥ ǀ medayatha ǀ kṛśám ǀ cit ǀ aśrīrám ǀ cit ǀ kṛṇutha ǀ su-prátīkam ǀbhadrám ǀ gṛhám ǀ kṛṇutha ǀ bhadra-vācaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ucyate ǀ sabhā́su ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, cows, give us nourisment; render the emaciated, the unlovely body the reverse; do you, whose lowing is auspicious, make my dwelling prosperous; great is the abundance that is attributed to you in religious assemblies.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, cows, give us nourisment; render the emaciated, the unlovely body the reverse; do you, whose lowing is auspicious, make my dwelling prosperous; great is the abundance that is attributed to you in religious assemblies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रजावतीः सूयवसं रिशंतीः शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबंतीः ।मा वः स्तेन ईशत माघशंसः परि वो हेती रुद्रस्य वृज्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: prajā́-vatīḥ ǀ su-yávasam ǀ riśántīḥ ǀ śuddhā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ su-prapāné ǀ píbantīḥ ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ stenáḥ ǀ īśata ǀ mā́ ǀ aghá-śaṃsaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vaḥ ǀ hetíḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ vṛjyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May you, cows, have many calves grazing upon good pasture, drinking pure water at accessible ponds; may no thief be your master; no beast of prey (assail you), and may the (fatal) weapon of Rudraavoid you.
verses.wilson_translation: May you, cows, have many calves grazing upon good pasture, drinking pure water at accessible ponds; may no thief be your master; no beast of prey (assail you), and may the (fatal) weapon of Rudraavoid you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उपेदमुपपर्चनमासु गोषूप पृच्यतां ।उप ऋषभस्य रेतस्युपेंद्र तव वीर्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ idám ǀ upa-párcanam ǀ āsú ǀ góṣu ǀ úpa ǀ pṛcyatām ǀúpa ǀ ṛṣabhásya ǀ rétasi ǀ úpa ǀ indra ǀ táva ǀ vīryé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the nourishment of the cows be solicited, let the vigour of the bull (be requested),Indra, for your invigoration.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the nourishment of the cows be solicited, let the vigour of the bull (be requested),Indra, for your invigoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIX Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YOUR men have followed Indra for his friendship, and for his loving-kindness glorified him.For he bestows great wealth, the Thunder-wielder: worship him, Great and Kind, to win his favour. Him to whose hand, men closely cling, and drivers stand on his golden chariot firmly stationed.With his firm arms he holds the reins; his Horses, the Stallions, are yoked ready for the journey. Thy devotees embrace thy feet for glory. Bold, thunder-armed, rich, through thy strength, in guerdon,Robed in a garment fair as heaven to look on, thou hast displayed thee like an active dancer. That Soma when effused hath best consistence, for which the food is dressed and grain is mingled;By which the men who pray, extolling Indra chief favourites of Gods, recite their praises. No limit of thy might hath been appointed, which by its greatness sundered earth and heaven.These the Prince filleth full with strong endeavour, driving, as ’twere, with help his flocks to waters. So be the lofty Indra prompt to listen, Helper unaided, golden-visored Hero.Yea, so may he, shown forth in might unequalled, smite down the many Vṛtras and the Dasyus.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वो नरः सख्याय सेपुर्महो यंतः सुमतये चकानाः ।महो हि दाता वज्रहस्तो अस्ति महामु रण्वमवसे यजध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ vaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ sepuḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ yántaḥ ǀ su-matáye ǀ cakānā́ḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ hí ǀ dātā́ ǀ vájra-hastaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ mahā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ raṇvám ǀ ávase ǀ yajadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your priests, (oḥ worshippers), proppitiate Indrafor his friendship, offering great (praise), and desirous of his favour; for the wielder of the thunderbolt is the giver of vast (wealth); worship him, therefore, who is mighty and benevolent, (to obtain) his protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Your priests, (oḥ worshippers), proppitiate Indrafor his friendship, offering great (praise), and desirous of his favour; for the wielder of the thunderbolt is the giver of vast (wealth); worship him, therefore, who is mighty and benevolent, (to obtain) his protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यस्मिन्हस्ते नर्या मिमिक्षुरा रथे हिरण्यये रथेष्ठाः ।आ रश्मयो गभस्त्योः स्थूरयोराध्वन्नश्वासो वृषणो युजानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ háste ǀ náryāḥ ǀ mimikṣúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ráthe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀ rathe-sthā́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ sthūráyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ádhvan ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ yujānā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: In whosehand(riches) good for man are accusative ulated, the chariot-mounted in a golden car; in whose arms the rays of light (are collected); whose vigorous horses, yoked (to his car, convey him) on the road (of the firmament).
verses.wilson_translation: In whosehand(riches) good for man are accusative ulated, the chariot-mounted in a golden car; in whose arms the rays of light (are collected); whose vigorous horses, yoked (to his car, convey him) on the road (of the firmament).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रिये ते पादा दुव आ मिमिक्षुर्धृष्णुर्वज्री शवसा दक्षिणावान् ।वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्वर्ण नृतविषिरो बभूथ ॥
verses.transliteration: śriyé ǀ te ǀ pā́dā ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mimikṣuḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ śávasā ǀ dákṣiṇa-vān ǀvásānaḥ ǀ átkam ǀ surabhím ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ nṛto íti ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ babhūtha ǁ
verses.english_translation: They offer adoration at your feet to acquire prosperity, for you are the overthrower of enemies by (your) strength, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the bestower of donations; leader (of rites), you are like the rolling sun, wearing in the sight (of all) a graceful and ever moving form.
verses.wilson_translation: They offer adoration at your feet to acquire prosperity, for you are the overthrower of enemies by (your) strength, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the bestower of donations; leader (of rites), you are like the rolling sun, wearing in the sight (of all) a graceful and ever moving form.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सोम आमिश्ल��मः सुतो भूद्यस्मिन्पक्तिः पच्यते संति धानाः ।इंद्रं नरः स्तुवंतो ब्रह्मकारा उक्था शंसंतो देववाततमाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ā́miśla-tamaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ bhūt ǀ yásmin ǀ paktíḥ ǀ pacyáte ǀ sánti ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀíndram ǀ náraḥ ǀ stuvántaḥ ǀ brahma-kārā́ḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ śáṃsantaḥ ǀ devávāta-tamāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: That libation is most perfectly mixed when, upon its being effused, the cakes are baked, and the barley is fried, and the priests, glorifying Indra, offering the (sacrificial) food, and reciting holy prayers, are approaching most nigh to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: That libation is most perfectly mixed when, upon its being effused, the cakes are baked, and the barley is fried, and the priests, glorifying Indra, offering the (sacrificial) food, and reciting holy prayers, are approaching most nigh to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न ते अंतः शवसो धाय्यस्य वि तु बाबधे रोदसी महित्वा ।आ ता सूरिः पृणति तूतुजानो यूथेवाप्सु समीजमान ऊती ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ ántaḥ ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ dhāyi ǀ asyá ǀ ví ǀ tú ǀ bābadhe ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀā́ ǀ tā́ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ pṛṇati ǀ tū́tujānaḥ ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ ap-sú ǀ sam-ī́jamānaḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: No limit of your strength has been assigned; heaven and earth are intimidated by its greatness; the pious worshipper, hastening (to sacrifice), and earnestly performing worship, gratifies you with the offering, as (the cow-keeper satisfies) the herds with water.
verses.wilson_translation: No limit of your strength has been assigned; heaven and earth are intimidated by its greatness; the pious worshipper, hastening (to sacrifice), and earnestly performing worship, gratifies you with the offering, as (the cow-keeper satisfies) the herds with water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवेदिंद्रः सुहव ऋष्वो अस्तूती अनूती हिरिशिप्रः सत्वा ।एवा हि जातो असमात्योजाः पुरू च वृत्रा हनति नि दस्यून् ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ astu ǀ ūtī́ ǀ ánūtī ǀ hiri-śipráḥ ǀ sátvā ǀevá ǀ hí ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ásamāti-ojāḥ ǀ purú ǀ ca ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ hanati ǀ ní ǀ dásyūn ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus may the mighty Indrabe successfully invoked; he, the azure-chinned, the giver of wealth, whether by coming or not coming (to the sacrifice); and may he who is of unequalled strength destroy, as soon as manifested, many opposing (evil spirits) and (hostile)Dasyus.
verses.wilson_translation: Thus may the mighty Indrabe successfully invoked; he, the azure-chinned, the giver of wealth, whether by coming or not coming (to the sacrifice); and may he who is of unequalled strength destroy, as soon as manifested, many opposing (evil spirits) and (hostile)Dasyus.

hymns.title: HYMN XXX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INDRA hath waxed yet more for hero prowess, alone, Eternal, he bestoweth treasures.Indra transcendeth both the worlds in greatness: one half of him equalleth earth and heaven. Yea, mighty I esteem his Godlike nature: none hindereth what he hath once determined.Near and afar he spread and set the regions, and every day the Sun became apparent. E’en now endures thine exploit of the Rivers, when, Indra, for their floods thou clavest passage.Like men who sit at meat the mountains settled: by thee, Most Wise! the regions were made steadfast. This is the truth, none else is like thee, Indra, no God superior to thee, no mortal.Thou slewest Ahi who besieged the waters, and lettest loose the streams to hurry seaward. Indra, thou breakest up the floods and portals on all sides, and the firmness of the mountain.Thou art the King of men, of all that liveth, engendering at once Sun, Heaven, and Morning.

verses.sanskrit: भूय इद्वावृधे वीर्यायँ एको अजुर्यो दयते वसूनि ।प्र रिरिचे दिव इंद्रः पृथिव्या अर्धमिदस्य प्रति रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.transliteration: bhū́yaḥ ǀ ít ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ajuryáḥ ǀ dayate ǀ vásūni ǀprá ǀ ririce ǀ diváḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ardhám ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ práti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
