verses.wilson_translation: War-drum, fill with your sound both heaven and earth; and let all things, fixed or moveable, be aware of it; do you, who are associated with Indraand the gods, drive away our foes to the remotest distance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्य वज्रो मरुतामनीकं मित्रस्य गर्भो वरुणस्य नाभिः ।सेमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव रथ प्रति हव्या गृभाय ॥
verses.transliteration: índrasya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ marútām ǀ ánīkam ǀ mitrásya ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ havyá-dātim ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ déva ǀ ratha ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ ǀ gṛbhāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sound loud against the (hostile) host; animate our prowess; thunder aloud, terrifying the evil-minded; rapid, drum, those whose delight is to harm us; you are the fist of Indra; inspire us with fierceness.
verses.wilson_translation: Sound loud against the (hostile) host; animate our prowess; thunder aloud, terrifying the evil-minded; rapid, drum, those whose delight is to harm us; you are the fist of Indra; inspire us with fierceness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप श्वासय पृथिवीमुत द्यां पुरुत्रा ते मनुतां विष्ठितं जगत् ।स दुंदुभे सजूरिंद्रेण देवैर्दूराद्दवीयो अप सेध शत्रून् ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ śvāsaya ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ te ǀ manutām ǀ ví-sthitam ǀ jágat ǀsáḥ ǀ dundubhe ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ deváiḥ ǀ dūrā́t ǀ dávīyaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ sedha ǀ śátrūn ǁ
verses.english_translation: Recover these our cattle,Indra; bring them back; the drum sounds repeatedly as a signal; our leaders, mounted on their steeds, assemble; may our warriors, riding in their cars, Indra, be victorious.
verses.wilson_translation: Recover these our cattle,Indra; bring them back; the drum sounds repeatedly as a signal; our leaders, mounted on their steeds, assemble; may our warriors, riding in their cars, Indra, be victorious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVIII. Agni and Others.
hymns.anukramani: २२ शंयुर्बार्हस्पत्य: [तृणपाणि:] ।१-१०अग्नि:; ११- १५, २० – २१ मरुत: [ १३-१५ लिंगोक्ता वा ], १६-१९ पूषा, २२ द्यावाभूमी वा पृश्निर्वा । प्रगाथ:; =[ १,३ बृहती; २, ४ सतोबृहती; ५ बृहती, ६ महासतोबृहती; ७ महाबृहती, ८ महासतोबृहती; ९ बृहती, १० सतोबृहती; ११ ककुप् , १२ सतोबृहती ], १३ पुरउष्णिक् ,१४ बृहती, १५ अतिजगती, १६ ककुप् , १७ सतोबृहती, १८ पुरउष्णिक्, १९-२० बृहती , २१ महाबृहती यवमध्या, २२ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice, for strength.Come, let us praise the Wise and Everlasting God, even as a well-beloved Friend, The Son of Strength; for is he not our gracious Lord? Let us serve him who bears our gifts.In battle may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives. Agni, thou beamest forth with light, great Hero, never changed by time.Shining, pure Agni! with a light that never fades, beam with thy fair beams brilliantly. Thou worshippest great Gods: bring them without delay by wisdom and thy wondrous power.O Agni, make them turn hither to succour us. Give strength, and win it for thyself. He whom floods, stones, and trees support, the offspring of eternal Law;He who when rubbed with force is brought to life by men upon the lofty height of earth; He who hath filled both worlds fult with his brilliant shine, who hastens with his smoke to heaven;He made himself apparent through the gloom by night, the Red Bull in the darksome nights, the Red Bull in the darksome nights. O Agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, O God,Kindled, Most Youthful One! by Bharadvāja's hand, shine on us, O pure God, with wealth, shine, Purifier! splendidly. Thou art the Lord of house and home of all the tribes, O Agni, of all tribes of men.Guard with a hundred forts thy kindler from distress, through hundred winters, Youngest God! and those who make thy singers rich. Wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord.Thou art the Charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed. With guards unfailing never negligent speed thou our children and our progeny.Keep far from us, O Agni, all celestial wrath and wickedness of godless men. Hither, O friends, with newest song drive her who freely pours her milk;Loose her who never turns away; Who, for the host of Maruts bright with native sheen, hath shed immortal fame like milk;Whom the impetuous Maruts look upon with love, who moves in splendour on their ways. For Bharadvāja she poured down in days of oldThe milch-cow yielding milk for all, and food that gives all nourishment. Your friend like Indra passing wise, with magic power like Varuṇa.Like Aryaman joy-giving, bringing plenteous food like ViSnxu for my wish, I praise, Bright as the host of Maruts mighty in their roar. May they bring Pūṣan free from foes;May they bring hither hundreds, thousands for our men: may they bring hidden stores to light, and make wealth easy to be found. Haste to me, Pūṣan, in thine car, bright Deity: I fain would speak:Most sinful is our foeman's hate. Tear not up by the roots the Kakambira tree: destroy thou all malignity.Let them not snare by day the neck of that Celestial Bird the Sun. Uninjured let thy friendship be, like the smooth surface of a skin,A flawless skin, containing curds, full to the mouth, containing curds. For thou art high above mankind, in glory equal to the Gods.Therefore, O Pūṣan, look upon us in the fight: now help us as in days of old. May the kind excellence of him the Kind, loud Roarers! be our guide,Be it the God's, O Maruts, or a mortal man's who worships, ye impetuous Ones! They whose high glory in a moment like the God, the Sun, goes round the space of heaven,The Maruts have obtained bright strength, a sacred name, strength that destroys the Vṛtras, strength Vṛtra-destroying excellent. Once, only once, the heaven was made, once only once, the earth was formed-Once, only Pṛśni's milk was shed: no second, after this, is born.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे ।प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñā́-yajñā ǀ vaḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ girā́-girā ǀ ca ǀ dákṣase ǀprá-pra ǀ vayám ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ priyám ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ śaṃsiṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: At every sacrifice (honour) the mighty Agniwith your reiterated praise, while we glorify him, the immortal, who knows all things, our dear friend.
verses.wilson_translation: At every sacrifice (honour) the mighty Agniwith your reiterated praise, while we glorify him, the immortal, who knows all things, our dear friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातं स हिनायमस्मयुर्दाशेम हव्यदातये ।भुवद्वाजेष्वविता भुवद्वृध उत त्राता तनूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ sáḥ ǀ hiná ǀ ayám ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ dā́śema ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀbhúvat ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhúvat ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ utá ǀ trātā́ ǀ tanū́nām ǁ
verses.english_translation: The son of strength, for he verily is propitious to us, to whom let us offer oblations as to the conveyer of them (to the gods); may he be our defender in battles; may he be our benefactor and the grandsire of our offspring.
verses.wilson_translation: The son of strength, for he verily is propitious to us, to whom let us offer oblations as to the conveyer of them (to the gods); may he be our defender in battles; may he be our benefactor and the grandsire of our offspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा ह्यग्ने अजरो महान्विभास्यर्चिषा ।अजस्रेण शोचिषा शोशुचच्छुचे सुदीतिभिः सु दीदिहि ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ vi-bhā́si ǀ arcíṣā ǀájasreṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ śóśucat ǀ śuce ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǀ sú ǀ dīdihi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who are the showerer (of benefits), mighty, and exempt from decay, you shine with (great) splendour; you are resplendent, brilliant (Agni), with unfading lustre; shine forth with glorious rays.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who are the showerer (of benefits), mighty, and exempt from decay, you shine with (great) splendour; you are resplendent, brilliant (Agni), with unfading lustre; shine forth with glorious rays.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महो देवान्यजसि यक्ष्यानुषक्तव क्रत्वोत दंसना ।अर्वाचः सीं कृणुह्यग्नेऽवसे रास्व वाजोत वंस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ yájasi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ānuṣák ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ utá ǀ daṃsánā ǀarvā́caḥ ǀ sīm ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ agne ǀ ávase ǀ rā́sva ǀ vā́jā ǀ utá ǀ vaṃsva ǁ
verses.english_translation: You sacrifice to the mighty gods; sacrifice (for us) continually, for (sacrifice is perfected) by your wisdom and your acts; bring them down,Agni, for our salvation; present (to them) the sacrificial food, partake of it yourself.
verses.wilson_translation: You sacrifice to the mighty gods; sacrifice (for us) continually, for (sacrifice is perfected) by your wisdom and your acts; bring them down,Agni, for our salvation; present (to them) the sacrificial food, partake of it yourself.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यमापो अद्रयो वना गर्भमृतस्य पिप्रति ।सहसा यो मथितो जायते नृभिः पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ vánā ǀ gárbham ǀ ṛtásya ǀ píprati ǀsáhasā ǀ yáḥ ǀ mathitáḥ ǀ jā́yate ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You are he) whom the waters, the mountains, the woods, nourish as the embryo of sacrifice; who, churned with strength by the performers (of the rite), are genitive rated in the highest plural ce of the earth.
verses.wilson_translation: (You are he) whom the waters, the mountains, the woods, nourish as the embryo of sacrifice; who, churned with strength by the performers (of the rite), are genitive rated in the highest plural ce of the earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यः पप्रौ भानुना रोदसी उभे धूमेन धावते दिवि ।तिरस्तमो ददृश ऊर्म्यास्वा श्यावास्वरुषो वृषा श्यावा अरुषो वृषा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ papráu ǀ bhānúnā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ dhūména ǀ dhāvate ǀ diví ǀtiráḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ ū́rmyāsu ǀ ā́ ǀ śyāvā́su ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ śyāvā́ḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who fills both heaven and earth with light, who mounts with smoke into the sky, this radiant showerer (of benefits) is beheld in the dark nights dispersing the gloom; this radiant showerer (of benefits) presides over the dark nights.
verses.wilson_translation: He who fills both heaven and earth with light, who mounts with smoke into the sky, this radiant showerer (of benefits) is beheld in the dark nights dispersing the gloom; this radiant showerer (of benefits) presides over the dark nights.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्भिरग्ने अर्चिभिः शुक्रेण देव शोचिषा ।भरद्वाजे समिधानो यविष्ठ्य रेवन्नः शुक्र दीदिहि द्युमत्पावक दीदिहि ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhát-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ arcí-bhiḥ ǀ śukréṇa ǀ deva ǀ śocíṣā ǀbharát-vāje ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ revát ǀ naḥ ǀ śukra ǀ dīdihi ǀ dyu-mát ǀ pāvaka ǀ dīdihi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine, resplendent Agni, youngest (of the gods), when kindled by Bharadvāja, shines with many flames, with pure lustre, (conferring) riches upon us; shine, resplendent purifier.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine, resplendent Agni, youngest (of the gods), when kindled by Bharadvāja, shines with many flames, with pure lustre, (conferring) riches upon us; shine, resplendent purifier.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वासां गृहपतिर्विशामसि त्वमग्ने मानुषीणां ।शतं पूर्भिर्यविष्ठ पाह्यंहसः समेद्धारं शतं हिमाः स्तोतृभ्यो ये च ददति ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvāsām ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ ási ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀśatám ǀ pūḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ sam-eddhā́ram ǀ śatám ǀ hímāḥ ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ dádati ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, are the lord of the dwelling, and of all men the descendants of Manu; protect me, youngest (of the gods), when kindling you, with a hundred defences against iniquity; (grant me) a hundred winters, (as well as to those) who bestow gifts upon your worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, are the lord of the dwelling, and of all men the descendants of Manu; protect me, youngest (of the gods), when kindling you, with a hundred defences against iniquity; (grant me) a hundred winters, (as well as to those) who bestow gifts upon your worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधांसि चोदय ।अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ citráḥ ǀ ūtyā́ ǀ váso íti ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ codaya ǀasyá ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ gādhám ǀ tucé ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wonderful (Agni), giver of dwellings, encourage us by (your) protection, and (the gift of) riches, for you are he conveyer, Agni, of this wealth; quickly bestow permanence upon our progeny.
verses.wilson_translation: Wonderful (Agni), giver of dwellings, encourage us by (your) protection, and (the gift of) riches, for you are he conveyer, Agni, of this wealth; quickly bestow permanence upon our progeny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पर्षि तोकं तनयं पर्तृभिष्ट्वमदब्धैरप्रयुत्वभिः ।अग्ने हेळांसि दैव्या युयोधि नोऽदेवानि ह्वरांसि च ॥
verses.transliteration: párṣi ǀ tokám ǀ tánayam ǀ partṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ádabdhaiḥ ǀ áprayutva-bhiḥ ǀágne ǀ héḷāṃsi ǀ dáivyā ǀ yuyodhi ǀ naḥ ǀ ádevāni ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: You protect with uninjurable, irremovable defences (our) sons and grandsons; remove far from us celestial wrath and human malevolence.
verses.wilson_translation: You protect with uninjurable, irremovable defences (our) sons and grandsons; remove far from us celestial wrath and human malevolence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सखायः सबर्दुघां धेनुमजध्वमुप नव्यसा वचः ।सृजध्वमनपस्फुरां ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ sabaḥ-dúghām ǀ dhenúm ǀ ajadhvam ǀ úpa ǀ návyasā ǀ vácaḥ ǀsṛjádhvam ǀ ánapa-sphurām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Approach, friends the milk-yielding cow with a new song, and let her loose unharmed.
verses.wilson_translation: Approach, friends the milk-yielding cow with a new song, and let her loose unharmed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या शर्धाय मारुताय स्वभानवे श्रवोऽमृत्यु धुक्षत ।या मृळीके मरुतां तुराणां या सुम्नैरेवयावरी ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ śárdhāya ǀ mā́rutāya ǀ svá-bhānave ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ámṛtyu ǀ dhúkṣata ǀyā́ ǀ mṛḷīké ǀ marútām ǀ turā́ṇām ǀ yā́ ǀ sumnáiḥ ǀ eva-yā́varī ǁ
verses.english_translation: She who yields immortal food to the powerful, self-irradiating band of the Maruts, who (is anxious) for the gratiication of the self-moving Maruts, who traverse the sky with (the passing waters0, shedding delight.
verses.wilson_translation: She who yields immortal food to the powerful, self-irradiating band of the Maruts, who (is anxious) for the gratiication of the self-moving Maruts, who traverse the sky with (the passing waters0, shedding delight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाजायाव धुक्षत द्विता ।धेनुं च विश्वदोहसमिषं च विश्वभोजसं ॥
verses.transliteration: bharát-vājāya ǀ áva ǀ dhukṣata ǀ dvitā́ ǀdhenúm ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-dohasam ǀ íṣam ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-bhojasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Milk for Bharadvājathe twofold (blessing), the cow that gives milk to the universe, food that is sufficient for all.
verses.wilson_translation: Milk for Bharadvājathe twofold (blessing), the cow that gives milk to the universe, food that is sufficient for all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं व इंद्रं न सुक्रतुं वरुणमिव मायिनं ।अर्यमणं न मंद्रं सृप्रभोजसं विष्णुं न स्तुष आदिशे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ su-krátum ǀ váruṇam-iva ǀ māyínam ǀaryamáṇam ǀ ná ǀ mandrám ǀ sṛprá-bhojasam ǀ víṣṇum ǀ ná ǀ stuṣe ǀ ā-díśe ǁ
verses.english_translation: I praise you, the (company of Maruts), for the distribution of wealth; (the company that), like Indra, is the achiever of great deeds; sagacious like Varuṇa; adorable as Aryamanand munificent as Viṣṇu.
verses.wilson_translation: I praise you, the (company of Maruts), for the distribution of wealth; (the company that), like Indra, is the achiever of great deeds; sagacious like Varuṇa; adorable as Aryamanand munificent as Viṣṇu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वेषं शर्धो न मारुतं तुविष्वण्यनर्वाणं पूषणं सं यथा शता ।सं सहस्रा कारिषच्चर्षणिभ्य आँ आविर्गूळ्हा वसू करत्सुवेदा नो वसू करत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tveṣám ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mā́rutam ǀ tuvi-sváni ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ sám ǀ yáthā ǀ śatā́ ǀsám ǀ sahásrā ǀ kā́riṣat ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ gūḷhā́ ǀ vásu ǀ karat ǀ su-védā ǀ naḥ ǀ vásu ǀ karat ǁ
verses.english_translation: I now (glorify) the brilliant vigour of the company of the Maruts, loud-sounding, irresistible, cherishing, whereby hundreds and thousands (of treasures) are bestowed collectively upon men; may that (company) make hidden wealth manifes; may it render the wealth easily accessible to us.
verses.wilson_translation: I now (glorify) the brilliant vigour of the company of the Maruts, loud-sounding, irresistible, cherishing, whereby hundreds and thousands (of treasures) are bestowed collectively upon men; may that (company) make hidden wealth manifes; may it render the wealth easily accessible to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ मा पूषन्नुप द्रव शंसिषं नु ते अपिकर्ण आघृणे ।अघा अर्यो अरातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mā ǀ pūṣan ǀ úpa ǀ drava ǀ śáṃsiṣam ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ api-karṇé ǀ āghṛṇe ǀaghā́ḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten,Pūṣan, to me; (repel), bright deity, (all) deadly assailing foes; close at your side I repeat your praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten,Pūṣan, to me; (repel), bright deity, (all) deadly assailing foes; close at your side I repeat your praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा काकंबीरमुद्वृहो वनस्पतिमशस्तीर्वि हि नीनशः ।मोत सूरो अह एवा चन ग्रीवा आदधते वेः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ kākambī́ram ǀ út ǀ vṛhaḥ ǀ vánaspátim ǀ áśastīḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ nī́naśaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ utá ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ áharíti ǀ evá ǀ caná ǀ grīvā́ḥ ǀ ā-dádhate ǀ véríti véḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Uproot not,Pūṣan, the forest lord with its progeny of crows; utterly destroy those who are my revilers; let not the adversary ensnare me, as (fowlers) set snares for birds.
verses.wilson_translation: Uproot not,Pūṣan, the forest lord with its progeny of crows; utterly destroy those who are my revilers; let not the adversary ensnare me, as (fowlers) set snares for birds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दृतेरिव तेऽवृकमस्तु सख्यं ।अच्छिद्रस्य दधन्वतः सुपूर्णस्य दधन्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛ́teḥ-iva ǀ te ǀ avṛkám ǀ astu ǀ sakhyám ǀácchidrasya ǀ dadhan-vátaḥ ǀ sú-pūrṇasya ǀ dadhan-vátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your friendship be unbroken, like (the surface) of a skin without a flaw, containing curds.
verses.wilson_translation: May your friendship be unbroken, like (the surface) of a skin without a flaw, containing curds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परो हि मर्त्यैरसि समो देवैरुत श्रिया ।अभि ख्यः पूषन्पृतनासु नस्त्वमवा नूनं यथा पुरा ॥
verses.transliteration: paráḥ ǀ hí ǀ mártyaiḥ ǀ ási ǀ samáḥ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ utá ǀ śriyā́ ǀabhí ǀ khyaḥ ǀ pūṣan ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ áva ǀ nūnám ǀ yáthā ǀ purā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Supreme are you above mortals; equal in glory are you to the gods; therefore,Pūṣan, regard us (favourably) in battles; defend us at present as (you have defended) those of old.
verses.wilson_translation: Supreme are you above mortals; equal in glory are you to the gods; therefore,Pūṣan, regard us (favourably) in battles; defend us at present as (you have defended) those of old.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वामी वामस्य धूतयः प्रणीतिरस्तु सूनृता ।देवस्य वा मरुतो मर्त्यस्य वेजानस्य प्रयज्यवः ॥
verses.transliteration: vāmī́ ǀ vāmásya ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀ prá-nītiḥ ǀ astu ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀdevásya ǀ vā ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mártyasya ǀ vā ǀ ījānásya ǀ pra-yajyavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, agitators, especially to be adored, may your kind and true speech be our conductress; that plural asant (speech which is the guide) to desirable (wealth) for both gods and sacrificing mortals.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, agitators, especially to be adored, may your kind and true speech be our conductress; that plural asant (speech which is the guide) to desirable (wealth) for both gods and sacrificing mortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सद्यश्चिद्यस्य चर्कृतिः परि द्यां देवो नैति सूर्यः ।त्वेषं शवो दधिरे नाम यज्ञियं मरुतो वृत्रहं शवो ज्येष्ठं वृत्रहं शवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yásya ǀ carkṛtíḥ ǀ pári ǀ dyā́m ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ éti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀtveṣám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ nā́ma ǀ yajñíyam ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vṛ́tra-hám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ vṛ́tra-hám ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose functions spread quickly round the heavens, like (the light of) the divine sun, since themarutspossess brillian, foe-humiliating, and adorable foe-destroying strength, most excellent foe-destroying strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Whose functions spread quickly round the heavens, like (the light of) the divine sun, since themarutspossess brillian, foe-humiliating, and adorable foe-destroying strength, most excellent foe-destroying strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सकृद्ध द्यौरजायत सकृद्भूमिरजायत ।पृश्न्या दुग्धं सकृत्पयस्तदन्यो नानु जायते ॥
verses.transliteration: sakṛ́t ǀ ha ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ajāyata ǀ sakṛ́t ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ ajāyata ǀpṛ́śnyāḥ ǀ dugdhám ǀ sakṛ́t ǀ páyaḥ ǀ tát ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ ánu ǀ jāyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Once, indeed, was the heaven genitive rated; once was the earth born; once was the milk of Pṛśni(pṛśnayai vai payaso marutojātāḥ:Taittirīya Saṃhitā2.2.11.4) drawn other than that was not similarly genitive rated.
verses.wilson_translation: Once, indeed, was the heaven genitive rated; once was the earth born; once was the milk of Pṛśni(pṛśnayai vai payaso marutojātāḥ:Taittirīya Saṃhitā2.2.11.4) drawn other than that was not similarly genitive rated.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIX. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I LAUD with newest songs the Righteous People, Mitra and Varuṇa who make us happy.Let them approach, here let them listen,Agni, Varuṇa, Mitra, Lords of fair dominion. Him, to be praised at each tribe's sacrifices, the Two young Matrons' sober-minded Herald,The Son of Strength, the Child of Heaven, the signal of sacrifice, red Agni will I worship. Unlike in form are the Red God's two Daughters: one is the Sun's, and stars bedeck the other.Apart, the Sanctifiers, in succession, come to the famed hymn, praised in holy verses. I with a lofty song call hither Vāyu, all-bounteous, filler of his car, most wealthy.Thou, Sage, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses, impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent. That chariot of the Aśvins, fair to look on, pleaseth me well, yoked with a thought, refulgent,Wherewith, Nāsatyas, Chiefs, ye seek our dwelling, to give new strength to us and to our children. Bulls of the Earth, O Vāta and Parjanya, stir up for us the regions of the water.Hearers of truth, ye, Sages, World-Supporters, increase his living wealth whose songs delight you. So may Sarasvatī, the Hero's Consort, brisk with rare life, the lightning's Child, inspire us,And, with the Dames accordant, give the singer a refuge unassailable and flawless. I praise with eloquence him who guards all pathways. He, when his love impelled him, went to Arka.May he vouchsafe us gear with gold to grace it: may Pūṣan make each prayer of ours efective. May Herald Agni, fulgent, bring for worship Tvaṣṭar adored, in homes and swift to listen,Glorious, first to share, the life-bestower, the ever active God, fair-armed, fair-handed. Rudra by day, Rudra at night we honour with these our songs, the Universe's Father.Him great and lofty, blissful, undecaying let us call specially as the Sage impels us. Ye who are youthful, wise, and meet for worship, come, Martits, to the longing of the singer.Coming, as erst to Aṅgiras, O Heroes, ye animate and quicken e’en the desert. Even as the herdsman driveth home his cattle, I urge my songs to him the strong swift HeroMay he, the glorious, lay upon his body the singer's hymns, as stars bedeck the heaven. He who for man's behoof in his afiliction thrice measured out the earthly regions, Viṣṇu-When one so great as thou affordeth shelter, may we with wealth and with ourselves be happy. Sweet be this song of mine to Ahibudhnya, Parvata, Savitar, with Floods and Lightnings;Sweet, with the Plants, to Gods who seek oblations. May liberal Bhaga speed us on to riches. Give riches borne on cars, with many heroes, contenting men, the guard of mighty Order.Give us a lasting home that we may battle with godless bands of men who fight against us, and meet with tribes to whom the Gods are gracious.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुषे जनं सुव्रतं नव्यसीभिर्गीर्भिर्मित्रावरुणा सुम्नयंता ।त आ गमंतु त इह श्रुवंतु सुक्षत्रासो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ॥
verses.transliteration: stuṣé ǀ jánam ǀ su-vratám ǀ návyasībhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ sumna-yántā ǀté ǀ ā́ ǀ gamantu ǀ té ǀ ihá ǀ śruvantu ǀ su-kṣatrā́saḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I commend with new hymns the man observant of his duty, and the beneficent Mitraand Varuṇa; may they, the mighty ones, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Agni, come to our rite, and listen (to our praises).
verses.wilson_translation: I commend with new hymns the man observant of his duty, and the beneficent Mitraand Varuṇa; may they, the mighty ones, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Agni, come to our rite, and listen (to our praises).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विशोविश ईड्यमध्वरेष्वदृप्तक्रतुमरतिं युवत्योः ।दिवः शिशुं सहसः सूनुमग्निं यज्ञस्य केतुमरुषं यजध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: viśáḥ-viśaḥ ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ ádṛpta-kratum ǀ aratím ǀ yuvatyóḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ śíśum ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ agním ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ aruṣám ǀ yájadhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I incite the worshipper) to offer worship to Agni, who is to be adored at the sacrifices of every ma; whose acts are free from arrogance; the lord of the two youthful (brides, heaven and earth); the child of heaven, the son of strength, the briliant symbol of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: (I incite the worshipper) to offer worship to Agni, who is to be adored at the sacrifices of every ma; whose acts are free from arrogance; the lord of the two youthful (brides, heaven and earth); the child of heaven, the son of strength, the briliant symbol of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरुषस्य दुहितरा विरूपे स्तृभिरन्या पिपिशे सूरो अन्या ।मिथस्तुरा विचरंती पावके मन्म श्रुतं नक्षत ऋच्यमाने ॥
verses.transliteration: aruṣásya ǀ duhitárā ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ anyā́ ǀ pipiśé ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ anyā́ ǀmithaḥ-túrā ǀ vicárantī íti vi-cárantī ǀ pāvaké íti ǀ mánma ǀ śrutám ǀ nakṣataḥ ǀ ṛcyámāne íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the two daughters of the radiant (sun) of various form, of whom one glitters with stars, the other (is bright) with the sun, mutually opposed, proceeding diversely, purifying (all things), and entitled to our laudation, be plural ased by the praise they hear (from us).
verses.wilson_translation: May the two daughters of the radiant (sun) of various form, of whom one glitters with stars, the other (is bright) with the sun, mutually opposed, proceeding diversely, purifying (all things), and entitled to our laudation, be plural ased by the praise they hear (from us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वायुमच्छा बृहती मनीषा बृहद्रयिं विश्ववारं रथप्रां ।द्युतद्यामा नियुतः पत्यमानः कविः कविमियक्षसि प्रयज्यो ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vāyúm ǀ áccha ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ bṛhát-rayim ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ ratha-prā́m ǀdyutát-yāmā ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ pátyamānaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ kavím ǀ iyakṣasi ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our earnest praise proceed to the presence of Vāyu, the possessor of vast riches, the desired of all, the filler of his chariot (with wealth for his worshippers); most adorable (Vāyu), who are riding in a radiant car, and driving your Niyut(steeds), do you, who are far-seeing, show favour to the sage, (your adorer).
verses.wilson_translation: May our earnest praise proceed to the presence of Vāyu, the possessor of vast riches, the desired of all, the filler of his chariot (with wealth for his worshippers); most adorable (Vāyu), who are riding in a radiant car, and driving your Niyut(steeds), do you, who are far-seeing, show favour to the sage, (your adorer).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मे वपुश्छदयदश्विनोर्यो रथो विरुक्मान्मनसा युजानः ।येन नरा नासत्येषयध्यै वर्तिर्याथस्तनयाय त्मने च ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ me ǀ vápuḥ ǀ chadayat ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ virúkmān ǀ mánasā ǀ yujānáḥ ǀyéna ǀ narā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ iṣayádhyai ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātháḥ ǀ tánayāya ǀ tmáne ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that splendid car of the Aśvins, which is harnessed at a thought, clothe my form (with radiance); that (car) with which,Nāsatyās, leaders of (rites), you go to the dwelling (of the worshipper) to fulfil his desires for his posterity and himself.
verses.wilson_translation: May that splendid car of the Aśvins, which is harnessed at a thought, clothe my form (with radiance); that (car) with which,Nāsatyās, leaders of (rites), you go to the dwelling (of the worshipper) to fulfil his desires for his posterity and himself.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पर्जन्यवाता वृषभा पृथिव्याः पुरीषाणि जिन्वतमप्यानि ।सत्यश्रुतः कवयो यस्य गीर्भिर्जगतः स्थातर्जगदा कृणुध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: párjanyavātā ǀ vṛṣabhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ púrīṣāṇi ǀ jinvatam ǀ ápyāni ǀsátya-śrutaḥ ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ jágat ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Parjanyaand Vāta, showerers of rain, and from te firmament available waters; sage Maruts, hearers of the truth, establishers of the world, multiply the moveable (wealth of him) by whose praises (you are propitiated).
verses.wilson_translation: Parjanyaand Vāta, showerers of rain, and from te firmament available waters; sage Maruts, hearers of the truth, establishers of the world, multiply the moveable (wealth of him) by whose praises (you are propitiated).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पावीरवी कन्या चित्रायुः सरस्वती वीरपत्नी धियं धात् ।ग्नाभिरच्छिद्रं शरणं सजोषा दुराधर्षं गृणते शर्म यंसत् ॥
verses.transliteration: pā́vīravī ǀ kanyā́ ǀ citrá-āyuḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ vīrá-patnī ǀ dhíyam ǀ dhāt ǀgnā́bhiḥ ǀ ácchidram ǀ śaraṇám ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ duḥ-ādhárṣam ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the purifying, amiable, graceful Sarasvatī, the bride of the hero, favour our pious rite; may she, together with the wives of the gods, well plural ased, bestow upon him who praises her a habitation free from defects and impenetrable (to wind and rain), and (grant him) felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: May the purifying, amiable, graceful Sarasvatī, the bride of the hero, favour our pious rite; may she, together with the wives of the gods, well plural ased, bestow upon him who praises her a habitation free from defects and impenetrable (to wind and rain), and (grant him) felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पथस्पथः परिपतिं वचस्या कामेन कृतो अभ्यानळर्कं ।स नो रासच्छुरुधश्चंद्राग्रा धियंधियं सीषधाति प्र पूषा ॥
verses.transliteration: patháḥ-pathaḥ ǀ pári-patim ǀ vacasyā́ ǀ kā́mena ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ānaṭ ǀ arkám ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsat ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ candrá-agrāḥ ǀ dhíyam-dhiyam ǀ sīsadhāti ǀ prá ǀ pūṣā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (the worshipper), influenced by the hope (of reward), approach with praise the adorable (Pūṣan), protector of all path; may he bestow upon us cows with golden horns; may Pūṣan bring to perfection our every rite.
verses.wilson_translation: May (the worshipper), influenced by the hope (of reward), approach with praise the adorable (Pūṣan), protector of all path; may he bestow upon us cows with golden horns; may Pūṣan bring to perfection our every rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमभाजं यशसं वयोधां सुपाणिं देवं सुगभस्तिमृभ्वं ।होता यक्षद्यजतं पस्त्यानामग्निस्त्वष्टारं सुहवं विभावा ॥
verses.transliteration: prathama-bhā́jam ǀ yaśásam ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́m ǀ su-pāṇím ǀ devám ǀ su-gábhastim ǀ ṛ́bhvam ǀhótā ǀ yakṣat ǀ yajatám ǀ pastyā́nām ǀ agníḥ ǀ tváṣṭāram ǀ su-hávam ǀ vibhā́-vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the illustrious Agni, the invoker of the gods, worship (with this oblation),Tvaṣṭā, the first divider (of forms), the renowned, the giver of food, the well-handed, the vast, the adored of householders, the readily invoked.
verses.wilson_translation: May the illustrious Agni, the invoker of the gods, worship (with this oblation),Tvaṣṭā, the first divider (of forms), the renowned, the giver of food, the well-handed, the vast, the adored of householders, the readily invoked.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भुवनस्य पितरं गीर्भिराभी रुद्रं दिवा वर्धया रुद्रमक्तौ ।बृहंतमृष्वमजरं सुषुम्नमृधग्घुवेम कविनेषितासः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhúvanasya ǀ pitáram ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ rudrám ǀ dívā ǀ vardháya ǀ rudrám ǀ aktáu ǀbṛhántam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ajáram ǀ su-sumnám ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ huvema ǀ kavínā ǀ iṣitā́saḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Exalt Rudra, the parent of the world, with these hmns by day; (exalt) Rudra (with them) by night; animated by the far-seeing, we invoke him, mighty, of plural asing aspect, undecaying, endowed with felicity, (the source of) prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: Exalt Rudra, the parent of the world, with these hmns by day; (exalt) Rudra (with them) by night; animated by the far-seeing, we invoke him, mighty, of plural asing aspect, undecaying, endowed with felicity, (the source of) prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ युवानः कवयो यज्ञियासो मरुतो गंत गृणतो वरस्यां ।अचित्रं चिद्धि जिन्वथा वृधंत इत्था नक्षंतो नरो अंगिरस्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yuvānaḥ ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ yajñiyāsaḥ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ gantá ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ varasyā́m ǀacitrám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ jínvatha ǀ vṛdhántaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ nákṣantaḥ ǀ naraḥ ǀ aṅgirasvát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ever youthful wise, and adorable Maruts, come to the praise of your adorer; thus augmenting, leaders (of rites), and spreading (through the firmament), like rays (of light), refresh the scanty woods (with rain).
verses.wilson_translation: Ever youthful wise, and adorable Maruts, come to the praise of your adorer; thus augmenting, leaders (of rites), and spreading (through the firmament), like rays (of light), refresh the scanty woods (with rain).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वीराय प्र तवसे तुरायाजा यूथेव पशुरक्षिरस्तं ।स पिस्पृशति तन्वि श्रुतस्य स्तृभिर्न नाकं वचनस्य विपः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ prá ǀ taváse ǀ turā́ya ǀ ája ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ paśu-rákṣiḥ ǀ ástam ǀsáḥ ǀ pispṛśati ǀ tanví ǀ śrutásya ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ nā́kam ǀ vacanásya ǀ vípaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer adoration to the valiant, powerful, swift-movig (company of the Maruts), as the herdsman (drives his) herd to their stall; may that (company) appropriate to its own body the praises of the pious worshipper, as the firmament (is studded) with stars.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer adoration to the valiant, powerful, swift-movig (company of the Maruts), as the herdsman (drives his) herd to their stall; may that (company) appropriate to its own body the praises of the pious worshipper, as the firmament (is studded) with stars.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो रजांसि विममे पार्थिवानि त्रिश्चिद्विष्णुर्मनवे बाधिताय ।तस्य ते शर्मन्नुपदद्यमाने राया मदेम तन्वा तना च ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ vi-mamé ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ tríḥ ǀ cit ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mánave ǀ bādhitā́ya ǀtásya ǀ te ǀ śárman ǀ upa-dadyámāne ǀ rāyā́ ǀ madema ǀ tanvā́ ǀ tánā ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we be happy in a home, in riches, in person nn, in children, bestowd upon us by you,Viṣṇu, who with three (steps) made the terrestrial reions for Manuwhen harassed (by theasuras).
verses.wilson_translation: May we be happy in a home, in riches, in person nn, in children, bestowd upon us by you,Viṣṇu, who with three (steps) made the terrestrial reions for Manuwhen harassed (by theasuras).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तन्नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो अद्भिरर्कैस्तत्पर्वतस्तत्सविता चनो धात् ।तदोषधीभिरभि रातिषाचो भगः पुरंधिर्जिन्वतु प्र राये ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ tát ǀ párvataḥ ǀ tát ǀ savitā́ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāt ǀtát ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ jinvatu ǀ prá ǀ rāyé ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Ahirbudhnya(propitiated) by (our) hymns, and Parvataand Savitāgive us food with water; may the bountiful (gods supply us), addition, with vegetable (grains); and may the all-wise Bhagabe propitious (to us) for (the acquisition of) riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May Ahirbudhnya(propitiated) by (our) hymns, and Parvataand Savitāgive us food with water; may the bountiful (gods supply us), addition, with vegetable (grains); and may the all-wise Bhagabe propitious (to us) for (the acquisition of) riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नु नो रयिं रथ्यं चर्षणिप्रां पुरुवीरं मह ऋतस्य गोपां ।क्षयं दाताजरं येन जनान्त्स्पृधो अदेवीरभि च क्रमाम विश आदेवीरभ्यश्नवाम ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ rathyám ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́m ǀ puru-vī́ram ǀ maháḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gopā́m ǀkṣáyam ǀ dāta ǀ ajáram ǀ yéna ǀ jánān ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ca ǀ krámāma ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā́-devīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ aśnávāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us, (universal gods), riches, comprehending chariots, numerous dependants, manymaleoffspring, (wealth) the giver of efficiency to the solemn rite, and a dwelling free from decay, wherewith we may overcome malevolent men and unrighteous (spirits), and afford support to those people who are devoted to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us, (universal gods), riches, comprehending chariots, numerous dependants, manymaleoffspring, (wealth) the giver of efficiency to the solemn rite, and a dwelling free from decay, wherewith we may overcome malevolent men and unrighteous (spirits), and afford support to those people who are devoted to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN L. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I CALL with prayers on Aditi your Goddess, on Agni, Mitra, Varuṇa for favour,On Aryaman who gives unasked, the gracious, on Gods who save, on Savitar and Bhaga. Visit, to prove us free from sin, O Sūrya Lord of great might, the bright Gods sprung from Dakṣa,Twice-born and true, observing sacred duties, Holy and full of light, whose tongue is Agni. And, O ye Heaven and Earth, a wide dominion, O ye most blissful Worlds, our lofty shelter,Give ample room and freedom for our dwelling, a home, ye Hemispheres, which none may rival. This day invited may the Sons of Rudra, resistless, excellent, stoop down to meet us;For, when beset with slight or sore affliction, we ever call upon the Gods, the Maruts; To whom the Goddess Rodasī clings closely, whom Pūṣan follows bringing ample bounty.What time ye hear our call and come, O Maruts, upon your separate path all creatures tremble. With a new hymn extol, O thou who singest, the Lover of the Song, the Hero Indra.May he, exalted, hear our invocation, and grant us mighty wealth and strength when lauded. Give full protection, Friends of man, ye Waters, in peace and trouble, to our sons and grandsons.For ye are our most motherly physicians, parents of all that standeth, all that moveth. May Savitar come hither and approach us, the God who rescues, Holy, goldenhanded,The God who, bounteous as the face of Morning, discloses precious gifts for him who worships. And thou, O Son of Strength, do thou turn hither the Gods to-day to this our holy service.May I for evermore enjoy thy bounty and, Agni, by thy grace be rich in heroes. Come also to my call, O ye Nāsatyas, yea, verily, through my prayers, ye Holy Sages.As from great darkness ye delivered Atri, protect us, Chiefs, from danger in the conflict. O Gods, bestow upon us riches, splendid with strength and heroes, bringing food in plenty.Be gracious, helpful Gods of earth, of heaven, born of the Cow, and dwellers in the waters. May Rudra and Sarasvatī, accordant, Viṣṇu and Vāyu, pour down gifts and bless us;Ṛbhukṣan, Vāja, and divine Vidhatar, Parjanya, Vāta make our food abundant. May this God Savitar, the Lord, the Offspring of Waters, pouring down his dew be gracious,And, with the Gods and Dames accordant, Tvaṣṭar; Dyaus with the Gods and Prthivi with oceans. May Aja-Ekapād and Ahibudhnya, and Earth and Ocean hear our invocation;All Gods who strengthen Law, invoked and lauded, and holy texts uttered by sages, help us. So with my thoughts and hymns of praise the children of Bharadvāja sing aloud to please you.The Dames invoked, and the resistless Vasus, and all ye Holy Ones have been exalted.

verses.sanskrit: हुवे वो देवीमदितिं नमोभिर्मृळीकाय वरुणं मित्रमग्निं ।अभिक्षदामर्यमणं सुशेवं त्रातॄंदेवान्त्सवितारं भगं च ॥
verses.transliteration: huvé ǀ vaḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ áditim ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ váruṇam ǀ mitrám ǀ agním ǀabhi-kṣadā́m ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ su-śévam ǀ trātṝ́n ǀ devā́n ǀ savitā́ram ǀ bhágam ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke with adorations, for the sake of felicity, the divine Aditiad Varuṇa,Mitraand Agni,Aryaman, the overthrower of foes, worthy of devotion,Savitāand Bhaga, and (all) protecting divinities.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke with adorations, for the sake of felicity, the divine Aditiad Varuṇa,Mitraand Agni,Aryaman, the overthrower of foes, worthy of devotion,Savitāand Bhaga, and (all) protecting divinities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुज्योतिषः सूर्य दक्षपितॄननागास्त्वे सुमहो वीहि देवान् ।द्विजन्मानो य ऋतसापः सत्याः स्वर्वंतो यजता अग्निजिह्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-jyótiṣaḥ ǀ sūrya ǀ dákṣa-pitṝn ǀ anāgāḥ-tvé ǀ su-mahaḥ ǀ vīhi ǀ devā́n ǀdvi-jánmānaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ sváḥ-vantaḥ ǀ yajatā́ḥ ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Radiant Sūrya, render the luminous deiies, who have Dakṣafor their progenitor, void of offence towards us; they who are twice born, desirous of sacrifice, observant of truth, possessors of wealth, deserving of worship, whose tongue is Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: Radiant Sūrya, render the luminous deiies, who have Dakṣafor their progenitor, void of offence towards us; they who are twice born, desirous of sacrifice, observant of truth, possessors of wealth, deserving of worship, whose tongue is Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत द्यावापृथिवी क्षत्रमुरु बृहद्रोदसी शरणं सुषुम्ने ।महस्करथो वरिवो यथा नोऽस्मे क्षयाय धिषणे अनेहः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ kṣatrám ǀ urú ǀ bṛhát ǀ rodasī íti ǀ śaraṇám ǀ susumne íti su-sumne ǀmaháḥ ǀ karathaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ dhiṣaṇe íti ǀ aneháḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or bestow, Heaven and Earth, vast strength; give us, Earth and Heaven, a spacious habitation for our comfort; so arrange, that infinite wealth may be ours, remove, beneficent deities, iniquity from our abode.
verses.wilson_translation: Or bestow, Heaven and Earth, vast strength; give us, Earth and Heaven, a spacious habitation for our comfort; so arrange, that infinite wealth may be ours, remove, beneficent deities, iniquity from our abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो रुद्रस्य सूनवो नमंतामद्या हूतासो वसवोऽधृष्टाः ।यदीमर्भे महति वा हितासो बाधे मरुतो अह्वाम देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ namantām ǀ adyá ǀ hūtā́saḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ árbhe ǀ mahatí ǀ vā ǀ hitā́saḥ ǀ bādhé ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áhvāma ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the sons of Rudra, givers of dwellings, the unsubdued, invoked on this occasion, stoop down to us, inasmuch as we call upon the divine Marutsthat they may be our helpers in difficulty, great or small.
verses.wilson_translation: May the sons of Rudra, givers of dwellings, the unsubdued, invoked on this occasion, stoop down to us, inasmuch as we call upon the divine Marutsthat they may be our helpers in difficulty, great or small.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मिम्यक्ष येषु रोदसी नु देवी सिषक्ति पूषा अभ्यर्धयज्वा ।श्रुत्वा हवं मरुतो यद्ध याथ भूमा रेजंते अध्वनि प्रविक्ते ॥
verses.transliteration: mimyákṣa ǀ yéṣu ǀ rodasī́ ǀ nú ǀ devī́ ǀ sísakti ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ abhyardha-yájvā ǀśrutvā́ ǀ hávam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ yāthá ǀ bhū́ma ǀ rejante ǀ ádhvani ǀ prá-vikte ǁ
verses.english_translation: With whom the divine Heaven and Earth are associated; whom Pūṣan, the rewarder (of his worshippers) with prosperity, honours; when,Maruts, having heard our invocation, you come hither, then on your several paths all beings tremble.
verses.wilson_translation: With whom the divine Heaven and Earth are associated; whom Pūṣan, the rewarder (of his worshippers) with prosperity, honours; when,Maruts, having heard our invocation, you come hither, then on your several paths all beings tremble.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्यं वीरं गिर्वणसमर्चेंद्रं ब्रह्मणा जरितर्नवेन ।श्रवदिद्धवमुप च स्तवानो रासद्वाजाँ उप महो गृणानः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ vīrám ǀ gírvaṇasam ǀ arca ǀ índram ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ návena ǀśrávat ǀ ít ǀ hávam ǀ úpa ǀ ca ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ rā́sat ǀ vā́jān ǀ úpa ǀ maháḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise, worshipper, with a new hymn, that hero,Indra, who is deserving of praise; may he, so glorified hear our invocation; may he, so lauded, bestow upon us abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise, worshipper, with a new hymn, that hero,Indra, who is deserving of praise; may he, so glorified hear our invocation; may he, so lauded, bestow upon us abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ओमानमापो मानुषीरमृक्तं धात तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ।यूयं हि ष्ठा भिषजो मातृतमा विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतो जनित्रीः ॥
verses.transliteration: omā́nam ǀ āpaḥ ǀ mānuṣīḥ ǀ ámṛktam ǀ dhā́ta ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ bhiṣájaḥ ǀ mātṛ́-tamāḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ jánitrīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Waters, friendly to mankind, grant uninterrupted (life) preserving (food) for (the perpetuation of our) sons and grandsons; grant us security and the removal (of all evil), for you are more than maternal physicians; you are the parents of the stationary and moveable universe.
verses.wilson_translation: Waters, friendly to mankind, grant uninterrupted (life) preserving (food) for (the perpetuation of our) sons and grandsons; grant us security and the removal (of all evil), for you are more than maternal physicians; you are the parents of the stationary and moveable universe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणो हिरण्यपाणिर्यजतो जगम्यात् ।यो दत्रवाँ उषसो न प्रतीकं व्यूर्णुते दाशुषे वार्याणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ trā́yamāṇaḥ ǀ híraṇya-pāṇiḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǀyáḥ ǀ dátra-vān ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ prátīkam ǀ vi-ūrṇuté ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the adorable, golden-handed Savitā, the preserver, come to us; he, the munificent, who, like the opening of the dawn, displays desirable (riches) to the offerer of the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: May the adorable, golden-handed Savitā, the preserver, come to us; he, the munificent, who, like the opening of the dawn, displays desirable (riches) to the offerer of the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्वं सूनो सहसो नो अद्या देवाँ अस्मिन्नध्वरे ववृत्याः ।स्यामहं ते सदमिद्रातौ तव स्यामग्नेऽवसा सुवीरः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tvám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ asmín ǀ adhvaré ǀ vavṛtyāḥ ǀsyā́m ǀ ahám ǀ te ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ rātáu ǀ táva ǀ syām ǀ agne ǀ ávasā ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: And do you, son of strength, bring back today the deities to this our sacrifice; may  I be ever in (the enoyment of) your bounty; may I, through your protection,Agni, be blessed with excellentmaledescendants.
verses.wilson_translation: And do you, son of strength, bring back today the deities to this our sacrifice; may  I be ever in (the enoyment of) your bounty; may I, through your protection,Agni, be blessed with excellentmaledescendants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्या मे हवमा जग्म्यातं नासत्या धीभिर्युवमंग विप्रा ।अत्रिं न महस्तमसोऽमुमुक्तं तूर्वतं नरा दुरितादभीके ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ jagmyātam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ viprā ǀátrim ǀ ná ǀ maháḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ amumuktam ǀ tū́rvatam ǀ narā ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ abhī́ke ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise Nāsatyāscome quickly to my invocation (united) with holy acts; (extricate us) from thick darkness, as you did extricate Atri; protect us, leaders (of rites) from danger in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Wise Nāsatyāscome quickly to my invocation (united) with holy acts; (extricate us) from thick darkness, as you did extricate Atri; protect us, leaders (of rites) from danger in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो रायो द्युमतो वाजवतो दातारो भूत नृवतः पुरुक्षोः ।दशस्यंतो दिव्याः पार्थिवासो गोजाता अप्या मृळता च देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dyu-mátaḥ ǀ vā́ja-vataḥ ǀ dātā́raḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ puru-kṣóḥ ǀdaśasyántaḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀ gó-jātāḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ ca ǀ devāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be unto us, gods, donors of splendid, invigorating riches, comprisingmaledescendants, and celebrated by many; celestialĀdityas, terrestrial Vasus, offspring of Pṛśni, children of the waters, granting our desires, make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Be unto us, gods, donors of splendid, invigorating riches, comprisingmaledescendants, and celebrated by many; celestialĀdityas, terrestrial Vasus, offspring of Pṛśni, children of the waters, granting our desires, make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो रुद्रः सरस्वती सजोषा मीळ्हुष्मंतो विष्णुर्मृळंतु वायुः ।ऋभुक्षा वाजो दैव्यो विधाता पर्जन्यावाता पिप्यतामिषं नः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ mīḷhúṣmantaḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mṛḷantu ǀ vāyúḥ ǀṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ vi-dhātā́ ǀ parjányāvā́tā ǀ pipyatām ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Rudraand Sarasvatī, alike well plural ased and Viṣṇuand Vāyu, make us happy, sending rain; and Ribhukṣin, and Vāja, and the divine Vidhātā; and may Parjanyaand Vātagrant us abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: May Rudraand Sarasvatī, alike well plural ased and Viṣṇuand Vāyu, make us happy, sending rain; and Ribhukṣin, and Vāja, and the divine Vidhātā; and may Parjanyaand Vātagrant us abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्य देवः सविता भगो नोऽपां नपादवतु दानु पप्रिः ।त्वष्टा देवेभिर्जनिभिः सजोषा द्यौर्देवेभिः पृथिवी समुद्रैः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ avatu ǀ dā́nu ǀ pápriḥ ǀtváṣṭā ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ samudráiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: And may the divine Savitāand Bhaga, and the grandson of the waters, (Agni), the prodigal of gifts, preserve us; and may Tvaṣṭāwith the gods, and Earth with the seas, (preserve us).
verses.wilson_translation: And may the divine Savitāand Bhaga, and the grandson of the waters, (Agni), the prodigal of gifts, preserve us; and may Tvaṣṭāwith the gods, and Earth with the seas, (preserve us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणोत्वज एकपात्पृथिवी समुद्रः ।विश्वे देवा ऋतावृधो हुवानाः स्तुता मंत्राः कविशस्ता अवंतु ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ ajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ samudráḥ ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ huvānā́ḥ ǀ stutā́ḥ ǀ mántrāḥ ǀ kavi-śastā́ḥ ǀ avantu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Ahirbudhnya, Aja-ekapād, and Earth and Ocean, hear us; may the universal gods, who are exalted by sacrifice, they who are invoked and praised (by us), to whom mystical prayers are addressed, and who have been glorified by (ancient) sages, preserve us.
verses.wilson_translation: May Ahirbudhnya, Aja-ekapād, and Earth and Ocean, hear us; may the universal gods, who are exalted by sacrifice, they who are invoked and praised (by us), to whom mystical prayers are addressed, and who have been glorified by (ancient) sages, preserve us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा नपातो मम तस्य धीभिर्भरद्वाजा अभ्यर्चंत्यर्कैः ।ग्ना हुतासो वसवोऽधृष्टा विश्वे स्तुतासो भूता यजत्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ nápātaḥ ǀ máma ǀ tásya ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ bharát-vājāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ arkáiḥ ǀgnā́ḥ ǀ hutā́saḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǀ víśve ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ yajatrāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus do my sons, of the race of Bharadvāja, worship the gods with sacred rites and holy hymns; and so, adorable (deities), may you, who are worshipped and glorified, the givers of dwellings, the invincible, universal gods, ever be adored, (together with your) wives.
verses.wilson_translation: Thus do my sons, of the race of Bharadvāja, worship the gods with sacred rites and holy hymns; and so, adorable (deities), may you, who are worshipped and glorified, the givers of dwellings, the invincible, universal gods, ever be adored, (together with your) wives.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LI. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १६ ऋजिश्वा भारद्वाज: । विश्वे देवा:। त्रिष्टुप् , १३ – १५ उष्णिक्, १६ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THAT mighty eye of Varuṇa and Mitra, infallible and dear, is moving upward.The pure and lovely face of holy Order hath shone like gold of heaven in its arising. The Sage who knows these Gods’ three ranks and orders, and all their generations near and distant,Beholding good and evil acts of mortals, Sūra marks well the doing of the pious. I praise you Guards of mighty Law eternal, Aditi, Mitra, Varuṇa, the noble,Aryaman, Bhaga, all whose thoughts are faithful: hither I call the Bright who share in common. Lords of the brave, infallible, foe-destroyers, great Kings, bestowers of fair homes to dwell in,Young, Heroes, ruling heaven with strong dominion, Ādityas, Aditi I seek with worship. O Heaven our Father, Earth our guileless Mother, O Brother Agni, and ye Vasus, bless us.Grant us, O Aditi and ye Ādityas, all of one mind, your manifold protection. Give us not up to any evil creature, as spoil to wolf or she-wolf, O ye Holy.For ye are they who guide aright our bodies, ye are the rulers of our speech and vigour. Let us not suffer for the sin of others, nor do the deed which ye, O Vasus, punish.Ye, Universal Gods! are all-controllers: may he do harm unto himself who hates Me. Mighty is homage: I adopt and use it. Homage hath held in place the earth and heaven.Homage to Gods! Homage commands and rules them. I banish even committed sin by homage You Furtherers of Law, pure in your spirit, infallible, dwellers in the home of Order,To you all Heroes mighty and far-seeing I bow me down, O Holy Ones, with homage. For these are they who shine with noblest splendour; through all our troubles these conduct us safely-Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, mighty Rulers, trueminded, faithful to the hymn's controllers. May they, Earth, Aditi, Indra, Bhaga, Pūṣan increase our laud, increase the Fivefold people.Giving good help, good refuge, goodly guidance, be they our good deliverers, good protectors. Come now, O Gods, to your celestial station: the Bharadvājas' priest entreats your favour.He, sacrificing, fain for wealth, hath honoured the Gods vath those who sit and share oblations. Agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away,Far, far, Lord of the brave I and give us easy paths. Soma, these pressing-stones have called aloud to win thee for our Friend.Destroy the greedy Paṇi, for a wolf is he. Ye, O most bountiful, are they who, led by Indra, seek the sky.Give us good paths for travel: guard us ivell at home. Now have we entered on the road that leads to bliss, without a foe,The road whereon a man escapes all enemies and gathers wealth.

verses.sanskrit: उदु त्यच्चक्षुर्महि मित्रयोराँ एति प्रियं वरुणयोरदब्धं ।ऋतस्य शुचि दर्शतमनीकं रुक्मो न दिव उदिता व्यद्यौत् ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyát ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ máhi ǀ mitráyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ éti ǀ priyám ǀ váruṇayoḥ ǀ ádabdham ǀṛtásya ǀ śúci ǀ darśatám ǀ ánīkam ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ diváḥ ǀ út-itā ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǁ
verses.english_translation: The expansive, illuminating, unobstructive, pure, and beautiful radiance of the sun, grateful to Mitraand Varuṇa, having risen, shines like the ornament of the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: The expansive, illuminating, unobstructive, pure, and beautiful radiance of the sun, grateful to Mitraand Varuṇa, having risen, shines like the ornament of the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वेद यस्त्रीणि विदथान्येषां देवानां जन्म सनुतरा च विप्रः ।ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन्नभि चष्टे सूरो अर्य एवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: véda ǀ yáḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ vidáthāni ǀ eṣām ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánma ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ vípraḥ ǀṛjú ǀ márteṣu ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ ca ǀ páśyan ǀ abhí ǀ caṣṭe ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ évān ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who knows the three cognizable (worlds); the sage (who knows) the mysterious birth of the divinities (abiding in them); he who is beholding the good and evil acts of mortals, he, the sun, the lord, makes manifest their intentions.
verses.wilson_translation: He who knows the three cognizable (worlds); the sage (who knows) the mysterious birth of the divinities (abiding in them); he who is beholding the good and evil acts of mortals, he, the sun, the lord, makes manifest their intentions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तुष उ वो मह ऋतस्य गोपानदितिं मित्रं वरुणं सुजातान् ।अर्यमणं भगमदब्धधीतीनच्छा वोचे सधन्यः पावकान् ॥
verses.transliteration: stuṣé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gopā́n ǀ áditim ǀ mitrám ǀ váruṇam ǀ su-jātā́n ǀaryamáṇam ǀ bhágam ǀ ádabdha-dhītīn ǀ áccha ǀ voce ǀ sa-dhanyáḥ ǀ pāvakā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: I praise you, protectors of the solemn sacrifice, the well-born Aditi,Mitraand Varuṇaand Aryamanand Bhaga; I celebrate the gods whose acts are unimpeded, the bestowers of wealth, the dispensers of purity.
verses.wilson_translation: I praise you, protectors of the solemn sacrifice, the well-born Aditi,Mitraand Varuṇaand Aryamanand Bhaga; I celebrate the gods whose acts are unimpeded, the bestowers of wealth, the dispensers of purity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रिशादसः सत्पतीँरदब्धान्महो राज्ञः सुवसनस्य दातॄन् ।यूनः सुक्षत्रान्क्षयतो दिवो नॄनादित्यान्याम्यदितिं दुवोयु ॥
verses.transliteration: riśā́dasaḥ ǀ sát-patīn ǀ ádabdhān ǀ maháḥ ǀ rā́jñaḥ ǀ su-vasanásya ǀ dātṝ́n ǀyū́naḥ ǀ su-kṣatrā́n ǀ kṣáyataḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ yāmi ǀ áditim ǀ duvaḥ-yú ǁ
verses.english_translation: The scatterers of the malevolent, the defenders of the virtuous, the irresistible, the mighty lords, the donors of good dwellings, ever young, very powerful, omnipresent, leader of heaven, the sons ofĀditya; I have recourse to Aditi, who is gratified by mine adoration.
verses.wilson_translation: The scatterers of the malevolent, the defenders of the virtuous, the irresistible, the mighty lords, the donors of good dwellings, ever young, very powerful, omnipresent, leader of heaven, the sons ofĀditya; I have recourse to Aditi, who is gratified by mine adoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्यौष्पितः पृथिवि मातरध्रुगग्ने भ्रातर्वसवो मृळता नः ।विश्व आदित्या अदिते सजोषा अस्मभ्यं शर्म बहुलं वि यंत ॥
verses.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ pítaríti ǀ pṛ́thivi ǀ mā́taḥ ǀ ádhruk ǀ ágne ǀ bhrātaḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ naḥ ǀvíśve ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ adite ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ bahulám ǀ ví ǀ yanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Father Heaven, innocent mother Earth, brother Agni, and you,Vasus, grant us happiness; all you sons of Aditi, and you Aditi, alike well-plural ased, bestow upon us ample felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: Father Heaven, innocent mother Earth, brother Agni, and you,Vasus, grant us happiness; all you sons of Aditi, and you Aditi, alike well-plural ased, bestow upon us ample felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो वृकाय वृक्ये समस्मा अघायते रीरधता यजत्राः ।यूयं हि ष्ठा रथ्यो नस्तनूनां यूयं दक्षस्य वचसो बभूव ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛ́kāya ǀ vṛkyé ǀ samasmai ǀ agha-yaté ǀ rīradhata ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tanū́nām ǀ yūyám ǀ dákṣasya ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ babhūvá ǁ
verses.english_translation: Subject us not, adorable (deities), to the robber or his wife; not to any one designing us harm; for you are the regulators of our person ns, of our strength, of our speech.
verses.wilson_translation: Subject us not, adorable (deities), to the robber or his wife; not to any one designing us harm; for you are the regulators of our person ns, of our strength, of our speech.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा व एनो अन्यकृतं भुजेम मा तत्कर्म वसवो यच्चयध्वे ।विश्वस्य हि क्षयथ विश्वदेवाः स्वयं रिपुस्तन्वं रीरिषीष्ट ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ énaḥ ǀ anyá-kṛtam ǀ bhujema ǀ mā́ ǀ tát ǀ karma ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ yát ǀ cáyadhve ǀvíśvasya ǀ hí ǀ kṣáyatha ǀ viśva-devāḥ ǀ svayám ǀ ripúḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ ririṣīṣṭa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us not suffer for the sin committed by another; let us not do that which,Vasus, you prohibit; you rule universal gods, over the universe; (so provide that) mine enemy may inflict injury on his own person n.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us not suffer for the sin committed by another; let us not do that which,Vasus, you prohibit; you rule universal gods, over the universe; (so provide that) mine enemy may inflict injury on his own person n.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नम इदुग्रं नम आ विवासे नमो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्यां ।नमो देवेभ्यो नम ईश एषां कृतं चिदेनो नमसा विवासे ॥
verses.transliteration: námaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ugrám ǀ námaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǀ námaḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀnámaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ īśe ǀ eṣām ǀ kṛtám ǀ cit ǀ énaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Reverence be to the potent (company of universal gods); I offer (them) reverence; reverence sustains both earth and heaven; revernce be to the gods; reverence is sovereign over them; I expiate by reverence whatever sin may have been committed.
verses.wilson_translation: Reverence be to the potent (company of universal gods); I offer (them) reverence; reverence sustains both earth and heaven; revernce be to the gods; reverence is sovereign over them; I expiate by reverence whatever sin may have been committed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतस्य वो रथ्यः पूतदक्षानृतस्य पस्त्यसदो अदब्धान् ।ताँ आ नमोभिरुरुचक्षसो नॄन्विश्वान्व आ नमे महो यजत्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ vaḥ ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ pūtá-dakṣān ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pastya-sádaḥ ǀ ádabdhān ǀtā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ uru-cákṣasaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ víśvān ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ name ǀ maháḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable (deities), I venerate with reverential salutations all you who are mighty, the mighty, the regulators of your sacrifice, of pure vigour, dwellers in the chamber of worship, unsubdued, far-seeing, leaders (of rites).
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable (deities), I venerate with reverential salutations all you who are mighty, the mighty, the regulators of your sacrifice, of pure vigour, dwellers in the chamber of worship, unsubdued, far-seeing, leaders (of rites).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते हि श्रेष्ठवर्चसस्त उ नस्तिरो विश्वानि दुरिता नयंति ।सुक्षत्रासो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निर्ऋतधीतयो वक्मराजसत्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ śréṣṭha-varcasaḥ ǀ té ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ náyanti ǀsu-kṣatrā́saḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ṛtá-dhītayaḥ ǀ vakmarā́ja-satyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May they, exceeding in splendour, so guide us, that all iniquities may disappear, they, the very powerful Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, practisers of truth, and faithful to those who are prominent in (their) praise.
verses.wilson_translation: May they, exceeding in splendour, so guide us, that all iniquities may disappear, they, the very powerful Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, practisers of truth, and faithful to those who are prominent in (their) praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते न इंद्रः पृथिवी क्षाम वर्धन्पूषा भगो अदितिः पंच जनाः ।सुशर्माणः स्ववसः सुनीथा भवंतु नः सुत्रात्रासः सुगोपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ kṣā́ma ǀ vardhan ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ páñca ǀ jánāḥ ǀsu-śármāṇaḥ ǀ su-ávasaḥ ǀ su-nīthā́ḥ ǀ bhávantu ǀ naḥ ǀ su-trātrā́saḥ ǀ su-gopā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May they,Indra, Earth,Pūṣan,Bhaga,Aditiand the five orders of beings, give increase to our habitations; may they be to us granters of happiness, bestowers of food, guides to good, our gracious defenders and preservers.
verses.wilson_translation: May they,Indra, Earth,Pūṣan,Bhaga,Aditiand the five orders of beings, give increase to our habitations; may they be to us granters of happiness, bestowers of food, guides to good, our gracious defenders and preservers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू सद्मानं दिव्यं नंशि देवा भारद्वाजः सुमतिं याति होता ।आसानेभिर्यजमानो मियेधैर्देवानां जन्म वसूयुर्ववंद ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ sadmā́nam ǀ divyám ǀ náṃśi ǀ devāḥ ǀ bhā́rat-vājaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ yāti ǀ hótā ǀāsānébhiḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ miyédhaiḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánma ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀ vavanda ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the preseenter of the oblation,Bharadvāja, quickly obtain, gods, a celestial abode, as he solicits your good-will; the instrumental tutor of the ceremony, together with pious associates, desirous of riches, glorifies the assembly of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May the preseenter of the oblation,Bharadvāja, quickly obtain, gods, a celestial abode, as he solicits your good-will; the instrumental tutor of the ceremony, together with pious associates, desirous of riches, glorifies the assembly of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अप त्यं वृजिनं रिपुं स्तेनमग्ने दुराध्यं ।दविष्ठमस्य सत्पते कृधी सुगं ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ tyám ǀ vṛjinám ǀ ripúm ǀ stenám ǀ agne ǀ duḥ-ādhyám ǀdaviṣṭhám ǀ asya ǀ sat-pate ǀ kṛdhí ǀ su-gám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drive away,Agni, to a distance the wicked, felonious, malignant enemy; grant us felicity, protector of the virtuous.
verses.wilson_translation: Drive away,Agni, to a distance the wicked, felonious, malignant enemy; grant us felicity, protector of the virtuous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ग्रावाणः सोम नो हि कं सखित्वनाय वावशुः ।जही न्यत्रिणं पणिं वृको हि षः ॥
verses.transliteration: grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ sakhi-tvanā́ya ǀ vāvaśúḥ ǀjahí ǀ ní ǀ atríṇam ǀ paṇím ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These our grinding stones are anxious,Soma, for your friendship; destroy the voracious Paṇi, for verily he is a wolf.
verses.wilson_translation: These our grinding stones are anxious,Soma, for your friendship; destroy the voracious Paṇi, for verily he is a wolf.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इंद्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः ।कर्ता नो अध्वन्ना सुगं गोपा अमा ॥
verses.transliteration: yūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ índra-jyeṣṭhāḥ ǀ abhí-dyavaḥ ǀkárta ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhvan ǀ ā́ ǀ su-gám ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ amā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have travelled along the road prosperously traversed and free from evil, and by which (a man) avoids adversaries and acquires wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We have travelled along the road prosperously traversed and free from evil, and by which (a man) avoids adversaries and acquires wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LIL Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १७ ऋजिश्वा भारद्वाज: । विश्वे देवा: । त्रिष्टुप् , ७-१२ गायत्री, १४ जगती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS I allow not in the earth or heaven, at sacrifice or in these holy duties.May the huge mountains crush him down: degraded be Atiyaja's sacrificing patron. Or he who holds us in contempt, O Maruts, or seeks to blame the prayer that we are making,May agonies of burning be his portion. May the sky scorch the man who hates devotion. Why then, O Soma, do they call thee keeper of prayer? Why then our guardian from reproaches?Why then beholdest thou how men revile us? Cast thy hot dart at him who hates devotion. May Mornings as they spring to life, protect me, and may the Rivers as they swell preserve me.My guardians be the firmly-seated mountains: the Fathers, when I call on Gods, defend me! Through all our days may we be healthy. minded, and look upon the Sun when he arises.Grant this the Treasure-Lord of treasures, coming, observant, oftenest of Gods, with succour! Most near, most oft comes Indra with protection, and she Sarasvatī, who swells with rivers -Parjanya, bringing health with herbs, and Agni, well lauded swift to listen, like a father. Hear this mine invocation; come hither, O Universal Gods,Be seated on this holy grass. To him who comes to meet you, Gods, with offerings bathed in holy oil-Approach ye, one and all, to him. All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing,And be exceeding good to us. May all the Gods who strengthen Law, with Ṛtus, listening to our call,Be pleased with theit appropriate draught. May Indra, with the Marut host, with Tvaṣṭar, Mitra, Aryaman,Accept the laud and these our gifts. O Agni, Priest, as rules ordain, offer this sacrifice of ours,Remembering the Heavenly Folk. Listen, All-Gods, to this mine invocation, Ye who inhabit heaven, and air's midregions,All ye, O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon this sacred grass, be joyful. May the All-Gods who claim our worship hear my thought; may the two World-halves hear it, and the Waters’ Child.Let me not utter words that ye may disregard. Closely allied with you may we rejoice in bliss. And those who, Mighty, with the wiles of serpents, were born on earth, in heaven, where waters gather-May they vouchsafe us life of full duration. May the Gods kindly give us nights and mornings. At this my call, O Agni and Parjanya, help, swift to hear, my thought and our laudation.One generates holy food, the other offspring, so grant us food enough with store of children. When holy grass is strewn and fire enkindled, with hymn and lowly homage I invite you.All-Gods, to day in this our great assembly rejoice, ye Holy, in the gifts we offer.

verses.sanskrit: न तद्दिवा न पृथिव्यानु मन्ये न यज्ञेन नोत शमीभिराभिः ।उब्जंतु तं सुभ्वः पर्वतासो नि हीयतामतियाजस्य यष्टा ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tát ǀ divā́ ǀ ná ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ ánu ǀ manye ǀ ná ǀ yajñéna ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ ābhíḥ ǀubjántu ǀ tám ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ní ǀ hīyatām ǀ ati-yājásya ǀ yaṣṭā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I do not regard it as worthy (of the gods) of heaven, or (those) of earth, as (fit to be compared) with the sacrifice (I offer) or with these (our) sacred rites; let, then, the mighty mountains overhelm him; let the employer of Atiyāja be ever degraded.
verses.wilson_translation: I do not regard it as worthy (of the gods) of heaven, or (those) of earth, as (fit to be compared) with the sacrifice (I offer) or with these (our) sacred rites; let, then, the mighty mountains overhelm him; let the employer of Atiyāja be ever degraded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अति वा यो मरुतो मन्यते नो ब्रह्म वा यः क्रियमाणं निनित्सात् ।तपूंषि तस्मै वृजिनानि संतु ब्रह्मद्विषमभि तं शोचतु द्यौः ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mányate ǀ naḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ kriyámāṇam ǀ nínitsāt ǀtápūṃṣi ǀ tásmai ǀ vṛjinā́ni ǀ santu ǀ brahma-dvíṣam ǀ abhí ǀ tám ǀ śocatu ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, may the energies of that man be enfeebled; may heaven consume that impious adversary who thinks himself superior to us, and who pretends to deprecate the worship that we offer.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, may the energies of that man be enfeebled; may heaven consume that impious adversary who thinks himself superior to us, and who pretends to deprecate the worship that we offer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: किमंग त्वा ब्रह्मणः सोम गोपां किमंग त्वाहुरभिशस्तिपां नः ।किमंग नः पश्यसि निद्यमानान्ब्रह्मद्विषे तपुषिं हेतिमस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: kím ǀ aṅgá ǀ tvā ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ soma ǀ gopā́m ǀ kím ǀ aṅgá ǀ tvā ǀ āhuḥ ǀ abhiśasti-pā́m ǀ naḥ ǀkím ǀ aṅgá ǀ naḥ ǀ paśyasi ǀ nidyámānān ǀ brahma-dvíṣe ǀ tápuṣim ǀ hetím ǀ asya ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the opening dawns preserve me; may the swelling rivers preserve me; may the firm-set mountains preserve me; may the progenitors (present) at the invocation of the gods preserve me.
verses.wilson_translation: May the opening dawns preserve me; may the swelling rivers preserve me; may the firm-set mountains preserve me; may the progenitors (present) at the invocation of the gods preserve me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवंतु मामुषसो जायमाना अवंतु मा सिंधवः पिन्वमानाः ।अवंतु मा पर्वतासो ध्रुवासोऽवंतु मा पितरो देवहूतौ ॥
verses.transliteration: ávantu ǀ mā́m ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ jā́yamānāḥ ǀ ávantu ǀ mā ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pínvamānāḥ ǀávantu ǀ mā ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ dhruvā́saḥ ǀ ávantu ǀ mā ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ devá-hūtau ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we at all seasons be possessed of sound minds; may we ever behold the rising sun; such may the affluent lord of riches, (Agni), render us, ever most ready to come (at our invocation), charged with our oblation to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May we at all seasons be possessed of sound minds; may we ever behold the rising sun; such may the affluent lord of riches, (Agni), render us, ever most ready to come (at our invocation), charged with our oblation to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वदानीं सुमनसः स्याम पश्येम नु सूर्यमुच्चरंतं ।तथा करद्वसुपतिर्वसूनां देवाँ ओहानोऽवसागमिष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration: viśva-dā́nīm ǀ su-mánasaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ páśyema ǀ nú ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ut-cárantam ǀtáthā ǀ karat ǀ vásu-patiḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ devā́n ǀ óhānaḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indrabe most prompt to come nigh for our protection, and Sarasvatīdwelling with (tributary) rivers; may Parjanya, with the plural nts, be a giver of happiness; and may Agni, worthily praised and earnestly invoked, (be to us) like a father.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indrabe most prompt to come nigh for our protection, and Sarasvatīdwelling with (tributary) rivers; may Parjanya, with the plural nts, be a giver of happiness; and may Agni, worthily praised and earnestly invoked, (be to us) like a father.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो नेदिष्ठमवसागमिष्ठः सरस्वती सिंधुभिः पिन्वमाना ।पर्जन्यो न ओषधीभिर्मयोभुरग्निः सु��ंसः सुहवः पितेव ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ síndhu-bhiḥ ǀ pínvamānā ǀparjányaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-śáṃsaḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, universal gods, hear this my invocationl; sit down upon this sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, universal gods, hear this my invocationl; sit down upon this sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे देवास आ गत शृणुता म इमं हवं ।एदं बर्हिर्नि षीदत ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ śṛṇutá ǀ me ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, gods, to him who honours you with the butter drippling oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, gods, to him who honours you with the butter drippling oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वो देवा घृतस्नुना हव्येन प्रतिभूषति ।तं विश्व उप गच्छथ ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ghṛtá-snunā ǀ havyéna ǀ prati-bhū́ṣati ǀtám ǀ víśve ǀ úpa ǀ gacchatha ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the sons of the immortal hear our praises, and be to us the givers of felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: May the sons of the immortal hear our praises, and be to us the givers of felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वंत्वमृतस्य ये ।सुमृळीका भवंतु नः ॥
