Far-seeing hath this Agni been established, deathless mid mortals, wise among the foolish.Here, O victorious God, forbear to harm us: may weforever share thy gracious favour. He who hath occupied his God-made dwelling, Agni, in wisdom hath surpassed Immortals.A Babe unborn, the plants and trees support him, and the earth beareth him the All-sustainer. Agni is Lord of Amṛta. in abundance, Lord of the gift of wealth and hero valour,Victorious God, let us not sit about thee like men devoid of strength, beauty, and worship. The foeman's treasure may be won with labour: may we be masters of our own possessions.Agni, no son is he who springs from others: lengthen not out the pathways of the foolish. Unwelcome for adoption is the stranger, one to be thought of as another's offipring,Though grown familiar by continual presence. May our strong hero come, freshly triumphant. Guard us from him who would assail us, Agni; preserve us O thou Victor, from dishonour.Here let the place of darkening come upon thee: may wealth be ours, desirable, in thousands. Shine this felicity on us, O Agni: may we attain to perfect understanding.All happiness be theirs who sing and praise thee. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वः शुक्राय भानवे भरध्वं हव्यं मतिं चाग्नये सुपूतं ।यो दैव्यानि मानुषा जनूंष्यंतर्विश्वानि विद्मना जिगाति ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ śukrā́ya ǀ bhānáve ǀ bharadhvam ǀ havyám ǀ matím ǀ ca ǀ agnáye ǀ sú-pūtam ǀyáḥ ǀ dáivyāni ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ janū́ṃṣi ǀ antáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ vidmánā ǀ jígāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer your sacred oblation, and praise the bright and radiant Agni, who passes with wisdom between alldivine and human beings.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer your sacred oblation, and praise the bright and radiant Agni, who passes with wisdom between alldivine and human beings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स गृत्सो अग्निस्तरुणश्चिदस्तु यतो यविष्ठो अजनिष्ट मातुः ।सं यो वना युवते शुचिदन्भूरि चिदन्ना समिदत्ति सद्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gṛ́tsaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ táruṇaḥ ǀ cit ǀ astu ǀ yátaḥ ǀ yáviṣṭhaḥ ǀ ájaniṣṭa ǀ mātúḥ ǀsám ǀ yáḥ ǀ vánā ǀ yuváte ǀ śúci-dan ǀ bhū́ri ǀ cit ǀ ánnā ǀ sám ǀ ít ǀ atti ǀ sadyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the sagacious Agnibe our conductor from the time that he is orn, most youthful, of his mother; hewho, bright-toothed, attacks the forest, and quickly devours his abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: May the sagacious Agnibe our conductor from the time that he is orn, most youthful, of his mother; hewho, bright-toothed, attacks the forest, and quickly devours his abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य देवस्य संसद्यनीके यं मर्तासः श्येतं जगृभ्रे ।नि यो गृभं पौरुषेयीमुवोच दुरोकमग्निरायवे शुशोच ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ devásya ǀ sam-sádi ǀ ánīke ǀ yám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ śyetám ǀ jagṛbhré ǀní ǀ yáḥ ǀ gṛ́bham ǀ páuruṣeyīm ǀ uvóca ǀ duḥ-ókam ǀ agníḥ ǀ āyáve ǀ śuśoca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whom mortals apprehend as white (shining) in the principal station of that divinity; he who assents tomanly adoration, and blazes for the good of man, and the discomfiture (of his foes).
verses.wilson_translation: Whom mortals apprehend as white (shining) in the principal station of that divinity; he who assents tomanly adoration, and blazes for the good of man, and the discomfiture (of his foes).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं कविरकविषु प्रचेता मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि ।स मा नो अत्र जुहुरः सहस्वः सदा त्वे सुमनसः स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ákaviṣu ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ márteṣu ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhāyi ǀsáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ juhuraḥ ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ tvé íti ǀ su-mánasaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: This far-seeing, sagacious, immortal Agni, has been stationed among short-sighted mortals; harm usnot, vigorous Agni, in this world, that we may ever be devoted to you.
verses.wilson_translation: This far-seeing, sagacious, immortal Agni, has been stationed among short-sighted mortals; harm usnot, vigorous Agni, in this world, that we may ever be devoted to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यो योनिं देवकृतं ससाद क्रत्वा ह्यग्निरमृताँ अतारीत् ।तमोषधीश्च वनिनश्च गर्भं भूमिश्च विश्वधायसं बिभर्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ yónim ǀ devá-kṛtam ǀ sasā́da ǀ krátvā ǀ hí ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ átārīt ǀtám ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ ca ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ ca ǀ gárbham ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǀ bibharti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The herbs, and the trees, and the earth, contain as a germ that all- supporting Agni, who occupies aplace provided by the gods, that by his functions he may convey (the offerings) to the immortals.
verses.wilson_translation: The herbs, and the trees, and the earth, contain as a germ that all- supporting Agni, who occupies aplace provided by the gods, that by his functions he may convey (the offerings) to the immortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईशे ह्यग्निरमृतस्य भूरेरीशे रायः सुवीर्यस्य दातोः ।मा त्वा वयं सहसावन्नवीरा माप्सवः परि षदाम मादुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ī́śe ǀ hí ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ dā́toḥ ǀmā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ sahasā-van ǀ avī́rāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápsavaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sadāma ǀ mā́ ǀ áduvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnihas power to grant abundant food; he has power to grant riches withmaleposterity; vigorous Agni,let us not sit down before you devoid of sons, of beauty, of devotion.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnihas power to grant abundant food; he has power to grant riches withmaleposterity; vigorous Agni,let us not sit down before you devoid of sons, of beauty, of devotion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परिषद्यं ह्यरणस्य रेक्णो नित्यस्य रायः पतयः स्याम ।न शेषो अग्ने अन्यजातमस्त्यचेतानस्य मा पथो वि दुक्षः ॥
verses.transliteration: pari-sádyam ǀ hí ǀ áraṇasya ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ nítyasya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǀná ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀ agne ǀ anyá-jātam ǀ asti ǀ ácetānasya ǀ mā́ ǀ patháḥ ǀ ví ǀ dukṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wealth is competent to the acquittance of debt; may we be masters of permanent riches; that is notoffspring which is begotten by another; alter not the paths (of the genitive ration) of a blockhead.
verses.wilson_translation: Wealth is competent to the acquittance of debt; may we be masters of permanent riches; that is notoffspring which is begotten by another; alter not the paths (of the genitive ration) of a blockhead.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि ग्रभायारणः सुशेवोऽन्योदर्यो मनसा मंतवा उ ।अधा चिदोकः पुनरित्स एत्या नो वाज्यभीषाळेतु नव्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ grábhāya ǀ áraṇaḥ ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ anyá-udaryaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ mántavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀádha ǀ cit ǀ ókaḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ eti ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ abhīṣā́ṭ ǀ etu ǀ návyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: One not acquitting debts, although worthy of regard, yet begotten of another, is not to be contemplatedeven in the mind (as fit) for acceptance; for verily he returns to his own house; therefore let there come to us (ason) new- born, possessed of food, victorious over foes.
verses.wilson_translation: One not acquitting debts, although worthy of regard, yet begotten of another, is not to be contemplatedeven in the mind (as fit) for acceptance; for verily he returns to his own house; therefore let there come to us (ason) new- born, possessed of food, victorious over foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वनुष्यतो नि पाहि त्वमु नः सहसावन्नवद्यात् ।सं त्वा ध्वस्मन्वदभ्येतु पाथः सं रयिः स्पृहयाय्यः सहस्री ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ tvám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasā-van ǀ avadyā́t ǀsám ǀ tvā ǀ dhvasman-vát ǀ abhí ǀ etu ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ sám ǀ rayíḥ ǀ spṛhayā́yyaḥ ǀ sahasrī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Agni, defend us against, the malignant; do you, who are endowed with strengt, (preserve us)from sin; may the (sacrificial) food come to you free from defect; may the riches that we desire come to us bythousands.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Agni, defend us against, the malignant; do you, who are endowed with strengt, (preserve us)from sin; may the (sacrificial) food come to you free from defect; may the riches that we desire come to us bythousands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एता नो अग्ने सौभगा दिदीह्यपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतेम ।विश्वा स्तोतृभ्यो गृणते च संतु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: etā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sáubhagā ǀ didīhi ǀ ápi ǀ krátum ǀ su-cétasam ǀ vatema ǀvíśvā ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ ca ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Illumine for us,Agni, these auspicious (riches); may we possess (a son) intelligent, the celebrator ofsacred rites; may all (good things) be to your praisers and to him who eulogizes (you); and do you ever cherishus with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Illumine for us,Agni, these auspicious (riches); may we possess (a son) intelligent, the celebrator ofsacred rites; may all (good things) be to your praisers and to him who eulogizes (you); and do you ever cherishus with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN V. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BRING forth your song of praise to mighty Agni, the speedy messenger of earth and heaven,Vaiśvānara, who, with those who wake, hath waxen great in the lap of all the Gods Immortal. Sought in the heavens, on earth is Agni stablished, leader of rivers, Bull of standing waters.Vaiśvānara when he hath grown in glory, shines on the tribes of men with light and treasure. For fear of thee forth fled the dark-hued races, scattered abroad, deserting their possessions,When, glowing, O Vaiśvānara, for Pūru, thou Agni didst light up and rend their castles. Agni Vaiśvānara, both Earth and Heaven submit them to thy threefold jurisdiction.Refulgent in thine undecaying lustre thou hast invested both the worlds with splendour. Agni, the tawny horses, loudly neighing our resonant hymns that drop with oil, attend thee;Lord of the tribes, our Charioteer of riches, Ensign of days, Vaiśvānara of mornings. In thee, O bright as Mitra, Vasus seated the might of Aduras, for they loved thy spirit.Thou dravest Dasyus from their home, O Agni, and broughtest forth broad light to light the Ārya. Born in the loftiest heaven thou in a moment reachest, like wind, the place where Gods inhabit.Thou, favouring thine offspring, roaredst loudly when giving life to creatures, Jātavedas. Send us that strength, Vaiśvānara, send it, Agni, that strength, O Jātavedas, full of splendour,Wherewith, all-bounteous God, thou pourest riches, as fame wide-spreading, on the man who offers. Agni, bestow upon our chiefs and nobles that famous power, that wealth which feedeth many.Accordant with the Vasus and the Rudras, Agni, Vaiśvānara, give us sure protection.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्नये तव��े भरध्वं गिरं दिवो अरतये पृथिव्याः ।यो विश्वेषाममृतानामुपस्थे वैश्वानरो वावृधे जागृवद्भिः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ agnáye ǀ taváse ǀ bharadhvam ǀ gíram ǀ diváḥ ǀ aratáye ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ víśveṣām ǀ amṛ́tānām ǀ upá-sthe ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ jāgṛvát-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer praise to the strong Agni, traversing without hindrance heaven and earth; he who (as)Vaiśvānaraprospers at the sacrifices of all the immortals, being associated with the awaking divinities.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer praise to the strong Agni, traversing without hindrance heaven and earth; he who (as)Vaiśvānaraprospers at the sacrifices of all the immortals, being associated with the awaking divinities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पृष्टो दिवि धाय्यग्निः पृथिव्यां नेता सिंधूनां वृषभः स्तियानां ।स मानुषीरभि विशो वि भाति वैश्वानरो वावृधानो वरेण ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭáḥ ǀ diví ǀ dhā́yi ǀ agníḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ netā́ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ stíyānām ǀsáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ váreṇa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the leader of the rivers, the showerer of the waters, the radiant, has been stationed in thefirmament and upon earth;Viśvānaraaugmenting with the most excellent (oblation) shines upon human beings.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the leader of the rivers, the showerer of the waters, the radiant, has been stationed in thefirmament and upon earth;Viśvānaraaugmenting with the most excellent (oblation) shines upon human beings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्भिया विश आयन्नसिक्नीरसमना जहतीर्भोजनानि ।वैश्वानर पूरवे शोशुचानः पुरो यदग्ने दरयन्नदीदेः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvát ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ āyan ǀ ásiknīḥ ǀ asamanā́ḥ ǀ jáhatīḥ ǀ bhójanāni ǀváiśvānara ǀ pūráve ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ daráyan ǀ ádīdeḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Through fear of you,Vaiśvānara, the dark-complexioned races, although of many minds, arrived,abandoning their possessions, when,Agni, shining upon Puru, you have blazed, consuming the cities of his foe.
verses.wilson_translation: Through fear of you,Vaiśvānara, the dark-complexioned races, although of many minds, arrived,abandoning their possessions, when,Agni, shining upon Puru, you have blazed, consuming the cities of his foe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव त्रिधातु पृथिवी उत द्यौर्वैश्वानर व्रतमग्ने सचंत ।त्वं भासा रोदसी आ ततंथाजस्रेण शोचिषा शोशुचानः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ váiśvānara ǀ vratám ǀ agne ǀ sacanta ǀtvám ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀ ájasreṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vaiśvānara Agni, the firmament, the earth, the heaven, combine in your worship; shining withundecaying splendour, you overspread heaven and earth with light.
verses.wilson_translation: Vaiśvānara Agni, the firmament, the earth, the heaven, combine in your worship; shining withundecaying splendour, you overspread heaven and earth with light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने हरितो वावशाना गिरः सचंते धुनयो घृताचीः ।पतिं कृष्टीनां रथ्यं रयीणां वैश्वानरमुषसां केतुमह्नां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ harítaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sacante ǀ dhúnayaḥ ǀ ghṛtā́cīḥ ǀpátim ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ rathyám ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ uṣásām ǀ ketúm ǀ áhnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: The horses (of Indra), full of ardour, worship you,Agni; the praises (of men), dispersers (of iniquity),accompanied by oblations, (honour you), the lord of men, the conveyer of riches, the Vaiśvānaraof dawns, themanifester of days.
verses.wilson_translation: The horses (of Indra), full of ardour, worship you,Agni; the praises (of men), dispersers (of iniquity),accompanied by oblations, (honour you), the lord of men, the conveyer of riches, the Vaiśvānaraof dawns, themanifester of days.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वे असुर्यं वसवो न्यृण्वन्क्रतुं हि ते मित्रमहो जुषंत ।त्वं दस्यूँरोकसो अग्न आज उरु ज्योतिर्जनयन्नार्याय ॥
verses.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ asuryám ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ní ǀ ṛṇvan ǀ krátum ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀtvám ǀ dásyūn ǀ ókasaḥ ǀ agne ǀ ājaḥ ǀ urú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ ā́ryāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Reverencer of friends,Agni, th Vasushave concentrated vigour in you; they have been propitiated byyour acts; genitive rating vast splendour for the Arya, do you, Agni, expel the Dasyusfrom the dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: Reverencer of friends,Agni, th Vasushave concentrated vigour in you; they have been propitiated byyour acts; genitive rating vast splendour for the Arya, do you, Agni, expel the Dasyusfrom the dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स जायमानः परमे व्योमन्वायुर्न पाथः परि पासि सद्यः ।त्वं भुवना जनयन्नभि क्रन्नपत्याय जातवेदो दशस्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ pári ǀ pāsi ǀ sadyáḥ ǀtvám ǀ bhúvanā ǀ janáyan ǀ abhí ǀ kran ǀ ápatyāya ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ daśasyán ǁ
verses.english_translation: Born in the highest heaven, you ever drink (Soma) like Vāyu; genitive rating the waters, you thunder,granting (his wishes) to your offspring, the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Born in the highest heaven, you ever drink (Soma) like Vāyu; genitive rating the waters, you thunder,granting (his wishes) to your offspring, the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तामग्ने अस्मे इषमेरयस्व वैश्वानर द्युमतीं जातवेदः ।यया राधः पिन्वसि विश्ववार पृथु श्रवो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́m ǀ agne ǀ asmé íti ǀ íṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ īrayasva ǀ váiśvānara ǀ dyu-mátīm ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀyáyā ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ pínvasi ǀ viśva-vāra ǀ pṛthú ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Send to us,Agni, (who are)Vaiśvānara Jātavedas, that brilliant sustenance whereby you conferwealth, and (grant), all-desired Agni, abundant food to the mortal, the donor (of the oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: Send to us,Agni, (who are)Vaiśvānara Jātavedas, that brilliant sustenance whereby you conferwealth, and (grant), all-desired Agni, abundant food to the mortal, the donor (of the oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं नो अग्ने मघवद्भ्यः पुरुक्षुं रयिं नि वाजं श्रुत्यं युवस्व ।वैश्वानर महि नः शर्म यच्छ रुद्रेभिरग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀ rayím ǀ ní ǀ vā́jam ǀ śrútyam ǀ yuvasva ǀváiśvānara ǀ máhi ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us who are affluent (in offerings),Agni, ample riches and renowned strength; associatedwith the Rudras, with the Vasus, grant us, Agni Vaiśvānara, infinite happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us who are affluent (in offerings),Agni, ample riches and renowned strength; associatedwith the Rudras, with the Vasus, grant us, Agni Vaiśvānara, infinite happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . PRAISE of the Asura, high imperial Ruler, the Manly One in whom the folk shall triumph-I laud his deeds who is as strong as Indra, and lauding celebrate the Fort-destroyer. Sage, Sing, Food, Light,—they bring him from the mountain, the blessed Sovran of the earth and heaven.I decorate with songs the mighty actions which Agni, Fort-destroyer, did aforetime. The foolish, faithless, rudely-speaking niggards, without belief or sacrifice or worship,—Far far sway hath Agni chased those Dasytis, and, in the cast, hath turned the godless westward. Him who brought eastward, manliest with his prowess, the Maids rejoicing in the western darkness,That Agni I extol, the Lord of riches, unyielding tamer of assailing foemen. Him who brake down the walls with deadly weapons, and gave the Mornings to anoble Husband,Young Agni, who with conquering strength subduing the tribes of Nahus made them bring their tribute. In whose protection all men rest by nature, desiring to enjoy his gracious favour-Agni Vaiśvānara in his Parents, bosom hath found the choicest seat in earth and heaven. Vaiśvānara the God, at the sun's setting, hath taken to himself deep-hidden treasures:Agni hath taken them from earth and heaven, from the sea under and the sea above us.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजो असुरस्य प्रशस्तिं पुंसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य ।इंद्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वंदे दारुं वंदमानो विवक्मि ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sam-rā́jaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ prá-śastim ǀ puṃsáḥ ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ anu-mā́dyasya ǀíndrasya-iva ǀ prá ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ vánde ǀ dārúm ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ vivakmi ǁ
verses.english_translation: I salute the demolisher (of cities), glorifying the excellence of the powerfulmale, the universal sovereignwho is the reverenced of all men; I proclaim his exploits (which are) like those of the mighty Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: I salute the demolisher (of cities), glorifying the excellence of the powerfulmale, the universal sovereignwho is the reverenced of all men; I proclaim his exploits (which are) like those of the mighty Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कविं केतुं धासिं भानुमद्रेर्हिन्वंति शं राज्यं रोदस्योः ।पुरंदरस्य गीर्भिरा विवासेऽग्नेर्व्रतानि पूर्व्या महानि ॥
verses.transliteration: kavím ǀ ketúm ǀ dhāsím ǀ bhānúm ǀ ádreḥ ǀ hinvánti ǀ śám ǀ rājyám ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀpuram-darásya ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǀ agnéḥ ǀ vratā́ni ǀ pūrvyā́ ǀ mahā́ni ǁ
verses.english_translation: They propitiate the wise, the manifesting, the sustaining,t he enlightener of the pious, the giver ofhappiness, the sovereign of heaven and earth; I glorify the ancient and mighty works of Agni, the demolisher ofcities.
verses.wilson_translation: They propitiate the wise, the manifesting, the sustaining,t he enlightener of the pious, the giver ofhappiness, the sovereign of heaven and earth; I glorify the ancient and mighty works of Agni, the demolisher ofcities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न्यक्रतून्ग्रथिनो मृध्रवाचः पणीँरश्रद्धाँ अवृधाँ अयज्ञान् ।प्रप्र तांदस्यूँरग्निर्विवाय पूर्वश्चकारापराँ अयज्यून् ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ akratū́n ǀ grathínaḥ ǀ mṛdhrá-vācaḥ ǀ paṇī́n ǀ aśraddhā́n ǀ avṛdhā́n ǀ ayajñā́n ǀprá-pra ǀ tā́n ǀ dásyūn ǀ agníḥ ǀ vivāya ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ cakāra ǀ áparān ǀ áyajyūn ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agniutterly confound those Dasyuswho perform no (sacred) rites, who are babblers defective inspeech, niggards, unbelievers; not honouring (Agni), offering no sacrifice; Agni preceding, has degrated thosewho instrumental tute no sacred ceremonies.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agniutterly confound those Dasyuswho perform no (sacred) rites, who are babblers defective inspeech, niggards, unbelievers; not honouring (Agni), offering no sacrifice; Agni preceding, has degrated thosewho instrumental tute no sacred ceremonies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो अपाचीने तमसि मदंतीः प्राचीश्चकार नृतमः शचीभिः ।तमीशानं वस्वो अग्निं गृणीषेऽनानतं दमयंतं पृतन्यून् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ apācī́ne ǀ támasi ǀ mádantīḥ ǀ prā́cīḥ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀtám ǀ ī́śānam ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ agním ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ ánānatam ǀ damáyantam ǀ pṛtanyū́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: The chief of leaders has, by the benefits (bestowed upon them), guided those praising (him) throughthe accusative ulated gloom (of night); I glorify that Agni, the unbending lord of wealth, the tamer of adversarieṣ
verses.wilson_translation: The chief of leaders has, by the benefits (bestowed upon them), guided those praising (him) throughthe accusative ulated gloom (of night); I glorify that Agni, the unbending lord of wealth, the tamer of adversarieṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो देह्यो अनमयद्वधस्नैर्यो अर्यपत्नीरुषसश्चकार ।स निरुध्या नहुषो यह्वो अग्निर्विशश्चक्रे बलिहृतः सहोभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dehyáḥ ǀ ánamayat ǀ vadha-snáiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ aryá-patnīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ cakā́ra ǀsáḥ ǀ ni-rúdhya ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ cakre ǀ bali-hṛ́taḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty Agni, who by his fatal (weapons) has baffled the devices (of theasuras), who has createdthe lawns, the birds of the sun, having coerced the people by his strength, has made them the tributaries of Nahuṣa.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty Agni, who by his fatal (weapons) has baffled the devices (of theasuras), who has createdthe lawns, the birds of the sun, having coerced the people by his strength, has made them the tributaries of Nahuṣa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य शर्मन्नुप विश्वे जनास एवैस्तस्थुः सुमतिं भिक्षमाणाः ।वैश्वानरो वरमा रोदस्योराग्निः ससाद पित्रोरुपस्थं ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ śárman ǀ úpa ǀ víśve ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ sasāda ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-stham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni Vaiśvānara, whom all men approach with pious offerings, soliciting his favour for the sake of(obtaining felicity), has come to the excellent station (intermediate) between his parents, heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni Vaiśvānara, whom all men approach with pious offerings, soliciting his favour for the sake of(obtaining felicity), has come to the excellent station (intermediate) between his parents, heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ देवो ददे बुध्न्या वसूनि वैश्वानर उदिता सूर्यस्य ।आ समुद्रादवरादा परस्मादाग्निर्ददे दिव आ पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ dade ǀ budhnyā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀā́ ǀ samudrā́t ǀ ávarāt ǀ ā́ ǀ párasmāt ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ dade ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine Agni Vaiśvānarahas removed from the firmament the investing (glooms) at the rising of thesun; he has removed them from the lower firmament of the earth, from the upper firmament of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine Agni Vaiśvānarahas removed from the firmament the investing (glooms) at the rising of thesun; he has removed them from the lower firmament of the earth, from the upper firmament of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I SEND forth even your God, victorious Agni, like a strong courser, with mine adoration.Herald of sacrifice be he who knoweth he hath reached Gods, himself, with measured motion. By paths that are thine own come hither, Agni, joyous, delighting in the Gods’ alliance,Making the heights of earth roar with thy fury, burning with eager teeth the woods and forests. The grass is strewn; the sacrifice advances adored as Priest, Agni is made propitious,Invoking both All-boon-bestowing Mothers of whom, Most Youthful! thou wast born to help us. Forthwith the men, the best of these for wisdom, have made him leader in the solemn worship.As Lord in homes of men is Agni stablished, the Holy One, the joyous, sweetly speaking. He hath come, chosen bearer, and is seated in man's home, Brahman, Agni, the Supporter,He whom both Heaven anct Earth exalt and strengthenwhom, Giver of all boons, the Hotar worships. These have passed all in glory, who, the manly, have wrought with skill the hymn of adoration;Who, listening, have advanced the people's welfare, and set their thoughts on this my holy statute. We, the Vasisthas, now implore thee, Agni, O Son of Strength, the Lord of wealth and treasure.Thou hast brought food to singers and to nobles. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो देवं चित्सहसानमग्निमश्वं न वाजिनं हिषे नमोभिः ।भवा नो दूतो अध्वरस्य विद्वांत्मना देवेषु विविदे मितद्रुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ devám ǀ cit ǀ sahasānám ǀ agním ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ vājínam ǀ hiṣe ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ tmánā ǀ devéṣu ǀ vivide ǀ mitá-druḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I propitiate with oblations the divine, vigorous Agni, rapid as a horse; do you, knowing (our desires), beour messenger of the sacrifice; he, the consumer of forests, is known spontaneously among the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: I propitiate with oblations the divine, vigorous Agni, rapid as a horse; do you, knowing (our desires), beour messenger of the sacrifice; he, the consumer of forests, is known spontaneously among the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ याह्यग्ने पथ्या अनु स्वा मंद्रो देवानां सख्यं जुषाणः ।आ सानु शुष्मैर्नदयन्पृथिव्या जंभेभिर्विश्वमुशधग्वनानि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agne ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svā́ḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ sakhyám ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀā́ ǀ sā́nu ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀ nadáyan ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ jámbhebhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ uśádhak ǀ vánāni ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Agni, rejoicing by thine own paths, gratified by the friendship of the gods; roarind with witheringflames above the high plural ces of the earth; threatening to consume all the forests.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Agni, rejoicing by thine own paths, gratified by the friendship of the gods; roarind with witheringflames above the high plural ces of the earth; threatening to consume all the forests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीनो यज्ञः सुधितं हि बर्हिः प्रीणीते अग्निरीळितो न होता ।आ मातरा विश्ववारे हुवानो यतो यविष्ठ जज्ञिषे सुशेवः ॥
verses.transliteration: prācī́naḥ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ hí ǀ barhíḥ ǀ prīṇīté ǀ agníḥ ǀ īḷitáḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǀā́ ǀ mātárā ǀ viśvávāre íti viśvá-vāre ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ jajñiṣé ǀ su-śévaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sacrifice is presen; the sacred grass is strewn;Agnilauded is satisfied, and is the ministrant priestinvoking the all-desired parents of whom you, honoured Agni, the youngest (of the gods), are born.
verses.wilson_translation: The sacrifice is presen; the sacred grass is strewn;Agnilauded is satisfied, and is the ministrant priestinvoking the all-desired parents of whom you, honoured Agni, the youngest (of the gods), are born.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सद्यो अध्वरे रथिरं जनंत मानुषासो विचेतसो य एषां ।विशामधायि विश्पतिर्दुरोणेऽग्निर्मंद्रो मधुवचा ऋतावा ॥
verses.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ rathirám ǀ jananta ǀ mā́nuṣāsaḥ ǀ ví-cetasaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀviśā́m ǀ adhāyi ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ agníḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ mádhu-vacāḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Judicious men promptly genitive rate at the sacred rite the directing (Agni), who (may convey) their(oblations); Agni, the lord of men, the giver of delight, the swee-spoken, the celebrator of sacrifices, has beenestablished in the dwelling of the people.
verses.wilson_translation: Judicious men promptly genitive rate at the sacred rite the directing (Agni), who (may convey) their(oblations); Agni, the lord of men, the giver of delight, the swee-spoken, the celebrator of sacrifices, has beenestablished in the dwelling of the people.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असादि वृतो वह्निराजगन्वानग्निर्ब्रह्मा नृषदने विधर्ता ।द्यौश्च यं पृथिवी वावृधाते आ यं होता यजति विश्ववारं ॥
verses.transliteration: ásādi ǀ vṛtáḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ā-jaganvā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ brahmā́ ǀ nṛ-sádane ǀ vi-dhartā́ ǀdyáuḥ ǀ ca ǀ yám ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ vavṛdhā́te íti ǀ ā́ ǀ yám ǀ hótā ǀ yájati ǀ viśvá-vāram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invester (with the priestly office), the bearer (of the oblation),Agni, the directing priest, the sustainer (ofall), is seated in the house of man, he whom heaven and earth extol, and whom, the desired of all, the ministrantpriests worship.
verses.wilson_translation: Invester (with the priestly office), the bearer (of the oblation),Agni, the directing priest, the sustainer (ofall), is seated in the house of man, he whom heaven and earth extol, and whom, the desired of all, the ministrantpriests worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते द्युम्नेभिर्विश्वमातिरंत मंत्रं ये वारं नर्या अतक्षन् ।प्र ये विशस्तिरंत श्रोषमाणा आ ये मे अस्य दीधयन्नृतस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ dyumnébhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ atiranta ǀ mántram ǀ yé ǀ vā ǀ áram ǀ náryāḥ ǀ átakṣan ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ víśaḥ ǀ tiránta ǀ śróṣamāṇāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yé ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ dī́dhayan ǀ ṛtásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: These men nourish the universe with viands who offer (to Agni) fitting commendation; those people alsowho eagerly listen (to his laudation) augment (the plural nty of the world), as do these my (associates), who areglorifiers of this truthful (duty).
verses.wilson_translation: These men nourish the universe with viands who offer (to Agni) fitting commendation; those people alsowho eagerly listen (to his laudation) augment (the plural nty of the world), as do these my (associates), who areglorifiers of this truthful (duty).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू त्वामग्न ईमहे वसिष्ठा ईशानं सूनो सहसो वसूनां ।इषं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवद्भ्य आनड्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ īmahe ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀ īśānám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀíṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ānaṭ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We Vasiṣṭhasimplore you,Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: We Vasiṣṭhasimplore you,Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII. Agni
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE King whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant.The men, the priests adore him with oblations. Agni hath shone forth when the dawn is breaking. Yea, he hath been acknowledged as most mighty, the joyous Priest of men, the youthful Agni.He, spreading o’er the earth, made light around him, and grew among the plants with blackened fellies.. How dost thou decorate our hymn, O Agni? What power dost thou exert when thou art lauded?When, Bounteous God, may we be lords of riches, winners of precious wealth which none may conquer? Far famed is this the Bhārata's own Agni he shineth like the Sun with lofty splendour.He who hath vanquished Pūru in the battle, the heavenly guest hath glowed in full refulgence. Full many oblations are in thee collected: with all thine aspects thou hast waxen gracious.Thou art already famed as praised and lauded, yet still, O nobly born, increase thy body. Be this my song, that winneth countless treasure, engendered with redoubled force for Agni,That, splendid, chasing sickness, slaying demons, it may delight our friend and bless the singers. We, the Vasisthas, now implore thee, Agni, O Son of Strength, the Lord of wealth and riches.Thou hast brought food to singers and to nobles. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: इंधे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन ।नरो हव्येभिरीळते सबाध आग्निरग्र उषसामशोचि ॥
verses.transliteration: indhé ǀ rā́jā ǀ sám ǀ aryáḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yásya ǀ prátīkam ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ ghṛténa ǀnáraḥ ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ágre ǀ uṣásām ǀ aśoci ǁ
verses.english_translation: The royal (Agni), the mater (of the sacrifice), is kindled with praises, he whose person n is invoked with(offerings of) butter, whom men associated worship with oblations, Agni, who is lighted before the dawn.
verses.wilson_translation: The royal (Agni), the mater (of the sacrifice), is kindled with praises, he whose person n is invoked with(offerings of) butter, whom men associated worship with oblations, Agni, who is lighted before the dawn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयमु ष्य सुमहाँ अवेदि होता मंद्रो मनुषो यह्वो अग्निः ।वि भा अकः ससृजानः पृथिव्यां कृष्णपविरोषधीभिर्ववक्षे ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ sú-mahān ǀ avedi ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀví ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǀ sasṛjānáḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ kṛṣṇá-paviḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ vavakṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: This great Agnihas been known among men as invoker (of the gods), the giver of deligh, the mighty; hehas spread (in the firmament), he, the darkpathed at large upon the earth, is nourished by the plural nts.
verses.wilson_translation: This great Agnihas been known among men as invoker (of the gods), the giver of deligh, the mighty; hehas spread (in the firmament), he, the darkpathed at large upon the earth, is nourished by the plural nts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कया नो अग्ने वि वसः सुवृक्तिं कामु स्वधामृणवः शस्यमानः ।कदा भवेम पतयः सुदत्र रायो वंतारो दुष्टरस्य साधोः ॥
verses.transliteration: káyā ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ví ǀ vasaḥ ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ kā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ṛṇavaḥ ǀ śasyámānaḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ bhavema ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ su-datra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ vantā́raḥ ǀ dustárasya ǀ sādhóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By what oblation,Agni, do you clothe our praise? What offering do you, when glorified, accept? When,giver of good, may we be the possessors and enjoyers of perfect and unmolested riches?
verses.wilson_translation: By what oblation,Agni, do you clothe our praise? What offering do you, when glorified, accept? When,giver of good, may we be the possessors and enjoyers of perfect and unmolested riches?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रप्रायमग्निर्भरतस्य शृण्वे वि यत्सूर्यो न रोचते बृहद्भाः ।अभि यः पूरुं पृतनासु तस्थौ द्युतानो दैव्यो अतिथिः शुशोच ॥
verses.transliteration: prá-pra ǀ ayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ bharatásya ǀ śṛṇve ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rócate ǀ bṛhát ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀabhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ pūrúm ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ tastháu ǀ dyutānáḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ śuśoca ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Agniis greatly celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite when he shines resplendent as the sun; hewho overcame Puruin battle, and shone glorious as the guest of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: This Agniis greatly celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite when he shines resplendent as the sun; hewho overcame Puruin battle, and shone glorious as the guest of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असन्नित्त्वे आहवनानि भूरि भुवो विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः ।स्तुतश्चिदग्ने शृण्विषे गृणानः स्वयं वर्धस्व तन्वं सुजात ॥
verses.transliteration: ásan ǀ ít ǀ tvé íti ǀ ā-hávanāni ǀ bhū́ri ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ánīkaiḥ ǀstutáḥ ǀ cit ǀ agne ǀ śṛṇviṣe ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ svayám ǀ vardhasva ǀ tanvám ǀ su-jāta ǁ
verses.english_translation: In you,Agni, are many offerings; do you with all your flames be propitious; favourably hear (the praises)of the worshipper; and do you of auspicious manifestation being glorified, spontaneously magnify (your) person n.
verses.wilson_translation: In you,Agni, are many offerings; do you with all your flames be propitious; favourably hear (the praises)of the worshipper; and do you of auspicious manifestation being glorified, spontaneously magnify (your) person n.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इदं वचः शतसाः संसहस्रमुदग्नये जनिषीष्ट द्विबर्हाः ।शं यत्स्तोतृभ्य आपये भवाति द्युमदमीवचातनं रक्षोहा ॥
verses.transliteration: idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ śata-sā́ḥ ǀ sám-sahasram ǀ út ǀ agnáye ǀ janiṣīṣṭa ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀśám ǀ yát ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ āpáye ǀ bhávāti ǀ dyu-mát ǀ amīva-cā́tanam ǀ rakṣaḥ-hā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vasi.ṣṭha illustrious in both heaven and earth, rich with a hundred and a thousand (head of cattle), hasaddressed this hymn to Agni, that such fame- conferring disease-removing, fiend-destroying (laudation) may be(the means of) happiness to the eulogists and their kindred.
verses.wilson_translation: Vasi.ṣṭha illustrious in both heaven and earth, rich with a hundred and a thousand (head of cattle), hasaddressed this hymn to Agni, that such fame- conferring disease-removing, fiend-destroying (laudation) may be(the means of) happiness to the eulogists and their kindred.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू त्वामग्न ईमहे वसिष्ठा ईशानं सूनो सहसो वसूनां ।इषं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवद्भ्य आनड्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ īmahe ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀ īśānám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀíṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ānaṭ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We Vasiṣṭhasimplore you,Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers, who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: We Vasiṣṭhasimplore you,Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers, who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ROUSED from their bosom is the Dawns' beloved, the joyous Priest, most sapient, Purifier.He gives a signal both to Gods and mortals, to Gods oblations, riches to the pious. Most wise is he who, forcing doors of Paṇis, brought the bright Sun to us who feedeth many.The cheerful Priest, men's Friend and home-companion, through still night's darkness he is made apparent. Wise, ne.'er deceived, uncircumscribed, refulgent, our gracious guest, a Friend with good attendants,Shines forth with wondrous light before the Mornings; the young plants hath he entered, Child of Waters. Seeking our gatherings, he, your Jātavedas, hath shone adorable through human ages,Who gleams refulgent with his lovely lustre: the kine have waked to meet him when enkindled. Go on thy message to the Gods, and fail not, O Agni, with their band who pray and worship.Bring all the Gods that they may give us riches, Sarasvatī, the Maruts, Aśvins, Waters. Vasiṣṭha, when enkindling thee, O Agni, hath slain jarutha. Give us wealth in plenty.Sing praise in choral song, O Jātavedas. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: अबोधि जार उषसामुपस्थाद्धोता मंद्रः कवितमः पावकः ।दधाति केतुमुभयस्य जंतोर्हव्या देवेषु द्रविणं सुकृत्सु ॥
verses.transliteration: ábodhi ǀ jāráḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ kaví-tamaḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀdádhāti ǀ ketúm ǀ ubháyasya ǀ jantóḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ dráviṇam ǀ sukṛ́t-su ǁ
verses.english_translation: The waster away (of living creatures), the invoker (of the gods), the giver of delight, the wisest of thewise, the purifier, (Agni), has been manifested from the lap of the dawn; he gives consciousness to both classesof beings (men and animals), oblations to the gods, and wealth to the pious.
verses.wilson_translation: The waster away (of living creatures), the invoker (of the gods), the giver of delight, the wisest of thewise, the purifier, (Agni), has been manifested from the lap of the dawn; he gives consciousness to both classesof beings (men and animals), oblations to the gods, and wealth to the pious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सुक्रतुर्यो वि दुरः पणीनां पुनानो अर्कं पुरुभोजसं नः ।होता मंद्रो विशां दमूनास्तिरस्तमो ददृशे राम्याणां ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arkám ǀ puru-bhójasam ǀ naḥ ǀhótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ rāmyā́ṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the doer of great deeds, who forced open the doors of the Paṇis, recovered for us the sacredfood-bestowing (herd of kine), he who is the invoker of the gods, the giver of delight to the lowly-minded, is seenof all people dissipating the gloom of the nights.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the doer of great deeds, who forced open the doors of the Paṇis, recovered for us the sacredfood-bestowing (herd of kine), he who is the invoker of the gods, the giver of delight to the lowly-minded, is seenof all people dissipating the gloom of the nights.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमूरः कविरदितिर्विवस्वान्त्सुसंसन्मित्रो अतिथिः शिवो नः ।चित्रभानुरुषसां भात्यग्रेऽपां गर्भः प्रस्व आ विवेश ॥
verses.transliteration: ámūraḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ vivásvān ǀ su-saṃsát ǀ mitráḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀcitrá-bhānuḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ bhāti ǀ ágre ǀ apā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unperplexed, far-seeing elevated, resplendent, right-directing, a friend, a guest, the bestower ofprosperity upon us, the wonderfully radiant he shines before the dawns, the embryo of the waters, he hasentered into the nascent plural nts.
verses.wilson_translation: Unperplexed, far-seeing elevated, resplendent, right-directing, a friend, a guest, the bestower ofprosperity upon us, the wonderfully radiant he shines before the dawns, the embryo of the waters, he hasentered into the nascent plural nts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईळेन्यो वो मनुषो युगेषु समनगा अशुचज्जातवेदाः ।सुसंदृशा भानुना यो विभाति प्रति गावः समिधानं बुधंत ॥
verses.transliteration: īḷényaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yugéṣu ǀ samana-gā́ḥ ǀ aśucat ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀsu-sandṛ́śā ǀ bhānúnā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ práti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sam-idhānám ǀ budhanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, are to be glorified in (all) the ages of men; you,Jātavedas, who are illustrious whenengaged in battle; our praises wake up the kindling (Agni), him who shines with conspicuous splendour.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, are to be glorified in (all) the ages of men; you,Jātavedas, who are illustrious whenengaged in battle; our praises wake up the kindling (Agni), him who shines with conspicuous splendour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने याहि दूत्यं मा रिषण्यो देवा��� अच्छा ब्रह्मकृता गणेन ।सरस्वतीं मरुतो अश्विनापो यक्षि देवान्रत्नधेयाय विश्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yāhí ǀ dūtyám ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣaṇyaḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ brahma-kṛ́tā ǀ gaṇéna ǀsárasvatīm ǀ marútaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ apáḥ ǀ yákṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ ratna-dhéyāya ǀ víśvān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Repair,Agni, to the presence of the gods in your office of messenger, (sent) by the assembly engagedin prayer; neglect us not; offer worship to Sarasvati, the Maruts, the Aśvins, the waters, the universal gods, thatthey may bestow treasures (upon us).
verses.wilson_translation: Repair,Agni, to the presence of the gods in your office of messenger, (sent) by the assembly engagedin prayer; neglect us not; offer worship to Sarasvati, the Maruts, the Aśvins, the waters, the universal gods, thatthey may bestow treasures (upon us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने समिधानो वसिष्ठो जरूथं हन्यक्षि राये पुरंधिं ।पुरुणीथा जातवेदो जरस्व यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ járūtham ǀ han ǀ yákṣi ǀ rāyé ǀ púram-dhim ǀpuru-nīthā́ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ jarasva ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vasiṣṭhais kindling you,Agni; destroy the malignant; worship the object of many rites, (the company ofthe gods), on behalf of the wealthy (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), praise (the gods),Jātavedas, with manifoldpraises, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Vasiṣṭhais kindling you,Agni; destroy the malignant; worship the object of many rites, (the company ofthe gods), on behalf of the wealthy (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), praise (the gods),Jātavedas, with manifoldpraises, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HE hath sent forth, bright, radiant, and refulgent, like the Dawn's Lover, his far-spreading lustre.Pure in his splendour shines the golden Hero: our longing thoughts hath he aroused and wakened. He, like the Sun, hath shone while Morn is breaking, and priests who weave the sacrifice sing praises,Agni, the God, who knows their generations and visits Gods, most bounteous, rapid envoy. Our songs and holy hymns go forth to Agni, seeking the God and asking him for riches,Him fair to see, of goodly aspect, mighty, men's messenger who carries their oblations. joined with the Vasus, Agni, bring thou Indra bring hither mighty Rudra with the Rudras,Aditi good to all men with Ādityas, Bṛhaspati All-bounteous, with the Singers. Men eagerly implore at sacrifices Agni, Most Youthful God, the joyous Herald.For he is Lord and Ruler over riches, and for Gods’ worship an unwearied envoy.

verses.sanskrit: उषो न जारः पृथु पाजो अश्रेद्दविद्युतद्दीद्यच्छोशुचानः ।वृषा हरिः शुचिरा भाति भासा धियो हिन्वान उशतीरजीगः ॥
verses.transliteration: uṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ jāráḥ ǀ pṛthú ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ aśret ǀ dávidyutat ǀ dī́dyat ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, like the lover of the dawn (the sun), radiant, bright, resplendent, displays extensive lustre, theshowerer (of benefits), the receiver (of oblations), he shines with splendour, encouraging holy rites; he arouses(mankind), desiring (his presence).
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, like the lover of the dawn (the sun), radiant, bright, resplendent, displays extensive lustre, theshowerer (of benefits), the receiver (of oblations), he shines with splendour, encouraging holy rites; he arouses(mankind), desiring (his presence).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्ण वस्तोरुषसामरोचि यज्ञं तन्वाना उशिजो न मन्म ।अग्निर्जन्मानि देव आ वि विद्वांद्रवद्दूतो देवयावा वनिष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration: sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vástoḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ aroci ǀ yajñám ǀ tanvānā́ḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mánma ǀagníḥ ǀ jánmāni ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ví ǀ vidvā́n ǀ dravát ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ deva-yā́vā ǀ vániṣṭhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, preceding the dawn, is radiant by day as the sun, and the priests celebrating the sacrifice repeathis praise; the divine, munificent Agni, the messenger (of the gods), cognizant of their birth, repairing to thedeities, hastens in various directions.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, preceding the dawn, is radiant by day as the sun, and the priests celebrating the sacrifice repeathis praise; the divine, munificent Agni, the messenger (of the gods), cognizant of their birth, repairing to thedeities, hastens in various directions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा गिरो मतयो देवयंतीरग्निं यंति द्रविणं भिक्षमाणाः ।सुसंदृशं सुप्रतीकं स्वंचं हव्यवाहमरतिं मानुषाणां ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ gíraḥ ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ agním ǀ yanti ǀ dráviṇam ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀsu-sandṛ́śam ǀ su-prátīkam ǀ su-áñcam ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ aratím ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devout praises and hymns, soliciting riches, proceed to Agni, who is of plural asant aspect, agreeableform, of graceful movement, the bearer of oblations, the ruler of men.
verses.wilson_translation: Devout praises and hymns, soliciting riches, proceed to Agni, who is of plural asant aspect, agreeableform, of graceful movement, the bearer of oblations, the ruler of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं नो अग्ने वसुभिः सजोषा रुद्रं रुद्रेभिरा वहा बृहंतं ।आदित्येभिरदितिं विश्वजन्यां बृहस्पतिमृक्वभिर्विश्ववारं ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ rudrám ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ bṛhántam ǀādityébhiḥ ǀ áditim ǀ viśvá-janyām ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ viśvá-vāram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Consentient with the Vasus,Agni, bring hither Indra, with the Rudras, the benevolent Aditi, with theĀdityas and Bṛhaspati, the desired of all, with the adorable (Aṅgirasas).
verses.wilson_translation: Consentient with the Vasus,Agni, bring hither Indra, with the Rudras, the benevolent Aditi, with theĀdityas and Bṛhaspati, the desired of all, with the adorable (Aṅgirasas).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मंद्रं होतारमुशिजो यविष्ठमग्निं विश ईळते अध्वरेषु ।स हि क्षपावाँ अभवद्रयीणामतंद्रो दूतो यजथाय देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ agním ǀ víśaḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀsáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣápā-vān ǀ ábhavat ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ átandraḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men desiring him celebrate at sacrifices the youthful Agni, the giver of delight, the invoker of the gods;he, the ruler of the night, has been the diligent envoy of the opulent (instrumental tutors of sacrifices) for the worship ofthe gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Men desiring him celebrate at sacrifices the youthful Agni, the giver of delight, the invoker of the gods;he, the ruler of the night, has been the diligent envoy of the opulent (instrumental tutors of sacrifices) for the worship ofthe gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GREAT art thou, Agni, sacrifice's Herald: not without thee are deathless Gods made joyful.Come hither with all Deities about thee here take thy seat, the first, as Priest, O Agni. Men with oblations evermore entreat thee, the swift, to undertake an envoy's duty.He on whose sacred grass with Gods thou sittest, to him, O Agni, are the days propitious. Three times a day in thee are shown the treasures sent for the mortal who presents oblation.Bring the Gods hither like a man, O Agni: be thou our envoy, guarding us from curses. Lord of the lofty sacrifice is Agni, Agni is Lord of every gift presented.The Vasus were contented with his wisdom, so the Gods made him their oblationbearer. O Agni, bring the Gods to taste our presents: with Indra leading, here let them be joyful.Convey this sacrifice to Gods in heaven. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: महाँ अस्यध्वरस्य प्रकेतो न ऋते त्वदमृता मादयंते ।आ विश्वेभिः सरथं याहि देवैर्न्यग्ने होता प्रथमः सदेह ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ adhvarásya ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀ ná ǀ ṛté ǀ tvát ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mādayante ǀā́ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yāhi ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ní ǀ agne ǀ hótā ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ sada ǀ ihá ǁ
verses.english_translation: Great are you,Agni, the manifester of the solemnity without you the immortals do not rejoice; come inthe same chariot with all the gods; sit down here the chief, the ministrant priest.
verses.wilson_translation: Great are you,Agni, the manifester of the solemnity without you the immortals do not rejoice; come inthe same chariot with all the gods; sit down here the chief, the ministrant priest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामीळते अजिरं दूत्याय हविष्मंतः सदमिन्मानुषासः ।यस्य देवैरासदो बर्हिरग्नेऽहान्यस्मै सुदिना भवंति ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ īḷate ǀ ajirám ǀ dūtyā́ya ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ mā́nuṣāsaḥ ǀyásya ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ásadaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ agne ǀ áhāni ǀ asmai ǀ su-dínā ǀ bhavanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men offering oblations, ever solicit you the quick-going (to undertake) the office of their messenger, forto him, on whose sacred grass you sit with the gods, the days are prosperous.
verses.wilson_translation: Men offering oblations, ever solicit you the quick-going (to undertake) the office of their messenger, forto him, on whose sacred grass you sit with the gods, the days are prosperous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिश्चिदक्तोः प्र चिकितुर्वसूनि त्वे अंतर्दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।मनुष्वदग्न इह यक्षि देवान्भवा नो दूतो अभिशस्तिपावा ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ cit ǀ aktóḥ ǀ prá ǀ cikituḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ tvé íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀmanuṣvát ǀ agne ǀ ihá ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ abhiśasti-pā́vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: In you,Agni, thrice in the day, (the priests) make manifest the treasures (of the oblation) for (the benefitof the) mortal donor; worship the gods on this occasion, Agni, as (you did) for Manu; be our messenger, ourprotector against malignity.
verses.wilson_translation: In you,Agni, thrice in the day, (the priests) make manifest the treasures (of the oblation) for (the benefitof the) mortal donor; worship the gods on this occasion, Agni, as (you did) for Manu; be our messenger, ourprotector against malignity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरीशे बृहतो अध्वरस्याग्निर्विश्वस्य हविषः कृतस्य ।क्रतुं ह्यस्य वसवो जुषंताथा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहं ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ īśe ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ agníḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ kṛtásya ǀkrátum ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀ átha ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ havya-vā́ham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnipresides over the solemn rite, over every consecrated oblation; the Vasusapproved of his acts;the gods have made him the bearer of the offering.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnipresides over the solemn rite, over every consecrated oblation; the Vasusapproved of his acts;the gods have made him the bearer of the offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आग्ने वह हविरद्याय देवानिंद्रज्येष्ठास इह मादयंतां ।इमं यज्ञं दिवि देवेषु धेहि यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agne ǀ vaha ǀ haviḥ-ádyāya ǀ devā́n ǀ índra-jyeṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mādayantām ǀimám ǀ yajñám ǀ diví ǀ devéṣu ǀ dhehi ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, bring the gods to eat of the oblation; may they, of whom Indrais the chief, be delighted on thisoccasion; convey this sacrifice to the deities in heaven, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, bring the gods to eat of the oblation; may they, of whom Indrais the chief, be delighted on thisoccasion; convey this sacrifice to the deities in heaven, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE with great reverence have approached The Youngest who hath shone forth well-kindled in his dwelling,With wondrous light between wide earth and heaven, well-worshipped, looking forth in all directions. Through his great might o’ercoming all misfortunes, praised in the house is Agni Jātavedas.May he protect us from disgrace and trouble, both us who laud him and our noble patrons. O Agni, thou art Varuṇa and Mitra: Vasisthas with their holy hymns exalt thee.With thee be most abundant gain of treasure. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: अगन्म महा नमसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे ।चित्रभानुं रोदसी अंतरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यंचं ॥
verses.transliteration: áganma ǀ mahā́ ǀ námasā ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ yáḥ ǀ dīdā́ya ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ své ǀ duroṇé ǀcitrá-bhānum ǀ ródasī íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ sú-āhutam ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pratyáñcam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us approach with profound reverence the youngest (of the gods), who shines when kindled in hisown abode; who is blazing wonderfully between heaven and earth, and, piously invoked, is coming from everyquarter.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us approach with profound reverence the youngest (of the gods), who shines when kindled in hisown abode; who is blazing wonderfully between heaven and earth, and, piously invoked, is coming from everyquarter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मह्ना विश्वा दुरितानि साह्वानग्निः ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः ।स नो रक्षिषद्दुरितादवद्यादस्मान्गृणत उत नो मघोनः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ sahvā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ stave ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rakṣiṣat ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ avadyā́t ǀ asmā́n ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that Agniwho by his greatness is the overcomer of all evils, who is praised as Jātavedasin the(sacrificial) chamber, protect us, glorifying him, and affluent (in oblations), from all sin and reproach.
verses.wilson_translation: May that Agniwho by his greatness is the overcomer of all evils, who is praised as Jātavedasin the(sacrificial) chamber, protect us, glorifying him, and affluent (in oblations), from all sin and reproach.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वरुण उत मित्रो अग्ने त्वां वर्धंति मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः ।त्वे वसु सुषणनानि संतु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ utá ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agne ǀ tvā́m ǀ vardhanti ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀtvé íti ǀ vásu ǀ su-sananā́ni ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are Varuṇa, you are Mitra,Agni; the Vasiṣṭhasaugment you with praises; may liberally distributedriches be (extant) in you, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: You are Varuṇa, you are Mitra,Agni; the Vasiṣṭhasaugment you with praises; may liberally distributedriches be (extant) in you, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BRING song and hymn to Agni, Asura-slayer, enlightener of all and thought-bestower.Like an oblation on the grass, to please him, I bring this to Vaiśvānara, hymn-inspirer. Thou with thy flame, O Agni, brightly glowing, hast at thy birth filled full the earth and heaven.TIOU with thy might, Vaiśvānara Jātavedas, settest the Gods free frodi the curse that bound them. Agni, when, born thou lookedst on all creatures, like a brisk herdsman moving round his cattle.The path to prayer, Vaiśvānara, thou foundest. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्नये विश्वशुचे धियंधेऽसुरघ्ने मन्म धीतिं भरध्वं ।भरे हविर्न बर्हिषि प्रीणानो वैश्वानराय यतये मतीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ agnáye ǀ viśva-śúce ǀ dhiyam-dhé ǀ asura-ghné ǀ mánma ǀ dhītím ǀ bharadhvam ǀbháre ǀ havíḥ ǀ ná ǀ barhíṣi ǀ prīṇānáḥ ǀ vaiśvānarā́ya ǀ yátaye ǀ matīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer praise and worshp to Agni, the enlightener of all, the accepter of pious rites, the destroyer of the Asuras; propitiating him, I now present the oblation on the sacred grass to Vaiśvānara, the granter of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer praise and worshp to Agni, the enlightener of all, the accepter of pious rites, the destroyer of the Asuras; propitiating him, I now present the oblation on the sacred grass to Vaiśvānara, the granter of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने शोचिषा शोशुचान आ रोदसी अपृणा जायमानः ।त्वं देवाँ अभिशस्तेरमुंचो वैश्वानर जातवेदो महित्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ śocíṣā ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀtvám ǀ devā́n ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ amuñcaḥ ǀ váiśvānara ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, radiant with lustre, fill the heaven and earth (with light) as soon as born; you,Vaiśvānara,from whom wealth proceeds, has by your might liberated the gods from malevolent (foes).
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, radiant with lustre, fill the heaven and earth (with light) as soon as born; you,Vaiśvānara,from whom wealth proceeds, has by your might liberated the gods from malevolent (foes).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जातो यदग्ने भुवना व्यख्यः पशून्न गोपा इर्यः परिज्मा ।वैश्वानर ब्रह्मणे विंद गातुं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: jātáḥ ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ bhúvanā ǀ ví ǀ ákhyaḥ ǀ paśū́n ǀ ná ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ íryaḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀváiśvānara ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ vinda ǀ gātúm ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When you are born,Agni, the lord, the circumambient, you watch over all creatures as a herdsman overhis cattle; be willing,Vaiśvānara, to requite our praise, and do you cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: When you are born,Agni, the lord, the circumambient, you watch over all creatures as a herdsman overhis cattle; be willing,Vaiśvānara, to requite our praise, and do you cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIV Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH reverence and with offered gifts serve we the God whose flame is bright:Let us bring Jātavedas fuel, and adore Agni when we invoke the Gods. Agni, may we perform thy rites with fuel, and honour thee, O Holy one, with praises:Honour thee, Priest of sacrifice! with butter, thee, God of blessed light! with our oblation. Come, Agni, with the Gods to our invoking, come, pleased, to offerings sanctified with Vaṣaṭ.May we be his who pays thee, God, due honour. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: समिधा जातवेदसे देवाय देवहूतिभिः ।हविर्भिः शुक्रशोचिषे नमस्विनो वयं दाशेमाग्नये ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-ídhā ǀ jātá-vedase ǀ devā́ya ǀ deváhūti-bhiḥ ǀhavíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ śukrá-śociṣe ǀ namasvínaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ dāśema ǀ agnáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us, laden with oblations, offer worship with fuel and invocations of the gods to the divine Jātavedas, to the purely lustrous Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us, laden with oblations, offer worship with fuel and invocations of the gods to the divine Jātavedas, to the purely lustrous Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं ते अग्ने समिधा विधेम वयं दाशेम सुष्टुती यजत्र ।वयं घृतेनाध्वरस्य होतर्वयं देव हविषा भद्रशोचे ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ vidhema ǀ vayám ǀ dāśema ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ yajatra ǀvayám ǀ ghṛténa ǀ adhvarasya ǀ hotaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ deva ǀ havíṣā ǀ bhadra-śoce ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we perform your rites,Agni, with fuel; may we offer you, adorable Agni, pious praises; may we(gratify you), ministrant of the sacrifice, with clarified butter; divine Agni, of auspicious lustre, may we (worshipyou) with oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: May we perform your rites,Agni, with fuel; may we offer you, adorable Agni, pious praises; may we(gratify you), ministrant of the sacrifice, with clarified butter; divine Agni, of auspicious lustre, may we (worshipyou) with oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो देवेभिरुप देवहूतिमग्ने याहि वषट्कृतिं जुषाणः ।तुभ्यं देवाय दाशतः स्याम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ devá-hūtim ǀ ágne ǀ yāhí ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtim ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀtúbhyam ǀ devā́ya ǀ dā́śataḥ ǀ syāma ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to our sacrifice,Agni, with the gods, propitiated by the sanctified oblations; may we be theofferers (of worship) to you who are divine, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to our sacrifice,Agni, with the gods, propitiated by the sanctified oblations; may we be theofferers (of worship) to you who are divine, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . OFFER oblations in his mouth, the bounteous God's whom we must serve.His who is nearest kin to us: Who for the Fivefold People's take hath seated him in every homeWise, Youthful, Master of the house. On all sides may that Agni guard our household folk and property;May he deliver us from woe. I have begotten this new hymn for Agni, Falcon of the sky:Will he not give us of his wealth? Whose lories when he glows in front of sacrite are fair to see,Like wealth of one with hero sons. May he enjoy this hallowed gift, Agni accept our songs, who bearsOblations, best of worshippers. Lord of the house, whom men must seek, we set thee down, O Worshipped OnelBright, rich in heroes, Agni! God Shine forth at night and morn: through thee with fires are we provided well.Thou, rich in heroes, art our Friend. The men come near thee for their gain, the singers with their songs of praise:Speech, thousandfold, comes near to thee. Bright, Purifier, meet for praise, Immortal with refulgent glow,Agni drives Rākṣasas away. As such, bring us abundant wealth, young Child of Strength, for this thou canstMay Bhaga give us what is choice. Thou, Agni, givest hero fame: Bhaga and Savitar the God,And Did give us what is good. Agni, preserve us from distress: consume our enemies, O God,Eternal, with the hottest flames. And, irresistible, be thou a mighty iron fort to us,With hundred walls for man's defence. Do thou preserve us, eve and morn, from sorrow, from the wicked men,Infallible! by day and night.

verses.sanskrit: उपसद्याय मीळ्हुष आस्ये जुहुता हविः ।यो नो नेदिष्ठमाप्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: upa-sádyāya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ āsyé ǀ juhuta ǀ havíḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ ā́pyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer the oblation to the present Agni, the showerer (of benefits); pour into the mouth of him who(bears) to us the nearest relationship.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer the oblation to the present Agni, the showerer (of benefits); pour into the mouth of him who(bears) to us the nearest relationship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः पंच चर्षणीरभि निषसाद दमेदमे ।कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ páñca ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ni-sasā́da ǀ dáme-dame ǀkavíḥ ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ yúvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who, juvenile, wise, the lord of the dwelling, abides with the five classes of men in every dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: Who, juvenile, wise, the lord of the dwelling, abides with the five classes of men in every dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो वेदो अमात्यमग्नी रक्षतु विश्वतः ।उतास्मान्पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ védaḥ ǀ amā́tyam ǀ agníḥ ǀ rakṣatu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀutá ǀ asmā́n ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May he defend for us the wealth that has been acquired, and preserve us from iniquity.
verses.wilson_translation: May he defend for us the wealth that has been acquired, and preserve us from iniquity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नवं नु स्तोममग्नये दिवः श्येनाय जीजनं ।वस्वः कुविद्वनाति नः ॥
verses.transliteration: návam ǀ nú ǀ stómam ǀ agnáye ǀ diváḥ ǀ śyenā́ya ǀ jījanam ǀvásvaḥ ǀ kuvít ǀ vanā́ti ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, to whom as to a (swift) hawk in heaven, I address this new hymn, bestow upon us amplewealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, to whom as to a (swift) hawk in heaven, I address this new hymn, bestow upon us amplewealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्पार्हा यस्य श्रियो दृशे रयिर्वीरवतो यथा ।अग्रे यज्ञस्य शोचतः ॥
verses.transliteration: spārhā́ḥ ǀ yásya ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀ rayíḥ ǀ vīrá-vataḥ ǀ yathā ǀágre ǀ yajñásya ǀ śócataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Of whom, blazing in the front of the sacrifice, the enviable honours are to be seen, like the riches of aman havingmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Of whom, blazing in the front of the sacrifice, the enviable honours are to be seen, like the riches of aman havingmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सेमां वेतु वषट्कृतिमग्निर्जुषत नो गिरः ।यजिष्ठो हव्यवाहनः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ vetu ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtim ǀ agníḥ ǀ juṣata ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀyájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that most adorable Agni, the bearer of oblations, accept our offering, gratified by our praises.
verses.wilson_translation: May that most adorable Agni, the bearer of oblations, accept our offering, gratified by our praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि त्वा नक्ष्य विश्पते द्युमंतं देव धीमहि ।सुवीरमग्न आहुत ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ nakṣya ǀ viśpate ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ deva ǀ dhīmahi ǀsu-vī́ram ǀ agne ǀ ā-huta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, the approachable; the lord of men, the invoked of all, we set you down (upon the altar), theresplendent, the righteously glorified.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, the approachable; the lord of men, the invoked of all, we set you down (upon the altar), theresplendent, the righteously glorified.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्षप उस्रश्च दीदिहि स्वग्नयस्त्वया वयं ।सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣápaḥ ǀ usráḥ ǀ ca ǀ dīdihi ǀ su-agnáyaḥ ǀ tváyā ǀ vayám ǀsu-vī́raḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Blaze,Agni, night and day, that by you we may be possessed of sacred fires; may you, friendly to us,be righteously praised.
verses.wilson_translation: Blaze,Agni, night and day, that by you we may be possessed of sacred fires; may you, friendly to us,be righteously praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा सातये नरो विप्रासो यंति धीतिभिः ।उपाक्षरा सहस्रिणी ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ sātáye ǀ náraḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀúpa ǀ ákṣarā ǀ sahasríṇī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise men approach with sacred rites for the acquisition of riches; perpetual, infinite (praise isaddressed to you);
verses.wilson_translation: Wise men approach with sacred rites for the acquisition of riches; perpetual, infinite (praise isaddressed to you);
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नी रक्षांसि सेधति शुक्रशोचिरमर्त्यः ।शुचिः पावक ईड्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sedhati ǀ śukrá-śociḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀśúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the bright, radiant, immortal, pure, purifying, adorable Agni, keep off therākṣasas].
verses.wilson_translation: May the bright, radiant, immortal, pure, purifying, adorable Agni, keep off therākṣasas].
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो राधांस्या भरेशानः सहसो यहो ।भगश्च दातु वार्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀbhágaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dātu ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength, who are the lord (of all), bestow riches upon us; and may Bhagagive us wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength, who are the lord (of all), bestow riches upon us; and may Bhagagive us wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वीरवद्यशो देवश्च सविता भगः ।दितिश्च दाति वार्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ca ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀdítiḥ ǀ ca ǀ dāti ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Agni, give us food along withmaleissue, and may the divine Savitā,Bhagaand Diti, give uswealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Agni, give us food along withmaleissue, and may the divine Savitā,Bhagaand Diti, give uswealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने रक्षा णो अंहसः प्रति ष्म देव रीषतः ।तपिष्ठैरजरो दह ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ rákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ práti ǀ sma ǀ deva ǀ ríṣataḥ ǀtápiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ daha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Preserve us,Agni, from sin; divine (Agni), who are exempt from decay, consume (our) foes with (your)hottest flames.
verses.wilson_translation: Preserve us,Agni, from sin; divine (Agni), who are exempt from decay, consume (our) foes with (your)hottest flames.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा मही न आयस्यनाधृष्टो नृपीतये ।पूर्भवा शतभुजिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ mahī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yasī ǀ ánādhṛṣṭaḥ ǀ nṛ́-pītaye ǀpū́ḥ ǀ bhava ǀ śatá-bhujiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, who are irresistibel, be to us, for the protection of our posterity, like the vast spacious,metal-walled cities (of therākṣasas).
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, who are irresistibel, be to us, for the protection of our posterity, like the vast spacious,metal-walled cities (of therākṣasas).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नः पाह्यंहसो दोषावस्तरघायतः ।दिवा नक्तमदाभ्य ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ dóṣā-vastaḥ ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀdívā ǀ náktam ǀ adābhya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Uninjurable Agni, dispeller of darkness, preserve us night and day from sin, and from the malevolent.
verses.wilson_translation: Uninjurable Agni, dispeller of darkness, preserve us night and day from sin, and from the malevolent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVI. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: १२ मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ:। अग्नि: । प्रगाथ: (=विषमा बृहती , समा सतोबृहती )  ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Son of Strength,Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all. His two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast.Then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, and heavenly gift of wealth to men. The flame of him the Bountiful, the Much-invoked, hath mounted up,And his red-coloured smoke-clouds reach and touch the sky: the men are kindling Agni well. Thee, thee Most Glorious One we make our messenger. Bring the Gods hither to the feast.Give us, O Son of Strength, all food that fcedeth man: give that for which we pray to thee. Thou, Agni, art the homestead's Lord, our Herald at the sacrifice.Lord of all boons, thou art the Cleanser and a Sage. Pay worship, and enjoy the good. Give riches to the sacrificer, O Most Wise, for thou art he who granteth wealth.Inspire with zeal each priest at this our solemn rite; all who are skilled in singing praise. O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes he to thee,Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, their stalls of kine. They in whose home, her hand bearing the sacred oil, Iḷā sits down well-satisfied-Guard them, Victorious God, from slander and from harm. give us a refuge famed afar. Do thou, a Priest with pleasant tongue, most wise, and very near to us,Agni, bring riches hither to our liberal chiefs, and speed the oflering of our gifts. They who bestow as bounty plenteous wealth of steeds, moved by desire of great renown-Do thou with saving help preserve them from distress, Most Youthful! with a hundred forts. The God who gives your wealth demands a full libation poured to him.Pour ye it forth, then fill the vessel full again: then doth the God pay heed to you. Him have the Gods appointed Priest of sacrifice, oblation-bearer, passing wise.Agni gives wealth and valour to the worshipper, to folk who offer up their gifts.

verses.sanskrit: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे ।प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: enā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ agním ǀ námasā ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀpriyám ǀ cétiṣṭham ǀ aratím ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ víśvasya ǀ dūtám ǀ amṛ́tam ǁ
