Thus the Vasisthas glorify with praises Indra, the Powerful whose arm wields thunder.Praised, may he guard our wealth in kine and heroes. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: उदु ब्रह्माण्यैरत श्रवस्येंद्रं समर्ये महया वसिष्ठ ।आ यो विश्वानि शवसा ततानोपश्रोता म ईवतो वचांसि ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ airata ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ índram ǀ sa-maryé ǀ mahaya ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ śávasā ǀ tatā́na ǀ upa-śrotā́ ǀ me ǀ ī́vataḥ ǀ vácāṃsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The sages) have offered prayers to (Indra) for food, worship Indra,Vasiṣṭhaat the sacrifice; may that Indra who has spread out all (the regions) by his might, be the hearer of my words when approaching him.
verses.wilson_translation: (The sages) have offered prayers to (Indra) for food, worship Indra,Vasiṣṭhaat the sacrifice; may that Indra who has spread out all (the regions) by his might, be the hearer of my words when approaching him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयामि घोष इंद्र देवजामिरिरज्यंत यच्छुरुधो विवाचि ।नहि स्वमायुश्चिकिते जनेषु तानीदंहांस्यति पर्ष्यस्मान् ॥
verses.transliteration: áyāmi ǀ ghóṣaḥ ǀ indra ǀ devá-jāmiḥ ǀ irajyánta ǀ yát ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ ví-vāci ǀnahí ǀ svám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ cikité ǀ jáneṣu ǀ tā́ni ǀ ít ǀ áṃhāṃsi ǀ áti ǀ parṣi ǀ asmā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indra, the plural nts grow up, the sound (of praise) acceptable to the gods, (uttered) by theworshipper, has been raised; by no one among men, is his own life understood; convey us beyond all those sins(by which life is shortened).
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indra, the plural nts grow up, the sound (of praise) acceptable to the gods, (uttered) by theworshipper, has been raised; by no one among men, is his own life understood; convey us beyond all those sins(by which life is shortened).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युजे रथं गवेषणं हरिभ्यामुप ब्रह्माणि जुजुषाणमस्थुः ।वि बाधिष्ट स्य रोदसी महित्वेंद्रो वृत्राण्यप्रती जघन्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yujé ǀ rátham ǀ go-éṣaṇam ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ jujuṣāṇám ǀ asthuḥ ǀví ǀ bādhiṣṭa ǀ syáḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ apratí ǀ jaghanvā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: I harness (by praises) the kine-bestowing chariot (of Indra) with his horses; (my) prayers have reachedhim who is plural ased (by devotion); he has surpassed in magnitude heaven and earth, slaying the unresistingenemies.
verses.wilson_translation: I harness (by praises) the kine-bestowing chariot (of Indra) with his horses; (my) prayers have reachedhim who is plural ased (by devotion); he has surpassed in magnitude heaven and earth, slaying the unresistingenemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आपश्चित्पिप्युः स्तर्यो न गावो नक्षन्नृतं जरितारस्त इंद्र ।याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छा त्वं हि धीभिर्दयसे वि वाजान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ pipyuḥ ǀ staryáḥ ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ nákṣan ǀ ṛtám ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀyāhí ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ dáyase ǀ ví ǀ vā́jān ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the waters increase like young; may your worshippers,Indra, possess water (in abundance); comelike the wind with the Niyutsteeds, for you, (propitiated) by holy rites, verily bestow upon us food.
verses.wilson_translation: May the waters increase like young; may your worshippers,Indra, possess water (in abundance); comelike the wind with the Niyutsteeds, for you, (propitiated) by holy rites, verily bestow upon us food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते त्वा मदा इंद्र मादयंतु शुष्मिणं तुविराधसं जरित्रे ।एको देवत्रा दयसे हि मर्तानस्मिंछूर सवने मादयस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ tvā ǀ mádāḥ ǀ indra ǀ mādayantu ǀ śuṣmíṇam ǀ tuvi-rā́dhasam ǀ jaritré ǀékaḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ dáyase ǀ hí ǀ mártān ǀ asmín ǀ śūra ǀ sávane ǀ mādayasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: May these inebriating draughts exhilarate you,Indra; bestow upon the praiser (a son vigorous andwealthy); for you alone among the gods are compassionate to mortals; be exhilarated here at this sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May these inebriating draughts exhilarate you,Indra; bestow upon the praiser (a son vigorous andwealthy); for you alone among the gods are compassionate to mortals; be exhilarated here at this sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवेदिंद्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं वसिष्ठासो अभ्यर्चंत्यर्कैः ।स नः स्तुतो वीरवत्पातु गोमद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vájra-bāhum ǀ vásiṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ arkáiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ pātu ǀ gó-mat ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: In this manner the Vasiṣṭhasglorify with hymns Indra, the showerer, the bearer of the thunderbolt; mayhe so glorified grant us wealth, comprisingmaleposterity and cattle; and do you ever cherish us with blessingṣ
verses.wilson_translation: In this manner the Vasiṣṭhasglorify with hymns Indra, the showerer, the bearer of the thunderbolt; mayhe so glorified grant us wealth, comprisingmaleposterity and cattle; and do you ever cherish us with blessingṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . A HOME is made for thee to dwell in, Indra: O Much-invoked, go thitherwith the heroes.That thou, to prosper us, mayst be our Helper, vouchsafe us wealth, rejoice with draughts of Soma. Indra, thy wish, twice-strong, is comprehended: pressed is the Soma, poured are pleasant juices.This hymn of praise, from loosened tongue, made perfect, draws Indra to itself with loud invoking. Come, thou Impetuous; God, from earth or heaven; come to our holy grass to drink the Soma.Hither to me let thy Bay Horses bring thee to listen to our hymns and make thee joyful. Come unto us with all thine aids, accordant, Lord of Bay Steeds, accepting our devotions,Fair-helmeted, o’ercoming with the mighty, and lending us the strength of bulls, O Indra. As to the chariot pole a vigorous courser, this laud is brought to the great strong Upholder.This hymn solicits wealth of thee: in heaven, as ’twere above the sky, set thou our glory. With precious things. O Indra, thus content us: may we attain to thine exalted favour.Send our chiefs plenteous food with hero children. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.english_translation: A plural ce has been prepared for you in the sacrificial chamber; proceed to it, invoked of many, along withthe leaders (of rites the Maruts), inasmuch as you are our protector, (promote our) prosperity; grant us riches; beexhilarated by the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: A plural ce has been prepared for you in the sacrificial chamber; proceed to it, invoked of many, along withthe leaders (of rites the Maruts), inasmuch as you are our protector, (promote our) prosperity; grant us riches; beexhilarated by the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Your purpose,Indra, is apprehended, you who are mighty in the two (worlds); the Somais effused; thesweet juices are poured (into the vessels); this perfect praise uttered with loosened tongue propitiates Indra withrepeated invocations.
verses.wilson_translation: Your purpose,Indra, is apprehended, you who are mighty in the two (worlds); the Somais effused; thesweet juices are poured (into the vessels); this perfect praise uttered with loosened tongue propitiates Indra withrepeated invocations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Come, Rijishin, from the sky, or from the firmament, to this sacred gras, to drink the Soma; let yourhorses bear you who are vigorous to my presence to (receive my) praise and for (thine) exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, Rijishin, from the sky, or from the firmament, to this sacred gras, to drink the Soma; let yourhorses bear you who are vigorous to my presence to (receive my) praise and for (thine) exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Lord of bay steeds, propitiated by our praise, come to us with all your protections, sharing insatisfaction, handsome-chinned, with the ancient (Maruts), overthrowing repeatedly (your) foes, and granting usa strong and vigorous (son).
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of bay steeds, propitiated by our praise, come to us with all your protections, sharing insatisfaction, handsome-chinned, with the ancient (Maruts), overthrowing repeatedly (your) foes, and granting usa strong and vigorous (son).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: This invogorating praise, like a horse attached, to car, has been addressed to you who are mighty andfierce, the up-bearer (of the world); this thine adorer desires of you,Indra, riches; do you grant us sustenancenotorious as the sky in heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: This invogorating praise, like a horse attached, to car, has been addressed to you who are mighty andfierce, the up-bearer (of the world); this thine adorer desires of you,Indra, riches; do you grant us sustenancenotorious as the sky in heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: In this manner,Indra, satisfy us (with the gift) of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yougreat giver; bestow upon us who are opulent (in offerings) food withmaledescendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: In this manner,Indra, satisfy us (with the gift) of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yougreat giver; bestow upon us who are opulent (in offerings) food withmaledescendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: WHEN with thy mighty help, O potent Indra, the armies rush together in their fury.When from the strong man's arm the lightning flieth, let not the mind go forth to side with others. O Indra, where the ground is hard to traverse, smite down our foes, the mortals who assail us,Keep far from us the curse of the reviler: bring us accumulated store of treasures. God of the fair helm, give Sudās a hundred succours, a thousand blessings, and thy bounty.Strike down the weapon of our mortal foeman: bestow upon us splendid fame and riches. I wait the power of one like thee, O Indra, gifts of a Helper such as thou art, Hero.Strong, Mighty God, dwell with me now and ever: Lord of Bay Horses, do not thou desert us. Here are the Kutsas supplicating Indra for might, the Lord of Bays for God-sent conquest.Make our foes ever easy to be vanquished: may we, victorious, win the spoil, O Hero. With precious things, O Indra, thus content us: may we attain to thine exalted favour.Send our chiefs plenteous food with hero children. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: आ ते मह इंद्रोत्युग्र समन्यवो यत्समरंत सेनाः ।पताति दिद्युन्नर्यस्य बाह्वोर्मा ते मनो विष्वद्र्यग्वि चारीत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ maháḥ ǀ indra ǀ ūtī́ ǀ ugra ǀ sá-manyavaḥ ǀ yát ǀ sam-áranta ǀ sénāḥ ǀpátāti ǀ didyút ǀ náryasya ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ viṣvadryák ǀ ví ǀ cārīt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fierce Indra, when animated by like fierce armies, encounter them; let the bright (weapon) wielded bythe arms of you who are mighty and the friend of man descend for our protection; let not your all-pervading mindwander (away from us).
verses.wilson_translation: Fierce Indra, when animated by like fierce armies, encounter them; let the bright (weapon) wielded bythe arms of you who are mighty and the friend of man descend for our protection; let not your all-pervading mindwander (away from us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि दुर्ग इंद्र श्नथिह्यमित्रानभि ये नो मर्तासो अमंति ।आरे तं शंसं कृणुहि निनित्सोरा नो भर संभरणं वसूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ duḥ-gé ǀ indra ǀ śnathihi ǀ amítrān ǀ abhí ǀ yé ǀ naḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ amánti ǀāré ǀ tám ǀ śáṃsam ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ ninitsóḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ sam-bháraṇam ǀ vásūnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroy,Indra, our adversaries in battle, those men who overpower us; remove far from us the calumnyof the reviler; bring to us abundance of treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroy,Indra, our adversaries in battle, those men who overpower us; remove far from us the calumnyof the reviler; bring to us abundance of treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतं ते शिप्रिन्नूतयः सुदासे सहस्रं शंसा उत रातिरस्तु ।जहि वधर्वनुषो मर्त्यस्यास्मे द्युम्नमधि रत्नं च धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration: śatám ǀ te ǀ śiprin ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ sahásram ǀ śáṃsāḥ ǀ utá ǀ rātíḥ ǀ astu ǀjahí ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ mártyasya ǀ asmé íti ǀ dyumnám ǀ ádhi ǀ rátnam ǀ ca ǀ dhehi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May hundreds of your protections, handsome-chinned, be (secured) to the liberal donor (of oblations);may thousands of blessing be bestowed (upon me) as well as wealth; cast the fatal weapon on the mischievousmortal; grant us food and wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May hundreds of your protections, handsome-chinned, be (secured) to the liberal donor (of oblations);may thousands of blessing be bestowed (upon me) as well as wealth; cast the fatal weapon on the mischievousmortal; grant us food and wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वावतो हींद्र क्रत्वे अस्मि त्वावतोऽवितुः शूर रातौ ।विश्वेदहानि तविषीव उग्रँ ओकः कृणुष्व हरिवो न मर्धीः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́-vataḥ ǀ hí ǀ indra ǀ krátve ǀ ásmi ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ avitúḥ ǀ śūra ǀ rātáu ǀvíśvā ǀ ít ǀ áhāni ǀ taviṣī-vaḥ ǀ ugra ǀ ókaḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mardhīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I am (in dependence),Indra, upon the acts of such as you are, upon the liberality of a protector, hero,such as you; vigorous and fierce Indra, give us a dwelling for all our days; lord of bay steeds, do us no harm.
verses.wilson_translation: I am (in dependence),Indra, upon the acts of such as you are, upon the liberality of a protector, hero,such as you; vigorous and fierce Indra, give us a dwelling for all our days; lord of bay steeds, do us no harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कुत्सा एते हर्यश्वाय शूषमिंद्रे सहो देवजूतमियानाः ।सत्रा कृधि सुहना शूर वृत्रा वयं तरुत्राः सनुयाम वाजं ॥
verses.transliteration: kútsāḥ ǀ eté ǀ hári-aśvāya ǀ śūṣám ǀ índre ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ devá-jūtam ǀ iyānā́ḥ ǀsatrā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ su-hánā ǀ śūra ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ vayám ǀ tárutrāḥ ǀ sanuyāma ǀ vā́jam ǁ
verses.english_translation: These (Vasiṣṭhas) are offering grateful (adoration) to the lord of bay steeds, soliciting the strengthassigned by the gods to Indra; make our enemies, Indra, easy to be overcome, and may we, safe from peril,enjoy abundance.
verses.wilson_translation: These (Vasiṣṭhas) are offering grateful (adoration) to the lord of bay steeds, soliciting the strengthassigned by the gods to Indra; make our enemies, Indra, easy to be overcome, and may we, safe from peril,enjoy abundance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा न इंद्र वार्यस्य पूर्धि प्र ते महीं सुमतिं वेविदाम ।इषं पिन्व मघवद्भ्यः सुवीरां यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vā́ryasya ǀ pūrdhi ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ mahī́m ǀ su-matím ǀ vevidāma ǀíṣam ǀ pinva ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ su-vī́rām ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: In this manner,Indra, satisfy us with the gift of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yourgreat favour; bestow upon us who are opulent in offerings food withmaledescendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: In this manner,Indra, satisfy us with the gift of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yourgreat favour; bestow upon us who are opulent in offerings food withmaledescendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVI. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SOMA unpressed ne’er gladdened liberal Indra, no juices pressed without a prayer have pleased him.I generate a laud that shall delight him, new and heroic, so that he may hear us. At every laud the Soma gladdens Indra: pressed juices please him as each psalm is chanted,What time the priests with one united effort call him to aid, as sons invoke their father. These deeds he did; let him achieve new exploits, such as the priests declare at their libations.Indra hath taken and possessed all castles, like as one common husband doth his spouses. Even thus have they declared him. Famed is Indra as Conqueror, sole distributer of treasures;Whose many succours come in close succession. May dear delightful benefits attend us. Thus, to bring help to men, Vasiṣṭha laudeth Indra, the peoples' Hero, at libation.Bestow upon us strength and wealth in thousands. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: न सोम इंद्रमसुतो ममाद नाब्रह्माणो मघवानं सुतासः ।तस्मा उक्थं जनये यज्जुजोषन्नृवन्नवीयः शृणवद्यथा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ásutaḥ ǀ mamāda ǀ ná ǀ ábrahmāṇaḥ ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀtásmai ǀ ukthám ǀ janaye ǀ yát ǀ jújoṣat ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somauneffused delights not Indra; the effused juices plural ase not Maghavan, unaccompanied byprayer; therefore, I offer to him praise that he may be plural ased with; that, like a prince, he may listen to a novel(strain).
verses.wilson_translation: The Somauneffused delights not Indra; the effused juices plural ase not Maghavan, unaccompanied byprayer; therefore, I offer to him praise that he may be plural ased with; that, like a prince, he may listen to a novel(strain).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उक्थौक्थे सोम इंद्रं ममाद नीथेनीथे मघवानं सुतासः ।यदीं सबाधः पितरं न पुत्राः समानदक्षा अवसे हवंते ॥
verses.transliteration: ukthé-ukthe ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índram ǀ mamāda ǀ nīthé-nīthe ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ pitáram ǀ ná ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ samāná-dakṣāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ hávante ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaeffused with reiterated prayer delights Indra; the effused juices, (offered) with repeatedpraise, (exhilarate)Maghavan; therefore, (the priests), combining together and making like exertion, invoke Indrafor protection, as sons (apply) to a father.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaeffused with reiterated prayer delights Indra; the effused juices, (offered) with repeatedpraise, (exhilarate)Maghavan; therefore, (the priests), combining together and making like exertion, invoke Indrafor protection, as sons (apply) to a father.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चकार ता कृणवन्नूनमन्या यानि ब्रुवंति वेधसः सुतेषु ।जनीरिव पतिरेकः समानो नि मामृजे पुर इंद्रः सु सर्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: cakā́ra ǀ tā́ ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ nūnám ǀ anyā́ ǀ yā́ni ǀ bruvánti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ sutéṣu ǀjánīḥ-iva ǀ pátiḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ samānáḥ ǀ ní ǀ mamṛje ǀ púraḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sú ǀ sárvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such exploits as his worshippers, when the Somais effused, proclaim that he has achieved, let himnow perform; may Indra, equal (to the task) and unaided, possess all the riches (of theasuras) as a husband hiswives.
verses.wilson_translation: Such exploits as his worshippers, when the Somais effused, proclaim that he has achieved, let himnow perform; may Indra, equal (to the task) and unaided, possess all the riches (of theasuras) as a husband hiswives.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा तमाहुरुत शृण्व इंद्र एको विभक्ता तरणिर्मघानां ।मिथस्तुर ऊतयो यस्य पूर्वीरस्मे भद्राणि सश्चत प्रियाणि ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ tám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ utá ǀ śṛṇve ǀ índraḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ maghā́nām ǀmithaḥ-túraḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhadrā́ṇi ǀ saścata ǀ priyā́ṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such have they proclaimed him;Indrais still celebrated as the distributor of riches, the transporter(beyond calamity), of whom many and emulous are the protections; may acceptable benefits attend us.
verses.wilson_translation: Such have they proclaimed him;Indrais still celebrated as the distributor of riches, the transporter(beyond calamity), of whom many and emulous are the protections; may acceptable benefits attend us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा वसिष्ठ इंद्रमूतये नॄन्कृष्टीनां वृषभं सुते गृणाति ।सहस्रिण उप नो माहि वाजान्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūtáye ǀ nṝ́n ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ suté ǀ gṛṇāti ǀsahasríṇaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ māhi ǀ vā́jān ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus does Vasiṣṭhaglorify Indra, the showerer (of benefits) upon the worshippers for the preservationof mankind; bestow upon us, (Indra), thousands of viands; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Thus does Vasiṣṭhaglorify Indra, the showerer (of benefits) upon the worshippers for the preservationof mankind; bestow upon us, (Indra), thousands of viands; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MEN call on Indra in the armed encounter that he may make the hymns they sing decisive.Hero, rejoicing in thy might, in combat give us a portion of the stall of cattle, Grant, Indra Maghavan, invoked of many, to these my friends the strength which thou possessest.Thou, Maghavan, hast rent strong places open: unclose for us, Wise God, thy hidden bounty. King of the living world, of men, is Indra, of all in varied form that earth containeth.Thence to the worshipper he giveth riches: may he enrich us also when we laud him. Maghavan Indra, when we all invoke him, bountiful ever sendeth strength to aid us:Whose perfect guerdon, never failing, bringeth wealth to the men, to friends the thing they covet. Quick, Indra, give us room and way to riches, and let us bring thy mind to grant us treasures,That we may win us cars and Steeds and cattle. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं नरो नेमधिता हवंते यत्पार्या युनजते धियस्ताः ।शूरो नृषाता शवसश्चकान आ गोमति व्रजे भजा त्वं नः ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ náraḥ ǀ nemá-dhitā ǀ havante ǀ yát ǀ pā́ryāḥ ǀ yunájate ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀśū́raḥ ǀ nṛ́-sātā ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ cakānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǀ bhaja ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men invoke Indrain battle when those actions which lead to victory are performed; do you who arehero, the benefactor of man, the desirer of prowess, plural ce us in possession of pastures abounding with cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Men invoke Indrain battle when those actions which lead to victory are performed; do you who arehero, the benefactor of man, the desirer of prowess, plural ce us in possession of pastures abounding with cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य इंद्र शुष्मो मघवंते अस्ति शिक्षा सखिभ्यः पुरुहूत नृभ्यः ।त्वं हि दृळ्हा मघवन्विचेता अपा वृधि परिवृतं न राधः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ śíkṣa ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ magha-van ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǀ pári-vṛtam ǀ ná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are the invoked of many, give to those men who are your friends that strength which,Maghavan, is thine; you, Maghavan (has forced open) the firm (shut, gates of cities); discover, discrimiantor (oftruth), the treasure now concealed.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are the invoked of many, give to those men who are your friends that strength which,Maghavan, is thine; you, Maghavan (has forced open) the firm (shut, gates of cities); discover, discrimiantor (oftruth), the treasure now concealed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो राजा जगतश्चर्षणीनामधि क्षमि विषुरूपं यदस्ति ।ततो ददाति दाशुषे वसूनि चोदद्राध उपस्तुतश्चिदर्वाक् ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ jágataḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀ víṣu-rūpam ǀ yát ǀ ásti ǀtátaḥ ǀ dadāti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásūni ǀ códat ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ úpa-stutaḥ ǀ cit ǀ arvā́k ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indrais lord of the earth and of men; (his is) the various wealth that exists upon the earth; thence hegives riches to the donor (of oblations); may he, glorified by us, bestow upon us wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrais lord of the earth and of men; (his is) the various wealth that exists upon the earth; thence hegives riches to the donor (of oblations); may he, glorified by us, bestow upon us wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू चिन्न इंद्रो मघवा सहूती दानो वाजं नि यमते न ऊती ।अनूना यस्य दक्षिणा पीपाय वामं नृभ्यो अभिवीता सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sá-hūtī ǀ dānáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ní ǀ yamate ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀánūnā ǀ yásya ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ pīpā́ya ǀ vāmám ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ abhí-vītā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the affluent and liberal,Indra, upon being invoked together (with the Maruts), quickly bestow foodfor our reservation, he whose unlimited, experienced liberality yields desirable (wealth) to those men (who arehis) friends.
verses.wilson_translation: May the affluent and liberal,Indra, upon being invoked together (with the Maruts), quickly bestow foodfor our reservation, he whose unlimited, experienced liberality yields desirable (wealth) to those men (who arehis) friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू इंद्र राये वरिवस्कृधी न आ ते मनो ववृत्याम मघाय ।गोमदश्वावद्रथवद्व्यंतो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ indra ǀ rāyé ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ vavṛtyāma ǀ maghā́ya ǀgó-mat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ rátha-vat ǀ vyántaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, grant quickly wealh for our enricment; may we attract your favour by our adoration; granting us(riches), comprising cattle and horses and chariots; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, grant quickly wealh for our enricment; may we attract your favour by our adoration; granting us(riches), comprising cattle and horses and chariots; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . COME to our prayers, O Indra, thou who knowest: let thy Bay Steeds be yoked and guided hither.Though mortal men on every side invoke thee, still give thine ear to us, O All-impeller. Thy greatness reacheth to our invocation, the sages' prayer which, Potent God, thou guardest.What time thy hand, O Mighty, holds the thunder, awful in strength thou hast become resistless. What time thou drewest both world-halves together, like heroes led by thee who call each other-For thou wast born for strength and high dominion-then e’en the active overthrew the sluggish. Honour us in these present days, O Indra, for hostile men are making expiation.Our sin that sinless Varuṇa discovered, the Wondrous-Wise hath long ago forgiven. We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra, that he may grant us gifts of ample riches,Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा ण इंद्रोप याहि विद्वानर्वांचस्ते हरयः संतु युक्ताः ।विश्वे चिद्धि त्वा विहवंत मर्ता अस्माकमिच्छृणुहि विश्वमिन्व ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhmā ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ arvā́ñcaḥ ǀ te ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ santu ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀvíśve ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ vi-hávanta ǀ mártāḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ít ǀ śṛṇuhi ǀ viśvam-inva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are wise, come to our adoration; let your horses harnessed be before us; gratified of all(men), all mortals severally invoke you; hear, therefore, our (invocation).
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are wise, come to our adoration; let your horses harnessed be before us; gratified of all(men), all mortals severally invoke you; hear, therefore, our (invocation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हवं त इंद्र महिमा व्यानड्ब्रह्म यत्पासि शवसिन्नृषीणां ।आ यद्वज्रं दधिषे हस्त उग्र घोरः सन्क्रत्वा जनिष्ठा अषाळ्हः ॥
verses.transliteration: hávam ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ mahimā́ ǀ ví ǀ ānaṭ ǀ bráhma ǀ yát ǀ pā́si ǀ śavasin ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀā́ ǀ yát ǀ vájram ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ háste ǀ ugra ǀ ghoráḥ ǀ sán ǀ krátvā ǀ janiṣṭhāḥ ǀ áṣāḷhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Endowed with strength, since you grant the prayers of the Ṛṣis, let your greatness,Indra, extend tothine invoker; and as, fierce deity, you hold the thunderbolt in yourhand, then formidable by your exploits youhave become invincible.
verses.wilson_translation: Endowed with strength, since you grant the prayers of the Ṛṣis, let your greatness,Indra, extend tothine invoker; and as, fierce deity, you hold the thunderbolt in yourhand, then formidable by your exploits youhave become invincible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव प्रणीतींद्र जोहुवानान्त्सं यन्नॄन्न रोदसी निनेथ ।महे क्षत्राय शवसे हि जज्ञेऽतूतुजिं चित्तूतुजिरशिश्नत् ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ indra ǀ jóhuvānān ǀ sám ǀ yát ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ninétha ǀmahé ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ śávase ǀ hí ǀ jajñé ǀ átūtujim ǀ cit ǀ tū́tujiḥ ǀ aśiśnat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since,Indra, by your guidance, you have conducted men, your zealous worshippers, over heaven andearth, you are born to (bestow) great wealth and strength, whence the presenter of offerings overcomes him whooffers them not.
verses.wilson_translation: Since,Indra, by your guidance, you have conducted men, your zealous worshippers, over heaven andearth, you are born to (bestow) great wealth and strength, whence the presenter of offerings overcomes him whooffers them not.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एभिर्न इंद्राहभिर्दशस्य दुर्मित्रासो हि क्षितयः पवंते ।प्रति यच्चष्टे अनृतमनेना अव द्विता वरुणो मायी नः सात् ॥
verses.transliteration: ebhíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ daśasya ǀ duḥ-mitrā́saḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ pávante ǀpráti ǀ yát ǀ cáṣṭe ǀ ánṛtam ǀ anenā́ḥ ǀ áva ǀ dvitā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ māyī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us,Indra, with these days, (wealth), for unfriendly men approach; may the untruth which the wiseand sinless Varuṇaobserves in us, (through your favour, Indra), doubly disappear.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us,Indra, with these days, (wealth), for unfriendly men approach; may the untruth which the wiseand sinless Varuṇaobserves in us, (through your favour, Indra), doubly disappear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वोचेमेदिंद्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः ।यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: vocéma ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ enam ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ dádat ǀ naḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ árcataḥ ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ áviṣṭhaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us glorify that opulent Indra, that he may give us great and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the pious rites of the worshipper; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us glorify that opulent Indra, that he may give us great and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the pious rites of the worshipper; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIX Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra: come hither, Lord of Bays, for this thou lovest.Drink of this fair, this well-effused libation: Maghavan, give us wealth when we implore thee. Come to us quickly with thy Bay Steeds, Hero, come to our prayer, accepting our devotion.Enjoy thyself aright at this libation, and listen thou unto the prayers we offer. What satisfaction do our hymns afford thee? When, Maghavan? Now let us do thee service.Hymns, only hymns, with love for thee, I weave thee: then hear, O Indra, these mine invocations. They, verily, were also human beings whom thou wast wont to hear, those earlier sages.Hence I, O Indra Maghavan, invoke thee: thou art our Providence, even as a Father. We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra, that he may grant us gifts of ample riches,Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: अयं सोम इंद्र तुभ्यं सुन्व आ तु प्र याहि हरिवस्तदोकाः ।पिबा त्वस्य सुषुतस्य चारोर्ददो मघानि मघवन्नियानः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ sunve ǀ ā́ ǀ tú ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ tát-okāḥ ǀpíba ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ cā́roḥ ǀ dádaḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀ magha-van ǀ iyānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somais poured out,Indra, for you; come, lord of bay steeds, to that dwelling (where it isprepared), drink of the plural ntifully-effused and grateful (libation), give us,Maghavan, when solicited for them,riches.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somais poured out,Indra, for you; come, lord of bay steeds, to that dwelling (where it isprepared), drink of the plural ntifully-effused and grateful (libation), give us,Maghavan, when solicited for them,riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन्वीर ब्रह्मकृतिं जुषाणोऽर्वाचीनो हरिभिर्याहि तूयं ।अस्मिन्नू षु सवने मादयस्वोप ब्रह्माणि शृणव इमा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhman ǀ vīra ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ arvācīnáḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀasmín ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ sávane ǀ mādayasva ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ śṛṇavaḥ ǀ imā́ ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Magnified hero,Indra, approving of the sacred rite, come to us speedily with your steeds; be exhilaratedat this sacrifice; hear these our prayers.
verses.wilson_translation: Magnified hero,Indra, approving of the sacred rite, come to us speedily with your steeds; be exhilaratedat this sacrifice; hear these our prayers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: का ते अस्त्यरंकृतिः सूक्तैः कदा नूनं ते मघवंदाशेम ।विश्वा मतीरा ततने त्वायाधा म इंद्र शृणवो हवेमा ॥
verses.transliteration: kā́ ǀ te ǀ asti ǀ áram-kṛtiḥ ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ dāśema ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ matī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tatane ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ ádha ǀ me ǀ indra ǀ śṛṇavaḥ ǀ hávā ǀ imā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: What satisfaction is there to you from our hymns? When,Maghavan, may we indeed present to you(oblations)? I expatiate in all praises addressed to you; hear,Indra, these my invocations.
verses.wilson_translation: What satisfaction is there to you from our hymns? When,Maghavan, may we indeed present to you(oblations)? I expatiate in all praises addressed to you; hear,Indra, these my invocations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतो घा ते पुरुष्या इदासन्येषां पूर्वेषामशृणोर्ऋषीणां ।अधाहं त्वा मघवंजोहवीमि त्वं न इंद्रासि प्रमतिः पितेव ॥
verses.transliteration: utó íti ǀ gha ǀ té ǀ puruṣyā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ āsan ǀ yéṣām ǀ pū́rveṣām ǀ áśṛṇoḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀádha ǀ ahám ǀ tvā ǀ magha-van ǀ johavīmi ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ asi ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Friendly to man were those ancien Ṛṣis whose praise you have listened to; therefore, I repeatedlyinvoke you,Maghavan; you,Indra, are well affected towards us as a parent.
verses.wilson_translation: Friendly to man were those ancien Ṛṣis whose praise you have listened to; therefore, I repeatedlyinvoke you,Maghavan; you,Indra, are well affected towards us as a parent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वोचेमेदिंद्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः ।यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: vocéma ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ enam ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ dádat ǀ naḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ árcataḥ ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ áviṣṭhaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us glorify that opulent Indra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us glorify that opulent Indra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH power and strength, O Mighty God, approach us: be the augmenter, Indra, of these riches;Strong Thunderer, Lord of men, for potent valour, for manly exploit and for high dominion. Thee, worth invoking, in the din of battle, heroes invoke in fray for life and sunlight.Among all people thou art foremost fighter: give up our enemies to easy slaughter. When fair bright days shall dawn on us, O Indra, and thou shalt bring thy banner near in battle,Agni the Asura shall sit as Herald, calling Gods hither for our great good fortune. Thine are we, Indra, thine, both these who praise thee, and those who give rich gifts, O God and Hero.Grant to our princes excellent protection, may they wax old and still be strong and happy. We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra that he may grant us gifts of ample riches:Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो देव शवसा याहि शुष्मिन्भवा वृध इंद्र रायो अस्य ।महे नृम्णाय नृपते सुवज्र महि क्षत्राय पौंस्याय शूर ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ deva ǀ śávasā ǀ yāhi ǀ śuṣmin ǀ bháva ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ asyá ǀmahé ǀ nṛmṇā́ya ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ su-vajra ǀ máhi ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ páuṃsyāya ǀ śūra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine and powerful (Indra), come to us with your strength; be the augmenter of our riches; be to us,king of men, wielder of the thunderbolt, for (a source of) vigour, of great prowess, hero, of manhood.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine and powerful (Indra), come to us with your strength; be the augmenter of our riches; be to us,king of men, wielder of the thunderbolt, for (a source of) vigour, of great prowess, hero, of manhood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हवंत उ त्वा हव्यं विवाचि तनूषु शूराः सूर्यस्य सातौ ।त्वं विश्वेषु सेन्यो जनेषु त्वं वृत्राणि रंधया सुहंतु ॥
verses.transliteration: hávante ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ hávyam ǀ ví-vāci ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ śū́rāḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sātáu ǀtvám ǀ víśveṣu ǀ sényaḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ tvám ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ randhaya ǀ su-hántu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Warriors invoke you, worthy to be invoked, in the variously clamorous (strife), for (the safety of their)person ns, and for the (long) enjoyment of the sun; you are a fit leader over all men; humble our enemies by thefatal (bolt).
verses.wilson_translation: Warriors invoke you, worthy to be invoked, in the variously clamorous (strife), for (the safety of their)person ns, and for the (long) enjoyment of the sun; you are a fit leader over all men; humble our enemies by thefatal (bolt).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहा यदिंद्र सुदिना व्युच्छांदधो यत्केतुमुपमं समत्सु ।न्यग्निः सीददसुरो न होता हुवानो अत्र सुभगाय देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: áhā ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ su-dínā ǀ vi-ucchā́n ǀ dádhaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ketúm ǀ upa-mám ǀ samát-su ǀní ǀ agníḥ ǀ sīdat ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ átra ǀ su-bhágāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indra, fortunate days arise, when you advance your emblem in battles, the strong Agni, theinvoker of the gods, summoning the gods hither for our benefit, sits down on the sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indra, fortunate days arise, when you advance your emblem in battles, the strong Agni, theinvoker of the gods, summoning the gods hither for our benefit, sits down on the sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं ते त इंद्र ये च देव स्तवंत शूर ददतो मघानि ।यच्छा सूरिभ्य उपमं वरूथं स्वाभुवो जरणामश्नवंत ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ té ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ deva ǀ stávanta ǀ śūra ǀ dádataḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀyáccha ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ várūtham ǀ su-ābhúvaḥ ǀ jaraṇā́m ǀ aśnavanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, divine Indra, who are yours, are they, hero, who are praising you and offering rich libations; grantto (your) pious (worshippers) an excellent abode; and may they, prosperous, attain old age.
verses.wilson_translation: We, divine Indra, who are yours, are they, hero, who are praising you and offering rich libations; grantto (your) pious (worshippers) an excellent abode; and may they, prosperous, attain old age.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वोचेमेदिंद्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः ।यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: vocéma ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ enam ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ dádat ǀ naḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ árcataḥ ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ áviṣṭhaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us glorify the opulent Indra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches; he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us glorify the opulent Indra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches; he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXI. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of Tawny Steeds,The Soma-drinker, O my friends. To him the Bounteous say the laud, and let us glorify, as men May do, the Giver of true gifts. O Indra, Lord of boundless might, for us thou winnest strength and kine,Thou winnest gold for us, Good Lord. Faithful to thee we loudly sing, heroic Indra, songs to thee: Mark, O Good Lord, this act of ours. Give us not up to man's reproach, to foeman's hateful calumny: In thee alone is all my strength. Thou art mine ample coat of mail, my Champion, Vṛtra-Slayer, thou:With thee for Friend I brave the foe. Yea, great art thou whose conquering might two independent Powers confess.The Heaven, O India, and the Earth. So let the voice surround thee, which attends the Maruts on their way,Reaching thee with the rays of light. Let the ascending drops attain to thee, the Wondrous God, in heaven:Let all the folk bow down to thee. Bring to the Wise, the Great, who waxeth mighty, your offerings, and make ready your devotion;To many clans he goeth, man's controller. For Indra, the sublime, the far-pervading, have singers generated prayer and praises:The sages never violate his statutes. The choirs have stablished Indra King for ever, for victory, him whose anger is resistless:And, for the Bays' Lord, strengthened those he loveth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र व इंद्राय मादनं हर्यश्वाय गायत ।सखायः सोमपाव्ने ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ mā́danam ǀ hári-aśvāya ǀ gāyata ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ soma-pā́vne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing, friends, an exhilarating hymn to Indra, the lord of bay steeds, the drinker of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing, friends, an exhilarating hymn to Indra, the lord of bay steeds, the drinker of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शंसेदुक्थं सुदानव उत द्युक्षं यथा नरः ।चकृमा सत्यराधसे ॥
verses.transliteration: śáṃsa ǀ ít ǀ ukthám ǀ su-dā́nave ǀ utá ǀ dyukṣám ǀ yáthā ǀ náraḥ ǀcakṛmá ǀ satyá-rādhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Repeat to the liberal Indrasuch brilliant praise as other (men repeat); let us offer it to him who is affluentin truth.
verses.wilson_translation: Repeat to the liberal Indrasuch brilliant praise as other (men repeat); let us offer it to him who is affluentin truth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न इंद्र वाजयुस्त्वं गव्युः शतक्रतो ।त्वं हिरण्ययुर्वसो ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ tvám ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀtvám ǀ hiraṇya-yúḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Indra, be willing to give us food; be willing,Śatakratu, to give us cattle; be willing, donor ofdwelling, to us gold.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Indra, be willing to give us food; be willing,Śatakratu, to give us cattle; be willing, donor ofdwelling, to us gold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयमिंद्र त्वायवोऽभि प्र णोनुमो वृषन् ।विद्धी त्वस्य नो वसो ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ indra ǀ tvā-yávaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ vṛṣan ǀviddhí ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ naḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devoted to you, showerer (of benefits), we glorify you; be cognizant, giver of dwellings, of this ourpraise.
verses.wilson_translation: Devoted to you, showerer (of benefits), we glorify you; be cognizant, giver of dwellings, of this ourpraise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो निदे च वक्तवेऽर्यो रंधीरराव्णे ।त्वे अपि क्रतुर्मम ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ nidé ǀ ca ǀ váktave ǀ aryáḥ ǀ randhīḥ ǀ árāvṇe ǀtvé íti ǀ ápi ǀ krátuḥ ǀ máma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are lord, subject us not to the reviler, to the abuser, to the withholder of offerings; may myworship verily (find favour) with you.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are lord, subject us not to the reviler, to the abuser, to the withholder of offerings; may myworship verily (find favour) with you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वर्मासि सप्रथः पुरोयोधश्च वृत्रहन् ।त्वया प्रति ब्रुवे युजा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ várma ǀ asi ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ puraḥ-yodháḥ ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀtváyā ǀ práti ǀ bruve ǀ yujā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Slayer of enemies, you,Indra, are our armour, vast and our preceder in battle; with you for my ally I defy(the foe).
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of enemies, you,Indra, are our armour, vast and our preceder in battle; with you for my ally I defy(the foe).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महाँ उतासि यस्य तेऽनु स्वधावरी सहः ।मम्नाते इंद्र रोदसी ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ utá ǀ asi ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́varī íti svadhā́-varī ǀ sáhaḥ ǀmamnā́te íti ǀ indra ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: You verily are great; and heaven and earth abounding with food, respect,Indra, your strength.
verses.wilson_translation: You verily are great; and heaven and earth abounding with food, respect,Indra, your strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा मरुत्वती परि भुवद्वाणी सयावरी ।नक्षमाणा सह द्युभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ marútvatī ǀ pári ǀ bhúvat ǀ vā́ṇī ǀ sa-yā́varī ǀnákṣamāṇā ǀ sahá ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the praises of your adorers, accompanying you (wherever you go), such as you are, and spreadingaround with radiance, reach you.
verses.wilson_translation: May the praises of your adorers, accompanying you (wherever you go), such as you are, and spreadingaround with radiance, reach you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वासस्त्वान्विंदवो भुवंदस्ममुप द्यवि ।सं ते नमंत कृष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvā́saḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ánu ǀ índavaḥ ǀ bhúvan ǀ dasmám ǀ úpa ǀ dyávi ǀsám ǀ te ǀ namanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ascending libations proceed,Indra, to you, abiding in heaven, of goodly aspect; men bow inreverence before you.
verses.wilson_translation: The ascending libations proceed,Indra, to you, abiding in heaven, of goodly aspect; men bow inreverence before you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो महे महिवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वं ।विशः पूर्वीः प्र चरा चर्षणिप्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ mahi-vṛ́dhe ǀ bharadhvam ǀ prá-cetase ǀ prá ǀ su-matím ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀvíśaḥ ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ cara ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring (libations) to the great (Indra), the giver of great (wealth); offer praise to the wise Indra; fulfiller (ofthe desires) of men, come to the people offering many (oblations).
verses.wilson_translation: Bring (libations) to the great (Indra), the giver of great (wealth); offer praise to the wise Indra; fulfiller (ofthe desires) of men, come to the people offering many (oblations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरुव्यचसे महिने सुवृक्तिमिंद्राय ब्रह्म जनयंत विप्राः ।तस्य व्रतानि न मिनंति धीराः ॥
verses.transliteration: uru-vyácase ǀ mahíne ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ índrāya ǀ bráhma ǀ janayanta ǀ víprāḥ ǀtásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sages engender sacred praise and (sacrificial) food for the wide- pervading, mighty Indra; theprudent impede not his functions.
verses.wilson_translation: The sages engender sacred praise and (sacrificial) food for the wide- pervading, mighty Indra; theprudent impede not his functions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वाणीरनुत्तमन्युमेव सत्रा राजानं दधिरे सहध्यै ।हर्यश्वाय बर्हया समापीन् ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ ánutta-manyum ǀ evá ǀ satrā́ ǀ rā́jānam ǀ dadhire ǀ sáhadhyai ǀhári-aśvāya ǀ barhaya ǀ sám ǀ āpī́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praises truly enable the universal monarch,Indra, whose wrath is irresistible, to overcome (his foes);urge your kinsmen, (worthippers, to glorify) the lord of bay steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Praises truly enable the universal monarch,Indra, whose wrath is irresistible, to overcome (his foes);urge your kinsmen, (worthippers, to glorify) the lord of bay steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: २७ (१-२५)  मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ: , २६ पूर्वार्धर्चस्य शक्तिर्वासिष्ठो वा    (शाट्यायने ब्राह्मणे),२६-२७ शक्तिर्वासिष्ठो वा (ताण्डके ब्राह्मणे) । इन्द्र: । प्रगाथ: – (बृहती , सतोबृहती),३ द्विपदा विराट् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LET none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us.Even from far away come thou unto our feast, or listen if already here. For here, like flies on honey, these who pray to thee sit by the juice that they have poured.Wealth-craving singers have on Indra set their hope, as men set foot upon a car. Longing for wealth I call on him, the Thunderer with the strong right hand,As a son calleth on his sire. These Soma juices, mixed with curd, have been expressed for Indra here.Come with thy Bay Steeds, Thunder-wielder, to our home, to drink them till they make thee glad. May he whose ear is open hear us. He is asked for wealth: will he despise our prayer?Him who bestows at once a hundred thousand gifts none shall restrain when he would give. The hero never checked by men hath gained his strength through Indra, heWho presses out and pours his deep libations forth, O Vṛtra-slayer, unto thee. When thou dost drive the fighting men together be, thou Mighty One, the mighty's shield.May we divide the wealth of him whom thou hast slain: bring us, Unreachable, his goods. For Indra, Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the Soma juice.Make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us. The Giver blesses him who gives. Grudge not, ye Soma pourers; stir you, pay the rites, for wealth, to the great Conqueror.Only the active conquers dwells in peace, and thrives: not for the niggard are the Gods. No one hath overturned or stayed the car of him who freely gives.The man whom Indra and the Marut host defend comes to a stable full of kine. Indra, that man when fighting shall obtain the spoil, whose strong defender thou wilt be.Be thou the gracious helper, Hero I of our cars, be thou the helper of our men. His portion is exceeding great like a victorious soldier's spoil.Him who is Indra, Lord of Bays, no foes subdue. He gives the Soma-pourer strength. Make for the Holy Gods a hymn that is not mean, but well-arranged and fair of form.Even many snares and bonds subdue not him who dwells with Indra through his sacrifice. Indra, what mortal will attack the man who hath his wealth in thee?The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan. In battles with the foe urge on our mighty ones who give the treasures dear to thee,And may we with our princes, Lord of Tawny Steeds! pass through all peril, led by thee. Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the mid-most wealth,Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee. Thou art renowned as giving wealth to every one in all the battles that are fought.Craving protection, all these people of the earth, O Much-invoked, implore thy name. If I, O Indra, were the Lord of riches ample as thine own,I should support the singer, God. who givest wealth! and not abandon him to woe. Each day would I enrich the man who sang my praise, in whatsoever place he were.No kinship is there better, Maghavan, than thine: a father even is no more. With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil.Your Indra, Much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood. A moral wins no riches by unworthy praise: wealth comes not to the niggard churl.Light is the task to give, O Maghavan, to one like me on the decisive day. Like kine unmilked we call aloud, Hero, to thee, and sing thy praise,Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not. None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born.Desiring horses, Indra Maghavan! and kine, as men of might we call on thee. Bring, Indra, the Victorious Ones; bring, elder thou, the younger host.For, Maghavan, thou art rich in treasures from of old, and must be called in every fight. Drive thou away our enemies, O Maghavan: make riches easy to be won.Be thou our good Protector in the strife for spoil: Cherisher of our friends be thou. O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons.Guide us, O Much-invoked, in this our way may we still live and look upon the light. Grant that no mighty foes, unknown, malevolent, unhallowed, tread us to the ground.With thine assistance, Hero, may we ass through all the waters that are rul`ng down.

verses.sanskrit: मो षु त्वा वाघतश्चनारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् ।आरात्ताच्चित्सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि ॥
verses.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ tvā ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ caná ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ ní ǀ rīraman ǀārā́ttāt ǀ cit ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ ihá ǀ vā ǀ sán ǀ úpa ǀ śrudhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not,Indra, (other) worshippers detain you far from us; come from whatever distance to ourassembly; present at this ceremony, hear our (prayers).
verses.wilson_translation: Let not,Indra, (other) worshippers detain you far from us; come from whatever distance to ourassembly; present at this ceremony, hear our (prayers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे हि ते ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा मधौ न म��्ष आसते ।इंद्रे कामं जरितारो वसूयवो रथे न पादमा दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ brahma-kṛ́taḥ ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ mádhau ǀ ná ǀ mákṣaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǀíndre ǀ kā́mam ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ ná ǀ pā́dam ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the libation is effused for you, these offerers of sacrifice swarm like flies around honey; the piouspraisers, desiring riches, fix their hope upon Indra, like a foot upon a chariot.
verses.wilson_translation: When the libation is effused for you, these offerers of sacrifice swarm like flies around honey; the piouspraisers, desiring riches, fix their hope upon Indra, like a foot upon a chariot.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रायस्कामो वज्रहस्तं सुदक्षिणं पुत्रो न पितरं हुवे ॥
verses.transliteration: rāyáḥ-kāmaḥ ǀ vájra-hastam ǀ su-dákṣiṇam ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ pitáram ǀ huve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous of riches, I call upon the benevolent wielder of the thunderbolt, as a son upon a father.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of riches, I call upon the benevolent wielder of the thunderbolt, as a son upon a father.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इम इंद्राय सुन्विरे सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।ताँ आ मदाय वज्रहस्त पीतये हरिभ्यां याह्योक आ ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ índrāya ǀ sunvire ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀtā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ mádāya ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ pītáye ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ yāhi ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These Soma, mixed with curds, are poured out to Indra; come, wielder of the thunderbolt, with yourhorses of our dwelling, to drink there for (your) exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: These Soma, mixed with curds, are poured out to Indra; come, wielder of the thunderbolt, with yourhorses of our dwelling, to drink there for (your) exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रवच्छ्रुत्कर्ण ईयते वसूनां नू चिन्नो मर्धिषद्गिरः ।सद्यश्चिद्यः सहस्राणि शता ददन्नकिर्दित्संतमा मिनत् ॥
verses.transliteration: śrávat ǀ śrút-karṇaḥ ǀ īyate ǀ vásūnām ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ mardhiṣat ǀ gíraḥ ǀsadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ satā́ ǀ dádat ǀ nákiḥ ǀ dítsantam ǀ ā́ ǀ minat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra, whose ear is ready to hear, listen to the suppliant for riches, and never disappoint ourprayers; he who is the giver of hundreds and thousands; may no one ever hinder him when willing to give.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, whose ear is ready to hear, listen to the suppliant for riches, and never disappoint ourprayers; he who is the giver of hundreds and thousands; may no one ever hinder him when willing to give.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वीरो अप्रतिष्कुत इंद्रेण शूशुवे नृभिः ।यस्ते गभीरा सवनानि वृत्रहन्त्सुनोत्या च धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ śūśuve ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ te ǀ gabhīrā́ ǀ sávanāni ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ sunóti ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhā́vati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, the hero who offers sacrifices to you, who eagerly approaches you (with praises), he,(protected) by Indra, is unresisted (by anyone), and is honoured by men.
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, the hero who offers sacrifices to you, who eagerly approaches you (with praises), he,(protected) by Indra, is unresisted (by anyone), and is honoured by men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भवा वरूथं मघवन्मघोनां यत्समजासि शर्धतः ।वि त्वाहतस्य वेदनं भजेमह्या दूणाशो भरा गयं ॥
verses.transliteration: bháva ǀ várūtham ǀ magha-van ǀ maghónām ǀ yát ǀ sam-ájāsi ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀví ǀ tvā́-hatasya ǀ védanam ǀ bhajemahi ǀ ā́ ǀ duḥ-náśaḥ ǀ bhara ǀ gáyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be a defence,Maghavan, to the wealthy (offerers in oblations), for you are the discomfiter of (our)adversaries; may we divide the spoil of the enemy slain by you, who are indestructible, bring it to our dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: Be a defence,Maghavan, to the wealthy (offerers in oblations), for you are the discomfiter of (our)adversaries; may we divide the spoil of the enemy slain by you, who are indestructible, bring it to our dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुनोता सोमपाव्ने सोममिंद्राय वज्रिणे ।पचता पक्तीरवसे कृणुध्वमित्पृणन्नित्पृणते मयः ॥
verses.transliteration: sunóta ǀ soma-pā́vne ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀpácata ǀ paktī́ḥ ǀ ávase ǀ kṛṇudhvám ǀ ít ǀ pṛṇán ǀ ít ǀ pṛṇaté ǀ máyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour out the libation to Indra, the thunderer, the drinker of the Soma; prepare the baked (cakes) tosatisfy him; do (what is agreeable to him), for he bestows happiness on (the worshipper) who plural ases them.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour out the libation to Indra, the thunderer, the drinker of the Soma; prepare the baked (cakes) tosatisfy him; do (what is agreeable to him), for he bestows happiness on (the worshipper) who plural ases them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा स्रेधत सोमिनो दक्षता महे कृणुध्वं राय आतुजे ।तरणिरिज्जयति क्षेति पुष्यति न देवासः कवत्नवे ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ sredhata ǀ sominaḥ ǀ dákṣata ǀ mahé ǀ kṛṇudhvám ǀ rāyé ǀ ā-túje ǀtaráṇiḥ ǀ ít ǀ jayati ǀ kṣéti ǀ púṣyati ǀ ná ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ kavatnáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offerers of the libation, do not hesitate; be active; sacrifice to the mighty benefactor for the sake ofriches; the assiduous worshipper conquers (his enemies), dwells in a habitation, and prospers; the gods favournot the imperfect rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Offerers of the libation, do not hesitate; be active; sacrifice to the mighty benefactor for the sake ofriches; the assiduous worshipper conquers (his enemies), dwells in a habitation, and prospers; the gods favournot the imperfect rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकिः सुदासो रथं पर्यास न रीरमत् ।इंद्रो यस्याविता यस्य मरुतो गमत्स गोमति व्रजे ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ su-dā́saḥ ǀ rátham ǀ pári ǀ āsa ǀ ná ǀ rīramat ǀíndraḥ ǀ yásya ǀ avitā́ ǀ yásya ǀ marútaḥ ǀ gámat ǀ sáḥ ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǁ
verses.english_translation: No one overturns, no one arrests the chariot of the liberal sacrificer; he, of whom Indrais the protector,of whom the Maruts(are the defenders), will walk in pastures filled with cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: No one overturns, no one arrests the chariot of the liberal sacrificer; he, of whom Indrais the protector,of whom the Maruts(are the defenders), will walk in pastures filled with cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गमद्वाजं वाजयन्निंद्र मर्त्यो यस्य त्वमविता भुवः ।अस्माकं बोध्यविता रथानामस्माकं शूर नृणां ॥
verses.transliteration: gámat ǀ vā́jam ǀ vājáyan ǀ indra ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ tvám ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ avitā́ ǀ ráthānām ǀ asmā́kam ǀ śūra ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the man of whom you,Indra, are the protector, invigorating (you with praise), enjoy (abundant) food;be the preserver, hero, of our chariots, (the preserver) of our people.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the man of whom you,Indra, are the protector, invigorating (you with praise), enjoy (abundant) food;be the preserver, hero, of our chariots, (the preserver) of our people.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदिन्न्वस्य रिच्यतेऽंशो धनं न जिग्युषः ।य इंद्रो हरिवान्न दभंति तं रिपो दक्षं दधाति सोमिनि ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ ricyate ǀ áṃśaḥ ǀ dhánam ǀ ná ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ hári-vān ǀ ná ǀ dabhanti ǀ tám ǀ rípaḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ dadhāti ǀ somíni ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily (Indra's) share (of the Soma) exceeds (that of other deities) like the wealth of the victorious;enemies overcome not him, who is the lord of bay steeds, who gives strength to the offerer of the libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily (Indra's) share (of the Soma) exceeds (that of other deities) like the wealth of the victorious;enemies overcome not him, who is the lord of bay steeds, who gives strength to the offerer of the libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मंत्रमखर्वं सुधितं सुपेशसं दधात यज्ञियेष्वा ।पूर्वीश्चन प्रसितयस्तरंति तं य इंद्रे कर्मणा भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mántram ǀ ákharvam ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ su-péśasam ǀ dádhāta ǀ yajñíyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ caná ǀ prá-sitayaḥ ǀ taranti ǀ tám ǀ yáḥ ǀ índre ǀ kármaṇā ǀ bhúvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Address (to Indra), among the gods, the ample, well-uttered, and graceful prayer; many bonds entanglenot him who, by his devotion, abides in Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Address (to Indra), among the gods, the ample, well-uttered, and graceful prayer; many bonds entanglenot him who, by his devotion, abides in Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कस्तमिंद्र त्वावसुमा मर्त्यो दधर्षति ।श्रद्धा इत्ते मघवन्पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति ॥
verses.transliteration: káḥ ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ tvā́-vasum ǀ ā́ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ dadharṣati ǀśraddhā́ ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ pā́rye ǀ diví ǀ vājī́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sisāsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: What mortal,Indra, injures him who has you for his support? He who offers you (sacrificial) food,Maghavan, with faith, he obtains food on the day of the libation.
verses.wilson_translation: What mortal,Indra, injures him who has you for his support? He who offers you (sacrificial) food,Maghavan, with faith, he obtains food on the day of the libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मघोनः स्म वृत्रहत्येषु चोदय ये ददति प्रिया वसु ।तव प्रणीती हर्यश्व सूरिभिर्विश्वा तरेम दुरिता ॥
verses.transliteration: maghónaḥ ǀ sma ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ codaya ǀ yé ǀ dádati ǀ priyā́ ǀ vásu ǀtáva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ hari-aśva ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ tarema ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Animate (those men) for the destruction of their foes, who offer treasures which are dear to you, theabounder in wealth; may we, lord of bay steeds, along with (your) worshippers, pass over all difficulties by yourguidance.
verses.wilson_translation: Animate (those men) for the destruction of their foes, who offer treasures which are dear to you, theabounder in wealth; may we, lord of bay steeds, along with (your) worshippers, pass over all difficulties by yourguidance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवेदिंद्रावमं वसु त्वं पुष्यसि मध्यमं ।सत्रा विश्वस्य परमस्य राजसि नकिष्ट्वा गोषु वृण्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ avamám ǀ vásu ǀ tvám ǀ puṣyasi ǀ madhyamám ǀsatrā́ ǀ víśvasya ǀ paramásya ǀ rājasi ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ góṣu ǀ vṛṇvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yours,Indra, is the vast valuable wealth; you cherish the middling; you rule over all that which is themost precious; no one opposes you in (the recovering of the) cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Yours,Indra, is the vast valuable wealth; you cherish the middling; you rule over all that which is themost precious; no one opposes you in (the recovering of the) cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वस्य धनदा असि श्रुतो य ईं भवंत्याजयः ।तवायं विश्वः पुरुहूत पार्थिवोऽवस्युर्नाम भिक्षते ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ víśvasya ǀ dhana-dā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ yé ǀ īm ǀ bhávanti ǀ ājáyaḥ ǀtáva ǀ ayám ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ pā́rthivaḥ ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ bhikṣate ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are celebrated as the giver of wealth to all even where battles occur; all the people of theearth--desirous of protection, solicit you, the invoked of many.
verses.wilson_translation: You are celebrated as the giver of wealth to all even where battles occur; all the people of theearth--desirous of protection, solicit you, the invoked of many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदिंद्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय ।स्तोतारमिद्दिधिषेय रदावसो न पापत्वाय रासीय ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ yā́vataḥ ǀ tvám ǀ etā́vat ǀ ahám ǀ ī́śīya ǀstotā́ram ǀ ít ǀ didhiṣeya ǀ radavaso íti rada-vaso ǀ ná ǀ pāpa-tvā́ya ǀ rāsīya ǁ
verses.english_translation: If I were lord of as much (affluence) as you are,Indra, then might I support (your) worshippers,dispenser of wealth, and not squander it upon wickedness.
verses.wilson_translation: If I were lord of as much (affluence) as you are,Indra, then might I support (your) worshippers,dispenser of wealth, and not squander it upon wickedness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षेयमिन्महयते दिवेदिवे राय आ कुहचिद्विदे ।नहि त्वदन्यन्मघवन्न आप्यं वस्यो अस्ति पिता चन ॥
verses.transliteration: śíkṣeyam ǀ ít ǀ maha-yaté ǀ divé-dive ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kuhacit-víde ǀnáhí ǀ tvát ǀ anyát ǀ magha-van ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ pitā́ ǀ caná ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I daily distribute wealth to the venerable wherever abiding; no other,Maghavan, than you is to besought by us; (no other is to us) a most excellent protector.
verses.wilson_translation: May I daily distribute wealth to the venerable wherever abiding; no other,Maghavan, than you is to besought by us; (no other is to us) a most excellent protector.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरंध्या युजा ।आ व इंद्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्र्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: taráṇiḥ ǀ ít ǀ sisāsati ǀ vā́jam ǀ púram-dhyā ǀ yujā́ ǀā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ name ǀ girā́ ǀ nemím ǀ táṣṭā-iva ǀ su-drvám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The prompt offers (of praise), with solemn rites combined, acquires food; I bend down with adoration toyou,Indra, the invoker of many, as a carpenter bends the wooden circumference of the wheel.
verses.wilson_translation: The prompt offers (of praise), with solemn rites combined, acquires food; I bend down with adoration toyou,Indra, the invoker of many, as a carpenter bends the wooden circumference of the wheel.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न दुष्टुती मर्त्यो विंदते वसु न स्रेधंतं रयिर्नशत् ।सुशक्तिरिन्मघवंतुभ्यं मावते देष्णं यत्पार्ये दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ duḥ-stutī́ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ vindate ǀ vásu ǀ ná ǀ srédhantam ǀ rayíḥ ǀ naśat ǀsu-śáktiḥ ǀ ít ǀ magha-van ǀ túbhyam ǀ mā́-vate ǀ deṣṇám ǀ yát ǀ pā́rye ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: A man acquires not wealth by unbecoming praise; affluence devolves not upon one obstructing(sacrifice) in you,Maghavan, is the power whereby bounty (may be shown) to such as I am on the day of libation.
verses.wilson_translation: A man acquires not wealth by unbecoming praise; affluence devolves not upon one obstructing(sacrifice) in you,Maghavan, is the power whereby bounty (may be shown) to such as I am on the day of libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः ।ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिंद्र तस्थुषः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ śūra ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ ádugdhāḥ-iva ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀī́śānam ǀ asyá ǀ jágataḥ ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śam ǀ ī́śānam ǀ indra ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We glorify you, hero, (Indra), the lord of all movable and stationary things, the beholder of the universe,with ladles filled (with Soma, like (the udders of) unmilked kine.
verses.wilson_translation: We glorify you, hero, (Indra), the lord of all movable and stationary things, the beholder of the universe,with ladles filled (with Soma, like (the udders of) unmilked kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न त्वावाँ अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते ।अश्वायंतो मघवन्निंद्र वाजिनो गव्यंतस्त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ anyáḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pā́rthivaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ná ǀ janiṣyate ǀaśva-yántaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ gavyántaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: No other such as you are, celestial or terrestrial, has been or will be born; desirous of horses, of food,of cattle affluent Indra, we invoke you.
verses.wilson_translation: No other such as you are, celestial or terrestrial, has been or will be born; desirous of horses, of food,of cattle affluent Indra, we invoke you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभी षतस्तदा भरेंद्र ज्यायः कनीयसः ।पुरूवसुर्हि मघवन्त्सनादसि भरेभरे च हव्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ satáḥ ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ índra ǀ jyā́yaḥ ǀ kánīyasaḥ ǀpuru-vásuḥ ǀ hí ǀ magha-van ǀ sanā́t ǀ ási ǀ bháre-bhare ǀ ca ǀ hávyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Elder Indra, bring that (wealth to me), being the junior, for,Maghavan, you have from the beginningbeen possessed of infinite treasure, and are to be adored at repeated sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Elder Indra, bring that (wealth to me), being the junior, for,Maghavan, you have from the beginningbeen possessed of infinite treasure, and are to be adored at repeated sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परा णुदस्व मघवन्नमित्रान्त्सुवेदा नो वसू कृधि ।अस्माकं बोध्यविता महाधने भवा वृधः सखीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: párā ǀ nudasva ǀ magha-van ǀ amítrān ǀ su-védā ǀ naḥ ǀ vásu ǀ kṛdhi ǀasmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ avitā́ ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ bháva ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ sákhīnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drive away,Maghavan, our enemies; render riches easy of acquisition; be our preserver in war; be theaugmenter of (the prosperity) of (your) friends.
verses.wilson_translation: Drive away,Maghavan, our enemies; render riches easy of acquisition; be our preserver in war; be theaugmenter of (the prosperity) of (your) friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा ।शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ krátum ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ pitā́ ǀ putrébhyaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀśíkṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ asmín ǀ puru-hūta ǀ yā́mani ǀ jīvā́ḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ aśīmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to us,Indra, wisdom, as a father (gives knowledge) to his sons; bestow wealth upon us on thisoccasion, you the invoked of many, so that we, living at the solemnity may (long) enjoy the light (of existence).
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to us,Indra, wisdom, as a father (gives knowledge) to his sons; bestow wealth upon us on thisoccasion, you the invoked of many, so that we, living at the solemnity may (long) enjoy the light (of existence).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो माशिवासो अव क्रमुः ।त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपोऽति शूर तरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ájñātāḥ ǀ vṛjánāḥ ǀ duḥ-ādhyáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áśivāsaḥ ǀ áva ǀ kramuḥ ǀtváyā ǀ vayám ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ śáśvatīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ áti ǀ śūra ǀ tarāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let no unknown, wicked, malevolent, malignant (enemies) overpower us; may we, protected by you,cross over many waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Let no unknown, wicked, malevolent, malignant (enemies) overpower us; may we, protected by you,cross over many waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIII Vasiṣṭha.
hymns.anukramani: १४ (१-९)  मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ: , १०–१४ वसिष्ठपुत्रा:। १-९ वसिष्ठपुत्रा: इन्द्रो वा ; १० – १४ वसिष्ठ : । त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THESE who wear hair-knots on the right, the movers of holy thought, white-robed, have won me over.I warned the men, when from the grass I raised me, Not from afar can my Vasisthas help you. WithSomathey brought Indra from a distance, Over Vaisanta, from the strong libation.Indra preferred Vasisthas to the Soma pressed by the son of Vayata, Pasadyumna. So, verily, with these he crossed the river, in company with these he slaughtered Bheda.So in the fight with the Ten Kings, Vasisthas! did Indra help Sudās through your devotions. I gladly, men I with prayer prayed by our fathers have fixed your axle: ye shall not be injured:Since, when ye sang aloud the Sakvari verses, Vasisthas! ye invigorated Indra. Like thirsty men they looked to heaven, in battle with the Ten Kings, surrounded and imploring.Then Indra heard Vasiṣṭha as he praised him, and gave the Trtsus ample room and freedom. Like sticks and staves wherewith they drive the cattle, Stripped bare, the Bharatas were found defenceless:Vasiṣṭha then became their chief and leader: then widely. were the Trtsus' clans extended. Three fertilize the worlds with genial moisture: three noble Creatures cast a light before them.Three that give warmth to all attend the morning. All these have they discovered, these Vasisthas. Like the Sun's growing glory is their splendour, and like the sea's is their unflathomed greatness.Their course is like the wind's. Your laud, Vasisthas, can never be attained by any other. They with perceptions of the heart in secret resort to that which spreads a thousand branches.The Apsaras brought hither the Vasisthas wearing the vesture spun for them by Yama. A form of lustre springing from the lightning wast thou, when Varuṇa and Mitra saw thee.Tliy one and only birth was then, Vasiṣṭha, when from thy stock Agastya brought thee hither. Born of their love for Urvasi, Vasiṣṭha thou, priest, art son of Varuṇa and Mitra;And as a fallen drop, in heavenly fervour, all the Gods laid thee on a lotus-blossorn. He thinker, knower both of earth and heaven, endowed with many a gift, bestowing thousands,Destined to wear the vesture spun by Yama, sprang from the Apsaras to life, Vasiṣṭha. Born at the sacrifice, urged by adorations, both with a common flow bedewed the pitcher.Then from the midst thereof there rose up Māna, and thence they say was born the sage Vasiṣṭha. He brings the bearer of the laud and Sāman: first shall he speak bringing the stone for pressing.With grateful hearts in reverence approach him: to you, O Pratrdas, Vasiṣṭha cometh.

verses.sanskrit: श्वित्यंचो मा दक्षिणतस्कपर्दा धियंजिन्वासो अभि हि प्रमंदुः ।उत्तिष्ठन्वोचे परि बर्हिषो नॄन्न मे दूरादवितवे वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śvityáñcaḥ ǀ mā ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ-kapardāḥ ǀ dhiyam-jinvā́saḥ ǀ abhí ǀ hí ǀ pra-mandúḥ ǀut-tíṣṭhan ǀ voce ǀ pári ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ná ǀ me ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ávitave ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The white-complexioned accomplishers of holy ceremonies, wearing the lock of hair on the right side,have afforded me delight, when, rising up I call the leaders (of rites) to the sacred grass; the Vasiṣṭhas, (mysons) should never be far from me.
verses.wilson_translation: The white-complexioned accomplishers of holy ceremonies, wearing the lock of hair on the right side,have afforded me delight, when, rising up I call the leaders (of rites) to the sacred grass; the Vasiṣṭhas, (mysons) should never be far from me.
