verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दूरादिंद्रमनयन्ना सुतेन तिरो वैशंतमति पांतमुग्रं ।पाशद्युम्नस्य वायतस्य सोमात्सुतादिंद्रोऽवृणीता वसिष्ठान् ॥
verses.transliteration: dūrā́t ǀ índram ǀ anayan ǀ ā́ ǀ suténa ǀ tiráḥ ǀ vaiśantám ǀ áti ǀ pā́ntam ǀ ugrám ǀpā́śa-dyumnasya ǀ vāyatásya ǀ sómāt ǀ sutā́t ǀ índraḥ ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ vásiṣṭhān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Disgracing (Pāśadyumna), they brought from afar the fierce Indra, when drinking the ladle of Somaathissacrifice, to (receive) the libation (of Sudāsa); Indra hastened from the effused Soma of Pāśadumna, theson of Vāyata, to the Vasiṣṭhas.
verses.wilson_translation: Disgracing (Pāśadyumna), they brought from afar the fierce Indra, when drinking the ladle of Somaathissacrifice, to (receive) the libation (of Sudāsa); Indra hastened from the effused Soma of Pāśadumna, theson of Vāyata, to the Vasiṣṭhas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवेन्नु कं सिंधुमेभिस्ततारेवेन्नु कं भेदमेभिर्जघान ।एवेन्नु कं दाशराज्ञे सुदासं प्रावदिंद्रो ब्रह्मणा वो वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ síndhum ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ tatāra ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ bhedám ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ jaghāna ǀevá ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ dāśa-rājñé ǀ su-dā́sam ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ índraḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vaḥ ǀ vasiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: In the same manner was he, (Sudāsa) enabled by them easily to cross the Sindhuriver; in the samemanner, through them he easily slew his foe; so in like manner,Vasiṣṭhas, through your prayers, did Indradefend Sudāsa in the war with the ten kings.
verses.wilson_translation: In the same manner was he, (Sudāsa) enabled by them easily to cross the Sindhuriver; in the samemanner, through them he easily slew his foe; so in like manner,Vasiṣṭhas, through your prayers, did Indradefend Sudāsa in the war with the ten kings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुष्टी नरो ब्रह्मणा वः पितॄणामक्षमव्ययं न किला रिषाथ ।यच्छक्वरीषु बृहता रवेणेंद्रे शुष्ममदधाता वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.transliteration: júṣṭī ǀ naraḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vaḥ ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀ ákṣam ǀ avyayam ǀ ná ǀ kíla ǀ riṣātha ǀyát ǀ śákvarīṣu ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ráveṇa ǀ índre ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ádadhāta ǀ vasiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By your prayers, leaders (of rites), is effected the gratificcation of your progenitors; I have set in motionthe axle (of the chariot); be no you intert, for by your sacred metres,Vasiṣṭhas, (chanted) with a loud voice, yousustain vigour in Inda.
verses.wilson_translation: By your prayers, leaders (of rites), is effected the gratificcation of your progenitors; I have set in motionthe axle (of the chariot); be no you intert, for by your sacred metres,Vasiṣṭhas, (chanted) with a loud voice, yousustain vigour in Inda.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उद्द्यामिवेत्तृष्णजो नाथितासोऽदीधयुर्दाशराज्ञे वृतासः ।वसिष्ठस्य स्तुवत इंद्रो अश्रोदुरुं तृत्सुभ्यो अकृणोदु लोकं ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ dyā́m-iva ǀ ít ǀ tṛṣṇá-jaḥ ǀ nāthitā́saḥ ǀ ádīdhayuḥ ǀ dāśa-rājñé ǀ vṛtā́saḥ ǀvásiṣṭhasya ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ aśrot ǀ urúm ǀ tṛ́tsu-bhyaḥ ǀ akṛṇot ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Suffering from thirst, soliciting (rain), supported (by the Tṛtsus) in the war with the tenrājās, (the Vasiṣṭhas) made Indraradiant as the sun; Indra heard (the praises) of Vasiṣṭhaglorifying him, and bestowed aspacious region on the Tṛtsus.
verses.wilson_translation: Suffering from thirst, soliciting (rain), supported (by the Tṛtsus) in the war with the tenrājās, (the Vasiṣṭhas) made Indraradiant as the sun; Indra heard (the praises) of Vasiṣṭhaglorifying him, and bestowed aspacious region on the Tṛtsus.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दंडा इवेद्गोअजनास आसन्परिच्छिन्ना भरता अर्भकासः ।अभवच्च पुरएता वसिष्ठ आदित्तृत्सूनां विशो अप्रथंत ॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍā́ḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ go-ájanāsaḥ ǀ āsan ǀ pári-chinnāḥ ǀ bharatā́ḥ ǀ arbhakā́saḥ ǀábhavat ǀ ca ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ tṛ́tsūnām ǀ víśaḥ ǀ aprathanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Bharatas, inferior (to their foes), were shorn (of their possessions), like he staves for driving cattle,(stripped of their leaves and branches); but Vasiṣṭhabecame their family priest, and the people of the Tṛtsusprospered.
verses.wilson_translation: The Bharatas, inferior (to their foes), were shorn (of their possessions), like he staves for driving cattle,(stripped of their leaves and branches); but Vasiṣṭhabecame their family priest, and the people of the Tṛtsusprospered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रयः कृण्वंति भुवनेषु रेतस्तिस्रः प्रजा आर्या ज्योतिरग्राः ।त्रयो घर्मास उषसं सचंते सर्वाँ इत्ताँ अनु विदुर्वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tráyaḥ ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ bhúvaneṣu ǀ rétaḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ ā́ryāḥ ǀ jyótiḥ-agrāḥ ǀtráyaḥ ǀ gharmā́saḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ sacante ǀ sárvān ǀ ít ǀ tā́n ǀ ánu ǀ viduḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Three shed moisture upon the regions, three are their glorious progeny, of which the chief is night;three communicators of warmth accompany the dawn; verily the Vasiṣṭhasunderstand all these.
verses.wilson_translation: Three shed moisture upon the regions, three are their glorious progeny, of which the chief is night;three communicators of warmth accompany the dawn; verily the Vasiṣṭhasunderstand all these.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यस्येव वक्षथो ज्योतिरेषां समुद्रस्येव महिमा गभीरः ।वातस्येव प्रजवो नान्येन स्तोमो वसिष्ठा अन्वेतवे वः ॥
verses.transliteration: sū́ryasya-iva ǀ vakṣáthaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ samudrásya-iva ǀ mahimā́ ǀ gabhīráḥ ǀvā́tasya-iva ǀ pra-javáḥ ǀ ná ǀ anyéna ǀ stómaḥ ǀ vasiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ánu-etave ǀ vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The glory of these Vasi.ṣṭhas is like the splendour of the sun; their greatness as profound as (thedepth of) the ocean; your praise,Vasiṣṭhas, has the velocity of the wind; by no other can it be surpassed.
verses.wilson_translation: The glory of these Vasi.ṣṭhas is like the splendour of the sun; their greatness as profound as (thedepth of) the ocean; your praise,Vasiṣṭhas, has the velocity of the wind; by no other can it be surpassed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त इन्निण्यं हृदयस्य प्रकेतैः सहस्रवल्शमभि सं चरंति ।यमेन ततं परिधिं वयंतोऽप्सरस उप सेदुर्वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ ít ǀ niṇyám ǀ hṛ́dayasya ǀ pra-ketáiḥ ǀ sahásra-valśam ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ caranti ǀyaména ǀ tatám ǀ pari-dhím ǀ váyantaḥ ǀ apsarásaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ seduḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By the wisdom seated in the heart the Vasiṣṭhastraverse the hidden thousand branched world, andthe Apsarasassit down wearing the vesture spread out by Yama.
verses.wilson_translation: By the wisdom seated in the heart the Vasiṣṭhastraverse the hidden thousand branched world, andthe Apsarasassit down wearing the vesture spread out by Yama.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्युतो ज्योतिः परि संजिहानं मित्रावरुणा यदपश्यतां त्वा ।तत्ते जन्मोतैकं वसिष्ठागस्त्यो यत्त्वा विश आजभार ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-dyútaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ pári ǀ sam-jíhānam ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ yát ǀ ápaśyatām ǀ tvā ǀtát ǀ te ǀ jánma ǀ utá ǀ ékam ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀ agástyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ viśáḥ ǀ ā-jabhā́ra ǁ
verses.english_translation: When Mitraand Varuṇabeheld you,Vasiṣṭha, quitting the lustre of the lightning (for a different form),then one of your births (took plural ce), inasmuch as Agastyabore you from your (former) abode.
verses.wilson_translation: When Mitraand Varuṇabeheld you,Vasiṣṭha, quitting the lustre of the lightning (for a different form),then one of your births (took plural ce), inasmuch as Agastyabore you from your (former) abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतासि मैत्रावरुणो वसिष्ठोर्वश्या ब्रह्मन्मनसोऽधि जातः ।द्रप्सं स्कन्नं ब्रह्मणा दैव्येन विश्वे देवाः पुष्करे त्वाददंत ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ asi ǀ maitrāvaruṇáḥ ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀ urváśyāḥ ǀ brahman ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ jātáḥ ǀdrapsám ǀ skannám ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ dáivyena ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ púṣkare ǀ tvā ǀ adadanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily,Vasiṣṭhayou are the son of Mitraand Varuṇa, born,Brahmā, of the will of Urvaśī, after theseminal effusion; all the gods have sustained you, (endowed) with celestial and Vedic vigour in the lake.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily,Vasiṣṭhayou are the son of Mitraand Varuṇa, born,Brahmā, of the will of Urvaśī, after theseminal effusion; all the gods have sustained you, (endowed) with celestial and Vedic vigour in the lake.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स प्रकेत उभयस्य प्रविद्वान्त्सहस्रदान उत वा सदानः ।यमेन ततं परिधिं वयिष्यन्नप्सरसः परि जज्ञे वसिष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ pra-vidvā́n ǀ sahásra-dānaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ sá-dānaḥ ǀyaména ǀ tatám ǀ pari-dhím ǀ vayiṣyán ǀ apsarásaḥ ǀ pári ǀ jajñe ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the sage, cognizant of both worlds, was the donor of thousands; he was verily donation; wearingthe vesture spread spread by Yama,Vasiṣṭhawas born of the Apsaras.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the sage, cognizant of both worlds, was the donor of thousands; he was verily donation; wearingthe vesture spread spread by Yama,Vasiṣṭhawas born of the Apsaras.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्रे ह जाताविषिता नमोभिः कुंभे रेतः सिषिचतुः समानं ।ततो ह मान उदियाय मध्यात्ततो जातमृषिमाहुर्वसिष्ठं ॥
verses.transliteration: satré ǀ ha ǀ jātáu ǀ iṣitā́ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ kumbhé ǀ rétaḥ ǀ sisicatuḥ ǀ samānám ǀtátaḥ ǀ ha ǀ mā́naḥ ǀ út ǀ iyāya ǀ mádhyāt ǀ tátaḥ ǀ jātám ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ āhuḥ ǀ vásiṣṭham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Consecrated for the sacrifice, propitiated by praises, they,Mitraand Varuṇa, poured a commoneffusion into the water-jar, from the midst of which Mānaarose, and from which also, they say,Vasiṣṭhawasborn.
verses.wilson_translation: Consecrated for the sacrifice, propitiated by praises, they,Mitraand Varuṇa, poured a commoneffusion into the water-jar, from the midst of which Mānaarose, and from which also, they say,Vasiṣṭhawasborn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उक्थभृतं सामभृतं बिभर्ति ग्रावाणं बिभ्रत्प्र वदात्यग्रे ।उपैनमाध्वं सुमनस्यमाना आ वो गच्छाति प्रतृदो वसिष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration: uktha-bhṛ́tam ǀ sāma-bhṛ́tam ǀ bibharti ǀ grā́vāṇam ǀ bíbhrat ǀ prá ǀ vadāti ǀ ágre ǀúpa ǀ enam ǀ ādhvam ǀ su-manasyámānāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ gacchāti ǀ pra-tṛdaḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pratṛts,Agastyacomes to you; welcome him with devoted minds, and he in the foremost station directsthe reciter of the prayer, the chanter of the hymn, the grinder of the stone, and repeats (what is to be repeated).
verses.wilson_translation: Pratṛts,Agastyacomes to you; welcome him with devoted minds, and he in the foremost station directsthe reciter of the prayer, the chanter of the hymn, the grinder of the stone, and repeats (what is to be repeated).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIV Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: २५ मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ:।विश्वे देवा:, १६ अहि:, १७ अहिर्बुध्न्य:।द्विपदा विराट् ,२२-२५ त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY our divine and brilliant hymn go forth, like a swift chariot wrought and fashioned well. The waters listen as they flow along: they know the origin of heaven and earth. Yea, the broad waters swell their flood ior him: of him strong heroes think amid their foes. Set ye for him the coursers to the pole: like Indra Thunderer is the Golden-armed. Arouse you, like the days, to sacrifice speed gladly like a traveller on the way. Go swift to battles, to the sacrifice: set up a flag, a hero for the folk. Up from his strength hath risen as ’twere a light: it bears the load as earth bears living things. Agni, no demon I invoke the Gods: by law completing it, I form a hymn. Closely albout you lay your heavenly song, and send your voice to where the Gods abide. Varuṇa, Mighty, with a thousand eyes, beholds the paths wherein these rivers run. He, King of kings, the glory of the floods, o’er all that liveth hath resistless sway. May he assist us among all the tribes, and make the envier's praise devoid of light. May the foes' threatening arrow pass us by: may he put far from us our bodies' sin. Agni, oblation-cater, through our prayers aid us: to him our dearest laud is brought. Accordant with the Gods choose for our Friend the Waters’ Child: may he be good to us. With lauds I sing the Dragon born of floods: he sits beneath the streams in middle air. Ne’er may the Dragon of the Deep harm us: ne’er fail this faithful servant's sacrifice. To these our heroes may they grant renown: may pious men march boldly on to wealth. Leading great hosts, with fierce attacks of these, they burn their foes as the Sun burns the earth. What time our wives draw near to us, may he, left-handed Tvaṣṭar, give us hero sons. May Tvaṣṭar find our hymn acceptable, and may Aramati, seeking wealth, be ours. May they who lavish gifts bestow those treasures: may Rodasī and Varuṇānī listen.May he, with the Varūtrīs, be our refuge, may bountiful Tvaṣṭar give us store of riches. So may rich Mountains and the liberal Waters, so may all Herbs that grow on ground, and Heaven,And Earth accordant with the Forest-Sovrans, and both the World-halves round about protect us. To this may both the wide Worlds lend approval, and Varuṇa in heaven, whose Friend is Indra.May all the Maruts give consent, the Victors, that we may hold great wealth in firm possession. May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Agni, Waters, Herbs, Trees accept the praise we offer.May we find refuge in the Marut's bosom. Protect us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्र शुक्रैतु देवी मनीषा अस्मत्सुतष्टो रथो न वाजी ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ śukrā́ ǀ etu ǀ devī́ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ asmát ǀ sú-taṣṭaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May pure and divine praise proceed from us (to the gods) like a swift well-constructed chariot.
verses.wilson_translation: May pure and divine praise proceed from us (to the gods) like a swift well-constructed chariot.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विदुः पृथिव्या दिवो जनित्रं शृण्वंत्यापो अध क्षरंतीः ॥
verses.transliteration: vidúḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ janítram ǀ śṛṇvánti ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ádha ǀ kṣárantīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The flowing waters having known the origin of earth and heaven; may they now hear (our praises).
verses.wilson_translation: The flowing waters having known the origin of earth and heaven; may they now hear (our praises).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आपश्चिदस्मै पिन्वंत पृथ्वीर्वृत्रेषु शूरा मंसंत उग्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ pínvanta ǀ pṛthvī́ḥ ǀ vṛtréṣu ǀ śū́rāḥ ǀ máṃsante ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vast waters offer nourishment to Indra; fierce warriors (combating) with foes, glorify him.
verses.wilson_translation: The vast waters offer nourishment to Indra; fierce warriors (combating) with foes, glorify him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ धूर्ष्वस्मै दधाताश्वानिंद्रो न वज्री हिरण्यबाहुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ asmai ǀ dádhāta ǀ áśvān ǀ índraḥ ǀ ná ǀ vajrī́ ǀ híraṇya-bāhuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yoke for him the horses of his chariot, the Indrais the wielder of the thunderbolt, the golden-armed.
verses.wilson_translation: Yoke for him the horses of his chariot, the Indrais the wielder of the thunderbolt, the golden-armed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र स्थाताहेव यज्ञं यातेव पत्मंत्मना हिनोत ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ prá ǀ sthāta ǀ áha-iva ǀ yajñám ǀ yā́tā-iva ǀ pátman ǀ tmánā ǀ hinota ǁ
verses.english_translation: Proceed to the sacrifice like one who goes along the road; proceed of your own accord.
verses.wilson_translation: Proceed to the sacrifice like one who goes along the road; proceed of your own accord.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्मना समत्सु हिनोत यज्ञं दधात केतुं जनाय वीरं ॥
verses.transliteration: tmánā ǀ samát-su ǀ hinóta ǀ yajñám ǀ dádhāta ǀ ketúm ǀ jánāya ǀ vīrám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Go of your own accord to battle; celebrate the significant and expiatory sacrifice for (the good of)mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: Go of your own accord to battle; celebrate the significant and expiatory sacrifice for (the good of)mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदस्य शुष्माद्भानुर्नार्त बिभर्ति भारं पृथिवी न भूम ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ asya ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ārta ǀ bíbharti ǀ bhārám ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
verses.english_translation: From the force of this (sacrifice) the sun rises; it sustains the burden (of the world) as (earth) supportsmany (beings).
verses.wilson_translation: From the force of this (sacrifice) the sun rises; it sustains the burden (of the world) as (earth) supportsmany (beings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ह्वयामि देवाँ अयातुरग्ने साधन्नृतेन धियं दधामि ॥
verses.transliteration: hváyāmi ǀ devā́n ǀ áyātuḥ ǀ agne ǀ sā́dhan ǀ ṛténa ǀ dhíyam ǀ dadhāmi ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke the gods,Agni, propitiating them by an inoffensive rite, I celebrate a pious act.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke the gods,Agni, propitiating them by an inoffensive rite, I celebrate a pious act.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वो देवीं धियं दधिध्वं प्र वो देवत्रा वाचं कृणुध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ dadhidhvam ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ vā́cam ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer (worshippers) your heavenly worship; earnestly address your praises to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer (worshippers) your heavenly worship; earnestly address your praises to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ चष्ट आसां पाथो नदीनां वरुण उग्रः सहस्रचक्षाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ caṣṭe ǀ āsām ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ nadī́nām ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ sahásra-cakṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fierce Varuṇa, the thousand-eyed, contemplates the water of these rivers.
verses.wilson_translation: The fierce Varuṇa, the thousand-eyed, contemplates the water of these rivers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: राजा राष्ट्रानां पेशो नदीनामनुत्तमस्मै क्षत्रं विश्वायु ॥
verses.transliteration: rā́jā ǀ rāṣṭrā́nām ǀ péśaḥ ǀ nadī́nām ǀ ánuttam ǀ asmai ǀ kṣatrám ǀ viśvá-āyu ǁ
verses.english_translation: He is the king of kings; the beauty of the rivers his all-pervading strength is irresistible.
verses.wilson_translation: He is the king of kings; the beauty of the rivers his all-pervading strength is irresistible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अविष्टो अस्मान्विश्वासु विक्ष्वद्युं कृणोत शंसं निनित्सोः ॥
verses.transliteration: áviṣṭo íti ǀ asmā́n ǀ víśvāsu ǀ vikṣú ǀ ádyum ǀ kṛṇota ǀ śáṃsam ǀ ninitsóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect us, gods, among all people; render extinct the calumny of the malevolent.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us, gods, among all people; render extinct the calumny of the malevolent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्येतु दिद्युद्द्विषामशेवा युयोत विष्वग्रपस्तनूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ etu ǀ didyút ǀ dviṣā́m ǀ áśevā ǀ yuyóta ǀ víṣvak ǀ rápaḥ ǀ tanū́nām ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the blazing (weapons) of foes pass by innocuous; separate, (gods), universally (from us) the sin ofour bodies.
verses.wilson_translation: May the blazing (weapons) of foes pass by innocuous; separate, (gods), universally (from us) the sin ofour bodies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवीन्नो अग्निर्हव्यान्नमोभिः प्रेष्ठो अस्मा अधायि स्तोमः ॥
verses.transliteration: ávīt ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ havya-át ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ asmai ǀ adhāyi ǀ stómaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, the feeder on oblations, propitiated by our homage, protect us; to him has our praise beenaddressed.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, the feeder on oblations, propitiated by our homage, protect us; to him has our praise beenaddressed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सजूर्देवेभिरपां नपातं सखायं कृध्वं शिवो नो अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration: sa-jū́ḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápātam ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kṛdhvam ǀ śiváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorify along with the gods our friend, the grandson of the waters; may he be propitious to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorify along with the gods our friend, the grandson of the waters; may he be propitious to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अब्जामुक्थैरहिं गृणीषे बुध्ने नदीनां रजस्सु षीदन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ap-jā́m ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ áhim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ budhné ǀ nadī́nām ǀ rájaḥ-su ǀ sī́dan ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify with hymns the disperser of the clouds in the firmament; the water-born, sitting among thewaters of the rivers.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify with hymns the disperser of the clouds in the firmament; the water-born, sitting among thewaters of the rivers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो रिषे धान्मा यज्ञो अस्य स्रिधदृतायोः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ riṣé ǀ dhāt ǀ mā́ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ asya ǀ sridhat ǀ ṛta-yóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not Ahirbudhnyabe disposed to work us harm; let not the sacrifice of the worshipper bedisregarded.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not Ahirbudhnyabe disposed to work us harm; let not the sacrifice of the worshipper bedisregarded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत न एषु नृषु श्रवो धुः प्र राये यंतु शर्धंतो अर्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ eṣú ǀ nṛ́ṣu ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ dhuḥ ǀ prá ǀ rāyé ǀ yantu ǀ śárdhantaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (the gods) bestow food upon our people; let foes contending for our riches perish.
verses.wilson_translation: May (the gods) bestow food upon our people; let foes contending for our riches perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तपंति शत्रुं स्वर्ण भूमा महासेनासो अमेभिरेषां ॥
verses.transliteration: tápanti ǀ śátrum ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǀ mahā́-senāsaḥ ǀ ámebhiḥ ǀ eṣām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders of great armies, by the power of these (divinities), consume their foes, as he sun (scorches)the regions.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders of great armies, by the power of these (divinities), consume their foes, as he sun (scorches)the regions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यन्नः पत्नीर्गमंत्यच्छा त्वष्टा सुपाणिर्दधातु वीरान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ naḥ ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ gámanti ǀ áccha ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ su-pāṇíḥ ǀ dádhātu ǀ vīrā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the wives (of the gods) come before us, may the dextrous Tvaṣṭāgrant usmaleprogeny.
verses.wilson_translation: When the wives (of the gods) come before us, may the dextrous Tvaṣṭāgrant usmaleprogeny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रति नः स्तोमं त्वष्टा जुषेत स्यादस्मे अरमतिर्वसूयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ juṣeta ǀ syā́t ǀ asmé íti ǀ arámatiḥ ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Tvaṣṭābe propitiated by this our praise; may he who is of comprehensive understanding beinclined to give us wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May Tvaṣṭābe propitiated by this our praise; may he who is of comprehensive understanding beinclined to give us wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता नो रासन्रातिषाचो वसून्या रोदसी वरुणानी शृणोतु ।वरूत्रीभिः सुशरणो नो अस्तु त्वष्टा सुदत्रो वि दधातु रायः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsan ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ varuṇānī́ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀvárūtrībhiḥ ǀ su-śaraṇáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ su-dátraḥ ǀ ví ǀ dadhātu ǀ rā́yaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May they who are the givers of gifts bestow upon us the treasure (we desire); may Rodasīand Varuṇānī hear (our supplications); may the genitive rous Tvaṣṭātogether with these (our) protectresses, be oursure refuge; may they give us riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May they who are the givers of gifts bestow upon us the treasure (we desire); may Rodasīand Varuṇānī hear (our supplications); may the genitive rous Tvaṣṭātogether with these (our) protectresses, be oursure refuge; may they give us riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तन्नो रायः पर्वतास्तन्न आपस्तद्रातिषाच ओषधीरुत द्यौः ।वनस्पतिभिः पृथिवी सजोषा उभे रोदसी परि पासतो नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tát ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǀvánaspáti-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pári ǀ pāsataḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the mountains, the waters, the liberal (wives of the gods), the plural nts, also the heaven and theearth, consentient with the forest lords and both the heaven and earth, preserve for us those (coveted) riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May the mountains, the waters, the liberal (wives of the gods), the plural nts, also the heaven and theearth, consentient with the forest lords and both the heaven and earth, preserve for us those (coveted) riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु तदुर्वी रोदसी जिहातामनु द्युक्षो वरुण इंद्रसखा ।अनु विश्वे मरुतो ये सहासो रायः स्याम धरुणं धियध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ tát ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ jihātām ǀ ánu ǀ dyukṣáḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ índra-sakhā ǀánu ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yé ǀ sahā́saḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ syāma ǀ dharúṇam ǀ dhiyádhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the vast heaven and earth consent, let the brilliant Varuṇa, of whom Indrais the friend consent; letall the victorious Marutsconsent that we may be a recepacle for the retention of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the vast heaven and earth consent, let the brilliant Varuṇa, of whom Indrais the friend consent; letall the victorious Marutsconsent that we may be a recepacle for the retention of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तन्न इंद्रो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निराप ओषधीर्वनिनो जुषंत ।शर्मन्त्स्याम मरुतामुपस्थे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀśárman ǀ syāma ǀ marútām ǀ upá-sthe ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra,Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, the waters, the herbs, the trees, be plural ased by our (praise); may we,(reclining) on the lap of the Maruts, enjoy felicity; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra,Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, the waters, the herbs, the trees, be plural ased by our (praise); may we,(reclining) on the lap of the Maruts, enjoy felicity; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXV. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BEFRIEND us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuṇa who receive oblations!Indra and Soma give health, strength and comfort, Indra and Pūṣan be our help in battle. Auspicious Friends to us be Bhaga, Sathsa, auspicious be Purandhi aid all Riches;The blessing of the true and well-conducted, and Aryaman in many forms apparent. Kind unto us he Maker and Sustainer, and the far-reaching Pair with God-like natures.Auspicious unto us be Earth and Heaven, the Mountain, and the Gods’ fair invocations. Favour us Agni with his face of splendour, and Varuva and Mitra and the Aśvins.Favour us noble actions of the pious, impetuous vita blow on us with favour. Early invoked, may Heaven and Earth be friendly, and Air's mid-region good for us to look on.To us may Herbs and Forest-Trees be gracious, gracious the Lord Victorious of the region. Be the God Indra with the Vasus friendly, and, with Ādityas, Varuṇa who blesseth.Kind, with the Rudras, be the Healer Rudra, and, with the Dames, may Tvaṣṭar kindly listen. Blest unto us be Soma, and devotions, blest be the Sacrifice, the Stones for pressing.Blest be the fixing of the sacred Pillars, blest be the tender Grass and blest the Altar. May the far-seeing Sun rise up to bless us: be the four Quarters of the sky auspicious.Auspicious be the firmly-seated Mountains, auspicious be the Rivers and the Waters. May Adid through holy works be gracioas, and may the Maruts, loud in song, be friendly.May Viṣṇu give felicity, and Pūṣan, the Air that cherisheth our life, and Vāyu. Prosper us Savitar, the God who rescues, and let the radiant Mornings be propitious.Auspicious to all creatures be Parjanya, auspicious be the field's benign Protector. May all the fellowship of Gods befriend us, Sarasvatī, with Holy Thoughts, be gracious.Friendly be they, the Liberal Ones who seek us, yea, those who dwell in heaven, on earth, in waters. May the great Lords of Truth protect and aid us: blest to us be our horses and our cattle.Kind be the pious skilful-handed Ṛbhus, kind be the Fathers at our invocations. May Aja-Ekapād, the God, be gracious, gracious the Dragon of the Deep, and Ocean.Gracious be he the swelling Child of Waters, gracious be Pṛśni who hath Gods to guard her. So may the Rudras, Vasus, and Ādityas accept the new hymn which we now are making.May all the Holy Ones of earth and heaven, and the Cow's offipring hear our invocation. They who of Holy Gods are very holy, Immortal, knowing Law, whom man must worship,—May these to-day give us broad paths to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: शं न इंद्राग्नी भवतामवोभिः शं न इंद्रावरुणा रातहव्या ।शमिंद्रासोमा सुविताय शं योः शं न इंद्रापूषणा वाजसातौ ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ bhavatām ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāváruṇā ǀ rātá-havyā ǀśám ǀ índrāsómā ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāpūṣáṇā ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indraand Agnibe (with us) with their protections for our hapiness; may Indra and Varuṇa, to whomoblations are offered, (be with us) for our happiness; may Indra and Somabe (with us) for our happiness, ourprosperity, our good; may Indra and Pūṣanbe (with us) in battle for our triumph.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indraand Agnibe (with us) with their protections for our hapiness; may Indra and Varuṇa, to whomoblations are offered, (be with us) for our happiness; may Indra and Somabe (with us) for our happiness, ourprosperity, our good; may Indra and Pūṣanbe (with us) in battle for our triumph.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो भगः शमु नः शंसो अस्तु शं नः पुरंधिः शमु संतु रायः ।शं नः सत्यस्य सुयमस्य शंसः शं नो अर्यमा पुरुजातो अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ satyásya ǀ su-yámasya ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ puru-jātáḥ ǀ astu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Bhaga(promote) our happiness; may Śaṃsa be our happiness; may Purandhi be (with us for) ourhappiness; may riches be (a source of) happiness; may the benediction of the true and virtuous yield ushappiness; may the variously-manifested Aryamanbe (with us) for our felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: May Bhaga(promote) our happiness; may Śaṃsa be our happiness; may Purandhi be (with us for) ourhappiness; may riches be (a source of) happiness; may the benediction of the true and virtuous yield ushappiness; may the variously-manifested Aryamanbe (with us) for our felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो धाता शमु धर्ता नो अस्तु शं न उरूची भवतु स्वधाभिः ।शं रोदसी बृहती शं नो अद्रिः शं नो देवानां सुहवानि संतु ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ dhātā́ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dhartā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ urūcī́ ǀ bhavatu ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀśám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ ádriḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ su-hávāni ǀ santu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the creator be to us for happiness; may the discriminator (between virtue and vice,Varuṇa) be(with us) for our happiness; may the wide earth (contribute) with sustenance to our happiness; may the vastheaven and earth be (to us for) happiness; may the mountains (yield) us happiness; may our pious invocations ofthe gods secure us happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May the creator be to us for happiness; may the discriminator (between virtue and vice,Varuṇa) be(with us) for our happiness; may the wide earth (contribute) with sustenance to our happiness; may the vastheaven and earth be (to us for) happiness; may the mountains (yield) us happiness; may our pious invocations ofthe gods secure us happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो अग्निर्ज्योतिरनीको अस्तु शं नो मित्रावरुणावश्विना शं ।शं नः सुकृतां सुकृतानि संतु शं न इषिरो अभि वातु वातः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ jyótiḥ-anīkaḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇau ǀ aśvínā ǀ śám ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ su-kṛ́tām ǀ su-kṛtā́ni ǀ santu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vātu ǀ vā́taḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, whose countenance is light, be (with us) for our happiness; may Mitraand Varuṇa, may the Aśvins be (present) for our felicity; may the virtuous be (promotive of) our happiness; may the restless wind blowfor our happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, whose countenance is light, be (with us) for our happiness; may Mitraand Varuṇa, may the Aśvins be (present) for our felicity; may the virtuous be (promotive of) our happiness; may the restless wind blowfor our happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वहूतौ शमंतरिक्षं दृशये नो अस्तु ।शं न ओषधीर्वनिनो भवंतु शं नो रजसस्पतिरस्तु जिष्णुः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ pūrvá-hūtau ǀ śám ǀ antárikṣam ǀ dṛśáye ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ astu ǀ jiṣṇúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May heaven and earth, the first invoked, (promote) our happiness; may the firmament be happiness toour view; may the herbs, the trees, (yield) us happiness; may the victorious lord of the world, (Indra), be(favourable to) our felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: May heaven and earth, the first invoked, (promote) our happiness; may the firmament be happiness toour view; may the herbs, the trees, (yield) us happiness; may the victorious lord of the world, (Indra), be(favourable to) our felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं न इंद्रो वसुभिर्देवो अस्तु शमादित्येभिर्वरुणः सुशंसः ।शं नो रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्जलाषः शं नस्त्वष्टा ग्नाभिरिह शृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ ādityébhiḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ su-śáṃsaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ jálāṣaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ gnā́bhiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ śṛṇotu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine (Indra), with the Vasus, grant us happiness; may the justly-praised Varuṇa, with theĀdityas, be (friendly to) our happiness; may the grief-assuaging Rudra, with the Rudras, be (for) our happiness;may Tvaṣṭā, with the wives of the gods, be (with us) for our happiness, and hear us at this solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine (Indra), with the Vasus, grant us happiness; may the justly-praised Varuṇa, with theĀdityas, be (friendly to) our happiness; may the grief-assuaging Rudra, with the Rudras, be (for) our happiness;may Tvaṣṭā, with the wives of the gods, be (with us) for our happiness, and hear us at this solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नः सोमो भवतु ब्रह्म शं नः शं नो ग्रावाणः शमु संतु यज्ञाः ।शं नः स्वरूणां मितयो भवंतु शं नः प्रस्वः शम्वस्तु वेदिः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ bráhma ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ yajñā́ḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ svárūṇām ǀ mitáyaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ astu ǀ védiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Somabe (offered for) our happiness; may the prayer be (uttered for) our happiness; may thestones (grind the Soma), the sacrifice be (solemnized for) our happiness; may the measured lengths of thesacrificialpostsbe (conducive to) our felicity; may the sacred grass be (strewn) for our happiness; may the altarbe (raised for) our happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May the Somabe (offered for) our happiness; may the prayer be (uttered for) our happiness; may thestones (grind the Soma), the sacrifice be (solemnized for) our happiness; may the measured lengths of thesacrificialpostsbe (conducive to) our felicity; may the sacred grass be (strewn) for our happiness; may the altarbe (raised for) our happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नः सूर्य उरुचक्षा उदेतु शं नश्चतस्रः प्रदिशो भवंतु ।शं नः पर्वता ध्रुवयो भवंतु शं नः सिंधवः शमु संत्वापः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ uru-cákṣāḥ ǀ út ǀ etu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ cátasraḥ ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ dhruváyaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the wide-seeing sun rise (for) our happines; may the four quarters of the horizon (exist for) ourfelicity; may the firm-set mountains be (for) our happiness; may the rivers, may the waters, be (diffused) for ourhappiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May the wide-seeing sun rise (for) our happines; may the four quarters of the horizon (exist for) ourfelicity; may the firm-set mountains be (for) our happiness; may the rivers, may the waters, be (diffused) for ourhappiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो अदितिर्भवतु व्रतेभिः शं नो भवंतु मरुतः स्वर्काः ।शं नो विष्णुः शमु पूषा नो अस्तु शं नो भवित्रं शम्वस्तु वायुः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ vratébhiḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-arkā́ḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavítram ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ astu ǀ vāyúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Aditi, with holy observances, be (for) our happiness; may the glorified Marutsbe (friendly to) ourfelicity; may Viṣṇu, may Pūṣan, be (promoters of) our happiness; may the firmament be propitious to us; may Vāyu (blow for) our happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May Aditi, with holy observances, be (for) our happiness; may the glorified Marutsbe (friendly to) ourfelicity; may Viṣṇu, may Pūṣan, be (promoters of) our happiness; may the firmament be propitious to us; may Vāyu (blow for) our happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणः शं नो भवंतूषसो विभातीः ।शं नः पर्जन्यो भवतु प्रजाभ्यः शं नः क्षेत्रस्य पतिरस्तु शंभुः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ trā́yamāṇaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ pra-jā́bhyaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣétrasya ǀ pátiḥ ǀ astu ǀ śam-bhúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine preserving Savitābe (radiant for) our happiness; may the opening dawns (break for)our happiness; may Parjanyabe (the granter of happiness) to our posterity; mayŚambhu, the lord of strength,be (the conferrer of) happiness upon us.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine preserving Savitābe (radiant for) our happiness; may the opening dawns (break for)our happiness; may Parjanyabe (the granter of happiness) to our posterity; mayŚambhu, the lord of strength,be (the conferrer of) happiness upon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो देवा विश्वदेवा भवंतु शं सरस्वती सह धीभिरस्तु ।शमभिषाचः शमु रातिषाचः शं नो दिव्याः पार्थिवाः शं नो अप्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ viśvá-devāḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ sárasvatī ǀ sahá ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ astu ǀśám ǀ abhi-sā́caḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivāḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine universal gods be (favourable) to our felicity; may Sarasvatī, with holy rites, behappiness; may those who assist at sacrifices, those who are liberal of gifts. Be (conducive to) our happiness;may celestial, terrestrial and aquatic things be (subservient to) our happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine universal gods be (favourable) to our felicity; may Sarasvatī, with holy rites, behappiness; may those who assist at sacrifices, those who are liberal of gifts. Be (conducive to) our happiness;may celestial, terrestrial and aquatic things be (subservient to) our happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नः सत्यस्य पतयो भवंतु शं नो अर्वंतः शमु संतु गावः ।शं न ऋभवः सुकृतः सुहस्ताः शं नो भवंतु पितरो हवेषु ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ satyásya ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ su-hástāḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ háveṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the lords of truth be (propitious to) our happiness; may horses, may cattle, (contribute to) ourhappiness; may the virtuous, the dexterousṚbhus, be to us (for) felicity; may the progenitors be (promoters of)our happiness at the seasons of worship.
verses.wilson_translation: May the lords of truth be (propitious to) our happiness; may horses, may cattle, (contribute to) ourhappiness; may the virtuous, the dexterousṚbhus, be to us (for) felicity; may the progenitors be (promoters of)our happiness at the seasons of worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो अज एकपाद्देवो अस्तु शं नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शं समुद्रः ।शं नो अपां नपात्पेरुरस्तु शं नः पृश्निर्भवतु देवगोपा ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ ajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ deváḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ śám ǀ samudráḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ perúḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ devá-gopā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine Aja-Ekapād be (favourable to) our happiness; may Ahirbudhnya, may the firmament, be(promotive of) our happiness; may the grandson of the waters, the protector, be (the securer of) our felicity; may Pṛśni, of whom the gods are the guardians, be to us (a granter of) happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine Aja-Ekapād be (favourable to) our happiness; may Ahirbudhnya, may the firmament, be(promotive of) our happiness; may the grandson of the waters, the protector, be (the securer of) our felicity; may Pṛśni, of whom the gods are the guardians, be to us (a granter of) happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या रुद्रा वसवो जुषंतेदं ब्रह्म क्रियमाणं नवीयः ।शृण्वंतु नो दिव्याः पार्थिवासो गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः ॥
verses.transliteration: ādityā́ḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀ idám ǀ bráhma ǀ kriyámāṇam ǀ návīyaḥ ǀśṛṇvántu ǀ naḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀ gó-jātāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yé ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Ādiyas, the Rudras, the Vasus, be gratified by this new and now repeated praise; maycelestial and terrestrial (beings), the progeny of the cow, (Pṛśni), and those who were entitled to worship, hearour (invocations).
verses.wilson_translation: May the Ādiyas, the Rudras, the Vasus, be gratified by this new and now repeated praise; maycelestial and terrestrial (beings), the progeny of the cow, (Pṛśni), and those who were entitled to worship, hearour (invocations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये देवानां यज्ञिया यज्ञियानां मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।ते नो रासंतामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ devā́nām ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ mánoḥ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsantām ǀ uru-gāyám ǀ adyá ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those who are the most adorable divinities, those who were the adored of Manu, those who areimmortal, the observers of truth, bestow upon us this day (a son), of wide-spread renown; and do you evercherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May those who are the most adorable divinities, those who were the adored of Manu, those who areimmortal, the observers of truth, bestow upon us this day (a son), of wide-spread renown; and do you evercherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVI. Viśvedevas
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LET the prayer issue from the seat of Order, for Sūrya with his beams hath loosed the cattle.With lofty ridges earth is far extended, and Agni's flame hath lit the spacious surface. O Asuras, O Varuṇa and Mitra, this hymn to you, like food, anew I offer.One of you is a strong unerring Leader, and Mitra, speaking, stirreth men to labour. The movements of the gliding wind come hither: like cows, the springs are filled to overflowing.Born in the station e’en of lofty heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed in this region. May I bring hither with my song, O Indra, wise Aryaman who yokes thy dear Bay Horses,Voracious, with thy noble car, O Hero, him who defeats the wrath of the malicious. In their own place of sacrifice adorers worship to gain long life and win his friendship.He hath poured food on men when they have praised him; be this, the dearest reverence, paid to Rudra. Coming together, glorious, loudly roaring - Sarasvatī, Mother of Floods, the seventh-With copious milk, with fair streams, strongly flowing, full swelling with the volume of their water;. And may the mighty Maruts, too, rejoicing, aid our devotion and protect our offspring.Let not swift-moving Aksara neglect us: they have increased our own appropriate riches, Bring ye the great Aramati before you, and Pūṣan as the Hero of the synod,Bhaga who looks upon this hymn with favour, and, as our strength, the bountiful Purandbi. May this our song of praise reach you, O Maruts, and Viṣṇu guardian of the future infant.May they vouchsafe the singer strength for offspring. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्मैतु सदनादृतस्य वि रश्मिभिः ससृजे सूर्यो गाः ।वि सानुना पृथिवी सस्र उर्वी पृथु प्रतीकमध्येधे अग्निः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ bráhma ǀ etu ǀ sádanāt ǀ ṛtásya ǀ ví ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ sasṛje ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀví ǀ sā́nunā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ sasre ǀ urvī́ ǀ pṛthú ǀ prátīkam ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́ ǀ īdhe ǀ agníḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the prayer proceed from the nail of the sacrifice, for Sūryawith his rays lets loose the waters; thespacious earth spreads (studded) with mountains, and Agniblazes on the extensive plural inṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Let the prayer proceed from the nail of the sacrifice, for Sūryawith his rays lets loose the waters; thespacious earth spreads (studded) with mountains, and Agniblazes on the extensive plural inṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमां वां मित्रावरुणा सुवृक्तिमिषं न कृण्वे असुरा नवीयः ।इनो वामन्यः पदवीरदब्धो जनं च मित्रो यतति ब्रुवाणः ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́m ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ íṣam ǀ ná ǀ kṛṇve ǀ asurā ǀ návīyaḥ ǀináḥ ǀ vām ǀ anyáḥ ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ jánam ǀ ca ǀ mitráḥ ǀ yatati ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Powerful Mitraand Varuṇa, to you I offer this new praise as if it were (sacrificial) food; one of you,(Varuṇa). The invincible lord, is the guide to the path (of virtue) Mitra when praised animates men to exertioṇ
verses.wilson_translation: Powerful Mitraand Varuṇa, to you I offer this new praise as if it were (sacrificial) food; one of you,(Varuṇa). The invincible lord, is the guide to the path (of virtue) Mitra when praised animates men to exertioṇ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वातस्य ध्रजतो रंत इत्या अपीपयंत धेनवो न सूदाः ।महो दिवः सदने जायमानोऽचिक्रदद्वृषभः सस्मिन्नूधन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vā́tasya ǀ dhrájataḥ ǀ rante ǀ ityā́ḥ ǀ ápīpayanta ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́dāḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ sádane ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ ácikradat ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ sásmin ǀ ū́dhan ǁ
verses.english_translation: The movements of the restless wind sport around; the milk-yielding kine are in good condition; theshowerer genitive rated in the dwelling of the mighty sun has cried aloud in that his plural ce of abiding, (the firmament).
verses.wilson_translation: The movements of the restless wind sport around; the milk-yielding kine are in good condition; theshowerer genitive rated in the dwelling of the mighty sun has cried aloud in that his plural ce of abiding, (the firmament).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरा य एता युनजद्धरी त इंद्र प्रिया सुरथा शूर धायू ।प्र यो मन्युं रिरिक्षतो मिनात्या सुक्रतुमर्यमणं ववृत्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: girā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ etā́ ǀ yunájat ǀ hárī íti ǀ te ǀ índra ǀ priyā́ ǀ su-ráthā ǀ śūra ǀ dhāyū́ íti ǀprá ǀ yáḥ ǀ manyúm ǀ rírikṣataḥ ǀ minā́ti ǀ ā́ ǀ su-krátum ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ vavṛtyām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hero,Indra, (come to the sacrifice of the man) who, by his adoration, has harnessed (to your car) theseyour favourite, graceful and vigorous horses; may I bring hither Aryaman, the doer of good deeds, who baffles thewrath of the malevolent.
verses.wilson_translation: Hero,Indra, (come to the sacrifice of the man) who, by his adoration, has harnessed (to your car) theseyour favourite, graceful and vigorous horses; may I bring hither Aryaman, the doer of good deeds, who baffles thewrath of the malevolent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यजंते अस्य सख्यं वयश्च नमस्विनः स्व ऋतस्य धामन् ।वि पृक्षो बाबधे नृभिः स्तवान इदं नमो रुद्राय प्रेष्ठं ॥
verses.transliteration: yájante ǀ asya ǀ sakhyám ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ namasvínaḥ ǀ své ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́man ǀví ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ bābadhe ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ idám ǀ námaḥ ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ préṣṭham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the offerers of adoration, engaging (in pious acts), worship (Rudra) in their own hall of sacrifice,(solicitous) of his friendship; praised by the leaders (of rites), he lavishes food (upon them); this most acceptableadoration is addressed to Rudra.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the offerers of adoration, engaging (in pious acts), worship (Rudra) in their own hall of sacrifice,(solicitous) of his friendship; praised by the leaders (of rites), he lavishes food (upon them); this most acceptableadoration is addressed to Rudra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यत्साकं यशसो वावशानाः सरस्वती सप्तथी सिंधुमाता ।याः सुष्वयंत सुदुघाः सुधारा अभि स्वेन पयसा पीप्यानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ sākám ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ saptáthī ǀ síndhu-mātā ǀyā́ḥ ǀ susváyanta ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ su-dhārā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ svéna ǀ páyasā ǀ pī́pyānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the seventh (stream),Sarasvatī, the mother of the Sindhuand those rivers that flow copious andfertilizing, bestowing abundance of food, and nourishing (the people) by their waters come at once together.
verses.wilson_translation: May the seventh (stream),Sarasvatī, the mother of the Sindhuand those rivers that flow copious andfertilizing, bestowing abundance of food, and nourishing (the people) by their waters come at once together.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्ये नो मरुतो मंदसाना धियं तोकं च वाजिनोऽवंतु ।मा नः परि ख्यदक्षरा चरंत्यवीवृधन्युज्यं ते रयिं नः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyé ǀ naḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ tokám ǀ ca ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ avantu ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀ khyat ǀ ákṣarā ǀ cárantī ǀ ávīvṛdhan ǀ yújyam ǀ té ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May these joyous and swift-going Marutsprotect our sacrifice and our offspring; let not the imperishablegoddess of speech, deserting us, speak (kindly) to our (adversaries); and may both (she and the Marut)associated augment our riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May these joyous and swift-going Marutsprotect our sacrifice and our offspring; let not the imperishablegoddess of speech, deserting us, speak (kindly) to our (adversaries); and may both (she and the Marut)associated augment our riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो महीमरमतिं कृणुध्वं प्र पूषणं विदथ्यं न वीरं ।भगं धियोऽवितारं नो अस्याः सातौ वाजं रातिषाचं पुरंधिं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ arámatim ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ prá ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ vidathyám ǀ ná ǀ vīrám ǀbhágam ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ avitā́ram ǀ naḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ sātáu ǀ vā́jam ǀ rāti-sā́cam ǀ púram-dhim ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invoke, (worshippers), the unresisting earth, and the adorable hero,Pūṣan; (invoke)Bhaga, theprotector of this our sacrifice, and Vāja, the sustainer of old, the liberal of gifts to our solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: Invoke, (worshippers), the unresisting earth, and the adorable hero,Pūṣan; (invoke)Bhaga, theprotector of this our sacrifice, and Vāja, the sustainer of old, the liberal of gifts to our solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छायं वो मरुतः श्लोक एत्वच्छा विष्णुं निषिक्तपामवोभिः ।उत प्रजायै गृणते वयो धुर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ ayám ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ etu ǀ áccha ǀ víṣṇum ǀ nisikta-pā́m ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀutá ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhuḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this praise come,Maruts, before you; (may it come) before Viṣṇu, the guardian of the embryo,with his protecting faculties; may they both bestow upon (me), their adorer, progeny and food; and do you evercherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May this praise come,Maruts, before you; (may it come) before Viṣṇu, the guardian of the embryo,with his protecting faculties; may they both bestow upon (me), their adorer, progeny and food; and do you evercherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LET your best-bearing car that must be lauded, ne’er injured, bring you Vājas and Ṛbhukṣans.Fill you, fair-helmeted! with mighty Soma, thrice-mixed, at our libations to delight you. Ye who behold the light of heaven, Ṛbhukṣans, give our rich patrons unmolested riches.Drink, heavenly-natured. at our sacrifices, and give us bounties for the hymns we sing you. For thou, O Bounteous One, art used to giving, at parting treasure whether small or ample.Filled full are both thine arms with great possessions: thy goodness keeps thee not from granting riches. Indra, high-famed, as Vāja and Ṛbhukṣans, thou goest working, singing to the dwelling.Lord of Bay Steeds, this day may we Vasisthas offer our prayers to thee and bring oblations. Thou winnest swift advancement for thy servant, through hymns, Lord of Bay Steeds, which thou hast favoured.For thee with friendly succour have we battled, and when, O Indra, wilt thou grant us riches? To us thy priests a home, as ’twere, thou givest: when, Indra wilt thou recognize our praises?May thy strong Steed, through our ancestral worship, bring food and wealth with heroes to our dwelling. Though Nirrti the Goddess reigneth round him, Autumns with food in plenty come to Indra.With three close Friends to length of days he cometh, he whom men let not rest at home in quiet. Promise us gifts, O Savitar: may riches come unto us in Parvata's full bounty.May the Celestial Guardian still attend us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: आ वो वाहिष्ठो वहतु स्तवध्यै रथो वाजा ऋभुक्षणो अमृक्तः ।अभि त्रिपृष्ठैः सवनेषु सोमैर्मदे सुशिप्रा महभिः पृणध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vahatu ǀ stavádhyai ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ ámṛktaḥ ǀabhí ǀ trí-pṛṣṭháiḥ ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ máde ǀ su-śiprāḥ ǀ mahá-bhiḥ ǀ pṛṇadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vājas, possessors of energy, let your capacious, commendable, and unobstructed chariot bring you(hither); be satiated, handsome-chinned, with the copious triply-combined libation (poured out) for yourexhilaration at our sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Vājas, possessors of energy, let your capacious, commendable, and unobstructed chariot bring you(hither); be satiated, handsome-chinned, with the copious triply-combined libation (poured out) for yourexhilaration at our sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यूयं ह रत्नं मघवत्सु धत्थ स्वर्दृश ऋभुक्षणो अमृक्तं ।सं यज्ञेषु स्वधावंतः पिबध्वं वि नो राधांसि मतिभिर्दयध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: yūyám ǀ ha ǀ rátnam ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dhattha ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ ámṛktam ǀsám ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ svadhā-vantaḥ ǀ pibadhvam ǀ ví ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ dayadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you,Ṛbhukṣins, beholders of heaven, preserve unmolested the precious (treasure) for us who areaffluent (in sacrificial offerings); do you who are possessed of strengh, drink fully at (our) solemnities, and with(favourable) minds bestow upon us riches.
verses.wilson_translation: For you,Ṛbhukṣins, beholders of heaven, preserve unmolested the precious (treasure) for us who areaffluent (in sacrificial offerings); do you who are possessed of strengh, drink fully at (our) solemnities, and with(favourable) minds bestow upon us riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उवोचिथ हि मघवंदेष्णं महो अर्भस्य वसुनो विभागे ।उभा ते पूर्णा वसुना गभस्ती न सूनृता नि यमते वसव्या ॥
verses.transliteration: uvócitha ǀ hí ǀ magha-van ǀ deṣṇám ǀ maháḥ ǀ árbhasya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ vi-bhāgé ǀubhā́ ǀ te ǀ pūrṇā́ ǀ vásunā ǀ gábhastī íti ǀ ná ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ ní ǀ yamate ǀ vasavyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Maghavan, have determined what is to be given in the apportionment of much or of little wealth,for both yourhandsare full of treasure, and your sincere (promises) of riches do not restrain them.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Maghavan, have determined what is to be given in the apportionment of much or of little wealth,for both yourhandsare full of treasure, and your sincere (promises) of riches do not restrain them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्र स्वयशा ऋभुक्षा वाजो न साधुरस्तमेष्यृक्वा ।वयं नु ते दाश्वांसः स्याम ब्रह्म कृण्वंतो हरिवो वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ svá-yaśāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ ástam ǀ eṣi ǀ ṛ́kvā ǀvayám ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ dāśvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ bráhma ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Indra, who areṚbhukṣin, and of especial renown, who, like food, are the fulfiller (of wants),come to the dwelling of the worshipper; lord of bay horses, may we,Vasiṣṭhas, be today the donors (of theofferings) to yo, the celebrators of your praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Indra, who areṚbhukṣin, and of especial renown, who, like food, are the fulfiller (of wants),come to the dwelling of the worshipper; lord of bay horses, may we,Vasiṣṭhas, be today the donors (of theofferings) to yo, the celebrators of your praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनितासि प्रवतो दाशुषे चिद्याभिर्विवेषो हर्यश्व धीभिः ।ववन्मा नु ते युज्याभिरूती कदा न इंद्र राय आ दशस्येः ॥
verses.transliteration: sánitā ǀ asi ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ cit ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ víveṣaḥ ǀ hari-aśva ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀvavanmá ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ yújyābhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ kadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ daśasyeḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of bay horses, you are the giver of descending (wealth) to the donor (of the oblation), by whosesacred rites you are magnified; when may you bestow upon us riches; when may we be secure by yourappropriate protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of bay horses, you are the giver of descending (wealth) to the donor (of the oblation), by whosesacred rites you are magnified; when may you bestow upon us riches; when may we be secure by yourappropriate protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वासयसीव वेधसस्त्वं नः कदा न इंद्र वचसो बुबोधः ।अस्तं तात्या धिया रयिं सुवीरं पृक्षो नो अर्वा न्युहीत वाजी ॥
verses.transliteration: vāsáyasi-iva ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ bubodhaḥ ǀástam ǀ tātyā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ rayím ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ pṛkṣáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ árvā ǀ ní ǀ uhīta ǀ vājī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indra, will you appreciate our praise; at present you establish us (your) adorers in our dwelling;let your swift horse, (influenced) by our protracted solemnity, convey to our abode riches,maleoffspring, andfood.
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indra, will you appreciate our praise; at present you establish us (your) adorers in our dwelling;let your swift horse, (influenced) by our protracted solemnity, convey to our abode riches,maleoffspring, andfood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अ��ि यं देवी निर्ऋतिश्चिदीशे नक्षंत इंद्रं शरदः सुपृक्षः ।उप त्रिबंधुर्जरदष्टिमेत्यस्ववेशं यं कृणवंत मर्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ yám ǀ devī́ ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ cit ǀ ī́śe ǀ nákṣante ǀ índram ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ su-pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀúpa ǀ tri-bandhúḥ ǀ jarát-aṣṭim ǀ eti ǀ ásvaveśam ǀ yám ǀ kṛṇávanta ǀ mártāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the upholder of the three regions, whom the divine Nirṛtiacknowledges as ruler, whom abundantyears pass over, whom mortals detain from his own abode, approaches to (recruit) his decaying strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the upholder of the three regions, whom the divine Nirṛtiacknowledges as ruler, whom abundantyears pass over, whom mortals detain from his own abode, approaches to (recruit) his decaying strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो राधांसि सवितः स्तवध्या आ रायो यंतु पर्वतस्य रातौ ।सदा नो दिव्यः पायुः सिषक्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ savitaríti ǀ stavádhyai ǀ ā́ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ párvatasya ǀ rātáu ǀsádā ǀ naḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ sisaktu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May riches worthy of laudation come,Savitā, to us; riches that are in the bestow of Parvata; may theheavenly protector (of all) preserve us; and, do you (Universal gods), ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May riches worthy of laudation come,Savitā, to us; riches that are in the bestow of Parvata; may theheavenly protector (of all) preserve us; and, do you (Universal gods), ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVIII. Savitar.
hymns.anukramani: ८ मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ:। १-६ सविता , ६ उत्तरार्धस्य भगो वा , ७-८  वाजिन: । त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ON high hath Savitar, this God, extended the golden lustre which he spreads around him.Now, now must Bhaga be invoked by mortals, Lord of great riches who distributes treasures. Rise up, O Savitar whose hands are golden, and hear this man while sacrifice is offered,Spreading afar thy broad and wide effulgence, and bringing mortal men the food that feeds them. Let Savitar the God he hymned with praises, to whom the Vasus, even, all sing glory.Sweet be our lauds to him whose due is worship: may he with all protection guard our princes. Even he whom Aditi the Goddess praises, rejoicing in God Savitar's incitement:Even he who praise the high imperial Rulers, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, sing in concert. They who come emulous to our oblation, dispensing bounty, from the earth and heaven.May they and Ahibudhnya hear our calling: guard us Varūtrī with the Ekadhenus. This may the Lord of Life, entreated, grant us,—the wealth which Savitar the God possesses.The mighty calls on Bhaga for protection, on Bhaga calls the weak to give him riches. Bless us the Vajins when we call, while slowly they move, strong Singers, to the Gods’ assembly.Crushing the wolf, the serpent, and the demons, may they completely banish all affliction. Deep-skilled in Law eternal, deathless, Singers, O Vajins, help us in each fray for booty.Drink of this meath, he satisfied, be joyful: then go on paths which Gods are wont to travel.

verses.sanskrit: उदु ष्य देवः सविता ययाम हिरण्ययीममतिं यामशिश्रेत् ।नूनं भगो हव्यो मानुषेभिर्वि यो रत्ना पुरूवसुर्दधाति ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ yayāma ǀ hiraṇyáyīm ǀ amátim ǀ yā́m ǀ áśiśret ǀnūnám ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣebhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ rátnā ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ dádhāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine Savitāhas diffused the golden radiance on high, of which he is the asylum; verily Bhagaisto be absorbed by men who, abounding in wealth, distributes treasures (among them).
verses.wilson_translation: The divine Savitāhas diffused the golden radiance on high, of which he is the asylum; verily Bhagaisto be absorbed by men who, abounding in wealth, distributes treasures (among them).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु तिष्ठ सवितः श्रुध्यस्य हिरण्यपाणे प्रभृतावृतस्य ।व्युर्वीं पृथ्वीममतिं सृजान आ नृभ्यो मर्तभोजनं सुवानः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ savitaríti ǀ śrudhí ǀ asyá ǀ híraṇya-pāṇe ǀ prá-bhṛtau ǀ ṛtásya ǀví ǀ urvī́m ǀ pṛthvī́m ǀ amátim ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ marta-bhójanam ǀ suvānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rise up Savitā; hear (our solicitations) upon the celebration of this ceremony, (you who are) diffusinglight over the spacious earth, and bestowing human enjoyment upon men.
verses.wilson_translation: Rise up Savitā; hear (our solicitations) upon the celebration of this ceremony, (you who are) diffusinglight over the spacious earth, and bestowing human enjoyment upon men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपि ष्टुतः सविता देवो अस्तु यमा चिद्विश्वे वसवो गृणंति ।स नः स्तोमान्नमस्यश्चनो धाद्विश्वेभिः पातु पायुभिर्नि सूरीन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ápi ǀ stutáḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ astu ǀ yám ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀ víśve ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stómān ǀ namasyáḥ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāt ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ pātu ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ ní ǀ sūrī́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorified be the divine Savitā, whom all the gods praise; may that adorable (diviniy) require our praises(with) food; may he always protect the devout with all his protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorified be the divine Savitā, whom all the gods praise; may that adorable (diviniy) require our praises(with) food; may he always protect the devout with all his protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि यं देव्यदितिर्गृणाति सवं देवस्य सवितुर्जुषाणा ।अभि सम्राजो वरुणो गृणंत्यभि मित्रासो अर्यमा सजोषाः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ yám ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ gṛṇā́ti ǀ savám ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀabhí ǀ sam-rā́jaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ abhí ǀ mitrā́saḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whom the divine Aditi, delighting at the birth of the divine Savitṛ, glorifies, whom the supremesoverigns,Varuṇa,Mitra,Āryaman, (and other gods) adore.
verses.wilson_translation: Whom the divine Aditi, delighting at the birth of the divine Savitṛ, glorifies, whom the supremesoverigns,Varuṇa,Mitra,Āryaman, (and other gods) adore.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि ये मिथो वनुषः सपंते रातिं दिवो रातिषाचः पृथिव्याः ।अहिर्बुध्न्य उत नः शृणोतु वरूत्र्येकधेनुभिर्नि पातु ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ yé ǀ mitháḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ sápante ǀ rātím ǀ diváḥ ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀáhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ várūtrī ǀ ékadhenu-bhiḥ ǀ ní ǀ pātu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whom those solicitous for wealth those enjoying (it), mutually worship, the benefactor of heaven andearth; may Ahirbudhnyahear us; may the protectress (the goddess of speech), cherish us with excellen cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Whom those solicitous for wealth those enjoying (it), mutually worship, the benefactor of heaven andearth; may Ahirbudhnyahear us; may the protectress (the goddess of speech), cherish us with excellen cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु तन्नो जास्पतिर्मंसीष्ट रत्नं देवस्य सवितुरियानः ।भगमुग्रोऽवसे जोहवीति भगमनुग्रो अध याति रत्नं ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ jā́ḥ-pátiḥ ǀ maṃsīṣṭa ǀ rátnam ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ iyānáḥ ǀbhágam ǀ ugráḥ ǀ ávase ǀ jóhavīti ǀ bhágam ǀ ánugraḥ ǀ ádha ǀ yāti ǀ rátnam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the protector of progeny, when solicited, consent to bestow upon us the precious (wealth of thedivine Savitā; the ardent (adorer) invokes repeatedly Bhagafor protection; the less ardent solicits Bhaga forwealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May the protector of progeny, when solicited, consent to bestow upon us the precious (wealth of thedivine Savitā; the ardent (adorer) invokes repeatedly Bhagafor protection; the less ardent solicits Bhaga forwealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो भवंतु वाजिनो हवेषु देवताता मितद्रवः स्वर्काः ।जंभयंतोऽहिं वृकं रक्षांसि सनेम्यस्मद्युयवन्नमीवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ háveṣu ǀ devá-tātā ǀ mitá-dravaḥ ǀ su-arkā́ḥ ǀjambháyantaḥ ǀ áhim ǀ vṛ́kam ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sánemi ǀ asmát ǀ yuyavan ǀ ámīvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Vājins, with slackened speed, bringing excellent food, be (disposed) for our happiness, uponour invocations at the worship of the gods; destroying the murderer, the robber, therākṣasas, and keepingfrom us ancient maladies.
verses.wilson_translation: May the Vājins, with slackened speed, bringing excellent food, be (disposed) for our happiness, uponour invocations at the worship of the gods; destroying the murderer, the robber, therākṣasas, and keepingfrom us ancient maladies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाजेवाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो धनेषु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।अस्य मध्वः पिबत मादयध्वं तृप्ता यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́je-vāje ǀ avata ǀ vājinaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dháneṣu ǀ viprāḥ ǀ amṛtāḥ ǀ ṛta-jñāḥ ǀasyá ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pibata ǀ mādáyadhvam ǀ tṛptā́ḥ ǀ yāta ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise, immortal Vājins, observers of truth, defend us in every conflict, and for the sake of wealth; drinkof this sweet (Soma), be exhilarated (thereby) and satisfied; proceed by the paths traversed by the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Wise, immortal Vājins, observers of truth, defend us in every conflict, and for the sake of wealth; drinkof this sweet (Soma), be exhilarated (thereby) and satisfied; proceed by the paths traversed by the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIX Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, erect, hath shown enriching favour: the flame goes forward to the Gods’ assembly.Like car-borne men the stones their path have chosen: let the priest, quickened, celebrate our worship. Soft to the tread, their sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them,At the folks early call on Night and Morning,—Vāyu, and Pūṣan with his team, to bless us. Here on their path the noble Gods proceeded: in the wide firmament the Beauteous decked them.Bend your way hither, ye who travel widely: hear this our envoy who hath gone to meet you. For they are holy aids at sacrifices: all Gods approach the place of congregation.Bring these, desirous, to our worship, Agni, swift the Nisatyas, Bhaga, and Purandhi. Agni, to these men's hymns, from earth, from heaven, bring Mitra, Varuṇa, Indra, and Agni,And Aryaman, and Aditi, and Viṣṇu. Sarasvatī be joyful, and the Maruts. Even as the holy wish, the gift is offered: may he, unsated, come when men desire him.Give never-failing ever-conquering riches: with Gods for our allies may we be victors. Now have both worlds been praised by the Vasisthas; and holy Mitra, Varuṇa, and Agni.May they, bright Deities, make our song supremest. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमतिं वस्वो अश्रेत्प्रतीची जूर्णिर्देवतातिमेति ।भेजाते अद्री रथ्येव पंथामृतं होता न इषितो यजाति ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ aśret ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ jūrṇíḥ ǀ devá-tātim ǀ eti ǀbhejā́te íti ǀ ádrī íti ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ pánthām ǀ ṛtám ǀ hótā ǀ naḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ yajāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let Agni, risen on high, accept the praise of the worshipper; she who makes (all creatures) old, lookingto the west, goes to the sacrifice; the pious pair, like two riders in a chariot, follow the path (of the ceremony); letthe Hotā, as enjoined, celebrate the rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Let Agni, risen on high, accept the praise of the worshipper; she who makes (all creatures) old, lookingto the west, goes to the sacrifice; the pious pair, like two riders in a chariot, follow the path (of the ceremony); letthe Hotā, as enjoined, celebrate the rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वावृजे सुप्रया बर्हिरेषामा विश्पतीव बीरिट इयाते ।विशामक्तोरुषसः पूर्वहूतौ वायुः पूषा स्वस्तये नियुत्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vavṛje ǀ su-prayā́ḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ ā́ ǀ viśpátī ivéti viśpátī-iva ǀ bī́riṭe ǀ iyāte íti ǀviśā́m ǀ aktóḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ pūrvá-hūtau ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ svastáye ǀ niyútvān ǁ
verses.english_translation: The food-bestowing sacred grass of these (the worshippers) is strewn; may the two lords of people,Vāyuwith the Niyutsteeds, and Pūṣan, invoked before the dawn upon the close of the night, appear now inthe firmament for the welfare of mankind.
verses.wilson_translation: The food-bestowing sacred grass of these (the worshippers) is strewn; may the two lords of people,Vāyuwith the Niyutsteeds, and Pūṣan, invoked before the dawn upon the close of the night, appear now inthe firmament for the welfare of mankind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ज्मया अत्र वसवो रंत देवा उरावंतरिक्षे मर्जयंत शुभ्राः ।अर्वाक्पथ उरुज्रयः कृणुध्वं श्रोता दूतस्य जग्मुषो नो अस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: jmayā́ḥ ǀ átra ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ranta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ uráu ǀ antárikṣe ǀ marjayanta ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀarvā́k ǀ patháḥ ǀ uru-jrayaḥ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ śrótā ǀ dūtásya ǀ jagmúṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine Vasussport on this occasion upon the earth; the brilliant (Maruts) in the expansivefirmament are being worshipped; swift-moving deities, direct your paths towards us; hear (the words) of this ourmessenger, (Agni), approaching you.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine Vasussport on this occasion upon the earth; the brilliant (Maruts) in the expansivefirmament are being worshipped; swift-moving deities, direct your paths towards us; hear (the words) of this ourmessenger, (Agni), approaching you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते हि यज्ञेषु यज्ञियास ऊमाः सधस्थं विश्वे अभि संति देवाः ।ताँ अध्वर उशतो यक्ष्यग्ने श्रुष्टी भगं नासत्या पुरंधिं ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀ ū́māḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ víśve ǀ abhí ǀ sánti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀtā́n ǀ adhvaré ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ agne ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ bhágam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ púram-dhim ǁ
verses.english_translation: These universal adorable guardian deities occupy a common station at sacrifices; worship,Agni, thosedivinities, deservers (of oblations) at the ceremony, the swift Bhaga, the Nāsatyāsand Purandhi.
verses.wilson_translation: These universal adorable guardian deities occupy a common station at sacrifices; worship,Agni, thosedivinities, deservers (of oblations) at the ceremony, the swift Bhaga, the Nāsatyāsand Purandhi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आग्ने गिरो दिव आ पृथिव्या मित्रं वह वरुणमिंद्रमग्निं ।आर्यमणमदितिं विष्णुमेषां सरस्वती मरुतो मादयंतां ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agne ǀ gíraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ mitrám ǀ vaha ǀ váruṇam ǀ índram ǀ agním ǀā́ ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ áditim ǀ víṣṇum ǀ eṣām ǀ sárasvatī ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mādayantām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring Agni, whether from heaven or earth, the adorable deities Mitra,Varuṇa,Indraand Agni,Āryaman,Aditiand Viṣṇu(for the good) of these (worshippers); and may Sarasvatīand the Marutsbedelighted (by our offerings).
verses.wilson_translation: Bring Agni, whether from heaven or earth, the adorable deities Mitra,Varuṇa,Indraand Agni,Āryaman,Aditiand Viṣṇu(for the good) of these (worshippers); and may Sarasvatīand the Marutsbedelighted (by our offerings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ररे हव्यं मतिभिर्यज्ञियानां नक्षत्कामं मर्त्यानामसिन्वन् ।धाता रयिमविदस्यं सदासां सक्षीमहि युज्येभिर्नु देवैः ॥
verses.transliteration: raré ǀ havyám ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ nákṣat ǀ kā́mam ǀ mártyānām ǀ ásinvan ǀdhā́ta ǀ rayím ǀ avi-dasyám ǀ sadā-sā́m ǀ sakṣīmáhi ǀ yújyebhiḥ ǀ nú ǀ deváiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The oblation is offered together with praises to the adorable deities; may (Agni), unaverse to the desireof mortals, be present; bestow (upon us gods), unwasting, all-benefiting riches; and may we today be associatedwith the assembled deities.
verses.wilson_translation: The oblation is offered together with praises to the adorable deities; may (Agni), unaverse to the desireof mortals, be present; bestow (upon us gods), unwasting, all-benefiting riches; and may we today be associatedwith the assembled deities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू रोदसी अभिष्टुते वसिष्ठैर्ऋतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।यच्छंतु चंद्रा उपमं नो अर्कं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ ródasī íti ǀ abhístute ítyabhí-stute ǀ vásiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀyácchantu ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ naḥ ǀ arkám ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
