Never, O Maruts, may we lose your bounty, nor, car-borne Lords! be hitidmost when ye deal it.Give us a share in that delightful treasure, the genuine wealth that, Bulls! is your possession. What time the men in fury rush together for running streams, for pastures, and for houses.Then, O ye Maruts, ye who spring from Rudra, be our protectors in the strife with foemen. Full many a deed ye did for our forefathers worthy of lauds which, even of old, they sang you.lle strong man, with the Maruts, wins in battle, the charger, with the Maruts, gains the booty. Ours, O ye Maruts, be the vigorous Hero, the Lord Divine of men, the strong Sustainer,With whom to fair lands we may cross the waters, and dwell in our own home with you beside us. May Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa and Agni, Waters, and Plants, and Trees accept our praises.May we find shelter in the Marut's bosom. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: क ईं व्यक्ता नरः सनीळा रुद्रस्य मर्या अध स्वश्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ké ǀ īm ǀ ví-aktāḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ sá-nīḷāḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ máryāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ su-áśvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who are these resplendent chiefs, the dwellers in one abode, the sons of Rudra, friends of man, atpresent well-mounted?
verses.wilson_translation: Who are these resplendent chiefs, the dwellers in one abode, the sons of Rudra, friends of man, atpresent well-mounted?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकिर्ह्येषां जनूंषि वेद ते अंग विद्रे मिथो जनित्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ hí ǀ eṣām ǀ janū́ṃṣi ǀ véda ǀ té ǀ aṅgá ǀ vidre ǀ mitháḥ ǀ janítram ǁ
verses.english_translation: No one indeed knows their origin, they alone respectively know their birth.
verses.wilson_translation: No one indeed knows their origin, they alone respectively know their birth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि स्वपूभिर्मिथो वपंत वातस्वनसः श्येना अस्पृध्रन् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ sva-pū́bhiḥ ǀ mitháḥ ǀ vapanta ǀ vā́ta-svanasaḥ ǀ śyenā́ḥ ǀ aspṛdhran ǁ
verses.english_translation: They go together by their own pure paths; roaring like the wind, and fleet as falcons, they mutually rivaleach other.
verses.wilson_translation: They go together by their own pure paths; roaring like the wind, and fleet as falcons, they mutually rivaleach other.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतानि धीरो निण्या चिकेत पृश्निर्यदूधो मही जभार ॥
verses.transliteration: etā́ni ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ niṇyā́ ǀ ciketa ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ yát ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ mahī́ ǀ jabhā́ra ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage may know those white-complexioned beings (the Maruts), whom the vast Pṛṣṇiborn at herudder.
verses.wilson_translation: The sage may know those white-complexioned beings (the Maruts), whom the vast Pṛṣṇiborn at herudder.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सा विट् सुवीरा मरुद्भिरस्तु सनात्सहंती पुष्यंती नृम्णं ॥
verses.transliteration: sā́ ǀ víṭ ǀ su-vī́rā ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ astu ǀ sanā́t ǀ sáhantī ǀ púṣyantī ǀ nṛmṇám ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the people, through (the favours of) the Maruts, always victorious, possessed ofmaleposterity,and in the enjoyment of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May the people, through (the favours of) the Maruts, always victorious, possessed ofmaleposterity,and in the enjoyment of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यामं येष्ठाः शुभा शोभिष्ठाः श्रिया सम्मिश्ला ओजोभिरुग्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́mam ǀ yéṣṭhāḥ ǀ śubhā́ ǀ śóbhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ śriyā́ ǀ sám-miślāḥ ǀ ójaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Marutsrapidly repair to the plural ce (of their destination), richly decorated with ornaments, investedwith beauty, terrible by their strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The Marutsrapidly repair to the plural ce (of their destination), richly decorated with ornaments, investedwith beauty, terrible by their strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उग्रं व ओजः स्थिरा शवांस्यधा मरुद्भिर्गणस्तुविष्मान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ugrám ǀ vaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ sthirā́ ǀ śávāṃsi ǀ ádha ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ gaṇáḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Terrible be your strength, steadfast your energies, prosperous be the company of the Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: Terrible be your strength, steadfast your energies, prosperous be the company of the Maruts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुभ्रो वः शुष्मः क्रुध्मी मनांसि धुनिर्मुनिरिव शर्धस्य धृष्णोः ॥
verses.transliteration: śubhráḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ krúdhmī ǀ mánāṃsi ǀ dhúniḥ ǀ múniḥ-iva ǀ śárdhasya ǀ dhṛṣṇóḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorious is your vigour, unrelenting are your minds; (the exertion) of your irresistible force, the agitator(of the trees), is like (the manifold tone of the prayers of) amuni.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorious is your vigour, unrelenting are your minds; (the exertion) of your irresistible force, the agitator(of the trees), is like (the manifold tone of the prayers of) amuni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनेम्यस्मद्युयोत दिद्युं मा वो दुर्मतिरिह प्रणङ्नः ॥
verses.transliteration: sánemi ǀ asmát ǀ yuyóta ǀ didyúm ǀ mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ duḥ-matíḥ ǀ ihá ǀ práṇak ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Withhold from us your ancient blazing (weapon) let not your displeasure light upon us at this sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Withhold from us your ancient blazing (weapon) let not your displeasure light upon us at this sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रिया वो नाम हुवे तुराणामा यत्तृपन्मरुतो वावशानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: priyā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ huve ǀ turā́ṇām ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ tṛpát ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke your beloved names,Maruts, destroyers (of foes), that they who are desirous of the offeringmay be satisfied.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke your beloved names,Maruts, destroyers (of foes), that they who are desirous of the offeringmay be satisfied.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वायुधास इष्मिणः सुनिष्का उत स्वयं तन्वः शुंभमानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-āyudhā́saḥ ǀ iṣmíṇaḥ ǀ su-niṣkā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ svayám ǀ tanváḥ ǀ śúmbhamānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bearers are (the Maruts) of bright weapons, rapid are they in motion, wearers of brilliant ornaments,and self-radiators of their person ns.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearers are (the Maruts) of bright weapons, rapid are they in motion, wearers of brilliant ornaments,and self-radiators of their person ns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुची वो हव्या मरुतः शुचीनां शुचिं हिनोम्यध्वरं शुचिभ्यः ।ऋतेन सत्यमृतसाप आयंछुचिजन्मानः शुचयः पावकाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śúcī ǀ vaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śúcīnām ǀ śúcim ǀ hinomi ǀ adhvarám ǀ śúci-bhyaḥ ǀṛténa ǀ satyám ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ āyan ǀ śúci-janmānaḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure oblations be offered,Maruts, to you who are pure; the shedders of water proceed by truth to truth,pure, purifying, of pure birth.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure oblations be offered,Maruts, to you who are pure; the shedders of water proceed by truth to truth,pure, purifying, of pure birth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंसेष्वा मरुतः खादयो वो वक्षस्सु रुक्मा उपशिश्रियाणाः ।वि विद्युतो न वृष्टिभी रुचाना अनु स्वधामायुधैर्यच्छमानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: áṃseṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ khādáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vákṣaḥ-su ǀ rukmā́ḥ ǀ upa-śiśriyāṇā́ḥ ǀví ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ rucānā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ā́yudhaiḥ ǀ yácchamānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bright ornaments,Maruts, are on your shoulders, shining (necklaces) are pendant on your breasts,glittering with rain, like lightnings, you are distributing the waters with your weapons.
verses.wilson_translation: Bright ornaments,Maruts, are on your shoulders, shining (necklaces) are pendant on your breasts,glittering with rain, like lightnings, you are distributing the waters with your weapons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र बुध्न्या व ईरते महांसि प्र नामानि प्रयज्यवस्तिरध्वं ।सहस्रियं दम्यं भागमेतं गृहमेधीयं मरुतो जुषध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ budhnyā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ īrate ǀ máhāṃsi ǀ prá ǀ nā́māni ǀ pra-yajyavaḥ ǀ tiradhvam ǀsahasríyam ǀ dámyam ǀ bhāgám ǀ etám ǀ gṛha-medhī́yam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ juṣadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your celestial splendours,Maruts, spread wide; objects of worship, you send down (the waters) thatbeat down (the dust); accept Maruts, this your portion of the domestic worship of the household multiplied athousand-fold.
verses.wilson_translation: Your celestial splendours,Maruts, spread wide; objects of worship, you send down (the waters) thatbeat down (the dust); accept Maruts, this your portion of the domestic worship of the household multiplied athousand-fold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदि स्तुतस्य मरुतो अधीथेत्था विप्रस्य वाजिनो हवीमन् ।मक्षू रायः सुवीर्यस्य दात नू चिद्यमन्य आदभदरावा ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ stutásya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ adhi-ithá ǀ itthā́ ǀ víprasya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ hávīman ǀmakṣú ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ dāta ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ā-dábhat ǀ árāvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: If,Maruts, you justly appreciate the praise of the devout offerer of (sacrificial) food, conjoined withoblations, then promptly bestow (upon us) riches, comprehending excellentmaleposterity, such as no unfriendlyman can take away.
verses.wilson_translation: If,Maruts, you justly appreciate the praise of the devout offerer of (sacrificial) food, conjoined withoblations, then promptly bestow (upon us) riches, comprehending excellentmaleposterity, such as no unfriendlyman can take away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्यासो न ये मरुतः स्वंचो यक्षदृशो न शुभयंत मर्याः ।ते हर्म्येष्ठाः शिशवो न शुभ्रा वत्सासो न प्रक्रीळिनः पयोधाः ॥
verses.transliteration: átyāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yé ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-áñcaḥ ǀ yakṣa-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubháyanta ǀ máryāḥ ǀté ǀ harmye-sthā́ḥ ǀ śíśavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ vatsā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-krīḷínaḥ ǀ payaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The swift-moving Marutsare like rapid horses, shining like men gazing at a festival innocent as childrenin the (paternal) mansion, frolicsome as calves, they are the dispensers of water.
verses.wilson_translation: The swift-moving Marutsare like rapid horses, shining like men gazing at a festival innocent as childrenin the (paternal) mansion, frolicsome as calves, they are the dispensers of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दशस्यंतो नो मरुतो मृळंतु वरिवस्यंतो रोदसी सुमेके ।आरे गोहा नृहा वधो वो अस्तु सुम्नेभिरस्मे वसवो नमध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: daśasyántaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mṛḷantu ǀ varivasyántaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀāré ǀ go-hā́ ǀ nṛ-hā́ ǀ vadháḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ sumnébhiḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ namadhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the munificent Maruts, filling the beautiful heaven and earth with their glory, make us happy; yourfatal weapon, the render of clouds, the destroyer of men, be far from us; bend down to us,Vasus, with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May the munificent Maruts, filling the beautiful heaven and earth with their glory, make us happy; yourfatal weapon, the render of clouds, the destroyer of men, be far from us; bend down to us,Vasus, with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वो होता जोहवीति सत्तः सत्राचीं रातिं मरुतो गृणानः ।य ईवतो वृषणो अस्ति गोपाः सो अद्वयावी हवते व उक्थैः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ johavīti ǀ sattáḥ ǀ satrā́cī ǀ rātím ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ī́vataḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ádvayāvī ǀ havate ǀ vaḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praising your universal liberality,Maruts, the ministrant priest repeatedly worships you, seated (in thesacrificial chamber); he, showerers (of benefits), who is the guardian of the zealous (worshipper), he (the priest),who is void of insincerity, glorifies you with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Praising your universal liberality,Maruts, the ministrant priest repeatedly worships you, seated (in thesacrificial chamber); he, showerers (of benefits), who is the guardian of the zealous (worshipper), he (the priest),who is void of insincerity, glorifies you with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे तुरं मरुतो रामयंतीमे सहः सहस आ नमंति ।इमे शंसं वनुष्यतो नि पांति गुरु द्वेषो अररुषे दधंति ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ turám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ ramayanti ǀ imé ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ namanti ǀimé ǀ śáṃsam ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ ní ǀ pānti ǀ gurú ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ áraruṣe ǀ dadhanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: These,Maruts, give plural asure to the zealous (worshipper); these humble the strength of the strong man;they entertain severe displeasure towards the withholder of offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: These,Maruts, give plural asure to the zealous (worshipper); these humble the strength of the strong man;they entertain severe displeasure towards the withholder of offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे रध्रं चिन्मरुतो जुनंति भृमिं चिद्यथा वसवो जुषंत ।अप बाधध्वं वृषणस्तमांसि धत्त विश्वं तनयं तोकमस्मे ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ radhrám ǀ cit ǀ marútaḥ ǀ junanti ǀ bhṛ́mim ǀ cit ǀ yáthā ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀápa ǀ bādhadhvam ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ dhattá ǀ víśvam ǀ tánayam ǀ tokám ǀ asmé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: These,Maruts, encourage the prosperous man; they encourage the (poor) wanderer; they, as Vasus,are plural ased (with you); showerers (of benefits), dissipate the darkness; grant us many sons and grandsons.
verses.wilson_translation: These,Maruts, encourage the prosperous man; they encourage the (poor) wanderer; they, as Vasus,are plural ased (with you); showerers (of benefits), dissipate the darkness; grant us many sons and grandsons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा वो दात्रान्मरुतो निरराम मा पश्चाद्दघ्म रथ्यो विभागे ।आ नः स्पार्हे भजतना वसव्ये यदीं सुजातं वृषणो वो अस्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ dātrā́t ǀ marutaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ arāma ǀ mā́ ǀ paścā́t ǀ daghma ǀ rathyaḥ ǀ vi-bhāgé ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ spārhé ǀ bhajatana ǀ vasavyé ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ su-jātám ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ásti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Never,Maruts, may we be excluded from your bounty; let us not, lords of chariots, be last in itsapportionment; make us sharers in that desirable opulence which, showerers (of benefit), is born of you.
verses.wilson_translation: Never,Maruts, may we be excluded from your bounty; let us not, lords of chariots, be last in itsapportionment; make us sharers in that desirable opulence which, showerers (of benefit), is born of you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सं यद्धनंत मन्युभिर्जनासः शूरा यह्वीष्वोषधीषु विक्षु ।अध स्मा नो मरुतो रुद्रियासस्त्रातारो भूत पृतनास्वर्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ hánanta ǀ manyú-bhiḥ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ śū́rāḥ ǀ yahvī́ṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ rudriyāsaḥ ǀ trātā́raḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ aryáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When heroic men, filled with wrath, assemble for (the sake of conquering) many plural nts and people;then,Maruts, sons of Rudra, be our defenders in battles against our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: When heroic men, filled with wrath, assemble for (the sake of conquering) many plural nts and people;then,Maruts, sons of Rudra, be our defenders in battles against our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भूरि चक्र मरुतः पित्र्याण्युक्थानि या वः शस्यंते पुरा चित् ।मरुद्भिरुग्रः पृतनासु साळ्हा मरुद्भिरित्सनिता वाजमर्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ cakra ǀ marutaḥ ǀ pítryāṇi ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ yā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śasyánte ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sā́ḷhā ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ ít ǀ sánitā ǀ vā́jam ǀ árvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have bestowed,Maruts, many (benefits) on our forefathers, which praiseworthy (benefits) havebeen celebrated in former times; by the (favour of the) Maruts the fierce (warrior) is victorious in combats; by the(favour of the) Maruts the worshipper ever obtains food.
verses.wilson_translation: You have bestowed,Maruts, many (benefits) on our forefathers, which praiseworthy (benefits) havebeen celebrated in former times; by the (favour of the) Maruts the fierce (warrior) is victorious in combats; by the(favour of the) Maruts the worshipper ever obtains food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे वीरो मरुतः शुष्म्यस्तु जनानां यो असुरो विधर्ता ।अपो येन सुक्षितये तरेमाध स्वमोको अभि वः स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ vīráḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ astu ǀ jánānām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ vi-dhartā́ ǀapáḥ ǀ yéna ǀ su-kṣitáye ǀ tárema ǀ ádha ǀ svám ǀ ókaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: May ourmaleprogeny,Maruts, be vigorous, one who is intelligent, the scatterer of (hostile) men, bywhom we may cross the water (of enmity) to a secure dwelling; may we, your (servants), dwell in our own abode.
verses.wilson_translation: May ourmaleprogeny,Maruts, be vigorous, one who is intelligent, the scatterer of (hostile) men, bywhom we may cross the water (of enmity) to a secure dwelling; may we, your (servants), dwell in our own abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तन्न इंद्रो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निराप ओषधीर्वनिनो जुषंत ।शर्मन्त्स्याम मरुतामुपस्थे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀśárman ǀ syāma ǀ marútām ǀ upá-sthe ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra,Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, the waters, the plural nts, the trees, be plural ased with us; may we recline inhappiness upon the lap of the Maruts; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra,Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, the waters, the plural nts, the trees, be plural ased with us; may we recline inhappiness upon the lap of the Maruts; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVII. Maruts.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YEA, through the power of your sweet juice, ye Holy! the Marut host is glad at sacrifices.They cause even spacious heaven and earth to tremble, they make the spring flow when they come, the Mighty. The Maruts watch the man who sings their praises, promoters of the thought of him who worships.Seat you on sacred grass in our assembly, this day, with friendly minds, to share the banquet. No others gleam so brightly as these Maruts with their own forms, their golden gauds, their weapons.With all adornments, decking earth and heaven, they heighten, for bright show, their common splendour. Far from us be your blazing dart, O Maruts, when we, through human frailty, sin against you.Let us not he exposed to that, ye Holy! May your most loving favour still attend us. May even what we have done delight the Maruts, the blameless Ones, the bright, the purifying.Further us, O ye Holy, with your kindness: advance us mightily that we may prosper. And may the Maruts, praised by all their titles, Heroes, enjoy the taste of our oblations.Give us of Amṛta for the sake of offspring: awake the excellent fair stores of riches. Hither, ye Maruts, praised, with all your succours, with all felicity come to our princes,Who, of themselves, a hundredfold increase us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: मध्वो वो नाम मारुतं यजत्राः प्र यज्ञेषु शवसा मदंति ।ये रेजयंति रोदसी चिदुर्वी पिन्वंत्युत्सं यदयासुरुग्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ mā́rutam ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ prá ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ śávasā ǀ madanti ǀyé ǀ rejáyanti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ pínvanti ǀ útsam ǀ yát ǀ áyāsuḥ ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable (Maruts), the worshippers vigorously celebrate at sacrifices your appellation of company ofthe Maruts, they who cause the spacious heaven and earth to tremble, the clouds to rain, the move everywhereterrible.
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable (Maruts), the worshippers vigorously celebrate at sacrifices your appellation of company ofthe Maruts, they who cause the spacious heaven and earth to tremble, the clouds to rain, the move everywhereterrible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निचेतारो हि मरुतो गृणंतं प्रणेतारो यजमानस्य मन्म ।अस्माकमद्य विदथेषु बर्हिरा वीतये सदत पिप्रियाणाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ni-cetā́raḥ ǀ hí ǀ marútaḥ ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ pra-netā́raḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ mánma ǀasmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vītáye ǀ sadata ǀ pipriyāṇā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Marutsverily are the benefactors of him who praises them, the gratifiers of the wishes of theinstitutor of the solemnity; do you, being plural ased, sit down today upon the grass at our ceremony, to partake (ofthe sacrificial food).
verses.wilson_translation: The Marutsverily are the benefactors of him who praises them, the gratifiers of the wishes of theinstitutor of the solemnity; do you, being plural ased, sit down today upon the grass at our ceremony, to partake (ofthe sacrificial food).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नैतावदन्ये मरुतो यथेमे भ्राजंते रुक्मैरायुधैस्तनूभिः ।आ रोदसी विश्वपिशः पिशानाः समानमंज्यंजते शुभे कं ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ etā́vat ǀ anyé ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ imé ǀ bhrā́jante ǀ rukmáiḥ ǀ ā́yudhaiḥ ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viśva-píśaḥ ǀ piśānā́ḥ ǀ samānám ǀ añjí ǀ añjate ǀ śubhé ǀ kám ǁ
verses.english_translation: No other (deities give) such (good things) as the Maruts, as they shine with brilliant (ornaments),weapons and person ns; illumining heaven and earth, wide-radiating, they heighten their common lustre for (our)good.
verses.wilson_translation: No other (deities give) such (good things) as the Maruts, as they shine with brilliant (ornaments),weapons and person ns; illumining heaven and earth, wide-radiating, they heighten their common lustre for (our)good.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋधक्सा वो मरुतो दिद्युदस्तु यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम ।मा वस्तस्यामपि भूमा यजत्रा अस्मे वो अस्तु सुमतिश्चनिष्ठा ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛ́dhak ǀ sā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ didyút ǀ astu ǀ yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ puruṣátā ǀ kárāma ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ tásyām ǀ ápi ǀ bhūma ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ cániṣṭhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that blazing (weapon) of your,Maruts, be far from us, although, through human infirmities, we offeryou offence; let us not, adorable Maruts, be exposed to your (shaft); may your favour the source of abundance,ever be shown to us.
verses.wilson_translation: May that blazing (weapon) of your,Maruts, be far from us, although, through human infirmities, we offeryou offence; let us not, adorable Maruts, be exposed to your (shaft); may your favour the source of abundance,ever be shown to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कृते चिदत्र मरुतो रणंतानवद्यासः शुचयः पावकाः ।प्र णोऽवत सुमतिभिर्यजत्राः प्र वाजेभिस्तिरत पुष्यसे नः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛté ǀ cit ǀ átra ǀ marútaḥ ǀ raṇanta ǀ anavadyā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ avata ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ prá ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ tirata ǀ puṣyáse ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Maruts, who are irreproachable, pure, and purifying, delight in this our ceremony; protect us,adorable Maruts, with favourable thoughts; be ever anxious to sustain us with food.
verses.wilson_translation: May the Maruts, who are irreproachable, pure, and purifying, delight in this our ceremony; protect us,adorable Maruts, with favourable thoughts; be ever anxious to sustain us with food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्तुतासो मरुतो व्यंतु विश्वेभिर्नामभिर्नरो हवींषि ।ददात नो अमृतस्य प्रजायै जिगृत रायः सूनृता मघानि ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vyantu ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀdádāta ǀ naḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ jigṛtá ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ maghā́ni ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the glorified Marutspartake of the oblations, they who, accompanied by the bending waters, arethe leaders of rites; bestow water, Maruts, upon our progeny, return suitable opulence for (the donation ofsacrificial) riches.
verses.wilson_translation: May the glorified Marutspartake of the oblations, they who, accompanied by the bending waters, arethe leaders of rites; bestow water, Maruts, upon our progeny, return suitable opulence for (the donation ofsacrificial) riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ स्तुतासो मरुतो विश्व ऊती अच्छा सूरीन्त्सर्वताता जिगात ।ये नस्त्मना शतिनो वर्धयंति यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ūtī́ ǀ áccha ǀ sūrī́n ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ jigāta ǀyé ǀ naḥ ǀ tmánā ǀ śatínaḥ ǀ vardháyanti ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorified Maruts, do you all come at the time of sacrifice to the presence of the worshippers along withyour protections, for you are they who, of your own will, multiply our hundreds; do you ever cherish us withblessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorified Maruts, do you all come at the time of sacrifice to the presence of the worshippers along withyour protections, for you are they who, of your own will, multiply our hundreds; do you ever cherish us withblessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVIII. Maruts.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING to the troop that pours down rain in common, the Mighty Company of celestial nature.They make the world-halves tremble with their greatness: from depths of earth and sky they reach to heaven. Yea, your birth, Maruts, was with wild commotion, ye who move swiftly, fierce in wrath, terrific.Ye all-surpassing in your might and vigour, each looker on the light fears at your coming. Give ample vital power unto our princes let our fair praises gratify the Maruts.As the way travelled helpeth people onward, so further us with your delightful succours. Your favoured singer counts his wealth by hundreds: the strong steed whom ye favour wins a thousand.The Sovran whom ye aid destroys the foeman. May this your gift, ye Shakers, be distinguished. I call, as such, the Sons of bounteous Rudra: will not the Maruts turn again to us-ward?What secret sin or open stirs their anger, that we implore the Swift Ones to forgive us. This eulogy of the Bounteous hath been spoken: accept, ye Maruts, this our hymn of praises.Ye Bulls, keep those who hate us at a distance. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्र साकमुक्षे अर्चता गणाय यो दैव्यस्य धाम्नस्तुविष्मान् ।उत क्षोदंति रोदसी महित्वा नक्षंते नाकं निर्ऋतेरवंशात् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sākam-úkṣe ǀ arcata ǀ gaṇā́ya ǀ yáḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǀ dhā́mnaḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀutá ǀ kṣodanti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ nákṣante ǀ nā́kam ǀ níḥ-ṛteḥ ǀ avaṃśā́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer worship to the company (of the Maruts), the associated dispensers of moisture, which is powerfulover the celestial region; the Maruts, by their greatness, oppress both heaven and earth; they spread from theearth and the firmament to heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer worship to the company (of the Maruts), the associated dispensers of moisture, which is powerfulover the celestial region; the Maruts, by their greatness, oppress both heaven and earth; they spread from theearth and the firmament to heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जनूश्चिद्वो मरुतस्त्वेष्येण भीमासस्तुविमन्यवोऽयासः ।प्र ये महोभिरोजसोत संति विश्वो वो यामन्भयते स्वर्दृक् ॥
verses.transliteration: janū́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ tveṣyéṇa ǀ bhī́māsaḥ ǀ túvi-manyavaḥ ǀ áyāsaḥ ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ utá ǀ sánti ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ bhayate ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́k ǁ
verses.english_translation: Formidable, high-spirited, quick-moving Maruts, your birth is from the illustrious Rudra; every gazer onthe sun is alarmed with the course of you who are pre-eminent in lustre and strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Formidable, high-spirited, quick-moving Maruts, your birth is from the illustrious Rudra; every gazer onthe sun is alarmed with the course of you who are pre-eminent in lustre and strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्वयो मघवद्भ्यो दधात जुजोषन्निन्मरुतः सुष्टुतिं नः ।गतो नाध्वा वि तिराति जंतुं प्र णः स्पार्हाभिरूतिभिस्तिरेत ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ dadhāta ǀ jújoṣan ǀ ít ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-stutím ǀ naḥ ǀgatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ ádhvā ǀ ví ǀ tirāti ǀ jantúm ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ spārhā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ tireta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant,Maruts, to us who are affluent (in sacrificial offering) abundant food; accept complacently ourearnest praise; the path you follow is not hurtful to living beings; may it increase our (prosperity) by (your)desirable protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant,Maruts, to us who are affluent (in sacrificial offering) abundant food; accept complacently ourearnest praise; the path you follow is not hurtful to living beings; may it increase our (prosperity) by (your)desirable protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युष्मोतो विप्रो मरुतः शतस्वी युष्मोतो अर्वा सहुरिः सहस्री ।युष्मोतः सम्राळुत हंति वृत्रं प्र तद्वो अस्तु धूतयो देष्णं ॥
verses.transliteration: yuṣmā́-ūtaḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śatasvī́ ǀ yuṣmā́-ūtaḥ ǀ árvā ǀ sáhuriḥ ǀ sahasrī́ ǀyuṣmā́-ūtaḥ ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ utá ǀ hanti ǀ vṛtrám ǀ prá ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀ deṣṇám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pious man protected,Maruts, by you, is the possessor of hundreds; the assailant, overcomer (ofhis foes), protected by you, is the possessor of thousands; protected by you, the emperor slays his enemy; maythe wealth that is given, agitators, by you ever be abundant.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious man protected,Maruts, by you, is the possessor of hundreds; the assailant, overcomer (ofhis foes), protected by you, is the possessor of thousands; protected by you, the emperor slays his enemy; maythe wealth that is given, agitators, by you ever be abundant.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ताँ आ रुद्रस्य मीळ्हुषो विवासे कुविन्नंसंते मरुतः पुनर्नः ।यत्सस्वर्ता जिहीळिरे यदाविरव तदेन ईमहे तुराणां ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ rudrásya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ vivāse ǀ kuvít ǀ náṃsante ǀ marútaḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀyát ǀ sasvártā ǀ jihīḷiré ǀ yát ǀ āvíḥ ǀ áva ǀ tát ǀ énaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ turā́ṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: I adore those sons of the showerer,Rudra; may the Maruts, repeatedly invoked, again come to us; maywe expiate (by praise) whatever we have committed secretly or openly against the swift-moving Maruts, by whichthey are displeased.
verses.wilson_translation: I adore those sons of the showerer,Rudra; may the Maruts, repeatedly invoked, again come to us; maywe expiate (by praise) whatever we have committed secretly or openly against the swift-moving Maruts, by whichthey are displeased.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सा वाचि सुष्टुतिर्मघोनामिदं सूक्तं मरुतो जुषंत ।आराच्चिद्द्वेषो वृषणो युयोत यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sā́ ǀ vāci ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ maghónām ǀ idám ǀ su-uktám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀārā́t ǀ cit ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ yuyota ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pious praise of the opulent Marutshas been recited; may the Maruts be gratified by this hymn;remove far from us, showerers (of benefits), those who hate us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious praise of the opulent Marutshas been recited; may the Maruts be gratified by this hymn;remove far from us, showerers (of benefits), those who hate us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LIX. Maruts.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHOMSO ye rescue here and there, whomso ye guide, O Deities,To him give shelter, Agni, Mitra, Varuṇa, ye Maruts, and thou Aryaman. Through your kind favour, Gods, on some auspicious day, the worshipper subdues his foes.That man increases home and strengthening ample food who brings you offerings as ye list. Vasiṣṭha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all.O Maruts, of our Soma juice effused to-day drink all of you with eager haste. Your succour in the battle injures not the man to whom ye, Heroes, grant your gifts.May your most recent favour turn to us again. Come quickly, ye who fain would drink. Come hitherward to drink the juice, O ye whose bounties give you joy.These offerings are for you, these, Maruts, I present. Go not to any place but this. Sit on our sacred grass, be graciously inclined to give the wealth for which we long,To take delight, ye Maruts, Friends of all, with Svāhā, in sweet Soma juice. Decking the beauty of their forms in secret the Swans with purple backs have flown down hither.Around me all the Company hath settled, like joyous Heroes glad in our libation. Maruts, the man whose wrath is hard to master, he who would slay us ere we think, O Vasus,May he be tangled in the toils of mischief; smite ye him down with your most flaming weapon. O Maruts, ye consuming Gods, enjoy this offering brought for you,To help us, ye who slay the foe. Sharers of household sacrifice, come, Maruts, stay not far away,That ye may help us, Bounteous Ones. Here, Self-strong Maruts, yea, even here. ye Sages with your sunbright skinsI dedicate your sacrifice. Tryambaka we worship, sweet augmenter of prosperity.As from its stem the cucumber, so may I be released from death, not reft of immortality.

verses.sanskrit: यं त्रायध्व इदमिदं देवासो यं च नयथ ।तस्मा अग्ने वरुण मित्रार्यमन्मरुतः शर्म यच्छत ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ trā́yadhve ǀ idám-idam ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ca ǀ náyatha ǀtásmai ǀ agne ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀ márutaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni,Varuṇa,Mitra,Maruts, grant happiness, gods, to him whom you preserve from (the perils of) this(world), whom you guide here (to the paths of virtue).
verses.wilson_translation: Agni,Varuṇa,Mitra,Maruts, grant happiness, gods, to him whom you preserve from (the perils of) this(world), whom you guide here (to the paths of virtue).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युष्माकं देवा अवसाहनि प्रिय ईजानस्तरति द्विषः ।प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति ॥
verses.transliteration: yuṣmā́kam ǀ devāḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ áhani ǀ priyé ǀ ījānáḥ ǀ tarati ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀprá ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyam ǀ tirate ǀ ví ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ várāya ǀ dā́śati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Through your protection, gods, the man who worships on an auspicious day overcomes hisadversaries; he who offers abundant (sacrificial) food to you to detain you (at his rite) enlarges his habitation.
verses.wilson_translation: Through your protection, gods, the man who worships on an auspicious day overcomes hisadversaries; he who offers abundant (sacrificial) food to you to detain you (at his rite) enlarges his habitation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि वश्चरमं चन वसिष्ठः परिमंसते ।अस्माकमद्य मरुतः सुते सचा विश्वे पिबत कामिनः ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ vaḥ ǀ caramám ǀ caná ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ pari-máṃsate ǀasmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ marutaḥ ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ víśve ǀ pibata ǀ kāmínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vasiṣṭhaoverlooks not the very lowest among you;Maruts, who are desirous (of the libation), do youall drink together today of our effused Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Vasiṣṭhaoverlooks not the very lowest among you;Maruts, who are desirous (of the libation), do youall drink together today of our effused Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि व ऊतिः पृतनासु मर्धति यस्मा अराध्वं नरः ।अभि व आवर्त्सुमतिर्नवीयसी तूयं यात पिपीषवः ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ márdhati ǀ yásmai ǀ árādhvam ǀ naraḥ ǀabhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ avart ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ návīyasī ǀ tū́yam ǀ yāta ǀ pipīṣavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your protection, leaders (of rites), yields no detriment to him whom you defend in battles; may yourlatest favour return to us; come quickly, eager to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Your protection, leaders (of rites), yields no detriment to him whom you defend in battles; may yourlatest favour return to us; come quickly, eager to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ओ षु घृष्विराधसो यातनांधांसि पीतये ।इमा वो हव्या मरुतो ररे हि कं मो ष्वन्यत्र गंतन ॥
verses.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ ghṛṣvi-rādhasaḥ ǀ yātána ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ pītáye ǀimā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ raré ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ mó íti ǀ sú ǀ anyátra ǀ gantana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you whose riches are connected together come to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, for Maruts, Ioffer to you these oblations, therefore go not away to any other (sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Do you whose riches are connected together come to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, for Maruts, Ioffer to you these oblations, therefore go not away to any other (sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ च नो बर्हिः सदताविता च नः स्पार्हाणि दातवे वसु ।अस्रेधंतो मरुतः सोम्ये मधौ स्वाहेह मादयाध्वै ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sádata ǀ avitá ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ spārhā́ṇi ǀ dā́tave ǀ vásu ǀásredhantaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ somyé ǀ mádhau ǀ svā́hā ǀ ihá ǀ mādayādhve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sit down on our sacred grass; come to bestow upon us desirable riches; doing no harm,Marutsdelightin the sweet Somalibation presented at this season.
verses.wilson_translation: Sit down on our sacred grass; come to bestow upon us desirable riches; doing no harm,Marutsdelightin the sweet Somalibation presented at this season.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सस्वश्चिद्धि तन्वः शुंभमाना आ हंसासो नीलपृष्ठा अपप्तन् ।विश्वं शर्धो अभितो मा नि षेद नरो न रण्वाः सवने मदंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sasváríti ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tanváḥ ǀ śúmbhamānāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ haṃsā́saḥ ǀ nī́la-pṛṣṭhāḥ ǀ apaptan ǀvíśvam ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ mā ǀ ní ǀ seda ǀ náraḥ ǀ ná ǀ raṇvā́ḥ ǀ sávane ǀ mádantaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Marutsyet unrevealed, decorating their person ns, descend like black-backed swans; let theentire company gather round me like happy men rejoicing together at a solemn rite.
verses.wilson_translation: May the Marutsyet unrevealed, decorating their person ns, descend like black-backed swans; let theentire company gather round me like happy men rejoicing together at a solemn rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो नो मरुतो अभि दुर्हृणायुस्तिरश्चित्तानि वसवो जिघांसति ।द्रुहः पाशान्प्रति स मुचीष्ट तपिष्ठेन हन्मना हंतना तं ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ duḥ-hṛṇāyúḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ cittā́ni ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀdruháḥ ǀ pā́śān ǀ práti ǀ sáḥ ǀ mucīṣṭa ǀ tápiṣṭhena ǀ hánmanā ǀ hantana ǀ tám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man,Maruts, who wounds our feelings, he who, rebuked by all, yet seeks,Vasus, to kill us, hewoudl bind us in the wounds of (Varuṇa), the avenger (of iniquity), such a man do you destroy with a consumingfatal weapon.
verses.wilson_translation: The man,Maruts, who wounds our feelings, he who, rebuked by all, yet seeks,Vasus, to kill us, hewoudl bind us in the wounds of (Varuṇa), the avenger (of iniquity), such a man do you destroy with a consumingfatal weapon.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सांतपना इदं हविर्मरुतस्तज्जुजुष्टन ।युष्माकोती रिशादसः ॥
verses.transliteration: sā́m-tapanāḥ ǀ idám ǀ havíḥ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ tát ǀ jujuṣṭana ǀyuṣmā́ka ǀ ūtī́ ǀ riśādasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, desroyers of foes, this oblaion is designed for you; do you, who are the devourers of enemies,(coming) with your protections, graciously accept it.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, desroyers of foes, this oblaion is designed for you; do you, who are the devourers of enemies,(coming) with your protections, graciously accept it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गृहमेधास आ गत मरुतो माप भूतन ।युष्माकोती सुदानवः ॥
verses.transliteration: gṛ́ha-medhāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ márutaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápa ǀ bhūtana ǀyuṣmā́ka ǀ ūtī́ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Objects of domestic worship, munificent Maruts, come with your protections; go not away.
verses.wilson_translation: Objects of domestic worship, munificent Maruts, come with your protections; go not away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इहेह वः स्वतवसः कवयः सूर्यत्वचः ।यज्ञं मरुत आ वृणे ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá-iha ǀ vaḥ ǀ sva-tavasaḥ ǀ kávayaḥ ǀ sū́rya-tvacaḥ ǀyajñám ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, of independent strength, who are far-seeing, glorious as the sun, come hither, come hither, Iinvoke you to the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, of independent strength, who are far-seeing, glorious as the sun, come hither, come hither, Iinvoke you to the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यंबकं यजामहे सुगंधिं पुष्टिवर्धनं ।उर्वारुकमिव बंधनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
verses.transliteration: trí-ambakam ǀ yajāmahe ǀ su-gándhim ǀ puṣṭi-várdhanam ǀurvārukám-iva ǀ bándhanāt ǀ mṛtyóḥ ǀ mukṣīya ǀ mā́ ǀ amṛ́tāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: We worship Tryambaka, whose fame is fragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated fromdeath, and, like theurvārukafrom its stalk, but not to immortality; let us worship Trayambaka, whose fame isfragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated from death like the urvāruka from its stalk, but not untoimmortality.
verses.wilson_translation: We worship Tryambaka, whose fame is fragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated fromdeath, and, like theurvārukafrom its stalk, but not to immortality; let us worship Trayambaka, whose fame isfragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated from death like the urvāruka from its stalk, but not untoimmortality.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LX. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHEN thou, O Sun, this day, arising sinless, shalt speak the truth to Varuṇa and Mitra,O Aditi, may all the Deities love us, and thou, O Aryaman, while we are singing. Looking on man, O Varuṇa and Mitra, this Sun ascendeth up by both the pathways,Guardian of all things fixt, of all that moveth, beholding good and evil acts of mortals. He from their home hath yoked the Seven gold Coursers who, dropping oil and fatness, carry Sūrya.Yours, Varuṇa and Mitra, he surveyeth the worlds and living creatures like a herdsman. Your coursers rich in store of sweets have mounted: to the bright ocean Sūrya hath ascended,For whom the Ādityas make his pathway ready, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa, accordant. For these, even Aryaman, Varuṇa and Mitra, are the chastisers of all guile and falsehood.These, Aditi's Sons, infallible and mighty, have waxen in the home of law Eternal. These, Mitra, Varuṇa whom none deceiveth, with great power quicken even the fool to wisdom,And, wakening, moreover, thoughtful insight, lead it by easy paths o’er grief and trouble. They ever vigilant, with eyes that close not, caring for heaven and earth, lead on the thoughtless.Even in the river's bed there is a shallow. across this broad expanse may they conduct us. When Aditi and Varuṇa and Mitra, like guardians, give Sudās their friendly shelter,Granting him sons and lineal succession, let us not, bold ones! move the Gods to anger. May he with ofierings purify the altar from any stains of Varuṇa's reviler.Aryaman save us us all those who hate us: give room and freedom to Sudās, ye Mighty. Hid from our eyes is their resplendent meeting: by their mysterious might they hold dominion.Heroes! we cry trembling in fear before you, even in the greatness of your power have mercy. He who wins favour for his prayer by worship, that he may gain him strength and highest riches,That good man's mind the Mighty Ones will follow: they have brought comfort to his spacious dwelling. This priestly task, Gods! Varuṇa and Mitra! hath been performed for you at sacrifices.Convey us safely over every peril. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर्य ब्रवोऽनागा उद्यन्मित्राय वरुणाय सत्यं ।वयं देवत्रादिते स्याम तव प्रियासो अर्यमन्गृणंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sūrya ǀ brávaḥ ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀ ut-yán ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ satyám ǀvayám ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ adite ǀ syāma ǀ táva ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ aryaman ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sūrya, when rising today, declare the truḥ to Mitraand Varuṇa, that we are void of sin; may we,Aditi,be (approved of) among the gods; praising you,Aryaman, may we be dear to you.
verses.wilson_translation: Sūrya, when rising today, declare the truḥ to Mitraand Varuṇa, that we are void of sin; may we,Aditi,be (approved of) among the gods; praising you,Aryaman, may we be dear to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य मित्रावरुणा नृचक्षा उभे उदेति सूर्यो अभि ज्मन् ।विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च गोपा ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ út ǀ eti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ jmán ǀvíśvasya ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ ca ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ṛjú ǀ márteṣu ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ ca ǀ páśyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Sūrya, the beholder of man, rises,Mitraand Varuṇa, upon both (heaven and earth), moving (inthe sky); he who is the preserver of all that is stationary or moveable, witnessing the upright acts or the sins ofmortals.
verses.wilson_translation: This Sūrya, the beholder of man, rises,Mitraand Varuṇa, upon both (heaven and earth), moving (inthe sky); he who is the preserver of all that is stationary or moveable, witnessing the upright acts or the sins ofmortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्त सप्त हरितः सधस्थाद्या ईं वहंति सूर्यं घृताचीः ।धामानि मित्रावरुणा युवाकुः सं यो यूथेव जनिमानि चष्टे ॥
verses.transliteration: áyukta ǀ saptá ǀ harítaḥ ǀ sadhá-sthāt ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ váhanti ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ghṛtā́cīḥ ǀdhā́māni ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǀ sám ǀ yáḥ ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ jánimāni ǀ cáṣṭe ǁ
verses.english_translation: He has harnessed his seven bay steeds,Mitraand Varuṇa, (to come) from your commondwelling-plural ce, (the firmament); the horses that, shedding water, convey that Sūryawho, friendly to you both,(contemplates all) regions, and looks carefully upon living creatures as (a herdsman) upon the herd.
verses.wilson_translation: He has harnessed his seven bay steeds,Mitraand Varuṇa, (to come) from your commondwelling-plural ce, (the firmament); the horses that, shedding water, convey that Sūryawho, friendly to you both,(contemplates all) regions, and looks carefully upon living creatures as (a herdsman) upon the herd.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उद्वां पृक्षासो मधुमंतो अस्थुरा सूर्यो अरुहच्छुक्रमर्णः ।यस्मा आदित्या अध्वनो रदंति मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सजोषाः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ vām ǀ pṛkṣā́saḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ aruhat ǀ śukrám ǀ árṇaḥ ǀyásmai ǀ ādityā́ḥ ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ rádanti ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For yo, (Mitraand Varuṇa), the sweet-flavoured viands have been prepared; the sun has ascended theshining firmament, for whom theĀdityasand the consentient Mitra, Varuṇa,Aryamanmake ready paths.
verses.wilson_translation: For yo, (Mitraand Varuṇa), the sweet-flavoured viands have been prepared; the sun has ascended theshining firmament, for whom theĀdityasand the consentient Mitra, Varuṇa,Aryamanmake ready paths.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे चेतारो अनृतस्य भूरेर्मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो हि संति ।इम ऋतस्य वावृधुर्दुरोणे शग्मासः पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धाः ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ cetā́raḥ ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sánti ǀimé ǀ ṛtásya ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ śagmā́saḥ ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ádabdhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These (deities),Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇa, are the detecters of much untruth; these unconquered sons of Aditi, dispensers of happiness, are magnified in the hall of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: These (deities),Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇa, are the detecters of much untruth; these unconquered sons of Aditi, dispensers of happiness, are magnified in the hall of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे मित्रो वरुणो दूळभासोऽचेतसं चिच्चितयंति दक्षैः ।अपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतंतस्तिरश्चिदंहः सुपथा नयंति ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ duḥ-dábhāsaḥ ǀ acetásam ǀ cit ǀ citayanti ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀápi ǀ krátum ǀ su-cétasam ǀ vátantaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ su-páthā ǀ nayanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: These, the unsubdued Mitra,Varuṇaand Aryaman, animate with energies the unconscious (sleepers);repairing tot he intelligent performer (of pious acts), they lead (him), by safe pahs (to heaven), removing alliniquity.
verses.wilson_translation: These, the unsubdued Mitra,Varuṇaand Aryaman, animate with energies the unconscious (sleepers);repairing tot he intelligent performer (of pious acts), they lead (him), by safe pahs (to heaven), removing alliniquity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे दिवो अनिमिषा पृथिव्याश्चिकित्वांसो अचेतसं नयंति ।प्रव्राजे चिन्नद्यो गाधमस्ति पारं नो अस्य विष्पितस्य पर्षन् ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ diváḥ ǀ áni-miṣā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ cikitvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ acetásam ǀ nayanti ǀpra-vrājé ǀ cit ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ gādhám ǀ asti ǀ pārám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ viṣpitásya ǀ parṣan ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Beholding) with unclosing eyes, and cognizant (of the things) of heaven and earth, they conduct theignorant man (to duty); in the lowes depth of the river, (through them), there is a bottom; may they lead us to theopposite shore of the vast expanse.
verses.wilson_translation: (Beholding) with unclosing eyes, and cognizant (of the things) of heaven and earth, they conduct theignorant man (to duty); in the lowes depth of the river, (through them), there is a bottom; may they lead us to theopposite shore of the vast expanse.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्गोपावददितिः शर्म भद्रं मित्रो यच्छंति वरुणः सुदासे ।तस्मिन्ना तोकं तनयं दधाना मा कर्म देवहेळनं तुरासः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ gopā́vat ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ bhadrám ǀ mitráḥ ǀ yácchanti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀtásmin ǀ ā́ ǀ tokám ǀ tánayam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ karma ǀ deva-héḷanam ǀ turāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Including our sons and grandsons in that preserving and auspicious felicity which Aditi,Mitraand Varuṇa confer upon the liberal donor (of the oblation), may we never, acting precipitately, incur the displeasureof the deities.
verses.wilson_translation: Including our sons and grandsons in that preserving and auspicious felicity which Aditi,Mitraand Varuṇa confer upon the liberal donor (of the oblation), may we never, acting precipitately, incur the displeasureof the deities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव वेदिं होत्राभिर्यजेत रिपः काश्चिद्वरुणध्रुतः सः ।परि द्वेषोभिरर्यमा वृणक्तूरुं सुदासे वृषणा उ लोकं ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ védim ǀ hótrābhiḥ ǀ yajeta ǀ rípaḥ ǀ kā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ varuṇa-dhrútaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀpári ǀ dvéṣaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ vṛṇaktu ǀ urúm ǀ su-dā́se ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let my adversary desecrate the altar by (ill-expressed) praises; repelled by Varuṇa, may he (undergo)various sufferings; may Aryamandefend us from those who hate us; confer, showerers (of benefits), a vastregion upon the liberal donor (of oblations).
verses.wilson_translation: Let my adversary desecrate the altar by (ill-expressed) praises; repelled by Varuṇa, may he (undergo)various sufferings; may Aryamandefend us from those who hate us; confer, showerers (of benefits), a vastregion upon the liberal donor (of oblations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सस्वश्चिद्धि समृतिस्त्वेष्येषामपीच्येन सहसा सहंते ।युष्मद्भिया वृषणो रेजमाना दक्षस्य चिन्महिना मृळता नः ॥
verses.transliteration: sasváríti ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ sám-ṛtiḥ ǀ tveṣī́ ǀ eṣām ǀ apīcyéna ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhante ǀyuṣmát ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ réjamānāḥ ǀ dákṣasya ǀ cit ǀ mahinā́ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The association of these (three deities) is of mysterious lustre; by their secret strength they overcome(all enemies); showerers (of benefits), through fear (of you our opponents) are trembling; have mercy upon us inthe mightiness of your strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The association of these (three deities) is of mysterious lustre; by their secret strength they overcome(all enemies); showerers (of benefits), through fear (of you our opponents) are trembling; have mercy upon us inthe mightiness of your strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो ब्रह्मणे सुमतिमायजाते वाजस्य सातौ परमस्य रायः ।सीक्षंत मन्युं मघवानो अर्य उरु क्षयाय चक्रिरे सुधातु ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ su-matím ǀ ā-yájāte ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáu ǀ paramásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀsī́kṣanta ǀ manyúm ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ urú ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ cakrire ǀ su-dhā́tu ǁ
verses.english_translation: These munificent (deities) conjointly accept the praise of the worshipper, and bestow a spaciousmansion for a dwelling upon him who, for the sake of food and excellent riches, devotes his mind to yourglorification.
verses.wilson_translation: These munificent (deities) conjointly accept the praise of the worshipper, and bestow a spaciousmansion for a dwelling upon him who, for the sake of food and excellent riches, devotes his mind to yourglorification.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं देव पुरोहितिर्युवभ्यां यज्ञेषु मित्रावरुणावकारि ।विश्वानि दुर्गा पिपृतं तिरो नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ devā ǀ puráḥ-hitiḥ ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ akāri ǀvíśvāni ǀ duḥ-gā́ ǀ pipṛtam ǀ tiráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Excellent Mitraand Varuṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Excellent Mitraand Varuṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXI. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O VARUNA and Mitra, Sūrya spreading the beauteous light of you Twain Gods ariseth.He who beholdetb all existing creatures observetb well the zeal that is in mortals. The holy sage, renowned afar, directeth his hymns to you, O Varuṇa and Mitra,—He whose devotions, sapient Gods, ye favour so that ye fill, as ’twere, with power his autumns. From the wide earth, O Varuṇa and Mitra from the great lofty heaven, ye, Bounteous Givers, -Have in the fields and houses set your warder-, who visit every spot and watch unceasing. I praise the strength of Varuṇa and Mitra that strength, by mightiness, keeps both worlds asunder.Heroless pass the months of the ungodly he who loves sacrifice makes his home enduring. Steers, all infallible are these your people in whom no wondrous thing is seen, no worship.Guile follows close the men who are untruthful: no secrets may be hidden from your knowledge. I will exalt your sacrifice with homage: as priest, I, Mitra-Varuṇa, invoke you.May these new hymns and prayers that I have fashioned delight you to the profit of the singer. This priestly task, Gods! Varuṇa and Mitra! hath been performed for you at sacrifices.Convey us safely over every peril. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वां चक्षुर्वरुण सुप्रतीकं देवयोरेति सूर्यस्ततन्वान् ।अभि यो विश्वा भुवनानि चष्टे स मन्युं मर्त्येष्वा चिकेत ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ vām ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ varuṇā ǀ su-prátīkam ǀ deváyoḥ ǀ eti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ tatanvā́n ǀabhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ cáṣṭe ǀ sáḥ ǀ manyúm ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ciketa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Spreading arond the beautiful light,Mitraand Varuṇa, of you two divinities,Sūryarises; he whobeholds all existing beings apprehends the acts of mortals.
verses.wilson_translation: Spreading arond the beautiful light,Mitraand Varuṇa, of you two divinities,Sūryarises; he whobeholds all existing beings apprehends the acts of mortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वां स मित्रावरुणावृतावा विप्रो मन्मानि दीर्घश्रुदियर्ति ।यस्य ब्रह्माणि सुक्रतू अवाथ आ यत्क्रत्वा न शरदः पृणैथे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ sáḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ vípraḥ ǀ mánmāni ǀ dīrgha-śrút ǀ iyarti ǀyásya ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ sukratū íti su-kratū ǀ ávāthaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ krátvā ǀ ná ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ pṛṇáithe íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage, the solemnizer of sacrifice, the ancient hearer (of holy prayer), earnestly repeats,Mitraand Varuṇa, your praises; he whose prayers, doers of good deeds, you favour, whose acts (of worship) yourecompense not for years.
verses.wilson_translation: The sage, the solemnizer of sacrifice, the ancient hearer (of holy prayer), earnestly repeats,Mitraand Varuṇa, your praises; he whose prayers, doers of good deeds, you favour, whose acts (of worship) yourecompense not for years.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रोरोर्मित्रावरुणा पृथिव्याः प्र दिव ऋष्वाद्बृहतः सुदानू ।स्पशो दधाथे ओषधीषु विक्ष्वृधग्यतो अनिमिषं रक्षमाणा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ uróḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ diváḥ ǀ ṛṣvā́t ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀspáśaḥ ǀ dadhāthe íti ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ yatáḥ ǀ áni-miṣam ǀ rákṣamāṇā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are vaster,Mitraand Varuṇa, than the ample earth, vaster, bounteous donors, than the gloriousand expansive heaven; you maintain beauty in plural nts and in people, diligent observers of truth, and vigilantlyprotecting (us).
verses.wilson_translation: You are vaster,Mitraand Varuṇa, than the ample earth, vaster, bounteous donors, than the gloriousand expansive heaven; you maintain beauty in plural nts and in people, diligent observers of truth, and vigilantlyprotecting (us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शंसा मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम शुष्मो रोदसी बद्बधे महित्वा ।अयन्मासा अयज्वनामवीराः प्र यज्ञमन्मा वृजनं तिराते ॥
verses.transliteration: śáṃsa ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ badbadhe ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀáyan ǀ mā́sāḥ ǀ áyajvanām ǀ avī́rāḥ ǀ prá ǀ yajñá-manmā ǀ vṛjánam ǀ tirāte ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise the splendour of Mitraand Varuṇa, whose strength, by its might, keeps heaven and earthasunder; may the days of those who differ not worship pass withoutmaledescendants; amy he who delights insacrifice increase in prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise the splendour of Mitraand Varuṇa, whose strength, by its might, keeps heaven and earthasunder; may the days of those who differ not worship pass withoutmaledescendants; amy he who delights insacrifice increase in prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमूरा विश्वा वृषणाविमा वां न यासु चित्रं ददृशे न यक्षं ।द्रुहः सचंते अनृता जनानां न वां निण्यान्यचिते अभूवन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ámūrā ǀ víśvā ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ vām ǀ ná ǀ yā́su ǀ citrám ǀ dádṛśe ǀ ná ǀ yakṣám ǀdrúhaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ ánṛtā ǀ jánānām ǀ ná ǀ vām ǀ niṇyā́ni ǀ acíte ǀ abhūvan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unperplexed, all-pervading showerers (of benefits), these (praises) are for you, in which nothingsurprising, no adoration (worthy of you) is beheld; the insincere commendations of men serve as offences;eulogies of you, althogh offered in secret, are not unappreciated.
verses.wilson_translation: Unperplexed, all-pervading showerers (of benefits), these (praises) are for you, in which nothingsurprising, no adoration (worthy of you) is beheld; the insincere commendations of men serve as offences;eulogies of you, althogh offered in secret, are not unappreciated.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समु वां यज्ञं महयं नमोभिर्हुवे वां मित्रावरुणा सबाधः ।प्र वां मन्मान्यृचसे नवानि कृतानि ब्रह्म जुजुषन्निमानि ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ yajñám ǀ mahayam ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ huvé ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀprá ǀ vām ǀ mánmāni ǀ ṛcáse ǀ návāni ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ bráhma ǀ jujuṣan ǀ imā́ni ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer sacrifice to you two with praises, I invoke you,Mitraand Varuṇa, when in trouble; may thepresent hymns be capable of gratifying you; may these (my) prayers be acceptable to you both.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer sacrifice to you two with praises, I invoke you,Mitraand Varuṇa, when in trouble; may thepresent hymns be capable of gratifying you; may these (my) prayers be acceptable to you both.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं देव पुरोहितिर्युवभ्यां यज्ञेषु मित्रावरुणावकारि ।विश्वानि दुर्गा पिपृतं तिरो नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ deva ǀ puráḥ-hitiḥ ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ akāri ǀvíśvāni ǀ duḥ-gā́ ǀ pipṛtam ǀ tiráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To you, divine Mitraand Varuṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: To you, divine Mitraand Varuṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXII. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SURYA hath sent aloft his beams of splendour o’er all the tribes of men in countless places.Together with the heaven he shines apparent, formed by his Makers well with power and wisdom. So hast thou mounted up before us, Sūrya, through these our praises, with fleet dappled horses.Declare us free from all offence to Mitra, and Varuṇa, and Aryaman, and Agni. May holy Agni, Varuṇa, and Mitra send down their riches upon us in thousands.May they, the Bright Ones, make our praise-song perfect, and, when we laud them, grant us all our wishes. O undivided Heaven and Earth, preserve us, us, Lofty Ones! your nobIy-born descendants.Let us not anger Varuṇa, nor Vāyu, nor him, the dearest Friend of mortals, Mitra. Stretch forth your arms and let our lives be lengthened: with fatness dew the pastures of our cattle.Ye Youthful, make us famed among the people: hear, Mitra-Varuṇa, these mine invocations. Now Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman vouchsafe us freedom and room, for us and for our children.May we find paths all fair and good to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सूर्यो बृहदर्चींष्यश्रेत्पुरु विश्वा जनिम मानुषाणां ।समो दिवा ददृशे रोचमानः क्रत्वा कृतः सुकृतः कर्तृभिर्भूत् ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ arcī́ṃṣi ǀ aśret ǀ purú ǀ víśvā ǀ jánima ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀsamáḥ ǀ divā́ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ rócamānaḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ sú-kṛtaḥ ǀ kartṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sūryaspreads his vast and numerous rays over all the crowds of men; shining bright by day, he isbeheld (by all) the same, the creator, the created, he is glorified by his worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: Sūryaspreads his vast and numerous rays over all the crowds of men; shining bright by day, he isbeheld (by all) the same, the creator, the created, he is glorified by his worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सूर्य प्रति पुरो न उद्गा एभिः स्तोमेभिरेतशेभिरेवैः ।प्र नो मित्राय वरुणाय वोचोऽनागसो अर्यम्णे अग्नये च ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sūrya ǀ práti ǀ puráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ út ǀ gāḥ ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ etaśébhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vocaḥ ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ aryamṇé ǀ agnáye ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rise up before us,Sūrya, with your glorious white horses; declare us free from sin to Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, and Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: Rise up before us,Sūrya, with your glorious white horses; declare us free from sin to Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, and Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि नः सहस्रं शुरुधो रदंत्वृतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।यच्छंतु चंद्रा उपमं नो अर्कमा नः कामं पूपुरंतु स्तवानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ radantu ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀyácchantu ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ naḥ ǀ arkám ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ pūpurantu ǀ stávānāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Varuṇa,Mitraand Agni, the alleviators of pain, the observers of truth, bestow upon us thousands(of riches); may they, the givers of delight, grant us excellent (food); glorified by us, many they fulfil our desires.
verses.wilson_translation: May Varuṇa,Mitraand Agni, the alleviators of pain, the observers of truth, bestow upon us thousands(of riches); may they, the givers of delight, grant us excellent (food); glorified by us, many they fulfil our desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्यावाभूमी अदिते त्रासीथां नो ये वां जज्ञुः सुजनिमान ऋष्वे ।मा हेळे भूम वरुणस्य वायोर्मा मित्रस्य प्रियतमस्य नृणां ॥
verses.transliteration: dyā́vābhūmī íti ǀ adite ǀ trā́sīthām ǀ naḥ ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ jajñúḥ ǀ su-jánimānaḥ ǀ ṛṣve íti ǀmā́ ǀ héḷe ǀ bhūma ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ priyá-tamasya ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indivisible and mighty heaven and earth protect us who, of fortunate birth, have knowledge of you both;let us not incur the displeasure of Varuṇa, or of Vāyu, or of Mitra, the best beloved of men.
verses.wilson_translation: Indivisible and mighty heaven and earth protect us who, of fortunate birth, have knowledge of you both;let us not incur the displeasure of Varuṇa, or of Vāyu, or of Mitra, the best beloved of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे न आ नो गव्यूतिमुक्षतं घृतेन ।आ नो जने श्रवयतं युवाना श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ bāhávā ǀ sisṛtam ǀ jīváse ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ukṣatam ǀ ghṛténa ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ jáne ǀ śravayatam ǀ yuvānā ǀ śrutám ǀ me ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ hávā ǀ imā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Stretch forth your arms for the prolongation of our existence, bedew with water the pastures of ourcattle, render us honoured among men; ever youthful Mitraand Varuṇa, hear these my invocations.
verses.wilson_translation: Stretch forth your arms for the prolongation of our existence, bedew with water the pastures of ourcattle, render us honoured among men; ever youthful Mitraand Varuṇa, hear these my invocations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमा नस्त्मने तोकाय वरिवो दधंतु ।सुगा नो विश्वा सुपथानि संतु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tmáne ǀ tokā́ya ǀ várivaḥ ǀ dadhantu ǀsu-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ su-páthāni ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryamangrant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy of accessunto us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryamangrant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy of accessunto us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIII. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.anukramani: ६ मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ:। १-४ सूर्य:, ५ सूर्य – मित्रावरुणा:, ६ मित्रावरुणौ अर्यमा च । त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . COMMON to all mankind, auspicious Sūrya, he who beholdeth all, is mounting upward;The God, the eye of Varuṇa and Mitra, who rolled up darkness like a piece of leather. Sūrya's great ensign, restless as the billow, that urgeth men to action, is advancing:Onward he still would roll the wheel well-rounded, which Etaśa, harnessed to the car-pole, moveth. Refulgent from the bosom of the Mornings, he in Whom singers take delight ascendeth.This Savitar, God, is my chief joy and pleasure, who breaketh not the universal statute. Golden, far-seeing, from the heaven he riseth: far is his goal, he hasteth on resplendent.Men, verily, inspirited by Sūrya speed to their aims and do the work assigned them. Where the irrunortals have prepared his pathway he flieth through the region like a falcon.With homage and oblations will we serve you, O Mitra-Varuṇa, when the Sun hath risen. Now Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman vouchsafe us freedom and room, for us and for our children.May we find paths all fair and good to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वेति सुभगो विश्वचक्षाः साधारणः सूर्यो मानुषाणां ।चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य देवश्चर्मेव यः समविव्यक्तमांसि ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ eti ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ viśvá-cakṣāḥ ǀ sā́dhāraṇaḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀcákṣuḥ ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ deváḥ ǀ cárma-iva ǀ yáḥ ǀ sam-ávivyak ǀ támāṃsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The auspicious Sūryarises, the eye of all, the common (parent) of men; the divine eye of Mitraand Varuṇa, who breaks through the glooms as through (investing) skin.
verses.wilson_translation: The auspicious Sūryarises, the eye of all, the common (parent) of men; the divine eye of Mitraand Varuṇa, who breaks through the glooms as through (investing) skin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उद्वेति प्रसवीता जनानां महान्केतुरर्णवः सूर्यस्य ।समानं चक्रं पर्याविवृत्सन्यदेतशो वहति धूर्षु युक्तः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ eti ǀ pra-savitā́ ǀ jánānām ǀ mahā́n ǀ ketúḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀsamānám ǀ cakrám ǀ pari-āvívṛtsan ǀ yát ǀ etaśáḥ ǀ váhati ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ yuktáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The animator of men arises, the great rain-shedding banner of Sūryarolling on the universal wheel,which the white steeds yoked to his car drag along.
verses.wilson_translation: The animator of men arises, the great rain-shedding banner of Sūryarolling on the universal wheel,which the white steeds yoked to his car drag along.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विभ्राजमान उषसामुपस्थाद्रेभैरुदेत्यनुमद्यमानः ।एष मे देवः सविता चच्छंद यः समानं न प्रमिनाति धाम ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-bhrā́jamānaḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ rebháiḥ ǀ út ǀ eti ǀ anu-madyámānaḥ ǀeṣáḥ ǀ me ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ cacchanda ǀ yáḥ ǀ samānám ǀ ná ǀ pra-minā́ti ǀ dhā́ma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Delighted by the praises (of his worshippers), the radiant sun rises from the lap of the dawns; thatdivine sun gratifies my desires, who limits not the lustre that is common (to all).
verses.wilson_translation: Delighted by the praises (of his worshippers), the radiant sun rises from the lap of the dawns; thatdivine sun gratifies my desires, who limits not the lustre that is common (to all).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो रुक्म उरुचक्षा उदेति दूरेअर्थस्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः ।नूनं जनाः सूर्येण प्रसूता अयन्नर्थानि कृणवन्नपांसि ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ uru-cákṣāḥ ǀ út ǀ eti ǀ dūré-arthaḥ ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ bhrā́jamānaḥ ǀnūnám ǀ jánāḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ prá-sūtāḥ ǀ áyan ǀ árthāni ǀ kṛṇávan ǀ ápāṃsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bright and glorious sun rises from the firmament far-going, traversing (the heavens), diffusing light;verily all beings animated by Sūryaproceed and execute their assigned labours.
verses.wilson_translation: The bright and glorious sun rises from the firmament far-going, traversing (the heavens), diffusing light;verily all beings animated by Sūryaproceed and execute their assigned labours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्रा चक्रुरमृता गातुमस्मै श्येनो न दीयन्नन्वेति पाथः ।प्रति वां सूर उदिते विधेम नमोभिर्मित्रावरुणोत हव्यैः ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ asmai ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dī́yan ǀ ánu ǀ eti ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀpráti ǀ vām ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ vidhema ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ utá ǀ havyáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He travels the path which the immortals have prepared for his course, darting along like a hawk; weworship you,Mitraand Varuṇa, when the sun has risen, with praises and oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: He travels the path which the immortals have prepared for his course, darting along like a hawk; weworship you,Mitraand Varuṇa, when the sun has risen, with praises and oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमा नस्त्मने तोकाय वरिवो दधंतु ।सुगा नो विश्वा सुपथानि संतु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tmáne ǀ tokā́ya ǀ várivaḥ ǀ dadhantu ǀsu-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ su-páthāni ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Mitra,Varuṇaand Aryamangrant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy ofaccess to us, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: May Mitra,Varuṇaand Aryamangrant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy ofaccess to us, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIV. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YE Twain who rule, in heaven and earth, the region, clothed be your clouds in robes of oil and fatness.May the imperial Varuṇa, and Mitra, and high-born Aryaman accept our presents. Kings, guards of rrtighty everlasting Order, come hitherward, ye Princes, Lords of Rivers.Send us from heaven, O Varuṇa and Mitra, rain and sweet food, ye who pour down your bounties. May the dear God, and Varuṇa and Mitra conduct us by the most effective pathways,That foes may say unto Sudās our chieftain, May, we, too, joy in food with Gods to guard us. Him who hath wrought for you this car in spirit, who makes the song rise upward and sustains it,Bedew with fatness, Varuṇa nd Mitra ye Kings, make glad the pleasant dwelling-places. To you this laud, O Varuṇa and Mitra is offered like bright Soma juice to Vāyu.Favour our songs of praise, wake thought and spirit. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: दिवि क्षयंता रजसः पृथिव्यां प्र वां घृतस्य निर्णिजो ददीरन् ।हव्यं नो मित्रो अर्यमा सुजातो राजा सुक्षत्रो वरुणो जुषंत ॥
verses.transliteration: diví ǀ kṣáyantā ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ prá ǀ vām ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ niḥ-níjaḥ ǀ dadīran ǀhavyám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ sú-jātaḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ su-kṣatráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ruling over the water that are in heaven and earth, impelled by you, (the clouds) assume the form ofrain may the auspiciously manifested Mitra, the royal Aryaman, the powerul Varuṇa, accept our oblatioṇ
verses.wilson_translation: Ruling over the water that are in heaven and earth, impelled by you, (the clouds) assume the form ofrain may the auspiciously manifested Mitra, the royal Aryaman, the powerul Varuṇa, accept our oblatioṇ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ राजाना मह ऋतस्य गोपा सिंधुपती क्षत्रिया यातमर्वाक् ।इळां नो मित्रावरुणोत वृष्टिमव दिव इन्वतं जीरदानू ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rājānā ǀ mahaḥ ǀ ṛtasya ǀ gopā ǀ síndhupatī íti síndhu-patī ǀ kṣatriyā ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀíḷām ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ utá ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ áva ǀ diváḥ ǀ invatam ǀ jīradānū íti jīra-dānū ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sovereigns, mighty preservers of water, powerful lords of rivers, come to our presence; send down tous munificent Mitraand Varuṇa, from the firmament, sustenance and rain.
verses.wilson_translation: Sovereigns, mighty preservers of water, powerful lords of rivers, come to our presence; send down tous munificent Mitraand Varuṇa, from the firmament, sustenance and rain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रस्तन्नो वरुणो देवो अर्यः प्र साधिष्ठेभिः पथिभिर्नयंतु ।ब्रवद्यथा न आदरिः सुदास इषा मदेम सह देवगोपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ prá ǀ sā́dhiṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ nayantu ǀbrávat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ aríḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ iṣā́ ǀ madema ǀ sahá ǀ devá-gopāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Mitra,Varuṇa, the divine Aryaman, conduct us by the most practicable paths, then, (when wedesire their guidance), accordingly as Aryaman promises to the liberal donor (of oblations), may we, enjoying theprotection of the gods, rejoice in abundance, together with posterity.
verses.wilson_translation: May Mitra,Varuṇa, the divine Aryaman, conduct us by the most practicable paths, then, (when wedesire their guidance), accordingly as Aryaman promises to the liberal donor (of oblations), may we, enjoying theprotection of the gods, rejoice in abundance, together with posterity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वां गर्तं मनसा तक्षदेतमूर्ध्वां धीतिं कृणवद्धारयच्च ।उक्षेथां मित्रावरुणा घृतेन ता राजाना सुक्षितीस्तर्पयेथां ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ gártam ǀ mánasā ǀ tákṣat ǀ etám ǀ ūrdhvā́m ǀ dhītím ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ dhāráyat ǀ ca ǀukṣéthām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ghṛténa ǀ tā́ ǀ rājānā ǀ su-kṣitī́ḥ ǀ tarpayethām ǁ
