verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, bedew with water him who fabricates your chariot in his mind, offering high praise,the people well affected towards him.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, bedew with water him who fabricates your chariot in his mind, offering high praise,the people well affected towards him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो वरुण मित्र तुभ्यं सोमः शुक्रो न वायवेऽयामि ।अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ túbhyam ǀ sómaḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāyáve ǀ ayāmi ǀaviṣṭám ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ jigṛtám ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Varuṇaand Mitra, this praise, pure as the Somalibation, has been offered to you, and also,Aryaman,(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Varuṇaand Mitra, this praise, pure as the Somalibation, has been offered to you, and also,Aryaman,(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXV. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH hymns I call you, when the Sun hath risen, Mitra, and Varuṇa whose thoughts are holy,Whose Power Divine, supreme and everlasting, comes with good heed at each man's supplication. For they are Asuras of Gods, the friendly make, both of you, our lands exceeding fruitful.May we obtain you, Varuṇa and Mitra, wherever Heaven and Earth and days may bless us. Bonds of the sinner, they bear many nooses: the wicked mortal hardly may escape them.Varuṇa-Mitra, may your path of Order bear us o’er trouble as a boat o’er waters. Come, taste our offering, Varuṇa and Mitra: bedew our pasture wil sweet food and fatness.Pour down in plenty here upon the people the choicest of your fair celestial water. To you this laud, O Varuṇa and Mitra, is offered, like bright Soma juice to Vāyu.Favour our songs of praise, wake thought and spirit. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति वां सूर उदिते सूक्तैर्मित्रं हुवे वरुणं पूतदक्षं ।ययोरसुर्यमक्षितं ज्येष्ठं विश्वस्य यामन्नाचिता जिगत्नु ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ vām ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ mitrám ǀ huve ǀ váruṇam ǀ pūtá-dakṣam ǀyáyoḥ ǀ asuryám ǀ ákṣitam ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ víśvasya ǀ yā́man ǀ ā-cítā ǀ jigatnú ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the sun has risen, I invoke Mitraand you,Varuṇa, of pure vigour, whose imperishable andsuperior might is triumphant in the crowded conflict over all enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: When the sun has risen, I invoke Mitraand you,Varuṇa, of pure vigour, whose imperishable andsuperior might is triumphant in the crowded conflict over all enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता हि देवानामसुरा तावर्या ता नः क्षितीः करतमूर्जयंतीः ।अश्याम मित्रावरुणा वयं वां द्यावा च यत्र पीपयन्नहा च ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ devā́nām ǀ ásurā ǀ táu ǀ aryā́ ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ karatam ǀ ūrjáyantīḥ ǀaśyā́ma ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ vayám ǀ vām ǀ dyā́vā ǀ ca ǀ yátra ǀ pīpáyan ǀ áhā ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: They verily are mighty among the gods; they are rulers; they bestow upon us a numerous posterity;may we obtain from you,Mitraand Varuṇa, whether on earth or in heaven, and whereever the (passing) daysmay preserve us.
verses.wilson_translation: They verily are mighty among the gods; they are rulers; they bestow upon us a numerous posterity;may we obtain from you,Mitraand Varuṇa, whether on earth or in heaven, and whereever the (passing) daysmay preserve us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता भूरिपाशावनृतस्य सेतू दुरत्येतू रिपवे मर्त्याय ।ऋतस्य मित्रावरुणा पथा वामपो न नावा दुरिता तरेम ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ bhū́ri-pāśau ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ sétū íti ǀ duratyétū íti duḥ-atyétū ǀ ripáve ǀ mártyāya ǀṛtásya ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ pathā́ ǀ vām ǀ apáḥ ǀ ná ǀ nāvā́ ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Holders are you of many fetters, barriers against the irreligious, invincible by hostile mortals; may wecross over all the danger,Mitraand Varuṇa, by the path of sacrifice, to you, as (we cross over) water by a boat.
verses.wilson_translation: Holders are you of many fetters, barriers against the irreligious, invincible by hostile mortals; may wecross over all the danger,Mitraand Varuṇa, by the path of sacrifice, to you, as (we cross over) water by a boat.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो मित्रावरुणा हव्यजुष्टिं घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतमिळाभिः ।प्रति वामत्र वरमा जनाय पृणीतमुद्नो दिव्यस्य चारोः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ havyá-juṣṭim ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ukṣatam ǀ íḷābhiḥ ǀpráti ǀ vām ǀ átra ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ jánāya ǀ pṛṇītám ǀ udnáḥ ǀ divyásya ǀ cā́roḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Mitraand Varuṇa, to our offered oblation sprinkle our plural ce of sacrifice with water and withviands (who) in this world (may present to you such) excellent (donations) that you may (thereby be induced to)gratify mankind with celestial and beautiful water.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Mitraand Varuṇa, to our offered oblation sprinkle our plural ce of sacrifice with water and withviands (who) in this world (may present to you such) excellent (donations) that you may (thereby be induced to)gratify mankind with celestial and beautiful water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो वरुण मित्र तुभ्यं सोमः शुक्रो न वायवेऽयामि ।अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ túbhyam ǀ sómaḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāyáve ǀ ayāmi ǀaviṣṭám ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ jigṛtám ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Varuṇaand Mitra, this praise, pure as the Somalibation, has been offered to you, and also,Aryaman(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Varuṇaand Mitra, this praise, pure as the Somalibation, has been offered to you, and also,Aryaman(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVI Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.anukramani: १९ मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ:। मित्रावरुणौ, ४-१३ आदित्या:, १४-१६ सूर्य: ।गायत्री,१०-१५  प्रगाथ: = (समा बृहती, विषमा सतोबृहती ), १६ पुर उष्णिक् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LET our strong hymn of praise go forth, the laud of Mitra-Varuṇa,With homage to that high-born Pair; The Two exceeding wise, the Sons of Dakṣa, whom the gods ordainedFor lordship, excellently great. Such, Guardians of our homes and us, O Mitra-Varuṇa, fulfilThe thoughts of those who sing your praise. So when the Sun hath risen to-day, may sinless Mitra, Aryaman,Bhaga, and Savitar sendus forth. May this our home be guarded well forward, ye Bounteous, on the way,Who bear us safely o’er distress.. And those Self-reigning, Aditi, whose statute is inviolate,The Kings who rule a vast domain. Soon as the Sun hath risen, to you, to Mitra-Varuṇa, I sing,And Aryarnan who slays the foe. With wealth of gold may this my song bring unmolested power and might,And, Brahmans, gain the sacrifice. May we be thine, God Varuṇa, and with our princes, Mitra, thine.Food and Heaven's light will we obtain. Many are they who strengthen Law, Sun-eyed, with Agni for their tongue,They who direct the three great gatherings with their thoughts, yea, all things with surpassing might. They who have stablished year and month and then the day, night, sacrifice and holy verse,Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryarnan, the Kings, have won dominion which none else may gain. So at the rising of the Sun we think of you with hymns to-day,Even as Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman deserve: ye are the charioteers of Law. True to Law, born in Law the strengtheners of Law, terrible, haters of the false,In their felicity which gives the best defence may we men and our princes dwell. Uprises, on the slope of heaven, that marvel that attracts die sightAs swift celestial Etaśa bears it away, prepared for every eye to see. Lord of each single head, of fixt and moving things, equally through the whole expanse,The Seven sister Bays bear Sūrya on his car, to bring us wealth and happiness. A hundred autumns may we see that bright Eye, God-ordained, ariseA hundred autumns may we live. Infallible through your wisdom, come hither, resplendent Varuṇa,And Mitra, to the Soma draught. Come as the laws of Heaven ordain, Varuṇa, Mitra, void of guile:Press near and drink the Soma juice. Come, Mitra, Varuṇa, accept, Heroes, our sacrificial gift:Drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.

verses.sanskrit: प्र मित्रयोर्वरुणयोः स्तोमो न एतु शूष्यः ।नम��्वांतुविजातयोः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ mitráyoḥ ǀ váruṇayoḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ etu ǀ śūṣyáḥ ǀnámasvān ǀ tuvi-jātáyoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this our propitiatory praise, accompanied by oblations, proceed to you,Mitraand Varuṇa, ofreiterated manifestations.
verses.wilson_translation: May this our propitiatory praise, accompanied by oblations, proceed to you,Mitraand Varuṇa, ofreiterated manifestations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या धारयंत देवाः सुदक्षा दक्षपितरा ।असुर्याय प्रमहसा ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ dhāráyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ su-dákṣā ǀ dákṣa-pitarā ǀasuryā́ya ǀ prá-mahasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You whom the gods uphold for their invigoration, both mighty, masters of strength and of diffusiveradiance.
verses.wilson_translation: You whom the gods uphold for their invigoration, both mighty, masters of strength and of diffusiveradiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता नः स्तिपा तनूपा वरुण जरितॄणां ।मित्र साधयतं धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sti-pā́ ǀ tanū-pā́ ǀ váruṇa ǀ jaritṝṇā́m ǀmítra ǀ sādháyatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protectors of our dwellings, protectors of our person ns,Mitraand Varuṇa, perfect the rites of youradorers.
verses.wilson_translation: Protectors of our dwellings, protectors of our person ns,Mitraand Varuṇa, perfect the rites of youradorers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर उदितेऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा ।सुवाति सविता भगः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀsuvā́ti ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Mitra, the destroyer of sin,Aryaman,Savitā,Bhaga, bestow (upon us), today at sun-rise what (wepray for).
verses.wilson_translation: May Mitra, the destroyer of sin,Aryaman,Savitā,Bhaga, bestow (upon us), today at sun-rise what (wepray for).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रावीरस्तु स क्षयः प्र नु यामन्त्सुदानवः ।ये नो अंहोऽतिपिप्रति ॥
verses.transliteration: supra-avī́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ prá ǀ nú ǀ yā́man ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀyé ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ati-píprati ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this our dwelling be well protected, liberal deities, on your departure, you who purify us from sin.
verses.wilson_translation: May this our dwelling be well protected, liberal deities, on your departure, you who purify us from sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्वराजो अदितिरदब्धस्य व्रतस्य ये ।महो राजान ईशते ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ádabdhasya ǀ vratásya ǀ yé ǀmaháḥ ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ īśate ǁ
verses.english_translation: And who are sovereign over all, and, with Aditi, preside over this unobstructed and great ceremony.
verses.wilson_translation: And who are sovereign over all, and, with Aditi, preside over this unobstructed and great ceremony.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रति वां सूर उदिते मित्रं गृणीषे वरुणं ।अर्यमणं रिशादसं ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ vām ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ mitrám ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ váruṇam ǀaryamáṇam ǀ riśā́dasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify you,Mitraand Varuṇa, and Aryaman, the consumer of enemies when the sun has risen.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify you,Mitraand Varuṇa, and Aryaman, the consumer of enemies when the sun has risen.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: राया हिरण्यया मतिरियमवृकाय शवसे ।इयं विप्रा मेधसातये ॥
verses.transliteration: rāyā́ ǀ hiraṇya-yā́ ǀ matíḥ ǀ iyám ǀ avṛkā́ya ǀ śávase ǀiyám ǀ víprā ǀ medhá-sātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this praise (be effective) for unimpeached strength, alone with golden treasure; may it (beeffective), sages, for the fulfilment of (the objects of) the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May this praise (be effective) for unimpeached strength, alone with golden treasure; may it (beeffective), sages, for the fulfilment of (the objects of) the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते स्याम देव वरुण ते मित्र सूरिभिः सह ।इषं स्वश्च धीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ syāma ǀ deva ǀ varuṇa ǀ té ǀ mitra ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ sahá ǀíṣam ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we be thine, divine Varuṇa; may we, along with pious worshippers, be,Mitra, thine; may we obtainfood and water.
verses.wilson_translation: May we be thine, divine Varuṇa; may we, along with pious worshippers, be,Mitra, thine; may we obtainfood and water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बहवः सूरचक्षसोऽग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृधः ।त्रीणि ये येमुर्विदथानि धीतिभिर्विश्वानि परिभूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: bahávaḥ ǀ sū́ra-cakṣasaḥ ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀtrī́ṇi ǀ yé ǀ yemúḥ ǀ vidáthāni ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ páribhūti-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Manifold radiant as the sun,Agni-tongued augmenters of sacrifice, you who have limited the threeuniversal sacrifices with comprehensive rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Manifold radiant as the sun,Agni-tongued augmenters of sacrifice, you who have limited the threeuniversal sacrifices with comprehensive rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि ये दधुः शरदं मासमादहर्यज्ञमक्तुं चादृचं ।अनाप्यं वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा क्षत्रं राजान आशत ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ yé ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ śarádam ǀ mā́sam ǀ ā́t ǀ áhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ aktúm ǀ ca ǀ ā́t ǀ ṛ́cam ǀanāpyám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ kṣatrám ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ āśata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who have established the year, and then the month and the day, the sacrifice, the night, and the holytext, they, the royal deities,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, enjoy unrivalled might.
verses.wilson_translation: Who have established the year, and then the month and the day, the sacrifice, the night, and the holytext, they, the royal deities,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, enjoy unrivalled might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तद्वो अद्य मनामहे सूक्तैः सूर उदिते ।यदोहते वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ manāmahe ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀyát ǀ óhate ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ yūyám ǀ ṛtásya ǀ rathyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Therefore today at sunrise we solicit you with hymns for (wealth), which Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman,bearers of water, you convey.
verses.wilson_translation: Therefore today at sunrise we solicit you with hymns for (wealth), which Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman,bearers of water, you convey.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावान ऋतजाता ऋतावृधो घोरासो अनृतद्विषः ।तेषां वः सुम्ने सुच्छर्दिष्टमे नरः स्याम ये च सूरयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ ṛtá-jātāḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ghorā́saḥ ǀ anṛta-dvíṣaḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ vaḥ ǀ sumné ǀ succhardíḥ-tame ǀ naraḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accepters of rites, genitive rated for rites, augmenters of rites, fierce enemies of the neglecter of rites, maywe, as well as those men who are your adorers, be in (the enjoyment of) the highest felicity, all confirmed by you.
verses.wilson_translation: Accepters of rites, genitive rated for rites, augmenters of rites, fierce enemies of the neglecter of rites, maywe, as well as those men who are your adorers, be in (the enjoyment of) the highest felicity, all confirmed by you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु त्यद्दर्शतं वपुर्दिव एति प्रतिह्वरे ।यदीमाशुर्वहति देव एतशो विश्वस्मै चक्षसे अरं ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyát ǀ darśatám ǀ vápuḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ eti ǀ prati-hvaré ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ āśúḥ ǀ váhati ǀ deváḥ ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ cákṣase ǀ áram ǁ
verses.english_translation: That beautiful orb (of the sun) rises on the near margin of the sky as the swift, divine, white-coloured(steed) bears it along for the beholding of all men.
verses.wilson_translation: That beautiful orb (of the sun) rises on the near margin of the sky as the swift, divine, white-coloured(steed) bears it along for the beholding of all men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शीर्ष्णःशीर्ष्णो जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं समया विश्वमा रजः ।सप्त स्वसारः सुविताय सूर्यं वहंति हरितो रथे ॥
verses.transliteration: śīrṣṇáḥ-śīrṣṇaḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ samáyā ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀsaptá ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ sū́ryam ǀ váhanti ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ráthe ǁ
verses.english_translation: The seven gliding steeds convey the sun, the lord of every individual moving or stationary thing,traversing the whole world in his chariot for the good (of all).
verses.wilson_translation: The seven gliding steeds convey the sun, the lord of every individual moving or stationary thing,traversing the whole world in his chariot for the good (of all).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तच्चक्षुर्देवहितं शुक्रमुच्चरत् ।पश्येम शरदः शतं जीवेम शरदः शतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ devá-hitam ǀ śukrám ǀ ut-cárat ǀpáśyema ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ śatám ǀ jī́vema ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ śatám ǁ
verses.english_translation: That pure eye (of the universe), beneficial of the gods, rises; may we behold it for a hundred years; maywe live a hundred years.
verses.wilson_translation: That pure eye (of the universe), beneficial of the gods, rises; may we behold it for a hundred years; maywe live a hundred years.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: काव्येभिरदाभ्या यातं वरुण द्युमत् ।मित्रश्च सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: kā́vyebhiḥ ǀ adābhyā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ varuṇa ǀ dyu-mát ǀmitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unconquerable, resplendent Varuṇaand Mitra, (induced) by our praises, come to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Unconquerable, resplendent Varuṇaand Mitra, (induced) by our praises, come to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो धामभिर्वरुण मित्रश्चा यातमद्रुहा ।पिबतं सोममातुजी ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ adrúhā ǀpíbatam ǀ sómam ǀ ātujī́ ítyā-tujī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: genitive le Mitraand Varuṇa, destroyers of foes, come from heaven with your glories, and drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: genitive le Mitraand Varuṇa, destroyers of foes, come from heaven with your glories, and drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यातं मित्रावरुणा जुषाणावाहुतिं नरा ।पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ juṣāṇáu ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ narā ǀpātám ǀ sómam ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Mitraand Varuṇa, leaders of rites, propitiated by the oblation, and drink the Soma, augmentersof the sacred rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Mitraand Varuṇa, leaders of rites, propitiated by the oblation, and drink the Soma, augmentersof the sacred rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I WITH a holy heart that brings oblation will sing forth praise to meet your car, ye Princes,Which, Much-desired! hath wakened as your envoy. I call you hither as a son his parents. Brightly hath Agni shone by us enkindled: the limits even of darkness were apparent.Eastward is seen the Banner of the Morning, the Banner born to give Heaven's Daughter glory. With hymns the deft priest is about you, Aśvins, the eloquent priest attends you now, Nāsatyas.Come by the paths that ye are wont to travel, on car that finds the light, laden with treasure. When, suppliant for your help, Lovers of Sweetness! I seeking wealth call you to our libation,Hitherward let your vigorous horses bear you: drink ye with us the well-pressed Soma juices. Bring forward, Aśvins, Gods, to its fulfilment my never-wearied prayer that asks for riches.Vouchsafe us all high spirit in the combat, and with your powers, O Lords of Power, assist us. Favour us in these prayers of ours, O Aśvins. May we have genial vigour, ne’er to fail us.So may we, strong in children and descendants, go, wealthy, to the banquet that awaits you. Lovers of Sweetness, we have brought this treasure to you as ’twere an envoy sent for friendship.Come unto us with spirits free from anger, in homes of men enjoying our oblation. With one, the same, intention, ye swift movers, o’er the Seven Rivers hath your chariot travelled.Yoked by the Gods, your strong steeds never weary while speeding forward at the pole they bear you. Exhaustless be your bounty to our princes who with their wealth incite the gift of riches,Who further friendship with their noble natures, combining wealth in kine with wealth in herses. Now hear, O Youthful Twain, mine invocation: come, Aśvins, to the home where food aboundeth.Vouchsafe us wealth, do honour to our nobles. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति वां रथं नृपती जरध्यै हविष्मता मनसा यज्ञियेन ।यो वां दूतो न धिष्ण्यावजीगरच्छा सूनुर्न पितरा विवक्मि ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ nṛpatī íti nṛ-patī ǀ jarádhyai ǀ havíṣmatā ǀ mánasā ǀ yajñíyena ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhiṣṇyau ǀ ájīgaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ ná ǀ pitárā ǀ vivakmi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lords of men, (I approach) to adore your chariot with devout praise and oblation, I address it as if itwere a messenger to awaken you, adorable deities, as a son (addresses) his parents.
verses.wilson_translation: Lords of men, (I approach) to adore your chariot with devout praise and oblation, I address it as if itwere a messenger to awaken you, adorable deities, as a son (addresses) his parents.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अशोच्यग्निः समिधानो अस्मे उपो अदृश्रंतमसश्चिदंताः ।अचेति केतुरुषसः पुरस्ताच्छ्रिये दिवो दुहितुर्जायमानः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśoci ǀ agníḥ ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ úpo íti ǀ adṛśran ǀ támasaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ántāḥ ǀáceti ǀ ketúḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ śriyé ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Kindled by us,Agniblazes, the extremities of the darkness are seen near athand, the banner (of thesun) is perceived rising with the glory on the east of the dawn, the daughter of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Kindled by us,Agniblazes, the extremities of the darkness are seen near athand, the banner (of thesun) is perceived rising with the glory on the east of the dawn, the daughter of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वां नूनमश्विना सुहोता स्तोमैः सिषक्ति नासत्या विवक्वान् ।पूर्वीभिर्यातं पथ्याभिरर्वाक्स्वर्विदा वसुमता रथेन ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ vām ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvinā ǀ sú-hotā ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ sisakti ǀ nāsatyā ǀ vivakvā́n ǀpūrvī́bhiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ pathyā́bhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ svaḥ-vídā ǀ vásu-matā ǀ ráthena ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily,Aśvins, the pious priest repeating (your praises) glorifies you,Nāsatyāswith hymns; cometherefore by formerly-trodden paths to our presence with your chariot, familiar with heaven, laden with treasure.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily,Aśvins, the pious priest repeating (your praises) glorifies you,Nāsatyāswith hymns; cometherefore by formerly-trodden paths to our presence with your chariot, familiar with heaven, laden with treasure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवोर्वां नूनमश्विना युवाकुर्हुवे यद्वां सुते माध्वी वसूयुः ।आ वां वहंतु स्थविरासो अश्वाः पिबाथो अस्मे सुषुता मधूनि ॥
verses.transliteration: avóḥ ǀ vām ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǀ huvé ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ suté ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ vahantu ǀ sthávirāsaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ píbāthaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ sú-sutā ǀ mádhūni ǁ
verses.english_translation: Relying on you,Aśvins, as protectors, desirous of wealth,Mādhvis, I invoke you when the Somaiseffused; may your stout horses bring you (hither); drink the sweet Soma poured out by us.
verses.wilson_translation: Relying on you,Aśvins, as protectors, desirous of wealth,Mādhvis, I invoke you when the Somaiseffused; may your stout horses bring you (hither); drink the sweet Soma poured out by us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीमु देवाश्विना धियं मेऽमृध्रां सातये कृतं वसूयुं ।विश्वा अविष्टं वाज आ पुरंधीस्ता नः शक्तं शचीपती शचीभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: prā́cīm ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ devā ǀ aśvinā ǀ dhíyam ǀ me ǀ ámṛdhrām ǀ sātáye ǀ kṛtam ǀ vasu-yúm ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ vā́je ǀ ā́ ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śaktam ǀ śacīpatī íti śacī-patī ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Aśvins, render my sincere and undisturbed adoration, offered for the sake of riches, (efficacious)for their acquisition; preserve all my caculties in (the time of) battle; protectors of pious acts (influenced) by ouracts, bestow upon us (wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Aśvins, render my sincere and undisturbed adoration, offered for the sake of riches, (efficacious)for their acquisition; preserve all my caculties in (the time of) battle; protectors of pious acts (influenced) by ouracts, bestow upon us (wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अविष्टं धीष्वश्विना न आसु प्रजावद्रेतो अह्रयं नो अस्तु ।आ वां तोके तनये तूतुजानाः सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम ॥
verses.transliteration: aviṣṭám ǀ dhīṣú ǀ aśvinā ǀ naḥ ǀ āsú ǀ prajā́-vat ǀ rétaḥ ǀ áhrayam ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ tū́tujānāḥ ǀ su-rátnāsaḥ ǀ devá-vītim ǀ gamema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect us,Aśvins, in these pious acts, may our procreative power fail not; but (through your favour)possessing sons and grandsons, distributing desired riches and enjoying ample wealth, may we accomplish theworship of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us,Aśvins, in these pious acts, may our procreative power fail not; but (through your favour)possessing sons and grandsons, distributing desired riches and enjoying ample wealth, may we accomplish theworship of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य वां पूर्वगत्वेव सख्ये निधिर्हितो माध्वी रातो अस्मे ।अहेळता मनसा यातमर्वागश्नंता हव्यं मानुषीषु विक्षु ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ vām ǀ pūrvagátvā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ ni-dhíḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ rātáḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀáheḷatā ǀ mánasā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ aśnántā ǀ havyám ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǁ
verses.english_translation: This treasure given by us has been plural ced,Mādhvis, before you, like (an envoy) who has come to thepresence (of a prince) for (acquiring his) friendship; come to our presence with benevolent thoughts, acceptingthe oblations offered among human beings.
verses.wilson_translation: This treasure given by us has been plural ced,Mādhvis, before you, like (an envoy) who has come to thepresence (of a prince) for (acquiring his) friendship; come to our presence with benevolent thoughts, acceptingthe oblations offered among human beings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्योगे भुरणा समाने परि वां सप्त स्रवतो रथो गात् ।न वायंति सुभ्वो देवयुक्ता ये वां धूर्षु तरणयो वहंति ॥
verses.transliteration: ékasmin ǀ yóge ǀ bhuraṇā ǀ samāné ǀ pári ǀ vām ǀ saptá ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ gāt ǀná ǀ vāyanti ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ devá-yuktāḥ ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ taráṇayaḥ ǀ váhanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Nourishers of all, the chariot of you two, who are associated in a common purpose, traverses the sevenflowing (streams); the excellent horses harnessed by the gods, who bear you rapidly, careering in the car, arenever wearied.
verses.wilson_translation: Nourishers of all, the chariot of you two, who are associated in a common purpose, traverses the sevenflowing (streams); the excellent horses harnessed by the gods, who bear you rapidly, careering in the car, arenever wearied.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असश्चता मघवद्भ्यो हि भूतं ये राया मघदेयं जुनंति ।प्र ये बंधुं सूनृताभिस्तिरंते गव्या पृंचंतो अश्व्या मघानि ॥
verses.transliteration: asaścátā ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ bhūtám ǀ yé ǀ rāyā́ ǀ magha-déyam ǀ junánti ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ bándhum ǀ sūnṛ́tābhiḥ ǀ tiránte ǀ gávyā ǀ pṛñcántaḥ ǀ áśvyā ǀ maghā́ni ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be propitious to those who are affluent (in oblations), who offer the wealth that is to be offered for thesake of riches; they who encourage a kinsman with kind commendations, distributing wealth of cattle and ofhorses.
verses.wilson_translation: Be propitious to those who are affluent (in oblations), who offer the wealth that is to be offered for thesake of riches; they who encourage a kinsman with kind commendations, distributing wealth of cattle and ofhorses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू मे हवमा शृणुतं युवाना यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् ।धत्तं रत्नानि जरतं च सूरीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ yuvānā ǀ yāsiṣṭám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ írā-vat ǀdhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ járatam ǀ ca ǀ sūrī́n ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ever youthful Aśvins, hear today my invocation; come Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared; grant wealth (to the offerer); elevate the worshipper and to you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Ever youthful Aśvins, hear today my invocation; come Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared; grant wealth (to the offerer); elevate the worshipper and to you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVIII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . COME, radiant Aśvins, with your noble horses: accept your servant's hymns, ye Wonder-Workers:Enjoy oblations which we bring to greet you. The gladdening juices stand prepared before you: come quickly and partake of mine oblation.Pass by the calling of our foe and bear us. Your chariot with a hundred aids, O Aśvins, beareth you swift as thought across the regions,Speeding to us, O ye whose wealth is Sūrya. What time this stone of yours, the Gods’ adorer, upraised, sounds forth for you as Soma-presser,Let the priest bring you, Fair Ones, through oblations. The nourishment ye have is, truly, wondrous: ye gave thereof a quickening store to Atri,Who being dear to you, receives your favour. That gift, which all may gain, ye gave Cyavāna, when he grew old, who offered you oblations,When ye bestowed on him enduring beauty. What time his wicked friends abandoned Bhujyu, O Aśvins, in the middle of the ocean,Your horse delivered him, your faithful servant. Ye lent your aid to Vrka when exhausted, and listened when invoked to Śayu's calling.Ye made the cow pour forth her milk like water, and, Aśvins, strengthened with your strength the barren. With his fair hymns this singer, too, extols you, waking with glad thoughts at the break of morning.May the cow nourish him with milk to feed llim. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: आ शुभ्रा यातमश्विना स्वश्वा गिरो दस्रा जुजुषाणा युवाकोः ।हव्यानि च प्रतिभृता वीतं नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śubhrā ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ su-áśvā ǀ gíraḥ ǀ dasrā ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ ǀ yuvā́koḥ ǀhavyā́ni ǀ ca ǀ práti-bhṛtā ǀ vītám ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Illustrious Aśvins, lords of handsome horses, come hither, propitiated; Dasrasā, by the praises of youradorer, and partake of our consecrated oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Illustrious Aśvins, lords of handsome horses, come hither, propitiated; Dasrasā, by the praises of youradorer, and partake of our consecrated oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वामंधांसि मद्यान्यस्थुररं गंतं हविषो वीतये मे ।तिरो अर्यो हवनानि श्रुतं नः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ mádyāni ǀ asthuḥ ǀ áram ǀ gantam ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ vītáye ǀ me ǀtiráḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ hávanāni ǀ śrutám ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The exhilarating viands have been prepared for you; come quickly to partake of my oblation;disregarding the invocations of an adversary, listen to ours.
verses.wilson_translation: The exhilarating viands have been prepared for you; come quickly to partake of my oblation;disregarding the invocations of an adversary, listen to ours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वां रथो मनोजवा इयर्ति तिरो रजांस्यश्विना शतोतिः ।अस्मभ्यं सूर्यावसू इयानः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ mánaḥ-javāḥ ǀ iyarti ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ aśvinā ǀ śatá-ūtiḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ sūryāvasū íti ǀ iyānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your chariot,Aśvins, in which you ride with Sūrya, hastens towards us at our solicitations, traversingthe regions as swift as thought, and laden with a hundred blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Your chariot,Aśvins, in which you ride with Sūrya, hastens towards us at our solicitations, traversingthe regions as swift as thought, and laden with a hundred blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं ह यद्वां देवया उ अद्रिरूर्ध्वो विवक्ति सोमसुद्युवभ्यां ।आ वल्गू विप्रो ववृतीत हव्यैः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ deva-yā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ádriḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ vívakti ǀ soma-sút ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀā́ ǀ valgū́ íti ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vavṛtīta ǀ havyáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the stone, seeking to propitiate you two divinities, is raised aloft, and loudly sounds, expressingfor you the Soma, then the pious worshipper brings you back, beautiful divinities, by his oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: When the stone, seeking to propitiate you two divinities, is raised aloft, and loudly sounds, expressingfor you the Soma, then the pious worshipper brings you back, beautiful divinities, by his oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चित्रं ह यद्वां भोजनं न्वस्ति न्यत्रये महिष्वंतं युयोतं ।यो वामोमानं दधते प्रियः सन् ॥
verses.transliteration: citrám ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ bhójanam ǀ nú ǀ ásti ǀ ní ǀ átraye ǀ máhiṣvantam ǀ yuyotam ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ omā́nam ǀ dádhate ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sán ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wonderful, verily, is the wealth that is yours; you have liberated from the cave Atri, who is dear to you,and enjoys your protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Wonderful, verily, is the wealth that is yours; you have liberated from the cave Atri, who is dear to you,and enjoys your protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्यद्वां जुरते अश्विना भूच्च्यवानाय प्रतीत्यं हविर्दे ।अधि यद्वर्प इतऊति धत्थः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyát ǀ vām ǀ juraté ǀ aśvinā ǀ bhūt ǀ cyávānāya ǀ pratī́tyam ǀ haviḥ-dé ǀádhi ǀ yát ǀ várpaḥ ǀ itáḥ-ūti ǀ dhattháḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such was your benevolence,Aśvins, to Cyavana, praising and offering oblations, that you in requitalrescued his body from departure.
verses.wilson_translation: Such was your benevolence,Aśvins, to Cyavana, praising and offering oblations, that you in requitalrescued his body from departure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्यं भुज्युमश्विना सखायो मध्ये जहुर्दुरेवासः समुद्रे ।निरीं पर्षदरावा यो युवाकुः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ bhujyúm ǀ aśvinā ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ jahuḥ ǀ duḥ-évāsaḥ ǀ samudré ǀníḥ ǀ īm ǀ parṣat ǀ árāvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When faithless friends had abandoned Bhujyuin the midst of the ocean, you brought him to shore,devoted to and relying upon you.
verses.wilson_translation: When faithless friends had abandoned Bhujyuin the midst of the ocean, you brought him to shore,devoted to and relying upon you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृकाय चिज्जसमानाय शक्तमुत श्रुतं शयवे हूयमाना ।यावघ्न्यामपिन्वतमपो न स्तर्यं चिच्छक्त्यश्विना शचीभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́kāya ǀ cit ǀ jásamānāya ǀ śaktam ǀ utá ǀ śrutam ǀ śayáve ǀ hūyámānā ǀyáu ǀ aghnyā́m ǀ ápinvatam ǀ apáḥ ǀ ná ǀ staryám ǀ cit ǀ śaktī́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have granted (his desires) to Vṛka, exhausted by his devotions; when called upon you havelistened toŚayu; you are they who have filled the barren cow (with milk) as (a river) with water; you have(endowed her) with strength,Aśvins, by your deeds.
verses.wilson_translation: You have granted (his desires) to Vṛka, exhausted by his devotions; when called upon you havelistened toŚayu; you are they who have filled the barren cow (with milk) as (a river) with water; you have(endowed her) with strength,Aśvins, by your deeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य कारुर्जरते सूक्तैरग्रे बुधान उषसां सुमन्मा ।इषा तं वर्धदघ्न्या पयोभिर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ kārúḥ ǀ jarate ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ ágre ǀ budhānáḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ su-mánmā ǀiṣā́ ǀ tám ǀ vardhat ǀ aghnyā́ ǀ páyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This your devoted worshipper, wwaking before the dawn, praises with hymns; nourish him with food,and let the cow (nourish him) with her milk; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: This your devoted worshipper, wwaking before the dawn, praises with hymns; nourish him with food,and let the cow (nourish him) with her milk; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIX. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY your gold chariot, drawn by vigorous horses, come to us, blocking up the earthand heaven,Bright with its fellies while its way drops fatness, food-laden, rich in coursers, man's protector. Let it approach, yoked by thewill, three-seated, extending far and wide o’er fivefold beings,Whereon ye visit God-adoring races, bending your course whither ye will, O Aśvins. Renowned, with noble horses, come ye hither: drink, Wondrous Pair, the cup that holds sweet juices.Your car whereon your Spouse is wont to travel marks with its track the farthest ends of heaven. When night was turning to the grey of morning the Maiden, Sūrya's Daughter, chose your splendour.When with your power and might ye aid the pious he comes through heat to life by your assistance. O Chariot-borne, this car of yours invested with rays of light comes harnessed to our dwelling.Herewith, O Aśvins, while the dawn is breaking, to this our sacrifice bring peace and blessing. Like the wild cattle thirsty for the lightning, Heroes, come nigh this day to our libations.Men call on you with hymns in many places, but let not other worshippers detain you. Bhujyu, abandoned in the midst of ocean, ye raised from out the water with your horses,Uninjured, winged, flagging not, undaunted, with deeds of wonder saving him, O Aśvins. Now hear, O Youthful Twain, mine invocation: come, Aśvins, to the home where food aboundeth.Vouchsafe us wealth, do honour to our nobles. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: आ वां रथो रोदसी बद्बधानो हिरण्ययो वृषभिर्यात्वश्वैः ।घृतवर्तनिः पविभी रुचान इषां वोळ्हा नृपतिर्वाजिनीवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ badbadhānáḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ yātu ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀghṛtá-vartaniḥ ǀ paví-bhiḥ ǀ rucānáḥ ǀ iṣā́m ǀ voḷhā́ ǀ nṛ-pátiḥ ǀ vājínī-vān ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your golden chariot, drawn by your vigorous horses, blocking up heaven and earth, come to us,following the track of the waters, radiant with (glowing) wheels, laden with viands, the protector of men, thereceptacle of food.
verses.wilson_translation: May your golden chariot, drawn by your vigorous horses, blocking up heaven and earth, come to us,following the track of the waters, radiant with (glowing) wheels, laden with viands, the protector of men, thereceptacle of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पप्रथानो अभि पंच भूमा त्रिवंधुरो मनसा यातु युक्तः ।विशो येन गच्छथो देवयंतीः कुत्रा चिद्याममश्विना दधाना ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ paprathānáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ páñca ǀ bhū́ma ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ yuktáḥ ǀvíśaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ kútra ǀ cit ǀ yā́mam ǀ aśvinā ǀ dádhānā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Renowned among the five orders of beings, furnished with three benches, harnessed at will, may itcome hither; that (vehicle) wherewith you repair to devout mortals, whatsoever,Aśvins, directing your course.
verses.wilson_translation: Renowned among the five orders of beings, furnished with three benches, harnessed at will, may itcome hither; that (vehicle) wherewith you repair to devout mortals, whatsoever,Aśvins, directing your course.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वश्वा यशसा यातमर्वाग्दस्रा निधिं मधुमंतं पिबाथः ।वि वां रथो वध्वा यादमानोऽंतांदिवो बाधते वर्तनिभ्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: su-áśvā ǀ yaśásā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ dásrā ǀ ni-dhím ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ pibāthaḥ ǀví ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vadhvā́ ǀ yā́damānaḥ ǀ ántān ǀ diváḥ ǀ bādhate ǀ vartaní-bhyām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Well-horsed and celebrated, come,Aśvins, to our presence; drink,Dasras, the sweet plural dge; yourchariot, conveying you, with your spouse, furrows with its two wheels the extremities of the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Well-horsed and celebrated, come,Aśvins, to our presence; drink,Dasras, the sweet plural dge; yourchariot, conveying you, with your spouse, furrows with its two wheels the extremities of the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवोः श्रियं परि योषावृणीत सूरो दुहिता परितक्म्यायां ।यद्देवयंतमवथः शचीभिः परि घ्रंसमोमना वां वयो गात् ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ śríyam ǀ pári ǀ yóṣā ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǀyát ǀ deva-yántam ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ ghraṃsám ǀ ománā ǀ vām ǀ váyaḥ ǀ gāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: The daughter of Sūryamade choice of your chariot at the approach of night; you defend the devoutworshipper by your deeds, when the resplendent (sacrificial) food proceeds to you to secure your protection.
verses.wilson_translation: The daughter of Sūryamade choice of your chariot at the approach of night; you defend the devoutworshipper by your deeds, when the resplendent (sacrificial) food proceeds to you to secure your protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो ह स्य वां रथिरा वस्त उस्रा रथो युजानः परियाति वर्तिः ।तेन नः शं योरुषसो व्युष्टौ न्यश्विना वहतं यज्ञे अस्मिन् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ha ǀ syáḥ ǀ vām ǀ rathirā ǀ váste ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ pari-yā́ti ǀ vartíḥ ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ ní ǀ aśvinā ǀ vahatam ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǁ
verses.english_translation: Riders in the chariot,Aśvin, come for our participation and welfare to this our sacrifice, at the dawn ofday, with that chariot which is clothed in radiance, and which, when harnessed, traverses its (appointed) road.
verses.wilson_translation: Riders in the chariot,Aśvin, come for our participation and welfare to this our sacrifice, at the dawn ofday, with that chariot which is clothed in radiance, and which, when harnessed, traverses its (appointed) road.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नरा गौरेव विद्युतं तृषाणास्माकमद्य सवनोप यातं ।पुरुत्रा हि वां मतिभिर्हवंते मा वामन्ये नि यमंदेवयंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: nárā ǀ gaurā́-iva ǀ vi-dyútam ǀ tṛṣāṇā́ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ sávanā ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀpuru-trā́ ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ hávante ǀ mā́ ǀ vām ǀ anyé ǀ ní ǀ yaman ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders of rites, like (thirsty) cattle, thirsting for the radiant (Soma), hasten today to our sacrifice; inmany ceremonies do the pious propitiate you with praises; let not other devout worshippers detain you.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders of rites, like (thirsty) cattle, thirsting for the radiant (Soma), hasten today to our sacrifice; inmany ceremonies do the pious propitiate you with praises; let not other devout worshippers detain you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं भुज्युमवविद्धं समुद्र उदूहथुरर्णसो अस्रिधानैः ।पतत्रिभिरश्रमैरव्यथिभिर्दंसनाभिरश्विना पारयंता ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ bhujyúm ǀ áva-viddham ǀ samudré ǀ út ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ árṇasaḥ ǀ ásridhānaiḥ ǀpatatrí-bhiḥ ǀ aśramáiḥ ǀ avyathí-bhiḥ ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ pāráyantā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You bore up Bhujyu,Aśvins, from the waters, when cast into the sea, bearing him to shore by yourexertions with your undecaying, unwearied, unharassed horses.
verses.wilson_translation: You bore up Bhujyu,Aśvins, from the waters, when cast into the sea, bearing him to shore by yourexertions with your undecaying, unwearied, unharassed horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू मे हवमा शृणुतं युवाना यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् ।धत्तं रत्नानि जरतं च सूरीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ yuvānā ǀ yāsiṣṭám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ írā-vat ǀdhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ járatam ǀ ca ǀ sūrī́n ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ever youthful Aśvins, hear today this my invocation; come, Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared, grant wealth (to the offerer), elevate the worshipper, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Ever youthful Aśvins, hear today this my invocation; come, Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared, grant wealth (to the offerer), elevate the worshipper, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXX. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . RICH in all blessings, Aśvins come ye hither: this place on earth is called your own possession,Like a strong horse with a fair back it standeth, whereon, as in a lap, ye seat you firmly. This most delightful eulogy awaits you in the man's house drink-offering hath been heated,Which bringeth you over the seas and rivers, yoking as’twere two well-matched shining horses. Whatever dwellings ye possess, O Aśvins, in fields of men or in the streams of heaven,Resting upon the summit of the mountain, or bringing food to him who gives oblation, Delight yourselves, ye Gods, in plants and waters when Ṛṣis give them and ye find they suit You.Enriching us with treasures in abundance ye have looked back to former generations. Aśvins, though ye have heard them oft aforetime, regard the many prayers which Ṛṣis offer.Come to the man even as his heart desireth: may we enjoy your most delightful favour. Come to the sacrifice offered you, Nāsatyas, with men, oblations, and prayer duly uttered.Come to Vasiṣṭha as his heart desireth, for unto you these holy hymns are chanted. This is the thought, this is the song, O Aśvins: accept this hymn of ours, ye Steers, with favour.May these our prayers addressed to you come nigh you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: आ विश्ववाराश्विना गतं नः प्र तत्स्थानमवाचि वां पृथिव्यां ।अश्वो न वाजी शुनपृष्ठो अस्थादा यत्सेदथुर्ध्रुवसे न योनिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ viśva-vārā ǀ aśvinā ǀ gatam ǀ naḥ ǀ prá ǀ tát ǀ sthā́nam ǀ avāci ǀ vām ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀáśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ śuná-pṛṣṭhaḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ sedáthuḥ ǀ dhruváse ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǁ
verses.english_translation: All-adored Aśvins, come to our (sacrifice), to that plural ce on earth which has been designated yours,which, like a swift, broad-backed horse, awaits you, and on which you are seated as firmly as in a dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: All-adored Aśvins, come to our (sacrifice), to that plural ce on earth which has been designated yours,which, like a swift, broad-backed horse, awaits you, and on which you are seated as firmly as in a dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सिषक्ति सा वां सुमतिश्चनिष्ठातापि घर्मो मनुषो दुरोणे ।यो वां समुद्रान्त्सरितः पिपर्त्येतग्वा चिन्न सुयुजा युजानः ॥
verses.transliteration: sísakti ǀ sā́ ǀ vām ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ cániṣṭhā ǀ átāpi ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ samudrā́n ǀ sarítaḥ ǀ píparti ǀ éta-gvā ǀ cit ǀ ná ǀ su-yújā ǀ yujānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This excellent praise, redolent of food, propitiates you; the ewer has been heated in the dwelling of theworshipper, which, reaching you, fills the ocean and the rivers (through the rain it obtains), associating you (inthe rite), like two well-matched horses in a chariot.
verses.wilson_translation: This excellent praise, redolent of food, propitiates you; the ewer has been heated in the dwelling of theworshipper, which, reaching you, fills the ocean and the rivers (through the rain it obtains), associating you (inthe rite), like two well-matched horses in a chariot.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यानि स्थानान्यश्विना दधाथे दिवो यह्वीष्वोषधीषु विक्षु ।नि पर्वतस्य मूर्धनि सदंतेषं जनाय दाशुषे वहंता ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ni ǀ sthā́nāni ǀ aśvinā ǀ dadhā́the íti ǀ diváḥ ǀ yahvī́ṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀní ǀ párvatasya ǀ mūrdháni ǀ sádantā ǀ íṣam ǀ jánāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ váhantā ǁ
verses.english_translation: To whatever plural ces you may descend,Aśvins, from heaven, whether amidst the spreading plural nts, oramong men, or sitting on the summit of the clouds, be the bearers of food to the man, the donor (of the oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: To whatever plural ces you may descend,Aśvins, from heaven, whether amidst the spreading plural nts, oramong men, or sitting on the summit of the clouds, be the bearers of food to the man, the donor (of the oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चनिष्टं देवा ओषधीष्वप्सु यद्योग्या अश्नवैथे ऋषीणां ।पुरूणि रत्ना दधतौ न्यस्मे अनु पूर्वाणि चख्यथुर्युगानि ॥
verses.transliteration: caniṣṭám ǀ devau ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀ yát ǀ yogyā́ḥ ǀ aśnávaithe íti ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ rátnā ǀ dádhatau ǀ ní ǀ asmé íti ǀ ánu ǀ pū́rvāṇi ǀ cakhyathuḥ ǀ yugā́ni ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch, divine Aśvins, as you accept that which is most acceptable in the plural nts and in the waters,and those (things) which are most suitable to you, (the offerings) of the Ṛṣis, therefore, bestowing upon usample riches, (favour us) as you have favoured, bestowing former couples.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch, divine Aśvins, as you accept that which is most acceptable in the plural nts and in the waters,and those (things) which are most suitable to you, (the offerings) of the Ṛṣis, therefore, bestowing upon usample riches, (favour us) as you have favoured, bestowing former couples.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रुवांसा चिदश्विना पुरूण्यभि ब्रह्माणि चक्षाथे ऋषीणां ।प्रति प्र यातं वरमा जनायास्मे वामस्तु सुमतिश्चनिष्ठा ॥
verses.transliteration: śuśru-vā́ṃsā ǀ cit ǀ aśvinā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ abhí ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ cakṣāthe íti ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀpráti ǀ prá ǀ yātam ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ jánāya ǀ asmé íti ǀ vām ǀ astu ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ cániṣṭhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, hearing the many prayers of the Ṛṣis, you look (favourably) upon (us); come to the sacrifice ofthis man, and may your desired favour be (shown) him.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, hearing the many prayers of the Ṛṣis, you look (favourably) upon (us); come to the sacrifice ofthis man, and may your desired favour be (shown) him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वां यज्ञो नासत्या हविष्मान्कृतब्रह्मा समर्यो भवाति ।उप प्र यातं वरमा वसिष्ठमिमा ब्रह्माण्यृच्यंते युवभ्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ havíṣmān ǀ kṛtá-brahmā ǀ sa-maryáḥ ǀ bhávāti ǀúpa ǀ prá ǀ yātam ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ vásiṣṭham ǀ imā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ ṛcyante ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, to the excellent Vasiṣṭha, the worshiper who, accompanied by the priests, ispresent, offering oblations and repeating praises; these prayers are recited to (bring) you (hither).
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, to the excellent Vasiṣṭha, the worshiper who, accompanied by the priests, ispresent, offering oblations and repeating praises; these prayers are recited to (bring) you (hither).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं मनीषा इयमश्विना गीरिमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथां ।इमा ब्रह्माणि युवयून्यग्मन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ iyám ǀ aśvinā ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣethām ǀimā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ yuva-yū́ni ǀ agman ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This adoration,Aśvins, this praise (is for you) be gratified, showerers (of benefits), by this laudationmay these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessing.
verses.wilson_translation: This adoration,Aśvins, this praise (is for you) be gratified, showerers (of benefits), by this laudationmay these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXI. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Night retireth from the Dawn her Sister; the Dark one yieldeth to the Red her pathway.Let us invoke you rich in steeds and cattle - by day and night keep far from us the arrow. Bearing rich treasure in your car, O Aśvins, come to the mortal who presents oblation.Keep at a distance penury and sickness; Lovers of Sweetness, day and night preserve us. May your strong horses, seeking bliss, bring hither your chariot at the earliest flush of morning.With coursers yoked by Law drive hither, Aśvins, your car whose reins are light, laden with treasure. The chariot, Princes, that conveys you, moving at daylight, triple-seated, fraught with riches,Even with this come unto us, Nāsatyas, that laden with all food it may approach us. Ye freed Cyavāna from old age and weakness: ye brought the courser fleet of food to Pedu.Ye rescued Atri from distress and darkness, and loosed for Jāhuṣa the bonds that bound him. This is the thought, this is the song, O Aśvins: accept this hymn of ours, ye Steers, With favour.May these our prayers addressed to you come nigh you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: अप स्वसुरुषसो नग्जिहीते रिणक्ति कृष्णीररुषाय पंथां ।अश्वामघा गोमघा वां हुवेम दिवा नक्तं शरुमस्मद्युयोतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ svásuḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ nák ǀ jihīte ǀ riṇákti ǀ kṛṣṇī́ḥ ǀ aruṣā́ya ǀ pánthām ǀáśva-maghā ǀ gó-maghā ǀ vām ǀ huvema ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ śárum ǀ asmát ǀ yuyotam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Night retires before the dawn, the sister (of the Aśvins); the dark night leaves the path clear for theradiant (sun); upon you, who are affluent in horses, affluenet in cattle, we call day and night; keep away from usthe malevolent.
verses.wilson_translation: Night retires before the dawn, the sister (of the Aśvins); the dark night leaves the path clear for theradiant (sun); upon you, who are affluent in horses, affluenet in cattle, we call day and night; keep away from usthe malevolent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उपायातं दाशुषे मर्त्याय रथेन वाममश्विना वहंता ।युयुतमस्मदनिराममीवां दिवा नक्तं माध्वी त्रासीथां नः ॥
verses.transliteration: upa-ā́yātam ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀ ráthena ǀ vāmám ǀ aśvinā ǀ váhantā ǀyuyutám ǀ asmát ǀ ánirām ǀ ámīvām ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ trā́sīthām ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to the mortal, the donor (of oblations) bringing desired wealth in your chariot; keep afar from usfamine and sickness; day and night,Mādhvis, protect us.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to the mortal, the donor (of oblations) bringing desired wealth in your chariot; keep afar from usfamine and sickness; day and night,Mādhvis, protect us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां रथमवमस्यां व्युष्टौ सुम्नायवो वृषणो वर्तयंतु ।स्यूमगभस्तिमृतयुग्भिरश्वैराश्विना वसुमंतं वहेथां ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ avamásyām ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ sumna-yávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ vartayantu ǀsyū́ma-gabhastim ǀ ṛtayúk-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ vahethām ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your docile and vigorous (horses) bring hither your chariot at the approaching dawn; conducthither,Aśvins, your radiating, wealth-laden chariot, with your rain-bestowing steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: May your docile and vigorous (horses) bring hither your chariot at the approaching dawn; conducthither,Aśvins, your radiating, wealth-laden chariot, with your rain-bestowing steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वां रथो नृपती अस्ति वोळ्हा त्रिवंधुरो वसुमाँ उस्रयामा ।आ न एना नासत्योप यातमभि यद्वां विश्वप्स्न्यो जिगाति ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ nṛpatī íti nṛ-patī ǀ ásti ǀ voḷhā́ ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ vásu-mān ǀ usrá-yāmā ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀ abhí ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ viśvá-psnyaḥ ǀ jígāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: With that chariot, lords of men, which is your vehicle, which has three benches, is laden with wealth,and is the precursor of day, come Nāsatyās, to us; with that chariot which traverses (the sky) as yourall-pervading form.
verses.wilson_translation: With that chariot, lords of men, which is your vehicle, which has three benches, is laden with wealth,and is the precursor of day, come Nāsatyās, to us; with that chariot which traverses (the sky) as yourall-pervading form.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं च्यवानं जरसोऽमुमुक्तं नि पेदव ऊहथुराशुमश्वं ।निरंहसस्तमसः स्पर्तमत्रिं नि जाहुषं शिथिरे धातमंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ cyávānam ǀ jarásaḥ ǀ amumuktam ǀ ní ǀ pedáve ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ āśúm ǀ áśvam ǀníḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ spartam ǀ átrim ǀ ní ǀ jāhuṣám ǀ śithiré ǀ dhātam ǀ antáríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: You exempted Cyavanafrom decay; you mounted Peduupon a swift charger; you extricated Atrifromtorture and darkness; you replaced Jāhuṣain his rebellious kingdom.
verses.wilson_translation: You exempted Cyavanafrom decay; you mounted Peduupon a swift charger; you extricated Atrifromtorture and darkness; you replaced Jāhuṣain his rebellious kingdom.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं मनीषा इयमश्विना गीरिमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथां ।इमा ब्रह्माणि युवयून्यग्मन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ iyám ǀ aśvinā ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣethām ǀimā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ yuva-yū́ni ǀ agman ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This adoration,Aśvins, this praise (is for you), be gratified, showerer (of benefits), by this laudation;may these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: This adoration,Aśvins, this praise (is for you), be gratified, showerer (of benefits), by this laudation;may these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . COME, O Nāsatyas, on your car resplendent, rich in abundant wealth of kine and horses.As harnessed steeds, all our laudations follow you whose forms shine with most delightful beauty. Come with the Gods associate, come ye hither to us, Nāsatyas, with your car accordant.'Twixt you and us there is ancestral friendship and common kin: remember and regard it. Awakened are the songs that praise the Aśvins, the kindred prayers and the Celestial Mornings.Inviting those we long for, Earth and Heaven, the singer calleth these Nāsatyas hither. What time the Dawns break forth in light, O Aśvins, to you the poets offer their devotions.God Savitar hath sent aloft his splendour, and fires sing praises with the kindled fuel. Come from the west, come from the cast, Nāsatyas, come, Aśvins, from below and from above us.Bring wealth from all sides for the Fivefold People. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: आ गोमता नासत्या रथेनाश्वावता पुरुश्चंद्रेण यातं ।अभि वां विश्वा नियुतः सचंते स्पार्हया श्रिया तन्वा शुभाना ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gó-matā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ráthena ǀ áśva-vatā ǀ puru-candréṇa ǀ yātam ǀabhí ǀ vām ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ spārháyā ǀ śriyā́ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ śubhānā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, with your cattle-giving, horse-bestowing, wealth- yielding chariot; all praises gatherround you, who are resplendent with admirable beauty of a person n.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, with your cattle-giving, horse-bestowing, wealth- yielding chariot; all praises gatherround you, who are resplendent with admirable beauty of a person n.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो देवेभिरुप यातमर्वाक्सजोषसा नासत्या रथेन ।युवोर्हि नः सख्या पित्र्याणि समानो बंधुरुत तस्य वित्तं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ráthena ǀyuvóḥ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ pítryāṇi ǀ samānáḥ ǀ bándhuḥ ǀ utá ǀ tásya ǀ vittam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sharing in satisfaction with the gods, come to our presence,Nāsatyās, with your chariot, for thefriendship (that prevails) between you and us is from our forefathers; a common ancestor (is ours); acknowledgehis affinity.
verses.wilson_translation: Sharing in satisfaction with the gods, come to our presence,Nāsatyās, with your chariot, for thefriendship (that prevails) between you and us is from our forefathers; a common ancestor (is ours); acknowledgehis affinity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु स्तोमासो अश्विनोरबुध्रंजामि ब्रह्माण्युषसश्च देवीः ।आविवासन्रोदसी धिष्ण्येमे अच्छा विप्रो नासत्या विवक्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ abudhran ǀ jāmí ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ca ǀ devī́ḥ ǀā-vívāsan ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dhíṣṇye íti ǀ imé íti ǀ áccha ǀ vípraḥ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ vivakti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praises wakn up the Aśvins, kindred adorations (arouse them) and the celestial dawns; the sage,addressing these laudations to the adorable heaven and earth glorifies the Nāsatyāsin their presence.
verses.wilson_translation: Praises wakn up the Aśvins, kindred adorations (arouse them) and the celestial dawns; the sage,addressing these laudations to the adorable heaven and earth glorifies the Nāsatyāsin their presence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि चेदुच्छंत्यश्विना उषासः प्र वां ब्रह्माणि कारवो भरंते ।ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता देवो अश्रेद्बृहदग्नयः समिधा जरंते ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ ca ǀ ít ǀ ucchánti ǀ aśvinau ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ prá ǀ vām ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ bharante ǀūrdhvám ǀ bhānúm ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aśret ǀ bṛhát ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ jarante ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the dawns arise, your worshippers,Aśvins, profer you praises; the divine Savitācasts hissplendours on high; the fires, with their (kindled) fuel, greatly glorify you.
verses.wilson_translation: When the dawns arise, your worshippers,Aśvins, profer you praises; the divine Savitācasts hissplendours on high; the fires, with their (kindled) fuel, greatly glorify you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पश्चातान्नासत्या पुरस्तादाश्विना यातमधरादुदक्तात् ।आ विश्वतः पांचजन्येन राया यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paścā́tāt ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ā́ ǀ purástāt ǀ ā́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yātam ǀ adharā́t ǀ údaktāt ǀā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyena ǀ rāyā́ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; (come),Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; (come),Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXIII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE have o’erpassed the limit of this darkness while, worshipping the Gods, we sang their praises.The song invoketh both Immortal Aśvins far-reaching, born of old, great WonderWorkers. And, O Nāsatyas, man's dear Priest is seated, who brings to sacrifice and offers worship,Be near and taste the pleasant juice, O Aśvins: with food, I call you to the sacrifices. We choosing you, have let our worship follow its course: ye Steers, accept this hymn with favour.Obeying you as your appointed servant, Vasiṣṭha singing hath with lauds aroused you. And these Two Priests come nigh unto our people, united, demon-slayers, mighty-handed.The juices that exhilarate are mingled. Injure us not, but come with happy fortune. Come from the west, come from the cast, Nāsatyas, come, Aśvins, from below and from above us.Bring wealth from all sides for the Fivefold People. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति स्तोमं देवयंतो दधानाः ।पुरुदंसा पुरुतमा पुराजामर्त्या हवते अश्विना गीः ॥
verses.transliteration: átāriṣma ǀ támasaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ asyá ǀ práti ǀ stómam ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀpuru-dáṃsā ǀ puru-támā ǀ purā-jā́ ǀ ámartyā ǀ havate ǀ aśvínā ǀ gī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devoted to the gods, and hymning their praise, we have crossed to the opposite shore of this (state of)darkness; the worshipper invokes the Aśvins, the doers of many deeds, the most mighty, the first born, theimmortal.
verses.wilson_translation: Devoted to the gods, and hymning their praise, we have crossed to the opposite shore of this (state of)darkness; the worshipper invokes the Aśvins, the doers of many deeds, the most mighty, the first born, theimmortal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न्यु प्रियो मनुषः सादि होता नासत्या यो यजते वंदते च ।अश्नीतं मध्वो अश्विना उपाक आ वां वोचे विदथेषु प्रयस्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyáḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ sādi ǀ hótā ǀ nā́satyā ǀ yáḥ ǀ yájate ǀ vándate ǀ ca ǀaśnītám ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ upāké ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ voce ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ práyasvān ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man who is dear to you,Nāsatyās, the invoker of the gods, has taken his seat, he who offersworship and repeats praise; be near,Aśvins, and partake of the libation; supplied with food, I address you atsacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: The man who is dear to you,Nāsatyās, the invoker of the gods, has taken his seat, he who offersworship and repeats praise; be near,Aśvins, and partake of the libation; supplied with food, I address you atsacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहेम यज्ञं पथामुराणा इमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथां ।श्रुष्टीवेव प्रेषितो वामबोधि प्रति स्तोमैर्जरमाणो वसिष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration: áhema ǀ yajñám ǀ pathā́m ǀ urāṇā́ḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣethām ǀśruṣṭīvā́-iva ǀ prá-iṣitaḥ ǀ vām ǀ abodhi ǀ práti ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ járamāṇaḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praising (the gods), we preparers the sacrifice for their coming; showerers (of benefits), be propitiatedby this pious laudation; despatched like a swift messenger,Vasiṣṭhaarouses you, glorifying you with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Praising (the gods), we preparers the sacrifice for their coming; showerers (of benefits), be propitiatedby this pious laudation; despatched like a swift messenger,Vasiṣṭhaarouses you, glorifying you with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप त्या वह्नी गमतो विशं नो रक्षोहणा संभृता वीळुपाणी ।समंधांस्यग्मत मत्सराणि मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतं शिवेन ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ tyā́ ǀ váhnī íti ǀ gamataḥ ǀ víśam ǀ naḥ ǀ rakṣaḥ-hánā ǀ sám-bhṛtā ǀ vīḷúpāṇī íti vīḷú-pāṇī ǀsám ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ agmata ǀ matsarā́ṇi ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mardhiṣṭam ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ śivéna ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those two, the bearers (of oblations), approach our people, destroyers ofrākṣasas,well-nourished, strong-handed; accept our exhilarating (sacrificial) viands; injure us not, but come with goodfortune.
verses.wilson_translation: May those two, the bearers (of oblations), approach our people, destroyers ofrākṣasas,well-nourished, strong-handed; accept our exhilarating (sacrificial) viands; injure us not, but come with goodfortune.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पश्चातान्नासत्या पुरस्तादाश्विना यातमधरादुदक्तात् ।आ विश्वतः पांचजन्येन राया यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paścā́tāt ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ā́ ǀ purástāt ǀ ā́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yātam ǀ adharā́t ǀ údaktāt ǀā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyena ǀ rāyā́ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; come,Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; come,Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN I.XXIV. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THESE morning sacrifices call you, Aśvins, at the break of day.For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house ye visit all. O Heroes, ye bestow wonderful nourishment. send it to him whose songs are sweetAccordant, both of you, drive your car down to us, and drink the savoury Soma juice. Approach ye and be near to us. drink, O ye Aśvins, of the meath.Draw forth the milk, ye Mighty, rich in genuine wealth: injure us not, and come to us. The horses that convey you in their rapid flight down to the worshipper's abode,With these your speedy coursers, Heroes, Aśvins, come, ye Gods, come well-inclined to us. Yea, verily, our princes seek the Aśvins in pursuit of food.These shall give lasting glory to our liberal lords, and, both Nāsatyas, shelter us. Those who have led the way, like cars, offending none, those who are guardians of the men-Also through their own might the heroes have grown strong, and dwell in safe and happy homes.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवंते अश्विना ।अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशं हि गच्छथः ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ díviṣṭayaḥ ǀ usrā́ ǀ havante ǀ aśvinā ǀayám ǀ vām ǀ ahve ǀ ávase ǀ śacīvasū íti śacī-vasū ǀ víśam-viśam ǀ hí ǀ gácchathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These pious praises glorify you, radiant Aśvins; I call upon you, who are rich, in acts of preservation,for you reach out to every individual.
verses.wilson_translation: These pious praises glorify you, radiant Aśvins; I call upon you, who are rich, in acts of preservation,for you reach out to every individual.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं चित्रं ददथुर्भोजनं नरा चोदेथां सूनृतावते ।अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ citrám ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ bhójanam ǀ narā ǀ códethām ǀ sūnṛ́tā-vate ǀarvā́k ǀ rátham ǀ sá-manasā ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǀ píbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are possessed, leaders (of rites), of marvellous wealth; bestow upon him who sincerely praisesyou; alike favourable-minded, direct your chariot to our presence; drink the sweet Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: You are possessed, leaders (of rites), of marvellous wealth; bestow upon him who sincerely praisesyou; alike favourable-minded, direct your chariot to our presence; drink the sweet Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यातमुप भूषतं मध्वः पिबतमश्विना ।दुग्धं पयो वृषणा जेन्यावसू मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ bhūṣatam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǀdugdhám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ jenyāvasū íti ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mardhiṣṭam ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Aśvins, tarry near us, drink of the sweet libation; showerers (of benefits), by whom riches arewon, milk the rain (from the firmament); harm us not; come hither.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Aśvins, tarry near us, drink of the sweet libation; showerers (of benefits), by whom riches arewon, milk the rain (from the firmament); harm us not; come hither.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वासो ये वामुप दाशुषो गृहं युवां दीयंति बिभ्रतः ।मक्षूयुभिर्नरा हयेभिरश्विना देवा यातमस्मयू ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ úpa ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǀ yuvā́m ǀ dī́yanti ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀmakṣuyú-bhiḥ ǀ narā ǀ háyebhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ devā ǀ yātam ǀ asmayū́ ítyasma-yū́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yours are the horses that, conveying you, bring you to the dwelling to the donor (of the oblation); divineleader (of rites), favourable inclined towards us, come with your rapid steed
verses.wilson_translation: Yours are the horses that, conveying you, bring you to the dwelling to the donor (of the oblation); divineleader (of rites), favourable inclined towards us, come with your rapid steed
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा ह यंतो अश्विना पृक्षः सचंत सूरयः ।ता यंसतो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं यशश्छर्दिरस्मभ्यं नासत्या ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ ha ǀ yántaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ sacanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ yaṃsataḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ dhruvám ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ chardíḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ nā́satyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pious worshippers now approaching you unite to offer (you sacrificial) food; do you two,Nāsatyās, grant to us who are affluent (in offerings) enduring fame and dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious worshippers now approaching you unite to offer (you sacrificial) food; do you two,Nāsatyās, grant to us who are affluent (in offerings) enduring fame and dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ये ययुरवृकासो रथा इव नृपातारो जनानां ।उत स्वेन शवसा शूशुवुर्नर उत क्षियंति सुक्षितिं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ yayúḥ ǀ avṛkā́sáḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ nṛ-pātā́raḥ ǀ jánānām ǀutá ǀ svéna ǀ śávasā ǀ śūśuvuḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣiyanti ǀ su-kṣitím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those worshippers, the benefactors of men, doing injury to none who go to you, like chariots (to thefarm), either prosper by their own strength, or inhabit an excellent abode.
verses.wilson_translation: Those worshippers, the benefactors of men, doing injury to none who go to you, like chariots (to thefarm), either prosper by their own strength, or inhabit an excellent abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXV. Dawn.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BORN in the heavens the Dawn hath flushed, and showing her majesty is come as Law ordaineth.She hath uncovered fiends and hateful darkness; best of Aṅgirases, hath waked the pathways. Rouse us this day to high and happy fortune: to great felicity, O Dawn, promote us.Vouchsafe us manifold and splendid riches, famed among mortals, man-befriending Goddess! See, lovely Morning's everlasting splendours, bright with their varied colours, have approached us.Filling the region of mid-air, producing the rites of holy worship, they have mounted. She yokes her chariot far away, and swiftly visits the lands where the Five Tribes are settled,Looking upon the works and ways of mortals, Daughter of Heaven, the world's Imperial Lady. She who is rich in spoil, the Spouse of Sūrya, wondrously opulent, rules all wealth and treasures.Consumer of our youth, the seers extol her: lauded by priests rich Dawn shines out refulgent. Apparent are the steeds of varied colour, the red steeds carrying resplendent Morning.On her all-lovely car she comes, the Fair One, and brings rich treasure for her faithful servant. True with the True and Mighty with the Mighty, with Gods a Goddess, Holy with the Holy,She brake strong fences down and gave the cattle: the kine were lowing as they greeted Morning. O Dawn, now give us wealth in kine and heroes, and horses, fraught with manifold enjoyment.Protect our sacred grass from man's reproaches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: व्युषा आवो दिविजा ऋतेनाविष्कृण्वाना महिमानमागात् ।अप द्रुहस्तम आवरजुष्टमंगिरस्तमा पथ्या अजीगः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ āvaḥ ǀ divi-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛténa ǀ āviḥ-kṛṇvānā́ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀápa ǀ drúhaḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ āvaḥ ǀ ájuṣṭam ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamā ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Dawn, the daughter of heaven, has risen; she comes, manifesting her magnificence in light; shescatters our foes as well as the odious darkness, and re-illuminates the paths thaat are to be trodden (by livingbeings).
verses.wilson_translation: The Dawn, the daughter of heaven, has risen; she comes, manifesting her magnificence in light; shescatters our foes as well as the odious darkness, and re-illuminates the paths thaat are to be trodden (by livingbeings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महे नो अद्य सुविताय बोध्युषो महे सौभगाय प्र यंधि ।चित्रं रयिं यशसं धेह्यस्मे देवि मर्तेषु मानुषि श्रवस्युं ॥
