verses.wilson_translation: He who without healing materials before the flow of blood from the necks was the effecter of there-union, the opulent Maghavan, again makes whole the dissevered (parts).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा भूम निष्ट्या इवेंद्र त्वदरणा इव ।वनानि न प्रजहितान्यद्रिवो दुरोषासो अमन्महि ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ bhūma ǀ níṣṭyāḥ-iva ǀ índra ǀ tvát ǀ áraṇāḥ-iva ǀvánāni ǀ ná ǀ pra-jahitā́ni ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ duróṣāsaḥ ǀ amanmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we never be like the abject,Indra, through your favour, nor suffer affliction; may we never be likebranchless trees; for, thunderer, unconsumable (by foes) we glorify you.
verses.wilson_translation: May we never be like the abject,Indra, through your favour, nor suffer affliction; may we never be likebranchless trees; for, thunderer, unconsumable (by foes) we glorify you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमन्महीदनाशवोऽनुग्रासश्च वृत्रहन् ।सकृत्सु ते महता शूर राधसा अनु स्तोमं मुदीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ámanmahi ǀ ít ǀ anāśávaḥ ǀ anugrā́saḥ ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀsakṛ́t ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ mahatā́ ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ ánu ǀ stómam ǀ mudīmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Neitherrashnor irate, we verily glorify you, slayer of Vṛtra, may we propitiate you, hero, for once (atleast) by our praise with great (sacrificial) wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Neitherrashnor irate, we verily glorify you, slayer of Vṛtra, may we propitiate you, hero, for once (atleast) by our praise with great (sacrificial) wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदि स्तोमं मम श्रवदस्माकमिंद्रमिंदवः ।तिरः पवित्रं ससृवांस आशवो मंदंतु तुग्र्यावृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ stómam ǀ máma ǀ śrávat ǀ asmā́kam ǀ índram ǀ índavaḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ sasṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ mándantu ǀ tugrya-vṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: If he hear our praise, then may our libations, flowing through the filter, dropping quickly, and diluted withconsecrated water, exhilarate Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: If he hear our praise, then may our libations, flowing through the filter, dropping quickly, and diluted withconsecrated water, exhilarate Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वद्य सधस्तुतिं वावातुः सख्युरा गहि ।उपस्तुतिर्मघोनां प्र त्वावत्वधा ते वश्मि सुष्टुतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ adyá ǀ sadhá-stutim ǀ vavā́tuḥ ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀúpa-stutiḥ ǀ maghónām ǀ prá ǀ tvā ǀ avatu ǀ ádha ǀ te ǀ vaśmi ǀ su-stutím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come quickly to-day to the collected laudation of your devoted friend; may the subsidiary praise ofwealthy (worshippers) reach you, but now I wish (to offer) your complete eulogy.
verses.wilson_translation: Come quickly to-day to the collected laudation of your devoted friend; may the subsidiary praise ofwealthy (worshippers) reach you, but now I wish (to offer) your complete eulogy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोता हि सोममद्रिभिरेमेनमप्सु धावत ।गव्या वस्त्रेव वासयंत इन्नरो निर्धुक्षन्वक्षणाभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sóta ǀ hí ǀ sómam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īm ǀ enam ǀ ap-sú ǀ dhāvata ǀgavyā́ ǀ vástrā-iva ǀ vāsáyantaḥ ǀ ít ǀ náraḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ dhukṣan ǀ vakṣáṇābhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Extract the Somawith the bruising stones, wash it with the consecrated waters; (for by so doing) theleaders (of the rain, the Maruts) clothing (the sky with clouds) as with vesture of the hide of the cow, milk, forth(the water) for the rivers.
verses.wilson_translation: Extract the Somawith the bruising stones, wash it with the consecrated waters; (for by so doing) theleaders (of the rain, the Maruts) clothing (the sky with clouds) as with vesture of the hide of the cow, milk, forth(the water) for the rivers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि ।अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पृण ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ jmáḥ ǀ ádha ǀ vā ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǀayā́ ǀ vardhasva ǀ tanvā́ ǀ girā́ ǀ máma ǀ ā́ ǀ jātā́ ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ pṛṇa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether come from the earth or the firmament, or the vast luminous (heaven), be magnified by this maydiffusive praise; satisfy,Śatakratu, (my) people.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether come from the earth or the firmament, or the vast luminous (heaven), be magnified by this maydiffusive praise; satisfy,Śatakratu, (my) people.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय सु मदिंतमं सोमं सोता वरेण्यं ।शक्र एणं पीपयद्विश्वया धिया हिन्वानं न वाजयुं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ sú ǀ madín-tamam ǀ sómam ǀ sota ǀ váreṇyam ǀśakráḥ ǀ enam ǀ pīpayat ǀ víśvayā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ hinvānám ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúm ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour out to Indrathe most exhilarating, the most excellent Soma, forŚakracherishes him who isdesirous of food, propitiating him by every pious act.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour out to Indrathe most exhilarating, the most excellent Soma, forŚakracherishes him who isdesirous of food, propitiating him by every pious act.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा त्वा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं गिरा ।भूर्णिं मृगं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ sómasya ǀ gáldayā ǀ sádā ǀ yā́can ǀ ahám ǀ girā́ ǀbhū́rṇim ǀ mṛgám ǀ ná ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ cukrudham ǀ káḥ ǀ ī́śānam ǀ ná ǀ yāciṣat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I never, when importuning you in sacrifices with the effusion of the Somaand with praise, exciteyou like a ferocious lion to wrath; who (is there in the world) that does not solicit his lorḍ
verses.wilson_translation: May I never, when importuning you in sacrifices with the effusion of the Somaand with praise, exciteyou like a ferocious lion to wrath; who (is there in the world) that does not solicit his lorḍ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मदेनेषितं मदमुग्रमुग्रेण शवसा ।विश्वेषां तरुतारं मदच्युतं मदे हि ष्मा ददाति नः ॥
verses.transliteration: mádena ǀ iṣitám ǀ mádam ǀ ugrám ǀ ugréṇa ǀ śávasā ǀvíśveṣām ǀ tarutā́ram ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ máde ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ dádāti ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (May Indradrink) with invogorated strength, the strong exhilarating (Soma) offered with animating(laudation); for in his delight he gives us (a son) the overcomer of all (foes), the humbler of their pride.
verses.wilson_translation: (May Indradrink) with invogorated strength, the strong exhilarating (Soma) offered with animating(laudation); for in his delight he gives us (a son) the overcomer of all (foes), the humbler of their pride.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शेवारे वार्या पुरु देवो मर्ताय दाशुषे ।स सुन्वते च स्तुवते च रासते विश्वगूर्तो अरिष्टुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: śévāre ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀsáḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ ca ǀ stuvaté ǀ ca ǀ rāsate ǀ viśvá-gūrtaḥ ǀ ari-stutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine (Indra), the accomplisher of all aims, the glorified by his foes, gives vast treasures to themortal who presents offerings at the sacrifice, to him who pours out the libation, who hymns his praise.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine (Indra), the accomplisher of all aims, the glorified by his foes, gives vast treasures to themortal who presents offerings at the sacrifice, to him who pours out the libation, who hymns his praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एंद्र याहि मत्स्व चित्रेण देव राधसा ।सरो न प्रास्युदरं सपीतिभिरा सोमेभिरुरु स्फिरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ mátsva ǀ citréṇa ǀ deva ǀ rā́dhasā ǀsáraḥ ǀ ná ǀ prāsi ǀ udáram ǀ sápīti-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ urú ǀ sphirám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come here,Indra, be exhilarated by the wonderful (libatory) affluence and with your fellow-troopers (the Maruts) fill with the Somayour vast belly, capacious as a lake,
verses.wilson_translation: Come here,Indra, be exhilarated by the wonderful (libatory) affluence and with your fellow-troopers (the Maruts) fill with the Somayour vast belly, capacious as a lake,
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये ।ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इंद्र केशिनो वहंतु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ sahásram ǀ ā́ ǀ śatám ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀbrahma-yújaḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ indra ǀ keśínaḥ ǀ váhantu ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your thousand, your hundred steeds,Indrayoke to your golden chariot, harnessed by prayer, withflowing manes, bring you to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: May your thousand, your hundred steeds,Indrayoke to your golden chariot, harnessed by prayer, withflowing manes, bring you to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या ।शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अंधसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ ráthe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀ hárī íti ǀ mayū́ra-śepyā ǀśiti-pṛṣṭhā́ ǀ vahatām ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ vivákṣaṇasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your two peacock-tailed, white-backed horses, yoked to your golden chariot, bring you to drink ofthe sweet praiseworthy libation.
verses.wilson_translation: May your two peacock-tailed, white-backed horses, yoked to your golden chariot, bring you to drink ofthe sweet praiseworthy libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबा त्वस्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव ।परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: píba ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ pūrvapā́ḥ-iva ǀpári-kṛtasya ǀ rasínaḥ ǀ iyám ǀ ā-sutíḥ ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ patyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink you, who are worthy to be glorified, of this consecrated and juicy libation, like the first drinker(vāyu); this excellent effusion issues for your exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink you, who are worthy to be glorified, of this consecrated and juicy libation, like the first drinker(vāyu); this excellent effusion issues for your exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य एको अस्ति दंसना महाँ उग्रो अभि व्रतैः ।गमत्स शिप्री न स योषदा गमद्धवं न परि वर्जति ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ daṃsánā ǀ mahā́m ǀ ugráḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vratáiḥ ǀgámat ǀ sáḥ ǀ śiprī́ ǀ ná ǀ sáḥ ǀ yoṣat ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀ hávam ǀ ná ǀ pári ǀ varjati ǁ
verses.english_translation: May he who alone overcomes (enemies) through (the power of) religious observances, who by piousacts is rendered mighty and fierce, who is handsome- chinned, approach; may he never be remote; may he cometo our invocation; may he never abandon us.
verses.wilson_translation: May he who alone overcomes (enemies) through (the power of) religious observances, who by piousacts is rendered mighty and fierce, who is handsome- chinned, approach; may he never be remote; may he cometo our invocation; may he never abandon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं पुरं चरिष्ण्वं वधैः शुष्णस्य सं पिणक् ।त्वं भा अनु चरो अध द्विता यदिंद्र हव्यो भुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ púram ǀ cariṣṇvám ǀ vadháiḥ ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǀtvám ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ caraḥ ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have broken to pieces the moveable city ofŚuṣṇawith your weapons; you who are light havefollowed him; wherefore,Indra, you are in two ways to be worshipped.
verses.wilson_translation: You have broken to pieces the moveable city ofŚuṣṇawith your weapons; you who are light havefollowed him; wherefore,Indra, you are in two ways to be worshipped.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मम त्वा सूर उदिते मम मध्यंदिने दिवः ।मम प्रपित्वे अपिशर्वरे वसवा स्तोमासो अवृत्सत ॥
verses.transliteration: máma ǀ tvā ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ máma ǀ madhyándine ǀ diváḥ ǀmáma ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ api-śarvaré ǀ vaso íti ǀ ā́ ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
verses.english_translation: May my prayers when the sun has risen, those also at noon, those also when evening arrives, bringyou back, giver of riches (to my sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: May my prayers when the sun has risen, those also at noon, those also when evening arrives, bringyou back, giver of riches (to my sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तुहि स्तुहीदेते घा ते मंहिष्ठासो मघोनां ।निंदिताश्वः प्रपथी परमज्या मघस्य मेध्यातिथे ॥
verses.transliteration: stuhí ǀ stuhí ǀ ít ǀ eté ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ máṃhiṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ maghónām ǀninditá-aśvaḥ ǀ pra-pathī́ ǀ parama-jyā́ḥ ǀ maghásya ǀ medhya-atithe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise (me), praise (me), Medhyātithi, for among the wealthy we are the most liberal donors of wealthto you; (praise me as one) who outstrips a horse in speed, follows the right path, and bears the best arms.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise (me), praise (me), Medhyātithi, for among the wealthy we are the most liberal donors of wealthto you; (praise me as one) who outstrips a horse in speed, follows the right path, and bears the best arms.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यदश्वान्वनन्वतः श्रद्धयाहं रथे रुहं ।उत वामस्य वसुनश्चिकेतति यो अस्ति याद्वः पशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ áśvān ǀ vánan-vataḥ ǀ śraddháyā ǀ ahám ǀ ráthe ǀ ruhám ǀutá ǀ vāmásya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ ciketati ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ yā́dvaḥ ǀ paśúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When with faith I harness the docile horses in the car, (praise me), for the descendant of Yādu,possessed of cattle, know how to distribute desirable riches.
verses.wilson_translation: When with faith I harness the docile horses in the car, (praise me), for the descendant of Yādu,possessed of cattle, know how to distribute desirable riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य ऋज्रा मह्यं मामहे सह त्वचा हिरण्यया ।एष विश्वान्यभ्यस्तु सौभगासंगस्य स्वनद्रथः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛjrā́ ǀ máhyam ǀ mamahé ǀ sahá ǀ tvacā́ ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǀeṣáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ sáubhagā ǀ āsaṅgásya ǀ svanát-rathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Praise me, saying), "He who has presented riches to me with a golden purse; may this rattling chariotof Asaṅgacarry off all the treasures (of my enemy)".
verses.wilson_translation: (Praise me, saying), "He who has presented riches to me with a golden purse; may this rattling chariotof Asaṅgacarry off all the treasures (of my enemy)".
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध प्लायोगिरति दासदन्यानासंगो अग्ने दशभिः सहस्रैः ।अधोक्षणो दश मह्यं रुशंतो नळा इव सरसो निरतिष्ठन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ plā́yogiḥ ǀ áti ǀ dāsat ǀ anyā́n ǀ ā-saṅgáḥ ǀ agne ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ sahásraiḥ ǀádha ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ máhyam ǀ rúśantaḥ ǀ naḷā́ḥ-iva ǀ sárasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ atiṣṭhan ǁ
verses.english_translation: (So praise me, saying), "Asaṅga, the son of plural _yoga, has given more than others,Agni, by tens ofthousands; ten times the (number of) vigorous and brilliant oxen (given by him) to me, issue forth like the reeds ofa lake.
verses.wilson_translation: (So praise me, saying), "Asaṅga, the son of plural _yoga, has given more than others,Agni, by tens ofthousands; ten times the (number of) vigorous and brilliant oxen (given by him) to me, issue forth like the reeds ofa lake.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अन्वस्य स्थूरं ददृशे पुरस्तादनस्थ ऊरुरवरंबमाणः ।शश्वती नार्यभिचक्ष्याह सुभद्रमर्य भोजनं बिभर्षि ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ asya ǀ sthūrám ǀ dadṛśe ǀ purástāt ǀ anastháḥ ǀ ūrúḥ ǀ ava-rámbamāṇaḥ ǀśáśvatī ǀ nā́rī ǀ abhi-cákṣya ǀ āha ǀ sú-bhadram ǀ arya ǀ bhójanam ǀ bibharṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Śaśvatī, perceiving that the sings of manhood were restored, exclaims, "Joy, husband, you arecapable of enjoyment".
verses.wilson_translation: Śaśvatī, perceiving that the sings of manhood were restored, exclaims, "Joy, husband, you arecapable of enjoyment".
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN II. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HERE is the Soma juice expressed; O Vasu, drink till thou art full:Undaunted God, we give it thee. Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool,’Tis like a courser bathed in stream. This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk.Indra, I call thee to our feast. Beloved of all, Indra alone drinks up the flowing Soma juiceAmong the Gods and mortal men. The Friend, whom not the brilliant-hued, the badly-mixt or bitter draught,Repels, the far-extending God; While other men than we with milk chase him as hunters chase a deer,And with their kine inveigle him. For him, for Indra, for the God, be pressed three draughts of Soma juiceIn the juice-drinker's own abode. Three reservoirs exude their drops, filled are three beakers to the brim,All for one offering to the God. Pure art thou, set in many a place, and blended in the midst with milkAnd curd, to cheer the Hero best. Here, Indra, are thy Soma-draughts pressed out by us, the strong, the pure:They crave admixture of the milk. O Indra, pour in milk, prepare the cake, and mix the Soma-draught.I hear them say that thou art rich. Quaffed juices fight within the breast. The drunken praise not by their wine,The naked praise not when it rains. Rich be the praiser of one rich, munificent and famed like thee:High rank be his, O Lord of Bays. Foe of the man who adds no milk, he heeds not any chanted hymnOr holy psalm that may he sung. Give us not, Indra, as a prey unto the scornful or the proud:Help, Mighty One, with power and might. This, even this, O Indra, we implore. as thy devoted friends,The Kaṇvas praise thee with their hymns. Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy:On thy land only have I thought. The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleepThey punish sloth unweariedly. Come hither swift with gifts of wealth - be not thou angry with us-likeA great man with a youthful bride. Let him not, wrathful with us, spend the evening far from us to-day,Like some unpleasant son-in-law. For well we know this Hero's love, most liberal of the boons he gives,His plans whom the three worlds display. Pour forth the gift which Kaṇvas bring, for none more glorious do we knowThan the Strong Lord with countless aids. O presser, offer Soma first to Indra, Hero, Śakra, himThe Friend of man, that he may drink; Who, in untroubled ways, is best provider, for his worshippers.Of strength in horses and in kine. Pressers, for him blend Soma juice, each draught most excellent, for himThe Brave, the Hero, for his joy. The Vṛtra-slayer drinks the juice. May he who gives a hundred aidsApproach, nor stay afar from us. May the strong Bay Steeds, yoked by prayer, bring hither unto us our Friend,Lover of Song, renowned by songs. Sweet are the Soma juices, come! Blent are the Soma juices, come!Ṛṣi-like, mighty, fair of cheek, come hither quickly to the feast. And lauds which strengthen thee for great bounty and valour, and exaltIndra who doeth glorious deeds, And songs to thee who lovest song, and all those hymns addressed to thee-These evermore confirm thy might. Thus he, sole doer of great deeds whose hand holds thunder, gives us strength,He who hath never been subdued. Vṛtra he slays with his right hand, even Indra, great with mighty power,And much-invoked in many a place. He upon whom all men depend, all regions, all achievements, heTakes pleasure in our wealthy chiefs. All this hath he accomplished, yea, Indra, most gloriously renowned,Who gives our wealthy princes strength. Who drives his chariot seeking spoil, from afar, to him he loves:For swift is he to bring men wealth. The Sage who, winning spoil with steeds, slays Vṛtra, Hero with the men,His servant's faithful succourer. O Priyamedhas, worship with collected mind this Indra whomThe Soma hath full well inspired. Ye Kaṇvas, sing the Mighty One, Lord of the Brave, who loves renown,All-present, glorified by song. Strong Friend, who, with no trace of feet, restores the cattle to the men,Who rest their wish and hope on him. Shaped as a Ram, Stone-hurler I once thou camest hither to the sonOf Kaṇva, wise Medhyātithi. Vibhindu, thou hast helped this man, giving him thousands four times ten,And afterward eight thousand more. And these twain pouring streams of milk, creative, daughters of delight,For wedlock sake I glorify.

verses.sanskrit: इदं वसो सुतमंधः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरं ।अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते ॥
verses.transliteration: idám ǀ vaso íti ǀ sutám ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ píba ǀ sú-pūrṇam ǀ udáram ǀánābhayin ǀ rarimá ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give of dwellings (Indra), drink this effused libation till your belly is full, we offer it, undaunted (Indra), toyou.
verses.wilson_translation: Give of dwellings (Indra), drink this effused libation till your belly is full, we offer it, undaunted (Indra), toyou.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नृभिर्धूतः सुतो अश्नैरव्यो वारैः परिपूतः ।अश्वो न निक्तो नदीषु ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ dhūtáḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ áśnaiḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́raiḥ ǀ pári-pūtaḥ ǀáśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ niktáḥ ǀ nadī́ṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Washed by the priests, effused by the stones, purified by the woollen filter, like a horse cleansed in astream.
verses.wilson_translation: Washed by the priests, effused by the stones, purified by the woollen filter, like a horse cleansed in astream.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः स्वादुमकर्म श्रीणंतः ।इंद्र त्वास्मिन्त्सधमादे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ te ǀ yávam ǀ yáthā ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ svādúm ǀ akarma ǀ śrīṇántaḥ ǀíndra ǀ tvā ǀ asmín ǀ sadha-mā́de ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have made it sweet for you as the barley-cake mixing it with milk, and therefore,Indra, (I invoke)you to this social rite.
verses.wilson_translation: We have made it sweet for you as the barley-cake mixing it with milk, and therefore,Indra, (I invoke)you to this social rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र इत्सोमपा एक इंद्रः सुतपा विश्वायुः ।अंतर्देवान्मर्त्यांश्च ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ít ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ suta-pā́ḥ ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀantáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ mártyān ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraverily is the chief drinker of the Somaamong gods and men, the drinker of the effused libation, theaccepter of all kinds of offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraverily is the chief drinker of the Somaamong gods and men, the drinker of the effused libation, theaccepter of all kinds of offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न यं शुक्रो न दुराशीर्न तृप्रा उरुव्यचसं ।अपस्पृण्वते सुहार्दं ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ná ǀ dúḥ-āśīḥ ǀ ná ǀ tṛprā́ḥ ǀ uru-vyácasam ǀapa-spṛṇvaté ǀ su-hā́rdam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We praise him) a universal kind-hearted (friend), whom the pure Soma, the mixture (of it) made withdifficulty, or other satisfying (offerings) do not displease.
verses.wilson_translation: (We praise him) a universal kind-hearted (friend), whom the pure Soma, the mixture (of it) made withdifficulty, or other satisfying (offerings) do not displease.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गोभिर्यदीमन्ये अस्मन्मृगं न व्रा मृगयंते ।अभित्सरंति धेनुभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ anyé ǀ asmát ǀ mṛgám ǀ ná ǀ vrā́ḥ ǀ mṛgáyante ǀabhi-tsáranti ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whom others pursue with offerings of milk and curds as hunters chase a deer (with nets and snares),and harass with (inappropriate) praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Whom others pursue with offerings of milk and curds as hunters chase a deer (with nets and snares),and harass with (inappropriate) praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रय इंद्रस्य सोमाः सुतासः संतु देवस्य ।स्वे क्षये सुतपाव्नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tráyaḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sómāḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ santu ǀ devásya ǀsvé ǀ kṣáye ǀ suta-pā́vnaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the three libations be effused for the divine Indrain his won dwelling, (for he is) the drinker of theeffused Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: May the three libations be effused for the divine Indrain his won dwelling, (for he is) the drinker of theeffused Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रयः कोशासः श्चोतंति तिस्रश्चम्वः सुपूर्णाः ।समाने अधि भार्मन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tráyaḥ ǀ kóśāsaḥ ǀ ścotanti ǀ tisráḥ ǀ camváḥ ǀ sú-pūrṇāḥ ǀsamāné ǀ ádhi ǀ bhā́rman ǁ
verses.english_translation: Three purifying vessels drop (the Soma), three ladles are well filled (for the libation), the whole isfurnished for the common sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Three purifying vessels drop (the Soma), three ladles are well filled (for the libation), the whole isfurnished for the common sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुचिरसि पुरुनिःष्ठाः क्षीरैर्मध्यत आशीर्तः ।दध्ना मंदिष्ठः शूरस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ asi ǀ puruniḥ-sthā́ḥ ǀ kṣīráiḥ ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ ā́-śīrtaḥ ǀdadhnā́ ǀ mándiṣṭhaḥ ǀ śū́rasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: You (Soma) are pure, distributed in many vessels, mixed at the mid-day sacrifice with milk, and (at thethird sacrifice) with curds, the most exhilarating (Soma) of the hero (Indra).
verses.wilson_translation: You (Soma) are pure, distributed in many vessels, mixed at the mid-day sacrifice with milk, and (at thethird sacrifice) with curds, the most exhilarating (Soma) of the hero (Indra).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे त इंद्र सोमास्तीव्रा अस्मे सुतासः ।शुक्रा आशिरं याचंते ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sómāḥ ǀ tīvrā́ḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀśukrā́ḥ ǀ ā-śíram ǀ yācante ǁ
verses.english_translation: These dsharp and pure Somalibations effused by us for you solicit you for admixture.
verses.wilson_translation: These dsharp and pure Somalibations effused by us for you solicit you for admixture.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ताँ आशिरं पुरोळाशमिंद्रेमं सोमं श्रीणीहि ।रेवंतं हि त्वा शृणोमि ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́n ǀ ā-śíram ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ índra ǀ imám ǀ sómam ǀ śrīṇīhi ǀrevántam ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ śṛṇómi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mix,Indra, the milk and Soma, (add) the cake to this libation. I hear that you are possessed of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Mix,Indra, the milk and Soma, (add) the cake to this libation. I hear that you are possessed of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हृत्सु पीतासो युध्यंते दुर्मदासो न सुरायां ।ऊधर्न नग्ना जरंते ॥
verses.transliteration: hṛt-sú ǀ pītā́saḥ ǀ yudhyante ǀ duḥ-mádāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ súrāyām ǀū́dhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ nagnā́ḥ ǀ jarante ǁ
verses.english_translation: The potations (of Soma) contend in your interior (for your exhilaration) like the inebriation caused bywine; your worshippers praise you (filled full of Soma) like the udder (of a cow with milk).
verses.wilson_translation: The potations (of Soma) contend in your interior (for your exhilaration) like the inebriation caused bywine; your worshippers praise you (filled full of Soma) like the udder (of a cow with milk).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रेवाँ इद्रेवतः स्तोता स्यात्त्वावतो मघोनः ।प्रेदु हरिवः श्रुतस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: revā́n ǀ ít ǀ revátaḥ ǀ stotā́ ǀ syā́t ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀprá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ śrutásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the eulogist of you, who are opulent, be opulent; may he even, lord of steeds, surpass one who iswealthy and renowned, like you.
verses.wilson_translation: May the eulogist of you, who are opulent, be opulent; may he even, lord of steeds, surpass one who iswealthy and renowned, like you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उक्थं चन शस्यमानमगोररिरा चिकेत ।न गायत्रं गीयमानं ॥
verses.transliteration: ukthám ǀ caná ǀ śasyámānam ǀ ágoḥ ǀ aríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ciketa ǀná ǀ gāyatrám ǀ gīyámānam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra), the enemy of the unbeliever, apprehends whatever prayer is being repeated, whatever chant isbeing chanted.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra), the enemy of the unbeliever, apprehends whatever prayer is being repeated, whatever chant isbeing chanted.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा न इंद्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः ।शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ pīyatnáve ǀ mā́ ǀ śárdhate ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǀśíkṣa ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Consign us not,Indra, to the slayer, not to an overpowering foe; doer of great deeds, enable us by youracts (to conquer).
verses.wilson_translation: Consign us not,Indra, to the slayer, not to an overpowering foe; doer of great deeds, enable us by youracts (to conquer).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इंद्र त्वायंतः सखायः ।कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरंते ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ tadít-arthāḥ ǀ índra ǀ tvā-yántaḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀkáṇvāḥ ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ jarante ǁ
verses.english_translation: Friends devoted,Indra, to you we, the descendants of Kaṇva, having your praise for our object, glorifyyou with prayers.
verses.wilson_translation: Friends devoted,Indra, to you we, the descendants of Kaṇva, having your praise for our object, glorifyyou with prayers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ ।तवेदु स्तोमं चिकेत ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ gha ǀ īm ǀ anyát ǀ ā́ ǀ papana ǀ vájrin ǀ apásaḥ ǀ náviṣṭau ǀtáva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stómam ǀ ciketa ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Engaged), thunderer, in your recent (worship) I utter no other praise than that of you, the doer of greatdeeds, I repeat only your glorification.
verses.wilson_translation: (Engaged), thunderer, in your recent (worship) I utter no other praise than that of you, the doer of greatdeeds, I repeat only your glorification.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इच्छंति देवाः सुन्वंतं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयंति ।यंति प्रमादमतंद्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: icchánti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sunvántam ǀ ná ǀ svápnāya ǀ spṛhayanti ǀyánti ǀ pra-mā́dam ǀ átandrāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods love the man who offers libations, they desire not to (let him) sleep, thence they, unslothful,obtain the inebriating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods love the man who offers libations, they desire not to (let him) sleep, thence they, unslothful,obtain the inebriating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ओ षु प्र याहि वाजेभिर्मा हृणीथा अभ्यस्मान् ।महाँ इव युवजानिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ hṛṇīthāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ asmā́n ǀmahā́n-iva ǀ yúva-jāniḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us quickly with excellent viands, be not bashful, like the ardent husband of a new bride.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us quickly with excellent viands, be not bashful, like the ardent husband of a new bride.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मो ष्वद्य दुर्हणावांत्सायं करदारे अस्मत् ।अश्रीर इव जामाता ॥
verses.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ adyá ǀ duḥ-hánāvān ǀ sāyám ǀ karat ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀaśrīráḥ-iva ǀ jā́mātā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let insuperable, delay (coming to us) today until the evening, like an unlucky son-in-law.
verses.wilson_translation: Let insuperable, delay (coming to us) today until the evening, like an unlucky son-in-law.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा ह्यस्य वीरस्य भूरिदावरीं सुमतिं ।त्रिषु जातस्य मनांसि ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ vīrásya ǀ bhūri-dā́varīm ǀ su-matím ǀtriṣú ǀ jātásya ǀ mánāṃsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: We know the munificent genitive rosity of the hero (Indra); of the purposes of him who is manifest in thethree worlds (we are aware).
verses.wilson_translation: We know the munificent genitive rosity of the hero (Indra); of the purposes of him who is manifest in thethree worlds (we are aware).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ तू षिंच कण्वमंतं न घा विद्म शवसानात् ।यशस्तरं शतमूतेः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ siñca ǀ káṇva-mantam ǀ ná ǀ gha ǀ vidma ǀ śavasānā́t ǀyaśáḥ-taram ǀ śatám-ūteḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour out the libation to him who is associated with the Kaṇva(family); we know not any one morecelebrated than the very powerful bestower of numerous protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour out the libation to him who is associated with the Kaṇva(family); we know not any one morecelebrated than the very powerful bestower of numerous protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठेन सोतरिंद्राय सोमं वीराय शक्राय ।भरा पिबन्नर्याय ॥
verses.transliteration: jyéṣṭhena ǀ sotaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ śakrā́ya ǀbhára ǀ píbat ǀ náryāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer, worshipper, the libation in the first plural ce to the hero, the powerful Indra, the benefactor of man;may he drink (of it).
verses.wilson_translation: Offer, worshipper, the libation in the first plural ce to the hero, the powerful Indra, the benefactor of man;may he drink (of it).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वेदिष्ठो अव्यथिष्वश्वावंतं जरितृभ्यः ।वाजं स्तोतृभ्यो गोमंतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ védiṣṭhaḥ ǀ avyathíṣu ǀ áśva-vantam ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀvā́jam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ gó-mantam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who most recognisant of (the merit) of those who give him no annoyance, bestows upon his adorersand praisers food with horses and cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: He who most recognisant of (the merit) of those who give him no annoyance, bestows upon his adorersand praisers food with horses and cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय ।सोमं वीराय शूराय ॥
verses.transliteration: pányam-panyam ǀ ít ǀ sotāraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhāvata ǀ mádyāya ǀsómam ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ śū́rāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten, offerers of the libation, (to present) the glorious Somato the valiant, the hero (Indra), for (his)exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten, offerers of the libation, (to present) the glorious Somato the valiant, the hero (Indra), for (his)exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् ।नि यमते शतमूतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: pā́tā ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ gha ǀ gamat ǀ ná ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀní ǀ yamate ǀ śatám-ūtiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the drinker of the Somalibation, the slayer of Vṛtra, approach, let him not be far from us; let thegranter of many protections keep in check (our enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: May the drinker of the Somalibation, the slayer of Vṛtra, approach, let him not be far from us; let thegranter of many protections keep in check (our enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायं ।गीर्भिः श्रुतं गिर्वणसं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ hárī íti ǀ brahma-yújā ǀ śagmā́ ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀgīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ śrutám ǀ gírvaṇasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the delightful steeds who are harnessed by prayer bring hither (our) friends (Indra), magnified bypraises, deserving of laudation.
verses.wilson_translation: May the delightful steeds who are harnessed by prayer bring hither (our) friends (Indra), magnified bypraises, deserving of laudation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वादवः सोमा आ याहि श्रीताः सोमा आ याहि ।शिप्रिन्नृषीवः शचीवो नायमच्छा सधमादं ॥
verses.transliteration: svādávaḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ śrītā́ḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀśíprin ǀ ṛ́ṣi-vaḥ ǀ śácī-vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ayám ǀ áccha ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Handsome-chinned (Indra), the honoured of sages, the doer of great deeds, come, for well-flavoured is Soma; come, for the libations are ready mixed; his (your worshipper) now (invites you) to be present at this socialexhilarating rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Handsome-chinned (Indra), the honoured of sages, the doer of great deeds, come, for well-flavoured is Soma; come, for the libations are ready mixed; his (your worshipper) now (invites you) to be present at this socialexhilarating rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतश्च यास्त्वा वर्धंति महे राधसे नृम्णाय ।इंद्र कारिणं वृधंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: stútaḥ ǀ ca ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ tvā ǀ várdhanti ǀ mahé ǀ rā́dhase ǀ nṛmṇā́ya ǀíndra ǀ kāríṇam ǀ vṛdhántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They who praising you magnify you,Indra, the instrumental tutor of rites, and those (hymns which glorify) youhave (for their object) great riches and strength.
verses.wilson_translation: They who praising you magnify you,Indra, the instrumental tutor of rites, and those (hymns which glorify) youhave (for their object) great riches and strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरश्च यास्ते गिर्वाह उक्था च तुभ्यं तानि ।सत्रा दधिरे शवांसि ॥
verses.transliteration: gíraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ girvāhaḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ca ǀ túbhyam ǀ tā́ni ǀsatrā́ ǀ dadhire ǀ śávāṃsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Upborne by hymns, those your praises and those prayers which are addressed to you, all combined,sustain your energies.
verses.wilson_translation: Upborne by hymns, those your praises and those prayers which are addressed to you, all combined,sustain your energies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवेदेष तुविकूर्मिर्वाजाँ एको वज्रहस्तः ।सनादमृक्तो दयते ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ tuvi-kūrmíḥ ǀ vā́jān ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vájra-hastaḥ ǀsanā́t ǀ ámṛktaḥ ǀ dayate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily this accomplisher of many acts, the chief (among the gods), the wielder of the thunderbolt, hewho has ever been unconquered, gives food (to his votaries).
verses.wilson_translation: Verily this accomplisher of many acts, the chief (among the gods), the wielder of the thunderbolt, hewho has ever been unconquered, gives food (to his votaries).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हंता वृत्रं दक्षिणेनेंद्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः ।महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: hántā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ dákṣiṇena ǀ índraḥ ǀ purú ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ mahī́bhiḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtrawith his righthand, the invoked of many in many (plural ces), the mighty by mighydeeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtrawith his righthand, the invoked of many in many (plural ces), the mighty by mighydeeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वाश्चर्षणय उत च्यौत्ना ज्रयांसि च ।अनु घेन्मंदी मघोनः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmin ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ cyautnā́ ǀ jráyāṃsi ǀ ca ǀánu ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ mandī́ ǀ maghónaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He upon whom all men depend, (in whom) overwhelming energies (abide), he verily is the delighter ofthe opulent (worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: He upon whom all men depend, (in whom) overwhelming energies (abide), he verily is the delighter ofthe opulent (worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष एतानि चकारेंद्रो विश्वा योऽति शृण्वे ।वाजदावा मघोनां ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ etā́ni ǀ cakāra ǀ índraḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ áti ǀ śṛṇvé ǀvāja-dā́vā ǀ maghónām ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Indrahas made all these (beings), who is thence exceedingly renowned; he is he donor of food toopulent worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: This Indrahas made all these (beings), who is thence exceedingly renowned; he is he donor of food toopulent worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रभर्ता रथं गव्यंतमपाकाच्चिद्यमवति ।इनो वसु स हि वोळ्हा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá-bhartā ǀ rátham ǀ gavyántam ǀ apākā́t ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ ávati ǀináḥ ǀ vásu ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ vóḷhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, whom, adoring, and desirous of cattle, the protector (Indra) defends against an ignorant (foe),becomes a prince, the possessor of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: He, whom, adoring, and desirous of cattle, the protector (Indra) defends against an ignorant (foe),becomes a prince, the possessor of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनिता विप्रो अर्वद्भिर्हंता वृत्रं नृभिः शूरः ।सत्योऽविता विधंतं ॥
verses.transliteration: sánitā ǀ vípraḥ ǀ árvat-bhiḥ ǀ hántā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀsatyáḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ vidhántam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Liberal, wise, (borne by his won) steeds, a hero, the slayer of Vṛtra, (aided) by the Maruts, truthful, heis the protector of the performer of holy rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Liberal, wise, (borne by his won) steeds, a hero, the slayer of Vṛtra, (aided) by the Maruts, truthful, heis the protector of the performer of holy rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यजध्वैनं प्रियमेधा इंद्रं सत्राचा मनसा ।यो भूत्सोमैः सत्यमद्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: yájadhva ǀ enam ǀ priya-medhāḥ ǀ índram ǀ satrā́cā ǀ mánasā ǀyáḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ satyá-madvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worship,Priyamedha, with mind intent upon him, that Indra, who is truthful when exhilarated by the Soma potations.
verses.wilson_translation: Worship,Priyamedha, with mind intent upon him, that Indra, who is truthful when exhilarated by the Soma potations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गाथश्रवसं सत्पतिं श्रवस्कामं पुरुत्मानं ।कण्वासो गात वाजिनं ॥
verses.transliteration: gāthá-śravasam ǀ sát-patim ǀ śrávaḥ-kāmam ǀ puru-tmā́nam ǀkáṇvāsaḥ ǀ gātá ǀ vājínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing,Kaṇvas, the mighty (Indra), of widely-sung renown, the protector of the good, the desirous of(sacrificial) food, present in many plural ces.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing,Kaṇvas, the mighty (Indra), of widely-sung renown, the protector of the good, the desirous of(sacrificial) food, present in many plural ces.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य ऋते चिद्गास्पदेभ्यो दात्सखा नृभ्यः शचीवान् ।ये अस्मिन्काममश्रियन् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛté ǀ cit ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ padébhyaḥ ǀ dā́t ǀ sákhā ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ śácī-vān ǀyé ǀ asmin ǀ kā́mam ǀ áśriyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who, a friend (to his worshippers), the doer of great deeds, tracing the catttle by their foot-marks,being without (other means of detection), restored them to those leaders (of rites) who willingly put their trust inhim.
verses.wilson_translation: He who, a friend (to his worshippers), the doer of great deeds, tracing the catttle by their foot-marks,being without (other means of detection), restored them to those leaders (of rites) who willingly put their trust inhim.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इत्था धीवंतमद्रिवः काण्वं मेध्यातिथिं ।मेषो भूतोऽभि यन्नयः ॥
verses.transliteration: itthā́ ǀ dhī́-vantam ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ kāṇvám ǀ médhya-atithim ǀmeṣáḥ ǀ bhūtáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yán ǀ áyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, thunderer, approaching in the form of a ram, have come to Medhyātithi, one of the race of Kaṇva, thus propitiating you.
verses.wilson_translation: You, thunderer, approaching in the form of a ram, have come to Medhyātithi, one of the race of Kaṇva, thus propitiating you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षा विभिंदो अस्मै चत्वार्ययुता ददत् ।अष्टा परः सहस्रा ॥
verses.transliteration: śíkṣa ǀ vibhindo íti vi-bhindo ǀ asmai ǀ catvā́ri ǀ ayútā ǀ dádat ǀaṣṭá ǀ paráḥ ǀ sahásrā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Liberal Vibhindu, you have given to me four times ten thousand, and afterwards eight thousand.
verses.wilson_translation: Liberal Vibhindu, you have given to me four times ten thousand, and afterwards eight thousand.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत सु त्ये पयोवृधा माकी रणस्य नप्त्या ।जनित्वनाय मामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ sú ǀ tyé íti ǀ payaḥ-vṛ́dhā ǀ mākī́ íti ǀ ráṇasya ǀ naptyā́ ǀjani-tvanā́ya ǀ mamahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify those two (heaven and earth), the augmenters of water, the originators (of beings), thebenefactors of the worshipper, on account of their genitive ration (of the wealth so given to me).
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify those two (heaven and earth), the augmenters of water, the originators (of beings), thebenefactors of the worshipper, on account of their genitive ration (of the wealth so given to me).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN III. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: मेध्यातिथि: काण्व: । इन्द्र:, २१ -२४ कौरयाण: पाकस्थामा । प्रगाथ : = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ), २१ अनुष्टुप् , २२ -२३  गायत्री, २४ बृहती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . DRINK, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught.Be, for our weal, our Friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well. In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: expose us not to foe's attack.With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and bring us to felicity. May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth.Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee. He, with his might enhanced by Ṛṣis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself.His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule. Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds,Indra, as worshippers in battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil. With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath Indra lighted up the Sun.In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops. Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first.The Ṛbhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first. Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice.And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty. I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer,Wherewith thou holpest Bhṛgu and the Yatis and Praskaṇva when the prize was staked. Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is thy manly strength.For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud. Help us, O Indra, when we pray to thee for wealth and hero might.First help thou on to strength the man who strives to win, and aid our laud, O Ancient One. Help for us, Indra, as thou holpest Paura once, this man's devotions bent on gain.Help, as thou gavest Ruśama and Śyāvaka and Svarṇara and Kṛpa aid. What newest of imploring prayers shall, then, the zealous mortal sing?For have not they who laud his might, and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven? When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as Ṛṣi and as sage?When ever wilt thou, Indra Maghavan, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call? These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee,Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth, and give unfailing aid. The Bhṛgus are like Suns, like Kaṇvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent upon.The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds. Best slayer of the Vṛtras, yoke thy Bay Steeds, Indra, from afar.Come with the High Ones hither, Maghavan, to us, Mighty, to drink the Soma juice. For these, the bards and singers, have cried out to thee with prayer, to gain the sacrifice.As such, O Maghavan, Indra, who lovest song, even as a lover bear my call. Thou from the lofty plains above, O Indra, hurledst Vṛtra down.Thou dravest forth the kine of guileful Mṛgaya and Arbuda from the mountain's hold. Bright were the flaming fires, the Sun gave forth his shine, and Soma, Indra's juice, shone clear.Indra, thou blewest the great Dragon from the air: men must regard that valorous deed. The fairest courser of them all, who runneth on as ’twere to heaven.Which Indra and the Maruts gave, and Pākasthāman Kaurayāṇ. To me hath Pākasthāman given, a ruddy horse, good at the pole,Filling is girth and rousing wealth; Compared with whom no other ten strong coursers, harnessed to the pole,Bear Tugrya to his dwelling place. Raiment is body, food is life, and healing ointment giveth strength.As the free-handed giver of the ruddy steed, I have named Pākasthāman fourth.

verses.sanskrit: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इंद्र गोमतः ।आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधेऽस्माँ अवंतु ते धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: píba ǀ sutásya ǀ rasínaḥ ǀ mátsva ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀāpíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ sadha-mā́dyaḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ te ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink,Indra, of our sapid libation, mixed with milk, and be satisfied; regard thyself as our kinsman, to beexhilarated along with us for our welfare; may your (good) intentions protect us.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink,Indra, of our sapid libation, mixed with milk, and be satisfied; regard thyself as our kinsman, to beexhilarated along with us for our welfare; may your (good) intentions protect us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा नः स्तरभिमातये ।अस्मांचित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūyā́ma ǀ te ǀ su-matáu ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ staḥ ǀ abhí-mātaye ǀasmā́n ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ avatāt ǀ abhíṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sumnéṣu ǀ yamaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we be offerers of oblations (to enjoy) your favour; harm us not for the sake of the enemy; protectus with your wondrous solicited (protections), maintain us ever in felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: May we be offerers of oblations (to enjoy) your favour; harm us not for the sake of the enemy; protectus with your wondrous solicited (protections), maintain us ever in felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धंतु या मम ।पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vardhantu ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ máma ǀpāvaká-varṇāḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ anūṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra), abounding in wealth, may these my praises magnify you; the brilliant pure sages glorify you withhymns.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra), abounding in wealth, may these my praises magnify you; the brilliant pure sages glorify you withhymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे ।सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ sahásram ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-kṛtaḥ ǀ samudráḥ-iva ǀ paprathe ǀsatyáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́ ǀ gṛṇe ǀ śávaḥ ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ vipra-rā́jye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invigorated by (the praises of) a thousand ṛṣis, this (Indra) is as vast as the ocean; the true mightinessand strength of him are glorified at sacrifices, and in the realm of the devout.
verses.wilson_translation: Invigorated by (the praises of) a thousand ṛṣis, this (Indra) is as vast as the ocean; the true mightinessand strength of him are glorified at sacrifices, and in the realm of the devout.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रमिद्देवतातय इंद्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।इंद्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इंद्रं धनस्य सातये ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ ít ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ índram ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀíndram ǀ sam-īké ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀ índram ǀ dhánasya ǀ sātáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke Indrafor the worship of the gods, and when the sacrifice is proceeding; adoring him, we callupon Indra as the close of the rite; we invoke him for the acquisition of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke Indrafor the worship of the gods, and when the sacrifice is proceeding; adoring him, we callupon Indra as the close of the rite; we invoke him for the acquisition of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इंद्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् ।इंद्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इंद्रे सुवानास इंदवः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ paprathat ǀ śávaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayat ǀíndre ǀ ha ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ yemire ǀ índre ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, by the might of his strength, has spread out the heaven and earth; Indra has lighted up the sun;in Indra are all beings aggregated; the distilling drops of the Somaflow to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, by the might of his strength, has spread out the heaven and earth; Indra has lighted up the sun;in Indra are all beings aggregated; the distilling drops of the Somaflow to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इंद्र स्तोमेभिरायवः ।समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणंत पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ pūrvá-pītaye ǀ índra ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀsam-īcīnā́saḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ gṛṇanta ǀ pū́rvyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men glorify you,Indra, with hymns that you may drink the first (of the gods); the associated Ṛbhusunite in your praise, the Rudrasglorify the ancient (Indra).
verses.wilson_translation: Men glorify you,Indra, with hymns that you may drink the first (of the gods); the associated Ṛbhusunite in your praise, the Rudrasglorify the ancient (Indra).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्येदिंद्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि ।अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवंति पूर्वथा ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ śávaḥ ǀ máde ǀ sutásya ǀ víṣṇavi ǀadyá ǀ tám ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ stuvanti ǀ pūrvá-thā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraaugments the energy and the strength of this (his worshipper), when he exhilaration of the Somais diffused through his body; men celebrate in due order his might today as they did of old.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraaugments the energy and the strength of this (his worshipper), when he exhilaration of the Somais diffused through his body; men celebrate in due order his might today as they did of old.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वा यामि सुवीर्यं तद्ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये ।येना यतिभ्यो भृगवे धने हिते येन प्रस्कण्वमाविथ ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ tvā ǀ yāmi ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ tát ǀ bráhma ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǀyéna ǀ yáti-bhyaḥ ǀ bhṛ́gave ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀ yéna ǀ práskaṇvam ǀ ā́vitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: I solicit you,Indra, for such vigour and for such food as may be hoped for in priority (to others),wherewith you have granted to Bhṛguthe wealth taken from those who had desired from sacrifices, wherewithyou have protected prakṣaṇva.
verses.wilson_translation: I solicit you,Indra, for such vigour and for such food as may be hoped for in priority (to others),wherewith you have granted to Bhṛguthe wealth taken from those who had desired from sacrifices, wherewithyou have protected prakṣaṇva.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येना समुद्रमसृजो महीरपस्तदिंद्र वृष्णि ते शवः ।सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं क्षोणीरनुचक्रदे ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ samudrám ǀ ásṛjaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ vṛ́ṣṇi ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀsadyáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́ ǀ ná ǀ sam-náśe ǀ yám ǀ kṣoṇī́ḥ ǀ anu-cakradé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wherewith you have sent the great waters tot he ocean; such as is your wish-fulfilling strength; thatmight of Indrais not easily to be resisted which the earth obeys.
verses.wilson_translation: Wherewith you have sent the great waters tot he ocean; such as is your wish-fulfilling strength; thatmight of Indrais not easily to be resisted which the earth obeys.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शग्धी न इंद्र यत्त्वा रयिं यामि सुवीर्यं ।शग्धि वाजाय प्रथमं सिषासते शग्धि स्तोमाय पूर्व्य ॥
verses.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ rayím ǀ yā́mi ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀśagdhí ǀ vā́jāya ǀ prathamám ǀ sísāsate ǀ śagdhí ǀ stómāya ǀ pūrvya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us,Indra, the wealth accompanied by vigour, which I solicit from you; give (wealth) first of all tohim desirous of gratifying you, presenting (sacrificial) food; give (wealth), you who are of old, to him who glorifiesyou.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us,Indra, the wealth accompanied by vigour, which I solicit from you; give (wealth) first of all tohim desirous of gratifying you, presenting (sacrificial) food; give (wealth), you who are of old, to him who glorifiesyou.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शग्धी नो अस्य यद्ध पौरमाविथ धिय इंद्र सिषासतः ।शग्धि यथा रुशमं श्यावकं कृपमिंद्र प्रावः स्वर्णरं ॥
verses.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ paurám ǀ ā́vitha ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sísāsataḥ ǀśagdhí ǀ yáthā ǀ rúśamam ǀ śyā́vakam ǀ kṛ́pam ǀ índra ǀ prá ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ sváḥ-naram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give to this our (worshipper) engaged in celebrating your sacred rites,Indra, (the wealth) whereby youhave protected the son of Puru, grant to the man (aspiring) to heaven (the wealth wherewith) you havepreserved, O Indra,Ruśama, Śyāvaka and Kṛpa.
verses.wilson_translation: Give to this our (worshipper) engaged in celebrating your sacred rites,Indra, (the wealth) whereby youhave protected the son of Puru, grant to the man (aspiring) to heaven (the wealth wherewith) you havepreserved, O Indra,Ruśama, Śyāvaka and Kṛpa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कन्नव्यो अतसीनां तुरो गृणीत मर्त्यः ।नही न्वस्य महिमानमिंद्रियं स्वर्गृणंत आनशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: kát ǀ návyaḥ ǀ atasī́nām ǀ turáḥ ǀ gṛṇīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀnahí ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ indriyám ǀ sváḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ ānaśúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: What living mortal, the prompter of ever-rising (praises), may now glorify Indra? No one of thoseheretofore praising him have attained the greatness of the properties of Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: What living mortal, the prompter of ever-rising (praises), may now glorify Indra? No one of thoseheretofore praising him have attained the greatness of the properties of Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कदु स्तुवंत ऋतयंत देवत ऋषिः को विप्र ओहते ।कदा हवं मघवन्निंद्र सुन्वतः कदु स्तुवत आ गमः ॥
verses.transliteration: kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuvántaḥ ǀ ṛta-yanta ǀ devátā ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ohate ǀkadā́ ǀ hávam ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who, praising you as the deity, (ever) hoped to sacrifice to you? What saint, what sage conveys (hispraises to yo?) When, opulent Indra, have you come to the invocation of one pouring out libations, of onerepeating (your) praise?
verses.wilson_translation: Who, praising you as the deity, (ever) hoped to sacrifice to you? What saint, what sage conveys (hispraises to yo?) When, opulent Indra, have you come to the invocation of one pouring out libations, of onerepeating (your) praise?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिरः स्तोमास ईरते ।सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयंतो रथा इव ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ mádhumat-tamāḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ īrate ǀsatrā-jítaḥ ǀ dhana-sā́ḥ ǀ ákṣita-ūtayaḥ ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: These most sweet songs, these hymns of praise ascent (to you), like triumphant chariots laden withwealth, charged with unfailing protections, intended to procure food.
verses.wilson_translation: These most sweet songs, these hymns of praise ascent (to you), like triumphant chariots laden withwealth, charged with unfailing protections, intended to procure food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमानशुः ।इंद्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयंत आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: káṇvāḥ-iva ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ sū́ryāḥ-iva ǀ víśvam ǀ ít ǀ dhītám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀíndram ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ maháyantaḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ priyá-medhāsaḥ ǀ asvaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Bhṛgus, like the Kaṇvas, have verily attained to the all- pervading (Indra), on whom they havemeditated, as the sun (pervades the unverse by his rays); men of the Priyamedharace, worshipping Indra withpraises glorify him.
verses.wilson_translation: The Bhṛgus, like the Kaṇvas, have verily attained to the all- pervading (Indra), on whom they havemeditated, as the sun (pervades the unverse by his rays); men of the Priyamedharace, worshipping Indra withpraises glorify him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि वृत्रहंतम हरी इंद्र परावतः ।अर्वाचीनो मघवन्त्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ hárī íti ǀ indra ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀarvācīnáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ ugráḥ ǀ ṛṣvébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Utter destroyer of Vṛtra, harness your horses come down to us, fierce Maghavan, with your attendantsfrom afar to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Utter destroyer of Vṛtra, harness your horses come down to us, fierce Maghavan, with your attendantsfrom afar to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे हि ते कारवो वावशुर्धिया विप्रासो मेधसातये ।स त्वं नो मघवन्निंद्र गिर्वणो वेनो न शृणुधी हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ vāvaśúḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ medhá-sātaye ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ venáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śṛṇudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: These wise celebrators (of holy rites) repeatedly propitiate you with pious praise for the acceptance ofthe sacrifice; do you, opulent Indra, who are entitled to praise, hear our invocation like one who listens to what hedesires.
verses.wilson_translation: These wise celebrators (of holy rites) repeatedly propitiate you with pious praise for the acceptance ofthe sacrifice; do you, opulent Indra, who are entitled to praise, hear our invocation like one who listens to what hedesires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निरिंद्र बृहतीभ्यो वृत्रं धनुभ्यो अस्फुरः ।निरर्बुदस्य मृगयस्य मायिनो निः पर्वतस्य गा आजः ॥
verses.transliteration: níḥ ǀ indra ǀ bṛhatī́bhyaḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ dhánu-bhyaḥ ǀ asphuraḥ ǀníḥ ǀ árbudasya ǀ mṛ́gayasya ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ párvatasya ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ājaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have extirpated Vṛtrawith your mighty weapons; you have been the destroyer of the deceptive Arbuda and Ṃgaya; you have extricated the cattle from the mountain.
verses.wilson_translation: You have extirpated Vṛtrawith your mighty weapons; you have been the destroyer of the deceptive Arbuda and Ṃgaya; you have extricated the cattle from the mountain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निरग्नयो रुरुचुर्निरु सूर्यो निः सोम इंद्रियो रसः ।निरंतरिक्षादधमो महामहिं कृषे तदिंद्र पौंस्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: níḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ rurucuḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indriyáḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀníḥ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ adhamaḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ áhim ǀ kṛṣé ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: When you had expelled the mighty Ahi from the firmament, then the fires blazed out, the sun shoneforth, the ambrosial Somadestined for Indraflowed out, and you, Indra, did manifest your manhood.
verses.wilson_translation: When you had expelled the mighty Ahi from the firmament, then the fires blazed out, the sun shoneforth, the ambrosial Somadestined for Indraflowed out, and you, Indra, did manifest your manhood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं मे दुरिंद्रो मरुतः पाकस्थामा कौरयाणः ।विश्वेषां त्मना शोभिष्ठमुपेव दिवि धावमानं ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ me ǀ dúḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ pā́ka-sthāmā ǀ káurayāṇaḥ ǀvíśveṣām ǀ tmánā ǀ śóbhiṣṭham ǀ úpa-iva ǀ diví ǀ dhā́vamānam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such wealth as Indraand the Marutshave bestowed upon me, such has Pākasthāman, the son of Kurayāṇa, bestowed, of itself the most magnificent of all, like the quick-moving (sun) in the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Such wealth as Indraand the Marutshave bestowed upon me, such has Pākasthāman, the son of Kurayāṇa, bestowed, of itself the most magnificent of all, like the quick-moving (sun) in the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रोहितं मे पाकस्थामा सुधुरं कक्ष्यप्रां ।अदाद्रायो विबोधनं ॥
verses.transliteration: róhitam ǀ me ǀ pā́ka-sthāmā ǀ su-dhúram ǀ kakṣya-prā́m ǀádāt ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ vi-bódhanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pākasthāman has given me a tawny robust beast of burden, the means of acquiring riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Pākasthāman has given me a tawny robust beast of burden, the means of acquiring riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मा अन्ये दश प्रति धुरं वहंति वह्नयः ।अस्तं वयो न तुग्र्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmai ǀ anyé ǀ dáśa ǀ práti ǀ dhúram ǀ váhanti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀástam ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ túgryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose burden ten other bearers (of loads) (would be required) to convey, such as were the steeds thatbore Bhujyuhome.
verses.wilson_translation: Whose burden ten other bearers (of loads) (would be required) to convey, such as were the steeds thatbore Bhujyuhome.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा पितुस्तनूर्वास ओजोदा अभ्यंजनं ।तुरीयमिद्रोहितस्य पाकस्थामानं भोजं दातारमब्रवं ॥
verses.transliteration: ātmā́ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ tanū́ḥ ǀ vā́saḥ ǀ ojaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ abhi-áñjanam ǀturī́yam ǀ ít ǀ róhitasya ǀ pā́ka-sthāmānam ǀ bhojám ǀ dātā́ram ǀ abravam ǁ
verses.english_translation: His father's own son, the giver of dwellings, the sustainer of strength like (invigorating) unguents, Icelebrate Pākasthāman, the destroyer (of foes), the despoiler (of enemies), the donor of the tawny (horse).
verses.wilson_translation: His father's own son, the giver of dwellings, the sustainer of strength like (invigorating) unguents, Icelebrate Pākasthāman, the destroyer (of foes), the despoiler (of enemies), the donor of the tawny (horse).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IV. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: २१ देवातिथि:  काण्व: ।इन्द्र:, १५ -१८  पूषा वा , १९ -२१ कुरुङ्ग: । प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती , समा सतोबृहती ), २१ पुर उष्णिक् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOUGH, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south,Thou chiefly art with Ānava and Turvaśa, brave Champion I urged by men to Come. Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Ruśama, Śyāvaka, and Kṛpa thou rejoicest thee,Still do the Kaṇvas, bringing praises, with their prayers, O Indra, draw thee hither: come. Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool,Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kaṇvas drink thy fill. May the drops gladden thee, rich Indra, and obtain bounty for him who pours the juice.Soma pressed in the mortar didst thou take and drink, and hence hast won surpassing might. With mightier strength he conquered strength, with energy he crushed their wrath.O Indra, Strong in youth, all those who sought the fray bent and bowed down to thee like trees. He who wins promise of thine aid goes girt as with a thousand mighty men of war.He makes his son preeminent in hero might: he serves with reverential prayer. With thee, the Mighty, for our Friend, we will not fear or feel fatigue.May we see Turvaśa and Yadu: thy great deed, O Hero, must be glorified. On his left hip the Hero hath reclined himself: the proffered feast offends him not.The milk is blended with the honey of the bee: quickly come hither, baste, and drink. Indra, thy friend is fair of form and rich in horses, cars, and kine.He evermore hath food accompanied by wealth, and radiant joins the company. Come like a thirsty antelope to the drinking-place: drink Soma to thy heart's desire.Raining it down, O Maghavan, day after day, thou gainest thy surpassing might. Priest, let the Soma juice flow forth, for Indra longs to drink thereof.He even now hath yoked his vigorous Bay Steeds: the Vṛtra-slayer hath come near. The man with whom thou fillcst thee with Soma deems himself a pious worshipper.This thine appropriate food is here poured out for thee: come, hasten forward. drink of it, Press out the Soma juice, ye priests, for Indra borne upon his car.The pressing-stones speak loud of Indra, while they shed the juice which, offered, honours him. To the brown juice may his dear vigorous Bay Steeds bring Indra, to our holy task.Hither let thy Car-steeds who seek the sacrifice bring thee to our drink-offerings. Pūṣan, the Lord of ample wealth, for firm alliance we elect.May he with wisdom, Śakra! Looser! Much-invoked! aid us to riches and to seed. Sharpen us like a razor in the barber's hands: send riches thou who settest free.Easy to find with thee are treasures of the Dawn for mortal man whom thou dost speed. Pūṣan, I long to win thy love, I long to praise thee, Radiant God.Excellent Lord, ’tis strange tome, no wish have I to sing the psalm that Pajra sings. My kine, O Radiant God, seek pasture where they will, my during wealth, Immortal One.Be our protector, Pūṣan! be, most liberal Lord, propitious to our gathering strength. Rich was the gift Kurunga gave, a hundred steeds at morning rites.Among the gifts of Turvaśas we thought of him, the opulent, the splendid King. What by his morning songs Kaṇva, the powerful, hath, with the Priyamedhas, gained- The herds of sixty thousand pure and spotless kine, have I, the Ṛṣi, driven away. The very trees were joyful at my coming: kine they obtained in plenty, steeds in plenty.

verses.sanskrit: यदिंद्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः ।सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ prā́k ǀ ápāk ǀ údak ǀ nyák ǀ vā ǀ hūyáse ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀsíma ǀ purú ǀ nṛ́-sūtaḥ ǀ asi ǀ ā́nave ǀ ási ǀ pra-śardha ǀ turváśe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch,Indra, as you are invoked by the people in the east, in the west, in the north, in the south, so,excellent Indra, have you been incited by men on behalf of the son of Anu; so, overcomer of foes, (have you beencalled upon) on behalf of Turvaśa.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch,Indra, as you are invoked by the people in the east, in the west, in the north, in the south, so,excellent Indra, have you been incited by men on behalf of the son of Anu; so, overcomer of foes, (have you beencalled upon) on behalf of Turvaśa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इंद्र मादयसे सचा ।कण्वासस्त्वा ब्रह्मभिः स्तोमवाहस इंद्रा यच्छंत्या गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ rúme ǀ rúśame ǀ śyā́vake ǀ kṛ́pe ǀ índra ǀ mādáyase ǀ sácā ǀkáṇvāsaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ bráhma-bhiḥ ǀ stóma-vāhasaḥ ǀ índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yacchanti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch,Indra, as you have been exhilarated in the society of Ruma,Ruśama, Śyāvaka and Kṛpa,so the Kaṇvas, bearers of oblations, attract you with their praises, (therefore) come here.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch,Indra, as you have been exhilarated in the society of Ruma,Ruśama, Śyāvaka and Kṛpa,so the Kaṇvas, bearers of oblations, attract you with their praises, (therefore) come here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणं ।आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ gauráḥ ǀ apā́ ǀ kṛtám ǀ tṛ́ṣyan ǀ éti ǀ áva ǀ íriṇam ǀā-pitvé ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ káṇveṣu ǀ sú ǀ sácā ǀ píba ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the thirsty Gaurahastens to the pool filled with water in the desert, so, (Indra), our affinity beingacknowledged, come quickly, and drink freely with the Kaṇvas.
verses.wilson_translation: As the thirsty Gaurahastens to the pool filled with water in the desert, so, (Indra), our affinity beingacknowledged, come quickly, and drink freely with the Kaṇvas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मंदंतु त्वा मघवन्निंद्रेंदवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते ।आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः ॥
verses.transliteration: mándantu ǀ tvā ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ índavaḥ ǀ rādhaḥ-déyāya ǀ sunvaté ǀā-múṣya ǀ sómam ǀ apibaḥ ǀ camū́ íti ǀ sutám ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ tát ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Opulent Indra, may the Somadrops exhilate you, that you may bestow wealth on the donor of thelibation; for taking it by stealth (when given), you have drunk the Soma poured out into the ladle, and havethence sustained pre- eminent strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Opulent Indra, may the Somadrops exhilate you, that you may bestow wealth on the donor of thelibation; for taking it by stealth (when given), you have drunk the Soma poured out into the ladle, and havethence sustained pre- eminent strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र चक्रे सहसा सहो बभंज मन्युमोजसा ।विश्वे त इंद्र पृतनायवो यहो नि वृक्षा इव येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ cakre ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ babháñja ǀ manyúm ǀ ójasā ǀvíśve ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pṛtanā-yávaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀ ní ǀ vṛkṣā́ḥ-iva ǀ yemire ǁ
verses.english_translation: By his strength he has overpowered the strength (of his foes), he has crushed thei wrath by hisprowess; all hostile armies have been arrested like trees (immoveable through fear), mighty Indra, by you.
verses.wilson_translation: By his strength he has overpowered the strength (of his foes), he has crushed thei wrath by hisprowess; all hostile armies have been arrested like trees (immoveable through fear), mighty Indra, by you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रेणेव सचते यवीयुधा यस्त आनळुपस्तुतिं ।पुत्रं प्रावर्गं कृणुते सुवीर्ये दाश्नोति नमउक्तिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásreṇa-iva ǀ sacate ǀ yavi-yúdhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ úpa-stutim ǀputrám ǀ prāvargám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ su-vī́rye ǀ dāśnóti ǀ náma_ukti-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who has made his praise attain to you associates himself with a thousand gallant combatants; hewho offers oblations with reverence begets a valiant son, the scatterer (of enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: He who has made his praise attain to you associates himself with a thousand gallant combatants; hewho offers oblations with reverence begets a valiant son, the scatterer (of enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव ।महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुं ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ bhema ǀ mā́ ǀ śramiṣma ǀ ugrásya ǀ sakhyé ǀ táva ǀmahát ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ abhi-cákṣyam ǀ kṛtám ǀ páśyema ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Secure) in the friendship of you who are terrible, let us not fear, let us not be harassed; great andglorious, showerer (of benefits), are your deeds, as we may behold them in the case of Turvaśa, of Yadu.
verses.wilson_translation: (Secure) in the friendship of you who are terrible, let us not fear, let us not be harassed; great andglorious, showerer (of benefits), are your deeds, as we may behold them in the case of Turvaśa, of Yadu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृषा न दानो अस्य रोषति ।मध्वा संपृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: savyā́m ǀ ánu ǀ sphigyám ǀ vavase ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ná ǀ dānáḥ ǀ asya ǀ roṣati ǀmádhvā ǀ sám-pṛktāḥ ǀ sāraghéṇa ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ dráva ǀ píba ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer (of benefits) with his left hip covers (the world), no tearer (of it) angers him; the delightful(Somajuices) are mixed with the sweet honey of the bee; come quickly hither, hasten, drink.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of benefits) with his left hip covers (the world), no tearer (of it) angers him; the delightful(Somajuices) are mixed with the sweet honey of the bee; come quickly hither, hasten, drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाँ इदिंद्र ते सखा ।श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चंद्रो याति सभामुप ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvī́ ǀ rathī́ ǀ su-rūpáḥ ǀ ít ǀ gó-mān ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ sákhā ǀśvātra-bhā́jā ǀ váyasā ǀ sacate ǀ sádā ǀ candráḥ ǀ yāti ǀ sabhā́m ǀ úpa ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is your friend,Indra, is verily possessed of horses, of cars, of cattle, and is of goodly form; he isever supplied with food-comprising riches, and delighting all, he enters an assembly.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is your friend,Indra, is verily possessed of horses, of cars, of cattle, and is of goodly form; he isever supplied with food-comprising riches, and delighting all, he enters an assembly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋश्यो न तृष्यन्नवपानमा गहि पिबा सोमं वशाँ अनु ।निमेघमानो मघवंदिवेदिव ओजिष्ठं दधिषे सहः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛ́śyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tṛ́ṣyan ǀ ava-pā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ váśān ǀ ánu ǀni-méghamānaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ divé-dive ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
