verses.english_translation: (Maruts), for whom the sacred grass is trimmed, it cannot be (that you submit to be detained), for youhave derived strength from the sacrifice, formerly (accompanied) by our praises.
verses.wilson_translation: (Maruts), for whom the sacred grass is trimmed, it cannot be (that you submit to be detained), for youhave derived strength from the sacrifice, formerly (accompanied) by our praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समु त्ये महतीरपः सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यं ।सं वज्रं पर्वशो दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ mahatī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sám ǀ kṣoṇī́ íti ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sū́ryam ǀsám ǀ vájram ǀ parva-śáḥ ǀ dadhuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They have concentrated the abundant waters, they have held together the heaven and earth, they havesustained the sun, they have divided (Vṛtra) joint by joint with the thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: They have concentrated the abundant waters, they have held together the heaven and earth, they havesustained the sun, they have divided (Vṛtra) joint by joint with the thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि वृत्रं पर्वशो ययुर्वि पर्वताँ अराजिनः ।चक्राणा वृष्णि पौंस्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ vṛtrám ǀ parva-śáḥ ǀ yayuḥ ǀ ví ǀ párvatān ǀ arājínaḥ ǀcakrāṇā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇi ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Independent of a ruler, they have divided Vṛtrajoint by joint; they have shattered the mountains,manifesting manly vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Independent of a ruler, they have divided Vṛtrajoint by joint; they have shattered the mountains,manifesting manly vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु त्रितस्य युध्यतः शुष्ममावन्नुत क्रतुं ।अन्विंद्रं वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ tritásya ǀ yúdhyataḥ ǀ śúṣmam ǀ āvan ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀánu ǀ índram ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǁ
verses.english_translation: They have come to the aid of the warring Trita, invigorating his strength, and (animating) his acts; theyhave come to the aid of Indra, for the destruction of Vṛtra.
verses.wilson_translation: They have come to the aid of the warring Trita, invigorating his strength, and (animating) his acts; theyhave come to the aid of Indra, for the destruction of Vṛtra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्युद्धस्ता अभिद्यवः शिप्राः शीर्षन्हिरण्ययीः ।शुभ्रा व्यंजत श्रिये ॥
verses.transliteration: vidyút-hastāḥ ǀ abhí-dyavaḥ ǀ śíprāḥ ǀ śīrṣán ǀ hiraṇyáyīḥ ǀśubhrā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ añjata ǀ śriyé ǁ
verses.english_translation: The birlliant (Maruts), bearing the lightning in theirhands, radiant above all, gloriously display theirgolden helmets on their heads.
verses.wilson_translation: The birlliant (Maruts), bearing the lightning in theirhands, radiant above all, gloriously display theirgolden helmets on their heads.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उशना यत्परावत उक्ष्णो रंध्रमयातन ।द्यौर्न चक्रदद्भिया ॥
verses.transliteration: uśánā ǀ yát ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ukṣṇáḥ ǀ rándhram ǀ áyātana ǀdyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakradat ǀ bhiyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorified, (Maruts), by Uśanas, when you approach from afar to the opening of the rainy (firmament),then (the dwellers on earth), like those in heaven, are clamorous through fear.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorified, (Maruts), by Uśanas, when you approach from afar to the opening of the rainy (firmament),then (the dwellers on earth), like those in heaven, are clamorous through fear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो मखस्य दावनेऽश्वैर्हिरण्यपाणिभिः ।देवास उप गंतन ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ makhásya ǀ dāváne ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ híraṇyapāṇi-bhiḥ ǀdévāsaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ gantana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, gods, to (show your) liberality at our sacrifice with your golden-footed steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, gods, to (show your) liberality at our sacrifice with your golden-footed steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदेषां पृषती रथे प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः ।यांति शुभ्रा रिणन्नपः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ eṣām ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ práṣṭiḥ ǀ váhati ǀ róhitaḥ ǀyā́nti ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ riṇán ǀ apáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the spotted antelope or the swift tawny deer conveys them in their chariot, then the brilliant(Maruts) depart, and the rains have gone.
verses.wilson_translation: When the spotted antelope or the swift tawny deer conveys them in their chariot, then the brilliant(Maruts) depart, and the rains have gone.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुषोमे शर्यणावत्यार्जीके पस्त्यावति ।ययुर्निचक्रया नरः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-sóme ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǀ ārjīké ǀ pastyá-vati ǀyayúḥ ǀ ní-cakrayā ǀ náraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The leaders of rites have proceeded with downward chariot-wheels to the Ṛjīka (Ārjīka) country,where lies the Śaryaṇāvat, abounding in dwellings, and where Somais plural ntiful.
verses.wilson_translation: The leaders of rites have proceeded with downward chariot-wheels to the Ṛjīka (Ārjīka) country,where lies the Śaryaṇāvat, abounding in dwellings, and where Somais plural ntiful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कदा गच्छाथ मरुत इत्था विप्रं हवमानं ।मार्डीकेभिर्नाधमानं ॥
verses.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ gacchātha ǀ marutaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ vípram ǀ hávamānam ǀmārḍīkébhiḥ ǀ nā́dhamānam ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,maruts, will you go with joy-bestowing riches to the sage thus adoring you, and soliciting (you forwealth)?
verses.wilson_translation: When,maruts, will you go with joy-bestowing riches to the sage thus adoring you, and soliciting (you forwealth)?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियो यदिंद्रमजहातन ।को वः सखित्व ओहते ॥
verses.transliteration: kát ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ kadha-priyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ índram ǀ ájahātana ǀkáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhi-tvé ǀ ohate ǁ
verses.english_translation: When was it,Maruts, who are gratified by praise, that you really deserted Indra? Who is there thatenjoys your friendship?
verses.wilson_translation: When was it,Maruts, who are gratified by praise, that you really deserted Indra? Who is there thatenjoys your friendship?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहो षु णो वज्रहस्तैः कण्वासो अग्निं मरुद्भिः ।स्तुषे हिरण्यवाशीभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sahó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vájra-hastaiḥ ǀ káṇvāsaḥ ǀ agním ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀstuṣé ǀ híraṇya-vāśībhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you of our race of Kaṇvapraise Agnitogether with the Maruts, bearing the thunderbolt in theirhands, and armed with golden lances.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you of our race of Kaṇvapraise Agnitogether with the Maruts, bearing the thunderbolt in theirhands, and armed with golden lances.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ओ षु वृष्णः प्रयज्यूना नव्यसे सुविताय ।ववृत्यां चित्रवाजान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ prá-yajyūn ǀ ā́ ǀ návyase ǀ suvitā́ya ǀvavṛtyā́m ǀ citrá-vājān ǁ
verses.english_translation: I bring to my presence, for the sake of most excellent prosperity, the showerers (of desires), theadorable (Maruts), the possessors of wonderful strength.
verses.wilson_translation: I bring to my presence, for the sake of most excellent prosperity, the showerers (of desires), theadorable (Maruts), the possessors of wonderful strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरयश्चिन्नि जिहते पर्शानासो मन्यमानाः ।पर्वताश्चिन्नि येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: giráyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ jihate ǀ párśānāsaḥ ǀ mányamānāḥ ǀpárvatāḥ ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ yemire ǁ
verses.english_translation: The hills, oppressed and agitated by them, move (from their plural ces), the mountains are restraineḍ
verses.wilson_translation: The hills, oppressed and agitated by them, move (from their plural ces), the mountains are restraineḍ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आक्ष्णयावानो वहंत्यंतरिक्षेण पततः ।धातारः स्तुवते वयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ akṣṇa-yā́vānaḥ ǀ vahanti ǀ antárikṣeṇa ǀ pátataḥ ǀdhā́tāraḥ ǀ stuvaté ǀ váyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Their horses), quickly traversing (space), bear them travelling through the firmament, giving food to theworshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: (Their horses), quickly traversing (space), bear them travelling through the firmament, giving food to theworshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि जानि पूर्व्यश्छंदो न ���ूरो अर्चिषा ।ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hí ǀ jáni ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ chándaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ arcíṣā ǀte ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ tasthire ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agniwas born the first among the gods, like the brilliant sun in splendour; then they (the Maruts) stoodround in their radiance.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniwas born the first among the gods, like the brilliant sun in splendour; then they (the Maruts) stoodround in their radiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH all the succours that are yours, O Aśvins, hither come to us:Wonderful, borne on paths of gold, drink ye the meath with Soma juice. Come now, ye Aśvins, on your car decked with a sun-bright canopy,Bountiful, with your golden forms, Sages with depth of intellect. Come hither from the Nahusas, come, drawn by pure hymns, from mid-air.O Aśvins, drink the savoury juice shed in the Kaṇvas' sacrifice. Come to us hither from the heavens, come from mid-air, well-loved by us:Here Kaṇva's son hath pressed for you the pleasant meath of Soma juice. Come, Aśvins, to give car to us, to drink the Soma, Aśvins, come.Hail, Strengtheners of the praise-song speed onward, ye Heroes, with your thoughts. As, Heroes, in the olden time the Ṛṣis called you to their aid,So now, O Aśvins, come to us, come near to this mine eulogy. Even from the luminous sphere of heaven come to us, ye who find the light,Carers for Vatsa, through our prayers and lauds, O yewho hearour call. Do others more than we adore the Aśvins with their hymns of praise?The Ṛṣi Vatsa, Kaṇva's son, hath magnified you with his songs. The holy singer with his hymns hath called you, Aśvins, hither-ward;Best Vṛtra-slayers, free from stain, as such bring us felicity. What time, ye Lords of ample wealth, the Lady mounted on your car,Then, O ye Aśvins, ye attained all wishes that your hearts desired. Come thence, O Aśvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments:Vatsa the sage, the sage's son, hath sung a song of sweets to you. Cheerers of many, rich in goods, discoverers of opulence,The Aśvins, Riders through the sky, have welcomed this my song of praise. O Aśvins, grant us all rich gifts wherewith no man mav interfere.Make us observe the stated times: give us not over to reproach. Whether, Nāsatyas, ye be nigh, or whether ye be far away,Come thence, O Aśvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments. Vatsa the Ṛṣi with his songs, Nāsatyas, hath exalted you:Grant him rich food distilling oil, graced with a thousand ornaments. Bestow on him, O Aśvins, food that strengthens, and that drops with oil,On him who praises you for bliss, and, Lords of bounty, prays for wealth. Come to us, ye who slay the foe, Lords of rich treasure, to this hymn.O Heroes, give us high renown and these good things of earth for help. The Priyamedhas have invoked you with all succours that are yours,You, Aśvins, Lords of solemn rites, with calls entreating you to come. Come to us, Aśvins, ye Who bring felicity, auspicious Ones,To Vatsa who with prayer and hymn, lovers of song, hath honoured you. Aid us, O Heroes, for those hymns for which ye helped GoSarya erst,Gave Vaśa, Dasavraja aid, and Kaṇva and Medhatithi: And favoured Trasadasyu, ye Heroes, in spoil-deciding fray:For these, O Aśvins, graciously assist us in acquiring strength. O Aśvins, may pure hymns of ours, and songs and praises, honour you:Best slayers everywhere of foes, as such we fondly yearn for you. Three places of the Aśvins, erst concealed, are made apparent now.Both Sages, with the flight of Law come hither unto those who live.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिरश्विना गच्छतं युवं ।दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ áśvinā ǀ gácchatam ǀ yuvám ǀdásrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀ píbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us,Aśvins, with all your protections;Dasras, riders in a golden chariot, drink the sweet Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Aśvins, with all your protections;Dasras, riders in a golden chariot, drink the sweet Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विना रथेन सूर्यत्वचा ।भुजी हिरण्यपेशसा कवी गंभीरचेतसा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ráthena ǀ sū́rya-tvacā ǀbhújī íti ǀ híraṇya-peśasā ǀ kávī íti ǀ gámbhīra-cetasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvin, partakers of sacrificial food, decorated with golden ornaments, wise, and endowed with profoundintellects, come verily in your chariot, invested with solar radiance.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvin, partakers of sacrificial food, decorated with golden ornaments, wise, and endowed with profoundintellects, come verily in your chariot, invested with solar radiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यातं नहुषस्पर्यांतरिक्षात्सुवृक्तिभिः ।पिबाथो अश्विना मधु कण्वानां सवने सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀpíbāthaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ mádhu ǀ káṇvānām ǀ sávane ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come from (the world of) man, come from the firmament, (attracted) by our pious praises, drink,Aśvins,the sweet Somaoffered at the sacriice of the Kaṇvas.
verses.wilson_translation: Come from (the world of) man, come from the firmament, (attracted) by our pious praises, drink,Aśvins,the sweet Somaoffered at the sacriice of the Kaṇvas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो यातं दिवस्पर्यांतरिक्षादधप्रिया ।पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामिह सुषाव सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ adha-priyā ǀputráḥ ǀ káṇvasya ǀ vām ǀ ihá ǀ susā́va ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us from above the heaven, you who love the (world) below, (come) from the firmament; the sonof Kaṇvahas been poured forth for you the sweet Somalibation.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us from above the heaven, you who love the (world) below, (come) from the firmament; the sonof Kaṇvahas been poured forth for you the sweet Somalibation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो यातमुपश्रुत्यश्विना सोमपीतये ।स्वाहा स्तोमस्य वर्धना प्र कवी धीतिभिर्नरा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa-śruti ǀ áśvinā ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀsvā́hā ǀ stómasya ǀ vardhanā ǀ prá ǀ kavī íti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ narā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Aśvins, to drink the Somaat our sacrifice, you who are praised (by him) and honoured by hispious acts, benefactors of the worshipper, sages and leaders of rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Aśvins, to drink the Somaat our sacrifice, you who are praised (by him) and honoured by hispious acts, benefactors of the worshipper, sages and leaders of rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि वां पुर ऋषयो जुहूरेऽवसे नरा ।आ यातमश्विना गतमुपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ purā́ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ juhūré ǀ ávase ǀ narā ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ úpa ǀ imā́m ǀ su-stutím ǀ máma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders of rites, when the Ṛṣis formerly invoked you for protection, you came; so now,Aśvins, comeat my devout praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders of rites, when the Ṛṣis formerly invoked you for protection, you came; so now,Aśvins, comeat my devout praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवश्चिद्रोचनादध्या नो गंतं स्वर्विदा ।धीभिर्वत्सप्रचेतसा स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ svaḥ-vidā ǀdhībhíḥ ǀ vatsa-pracetasā ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ havana-śrutā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Familiar with heaven, come to us from the sky, or from above the bright (firmament); favourably inclidedto the worshipper, (come), induced by his pious acts; hearers of invocations (come, induced) by our praiseṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Familiar with heaven, come to us from the sky, or from above the bright (firmament); favourably inclidedto the worshipper, (come), induced by his pious acts; hearers of invocations (come, induced) by our praiseṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: किमन्ये पर्यासतेऽस्मत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना ।पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: kím ǀ anyé ǀ pári ǀ āsate ǀ asmát ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀputráḥ ǀ káṇvasya ǀ vām ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ avīvṛdhat ǁ
verses.english_translation: What others than ourselves adore the Aśvinswith praises? The Ṛṣi Vatsa, the son of Kaṇva, hasmagnified you with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: What others than ourselves adore the Aśvinswith praises? The Ṛṣi Vatsa, the son of Kaṇva, hasmagnified you with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां विप्र इहावसेऽह्वत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना ।अरिप्रा वृत्रहंतमा ता नो भूतं मयोभुवा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ávase ǀ áhvat ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀáriprā ǀ vṛ́trahan-tamā ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūtam ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise adorer invokes you hither with praise,Aśvins, for protection; sinless, utter destroyers ofenemies, be to us the sources of felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise adorer invokes you hither with praise,Aśvins, for protection; sinless, utter destroyers ofenemies, be to us the sources of felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यद्वां योषणा रथमतिष्ठद्वाजिनीवसू ।विश्वान्यश्विना युवं प्र धीतान्यगच्छतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ yóṣaṇā ǀ rátham ǀ átiṣṭhat ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀvíśvāni ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ prá ǀ dhītā́ni ǀ agacchatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Affluent in sacrifices, when the maiden (sūrya) mounted your chariot, then,Aśvins, you obtained allyour desires.
verses.wilson_translation: Affluent in sacrifices, when the maiden (sūrya) mounted your chariot, then,Aśvins, you obtained allyour desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना ।वत्सो वां मधुमद्वचोऽशंसीत्काव्यः कविः ॥
verses.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ sahásra-nirnijā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀvatsáḥ ǀ vām ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ vácaḥ ǀ áśaṃsīt ǀ kāvyáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: From wheresoever (you may be) come,Aśvins, with your thousandfold diversified chariot; the sage Vatsa, the son of Kavi, has addressed you with sweet worlds.
verses.wilson_translation: From wheresoever (you may be) come,Aśvins, with your thousandfold diversified chariot; the sage Vatsa, the son of Kavi, has addressed you with sweet worlds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरुमंद्रा पुरूवसू मनोतरा रयीणां ।स्तोमं मे अश्विनाविममभि वह्नी अनूषातां ॥
verses.transliteration: puru-mandrā́ ǀ puruvásū íti puru-vásū ǀ manotárā ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀstómam ǀ me ǀ aśvínau ǀ imám ǀ abhí ǀ váhnī íti ǀ anūṣātām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Delighters of many, abonding in wealth, bestowers of riches,Aśvins, sustainers of all, approve of thismy adoration.
verses.wilson_translation: Delighters of many, abonding in wealth, bestowers of riches,Aśvins, sustainers of all, approve of thismy adoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वान्यश्विना धत्तं राधांस्यह्रया ।कृतं न ऋत्वियावतो मा नो रीरधतं निदे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aśvinā ǀ dhattám ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ áhrayā ǀkṛtám ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛtvíya-vataḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rīradhatam ǀ nidé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us,Aśvins, all riches that may not bring us shame, make us the begetters of progeny in dueseason, subject us not to reproach.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us,Aśvins, all riches that may not bring us shame, make us the begetters of progeny in dueseason, subject us not to reproach.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अध्यंबरे ।अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ stháḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ámbare ǀátaḥ ǀ sahásra-nirnijā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether,Nāsatyās, you be far off, or whether you be near, come from there wiḥ your thousandolddiversified chariot.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether,Nāsatyās, you be far off, or whether you be near, come from there wiḥ your thousandolddiversified chariot.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वां नासत्यावृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ।तस्मै सहस्रनिर्णिजमिषं धत्तं घृतश्चुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ nāsatyau ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ ávīvṛdhat ǀtásmai ǀ sahásra-nirnijam ǀ íṣam ǀ dhattam ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give,Nāsatyās, food of many kinds dripping with butter to him, the ṛṣi Vatsa, who has magnifiedyou both with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Give,Nāsatyās, food of many kinds dripping with butter to him, the ṛṣi Vatsa, who has magnifiedyou both with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रास्मा ऊर्जं घृतश्चुतमश्विना यच्छतं युवं ।यो वां सुम्नाय तुष्टवद्वसूयाद्दानुनस्पती ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ asmai ǀ ū́rjam ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǀ áśvinā ǀ yácchatam ǀ yuvám ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ tustávat ǀ vasu-yā́t ǀ dānunaḥ ǀ patī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give,Aśvins, invigorating food, dripping with butter, to him who praises you, the lords of liberality, toobtain happiness; who desires affluence.
verses.wilson_translation: Give,Aśvins, invigorating food, dripping with butter, to him who praises you, the lords of liberality, toobtain happiness; who desires affluence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो गंतं रिशादसेमं स्तोमं पुरुभुजा ।कृतं नः सुश्रियो नरेमा दातमभिष्टये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ riśādasā ǀ imám ǀ stómam ǀ puru-bhujā ǀkṛtám ǀ naḥ ǀ su-śríyaḥ ǀ narā ǀ imā́ ǀ dātam ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Confounders of the malignant, partakers of many (oblations), come to this our adoration; render usprosperous leaders (of rites); give these (good things of earth) to our desires.
verses.wilson_translation: Confounders of the malignant, partakers of many (oblations), come to this our adoration; render usprosperous leaders (of rites); give these (good things of earth) to our desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत ।राजंतावध्वराणामश्विना यामहूतिषु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ priyá-medhāḥ ǀ ahūṣata ǀrā́jantau ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ áśvinā ǀ yā́ma-hūtiṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Priyamedhasat the sacrifices to the gods invoke you,Aśvins, who rule over religious rites,together with your protections.
verses.wilson_translation: The Priyamedhasat the sacrifices to the gods invoke you,Aśvins, who rule over religious rites,together with your protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो गंतं मयोभुवाश्विना शंभुवा युवं ।यो वां विपन्यू धीतिभिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ áśvinā ǀ śam-bhúvā ǀ yuvám ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ vi-panyū íti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ ávīvṛdhat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us,Aśvins, sources of happiness, sources of health; (come), adorable (Aśvins), to that Vatsa,who has magnified you with sacrifices and with praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Aśvins, sources of happiness, sources of health; (come), adorable (Aśvins), to that Vatsa,who has magnified you with sacrifices and with praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: याभिः कण्वं मेधातिथिं याभिर्वशं दशव्रजं ।याभिर्गोशर्यमावतं ताभिर्नोऽवतं नरा ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ káṇvam ǀ médha-atithim ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ váśam ǀ dáśa-vrajam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ gó-śaryam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avatam ǀ narā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders (of rites), protect us with those protections with which you have protected Kaṇvaand Medhātithi,Viśaand Daśavraja, with which you have protected Gośarya.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders (of rites), protect us with those protections with which you have protected Kaṇvaand Medhātithi,Viśaand Daśavraja, with which you have protected Gośarya.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: याभिर्नरा त्रसदस्युमावतं कृत्व्ये धने ।ताभिः ष्वस्माँ अश्विना प्रावतं वाजसातये ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ narā ǀ trasádasyum ǀ ā́vatam ǀ kṛ́tvye ǀ dháne ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ sú ǀ asmā́n ǀ aśvinā ǀ prá ǀ avatam ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: (And) with which, leaders (of rites), you protected Trasadasyuwhen wealth was to be acquired; do youwith the same graciously protec tus,Aśvins, for the acquisition of food.
verses.wilson_translation: (And) with which, leaders (of rites), you protected Trasadasyuwhen wealth was to be acquired; do youwith the same graciously protec tus,Aśvins, for the acquisition of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वां स्तोमाः सुवृक्तयो गिरो वर्धंत्वश्विना ।पुरुत्रा वृत्रहंतमा ता नो भूतं पुरुस्पृहा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ stómāḥ ǀ su-vṛktáyaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vardhantu ǀ aśvinā ǀpúru-trā ǀ vṛ́trahan-tamā ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūtam ǀ puru-spṛ́hā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (perfect) hymns and holy praises magnify you,Aśvins; protectors of many, exerminators of foes,greatly are you desired of us.
verses.wilson_translation: May (perfect) hymns and holy praises magnify you,Aśvins; protectors of many, exerminators of foes,greatly are you desired of us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि पदान्यश्विनोराविः सांति गुहा परः ।कवी ऋतस्य पत्मभिरर्वाग्जीवेभ्यस्परि ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ padā́ni ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ sánti ǀ gúhā ǀ paráḥ ǀkavī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pátma-bhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ jīvébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǁ
verses.english_translation: The three wheels (of the chariot) of he Aśvins, which were invisible, have become manifest; do youtwo, who are cognizant of the past, (come) by the paths of truth to the presence of living beings.
verses.wilson_translation: The three wheels (of the chariot) of he Aśvins, which were invisible, have become manifest; do youtwo, who are cognizant of the past, (come) by the paths of truth to the presence of living beings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To help and favour Vatsa now, O Aśvins, come ye hitherward.Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignities away. All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air,Bestow, ye Aśvins, upon us. Remember Kaṇva first of all among the singers, Aśvins, whoHave thought upon your wondrous deeds. Aśvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused,This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of ample wealth, through which ye think upon the foe. Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-Workers, and in growing plants,Therewith, O Aśvins, succour me. What force, Nāsatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal,This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts. Now hath the Ṛṣi splendidly thought out the Aśvins' hymn of praise.Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets. Ye Aśvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way.May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven. When, O Nāsatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns,Or, Aśvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanya specially. As erst Kakṣīvān and the Ṛṣi Vyaśva, as erst Dīrghatamas invoked your presence,Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Pṛthi, so be ye mindful of us here, O Aśvins. Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies,Come to the house to give us seed and offspring, Whether with Indra ye be faring, Aśvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vāyu,In concord with the Ṛbhus or Ādityas, or standing still in Viṣṇu's striding-places. When I, O Aśvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength,Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Aśvins' noblest grace. Now come, ye Aśvins, hitherward: here are oblations set for you;These Soma-draughts to aid Yadu andTurvaśa, these offered you mid Kaniva's Sons. Whatever healing balm is yours, Nisatyas, near or far away,Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada. Together with the Goddess, with the Aśvins' Speech have I awoke.Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn, and holy gift from mortal men. Awake the Aśvins, Goddess Dawn! Up Mighty Lady of sweet strains!Rise, straightway, priest of sacrifice! High glory to the gladdening draught! Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light shinest together with the Sun,And to this man-protecting home the chariot ofthe Aśvins comes. When yellow stalks give forth the juice, as cows from udders pour their milk,And voices sound the song of praise, the Aśvins' worshippers show first. Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men,And power and skill, most sapient Ones! When Aśvins, worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house.With wisdom or the bliss ye bring.

verses.sanskrit: आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गंतमवसे ।प्रास्मै यच्छतमवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ vatsásya ǀ gantam ǀ ávase ǀprá ǀ asmai ǀ yacchatam ǀ avṛkám ǀ pṛthú ǀ chardíḥ ǀ yuyutám ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Aśvins, without fail, for the protection of the worshipper; confer upon him a secure and spaciousdwelling; drive away those who make no offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Aśvins, without fail, for the protection of the worshipper; confer upon him a secure and spaciousdwelling; drive away those who make no offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदंतरिक्षे यद्दिवि यत्पंच मानुषाँ अनु ।नृम्णं तद्धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ yát ǀ diví ǀ yát ǀ páñca ǀ mā́nuṣān ǀ ánu ǀnṛmṇám ǀ tát ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever wealth may be in the firmament, in heaven, or among the five (classes) of men, bestow,Aśvins, (upon us).
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever wealth may be in the firmament, in heaven, or among the five (classes) of men, bestow,Aśvins, (upon us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमामृशुः ।एवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ vām ǀ dáṃsāṃsi ǀ aśvinā ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ pari-mamṛśúḥ ǀevá ǀ ít ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Recognize,Aśvins, (the devotions0 of the son of Kaṇva, as (you have recognized) those former sageswho have repeatedly addresswed pious works to you.
verses.wilson_translation: Recognize,Aśvins, (the devotions0 of the son of Kaṇva, as (you have recognized) those former sageswho have repeatedly addresswed pious works to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना स्तोमेन परि षिच्यते ।अयं सोमो मधुमान्वाजिनीवसू येन वृत्रं चिकेतथः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ stómena ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ yéna ǀ vṛtrám ǀ cíketathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This oblation is poured out,Aśvin, to you with praise; this sweet- savoured Somais offered to you, whoare alluent with food, (animated) by which you meditate (the destruction) of the foe.
verses.wilson_translation: This oblation is poured out,Aśvin, to you with praise; this sweet- savoured Somais offered to you, whoare alluent with food, (animated) by which you meditate (the destruction) of the foe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदप्सु यद्वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कृतं ।तेन माविष्टमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ ap-sú ǀ yát ǀ vánaspátau ǀ yát ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ puru-daṃsasā ǀ kṛtám ǀténa ǀ mā ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Doers of many deeds,Aśvinspreserve me with that (healing virtue) deposited (by you) in the waters, inthe trees, in the herbs.
verses.wilson_translation: Doers of many deeds,Aśvinspreserve me with that (healing virtue) deposited (by you) in the waters, inthe trees, in the herbs.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यन्नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद्वा देव भिषज्यथः ।अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विंधते हविष्मंतं हि गच्छथः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ bhuraṇyáthaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ devā ǀ bhiṣajyáthaḥ ǀayám ǀ vām ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vindhate ǀ havíṣmantam ǀ hí ǀ gácchathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Although,Nāsatyās, you cherish (all beings), though, divinities, you heal (all disease),, yet this youradorer does not obtain you by praises (only), you go to him who offers you oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Although,Nāsatyās, you cherish (all beings), though, divinities, you heal (all disease),, yet this youradorer does not obtain you by praises (only), you go to him who offers you oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नूनमश्विनोर्ऋषिः स्तोमं चिकेत वामया ।आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिंचादथर्वणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ stómam ǀ ciketa ǀ vāmáyā ǀā́ ǀ sómam ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ gharmám ǀ siñcāt ǀ átharvaṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: When verily you arrive,Aśvins, the ṛṣi understands with excellent (comprehension) the praise (to beaddressed to you); he will sprinkle the sweet- flavoured Somaand thegharma(oblation) on Atharvanfire.
verses.wilson_translation: When verily you arrive,Aśvins, the ṛṣi understands with excellent (comprehension) the praise (to beaddressed to you); he will sprinkle the sweet- flavoured Somaand thegharma(oblation) on Atharvanfire.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना ।आ वां स्तोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ raghú-vartanim ǀ rátham ǀ tiṣṭhāthaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ stómāḥ ǀ imé ǀ máma ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cucyavīrata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Abscond at once,Aśvins, your light-moving chariot; may these praises bring you down radiant as thesun.
verses.wilson_translation: Abscond at once,Aśvins, your light-moving chariot; may these praises bring you down radiant as thesun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि ।यद्वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ vām ǀ nāsatyā ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ā-cucyuvīmáhi ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ vā́ṇībhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Acknowledge Nāsatyās, that we may bring you down today by the prayers and he praises of the sonof Kaṇva.
verses.wilson_translation: Acknowledge Nāsatyās, that we may bring you down today by the prayers and he praises of the sonof Kaṇva.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वां कक्षीवाँ उत यद्व्यश्व ऋषिर्यद्वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव ।पृथी यद्वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथां ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vām ǀ kakṣī́vān ǀ utá ǀ yát ǀ ví-aśvaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ dīrghá-tamāḥ ǀ juhā́va ǀpṛ́thī ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ vainyáḥ ǀ sádaneṣu ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ átaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ cetayethām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Consider (my praises) in the same maner as (you have considered) when Kakṣīvatpraied yo, whenthe ṛṣi Vyaśva, when Dīrghatamas, or Pṛthin, the son of Vena, glorified you in the chambers of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Consider (my praises) in the same maner as (you have considered) when Kakṣīvatpraied yo, whenthe ṛṣi Vyaśva, when Dīrghatamas, or Pṛthin, the son of Vena, glorified you in the chambers of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा ।वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातं ॥
verses.transliteration: yātám ǀ chardiḥ-páu ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ ǀ bhūtám ǀ jagat-páu ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ tanū-pā́ ǀvartíḥ ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ yātam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come (to us as) guardians of our dwelling, become our defenders, be protectors of our dependants,cherishers of our person ns; come to the dwelling for (the good of) our sons and grandsons.
verses.wilson_translation: Come (to us as) guardians of our dwelling, become our defenders, be protectors of our dependants,cherishers of our person ns; come to the dwelling for (the good of) our sons and grandsons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदिंद्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद्वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा ।यदादित्येभिर्ऋभुभिः सजोषसा यद्वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ índreṇa ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yātháḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ vāyúnā ǀ bhávathaḥ ǀ sám-okasā ǀyát ǀ ādityébhiḥ ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ vi-krámaṇeṣu ǀ tíṣṭhathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Although,Aśvinsyou should be riding in the same chariot with Indra, although you should be domiciledwith Vāyu, although you should be enjoying gratification along with theĀdityasandṚbhus, although you beproceeding on the tracks of Viṣṇu, (nevertheless come here).
verses.wilson_translation: Although,Aśvinsyou should be riding in the same chariot with Indra, although you should be domiciledwith Vāyu, although you should be enjoying gratification along with theĀdityasandṚbhus, although you beproceeding on the tracks of Viṣṇu, (nevertheless come here).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये ।यत्पृत्सु तुर्वणे सहस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ aśvínau ǀ ahám ǀ huvéya ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀyát ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ turváṇe ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ tát ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch as I invoke you,Aśvins, today for success in war (therefore grant it), for the triumphantprotection of the Aśvins is the most excellent for the destruction (of enemies) in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch as I invoke you,Aśvins, today for success in war (therefore grant it), for the triumphantprotection of the Aśvins is the most excellent for the destruction (of enemies) in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता ।इमे सोमासो अधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ imā́ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vām ǀ hitā́ ǀimé ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ turváśe ǀ yádau ǀ imé ǀ káṇveṣu ǀ vām ǀ átha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Aśvins, these libations are prepared for you; those libations which were presented you by Turvaśa and Yadu, they are now offered to you by Kaṇvas.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Aśvins, these libations are prepared for you; those libations which were presented you by Turvaśa and Yadu, they are now offered to you by Kaṇvas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यन्नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजं ।तेन नूनं विमदाय प्रचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यच्छतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ parāké ǀ arvāké ǀ ásti ǀ bheṣajám ǀténa ǀ nūnám ǀ vi-madā́ya ǀ pra-cetasā ǀ chardíḥ ǀ vatsā́ya ǀ yacchatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The healing drug,Nāsatyās, that is afar off or near, wherewith (you wen) to (his) dwelling for thesake of Vimada, do you who are of surpassing wisdom now grant to Vatsa.
verses.wilson_translation: The healing drug,Nāsatyās, that is afar off or near, wherewith (you wen) to (his) dwelling for thesake of Vimada, do you who are of surpassing wisdom now grant to Vatsa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभुत्स्यु प्र देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः ।व्यावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ábhutsi ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ devyā́ ǀ sākám ǀ vācā́ ǀ ahám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀví ǀ āvaḥ ǀ devi ǀ ā́ ǀ matím ǀ ví ǀ rātím ǀ mártyebhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I awake with the pious praise of the Aśvins; scatter, goddess, (the darkness) at my eulogy; bestowwealth upon (us) mortals.
verses.wilson_translation: I awake with the pious praise of the Aśvins; scatter, goddess, (the darkness) at my eulogy; bestowwealth upon (us) mortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र बोधयोषो अश्विना प्र देवि सूनृते महि ।प्र यज्ञहोतरानुषक्प्र मदाय श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ bodhaya ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ prá ǀ devi ǀ sūnṛte ǀ mahi ǀprá ǀ yajña-hotaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀ prá ǀ mádāya ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Uṣas, truht-speaking mighty goddess, awake the Aśvins; invoker of the adorable (deities, arouse them)successively; the copious sacrificial food (is prepared) for their exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Uṣas, truht-speaking mighty goddess, awake the Aśvins; invoker of the adorable (deities, arouse them)successively; the copious sacrificial food (is prepared) for their exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे ।आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नृपाय्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ yā́si ǀ bhānúnā ǀ sám ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ rocase ǀā́ ǀ ha ǀ ayám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yāti ǀ nṛ-pā́yyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: When, Uṣas, you move with radiance, you shine equally with the sun; and this chariot of the Aśvinsproceeds to the hall of sacrifice frequented by the leaders (of the rite).
verses.wilson_translation: When, Uṣas, you move with radiance, you shine equally with the sun; and this chariot of the Aśvinsproceeds to the hall of sacrifice frequented by the leaders (of the rite).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः ।यद्वा वाणीरनूषत प्र देवयंतो अश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ ā́-pītāsaḥ ǀ aṃśávaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duhré ǀ ū́dha-bhiḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ ánūṣata ǀ prá ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the yellow Somastalks milk forth as cows from their udders, when the devout (priests) repeat thewords of praise, then, OAśvins, preserve us.
verses.wilson_translation: When the yellow Somastalks milk forth as cows from their udders, when the devout (priests) repeat thewords of praise, then, OAśvins, preserve us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र द्युम्नाय प्र शवसे प्र नृषाह्याय शर्मणे ।प्र दक्षाय प्रचेतसा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ dyumnā́ya ǀ prá ǀ śávase ǀ prá ǀ nṛ-sáhyāya ǀ śármaṇe ǀprá ǀ dákṣāya ǀ pra-cetasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Endowed with great wisdom, preserve us for fame, for strength, for victory, for happiness, forprosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: Endowed with great wisdom, preserve us for fame, for strength, for victory, for happiness, forprosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यन्नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः ।यद्वा सुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ nūnám ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ pitúḥ ǀ yónā ǀ ni-sī́dathaḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ sumnébhiḥ ǀ ukthyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Although,Aśvins, you be seated in the region of the paternal (heaven engaged in) holy rites, or,glorified by us, (abide there) with plural asures, (yet come here).
verses.wilson_translation: Although,Aśvins, you be seated in the region of the paternal (heaven engaged in) holy rites, or,glorified by us, (abide there) with plural asures, (yet come here).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Aśvins.
hymns.anukramani: ६ प्रगाथो ( घौर: )  काण्व: । अश्विनौ ।१ बृहती , २ मध्येज्योति:, ३ अनुष्टुप् ( पिंगलमतेन – शंकुमती ), ४ आस्तारपंक्ति:, ५-६ प्रगाथ: =  ( ५  बृहती ,६ सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHETHER ye travel far away or dwell in yonder light of heaven,Or in a mansion that is built above the sea, come thence, ye Aśvins, hitherward. Or if for Manu.ye prepared the sacrifice, remember also Kaṇva's son.I call Bṛhaspati, Indra, Viṣṇu, all the gods, the Aśvins borne by rapid steeds. Those Aśvins I invoke who work marvels, brought hither to receive,With whom our friendship is most famed, and kinship passing that of Gods. On whom the solemn rites depend, whose worshippers rise without the Sun:These who foreknow the holy work of sacrifice, and by their Godhead drink the sweets of Soma juice. Whether ye, Lords of ample wealth, now linger in the cast or west,With Druhyu, or with Anu, Yadu, Turvaga, I call you hither; come to me. Lords of great riches, whether through the firmament ye fly or speed through heaven and earth,Or with your Godlike natures stand upon your cars, come thence, O Aśvins, hitherward.

verses.sanskrit: यत्स्थो दीर्घप्रसद्मनि यद्वादो रोचने दिवः ।यद्वा समुद्रे अध्याकृते गृहेऽत आ यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ stháḥ ǀ dīrghá-prasadmani ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ adáḥ ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ samudré ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́-kṛte ǀ gṛhé ǀ átaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether,Aśvins, you are at present where the spacious halls of sacrifice (abound), whether you are inyonder bright sphere of heaven, or whether you are in a dwelling constructed above the firmament, come here.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether,Aśvins, you are at present where the spacious halls of sacrifice (abound), whether you are inyonder bright sphere of heaven, or whether you are in a dwelling constructed above the firmament, come here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा यज्ञं मनवे सम्मिमिक्षथुरेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतं ।बृहस्पतिं विश्वांदेवाँ अहं हुव इंद्राविष्णू अश्विनावाशुहेषसा ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ yajñám ǀ mánave ǀ sam-mimikṣáthuḥ ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ bodhatam ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ índrāvíṣṇū íti ǀ aśvínau ǀ āśu-héṣasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: In like manner, as you have prepared,Aśvins, the sacrifice for Manu, consent (to prepare it) for the sonof Kaṇva; for I invoke Bṛhaspati, the universal gods,Indraand Viṣṇu, and the Aśvins, with rapid steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: In like manner, as you have prepared,Aśvins, the sacrifice for Manu, consent (to prepare it) for the sonof Kaṇva; for I invoke Bṛhaspati, the universal gods,Indraand Viṣṇu, and the Aśvins, with rapid steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्या न्वश्विना हुवे सुदंससा गृभे कृता ।ययोरस्ति प्र णः सख्यं देवेष्वध्याप्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tyā́ ǀ nú ǀ aśvínā ǀ huve ǀ su-dáṃsasā ǀ gṛbhé ǀ kṛtā́ ǀyáyoḥ ǀ ásti ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ sakhyám ǀ devéṣu ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́pyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke those Aśvins, who are famed for great deeds, induced (to come here) for acceptance (of ouroblations), of whom among the gods the friendship is especially to be obtained.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke those Aśvins, who are famed for great deeds, induced (to come here) for acceptance (of ouroblations), of whom among the gods the friendship is especially to be obtained.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ययोरधि प्र यज्ञा असूरे संति सूरयः ।ता यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य प्रचेतसा स्वधाभिर्या पिबतः सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: yáyoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ prá ǀ yajñā́ḥ ǀ asūré ǀ sánti ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ adhvarásya ǀ prá-cetasā ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ píbataḥ ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Upon whom (all) sacrifices are dependent, of whom there are worshippers in a plural ce where is noworship, those two familiar with undecaying sacrifices (I invoke) with praises, that you may drink the sweet Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Upon whom (all) sacrifices are dependent, of whom there are worshippers in a plural ce where is noworship, those two familiar with undecaying sacrifices (I invoke) with praises, that you may drink the sweet Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्याश्विनावपाग्यत्प्राक्स्थो वाजिनीवसू ।यद्द्रुह्यव्यनवि तुर्वशे यदौ हुवे वामथ मा गतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ aśvinau ǀ ápāk ǀ yát ǀ prā́k ǀ stháḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀyát ǀ druhyávi ǀ ánavi ǀ turváśe ǀ yádau ǀ huvé ǀ vām ǀ átha ǀ mā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether,Aśvins, you abide today in the west, whether opulent in food, you abide in the east, whetheryou sojourn with Druhyu, Anu, Turvaśu or Yadu, I invoke you, therefore, come to me.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether,Aśvins, you abide today in the west, whether opulent in food, you abide in the east, whetheryou sojourn with Druhyu, Anu, Turvaśu or Yadu, I invoke you, therefore, come to me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदंतरिक्षे पतथः पुरुभुजा यद्वेमे रोदसी अनु ।यद्वा स्वधाभिरधितिष्ठथो रथमत आ यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ pátathaḥ ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ imé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ánu ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ adhi-tíṣṭhathaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ átaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protectors of many, whether you traverse the firmament, or pass along earth and heaven, whether youascend your chariot with (all) your splendours, come from there,Aśvins, here.
verses.wilson_translation: Protectors of many, whether you traverse the firmament, or pass along earth and heaven, whether youascend your chariot with (all) your splendours, come from there,Aśvins, here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XI. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: १० वत्स: काण्व: । अग्नि: ।गायत्री , १ प्रतिष्ठा, २ वर्धमाना , १० त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU Agni, God mid mortal men, art guard of sacred rites, thou artTo be adored at sacrifice. O Mighty Agni, thou must be glorified at our festivals,Bearing our offerings to the Gods. O Jātavedas Agni, fight and drive our foes afar from us,Themand their godless enmities. Thou, Jātavedas, seekest not the worship of a hostile man,However nigh itbe to thee. We sages, mortals as we are, adore the mighty name oof thee,Immortal Jātavedas' name. Sages, we call the Sage to help, mortals, we call the God to aid:We call on Agni with our songs. May Vatsa draw- thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place,Agni, with song that yearns for thee. Thou art the same in many a place: mid all the people thou art Lord.In fray and fightt we call on thee. When we are seeking strength we call Agni to help us in the strife,The giver of rich gifts in war. Ancient, adorablie at sacrifices, Priest from of old, meet for our praise, thou sittest.Fill full and satisfy thy body, Agni, and win us happiness by offering worship.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा ।त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀtvám ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who are a god among mortals, (and among gods), you are the guardian of religious obligations;you are to be hymned at sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who are a god among mortals, (and among gods), you are the guardian of religious obligations;you are to be hymned at sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमसि प्रशस्यो विदथेषु सहंत्य ।अग्ने रथीरध्वराणां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ asi ǀ pra-śásyaḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ sahantya ǀágne ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Victor (over enemies), you are to be hymned at solemn rites; you,Agni, are the charioteer of sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Victor (over enemies), you are to be hymned at solemn rites; you,Agni, are the charioteer of sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वमस्मदप द्विषो युयोधि जातवेदः ।अदेवीरग्ने अरातीः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asmát ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ yuyodhí ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀádevīḥ ǀ agne ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Jātavedas, drive away from us those who hate us; (drive away),Agni, the impious hostilehosts.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Jātavedas, drive away from us those who hate us; (drive away),Agni, the impious hostilehosts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंति चित्संतमह यज्ञं मर्तस्य रिपोः ।नोप वेषि जातवेदः ॥
verses.transliteration: ánti ǀ cit ǀ sántam ǀ áha ǀ yajñám ǀ mártasya ǀ ripóḥ ǀná ǀ úpa ǀ veṣi ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You desire not,Jātavedas, the sacrifice of the man who is our adversary, although plural ced before you.
verses.wilson_translation: You desire not,Jātavedas, the sacrifice of the man who is our adversary, although plural ced before you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मर्ता अमर्त्यस्य ते भूरि नाम मनामहे ।विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
verses.transliteration: mártāḥ ǀ ámartyasya ǀ te ǀ bhū́ri ǀ nā́ma ǀ manāmahe ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Prudent mortals, we offer abundant homage to you, who are immortal and all-knowing.
verses.wilson_translation: Prudent mortals, we offer abundant homage to you, who are immortal and all-knowing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विप्रं विप्रासोऽवसे देवं मर्तास ऊतये ।अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: vípram ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀagním ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Prudent mortals, we invoke the sage deity Agniwith hymns to propitiate him for our protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Prudent mortals, we invoke the sage deity Agniwith hymns to propitiate him for our protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् ।अग्ने त्वांकामया गिरा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yamat ǀ paramā́t ǀ cit ǀ sadhá-sthāt ǀágne ǀ tvā́m-kāmayā ǀ girā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vatsa, by the praise that seeks to propitiate you,Agni, would draw your thought from the supremeassembly (of the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Vatsa, by the praise that seeks to propitiate you,Agni, would draw your thought from the supremeassembly (of the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः ।समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: puru-trā́ ǀ hí ǀ sa-dṛ́ṅ ǀ ási ǀ víśaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pra-bhúḥ ǀsamát-su ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: You look upon many plural ces, you are lord over all people; we call upon you in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: You look upon many plural ces, you are lord over all people; we call upon you in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयंतो हवामहे ।वाजेषु चित्रराधसं ॥
verses.transliteration: samát-su ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀvā́jeṣu ǀ citrá-rādhasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desiring strength, we call upon Agnifor protection in battles; upon him who is the granter of wonderfulriches (won) in conflicts.
verses.wilson_translation: Desiring strength, we call upon Agnifor protection in battles; upon him who is the granter of wonderfulriches (won) in conflicts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि ।स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रयस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: pratnáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ sanā́t ǀ ca ǀ hótā ǀ návyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sátsi ǀsvā́m ǀ ca ǀ agne ǀ tanvám ǀ pipráyasva ǀ asmábhyam ǀ ca ǀ sáubhagam ǀ ā́ ǀ yajasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, the ancient, are to be hymned at sacrifices; from eternity the invoker of the gods, you sit (at thesolemnity) entitled to laudation; cherish,Agni, yor own person n, and grant us prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: You, the ancient, are to be hymned at sacrifices; from eternity the invoker of the gods, you sit (at thesolemnity) entitled to laudation; cherish,Agni, yor own person n, and grant us prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . JOY, Mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma-draughts, wherewithThou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we long. Wherewith thou bolpest Adhrigu, the great Daśagva, and the GodWho stirs the sunlight, and the sea, for that we long. Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floodsTo go the way ordained by Law, for that we long. Accept this laud for aid, made pure like oil, thou Caster of the Stone,Whereby even in a moment thou hast waxen great. Be pleased, Song-lover, with this song it flows abundant like the sea.Indra, with all thy succours thou hast waxen great. The God who from afar hath sent gifts to maintain our friendship's bond,Thou. spreading them like rain from heaven, hast waxen great. The beams that mark him have grown strong, the thunder rests between his arms,When, like the Sun, he hath increased both Heaven and Earth. When, Mighty Lord of Heroes, thou didst cat a thousand buffaloes,Then grew and waxed exceeding great thine Indra-power. Indra consumeth with the rays of Sūrya the malicious man:Like Agni conquering the woods, he hath grown strong. This newest thought of ours that suits the time approaches unto thee:Serving, beloved in many a place it metes and marks. The pious germ of sacrifice directly purifies the soul.By Indra's lauds it waxes great, it metes and marks. Indra who wins the friend hath spread himself to drink the Soma-draught:Like worshipper's dilating praise; it metes and marks. He whom the sages, living men, have gladdened, offering up their hymns,Hath swelled like oil of sacrifice in Agni's mouth. Aditi also hath brought forth a hymn for Indra, Sovran Lord:The work of sacrifice for help is glorified. The ministering priests have sung their songs for aid and eulogy:God, thy Bays turn not from the rite which Law ordains. If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Viṣṇu's or Tṛta Āptya's side,Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops; Or, Śakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air,Rejoice thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops. Or, Lord of Heroes if thou aid the worshipper who shed; the, juice,Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops. To magnify the God, the God, Indra, yea, Indra for your help,And promptly end the sacrifice-this have they gained. With worship, him whom men adore, with Soma, him who drinks it most,Indra with lauds have they increasedthis have they gained. His leadings are with power and might and his instructions manifold:He gives the worshipper all wealth: this have they gained. For slaying Vṛtra have the Gods set Indra in the foremost place.Indra the choral bands have sung, for vigorous strength. We to the Mighty with our might, with lauds to him who hears our call,With holy hymns have sung aloud, for vigorous strength. Not earth, nor heaven, nor firmaments contain the Thunder-wielding God:They shake before his violent rush and vigorous strength. What time the Gods, O Indra, get thee foremost in the furious fight,Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on. When Vṛtra, stayer of the floods, thou si"est, Thundeicr with might,Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on. When Viṣṇu, through thine energy, strode wide those three great steps of his,Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on. When thy two beautiful Bay Steeds grew great and greater day by day,Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee. When, Indra, all the Marut folk humbly submitted them to thee,Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee. When yonder Sun, that brilliant light, thou settest in the heaven above,Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee. To thee, O Indra, with this thought the sage lifts up this eulogy,Akin and leading as on foot to sacrifice. When in thine own dear dwelling all gathered have lifted up the voiceMilk-streams at worship's central spot, for sacrifice, As Priest, O Indra, give us wealth in brave men and good steeds ana kineThat we may first remember thee for sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: य इंद्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति ।येना हंसि न्यत्रिणं तमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ soma-pā́tamaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ cétati ǀyéna ǀ háṃsi ǀ ní ǀ atríṇam ǀ tám ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit, most powerful Indra, who are the deep quaffer of the Soma, that exhilaration whichcontemplates (heroic deeds), whereby you slay the devourer (of men).
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit, most powerful Indra, who are the deep quaffer of the Soma, that exhilaration whichcontemplates (heroic deeds), whereby you slay the devourer (of men).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयंतं स्वर्णरं ।येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ dáśa-gvam ǀ ádhri-gum ǀ vepáyantam ǀ sváḥ-naram ǀyéna ǀ samudrám ǀ ā́vitha ǀ tám ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit that (exhilaration) whereby you have defended Adhrigu, the accomplisher of the ten (monthśrite), and the trembling leader of heaven, (the sun), and the ocean.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit that (exhilaration) whereby you have defended Adhrigu, the accomplisher of the ten (monthśrite), and the trembling leader of heaven, (the sun), and the ocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येन सिंधुं महीरपो रथाँ इव प्रचोदयः ।पंथामृतस्य यातवे तमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ síndhum ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ráthān-iva ǀ pra-codáyaḥ ǀpánthām ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yā́tave ǀ tám ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit that (exhilaration) whereby you urge on the mighty waters to the sea, in like manner as(charioteers drive) their cars (to the goal), and (whereby) to travel the paths of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit that (exhilaration) whereby you urge on the mighty waters to the sea, in like manner as(charioteers drive) their cars (to the goal), and (whereby) to travel the paths of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमं स्तोममभिष्टये घृतं न पूतमद्रिवः ।येना नु सद्य ओजसा ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ stómam ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pūtám ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀyéna ǀ nú ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ vavákṣitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accepts, thunderer, their praise (offered) for the attainment of our desires, like consecrated butter;(induced) by which, you, promptly bear us by your might (to our objects).
verses.wilson_translation: Accepts, thunderer, their praise (offered) for the attainment of our desires, like consecrated butter;(induced) by which, you, promptly bear us by your might (to our objects).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमं जुषस्व गिर्वणः समुद्र इव पिन्वते ।इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ juṣasva ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ samudráḥ-iva ǀ pinvate ǀíndra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ vavákṣitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be plural ased, you who are gratified by praise, with this our eulogy swelling like the oceans, (induced bywhich),Indra, you ber us with all your proections (to our objects).
verses.wilson_translation: Be plural ased, you who are gratified by praise, with this our eulogy swelling like the oceans, (induced bywhich),Indra, you ber us with all your proections (to our objects).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो नो देवः परावतः सखित्वनाय मामहे ।दिवो न वृष्टिं प्रथयन्ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ sakhi-tvanā́ya ǀ mamahé ǀdiváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ pratháyan ǀ vavákṣitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I glorify Indra) the deity, who, coming from afar, has given us, through friendship, (riches); heaping(them upon us) like rain from heaven, you have borne us (to our objects).
verses.wilson_translation: (I glorify Indra) the deity, who, coming from afar, has given us, through friendship, (riches); heaping(them upon us) like rain from heaven, you have borne us (to our objects).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ववक्षुरस्य केतवो उत वज्रो गभस्त्योः ।यत्सूर्यो न रोदसी अवर्धयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: vavakṣúḥ ǀ asya ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vájraḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀyát ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ávardhayat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The banners of Indra, the thunderbolt (he bears) in hishands, have brought (us benefits), when, likethe sun, he has expanded heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: The banners of Indra, the thunderbolt (he bears) in hishands, have brought (us benefits), when, likethe sun, he has expanded heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रवृद्ध सत्पते सहस्रं महिषाँ अघः ।आदित्त इंद्रियं महि प्र वावृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ pra-vṛddha ǀ sat-pate ǀ sahásram ǀ mahiṣā́n ǀ ághaḥ ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ indriyám ǀ máhi ǀ prá ǀ vavṛdhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Great Indra, protector of the good, when you have slain thousands of mighty (foes), then your vast andspecial energy has been augmented.
verses.wilson_translation: Great Indra, protector of the good, when you have slain thousands of mighty (foes), then your vast andspecial energy has been augmented.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्न्यर्शसानमोषति ।अग्निर्वनेव सासहिः प्र वावृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ ní ǀ arśasānám ǀ oṣati ǀagníḥ ǀ vánā-iva ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ prá ǀ vavṛdhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, with the rays of the sun, utterly consumes his adversary; like fire (burning) the forests, hespreads victorious.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, with the rays of the sun, utterly consumes his adversary; like fire (burning) the forests, hespreads victorious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं त ऋत्वियावती धीतिरेति नवीयसी ।सपर्यंती पुरुप्रिया मिमीत इत् ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ te ǀ ṛtvíya-vatī ǀ dhītíḥ ǀ eti ǀ návīyasī ǀsaparyántī ǀ puru-priyā́ ǀ mímīte ǀ ít ǁ
verses.english_translation: This new praise, suited to the season, approaches, (Indra), to you; offering adoration and greatlydelighting (you), it verily proclaims the measure (of your merits).
verses.wilson_translation: This new praise, suited to the season, approaches, (Indra), to you; offering adoration and greatlydelighting (you), it verily proclaims the measure (of your merits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गर्भो यज्ञस्य देवयुः क्रतुं पुनीत आनुषक् ।स्तोमैरिंद्रस्य वावृधे मिमीत इत् ॥
verses.transliteration: gárbhaḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ krátum ǀ punīte ǀ ānuṣák ǀstómaiḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ mímīte ǀ ít ǁ
verses.english_translation: The devout praiser of the adorable (Indra) purifies in due succession the offering (of the Soma); withsacred hymns he magnifies (the might) of Indra; he verily proclaims the measure (of hismerits).
verses.wilson_translation: The devout praiser of the adorable (Indra) purifies in due succession the offering (of the Soma); withsacred hymns he magnifies (the might) of Indra; he verily proclaims the measure (of hismerits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनिर्मित्रस्य पप्रथ इंद्रः सोमस्य पीतये ।प्राची वाशीव सुन्वते मिमीत इत् ॥
verses.transliteration: saníḥ ǀ mitrásya ǀ paprathe ǀ índraḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǀprā́cī ǀ vā́śī-iva ǀ sunvaté ǀ mímīte ǀ ít ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the benefactor of his friend (the worshipper), has enlarged himself todrikthe Soma, in likemanner as the pious praise dilates and proclaims the measure (of his merits).
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the benefactor of his friend (the worshipper), has enlarged himself todrikthe Soma, in likemanner as the pious praise dilates and proclaims the measure (of his merits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं विप्रा उक्थवाहसोऽभिप्रमंदुरायवः ।घृतं न पिप्य आसन्यृतस्य यत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ víprāḥ ǀ ukthá-vāhasaḥ ǀ abhi-pramandúḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pipye ǀ āsáni ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yát ǁ
verses.english_translation: I pour the oblation of the sacrifice, like clarified butter, into the mouth (of that Indra), whom wise men,addressing with prayers, delight.
verses.wilson_translation: I pour the oblation of the sacrifice, like clarified butter, into the mouth (of that Indra), whom wise men,addressing with prayers, delight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्वराजे अदितिः स्तोममिंद्राय जीजनत् ।पुरुप्रशस्तमूतय ऋतस्य यत् ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ sva-rā́je ǀ áditiḥ ǀ stómam ǀ índrāya ǀ jījanat ǀpuru-praśastám ǀ ūtáye ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The excellent praise which Aditibrought forth for the imperial Indra, for our protection, is that which was(the product) of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The excellent praise which Aditibrought forth for the imperial Indra, for our protection, is that which was(the product) of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वह्नय ऊतयेऽनूषत प्रशस्तये ।न देव विव्रता हरी ऋतस्य यत् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ ánūṣata ǀ prá-śastaye ǀná ǀ deva ǀ ví-vratā ǀ hárī íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bearers of the oblation glorify (Indra) for his excellent protection; now, divinity, let yourmany-actioned horses (bear you to the offering) of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The bearers of the oblation glorify (Indra) for his excellent protection; now, divinity, let yourmany-actioned horses (bear you to the offering) of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्सोममिंद्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये ।यद्वा मरुत्सु मंदसे समिंदुभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀ víṣṇavi ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ trité ǀ āptyé ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ marút-su ǀ mándase ǀ sám ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch as you are exhilarated by the Somashared with Viṣṇu, or when (offered) by Trita, the son ofthe waters, or along with the Maruts, so now (be gratified) by (our) libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch as you are exhilarated by the Somashared with Viṣṇu, or when (offered) by Trita, the son ofthe waters, or along with the Maruts, so now (be gratified) by (our) libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मंदसे ।अस्माकमित्सुते रणा समिंदुभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ śakra ǀ parā-váti ǀ samudré ǀ ádhi ǀ mándase ǀasmā́kam ǀ ít ǀ suté ǀ raṇa ǀ sám ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch,Śakra, as you are exhilarated (by the Soma) on the far- distant ocean, so be you gratifiednow, when the Soma is effused by our libations.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch,Śakra, as you are exhilarated (by the Soma) on the far- distant ocean, so be you gratifiednow, when the Soma is effused by our libations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वासि सुन्वतो वृधो यजमानस्य सत्पते ।उक्थे वा यस्य रण्यसि समिंदुभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ ási ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sat-pate ǀukthé ǀ vā ǀ yásya ǀ ráṇyasi ǀ sám ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inasmuch, protector of the virtuous, as you are the benefactor of the worshipper offering you libations,or by whose prayers you are propitiated, so now (be gratified) by our libations.
verses.wilson_translation: Inasmuch, protector of the virtuous, as you are the benefactor of the worshipper offering you libations,or by whose prayers you are propitiated, so now (be gratified) by our libations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवंदेवं वोऽवस इंद्रमिंद्रं गृणीषणि ।अधा यज्ञाय तुर्वणे व्यानशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: devám-devam ǀ vaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ índram-indram ǀ gṛṇīṣáṇi ǀádha ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ turváṇe ǀ ví ǀ ānaśuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify the divine Indrawherever worshipped for your protection; (my praises) have reached him for theprompt (fulfilment) of the (objects of the) sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify the divine Indrawherever worshipped for your protection; (my praises) have reached him for theprompt (fulfilment) of the (objects of the) sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेभिर्यज्ञवाहसं सोमेभिः सोमपातमं ।होत्राभिरिंद्रं वावृधुर्व्यानशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñébhiḥ ǀ yajñá-vāhasam ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ soma-pā́tamam ǀhótrābhiḥ ǀ índram ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ ví ǀ ānaśuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (His worshippers) have magnified with many sacrifices him to whom the sacrifice is offered, and withmany libations the eager quaffer of the Soma; (they have magnified)Indrawith hymns, (their praises) haveattained him.
verses.wilson_translation: (His worshippers) have magnified with many sacrifices him to whom the sacrifice is offered, and withmany libations the eager quaffer of the Soma; (they have magnified)Indrawith hymns, (their praises) haveattained him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः ।विश्वा वसूनि दाशुषे व्यानशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: mahī́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ prá-nītayaḥ ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ví ǀ ānaśuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Infinite are his bounties, many are his glories; ample treasures have reached the donor (of oblations).
verses.wilson_translation: Infinite are his bounties, many are his glories; ample treasures have reached the donor (of oblations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वृत्राय हंतवे देवासो दधिरे पुरः ।इंद्रं वाणीरनूषता समोजसे ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ puráḥ ǀíndram ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ sám ǀ ójase ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods have plural ced Indra(foremost) for the destruction of Vṛtra; their praise has been addressed tohim to enhance his vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods have plural ced Indra(foremost) for the destruction of Vṛtra; their praise has been addressed tohim to enhance his vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महांतं महिना वयं स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुतं ।अर्कैरभि प्र णोनुमः समोजसे ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́ntam ǀ mahinā́ ǀ vayám ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ havana-śrútam ǀarkáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ójase ǁ
verses.english_translation: We repeatedly glorify with praises and adorations him who is great with greatness, who hears ourinvocations, (to enhance) his vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: We repeatedly glorify with praises and adorations him who is great with greatness, who hears ourinvocations, (to enhance) his vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न यं विविक्तो रोदसी नांतरिक्षाणि वज्रिणं ।अमादिदस्य तित्विषे समोजसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ viviktáḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ná ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ vajríṇam ǀámāt ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ titviṣe ǀ sám ǀ ójasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The thunderer, from whom neither the heaven and earth nor the firmament are separated; from thestrength of whom, the mighty one, (the world) derives lustre.
verses.wilson_translation: The thunderer, from whom neither the heaven and earth nor the firmament are separated; from thestrength of whom, the mighty one, (the world) derives lustre.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदिंद्र पृतनाज्ये देवास्त्वा दधिरे पुरः ।आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ pṛtanā́jye ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tvā ǀ dadhiré ǀ puráḥ ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ haryatā́ ǀ hárī íti ǀ vavakṣatuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indra, the gods plural ced you foremost in the battle, then your beloved horses bore you.
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indra, the gods plural ced you foremost in the battle, then your beloved horses bore you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदा वृत्रं नदीवृतं शवसा वज्रिन्नवधीः ।आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ nadī-vṛ́tam ǀ śávasā ǀ vajrin ǀ ávadhīḥ ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ haryatā́ ǀ hárī íti ǀ vavakṣatuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When, thunderer, by your strength you did slay Vṛtra, the obstructer of the waters, then your belovedhorses bore you.
verses.wilson_translation: When, thunderer, by your strength you did slay Vṛtra, the obstructer of the waters, then your belovedhorses bore you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदा ते विष्णुरोजसा त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे ।आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ te ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ padā́ ǀ vi-cakramé ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ haryatā́ ǀ hárī íti ǀ vavakṣatuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When your (younger brother)Viṣṇuby (his) strength stepped his three paces, then verily your belovedhorses bore you.
verses.wilson_translation: When your (younger brother)Viṣṇuby (his) strength stepped his three paces, then verily your belovedhorses bore you.
