verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदा ते हर्यता हरी वावृधाते दिवेदिवे ।आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ te ǀ haryatā́ ǀ hárī íti ǀ vavṛdhā́te íti ǀ divé-dive ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ yemire ǁ
verses.english_translation: When your beloved horses had augmented day by day, then all existent beings were subject unto you.
verses.wilson_translation: When your beloved horses had augmented day by day, then all existent beings were subject unto you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदा ते मारुतीर्विशस्तुभ्यमिंद्र नियेमिरे ।आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ te ǀ mā́rutīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ indra ǀ ni-yemiré ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ yemire ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indra, your people, the Maruts, were regulated by you, then all existent beings were subject untoyou.
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indra, your people, the Maruts, were regulated by you, then all existent beings were subject untoyou.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदा सूर्यममुं दिवि शुक्रं ज्योतिरधारयः ।आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ amúm ǀ diví ǀ śukrám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ádhārayaḥ ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ yemire ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whenyou had plural ced yonder pure light, the sun, in the sky, then all existing beings were subject untoyou.
verses.wilson_translation: Whenyou had plural ced yonder pure light, the sun, in the sky, then all existing beings were subject untoyou.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमां त इंद्र सुष्टुतिं विप्र इयर्ति धीतिभिः ।जामिं पदेव पिप्रतीं प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́m ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ su-stutím ǀ vípraḥ ǀ iyarti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀjāmím ǀ padā́-iva ǀ pípratīm ǀ prá ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise (worshipper),Indra, offers you this gratifying sincere praise along with pious rites at thesacrifice, as (a man plural ces) a kinsman in (a prominent) position.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise (worshipper),Indra, offers you this gratifying sincere praise along with pious rites at thesacrifice, as (a man plural ces) a kinsman in (a prominent) position.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदस्य धामनि प्रिये समीचीनासो अस्वरन् ।नाभा यज्ञस्य दोहना प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ asya ǀ dhā́mani ǀ priyé ǀ sam-īcīnā́saḥ ǀ ásvaran ǀnā́bhā ǀ yajñásya ǀ dohánā ǀ prá ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the congregated (worshippers) praise him aloud in a plural ce that plural ases (him) on the navel (of theearth), in the spot where the libation is effused at the sacrifice, (then).
verses.wilson_translation: When the congregated (worshippers) praise him aloud in a plural ce that plural ases (him) on the navel (of theearth), in the spot where the libation is effused at the sacrifice, (then).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं सुगव्यमिंद्र दद्धि नः ।होतेव पूर्वचित्तये प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: su-vī́ryam ǀ su-áśvyam ǀ su-gávyam ǀ indra ǀ daddhi ǀ naḥ ǀhótā-iva ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǀ prá ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us,Indra, (wealth), comprising worthymaleofspring, excellent horses, and good cattle;like the ministrant priest (I worship you) at the sacrifice, (to secure) your prior consideration.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us,Indra, (wealth), comprising worthymaleofspring, excellent horses, and good cattle;like the ministrant priest (I worship you) at the sacrifice, (to secure) your prior consideration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INDRA, when Soma juices flow, makes his mind pure and meet for lauds.He gains the power that brings success, for great is he. In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success,Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the water-floods. Him, to win strength, have I invoked, even Indra mighty for the fray.Be thou most near to us for bliss, a Friend to aid. Indra, Song -lover, here for thee the worshipper's libation flows.Rejoicing in this sacred grass thou shinest forth. Even now, O Indra, give us that which, pressing juice, we crave of thee.Bring us wealth manifold which finds the light of heaven. What time the zealous worshipper hath boldly sung his songs to thee,Like branches of a tree up-grows what they desire. Generate songs even as of old, give car unto the singer's call.Thou for the pious hast grown great at each carouse. Sweet strains that glorify him play like waters speeding down a slope,Yea, him who in this song is called the Lord of Heaven; Yea, who alone is called the Lord, the single Ruler of the folk,By worshippers seeking aid: may he joy in the draught. Praise him, the Glorious, skilled in song, Lord of the two victorious Bays:They seek the worshipper's abode who bows in prayer. Put forth thy strength: with dappled Steeds come, thou of mighty intellect,With swift Steeds to the sacrifice, for ’tis thy joy. Grant wealth to those who praise thee, Lord of Heroes, Mightiest Indra: giveOur princes everlasting fame and opulence. I call thee when the Sun is risen, I call thee at the noon of day:With thy car-horses, Indra, come wellpleased to us. Speed forward hither, come to us, rejoice thee in the milky draught:Spin out the thread of ancient time, as well is known. If, Śakra, Vṛtra-slayer, thou be far away or near to us.Or in the sea, thou art the guard of Soma juice. Let songs we sing and Soma-drops expressed by us make Indra strong:The tribes who bring oblations find delight in him. Him sages longing for his aid, with offerings brought in eager haste,Him. even as branches, all mankind have made to grow. At the Trkadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirred the mind:May our songs strengthen him who still hath strengthened us. When, true to duty, at due times the worshipper offers lauds to thee,They call him Purifier, Pure, and Wonderful. That mind of Rudra, fresh and strong, moves conscious in the ancient ways,With reference whereto the wise have ordered this. If thou elect to be my Friend drink of this sacrificial juice,By help whereof we may subdue all enemies. O Indra, Lover of the song, when shall thy praiser be most blest?When wilt thou grant us wealth in herds of kine and steeds? And thy two highIy-lauded Bays, strong stallions, draw thy car who artUntouched by age, most gladdening car for which we pray. With ancient offerings we implore the Young and Strong whom many praise.He from of old hath sat upon dear sacred grass. Wax miglity, thou whom many laud for aids which Ṛṣis have extolled.Pour down for us abundant food and guard us well. O Indra, Caster of the Stone, thou helpest him who praises thee:From sacrifice I send to thee a mindyoked hymn. Here, yoking for the Soma-draught these Horses, sharers of thy feast,Thy Bay Steeds, Indra, fraught with weal tb, consent to come. Attendants on thy glory, let the Rudras roar assent to thee,And all the Marut companies come tothe feast. These his victorious followers bold in the heavens the place they love,Leagued in the heart of sacrifice, as well we know. That we may long behold the light, what time the ordered rite proceeds,He duly measures, as he views, the sacrifice. O Indra, strong is this thy car, and strong are these Bay Steeds of thine:O Śatakratu, thou art strong, strong is our call. Strong is the press-stone, strong thy joy, strong is the flowing Soma juice:Strong is the rite thou furtherest, strong is our call. As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunderer with thy thousand aids:For thou hast won the hymn of praise. Strong is our call.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रः सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीत उक्थ्यं ।विदे वृधस्य दक्षसो महान्हि षः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sutéṣu ǀ sómeṣu ǀ krátum ǀ punīte ǀ ukthyám ǀvidé ǀ vṛdhásya ǀ dákṣasaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, when the Somajuices are effused, sanctifies the offerer and the praiser for the attainment ofincrease giving strength, for he is mighty.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, when the Somajuices are effused, sanctifies the offerer and the praiser for the attainment ofincrease giving strength, for he is mighty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानां सदने वृधः ।सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ prathamé ǀ ví-omani ǀ devā́nām ǀ sádane ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀsu-pāráḥ ǀ suśrávaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǁ
verses.english_translation: Abiding in the highest heaven, in the dwelling of the gods, he is the giver of increase, the accomplisher(of works), the possessor of great renown, the conqueror of (the obstructer of) the rains.
verses.wilson_translation: Abiding in the highest heaven, in the dwelling of the gods, he is the giver of increase, the accomplisher(of works), the possessor of great renown, the conqueror of (the obstructer of) the rains.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमह्वे वाजसातय इंद्रं भराय शुष्मिणं ।भवा नः सुम्ने अंतमः सखा वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ahve ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ índram ǀ bhárāya ǀ śuṣmíṇam ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ sumné ǀ ántamaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke the powerful Indrafor (aid in) the food-bestowing combat; be near unto us for our happiness;be a friend for our increase.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke the powerful Indrafor (aid in) the food-bestowing combat; be near unto us for our happiness;be a friend for our increase.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं त इंद्र गिर्वणो रातिः क्षरति सुन्वतः ।मंदानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ rātíḥ ǀ kṣarati ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀmandānáḥ ǀ asyá ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: This gift of the offerer of the libation flows to you,Indra, who are gratified by praise, exhilarated bywhich you reign over the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: This gift of the offerer of the libation flows to you,Indra, who are gratified by praise, exhilarated bywhich you reign over the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नूनं तदिंद्र दद्धि नो यत्त्वा सुन्वंत ईमहे ।रयिं नश्चित्रमा भरा स्वर्विदं ॥
verses.transliteration: nūnám ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ daddhi ǀ naḥ ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ sunvántaḥ ǀ ī́mahe ǀrayím ǀ naḥ ǀ citrám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us,Indra, that which, when pouring out the libation, we solicit of you; grant us thewondrous wealth that is the means of obtaining heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us,Indra, that which, when pouring out the libation, we solicit of you; grant us thewondrous wealth that is the means of obtaining heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तोता यत्ते विचर्षणिरतिप्रशर्धयद्गिरः ।वया इवानु रोहते जुषंत यत् ॥
verses.transliteration: stotā́ ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ ati-praśardháyat ǀ gíraḥ ǀvayā́ḥ-iva ǀ ánu ǀ rohate ǀ juṣánta ǀ yát ǁ
verses.english_translation: When your discriminating eulogist has addressed to you overpowering praises, then, if they areacceptable to you, they expand like the branches (of a tree).
verses.wilson_translation: When your discriminating eulogist has addressed to you overpowering praises, then, if they areacceptable to you, they expand like the branches (of a tree).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्नवज्जनया गिरः शृणुधी जरितुर्हवं ।मदेमदे ववक्षिथा सुकृत्वने ॥
verses.transliteration: pratna-vát ǀ janaya ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śṛṇudhí ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ hávam ǀmáde-made ǀ vavakṣitha ǀ su-kṛ́tvane ǁ
verses.english_translation: genitive rate your eulogies as of old; hear the invocation of the adorer; you bear in your reiteratedexultation (blessings) to the liberal donor (of the oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: genitive rate your eulogies as of old; hear the invocation of the adorer; you bear in your reiteratedexultation (blessings) to the liberal donor (of the oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रीळंत्यस्य सूनृता आपो न प्रवता यतीः ।अया धिया य उच्यते पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: krī́ḷanti ǀ asya ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-vátā ǀ yatī́ḥ ǀayā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ucyáte ǀ pátiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The kind and true words of him who in this hymn is called the lord of heaven sport like waters flowingby a downward (channel).
verses.wilson_translation: The kind and true words of him who in this hymn is called the lord of heaven sport like waters flowingby a downward (channel).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतो पतिर्य उच्यते कृष्टीनामेक इद्वशी ।नमोवृधैरवस्युभिः सुते रण ॥
verses.transliteration: utó íti ǀ pátiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ucyáte ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ vaśī́ ǀnamaḥ-vṛdháiḥ ǀ avasyú-bhiḥ ǀ suté ǀ raṇa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or he, who is called the one absolute lord of men-- praise him, when the libation is effused, withmagnifying songs, imploring his protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Or he, who is called the one absolute lord of men-- praise him, when the libation is effused, withmagnifying songs, imploring his protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तुहि श्रुतं विपश्चितं हरी यस्य प्रसक्षिणा ।गंतारा दाशुषो गृहं नमस्विनः ॥
verses.transliteration: stuhí ǀ śrutám ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ hárī íti ǀ yásya ǀ pra-sakṣíṇā ǀgántārā ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǀ namasvínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise the renowned, the sapient (Indra), whose victorious horses proceed to the dwelling of the devoutdonor (of the libation).
verses.wilson_translation: Praise the renowned, the sapient (Indra), whose victorious horses proceed to the dwelling of the devoutdonor (of the libation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तूतुजानो महेमतेऽश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः ।आ याहि यज्ञमाशुभिः शमिद्धि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: tūtujānáḥ ǀ mahe-mate ǀ áśvebhiḥ ǀ pruṣitápsu-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ yajñám ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ śám ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: Munificently minded, do you, who are quick of movement, come with shining and swift steeds to thesacrifice, for verily there is gratification to you thereby.
verses.wilson_translation: Munificently minded, do you, who are quick of movement, come with shining and swift steeds to thesacrifice, for verily there is gratification to you thereby.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र शविष्ठ सत्पते रयिं गृणत्सु धारय ।श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनं ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ sat-pate ǀ rayím ǀ gṛṇát-su ǀ dhāraya ǀśrávaḥ ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ vasu-tvanám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most powerful Indra, protector of the virtuous, secure us who praise you in the possession of riches,(grant) to the pious imperishable all-pervading sustenance.
verses.wilson_translation: Most powerful Indra, protector of the virtuous, secure us who praise you in the possession of riches,(grant) to the pious imperishable all-pervading sustenance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हवे त्वा सूर उदिते हवे मध्यंदिने दिवः ।जुषाण इंद्र सप्तिभिर्न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: háve ǀ tvā ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ háve ǀ madhyándine ǀ diváḥ ǀjuṣāṇáḥ ǀ indra ǀ sápti-bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke you when the sun is risen; I invoke (you) at mid-day; being propitited, come to us,Indra, withyour gliding steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke you when the sun is risen; I invoke (you) at mid-day; being propitited, come to us,Indra, withyour gliding steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ तू गहि प्र तु द्रव मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ।तंतुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं यथा विदे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ gahi ǀ prá ǀ tú ǀ drava ǀ mátsva ǀ sutásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀtántum ǀ tanuṣva ǀ pūrvyám ǀ yáthā ǀ vidé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come quickly; hasten, be exhilarated by the libation mixed with milk; extend the ancient sacrifice, sothat I may obtain (its reward).
verses.wilson_translation: Come quickly; hasten, be exhilarated by the libation mixed with milk; extend the ancient sacrifice, sothat I may obtain (its reward).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् ।यद्वा समुद्रे अंधसोऽवितेदसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ śakra ǀ ási ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ arvā-váti ǀ vṛtra-han ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ samudré ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ ít ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether,Śakra, you be far off, or, slayer of Vṛtra, near athand, or whether you be in the firmament,you are the guardian of the (sacrificial) food.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether,Śakra, you be far off, or, slayer of Vṛtra, near athand, or whether you be in the firmament,you are the guardian of the (sacrificial) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वर्धंतु नो गिर इंद्रं सुतास इंदवः ।इंद्रे हविष्मतीर्विशो अराणिषुः ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ índram ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀíndre ǀ havíṣmatīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ arāṇiṣuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our praises magnify Indra! May our effused libations gratify Indra! May the people bearingoblations excite plural asure in Indra!
verses.wilson_translation: May our praises magnify Indra! May our effused libations gratify Indra! May the people bearingoblations excite plural asure in Indra!
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमिद्विप्रा अवस्यवः प्रवत्वतीभिरूतिभिः ।इंद्रं क्षोणीरवर्धयन्वया इव ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ víprāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ pravátvatībhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀíndram ǀ kṣoṇī́ḥ ǀ avardhayan ǀ vayā́ḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pious, desiring his protection, magnify him by ample and plural asure- yielding (libations); the earth,(and other worlds, spread out) like the branches of a tree, magnify Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious, desiring his protection, magnify him by ample and plural asure- yielding (libations); the earth,(and other worlds, spread out) like the branches of a tree, magnify Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत ।तमिद्वर्धंतु नो गिरः सदावृधं ॥
verses.transliteration: trí-kadrukeṣu ǀ cétanam ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ atnata ǀtám ǀ ít ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sadā́-vṛdham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods propitiate the superintending adorable (Indra) at the Trikadruka rites. May our praisesmagnify him who is ever the magnifier (of his worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: The gods propitiate the superintending adorable (Indra) at the Trikadruka rites. May our praisesmagnify him who is ever the magnifier (of his worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत�� यत्ते अनुव्रत उक्थान्यृतुथा दधे ।शुचिः पावक उच्यते सो अद्भुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: stotā́ ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ánu-vrataḥ ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ dadhé ǀśúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ucyate ǀ sáḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your worshipper is observant of his duty, inasmuch as he offers prayers indue season; for you are hewho is called pure, purifying, wonderful.
verses.wilson_translation: Your worshipper is observant of his duty, inasmuch as he offers prayers indue season; for you are hewho is called pure, purifying, wonderful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदिद्रुद्रस्य चेतति यह्वं प्रत्नेषु धामसु ।मनो यत्रा वि तद्दधुर्विचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ rudrásya ǀ cetati ǀ yahvám ǀ pratnéṣu ǀ dhā́ma-su ǀmánaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ ví ǀ tát ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ ví-cetasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The progeny of Rudra(the Maruts) is known in ancient plural ces, and to them the intelligent worshippersoffer adoration.
verses.wilson_translation: The progeny of Rudra(the Maruts) is known in ancient plural ces, and to them the intelligent worshippersoffer adoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदि मे सख्यमावर इमस्य पाह्यंधसः ।येन विश्वा अति द्विषो अतारिम ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ me ǀ sakhyám ǀ ā-váraḥ ǀ imásya ǀ pāhi ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀyéna ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ átārima ǁ
verses.english_translation: If, (Indra), you choose my friendship, partake of this (sacrificial) food, by which we may pass beyond(the reach of) all adversaries.
verses.wilson_translation: If, (Indra), you choose my friendship, partake of this (sacrificial) food, by which we may pass beyond(the reach of) all adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कदा त इंद्र गिर्वणः स्तोता भवाति शंतमः ।कदा नो गव्ये अश्व्ये वसौ दधः ॥
verses.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ stotā́ ǀ bhavāti ǀ śám-tamaḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávye ǀ áśvye ǀ vásau ǀ dadhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indra, who delight in praise, may your worshipper be entirely happy? When will you establish usin (the affluence of) cattle, of horses, of dwellings?
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indra, who delight in praise, may your worshipper be entirely happy? When will you establish usin (the affluence of) cattle, of horses, of dwellings?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत ते सुष्टुता हरी वृषणा वहतो रथं ।अजुर्यस्य मदिंतमं यमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ te ǀ sú-stutā ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ vahataḥ ǀ rátham ǀajuryásya ǀ madín-tamam ǀ yám ǀ ī́mahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or, when will your renowned and vigorous horses bring the chariot of you, who are exempt from decay,that exhilarating (wealth) which we solicit?
verses.wilson_translation: Or, when will your renowned and vigorous horses bring the chariot of you, who are exempt from decay,that exhilarating (wealth) which we solicit?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमीमहे पुरुष्टुतं यह्वं प्रत्नाभिरूतिभिः ।नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सददध द्विता ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ īmahe ǀ puru-stutám ǀ yahvám ǀ pratnā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ priyé ǀ sadat ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit with ancient and gratifying (offerings) him who is mighty and the invoked of many; may he sitdown on the plural asant sacred grass, and accept the two-fold (offering of cakes and Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit with ancient and gratifying (offerings) him who is mighty and the invoked of many; may he sitdown on the plural asant sacred grass, and accept the two-fold (offering of cakes and Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वर्धस्वा सु पुरुष्टुत ऋषिष्टुताभिरूतिभिः ।धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषमवा च नः ॥
verses.transliteration: várdhasva ǀ sú ǀ puru-stuta ǀ ṛ́ṣi-stutābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀdhukṣásva ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀ íṣam ǀ áva ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praised of many, prosper (us) with the protections hymned by the ṛṣis, send down upon us nutritiousfood.
verses.wilson_translation: Praised of many, prosper (us) with the protections hymned by the ṛṣis, send down upon us nutritiousfood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र त्वमवितेदसीत्था स्तुवतो अद्रिवः ।ऋतादियर्मि ते धियं मनोयुजं ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ tvám ǀ avitā́ ǀ ít ǀ asi ǀ itthā́ ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀṛtā́t ǀ iyarmi ǀ te ǀ dhíyam ǀ manaḥ-yújam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thunderbolt-bearing Indra, you are the protector of him who thus eulogises you; I seek through sacrificefor your favour, which is to be gained by praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Thunderbolt-bearing Indra, you are the protector of him who thus eulogises you; I seek through sacrificefor your favour, which is to be gained by praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या युजानः सोमपीतये ।हरी इंद्र प्रतद्वसू अभि स्वर ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ sadha-mā́dyā ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀhárī íti ǀ indra ǀ pratádvasū íti pratát-vasū ǀ abhí ǀ svara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Harnessing your horses,Indra, laden with treasure and sharing your exhilaratio, come here to drink ofthe Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Harnessing your horses,Indra, laden with treasure and sharing your exhilaratio, come here to drink ofthe Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि स्वरंतु ये तव रुद्रासः सक्षत श्रियं ।उतो मरुत्वतीर्विशो अभि प्रयः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ svarantu ǀ yé ǀ táva ǀ rudrā́saḥ ǀ sakṣata ǀ śríyam ǀutó íti ǀ marútvatīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the sons of Rudra, who are your followers, approach and partake of the glory (of the sacrifice); andmay (other celestial) people associated with the Maruts(partake of the sacrificial) food.
verses.wilson_translation: May the sons of Rudra, who are your followers, approach and partake of the glory (of the sacrifice); andmay (other celestial) people associated with the Maruts(partake of the sacrificial) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमा अस्य प्रतूर्तयः पदं जुषंत यद्दिवि ।नाभा यज्ञस्य सं दधुर्यथा विदे ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ prá-tūrtayaḥ ǀ padám ǀ juṣanta ǀ yát ǀ diví ǀnā́bhā ǀ yajñásya ǀ sám ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vidé ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those who (are his attndants), victorious (over enemies), be satisfied with the station (which theyoccupy) in heaven, and may they be assembled at the navel of the sacrifice, that I may therefrom acquire(wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: May those who (are his attndants), victorious (over enemies), be satisfied with the station (which theyoccupy) in heaven, and may they be assembled at the navel of the sacrifice, that I may therefrom acquire(wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं दीर्घाय चक्षसे प्राचि प्रयत्यध्वरे ।मिमीते यज्ञमानुषग्विचक्ष्य ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ dīrghā́ya ǀ cákṣase ǀ prā́ci ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀmímīte ǀ yajñám ǀ ānuṣák ǀ vi-cákṣya ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the ceremony is being prepared in the hall of sacrifice, this (Indra), having inspected the rite,regulates (the performance) in due succession for a distant object.
verses.wilson_translation: When the ceremony is being prepared in the hall of sacrifice, this (Indra), having inspected the rite,regulates (the performance) in due succession for a distant object.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषायमिंद्र ते रथ उतो ते वृषणा हरी ।वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो वृषा हवः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ ayám ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ utó íti ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ hárī íti ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ tvám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ hávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your chariot,Indra, is a showerer (of benefits), showerers (of benefits) are your horses; you alsoŚatakratu, are the showerer (of benefits) the invocation (addressed to you) is the showerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: Your chariot,Indra, is a showerer (of benefits), showerers (of benefits) are your horses; you alsoŚatakratu, are the showerer (of benefits) the invocation (addressed to you) is the showerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः ।वृषा यज्ञो यमिन्वसि वृषा हवः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ grā́vā ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ayám ǀ sutáḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ yám ǀ ínvasi ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ hávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The stone (that bruises the Soma) is the showerer (of benefits), so is your exhilaration and this Somathat is effused; the sacrifice that you accept is the showerer (of benefits),such also is your invocation.
verses.wilson_translation: The stone (that bruises the Soma) is the showerer (of benefits), so is your exhilaration and this Somathat is effused; the sacrifice that you accept is the showerer (of benefits),such also is your invocation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिंचित्राभिरूतिभिः ।वावंथ हि प्रतिष्टुतिं वृषा हवः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ tvā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ huve ǀ vájrin ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀvavántha ǀ hí ǀ práti-stutim ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ hávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer (of the oblation) I invoke with manifold and gratifying (praises) you, O thunderer, theshowerer (of benefits); inasmuch as you acknowledge the eulogy addressed to you, your invocation is theshowerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of the oblation) I invoke with manifold and gratifying (praises) you, O thunderer, theshowerer (of benefits); inasmuch as you acknowledge the eulogy addressed to you, your invocation is theshowerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . IF I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single Sovran of all wealth,My worshipper should be rich in kine. I should be fain, O Lord of Power, to strengthen and enrich the sage,Were I the Lord of herds of kine. To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cowYielding in plenty kine and steeds. None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence,The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give. The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth, and madeHimself a diadem in heaven. Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen greatHast won all treasures for thine own. In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light,When he cleft Vala limb from limb. Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Aṅgirases,And Vala he cast headlong down. By Indra were the lumirious realms of heaven established and secured,Firm and immovable from their place. Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods:Bright shine the drops that gladden thee. For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify:Thou blessest those who worship thee. Let the two long-maned Bay Steeds bring Indra to drink the Soma juice,The Bountiful to our sacrifice. With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuci,Subduing all contending hosts. The Dasyus, when they fain would climbby magic arts and mount to heaven,Thou, Indra, castest down to earth. As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every sideTheir settlement who poured no gifts.

verses.sanskrit: यदिंद्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् ।स्तोता मे गोषखा स्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ ahám ǀ yáthā ǀ tvám ǀ ī́śīya ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀstotā́ ǀ me ǀ gó-sakhā ǀ syāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: If,Indra, I were, as you are, sole, lord over wealth, then should my eulogist be possessed of cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: If,Indra, I were, as you are, sole, lord over wealth, then should my eulogist be possessed of cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे ।यदहं गोपतिः स्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: śíkṣeyam ǀ asmai ǀ dítseyam ǀ śácī-pate ǀ manīṣíṇe ǀyát ǀ ahám ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ syā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of might, I would give to that intelligent worshipper that which I should wish to give, if I were thepossessor of cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of might, I would give to that intelligent worshipper that which I should wish to give, if I were thepossessor of cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धेनुष्ट इंद्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते ।गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ॥
verses.transliteration: dhenúḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǀgā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ pipyúṣī ǀ duhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your praise,Indra, is a cow to the worshipper offering the libations, it milks him in abundance cattle andhorses.
verses.wilson_translation: Your praise,Indra, is a cow to the worshipper offering the libations, it milks him in abundance cattle andhorses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इंद्र देवो न मर्त्यः ।यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघं ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ vartā́ ǀ asti ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ índra ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ mártyaḥ ǀyát ǀ dítsasi ǀ stutáḥ ǀ maghám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Neither god nor man,Indra, is the obstructor of your affluence, (of) the wealth which you, when praised,design to bestow.
verses.wilson_translation: Neither god nor man,Indra, is the obstructor of your affluence, (of) the wealth which you, when praised,design to bestow.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञ इंद्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् ।चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñáḥ ǀ índram ǀ avardhayat ǀ yát ǀ bhū́mim ǀ ví ǀ ávartayat ǀcakrāṇáḥ ǀ opaśám ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sacrifice has magnified Indra, so that he has supported the earth (with rain), making (the cloud)quiescent in the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Sacrifice has magnified Indra, so that he has supported the earth (with rain), making (the cloud)quiescent in the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वावृधानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः ।ऊतिमिंद्रा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: vavṛdhānásya ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ víśvā ǀ dhánāni ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀūtím ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit,Indra, the protection of you, who are ever being magnified, the conqueror of all the riches (ofthe enemy).
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit,Indra, the protection of you, who are ever being magnified, the conqueror of all the riches (ofthe enemy).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्यंतरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना ।इंद्रो यदभिनद्वलं ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ antárikṣam ǀ atirat ǀ máde ǀ sómasya ǀ rocanā́ ǀíndraḥ ǀ yát ǀ ábhinat ǀ valám ǁ
verses.english_translation: In the exhilaration of the Soma,Indrahas traversed the radiant firmament that he might pierce (theasura)Vala.
verses.wilson_translation: In the exhilaration of the Soma,Indrahas traversed the radiant firmament that he might pierce (theasura)Vala.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उद्गा आजदंगिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः ।अर्वांचं नुनुदे वलं ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ājat ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ kṛṇván ǀ gúhā ǀ satī́ḥ ǀarvā́ñcam ǀ nunude ǀ valám ǁ
verses.english_translation: He liberated the cows for theaṅgirasas, making manifest those that have been hidden in the cave,hurling Valaheadlong down.
verses.wilson_translation: He liberated the cows for theaṅgirasas, making manifest those that have been hidden in the cave,hurling Valaheadlong down.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रेण रोचना दिवो दृळ्हानि दृंहितानि च ।स्थिराणि न पराणुदे ॥
verses.transliteration: índreṇa ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ dṛḷhā́ni ǀ dṛṃhitā́ni ǀ ca ǀsthirā́ṇi ǀ ná ǀ parā-núde ǁ
verses.english_translation: By Indrathe constellations were made stable and firm and stationary, so that they could not be movedby any.
verses.wilson_translation: By Indrathe constellations were made stable and firm and stationary, so that they could not be movedby any.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इंद्राजिरायते ।वि ते मदा अराजिषुः ॥
verses.transliteration: apā́m ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ mádan-iva ǀ stómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ ajira-yate ǀví ǀ te ǀ mádāḥ ǀ arājiṣuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your praise,Indra, mounts aloft like the exulting wave of the waters, your exhilarations have beenmanifested.
verses.wilson_translation: Your praise,Indra, mounts aloft like the exulting wave of the waters, your exhilarations have beenmanifested.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इंद्रास्युक्थवर्धनः ।स्तोतॄणामुत भद्रकृत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ stoma-várdhanaḥ ǀ índra ǀ ási ǀ uktha-várdhanaḥ ǀstotṝṇā́m ǀ utá ǀ bhadra-kṛ́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, are to be magnified by praise, you are to be magnified by prayer; you are the benefactor ofthose who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, are to be magnified by praise, you are to be magnified by prayer; you are the benefactor ofthose who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रमित्केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ।उप यज्ञं सुराधसं ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ ít ǀ keśínā ǀ hárī íti ǀ soma-péyāya ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀúpa ǀ yajñám ǀ su-rā́dhasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the long-maned horses bring the wealth-bestowing Indrato the sacrifice to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the long-maned horses bring the wealth-bestowing Indrato the sacrifice to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इंद्रोदवर्तयः ।विश्वा यदजयः स्पृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: apā́m ǀ phénena ǀ námuceḥ ǀ śíraḥ ǀ indra ǀ út ǀ avartayaḥ ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ yát ǀ ájayaḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have struck off,Indra, the head of Namuciwith the foam of the waters, when you had subdued allyour enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: You have struck off,Indra, the head of Namuciwith the foam of the waters, when you had subdued allyour enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मायाभिरुत्सिसृप्सत इंद्र द्यामारुरुक्षतः ।अव दस्यूँरधूनुथाः ॥
verses.transliteration: māyā́bhiḥ ǀ ut-sísṛpsataḥ ǀ índra ǀ dyā́m ǀ ā-rúrukṣataḥ ǀáva ǀ dásyūn ǀ adhūnuthāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have hurled down,Indra, the Dasyus, gliding upwards by their devices and ascending to heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: You have hurled down,Indra, the Dasyus, gliding upwards by their devices and ascending to heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असुन्वामिंद्र संसदं विषूचीं व्यनाशयः ।सोमपा उत्तरो भवन् ॥
verses.transliteration: asunvā́m ǀ indra ǀ sam-sádam ǀ víṣūcīm ǀ ví ǀ anāśayaḥ ǀsoma-pā́ḥ ǀ út-taraḥ ǀ bhávan ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, the most excellent drinker of the Soma, destroy the adverse assembly that offers nolibations.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, the most excellent drinker of the Soma, destroy the adverse assembly that offers nolibations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud.Invite the powerful Indra with your songs of praise. Whose lofty might-for doubly strong is he-supports the heavens and earth,And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power. Such, Praised by many! thou art King alone thou smitest Vṛtras dead,To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown. We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray,Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold. Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Āyu and for Manu's sake:Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth. This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine:Win thou the waters day by day, thralls of the strong. That lofty Indra-power of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence,Thy thunderbolt for which we long, the wish makes keen. O Indra, Heaven and Earth augment thy manly power and thy renown;The waters and thy mountains stir and urge thee on. Viṣṇu the lofty ruling Power, Varuṇa, Mitra sing thy praise:In thee the Marut' company have great delight. O Indra, thou wast born the Lord of men, most liberal of thy gifts:Excellent deeds for evermore are all thine own. Ever, alone, O highly-praised, thou sendest Vṛtras to their rest:None else than Indra executes the mighty deed. Though here and there, in varied hymns, Indra, men call on thee for aid,Still with our heroes fight and win the light of heaven. Already have all forms of him entered our spacious dwelling-place:For victory stir thou Indra, up, the Lord of Might.

verses.sanskrit: तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं ।इंद्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ puru-stutám ǀíndram ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ taviṣám ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorify him the invoked of many, the praised of many; adore the powerful Indrawith hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorify him the invoked of many, the praised of many; adore the powerful Indrawith hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत्सहो दाधार रोदसी ।गिरीँरज्राँ अपः स्वर्वृषत्वना ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ dvi-bárhasaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ dādhā́ra ǀ ródasī íti ǀgirī́n ǀ ájrān ǀ apáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ vṛṣa-tvanā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vast strength of whom, powerful in both (regions), has sustained the heaven and earth, and by itsvigour (upheld) the swift clouds and flowing waters.
verses.wilson_translation: The vast strength of whom, powerful in both (regions), has sustained the heaven and earth, and by itsvigour (upheld) the swift clouds and flowing waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स राजसि पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे ।इंद्र जैत्रा श्रवस्या च यंतवे ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ rājasi ǀ puru-stuta ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnase ǀíndra ǀ jáitrā ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ ca ǀ yántave ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, the praised of many, reign; you, single, have slain many enemies, in order to acquire the spoils ofvictory and abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: You, the praised of many, reign; you, single, have slain many enemies, in order to acquire the spoils ofvictory and abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृत्सु सासहिं ।उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ te ǀ mádam ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ sasahím ǀūṃ íti ǀ loka-kṛtnúm ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ hari-śríyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We celebrate, thunderer, your exhilaration, the showerer (of benefits), the overcomer (of foes) in battle,the maker of the world, the glorious with your steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: We celebrate, thunderer, your exhilaration, the showerer (of benefits), the overcomer (of foes) in battle,the maker of the world, the glorious with your steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ ।मंदानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ āyáve ǀ mánave ǀ ca ǀ vivéditha ǀmandānáḥ ǀ asyá ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whereby you have made the plural nets manifest to Ayu and to Manu, and rule rejoicing over this sacredrite.
verses.wilson_translation: Whereby you have made the plural nets manifest to Ayu and to Manu, and rule rejoicing over this sacredrite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवंति पूर्वथा ।वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ adyá ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ stuvanti ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀvṛ́ṣa-patnīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ jaya ǀ divé-dive ǁ
verses.english_translation: The reciters of prayer celebrate that your (exhilaration) now as of old; do you daily hold in subjectionthe waters, the wives of the showerer.
verses.wilson_translation: The reciters of prayer celebrate that your (exhilaration) now as of old; do you daily hold in subjectionthe waters, the wives of the showerer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव त्यदिंद्रियं बृहत्तव शुष्ममुत क्रतुं ।वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ tyát ǀ indriyám ǀ bṛhát ǀ táva ǀ śúṣmam ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀvájram ǀ śiśāti ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ váreṇyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise sharpens your great energy, your strength, your acts, and your majestic thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise sharpens your great energy, your strength, your acts, and your majestic thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव द्यौरिंद्र पौंस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः ।त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ vardhati ǀ śrávaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ hinvire ǁ
verses.english_translation: The heaven invigorates your manhood,Indra, the earth (spreads) your renown; the waters, themountains propitiate you.
verses.wilson_translation: The heaven invigorates your manhood,Indra, the earth (spreads) your renown; the waters, themountains propitiate you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः ।त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ bṛhán ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ gṛṇāti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ madati ǀ ánu ǀ mā́rutam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Viṣṇu, the mighty giver of dwellings, praises you, and Mitraand Varuṇa; the company of the Marutsimitates you in exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Viṣṇu, the mighty giver of dwellings, praises you, and Mitraand Varuṇa; the company of the Marutsimitates you in exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वृषा जनानां मंहिष्ठ इंद्र जज्ञिषे ।सत्रा विश्वा स्वपत्यानि दधिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ jánānām ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ indra ǀ jajñiṣe ǀsatrā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ su-apatyā́ni ǀ dadhiṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, who are the showerer, have been born the most bountiful of beings; you associate with youall good offspring.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, who are the showerer, have been born the most bountiful of beings; you associate with youall good offspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्रा त्वं पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि तोशसे ।नान्य इंद्रात्करणं भूय इन्वति ॥
verses.transliteration: satrā́ ǀ tvám ǀ puru-stuta ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ tośase ǀná ǀ anyáḥ ǀ índrāt ǀ káraṇam ǀ bhū́yaḥ ǀ invati ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra), the praised of many, you alone destroy many mighty foes; no other Indra achieves such greatexploits.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra), the praised of many, you alone destroy many mighty foes; no other Indra achieves such greatexploits.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदिंद्र मन्मशस्त्वा नाना हवंत ऊतये ।अस्माकेभिर्नृभिरत्रा स्वर्जय ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ manma-śáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ nā́nā ǀ hávante ǀ ūtáye ǀasmā́kebhiḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ átra ǀ sváḥ ǀ jaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: When (in the combat),Indra, they invoke you in many ways with praise for protection, then do you (soinvoked) by our leaders overcome all (our enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: When (in the combat),Indra, they invoke you in many ways with praise for protection, then do you (soinvoked) by our leaders overcome all (our enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरं क्षयाय नो महे विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् ।इंद्रं जैत्राय हर्षया शचीपतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: áram ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ naḥ ǀ mahé ǀ víśvā ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ ā-viśán ǀíndram ǀ jáitrāya ǀ harṣaya ǀ śacī́-pátim ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the forms (of Indra) have sufficiently entered into our own spacious abode; gratify Indra the lord ofŚacī, (that he may give us) the spoil of victory.
verses.wilson_translation: All the forms (of Indra) have sufficiently entered into our own spacious abode; gratify Indra the lord ofŚacī, (that he may give us) the spoil of victory.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVI. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . PRAISE Indra whom our songs must laud, sole Sovran of mankind, the ChiefMost liberal who controlleth men. In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs.Like the floods' longing for the sea. Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight,Strong for the gain of mighty spoil. Whose perfect ecstasies are wide, profound, victorious, and givejoy in the field where heroes win. Him, when the spoils of war are staked, men call to be their advocate:They who have Indra win the day. Men honour him with stirring songs and magnify with solemn rites:Indra is he who giveth case. Indra is priest and Ṛṣi, he is much invoked by many men,And mighty by his mighty powers. Meet to be lauded and invoked, true Hero with his deeds of might,Victorious even when alone. The men, the people magnify that Indra with their Slina. songs,With hymns and sacred eulogies Him who advances them to wealth, sends light to lead them in the war,And quells their foemen in the fray. May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a shipSafely beyond all enemies. As such, O Indra, honour us with gifts of booty, further us,And lead us to felicity.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिंद्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः ।नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sam-rā́jam ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ índram ǀ stota ǀ návyam ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀnáram ǀ nṛ-sáham ǀ máṃhiṣṭham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorify with hymns the adorable Indra, the supreme king of men, the leader (of rites), the overcomer ofenemies, the most munificent.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorify with hymns the adorable Indra, the supreme king of men, the leader (of rites), the overcomer ofenemies, the most munificent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यंति विश्वानि च श्रवस्या ।अपामवो न समुद्रे ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmin ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ ráṇyanti ǀ víśvāni ǀ ca ǀ śravasyā́ ǀapā́m ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ samudré ǁ
verses.english_translation: In whom all praises, all kinds of sustenance concentrate, like the aggregation of the waters in theocean.
verses.wilson_translation: In whom all praises, all kinds of sustenance concentrate, like the aggregation of the waters in theocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे ज्येष्ठराजं भरे कृत्नुं ।महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ su-stutyā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǀ jyeṣṭha-rā́jam ǀ bháre ǀ kṛtnúm ǀmaháḥ ǀ vājínam ǀ saní-bhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I worship Indrawith pious praises, glorious among the best (of beings), the achiever of great deeds inwar mighty for the acquisition (of wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: I worship Indrawith pious praises, glorious among the best (of beings), the achiever of great deeds inwar mighty for the acquisition (of wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्यानूना गभीरा मदा उरवस्तरुत्राः ।हर्षुमंतः शूरसातौ ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ ánūnāḥ ǀ gabhīrā́ḥ ǀ mádāḥ ǀ urávaḥ ǀ tárutrāḥ ǀharṣu-mántaḥ ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose unbounded and profound exhilarations are many, protective, and animating in waṛ
verses.wilson_translation: Whose unbounded and profound exhilarations are many, protective, and animating in waṛ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमिद्धनेषु हितेष्वधिवाकाय हवंते ।येषामिंद्रस्ते जयंति ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ dháneṣu ǀ hitéṣu ǀ adhi-vākā́ya ǀ havante ǀyéṣām ǀ índraḥ ǀ té ǀ jayanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: (His worshippers) invoke him to take part (in spoiling) the trasures deposited (with the foe); theyconquer, of whom Indrais (the partisan).
verses.wilson_translation: (His worshippers) invoke him to take part (in spoiling) the trasures deposited (with the foe); theyconquer, of whom Indrais (the partisan).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमिच्च्यौत्नैरार्यंति तं कृतेभिश्चर्षणयः ।एष इंद्रो वरिवस्कृत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ cyautnáiḥ ǀ ā́ryanti ǀ tám ǀ kṛtébhiḥ ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀeṣáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ varivaḥ-kṛ́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: They honour him with animating (hymns), men (honour) him with sacred rites, for Indrais the giver ofwealth.
verses.wilson_translation: They honour him with animating (hymns), men (honour) him with sacred rites, for Indrais the giver ofwealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो ब्रह्मेंद्र ऋषिरिंद्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः ।महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ brahmā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ purú ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ mahī́bhiḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indrais Brahmā, Indra is the ṛṣi; Indra is the much-invoked of many, mighty with mighty deeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrais Brahmā, Indra is the ṛṣi; Indra is the much-invoked of many, mighty with mighty deeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स स्तोम्यः स हव्यः सत्यः सत्वा तुविकूर्मिः ।एकश्चित्सन्नभिभूतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ stómyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ satyáḥ ǀ sátvā ǀ tuvi-kūrmíḥ ǀékaḥ ǀ cit ǀ sán ǀ abhí-bhūtiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He is to be praised, he is to be invoked, he is true, powerful the doer of many deeds; he, being single,is the overcomer (of his foes).
verses.wilson_translation: He is to be praised, he is to be invoked, he is true, powerful the doer of many deeds; he, being single,is the overcomer (of his foes).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमर्केभिस्तं सामभिस्तं गायत्रैश्चर्षणयः ।इंद्रं वर्धंति क्षितयः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ arkébhiḥ ǀ tám ǀ sā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ tám ǀ gāyatráiḥ ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀíndram ǀ vardhanti ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Men who are cognizant (of sacred texts) magnify Indrawith pious precepts, with sacred songs, and withprayers.
verses.wilson_translation: Men who are cognizant (of sacred texts) magnify Indrawith pious precepts, with sacred songs, and withprayers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा कर्तारं ज्योतिः समत्सु ।सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान् ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-netā́ram ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ kártāram ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ samát-su ǀsasahvā́ṃsam ǀ yudhā́ ǀ amítrān ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him (they magnify) who brings before them the spoil, who gives lustre in combats, who overcomesenemies in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Him (they magnify) who brings before them the spoil, who gives lustre in combats, who overcomesenemies in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पप्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः ।इंद्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pápriḥ ǀ pārayāti ǀ svastí ǀ nāvā́ ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra, the fulfiller (of desires), the invoked of many, bear us beyond (the reach of) all our enemies,to welfare, as if by a ship (across the sea).
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, the fulfiller (of desires), the invoked of many, bear us beyond (the reach of) all our enemies,to welfare, as if by a ship (across the sea).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं न इंद्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च ।अच्छा च नः सुम्नं नेषि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ daśasyá ǀ ca ǀ gātu-yá ǀ ca ǀáccha ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ neṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Indra, (endow) us with vigour, bestow upon us (wealth, enable us) to go (by the right way), leadus to felicity.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Indra, (endow) us with vigour, bestow upon us (wealth, enable us) to go (by the right way), leadus to felicity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVII Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १५ इरिम्बिष्ठिः काण्व: ।इन्द्र: ; १४ वास्तोष्पतिर्वा । गायत्री , प्रगाथ:= (१४ बृहती , १५  सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . COME, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma hereSit thou on this my sacred grass. O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherwardGive car and listen to our prayers. We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend,We, Indra, bringing Soma juice. Come unto us who bring the juice, come unto this our eulogy,Fair-visored! drink thou of the juice. I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it spread:Take with. thy tongue the pleasant drink. Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice:Sweet be the Soma to thine heart. Like women, let this Soma-draught, invested with its robe, approach,O active Indra, close to thee. Indra, transported with the juice, vast in his bulk, strong in his neckAnd stout arms, smites the Vṛtras down. O Indra, go thou forward, thou who rulest over all by might:Thou Vṛtra-slayer slay the fiends, Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest ample wealth to himWho sheds the juice and worships thee. Here, Indra, is thy Soma-draught, made pure upon the sacred grass:Run hither, come and drink thereof. Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well this juice is shed for thy delightThou art invoked, Akhandala! To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Srngavrs! to thee,To him have I addressed my thought. Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home armour of Soma-offerers:The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Ṛṣis’ Friend. Holy Prdikusanu, winner of the spoil, one eminent o’er many men,Lead on the wild horse Indra with his vigorous grasp forward to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sanskrit: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इंद्र सोमं पिबा इमं ।एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ susumá ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ índra ǀ sómam ǀ píba ǀ imám ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǀ máma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, we express,Indra, for you, the Soma; drink it; sit down upon this my sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, we express,Indra, for you, the Soma; drink it; sit down upon this my sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिंद्र केशिना ।उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ brahma-yújā ǀ hárī íti ǀ váhatām ǀ indra ǀ keśínā ǀúpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let your long-maned horses,Indra, that are yoked by prayers, bring you here, anddo you hear ourprayers.
verses.wilson_translation: Let your long-maned horses,Indra, that are yoked by prayers, bring you here, anddo you hear ourprayers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिंद्र सोमिनः ।सुतावंतो हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmā́ṇaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ yujā́ ǀ soma-pā́m ǀ indra ǀ somínaḥ ǀsutá-vantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Webrāhmaṇas, offerers of Soma, bearing the effused Soma, invoke with suitable (prayers), you thedrinker of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Webrāhmaṇas, offerers of Soma, bearing the effused Soma, invoke with suitable (prayers), you thedrinker of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो याहि सुतावतोऽस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप ।पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नंधसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ su-stutī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀpíba ǀ sú ǀ śiprin ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us offering the libation, accept our earnest praises; drink, handsome-jawed, of the (sacrificial)beverage.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us offering the libation, accept our earnest praises; drink, handsome-jawed, of the (sacrificial)beverage.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते सिंचामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु ।गृभाय जिह्वया मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ siñcāmi ǀ kukṣyóḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gā́trā ǀ ví ǀ dhāvatu ǀgṛbhāyá ǀ jihváyā ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: I fill your belly (with the libation); let is spread throughout the limbs; take the honied Somawith yourtongue.
verses.wilson_translation: I fill your belly (with the libation); let is spread throughout the limbs; take the honied Somawith yourtongue.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वादुष्टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमांतन्वे तव ।सोमः शमस्तु ते हृदे ॥
verses.transliteration: svādúḥ ǀ te ǀ astu ǀ sam-súde ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ tanvé ǀ táva ǀsómaḥ ǀ śám ǀ astu ǀ te ǀ hṛdé ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the sweet-flavoured Somabe grateful to you, who are munificent; (may it be grateful) to your bodymay it be exhilarating to your heart.
verses.wilson_translation: May the sweet-flavoured Somabe grateful to you, who are munificent; (may it be grateful) to your bodymay it be exhilarating to your heart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयमु त्वा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संवृतः ।प्र सोम इंद्र सर्पतु ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀ jánīḥ-iva ǀ abhí ǀ sám-vṛtaḥ ǀprá ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sarpatu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this Soma, invested (with milk), approach you, observant Indra, like a bride (clad in white apparel).
verses.wilson_translation: May this Soma, invested (with milk), approach you, observant Indra, like a bride (clad in white apparel).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरंधसो मदे ।इंद्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
verses.transliteration: tuvi-grī́vaḥ ǀ vapā́-udaraḥ ǀ su-bāhúḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ máde ǀíndraḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Long-necked, large-bellied, strong-armed Indra, in the exhilaration of the (sacrificial) food, destroys hisenemies.
verses.wilson_translation: Long-necked, large-bellied, strong-armed Indra, in the exhilaration of the (sacrificial) food, destroys hisenemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र प्रेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा ।वृत्राणि वृत्रहंजहि ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ prá ǀ ihi ǀ puráḥ ǀ tvám ǀ víśvasya ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀvṛtrā́ṇi ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ jahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who by your strength are the lord over all, come to us, slayer of Vṛtra, subdue our foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who by your strength are the lord over all, come to us, slayer of Vṛtra, subdue our foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वंकुशो येना वसु प्रयच्छसि ।यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: dīrgháḥ ǀ te ǀ astu ǀ aṅkuśáḥ ǀ yéna ǀ vásu ǀ pra-yácchasi ǀyájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǁ
verses.english_translation: Long be your goad, wherewith you bestow wealth upon the sacrificer offering libations.
verses.wilson_translation: Long be your goad, wherewith you bestow wealth upon the sacrificer offering libations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं त इंद्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि ।एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ní-pūtaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀā́ ǀ ihi ǀ īm ǀ asyá ǀ dráva ǀ píba ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Soma, purified (by filtering) through the sacred grass is for you,Indra, come to it, hasten, drink.
verses.wilson_translation: This Soma, purified (by filtering) through the sacred grass is for you,Indra, come to it, hasten, drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः ।आखंडल प्र हूयसे ॥
verses.transliteration: śā́cigo íti śā́ci-go ǀ śā́ci-pūjana ǀ ayám ǀ ráṇāya ǀ te ǀ sutáḥ ǀā́khaṇḍala ǀ prá ǀ hūyase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Renowned for radiance, renowned for adoration, this libation is for your gratification; destroyer of foes,you are earnestly invoked.
verses.wilson_translation: Renowned for radiance, renowned for adoration, this libation is for your gratification; destroyer of foes,you are earnestly invoked.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते शृंगवृषो नपात्प्रणपात्कुंडपाय्यः ।न्यस्मिंदध्र आ मनः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ śṛṅga-vṛṣaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ pránapādíti prá-napāt ǀ kuṇḍa-pā́yyaḥ ǀní ǀ asmin ǀ dadhre ǀ ā́ ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra), who was the offspring of Śṛṅgavṛṣa, of whom the kuṇḍapāyya rite was the protector, (thesages) have fixed (of old) their minds upon this ceremony.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra), who was the offspring of Śṛṅgavṛṣa, of whom the kuṇḍapāyya rite was the protector, (thesages) have fixed (of old) their minds upon this ceremony.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणांसत्रं सोम्यानां ।द्रप्सो भेत्ता पुरां शश्वतीनामिंद्रो मुनीनां सखा ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́stoḥ ǀ pate ǀ dhruvā́ ǀ sthū́ṇā ǀ áṃsatram ǀ somyā́nām ǀdrapsáḥ ǀ bhettā́ ǀ purā́m ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ índraḥ ǀ múnīnām ǀ sákhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of dwellings, may the (roof) pillar be strong; may there be vigour of body for the offerers of libation;may Indra, the drinker (of the Soma), the destroyer of the numerous cities (of theasuras), ever be the friend ofthe Munis.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of dwellings, may the (roof) pillar be strong; may there be vigour of body for the offerers of libation;may Indra, the drinker (of the Soma), the destroyer of the numerous cities (of theasuras), ever be the friend ofthe Munis.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पृदाकुसानुर्यजतो गवेषण एकः सन्नभि भूयसः ।भूर्णिमश्वं नयत्तुजा पुरो गृभेंद्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛ́dāku-sānuḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ go-éṣaṇaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ sán ǀ abhí ǀ bhū́yasaḥ ǀbhū́rṇim ǀ áśvam ǀ nayat ǀ tujā́ ǀ puráḥ ǀ gṛbhā́ ǀ índram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: With head uplifted like a serpent, adorable, the recoverer of the cattle,Indrasingle, is superior tomultitudes; (the worshipper) brings Indra to drink the Somaby a rapid seizure, like a loaded horse (by a halter).
verses.wilson_translation: With head uplifted like a serpent, adorable, the recoverer of the cattle,Indrasingle, is superior tomultitudes; (the worshipper) brings Indra to drink the Somaby a rapid seizure, like a loaded horse (by a halter).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVIII. Ādityas.
hymns.anukramani: २२ इरिम्बिष्ठिः काण्व: ।आदित्या: ;४,६,७, अदिति:; ८ अश्विनौ; ९ अग्निसूर्यानिला : । उष्णिक् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Now let the mortal offer prayer to win the unexampled graceOf these Ādityas and their aid to cherish life. For not an enemy molests the paths which these Ādityas tread:Infallible guards, they strengthen us in happiness. Now soon may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuṇa, Mitra, AryamanGive us the shelter widely spread which we implore. With Gods come thou whose fostering care none checks, O Goddesss Aditi:Come, dear to many, with the Lords who guard us well. For well these Sons of Aditi know to keep enmities aloof,Unrivalled, giving ample room, they save from woe. Aditi guard our herd by day, Aditi, free from guile, by night,Aditi, ever strengthening, save us from grief! And in the day our hymn is this: May Aditi come nigh to help,With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes. And may the Aśvins, the divine Pair of Physicians, send us health:May they remove iniquity and chase our foes. May Agni bless us with his fires, and Sūrya warm us pleasantly:May the pure Wind breathe sweet on us, and chase our foes. Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity:Ādityas, keep us ever far from sore distress. Remove from us the arrow, keep famine, Ādityas! far away:Keep enmities afar from us, Lords of all wealth! Now, O Ādityas, grant to us the shelter that lets man go free,Yea, even the sinner from his sin, ye Bounteous Gods  Whatever mortal with the powe r of demons fain would injure us,May he, impetuous, suffer harm by his own deeds. May sin o’ertake our human foe, the man who speaketh evil thing,Him who would cause our misery, whose heart is false. Gods, ye are with the simple ones, ye know each mortal in your hearts;Ye, Vasus, well discriminate the false and true. Fain would we have the sheltering aid of mountains and of water-floods:Keep far from us iniquity, O Heaven and Earth. So with auspicious sheltering aid do ye, O Vasus, carry usBeyond all trouble and distress, borne in your ship. Ādityas, ye Most Mighty Ones, grant to our children and their seedExtended term of life that they may live long days. Sacrifice, O Ādityas, is your inward monitor: be kind,For in the bond of kindred we are bound to you. The Maruts’ high protecting aid, the Aśvins, and the God who saves,Mitra and Varuṇa for weal we supplicate. Grant us a home with triple guard, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa!Unthreatened, Maruts! meet for praise, and filled with men. And as we human beings, O Ādityas, are akin to death,Graciously lengthen ye our lives that we may live.

verses.sanskrit: इदं ह नूनमेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः ।आदित्यानामपूर्व्यं सवीमनि ॥
verses.transliteration: idám ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ eṣām ǀ sumnám ǀ bhikṣeta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀādityā́nām ǀ ápūrvyam ǀ sávīmani ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let a mortal now earnestly solicit at the worship of theseĀdityasunprecedented riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Let a mortal now earnestly solicit at the worship of theseĀdityasunprecedented riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनर्वाणो ह्येषां पंथा आदित्यानां ।अदब्धाः संति पायवः सुगेवृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: anarvā́ṇaḥ ǀ hí ǀ eṣām ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ ādityā́nām ǀádabdhāḥ ǀ sánti ǀ pāyávaḥ ǀ suge-vṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The paths of theseĀdityasare unobstructed and unopposed; may they yield us security and augmentour happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: The paths of theseĀdityasare unobstructed and unopposed; may they yield us security and augmentour happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।शर्म यच्छंतु सप्रथो यदीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀśárma ǀ yacchantu ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ī́mahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Savitā,Bhaga,Varuṇa,Mitra, and Aryamanbestow upon us that ample felicity which we solicit.
verses.wilson_translation: May Savitā,Bhaga,Varuṇa,Mitra, and Aryamanbestow upon us that ample felicity which we solicit.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवेभिर्देव्यदितेऽरिष्टभर्मन्ना गहि ।स्मत्सूरिभिः पुरुप्रिये सुशर्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: devébhiḥ ǀ devi ǀ adite ǀ áriṣṭa-bharman ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀsmát ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ puru-priye ǀ suśárma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Aditi, bringer of safety, beloved of many, com propitiously with the wise and happy divinitieṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Aditi, bringer of safety, beloved of many, com propitiously with the wise and happy divinitieṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेर्विदुर्द्वेषांसि योतवे ।अंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयोऽनेहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ putrā́saḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ vidúḥ ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ yótave ǀaṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ uru-cákrayaḥ ǀ anehásaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These sons of Aditiknow how to drive away (our) enmies; and, doers of great deeds and donors ofsecurity, (they know how to extricate us) from sin.
verses.wilson_translation: These sons of Aditiknow how to drive away (our) enmies; and, doers of great deeds and donors ofsecurity, (they know how to extricate us) from sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्नो दिवा पशुमदितिर्नक्तमद्वयाः ।अदितिः पात्वंहसः सदावृधा ॥
verses.transliteration: áditiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dívā ǀ paśúm ǀ áditiḥ ǀ náktam ǀ ádvayāḥ ǀáditiḥ ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ sadā́-vṛdhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Aditiprotect our cattle by day, ad, free from duplicity (guard them) by night; may Aditi, by herconstant favour, preserve us from sin.
verses.wilson_translation: May Aditiprotect our cattle by day, ad, free from duplicity (guard them) by night; may Aditi, by herconstant favour, preserve us from sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्या गमत् ।सा शंताति मयस्करदप स्रिधः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ syā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ dívā ǀ matíḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ūtyā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀsā́ ǀ śám-tāti ǀ máyaḥ ǀ karat ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the monitress Aditicome to us, for our prosecution by day; may she grant us tranquil felicity, andlive away, (our) enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: May the monitress Aditicome to us, for our prosecution by day; may she grant us tranquil felicity, andlive away, (our) enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्या दैव्या भिषजा शं नः करतो अश्विना ।युयुयातामितो रपो अप स्रिधः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ dáivyā ǀ bhiṣájā ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ karataḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀyuyuyā́tām ǀ itáḥ ǀ rápaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the two divine physicians, the Aśvins, grant us health; may they drive away from hence iniquity;(may they drive) away our foes.
verses.wilson_translation: May the two divine physicians, the Aśvins, grant us health; may they drive away from hence iniquity;(may they drive) away our foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शमग्निरग्निभिः करच्छं नस्तपतु सूर्यः ।शं वातो वात्वरपा अप स्रिधः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ agníḥ ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ karat ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ tapatu ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀśám ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ vātu ǀ arapā́ḥ ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the two divine physicians, the Aśvins, grant us health; may they drive away from hence iniquity;(may they drive) away our foes.
verses.wilson_translation: May the two divine physicians, the Aśvins, grant us health; may they drive away from hence iniquity;(may they drive) away our foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपामीवामप स्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिं ।आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ ámīvām ǀ ápa ǀ srídham ǀ ápa ǀ sedhata ǀ duḥ-matím ǀā́dityāsaḥ ǀ yuyótana ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ādityas, remove (from us) disease, enemies, malignity; keep us afar from sin.
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityas, remove (from us) disease, enemies, malignity; keep us afar from sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युयोता शरुमस्मदाँ आदित्यास उतामतिं ।ऋधग्द्वेषः कृणुत विश्ववेदसः ॥
verses.transliteration: yuyóta ǀ śárum ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ utá ǀ ámatim ǀṛ́dhak ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ kṛṇuta ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Keep afar from us,Ādityas, malignity, ill-will; do you who are all- wise keep afar those who hate us.
verses.wilson_translation: Keep afar from us,Ādityas, malignity, ill-will; do you who are all- wise keep afar those who hate us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्सु नः शर्म यच्छतादित्या यन्मुमोचति ।एनस्वंतं चिदेनसः सुदानवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ yát ǀ múmocati ǀénasvantam ǀ cit ǀ énasaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant freely to us, genitive rousĀdityas, that happiness which liberates even the offending (worshipper)from sin.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant freely to us, genitive rousĀdityas, that happiness which liberates even the offending (worshipper)from sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो नः कश्चिद्रिरिक्षति रक्षस्त्वेन मर्त्यः ।स्वैः ष एवै रिरिषीष्ट युर्जनः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ cit ǀ rírikṣati ǀ rakṣaḥ-tvéna ǀ mártyaḥ ǀsváiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ ririṣīṣṭa ǀ yúḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that man who, from his diabolical nature seeks to do us evil-- may he, injuring himself by his owndevices, incu that evil.
verses.wilson_translation: May that man who, from his diabolical nature seeks to do us evil-- may he, injuring himself by his owndevices, incu that evil.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समित्तमघमश्नवद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं रिपुं ।यो अस्मत्रा दुर्हणावाँ उप द्वयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ít ǀ tám ǀ aghám ǀ aśnavat ǀ duḥ-śáṃsam ǀ mártyam ǀ ripúm ǀyáḥ ǀ asma-trā́ ǀ duḥ-hánāvān ǀ úpa ǀ dvayúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May iniquity pervade hat calumniating and hostile mortal who wishes to do us harm, and is treacheroustowards us.
verses.wilson_translation: May iniquity pervade hat calumniating and hostile mortal who wishes to do us harm, and is treacheroustowards us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पाकत्रा स्थन देवा हृत्सु जानीथ मर्त्यं ।उप द्वयुं चाद्वयुं च वसवः ॥
verses.transliteration: pāka-trā́ ǀ sthana ǀ devāḥ ǀ hṛt-sú ǀ jānītha ǀ mártyam ǀúpa ǀ dvayúm ǀ ca ǀ ádvayum ǀ ca ǀ vasavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deities, you are (propitious) to sincere (worshippers), you know,Vasus, the hearts of men, anddistinguish between the single and double-minded.
verses.wilson_translation: Deities, you are (propitious) to sincere (worshippers), you know,Vasus, the hearts of men, anddistinguish between the single and double-minded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ शर्म पर्वतानामोतापां वृणीमहे ।द्यावाक्षामारे अस्मद्रपस्कृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śárma ǀ párvatānām ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ apā́m ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀdyā́vākṣāmā ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ rápaḥ ǀ kṛtam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit the happiness of the mountains and of the waters; heaven and earth, remove sin far from us.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit the happiness of the mountains and of the waters; heaven and earth, remove sin far from us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो भद्रेण शर्मणा युष्माकं नावा वसवः ।अति विश्वानि दुरिता पिपर्तन ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ bhadréṇa ǀ śármaṇā ǀ yuṣmā́kam ǀ nāvā́ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀáti ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ pipartana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Convey us,Vasus, in your vessel, with auspicious felicity, beyond all calamities.
