verses.wilson_translation: Convey us,Vasus, in your vessel, with auspicious felicity, beyond all calamities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुचे तनाय तत्सु नो द्राघीय आयुर्जीवसे ।आदित्यासः सुमहसः कृणोतन ॥
verses.transliteration: tucé ǀ tánāya ǀ tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ drā́ghīyaḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jīváse ǀā́dityāsaḥ ǀ su-mahasaḥ ǀ kṛṇótana ǁ
verses.english_translation: RadiantĀdityasgrant to our sons and grandsons to enjoy long life.
verses.wilson_translation: RadiantĀdityasgrant to our sons and grandsons to enjoy long life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञो हीळो वो अंतर आदित्या अस्ति मृळत ।युष्मे इद्वो अपि ष्मसि सजात्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñáḥ ǀ hīḷáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ ásti ǀ mṛḷáta ǀyuṣmé íti ǀ ít ǀ vaḥ ǀ ápi ǀ smasi ǀ sa-jātyé ǁ
verses.english_translation: The duly-presented sacrifice is ready for you,Ādityas; grant us, therefore, happiness; may we everabide in near relationship with you.
verses.wilson_translation: The duly-presented sacrifice is ready for you,Ādityas; grant us, therefore, happiness; may we everabide in near relationship with you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्वरूथं मरुतां देवं त्रातारमश्विना ।मित्रमीमहे वरुणं स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ várūtham ǀ marútām ǀ devám ǀ trātā́ram ǀ aśvínā ǀmitrám ǀ īmahe ǀ váruṇam ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit of the divine protector of he Maruts, of the Aśvisn, of Mitraand of Varuṇa, a spaciousdwelling for our welfare.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit of the divine protector of he Maruts, of the Aśvisn, of Mitraand of Varuṇa, a spaciousdwelling for our welfare.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनेहो मित्रार्यमन्नृवद्वरुण शंस्यं ।त्रिवरूथं मरुतो यंत नश्छर्दिः ॥
verses.transliteration: aneháḥ ǀ mitra ǀ aryaman ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ varuṇa ǀ śáṃsyam ǀtri-várūtham ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yanta ǀ naḥ ǀ chardíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇaand Maruts, grant us a secure, excellent and well-peopled dwelling, athree-fold shelter.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇaand Maruts, grant us a secure, excellent and well-peopled dwelling, athree-fold shelter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये चिद्धि मृत्युबंधव आदित्या मनवः स्मसि ।प्र सू न आयुर्जीवसे तिरेतन ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ mṛtyú-bandhavaḥ ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ mánavaḥ ǀ smási ǀprá ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ tiretana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since,Ādityas, we mortals are of kin to death, do you benevolently (exert yourselves to) prolong ourlives.
verses.wilson_translation: Since,Ādityas, we mortals are of kin to death, do you benevolently (exert yourselves to) prolong ourlives.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIX. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ३७ सोभरि: काण्व:।अग्नि :,३४-३५ आदित्या:; ३६-३७  त्रसदस्यु: पौरुकुत्स्य:। १-२६ प्रगाथ:= ( विषमा ककुप् , समा सतोबृहती ) , २७ द्विपदा विराट् , २८-३३ प्रगाथ: = ( समा ककुप् , विषमा सतोबृहती ), ३४ उष्णिक्,३५ सतोबृहती , ३६ ककुप् ; ३७ पंक्ति : ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING praise to hiin, the Lord of Light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger,And sent oblation to Gods. Agni, the Bounteous Giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari-Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice. Thee have we chosen skilftillest in sacrifice, Immortal Priest among the Gods,Wise finisher of this holy rite: The Son of Strength, the blessed, brightly shining One, Agni whose light is excellent.May be by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuṇa, and the Floods. The mortal who hath ministered to Agni with oblation, fuel, ritual lore,And reverence, skilled in sacrifice. Verily swift to run are his fleet-footed steeds, and most resplendent fame is his.No trouble caused by Gods or wrought by mortal man from any side o’ertaketh him. May we by thine own fires be well supplied with fire, O Son of Strength, O Lord of Might:Thou as our Friend hast worthy men. Agni, who praises like a guest of friendly mind, is as a car that brings us gear.Also in thee is found perfect security thou art the Sovran Lord of wealth. That man, moreover, merits praise who brings, auspicious Agni, sacrificial giftsMay he win riches by his thoughts. He for whose sacrifice thou standest up erect is prosperous and rules o’er men.He wins with coursers and with singers killed in song: with heroes he obtains the prize. He in whose dwelling Agni is chief ornament, and, all-desired, loves his laud well,And zealously tends his offerings- His, or the lauding sage's word, his, Son of Strength! who Is most prompt with sacred gifts,Set thou beneath the Gods, Vasu, above mankind, the speech of the intelligent. He who with sacrificial gifts or homage bringeth very skilful Agni nigh,Or him who flashes fast with song, The mortal who with blazing fuel, as his laws command, adores the Perfect God,Blest with his thoughts in splendour shall exceed all men, as though he overpassed the floods. Give us the splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode,The wrath of evil-hearted folk. That, wherewith Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, the Aśvins, Bhaga give us light,That may we, by thy power finding best furtherance, worship, O Indra, helped by thee. O Agni, most devout are they, the sages who have set thee Sage exceeding wise,O God, for men to look upon: Who have arranged thine altar Blessed God, at morn brought thine oblation, pressed the juice.They by their deeds of strength have won diem, mighty wealth, who have set all their hope in thee. -May Agni worshipped bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One, and sacrifice bring bliss;Yea, may our praises bring us bliss. Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight.Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid. I praise with song the Friend of man, whom Gods sent down to be herald and messenger,Best worshipper, bearer of our gifts. Thou unto sharp-toothed Agni, Young and Radiant God, proclaimest with thy song the feast-Agni, who for our sweet strains moulds heroic strength when sacred oil is offered him, While, served with sacrificial oil, now upward and now downward Agni moves his sword,As doth the Asura his robe. The God, the Friend of man, who bears our gifts to heaven, the God with his sweet-smelling mouth,Distributes, skilled in sacrifice, his precious things, Invoking Priest, Immortal God. Son of Strength, Agni, if thou wert the mortal, bright as Mitra, I worshipped with our gifts!And I were the Immortal God I would not give thee up, Vasu, to calumny, or misery, O Bounteous One.My worshipper should feel no hunger or distress, nor, Agni, should he live in sin. Like a son cherished in his father's houi§e, let our oblation rise unto the Gods. With thine immediate aid may I, excellent Agni, ever gain my wishA mortal with a God to help. O Agni, by thy wisdom, by thy bounties, by thy leading may I gather wealth.Excellent Agni, thou art called my Providence: delight thou to be liberal. Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of noble heroes and great strength,Whose bond of friendship is thy choice. Thy spark is black and crackling, kindled in due time, O Bounteous, it is taken up.Thou art the dear Friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night. We Sobharis have come to him, for succour, who is good to help with thousand powers,The Sovran, Trasadasyu's Friend. O Agni, thou on whom all other fires depend, as branches on the parent stem,I make the treasures of the folk, like songs, mine own, while I exalt thy sovran might. The mortal whom, Ādityas, ye, Guilelew, lead to the farther bankOf all the princes, Bounteous Ones Whoe’er he be, Man-ruling Kings! the Regent of the race of men-May we, O Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, like him be furtherers of your law. A gift of fifty female slaves hath Trasadasyu given me, Purukutsa's son,Most liberal, kind, lord of the brave. And Śyāva too for me led forth a strong steed at Suvastu's ford:A herd of three times seventy kine, good lord of gifts, he gave to me.

verses.sanskrit: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे ।देवत्रा हव्यमोहिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ gūrdhaya ǀ sváḥ-naram ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ devám ǀ aratím ǀ dadhanvire ǀdeva-trā́ ǀ havyám ǀ ā́ ǀ ūhire ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorify (Agni), the leader of all (sacred rites); the priests approach the divine lord, (and through him)convey the oblation to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorify (Agni), the leader of all (sacred rites); the priests approach the divine lord, (and through him)convey the oblation to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीळिष्व यंतुरं ।अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: víbhūta-rātim ǀ vipra ǀ citrá-śociṣam ǀ agním ǀ īḷiṣva ǀ yantúram ǀasyá ǀ médhasya ǀ somyásya ǀ sobhare ǀ prá ǀ īm ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ pū́rvyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise, pious Sobhari, at the sacrifice this ancient Agni, who is the giver of opulence, the wonderfullyluminous, the regulator of this rite, at which the Somais presented.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise, pious Sobhari, at the sacrifice this ancient Agni, who is the giver of opulence, the wonderfullyluminous, the regulator of this rite, at which the Somais presented.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यं ।अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुं ॥
verses.transliteration: yájiṣṭham ǀ tvā ǀ vavṛmahe ǀ devám ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ hótāram ǀ ámartyam ǀasyá ǀ yajñásya ǀ su-krátum ǁ
verses.english_translation: We adore you, the most adorable deity, the invoker of the gods, the immortal, the perfecter of thissacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: We adore you, the most adorable deity, the invoker of the gods, the immortal, the perfecter of thissacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निं श्रेष्ठशोचिषं ।स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ su-bhágam ǀ su-dī́ditim ǀ agním ǀ śréṣṭha-śociṣam ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ sáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ sumnám ǀ yakṣate ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the great grandson of (sacrificial) food, the possessor of opulence, the illuminator, the shedder ofexcellent light; may he obtain for us by sacrifice the happiness in heaven (that is the gift) of Mitra, of Varuṇa, ofthe waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the great grandson of (sacrificial) food, the possessor of opulence, the illuminator, the shedder ofexcellent light; may he obtain for us by sacrifice the happiness in heaven (that is the gift) of Mitra, of Varuṇa, ofthe waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः समिधा य आहुती यो वेदेन ददाश मर्तो अग्नये ।यो नमसा स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́-hutī ǀ yáḥ ǀ védena ǀ dadā́śa ǀ mártaḥ ǀ agnáye ǀyáḥ ǀ námasā ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man who has presented (worship) to Agniwith fuel, with burnt offerings, with the Veda, with(sacrificial) food, and is diligent in pious rites.
verses.wilson_translation: The man who has presented (worship) to Agniwith fuel, with burnt offerings, with the Veda, with(sacrificial) food, and is diligent in pious rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तस्येदर्वंतो रंहयंत आशवस्तस्य द्युम्नितमं यशः ।न तमंहो देवकृतं कुतश्चन न मर्त्यकृतं नशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tásya ǀ ít ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ raṃhayante ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ tásya ǀ dyumní-tamam ǀ yáśaḥ ǀná ǀ tám ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ devá-kṛtam ǀ kútaḥ ǀ caná ǀ ná ǀ mártya-kṛtam ǀ naśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Of him assuredly the rapid horses rush (on the foe); his is most brilliant glory; him no evil, whether thework of gods or of men, ever assails.
verses.wilson_translation: Of him assuredly the rapid horses rush (on the foe); his is most brilliant glory; him no evil, whether thework of gods or of men, ever assails.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वग्नयो वो अग्निभिः स्याम सूनो सहस ऊर्जां पते ।सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-agnáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ ūrjām ǀ pate ǀsu-vī́raḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength, lord of (sacrificial) food, may we be favoured with your various fires; do you, (Agni),endowed with energy, be well-disposed towards us!
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength, lord of (sacrificial) food, may we be favoured with your various fires; do you, (Agni),endowed with energy, be well-disposed towards us!
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रशंसमानो अतिथिर्न मित्रियोऽग्नी रथो न वेद्यः ।त्वे क्षेमासो अपि संति साधवस्त्वं राजा रयीणां ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-śáṃsamānaḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitríyaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ védyaḥ ǀtvé íti ǀ kṣémāsaḥ ǀ ápi ǀ santi ǀ sādhávaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ rā́jā ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, when honoured like a guest, is gracious to his praisers; he is to be recognized as a chariot(bringing the fruit of the worship); in you verily the virtuous are confiding; you are therājāof riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, when honoured like a guest, is gracious to his praisers; he is to be recognized as a chariot(bringing the fruit of the worship); in you verily the virtuous are confiding; you are therājāof riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सो अद्धा दाश्वध्वरोऽग्ने मर्तः सुभग स प्रशंस्यः ।स धीभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ addhā́ ǀ dāśú-adhvaraḥ ǀ ágne ǀ mártaḥ ǀ su-bhaga ǀ sáḥ ǀ pra-śáṃsyaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ astu ǀ sánitā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, may he who is the offerer of sacrifice obtain his reward; he, auspicious Agni, is worthy ofcommendation; may he by his pious rites become the giver of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, may he who is the offerer of sacrifice obtain his reward; he, auspicious Agni, is worthy ofcommendation; may he by his pious rites become the giver of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य त्वमूर्ध्वो अध्वराय तिष्ठसि क्षयद्वीरः स साधते ।सो अर्वद्भिः सनिता स विपन्युभिः स शूरैः सनिता कृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ tvám ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ tíṣṭhasi ǀ kṣayát-vīraḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ sādhate ǀsáḥ ǀ árvat-bhiḥ ǀ sánitā ǀ sáḥ ǀ vipanyú-bhiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ śū́raiḥ ǀ sánitā ǀ kṛtám ǁ
verses.english_translation: He whose sacrifice you preside, prospers, having his dwelling filled withmaleoffspring; he is theeffecter of his purposes through his horses, through his wise (counsellors), his valiant adherents.
verses.wilson_translation: He whose sacrifice you preside, prospers, having his dwelling filled withmaleoffspring; he is theeffecter of his purposes through his horses, through his wise (counsellors), his valiant adherents.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्याग्निर्वपुर्गृहे स्तोमं चनो दधीत विश्ववार्यः ।हव्या वा वेविषद्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ agníḥ ǀ vápuḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀ stómam ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dádhīta ǀ viśvá-vāryaḥ ǀhavyā́ ǀ vā ǀ véviṣat ǀ víṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (So is he) in whose dwelling the all-desired and embodied Agnireceives praise and food, and conveysoblations to the all-pervading deities.
verses.wilson_translation: (So is he) in whose dwelling the all-desired and embodied Agnireceives praise and food, and conveysoblations to the all-pervading deities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विप्रस्य वा स्तुवतः सहसो यहो मक्षूतमस्य रातिषु ।अवोदेवमुपरिमर्त्यं कृधि वसो विविदुषो वचः ॥
verses.transliteration: víprasya ǀ vā ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀ makṣú-tamasya ǀ rātíṣu ǀaváḥ-devam ǀ upári-martyam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ váso íti ǀ vividúṣaḥ ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength, giver of dwellings, plural ce the prayer of he devout intelligent worshipper, who is mostprompt in offerings, below the gods and above mortals.
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength, giver of dwellings, plural ce the prayer of he devout intelligent worshipper, who is mostprompt in offerings, below the gods and above mortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो अग्निं हव्यदातिभिर्नमोभिर्वा सुदक्षमाविवासति ।गिरा वाजिरशोचिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agním ǀ havyádāti-bhiḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ su-dákṣam ǀ ā-vívāsati ǀgirā́ ǀ vā ǀ ajirá-śociṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who propitiated the powerful and quick radiating Agniwith offerings of oblations, with reverentialadorations and with praise, (is prosperous).
verses.wilson_translation: He who propitiated the powerful and quick radiating Agniwith offerings of oblations, with reverentialadorations and with praise, (is prosperous).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समिधा यो निशिती दाशददितिं धामभिरस्य मर्त्यः ।विश्वेत्स धीभिः सुभगो जनाँ अति द्युम्नैरुद्न इव तारिषत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-ídhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ní-śitī ǀ dā́śat ǀ áditim ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ asya ǀ mártyaḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ jánān ǀ áti ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ udnáḥ-iva ǀ tāriṣat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mortal who propitiates Aditiwith his (Agni's) many forms by blazing fuel, prospering through hispious rites, shall surpass all men in renown as (if he had crossed over) the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: The mortal who propitiates Aditiwith his (Agni's) many forms by blazing fuel, prospering through hispious rites, shall surpass all men in renown as (if he had crossed over) the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासहत्सदने कं चिदत्रिणं ।मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ agne ǀ dyumnám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ yát ǀ sasáhat ǀ sádane ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ atríṇam ǀmanyúm ǀ jánasya ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us,Agni, that power which may overcome any cannibal (entering) into our abode, thewrath of any malignant (being).
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us,Agni, that power which may overcome any cannibal (entering) into our abode, thewrath of any malignant (being).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येन चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा येन नासत्या भगः ।वयं तत्ते शवसा गातुवित्तमा इंद्रत्वोता विधेमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ cáṣṭe ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ yéna ǀ nā́satyā ǀ bhágaḥ ǀvayám ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ śávasā ǀ gātuvít-tamāḥ ǀ índratvā-ūtāḥ ǀ vidhemahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protected by Indra, well-knowing the path that through your power, (Agni), we should follow, we adorethat (radiance) of you, by which Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, the Nāsatyās, and Bhagashine.
verses.wilson_translation: Protected by Indra, well-knowing the path that through your power, (Agni), we should follow, we adorethat (radiance) of you, by which Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, the Nāsatyās, and Bhagashine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्यो ये त्वा विप्र निदधिरे नृचक्षसं ।विप्रासो देव सुक्रतुं ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ vipra ǀ ni-dadhiré ǀ nṛ-cákṣasam ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ deva ǀ su-krátum ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those verily,Agni, are of approved piety who as your worshippers, sagacious deity, have establishedyou as the contemplator of men, the perfomer of good works.
verses.wilson_translation: Those verily,Agni, are of approved piety who as your worshippers, sagacious deity, have establishedyou as the contemplator of men, the perfomer of good works.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त इद्वेदिं सुभग त आहुतिं ते सोतुं चक्रिरे दिवि ।त इद्वाजेभिर्जिग्युर्महद्धनं ये त्वे कामं न्येरिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ ít ǀ védim ǀ su-bhaga ǀ té ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ té ǀ sótum ǀ cakrire ǀ diví ǀté ǀ ít ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ jigyuḥ ǀ mahát ǀ dhánam ǀ yé ǀ tvé íti ǀ kā́mam ǀ ni-eriré ǁ
verses.english_translation: Auspicious (Agni), they have set up the altar, have presented oblations, have expressed the libation ona (fortunate) day; they have won by their efforts infinite wealth who have plural ced their affection upon you.
verses.wilson_translation: Auspicious (Agni), they have set up the altar, have presented oblations, have expressed the libation ona (fortunate) day; they have won by their efforts infinite wealth who have plural ced their affection upon you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः ।भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhadráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ rātíḥ ǀ su-bhaga ǀ bhadráḥ ǀ adhvaráḥ ǀbhadrā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agni, to whom burnt-offerings have been made, be propitious to us; auspicious (Agni), may yourgifts be blessings, may the sacrifice (we offer) be beneficial, may our praises yield us happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, to whom burnt-offerings have been made, be propitious to us; auspicious (Agni), may yourgifts be blessings, may the sacrifice (we offer) be beneficial, may our praises yield us happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहः ।अव स्थिरा तनुहि भू���ि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhadrám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀ yéna ǀ samát-su ǀ sasáhaḥ ǀáva ǀ sthirā́ ǀ tanuhi ǀ bhū́ri ǀ śárdhatām ǀ vanéma ǀ te ǀ abhíṣṭi-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give us that resolute mind in conflict by which you conquer in combats; humble the many firm (resolves)of our foes; may we propitiate you by our sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Give us that resolute mind in conflict by which you conquer in combats; humble the many firm (resolves)of our foes; may we propitiate you by our sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईळे गिरा मनुर्हितं यं देवा दूतमरतिं न्येरिरे ।यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहनं ॥
verses.transliteration: ī́ḷe ǀ girā́ ǀ mánuḥ-hitam ǀ yám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ aratím ǀ ni-eriré ǀyájiṣṭham ǀ havya-vā́hanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I worship Agni, who has been established by Manuwith praise, whom the gods have appointed theirroyal messenger, who is the most adorable, the bearer of oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: I worship Agni, who has been established by Manuwith praise, whom the gods have appointed theirroyal messenger, who is the most adorable, the bearer of oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तिग्मजंभाय तरुणाय राजते प्रयो गायस्यग्नये ।यः पिंशते सूनृताभिः सुवीर्यमग्निर्घृतेभिराहुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: tigmá-jambhāya ǀ táruṇāya ǀ rā́jate ǀ práyaḥ ǀ gāyasi ǀ agnáye ǀyáḥ ǀ piṃśáte ǀ sūnṛ́tābhiḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ agníḥ ǀ ghṛtébhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer (sacriicial) food to that bright-shining, every-youthful, royal Agni, who, (when gratified) by sincerepraises, and worshipped with oblations, bestows excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Offer (sacriicial) food to that bright-shining, every-youthful, royal Agni, who, (when gratified) by sincerepraises, and worshipped with oblations, bestows excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदी घृतेभिराहुतो वाशीमग्निर्भरत उच्चाव च ।असुर इव निर्णिजं ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ ghṛtébhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀ vā́śīm ǀ agníḥ ǀ bhárate ǀ út ǀ ca ǀ áva ǀ ca ǀásuraḥ-iva ǀ niḥ-níjam ǁ
verses.english_translation: When Agni, worshipped with oblations, sends his voice upwards and downwards, as the sun disperseshis rays, (we praise him).
verses.wilson_translation: When Agni, worshipped with oblations, sends his voice upwards and downwards, as the sun disperseshis rays, (we praise him).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो हव्यान्यैरयता मनुर्हितो देव आसा सुगंधिना ।विवासते वार्याणि स्वध्वरो होता देवो अमर्त्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ áirayata ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ su-gandhínā ǀvívāsate ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǀ hótā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine (Agni), established by Manu, the offerer of the sacrifice, the invoker (of the gods), the divine,the immortal, who conveys the oblations in his fragrant mouth, bestows (upon his adorers) desirable (riches).
verses.wilson_translation: The divine (Agni), established by Manu, the offerer of the sacrifice, the invoker (of the gods), the divine,the immortal, who conveys the oblations in his fragrant mouth, bestows (upon his adorers) desirable (riches).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदग्ने मर्त्यस्त्वं स्यामहं मित्रमहो अमर्त्यः ।सहसः सूनवाहुत ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ agne ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ syā́m ǀ ahám ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀsáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ ā-huta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, son of strength, shining with friendly radiance, and worshipped with oblations, may I, who,although mortal, am as you are, become immortal.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, son of strength, shining with friendly radiance, and worshipped with oblations, may I, who,although mortal, am as you are, become immortal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा रासीयाभिशस्तये वसो न पापत्वाय संत्य ।न मे स्तोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः स्यादग्ने न पापया ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ rāsīya ǀ abhí-śastaye ǀ vaso íti ǀ ná ǀ pāpa-tvā́ya ǀ santya ǀná ǀ me ǀ stotā́ ǀ amati-vā́ ǀ ná ǀ dúḥ-hitaḥ ǀ syā́t ǀ agne ǀ ná ǀ pāpáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I not be accusative ed,Vasu, of calumniating you, nor, gracious (Agni), of sinfulness (against you); letnot (the priest) the reciter of my praises be dull of intellect or ill-disposed; (may he not err), Agni, throughwickedness.
verses.wilson_translation: May I not be accusative ed,Vasu, of calumniating you, nor, gracious (Agni), of sinfulness (against you); letnot (the priest) the reciter of my praises be dull of intellect or ill-disposed; (may he not err), Agni, throughwickedness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पितुर्न पुत्रः सुभृतो दुरोण आ देवाँ एतु प्र णो हविः ॥
verses.transliteration: pitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ sú-bhṛtaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ ā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ etu ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ havíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Cherished by us as a son by a father, let him (Agni) in our dwelling convey promptly our oblation to thegods.
verses.wilson_translation: Cherished by us as a son by a father, let him (Agni) in our dwelling convey promptly our oblation to thegods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्नेदिष्ठाभिः सचेय जोषमा वसो ।सदा देवस्य मर्त्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ahám ǀ agne ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ nédiṣṭhābhiḥ ǀ saceya ǀ jóṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀsádā ǀ devásya ǀ mártyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, granter of dwellings, may I, who am mortal, ever enjoy plural asure through your proximateprotections.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, granter of dwellings, may I, who am mortal, ever enjoy plural asure through your proximateprotections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा सनेयं तव रातिभिरग्ने तव प्रशस्तिभिः ।त्वामिदाहुः प्रमतिं वसो ममाग्ने हर्षस्व दातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ krátvā ǀ saneyam ǀ táva ǀ rātí-bhiḥ ǀ ágne ǀ táva ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ āhuḥ ǀ prá-matim ǀ vaso íti ǀ máma ǀ agne ǀ hárṣasva ǀ dā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I propitiate you,Agni, by worshipping you, by the gifts presented to you, by your praises; verily,Vasu, they have called you the benevolent- minded; delight, Agni, to give me wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May I propitiate you,Agni, by worshipping you, by the gifts presented to you, by your praises; verily,Vasu, they have called you the benevolent- minded; delight, Agni, to give me wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तिरते वाजभर्मभिः ।यस्य त्वं सख्यमावरः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sáḥ ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ su-vī́rābhiḥ ǀ tirate ǀ vā́jabharma-bhiḥ ǀyásya ǀ tvám ǀ sakhyám ǀ ā-váraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He,Agni, whose friendship you accept, prospers through your favours, grantingmaleprogeny andample food.
verses.wilson_translation: He,Agni, whose friendship you accept, prospers through your favours, grantingmaleprogeny andample food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इंधानः सिष्णवा ददे ।त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ nī́la-vān ǀ vāśáḥ ǀ ṛtvíyaḥ ǀ índhānaḥ ǀ siṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀtvám ǀ mahīnā́m ǀ uṣásām ǀ asi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ kṣapáḥ ǀ vástuṣu ǀ rājasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sprinkled, (Agni, with the libation), the dripping (Soma), car-borne, agreeable, offered in due season,resplendent, have been presented to you; you are the beloved of the mighty dawns; you reign over the things ofnight.
verses.wilson_translation: Sprinkled, (Agni, with the libation), the dripping (Soma), car-borne, agreeable, offered in due season,resplendent, have been presented to you; you are the beloved of the mighty dawns; you reign over the things ofnight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमागन्म सोभरयः सहस्रमुष्कं स्वभिष्टिमवसे ।सम्राजं त्रासदस्यवं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ā́ ǀ aganma ǀ sóbharayaḥ ǀ sahásra-muṣkam ǀ su-abhiṣṭím ǀ ávase ǀsam-rā́jam ǀ trā́sadasyavam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, the Sobharis, have come to the thousand-rayed, the sincerely- worshipped, the universalsovereign, the ally of Trasadasyu, for his protection.
verses.wilson_translation: We, the Sobharis, have come to the thousand-rayed, the sincerely- worshipped, the universalsovereign, the ally of Trasadasyu, for his protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते अग्ने अन्ये अग्नय उपक्षितो वया इव ।विपो न द्युम्ना नि युवे जनानां तव क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ anyé ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ upa-kṣítaḥ ǀ vayā́ḥ-iva ǀvípaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ ní ǀ yuve ǀ jánānām ǀ táva ǀ kṣatrā́ṇi ǀ vardháyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, on whom your other fires are dependent, like branches (on the stem of the tree), may I amongmen, magnifying your powers, become possessed, like (other) votaries, of (abundant) food.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, on whom your other fires are dependent, like branches (on the stem of the tree), may I amongmen, magnifying your powers, become possessed, like (other) votaries, of (abundant) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यमादित्यासो अद्रुहः पारं नयथ मर्त्यं ।मघोनां विश्वेषां सुदानवः ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ ādityāsaḥ ǀ adruhaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ náyatha ǀ mártyam ǀmaghónām ǀ víśveṣām ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Benevolent and genitive rousĀdityas, amid all the offerers of oblations, the man whom you conduct to thelimit (of his undertakings obtains his reward).
verses.wilson_translation: Benevolent and genitive rousĀdityas, amid all the offerers of oblations, the man whom you conduct to thelimit (of his undertakings obtains his reward).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यूयं राजानः कं चिच्चर्षणीसहः क्षयंतं मानुषाँ अनु ।वयं ते वो वरुण मित्रार्यमन्त्स्यामेदृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: yūyám ǀ rājānaḥ ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ carṣaṇi-sahaḥ ǀ kṣáyantam ǀ mā́nuṣān ǀ ánu ǀvayám ǀ té ǀ vaḥ ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀ syā́ma ǀ ít ǀ ṛtásya ǀ rathyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Royal (Ādityas), overcomers of (hostile) men, (you subdue) any one harassing those (who areengaged in sacred rites) and may we,Varuṇa,Mitra, and Aryaman, be the conveyers of the sacrifice(addressed) to you.
verses.wilson_translation: Royal (Ādityas), overcomers of (hostile) men, (you subdue) any one harassing those (who areengaged in sacred rites) and may we,Varuṇa,Mitra, and Aryaman, be the conveyers of the sacrifice(addressed) to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अदान्मे पौरुकुत्स्यः पंचाशतं त्रसदस्युर्वधूनां ।मंहिष्ठो अर्यः सत्पतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádāt ǀ me ǀ pauru-kutsyáḥ ǀ pañcāśátam ǀ trasádasyuḥ ǀ vadhū́nām ǀmáṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ sát-patiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The magnificent lord, the protector of the virtuous,Trasadasyu, the son of Purukutsa, has given me fivehundred brides.
verses.wilson_translation: The magnificent lord, the protector of the virtuous,Trasadasyu, the son of Purukutsa, has given me fivehundred brides.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत मे प्रयियोर्वयियोः सुवास्त्वा अधि तुग्वनि ।तिसॄणां सप्ततीनां श्यावः प्रणेता भुवद्वसुर्दियानां पतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ me ǀ prayíyoḥ ǀ vayíyoḥ ǀ su-vā́stvāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ túgvani ǀtisṝṇā́m ǀ saptatīnā́m ǀ śyāváḥ ǀ pra-netā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ vásuḥ ǀ díyānām ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The affluentŚyāva, the lord of kine, has given to me upon the banks of Suvastua present of seventythree (cows).
verses.wilson_translation: The affluentŚyāva, the lord of kine, has given to me upon the banks of Suvastua present of seventythree (cows).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XX Maruts.
hymns.anukramani: २६  सोभरि: काण्व:। मरुत: । प्रगाथ:= ( विषमा ककुप् , समा सतोबृहती ), १४  सतो विराट् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LET none, Swift Travellers! check you: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away,Ye benders even of what is firm. Maruts, Ṛbhukṣans, Rudras come ye with your cars strong-fellied and exceeding bright.Come, ye for whom we long, with food, to sacrifice, come ye with love to Sobbari. For well we know the vigorous might of Rudra's Sons, the Martits, who are passing strong,Swift Viṣṇu's band, who send the rain., Islands are bursting forth and misery is stayed: the heaven and earth are joined in one.Decked with bright rings, ye spread the broad expanses out, when ye, Self. luminous, stirred yourselves. Even things immovable shake and reel, the mountains and the forest trees at your approach,And the earth trembles as ye come. To lend free course, O Maruts, to your furious rush, heaven high and higher still gives way,Where they, the Heroes mighty with their arms, display their gleaming omaments on their forms. After their Godlike nature they, the bull. like Heroes, dazzling and impetuous, wearGreat splendour as they show erect. The pivot of the Sobharis' chariot within the golden box is balmed with milk.May they the Well-born, Mighty, kindred of the Cow, aid us to food and to delight. Bring, ye who sprinkle balmy drops. oblations to your vigorous Marut company,To those whose leader is the Bull. Come hither, O ye Mares, on your stronghorsed car, solid in look, with solid naves.Lightly like winged falcons, O ye Heroes, come, come to enjoy our ofrerings. Their decoration is the same: their omaments of gold are bright upon their arms;Their lances glitter splendidly. They toil not to defend their bodies from attack, strong Heroes with their mighty arms.Strong are your bows and strong the weapons in your cars, and glory sits on every face. Whose name extendeth like a sea, alone, resplendent, so that all have joy in it,And life-power like ancestral might. Pay honour to these Maruts and sing praise to them, for of the wheel-spokes of the carOf these loud roarers none is last: this is their power, this moves them to give mighty gifts. Blest by your favouring help was he, O Maruts, at the earlier flushings of the morn,And even now shall he be blest. The strong man to whose sacrifice, O Heroes, ye approach that ye may taste thereof,With glories and with war that winneth spoil shall gain great bliss, ye Shakers of the world. Even as Rudra's Sons, the brood of the Creator Dyaus, the Asura, desire,O Youthful Ones, so shall it be: And these the bounteous, worthy of the Maruts who move onward pouring down the rain-Even for their sake, O Youthful Ones, with kindest heart take us to you to be your own. O Sobhari, with newest song sing out unto the youthful purifying Bulls,Even as a plougher to his steers. Who, like a celebrated boxer, overcome the challengers in every fight:They who, like shining bulls, are most illustrious-honour those Maruts with thy song. Allied by common ancestry, ye Maruts, even the Cows, alike in energy,Lick, all by turns, each other's head. Even mortal man, ye Dancers breast adorned with gold, attains to brotherhood with you.Mark ye and notice us, O Maruts; evermore your friendship is secured to us. O Maruts, rich in noble gifts, bring us a portion of the Maruts’ medicine,Ye Coursers who are Friends to us. Haters of those who serve you not, bliss-bringers, bring us bliss with those auspicious aidsWherewith ye are victorious and guard Sindhu well, and succour Krvi in his need. Maruts, who rest on fair trimmed grass, what balm soever Sindhu or Asikni hath,Or mountains or the seas contain. Ye carry on your bodies, ye who see it all: so bless us graciously therewith.Cast, Maruts, to the ground our sick man's malady: replace the dislocated limb.

verses.sanskrit: आ गंता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थाता समन्यवः ।स्थिरा चिन्नमयिष्णवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ganta ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣaṇyata ǀ prá-sthāvānaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápa ǀ sthāta ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǀsthirā́ ǀ cit ǀ namayiṣṇavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Far-travellig (winds), alike wrathful, come here, harm us not; benders of the solid (mountains), withdrawnot from us.
verses.wilson_translation: Far-travellig (winds), alike wrathful, come here, harm us not; benders of the solid (mountains), withdrawnot from us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वीळुपविभिर्मरुत ऋभुक्षण आ रुद्रासः सुदीतिभिः ।इषा नो अद्या गता पुरुस्पृहो यज्ञमा सोभरीयवः ॥
verses.transliteration: vīḷupaví-bhiḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ rudrāsaḥ ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǀiṣā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ puru-spṛhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ sobharī-yávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mighty sons of Rudra,Maruts, come with brilliant, strong-wheeled (chariots); desired of many,well-disposed to Sobhari, come today to our sacrifice with (abundant) food.
verses.wilson_translation: Mighty sons of Rudra,Maruts, come with brilliant, strong-wheeled (chariots); desired of many,well-disposed to Sobhari, come today to our sacrifice with (abundant) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा हि रुद्रियाणां शुष्ममुग्रं मरुतां शिमीवतां ।विष्णोरेषस्य मीळ्हुषां ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ rudríyāṇām ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ugrám ǀ marútām ǀ śímī-vatām ǀvíṣṇoḥ ǀ eṣásya ǀ mīḷhúṣām ǁ
verses.english_translation: We know the great strength of the active sons of Rudra, the Maruts, the shedders of the diffusive raiṇ
verses.wilson_translation: We know the great strength of the active sons of Rudra, the Maruts, the shedders of the diffusive raiṇ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि द्वीपानि पापतंतिष्ठद्दुच्छुनोभे युजंत रोदसी ।प्र धन्वान्यैरत शुभ्रखादयो यदेजथ स्वभानवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ dvīpā́ni ǀ pā́patan ǀ tíṣṭhat ǀ ducchúnā ǀ ubhé íti ǀ yujanta ǀ ródasī íti ǀprá ǀ dhánvāni ǀ airata ǀ śubhra-khādayaḥ ǀ yát ǀ éjatha ǀ sva-bhānavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They fall upon the island; the firm-set (trees) are with difficulty sustained; they agitate both heaven andearth; they urge on the waters; bright- weaponed, far-shining, whatever (you approach) you cause to tremble.
verses.wilson_translation: They fall upon the island; the firm-set (trees) are with difficulty sustained; they agitate both heaven andearth; they urge on the waters; bright- weaponed, far-shining, whatever (you approach) you cause to tremble.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्युता चिद्वो अज्मन्ना नानदति पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः ।भूमिर्यामेषु रेजते ॥
verses.transliteration: ácyutā ǀ cit ǀ vaḥ ǀ ájman ǀ ā́ ǀ nā́nadati ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǀbhū́miḥ ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ rejate ǁ
verses.english_translation: At your coming the unprecipitated mountains and trees resound; the earth shakes at your passage.
verses.wilson_translation: At your coming the unprecipitated mountains and trees resound; the earth shakes at your passage.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमाय वो मरुतो यातवे द्यौर्जिहीत उत्तरा बृहत् ।यत्रा नरो देदिशते तनूष्वा त्वक्षांसि बाह्वोजसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ámāya ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yā́tave ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ jíhīte ǀ út-tarā ǀ bṛhát ǀyátra ǀ náraḥ ǀ dédiśate ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ tvákṣāṃsi ǀ bahú-ojasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Alarmed) at your violence,Maruts, the heaven seeks to rise higher, abandoning the firmament, where(you) the strong-armed leaders (of rites) display the ornaments of (your) person ns.
verses.wilson_translation: (Alarmed) at your violence,Maruts, the heaven seeks to rise higher, abandoning the firmament, where(you) the strong-armed leaders (of rites) display the ornaments of (your) person ns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वधामनु श्रियं नरो महि त्वेषा अमवंतो वृषप्सवः ।वहंते अह्रुतप्सवः ॥
verses.transliteration: svadhā́m ǀ ánu ǀ śríyam ǀ náraḥ ǀ máhi ǀ tveṣā́ḥ ǀ áma-vantaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-psavaḥ ǀváhante ǀ áhruta-psavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The radiant, strong, rain-shedding, undisguised leaders of rites display their great glory when acceptingthe (sacrificial) food.
verses.wilson_translation: The radiant, strong, rain-shedding, undisguised leaders of rites display their great glory when acceptingthe (sacrificial) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गोभिर्वाणो अज्यते सोभरीणां रथे कोशे हिरण्यये ।गोबंधवः सुजातास इषे भुजे महांतो नः स्परसे नु ॥
verses.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ vāṇáḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ sóbharīṇām ǀ ráthe ǀ kóśe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀgó-bandhavaḥ ǀ su-jātā́saḥ ǀ iṣé ǀ bhujé ǀ mahā́ntaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ spárase ǀ nú ǁ
verses.english_translation: The voice (of the Maruts) blends with the songs of the Sobharis in the receptacle of their goldenchariot; may the mighty well-born Maruts, the offspring of the (bridled) cow, (be gracious) to us regard of food,enjoyment, and kindness.
verses.wilson_translation: The voice (of the Maruts) blends with the songs of the Sobharis in the receptacle of their goldenchariot; may the mighty well-born Maruts, the offspring of the (bridled) cow, (be gracious) to us regard of food,enjoyment, and kindness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रति वो वृषदंजयो वृष्णे शर्धाय मारुताय भरध्वं ।हव्या वृषप्रयाव्णे ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛṣat-añjayaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ śárdhāya ǀ mā́rutāya ǀ bharadhvam ǀhavyā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-prayāvne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sprinklers of the libation, present the offerings to the rain-bestowing swift-passing company of the Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: Sprinklers of the libation, present the offerings to the rain-bestowing swift-passing company of the Maruts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषणश्वेन मरुतो वृषप्सुना रथेन वृषनाभिना ।आ श्येनासो न पक्षिणो वृथा नरो हव्या नो वीतये गत ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣaṇaśvéna ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-psunā ǀ ráthena ǀ vṛ́ṣa-nābhinā ǀā́ ǀ śyenā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ pakṣíṇaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ naraḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vītáye ǀ gata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, leaders (of rites), come like swift-flying birds in your rain- shedding, strong-horsed chariot,whose wheels bestow showers, to partake of our oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, leaders (of rites), come like swift-flying birds in your rain- shedding, strong-horsed chariot,whose wheels bestow showers, to partake of our oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समानमंज्येषां वि भ्राजंते रुक्मासो अधि बाहुषु ।दविद्युतत्यृष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration: samānám ǀ añjí ǀ eṣām ǀ ví ǀ bhrājante ǀ rukmā́saḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ bāhúṣu ǀdávidyutati ǀ ṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Their decoration is the same; gold (necklaces) shine (on their breasts), lances gleam upon theirshoulders.
verses.wilson_translation: Their decoration is the same; gold (necklaces) shine (on their breasts), lances gleam upon theirshoulders.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त उग्रासो वृषण उग्रबाहवो नकिष्टनूषु येतिरे ।स्थिरा धन्वान्यायुधा रथेषु वोऽनीकेष्वधि श्रियः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ ugrā́saḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ ugrá-bāhavaḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ yetire ǀsthirā́ ǀ dhánvāni ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ rátheṣu ǀ vaḥ ǀ ánīkeṣu ǀ ádhi ǀ śríyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fierce, vigorous, strong-armed, they need not exert (the energy of their) person ns; bows and arrows areready in your chariots; the glory (of conquest) over (hostile) armies is yours.
verses.wilson_translation: Fierce, vigorous, strong-armed, they need not exert (the energy of their) person ns; bows and arrows areready in your chariots; the glory (of conquest) over (hostile) armies is yours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येषामर्णो न सप्रथो नाम त्वेषं शश्वतामेकमिद्भुजे ।वयो न पित्र्यं सहः ॥
verses.transliteration: yéṣām ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ tveṣám ǀ śáśvatām ǀ ékam ǀ ít ǀ bhujé ǀváyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pítryam ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: One illustrious name is given to them all, as widely diffused as water for the gratification (of theirworshippers), like invigoraing paternal food.
verses.wilson_translation: One illustrious name is given to them all, as widely diffused as water for the gratification (of theirworshippers), like invigoraing paternal food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तान्वंदस्व मरुतस्ताँ उप स्तुहि तेषां हि धुनीनां ।अराणां न चरमस्तदेषां दाना मह्ना तदेषां ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́n ǀ vandasva ǀ marútaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ téṣām ǀ hí ǀ dhúnīnām ǀarā́ṇām ǀ ná ǀ caramáḥ ǀ tát ǀ eṣām ǀ dānā́ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ tát ǀ eṣām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise them, praise the Maruts, for we are (dependen) upon those agitators (of all things) as a menial isupon his lords; therefore are their donations (characterized) by munificence; such are their (gifts).
verses.wilson_translation: Praise them, praise the Maruts, for we are (dependen) upon those agitators (of all things) as a menial isupon his lords; therefore are their donations (characterized) by munificence; such are their (gifts).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुभगः स व ऊतिष्वास पूर्वासु मरुतो व्युष्टिषु ।यो वा नूनमुतासति ॥
verses.transliteration: su-bhágaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtíṣu ǀ ā́sa ǀ pū́rvāsu ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀyáḥ ǀ vā ǀ nūnám ǀ utá ǀ ásati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fortunate was he,Maruts, who, in former days, was secure in your protections, as is he who nowenjoys them.
verses.wilson_translation: Fortunate was he,Maruts, who, in former days, was secure in your protections, as is he who nowenjoys them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य वा यूयं प्रति वाजिनो नर आ हव्या वीतये गथ ।अभि ष द्युम्नैरुत वाजसातिभिः सुम्ना वो धूतयो नशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ vā ǀ yūyám ǀ práti ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ naraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ havyā́ ǀ vītáye ǀ gathá ǀabhí ǀ sáḥ ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā́jasāti-bhiḥ ǀ sumnā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀ naśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sacrificer, to partake of whose oblations you approach, leaders of rites, enjoys, agitators of allthings, the felicity you bestow, together with abundant viands, and the gift of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The sacrificer, to partake of whose oblations you approach, leaders of rites, enjoys, agitators of allthings, the felicity you bestow, together with abundant viands, and the gift of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यथा रुद्रस्य सूनवो दिवो वशंत्यसुरस्य वेधसः ।युवानस्तथेदसत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ váśanti ǀ ásurasya ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀyúvānaḥ ǀ táthā ǀ ít ǀ asat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this (our praise) take effect, so that the ever-youthful sons of Rudra, creators of the cloud,(coming) from heaven, may be plural ased with us.
verses.wilson_translation: May this (our praise) take effect, so that the ever-youthful sons of Rudra, creators of the cloud,(coming) from heaven, may be plural ased with us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये चार्हंति मरुतः सुदानवः स्मन्मीळ्हुषश्चरंति ये ।अतश्चिदा न उप वस्यसा हृदा युवान आ ववृध्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ ca ǀ árhanti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ smát ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ cáranti ǀ yé ǀátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vásyasā ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ yúvānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛdhvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Youthful (Maruts), approaching us with benevolent hearts, grant prosperity to those liberal men whoworship you, who zealously propitiate you, the showerers of rain, with oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Youthful (Maruts), approaching us with benevolent hearts, grant prosperity to those liberal men whoworship you, who zealously propitiate you, the showerers of rain, with oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यून ऊ षु नविष्ठया वृष्णः पावकाँ अभि सोभरे गिरा ।गाय गा इव चर्कृषत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yū́naḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ náviṣṭhayā ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ pāvakā́n ǀ abhí ǀ sobhare ǀ girā́ ǀgā́ya ǀ gā́ḥ-iva ǀ cárkṛṣat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise, Sobhari, (and attract here) by a new song the youthful purifying showerers, as (a plural ughman)repeatedly drags his oxen.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise, Sobhari, (and attract here) by a new song the youthful purifying showerers, as (a plural ughman)repeatedly drags his oxen.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: साहा ये संति मुष्टिहेव हव्यो विश्वासु पृत्सु होतृषु ।वृष्णश्चंद्रान्न सुश्रवस्तमान्गिरा वंदस्व मरुतो अह ॥
verses.transliteration: sahā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ sánti ǀ muṣṭihā́-iva ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ víśvāsu ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ hótṛṣu ǀvṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ candrā́n ǀ ná ǀ suśrávaḥ-tamān ǀ girā́ ǀ vándasva ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Propitiate wiḥ praise he Maruts, the senders of rain, the givers of plural asure, the liberal bestowers offood; who are ever victorious in combats, and like a boxer who has been challenged over his challengerṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Propitiate wiḥ praise he Maruts, the senders of rain, the givers of plural asure, the liberal bestowers offood; who are ever victorious in combats, and like a boxer who has been challenged over his challengerṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गावश्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबंधवः ।रिहते ककुभो मिथः ॥
verses.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǀ sa-jātyéna ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sá-bandhavaḥ ǀrihaté ǀ kakúbhaḥ ǀ mitháḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, who are of like wrath, offspring of the maternal cow (Pṛśni), related by a common origin, theyseverally spread through the quarters of the horizon.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, who are of like wrath, offspring of the maternal cow (Pṛśni), related by a common origin, theyseverally spread through the quarters of the horizon.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मर्तश्चिद्वो नृतवो रुक्मवक्षस उप भ्रातृत्वमायति ।अधि नो गात मरुतः सदा हि व आपित्वमस्ति निध्रुवि ॥
verses.transliteration: mártaḥ ǀ cit ǀ vaḥ ǀ nṛtavaḥ ǀ rukma-vakṣasaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bhrātṛ-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ ayati ǀádhi ǀ naḥ ǀ gāta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ āpi-tvám ǀ ásti ǀ ní-dhruvi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts, dancing (through the air), decorated with golden breast-plural tes, the mortal (who worships you)attains your brotherhood; speak favourably to us, for your affinity is ever (made known) at the regulated(sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, dancing (through the air), decorated with golden breast-plural tes, the mortal (who worships you)attains your brotherhood; speak favourably to us, for your affinity is ever (made known) at the regulated(sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मरुतो मारुतस्य न आ भेषजस्य वहता सुदानवः ।यूयं सखायः सप्तयः ॥
verses.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ mā́rutasya ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bheṣajásya ǀ vahata ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀyūyám ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ saptayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: genitive rous fiends,Maruts, swift gliding (through the air), bring to us (the boon) of the medicaments thatbelong to your company.
verses.wilson_translation: genitive rous fiends,Maruts, swift gliding (through the air), bring to us (the boon) of the medicaments thatbelong to your company.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: याभिः सिंधुमवथ याभिस्तूर्वथ याभिर्दशस्यथा क्रिविं ।मयो नो भूतोतिभिर्मयोभुवः शिवाभिरसचद्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ síndhum ǀ ávatha ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ tū́rvatha ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ daśasyátha ǀ krívim ǀmáyaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ ǀ śivā́bhiḥ ǀ asaca-dviṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With those auspicious protectionw with which you have guarded the ocean, with which you havedesroyed (your enemies), with which you provided the well (for Gotama), do you who are he sources ofhappiness, the unconquerable by your adversaries, bestow happiness upon uṣ]The unconquerable:asasacadviṣa = śatrurahitaḥ, destitute of enemies].
verses.wilson_translation: With those auspicious protectionw with which you have guarded the ocean, with which you havedesroyed (your enemies), with which you provided the well (for Gotama), do you who are he sources ofhappiness, the unconquerable by your adversaries, bestow happiness upon uṣ]The unconquerable:asasacadviṣa = śatrurahitaḥ, destitute of enemies].
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्सिंधौ यदसिक्न्यां यत्समुद्रेषु मरुतः सुबर्हिषः ।यत्पर्वतेषु भेषजं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ síndhau ǀ yát ǀ ásiknyām ǀ yát ǀ samudréṣu ǀ marutaḥ ǀ su-barhiṣaḥ ǀyát ǀ párvateṣu ǀ bheṣajám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever medicament there may be in the Sindhu, the Asikni, in the oceans, in the mountains,Maruts,who are gratified by sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever medicament there may be in the Sindhu, the Asikni, in the oceans, in the mountains,Maruts,who are gratified by sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वं पश्यंतो बिभृथा तनूष्वा तेना नो अधि वोचत ।क्षमा रपो मरुत आतुरस्य न इष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvam ǀ páśyantaḥ ǀ bibhṛtha ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ téna ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀkṣamā́ ǀ rápaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ā́turasya ǀ naḥ ǀ íṣkarta ǀ ví-hrutam ǀ púnaríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, beholding every sort, collect them for (the good of) our bodies, ad instrumental uct us in their (uses); letthe cure of sickness (be the portion),Maruts, of him among us who for his wickedness is sick; re-establish hisenfeebled (frame).
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, beholding every sort, collect them for (the good of) our bodies, ad instrumental uct us in their (uses); letthe cure of sickness (be the portion),Maruts, of him among us who for his wickedness is sick; re-establish hisenfeebled (frame).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १८ सोभरि: काण्व:। इन्द्र: १७ -१८ चित्र: । प्रगाथ: = (विषमा ककुप् , समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves,Call on thee wonderful in fight On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth.We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, havie chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God. Come hither, for the drops are here, O Lord of corn-lands. Lord of horses, Lord of kine:Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord! For we the kinless singers have drawn hither thee, O Indra, who hast numerous kin.With all the forms thou hast, comic thou of bull-like strength, come near to drink the Soma juice. Sitting like birds beside thy meath., mingled with milk, that gladdeneth and exalteth thee,Indra, to thee we sing aloud. We speak to thee with this our reverential prayer. Why art thou pondering yet awhile?Here are our wishes; thou art liberal, Lord of Bays: we and our hymns are present here. For not in recent times alone, O Indra, Thunder-armed, have we obtained thine aid.Of old we knew thy plenteous wealth. Hero, we knew thy friendship and thy rich rewards: these, Thunderer, now we crave of thee.O Vasu, for all wealth that cometh of the kine, sharpen our powers, fair-visored God. Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you,Even Indra, O my friends, for help Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight.May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds. Hero, may we, with thee for Friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath,In fight with people rich in kine. May we be victors in the singer's battlesong, and meet the wicked, Much invoked!With heroes smite the foeman and show forth our strength. O Indra, further thou our thoughts. O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou:Thou seekest comradeship in war. Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine.What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a Father, art invoked. O Indra, let us not, like fools who waste their lives at home, with friendship such as thineSit idly by the poured-out juice. Giver of kine, may we not miss thy gracious gifts: let us not rob thee of thine own.Strip even the strong places of the foe, and bring: thy gifts can never be made vain. Indra or blest Sarasvatī alone bestows such wealth, treasure so great, or thou,O Citra, on the worshipper. Citra is King, and only kinglings are the rest who dwell beside Sarasvatī.He, like Parjanya with his rain, hath spread himself with thousand, yea, with myriad gifts.

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरंतोऽवस्यवः ।वाजे चित्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā́m ǀ apūrvya ǀ sthūrám ǀ ná ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ bhárantaḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀvā́je ǀ citrám ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unpreceded Indra, cherishing you (with sacrificial food), desirous of your protection, we invoke you whoare manifold in battle, as (men call upon) some stout (person n for help).
verses.wilson_translation: Unpreceded Indra, cherishing you (with sacrificial food), desirous of your protection, we invoke you whoare manifold in battle, as (men call upon) some stout (person n for help).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् ।त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इंद्र सानसिं ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ kárman ǀ ūtáye ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ ugráḥ ǀ cakrāma ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ avitā́ram ǀ vavṛmáhe ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sānasím ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have recourse,Indra, to you for protection at sacred rites; may he who is ever young, fierce,resolute, come to us! We, your friends, Indra, rely upon you as our protector and benefactor.
verses.wilson_translation: We have recourse,Indra, to you for protection at sacred rites; may he who is ever young, fierce,resolute, come to us! We, your friends, Indra, rely upon you as our protector and benefactor.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ याहीम इंदवोऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते ।सोमं सोमपते पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ imé ǀ índavaḥ ǀ áśva-pate ǀ gó-pate ǀ úrvarā-pate ǀsómam ǀ soma-pate ǀ piba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of horses, of cattle, of corn-land, these libations (are for you); come, lord of the Soma, drink theeffused Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of horses, of cattle, of corn-land, these libations (are for you); come, lord of the Soma, drink theeffused Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं हि त्वा बंधुमंतमबंधवो विप्रास इंद्र येमिम ।या ते धामानि वृषभ तेभिरा गहि विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ bándhu-mantam ǀ abandhávaḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ indra ǀ yemimá ǀyā́ ǀ te ǀ dhā́māni ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Intelligent, but destitute of kin, let us connect ourselves,Indra, with you, who abound with kinsmen;come, showerer (of benefits), with all your glories, to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Intelligent, but destitute of kin, let us connect ourselves,Indra, with you, who abound with kinsmen;come, showerer (of benefits), with all your glories, to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सीदंतस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे ।अभि त्वामिंद्र नोनुमः ॥
verses.transliteration: sī́dantaḥ ǀ te ǀ váyaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ gó-śrīte ǀ mádhau ǀ madiré ǀ vivákṣaṇe ǀabhí ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ nonumaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Gathering like (a flock of) birds round your exhilarating heaven- bestowing Somamixed with curds, werepeatedly glorify you,Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Gathering like (a flock of) birds round your exhilarating heaven- bestowing Somamixed with curds, werepeatedly glorify you,Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा च त्वैना नमसा वदामसि किं मुहुश्चिद्वि दीधयः ।संति कामासो हरिवो ददिष्ट्वं स्मो वयं संति नो धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ ca ǀ tvā ǀ enā́ ǀ námasā ǀ vádāmasi ǀ kím ǀ múhuḥ ǀ cit ǀ ví ǀ dīdhayaḥ ǀsánti ǀ kā́māsaḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ tvám ǀ smáḥ ǀ vayám ǀ sánti ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We salute you with this adoration; why do you so often mediate (upon our requests)? Master of baysteeds, let our desires be granted. You are their bestower, we are your (suppliants) and our sacred rites are(addressed to you).
verses.wilson_translation: We salute you with this adoration; why do you so often mediate (upon our requests)? Master of baysteeds, let our desires be granted. You are their bestower, we are your (suppliants) and our sacred rites are(addressed to you).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नूत्ना इदिंद्र ते वयमूती अभूम नहि नू ते अद्रिवः ।विद्मा पुरा परीणसः ॥
verses.transliteration: nū́tnāḥ ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ ūtī́ ǀ abhūma ǀ nahí ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀvidmá ǀ purā́ ǀ párīṇasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We verily are the most recent (objects) of your protection,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, we have notknown of old one greater than you.
verses.wilson_translation: We verily are the most recent (objects) of your protection,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, we have notknown of old one greater than you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा सखित्वमुत शूर भोज्यमा ते ता वज्रिन्नीमहे ।उतो समस्मिन्ना शिशीहि नो वसो वाजे सुशिप्र गोमति ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ utá ǀ śūra ǀ bhojyám ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ tā́ ǀ vajrin ǀ īmahe ǀutó íti ǀ samasmin ǀ ā́ ǀ śiśīhi ǀ naḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ vā́je ǀ su-śipra ǀ gó-mati ǁ
verses.english_translation: We acknowledge, hero, your friendship, (the wealth) to be enjoyed through you, and solicit both,thunderer, of you; giver of dwellings,Indraof the handsome jaws, sustain us in all abundance and in (store of)cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: We acknowledge, hero, your friendship, (the wealth) to be enjoyed through you, and solicit both,thunderer, of you; giver of dwellings,Indraof the handsome jaws, sustain us in all abundance and in (store of)cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु वः स्तुषे ।सखाय इंद्रमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ idám-idam ǀ purā́ ǀ prá ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ā-ninā́ya ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ stuṣe ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify friends, for your protection, that Indrawho has brought to us of old this or that excellent(wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify friends, for your protection, that Indrawho has brought to us of old this or that excellent(wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमंदत ।आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतं ॥
verses.transliteration: hári-aśvam ǀ sát-patim ǀ carṣaṇi-sáham ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ yáḥ ǀ ámandata ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vayati ǀ gávyam ǀ áśvyam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śatám ǁ
verses.english_translation: That man glorifies Indra, the lord of bay steeds, the protector of the good, the overcomer of enemies,who rejoices (in the fulfilment of his wishes); may Maghavanbestow upon us, his worshippers, hundreds of cattleand horses.
verses.wilson_translation: That man glorifies Indra, the lord of bay steeds, the protector of the good, the overcomer of enemies,who rejoices (in the fulfilment of his wishes); may Maghavanbestow upon us, his worshippers, hundreds of cattleand horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसंतं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि ।संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ॥
verses.transliteration: tváyā ǀ ha ǀ svit ǀ yujā́ ǀ vayám ǀ práti ǀ śvasántam ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ bruvīmahi ǀsam-sthé ǀ jánasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With you, showerer (of benefits), for our ally, we bid defiance to one assailing us in a contest (onbehalf) of a man possessing herds of cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: With you, showerer (of benefits), for our ally, we bid defiance to one assailing us in a contest (onbehalf) of a man possessing herds of cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जयेम कारे पुरुहूत कारिणोऽभि तिष्ठेम दूढ्यः ।नृभिर्वृत्रं हन्याम शूशुयाम चावेरिंद्र प्र णो धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: jáyema ǀ kāré ǀ puru-hūta ǀ kāríṇaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ tiṣṭhema ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ hanyā́ma ǀ śūśuyā́ma ǀ ca ǀ áveḥ ǀ indra ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, invoked of many, may we conquer in battle those contending against us; may we resist themalignant; may we, aided by the leaders (of rites, the Maruts), slay Vṛtra; may we be prosperous, and do youprotect our pious works.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, invoked of many, may we conquer in battle those contending against us; may we resist themalignant; may we, aided by the leaders (of rites, the Maruts), slay Vṛtra; may we be prosperous, and do youprotect our pious works.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिंद्र जनुषा सनादसि ।युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥
verses.transliteration: abhrātṛvyáḥ ǀ anā́ ǀ tvám ǀ ánāpiḥ ǀ indra ǀ janúṣā ǀ sanā́t ǀ asi ǀyudhā́ ǀ ít ǀ āpi-tvám ǀ icchase ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, are by your birth brotherless; from ever are you without a kinsman; the kindred you desire is(that of him) who engages in war.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, are by your birth brotherless; from ever are you without a kinsman; the kindred you desire is(that of him) who engages in war.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकी रेवंतं सख्याय विंदसे पीयंति ते सुराश्वः ।यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ revántam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ vindase ǀ pī́yanti ǀ te ǀ surāśváḥ ǀyadā́ ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ nadanúm ǀ sám ǀ ūhasi ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ hūyase ǁ
verses.english_translation: You acknowledge no friendship for the wealthy man (who makes no offerings); those who are puffed upwith wine offered you; when you instrumental tute (the sacrifice), you expelled niggardliness, and you are invoked as aprotector.
verses.wilson_translation: You acknowledge no friendship for the wealthy man (who makes no offerings); those who are puffed upwith wine offered you; when you instrumental tute (the sacrifice), you expelled niggardliness, and you are invoked as aprotector.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा ते अमाजुरो यथा मूरास इंद्र सख्ये त्वावतः ।नि षदाम सचा सुते ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ amā-júraḥ ǀ yathā ǀ mūrā́saḥ ǀ indra ǀ sakhyé ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀní ǀ sadāma ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us not, like fools,Indra, be regardless of the friendship of such as you are; let us assemble togetherwhen the libation is effused.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us not, like fools,Indra, be regardless of the friendship of such as you are; let us assemble togetherwhen the libation is effused.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा ते गोदत्र निरराम राधस इंद्र मा ते गृहामहि ।दृळ्हा चिदर्यः प्र मृशाभ्या भर न ते दामान आदभे ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ go-datra ǀ níḥ ǀ arāma ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ índra ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ gṛhāmahi ǀdṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ aryáḥ ǀ prá ǀ mṛśa ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ ná ǀ te ǀ dāmā́naḥ ǀ ā-dábhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us never,Indra, giver of cattle, cease (to benefit) from your wealth; let us not accept it (from anotherthan) you; do you, who are the lord, connfirm to us permanent (riches), bestow them upon us; your benefactionscannoe be arrested.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us never,Indra, giver of cattle, cease (to benefit) from your wealth; let us not accept it (from anotherthan) you; do you, who are the lord, connfirm to us permanent (riches), bestow them upon us; your benefactionscannoe be arrested.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो वा घेदियन्मघं सरस्वती वा सुभगा ददिर्वसु ।त्वं वा चित्र दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ íyat ǀ maghám ǀ sárasvatī ǀ vā ǀ su-bhágā ǀ dadíḥ ǀ vásu ǀtvám ǀ vā ǀ citra ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Is it Indrawho has given to the donor (of the oblation) so much affluence? Is it the auspicious Sarasvatī (who has given) the treasure? Or,Citra, is it you?
verses.wilson_translation: Is it Indrawho has given to the donor (of the oblation) so much affluence? Is it the auspicious Sarasvatī (who has given) the treasure? Or,Citra, is it you?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चित्र इद्राजा राजका इदन्यके यके सरस्वतीमनु ।पर्जन्य इव ततनद्धि वृष्ट्या सहस्रमयुता ददत् ॥
verses.transliteration: cítraḥ ǀ ít ǀ rā́jā ǀ rājakā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ anyaké ǀ yaké ǀ sárasvatīm ǀ ánu ǀparjányaḥ-iva ǀ tatánat ǀ hí ǀ vṛṣṭyā́ ǀ sahásram ǀ ayútā ǀ dádat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily the RājāCitra, giving his thousands and tens of thousands, has overspread (with his bounty)those other petty princes, who rules along the Sarasvatī, as Parjanya(overspeads the earth) with rain.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily the RājāCitra, giving his thousands and tens of thousands, has overspread (with his bounty)those other petty princes, who rules along the Sarasvatī, as Parjanya(overspeads the earth) with rain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXII. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HITHERWARD have I called to-day, for succour, that most wondrous carWhich ye ascended, Aśvins, ye whose paths are red, swift to give Car, for Sūrya's sake. Car ever young, much longed-for, easily invoked, soon guided, first in deeds of might,Which waits and serves, O Sobhari, with benevolence, without a rival or a foe. These Aśvins with our homage, these Two Omnipresent DeitiesHitherward will we bring for kind help, these who seek the dwelling of the worshipper. One of your chariot wheels is moving swiftly round, one speeds for you its onward course.Like a milch-cow, O Lords of splendour, and with haste let your benevolence come to us. That chariot of yours which hath a triple seat and reins of gold,The famous car that traverseth the heaven and earth, thereon Nāsatyas, Aśvins, come. Ye with your plough, when favouring Manu with your help, ploughed the first harvest in the sky.As such will we exalt you, Lords of splendour, now, O Aśvins, with our prayer and praise. Come to us, Lords of ample wealth, by paths of everlasting Law,Whereby to high dominion ye with mighty strength raised Trksi, Trasadasyu's son. This Soma pressed with stones is yours, ye Heroes, Lords of plenteous wealth.Approach to drink the Soma, come, drink in the worshipper's abode. O Aśvins, mount the chariot, mount the golden seat, ye who are Lords of plenteous wealth,And bring to us abundant food. The aids wherewith ye helped Paktha and Adhrigt;, and Babhru severed from his friends,—With those, O Aśvins, come hither with speed and soon, and heal whatever is diseased. When we continually invoke the Aśvins, the resistless, at this time of day,We lovers of the song, with songs. Through these, ye Mighty Ones, come hither to my call which brings all blessings, wears all forms,—Tlirough which, All-present Heroes, lavishest of food ye strengthened Krvi, come through these. I speak to both of these as such, these Aśvins whom I reverence at this time of day:With homage we entreat them both. Ye who are Lords of splendour, ye whose paths are red, at eve, at mom, at sacrifice,Give us not utterly as prey to mortal foe, ye Rudras, Lords of ample wealth. For bliss I call. the blissful car, at morn the inseparable Aśvins with their carI call, like Sobhari our sire. Rapid as thought, and strong, and speeding to thejoy, bringing.your swiftly-coming help,Be to us a protection even from far away Lords of great wealth, with many aids.' Come, Wonder-Workers, to our home, our home, O Aśvins, rich in cattle, steeds, and gold,Chief drinkers of the Soma's juice Choice-worthy strength, heroic, firm and excellent, uninjured by the Rakṣas foe,At this your coming nigh, ye Lords of ample wealth and all good things, may we obtain.

verses.sanskrit: ओ त्यमह्व आ रथमद्या दंसिष्ठमूतये ।यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी आ सूर्यायै तस्थथुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ó íti ǀ tyám ǀ ahve ǀ ā́ ǀ rátham ǀ adyá ǀ dáṃsiṣṭham ǀ ūtáye ǀyám ǀ aśvinā ǀ su-havā ǀ rudravartanī íti rudra-vartanī ǀ ā́ ǀ sūryā́yai ǀ tastháthuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke to-day for our protection that splendid chariot, which, adorable Aśvins, advancing on the pathto battle, you ascended (to go to the wwedding) of Sūrya.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke to-day for our protection that splendid chariot, which, adorable Aśvins, advancing on the pathto battle, you ascended (to go to the wwedding) of Sūrya.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वायुषं सुहवं पुरुस्पृहं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यं ।सचनावंतं सुमतिभिः सोभरे विद्वेषसमनेहसं ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrva-āyúṣam ǀ su-hávam ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ bhujyúm ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ pū́rvyam ǀsacanā́-vantam ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ sobhare ǀ ví-dveṣasam ǀ anehásam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Celebrate, Sobhari, with praises (that chariot), the benefactor of former (encomiasts), the worthilyinvoked, the desired of many, the preserver, the foremost in battles, the relied upon by all, the scatterer ofenemies, the exempt from ill.
verses.wilson_translation: Celebrate, Sobhari, with praises (that chariot), the benefactor of former (encomiasts), the worthilyinvoked, the desired of many, the preserver, the foremost in battles, the relied upon by all, the scatterer ofenemies, the exempt from ill.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा देवा नमोभिरश्विना ।अर्वाचीना स्ववसे करामहे गंतारा दाशुषो गृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ puru-bhū́tamā ǀ devā́ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀarvācīnā́ ǀ sú ǀ ávase ǀ karāmahe ǀ gántārā ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
verses.english_translation: We incite by our adorations on this occasion the two divine Aśvins, the overcomers of foes, that theymay come down for our protection and proceed to the dwelling of the donor (of the offering).
verses.wilson_translation: We incite by our adorations on this occasion the two divine Aśvins, the overcomers of foes, that theymay come down for our protection and proceed to the dwelling of the donor (of the offering).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवो रथस्य परि चक्रमीयत ईर्मान्यद्वामिषण्यति ।अस्माँ अच्छा सुमतिर्वां शुभस्पती आ धेनुरिव धावतु ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ ráthasya ǀ pári ǀ cakrám ǀ īyate ǀ īrmā́ ǀ anyát ǀ vām ǀ iṣaṇyati ǀasmā́n ǀ áccha ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ vām ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ dhenúḥ-iva ǀ dhāvatu ǁ
verses.english_translation: One of the wheels of your car moves in every direction; the other, impellers of actions, remains withyou; may your favour, lords of rain, hasten towards us as a cow (to her calf)!
verses.wilson_translation: One of the wheels of your car moves in every direction; the other, impellers of actions, remains withyou; may your favour, lords of rain, hasten towards us as a cow (to her calf)!
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रथो यो वां त्रिवंधुरो हिरण्याभीशुरश्विना ।परि द्यावापृथिवी भूषति श्रुतस्तेन नासत्या गतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ráthaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ híraṇya-abhīśuḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀpári ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ bhū́ṣati ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ téna ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your celebrated chariot,Aśvins, that is three-banked, and caparisoned with gold, graces heaven andearth; come with it,Nāsatyās.
verses.wilson_translation: Your celebrated chariot,Aśvins, that is three-banked, and caparisoned with gold, graces heaven andearth; come with it,Nāsatyās.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दशस्यंता मनवे पूर्व्यं दिवि यवं वृकेण कर्षथः ।ता वामद्य सुमतिभिः शुभस्पती अश्विना प्र स्तुवीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: daśasyántā ǀ mánave ǀ pūrvyám ǀ diví ǀ yávam ǀ vṛ́keṇa ǀ karṣathaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ áśvinā ǀ prá ǀ stuvīmahi ǁ
