verses.english_translation: Bestowing upon Manuthe ancient (rain) from the firmament, you enabled him to cultivate (the soil) withthe plural ugh (and reap) the barley; now therefore,Aśvins, lords of rain, we glorify you both with praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestowing upon Manuthe ancient (rain) from the firmament, you enabled him to cultivate (the soil) withthe plural ugh (and reap) the barley; now therefore,Aśvins, lords of rain, we glorify you both with praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप नो वाजिनीवसू यातमृतस्य पथिभिः ।येभिस्तृक्षिं वृषणा त्रासदस्यवं महे क्षत्राय जिन्वथः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ yātám ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀyébhiḥ ǀ tṛkṣím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ trāsadasyavám ǀ mahé ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ jínvathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rich in food,Aśvins, come to us by the paths of sacrifice, those by which showerers (of benefits), youwent to gratify Tṛkṣi, the son of Trasadasyu, with vast wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Rich in food,Aśvins, come to us by the paths of sacrifice, those by which showerers (of benefits), youwent to gratify Tṛkṣi, the son of Trasadasyu, with vast wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं वामद्रिभिः सुतः सोमो नरा वृषण्वसू ।आ यातं सोमपीतये पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ narā ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ píbatam ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders (of rites), affluent in rain, this Somahas been expressed by the (grinding) stones for you; cometo drink the Soma, drink it in the dwelling of the donor.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders (of rites), affluent in rain, this Somahas been expressed by the (grinding) stones for you; cometo drink the Soma, drink it in the dwelling of the donor.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ हि रुहतमश्विना रथे कोशे हिरण्यये वृषण्वसू ।युंजाथां पीवरीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hí ǀ ruhátam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ráthe ǀ kóśe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀyuñjā́thām ǀ pī́varīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, who are rich in rain, ascend your golden chariot, a storehouse (of weapons); bring to usfattening food.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, who are rich in rain, ascend your golden chariot, a storehouse (of weapons); bring to usfattening food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: याभिः पक्थमवथो याभिरध्रिगुं याभिर्बभ्रुं विजोषसं ।ताभिर्नो मक्षू तूयमश्विना गतं भिषज्यतं यदातुरं ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ pakthám ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ádhri-gum ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ babhrúm ǀ ví-joṣasam ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ tū́yam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ bhiṣajyátam ǀ yát ǀ ā́turam ǁ
verses.english_translation: With those protections with which you have defended Paktha,Adhrigu, and Babhru, when propitiatingyou, come to us,Aśvins, quickly; administermedicineto the sick.
verses.wilson_translation: With those protections with which you have defended Paktha,Adhrigu, and Babhru, when propitiatingyou, come to us,Aśvins, quickly; administermedicineto the sick.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदध्रिगावो अध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना हवामहे ।वयं गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ ádhri-gāvaḥ ǀ ádhrigū ítyadhri-gū ǀ idā́ ǀ cit ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ hávāmahe ǀvayám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: At the tiem when hurrying, devout, we invoke you both speedily going to battle, at the dawn of day, withour hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: At the tiem when hurrying, devout, we invoke you both speedily going to battle, at the dawn of day, withour hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ताभिरा यातं वृषणोप मे हवं विश्वप्सुं विश्ववार्यं ।इषा मंहिष्ठा पुरुभूतमा नरा याभिः क्रिविं वावृधुस्ताभिरा गतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ úpa ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ viśvá-psum ǀ viśvá-vāryam ǀiṣā́ ǀ máṃhiṣṭhā ǀ puru-bhū́tamā ǀ narā ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ krívim ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then, showerers, come to my manifold all-propitiating invocation with those (protections), with which,leaders (of rites), you, who are gratified (by oblations), munificent (in gifts), and the overcomers of numerous(foes), gave augmentation to the well; with such (protections) come here.
verses.wilson_translation: Then, showerers, come to my manifold all-propitiating invocation with those (protections), with which,leaders (of rites), you, who are gratified (by oblations), munificent (in gifts), and the overcomers of numerous(foes), gave augmentation to the well; with such (protections) come here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ताविदा चिदहानां तावश्विना वंदमान उप ब्रुवे ।ता उ नमोभिरीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: táu ǀ idā́ ǀ cit ǀ áhānām ǀ táu ǀ aśvínā ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀtáu ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: I address the Aśvins, glorifying them at break of day; we solicit them with oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: I address the Aśvins, glorifying them at break of day; we solicit them with oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ताविद्दोषा ता उषसि शुभस्पती ता यामन्रुद्रवर्तनी ।मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे वाजिनीवसू परो रुद्रावति ख्यतं ॥
verses.transliteration: táu ǀ ít ǀ doṣā́ ǀ táu ǀ uṣási ǀ śubháḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀ tā́ ǀ yā́man ǀ rudrávartanī íti rudrá-vartanī ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mártāya ǀ ripáve ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ paráḥ ǀ rudrau ǀ áti ǀ khyatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We adore those lords of water, leaders on the road of battle, in the evening, at dawn, and at mid-day;therefore,Rudraswho are rich in food, give us not up hereafter to a mortal adversary; rudravartanī : yuddherodanaśilamārgau stūyamānamārgau vā].
verses.wilson_translation: We adore those lords of water, leaders on the road of battle, in the evening, at dawn, and at mid-day;therefore,Rudraswho are rich in food, give us not up hereafter to a mortal adversary; rudravartanī : yuddherodanaśilamārgau stūyamānamārgau vā].
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सुग्म्याय सुग्म्यं प्राता रथेनाश्विना वा सक्षणी ।हुवे पितेव सोभरी ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ súgmyāya ǀ súgmyam ǀ prātáríti ǀ ráthena ǀ aśvínā ǀ vā ǀ sakṣáṇī íti ǀhuvé ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ sóbharī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable Aśvins, bring in your chariot at early dawn happiness to me, soliciting happiness; I, Sobhari,invoke you as (did my) father.
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable Aśvins, bring in your chariot at early dawn happiness to me, soliciting happiness; I, Sobhari,invoke you as (did my) father.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मनोजवसा वृषणा मदच्युता मक्षुंगमाभिरूतिभिः ।आरात्ताच्चिद्भूतमस्मे अवसे पूर्वीभिः पुरुभोजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: mánaḥ-javasā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ mada-cyutā ǀ makṣum-gamā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀārā́ttāt ǀ cit ǀ bhūtam ǀ asmé íti ǀ ávase ǀ pūrvī́bhiḥ ǀ puru-bhojasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Aśvins), who are swift as thought, the showerers (of benefits), prostrators of the arrogant, the givers ofenjoyment to many, be ever near unto us, for our security, with many and prompt protections.
verses.wilson_translation: (Aśvins), who are swift as thought, the showerers (of benefits), prostrators of the arrogant, the givers ofenjoyment to many, be ever near unto us, for our security, with many and prompt protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो अश्वावदश्विना वर्तिर्यासिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा ।गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áśva-vat ǀ aśvinā ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yāsiṣṭam ǀ madhu-pātamā ǀ narā ǀgó-mat ǀ dasrā ǀ híraṇya-vat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, of goodly aspect, leaders (of rites), deep drinkers of the Soma, come to our dwelling aboundingwith horses, with cattle, with gold.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, of goodly aspect, leaders (of rites), deep drinkers of the Soma, come to our dwelling aboundingwith horses, with cattle, with gold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रावर्गं सुवीर्यं सुष्ठु वार्यमनाधृष्टं रक्षस्विना ।अस्मिन्ना वामायाने वाजिनीवसू विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: su-prāvargám ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ suṣṭhú ǀ vā́ryam ǀ ánādhṛṣṭam ǀ rakṣasvínā ǀasmín ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ā-yā́ne ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ víśvā ǀ vāmā́ni ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we obtain from you (wealth) spontaneously bestowed, comprising excellent strength, such as isdesired by all, and unassailable by a powerful (foe); may we obtain from you who are rich in food, upon youcoming here, all good things.
verses.wilson_translation: May we obtain from you (wealth) spontaneously bestowed, comprising excellent strength, such as isdesired by all, and unassailable by a powerful (foe); may we obtain from you who are rich in food, upon youcoming here, all good things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WORSHIP thou Jātavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts,Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame. Thou, all men's friend, Visvamanas, exaltest Agni with thy song,The Giver, and his flames with which no cars contend. Whose resolute assault, to win vigour and food, deserves our praise,—Through whose discovering power the priest obtaineth wealth. Up springs the imperishable flame, the flame of the Refulgent OneMost bright, with glowing jaws and glory in his train. Skilled in fair sacrifice, extolled, arise in Godlike loveliness,Shining with lofty splendour, with effulgent light. Called straight to our oblations, come, O Agni, through our eulogies,As thou hast been our envoy bearing up our gifts. I call your Agni, from of old Invoking Priest of living men:Him with this song I laud and magnify for you. Whom, wondrous wise, they animate with solemn rites and his fair form,Kind as a friend to men who keep the holy Law. Him, true to Law, who perfecteth the sacrifice,. Law-loving ones!Ye with your song have gratified in the place of prayer. May all our sacrifices go to him the truest Aṅgiras,Who is among mankind the most illustrious Priest. Imperishable Agni, thine are all these high enkindled lights,Like horses and like stallions showing forth their strength. So give us, Lord of Power and Might, riches combined with hero strength,And guard us with our sons and grand. sons in our frays. Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manti's race,Agni averteth from us all the demon host. O Hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine,Burn down the Rākṣasas, enchanters, with thy flame. No mortal foe can e’er prevail by arts of magic over himWho serveth Agni well with sacrificial gifts. Vyaśva the sage, who sought the Bull, hath won thee, finder of good things:As such may we enkindle thee for ample wealth. Uśanā Kāvya stablished thee, O Agni, as Invoking Priest:Thee, Jātavedas, Sacrificing Priest for man. All Deities of one accord appointed thee their messenger:Thou, God, through hearing, hadst first claim to sacrifice. Him may the mortal hero make his own immortal messenger.Far-spreading, Purifier, him whose path is black. With lifted ladles let us call him splendid with his brilliant flame,Men's ancient Agni, wasting not, adorable. The man who pays the worship due to him with sacrificial giftsObtains both plenteous nourishment and hero fame. To Jātavedas Agni, chief in sacrifices, first of allWith homage goes the ladle rich with sacred gifts. Even as Vyatya did, may we with these most high and liberal hymnsPay worship unto Agni of the splendid flame. Now sing, as Sthurayupa sang, with lands to him who spreadeth far,To Agni of the home, O Ṛṣi, Vyaśva's son. As welcome guest of human kind, as offspring of the forest kings,The sages worship ancient Agni for his aid. For men's oblations brought to him who is the mighty Lord of all,Sit, Agni, mid our homage, on the sacred grass. Grant us abundant. treasures, grant the opulence which many crave,With store of heroes, progeny, and high renown. Agni, Most Youthful of the Gods, send evermore the gift of wealthUnto Varosusaman and to all his folk. A mighty Conqueror art thou, O Agni, so disclose to usFood in our herds of kine and gain of ample wealth. Thou, Agni, art a glorious God: bring hither Mitra, Varuṇa,Imperial Sovrans, holy-minded, true to Law.

verses.sanskrit: ईळिष्वा हि प्रतीव्यं यजस्व जातवेदसं ।चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: ī́ḷiṣva ǀ hí ǀ pratīvyám ǀ yájasva ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀcariṣṇú-dhūmam ǀ ágṛbhīta-śociṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adore him who resists (our foes), worship Jātavedasthe diffuser of smoke, of unobstructed radiance.
verses.wilson_translation: Adore him who resists (our foes), worship Jātavedasthe diffuser of smoke, of unobstructed radiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दामानं विश्वचर्षणेऽग्निं विश्वमनो गिरा ।उत स्तुषे विष्पर्धसो रथानां ॥
verses.transliteration: dāmā́nam ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǀ agním ǀ viśva-manaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀutá ǀ stuṣe ǀ ví-spardhasaḥ ǀ ráthānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Commend with praise, all-beholding Viśvamanas, that Agni, who is the giver of chariots to theunenvious (worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: Commend with praise, all-beholding Viśvamanas, that Agni, who is the giver of chariots to theunenvious (worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येषामाबाध ऋग्मिय इषः पृक्षश्च निग्रभे ।उपविदा वह्निर्विंदते वसु ॥
verses.transliteration: yéṣām ǀ ā-bādháḥ ǀ ṛgmíyaḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pṛkṣáḥ ǀ ca ǀ ni-grábhe ǀupa-vídā ǀ váhniḥ ǀ vindate ǀ vásu ǁ
verses.english_translation: The repeller (of foes), the glorified by hyms, arrests the food and drink, and the bearer of oblationstakes away the wealth (of those) of whom he foreknows (the neglect of sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: The repeller (of foes), the glorified by hyms, arrests the food and drink, and the bearer of oblationstakes away the wealth (of those) of whom he foreknows (the neglect of sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदस्य शोचिरस्थाद्दीदियुषो व्यजरं ।तपुर्जंभस्य सुद्युतो गणश्रियः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ asya ǀ śocíḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ dīdiyúṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ajáram ǀtápuḥ-jambhasya ǀ su-dyútaḥ ǀ gaṇa-śríyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The imperishable lustre rises of that Agni, who is radiant, bright with blazing teech, resplendent, andglorious amid troops (of worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: The imperishable lustre rises of that Agni, who is radiant, bright with blazing teech, resplendent, andglorious amid troops (of worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वर स्तवानो देव्या कृपा ।अभिख्या भासा बृहता शुशुक्वनिः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ su-adhvara ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ devyā́ ǀ kṛpā́ ǀabhi-khyā́ ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ śuśukvániḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rise up with celestial splendour, you who are radiant with great and present lustre, who are worthilyworshipped and glorified.
verses.wilson_translation: Rise up with celestial splendour, you who are radiant with great and present lustre, who are worthilyworshipped and glorified.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिर्हव्या जुह्वान आनुषक् ।यथा दूतो बभूथ हव्यवाहनः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ yāhí ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ júhvānaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀyáthā ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ babhū́tha ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Proceed,Agni, with pious praises, offering in due order the oblations (to the gods), for you are theirmessenger, the bearer of oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Proceed,Agni, with pious praises, offering in due order the oblations (to the gods), for you are theirmessenger, the bearer of oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं हुवे होतारं चर्षणीनां ।तमया वाचा गृणे तमु वः स्तुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ huve ǀ hótāram ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀtám ǀ ayā́ ǀ vācā́ ǀ gṛṇe ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ stuṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke for you, (worshippers),Agni, the ancient ministrant priest of man, I praise him with this hymn, Iglorify him for you.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke for you, (worshippers),Agni, the ancient ministrant priest of man, I praise him with this hymn, Iglorify him for you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञेभिरद्भुतक्रतुं यं कृपा सूदयंत इत् ।मित्रं न जने सुधितमृतावनि ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñébhiḥ ǀ ádbhuta-kratum ǀ yám ǀ kṛpā́ ǀ sūdáyante ǀ ít ǀmitrám ǀ ná ǀ jáne ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ ṛtá-vani ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Worship him who is) of wondrous works, who, gladdened (by offerings), is present like a friend, whom(the priests) by their sacrifices, according to their power, render propitious to the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: (Worship him who is) of wondrous works, who, gladdened (by offerings), is present like a friend, whom(the priests) by their sacrifices, according to their power, render propitious to the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावानमृतायवो यज्ञस्य साधनं गिरा ।उपो एनं जुजुषुर्नमसस्पदे ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtá-vānam ǀ ṛta-yavaḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀ girā́ ǀúṣaḥ ǀ enam ǀ jujuṣuḥ ǀ námasaḥ ǀ padé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pious worshippers, at the plural ce of offerings adore with praise him who is gratified by worship, thecompleter of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Pious worshippers, at the plural ce of offerings adore with praise him who is gratified by worship, thecompleter of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा नो अंगिरस्तमं यज्ञासो यंतु संयतः ।होता यो अस्ति विक्ष्वा यशस्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamam ǀ yajñā́saḥ ǀ yantu ǀ sam-yátaḥ ǀhótā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ vikṣú ǀ ā́ ǀ yaśáḥ-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let our sacrificers, prepared (with their implements), present themselves before the chief of the Aṅgirasas, who is the most renowned offerer of oblations among men.
verses.wilson_translation: Let our sacrificers, prepared (with their implements), present themselves before the chief of the Aṅgirasas, who is the most renowned offerer of oblations among men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने तव त्ये अजरेंधानासो बृहद्भाः ।अश्वा इव वृषणस्तविषीयवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ táva ǀ tyé ǀ ajara ǀ índhānāsaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀáśvāḥ-iva ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ taviṣī-yávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These your vast blazing flames, undecaying Agni, are most powerful, vigorous as horses.
verses.wilson_translation: These your vast blazing flames, undecaying Agni, are most powerful, vigorous as horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं न ऊर्जां पते रयिं रास्व सुवीर्यं ।प्राव नस्तोके तनये समत्स्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjām ǀ pate ǀ rayím ǀ rāsva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀprá ǀ ava ǀ naḥ ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ samát-su ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, who are the lord of food, give us riches, withmaleoffspring; defend us, with our sons andgrandsons.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, who are the lord of food, give us riches, withmaleoffspring; defend us, with our sons andgrandsons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशि ।विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षांसि सेधति ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ śitáḥ ǀ sú-prītaḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ viśí ǀvíśvā ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ práti ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sedhati ǁ
verses.english_translation: When Agni, the lord of man, sharpened (by sacrifice), and, well plural ased, is present in the abode of aman, he verily defends it against all evil spirits.
verses.wilson_translation: When Agni, the lord of man, sharpened (by sacrifice), and, well plural ased, is present in the abode of aman, he verily defends it against all evil spirits.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते ।नि मायिनस्तपुषा रक्षसो दह ॥
verses.transliteration: śruṣṭī́ ǀ agne ǀ návasya ǀ me ǀ stómasya ǀ vīra ǀ viśpate ǀní ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ tápuṣā ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ daha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hero,Agni, lord of men, hearing this my present praise, consume the guilefulrākṣasasby yourflames.
verses.wilson_translation: Hero,Agni, lord of men, hearing this my present praise, consume the guilefulrākṣasasby yourflames.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य मायया चन रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः ।यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tásya ǀ māyáyā ǀ caná ǀ ripúḥ ǀ īśīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ dadā́śa ǀ havyádāti-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: No hostile mortal shall have power by fraud over him who by the (sacred) offerers of the oblationpresents (offerings) to Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: No hostile mortal shall have power by fraud over him who by the (sacred) offerers of the oblationpresents (offerings) to Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्यश्वस्त्वा वसुविदमुक्षण्युरप्रीणादृषिः ।महो राये तमु त्वा समिधीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ví-aśvaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ ukṣaṇyúḥ ǀ aprīṇāt ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ṛṣi Vyaśva, desirous (of propitiating) the showerer (of rain), has gratified you, the bestower ofwealth; so we too kindle you for (the acquisition of) ample riches.
verses.wilson_translation: The ṛṣi Vyaśva, desirous (of propitiating) the showerer (of rain), has gratified you, the bestower ofwealth; so we too kindle you for (the acquisition of) ample riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उशना काव्यस्त्वा नि होतारमसादयत् ।आयजिं त्वा मनवे जातवेदसं ॥
verses.transliteration: uśánā ǀ kāvyáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ní ǀ hótāram ǀ asādayat ǀā-yajím ǀ tvā ǀ mánave ǀ jātá-vedasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Uśanā, the son of Kavi, has established you,Jātavedas, as the ministrant priest, you as the offererof sacrifice, for Manu.
verses.wilson_translation: Uśanā, the son of Kavi, has established you,Jātavedas, as the ministrant priest, you as the offererof sacrifice, for Manu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत ।श्रुष्टी देव प्रथमो यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ ákrata ǀśruṣṭī́ ǀ deva ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ bhuvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the consentient gods have made you their messenger, may you, divine Agni, who are the first (of thedeities), quickly become the object of their worship.
verses.wilson_translation: All the consentient gods have made you their messenger, may you, divine Agni, who are the first (of thedeities), quickly become the object of their worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमं घा वीरो अमृतं दूतं कृण्वीत मर्त्यः ।पावकं कृष्णवर्तनिं विहायसं ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ gha ǀ vīráḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ dūtám ǀ kṛṇvīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀpāvakám ǀ kṛṣṇá-vartanim ǀ ví-hāyasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pious mortal has appointed this immortal, purifying, dark-moving, mighty (Agni), his messenger.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious mortal has appointed this immortal, purifying, dark-moving, mighty (Agni), his messenger.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं हुवेम यतस्रुचः सुभासं शुक्रशोचिषं ।विशामग्निमजरं प्रत्नमीड्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ huvema ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀ su-bhā́sam ǀ śukrá-śociṣam ǀviśā́m ǀ agním ǀ ajáram ǀ pratnám ǀ ī́ḍyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us with uplifted ladles invoke him, the brilliant, bright-shining, undecaying, ancient Agni, who is to beadored by men.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us with uplifted ladles invoke him, the brilliant, bright-shining, undecaying, ancient Agni, who is to beadored by men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो अस्मै हव्यदातिभिराहुतिं मर्तोऽविधत् ।भूरि पोषं स धत्ते वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ havyádāti-bhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ávidhat ǀbhū́ri ǀ póṣam ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man who by the (holy) presenters of oblations makes offerings to him, receives (from Agni) amplenourishment, withmaleprogeny, and fame.
verses.wilson_translation: The man who by the (holy) presenters of oblations makes offerings to him, receives (from Agni) amplenourishment, withmaleprogeny, and fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं जातवेदसमग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं ।प्रति स्रुगेति नमसा हविष्मती ॥
verses.transliteration: prathamám ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ agním ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǀpráti ǀ srúk ǀ eti ǀ námasā ǀ havíṣmatī ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ladle charged with the oblation proceeds with reverence at sacrifices to the ancient Agni, the first(of the gods), the cognizant of all that exists.
verses.wilson_translation: The ladle charged with the oblation proceeds with reverence at sacrifices to the ancient Agni, the first(of the gods), the cognizant of all that exists.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आभिर्विधेमाग्नये ज्येष्ठाभिर्व्यश्ववत् ।मंहिष्ठाभिर्मतिभिः शुक्रशोचिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́bhiḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ agnáye ǀ jyéṣṭhābhiḥ ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀmáṃhiṣṭhābhiḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ śukrá-śociṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us, like Vyaśva, glorify the brilliant Agniwith these excellent and most pious praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us, like Vyaśva, glorify the brilliant Agniwith these excellent and most pious praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नूनमर्च विहायसे स्तोमेभिः स्थूरयूपवत् ।ऋषे वैयश्व दम्यायाग्नये ॥
verses.transliteration: nūnám ǀ arca ǀ ví-hāyase ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ sthūrayūpa-vát ǀṛ́ṣe ǀ vaiyaśva ǀ dámyāya ǀ agnáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṛṣi, son of Vyaśva, adore the far-spreading domestic Agni, with praises, like Sthūrayūpa.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛṣi, son of Vyaśva, adore the far-spreading domestic Agni, with praises, like Sthūrayūpa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतिथिं मानुषाणां सूनुं वनस्पतीनां ।विप्रा अग्निमवसे प्रत्नमीळते ॥
verses.transliteration: átithim ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ sūnúm ǀ vánaspátīnām ǀvíprāḥ ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ pratnám ǀ īḷate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pious men glorify the ancient Agni, the guest of men, the son of the trees, for protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Pious men glorify the ancient Agni, the guest of men, the son of the trees, for protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महो विश्वाँ अभि षतोऽभि हव्यानि मानुषा ।अग्ने नि षत्सि नमसाधि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ abhí ǀ satáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ havyā́ni ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀágne ǀ ní ǀ satsi ǀ námasā ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sit down,Agni, on the sacred grass, in the presence of all those worshippers diligent (in pious works,induced) by their veneration (to accept) the oblations of men.
verses.wilson_translation: Sit down,Agni, on the sacred grass, in the presence of all those worshippers diligent (in pious works,induced) by their veneration (to accept) the oblations of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु वंस्व रायः पुरुस्पृहः ।सुवीर्यस्य प्रजावतो यशस्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: váṃsva ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǀ váṃsva ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀsu-vī́ryasya ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ yáśasvataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us (Agni) many desirable (things), grant us riches, envied by many, (comprehending) vigour,offspring, fame.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us (Agni) many desirable (things), grant us riches, envied by many, (comprehending) vigour,offspring, fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वरो सुषाम्णेऽग्ने जनाय चोदय ।सदा वसो रातिं यव���ष्ठ शश्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ varo íti ǀ su-sā́mne ǀ ágne ǀ jánāya ǀ codaya ǀsádā ǀ vaso íti ǀ rātím ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ śáśvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, (who are) the desired of all, the humbler (of foes), the youngest (of the gods), ever bestow richesupon the tranquil and constant man.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, (who are) the desired of all, the humbler (of foes), the youngest (of the gods), ever bestow richesupon the tranquil and constant man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सुप्रतूरसि त्वं नो गोमतीरिषः ।महो रायः सातिमग्ने अपा वृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ su-pratū́ḥ ǀ ási ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ sātím ǀ agne ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You verily are a liberal benefactor; bestow upon us,Agni, food, with cattle, and the gift of abundantriches.
verses.wilson_translation: You verily are a liberal benefactor; bestow upon us,Agni, food, with cattle, and the gift of abundantriches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं यशा अस्या मित्रावरुणा वह ।ऋतावाना सम्राजा पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ tvám ǀ yaśā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ ā́ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ vaha ǀṛtá-vānā ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ pūtá-dakṣasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agni, are renowned, bring hither the truthful, the purely vigorous, the resplendent deities Mitraand Varuṇa.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, are renowned, bring hither the truthful, the purely vigorous, the resplendent deities Mitraand Varuṇa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIV. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ३० विश्वमना वैयश्व: । इन्द्र:, २८-३० वरु: सौषाम्णि: । उष्णिक्, ३० अनुष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . COMPANIONS, let us learn a prayer to Indra. whom the thunder arms,To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend. For thou by slaying Vṛtra art the Vṛtra-slayer, famed for might.Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs. As such, when glorified, bring us riches of very wondrous fame,Set in the highest rank, Wealth-giver, Lord of Bays! Yea, Indra, thou disclosest that preeminent dear wealth of men:Boldly, O Bold One, glorified, bring it to us. The workers of destruction stay neither thy right hand nor thy left:Nor hosts that press about thee, Lord of Bays, in fight. O Thunder-armed, I come with songs to thee as to a stall with kine:Fulfil the wish and thought of him who sings thy praise. Chief Vṛtra-slayer, through the hymn of Visvamanas think of all,All that concerneth us, Excellent, Mighty Guide. May we, O Vṛtra-slayer, O Hero, find this thy newest boon, Longed-for, and excellent, thou who art much invoked! O Indra, Dancer, Much-invoked! as thy great power is unsurpassed,So be thy bounty to the worshipper unchecked. Most Mighty, most heroic One, for mighty bounty fill thee full.Though strong, strengthen thyself to win wealth, Maghavan! O Thunderer, never have our prayers gone forth to any God but thee:So help us, Maghavan, with thine assistance now. For, Dancer, verily I find none else for bounty, saving thee,For splendid wealth and power, thou Lover of the Song. For Indra pour ye out the drops meath blent with Soma let him drinkWith bounty and with majesty will he further us. I spake to the Bay Coursers' Lord, to him who gives ability:Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee. Never was any Hero born before thee mightier than thou:None certairdy like thee in goodness and in wealth. O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most:So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us. Indra, whom Tawny Coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent,None by his power or by his goodness hath attained. We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and mightWho must be glorified by constant sacri fice. Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends, the Hero who deserves the laud,Him who with none to aid o’ercomes all tribes of men. To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, Celestial God,Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than meath. Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne’er may be surpassed,Whose liberality, like light, is over all. As Vyaśva did, praise Indra, praise the Strong unfluctuating Guide,Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper. Now, son of Vyaśva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new,The very Wise, whom living men must glorify Thou knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive powers,As one secure from pitfalls each returning day. O Indra, bring that aid wherewith of old, Most Wondrous! thou didst slayHis foes for active Kutsa: send it down to us. So now we seek thee fresh in might, Most Wonderful in act! for gain:For thou art he who conquers all our foes for us. Who will set free from ruinous woe, or Ārya on the Seven Streams:O valiant Hero, bend the Dāsa's weapon down. As to Varosusaman thou broughtest great riches, for their gain,To Vyaśva's sons, Blest Lady, rich in ample wealth! Let Narya's sacrificial meed reach Vyaśva's Soma-bearing sons:In hundreds and in thousands be the great reward. If one should ask thee, Where is he who sacrificed? Whither lookest thou?Like Vala he hath passed away and dwelleth now on Gomati.

verses.sanskrit: सखाय आ शिषामहि ब्रह्मेंद्राय वज्रिणे ।स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śiṣāmahi ǀ bráhma ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀstuṣé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vaḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamāya ǀ dhṛṣṇáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us earnestly, friends, address our prayer to Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, for you I praise thechief leader (in battles), the resolute (opposer of foes).
verses.wilson_translation: Let us earnestly, friends, address our prayer to Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, for you I praise thechief leader (in battles), the resolute (opposer of foes).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा ।मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि ॥
verses.transliteration: śávasā ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátyena ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀmagháiḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ áti ǀ śūra ǀ dāśasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are renowned for strength; from the slaying of Vṛtra, you are (famed as) Vṛtrahan; you surpass,hero, the opulent in the donation of your riches.
verses.wilson_translation: You are renowned for strength; from the slaying of Vṛtra, you are (famed as) Vṛtrahan; you surpass,hero, the opulent in the donation of your riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः स्तवान आ भर रयिं चित्रश्रवस्तमं ।निरेके चिद्यो हरिवो वसुर्ददिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ rayím ǀ citráśravaḥ-tamam ǀnireké ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praised by us, bestow upon us riches of wonderful variety; you, the lord of steeds, who, at the issue (ofyour weapons) put your enemies to flight, are the donor (of treasures).
verses.wilson_translation: Praised by us, bestow upon us riches of wonderful variety; you, the lord of steeds, who, at the issue (ofyour weapons) put your enemies to flight, are the donor (of treasures).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ निरेकमुत प्रियमिंद्र दर्षि जनानां ।धृषता धृष्णो स्तवमान आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nirekám ǀ utá ǀ priyám ǀ índra ǀ dárṣi ǀ jánānām ǀdhṛṣatā́ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ stávamānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Burst open to your worshippers,Indra, the highly prized wealth; glorified by us, do you who areendowed with resolution, bring (us wealth) with a resolute (mind).
verses.wilson_translation: Burst open to your worshippers,Indra, the highly prized wealth; glorified by us, do you who areendowed with resolution, bring (us wealth) with a resolute (mind).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न ते सव्यं न दक्षिणं हस्तं वरंत आमुरः ।न परिबाधो हरिवो गविष्टिषु ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ savyám ǀ ná ǀ dákṣiṇam ǀ hástam ǀ varante ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀná ǀ pari-bā́dhaḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of steeds, in the recovery of the cattle the opponents resist not your lefthandnor your right, yourenemies (resist you) not.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of steeds, in the recovery of the cattle the opponents resist not your lefthandnor your right, yourenemies (resist you) not.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा गोभिरिव व्रजं गीर्भिर्ऋणोम्यद्रिवः ।आ स्मा कामं जरितुरा मनः पृण ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ góbhiḥ-iva ǀ vrajám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ṛṇomi ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀā́ ǀ sma ǀ kā́mam ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ pṛṇa ǁ
verses.english_translation: I approach you, thunderer, with praises, as (a cowherd goes) with cattle to the pasture; gratify thedesire, satisfy the mind of your adorer.
verses.wilson_translation: I approach you, thunderer, with praises, as (a cowherd goes) with cattle to the pasture; gratify thedesire, satisfy the mind of your adorer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानि विश्वमनसो धिया नो वृत्रहंतम ।उग्र प्रणेतरधि षू वसो गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ viśvá-manasaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀúgra ǀ pranetaríti pra-netaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sú ǀ vaso íti ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fierce destroyer of Vṛtra, bringer (of wealth to your worshippers), subduer of enemies, preside over all(the offerings) of us, Visvamanasa, with a (favourable) mind.
verses.wilson_translation: Fierce destroyer of Vṛtra, bringer (of wealth to your worshippers), subduer of enemies, preside over all(the offerings) of us, Visvamanasa, with a (favourable) mind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्विद्याम शूर नव्यसः ।वसोः स्पार्हस्य पुरुहूत राधसः ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ asyá ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ śūra ǀ návyasaḥ ǀvásoḥ ǀ spārhásya ǀ puru-hūta ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, hero, slayer of Vṛtra, invoked of many become possessed of this your new, desirable, andhappiness producing wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, hero, slayer of Vṛtra, invoked of many become possessed of this your new, desirable, andhappiness producing wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र यथा ह्यस्ति तेऽपरीतं नृतो शवः ।अमृक्ता रातिः पुरुहूत दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ yáthā ǀ hí ǀ ásti ǀ te ǀ ápari-itam ǀ nṛto íti ǀ śávaḥ ǀámṛktā ǀ rātíḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: As,Indra, inspirer (of men), your strength is irresistible, (so) invoked of many, your munificence to thedonor (of oblations) cannot be marred.
verses.wilson_translation: As,Indra, inspirer (of men), your strength is irresistible, (so) invoked of many, your munificence to thedonor (of oblations) cannot be marred.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वृषस्व महामह महे नृतम राधसे ।दृळ्हश्चिद्दृह्य मघवन्मघत्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ mahā-maha ǀ mahé ǀ nṛ-tama ǀ rā́dhase ǀdṛḷháḥ ǀ cit ǀ dṛhya ǀ magha-van ǀ magháttaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most adorable, chief leader (of men), invigorate (yourself with the Soma) for (the conquest of) greatwealth; consume,Maghavan, the strong (cities of theasuras) for the rich spoil.
verses.wilson_translation: Most adorable, chief leader (of men), invigorate (yourself with the Soma) for (the conquest of) greatwealth; consume,Maghavan, the strong (cities of theasuras) for the rich spoil.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू अन्यत्रा चिदद्रिवस्त्वन्नो जग्मुराशसः ।मघवंछग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ anyátra ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ tvát ǀ naḥ ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǀmágha-van ǀ śagdhí ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wielder of the thunderbolt, our solicitations have been formerly addressed to other gods, than you; giveus,Maghavan, of your (spoil and guard it) for us with (your) protections.
verses.wilson_translation: Wielder of the thunderbolt, our solicitations have been formerly addressed to other gods, than you; giveus,Maghavan, of your (spoil and guard it) for us with (your) protections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नह्यंग नृतो त्वदन्यं विंदामि राधसे ।राये द्युम्नाय शवसे च गिर्वणः ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ aṅgá ǀ nṛto íti ǀ tvát ǀ anyám ǀ vindā́mi ǀ rā́dhase ǀrāyé ǀ dyumnā́ya ǀ śávase ǀ ca ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily, impeller (of men), who are to be worshipped by praise, I apply to no other than you forsustenance, riches, reputation, and strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily, impeller (of men), who are to be worshipped by praise, I apply to no other than you forsustenance, riches, reputation, and strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एंदुमिंद्राय सिंचत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु ।प्र राधसा चोदयाते महित्वना ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ índum ǀ índrāya ǀ siñcata ǀ píbāti ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀprá ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ codayāte ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effuse the Somafor Indra, let him quaff the Soma; he by his might rewards (the donor) with wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Effuse the Somafor Indra, let him quaff the Soma; he by his might rewards (the donor) with wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उपो हरीणां पतिं दक्षं पृंचंतमब्रवं ।नूनं श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ hárīṇām ǀ pátim ǀ dákṣam ǀ pṛñcántam ǀ abravam ǀnūnám ǀ śrudhi ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ aśvyásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let me address the lord of steeds, who associates his strength (with the Maruts); now hear the words ofthe son of Vyaśvapraising you.
verses.wilson_translation: Let me address the lord of steeds, who associates his strength (with the Maruts); now hear the words ofthe son of Vyaśvapraising you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नह्यंग पुरा चन जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् ।नकी राया नैवथा न भंदना ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ aṅgá ǀ purā́ ǀ caná ǀ jajñé ǀ vīrá-taraḥ ǀ tvát ǀnákiḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ ná ǀ evá-thā ǀ ná ǀ bhandánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: No one,Indra, has ever been born more mighty than you, no one (surpassing you) in riches; no one(more powerful) in protection; no one (more entitled) to praise.
verses.wilson_translation: No one,Indra, has ever been born more mighty than you, no one (surpassing you) in riches; no one(more powerful) in protection; no one (more entitled) to praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एदु मध्वो मदिंतरं सिंच वाध्वर्यो अंधसः ।एवा हि वीरः स्तवते सदावृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ madín-taram ǀ siñcá ǀ vā ǀ adhvaryo íti ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀevá ǀ hí ǀ vīráḥ ǀ stávate ǀ sadā́-vṛdhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour out, priest, the most exhilarating (draught) of the sweet (sacrificial)Soma, for he, the ever-mightyhero, alone is praised.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour out, priest, the most exhilarating (draught) of the sweet (sacrificial)Soma, for he, the ever-mightyhero, alone is praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र स्थातर्हरीणां नकिष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिं ।उदानंश शवसा न भंदना ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ harīṇām ǀ nákiḥ ǀ te ǀ pūrvyá-stutim ǀút ǀ ānaṃśa ǀ śávasā ǀ ná ǀ bhandánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, ruler of horses, no one surpasses your ancient praise, either for force or for fame.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, ruler of horses, no one surpasses your ancient praise, either for force or for fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः ।अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ vā́jānām ǀ pátim ǀ áhūmahi ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀáprāyu-bhiḥ ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ vavṛdhényam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous of food, we invoke your lord of viands, who is to be magnified by sacrifices (offered) byattentive (worshipers).
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of food, we invoke your lord of viands, who is to be magnified by sacrifices (offered) byattentive (worshipers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतो न्विंद्रं स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरं ।कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत् ॥
verses.transliteration: éto íti ǀ nú ǀ índram ǀ stávāma ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ stómyam ǀ náram ǀkṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ásti ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, freinds, let us glorify Indra, the leader, who is entitled to praise, who, single, overcomes allhostile hosts.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, freinds, let us glorify Indra, the leader, who is entitled to praise, who, single, overcomes allhostile hosts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अगोरुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः ।घृतात्स्वादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत ॥
verses.transliteration: ágo-rudhāya ǀ go-íṣe ǀ dyukṣā́ya ǀ dásmyam ǀ vácaḥ ǀghṛtā́t ǀ svā́dīyaḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vocata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Recite agreeable words, sweeter than clarified butter, or than Soma, to the illustrious (Indra), who isgratified by eulogy, who rejects not praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Recite agreeable words, sweeter than clarified butter, or than Soma, to the illustrious (Indra), who isgratified by eulogy, who rejects not praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्यामितानि वीर्या न राधः पर्येतवे ।ज्योतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ ámitāni ǀ vīryā́ ǀ ná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ pári-etave ǀjyótiḥ ǀ ná ǀ víśvam ǀ abhí ǀ ásti ǀ dákṣiṇā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose energies are unbounded, whose wealth cannot be carried away, whose bounty extends like thefirmament over all.
verses.wilson_translation: Whose energies are unbounded, whose wealth cannot be carried away, whose bounty extends like thefirmament over all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तुहींद्रं व्यश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमं ।अर्यो गयं मंहमानं वि दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: stuhí ǀ índram ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀ ánūrmim ǀ vājínam ǀ yámam ǀaryáḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ máṃhamānam ǀ ví ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorify Indra, the unassailable, the powerful, the regulator (of man), as was done by Vyaśva, he, thelord, gives a spacious dwelling to the donor (of the oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: Glorify Indra, the unassailable, the powerful, the regulator (of man), as was done by Vyaśva, he, thelord, gives a spacious dwelling to the donor (of the oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा नूनमुप स्तुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवं ।सुविद्वांसं चर्कृत्यं चरणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ nūnám ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ váiyaśva ǀ daśamám ǀ návam ǀsú-vidvāṃsam ǀ carkṛ́tyam ǀ caráṇīnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise verily at present, son of Vyaśva, praise (Indra), who is the tenth of the pervading (vitalprinciples), the adorable, the all-wise to be honoured repeatedly (by sacred rites).
verses.wilson_translation: Praise verily at present, son of Vyaśva, praise (Indra), who is the tenth of the pervading (vitalprinciples), the adorable, the all-wise to be honoured repeatedly (by sacred rites).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वेत्था हि निर्ऋतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजं ।अहरहः शुंध्युः परिपदामिव ॥
verses.transliteration: véttha ǀ hí ǀ níḥ-ṛtīnām ǀ vájra-hasta ǀ pari-vṛ́jam ǀáhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ śundhyúḥ ǀ paripádām-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are cognizant, wielder of the thunderbolt, of the departure of evil beings, as the purifying sun dayby day (is of that) of the birds flying in all directions (from their roost).
verses.wilson_translation: You are cognizant, wielder of the thunderbolt, of the departure of evil beings, as the purifying sun dayby day (is of that) of the birds flying in all directions (from their roost).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदिंद्राव आ भर येना दंसिष्ठ कृत्वने ।द्विता कुत्साय शिश्नथो नि चोदय ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ indra ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ yéna ǀ daṃsiṣṭha ǀ kṛ́tvane ǀdvitā́ ǀ kútsāya ǀ śiśnathaḥ ǀ ní ǀ codaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, of goodly aspect, bring to the offerer (of the oblation) that (protection) wherewith to defend himyou have twice slain (the goe) for Kutsa; show the same (care of us).
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, of goodly aspect, bring to the offerer (of the oblation) that (protection) wherewith to defend himyou have twice slain (the goe) for Kutsa; show the same (care of us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमीमहे नव्यं दंसिष्ठ सन्यसे ।स त्वं नो विश्वा अभिमातीः सक्षणिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ nūnám ǀ īmahe ǀ návyam ǀ daṃsiṣṭha ǀ sányase ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ sakṣáṇiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra) of goodly aspect, we implore you who are entitled to praise, for (our) preservation; for you arethe overcomer of all our adversaries.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra) of goodly aspect, we implore you who are entitled to praise, for (our) preservation; for you arethe overcomer of all our adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य ऋक्षादंहसो मुचद्यो वार्यात्सप्त सिंधुषु ।वधर्दासस्य तुविनृम्ण नीनमः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛ́kṣāt ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ mucát ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ ā́ryāt ǀ saptá ǀ síndhuṣu ǀvádhaḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇa ǀ nīnamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (He it is) who rescues men from the wickedness of evil beings, who enriches (the dwellers) on theseven rivers; now hurl, you who abound in wealth, your weapon at the Dāsa.
verses.wilson_translation: (He it is) who rescues men from the wickedness of evil beings, who enriches (the dwellers) on theseven rivers; now hurl, you who abound in wealth, your weapon at the Dāsa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यथा वरो सुषाम्णे सनिभ्य आवहो रयिं ।व्यश्वेभ्यः सुभगे वाजिनीवति ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ varo íti ǀ su-sā́mne ǀ saní-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ávahaḥ ǀ rayím ǀví-aśvebhyaḥ ǀ su-bhage ǀ vājinī-vati ǁ
verses.english_translation: As you, Varu, have distributed vast wealth to those who have solicited (riches) on behalf of Susāman,(so do you now distribute) to the descendants of Vyaśva; (and so too you), auspicious food-bestowing (Uṣas).
verses.wilson_translation: As you, Varu, have distributed vast wealth to those who have solicited (riches) on behalf of Susāman,(so do you now distribute) to the descendants of Vyaśva; (and so too you), auspicious food-bestowing (Uṣas).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नार्यस्य दक्षिणा व्यश्वाँ एतु सोमिनः ।स्थूरं च राधः शतवत्सहस्रवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nāryásya ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ ví-aśvān ǀ etu ǀ somínaḥ ǀsthūrám ǀ ca ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ śatá-vat ǀ sahásra-vat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the gifts of a humane (price), when offering the Somalibation, extend to the Vyaśvas, yes, andsubstantial wealthy by hundreds and thousands.
verses.wilson_translation: May the gifts of a humane (price), when offering the Somalibation, extend to the Vyaśvas, yes, andsubstantial wealthy by hundreds and thousands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वा पृच्छादीजानः कुहया कुहयाकृते ।एषो अपश्रितो वलो गोमतीमव तिष्ठति ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ pṛcchā́t ǀ ījānáḥ ǀ kuhayā́ ǀ kuhayā-kṛte ǀeṣáḥ ǀ ápa-śritaḥ ǀ valáḥ ǀ go-matī́m ǀ áva ǀ tiṣṭhati ǁ
verses.english_translation: If any ask of you, (Uṣas), when anywhere present, where the sacrificer (Varu dwells), (reply) thepowerful (prince), the refuge of all, abides on (the banks of) the Gomatīriver.
verses.wilson_translation: If any ask of you, (Uṣas), when anywhere present, where the sacrificer (Varu dwells), (reply) thepowerful (prince), the refuge of all, abides on (the banks of) the Gomatīriver.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXV. Mitra-Varuṇa.
hymns.anukramani: २४ विश्वमना  वैयश्व: । मित्रावरुणौ, १०-१२ विश्वे देवा : । उष्णिक् ,२३ उष्णिग्गर्भा ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I WORSHIP you who guard this All, Gods, holiest among the Gods,You, faithful to the Law, whose power is sanctified. So, too, like charioteers are they, Mitra and sapient Varuṇa,Sons high-born from of old, whose holy laws stand fast. These Twain, possessors of all wealth, most glorious, for supremest swayAditi, Mighty Mother, true to Law, brought forth. Great Varuṇa and Mitra, Gods, Asuras and imperial Lords,True to Eternal Law proclaim the high decree. The offspring of a lofty Power, Dakṣa's Two Sons exceeding strong,Who, Lords of flowing rain, dwell in the place of food. Ye who have gathered up your gifts, celestial and terrestrial food,Let your rain come to us fraught with the mist of heaven. The Twain, who from the lofty sky seem to look down on herds below,Holy, imperial Lords, are set to be revered. They, true to Law, exceeding strong, have sat them down for savran rule:Princes whose laws stand fast, they have obtained their sway. Pathfinders even better than the eye, with unobstructed sight,Even when they close their lids, observant, they perceive. So may the Goddess Aditi, may the Nāsatyas guard us well,The Martits guard us well,.endowed with mighty strength. Do ye, O Bounteous Gods, protect our dwelling lace by day and night:With you for our defenders may we go unharmed. May we, unharmed, serve bountiful Viṣṇu, the God who slayeth none:Self-moving Sindhu hear and be the first to mark. This sure protection we elect, desirable and reaching far,Which Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman afford. And may the Sindhu of the floods, the Maruts, and the ASvin Pair,Boon Indra, and boon Viṣṇu have one mind with us. Because these warring Heroes stay the enmity of every foe,As the fierce water-flood repels the furious ones. Here this one God, the Lord of men, looks forth exceeding far and wide:And we, for your advantage, keep his holy laws. We keep the old accustomed laws, the statutes of supremacy,The Iong-known laws of Mitra and of Varuṇa. He who hath measured with his ray the boundaries of heaven and earth,And with his majesty hath filled the two worlds full, Sūrya hath spread his light aloft up to the region of the sky,Like Agni all aflame when gifts are offered him. With him who sits afar the word is lord of food that comes from kine,Controller of the gift of unempoisoned food. So unto Sūrya, Heaven, and Earth at morning and at eve I speak.Bringing enjoyments ever rise thou up for us. From Uksanyayana a bay, from Harayana a white steed,And from Susaman we obtained a hamessed car. These two shall bring me further gain of troops of tawny-coloured steeds,The carriers shall they be of active men of war. And the two sages have I gained who hold the reins and bear the whip,And the two great strong coursers, with my newest song.

verses.sanskrit: ता वां विश्वस्य गोपा देवा देवेषु यज्ञिया ।ऋतावाना यजसे पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvasya ǀ gopā́ ǀ devā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyā ǀṛtá-vānā ǀ yajase ǀ pūtá-dakṣasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You two are the protectors of the universe, divine and to be adored among the gods; therefore,(Viśvamanas), you sacrifice to the pair who are observant of truth and endowed with real power.
verses.wilson_translation: You two are the protectors of the universe, divine and to be adored among the gods; therefore,(Viśvamanas), you sacrifice to the pair who are observant of truth and endowed with real power.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रा तना न रथ्या वरुणो यश्च सुक्रतुः ।सनात्सुजाता तनया धृतव्रता ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrā́ ǀ tánā ǀ ná ǀ rathyā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀsanā́t ǀ su-jātā́ ǀ tánayā ǀ dhṛtá-vratā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, doers of good deeds, (diffusers of) riches, who are the charioteers (of men),well-born of old, the sons, (of Aditi), observant of vows, (you are worshipped by me).
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, doers of good deeds, (diffusers of) riches, who are the charioteers (of men),well-born of old, the sons, (of Aditi), observant of vows, (you are worshipped by me).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता माता विश्ववेदसासुर्याय प्रमहसा ।मही जजानादितिर्ऋतावरी ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ viśvá-vedasā ǀ asuryā́ya ǀ prá-mahasā ǀmahī́ ǀ jajāna ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ṛtá-varī ǁ
verses.english_translation: The great and truthful Aditi, the mother (of the gods), gave birth to those two who are possessed of allaffluence, and shining with great splendour, for the (destruction of the)asuras.
verses.wilson_translation: The great and truthful Aditi, the mother (of the gods), gave birth to those two who are possessed of allaffluence, and shining with great splendour, for the (destruction of the)asuras.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महांता मित्रावरुणा सम्राजा देवावसुरा ।ऋतावानावृतमा घोषतो बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́ntā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ deváu ǀ ásurā ǀṛtá-vānau ǀ ṛtám ǀ ā́ ǀ ghoṣataḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The great Mitraand Varuṇa, the two sovereign and powerful deities, the observers of truth, illumine oursolemn rite.
verses.wilson_translation: The great Mitraand Varuṇa, the two sovereign and powerful deities, the observers of truth, illumine oursolemn rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नपाता शवसो महः सूनू दक्षस्य सुक्रतू ।सृप्रदानू इषो वास्त्वधि क्षितः ॥
verses.transliteration: nápātā ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ sūnū́ íti ǀ dákṣasya ǀ sukrátū íti su-krátū ǀsṛprádānū íti sṛprá-dānū ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ vā́stu ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣitaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grandson sof mighty strength, son sof energy, doers of good deeds, liberal benefactors, they presideover the habitation of food.
verses.wilson_translation: Grandson sof mighty strength, son sof energy, doers of good deeds, liberal benefactors, they presideover the habitation of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सं या दानूनि येमथुर्दिव्याः पार्थिवीरिषः ।नभस्वतीरा वां चरंतु वृष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ yā́ ǀ dā́nūni ǀ yemáthuḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀnábhasvatīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ carantu ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow (upon us) good gifts, viands, whether of heaven or earth; may the water-shedding rains attendupon you.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow (upon us) good gifts, viands, whether of heaven or earth; may the water-shedding rains attendupon you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधि या बृहतो दिवोऽभि यूथेव पश्यतः ।ऋतावाना सम्राजा नमसे हिता ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhi ǀ yā́ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ páśyataḥ ǀṛtá-vānā ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ námase ǀ hitā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (These are they) who look upon the great deities as (a bull contemplates) the herd, sovereignsobservant of truth and propitious to adoration.
verses.wilson_translation: (These are they) who look upon the great deities as (a bull contemplates) the herd, sovereignsobservant of truth and propitious to adoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावाना नि षेदतुः साम्राज्याय सुक्रतू ।धृतव्रता क्षत्रिया क्षत्रमाशतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtá-vānā ǀ ní ǀ sedatuḥ ǀ sā́m-rājyāya ǀ sukrátū íti su-krátū ǀdhṛtá-vratā ǀ kṣatríyā ǀ kṣatrám ǀ āśatuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Observers of truth, doers of good deeds, they sit down for the office of sovereignty; observant ofobligations, endowed with strength, they acquire vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Observers of truth, doers of good deeds, they sit down for the office of sovereignty; observant ofobligations, endowed with strength, they acquire vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अक्ष्णश्चिद्गातुवित्तरानुल्बणेन चक्षसा ।नि चिन्मिषंता निचिरा नि चिक्यतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: akṣṇáḥ ǀ cit ǀ gātuvít-tarā ǀ anulbaṇéna ǀ cákṣasā ǀní ǀ cit ǀ miṣántā ǀ ni-cirā́ ǀ ní ǀ cikyatuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Through knowers of the path, even before the eye (can see), causing (alll beings) to open their eyelids,existing from of old, and shining with a mild radiance, verily they have been worshipped.
verses.wilson_translation: Through knowers of the path, even before the eye (can see), causing (alll beings) to open their eyelids,existing from of old, and shining with a mild radiance, verily they have been worshipped.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो देव्यदितिरुरुष्यतां नासत्या ।उरुष्यंतु मरुतो वृद्धशवसः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ uruṣyátām ǀ nā́satyā ǀuruṣyántu ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vṛddhá-śavasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the divine Aditi, may the Nāsatyāsalso protect us; may the rapid Marutsdefend us.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine Aditi, may the Nāsatyāsalso protect us; may the rapid Marutsdefend us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो नावमुरुष्यत दिवा नक्तं सुदानवः ।अरिष्यंतो नि पायुभिः सचेमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ nāvám ǀ uruṣyata ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀáriṣyantaḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ sacemahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Munificent and irresistible (Maruts), guard our vessel by day and night, so that we may be securethrough your protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Munificent and irresistible (Maruts), guard our vessel by day and night, so that we may be securethrough your protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अघ्नते विष्णवे वयमरिष्यंतः सुदानवे ।श्रुधि स्वयावन्त्सिंधो पूर्वचित्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: ághnate ǀ víṣṇave ǀ vayám ǀ áriṣyantaḥ ǀ su-dā́nave ǀśrudhí ǀ sva-yāvan ǀ sindho íti ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, injured (through his protection, offer praise) to the liberal Viṣṇu, who harms not (his adorers); doyou who goes by thyself alone (to combat), and cause wealth to flow (to the worshipper), hear (our prayer) inbehalf of him who has commenced the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: We, injured (through his protection, offer praise) to the liberal Viṣṇu, who harms not (his adorers); doyou who goes by thyself alone (to combat), and cause wealth to flow (to the worshipper), hear (our prayer) inbehalf of him who has commenced the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तद्वार्यं वृणीमहे वरिष्ठं गोपयत्यं ।मित्रो यत्पांति वरुणो यदर्यमा ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ vā́ryam ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ váriṣṭham ǀ gopayátyam ǀmitráḥ ǀ yát ǀ pā́nti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yát ǀ aryamā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit that ample, all-desired, all-guarding (wealth) which Mitra,Varuṇaand Aryamanhold undertheir protection.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit that ample, all-desired, all-guarding (wealth) which Mitra,Varuṇaand Aryamanhold undertheir protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नः सिंधुरपां तन्मरुतस्तदश्विना ।इंद्रो विष्णुर्मीढ्वांसः सजोषसः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ tát ǀ marútaḥ ǀ tát ǀ aśvínā ǀíndraḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mīḍhvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yes, may he who causes the waters to flow (Parjanya), the Maruts, the Aśvins,Indra,Viṣṇu, may all(these deities) together, the showerers (of benefits, protect) that wealth for us.
verses.wilson_translation: Yes, may he who causes the waters to flow (Parjanya), the Maruts, the Aśvins,Indra,Viṣṇu, may all(these deities) together, the showerers (of benefits, protect) that wealth for us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते हि ष्मा वनुषो नरोऽभिमातिं कयस्य चित् ।तिग्मं न क्षोदः प्रतिघ्नंति भूर्णयः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ abhí-mātim ǀ káyasya ǀ cit ǀtigmám ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ prati-ghnánti ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those desirable leaders (of men), rapid in movement, break down the haughtiness of any (foe)whatever, as an impetuous current (sweeps away all obstacles).
verses.wilson_translation: Those desirable leaders (of men), rapid in movement, break down the haughtiness of any (foe)whatever, as an impetuous current (sweeps away all obstacles).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयमेक इत्था पुरूरु चष्टे वि विश्पतिः ।तस्य व्रतान्यनु वश्चरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ purú ǀ urú ǀ caṣṭe ǀ ví ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀtásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ánu ǀ vaḥ ǀ carāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: This one, the lord of man (Mitra), contemplates many vast things; we follow his rites for you.
verses.wilson_translation: This one, the lord of man (Mitra), contemplates many vast things; we follow his rites for you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु पूर्वाण्योक्या साम्राज्यस्य सश्चिम ।मित्रस्य व्रता वरुणस्य दीर्घश्रुत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ pū́rvāṇi ǀ okyā́ ǀ sām-rājyásya ǀ saścima ǀmitrásya ǀ vratā́ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dīrgha-śrút ǁ
verses.english_translation: We observe the ancient rites of the imperial Varuṇaand the renowned Mitra, (rites) that are good for(our) dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: We observe the ancient rites of the imperial Varuṇaand the renowned Mitra, (rites) that are good for(our) dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि यो रश्मिना दिवोऽंतान्ममे पृथिव्याः ।उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ yáḥ ǀ raśmínā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántān ǀ mamé ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ paprau ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Mitrais he) who has measured with his rays the limits of both heaven and earth; who has filled bothheaven and earth with his greatness.
verses.wilson_translation: (Mitrais he) who has measured with his rays the limits of both heaven and earth; who has filled bothheaven and earth with his greatness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु ष्य शरणे दिवो ज्योतिरयंस्त सूर्यः ।अग्निर्न शुक्रः समिधान आहुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ śaraṇé ǀ diváḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ayaṃsta ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukráḥ ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He,Sūrya, has uplifted his radiance in the region of the heaven; kindled and invoked withburnt-offerings, he is bright, like Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: He,Sūrya, has uplifted his radiance in the region of the heaven; kindled and invoked withburnt-offerings, he is bright, like Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वचो दीर्घप्रसद्मनीशे वाजस्य गोमतः ।ईशे हि पित्वोऽविषस्य दावने ॥
verses.transliteration: vácaḥ ǀ dīrghá-prasadmani ǀ ī́śe ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀī́śe ǀ hí ǀ pitváḥ ǀ aviṣásya ǀ dāváne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Raise your voice in the spacious hall of sacrifice (to him) who is lord over food derived from cattle, whois able to grant nutritious sustenance.
verses.wilson_translation: Raise your voice in the spacious hall of sacrifice (to him) who is lord over food derived from cattle, whois able to grant nutritious sustenance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्सूर्यं रोदसी उभे दोषा वस्तोरुप ब्रुवे ।भोजेष्वस्माँ अभ्युच्चरा सदा ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀbhojéṣu ǀ asmā́n ǀ abhí ǀ út ǀ cara ǀ sádā ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify by night and day that sun (Mitraand Varuṇa) and both the heaven and earth; do you (Varuṇa)ever bring us to the presence of the bountiful.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify by night and day that sun (Mitraand Varuṇa) and both the heaven and earth; do you (Varuṇa)ever bring us to the presence of the bountiful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋज्रमुक्षण्यायने रजतं हरयाणे ।रथं युक्तमसनाम सुषामणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛjrám ǀ ukṣaṇyā́yane ǀ rajatám ǀ hárayāṇe ǀrátham ǀ yuktám ǀ asanāma ǀ su-sā́mani ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have received from the son of Suṣāman, the descendant of Ukṣan, the overcomer (of foes), awell-going chariot of silver, yoked (with a pair of horses).
verses.wilson_translation: We have received from the son of Suṣāman, the descendant of Ukṣan, the overcomer (of foes), awell-going chariot of silver, yoked (with a pair of horses).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता मे अश्व्यानां हरीणां नितोशना ।उतो नु कृत्व्यानां नृवाहसा ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ me ǀ áśvyānām ǀ hárīṇām ǀ ni-tóśanā ǀutó íti ǀ nú ǀ kṛ́tvyānām ǀ nṛ-vā́hasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Among bay horses these two are pre-eminently the destroyers (of foes), and of those eager in combat;the two strong bearers of men.
verses.wilson_translation: Among bay horses these two are pre-eminently the destroyers (of foes), and of those eager in combat;the two strong bearers of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्मदभीशू कशावंता विप्रा नविष्ठया मती ।महो वाजिनावर्वंता सचासनं ॥
verses.transliteration: smádabhīśū íti smát-abhīśū ǀ káśā-vantā ǀ víprā ǀ náviṣṭhayā ǀ matī́ ǀmaháḥ ǀ vājínau ǀ árvantā ǀ sácā ǀ asanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Through this new praise (of Mitraand Varuṇa) I have obtained at the same moment of the mightyprince, two fast-going sagacious steeds, with whip and reins.
verses.wilson_translation: Through this new praise (of Mitraand Varuṇa) I have obtained at the same moment of the mightyprince, two fast-going sagacious steeds, with whip and reins.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVI. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I CALL your chariot to receive united praise mid princely men,Strong Gods who pour down wealth, of never vanquished might! Ye to Varosusaman come, Nāsatyas, for this glorious rite.With your protecting aid. Strong Gods, who pour down wealth. So with oblations we invoke you, rich in ample wealth, to-day,When night hath passed, O ye who send us plenteous food.O Aśvins, Heroes, let your car, famed, best to travel, come to us,And, for his glory, mark your zealous servant's lauds. Aśvins, who send us precious gifts, even when offended, think of him:For ye, O Rudras, lead us safe beyond our foes. For, Wonder-Workers, with fleet steeds ye fly completely round this All,Stirring our thoughts, ye Lords of splendour, honey-hued. With all-sustaining opulence, Aśvins, come hitherward to us,Ye rich and noble Heroes, ne’er to be o’erthrown. To welcome this mine offering, O ye Indra-like Nāsatyas, comeAs Gods of best accord this day with other Gods. For we, like Vyaśva, lifting up our voice like oxen, call on you:With all your loving kindness, Sages, come to us. O Ṛṣi, laud the Aśvins well. Will they not listen to thy call?Will they not burn the Paṇis who are nearer them? O Heroes, listen to the son of Vyaśva, and regard me here,Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, of one accord. Gods whom we yearn for, of your gifts, of what ye bring to us, bestowBy princes' hands on me, ye Mighty, day by day. Him whom your sacrifices clothe, even as a woman with her robe,The Aśvins help to glory honouring him well. Whoso regards your care of men as succour widest in its reach,About his dwelling go, ye Aśvins, loving us. Come to us ye who pour down wealth, come to the home which men must guard:Like shafts, ye are made meet for sacrifice by song. Most fetching of all calls, the laud, as envoy, Heroes, called to youBe it your own, O Aśvin Pair. Be ye in yonder sea of heaven, or joying in the home of food,Listen to me, Immortal Ones. This river with his lucid flow attracts you, more than all the streams,—Even Sindhu with his path of gold. O Aśvins, with that glorious fame come hither, through our brilliant song,Come ye whose ways are marked with light. Harness the steeds who draw the car, O Vasu, bring the well-fed pair.O Vāyu, drink thou of our meath: come unto our drink-offerings. Wonderful Vāyu, Lord of Right, thou who art Tvaṣṭar's son-in-law,Thy saving succour we elect. To Tvaṣṭar's son-in-law we pray for wealth whereof he hath control:For glory we seek vayu, men with juice effused. From heaven, auspicious Vāyu, come drive hither with thy noble steeds:Come on thy mighty car with wide-extending seat. We call thee to the homes of men, thee wealthiest in noble food,And liberal as a press-stone with a horse's back. So, glad and joyful in thine heart, do thou, God, Vāyu, first of allVouchsafe us water, strength, and thought.

verses.sanskrit: युवोरु षू रथं हुवे सधस्तुत्याय सूरिषु ।अतूर्तदक्षा वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ rátham ǀ huve ǀ sadhá-stutyāya ǀ sūríṣu ǀátūrta-dakṣā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Aśvins) of irresistible strength, affluent showerers (of benefits), I invoke your chariot amid the pious,who are assembled to celebrate your presence.
verses.wilson_translation: (Aśvins) of irresistible strength, affluent showerers (of benefits), I invoke your chariot amid the pious,who are assembled to celebrate your presence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं वरो सुषाम्णे महे तने नासत्या ।अवोभिर्याथो वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ varo íti ǀ su-sā́mne ǀ mahé ǀ táne ǀ nāsatyā ǀávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Say), Varu (thus),Nāsatyās, senders of rain, affluent showerers (of benefits), as you came to Suṣāman with your protections to (grant him) great riches, (so come to me).
verses.wilson_translation: (Say), Varu (thus),Nāsatyās, senders of rain, affluent showerers (of benefits), as you came to Suṣāman with your protections to (grant him) great riches, (so come to me).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता वामद्य हवामहे हव्येभिर्वाजिनीवसू ।पूर्वीरिष इषयंतावति क्षपः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ havāmahe ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ iṣáyantau ǀ áti ǀ kṣapáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Affluent in nourishment, we invoke you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) food, on this occasion at dawnwith oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Affluent in nourishment, we invoke you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) food, on this occasion at dawnwith oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां वाहिष्ठो अश्विना रथो यातु श्रुतो नरा ।उप स्तोमांतुरस्य दर्शथः श्रिये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ yātu ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ narā ǀúpa ǀ stómān ǀ turásya ǀ darśathaḥ ǀ śriyé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders (of rites), let your renowned all-conveying chariot come to us, and (do you) recognize thepraisers of the zealous (worshipper) for his prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders (of rites), let your renowned all-conveying chariot come to us, and (do you) recognize thepraisers of the zealous (worshipper) for his prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुहुराणा चिदश्विना मन्येथां वृषण्वसू ।युवं हि रुद्रा पर्षथो अति द्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: juhurāṇā́ ǀ cit ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ manyethām ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀyuvám ǀ hí ǀ rudrā ǀ párṣathaḥ ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, affluent showerers (of benefits), detect the guileful, verily,Rudras, vex your adversaries.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, affluent showerers (of benefits), detect the guileful, verily,Rudras, vex your adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दस्रा हि विश्वमानुषङ्मक्षूभिः परिदीयथः ।धियंजिन्वा मधुवर्णा शुभस्पती ॥
verses.transliteration: dasrā́ ǀ hí ǀ víśvam ǀ ānuṣák ǀ makṣú-bhiḥ ǀ pari-dī́yathaḥ ǀdhiyam-jinvā́ ǀ mádhu-varṇā ǀ śubháḥ ǀ pátī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Dasras, who are gratified by sacred rites, of fascinating complexion, lords of rain, pass with your fleet(horses) completely round our entier (sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Dasras, who are gratified by sacred rites, of fascinating complexion, lords of rain, pass with your fleet(horses) completely round our entier (sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप नो यातमश्विना राया विश्वपुषा सह ।मघवाना सुवीरावनपच्युता ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ rāyā́ ǀ viśva-púṣā ǀ sahá ǀmaghá-vānā ǀ su-vī́rau ǀ ánapa-cyutā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us,Aśvins, with all-supporting riches, for you are opulent, heroic, overthrown of none.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Aśvins, with all-supporting riches, for you are opulent, heroic, overthrown of none.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ मे अस्य प्रतीव्यमिंद्रनासत्या गतं ।देवा देवेभिरद्य सचनस्तमा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ pratīvyám ǀ índranāsatyā ǀ gatam ǀdevā́ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sacánaḥ-tamā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Nāsatyās, who are most accessible, come to this my sacrifice; come, gods, today with(other) divinities.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Nāsatyās, who are most accessible, come to this my sacrifice; come, gods, today with(other) divinities.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं हि वां हवामह उक्षण्यंतो व्यश्ववत् ।सुमतिभिरुप विप्राविहा गतं ॥
