verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ hávāmahe ǀ ukṣaṇyántaḥ ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀsumatí-bhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ viprau ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous of you who are bestowers of wealth, we invoke you, as did (your father)Vyaśva; come,sagacious Aśvins, here with favourable intentions.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of you who are bestowers of wealth, we invoke you, as did (your father)Vyaśva; come,sagacious Aśvins, here with favourable intentions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना स्वृषे स्तुहि कुवित्ते श्रवतो हवं ।नेदीयसः कूळयातः पणीँरुत ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvínā ǀ sú ǀ ṛṣe ǀ stuhi ǀ kuvít ǀ te ǀ śrávataḥ ǀ hávam ǀnédīyasaḥ ǀ kūḷayātaḥ ǀ paṇī́n ǀ utá ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise the Aśvinsdevoutly, Ṛṣi, that they may repeatedly hear your invocation, and destroy thenearest (approaching enemies) and the Paṇis.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise the Aśvinsdevoutly, Ṛṣi, that they may repeatedly hear your invocation, and destroy thenearest (approaching enemies) and the Paṇis.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वैयश्वस्य श्रुतं नरोतो मे अस्य वेदथः ।सजोषसा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ॥
verses.transliteration: vaiyaśvásya ǀ śrutam ǀ narā ǀ utó íti ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ vedathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hear, leaders (of rites), (the invocation) of me the son of Vyaśva, and understand its (purport), and may Varuṇa,Mitraans Aryamanconcurrently (grant me wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: Hear, leaders (of rites), (the invocation) of me the son of Vyaśva, and understand its (purport), and may Varuṇa,Mitraans Aryamanconcurrently (grant me wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवादत्तस्य धिष्ण्या युवानीतस्य सूरिभिः ।अहरहर्वृषण मह्यं शिक्षतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvā́-dattasya ǀ dhiṣṇyā ǀ yuvā́-nītasya ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀáhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ máhyam ǀ śikṣatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adorable showerers (of benefits), bestow daily upon me (some) of that (wealth) which is given by you,which is brought by you for the worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable showerers (of benefits), bestow daily upon me (some) of that (wealth) which is given by you,which is brought by you for the worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वां यज्ञेभिरावृतोऽधिवस्त्रा वधूरिव ।सपर्यंता शुभे चक्राते अश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ ā́-vṛtaḥ ǀ ádhi-vastrā ǀ vadhū́ḥ-iva ǀsaparyántā ǀ śubhé ǀ cakrāte íti ǀ aśvínā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The man who is enveloped in sacrifices (offered) to you, like a woman with additional raiment,rewarding him,Aśvins, you plural ce him in prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: The man who is enveloped in sacrifices (offered) to you, like a woman with additional raiment,rewarding him,Aśvins, you plural ce him in prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वामुरुव्यचस्तमं चिकेतति नृपाय्यं ।वर्तिरश्विना परि यातमस्मयू ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ uruvyácaḥ-tamam ǀ cíketati ǀ nṛ-pā́yyam ǀvartíḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ pári ǀ yātam ǀ asmayū́ ítyasma-yū́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Favourably disposed towards me, come,Aśvins, to the dwelling of him who knows (how to prepare foryou) the most copiously effused (libation) to be drunk by the leaders (of rites).
verses.wilson_translation: Favourably disposed towards me, come,Aśvins, to the dwelling of him who knows (how to prepare foryou) the most copiously effused (libation) to be drunk by the leaders (of rites).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं सु वृषण्वसू यातं वर्तिर्नृपाय्यं ।विषुद्रुहेव यज्ञमूहथुर्गिरा ॥
verses.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ sú ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ yātám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ nṛ-pā́yyam ǀviṣudrúhā-iva ǀ yajñám ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ girā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Affluent showerers (of benefits), come to our dwelling for (the libation) to be drunk by the leaders (ofrites), for you bring the sacrifice to completion by praise, as the fatal shaft (slays the deer).
verses.wilson_translation: Affluent showerers (of benefits), come to our dwelling for (the libation) to be drunk by the leaders (ofrites), for you bring the sacrifice to completion by praise, as the fatal shaft (slays the deer).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाहिष्ठो वां हवानां स्तोमो दूतो हुवन्नरा ।युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vām ǀ hávānām ǀ stómaḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ huvat ǀ narā ǀyuvā́bhyām ǀ bhūtu ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, leaders (of rites), among (all) invocations may my most earnest praise invoke you as amessenger may it be (acceptable) to you.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, leaders (of rites), among (all) invocations may my most earnest praise invoke you as amessenger may it be (acceptable) to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यददो दिवो अर्णव इषो वा मदथो गृहे ।श्रुतमिन्मे अमर्त्या ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ arṇavé ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ vā ǀ mádathaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀśrutám ǀ ít ǀ me ǀ amartyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether, immortal (Aśvins), you rejoice in the water of the firmament, or in the dwelling of theworshipper hear this my (invocation).
verses.wilson_translation: Whether, immortal (Aśvins), you rejoice in the water of the firmament, or in the dwelling of theworshipper hear this my (invocation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत स्या श्वेतयावरी वाहिष्ठा वां नदीनां ।सिंधुर्हिरण्यवर्तनिः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ syā́ ǀ śveta-yā́varī ǀ vā́hiṣṭhā ǀ vām ǀ nadī́nām ǀsíndhuḥ ǀ híraṇya-vartaniḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily this Śvetayāvarī, the golden-pathed river, is of all rivers the especial bearer of your (praises).
verses.wilson_translation: Verily this Śvetayāvarī, the golden-pathed river, is of all rivers the especial bearer of your (praises).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्मदेतया सुकीर्त्याश्विना श्वेतया धिया ।वहेथे शुभ्रयावाना ॥
verses.transliteration: smát ǀ etáyā ǀ su-kīrtyā́ ǀ áśvinā ǀ śvetáyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀváhethe íti ǀ śubhra-yāvānā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, following a brilliant course, you acquire celebrity by the white river worthily praising you theenricher (of the peole on its banks).
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, following a brilliant course, you acquire celebrity by the white river worthily praising you theenricher (of the peole on its banks).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि त्वं रथासहा युवस्व पोष्या वसो ।आन्नो वायो मधु पिबास्माकं सवना गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ tvám ǀ ratha-sáhā ǀ yuvásva ǀ póṣyā ǀ vaso íti ǀā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ vāyo íti ǀ mádhu ǀ piba ǀ asmā́kam ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yoke your chariot-drawing horses,Vāyu; bring them,Vasu, encouraged (to the sacrifice); then drinkour Soma, come to our daily libations.
verses.wilson_translation: Yoke your chariot-drawing horses,Vāyu; bring them,Vasu, encouraged (to the sacrifice); then drinkour Soma, come to our daily libations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव वायवृतस्पते त्वष्टुर्जामातरद्भुत ।अवांस्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ vāyo íti ǀ ṛtaḥ-pate ǀ tváṣṭuḥ ǀ jāmātaḥ ǀ adbhuta ǀávāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit your protection,Vāyu, lord of sacrifice wonderful son-in- law of Tvaṣṭā.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit your protection,Vāyu, lord of sacrifice wonderful son-in- law of Tvaṣṭā.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टुर्जामातरं वयमीशानं राय ईमहे ।सुतावंतो वायुं द्युम्ना जनासः ॥
verses.transliteration: tváṣṭuḥ ǀ jā́mātaram ǀ vayám ǀ ī́śānam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īmahe ǀsutá-vantaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, the offerers of Soma, solicit riches from the sovereign, the son- in-law of Tvaṣṭā; (may webecome) wealthy.
verses.wilson_translation: We, the offerers of Soma, solicit riches from the sovereign, the son- in-law of Tvaṣṭā; (may webecome) wealthy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वायो याहि शिवा दिवो वहस्वा सु स्वश्व्यं ।वहस्व महः पृथुपक्षसा रथे ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ yāhí ǀ śiva ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ váhasva ǀ sú ǀ su-áśvyam ǀváhasva ǀ maháḥ ǀ pṛthu-pákṣasā ǀ ráthe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Establish,Vāyu, happiness in heaven; bear quickly your well-horsed (chariot); do you, who are mighty,yoke the broad-flanked (horses) to the car.
verses.wilson_translation: Establish,Vāyu, happiness in heaven; bear quickly your well-horsed (chariot); do you, who are mighty,yoke the broad-flanked (horses) to the car.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां हि सुप्सरस्तमं नृषदनेषु हूमहे ।ग्रावाणं नाश्वपृष्ठं मंहना ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ supsáraḥ-tamam ǀ nṛ-sádaneṣu ǀ hūmáhe ǀgrā́vāṇam ǀ ná ǀ áśva-pṛṣṭham ǀ maṃhánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke you who are of graceful form, extending through your magnitude your limbs in all directions,to our religious rites, like the stone (for bruising the Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke you who are of graceful form, extending through your magnitude your limbs in all directions,to our religious rites, like the stone (for bruising the Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं नो देव मनसा वायो मंदानो अग्रियः ।कृधि वाजाँ अपो धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ deva ǀ mánasā ǀ vā́yo íti ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀkṛdhí ǀ vā́jān ǀ apáḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Vāyu, foremost (of the gods), exulting in your won mind, cause our rites to be productive of foodand water.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Vāyu, foremost (of the gods), exulting in your won mind, cause our rites to be productive of foodand water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: २२ मनुर्वैवस्वत: ।विश्वे देवा: ।प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . CHEIF Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice:With song I seek the Maruts, Brahmaṇaspati, Gods for help much to be desired. I sing to cattle and to Earth, to trees, to Dawns, to Night, to plants.O all ye Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, be ye the furtherers of our thoughts. Forth go, with Agni, to the Gods our sacrifice of ancient use,To the Ādityas, Varuṇa whose Law stands fast, and the all-lightening Marut troop. Lords of all wealth, may they be strengtheners of man, destroyers of his enemies.Lords of all wealth, do ye, with guards which none may harm, preserve our dwelling free from foes. Come to us with one mind to-day, come to us all with one accord,Maruts with holy song, and, Goddess Aditi, Mighty One, to our house and home. Send us delightful things, ye Maruts, on your steeds: come ye, O Mitra, to our gifts.Let Indra, Varuṇa, and the Ādityas sit, swift Heroes, on our sacred grass. We who have trimmed the grass for you, and set the banquet in array,And pressed the Soma, call you, Varuina, like men, with sacrificial fires aflame. O Maruts, Visinu, Aśvins, Pūṣan, haste away with minds turned hitherward to Me.Let the Strong Indra, famed as Vṛtra's slayer, come first with the winners of the spoil. Ye Guileless Gods, bestow on us a refuge strong on every side,A sure protection, Vasus, unassailable from near at hand or from afar. Kinship have I with you, and close alliance O ye Gods, destroyers of our foes.Call us to our prosperity of former days, and soon to new klicity. For now have I sent forth to you, that I may win a fair reward,Lords of all wealth, with homage, this my song of praise. like a milch-cow that faileth not. Excellent Savitar hath mounted up on high for you, ye sure and careful Guides.Bipeds and quadrupeds, with several hopes and aims, and birds have settled to their tasks. Singing their praise with God-like thought let us invoke each God for grace,Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you. For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts.May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing case and ample room. I laud you, O ye Guileless Gods, here where we meet to render praise.None, Varuṇa and Mitra, harins the mortal, man who honours and obeys your laws. He makes his house endure, he gathers plenteous food who pays obedience to your will.Born in his sons anew he spreads as Law commands, and prospers every way unharmed. E’en without war he gathers wealth, and goes hisway on pleasant paths,Whom Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryaman protect, sharing the gift,of one accord. E’en on the plain for him ye make a sloping path, an easy way where road is none:And far away from him the ineffectual shaft must vanish, shot at him in vain. If ye appoint the rite to-day, kind Rulers, when the Sun ascends,Lords of all wealth, at sunset or at wakingtime, or be it at the noon of day, Or, Asuras, when ye have sheltered the worshipper who goes to sacrifice, at evemay we, O Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, come then into the midst of You. If ye to-day at sunrise, or at noon, or in the gloom of eve,Lords of all riches, give fair treasure to the man, the wise man who hath sacrificed, Then we, imperial Rulers, claim of you this boon, your wide protection, as a son.May we, Ādityas, offering holy gifts, obtain that which shall bring us greater bliss.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे ।ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पतिं देवाँ अवो वरेण्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ukthé ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀṛcā́ ǀ yāmi ǀ marútaḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ devā́n ǀ ávaḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agniis the Purohitaat the sacrifice; the stones, the sacred grass (are prepared) for the ceremony. Iinvoke with the holy verse the Maruts,Brahmaṇaspati, and all the gods, for their desirable protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniis the Purohitaat the sacrifice; the stones, the sacred grass (are prepared) for the ceremony. Iinvoke with the holy verse the Maruts,Brahmaṇaspati, and all the gods, for their desirable protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पशुं गासि पृथिवीं वनस्पतीनुषासा नक्तमोषधीः ।विश्वे च नो वसवो विश्ववेदसो धीनां भूत प्रावितारः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paśúm ǀ gāsi ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ uṣásā ǀ náktam ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀvíśve ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ bhūta ǀ pra-avitā́raḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You come (Agni) to the victim, to the dwelling (of the worshipper), to the touchwood, to the Soma, atdawn and at night; universal deities, givers of wealth, knowing all things, be the defenders of our pious actṣ
verses.wilson_translation: You come (Agni) to the victim, to the dwelling (of the worshipper), to the touchwood, to the Soma, atdawn and at night; universal deities, givers of wealth, knowing all things, be the defenders of our pious actṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सू न एत्वध्वरोऽग्ना देवेषु पूर्व्यः ।आदित्येषु प्र वरुणे धृतव्रते मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ etu ǀ adhvaráḥ ǀ agnā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀādityéṣu ǀ prá ǀ váruṇe ǀ dhṛtá-vrate ǀ marút-su ǀ viśvá-bhānuṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the ancient sacrifice proceed first to Agni, then to the gods, -- to theĀdityas, to Varuṇa, observantof obligations, to the all-resplendent Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the ancient sacrifice proceed first to Agni, then to the gods, -- to theĀdityas, to Varuṇa, observantof obligations, to the all-resplendent Maruts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे हि ष्मा मनवे विश्ववेदसो भुवन्वृधे रिशादसः ।अरिष्टेभिः पायुभिर्विश्ववेदसो यंता नोऽवृकं छर्दिः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ mánave ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ bhúvan ǀ vṛdhé ǀ riśā́dasaḥ ǀáriṣṭebhiḥ ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ yánta ǀ naḥ ǀ avṛkám ǀ chardíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the universal deities, possessors of all opulence, destroyers of foes, be (near) to Manufor hisprosperity; do you, who know all things, secure to us an abode safe from robbers through unassailableprotections.
verses.wilson_translation: May the universal deities, possessors of all opulence, destroyers of foes, be (near) to Manufor hisprosperity; do you, who know all things, secure to us an abode safe from robbers through unassailableprotections.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो अद्य समनसो गंता विश्वे सजोषसः ।ऋचा गिरा मरुतो देव्यदिते सदने पस्त्ये महि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ gánta ǀ víśve ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀṛcā́ ǀ girā́ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ dévi ǀ ádite ǀ sádane ǀ pástye ǀ mahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Universal deities, united together and of one mind, come this day to us, (attracted) by the sacred praiseaddressed to you; and do you,Maruts, and the mighty goddess Aditi, (come) to the dwelling, (our) abode.
verses.wilson_translation: Universal deities, united together and of one mind, come this day to us, (attracted) by the sacred praiseaddressed to you; and do you,Maruts, and the mighty goddess Aditi, (come) to the dwelling, (our) abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रिया मरुतो या वो अश्व्या हव्या मित्र प्रयाथन ।आ बर्हिरिंद्रो वरुणस्तुरा नर आदित्यासः सदंतु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ áśvyā ǀ havyā́ ǀ mitra ǀ pra-yāthána ǀā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ turā́ḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ sadantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Direct,Maruts, your beloved horses (to our rite);Mitra, (come to our) oblations; and may Indra, and Varuṇa, and the swift leaders, theĀdityas, sit down on our sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Direct,Maruts, your beloved horses (to our rite);Mitra, (come to our) oblations; and may Indra, and Varuṇa, and the swift leaders, theĀdityas, sit down on our sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं वो वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आनुषक् ।सुतसोमासो वरुण हवामहे मनुष्वदिद्धाग्नयः ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ hitá-prayasaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀsutá-somāsaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ havāmahe ǀ manuṣvát ǀ iddhá-agnayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bearing the clipped sacred grass, offering in due order the (sacrificial) food, presenting the effused Soma, and having the fires kindled, we invoke you,Varuṇa, (and the rest), as did Manus.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearing the clipped sacred grass, offering in due order the (sacrificial) food, presenting the effused Soma, and having the fires kindled, we invoke you,Varuṇa, (and the rest), as did Manus.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ प्र यात मरुतो विष्णो अश्विना पूषन्माकीनया धिया ।इंद्र आ यातु प्रथमः सनिष्युभिर्वृषा यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ prá ǀ yāta ǀ márutaḥ ǀ víṣṇo íti ǀ áśvinā ǀ pū́ṣan ǀ mā́kīnayā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀíndraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ saniṣyú-bhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ gṛṇé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maruts,Viṣṇu,Aśvins,Pūṣan, come here (induced) by my praise; may Indra, the first (of the gods),also come, the showerer (of benefits), he who is praised by (his) worshippers as the slayer of Vṛtra.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts,Viṣṇu,Aśvins,Pūṣan, come here (induced) by my praise; may Indra, the first (of the gods),also come, the showerer (of benefits), he who is praised by (his) worshippers as the slayer of Vṛtra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि नो देवासो अद्रुहोऽच्छिद्रं शर्म यच्छत ।न यद्दूराद्वसवो नू चिदंतितो वरूथमादधर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ adruhaḥ ǀ ácchidram ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀná ǀ yát ǀ dūrā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ ántitaḥ ǀ várūtham ǀ ā-dadhárṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unoppressive deities, bestow upon us a mansion without defect, so that, subduers (of foes), no onemay injure our defences, whether from afar or near.
verses.wilson_translation: Unoppressive deities, bestow upon us a mansion without defect, so that, subduers (of foes), no onemay injure our defences, whether from afar or near.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति हि वः सजात्यं रिशादसो देवासो अस्त्याप्यं ।प्र णः पूर्वस्मै सुविताय वोचत मक्षू सुम्नाय नव्यसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ásti ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ sa-jātyám ǀ riśādasaḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ ā́pyam ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rvasmai ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ vocata ǀ makṣú ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ návyase ǁ
verses.english_translation: There is identity of race among you, deities, destroyers of foes; there is kindred (with me yourworshipper); therefore, utter at once the command for our former prosperity and for new happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: There is identity of race among you, deities, destroyers of foes; there is kindred (with me yourworshipper); therefore, utter at once the command for our former prosperity and for new happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इदा हि व उपस्तुतिमिदा वामस्य भक्तये ।उप वो विश्ववेदसो नमस्युराँ असृक्ष्यन्यामिव ॥
verses.transliteration: idā́ ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ úpa-stutim ǀ idā́ ǀ vāmásya ǀ bhaktáye ǀúpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ namasyúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ásṛkṣi ǀ ányām-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deities, possessed of all wealth, I, desirous of offering worship, address to you verily unprecedentedpraise, for the sake of obtaining desired affluence.
verses.wilson_translation: Deities, possessed of all wealth, I, desirous of offering worship, address to you verily unprecedentedpraise, for the sake of obtaining desired affluence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदु ष्य वः सविता सुप्रणीतयोऽस्थादूर्ध्वो वरेण्यः ।नि द्विपादश्चतुष्पादो अर्थिनोऽविश्रन्पतयिष्णवः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-pranītayaḥ ǀ ásthāt ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀní ǀ dvi-pā́daḥ ǀ cátuḥ-pādaḥ ǀ arthínaḥ ǀ áviśran ǀ patayiṣṇávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devoutly praised (Maruts), when the adorable Savitāhas risen above you, then bipeds andquadrupeds, and the flying birds, seeking (their objects), enter (upon their functions).
verses.wilson_translation: Devoutly praised (Maruts), when the adorable Savitāhas risen above you, then bipeds andquadrupeds, and the flying birds, seeking (their objects), enter (upon their functions).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवंदेवं वोऽवसे देवंदेवमभिष्टये ।देवंदेवं हुवेम वाजसातये गृणंतो देव्या धिया ॥
verses.transliteration: devám-devam ǀ vaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ devám-devam ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀdevám-devam ǀ huvema ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ devyā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We would invoke each deity among you (gods) for protection, each deity for the attainment of ourdesires, each deity for the acquisition of food, glorifying you with divine praise.
verses.wilson_translation: We would invoke each deity among you (gods) for protection, each deity for the attainment of ourdesires, each deity for the acquisition of food, glorifying you with divine praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवासो हि ष्मा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकं सरातयः ।ते नो अद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवंतु वरिवोविदः ॥
verses.transliteration: devā́saḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ mánave ǀ sá-manyavaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ sākám ǀ sá-rātayaḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ té ǀ aparám ǀ tucé ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ bhávantu ǀ varivaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the universal gods with one consent be together the givers (of riches) to Manu; may they, bothtoday and hereafter, be the bestowers of wealth upon us and upon our posterity.
verses.wilson_translation: May the universal gods with one consent be together the givers (of riches) to Manu; may they, bothtoday and hereafter, be the bestowers of wealth upon us and upon our posterity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वः शंसाम्यद्रुहः संस्थ उपस्तुतीनां ।न तं धूर्तिर्वरुण मित्र मर्त्यं यो वो धामभ्योऽविधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ śaṃsāmi ǀ adruhaḥ ǀ sam-sthé ǀ úpa-stutīnām ǀná ǀ tám ǀ dhūrtíḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ mártyam ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhā́ma-bhyaḥ ǀ ávidhat ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify you, inoxious deities, in the plural ce of praises; no harm befalls the man who,Mitraand Varuṇa,offers (oblations) to your glories.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify you, inoxious deities, in the plural ce of praises; no harm befalls the man who,Mitraand Varuṇa,offers (oblations) to your glories.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति ।प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्पर्यरिष्टः सर्व एधते ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyam ǀ tirate ǀ ví ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ várāya ǀ dā́śati ǀprá ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ dhármaṇaḥ ǀ pári ǀ áriṣṭaḥ ǀ sárvaḥ ǀ edhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: He enlarges his dweling, he has abundant food who offers you (oblations) to obtain a blessing; throughhis pious acts he is born on every side in his children; all prosper (through your favour) unharmed (by enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: He enlarges his dweling, he has abundant food who offers you (oblations) to obtain a blessing; throughhis pious acts he is born on every side in his children; all prosper (through your favour) unharmed (by enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋते स विंदते युधः सुगेभिर्यात्यध्वनः ।अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः सरातयो यं त्रायंते सजोषसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛté ǀ sáḥ ǀ vindate ǀ yudháḥ ǀ su-gébhiḥ ǀ yāti ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀaryamā́ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sá-rātayaḥ ǀ yám ǀ trā́yante ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He gains (wealth) without war, he travels along the roads with quick (horses), whom Aryaman, Mitraand Varuṇa, alike munificent, and acting in concert, protect.
verses.wilson_translation: He gains (wealth) without war, he travels along the roads with quick (horses), whom Aryaman, Mitraand Varuṇa, alike munificent, and acting in concert, protect.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अज्रे चिदस्मै कृणुथा न्यंचनं दुर्गे चिदा सुसरणं ।एषा चिदस्मादशनिः परो नु सास्रेधंती वि नश्यतु ॥
verses.transliteration: ájre ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ kṛṇutha ǀ ni-áñcanam ǀ duḥ-gé ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ su-saraṇám ǀeṣā́ ǀ cit ǀ asmāt ǀ aśániḥ ǀ paráḥ ǀ nú ǀ sā́ ǀ ásredhantī ǀ ví ǀ naśyatu ǁ
verses.english_translation: You enable him (Manu) to proceed by an unobstructed road; you grant him easy access to difficultpasses; may the weapon (of the foe) be far from him, and, inflicting no injury, perish.
verses.wilson_translation: You enable him (Manu) to proceed by an unobstructed road; you grant him easy access to difficultpasses; may the weapon (of the foe) be far from him, and, inflicting no injury, perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर्य उद्यति प्रियक्षत्रा ऋतं दध ।यन्निम्रुचि प्रबुधि विश्ववेदसो यद्वा मध्यंदिने दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ut-yatí ǀ príya-kṣatrāḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ dadhá ǀyát ǀ ni-mrúci ǀ pra-búdhi ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ madhyándine ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divinities of benevolent vigour, since you preside over the rite today, at the rising of the sun, since,possessors of all wealth, (you are present) at his setting, or at his waking, or at the meridian of the day.
verses.wilson_translation: Divinities of benevolent vigour, since you preside over the rite today, at the rising of the sun, since,possessors of all wealth, (you are present) at his setting, or at his waking, or at the meridian of the day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वाभिपित्वे असुरा ऋतं यते छर्दिर्येम वि दाशुषे ।वयं तद्वो वसवो विश्ववेदस उप स्थेयाम मध्य आ ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ asurāḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ yaté ǀ chardíḥ ǀ yemá ǀ ví ǀ dāśúṣe ǀvayám ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ stheyāma ǀ mádhye ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or since all-wise deities, you accept the sacrifice, bestowing on the zealous donor (of the oblation) aswelling (such as we may worship in) then, possessors of all wealth, distributors of riches, may we worshp you inthe midst (of that dwelling).
verses.wilson_translation: Or since all-wise deities, you accept the sacrifice, bestowing on the zealous donor (of the oblation) aswelling (such as we may worship in) then, possessors of all wealth, distributors of riches, may we worshp you inthe midst (of that dwelling).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर उदिते यन्मध्यंदिन आतुचि ।वामं धत्थ मनवे विश्ववेदसो जुह्वानाय प्रचेतसे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ yát ǀ madhyándine ǀ ā-túci ǀvāmám ǀ dhatthá ǀ mánave ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ júhvānāya ǀ prá-cetase ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Gods), who are possessed of all wealth, bestow the desired (opulence) upon the intelligent Manu,offering oblations to you at sunrise, mid-day and sunset.
verses.wilson_translation: (Gods), who are possessed of all wealth, bestow the desired (opulence) upon the intelligent Manu,offering oblations to you at sunrise, mid-day and sunset.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं तद्वः सम्राज आ वृणीमहे पुत्रो न बहुपाय्यं ।अश्याम तदादित्या जुह्वतो हविर्येन वस्योऽनशामहै ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ sam-rājaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ bahu-pā́yyam ǀaśyā́ma ǀ tát ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ júhvataḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ yéna ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ anáśāmahai ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit of you, resplendent deities, as a son (of a father), that which is to be enjoyed by many;offering oblations, may we obtain that (wealth),Ādityas, by which we may possess abundance.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit of you, resplendent deities, as a son (of a father), that which is to be enjoyed by many;offering oblations, may we obtain that (wealth),Ādityas, by which we may possess abundance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVIII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Thirty Gods and Three besides, whose seat hath been the sacred grass,From time of old have found and gained. Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Agnis, with Consorts, sending boons,To whom our Vaṣaṭ! is addressed: These are our guardians in the west, and northward here, and in the south,And on the cast, with all the tribe. Even as the Gods desire so verily shall it be. None minisheth this power of theirs,No demon, and no mortal The Seven carry seven spears; seven are the splendours they possess,And seven the glories they assume.

verses.english_translation: May the three-and-thirty divinities sit down upon the sacred grass; may they accept (our offerings), andbestow upon us both (sorts of wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: May the three-and-thirty divinities sit down upon the sacred grass; may they accept (our offerings), andbestow upon us both (sorts of wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: May Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryamanand the Agnis, with their wives, honouring the donors (of the oblation),and addressed with the sacrificial exclamation.
verses.wilson_translation: May Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryamanand the Agnis, with their wives, honouring the donors (of the oblation),and addressed with the sacrificial exclamation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Be our protectors, whether coming with all their attendants from the west, from the north, from thesouth, from the east.
verses.wilson_translation: Be our protectors, whether coming with all their attendants from the west, from the north, from thesouth, from the east.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Whatever the gods desire, that assuredly comes to pass; no one can resist their (will), no mortalwithholds (their) offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever the gods desire, that assuredly comes to pass; no one can resist their (will), no mortalwithholds (their) offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Seven are he lances of the seven (troops of the Maruts), seven are their ornaments, they wear sevensurpassing glories.
verses.wilson_translation: Seven are he lances of the seven (troops of the Maruts), seven are their ornaments, they wear sevensurpassing glories.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIX Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १० मनुर्वैवस्वत:, कश्यपो वा मारीच:।  विश्वे देवा: । द्विपदा विराट्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ONE is a youth brown, active, manifold he decks the golden one with ornament. Another, luminous, occupies the place of sacritice, Sage, among the Gods. One brandishes in his hand an iron knife, firm, in his seat amid the Deities. Another holds the thunderbolt, wherewith he slays the Vṛtras, resting in his hand. Another bears a pointed weapon: bright is he, and strong, with healing medicines. Another, thief-like, watches well the ways, and knows the places where the treasures lie. Another with his mighty stride hath made his three steps thither where the Gods rejoice. Two with one Dame ride on with winged steeds, and journey forth like travellers on their way. Two, highest, in the heavens have set their seat, worshipped with holy oil, imperial Kings. Some, singing lauds, conceived the Sāma-hymn, great hymn whereby they caused the Sun to shine.

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रुरेको विषुणः सूनरो युवांज्यंक्ते हिरण्ययं ॥
verses.transliteration: babhrúḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ víṣuṇaḥ ǀ sūnáraḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ añjí ǀ aṅkte ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (Soma) brown of hue, all-pervading, leader of the nights, ever young, decorates (himself) withgolden ornament.
verses.wilson_translation: One (Soma) brown of hue, all-pervading, leader of the nights, ever young, decorates (himself) withgolden ornament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: योनिमेक आ ससाद द्योतनोऽंतर्देवेषु मेधिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: yónim ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sasāda ǀ dyótanaḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ médhiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (Agni) intelligent, resplended among the gods, is seated in his plural ce (the altar).
verses.wilson_translation: One (Agni) intelligent, resplended among the gods, is seated in his plural ce (the altar).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाशीमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयसीमंतर्देवेषु निध्रुविः ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́śīm ǀ ékaḥ ǀ bibharti ǀ háste ǀ āyasī́m ǀ antáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ní-dhruviḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (Tvaṣṭā) immoveably stationed among the gods, holds his metal axe in hishand.
verses.wilson_translation: One (Tvaṣṭā) immoveably stationed among the gods, holds his metal axe in hishand.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वज्रमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आहितं तेन वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
verses.transliteration: vájram ǀ ékaḥ ǀ bibharti ǀ háste ǀ ā́-hitam ǀ téna ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnate ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (Indra) holds his thunderbol wielded in hishand, by which he slays the Vṛtras.
verses.wilson_translation: One (Indra) holds his thunderbol wielded in hishand, by which he slays the Vṛtras.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तिग्ममेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयुधं शुचिरुग्रो जलाषभेषजः ॥
verses.transliteration: tigmám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ bibharti ǀ háste ǀ ā́yudham ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ jálāṣa-bheṣajaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (Rudra) brilliant and fierce, (yet) the distributor of healingmedicines, holds his sharp weapon in hishand.
verses.wilson_translation: One (Rudra) brilliant and fierce, (yet) the distributor of healingmedicines, holds his sharp weapon in hishand.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पथ एकः पीपाय तस्करो यथाँ एष वेद निधीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: patháḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ pīpāya ǀ táskaraḥ ǀ yathā ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ veda ǀ ni-dhīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (Pūṣan) watches the roads like a robber, and is cognizant of hidden treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: One (Pūṣan) watches the roads like a robber, and is cognizant of hidden treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रीण्येक उरुगायो वि चक्रमे यत्र देवासो मदंति ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ ékaḥ ǀ uru-gāyáḥ ǀ ví ǀ cakrame ǀ yátra ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ mádanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: One (Viṣṇu) wide-stepping, has traversed thethree worldswhere the gods rejoice.
verses.wilson_translation: One (Viṣṇu) wide-stepping, has traversed thethree worldswhere the gods rejoice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विभिर्द्वा चरत एकया सह प्र प्रवासेव वसतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví-bhiḥ ǀ dvā́ ǀ carataḥ ǀ ékayā ǀ sahá ǀ prá ǀ pravāsā́-iva ǀ vasataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Two (the Aśvins), travel with swift (horses) along with one (bride Sūrya), like travellers to foreigncountries.
verses.wilson_translation: Two (the Aśvins), travel with swift (horses) along with one (bride Sūrya), like travellers to foreigncountries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सदो द्वा चक्राते उपमा दिवि सम्राजा सर्पिरासुती ॥
verses.transliteration: sádaḥ ǀ dvā́ ǀ cakrāte íti ǀ upa-mā́ ǀ diví ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ sarpírāsutī íti sarpíḥ-āsutī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Two of like beauty and of royal rank (Mitraand Varuṇa), worshipped with oblations of clarified butter,have taken their seat in heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Two of like beauty and of royal rank (Mitraand Varuṇa), worshipped with oblations of clarified butter,have taken their seat in heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्चंत एके महि साम मन्वत तेन सूर्यमरोचयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: árcantaḥ ǀ éke ǀ máhi ǀ sā́ma ǀ manvata ǀ téna ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Some (the Atris) when worshipping, call to mind the great Sāman, wherewith they light up the suṇ
verses.wilson_translation: Some (the Atris) when worshipping, call to mind the great Sāman, wherewith they light up the suṇ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXX. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: ४ मनुर्वैवस्वत: । विश्वे देवा: । १ गायत्री , २  पुरउष्णिक् , ३ बृहती , ४ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . NOT one of you, ye Gods, is small, none of you is a feeble child:All of you, verily, are great. Thus be ye lauded, ye destroyers of the foe, ye Three-and-Thirty Deities,The Gods of man, the Holy Ones. As such defend and succour us, with benedictions speak to us:Lead us not from our fathers' and from Manu's path into the distance far away. Ye Deities who stay with us, and all ye Gods of all mankind,Give us your wide protection, give shelter for cattle and for steed.

verses.sanskrit: नहि वो अस्त्यर्भको देवासो न कुमारकः ।विश्वे सतोमहांत इत् ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ vaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ arbhakáḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kumārakáḥ ǀvíśve ǀ satáḥ-mahāntaḥ ǀ ít ǁ
verses.english_translation: There is no one among you, gods, who is an infant or a youth; you verily are all of mature existence.
verses.wilson_translation: There is no one among you, gods, who is an infant or a youth; you verily are all of mature existence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुतासो असथा रिशादसो ये स्थ त्रयश्च त्रिंशच्च ।मनोर्देवा यज्ञियासः ॥
verses.transliteration: íti ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ asatha ǀ riśādasaḥ ǀ yé ǀ sthá ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ triṃśát ǀ ca ǀmánoḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ yajñiyāsaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroyers of foes, gods, adored by Manu, who are three-and-thirty, and are thus hymned.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroyers of foes, gods, adored by Manu, who are three-and-thirty, and are thus hymned.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नस्त्राध्वं तेऽवत त उ नो अधि वोचत ।मा नः पथः पित्र्यान्मानवादधि दूरं नैष्ट परावतः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ trādhvam ǀ te ǀ avata ǀ té ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ pítryāt ǀ mānavā́t ǀ ádhi ǀ dūrám ǀ naiṣṭa ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you preserve us, do you protect us, do you direct us (to our good); lead us not afar from the paternalpaths of Manu, nor from those still more distant.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you preserve us, do you protect us, do you direct us (to our good); lead us not afar from the paternalpaths of Manu, nor from those still more distant.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये देवास इह स्थन विश्वे वैश्वानरा उत ।अस्मभ्यं शर्म सप्रथो गवेऽश्वाय यच्छत ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ sthána ǀ víśve ǀ vaiśvānarā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀasmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ gáve ǀ áśvāya ǀ yacchata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Gods, who are here present, all to whom this full sacrifice is offered, bestow upon us, upon our cattleand horses, happiness far renowned.
verses.wilson_translation: Gods, who are here present, all to whom this full sacrifice is offered, bestow upon us, upon our cattleand horses, happiness far renowned.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXI. Various Deities.
hymns.anukramani: १८ मनुर्वैवस्वत: ।१-४ यज्ञ: यजमानश्च , ५-९  दंपति , १०-१८ दम्पत्याशिष: । गायत्री ; ९,१४ अनुष्टुप् , १० पादनिचृत , १५-१८ पंक्ति: ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THAT Brahman pleases Indra well, who worships, sacrifices, pours Libation, and prepares the meal. Śakra protects from woe the man who gives him sacrificial cake.And offers Soma blent with milk. His chariot shall be glorious, sped by Gods, and mighty shall he be,Subduing all hostilities. Each day that passes, in his house flows his libation, rich in milk,Exhaustless, bringing progeny. O Gods, with constant draught of milk, husband and wife with one accordPress out and wash the Soma juice. They gain sufficient food: they come united to the sacred grass,And never do they fail in strength. Never do they deny or seek to hide the favour of the Gods:They win high glory for themselves. With sons and daughters by their side they reach their full extent of life,Both decked with ornaments of gold. Serving the Immortal One with gifts of sacrificial meal and wealth,They satisfy the claims of love and pay due honour to the Gods. We claim protection from the Hills, we claim protection of the Floods,Of him who stands by Viṣṇu's side. May Pūṣan come, and Bhaga, Lord of wealth, All-bounteous, for our wealBroad be the path that leads to bliss: Aramati, and, free from foes, Visva with spirit of a God,And the Ādityas’ peerless might. Seeing that Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuṇa are guarding us,The paths of Law are fair to tread. I glorify with song, for wealth, Agni the God, the first of you.We honour as a well-loved Friend the God who prospereth our fields. As in all frays the hero, so swift moves his car whom Gods attend.The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not. Ne’er are ye injured, worshipper, presser of juice, or pious man.The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not. None in his action equals him, none holds him far or keeps him off.The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not. Such strength of heroes shall be his, such mastery of fleet-foot steeds.The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sanskrit: यो यजाति यजात इत्सुनवच्च पचाति च ।ब्रह्मेदिंद्रस्य चाकनत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ yájāti ǀ yájāte ǀ ít ǀ sunávat ǀ ca ǀ pácāti ǀ ca ǀbrahmā́ ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ cākanat ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who offers oblations (to the gods, again) offers them; he pours forth libations and presents (thesacred cake), he delights in reiterating the praise verily of Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: He who offers oblations (to the gods, again) offers them; he pours forth libations and presents (thesacred cake), he delights in reiterating the praise verily of Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं यो अस्मै सोमं ररत आशिरं ।पादित्तं शक्रो अंहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ sómam ǀ rárate ǀ ā-śíram ǀpā́t ǀ ít ǀ tám ǀ śakráḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraprotects from sin that man who offers him cakes and presents Somamixed with milk.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraprotects from sin that man who offers him cakes and presents Somamixed with milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तस्य द्युमाँ असद्रथो देवजूतः स शूशुवत् ।विश्वा वन्वन्नमित्रिया ॥
verses.transliteration: tásya ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ asat ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ devá-jūtaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ śūśuvat ǀvíśvā ǀ vanván ǀ amitríyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: A brilliant chariot comes to him, sent by the gods, with which, baffling all hostilities, he prospers.
verses.wilson_translation: A brilliant chariot comes to him, sent by the gods, with which, baffling all hostilities, he prospers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य प्रजावती गृहेऽसश्चंती दिवेदिवे ।इळा धेनुमती दुहे ॥
verses.transliteration: ásya ǀ prajā́-vatī ǀ gṛhé ǀ ásaścantī ǀ divé-dive ǀíḷā ǀ dhenu-mátī ǀ duhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: In his house perpetual abundance, accompanied by progeny, (is present), and kine are milked day byday.
verses.wilson_translation: In his house perpetual abundance, accompanied by progeny, (is present), and kine are milked day byday.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या दंपती समनसा सुनुत आ च धावतः ।देवासो नित्ययाशिरा ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ dámpatī íti dám-patī ǀ sá-manasā ǀ sunutáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhā́vataḥ ǀdévāsaḥ ǀ nítyayā ǀ ā-śírā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Gods, may the husband and wife, who with one mind offer libations and purify them, and (propitiateyou) with the Somaever mixed with milk.
verses.wilson_translation: Gods, may the husband and wife, who with one mind offer libations and purify them, and (propitiateyou) with the Somaever mixed with milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रति प्राशव्याँ इतः सम्यंचा बर्हिराशाते ।न ता वाजेषु वायतः ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ prāśavyā́n ǀ itaḥ ǀ samyáñcā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ āśāte íti ǀná ǀ tā́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vāyataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Constantly associated, may they acquire appropriate (sacrificial) viands; may they be able to offersacrifice; may the never be wanting in food (given by the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Constantly associated, may they acquire appropriate (sacrificial) viands; may they be able to offersacrifice; may the never be wanting in food (given by the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न देवानामपि ह्नुतः सुमतिं न जुगुक्षतः ।श्रवो बृहद्विवासतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ hnutaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ná ǀ jughukṣataḥ ǀśrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vivāsataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They retract not (their promises) to the gods, they withhold not your praise, but offer abundant(sacrificial) food.
verses.wilson_translation: They retract not (their promises) to the gods, they withhold not your praise, but offer abundant(sacrificial) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रिणा ता कुमारिणा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतः ।उभा हिरण्यपेशसा ॥
verses.transliteration: putríṇā ǀ tā́ ǀ kumāríṇā ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnutaḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ híraṇya-peśasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Blessed with youthful and adolescent offsprin, and both having their person ns richly ornamented, theypass (happily) their whole life.
verses.wilson_translation: Blessed with youthful and adolescent offsprin, and both having their person ns richly ornamented, theypass (happily) their whole life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रा कृतद्वसू दशस्यंतामृताय कं ।समूधो रोमशं हतो देवेषु कृणुतो दुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: vītí-hotrā ǀ kṛtádvasū íti kṛtát-vasū ǀ daśasyántā ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ kám ǀsám ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ romaśám ǀ hataḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ kṛṇutaḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offering acceptable sacrifices, obtaining the wealth they solicit, presenting gratifying (oblations to thegods), for the sake of immortality enjoying person nal union, they (wife and husband) worship the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Offering acceptable sacrifices, obtaining the wealth they solicit, presenting gratifying (oblations to thegods), for the sake of immortality enjoying person nal union, they (wife and husband) worship the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ शर्म पर्वतानां वृणीमहे नदीनां ।आ विष्णोः सचाभुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śárma ǀ párvatānām ǀ vṛṇīmáhe ǀ nadī́nām ǀā́ ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit the happiness (afforded) by the mountains, the rivers, and Viṣṇu, associated (with thegods).
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit the happiness (afforded) by the mountains, the rivers, and Viṣṇu, associated (with thegods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऐतु पूषा रयिर्भगः स्वस्ति सर्वधातमः ।उरुरध्वा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ etu ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ svastí ǀ sarva-dhā́tamaḥ ǀurúḥ ǀ ádhvā ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the adorable Pūṣan, the possessor of opulence, the most benevolent patron to all, comeauspiciously; may a wide path (be open) for our prosperity.
verses.wilson_translation: May the adorable Pūṣan, the possessor of opulence, the most benevolent patron to all, comeauspiciously; may a wide path (be open) for our prosperity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरमतिरनर्वणो विश्वो देवस्य मनसा ।आदित्यानामनेह इत् ॥
verses.transliteration: arámatiḥ ǀ anarváṇaḥ ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ mánasā ǀādityā́nām ǀ aneháḥ ǀ ít ǁ
verses.english_translation: All men with (devout) minds are the unwearied (praisers) of the irresistible deity (Pūṣan), verily the(most) sinless of theĀdityas.
verses.wilson_translation: All men with (devout) minds are the unwearied (praisers) of the irresistible deity (Pūṣan), verily the(most) sinless of theĀdityas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यथा नो मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः संति गोपाः ।सुगा ऋतस्य पंथाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀsu-gā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pánthāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since Mitra,Aryamanand Varuṇaare our protectors, may the paths of the sacrifice be easily traversed(by them).
verses.wilson_translation: Since Mitra,Aryamanand Varuṇaare our protectors, may the paths of the sacrifice be easily traversed(by them).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं गिरा देवमीळे वसूनां ।सपर्यंतः पुरुप्रियं मित्रं न क्षेत्रसाधसं ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ girā́ ǀ devám ǀ īḷe ǀ vásūnām ǀsaparyántaḥ ǀ puru-priyám ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ kṣetra-sā́dhasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I worship the divine Agni, the preceder of you, (gods), with praise, (for the sake) of riches; theworshippers (cherish him), the bountiful perfector of the sacrifice, like a friend.
verses.wilson_translation: I worship the divine Agni, the preceder of you, (gods), with praise, (for the sake) of riches; theworshippers (cherish him), the bountiful perfector of the sacrifice, like a friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मक्षू देववतो रथः शूरो वा पृत्सु कासु चित् ।देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: makṣú ǀ devá-vataḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ vā ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ kā́su ǀ cit ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The chariot of the devout worshipper quickly (prevails), as the hero (prevails) in all combats whatever;the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are nosacrificers.
verses.wilson_translation: The chariot of the devout worshipper quickly (prevails), as the hero (prevails) in all combats whatever;the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are nosacrificers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न यजमान रिष्यसि न सुन्वान न देवयो ।देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yajamāna ǀ riṣyasi ǀ ná ǀ sunvāna ǀ ná ǀ devayo íti deva-yo ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devoted to the gods, pouring out to them libations, you, worshipper, shall not perish; the celebrator ofthe sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.
verses.wilson_translation: Devoted to the gods, pouring out to them libations, you, worshipper, shall not perish; the celebrator ofthe sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशन्न प्र योषन्न योषति ।देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ tám ǀ kármaṇā ǀ naśat ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ yoṣat ǀ ná ǀ yoṣati ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: No one obstructs him by his acts, he is never driven (from his station), he is never separated (from hisfamily); the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who areno sacrificers.
verses.wilson_translation: No one obstructs him by his acts, he is never driven (from his station), he is never separated (from hisfamily); the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who areno sacrificers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असदत्र सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यं ।देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ásat ǀ átra ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ utá ǀ tyát ǀ āśu-áśvyam ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him in this life is a valiant progeny, to him are swift herds of horses; the celebrator of the sacrifice,who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.
verses.wilson_translation: To him in this life is a valiant progeny, to him are swift herds of horses; the celebrator of the sacrifice,who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . KANVAS, tell forth with song the deeds of Indra, the Impetuous,Wrought in the Soma's wild delight. Strong God, he slew Anarsani, Srbinda, Pipru, and the fiend,Ahīśuva, and loosed the floods.. Thou broughtest down the dwelling-place, the height of lofty Arbuda.That exploit, Indra, must be famed. Bold, to your famous Soma I call the fair-visored God for aid,Down like a torrent from the hill. Rejoicing in the Soma-draughts, Hero, burst open, like a fort,The stall of horses and of kine. If my libation gladdens, if thou takest pleasure in my laud,Come with thy Godhead from afar. O Indra, Lover of the Song, the singers of thy praise are we:O Soma-drinker, quicken us. And, taking thy delight with us bring us still undiminished food:Great is thy wealth, O Maghavan. Make thou us rich in herds of kine, in steeds, in gold: let us exertOur strength in sacrificial gifts. Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, to whom high laud is due.Who worketh well to succour us. He, Śatakratu, even in fight acts as a Vṛtra-slayer s,till:He gives his worshippers much wealth. May he, this A;akra, strengthen us, Boon God who satisfies our needs,Indra, with all lhis saving helps. To him, the mighty stream of wealth, the Soma-presser's rescuing Friend,To Indra sing your song of praise; Who bringeth what is great and firm, who winneth glory in his wars,Lord of vast wealth through power and might. There liveth none to cheek or stay his energies and gracious deeds:None who can say, He giveth not. No debt is due by Brahmans now, by active men who press the juice:Well hath each Soma-draught been paid. Sing ye to him who must be praised, say lauds to him who must be praised,Bring prayer to him who must be praised. May be, unchecked, strong, meet for praise, bring hundreds, thousands forth to light,Indra who aids the worshipper. Go with thy God-like nature forth, go where the folk are calling thee:Drink, Indra, of the drops we pour. Drink milky draughts which are thine own, this too which was with Tugrya once,This is it, Indra, that is thine. Pass him who psours libations out in angry mood or after sin:Here drink the juice we offer thee. Over the three great distances, past the Five Peoples go thy way,O Indra, noticing our voice. Send forth thy ray like Sūrya: let my songs attract thee hitherward,Like waters gathering to the vale. Now to the Hero fair of cheek, Adhvaryu, pour the Soma forth:Bring of the juice that he may drink Who cleft the water-cloud in twain, loosed rivers for their downward flow,And set the ripe milk in the kine. He, meet for praise, slew Vṛtra, slew Ahīśuva, Urnavabha's son,And pierced th:rough Arbuda with frost. To him your matchless Mighty One, unconquerable Conqueror,Sing forth the prayer which Gods have given: Indra, who in the wild delight of Soma juice considers hereAll holy Laws among the Gods. Hither let these thy Bays who share thy banquet, Steeds with golden manes,Convey thee to the feast prepared. Hither, O thou whom many laud, the Bays whom Priyamedha praised,Shall bring thee to the Soma-draught.

verses.sanskrit: प्र कृतान्यृजीषिणः कण्वा इंद्रस्य गाथया ।मदे सोमस्य वोचत ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ ṛjīṣíṇaḥ ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ gā́thayā ǀmáde ǀ sómasya ǀ vocata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Celebrate with songs the great deeds of Indra, the drinker of the stale Soma, when in his exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Celebrate with songs the great deeds of Indra, the drinker of the stale Soma, when in his exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः सृबिंदमनर्शनिं पिप्रुं दासमहीशुवं ।वधीदुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sṛ́bindam ǀ ánarśanim ǀ píprum ǀ dāsám ǀ ahīśúvam ǀvádhīt ǀ ugráḥ ǀ riṇán ǀ apáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fierce (deity) who, liberating the waters, has slain Sṛbinda, Anarśani, Pipru,Dāsaand Ahiśuva.
verses.wilson_translation: The fierce (deity) who, liberating the waters, has slain Sṛbinda, Anarśani, Pipru,Dāsaand Ahiśuva.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न्यर्बुदस्य विष्टपं वर्ष्माणं बृहतस्तिर ।कृषे तदिंद्र पौंस्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ árbudasya ǀ viṣṭápam ǀ varṣmā́ṇam ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ tira ǀkṛṣé ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pierce the rain-holding domain of the vast Arbuda; achieve,Indra, this manly exploit.
verses.wilson_translation: Pierce the rain-holding domain of the vast Arbuda; achieve,Indra, this manly exploit.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रति श्रुताय वो धृषत्तूर्णाशं न गिरेरधि ।हुवे सुशिप्रमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: práti ǀ śrutā́ya ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ tū́rṇāśam ǀ ná ǀ giréḥ ǀ ádhi ǀhuvé ǀ su-śiprám ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke the victorious handsome-jawed Indrafor your protection, and to hear (your praises), as (atraveller invokes) the water from the cloud.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke the victorious handsome-jawed Indrafor your protection, and to hear (your praises), as (atraveller invokes) the water from the cloud.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स गोरश्वस्य वि व्रजं मंदानः सोम्येभ्यः ।पुरं न शूर दर्षसि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ ví ǀ vrajám ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ somyébhyaḥ ǀpúram ǀ ná ǀ śūra ǀ darṣasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Exhilarated by the Somadraughts, you, hero, throw open the pastures of the cattle and horses like a(hostile) city.
verses.wilson_translation: Exhilarated by the Somadraughts, you, hero, throw open the pastures of the cattle and horses like a(hostile) city.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदि मे रारणः सुत उक्थे वा दधसे चनः ।आरादुप स्वधा गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ me ǀ raráṇaḥ ǀ suté ǀ ukthé ǀ vā ǀ dádhase ǀ cánaḥ ǀārā́t ǀ úpa ǀ svadhā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: If you are propitiated by my libation and praise, and bestow food (upon me), come with viands from afar.
verses.wilson_translation: If you are propitiated by my libation and praise, and bestow food (upon me), come with viands from afar.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं घा ते अपि ष्मसि स्तोतार इंद्र गिर्वणः ।त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ ápi ǀ smasi ǀ stotā́raḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ jinva ǀ soma-pāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are plural ased by praise, we are your adorers; do you, therefore, who are the drinker of the Soma, be genitive rous unto us.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are plural ased by praise, we are your adorers; do you, therefore, who are the drinker of the Soma, be genitive rous unto us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नः पितुमा भर संरराणो अविक्षितं ।मघवन्भूरि ते वसु ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ pitúm ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ sam-rarāṇáḥ ǀ ávi-kṣitam ǀmágha-van ǀ bhū́ri ǀ te ǀ vásu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Gratified by us, bring us undiminished food,Maghavan, for vast is your wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Gratified by us, bring us undiminished food,Maghavan, for vast is your wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो गोमतस्कृधि हिरण्यवतो अश्विनः ।इळाभिः सं रभेमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ híraṇya-vataḥ ǀ aśvínaḥ ǀíḷābhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ rabhemahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Make us (Indra) possessed of cattle, of gold, and of horses; may we prosper with abundant viands.
verses.wilson_translation: Make us (Indra) possessed of cattle, of gold, and of horses; may we prosper with abundant viands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बृबदुक्थं हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये ।साधु कृण्वंतमवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛbát-uktham ǀ havāmahe ǀ sṛprá-karasnam ǀ ūtáye ǀsā́dhu ǀ kṛṇvántam ǀ ávase ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke Indra, who is greatly to be praised, whose arm is stretched out for the protection (of theworld), acting nobly for our defence.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke Indra, who is greatly to be praised, whose arm is stretched out for the protection (of theworld), acting nobly for our defence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः संस्थे चिच्छतक्रतुरादीं कृणोति वृत्रहा ।जरितृभ्यः पुरूवसुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sam-sthé ǀ cit ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ īm ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀjaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The slayer of Vṛtra, the accomplisher of a hundred exploits in war, achieves them that he may be thegiver of much wealth to his worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: The slayer of Vṛtra, the accomplisher of a hundred exploits in war, achieves them that he may be thegiver of much wealth to his worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः शक्रश्चिदा शकद्दानवाँ अंतराभरः ।इंद्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śakráḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ śakat ǀ dā́na-vān ǀ antara-ābharáḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: MayŚakragive us strength, may the liberal Indrawith all protections be the supplier of our deficiencieṣ
verses.wilson_translation: MayŚakragive us strength, may the liberal Indrawith all protections be the supplier of our deficiencieṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो रायोऽवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा ।तमिंद्रमभि गायत ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ avániḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ su-pāráḥ ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀtám ǀ índram ǀ abhí ǀ gāyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Glorify that Indrawho is the preserver of riches, the mighty, the conveyor beyond (calamity), the friendof the offerer of the libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorify that Indrawho is the preserver of riches, the mighty, the conveyor beyond (calamity), the friendof the offerer of the libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आयंतारं महि स्थिरं पृतनासु श्रवोजितं ।भूरेरीशानमोजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā-yantā́ram ǀ máhi ǀ sthirám ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ śravaḥ-jítam ǀbhū́reḥ ǀ ī́śānam ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him who comes near, the mighty, the firm in battles, the acquirer of fame, the lord of vast riches throughhis prowess.
verses.wilson_translation: Him who comes near, the mighty, the firm in battles, the acquirer of fame, the lord of vast riches throughhis prowess.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकिरस्य शचीनां नियंता सूनृतानां ।नकिर्वक्ता न दादिति ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ asya ǀ śácīnām ǀ ni-yantā́ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀnákiḥ ǀ vaktā́ ǀ ná ǀ dāt ǀ íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: No one puts a limit to his glorious deeds, no one asserts that he is not genitive rous.
verses.wilson_translation: No one puts a limit to his glorious deeds, no one asserts that he is not genitive rous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न नूनं ब्रह्मणामृणं प्राशूनामस्ति सुन्वतां ।न सोमो अप्रता पपे ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ nūnám ǀ brahmáṇām ǀ ṛṇám ǀ prāśūnā́m ǀ asti ǀ sunvatā́m ǀná ǀ sómaḥ ǀ apratā́ ǀ pape ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily no debt is due (to the gods) by those Soma-partakingbrāhmaṇasoffering libations; the Soma isnot drunk without the expenditure of boundless (wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: Verily no debt is due (to the gods) by those Soma-partakingbrāhmaṇasoffering libations; the Soma isnot drunk without the expenditure of boundless (wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पन्य इदुप गायत पन्य उक्थानि शंसत ।ब्रह्मा कृणोत पन्य इत् ॥
verses.transliteration: pánye ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǀ gāyata ǀ pánye ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ śaṃsata ǀbráhma ǀ kṛṇota ǀ pánye ǀ ít ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing praises to the adorable (Indra), repeat prayers to the adorable (Indra), address hymns to theadorable (Indra).
verses.wilson_translation: Sing praises to the adorable (Indra), repeat prayers to the adorable (Indra), address hymns to theadorable (Indra).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पन्य आ दर्दिरच्छता सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः ।इंद्रो यो यज्वनो वृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: pányaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dardirat ǀ śatā́ ǀ sahásrā ǀ vājī́ ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ yájvanaḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The powerful Indra, the discomfiter of hundreds and thousands, unchecked (by foes), is adorable; hewho is the benefactor of the sacrificer.
verses.wilson_translation: The powerful Indra, the discomfiter of hundreds and thousands, unchecked (by foes), is adorable; hewho is the benefactor of the sacrificer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि षू चर स्वधा अनु कृष्टीनामन्वाहुवः ।इंद्र पिब सुतानां ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ sú ǀ cara ǀ svadhā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ā-húvaḥ ǀíndra ǀ píba ǀ sutā́nām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are to be invoked of man, come to their offered viands, drink of (their) libations.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are to be invoked of man, come to their offered viands, drink of (their) libations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिब स्वधैनवानामुत यस्तुग्र्ये सचा ।उतायमिंद्र यस्तव ॥
verses.transliteration: píba ǀ svá-dhainavānām ǀ utá ǀ yáḥ ǀ túgrye ǀ sácā ǀutá ǀ ayám ǀ indra ǀ yáḥ ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink of the (Soma) purchased by the cow, that (Soma) which is mixed with water, that by which,Indra,is especially yours.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink of the (Soma) purchased by the cow, that (Soma) which is mixed with water, that by which,Indra,is especially yours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतीहि मन्युषाविणं सुषुवांसमुपारणे ।इमं रातं सुतं पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ ihi ǀ manyu-sāvínam ǀ susu-vā́ṃsam ǀ upa-áraṇe ǀimám ǀ rātám ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, pass by the man who offers the libation in anger, him who pours it out upon a spot disapprovedof; drink this presented Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, pass by the man who offers the libation in anger, him who pours it out upon a spot disapprovedof; drink this presented Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इहि तिस्रः परावत इहि पंच जनाँ अति ।धेना इंद्रावचाकशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ihí ǀ tisráḥ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ihí ǀ páñca ǀ jánān ǀ áti ǀdhénāḥ ǀ indra ǀ ava-cā́kaśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who has beheld our praises, proceed in three directions from a distance, pass beyond the fiveorders of beings.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who has beheld our praises, proceed in three directions from a distance, pass beyond the fiveorders of beings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यो रश्मिं यथा सृजा त्वा यच्छंतु मे गिरः ।निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥
verses.transliteration: sū́ryaḥ ǀ raśmím ǀ yáthā ǀ sṛja ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ yacchantu ǀ me ǀ gíraḥ ǀnimnám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ sadhryák ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the sun disperses his rays, do you disperse (wealth upon me); may my praises rapidly draw you, aswaters (reach) the low ground.
verses.wilson_translation: As the sun disperses his rays, do you disperse (wealth upon me); may my praises rapidly draw you, aswaters (reach) the low ground.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवा तु हि षिंच सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे ।भरा सुतस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhvaryo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tú ǀ hí ǀ siñcá ǀ sómam ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ śipríṇe ǀbhára ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adhvaryu, quickly pour forth the Somato the hero Indrawith the goodly jaws; bring the Soma for hisdrinking.
verses.wilson_translation: Adhvaryu, quickly pour forth the Somato the hero Indrawith the goodly jaws; bring the Soma for hisdrinking.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य उद्नः फलिगं भिनन्न्यक्सिंधूँरवासृजत् ।यो गोषु पक्वं धारयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ udnáḥ ǀ phali-gám ǀ bhinát ǀ nyák ǀ síndhūn ǀ ava-ásṛjat ǀyáḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ pakvám ǀ dhāráyat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who clove the cloud for (the issue of) the rain, who sent down the waters, who plural ced the mature (milk)in the cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Who clove the cloud for (the issue of) the rain, who sent down the waters, who plural ced the mature (milk)in the cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहन्वृत्रमृचीषम और्णवाभमहीशुवं ।हिमेनाविध्यदर्बुदं ॥
verses.transliteration: áhan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ṛ́cīṣamaḥ ǀ aurṇa-vābhám ǀ ahīśúvam ǀhiména ǀ avidhyat ǀ árbudam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The brilliant Indraslew Vṛtra, Aurṇavābha, Ahiśava; he smote Arbudawith frost.
verses.wilson_translation: The brilliant Indraslew Vṛtra, Aurṇavābha, Ahiśava; he smote Arbudawith frost.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र व उग्राय निष्टुरेऽषाळ्हाय प्रसक्षिणे ।देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ ugrā́ya ǀ niḥ-túre ǀ áṣāḷhāya ǀ pra-sakṣíṇe ǀdeváttam ǀ bráhma ǀ gāyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing aloud (priests) to the fierce, victorious (Indra) the overpowerer, the subduer (of foes), the praiseinspired by the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing aloud (priests) to the fierce, victorious (Indra) the overpowerer, the subduer (of foes), the praiseinspired by the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो विश्वान्यभि व्रता सोमस्य मदे अंधसः ।इंद्रो देवेषु चेतति ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ abhí ǀ vratā́ ǀ sómasya ǀ máde ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ cétati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who, in the exhilaration of the quaffed Soma, makes known among the gods all pious rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who, in the exhilaration of the quaffed Soma, makes known among the gods all pious rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या ।वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितं ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ sadha-mā́dyā ǀ hárī íti ǀ híraṇya-keśyā ǀvoḷhā́m ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀ hitám ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those two golden-maned steeds, together exulting, bring him here to the salutary (sacrificial) food.
verses.wilson_translation: May those two golden-maned steeds, together exulting, bring him here to the salutary (sacrificial) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्वांचं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी ।सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ॥
verses.transliteration: arvā́ñcam ǀ tvā ǀ puru-stuta ǀ priyámedha-stutā ǀ hárī íti ǀsoma-péyāya ǀ vakṣataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the glorified of many, let your horses, praised by Priyamedha, bring you down to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the glorified of many, let your horses, praised by Priyamedha, bring you down to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १९ मेध्यातिथि : काण्व:। इन्द्र: । बृहती , १६-१८ गायत्री , १९  अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed.Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vṛtra-slayer, sit. Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place:When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull? Boldly, Bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kaṇvas' sake.O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store ol kine. Medhyātithi, to Indra sing, drink of the juice to make thee glad.Close-knit to his Bay Steeds, bolt-armed, beside the juice is he: his chariot is of gold. He Who is praised as strong of hand both right and left, most wise and hold:Indra who, rich in hundreds, gathers thousands up, honoured as breaker-down of forts. The bold of heart whom none provokes, who stands in bearded confidence;Much-lauded, very glorious, overthrowing foes, strong Helper, like a bull with might. Who knows what vital ower he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice?This is the fair-checked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength. As a wild elephant rushes on this way and that way, mad with heat,'None may compel thee, yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power. When he, the Mighty, ne’er o’erthrown, steadfast, made ready for the fight,When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come. Yea, verily, thou art a Bull, with a bull's rush. whom none may stay:Thou Mighty One, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far. Thy reins are very bulls in strength, bulls' strength is in thy golden whip.Thy car, O Maghavan, thy Bays are strong as bulls: thou, Śatakratu, art a Bull. Let the strong presser press for thee. Bring hither, thou straight-rushing Bull.The mighty makes the mighty run in flowing streams for thee whom thy Bay Horses bear. Come, thou most potent Indra, come to drink the savoury Soma juice.Maghavan, very wise, will quickly come to hear the songs, the prayer, the hymns of praise. When thou hast mounted on thy car let thy yoked Bay Steeds carry thee,Past other men's libations, Lord of Hundred Powers, thee, Vṛtra-slayer, thee our Friend. O thou Most Lofty One, accept our laud as nearest to thine heart.May our libations be most sweet to make thee glad, O Soma-drinker, Heavenly Lord. Neither in thy decree nor mine, but in another's he delights,—The man who brought us unto this. Indra himself hath said, The mind of woman brooks not discipline,Her intellect hath little weight. His pair of horses, rushing on in their wild transport, draw his car:High-lifted is the stallion's yoke. Cast down thine eyes and look not up. More closely set thy feet. Let noneSee what thy garment veils, for thou, a Brahman, hast become a dame.

verses.sanskrit: वयं घ त्वा सुतावंत आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः ।पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ tvā ǀ sutá-vantaḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀpavítrasya ǀ pra-srávaṇeṣu ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ pári ǀ stotā́raḥ ǀ āsate ǁ
verses.english_translation: We are pouring forth to you Somalike water; the praisers, strewing the clipped sacred grass, worshipyou, slayer of Vṛtra, in the streams (falling) from the filter.
verses.wilson_translation: We are pouring forth to you Somalike water; the praisers, strewing the clipped sacred grass, worshipyou, slayer of Vṛtra, in the streams (falling) from the filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वरंति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः ।कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इंद्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः ॥
