verses.transliteration: sváranti ǀ tvā ǀ suté ǀ náraḥ ǀ váso íti ǀ nireké ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ sutám ǀ tṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamaḥ ǀ índra ǀ svabdī́-iva ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The leaders (of rites), repeating praises, shout to you,Vasu, when the libation issues forth; when,Indra,bellowing like a bull, do you come to the dwelling thirsting fo the Soma?
verses.wilson_translation: The leaders (of rites), repeating praises, shout to you,Vasu, when the libation issues forth; when,Indra,bellowing like a bull, do you come to the dwelling thirsting fo the Soma?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणं ।पिशंगरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमंतमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: káṇvebhiḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ vā́jam ǀ darṣi ǀ sahasríṇam ǀpiśáṅga-rūpam ǀ magha-van ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀ makṣú ǀ gó-mantam ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Resolute (Indra), bestow abundantly upon the descendants of Kaṇvathousands of viands; wise Maghavan, we earnestly solicit you for (wealth) of gold and cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Resolute (Indra), bestow abundantly upon the descendants of Kaṇvathousands of viands; wise Maghavan, we earnestly solicit you for (wealth) of gold and cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पाहि गायांधसो मद इंद्राय मेध्यातिथे ।यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यः सुते सचा वज्री रथो हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.transliteration: pāhí ǀ gā́ya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ máde ǀ índrāya ǀ medhya-atithe ǀyáḥ ǀ sám-miślaḥ ǀ háryoḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ vajrī́ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink, Medhyātithi, and in the exhilaration of the draught sing to Indra, to him who has harnessed hishorses, who, when the Somais poured out, is present, the wielder of the thunderbolt, whose chariot is of golḍ
verses.wilson_translation: Drink, Medhyātithi, and in the exhilaration of the draught sing to Indra, to him who has harnessed hishorses, who, when the Somais poured out, is present, the wielder of the thunderbolt, whose chariot is of golḍ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः सुषव्यः सुदक्षिण इनो यः सुक्रतुर्गृणे ।य आकरः सहस्रा यः शतामघ इंद्रो यः पूर्भिदारितः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ su-savyáḥ ǀ su-dákṣiṇaḥ ǀ ináḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ gṛṇé ǀyáḥ ǀ ā-karáḥ ǀ sahásrā ǀ yáḥ ǀ śatá-maghaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pūḥ-bhít ǀ āritáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is well-handled, both left and right, who is the lord, who is wise, he performer of numerousgreat acts, the giver of vast wealth,Indra, who is the demolisher of cities, who is gratified by praise, is glorified(by us).
verses.wilson_translation: He who is well-handled, both left and right, who is the lord, who is wise, he performer of numerousgreat acts, the giver of vast wealth,Indra, who is the demolisher of cities, who is gratified by praise, is glorified(by us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो धृषितो योऽवृतो यो अस्ति श्मश्रुषु श्रितः ।विभूतद्युम्नश्च्यवनः पुरुष्टुतः क्रत्वा गौरिव शाकिनः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dhṛṣitáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ śmáśruṣu ǀ śritáḥ ǀvíbhūta-dyumnaḥ ǀ cyávanaḥ ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ gáuḥ-iva ǀ śākináḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is the subduer (of foes), the unresisted, practised in combats, possessed of vast wealth, thedemander of the libation, the praised of many, who by his acts (of bounty) is like a cow to the competent(worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: He who is the subduer (of foes), the unresisted, practised in combats, possessed of vast wealth, thedemander of the libation, the praised of many, who by his acts (of bounty) is like a cow to the competent(worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबंतं कद्वयो दधे ।अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मंदानः शिप्र्यंधसः ॥
verses.transliteration: káḥ ǀ īm ǀ veda ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ píbantam ǀ kát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ vi-bhinátti ǀ ójasā ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ śiprī́ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who knows him drinking with (the priests) when the Somais effused? What food has he partaken of?He, the handsome-jawed, who, exhilarated by the (sacrificial) Soma, destroys cities by his might.
verses.wilson_translation: Who knows him drinking with (the priests) when the Somais effused? What food has he partaken of?He, the handsome-jawed, who, exhilarated by the (sacrificial) Soma, destroys cities by his might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे ।नकिष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महांश्चरस्योजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: dānā́ ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāraṇáḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ carátham ǀ dadhe ǀnákiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ní ǀ yamat ǀ ā́ ǀ suté ǀ gamaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ carasi ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: As a wild elephant emitting the dews of passion, he manifests his exhilaration in many plural ces; no onechecks you, (Indra), come to the libation; you are mighty, and goes (everywhere) through your strength.
verses.wilson_translation: As a wild elephant emitting the dews of passion, he manifests his exhilaration in many plural ces; no onechecks you, (Indra), come to the libation; you are mighty, and goes (everywhere) through your strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः ।यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेंद्रो योषत्या गमत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ sán ǀ áni-stṛtaḥ ǀ sthiráḥ ǀ ráṇāya ǀ sáṃskṛtaḥ ǀyádi ǀ stotúḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ hávam ǀ ná ǀ índraḥ ǀ yoṣati ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is fierce, unmoved (by foes) and firm, ready equipped for battle-- if Maghavanhears theinvocation of his adorer, he will not go apart (from us) but come here.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is fierce, unmoved (by foes) and firm, ready equipped for battle-- if Maghavanhears theinvocation of his adorer, he will not go apart (from us) but come here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽवृतः ।वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: satyám ǀ itthā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ít ǀ asi ǀ vṛ́ṣa-jūtiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ ugra ǀ śṛṇviṣé ǀ parā-váti ǀ vṛ́ṣo íti ǀ arvā-váti ǀ śrutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily (Indra), in this manner you are the showerer (of benefits), brought by vigorous (steeds) to us,unresisted (by foes); fierce (Indra), you are celebrated as a showerer (of benefits) when afar; you are celebratedas a showerer (of benefits) when near.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily (Indra), in this manner you are the showerer (of benefits), brought by vigorous (steeds) to us,unresisted (by foes); fierce (Indra), you are celebrated as a showerer (of benefits) when afar; you are celebratedas a showerer (of benefits) when near.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषणस्ते अभीशवो वृषा कशा हिरण्ययी ।वृषा रथो मघवन्वृषणा हरी वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ te ǀ abhī́śavaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ káśā ǀ hiraṇyáyī ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ tvám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerers (of benefits) are your reins, such also is your golden whip, your chariot,Maghavan, is ashowerer (of benefits), so are your two horses; and you, too,Śatakratu, are the showerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: Showerers (of benefits) are your reins, such also is your golden whip, your chariot,Maghavan, is ashowerer (of benefits), so are your two horses; and you, too,Śatakratu, are the showerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा सोता सुनोतु ते वृषन्नृजीपिन्ना भर ।वृषा दधन्वे वृषणं नदीष्वा तुभ्यं स्थातर्हरीणां ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ sótā ǀ sunotu ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣan ǀ ṛjīpin ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ dadhanve ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ túbhyam ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ harīṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer (of benefits), may the offerer of the libation to you effuse the Somaas a showerer;straight-going (Indra), bring (us wealth); arrester of your horses, the showerer (of the oblation) has prepared thebountiful Soma to be mixed with the waters for you.
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer (of benefits), may the offerer of the libation to you effuse the Somaas a showerer;straight-going (Indra), bring (us wealth); arrester of your horses, the showerer (of the oblation) has prepared thebountiful Soma to be mixed with the waters for you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एंद्र याहि पीतये मधु शविष्ठ सोम्यं ।नायमच्छा मघवा शृणवद्गिरो ब्रह्मोक्था च सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ pītáye ǀ mádhu ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ somyám ǀná ǀ ayám ǀ áccha ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ gíraḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ca ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, most powerful Indra, to drink of the Somaambrosia, (for without coming) this Maghavan, theachiever of many exploits, hears not our praises, our chants, our hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, most powerful Indra, to drink of the Somaambrosia, (for without coming) this Maghavan, theachiever of many exploits, hears not our praises, our chants, our hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वहंतु त्वा रथेष्ठामा हरयो रथयुजः ।तिरश्चिदर्यं सवनानि वृत्रहन्नन्येषां या शतक्रतो ॥
verses.transliteration: váhantu ǀ tvā ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ ratha-yújaḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ aryám ǀ sávanāni ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anyéṣām ǀ yā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǁ
verses.english_translation: Śatakratu, slayer of Vṛtra, let your horses, yoked to your car, bring you, the lord, riding in your chariot,(to our sacrifices), avoiding those sacrifices (offered) by others.
verses.wilson_translation: Śatakratu, slayer of Vṛtra, let your horses, yoked to your car, bring you, the lord, riding in your chariot,(to our sacrifices), avoiding those sacrifices (offered) by others.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमद्यांतमं स्तोमं धिष्व महामह ।अस्माकं ते सवना संतु शंतमा मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ ántamam ǀ stómam ǀ dhiṣva ǀ mahā-maha ǀasmā́kam ǀ te ǀ sávanā ǀ santu ǀ śám-tamā ǀ mádāya ǀ dyukṣa ǀ soma-pāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Greatest of the great, brilliant drinker of the Soma, accept today this our present praise; may oursacrifices be most sucessful in exciting your exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Greatest of the great, brilliant drinker of the Soma, accept today this our present praise; may oursacrifices be most sucessful in exciting your exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि षस्तव नो मम शास्त्रे अन्यस्य रण्यति ।यो अस्मान्वीर आनयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ sáḥ ǀ táva ǀ naḥ ǀ máma ǀ śāstré ǀ anyásya ǀ ráṇyati ǀyáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ vīráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ánayat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The hero (Indra) who has (ever) guided us delights not in your punishment, nor in mine; nor in that ofany other.
verses.wilson_translation: The hero (Indra) who has (ever) guided us delights not in your punishment, nor in mine; nor in that ofany other.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रश्चिद्घा तदब्रवीत्स्त्रिया अशास्यं मनः ।उतो अह क्रतुं रघुं ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ tát ǀ abravīt ǀ striyā́ḥ ǀ aśāsyám ǀ mánaḥ ǀutó íti ǀ áha ǀ krátum ǀ raghúm ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily Indrasaid that the mind of a woman is not to be controlled, he declared also that her intellect wassmall.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily Indrasaid that the mind of a woman is not to be controlled, he declared also that her intellect wassmall.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सप्ती चिद्घा मदच्युता मिथुना वहतो रथं ।एवेद्धूर्वृष्ण उत्तरा ॥
verses.transliteration: sáptī íti ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ mada-cyútā ǀ mithunā́ ǀ vahataḥ ǀ rátham ǀevá ǀ ít ǀ dhū́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ út-tarā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The two horses of Indra, hastening to the exhilaration (of the Soma), draw his chariot; the pole of theshowerer rests upon them.
verses.wilson_translation: The two horses of Indra, hastening to the exhilaration (of the Soma), draw his chariot; the pole of theshowerer rests upon them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधः पश्यस्व मोपरि संतरां पादकौ हर ।मा ते कशप्लकौ दृशन् स्त्री हि ब्रह्मा बभूविथ ॥
verses.transliteration: adháḥ ǀ paśyasva ǀ mā́ ǀ upári ǀ sam-tarā́m ǀ pādakáu ǀ hara ǀmā́ ǀ te ǀ kaśa-plakáu ǀ dṛśan ǀ strī́ ǀ hí ǀ brahmā́ ǀ babhū́vitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Cast your eyes (son of pluralyoga) downwards, not upwards; keep your feet close together; let not (men)behold yourankles, for from having been abrahmāyou have become a feminine le.
verses.wilson_translation: Cast your eyes (son of pluralyoga) downwards, not upwards; keep your feet close together; let not (men)behold yourankles, for from having been abrahmāyou have become a feminine le.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIV. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: (१८) १ १५ नीपातिथि: काण्व:, १६ -१८ सहस्रं वसुरोचिषोऽङ्गिरस: । इन्द्र: । अनुष्टुप् , १६-१८ गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Come hither, Indra, with thy Bays, come thou to Kaṇva's eulogy.Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven. May the stone draw thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice.Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven. The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep.Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven. The Kaṇvas call thee hitherward for succour and to win the spoil.Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven. I set for thee, as for the Strong, the first draught of the juices shed. Come with abundant blessings, come with perfect care to succour us. Come, Lord of lofty thought, who hast infinite wealth and countless aids. Adorable mid Gods, the Priest good to mankind shall bring thee near. As wings the falcon, so thy Bays rushing in joy shall carry thee. Come from the enemy to us, to svaha and the Soma-draught. Come hither with thine car inclined to hear, take pleasure in our lauds. Lord of well-nourished Horses, come with well-fed Steeds alike in hue. Come hither from the mountains, come from regions of the sea of air. Disclose to us O Hero, wealth in thousands both of kine and steeds. Bring riches hitherward to us in hundreds, thousands, myriads.Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven. The thousand steeds, the mightiest troop, which we and Indra have receivedFrom Vasurocis as a gift, The brown that match the wind in speed, and bright bay coursers fleet of foot,Like Suns, resplendent are they all. Mid the Pargvata's rich gifts, swift steeds whose wheels run rapidly,I seemed to stand amid a wood.

verses.sanskrit: एंद्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिं ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ káṇvasya ǀ su-stutím ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Indra, with your horses to receive the praise of Kaṇva; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiantwith oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Indra, with your horses to receive the praise of Kaṇva; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiantwith oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा ग्रावा वदन्निह सोमी घोषेण यच्छतु ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ grā́vā ǀ vádan ǀ ihá ǀ somī́ ǀ ghóṣeṇa ǀ yacchatu ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the grinding stone, yielding the Somaas it utters a sound, bring you here with the noise; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: May the grinding stone, yielding the Somaas it utters a sound, bring you here with the noise; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: átra ǀ ví ǀ nemíḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ úrām ǀ ná ǀ dhūnute ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: The circumference of these (stones) shakes (the Soma) at this (rite), as a wolf (terrifies) a sheep doyou, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: The circumference of these (stones) shakes (the Soma) at this (rite), as a wolf (terrifies) a sheep doyou, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा कण्वा इहावसे हवंते वाजसातये ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ávase ǀ hávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Kaṇvasinvoke you here for protection and for food; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: The Kaṇvasinvoke you here for protection and for food; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दधामि ते सुतानां वृष्णे न पूर्वपाय्यं ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: dádhāmi ǀ te ǀ sutā́nām ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ ná ǀ pūrva-pā́yyam ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: I make offering to you of the libations as the first drink is presented to the showerer; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: I make offering to you of the libations as the first drink is presented to the showerer; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्मत्पुरंधिर्न आ गहि विश्वतोधीर्न ऊतये ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: smát-purandhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ viśvátaḥ-dhīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra) master of the family of heaven, come to us; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra) master of the family of heaven, come to us; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो याहि महेमते सहस्रोते शतामघ ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ mahe-mate ǀ sáhasra-ūte ǀ śáta-magha ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sagacious (Indra) bestower of numerous protections, granter of infinite wealth, come uno us; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Sagacious (Indra) bestower of numerous protections, granter of infinite wealth, come uno us; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा होता मनुर्हितो देवत्रा वक्षदीड्यः ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ vakṣat ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (Agni) the invoker, adorable among the gods, the benefactor of man, bring you here; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: May (Agni) the invoker, adorable among the gods, the benefactor of man, bring you here; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा मदच्युता हरी श्येनं पक्षेव वक्षतः ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ mada-cyútā ǀ hárī íti ǀ śyenám ǀ pakṣā́-iva ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let your two steeds, humiliators of the pride (of foes), bring you as (his) two wings (bear along) thefalcon; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Let your two steeds, humiliators of the pride (of foes), bring you as (his) two wings (bear along) thefalcon; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ याह्यर्य आ परि स्वाहा सोमस्य पीतये ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pári ǀ svā́hā ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, lord, from whatever direction, to drink the Somaoffered withsvāhā; do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, lord, from whatever direction, to drink the Somaoffered withsvāhā; do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो याह्युपश्रुत्युक्थेषु रणया इह ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ úpa-śruti ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ raṇaya ǀ ihá ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to listen to our praises, when they are being recited-- bestow upon us delight; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to listen to our praises, when they are being recited-- bestow upon us delight; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सरूपैरा सु नो गहि संभृतैः संभृताश्वः ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: sá-rūpaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ gahi ǀ sám-bhṛtaiḥ ǀ sámbhṛta-aśvaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are possessed of cherished steeds, come to us with (your) well-fed and like-shaped horses;do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are possessed of cherished steeds, come to us with (your) well-fed and like-shaped horses;do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ याहि पर्वतेभ्यः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपः ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ párvatebhyaḥ ǀ samudrásya ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come from the mountains, from above the region of the firmament; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Come from the mountains, from above the region of the firmament; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो गव्यान्यश्व्या सहस्रा शूर दर्दृहि ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávyāni ǀ áśvyā ǀ sahásrā ǀ śūra ǀ dardṛhi ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us, hero, thousands of herds of cattle and horses; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us, hero, thousands of herds of cattle and horses; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नः सहस्रशो भरायुतानि शतानि च ।दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasra-śáḥ ǀ bhara ǀ ayútāni ǀ śatā́ni ǀ ca ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to us, by thousands, tens of thousands, and hundres (of good things); do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to us, by thousands, tens of thousands, and hundres (of good things); do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यदिंद्रश्च दद्वहे सहस्रं वसुरोचिषः ।ओजिष्ठमश्व्यं पशुं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ dádvahe íti ǀ sahásram ǀ vásu-rociṣaḥ ǀójiṣṭham ǀ áśvyam ǀ paśúm ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, the thousand Vasurociṣas, and Indra(our leader), when we obtain vigorous herds of horseṣ..
verses.wilson_translation: We, the thousand Vasurociṣas, and Indra(our leader), when we obtain vigorous herds of horseṣ..
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य ऋज्रा वातरंहसोऽरुषासो रघुष्यदः ।भ्राजंते सूर्या इव ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ ṛjrā́ḥ ǀ vā́ta-raṃhasaḥ ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ raghu-syádaḥ ǀbhrā́jante ǀ sū́ryāḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Such as are straight-going, fleet as the wind, bright-coloured, light- footed, and shine like the suṇ..
verses.wilson_translation: Such as are straight-going, fleet as the wind, bright-coloured, light- footed, and shine like the suṇ..
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पारावतस्य रातिषु द्रवच्चक्रेष्वाशुषु ।तिष्ठं वनस्य मध्य आ ॥
verses.transliteration: pā́rāvatasya ǀ rātíṣu ǀ dravát-cakreṣu ǀ āśúṣu ǀtíṣṭham ǀ vánasya ǀ mádhye ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then (having received) the horses, attached to the rolling-wheeled chariot, given from afar, we departto the middle of the forest.
verses.wilson_translation: Then (having received) the horses, attached to the rolling-wheeled chariot, given from afar, we departto the middle of the forest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXV. Aśvins.
hymns.anukramani: २४ श्यावाश्व आत्रेय: । अश्विनौ  । उपरिष्टाज्ज्योति: ( त्रिष्टुप् ), २२, २४ पंक्ति:, २३ महाबृहती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH Agni and with Indra, Viṣṇu. Varuṇa, with the Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, closely leagued;Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, drink the Soma juice. With all the Holy Thoughts, all being Mighty Ones! in close alliance wil the Mountains, Heaven, and Earth;Accordant. of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, drink the Soma juice. With all the Deities, three times eleven, here, in close alliance with the Maruts, Bhṛgus, Floods;Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, drink the Soma juice. Accept the sacrifice, attend to this my call: come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, bring us strengthening food. Accept our praise-song as a youth accepts a maid. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, bring us strengthening food. Accept the songs we sing, accept the solemn rite. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, bring us strengthening food. Ye fly as starlings fly unto the forest trees; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aśvins, to our home. Ye fly like swans, like those who travel on their way; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aśvins, to our home. Ye fly to our oblation like a pair of hawks; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aśvins, to our home. Come hitherward and drink and satisfy yourselves, bestow upon us progeny and affluence.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, grant us vigorous strength. Conquer your foes, protect us, praise your worshippers; bestow upon us progeny and affluence.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, grant us vigorous strength. Slay enemies, animate men whom ye befriend; bestow upon us progeny and affluence.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, O Aśvins, grant us vigorous strength. With Mitra, Varuṇa, Dharma, and the Maruts in your company approach unto your praiser's call.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, and with the Ādityas, Aśvins! come. With Viṣṇu and the Aṅgirases attending you, and with the Maruts come unto your praiser's call.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, and with the Ādityas, Aśvins! come. With Ṛbhus and With Vājas. O ye Mighty Ones, leagued with the Maruts come ye to your praiser's call.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, and with the Ādityas, Aśvins! come. Give spirit to our prayer and animate our thoughts; slay ye the Rākṣasas and drive away disease.Accordant, of One mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, -the presser's Soma, Aśvins drink. Strengthen the Ruling Power, strengthen the men of war; slay ye the Rākṣasas and drive away disease.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Aśvins drink. Give strength unto the milch-kine, give the people strength, slay ye the Rākṣasas and drive away disease.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Aśvins drink. As ye heard Atri's earliest eulogy, so hear Śyāvāśva, Soma-presser, ye who reel in joy.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aśvins, three days old. Further like running streams Śyāvāśva's eulogies who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aśvins, three days old. Seize, as ye grasp the reins, Śyāvāśva's solemn rites who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy.Accordant, of one mind with Sūrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aśvins, three days old. Drive down your chariot hitherward drink ye the Soma's savoury juice.Approach, ye Aśvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper. When sacrifice which tells our reverence hath begun. Heroes! to drink the gushing juice,Approach, ye Aśvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper. Sate you with consecrated drink, with juice effused, ye Deities.Approach, ye Aśvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निनेंद्रेण वरुणेन विष्णुनादित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: agnínā ǀ índreṇa ǀ váruṇena ǀ víṣṇunā ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ rudráiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated with Agni, with Indra, with Varuṇa, with Viṣṇu, with theĀdityas, the Rudras, and the Vasus, and united with the dawn and with Sūrya, drink,Aśvins, the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated with Agni, with Indra, with Varuṇa, with Viṣṇu, with theĀdityas, the Rudras, and the Vasus, and united with the dawn and with Sūrya, drink,Aśvins, the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वाभिर्धीभिर्भुवनेन वाजिना दिवा पृथिव्याद्रिभिः सचाभुवा ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvābhiḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ bhúvanena ǀ vājinā ǀ divā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Powerful (Aśvins), associated with all intelligences, with all beings, with heaven, with earth, with themountains, united with the dawn and with the Sūrya, drink, Aśvins, the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Powerful (Aśvins), associated with all intelligences, with all beings, with heaven, with earth, with themountains, united with the dawn and with the Sūrya, drink, Aśvins, the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वैर्देवैस्त्रिभिरेकादशैरिहाद्भिर्मरुद्भिर्भृगुभिः सचाभुवा ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvaiḥ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ ekādaśáiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ bhṛ́gu-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated with all the thrice-eleven deities at this ceremony, with the waters, with the Maruts, with the Bhṛgus, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, drink,Aśvins, the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated with all the thrice-eleven deities at this ceremony, with the waters, with the Maruts, with the Bhṛgus, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, drink,Aśvins, the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुषेथां यज्ञं बोधतं हवस्य मे विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: juṣéthām ǀ yajñám ǀ bódhatam ǀ hávasya ǀ me ǀ víśvā ǀ ihá ǀ devau ǀ sávanā ǀ áva ǀ gacchatam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǀ voḷham ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be gratified by the sacrifice; hear my invocation; recognize, deities, all the offerings in this ceremony;united with the dawn and with Sūrya, bring us Aśvins, food.
verses.wilson_translation: Be gratified by the sacrifice; hear my invocation; recognize, deities, all the offerings in this ceremony;united with the dawn and with Sūrya, bring us Aśvins, food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तोमं जुषेथां युवशेव कन्यनां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: stómam ǀ juṣethām ǀ yuvaśā́-iva ǀ kanyánām ǀ víśvā ǀ ihá ǀ devau ǀ sávanā ǀ áva ǀ gacchatam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǀ voḷham ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be gratified by our praise as youths are delighted (by the voices) of maidens; recognize, deities, all theofferings in this ceremony; united with the dawn adn with Sūrya, bring us,Aśvins, food.
verses.wilson_translation: Be gratified by our praise as youths are delighted (by the voices) of maidens; recognize, deities, all theofferings in this ceremony; united with the dawn adn with Sūrya, bring us,Aśvins, food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरो जुषेथामध्वरं जुषेथां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: gíraḥ ǀ juṣethām ǀ adhvarám ǀ juṣethām ǀ víśvā ǀ ihá ǀ devau ǀ sávanā ǀ áva ǀ gacchatam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǀ voḷham ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be gratified, deities, by our praises, be gratified by the sacrifice, recognize, deities, all the offerings inthis ceremony; united with the dawn and with Sūrya, bring us,Aśvins, food.
verses.wilson_translation: Be gratified, deities, by our praises, be gratified by the sacrifice, recognize, deities, all the offerings inthis ceremony; united with the dawn and with Sūrya, bring us,Aśvins, food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हारिद्रवेव पतथो वनेदुप सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: hāridravā́-iva ǀ patathaḥ ǀ vánā ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ mahiṣā́-iva ǀ áva ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ tríḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You alight upon the effused Somaas the Hāridravā plural nges unto the water; you fall upon it like twobuffaloes (plural nging into a pool); united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come,Aśvins, by the triple path.
verses.wilson_translation: You alight upon the effused Somaas the Hāridravā plural nges unto the water; you fall upon it like twobuffaloes (plural nging into a pool); united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come,Aśvins, by the triple path.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हंसाविव पतथो अध्वगाविव सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: haṃsáu-iva ǀ patathaḥ ǀ adhvagáu-iva ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ mahiṣā́-iva ǀ áva ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ tríḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: As two geese, as two travellers, as two buffaloes (hasten to water), you alight,Aśvins, upon the effused Soma; united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come, Aśvins, by the triple path.
verses.wilson_translation: As two geese, as two travellers, as two buffaloes (hasten to water), you alight,Aśvins, upon the effused Soma; united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come, Aśvins, by the triple path.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्येनाविव पतथो हव्यदातये सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: śyenáu-iva ǀ patathaḥ ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ mahiṣā́-iva ǀ áva ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ tríḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You hasten like two falcons to the offerer of the libation, you alight upon the effused Somaas twobuffaloes (hasten to water), united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come,Aśvins, by the triple path.
verses.wilson_translation: You hasten like two falcons to the offerer of the libation, you alight upon the effused Somaas twobuffaloes (hasten to water), united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come,Aśvins, by the triple path.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबतं च तृप्णुतं चा च गच्छतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: píbatam ǀ ca ǀ tṛpṇutám ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ gacchatam ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ca ǀ dhattám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhattam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ū́rjam ǀ naḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink,Aśvins, the Soma, and satiate yourselves; come here; give us progeny; give us wealth; unitedwith the dawn and with Sūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink,Aśvins, the Soma, and satiate yourselves; come here; give us progeny; give us wealth; unitedwith the dawn and with Sūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जयतं च प्र स्तुतं च प्र चावतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: jáyatam ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ stutam ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ avatam ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ca ǀ dhattám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhattam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ū́rjam ǀ naḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Conquer (Aśvins), your foes; protect and praise (your worshipper), grant progeny, give wealth, andunited with the dawn and with Sūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Conquer (Aśvins), your foes; protect and praise (your worshipper), grant progeny, give wealth, andunited with the dawn and with Sūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हतं च शत्रून्यततं च मित्रिणः प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: hatám ǀ ca ǀ śátrūn ǀ yátatam ǀ ca ǀ mitríṇaḥ ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ca ǀ dhattám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhattam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ū́rjam ǀ naḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroy your foes, repair to your friends, grant progeny, give wealth, and, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, give us,Aśvins, strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroy your foes, repair to your friends, grant progeny, give wealth, and, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, give us,Aśvins, strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणवंता उत धर्मवंता मरुत्वंता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrā́váruṇa-vantau ǀ utá ǀ dhárma-vantā ǀ marútvantā ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ hávam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated with Mitraand Varuṇa, with Dharma, with the Maruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūryaand with theĀdityas.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated with Mitraand Varuṇa, with Dharma, with the Maruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūryaand with theĀdityas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंगिरस्वंता उत विष्णुवंता मरुत्वंता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: áṅgirasvantau ǀ utá ǀ víṣṇu-vantā ǀ marútvantā ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ hávam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated with the Aṅgirasas, with Viṣṇu, with the Maruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūrya, and with theĀdityas.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated with the Aṅgirasas, with Viṣṇu, with the Maruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūrya, and with theĀdityas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुमंता वृषणा वाजवंता मरुत्वंता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवं ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛbhu-mántā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vā́ja-vantā ǀ marútvantā ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ hávam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated with theṚbhus, and with themaruts, repair, showerers (of benefits), dispensers of food, tothe invocation of the adorer; repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūrya, and with theĀdityas.
verses.wilson_translation: Associated with theṚbhus, and with themaruts, repair, showerers (of benefits), dispensers of food, tothe invocation of the adorer; repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūrya, and with theĀdityas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं धियो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥

verses.english_translation: Be propitious to prayer, be propitious to sacred rites, slay therākṣasas, remedy diseases united withthe dawn and with Sūrya, (drink),Aśvins, the Somaof the offerer.
verses.wilson_translation: Be propitious to prayer, be propitious to sacred rites, slay therākṣasas, remedy diseases united withthe dawn and with Sūrya, (drink),Aśvins, the Somaof the offerer.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेरिव शृणुतं पूर्व्यस्तुतिं श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यं ॥

verses.english_translation: Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), hear the earnest praise ofŚyāvāśvaoffering libations as(you did) that of Atri, and, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, (drink),Aśvins, (the Soma) prepared theprevious day.

verses.english_translation: Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), accept the earnest praises ofŚyāvāśvaoffering youlibations as if you were accepting oblations; and, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, (drink),Aśvins, (the Soma) prepared the previous day.

verses.sanskrit: रश्मीँरिव यच्छतमध्वराँ उप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यं ॥

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाग्रथं नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ।आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: arvā́k ǀ rátham ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǀ píbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ vām ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ dhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Direct your chariot downwards, drink the Somanectar; come,Aśvins, come (here); desirous of yourprotection, I invoke you; give precious riches to the donor of the offering.
verses.wilson_translation: Direct your chariot downwards, drink the Somanectar; come,Aśvins, come (here); desirous of yourprotection, I invoke you; give precious riches to the donor of the offering.

verses.sanskrit: नमोवाके प्रस्थिते अध्वरे नरा विवक्षणस्य पीतये ।आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥

verses.english_translation: Come, leaders of rites, when the sacrifice, at which your adoration is cited, is commenced, to drink ofthe Somaoffered by me; come,Aśvins, come (here), desirous of protection, I invoke you; give precious riches tothe donor of the offering.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहाकृतस्य तृंपतं सुतस्य देवावंधसः ।आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥

verses.english_translation: Divine (Aśvins), partake to satiety of the sacrificial Soma, consecrated with the exclamationsvāhā;come, Aśvins, come (here); desirous of protection, I invoke you; give precious riches to the donor of the offering.

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVI. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU helpest him whose grass is trimmed, who sheds the juice, O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.The share which they have fixed for thee, thou, Indra, Victor o’er all hosts and space, begirt with Maruts, Lord of Heroes, winner of the floods. Maghavan, help thy worshipper: let him help thee. O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.The share which they have fixed for thee, etc. Thou aidest Gods with food, and that with might aids thee,O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. Creator of the heaven, creator of the earth, O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. Father of cattle, father of all steeds art thou. O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. Stone-hurler, glorify the Atris' hymn of praise. O Śatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. Hear thou Śyāvāśva while he pours to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites.Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his prayers.

verses.sanskrit: अवितासि सुन्वतो वृक्तबर्हिषः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इंद्र सत्पते ॥
verses.transliteration: avitā́ ǀ asi ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyám ǀ te ǀ bhāgám ǀ ádhārayan ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sehānáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǀ marútvān ǀ indra ǀ sat-pate ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are the protector of the effuser of the libation, of the strewer of he clipped sacred grass; drinkjoyfully,Śatakratu, the Somafor your exhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of thevirtuous, who are the victor over all (hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leaderof the Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: You are the protector of the effuser of the libation, of the strewer of he clipped sacred grass; drinkjoyfully,Śatakratu, the Somafor your exhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of thevirtuous, who are the victor over all (hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leaderof the Maruts.

verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः ।प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इंद्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ táthā ǀ śṛṇu ǀ yáthā ǀ áśṛṇoḥ ǀ átreḥ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ kṛṇvatáḥ ǀprá ǀ trasádasyum ǀ āvitha ǀ tvám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vardháyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hear (the praises) ofŚyāvāśvaoffering the libations, as you have heard (those) of Atriengaged inholy rites; you alone,Indra, have defended Trasadasyuin battle, animating his prayers.
verses.wilson_translation: Hear (the praises) ofŚyāvāśvaoffering the libations, as you have heard (those) of Atriengaged inholy rites; you alone,Indra, have defended Trasadasyuin battle, animating his prayers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS prayer, and those who shed the juice, in wars with Vṛtra thou holpest, Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy succours.O Vṛtra-slayer, from libation poured at noon, drink of the Soma juice, thou blameless Thunderer. Thou mighty Conqueror of hostile armaments, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help. Sole Ruler, thou art Sovran of this world of life, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help. Thou only sunderest these two consistent worlds, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help. Thou art the Lord supreme o’er rest and energy, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help. Thou helpest one to power, and one thou hast not helped, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving aid. Hear thou Śyāvāśva while he sings to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites.Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his powers.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेदं ब्रह्म वृत्रतूर्येष्वाविथ प्र सुन्वतः शचीपत इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ idám ǀ bráhma ǀ vṛtra-tū́ryeṣu ǀ āvitha ǀ prá ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You protect,Indra, lord of rites, with all protections in combats with enemies, this sacrifice of him whooffers you the libations; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt drink of the Somaat themid-day solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: You protect,Indra, lord of rites, with all protections in combats with enemies, this sacrifice of him whooffers you the libations; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt drink of the Somaat themid-day solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सेहान उग्र पृतना अभि द्रुहः शचीपत इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sehānáḥ ǀ ugra ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ drúhaḥ ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fierce Indra, defeater of hostile armies, lord of rites, (you protect) with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-day solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: Fierce Indra, defeater of hostile armies, lord of rites, (you protect) with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-day solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एकराळस्य भुवनस्य राजसि शचीपत इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: eka-rā́ṭ ǀ asyá ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rājasi ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You shine the sole sovereign of this world,Indra, lord of rites, with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-day solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: You shine the sole sovereign of this world,Indra, lord of rites, with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-day solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सस्थावाना यवयसि त्वमेक इच्छचीपत इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sa-sthā́vānā ǀ yavayasi ǀ tvám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You alone,Indra, lord of rites, separate the combined worlds (heaven and earth) with all yourprotections; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-daysolemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: You alone,Indra, lord of rites, separate the combined worlds (heaven and earth) with all yourprotections; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-daysolemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्षेमस्य च प्रयुजश्च त्वमीशिषे शचीपत इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣémasya ǀ ca ǀ pra-yújaḥ ǀ ca ǀ tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, lord of rites, are sovereign over our prosperity and gains, with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-day solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: You, lord of rites, are sovereign over our prosperity and gains, with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid-day solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्राय त्वमवसि न त्वमाविथ शचीपत इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣatrā́ya ǀ tvam ǀ ávasi ǀ ná ǀ tvam ǀ āvitha ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are for the strength (of the world), you protect with all your protections, but you need no defender,Indra, lord of rites; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid- daysolemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: You are for the strength (of the world), you protect with all your protections, but you need no defender,Indra, lord of rites; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Somaat the mid- daysolemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य रेभतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः ।प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इंद्र क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ rébhataḥ ǀ táthā ǀ śṛṇu ǀ yáthā ǀ áśṛṇoḥ ǀ átreḥ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ kṛṇvatáḥ ǀprá ǀ trasádasyum ǀ āvitha ǀ tvám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vardháyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hear the praises ofŚyāvāśvaeulogizing you, as you have heard those of Atriengaged in piousrites; you alone have protected Trasadasyuin battle, augmenting his vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Hear the praises ofŚyāvāśvaeulogizing you, as you have heard those of Atriengaged in piousrites; you alone have protected Trasadasyuin battle, augmenting his vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVIII. Indra-Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YE Twain are Priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works:Indra and Agni, mark this well. Ye bounteous riders on the car, ye Vṛtra-slayers unsubdued:Indra and Agni, mark this well. The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight:Indra, and Agni, mark this well. Accept our sacrifice for weal, sharers of praise! the Soma shed:Indra and Agni, Heroes, come. Be pleased with these libations which attract you to our sacred giftsIndra and Agni, Heroes, come. Accept this eulogy of mine whose model is the Gāyatrī:Indra and Agni, Heroes, Come. Come with the early-faring Gods, ye who are Lords of genuine wealth:Indra-Agni, to the Soma-draught Hear ye the call of Atris, hear Śyāvāśva as he sheds the juice:Indra-Agni to the Soma-draught Thus have I called you to our aid as sages called on you of old:Indra-Agni to the Soma draught! Indra's and Agni's grace I claim, Sarasvatī's associatesTo whom this psalm of praise is sung.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु ।इंद्राग्नी तस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñásya ǀ hí ǀ stháḥ ǀ ṛtvíjā ǀ sásnī íti ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ kárma-su ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraand Agni, you are the pure ministrants, (encouragers) in offerings and sacred rites-- hear (thepraise) of this (your worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: Indraand Agni, you are the pure ministrants, (encouragers) in offerings and sacred rites-- hear (thepraise) of this (your worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता ।इंद्राग्नी तस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tośā́sā ǀ ratha-yā́vānā ǀ vṛtra-hánā ǀ áparā-jitā ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroyers (of foes), riding in one chariot, slayers of Vṛtra, invincible; hear,Indraand Agni, (the praise)of this (your worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: Destroyers (of foes), riding in one chariot, slayers of Vṛtra, invincible; hear,Indraand Agni, (the praise)of this (your worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः ।इंद्राग्नी तस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.transliteration: idám ǀ vām ǀ madirám ǀ mádhu ǀ ádhukṣan ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The leaders of rites have effused by the stones this sweet exhilarating (Soma) for you; hear,Indraand Agni, (the praise) of this (your worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: The leaders of rites have effused by the stones this sweet exhilarating (Soma) for you; hear,Indraand Agni, (the praise) of this (your worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये सुतं सोमं सधस्तुती ।इंद्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
verses.transliteration: juṣéthām ǀ yajñám ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ sadhastutī íti sadha-stutī ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ narā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associate in praie, accept the sacrifice; leaders of rites,Indraand Agni, come hither to the Somaeffused for this solemnity.
verses.wilson_translation: Associate in praie, accept the sacrifice; leaders of rites,Indraand Agni, come hither to the Somaeffused for this solemnity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमा जुषेथां सवना येभिर्हव्यान्यूहथुः ।इंद्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ ǀ juṣethām ǀ sávanā ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ ūháthuḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ narā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accept these sacrifices whereby you have borne away the oblations; leaders of rites,Indraand Agni,come hither.
verses.wilson_translation: Accept these sacrifices whereby you have borne away the oblations; leaders of rites,Indraand Agni,come hither.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमां गायत्रवर्तनिं जुषेथां सुष्टुतिं मम ।इंद्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́m ǀ gāyatrá-vartanim ǀ juṣéthām ǀ su-stutím ǀ máma ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ narā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Accept this my earnest praise, following the path of thegāyatrī; leaders of rites,Indraand Agni, comehere.
verses.wilson_translation: Accept this my earnest praise, following the path of thegāyatrī; leaders of rites,Indraand Agni, comehere.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रातर्यावभिरा गतं देवेभिर्जेन्यावसू ।इंद्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: prātaryā́va-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ jenyāvasū íti ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rich with the spoils of victory, come,Indraand Agni, to drink of the Soma, with the deities astir in themorning.
verses.wilson_translation: Rich with the spoils of victory, come,Indraand Agni, to drink of the Soma, with the deities astir in themorning.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतोऽत्रीणां शृणुतं हवं ।इंद्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ átrīṇām ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávam ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hear the invocation,Indraand Agni, ofŚyāvāśvapouring out the effused Soma, (and) the Atris, todrink of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Hear the invocation,Indraand Agni, ofŚyāvāśvapouring out the effused Soma, (and) the Atris, todrink of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवंत मेधिराः ।इंद्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ vām ǀ ahve ǀ ūtáye ǀ yáthā ǀ áhuvanta ǀ médhirāḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke you both,Indraand Agni, as the sages have invoked you, for your protection (and) to drink ofthe Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke you both,Indraand Agni, as the sages have invoked you, for your protection (and) to drink ofthe Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आहं सरस्वतीवतोरिंद्राग्न्योरवो वृणे ।याभ्यां गायत्रमृच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ahám ǀ sárasvatī-vatoḥ ǀ indrāgnyóḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ vṛṇe ǀyā́bhyām ǀ gāyatrám ǀ ṛcyáte ǁ
verses.english_translation: I solicit the protection of Indraand Agni, associated with Sarasvatī, to whom this Gāyatrīhymn isaddressed.
verses.wilson_translation: I solicit the protection of Indraand Agni, associated with Sarasvatī, to whom this Gāyatrīhymn isaddressed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIX. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE glorious Agni have I praised, and worshipped with. the sacred food.May Agni deck the Gods for us. Between both gathering-places he goes on his embassy, the Sage. May all the others die away. Agni, burn down the word within their bodies through our newest speech,All hatreds of the godless, all the wicked man's malignities. Away let the destroyers go. May all the others die away. Agni, I offer hymns to thee, like holy oil within thy mouth.Acknowledge them. among the Gods, for thou art the most excellent, the worshipper's blissful messenger. Let all the others die away. Agni bestows all vital power even as each man supplicates.He brings the Vasus strengthening gifts, and grants delight, in rest and stir, for every calling on the Gods. Let all the others die away. Agni hath made himself renowned by wonderful victorious act.He is the Priest of all the tribes, chosen with sacrificial meeds. He urges Deities to receive. Let all the others die away. Agni knows all that springs from Gods, he knows the mystery of men.Giver of wealth is Agni, he uncloses both the doors to us when worshipped with our newest gift. Let all the others die away. Agni inhabiteth with Gods and men who offer sacrifice.He cherisheth with great delight much wisdom, as all things that be, God among Gods adorable. May all the others die away. Agni who liveth in all streams, Lord of the Sevenfold Race of men,Him dweller in three homes we seek, best slayer of the Dasyus for Mandhātar, first in sacrifice. Let all the others die away. Agni the Wise inhabiteth three gathering-places, triply formed.Decked as our envoy let the Sage bring hither and conciliate the Thrice Eleven Deities. Let all the others die away. Our Agni, thou art first among the Gods, and first mid living men.Thou only rulest over wealth. Round about thee, as natural dams, circumfluous the waters run. Let all the others die away.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमस्तोष्यृग्मियमग्निमीळा यजध्यै ।अग्निर्देवाँ अनक्तु न उभे हि विदथे कविरंतश्चरति दूत्यं नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ astoṣi ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀ agním ǀ īḷā́ ǀ yajádhyai ǀagníḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ anaktu ǀ naḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ hí ǀ vidáthe íti ǀ kavíḥ ǀ antáríti ǀ cárati ǀ dūtyám ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: I glorify the adorable Agni, (I invite) Agni with praise to the sacrifice, may Agni brighten the gods with theoblations at our sacrifice; the sage Agni traverses both (worlds discharging his function) as messenger of thegods; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify the adorable Agni, (I invite) Agni with praise to the sacrifice, may Agni brighten the gods with theoblations at our sacrifice; the sage Agni traverses both (worlds discharging his function) as messenger of thegods; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्ने नव्यसा वचस्तनूषु शंसमेषां ।न्यराती रराव्णां विश्वा अर्यो अरातीरितो युच्छंत्वामुरो नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ agne ǀ návyasā ǀ vácaḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ śáṃsam ǀ eṣām ǀní ǀ árātīḥ ǀ rárāvṇām ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātīḥ ǀ itáḥ ǀ yucchantu ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Propitiated),Agni, by our new praise baffle the hostile attempts of these against our person ns, consumethe enemies of those who are liberal (at sacred rites); may all our foolish assailants depart from here, may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: (Propitiated),Agni, by our new praise baffle the hostile attempts of these against our person ns, consumethe enemies of those who are liberal (at sacred rites); may all our foolish assailants depart from here, may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने मन्मानि तुभ्यं कं घृतं न जुह्व आसनि ।स देवेषु प्र चिकिद्धि त्वं ह्यसि पूर्व्यः शिवो दूतो विवस्वतो नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ mánmāni ǀ túbhyam ǀ kám ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ juhve ǀ āsáni ǀsáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ prá ǀ cikiddhi ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: I pour into your mouth,Agni, praises as others (fill it) with delicious butter; do you amidst the godsacknowledge (them), for you are ancient, the giver of happiness, the messenger of Vivaśvat; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: I pour into your mouth,Agni, praises as others (fill it) with delicious butter; do you amidst the godsacknowledge (them), for you are ancient, the giver of happiness, the messenger of Vivaśvat; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्तदग्निर्वयो दधे यथायथा कृपण्यति ।ऊर्जाहुतिर्वसूनां शं च योश्च मयो दधे विश्वस्यै देवहूत्यै नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: tát-tat ǀ agníḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ yáthā-yathā ǀ kṛpaṇyáti ǀūrjā́-āhutiḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ śám ǀ ca ǀ yóḥ ǀ ca ǀ máyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ víśvasyai ǀ devá-hūtyai ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnigrants whatever food is solicited; invoked with offerings, he bestows on the worshippershappiness springing from tranquility and the enjoyment (of objects of sense); he is requisite for all invocation ofthe gods; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnigrants whatever food is solicited; invoked with offerings, he bestows on the worshippershappiness springing from tranquility and the enjoyment (of objects of sense); he is requisite for all invocation ofthe gods; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स चिकेत सहीयसाग्निश्चित्रेण कर्मणा ।स होता शश्वतीनां दक्षिणाभिरभीवृत इनोति च प्रतीव्यं नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ciketa ǀ sáhīyasā ǀ agníḥ ǀ citréṇa ǀ kármaṇā ǀsáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ dákṣiṇābhiḥ ǀ abhí-vṛtaḥ ǀ inóti ǀ ca ǀ pratīvyám ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agniis known by his most powerful and manifold deeds; he is the invoker of the eternals; surroundedby victims, he proceeds against the foe; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniis known by his most powerful and manifold deeds; he is the invoker of the eternals; surroundedby victims, he proceeds against the foe; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्जाता देवानामग्निर्वेद मर्तानामपीच्यं ।अग्निः स द्रविणोदा अग्निर्द्वारा व्यूर्णुते स्वाहुतो नवीयसा नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jātā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ agníḥ ǀ veda ǀ mártānām ǀ apīcyám ǀagníḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ dvā́rā ǀ ví ǀ ūrṇute ǀ sú-āhutaḥ ǀ návīyasā ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agniknows the birth of the gods; Agni knows the secrets of mankind; Agni is the giver of riches; Agni,duly worshipped with a new (oblation), sets open the doors (of opulence); may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniknows the birth of the gods; Agni knows the secrets of mankind; Agni is the giver of riches; Agni,duly worshipped with a new (oblation), sets open the doors (of opulence); may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्देवेषु संवसुः स विक्षु यज्ञियास्वा ।स मुदा काव्या पुरु विश्वं भूमेव पुष्यति देवो देवेषु यज्ञियो नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ sám-vasuḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ yajñíyāsu ǀ ā́ ǀsáḥ ǀ mudā́ ǀ kā́vyā ǀ purú ǀ víśvam ǀ bhū́ma-iva ǀ puṣyati ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnihas his abode among the gods, he (dwells) among pious people; he cherishes with plural asure manypious acts, as the earth all (beings); a god adorable among the gods; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnihas his abode among the gods, he (dwells) among pious people; he cherishes with plural asure manypious acts, as the earth all (beings); a god adorable among the gods; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो अग्निः सप्तमानुषः श्रितो विश्वेषु सिंधुषु ।तमागन्म त्रिपस्त्यं मंधातुर्दस्युहंतममग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ saptá-mānuṣaḥ ǀ śritáḥ ǀ víśveṣu ǀ síndhuṣu ǀtám ǀ ā́ ǀ aganma ǀ tri-pastyám ǀ mandhātúḥ ǀ dasyuhán-tamam ǀ agním ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us approach that Agniwho is ministered to by seven priess; who takes refuge in all rivers, whohasatriple dwelling plural ce, the slayer of the Dasyufor Mandhātā, who is foremost in sacrifices; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us approach that Agniwho is ministered to by seven priess; who takes refuge in all rivers, whohasatriple dwelling plural ce, the slayer of the Dasyufor Mandhātā, who is foremost in sacrifices; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निस्त्रीणि त्रिधातून्या क्षेति विदथा कविः ।स त्रीँरेकादशाँ इह यक्षच्च पिप्रयच्च नो विप्रो दूतः परिष्कृतो नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ tri-dhā́tūni ǀ ā́ ǀ kṣeti ǀ vidáthā ǀ kavíḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ trī́n ǀ ekādaśā́n ǀ ihá ǀ yákṣat ǀ ca ǀ pipráyat ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the sage, inhabits the three elementary regions; may he, intelligent, and richly decorated, themessenger (of the gods), here perform worship to the thrice eleven deities, and satisfy all our desires; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the sage, inhabits the three elementary regions; may he, intelligent, and richly decorated, themessenger (of the gods), here perform worship to the thrice eleven deities, and satisfy all our desires; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्न आयुषु त्वं देवेषु पूर्व्य वस्व एक इरज्यसि ।त्वामापः परिस्रुतः परि यंति स्वसेतवो नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ āyúṣu ǀ tvám ǀ devéṣu ǀ pūrvya ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ irajyasi ǀtvā́m ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ pari-srútaḥ ǀ pári ǀ yanti ǀ svá-setavaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, ancient Agni, among men and gods, are alone to us the lord of wealth; the flowing waters confinedwithin their own banks flow around you;may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: You, ancient Agni, among men and gods, are alone to us the lord of wealth; the flowing waters confinedwithin their own banks flow around you;may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XL. Indra-Agni.
hymns.anukramani: १२ नाभाक: काण्व:। इन्द्राग्नी । महापंक्ति:, २ शक्वरी ,१२ त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INDRA and Agni, surely ye as Conquerors will give us wealth,Whereby in fight we may o’ercome that which is strong and firmly fixed, as Agni burns the woods with wind. Let all the others die away. We set no snares to tangle you; Indra we worship and adore, Hero of heroes mightiest.Once may he come unto us with his Steed, come unto us to win us strength, and to complete the sacrifice. For, famous Indra-Agni, ye are dwellers in the midst of frays.Sages in wisdom, ye are knit to him who seeketh you as friends. Heroes, bestow on him his wish. Nabhāka-like, with sacred song Indra's and Agni's praise I sing,Theirs to whom all this world belongs, this heaven and this mighty earth which bear rich treasure in their lap. To Indra and to Agni send your prayers, as was Nabhāka's wont,—Who oped with sideway opening the sea with its foundations seven—Indra all powerful in his might. Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant,Demolish thou the Dāsa's might. May we with Indra's help divide the treasure he hath gathered up. What time with this same song these men call Indra-Agni sundry ways,May we with our own heroes quell those who provoke us to the fight, and conquer those who strive with us. The Two refulgent with their beams rise and come downward from the sky.By Indra's and by Agni's hest, flowing away, the rivers, run which they released from their restraint. O Indra, many are thine aids, many thy ways of guiding us,Lord of the Bay Steeds, Hinva's Son. To a Good Hero come our prayers, which soon shall have accomplishment. Inspire him with your holy hymns, the Hero bright and glorious,Him who with might demolisheth even the brood of Śuṣṇa, and winneth for us the heavenly streams. Inspire him worshipped with fair rites, the glorious Hero truly brave.He brake in pieces Śuṣṇa's brood who still expected not the stroke, and won for us the heavenly streams. Let all the others die away. Thus have we sung anew to Indra-Agni, as sang our sires, Aṅgirases, and Mandhātar.Guard us with triple shelter and preserve us: may we be masters of a store of riches.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी युवं सु नः सहंता दासथो रयिं ।येन दृळ्हा समत्स्वा वीळु चित्साहिषीमह्यग्निर्वनेव वात इन्नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ yuvám ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ sáhantā ǀ dā́sathaḥ ǀ rayím ǀyéna ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ samát-su ǀ ā́ ǀ vīḷú ǀ cit ǀ sahiṣīmáhi ǀ agníḥ ǀ vánā-iva ǀ vā́te ǀ ít ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Victorious Indraand Agni, bestow upon us riches whereby we may destroy our powerful enemies incombats as fire fanned by the wind consumes the forests; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Victorious Indraand Agni, bestow upon us riches whereby we may destroy our powerful enemies incombats as fire fanned by the wind consumes the forests; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि वां वव्रयामहेऽथेंद्रमिद्यजामहे शविष्ठं नृणां नरं ।स नः कदा चिदर्वता गमदा वाजसातये गमदा मेधसातये नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ vām ǀ vavráyāmahe ǀ átha ǀ índram ǀ ít ǀ yajāmahe ǀ śáviṣṭham ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ náram ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ cit ǀ árvatā ǀ gámat ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ gámat ǀ ā́ ǀ medhá-sātaye ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do we not invoke you both? We worship especially Indra, who is the strongest leader of men; he comesoccasionally with his horses to bestow upon us food; he comes to partake of the sacrifice; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Do we not invoke you both? We worship especially Indra, who is the strongest leader of men; he comesoccasionally with his horses to bestow upon us food; he comes to partake of the sacrifice; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता हि मध्यं भराणामिंद्राग्नी अधिक्षितः ।ता उ कवित्वना कवी पृच्छ्यमाना सखीयते सं धीतमश्नुतं नरा नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ mádhyam ǀ bhárāṇām ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ adhi-kṣitáḥ ǀtā́ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ kavi-tvanā́ ǀ kavī́ íti ǀ pṛcchyámānā ǀ sakhi-yaté ǀ sám ǀ dhītám ǀ aśnutam ǀ narā ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: They two,Indraand Agni, are present in the midst of battles; do you two, leaders of rites, who are reallysages, when solicited (by the wise), accept the offering (from him) who seeks your friendship; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: They two,Indraand Agni, are present in the midst of battles; do you two, leaders of rites, who are reallysages, when solicited (by the wise), accept the offering (from him) who seeks your friendship; may all ouradversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च नभाकवदिंद्राग्नी यजसा गिरा ।ययोर्विश्वमिदं जगदियं द्यौः पृथिवी मह्युपस्थे बिभृतो वसु नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ arca ǀ nabhāka-vát ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ yajásā ǀ girā́ ǀyáyoḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ idám ǀ jágat ǀ iyám ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ mahī́ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ bibhṛtáḥ ǀ vásu ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worship, like Nabhāka,Indraand Agniwith sacrifice and praise, of whom is this universe, upon whoselap this heaven and the spacious earth deposit their treasure; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.wilson_translation: Worship, like Nabhāka,Indraand Agniwith sacrifice and praise, of whom is this universe, upon whoselap this heaven and the spacious earth deposit their treasure; may all our adversaries perish.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्माणि नभाकवदिंद्राग्निभ्यामिरज्यत ।या सप्तबुध्नमर्णवं जिह्मबारमपोर्णुत इंद्र ईशान ओजसा नभंतामन्यके समे ॥
