verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ mūrā́ḥ ǀ aviṣyávaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ upa-hásvānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dabhan ǀmā́kīm ǀ brahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ vanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not fools, seeking protection, nor mockers trouble you; favour not the enemies of the brāhmaṇaṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Let not fools, seeking protection, nor mockers trouble you; favour not the enemies of the brāhmaṇaṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इह त्वा गोपरीणसा महे मंदंतु राधसे ।सरो गौरो यथा पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ tvā ǀ gó-parīṇasā ǀ mahé ǀ mandantu ǀ rā́dhase ǀsáraḥ ǀ gauráḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ piba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let (the worships) gladden you here with the Somamixed with milk, for the attainment of great wealth;drink it as the buffalo a lake.
verses.wilson_translation: Let (the worships) gladden you here with the Somamixed with milk, for the attainment of great wealth;drink it as the buffalo a lake.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या वृत्रहा परावति सना नवा च चुच्युवे ।ता संसत्सु प्र वोचत ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ parā-váti ǀ sánā ǀ návā ǀ ca ǀ cucyuvé ǀtā́ ǀ saṃsát-su ǀ prá ǀ vocata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Proclaim in our assemblies those perpetual and ever new riches which the slayer of Vṛtrasends fromafar.
verses.wilson_translation: Proclaim in our assemblies those perpetual and ever new riches which the slayer of Vṛtrasends fromafar.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिंद्रः सहस्रबाह्वे ।अत्रादेदिष्ट पौंस्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ápibat ǀ kadrúvaḥ ǀ sutám ǀ índraḥ ǀ sahásra-bāhve ǀátra ǀ adediṣṭa ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indradrank the Somaoffering of Kadru, (he smote the enemies) of the thousand-armed; there did hismight shine forth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indradrank the Somaoffering of Kadru, (he smote the enemies) of the thousand-armed; there did hismight shine forth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं तत्तुर्वशे यदौ विदानो अह्नवाय्यं ।व्यानट् तुर्वणे शमि ॥
verses.transliteration: satyám ǀ tát ǀ turváśe ǀ yádau ǀ vídānaḥ ǀ ahnavāyyám ǀví ǀ ānaṭ ǀ turváṇe ǀ śámi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Well-knowing those (sacrificial) deeds of Turvaśaand Yadu, he overcame Anhavāyya in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Well-knowing those (sacrificial) deeds of Turvaśaand Yadu, he overcame Anhavāyya in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः ।समानमु प्र शंसिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: taráṇim ǀ vaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ tradám ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀsamānám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ śaṃsiṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I praise our common (Indra), the deliverer of your families, the slayer (of your enemies, the bestower) ofriches in cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: I praise our common (Indra), the deliverer of your families, the slayer (of your enemies, the bestower) ofriches in cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुक्षणं न वर्तव उक्थेषु तुग्र्यावृधं ।इंद्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛbhukṣáṇam ǀ ná ǀ vártave ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ tugrya-vṛ́dham ǀíndram ǀ sóme ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I praise) in hymns the mighty Indra, the augmenter of waters, for the attainment of wealth, when the Soma is effused with (song).
verses.wilson_translation: (I praise) in hymns the mighty Indra, the augmenter of waters, for the attainment of wealth, when the Soma is effused with (song).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः कृंतदिद्वि योन्यं त्रिशोकाय गिरिं पृथुं ।गोभ्यो गातुं निरेतवे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ kṛntát ǀ ít ǀ ví ǀ yonyám ǀ tri-śókāya ǀ girím ǀ pṛthúm ǀgóbhyaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ níḥ-etave ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra), who clove for Triśokathe broad womb-like cloud, (and made) a path for the cows to issueforth?
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra), who clove for Triśokathe broad womb-like cloud, (and made) a path for the cows to issueforth?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्दधिषे मनस्यसि मंदानः प्रेदियक्षसि ।मा तत्करिंद्र मृळय ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ manasyási ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ prá ǀ ít ǀ íyakṣasi ǀmā́ ǀ tát ǀ kaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever you undertake in your exhilaration, whatever you purpose in your mind or are thinking tobestow-- OIndra, do it not, but bless us.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever you undertake in your exhilaration, whatever you purpose in your mind or are thinking tobestow-- OIndra, do it not, but bless us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दभ्रं चिद्धि त्वावतः कृतं शृण्वे अधि क्षमि ।जिगात्विंद्र ते मनः ॥
verses.transliteration: dabhrám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ kṛtám ǀ śṛṇvé ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀjígātu ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the least deeds of one like you are renowned in the earth; may your care visit me.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the least deeds of one like you are renowned in the earth; may your care visit me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवेदु ताः सुकीर्तयोऽसन्नुत प्रशस्तयः ।यदिंद्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ su-kīrtáyaḥ ǀ ásan ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǀyát ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáyāsi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yours be those ascriptions of praise, your those hymns, through which,Indra, you bless us.
verses.wilson_translation: Yours be those ascriptions of praise, your those hymns, through which,Indra, you bless us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा न एकस्मिन्नागसि मा द्वयोरुत त्रिषु ।वधीर्मा शूर भूरिषु ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ékasmin ǀ ā́gasi ǀ mā́ ǀ dváyoḥ ǀ utá ǀ triṣú ǀvádhīḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ śūra ǀ bhū́riṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Slay us not for one sin, not for two, not for three; O hero, slay us not for many.
verses.wilson_translation: Slay us not for one sin, not for two, not for three; O hero, slay us not for many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बिभया हि त्वावत उग्रादभिप्रभंगिणः ।दस्मादहमृतीषहः ॥
verses.transliteration: bibháya ǀ hí ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ ugrā́t ǀ abhi-prabhaṅgínaḥ ǀdasmā́t ǀ ahám ǀ ṛti-sáhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I am afraid of one like you, terrible, the smiter of enemies, the destroyer, who endures hostie attacks.
verses.wilson_translation: I am afraid of one like you, terrible, the smiter of enemies, the destroyer, who endures hostie attacks.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा सख्युः शूनमा विदे मा पुत्रस्य प्रभूवसो ।आवृत्वद्भूतु ते मनः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ śū́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ vide ǀ mā́ ǀ putrásya ǀ prabhuvaso íti prabhu-vaso ǀā-vṛ́tvat ǀ bhūtu ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wealthy (Indra), may I never have to tell you of the destitutuion of my friend or my son; may your mindbe favourable towards me.
verses.wilson_translation: Wealthy (Indra), may I never have to tell you of the destitutuion of my friend or my son; may your mindbe favourable towards me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: को नु मर्या अमिथितः सखा सखायमब्रवीत् ।जहा को अस्मदीषते ॥
verses.transliteration: káḥ ǀ nú ǀ maryāḥ ǀ ámithitaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhāyam ǀ abravīt ǀjahā́ ǀ káḥ ǀ asmát ǀ īṣate ǁ
verses.english_translation: "Who, O mortals", said (Indra), "unprovoked, has ever, as a friend, slain his friend? Who fleeth fromme?"
verses.wilson_translation: "Who, O mortals", said (Indra), "unprovoked, has ever, as a friend, slain his friend? Who fleeth fromme?"
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवारे वृषभा सुतेऽसिन्वन्भूर्यावयः ।श्वघ्नीव निवता चरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: evā́re ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ suté ǀ ásinvan ǀ bhū́ri ǀ āvayaḥ ǀśvaghnī́-iva ǀ ni-vátā ǀ cáran ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer (of benefits), when the ready Somawas effused, you did devour much, without stint, rushingdown like a gameste.
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer (of benefits), when the ready Somawas effused, you did devour much, without stint, rushingdown like a gameste.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त एता वचोयुजा हरी गृभ्णे सुमद्रथा ।यदीं ब्रह्मभ्य इद्ददः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ etā́ ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀ hárī íti ǀ gṛbhṇe ǀ sumát-rathā ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ brahmá-bhyaḥ ǀ ít ǀ dádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I draw here your two steeds, harnessed to a beauiful chariot and yoked by hymns, since you givewealth to thebrāhmaṇas.
verses.wilson_translation: I draw here your two steeds, harnessed to a beauiful chariot and yoked by hymns, since you givewealth to thebrāhmaṇas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भिंधि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः ।वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: bhindhí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ pári ǀ bā́dhaḥ ǀ jahí ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀvásu ǀ spārhám ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Cleave asunder all the hostile hosts, frustrate their destructive attacks, and bestow on us their desirablewealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Cleave asunder all the hostile hosts, frustrate their destructive attacks, and bestow on us their desirablewealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वीळाविंद्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतं ।वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vīḷáu ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ sthiré ǀ yát ǀ párśāne ǀ párā-bhṛtam ǀvásu ǀ spārhám ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow on us,Indra, that desirable wealth, which is deosited in strongholds, in fastnesses, and inplaces which can stand an attack.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow on us,Indra, that desirable wealth, which is deosited in strongholds, in fastnesses, and inplaces which can stand an attack.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषो भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति ।वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ viśvá-mānuṣaḥ ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ dattásya ǀ védati ǀvásu ǀ spārhám ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow on us,Indra, that desirable wealth which all men recognize as given abundantly by you.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow on us,Indra, that desirable wealth which all men recognize as given abundantly by you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ३३ वशोऽश्व्य: । इन्द्र:; २१ -२४ कानीत: पृथुश्रवा:; २५-२८ , ३२ वायु: । गायत्री , १ पादनिचृत् ; ५ ककुप् ,७ बृहती , ८ अनुष्टुप्  , ९ सतोबृहती, ११-१२ विपरीतोत्तर: प्रगाथ: = ( बृहती, विपरीता ), १३ द्विपदा जगती , १४ बृहती पिपीलिकमध्या, १५ ककुम्न्यंकुशिरा, १६ विराट्, १७ जगती, १८  उपरिष्टाद् बृहती ,१९ बृहती , २० विषमपदा बृहती ; २१ ,२४ पंक्ति:; २२ संस्तारपंक्ति: , २४ -२८ ; प्रगाथ: = ( बृहती , सतोबृहती ), ३० द्विपदा विराट् , ३१ उष्णिक् , ३२ पंक्ति: ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our Guide, depend on one like thee,Thou driver of the Tawny Steeds. For, Hurler of the Bolt, we know thee true, the giver of our food,We know the giver of our wealth. O thou whose majesty the bards celebrate with their songs, thou Lord,Of hundred powers and hundred aids. Fair guidance hath the mortal man whom Aryaman, the Marut host,And Mitra, void of guile, protect. Kine, steeds, and hero strength he gains, and prospers, by the Ādityas sped,Ever in wealth which all desire. We pray to Indra for his gift, to him the Fearless and the Strong,We pray to him the Lord of wealth. For verily combined in him are all the fearless powers of aid.Him, rich in wealth, let swift Steeds bring to us, his Bays, to Soma juice for his carouse: Yea, that most excellent carouse, Indra, which slays most enemies,With Heroes wins the light of heaven, and is invincible in war: Which merits fame, all-bountiful! and, unsubdued, hath victory in deeds of might.So come to our libations, Strongest! Excellent! May we obtain a stall of kine. Responding to our wish for cows, for steeds, and chariots, as of old,Be gracious, Greatest of the Great For, Hero, nowhere can I find the bounds of thy munificence.Still do thou favour us, O Bolt-armed Maghavan: with strength hast thou rewarded hymns. High, glorifier of his friend, he knows all generations, he whom many praise.All races of mankind with ladies lifted up invoke that Mighty Indra's aid. Be he our Champion and Protector in great deeds, rich in all wealth, the Vṛtra-slayer, Maghavan. In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your Hero with high laud, to him the Wise,To Indra, glorious in his name, the Mighty One, even as the hymn alloweth it. Thou givest wealth to me myself, thou givest treasure, Excellent! and the strong steed,O Much-invoked, in deeds of might, yea, even now. Him, Sovran Ruler of all precious things, who even hath power o’er this fair form of his,As now it taketh shape, and afterward, We praise, so that the Mighty One may speed to you, Pourer ofbounties, Traveller, prepared to go.Thou favourest the Maruts known to all, by song and sacrifice.With song and praise I sing to thee. We in the sacrifice perform their will whose voice is lifted high,The worship of those Thundering Ones who o’er the ridges of these mountains fly in troops. O Indra, Mightiest, bring us that which crushes men of evil minds,Wealth suited to our needs, O Stirrer of the thought, best wealth, O thou who stirrest thought. O Winner, noble winner, strong, wondrous, most splendid, excellent,Sole Lord of victory, bring all-overpowering wealth, joy-giving, chief in deeds of might. Now let the godless man approach who hath received reward so greatAs Vaśa, Aśvya, when this light of morning dawned, received from Pṛthuśravas, from Kanīta's son. Steeds sixty thousand and ten thousand kine, and twenty hundred camels I obtained;Ten hundred brown in hue, and other ten red in three spots: in all, ten thousand kine. Ten browns that make my wealth increase, fleet steeds whose tails are long and fair,Turn with swift whirl my chariot wheel; The gifts which Pṛthuśravas gave, Kanīta's son munificent.He gave a chariot wrought of gold: the prince was passing bountiful, and won himself most lofty fame. Come thou to this great rite of ours, Vāyu! to give us vigorous light.We have served thee that thou mightest give much to us, yea, mightest quickly give great wealth. Who with thrice seven times seventy horses comes to us, invested with the rays of morn,Through these our Soma-draughts and those who press, to give, drinker of pure bright Soma Juice. Who hath inclined this glorious one, bounteous himself, to give me gifts.Borne on firm chariot with the prosperous Nahuṣa, wise, to a man yet more devout. Sole Lord in beauty meet for praise, O Vāyu, dropping fatness down,Hurried along by steeds, by camels, and by hounds, spreads forth thy train: even this it is. So, as a prize dear to the strong, the sixty thousand have I gained,Bulls that resemble vigorous steeds. To me come oxen like a herd, yea, unto me the oxen come. And in the grazing herd he made a hundred camels bleat for me,And twenty hundred mid the white. A hundred has the sage received, Dāsa Balbūtha's and Tarukṣa's gifts.These are thy people, Vāyu, who rejoice with Indra for their guard, rejoice with Gods for guards. And now to Vaśa Aśvya here this stately woman is led forth,Adorned with ornaments of gold.

verses.sanskrit: त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिंद्र प्रणेतः ।स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́-vataḥ ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ vayám ǀ indra ǀ pranetaríti pra-netaḥ ǀsmási ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ harīṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: O wealthy Indra, the leader (of rites), we belong to one like you, ruler of horses.
verses.wilson_translation: O wealthy Indra, the leader (of rites), we belong to one like you, ruler of horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां हि सत्यमद्रिवो विद्म दातारमिषां ।विद्म दातारं रयीणां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ satyám ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ vidmá ǀ dātā́ram ǀ iṣā́m ǀvidmá ǀ dātā́ram ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, thunderer, we verily know to be giver of food, you we know to be the give of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: You, thunderer, we verily know to be giver of food, you we know to be the give of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यस्य ते महिमानं शतमूते शतक्रतो ।गीर्भिर्गृणंति कारवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ śátam-ūte ǀ śátakrato íti śáta-krato ǀgīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ kārávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OŚatakratu, wielding a hundred protections, whose greatness the worshippers praise with theirhymns.
verses.wilson_translation: OŚatakratu, wielding a hundred protections, whose greatness the worshippers praise with theirhymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा ।मित्रः पांत्यद्रुहः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-nītháḥ ǀ gha ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ yám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yám ǀ aryamā́ ǀmitráḥ ǀ pā́nti ǀ adrúhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fortunate in sacrifice is that mortal whom the guileless Maruts, whom Aryamanand Mitra, protect.
verses.wilson_translation: Fortunate in sacrifice is that mortal whom the guileless Maruts, whom Aryamanand Mitra, protect.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दधानो गोमदश्ववत्सुवीर्यमादित्यजूत एधते ।सदा राया पुरुस्पृहा ॥
verses.transliteration: dádhānaḥ ǀ gó-mat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ ādityá-jūtaḥ ǀ edhate ǀsádā ǀ rāyā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́hā ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is directed byĀdityaever increases, possessing abundance of kine and horses and vigorouschildren; he increases in wealth longed for by many.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is directed byĀdityaever increases, possessing abundance of kine and horses and vigorouschildren; he increases in wealth longed for by many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमिंद्रं दानमीमहे शवसानमभीर्वं ।ईशानं राय ईमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ índram ǀ dā́nam ǀ īmahe ǀ śavasānám ǀ ábhīrvam ǀī́śānam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit a gift from this Indra, the displayer of might, the fearless; we solicit wealth from the lord.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit a gift from this Indra, the displayer of might, the fearless; we solicit wealth from the lord.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्हि संत्यूतयो विश्वा अभीरवः सचा ।तमा वहंतु सप्तयः पुरूवसुं मदाय हरयः सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tásmin ǀ hí ǀ sánti ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ábhīravaḥ ǀ sácā ǀtám ǀ ā́ ǀ vahantu ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ puru-vásum ǀ mádāya ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: In him abide united all secure protections; lord of vast wealth, may his gliding steeds bear him to theexpressed Somafor his exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: In him abide united all secure protections; lord of vast wealth, may his gliding steeds bear him to theexpressed Somafor his exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यो य इंद्र वृत्रहंतमः ।य आददिः स्वर्नृभिर्यः पृतनासु दुष्टरः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ vṛtrahán-tamaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ā-dadíḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ dustáraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: That exhilaration of your,Indra, which is pre-eminent, which utterly desroys your enemies, which winswealth from men, and is invincible in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: That exhilaration of your,Indra, which is pre-eminent, which utterly desroys your enemies, which winswealth from men, and is invincible in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो दुष्टरो विश्ववार श्रवाय्यो वाजेष्वस्ति तरुता ।स नः शविष्ठ सवना वसो गहि गमेम गोमति व्रजे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dustáraḥ ǀ viśva-vāra ǀ śravā́yyaḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ ásti ǀ tarutā́ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ gahi ǀ gaméma ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Which is invincibel in contests -- O you desired by all-- well-worthy of praise and the deliverer (fromenemies); come to our oblations, most mighty one, giver of dwellings; may we obtain a stall full of kine.
verses.wilson_translation: Which is invincibel in contests -- O you desired by all-- well-worthy of praise and the deliverer (fromenemies); come to our oblations, most mighty one, giver of dwellings; may we obtain a stall full of kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया ।वरिवस्य महामह ॥
verses.transliteration: gavyó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ purā́ ǀ aśva-yā́ ǀ utá ǀ ratha-yā́ ǀvarivasyá ǀ mahā-maha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of wealth, visit us as of old, go give us cows, horses and chariots.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of wealth, visit us as of old, go give us cows, horses and chariots.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि ते शूर राधसोऽंतं विंदामि सत्रा ।दशस्या नो मघवन्नू चिदद्रिवो धियो वाजेभिराविथ ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ te ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ ántam ǀ vindā́mi ǀ satrā́ ǀdaśasyá ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ āvitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily, hero, I find no limit to your wealth; OMaghavan, the thunderer, bestow (your gifts) quickly uponus, and bless our offerings with (abundant) food.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily, hero, I find no limit to your wealth; OMaghavan, the thunderer, bestow (your gifts) quickly uponus, and bless our offerings with (abundant) food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य ऋष्वः श्रावयत्सखा विश्वेत्स वेद जनिमा पुरुष्टुतः ।तं विश्वे मानुषा युगेंद्रं हवंते तविषं यतस्रुचः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ śravayát-sakhā ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ veda ǀ jánima ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǀtám ǀ víśve ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ índram ǀ havante ǀ taviṣám ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The graceful Indra, whose friends extol him, knows, praised of many, all births; him, the mighty, all meninvoke at all times, seizing the ladles (for oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: The graceful Indra, whose friends extol him, knows, praised of many, all births; him, the mighty, all meninvoke at all times, seizing the ladles (for oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो वाजेष्वविता पुरूवसुः पुरःस्थाता मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ avitā́ ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ puraḥ-sthātā́ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Maghavan, the wealthy, the slayer of Vṛtra, stand before us as our defender in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: May Maghavan, the wealthy, the slayer of Vṛtra, stand before us as our defender in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वो वीरमंधसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसं ।इंद्रं नाम श्रुत्यं शाकिनं वचो यथा ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ vīrám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ mádeṣu ǀ gāya ǀ girā́ ǀ mahā́ ǀ ví-cetasam ǀíndram ǀ nā́ma ǀ śrútyam ǀ śākínam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ yáthā ǁ
verses.english_translation: At the time of the exhilaration of the Soma, sing, according to your hymns, with a loud voice, you wisehero Indra, the humbler of enemies, the strong, the ever-worthy to be praised.
verses.wilson_translation: At the time of the exhilaration of the Soma, sing, according to your hymns, with a loud voice, you wisehero Indra, the humbler of enemies, the strong, the ever-worthy to be praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ददी रेक्णस्तन्वे ददिर्वसु ददिर्वाजेषु पुरुहूत वाजिनं ।नूनमथ ॥
verses.transliteration: dadíḥ ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ tanvé ǀ dadíḥ ǀ vásu ǀ dadíḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vājínam ǀnūnám ǀ átha ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra), invoked by many, speedily give me wealth; give riches, give abundance of food in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra), invoked by many, speedily give me wealth; give riches, give abundance of food in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेषामिरज्यंतं वसूनां सासह्वांसं चिदस्य वर्पसः ।कृपयतो नूनमत्यथ ॥
verses.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ irajyántam ǀ vásūnām ǀ sasahvā́ṃsam ǀ cit ǀ asyá ǀ várpasaḥ ǀkṛpa-yatáḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ áti ǀ átha ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We praise you), the lord of all riches, the subduer of this obstructor waging (attacks), -- speedily giveus abundant (wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: (We praise you), the lord of all riches, the subduer of this obstructor waging (attacks), -- speedily giveus abundant (wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महः सु वो अरमिषे स्तवामहे मीळ्हुषे अरंगमाय जग्मये ।यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिर्विश्वमनुषां मरुतामियक्षसि गाये त्वा नमसा गिरा ॥
verses.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ sú ǀ vaḥ ǀ áram ǀ iṣe ǀ stávāmahe ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ aram-gamā́ya ǀ jágmaye ǀyajñébhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ viśvá-manuṣām ǀ marútām ǀ iyakṣasi ǀ gā́ye ǀ tvā ǀ námasā ǀ girā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I desire the coming of you, the mighty one, we give praise with oblations and ymns to the showerer whohastens readily (to the sacrifice), associated with the Maruts, you are worshipped of all men; I glorify you withadoration and praise.
verses.wilson_translation: I desire the coming of you, the mighty one, we give praise with oblations and ymns to the showerer whohastens readily (to the sacrifice), associated with the Maruts, you are worshipped of all men; I glorify you withadoration and praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये पातयंते अज्मभिर्गिरीणां स्नुभिरेषां ।यज्ञं महिष्वणीनां सुम्नं तुविष्वणीनां प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ pātáyante ǀ ájma-bhiḥ ǀ girīṇā́m ǀ snú-bhiḥ ǀ eṣām ǀyajñám ǀ mahi-svánīnām ǀ sumnám ǀ tuvi-svánīnām ǀ prá ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We present) the oblation to those loud-sounding (Maruts) who rush along with the streaming trains ofthe clouds; may we obtain in the sacrifice the happiness which those deep-roarers bestow.
verses.wilson_translation: (We present) the oblation to those loud-sounding (Maruts) who rush along with the streaming trains ofthe clouds; may we obtain in the sacrifice the happiness which those deep-roarers bestow.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रभंगं दुर्मतीनामिंद्र शविष्ठा भर ।रयिमस्मभ्यं युज्यं चोदयन्मते ज्येष्ठं चोदयन्मते ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-bhaṅgám ǀ duḥ-matīnā́m ǀ índra ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀrayím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ yújyam ǀ codayat-mate ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ codayat-mate ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We worship) the crusher of the malevolent, most powerful Indra, bring to us suitable wealth, Oinspirer-- (bring) most excellent( wealth), O inspirer.
verses.wilson_translation: (We worship) the crusher of the malevolent, most powerful Indra, bring to us suitable wealth, Oinspirer-- (bring) most excellent( wealth), O inspirer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनितः सुसनितरुग्र चित्र चेतिष्ठ सूनृत ।प्रासहा सम्राट् सहुरिं सहंतं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: sánitaríti ǀ sú-sanitaḥ ǀ úgra ǀ cítra ǀ cétiṣṭha ǀ sū́nṛta ǀpra-sáhā ǀ sam-rāṭ ǀ sáhurim ǀ sáhantam ǀ bhujyúm ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ pū́rvyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: O bountiful, mos bountiful, mighty, wondeful, best giver of knowledge and supremely truthful, by yourprowess, universal ruler, (bring to us) in conflicts ample wealth, overpowering those who attack us, and causingenjoyment.
verses.wilson_translation: O bountiful, mos bountiful, mighty, wondeful, best giver of knowledge and supremely truthful, by yourprowess, universal ruler, (bring to us) in conflicts ample wealth, overpowering those who attack us, and causingenjoyment.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ स एतु य ईवदाँ अदेवः पूर्तमाददे ।यथा चिद्वशो अश्व्यः पृथुश्रवसि कानीतेऽस्या व्युष्याददे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ etu ǀ yáḥ ǀ ī́vat ǀ ā́ ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ pūrtám ǀ ā-dadé ǀyáthā ǀ cit ǀ váśaḥ ǀ aśvyáḥ ǀ pṛthu-śrávasi ǀ kā́nīté ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ vi-úṣi ǀ ā-dadé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let him draw near, who, though not a god, would receive this complete living gift-- since Vaśa, the sonof Aśva, receives it at the dawn of this (morning) at thehandsof Pṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta.
verses.wilson_translation: Let him draw near, who, though not a god, would receive this complete living gift-- since Vaśa, the sonof Aśva, receives it at the dawn of this (morning) at thehandsof Pṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिं सहस्राश्व्यस्यायुतासनमुष्ट्रानां विंशतिं शता ।दश श्यावीनां शता दश त्र्यरुषीणां दश गवां सहस्रा ॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ áśvyasya ǀ ayútā ǀ asanam ǀ úṣṭrānām ǀ viṃśatím ǀ śatā́ ǀdáśa ǀ śyā́vīnām ǀ śatā́ ǀ dáśa ǀ trí-aruṣīṇām ǀ dáśa ǀ gávām ǀ sahásrā ǁ
verses.english_translation: I have received sixty thousand horses, and ens of housands-- a score of hundreds of camels-- athousand brown mares-- and ten times ten thousand cows with three red patches.
verses.wilson_translation: I have received sixty thousand horses, and ens of housands-- a score of hundreds of camels-- athousand brown mares-- and ten times ten thousand cows with three red patches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दश श्यावा ऋधद्रयो वीतवारास आशवः ।मथ्रा नेमिं नि वावृतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: dáśa ǀ śyāvā́ḥ ǀ ṛdhát-rayaḥ ǀ vītá-vārāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀmathrā́ḥ ǀ nemím ǀ ní ǀ vavṛtuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ten brown horses bear along the wheel (of my chariot), of mature vigour, of complete power, andtrampling down obstacles.
verses.wilson_translation: Ten brown horses bear along the wheel (of my chariot), of mature vigour, of complete power, andtrampling down obstacles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दानासः पृथुश्रवसः कानीतस्य सुराधसः ।रथं हिरण्ययं ददन्मंहिष्ठः सूरिरभूद्वर्षिष्ठमकृत श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: dā́nāsaḥ ǀ pṛthu-śrávasaḥ ǀ kānītásya ǀ su-rā́dhasaḥ ǀrátham ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ dádat ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ abhūt ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ akṛta ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These arehtje gifts of the wealthy Pṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta; he, bestowing a golden chariot,has proved himself most liberal and wise, he has won most abundant fame.
verses.wilson_translation: These arehtje gifts of the wealthy Pṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta; he, bestowing a golden chariot,has proved himself most liberal and wise, he has won most abundant fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो वायो महे तने याहि मखाय पाजसे ।वयं हि ते चकृमा भूरि दावने सद्यश्चिन्महि दावने ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vāyo íti ǀ mahé ǀ táne ǀ yāhí ǀ makhā́ya ǀ pā́jase ǀvayám ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ cakṛmá ǀ bhū́ri ǀ dāváne ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ máhi ǀ dāváne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us,Vāyu, to bestow great wealth and glorious strength; we have offered (libations) to you thegiver of abundant (wealth), we have offered immediately to you the giver of great (gifts).
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Vāyu, to bestow great wealth and glorious strength; we have offered (libations) to you thegiver of abundant (wealth), we have offered immediately to you the giver of great (gifts).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो अश्वेभिर्वहते वस्त उस्रास्त्रिः सप्त सप्ततीनां ।एभिः सोमेभिः सोमसुद्भिः सोमपा दानाय शुक्रपूतपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ áśvebhiḥ ǀ váhate ǀ váste ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ saptatīnā́m ǀebhíḥ ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ somasút-bhiḥ ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ śukrapūta-pāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is borne on horses and surrounds himself with thrice seven times seventy cows-- he comes toyou with these Soma-libations and Soma-priests, to offer to you, drinker of the Soma, drinker of the bright pure Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is borne on horses and surrounds himself with thrice seven times seventy cows-- he comes toyou with these Soma-libations and Soma-priests, to offer to you, drinker of the Soma, drinker of the bright pure Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो म इमं चिदु त्मनामंदच्चित्रं दावने ।अरट्वे अक्षे नहुषे सुकृत्वनि सुकृत्तराय सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ me ǀ imám ǀ cit ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tmánā ǀ ámandat ǀ citrám ǀ dāváne ǀaraṭvé ǀ ákṣe ǀ náhuṣe ǀ su-kṛ́tvani ǀ sukṛ́t-tarāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who of his own will has been plural ased to give me this honoured gift, he, performer of good works,(has determined) on a pre-eminently good action, amid Aratva,Nahuṣaand Sukṛtvan.
verses.wilson_translation: He who of his own will has been plural ased to give me this honoured gift, he, performer of good works,(has determined) on a pre-eminently good action, amid Aratva,Nahuṣaand Sukṛtvan.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उचथ्ये वपुषि यः स्वराळुत वायो घृतस्नाः ।अश्वेषितं रजेषितं शुनेषितं प्राज्म तदिदं नु तत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ucathyé ǀ vápuṣi ǀ yáḥ ǀ sva-rā́ṭ ǀ utá ǀ vāyo íti ǀ ghṛta-snā́ḥ ǀáśva-iṣitam ǀ rájaḥ-iṣitam ǀ śúnā-iṣitam ǀ prá ǀ ájma ǀ tát ǀ idám ǀ nú ǀ tát ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is self-resplendent in his glorious body, who is bright, OVāyu, like ghī, has given me thisfood, brought by horses, brought by camels, brought by dogs.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is self-resplendent in his glorious body, who is bright, OVāyu, like ghī, has given me thisfood, brought by horses, brought by camels, brought by dogs.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध प्रियमिषिराय षष्टिं सहस्रासनं ।अश्वानामिन्न वृष्णां ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ priyám ǀ iṣirā́ya ǀ ṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ asanam ǀáśvānām ǀ ít ǀ ná ǀ vṛ́ṣṇām ǁ
verses.english_translation: I have now received (a gift) dear to the beneficent king, sixty thousand bulls vigorous like horses.
verses.wilson_translation: I have now received (a gift) dear to the beneficent king, sixty thousand bulls vigorous like horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गावो न यूथमुप यंति वध्रय उप मा यंति वध्रयः ॥
verses.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yūthám ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ vádhrayaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ mā ǀ ā́ ǀ yanti ǀ vádhrayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the cows to the herd, so repair the oxen; so the oxen repair to me.
verses.wilson_translation: As the cows to the herd, so repair the oxen; so the oxen repair to me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध यच्चारथे गणे शतमुष्ट्राँ अचिक्रदत् ।अध श्वित्नेषु विंशतिं शता ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ yát ǀ cā́rathe ǀ gaṇé ǀ śatám ǀ úṣṭrān ǀ ácikradat ǀádha ǀ śvítneṣu ǀ viṃśatím ǀ śatā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since, when the herd were wandering (to the wood), he called a hundred camels (to give them to me),and two thousand from among the white herds (of cows).
verses.wilson_translation: Since, when the herd were wandering (to the wood), he called a hundred camels (to give them to me),and two thousand from among the white herds (of cows).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतं दासे बल्बूथे विप्रस्तरुक्ष आ ददे ।ते ते वायविमे जना मदंतींद्रगोपा मदंति देवगोपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śatám ǀ dāsé ǀ balbūthé ǀ vípraḥ ǀ tárukṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀté ǀ te ǀ vāyo íti ǀ imé ǀ jánāḥ ǀ mádanti ǀ índra-gopāḥ ǀ mádanti ǀ devá-gopāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I, the sage, accep the hundred from the slave Balbūtha, the cowherd; we here are your, OVāyu-those who have Indraand the gods for protectors rejoice (through your favour).
verses.wilson_translation: I, the sage, accep the hundred from the slave Balbūtha, the cowherd; we here are your, OVāyu-those who have Indraand the gods for protectors rejoice (through your favour).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध स्या योषणा मही प्रतीची वशमश्व्यं ।अधिरुक्मा वि नीयते ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ syā́ ǀ yóṣaṇā ǀ mahī́ ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ váśam ǀ aśvyám ǀádhi-rukmā ǀ ví ǀ nīyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: This tall maiden, adorned with gold, is led towards me,Vaśa, the son of Aśva.
verses.wilson_translation: This tall maiden, adorned with gold, is led towards me,Vaśa, the son of Aśva.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVII. Ādityas.
hymns.anukramani: १८ त्रित आप्त्य: । आदित्या: , १४ -१८ आदित्योषस: ( दु:स्वप्नघ्नं ) । महापंक्ति: ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GREAT help ye give the worshipper, Varuṇa, Mitra, Mighty Ones! No sorrow ever reaches him whom ye, Ādityas, keep from harm. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford. O Gods, Ādityas, well ye know the way to keep all woes afar.As the birds spread their sheltering wings, spread your protection over us. As the birds spread their sheltering wings let your protection cover us.We mean all shelter and defence, ye who have all things for your own. To whomsoever they, Most Wise, have given a home and means of life,O'er the whole riches of this man they, the Ādityas, have control. As drivers of the car avoid ill roads, let sorrows pass us by.May we be under Indra's guard, in the Ādityas’ favouring grace. For verily men sink and faint through loss of wealth which ye have given.Much hath he gained from you, O Gods, whom ye, Ādityas, have approached. On him shall no fierce anger fall, no sore distress shall visit him,To whom, Ādityas, ye have lent your shelter that extendeth far. Resting in you, O Gods, we are like men who fight in coats of mail.Ye guard us from each great offence, ye guard us from each lighter fault. May Aditi defend us, may Aditi guard and shelter us,Mother of wealthy Mitra and of Aryaman and Varuṇa. The shelter, Gods, that is secure, auspicious, free from malady,A sure protection, triply strong, even that do ye extend to us. Look down on us, Ādityas, as a guide exploring from the bank.Lead us to pleasant ways as men lead horses to an easy ford. Ill be it for the demons' friend to find us or come near to us.But for the milch-cow be it well, and for the man who strives for fame. Each evil deed made manifest, and that which is concealed, O Gods,The whole thereof remove from us to Trita Āptya far away. Daughter of Heaven, the dream that bodes evil to us or to our kine,Remove, O Lady of the Light, to Trita Āptya far away. Even if, O Child of Heaven, it make a garland or a chain of gold,The whole bad dream, whate’er it be, to Trita Āptya we consign. To him whose food and work is this, who comes to take his share therein,To Trita, and to Dvita, Dawn! bear thou the evil dream away. As we collect the utmost debt, even the eighth and sixteenth part,So unto Āptya we transfer together all the evil dream. Now have we conquered and obtained, and from our trespasses are free.Shine thou away the evil dream, O Dawn, whereof we are afraid. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.

verses.sanskrit: महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्र दाशुषे ।यमादित्या अभि द्रुहो रक्षथा नेमघं नशदनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: máhi ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahatā́m ǀ ávaḥ ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ dāśúṣe ǀyám ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ druháḥ ǀ rákṣatha ǀ ná ǀ īm ǀ aghám ǀ naśat ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, you are great, and great is your protection to the offerer; no evil,Ādityas, harmshim whom you guard from the injurer; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, you are great, and great is your protection to the offerer; no evil,Ādityas, harmshim whom you guard from the injurer; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विदा देवा अघानामादित्यासो अपाकृतिं ।पक्षा वयो यथोपरि व्यस्मे शर्म यच्छतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: vidá ǀ devāḥ ǀ aghā́nām ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ apa-ā́kṛtim ǀpakṣā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ upári ǀ ví ǀ asmé íti ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: DivineĀdityas, you know the averting of evils; as birds (spread) their wings over (their) young, grantus happiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: DivineĀdityas, you know the averting of evils; as birds (spread) their wings over (their) young, grantus happiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: व्यस्मे अधि शर्म तत्पक्षा वयो न यंतन ।विश्वानि विश्ववेदसो वरूथ्या मनामहेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ asmé íti ǀ ádhi ǀ śárma ǀ tát ǀ pakṣā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yantana ǀvíśvāni ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ varūthyā́ ǀ manāmahe ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us that happiness of yours, as birds (spread) their wings; O you possessed of all wealth, wesolicit all riches suitable for our dwelling; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us that happiness of yours, as birds (spread) their wings; O you possessed of all wealth, wesolicit all riches suitable for our dwelling; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मा अरासत क्षयं जीवातुं च प्रचेतसः ।मनोर्विश्वस्य घेदिम आदित्या राय ईशतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmai ǀ árāsata ǀ kṣáyam ǀ jīvā́tum ǀ ca ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀmánoḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ imé ǀ ādityā́ḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īśate ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To whomsoever these wiseĀdityasgran a dwelling and the means of life, (for him) they master thewealth of every man; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: To whomsoever these wiseĀdityasgran a dwelling and the means of life, (for him) they master thewealth of every man; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि णो वृणजन्नघा दुर्गाणि रथ्यो यथा ।स्यामेदिंद्रस्य शर्मण्यादित्यानामुतावस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṇajan ǀ aghā́ ǀ duḥ-gā́ni ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ yathā ǀsyā́ma ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ śármaṇi ǀ ādityā́nām ǀ utá ǀ ávasi ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our sins avoid us as charioteers inaccessible plural ce; may we abide in Indra's happiness and in theprotection of the Ādiyas; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: May our sins avoid us as charioteers inaccessible plural ce; may we abide in Indra's happiness and in theprotection of the Ādiyas; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परिह्वृतेदना जनो युष्मादत्तस्य वायति ।देवा अदभ्रमाश वो यमादित्या अहेतनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: pari-hvṛtā́ ǀ ít ǀ anā́ ǀ jánaḥ ǀ yuṣmā́-dattasya ǀ vāyati ǀdévāḥ ǀ ádabhram ǀ āśa ǀ vaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ áhetana ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Only by painful means does a living man obtain the wealth which you bestow; but he whom you, divineĀdityas, visit, wins great (riches); your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Only by painful means does a living man obtain the wealth which you bestow; but he whom you, divineĀdityas, visit, wins great (riches); your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न तं तिग्मं चन त्यजो न द्रासदभि तं गुरु ।यस्मा उ शर्म सप्रथ आदित्यासो अराध्वमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ tigmám ǀ caná ǀ tyájaḥ ǀ ná ǀ drāsat ǀ abhí ǀ tám ǀ gurú ǀyásmai ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ árādhvam ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him fierce wrath touches not, nor heavy (calamity), to whom,Ādityas, you have given greathappiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Him fierce wrath touches not, nor heavy (calamity), to whom,Ādityas, you have given greathappiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युष्मे देवा अपि ष्मसि युध्यंत इव वर्मसु ।यूयं महो न एनसो यूयमर्भादुरुष्यतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yuṣmé íti ǀ devāḥ ǀ ápi ǀ smasi ǀ yúdhyantaḥ-iva ǀ várma-su ǀyūyám ǀ maháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ énasaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ árbhāt ǀ uruṣyata ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deities, may we abide in you as warriors in their armour; do you defend us from great evil, do youdefend us from litt;e your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Deities, may we abide in you as warriors in their armour; do you defend us from great evil, do youdefend us from litt;e your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्न उरुष्यत्वदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।माता मित्रस्य रेवतोऽर्यम्णो वरुणस्य चानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: áditiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyatu ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǀmātā́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ revátaḥ ǀ aryamṇáḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ ca ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Aditidefend us, may Aditi grant us happiness, the mother of the wealthy Mitra,Aryamaand Varuṇa; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: May Aditidefend us, may Aditi grant us happiness, the mother of the wealthy Mitra,Aryamaand Varuṇa; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्देवाः शर्म शरणं यद्भद्रं यदनातुरं ।त्रिधातु यद्वरूथ्यं तदस्मासु वि यंतनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ devāḥ ǀ śárma ǀ śaraṇám ǀ yát ǀ bhadrám ǀ yát ǀ anāturám ǀtri-dhā́tu ǀ yát ǀ varūthyám ǀ tát ǀ asmā́su ǀ ví ǀ yantana ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant to us, deities, that happiness which is a refuge, auspicious, and free from sickness, which isthreefold and fit for a (secure) shelter; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant to us, deities, that happiness which is a refuge, auspicious, and free from sickness, which isthreefold and fit for a (secure) shelter; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या अव हि ख्यताधि कूलादिव स्पशः ।सुतीर्थमर्वतो यथानु नो नेषथा सुगमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́dityāḥ ǀ áva ǀ hí ǀ khyáta ǀ ádhi ǀ kū́lāt-iva ǀ spáśaḥ ǀsu-tīrthám ǀ árvataḥ ǀ yathā ǀ ánu ǀ naḥ ǀ neṣatha ǀ su-gám ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ādityas, look down upon us as those who look from the shore; as (men lead) their horses to a secure Ghāṭa, so conduct us along a good path; your aids are void of harm, your aids are void of harm, your aids aretrue aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityas, look down upon us as those who look from the shore; as (men lead) their horses to a secure Ghāṭa, so conduct us along a good path; your aids are void of harm, your aids are void of harm, your aids aretrue aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नेह भद्रं रक्षस्विने नावयै नोपया उत ।गवे च भद्रं धेनवे वीराय च श्रवस्यतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ ihá ǀ bhadrám ǀ rakṣasvíne ǀ ná ǀ ava-yái ǀ ná ǀ upa-yái ǀ utá ǀgáve ǀ ca ǀ bhadrám ǀ dhenáve ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ ca ǀ śravasyaté ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let there not be prosperit here to our powerul (foe), nor to him who threaten or assails us; but let therebe prosperity to our cattle, our kine, and ourmaleoffspring desirous of food; your aids are void of harm, your aidsare true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Let there not be prosperit here to our powerul (foe), nor to him who threaten or assails us; but let therebe prosperity to our cattle, our kine, and ourmaleoffspring desirous of food; your aids are void of harm, your aidsare true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदाविर्यदपीच्यं देवासो अस्ति दुष्कृतं ।त्रिते तद्विश्वमाप्त्य आरे अस्मद्दधातनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ āvíḥ ǀ yát ǀ apīcyám ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ duḥ-kṛtám ǀtrité ǀ tát ǀ víśvam ǀ āptyé ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ dadhātana ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deities, whatever evil is manifest, whatever is concealed, (let it be not found) in TritaĀptya, keep it farfrom us; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Deities, whatever evil is manifest, whatever is concealed, (let it be not found) in TritaĀptya, keep it farfrom us; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यच्च गोषु दुःष्वप्न्यं यच्चास्मे दुहितर्दिवः ।त्रिताय तद्विभावर्याप्त्याय परा वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ ca ǀ góṣu ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ asmé íti ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀtritā́ya ǀ tát ǀ vibhā-vari ǀ āptyā́ya ǀ párā ǀ vaha ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Daughter of heaven, (Uṣas), whatever ill-omened dream threatens our cattle, keep it, O brilliant one,far from TritaĀptya; y our aids are void of harm, your aids, are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Daughter of heaven, (Uṣas), whatever ill-omened dream threatens our cattle, keep it, O brilliant one,far from TritaĀptya; y our aids are void of harm, your aids, are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निष्कं वा घा कृणवते स्रजं वा दुहितर्दिवः ।त्रिते दुःष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये परि दद्मस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: niṣkám ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ kṛṇávate ǀ srájam ǀ vā ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀtrité ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ sárvam ǀ āptyé ǀ pári ǀ dadmasi ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Daughter of heaven, whatever ill-omened dream threatens TritaĀptya, we transfer it to the worker ofgold ornaments or to the maker of garlands; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Daughter of heaven, whatever ill-omened dream threatens TritaĀptya, we transfer it to the worker ofgold ornaments or to the maker of garlands; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तदन्नाय तदपसे तं भागमुपसेदुषे ।त्रिताय च द्विताय चोषो दुःष्वप्न्यं वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: tát-annāya ǀ tát-apase ǀ tám ǀ bhāgám ǀ upa-sedúṣe ǀtritā́ya ǀ ca ǀ dvitā́ya ǀ ca ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ vaha ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Uṣas, bear (elsewhere) the ill-omened dream for Tritaand Dvita, who eat and do (in dreams) that(which is eaten and done amiss when awake) and who obtain that (inauspicious) portion; your aids are void ofharm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: Uṣas, bear (elsewhere) the ill-omened dream for Tritaand Dvita, who eat and do (in dreams) that(which is eaten and done amiss when awake) and who obtain that (inauspicious) portion; your aids are void ofharm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यथा कलां यथा शफं यथ ऋणं संनयामसि ।एवा दुःष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये सं नयामस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ kalā́m ǀ yáthā ǀ śaphám ǀ yáthā ǀ ṛṇám ǀ sam-náyāmasi ǀevá ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ sárvam ǀ āptyé ǀ sám ǀ nayāmasi ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As (in the sacrifice) we put severally together the proper parts and the hoofs, and as we discharge adebt, so we transfer all the ill-omened dream that rests on Āptya; your aids are void of harm, your aids are trueaids.
verses.wilson_translation: As (in the sacrifice) we put severally together the proper parts and the hoofs, and as we discharge adebt, so we transfer all the ill-omened dream that rests on Āptya; your aids are void of harm, your aids are trueaids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयं ।उषो यस्माद्दुःष्वप्न्यादभैष्माप तदुच्छत्वनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ájaiṣma ǀ adyá ǀ ásanāma ǀ ca ǀ ábhūma ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ vayám ǀúṣaḥ ǀ yásmāt ǀ duḥ-svápnyāt ǀ ábhaiṣma ǀ ápa ǀ tát ǀ ucchatu ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we be today victorious, and obtain (happiness); may we be free from evil; Uṣas, may that ill dreamdepart, of which we were afraid; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.wilson_translation: May we be today victorious, and obtain (happiness); may we be free from evil; Uṣas, may that ill dreamdepart, of which we were afraid; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVIII. Soma.
hymns.anukramani: १५  प्रगाथो घौर: काण्व:। सोम: । त्रिष्टुप् , ५  जगती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WISELY have I enjoyed the savoury viand, religious-thoughted, best to find out treasure,The food to which all Deities and mortals, calling it meath, gather themselves together. Tlou shalt be Aditi as thou hast entered within, appeaser of celestial anger.Indu, enjoying Indra's friendship, bring us—as a swift steed the car—forward to riches. We have drunk Soma and become immortal; we have attained the light, the Gods discovered.Now what may foeman's malice do to harm us? What, O Immortal, mortal man's deception? Absorbed into the heart, be sweet, O Indu, as a kind father to his son, O Soma,As a wise Friend to friend: do thou, wide-ruler, O Soma, lengthen out our days for living. These glorious drops that give me freedom have I drunk. Closely they knit my joints as straps secure a car.Let them protect my foot from slipping on the way: yea, let the drops I drink preserve me from disease. Make me shine bright like fire produced by friction: give us a clearer sight and make us better.For in carouse I think of thee, O Soma, Shall I, as a rich man, attain to comfort? May we enjoy with an enlivened spirit the juice thou givest, like ancestral riches.O Soma, King, prolong thou our existence as Sūrya makes the shining days grow longer. King Soma, favour us and make us prosper: we are thy devotees; of this be mindful.Spirit and power are fresh in us, O Indu give us not up unto our foeman's pleasure. For thou hast settled in each joint, O Soma, aim of men's eyes and guardian of our bodies.When we offend against thine holy statutes, as a kind Friend, God, best of all, be gracious. May I be with the Friend whose heart is tender, who, Lord of Bays! when quaffed will never harm me-This Soma now deposited within me. For this, I pray for longer life to Indra. Our maladies have lost their strength and vanished: they feared, and passed away into the darkness.Soma hath risen in us, exceeding mighty, and we are come where men prolong existence., Fathers, that Indu which our hearts have drunken, Immortal in himself, hath entered mortals.So let us serve this Soma with oblation, and rest securely in his grace and favour. Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven.So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches, Give us your blessing, O ye Gods’ preservers. Never may sleep or idle talk control us.But evermore may we, as friends of Soma, speak to the synod with brave sons around us. On all sides,. Soma, thou art our life-giver: aim of all eyes, light-finder, come within us.Indu, of one accord with thy protections both from behind and from before preserve us.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादोरभक्षि वयसः सुमेधाः स्वाध्यो वरिवोवित्तरस्य ।विश्वे यं देवा उत मर्त्यासो मधु ब्रुवंतो अभि संचरंति ॥
verses.transliteration: svādóḥ ǀ abhakṣi ǀ váyasaḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ varivovít-tarasya ǀvíśve ǀ yám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ bruvántaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sam-cáranti ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I, the wise and devout, enjoy the delicious, abundantly honoured Somafood, which all gods andmortals, pronouncing sweet, seek to obtain.
verses.wilson_translation: May I, the wise and devout, enjoy the delicious, abundantly honoured Somafood, which all gods andmortals, pronouncing sweet, seek to obtain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंतश्च प्रागा अदितिर्भवास्यवयाता हरसो दैव्यस्य ।इंदविंद्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणः श्रौष्टीव धुरमनु राय ऋध्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: antáríti ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ ágāḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ bhavāsi ǀ ava-yātā́ ǀ hárasaḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǀíndo íti ǀ índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ śráuṣṭī-iva ǀ dhúram ǀ ánu ǀ rāyé ǀ ṛdhyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You enter within, and unimpaired, you avert the anger of the gods;Soma, enjoying the friendship of Indra, may you bring us to wealth as a swift (horse) its burden.
verses.wilson_translation: You enter within, and unimpaired, you avert the anger of the gods;Soma, enjoying the friendship of Indra, may you bring us to wealth as a swift (horse) its burden.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपाम सोमममृता अभूमागन्म ज्योतिरविदाम देवान् ।किं नूनमस्मान्कृणवदरातिः किमु धूर्तिरमृत मर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: ápāma ǀ sómam ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ abhūma ǀ áganma ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ávidāma ǀ devā́n ǀkím ǀ nūnám ǀ asmā́n ǀ kṛṇavat ǀ árātiḥ ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dhūrtíḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ mártyasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: We drink the Soma, may we become immortal; we have attained the light of (heaven), we have knownthe gods; what now could the enemy do to us, or what, O immortal, should the aggriever do to the mortal?
verses.wilson_translation: We drink the Soma, may we become immortal; we have attained the light of (heaven), we have knownthe gods; what now could the enemy do to us, or what, O immortal, should the aggriever do to the mortal?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शं नो भव हृद आ पीत इंदो पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः ।सखेव सख्य उरुशंस धीरः प्र ण आयुर्जीवसे सोम तारीः ॥
verses.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhava ǀ hṛdé ǀ ā́ ǀ pītáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ soma ǀ sūnáve ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀsákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ uru-śaṃsa ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ soma ǀ tārīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Osoma, drunk by us, be bliss to our hearts, as a father is indulgent to a son or a friend to a friend; OSoma, worthy of wide praise, do you, wise one, extend our years that we may live.
verses.wilson_translation: Osoma, drunk by us, be bliss to our hearts, as a father is indulgent to a son or a friend to a friend; OSoma, worthy of wide praise, do you, wise one, extend our years that we may live.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमे मा पीता यशस उरुष्यवो रथं न गावः समनाह पर्वसु ।ते मा रक्षंतु विस्रसश्चरित्रादुत मा स्रामाद्यवयंत्विंदवः ॥
verses.transliteration: imé ǀ mā ǀ pītā́ḥ ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ uruṣyávaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sám ǀ anāha ǀ párva-su ǀté ǀ mā ǀ rakṣantu ǀ vi-srásaḥ ǀ carítrāt ǀ utá ǀ mā ǀ srā́māt ǀ yavayantu ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May these glory-conferring protecting Soma-streams knit together my joints as cows draw together achariot falling in pieces; may they keep us from a loosely-knit worship; may they deliver me from sickness.
verses.wilson_translation: May these glory-conferring protecting Soma-streams knit together my joints as cows draw together achariot falling in pieces; may they keep us from a loosely-knit worship; may they deliver me from sickness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं न मा मथितं सं दिदीपः प्र चक्षय कृणुहि वस्यसो नः ।अथा हि ते मद आ सोम मन्ये रेवाँ इव प्र चरा पुष्टिमच्छ ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ ná ǀ mā ǀ mathitám ǀ sám ǀ didīpaḥ ǀ prá ǀ cakṣaya ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀátha ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ máde ǀ ā́ ǀ soma ǀ mánye ǀ revā́n-iva ǀ prá ǀ cara ǀ puṣṭím ǀ áccha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, kindle me like the fire ignited by attrition, brighten (our eyes) and make us rich; I praise you nowfor exhilaration; come now, full of wealth, to nourish us.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, kindle me like the fire ignited by attrition, brighten (our eyes) and make us rich; I praise you nowfor exhilaration; come now, full of wealth, to nourish us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इषिरेण ते मनसा सुतस्य भक्षीमहि पित्र्यस्येव रायः ।सोम राजन्प्र ण आयूंषि तारीरहानीव सूर्यो वासराणि ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣiréṇa ǀ te ǀ mánasā ǀ sutásya ǀ bhakṣīmáhi ǀ pítryasya-iva ǀ rāyáḥ ǀsóma ǀ rājan ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ tārīḥ ǀ áhāni-iva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ vāsarā́ṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we partake of you, effused, with a longing mind as (men enjoy) paternal wealth; King Soma,prolong our lives, as the sun the world-establishing day.
verses.wilson_translation: May we partake of you, effused, with a longing mind as (men enjoy) paternal wealth; King Soma,prolong our lives, as the sun the world-establishing day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोम राजन्मृळया नः स्वस्ति तव स्मसि व्रत्यास्तस्य विद्धि ।अलर्ति दक्ष उत मन्युरिंदो मा नो अर्यो अनुकामं परा दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sóma ǀ rājan ǀ mṛḷáya ǀ naḥ ǀ svastí ǀ táva ǀ smasi ǀ vratyā́ḥ ǀ tásya ǀ viddhi ǀálarti ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ utá ǀ manyúḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ anu-kāmám ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: King Soma, bless us for our welfare; we worshippers are yours, do you recognize it; the enemy goesstrong and fierce, O Soma; give us not over to him as he desires.
verses.wilson_translation: King Soma, bless us for our welfare; we worshippers are yours, do you recognize it; the enemy goesstrong and fierce, O Soma; give us not over to him as he desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि नस्तन्वः सोम गोपा गात्रेगात्रे निषसत्था नृचक्षाः ।यत्ते वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि स नो मृळ सुषखा देव वस्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ soma ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ gā́tre-gātre ǀ ni-sasáttha ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀyát ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ pra-minā́ma ǀ vratā́ni ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷa ǀ su-sakhā́ ǀ deva ǀ vásyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OSoma, you are the guardian of our bodies, you dwell in each limb as the beholder of man; though weimpair your rites, yet, divine one, bless us, you who are possessed of most excellent food and good friends.
verses.wilson_translation: OSoma, you are the guardian of our bodies, you dwell in each limb as the beholder of man; though weimpair your rites, yet, divine one, bless us, you who are possessed of most excellent food and good friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋदूदरेण सख्या सचेय यो मा न रिष्येद्धर्यश्व पीतः ।अयं यः सोमो न्यधाय्यस्मे तस्मा इंद्रं प्रतिरमेम्यायुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛdūdáreṇa ǀ sákhyā ǀ saceya ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā ǀ ná ǀ ríṣyet ǀ hari-aśva ǀ pītáḥ ǀayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ní ǀ ádhāyi ǀ asmé íti ǀ tásmai ǀ índram ǀ pra-tíram ǀ emi ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I obtain a wholesome friend who, when quaffed, will not harm me, O lord of bay horses; I ask of Indra a long permanence for this Somawhich has been plural ced within us.
verses.wilson_translation: May I obtain a wholesome friend who, when quaffed, will not harm me, O lord of bay horses; I ask of Indra a long permanence for this Somawhich has been plural ced within us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अप त्या अस्थुरनिरा अमीवा निरत्रसंतमिषीचीरभैषुः ।आ सोमो अस्माँ अरुहद्विहाया अगन्म यत्र प्रतिरंत आयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ ánirāḥ ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ atrasan ǀ támiṣīcīḥ ǀ ábhaiṣuḥ ǀā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ aruhat ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀ áganma ǀ yátra ǀ pra-tiránte ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those irremovable sicknesses depart; let those strong (pains) which have made us tremble, beafraid; the mighty Somahas climbed into us, we have attained that (draught) by which men prolong life.
verses.wilson_translation: May those irremovable sicknesses depart; let those strong (pains) which have made us tremble, beafraid; the mighty Somahas climbed into us, we have attained that (draught) by which men prolong life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो न इंदुः पितरो हृत्सु पीतोऽमर्त्यो मर्त्याँ आविवेश ।तस्मै सोमाय हविषा विधेम मृळीके अस्य सुमतौ स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ pitaraḥ ǀ hṛt-sú ǀ pītáḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ mártyān ǀ ā-vivéśa ǀtásmai ǀ sómāya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǀ mṛḷīké ǀ asya ǀ su-matáu ǀ syāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: That Somawhich, drunk into our hearts, has entered, immortal, into us mortals-- to him, fathers, let usdo worship with oblations; may we abide in his bliss and favour.
verses.wilson_translation: That Somawhich, drunk into our hearts, has entered, immortal, into us mortals-- to him, fathers, let usdo worship with oblations; may we abide in his bliss and favour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम पितृभिः संविदानोऽनु द्यावापृथिवी आ ततंथ ।तस्मै त इंदो हविषा विधेम वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sam-vidānáḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀtásmai ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǀ vayám ǀ syāma ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, you in conjunction with the fathers do stretch our successively heaven and earth-- to you let usdo worship with oblations, may we be lords of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, you in conjunction with the fathers do stretch our successively heaven and earth-- to you let usdo worship with oblations, may we be lords of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रातारो देवा अधि वोचता नो मा नो निद्रा ईशत मोत जल्पिः ।वयं सोमस्य विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
verses.transliteration: trā́tāraḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ni-drā́ ǀ īśata ǀ mā́ ǀ utá ǀ jálpiḥ ǀvayám ǀ sómasya ǀ viśváha ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ vidátham ǀ ā́ ǀ vadema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Guardian gods, speak favourably to us; let no dreams nor the censurer overpower us; may we be everdear to Soma; possessed of brave offspring, may we utter our hymn.
verses.wilson_translation: Guardian gods, speak favourably to us; let no dreams nor the censurer overpower us; may we be everdear to Soma; possessed of brave offspring, may we utter our hymn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो वयोधास्त्वं स्वर्विदा विशा नृचक्षाः ।त्वं न इंद ऊतिभिः सजोषाः पाहि पश्चातादुत वा पुरस्तात् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ tvám ǀ svaḥ-vít ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ paścā́tāt ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ purástāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, give us food from every side; you are the bestower of heaven; enter us, beholder of men; OSoma, rejoicing with your protecting powers, guard us from behind and before.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, give us food from every side; you are the bestower of heaven; enter us, beholder of men; OSoma, rejoicing with your protecting powers, guard us from behind and before.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIX. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: १० प्रस्कण्व: काण्व:। इन्द्र: । प्रगाथ:= ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as Invoking Priest.Let the extended ladle full of oil balm thee, best Priest, to sit on sacred grass. For unto thee, O Aṅgiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice.To Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, we seek, foremost in sacrificial rites. Agni, thou art Disposer, Sage, Herald, bright God! and worshipful,Best offerer, cheerful, to be praised in holy rites, pure Lord! by singers with their hymns. Most Youthful and Eternal, bring the longing Gods to me, the guileless, for the feast.Come, Vasu, to the banquet that is well-prepared: rejoice thee, gracious, with our songs. Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, Preserver, righteous, and a Sage.The holy singers, O refulgent kindled God! arrangers, call on thee to come. Shine, Most Resplendent! blaze, send bliss unto the folk, and to thy worshipperGreat art thou.So may my princes, with good fires, subduing foes, rest in the keeping of the Gods. O Agni, as thou burnest down to earth even high-grown underwood,So, bright as Mitra is, burn him who injures us, him who plots ill against thy friend. Give us not as a prey to mortal enemy, nor to the wicked friend of fiends.With conquering guards, auspicious, unassailable, protect us, O Most Youthful God. Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn,Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might, through four hymns, Vasu, guard thou us. Preserve us from each fiend who brings the Gods no gift, preserve thou us in deeds of strength:For we possess in thee the nearest Friend of all, for service of the Gods and weal. O Holy Agni, give us wealth renowned with men and strengthening life.Bestow on us, O Helper, that which many crave, more glorious still by righteousness; Wherewith we may o’ercome our rivals in the war, o’erpowering the foe's designs.So wax thou by our food, O Excellent in strength. Quicken our thoughts that find out wealth. Agni is even as a bull who whets and brandishes his horns.Well-sharpened are his jaws which may not be withstood: the Child of Strength hath powerful teeth. Not to be stayed, O Bull, O Agni, are thy teeth when thou art spreading far and wide.Make our oblations duly offered up, O Priest, and give us store of precious things. Thou liest in the wood: from both thy Mothers mortals kindle thee.Unweariedly thou bearest up the offerer's gifts, then shinest bright among the Gods. And so the seven priests, O Agni, worship thee, Free-giver, Everlasting One.Thou cleavest through the rock with heat and fervent glow. Agni, rise up above the men. For you let us whose grass is trimmed call Agni, Agni, restless God.Let us whose food is offered call to all the tribes Agni the Invoking Priest of men. Agni, with noble psalm that tells his wish he dwells, thinking on thee who guardest him.Speedily bring us strength of many varied sorts to be most near to succour us. Agni, Praise-singer! Lord of men, God burner-up of Rākṣasas,Mighty art thou, the ever-present Household-Lord, Home-friend and Guardian from the sky. Let no fiend come among us, O thou rich in light, no spell of those who deal in spells.To distant pastures drive faint hunger: far away, O Agni, chase the demons’ friends.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिंद्रमर्च यथा विदे ।यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ su-rā́dhasam ǀ índram ǀ arca ǀ yáthā ǀ vidé ǀyáḥ ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ sahásreṇa-iva ǀ śíkṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: I would praise to you the bounteous Indraas is fit, the wealth- abounding Maghavan, who loves to helpwith thousandfold treasure those who praise him.
verses.wilson_translation: I would praise to you the bounteous Indraas is fit, the wealth- abounding Maghavan, who loves to helpwith thousandfold treasure those who praise him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हंति वृत्राणि दाशुषे ।गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः ॥
verses.transliteration: śatā́nīkā-iva ǀ prá ǀ jigāti ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ hánti ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀgiréḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ rásāḥ ǀ asya ǀ pinvire ǀ dátrāṇi ǀ puru-bhójasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He rushes on boldly like a weapon with a hundred edges, he smites the enemies of his worshipper; thegifts of him who feeds many, swell like the streams of a mountain.
verses.wilson_translation: He rushes on boldly like a weapon with a hundred edges, he smites the enemies of his worshipper; thegifts of him who feeds many, swell like the streams of a mountain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा सुतास इंदवो मदा य इंद्र गिर्वणः ।आपो न वज्रिन्नन्वोक्यं सरः पृणंति शूर राधसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ mádāḥ ǀ yé ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ vajrin ǀ ánu ǀ okyám ǀ sáraḥ ǀ pṛṇánti ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: The expressed exhilarate Soma, OIndra, lover of hymns, fills you for bounty, O hero, O thunderer, asthe waters flow to their accusative tomed lake.
verses.wilson_translation: The expressed exhilarate Soma, OIndra, lover of hymns, fills you for bounty, O hero, O thunderer, asthe waters flow to their accusative tomed lake.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनेहसं प्रतरणं विवक्षणं मध्वः स्वादिष्ठमीं पिब ।आ यथा मंदसानः किरासि नः प्र क्षुद्रेव त्मना धृषत् ॥
verses.transliteration: anehásam ǀ pra-táraṇam ǀ vivákṣaṇam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ svā́diṣṭham ǀ īm ǀ piba ǀā́ ǀ yáthā ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ kirā́si ǀ naḥ ǀ prá ǀ kṣudrā́-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ dhṛṣát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink the incomparable, helpful, swelling Soma, the sweet of the Soma, that in your exultation you maypour out treasure for us, just as the mill-stone pours out meal.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink the incomparable, helpful, swelling Soma, the sweet of the Soma, that in your exultation you maypour out treasure for us, just as the mill-stone pours out meal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नः स्तोममुप द्रवद्धियानो अश्वो न सोतृभिः ।यं ते स्वधावन्त्स्वदयंति धेनव इंद्र कण्वेषु रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ úpa ǀ dravát ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sótṛ-bhiḥ ǀyám ǀ te ǀ svadhā-van ǀ svadáyanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ índra ǀ káṇveṣu ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come quickly to our praise--urged on by the Soma-pressers like a horse- - which the kine make sweet,for you, OIndra, of independent mighty; there are gifts (for you) among the Kaṇva's.
verses.wilson_translation: Come quickly to our praise--urged on by the Soma-pressers like a horse- - which the kine make sweet,for you, OIndra, of independent mighty; there are gifts (for you) among the Kaṇva's.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उग्रं न वीरं नमसोप सेदिम विभूतिमक्षितावसुं ।उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो न सिंचते क्षरंतींद्र धीतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ugrám ǀ ná ǀ vīrám ǀ námasā ǀ úpa ǀ sedima ǀ ví-bhūtim ǀ ákṣita-vasum ǀudrī́-iva ǀ vajrin ǀ avatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ siñcaté ǀ kṣáranti ǀ indra ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have approached you with homage like a mighty hero, the pre-eminent one, of imperishable wealth;OIndra, thunderer, our prayers flow forth as an abundant fountain pours out its streams.
verses.wilson_translation: We have approached you with homage like a mighty hero, the pre-eminent one, of imperishable wealth;OIndra, thunderer, our prayers flow forth as an abundant fountain pours out its streams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्ध नूनं यद्वा यज्ञे यद्वा पृथिव्यामधि ।अतो नो यज्ञमाशुभिर्महेमत उग्र उग्रेभिरा गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ yajñé ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ ádhi ǀátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ mahe-mate ǀ ugráḥ ǀ ugrébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether you are now present at a sacrifice, or whether you are abroad on the earth, come from thencewith your swift steeds to our sacrifice, O you of lofty counsel, come, strong one, with the strong (steeds).
verses.wilson_translation: Whether you are now present at a sacrifice, or whether you are abroad on the earth, come from thencewith your swift steeds to our sacrifice, O you of lofty counsel, come, strong one, with the strong (steeds).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अजिरासो हरयो ये त आशवो वाता इव प्रसक्षिणः ।येभिरपत्यं मनुषः परीयसे येभिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
verses.transliteration: ajirā́saḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ vā́tāḥ-iva ǀ pra-sakṣíṇaḥ ǀyébhiḥ ǀ ápatyam ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ pari-ī́yase ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agile and swift are your steeds, overpowering like the winds; with which you encircle the race of Manus,with which he whole heaven becomes visible.
verses.wilson_translation: Agile and swift are your steeds, overpowering like the winds; with which you encircle the race of Manus,with which he whole heaven becomes visible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतावतस्त ईमह इंद्र सुम्नस्य गोमतः ।यथा प्रावो मघवन्मेध्यातिथिं यथा नीपातिथिं धने ॥
verses.transliteration: etā́vataḥ ǀ te ǀ īmahe ǀ índra ǀ sumnásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀyáthā ǀ prá ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ médhya-atithim ǀ yáthā ǀ nī́pa-atithim ǀ dháne ǁ
verses.english_translation: OIndra, we long for such a bounty of yours, rich in kine; (help us),Maghavan, as you did help Medhyātithi with wealth, as you did help Nīpātithi.
verses.wilson_translation: OIndra, we long for such a bounty of yours, rich in kine; (help us),Maghavan, as you did help Medhyātithi with wealth, as you did help Nīpātithi.
