verses.sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्युत द्वितीयया ।पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो ॥
verses.transliteration: pāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ékayā ǀ pāhí ǀ utá ǀ dvitī́yayā ǀpāhí ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ tisṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ūrjām ǀ pate ǀ pāhí ǀ catasṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, protect us by one (rich), or protect us by a second; lord of strength, protect us by three sons;protect us, giver of dwellings, by four.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, protect us by one (rich), or protect us by a second; lord of strength, protect us by three sons;protect us, giver of dwellings, by four.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नोऽव ।त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: pāhí ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀ prá ǀ sma ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ ava ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ āpím ǀ nákṣāmahe ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect us from every impiousrākṣasa, shield us in battles; we approach you, our nearest neighbour,our kinsman, for sacrifice and for increase.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us from every impiousrākṣasa, shield us in battles; we approach you, our nearest neighbour,our kinsman, for sacrifice and for increase.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधं रयिं पावक शंस्यं ।रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहं सुनीती स्वयशस्तरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ vayaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ rayím ǀ pāvaka ǀ śáṃsyam ǀrā́sva ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ upa-māte ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ sú-nītī ǀ sváyaśaḥ-taram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purifying Agni, bestow upon us food-augmenting excellent wealth; and (bring) us, O meter-out of good,by auspicious guidance, (a treasure) desired by many and bringing its own fame.
verses.wilson_translation: Purifying Agni, bestow upon us food-augmenting excellent wealth; and (bring) us, O meter-out of good,by auspicious guidance, (a treasure) desired by many and bringing its own fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येन वंसाम पृतनासु शर्धतस्तरंतो अर्य आदिशः ।स त्वं नो वर्ध प्रयसा शचीवसो जिन्वा धियो वसुविदः ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ váṃsāma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀ tárantaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā-díśaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ vardha ǀ práyasā ǀ śacīvaso íti śacī-vaso ǀ jínva ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ vasu-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By which we may escape and destroy in battles our impetuous weapon- aiming enemies; O you who bywisdom establish our rites, bless us with food, prosper our wealth-obtaining offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: By which we may escape and destroy in battles our impetuous weapon- aiming enemies; O you who bywisdom establish our rites, bless us with food, prosper our wealth-obtaining offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शिशानो वृषभो यथाग्निः शृंगे दविध्वत् ।तिग्मा अस्य हनवो न प्रतिधृषे सुजंभः सहसो यहुः ॥
verses.transliteration: śíśānaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yathā ǀ agníḥ ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ dávidhvat ǀtigmā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ hánavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ prati-dhṛ́ṣe ǀ su-jámbhaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ yahúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agnitosses his horns, sharpening them as a bull; his sharp jaws are not to be resisted; he is mightytoothed, this son of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnitosses his horns, sharpening them as a bull; his sharp jaws are not to be resisted; he is mightytoothed, this son of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि ते अग्ने वृषभ प्रतिधृषे जंभासो यद्वितिष्ठसे ।स त्वं नो होतः सुहुतं हविष्कृधि वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ prati-dhṛ́ṣe ǀ jámbhāsaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vi-tíṣṭhase ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ hotaríti ǀ sú-hutam ǀ havíḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ váṃsva ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since you spread out on all sides, your teeth, bull Agni, are not to be resisted; O offerer, do you makeour oblation rightly presented; give us many precious (gifts).
verses.wilson_translation: Since you spread out on all sides, your teeth, bull Agni, are not to be resisted; O offerer, do you makeour oblation rightly presented; give us many precious (gifts).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शेषे वनेषु मात्रोः सं त्वा मर्तास इंधते ।अतंद्रो हव्या वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि ॥
verses.transliteration: śéṣe ǀ váneṣu ǀ mātróḥ ǀ sám ǀ tvā ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ indhate ǀátandraḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ vahasi ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ devéṣu ǀ rājasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You sleep within your mothers in the woods, mortals kindle you; unwearied you bear the offerings of thesacrificer, then you shine among the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: You sleep within your mothers in the woods, mortals kindle you; unwearied you bear the offerings of thesacrificer, then you shine among the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सप्त होतारस्तमिदीळते त्वाग्ने सुत्यजमह्रयं ।भिनत्स्यद्रिं तपसा वि शोचिषा प्राग्ने तिष्ठ जनाँ अति ॥
verses.transliteration: saptá ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ tám ǀ ít ǀ īḷate ǀ tvā ǀ ágne ǀ su-tyájam ǀ áhrayam ǀbhinátsí ǀ ádrim ǀ tápasā ǀ ví ǀ śocíṣā ǀ prá ǀ agne ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ jánān ǀ áti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The seven priests praise you,Agni, giver of good things and unfailing; you cleave the cloud with yourfierce splendour; go forth, having overcome our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: The seven priests praise you,Agni, giver of good things and unfailing; you cleave the cloud with yourfierce splendour; go forth, having overcome our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमग्निं वो अध्रिगुं हुवेम वृक्तबर्हिषः ।अग्निं हितप्रयसः शश्वतीष्वा होतारं चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: agním-agnim ǀ vaḥ ǀ ádhri-gum ǀ huvéma ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀagním ǀ hitá-prayasaḥ ǀ śaśvatī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ hótāram ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Now that we have cut the sacred grass, let us invoke for you Agni, Agni the irresistible; having plural cedthe oblations, let us invoke Agni, abiding in many (plural ces), the offerer of sacrifices for men.
verses.wilson_translation: Now that we have cut the sacred grass, let us invoke for you Agni, Agni the irresistible; having plural cedthe oblations, let us invoke Agni, abiding in many (plural ces), the offerer of sacrifices for men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: केतेन शर्मन्त्सचते सुषामण्यग्ने तुभ्यं चिकित्वना ।इषण्यया नः पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: kétena ǀ śárman ǀ sacate ǀ su-sāmáni ǀ ágne ǀ túbhyam ǀ cikitvánā ǀiṣaṇyáyā ǀ naḥ ǀ puru-rū́pam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ vā́jam ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The sacrificer) worships you by praises,Agni, with the experienced (priests) in the rite celebrated withbeautiful Sāmanhymns;bring us of your own accord for our protection food of various kinds which may bealways in our reach.
verses.wilson_translation: (The sacrificer) worships you by praises,Agni, with the experienced (priests) in the rite celebrated withbeautiful Sāmanhymns;bring us of your own accord for our protection food of various kinds which may bealways in our reach.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तेपानो देव रक्षसः ।अप्रोषिवान्गृहपतिर्महाँ असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ járitaḥ ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ tepānáḥ ǀ deva ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀáproṣi-vān ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ diváḥ ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ duroṇa-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, worthy of praise, you are the guardian of men, the consumer of therākṣasas; you aregreat, you the never-absent guardian of the (worshipper's) house, the protector of heaven, ever present in thedwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, worthy of praise, you are the guardian of men, the consumer of therākṣasas; you aregreat, you the never-absent guardian of the (worshipper's) house, the protector of heaven, ever present in thedwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो रक्ष आ वेशीदाघृणीवसो मा यातुर्यातुमावतां ।परोगव्यूत्यनिरामप क्षुधमग्ने सेध रक्षस्विनः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ veśīt ǀ āghṛṇivaso ítyāghṛṇi-vaso ǀ mā́ ǀ yātúḥ ǀ yātu-mā́vatām ǀparaḥ-gavyūtí ǀ ánirām ǀ ápa ǀ kṣúdham ǀ ágne ǀ sédha ǀ rakṣasvínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you brilliant wealth, let not therākṣasaenter us, nor the torment of the evil spirits;Agni, drive awayfurther than agavyūtifrom us poverty, hunger and the strong demons.
verses.wilson_translation: O you brilliant wealth, let not therākṣasaenter us, nor the torment of the evil spirits;Agni, drive awayfurther than agavyūtifrom us poverty, hunger and the strong demons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXI. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: १८  भर्ग: प्रागाथ: । इन्द्र: । प्रगाथ:= ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती, )  १७ शंकुमती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . PREPARE oblation: let him come; and let the minister serve againWho knows the ordering thereof, Rejoicing in his friendship, let the priest be seated over man,Beside the shoot of active power. Him, glowing bright beyond all thought, they seek among the race of man;With him fortonguethey seize the food. He hath inflamed the twofold plain: life-giving, he hath climbed the wood,And with his tongue hath struck the rock. Wandering here the radiant Calf finds none to fetter him, and seeksThe Mother to declare his praise. And now that great and mighty team, the team of horses that are his,And traces of his car, are seen. The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work,On the stream's loud-resounding bank. Entreated by Vivasvān's ten, Indra cast down the water-jarWith threefold hammer from the sky. Three times the newly-kindled flame proceeds around the sacrifice:The priests anoint it with the meath. With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above,Exhaustless, with the mouth below. The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank,At the out-shedding of the fount. Ye cows, protect the fount: the two Mighty Ones bless the sacrifice.The handles twain are wrought of gold. Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earthSupply the liquid to the Bull. These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside the mother cowsThey meet together with their kin. Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food in heaven,To Indra, Agni light and prayer. The Pious One milked out rich food, sustenance dealt in portions seven,Together with the Sun's seven rays. I took some Soma when the Sun rose up, O Mitra, Varuṇa.That is the sick man's medicine. From where oblations must be laid, which is the Well-beloved's home,He with his tongue hath compassed heaven.

verses.sanskrit: उभयं शृणवच्च न इंद्रो अर्वागिदं वचः ।सत्राच्या मघवा सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ubháyam ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀsatrā́cyā ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ śáviṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indralisten to both these our hymns; may the mightiest Maghavancome to us, (plural ased) with ourdevoted offering, to drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indralisten to both these our hymns; may the mightiest Maghavancome to us, (plural ased) with ourdevoted offering, to drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसे धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः ।उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामं हि ते मनः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ hí ǀ sva-rā́jam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ tám ǀ ójase ǀ dhiṣáṇe íti ǀ niḥ-tatakṣátuḥ ǀutá ǀ upa-mā́nām ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ní ǀ sīdasi ǀ sóma-kāmam ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him, self-resplendent, have heaven and earth formed as the showerer, him (they have formed) forstrength; therefore, you sit down first of your peers; your mind loved the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Him, self-resplendent, have heaven and earth formed as the showerer, him (they have formed) forstrength; therefore, you sit down first of your peers; your mind loved the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वृषस्व पुरूवसो सुतस्येंद्रांधसः ।विद्मा हि त्वा हरिवः पृत्सु सासहिमधृष्टं चिद्दधृष्वणिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ sutásya ǀ indra ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ sasahím ǀ ádhṛṣṭam ǀ cit ǀ dadhṛṣváṇim ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, possessor of much wealth, pour the effused Somawithin you; possessor of (bright) coursers, weknow you, the overpowerer in battles, the unconquerable, the conqueror.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, possessor of much wealth, pour the effused Somawithin you; possessor of (bright) coursers, weknow you, the overpowerer in battles, the unconquerable, the conqueror.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अप्रामिसत्य मघवंतथेदसदिंद्र क्रत्वा यथा वशः ।सनेम वाजं तव शिप्रिन्नवसा मक्षू चिद्यंतो अद्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: áprāmi-satya ǀ magha-van ǀ táthā ǀ ít ǀ asat ǀ índra ǀ krátvā ǀ yáthā ǀ váśaḥ ǀsanéma ǀ vā́jam ǀ táva ǀ śiprin ǀ ávasā ǀ makṣú ǀ cit ǀ yántaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra,Maghavanof unbroken truth, it ever comes to pass as you in your knowledge may desire, by yourprotection, O handsome-jawed, may we obtain food, speedily, O thunderer, subduing our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra,Maghavanof unbroken truth, it ever comes to pass as you in your knowledge may desire, by yourprotection, O handsome-jawed, may we obtain food, speedily, O thunderer, subduing our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शग्ध्यू षु शचीपत इंद्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀbhágam ǀ ná ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ yaśásam ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ ánu ǀ śūra ǀ cárāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indr, lord of rites, give us (our desire) with all your helping powers; hero, we worship you as happiness,the glorious, the obtainer of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indr, lord of rites, give us (our desire) with all your helping powers; hero, we worship you as happiness,the glorious, the obtainer of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ।नकिर्हि दानं परिमर्धिषत्त्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: pauráḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ puru-kṛ́t ǀ gávām ǀ asi ǀ útsaḥ ǀ deva ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀnákiḥ ǀ hí ǀ dā́nam ǀ pari-márdhiṣat ǀ tvé íti ǀ yát-yat ǀ yā́mi ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are the increaser of horses, the multiplier of cows; you, deity, with your golden body; none canharm the gifts laid up for me in you; bring me whatever I ask.
verses.wilson_translation: You are the increaser of horses, the multiplier of cows; you, deity, with your golden body; none canharm the gifts laid up for me in you; bring me whatever I ask.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये ।उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिंद्राश्वमिष्टये ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ cérave ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ bhágam ǀ vásuttaye ǀút ǀ vavṛṣasva ǀ magha-van ǀ gó-iṣṭaye ǀ út ǀ indra ǀ áśvam-iṣṭaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are (bounteous), come, may you obtain wealth to distribute to the worshipper; shower your bounty,Maghavan, on me desiring cows, shower it,Indra, on me desiring horses.
verses.wilson_translation: You are (bounteous), come, may you obtain wealth to distribute to the worshipper; shower your bounty,Maghavan, on me desiring cows, shower it,Indra, on me desiring horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मंहसे ।आ पुरंदरं चकृम विप्रवचस इंद्रं गायंतोऽवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ purú ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ śatā́ni ǀ ca ǀ yūthā́ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ maṃhase ǀā́ ǀ puram-darám ǀ cakṛma ǀ vípra-vacasaḥ ǀ índram ǀ gā́yantaḥ ǀ ávase ǁ
verses.english_translation: You grant many hundreds and thousands of herds as a gift (to the offerer), uttering long praises, we,hymning Indra, the destroyer of cities, bring him before us for our protection.
verses.wilson_translation: You grant many hundreds and thousands of herds as a gift (to the offerer), uttering long praises, we,hymning Indra, the destroyer of cities, bring him before us for our protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अविप्रो वा यदविधद्विप्रो वेंद्र ते वचः ।स प्र ममंदत्त्वाया शतक्रतो प्राचामन्यो अहंसन ॥
verses.transliteration: avipráḥ ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ ávidhat ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vā ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ vácaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ prá ǀ mamandat ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ prā́cāmanyo íti prā́cā-manyo ǀ áham-sana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, whether it be the unskilled or the skilled who celebrate your praise, each rejoices in his desire foryou, OŚatakratu, whose wrath presses ever forwards, who meet the foe, proclaiming, "It is I".
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, whether it be the unskilled or the skilled who celebrate your praise, each rejoices in his desire foryou, OŚatakratu, whose wrath presses ever forwards, who meet the foe, proclaiming, "It is I".
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उग्रबाहुर्म्रक्षकृत्वा पुरंदरो यदि मे शृणवद्धवं ।वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं स्तोमैरिंद्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: ugrá-bāhuḥ ǀ mrakṣa-kṛ́tvā ǀ puram-daráḥ ǀ yádi ǀ me ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ hávam ǀvasu-yávaḥ ǀ vásu-patim ǀ śatá-kratum ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ índram ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: If the strong-armed slayer of enemies, the destroyer of cities, will but hear my invocation, we, desiringwealth, will with our praises call one IndraŚatakratu, the lord of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: If the strong-armed slayer of enemies, the destroyer of cities, will but hear my invocation, we, desiringwealth, will with our praises call one IndraŚatakratu, the lord of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न पापासो मनामहे नारायासो न जळ्हवः ।यदिन्न्विंद्रं वृषणं सचा सुते सखायं कृणवामहै ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ pāpā́saḥ ǀ manāmahe ǀ ná ǀ árāyāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jáḷhavaḥ ǀyát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kṛṇávāmahai ǁ
verses.english_translation: We are not evil who worship him, nor too poor to offer gifts, nor destitute of sacred fires-- sinceassembled together, when the Somais effused, we make Indra, the showerer, our friend.
verses.wilson_translation: We are not evil who worship him, nor too poor to offer gifts, nor destitute of sacred fires-- sinceassembled together, when the Somais effused, we make Indra, the showerer, our friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उग्रं युयुज्म पृतनासु सासहिमृणकातिमदाभ्यं ।वेदा भृमं चित्सनिता रथीतमो वाजिनं यमिदू नशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ugrám ǀ yuyujma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sasahím ǀ ṛṇá-kātim ǀ ádābhyam ǀvéda ǀ bhṛmám ǀ cit ǀ sánitā ǀ rathí-tamaḥ ǀ vājínam ǀ yám ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ náśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: We join (to our rite) the mighty Indra, the subduer of enemies in battles, the inviolate, him to whompraise is due as a debt; he, the best of charioteers, knows (among steeds) the strong racer, and (among men)he, the bounteous (knows) the offerer whom he is to reach.
verses.wilson_translation: We join (to our rite) the mighty Indra, the subduer of enemies in battles, the inviolate, him to whompraise is due as a debt; he, the best of charioteers, knows (among steeds) the strong racer, and (among men)he, the bounteous (knows) the offerer whom he is to reach.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत इंद्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि ।मघवंछग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिर्वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ bháyāmahe ǀ tátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ kṛdhi ǀmágha-van ǀ śagdhí ǀ táva ǀ tám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, give us security from him of whom we are afraid,Maghavan, be strong for us with yourprotections; destroy our enemies, destroy those who harm us.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, give us security from him of whom we are afraid,Maghavan, be strong for us with yourprotections; destroy our enemies, destroy those who harm us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि राधस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विधतः ।तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निंद्र गिर्वणः सुतावंतो हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ rādhaḥ-pate ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ kṣáyasya ǀ ási ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ sutá-vantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of wealth, you are (the bestower) of great wealth and a dwelling plural ce upon your worshipper; assuch, we invoke you, bearing the Soma, OMaghavan,Indra, who are to be honoured with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of wealth, you are (the bestower) of great wealth and a dwelling plural ce upon your worshipper; assuch, we invoke you, bearing the Soma, OMaghavan,Indra, who are to be honoured with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र स्पळुत वृत्रहा परस्पा नो वरेण्यः ।स नो रक्षिषच्चरमं स मध्यमं स पश्चात्पातु नः पुरः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ spáṭ ǀ utá ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rakṣiṣat ǀ caramám ǀ sáḥ ǀ madhyamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ paścā́t ǀ pātu ǀ naḥ ǀ puráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the all-knower, the slayer of Vṛtra, the protector, is to be chosen by us; may he guard our (son),our last (son), our middle (son), may he protect us from behind and before.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the all-knower, the slayer of Vṛtra, the protector, is to be chosen by us; may he guard our (son),our last (son), our middle (son), may he protect us from behind and before.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नः पश्चादधरादुत्तरात्पुर इंद्र नि पाहि विश्वतः ।आरे अस्मत्कृणुहि दैव्यं भयमा��े हेतीरदेवीः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ paścā́t ǀ adharā́t ǀ uttarā́t ǀ puráḥ ǀ índra ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀāré ǀ asmát ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ dáivyam ǀ bhayám ǀ āré ǀ hetī́ḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, protect us from the west, from the south, from the north, from the east, protect us from every side;keep far from us supernatural alarm, keep afar the weapons of the demons.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, protect us from the west, from the south, from the north, from the east, protect us from every side;keep far from us supernatural alarm, keep afar the weapons of the demons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इंद्र त्रास्व परे च नः ।विश्वा च नो जरितॄन्त्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: adyá-adya ǀ śváḥ-śvaḥ ǀ índra ǀ trā́sva ǀ paré ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ jaritṝ́n ǀ sat-pate ǀ áhā ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ ca ǀ rakṣiṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Save us,Indra, every today, every tomorrow, and every succeeding day; lord of the good, protect us,your praisers, in all days, by day and night.
verses.wilson_translation: Save us,Indra, every today, every tomorrow, and every succeeding day; lord of the good, protect us,your praisers, in all days, by day and night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रभंगी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो विर्याय कं ।उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-bhaṅgī́ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ tuví-maghaḥ ǀ sám-miślaḥ ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ kám ǀubhā́ ǀ te ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ ní ǀ yā́ ǀ vájram ǀ mimikṣátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maghavanis the shatterer, the hero, great in wealth, and the conductor to victory (over our enemies),Śatakratu, both your arms, which grasp the thunderbolt, are the showerers (of blessings).
verses.wilson_translation: Maghavanis the shatterer, the hero, great in wealth, and the conductor to victory (over our enemies),Śatakratu, both your arms, which grasp the thunderbolt, are the showerers (of blessings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXII. Aśvins.
hymns.anukramani: १२  प्रगाथो घौर: काण्व:। इन्द्र: । पंक्ति: , ७-९  बृहती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ROUSE ye for him who keeps the Law, yoke your steeds, Aśvins, to your carLet your protecting help be near. Come, Aśvins, with your car more swift than is the twinkling of an eyeLet your protecting help be near. Aśvins, ye overlaid with cold the fiery pit for Atri's sake:Let your protecting help be near. Where are ye? whither are ye gone? whither, like falcons, have ye flown?Let your protecting help be near. If ye at any time this day are listening to this my call,Let your protecting help be near. The Aśvins, first to hear our prayer, for closest kinship I approach:Let your protecting help be near. For Atri ye, O Aśvins, made a dwelling-place to shield him well,Let your protecting help be near. Ye warded off the fervent heat for Atri when he sweetly spake:Let your protecting help be near. Erst Saptavadhri by his prayer obtained the trenchant edge of fire:Let your protecting help be near. Come hither, O ye Lords of wealth, and listen to this call of mine:Let your protecting help be near. What is this praise told forth of you as Elders in the ancient way?Let your protecting help be near. One common brotherhood is yours, Aśvins your kindred is the same:Let your protecting help be near. This is your chariot, Aśvins, which speeds through the regions, earth and heavenLet your protecting aid be near. Approach ye hitherward to us with thousands both of steeds and kine:Let your protecting help be near. Pass us not by, remember us with thousands both of kineandsteeds:Let your protecting help be near. The purple-tinted Dawn hath risen, and true to Law hath made the lightLet your protecting help be near. He looked upon the Aśvins, as an axe-armed man upon a tree:Let your protecting help be near. By the black band encompassed round, break it down, bold one, like a fort.Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sanskrit: प्रो अस्मा उपस्तुतिं भरता यज्जुजोषति ।उक्थैरिंद्रस्य माहिनं वयो वर्धंति सोमिनो भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: pró íti ǀ asmai ǀ úpa-stutim ǀ bhárata ǀ yát ǀ jújoṣati ǀuktháiḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ mā́hinam ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vardhanti ǀ somínaḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Present the offering of praise to Indra, since he enjoys it; (the priests) augment the ample food of the Soma-loving Indra with their recited hymns, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Present the offering of praise to Indra, since he enjoys it; (the priests) augment the ample food of the Soma-loving Indra with their recited hymns, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयुजो असमो नृभिरेकः कृष्टीरयास्यः ।पूर्वीरति प्र वावृधे विश्वा जातान्योजसा भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayujáḥ ǀ ásamaḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ ayā́syaḥ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ áti ǀ prá ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ ójasā ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Without a fellow and unlike the other gods, he alone, unconquerable, surpasses the men of formertimes, he surpasses in might all beings;Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Without a fellow and unlike the other gods, he alone, unconquerable, surpasses the men of formertimes, he surpasses in might all beings;Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहितेन चिदर्वता जीरदानुः सिषासति ।प्रवाच्यमिंद्र तत्तव वीर्याणि करिष्यतो भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: áhitena ǀ cit ǀ árvatā ǀ jīrá-dānuḥ ǀ sisāsati ǀpra-vā́cyam ǀ indra ǀ tát ǀ táva ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ kariṣyatáḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the swift giver, wishes to bestow blessings (upon us) with his unurged courser, your greatness,Indra, as you are about to display your powers, should be proclaimed, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the swift giver, wishes to bestow blessings (upon us) with his unurged courser, your greatness,Indra, as you are about to display your powers, should be proclaimed, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ याहि कृणवाम त इंद्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धना ।येभिः शविष्ठ चाकनो भद्रमिह श्रवस्यते भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ kṛṇávāma ǀ te ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ várdhanā ǀyébhiḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ cākánaḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ ihá ǀ śravasyaté ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, come here; let us perform for you our sacred rites augmenting your vigour; by which (rites), mostmightyone, you desire to bless him who wishes for food; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, come here; let us perform for you our sacred rites augmenting your vigour; by which (rites), mostmightyone, you desire to bless him who wishes for food; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धृषतश्चिद्धृषन्मनः कृणोषींद्र यत्त्वं ।तीव्रैः सोमैः सपर्यतो नमोभिः प्रतिभूषतो भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: dhṛṣatáḥ ǀ cit ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ mánaḥ ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ tvám ǀtīvráiḥ ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ saparyatáḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ prati-bhū́ṣataḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have made your mind,Indra, more resolute than the resolute, since you (wish to give the desires)of him who worships you with the intoxicating Somaand adorns you with adorations; Indra's gifts are worthy ofpraise.
verses.wilson_translation: You have made your mind,Indra, more resolute than the resolute, since you (wish to give the desires)of him who worships you with the intoxicating Somaand adorns you with adorations; Indra's gifts are worthy ofpraise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव चष्ट ऋचीषमोऽवताँ इव मानुषः ।जुष्ट्वी दक्षस्य सोमिनः सखायं कृणुते युजं भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ caṣṭe ǀ ṛ́cīṣamaḥ ǀ avatā́n-iva ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀjuṣṭvī́ ǀ dákṣasya ǀ somínaḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kṛṇute ǀ yújam ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who is well-deserving of the hymn, looks down (with favour) upon us as a (thirsty) man (looksdown) on wells; and being well-plural ased he makes the energetic Soma-offerer his friend; Indra's gifts are worthyof praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who is well-deserving of the hymn, looks down (with favour) upon us as a (thirsty) man (looksdown) on wells; and being well-plural ased he makes the energetic Soma-offerer his friend; Indra's gifts are worthyof praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे त इंद्र वीर्यं देवा अनु क्रतुं ददुः ।भुवो विश्वस्य गोपतिः पुरुष्टुत भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vīryám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ krátum ǀ daduḥ ǀbhúvaḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ puru-stuta ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, by the example of your power and knowledge the gods attain the same; O hymned by many, youare herdsman of the universe; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, by the example of your power and knowledge the gods attain the same; O hymned by many, youare herdsman of the universe; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गृणे तदिंद्र ते शव उपमं देवतातये ।यद्धंसि वृत्रमोजसा शचीपते भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: gṛṇé ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ devá-tātaye ǀyát ǀ háṃsi ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ójasā ǀ śacī-pate ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, I laud that might of yours which isnear athandto the worshipper-- (I laud you) that you slay Vṛtra,O lord of rites, by your strength; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, I laud that might of yours which isnear athandto the worshipper-- (I laud you) that you slay Vṛtra,O lord of rites, by your strength; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समनेव वपुष्यतः कृणवन्मानुषा युगा ।विदे तदिंद्रश्चेतनमध श्रुतो भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: sámanā-iva ǀ vapuṣyatáḥ ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀvidé ǀ tát ǀ índraḥ ǀ cétanam ǀ ádha ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As a woman who shows no partiality wins her lovers to her, so Indraconfers periods of time onmankind;it is Indra who has performed that knowledge- giving achievement, therefore he is renowned; Indra's gifts areworthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: As a woman who shows no partiality wins her lovers to her, so Indraconfers periods of time onmankind;it is Indra who has performed that knowledge- giving achievement, therefore he is renowned; Indra's gifts areworthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उज्जातमिंद्र ते शव उत्त्वामुत्तव क्रतुं ।भूरिगो भूरि वावृधुर्मघवंतव शर्मणि भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ jātám ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀ út ǀ tvā́m ǀ út ǀ táva ǀ krátum ǀbhū́rigo íti bhū́ri-go ǀ bhū́ri ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ mágha-van ǀ táva ǀ śármaṇi ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maghavan, rich in cattle, (those who abide) in your happiness have greatly augmented your might whenit was born, (they have greatly augmented) you,Indraand your knwoeldge; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Maghavan, rich in cattle, (those who abide) in your happiness have greatly augmented your might whenit was born, (they have greatly augmented) you,Indraand your knwoeldge; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहं च त्वं च वृत्रहन्त्सं युज्याव सनिभ्य आ ।अरातीवा चिदद्रिवोऽनु नौ शूर मंसते भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ ca ǀ tvám ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ sám ǀ yujyāva ǀ saní-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀarāti-vā́ ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ nau ǀ śūra ǀ maṃsate ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May I and you, slayer of Vṛtra, be close to you united until wealth is obtained; hero, wielding thethunderbolt, even the niggard concedes (that our union gives wealth);Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: May I and you, slayer of Vṛtra, be close to you united until wealth is obtained; hero, wielding thethunderbolt, even the niggard concedes (that our union gives wealth);Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमिद्वा उ तं वयमिंद्रं स्तवाम नानृतं ।महाँ असुन्वतो वधो भूरि ज्योतींषि सुन्वतो भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: satyám ǀ ít ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tám ǀ vayám ǀ índram ǀ stavāma ǀ ná ǀ ánṛtam ǀmahā́n ǀ ásunvataḥ ǀ vadháḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us praise that Indrawith truth, not with untruth, great is the destruction of him who offers not but tohim who offers abundant Soma-oblations, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us praise that Indrawith truth, not with untruth, great is the destruction of him who offers not but tohim who offers abundant Soma-oblations, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . EXERTING all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speechAgni your dear familiar Friend, the darling Guest in every home. Whom, served with sacrificial oil like Mitra, men presenting giftsEulogize with their songs of praise Much-lauded Jātavedas, him who bears oblations up to heavenPrepared in service of the Gods. To noblest Agni, Friend of man, best Vṛtra-slayer, are we come,Him in whose presence Rksa's son, mighty Srutarvan, waxes great; To deathless Jātavedas, meet for praise, adored, with sacred oil,Visible through the gloom of night Even Agni whom these priestly men worship with sacrificial gifts,With lifted ladles offering them. O Agni, this our newest hymn hath been addressed from us to thee,O cheerful Guest, well-born, most wise, worker of wonders, ne’er deceived. Agni, may it be dear to thee, most grateful, and exceeding sweet:Grow mightier, eulogized therewith. Splendid with splendours may it be, and in the battle with the foeAdd loftier glory to thy fame. Steed, cow, a lord of heroes, bright like Indra, who shall fill the car.Whose high renown ye celebrate, and people praise each glorious deed. Thou whom Gopavana made glad with song, O Agni Aṅgiras,Hear this my call, thou Holy One. Thou whom the priestly folk implore to aid the gathering of the spoil,Such be thou in the fight with foes. I, called to him who reels with joy, Srutarvan, Rksa's son, shall strokeThe heads of four presented steeds, like the long wool of fleecy rams. Four coursers with a splendid car, Savistha's horses, fleet of foot,Shall bring me to the sacred feast, as flying steeds brought Tugra's son. The very truth do I declare to thee, Paruṣṇī, mighty flood.Waters! no man is there who gives more horses than Savistha gives.

verses.sanskrit: स पूर्व्यो महानां वेनः क्रतुभिरानजे ।यस्य द्वारा मनुष्पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ mahā́nām ǀ venáḥ ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ ānaje ǀyásya ǀ dvā́rā ǀ mánuḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ānajé ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, (Indra), the chief of those to be honoured, desirous of our offerings, approaches; he, the doors ofwhose favour, the sacred rites,Manu, the (universal) father, attained among the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: He, (Indra), the chief of those to be honoured, desirous of our offerings, approaches; he, the doors ofwhose favour, the sacred rites,Manu, the (universal) father, attained among the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो मानं नोत्सदन्त्सोमपृष्ठासो अद्रयः ।उक्था ब्रह्म च शंस्या ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ mā́nam ǀ ná ǀ út ǀ sadan ǀ sóma-pṛṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀukthā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ ca ǀ śáṃsyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the stones which press out the Somanever forsake Indra, maker of heaven, nor the praises andhymns which are to be uttered.
verses.wilson_translation: May the stones which press out the Somanever forsake Indra, maker of heaven, nor the praises andhymns which are to be uttered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स विद्वाँ अंगिरोभ्य इंद्रो गा अवृणोदप ।स्तुषे तदस्य पौंस्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ avṛṇot ǀ ápa ǀstuṣé ǀ tát ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the wise Indra, discovered the cows to the Aṅgirasas; I glorify that his might.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the wise Indra, discovered the cows to the Aṅgirasas; I glorify that his might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स प्रत्नथा कविवृध इंद्रो वाकस्य वक्षणिः ।शिवो अर्कस्य होमन्यस्मत्रा गंत्ववसे ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pratná-thā ǀ kavi-vṛdháḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vākásya ǀ vakṣáṇiḥ ǀśiváḥ ǀ arkásya ǀ hómani ǀ asma-trā́ ǀ gantu ǀ ávase ǁ
verses.english_translation: As in former times, so now too is Indrathe blesser of the worshipper and the bearer of him who praiseshim; may he come among us auspicious for our protection at the oblation of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: As in former times, so now too is Indrathe blesser of the worshipper and the bearer of him who praiseshim; may he come among us auspicious for our protection at the oblation of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदू नु ते अनु क्रतुं स्वाहा वरस्य यज्यवः ।श्वात्रमर्का अनूषतेंद्र गोत्रस्य दावने ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ ánu ǀ krátum ǀ svā́hā ǀ várasya ǀ yájyavaḥ ǀśvātrám ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ índra ǀ gotrásya ǀ dāváne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Forthwith,Indra, as they offer to Agnithe lord of Svāhā, the singers successively praise your deeds,for your attainment of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Forthwith,Indra, as they offer to Agnithe lord of Svāhā, the singers successively praise your deeds,for your attainment of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रे विश्वानि वीर्या कृतानि कर्त्वानि च ।यमर्का अध्वरं विदुः ॥
verses.transliteration: índre ǀ víśvāni ǀ vīryā́ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ kártvāni ǀ ca ǀyám ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ vidúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: In that Indra, whom the singers know as the unharming, all past and future powers abide.
verses.wilson_translation: In that Indra, whom the singers know as the unharming, all past and future powers abide.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्पांचजन्यया विशेंद्रे घोषा असृक्षत ।अस्तृणाद्बर्हणा विपोऽर्यो मानस्य स क्षयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ pā́ñca-janyayā ǀ viśā́ ǀ índre ǀ ghóṣāḥ ǀ ásṛkṣata ǀástṛṇāt ǀ barháṇā ǀ vipáḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ mā́nasya ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When praises are addressed to Indraby the men of the five classes, he destroys their enemies by hismight; he, the lord, is the abode of the worshipper's homage.
verses.wilson_translation: When praises are addressed to Indraby the men of the five classes, he destroys their enemies by hismight; he, the lord, is the abode of the worshipper's homage.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयमु ते अनुष्टुतिश्चकृषे तानि पौंस्या ।प्रावश्चक्रस्य वर्तनिं ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ ánu-stutiḥ ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ tā́ni ǀ páuṃsyā ǀprá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ cakrásya ǀ vartaním ǁ
verses.english_translation: This praise is yours, for you have achieved those exploits; you have guarded the road of ourchariot-wheel (to the sacrificial rite).
verses.wilson_translation: This praise is yours, for you have achieved those exploits; you have guarded the road of ourchariot-wheel (to the sacrificial rite).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य वृष्णो व्योदन उरु क्रमिष्ट जीवसे ।यवं न पश्व आ ददे ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ vi-ódane ǀ urú ǀ kramiṣṭa ǀ jīváse ǀyávam ǀ ná ǀ paśváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the various sustenance, given by Indra, the showerer, is obtained, all men step over with widestrides for (dear) life; they receive it as cattle and barley.
verses.wilson_translation: When the various sustenance, given by Indra, the showerer, is obtained, all men step over with widestrides for (dear) life; they receive it as cattle and barley.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तद्दधाना अवस्यवो युष्माभिर्दक्षपितरः ।स्याम मरुत्वतो वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ yuṣmā́bhiḥ ǀ dákṣa-pitaraḥ ǀsyā́ma ǀ marútvataḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Presenting our praise, and desiring protection, may we with you (O priests) be lords of food, to offersacrifice to (Indra) attended by the Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: Presenting our praise, and desiring protection, may we with you (O priests) be lords of food, to offersacrifice to (Indra) attended by the Maruts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बळृत्वियाय धाम्न ऋक्वभिः शूर नोनुमः ।जेषामेंद्र त्वया युजा ॥
verses.transliteration: báṭ ǀ ṛtvíyāya ǀ dhā́mne ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ śūra ǀ nonumaḥ ǀjéṣāma ǀ indra ǀ tváyā ǀ yujā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hero, by our hymns we offer praise to you, who appear at the time of sacrifice, and wear auspicioussplendour; with you as our ally may we conquer (our enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: Hero, by our hymns we offer praise to you, who appear at the time of sacrifice, and wear auspicioussplendour; with you as our ally may we conquer (our enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे रुद्रा मेहना पर्वतासो वृत्रहत्ये भरहूतौ सजोषाः ।यः शंसते स्तुवते धायि पज्र इंद्रज्येष्ठा अस्माँ अवंतु देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ mehánā ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ bhára-hūtau ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ śáṃsate ǀ stuvaté ǀ dhā́yi ǀ pajráḥ ǀ índra-jyeṣṭhāḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Rudras, the showering clouds, and (Indra) who rejoices with us in the battle-challenge which brings Vṛtra's destruction, and who comes in his might to the reciter and singer of his praises-- may these gods, with Indra at their head, protect us.
verses.wilson_translation: The Rudras, the showering clouds, and (Indra) who rejoices with us in the battle-challenge which brings Vṛtra's destruction, and who comes in his might to the reciter and singer of his praises-- may these gods, with Indra at their head, protect us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YOKE, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invite the Gods: As ancient Herald seat thyself. And, God, as skilfullest of all, call for us hitherward the Gods:Give all our wishes sure effect. For thou, Most Youthful, Son of Strength, thou to whom sacrifice is paid,Art holy, faithful to the Law. This Agni, Lord of wealth and spoil hundredfold, thousandfold, is headAnd chief of riches and a Sage. As craftsmen bend the felly, so bend at our general call: come nigh,Aṅgiras, to the sacrifice. Now, O Virūpa, rouse for him, Strong God who shines at early morn,Fair praise with voice that ceases not. With missile of this Agni, his who looks afar, will we lay lowThe thief in combat for the kine. Let not the Companies of Gods fail us, like Dawns that float away,Like cows who leave the niggardly. Let not the sinful tyranny of any fiercely hating foeSmite us, as billows smite a ship. O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength:With terrors trouble thou the foe. Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid in winning cattle, winning wealth?Maker of room, make room for us. In this great battle cast us not aside as one who bears a load:Snatch up the wealth and win it all. O Agni, let this plague pursue and fright another and not us:Make our impetuous strength more strong. The reverent or unwearied man whose holy labour he accepts,Him Agni favours with success. Abandoning the foeman's host pass hither to this company:Assist the men with whom I stand. As we have known thy gracious help, as of a Father, long ago,So now we pray to thee for bliss.

verses.sanskrit: उत्त्वा मंदंतु स्तोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ।अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ tvā ǀ mandantu ǀ stómāḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣvá ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀáva ǀ brahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our praises exhilarate you, thunderer, make food for us, destroy the haters of thebrāhmaṇas.
verses.wilson_translation: May our praises exhilarate you, thunderer, make food for us, destroy the haters of thebrāhmaṇas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पदा पणीँरराधसो नि बाधस्व महाँ असि ।नहि त्वा कश्चन प्रति ॥
verses.transliteration: padā́ ǀ paṇī́n ǀ arādhásaḥ ǀ ní ǀ bādhasva ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀnahí ǀ tvā ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ práti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Crush with your foot thepaṇiswho offer no oblations; you are mighty; there is none else like unto you.
verses.wilson_translation: Crush with your foot thepaṇiswho offer no oblations; you are mighty; there is none else like unto you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिंद्र त्वमसुतानां ।त्वं राजा जनानां ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ sutā́nām ǀ indra ǀ tvám ǀ ásutānām ǀtvám ǀ rā́jā ǀ jánānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, are the lord of the Somaeffused or not effused, you are the king of all men.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, are the lord of the Somaeffused or not effused, you are the king of all men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एहि प्रेहि क्षयो दिव्याघोषंचर्षणीनां ।ओभे पृणासि रोदसी ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ prá ǀ ihi ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ diví ǀ ā-ghóṣan ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ pṛṇāsi ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, here, come forth from heaven to our dwelling, shouting for the sake of men; you fill both heavenand earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, here, come forth from heaven to our dwelling, shouting for the sake of men; you fill both heavenand earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्यं चित्पर्वतं गिरिं शतवंतं सहस्रिणं ।वि स्तोतृभ्यो रुरोजिथ ॥
verses.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ párvatam ǀ girím ǀ śatá-vantam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀví ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ rurojitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you burst, for your worshippers, the gnarled cloud with its hundreds and thousands of showers
verses.wilson_translation: Do you burst, for your worshippers, the gnarled cloud with its hundreds and thousands of showers
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा दिवा सुते वयं नक्तं हवामहे ।अस्माकं काममा पृण ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ dívā ǀ suté ǀ vayám ǀ náktam ǀ havāmahe ǀasmā́kam ǀ kā́mam ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇa ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke you when the Somais effused by day, we invoke you by night; fulfil our desire.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke you when the Somais effused by day, we invoke you by night; fulfil our desire.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्व स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः ।ब्रह्मा कस्तं सपर्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: kvá ǀ syáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ tuvi-grī́vaḥ ǀ ánānataḥ ǀbrahmā́ ǀ káḥ ǀ tám ǀ saparyati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where is that ever-youthful showerer, strong-necked and bowing to none? What hymner worships you?
verses.wilson_translation: Where is that ever-youthful showerer, strong-necked and bowing to none? What hymner worships you?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कस्य स्वित्सवनं वृषा जुजुष्वाँ अव गच्छति ।इंद्रं क उ स्विदा चके ॥
verses.transliteration: kásya ǀ svit ǀ sávanam ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ jujuṣvā́n ǀ áva ǀ gacchati ǀíndram ǀ káḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svit ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǁ
verses.english_translation: To whose offering does the showerer come down plural ased? Who can praise Indra?
verses.wilson_translation: To whose offering does the showerer come down plural ased? Who can praise Indra?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कं ते दाना असक्षत वृत्रहन्कं सुवीर्या ।उक्थे क उ स्विदंतमः ॥
verses.transliteration: kám ǀ te ǀ dānā́ḥ ǀ asakṣata ǀ vṛ́tra-han ǀ kám ǀ su-vī́ryā ǀukthé ǀ káḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svit ǀ ántamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: In what character, O slayer of Vṛtra, do the sacrificial offerings honour you, or the brave praises in thehymn? Who is nearest (in time of battle)?
verses.wilson_translation: In what character, O slayer of Vṛtra, do the sacrificial offerings honour you, or the brave praises in thehymn? Who is nearest (in time of battle)?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं ते मानुषे जने सोमः पूरुषु सूयते ।तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pūrúṣu ǀ sūyate ǀtásya ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ prá ǀ drava ǀ píba ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you is this Somaeffused among men by me of mortal race; draw near, hasten, drink it.
verses.wilson_translation: For you is this Somaeffused among men by me of mortal race; draw near, hasten, drink it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं ते शर्यणावति सुषोमायामधि प्रियः ।आर्जीकीये मदिंतमः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǀ su-sómāyām ǀ ádhi ǀ priyáḥ ǀārjīkī́ye ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This is your beloved most exhilarating Somawhich grows in the Śaryaṇāvat lake by the Suṣomāriver in the Ārjikīya country.
verses.wilson_translation: This is your beloved most exhilarating Somawhich grows in the Śaryaṇāvat lake by the Suṣomāriver in the Ārjikīya country.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमद्य राधसे महे चारुं मदाय घृष्वये ।एहीमिंद्र द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ adyá ǀ rā́dhase ǀ mahé ǀ cā́rum ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǀā́ ǀ ihi ǀ īm ǀ indra ǀ dráva ǀ píba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come today,Indra, hasten, drink this grateful Somafor our great wealth, and for your own foe-crushingexultation.
verses.wilson_translation: Come today,Indra, hasten, drink this grateful Somafor our great wealth, and for your own foe-crushingexultation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . NOT to forsake me, I invoke this Indra girt by Maruts,Lord Of magic power who rules with might. This Indra with his Marut Friends clave into pieces Vṛtra's beadWith hundred-knotted thunderbolt. Indra, with Marut Friends grown strong, hath rent asunder Vṛtra, andReleased the waters of the sea. This is that Indra who, begirt by Maruts, won the light of heavenThat he might drink the Soma juice. Mighty, impetuous, begirt by Maruts, him who loudly roars,Indra we invocate with songs. Indra begirt by Maruts we invoke after the ancient plan,That he may drink the Soma juice. O liberal Indra, Marut-girt, much-lauded Śatakratu, drinkThe Soma at this sacrifice. To thee, O Indra, Marut-girt, these Soma juices, Thunderer!Are offered from the heart with lauds. Drink, Indra, with thy Marut Friends, pressed Soma at the morning rites,Whetting thy thunderbolt with strength. Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffedThe Soma which the mortar pressed. Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar,What time thou smotest Dasyus dead. From Indra have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts,Delicate, faithful. to the Law.

verses.sanskrit: यदिंद्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः ।आ याहि तूयमाशुभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ prā́k ǀ ápāk ǀ údak ǀ nyák ǀ vā ǀ hūyáse ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether you are invoked by us, the leaders of rites, from the east, the west, the norh, or the south,come here quickly with your rapid steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether you are invoked by us, the leaders of rites, from the east, the west, the norh, or the south,come here quickly with your rapid steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा प्रस्रवणे दिवो मादयासे स्वर्णरे ।यद्वा समुद्रे अंधसः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ pra-srávaṇe ǀ diváḥ ǀ mādáyāse ǀ sváḥ-nare ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ samudré ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether you rejoice in the ambrosia-fountain of heaven, or in some other heavenward-leading sacrifice(on earth), or in the ocean-like firmament of the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether you rejoice in the ambrosia-fountain of heaven, or in some other heavenward-leading sacrifice(on earth), or in the ocean-like firmament of the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा गीर्भिर्महामुरुं हुवे गामिव भोजसे ।इंद्र सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ urúm ǀ huvé ǀ gā́m-iva ǀ bhójase ǀíndra ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, by my praises I invoke you, great and strong one, to drink the Somaas a bull to eat (his fodder).
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, by my praises I invoke you, great and strong one, to drink the Somaas a bull to eat (his fodder).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त इंद्र महिमानं हरयो देव ते महः ।रथे वहंतु बिभ्रतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ deva ǀ te ǀ máhaḥ ǀráthe ǀ vahantu ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let your steeds,Indra, bearing you in your chariot, bring hither yourmight, (may they bring here) yoursplendour, O divine one.
verses.wilson_translation: Let your steeds,Indra, bearing you in your chariot, bring hither yourmight, (may they bring here) yoursplendour, O divine one.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र गृणीष उ स्तुषे महाँ उग्र ईशानकृत् ।एहि नः सुतं पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ gṛṇīṣé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuṣé ǀ mahā́n ǀ ugráḥ ǀ īśāna-kṛ́t ǀā́ ǀ ihi ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ píba ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, you are invoked, you are praised, the great, the strong, the wilder of sovereignty; come here anddrink our libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, you are invoked, you are praised, the great, the strong, the wilder of sovereignty; come here anddrink our libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुतावंतस्त्वा वयं प्रयस्वंतो हवामहे ।इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.transliteration: sutá-vantaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀidám ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bearing the effused Somaand the sacrificial food, we invoke you,Indra, to sit on our sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearing the effused Somaand the sacrificial food, we invoke you,Indra, to sit on our sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसींद्र साधारणस्त्वं ।तं त्वा वयं हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatām ǀ ási ǀ índra ǀ sā́dhāraṇaḥ ǀ tvám ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Because you are common to many worshippers, therefore,Indra, we invoke you.
verses.wilson_translation: Because you are common to many worshippers, therefore,Indra, we invoke you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इदं ते सोम्यं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः ।जुषाण इंद्र तत्पिब ॥
verses.transliteration: idám ǀ te ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀ ádhukṣan ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀjuṣāṇáḥ ǀ indra ǀ tát ǀ piba ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests have milked for you with their stones this nectar of the Soma; drink it,Indra, well plural ased.
verses.wilson_translation: The priests have milked for you with their stones this nectar of the Soma; drink it,Indra, well plural ased.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वाँ अर्यो विपश्चितोऽति ख्यस्तूयमा गहि ।अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvān ǀ aryáḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ áti ǀ khyaḥ ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀasmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, the lord, pass by all other worshippers and come quickly to us, and bestow on us abundantfood.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, the lord, pass by all other worshippers and come quickly to us, and bestow on us abundantfood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दाता मे पृषतीनां राजा हिरण्यवीनां ।मा देवा मघवा रिषत् ॥
verses.transliteration: dātā́ ǀ me ǀ pṛ́ṣatīnām ǀ rā́jā ǀ hiraṇya-vī́nām ǀmā́ ǀ devāḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ riṣat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (Indra) the king give me cows adorned with gold; O gods, let not Maghavanbe harmed.
verses.wilson_translation: May (Indra) the king give me cows adorned with gold; O gods, let not Maghavanbe harmed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रे पृषतीनामधि श्चंद्रं बृहत्पृथु ।शुक्रं हिरण्यमा ददे ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásre ǀ pṛ́ṣatīnām ǀ ádhi ǀ candrám ǀ bṛhát ǀ pṛthú ǀśukrám ǀ híraṇyam ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
verses.english_translation: Upon a thousand cows I obtain gold, abundant, delightful, wide-spread, and pure.
verses.wilson_translation: Upon a thousand cows I obtain gold, abundant, delightful, wide-spread, and pure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नपातो दुर्गहस्य मे सहस्रेण सुराधसः ।श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत ॥
verses.transliteration: nápātaḥ ǀ duḥ-gáhasya ǀ me ǀ sahásreṇa ǀ su-rā́dhasaḥ ǀśrávaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ akrata ǁ
verses.english_translation: plural nged as I am in sorrow, my children, by the favour of the gods, obtain food, and are blessed withabundance in a thousand cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: plural nged as I am in sorrow, my children, by the favour of the gods, obtain food, and are blessed withabundance in a thousand cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVI. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SCARCELY was Śatakratu, born when of his Mother he inquired,Who are the mighty? Who are famed?. Then Śavasī declared to him Aurṇavābha, Ahīśuva:Son, these be they thou must o’erthrow The Vṛtra-slayer smote them all as spokes are hammered into naves:The Dasyu-killer waxed in might. Then Indra at a single draught drank the contents of thirty pails,Pails that were filled with Soma juice. Indra in groundless realms of space pierced the Gandharva through, that heMight make Brahmans' strength increase. Down from the mountains Indra shot hither his well-directed shaft:He gained the ready brew of rice. One only is that shaft of thine, with thousand feathers, hundred barbs,Which, Indra, thou hast made thy friend. Strong as the Ṛbhus at thy birth, therewith to those who praise thee, men,And women, bring thou food to eat. By thee these exploits were achieved, the mightiest deeds, abundantly:Firm in thy heart thou settest them. All these things Viṣṇu brought, the Lord of ample stride whom thou hadst sent-A hundred buffaloes, a brew of rice and milk: and Indra, slew the ravening boar Most deadly is thy bow, successful, fashioned well: good is thine arrow, decked with gold.Warlike and well equipped thine arms are, which increase sweetness for him who drinks the sweet.

verses.sanskrit: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिंद्रं सबाध ऊतये ।बृहद्गायंतः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: táraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vidát-vasum ǀ índram ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀbṛhát ǀ gā́yantaḥ ǀ sutá-some ǀ adhvaré ǀ huvé ǀ bháram ǀ ná ǀ kāríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thronging together, (worship) for your protection Indrafull of might and the revealer of wealth; (worshiphim), chanting the Bṛhat-sāmanat his sacrifice where the Somais effused, I invoke him as (men invoke) abeneficent master of a household.
verses.wilson_translation: Thronging together, (worship) for your protection Indrafull of might and the revealer of wealth; (worshiphim), chanting the Bṛhat-sāmanat his sacrifice where the Somais effused, I invoke him as (men invoke) abeneficent master of a household.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न यं दुध्रा वरंते न स्थिरा मुरो मदे सुशिप्रमंधसः ।य आदृत्या शशमानाय सुन्वते दाता जरित्र उक्थ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ dudhrā́ḥ ǀ várante ǀ ná ǀ sthirā́ḥ ǀ múraḥ ǀ máde ǀ su-śiprám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ā-dṛ́tya ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ sunvaté ǀ dā́tā ǀ jaritré ǀ ukthyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the handsome-jawed, whom, inthe intoxication of the Soma, the fierce (demons) withstand not, north firm gods, nor mortal (men)-- who confers glorious wealth on him who reverently praises him, offers the Somaand sings hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the handsome-jawed, whom, inthe intoxication of the Soma, the fierce (demons) withstand not, north firm gods, nor mortal (men)-- who confers glorious wealth on him who reverently praises him, offers the Somaand sings hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः शक्रो मृक्षो अश्व्यो यो वा कीजो हिरण्ययः ।स ऊर्वस्य रेजयत्यपावृतिमिंद्रो गव्यस्य वृत्रहा ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śakráḥ ǀ mṛkṣáḥ ǀ áśvyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ kī́jaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ ūrvásya ǀ rejayati ǀ ápa-vṛtim ǀ índraḥ ǀ gávyasya ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: HeŚakra, who is the purifier (of his worshippers), and well-skilled in horses, who is wonderful andgolden-bodied-- he,Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, shakes the hiding-plural ce of the numerous herd of kine.
verses.wilson_translation: HeŚakra, who is the purifier (of his worshippers), and well-skilled in horses, who is wonderful andgolden-bodied-- he,Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, shakes the hiding-plural ce of the numerous herd of kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निखातं चिद्यः पुरुसंभृतं वसूदिद्वपति दाशुषे ।वज्री सुशिप्रो हर्यश्व इत्करदिंद्रः क्रत्वा यथा वशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ní-khātam ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ puru-sambhṛtám ǀ vásu ǀ út ǀ ít ǀ vápati ǀ dāśúṣe ǀvajrī́ ǀ su-śipráḥ ǀ hári-aśvaḥ ǀ ít ǀ karat ǀ índraḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ yáthā ǀ váśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who verily pours forth to the offerer the buried wealth accusative ulated by many, he,Indra, thethunderer, handsome-jawed, borne on bay steeds, does as he plural ases, (when propitiated) with sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: He who verily pours forth to the offerer the buried wealth accusative ulated by many, he,Indra, thethunderer, handsome-jawed, borne on bay steeds, does as he plural ases, (when propitiated) with sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वावंथ पुरुष्टुत पुरा चिच्छूर नृणां ।वयं तत्त इंद्र सं भरामसि यज्ञमुक्थं तुरं वचः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vavántha ǀ puru-stuta ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀ śūra ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀvayám ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sám ǀ bharāmasi ǀ yajñám ǀ ukthám ǀ turám ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hero, praised of many, what of old time you did desire from your votaries, that,Indra, we hasten to bringto you-- oblation and recited praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Hero, praised of many, what of old time you did desire from your votaries, that,Indra, we hasten to bringto you-- oblation and recited praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सचा सोमेषु पुरुहूत वज्रिवो मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः ।त्वमिद्धि ब्रह्मकृते काम्यं वसु देष्ठः सुन्वते भुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sácā ǀ sómeṣu ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ dyukṣa ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀtvám ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ brahma-kṛ́te ǀ kā́myam ǀ vásu ǀ déṣṭhaḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ bhúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bearer of the thunderbolt, invoked of many, radiant, drinker of the Soma, be present at our libations foryour exhilaration; for you are an abundant giver of desirable wealth to him who utters your praises and effusesthe Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearer of the thunderbolt, invoked of many, radiant, drinker of the Soma, be present at our libations foryour exhilaration; for you are an abundant giver of desirable wealth to him who utters your praises and effusesthe Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयमेनमिदा ह्योऽपीपेमेह वज्रिणं ।तस्मा उ अद्य समना सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ enam ǀ idā́ ǀ hyáḥ ǀ ápīpema ǀ ihá ǀ vajríṇam ǀtásmai ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ adyá ǀ samanā́ ǀ sutám ǀ bhara ǀ ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ bhūṣata ǀ śruté ǁ
verses.english_translation: Today and yesterday we have here refreshed him, the thunderer; bring to him today our libation effusedfor (success in) battle; let him now hasten here on hearing our praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Today and yesterday we have here refreshed him, the thunderer; bring to him today our libation effusedfor (success in) battle; let him now hasten here on hearing our praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति ।सेमं नः स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहींद्र प्र चित्रया धिया ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́kaḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ vāraṇáḥ ǀ urā-máthiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vayúneṣu ǀ bhūṣati ǀsáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ índra ǀ prá ǀ citráyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The obstructing robber, the destroyer of travelling enemies, is obedient to him in hiw ways; hasten,Indra, (drawn) by our gorgeous rite, welcoming this our hymn.
verses.wilson_translation: The obstructing robber, the destroyer of travelling enemies, is obedient to him in hiw ways; hasten,Indra, (drawn) by our gorgeous rite, welcoming this our hymn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कदू न्वस्याकृतमिंद्रस्यास्ति पौंस्यं ।केनो नु कं श्रोमतेन न शुश्रुवे जनुषः परि वृत्रहा ॥
verses.transliteration: kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ ákṛtam ǀ índrasya ǀ asti ǀ páuṃsyam ǀkéno íti ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ śrómatena ǀ ná ǀ śuśruve ǀ janúṣaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: What act of might is there, unperformed by Indra? Who has not heard of his famous (heroism)? He, theslayer of Vṛtra, (is renowned) from his birth.
verses.wilson_translation: What act of might is there, unperformed by Indra? Who has not heard of his famous (heroism)? He, theslayer of Vṛtra, (is renowned) from his birth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कदू महीरधृष्टा अस्य तविषीः कदु वृत्रघ्नो अस्तृतं ।इंद्रो विश्वान्बेकनाटाँ अहर्दृश उत क्रत्वा पणीँरभि ॥
verses.transliteration: kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǀ asya ǀ táviṣīḥ ǀ kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vṛtra-ghnáḥ ǀ ástṛtam ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ beka-nā́ṭān ǀ ahaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ utá ǀ krátvā ǀ paṇī́n ǀ abhí ǁ
verses.english_translation: When were his mighty forces ever languid? When was aught undestroyed before the slayer of Vṛtra?Indraby his energy overpowers all the huckstering usurers who see only this world's days.
verses.wilson_translation: When were his mighty forces ever languid? When was aught undestroyed before the slayer of Vṛtra?Indraby his energy overpowers all the huckstering usurers who see only this world's days.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं घा ते अपूर्व्येंद्र ब्रह्माणि वृत्रहन् ।पुरूतमासः पुरुहूत वज्रिवो भृतिं न प्र भरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ ápūrvyā ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vṛtra-han ǀpuru-támāsaḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀ bhṛtím ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ bharāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, slayer of Vṛra, invoked of many, we, your many worshippers, offer new hymns to you, thunderer,as your wages.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, slayer of Vṛra, invoked of many, we, your many worshippers, offer new hymns to you, thunderer,as your wages.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वीश्चिद्धि त्वे तुविकूर्मिन्नाशसो हवंत इंद्रोतयः ।तिरश्चिदर्यः सवना वसो गहि शविष्ठ श्रुधि मे हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvī́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvé íti ǀ tuvi-kūrmin ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǀ hávante ǀ indra ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ aryáḥ ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ gahi ǀ śáviṣṭha ǀ śrudhí ǀ me ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, doer of many great deeds, (other worshippers) invoke the manifold hopes and protections whichabide in you; but rejecting the enemy's oblations, come to us bestower of dwellings; O mightiest, hear my appeal.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, doer of many great deeds, (other worshippers) invoke the manifold hopes and protections whichabide in you; but rejecting the enemy's oblations, come to us bestower of dwellings; O mightiest, hear my appeal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं घा ते त्वे इद्विंद्र विप्रा अपि ष्मसि ।नहि त्वदन्यः पुरुहूत कश्चन मघवन्नस्ति मर्डिता ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ tvé íti ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ índra ǀ víprāḥ ǀ ápi ǀ smasi ǀnahí ǀ tvát ǀ anyáḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ mágha-van ǀ ásti ǀ marḍitā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, we are your, therefore we, your worshippers, depend on you; other than you,Maghavan, invokedof many, there is no giver of happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, we are your, therefore we, your worshippers, depend on you; other than you,Maghavan, invokedof many, there is no giver of happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अस्या अमतेरुत क्षुधोऽभिशस्तेरव स्पृधि ।त्वं न ऊती तव चित्रया धिया शिक्षा शचिष्ठ गातुवित् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ ámateḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣudháḥ ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ áva ǀ spṛdhi ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ táva ǀ citráyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ śíkṣa ǀ śaciṣṭha ǀ gātu-vít ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deliver from us this poverty, hunger and calumny; give us (our desire) by your protection and wondrousworking; O mightiest, you know the right way.
verses.wilson_translation: Deliver from us this poverty, hunger and calumny; give us (our desire) by your protection and wondrousworking; O mightiest, you know the right way.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोम इद्वः सुतो अस्तु कलयो मा बिभीतन ।अपेदेष ध्वस्मायति स्वयं घैषो अपायति ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ ít ǀ vaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ astu ǀ kálayaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ bibhītana ǀápa ǀ ít ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ dhvasmā́ ǀ ayati ǀ svayám ǀ gha ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ayati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let your effused Somabe only (for Indra); O sons of Kali, fear not; that malignant (spirit) departs, of hisown accord he departs.
verses.wilson_translation: Let your effused Somabe only (for Indra); O sons of Kali, fear not; that malignant (spirit) departs, of hisown accord he departs.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १५ कलि: प्रागाथ: । इन्द्र: । प्रगाथ:= ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ), १५ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . BRING us a thousand, Indra, as our guerdon for the Soma juice:Hundreds of kine, O Hero, bring. Bring cattle, bring us ornament, bring us embellishment and steeds,Give us, besides, two rings of gold. And, Bold One, bring in ample store rich jewels to adorn the ear,For thou, Good Lord, art far renowned. None other is there for the priest, Hero! but thou, to give him gifts,To win much spoil and prosper him. Indra can never be brought low, Śakra can never be subdued:He heareth and beholdeth all. He spieth out the wrath of man, he who can never be deceived:Ere blame can come he marketh it. He hath his stomach full of might, the Vṛtra-slayer, Conqueror,The Soma-drinker, ordering all. In thee all treasures are combined, Soma all blessed things in thee,Uninjured, easy to bestow. To thee speeds forth my hope that craves the gift of corn, and kine and gold,Yea, craving horses, speeds to thee. Indra, through hope in thee alone even this sickle do I grasp.Fill my hand, Maghavan, with all that it can hold of barley cut or gathered up.

verses.sanskrit: त्यान्नु क्षत्रियाँ अव आदित्यान्याचिषामहे ।सुमृळीकाँ अभिष्टये ॥
verses.transliteration: tyā́n ǀ nú ǀ kṣatríyān ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ādityā́n ǀ yāciṣāmahe ǀsu-mṛḷīkā́n ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit for protection thosekṣatriyas, theĀdityaswho bless (their votaries) abundantly to theattainment of their desires.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit for protection thosekṣatriyas, theĀdityaswho bless (their votaries) abundantly to theattainment of their desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मित्रो नो अत्यंहतिं वरुणः पर्षदर्यमा ।आदित्यासो यथा विदुः ॥
verses.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áti ǀ aṃhatím ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ parṣat ǀ aryamā́ ǀādityā́saḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vidúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May theĀdityas,Mitra,Varuṇa, and Aryaman, bear us across our distress, as they know it well.
verses.wilson_translation: May theĀdityas,Mitra,Varuṇa, and Aryaman, bear us across our distress, as they know it well.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तेषां हि चित्रमुक्थ्यं वरूथमस्ति दाशुषे ।आदित्यानामरंकृते ॥
verses.transliteration: téṣām ǀ hí ǀ citrám ǀ ukthyám ǀ várūtham ǀ ásti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀādityā́nām ǀ aram-kṛ́te ǁ
verses.english_translation: To thoseĀdityasbelongs wonderful wealth, worthy of all praise, (laid up) for the offerer of oblationsand the sacrificer.
verses.wilson_translation: To thoseĀdityasbelongs wonderful wealth, worthy of all praise, (laid up) for the offerer of oblationsand the sacrificer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्रार्यमन् ।अवांस्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: máhi ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahatā́m ǀ ávaḥ ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀávāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are great,Varuṇa,Mitraand Aryaman, and great is your protection; your protections we implore.
verses.wilson_translation: You are great,Varuṇa,Mitraand Aryaman, and great is your protection; your protections we implore.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जीवान्नो अभि धेतनादित्यासः पुरा हथात् ।कद्ध स्थ हवनश्रुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: jīvā́n ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dhetana ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ háthāt ǀkát ǀ ha ǀ stha ǀ havana-śrutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ādityas, hasten to us before our death, while we are yet alive; where are you, hearers of prayer?
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityas, hasten to us before our death, while we are yet alive; where are you, hearers of prayer?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वः श्रांताय सुन्वते वरूथमस्ति यच्छर्दिः ।तेना नो अधि वोचत ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ śrāntā́ya ǀ sunvaté ǀ várūtham ǀ ásti ǀ yát ǀ chardíḥ ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever wealh, whatever dwelling is yours (to give) to the wearied offerer of libations-- with thesespeak to us a kindly answer.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever wealh, whatever dwelling is yours (to give) to the wearied offerer of libations-- with thesespeak to us a kindly answer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति देवा अंहोरुर्वस्ति रत्नमनागसः ।आदित्या अद्भुतैनसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásti ǀ devāḥ ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ urú ǀ ásti ǀ rátnam ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀā́dityāḥ ǀ ádbhuta-enasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Great, O deities, is (the guild) of the sinner, but to the sinless is happiness;Ādityas, you are void ofsin.
verses.wilson_translation: Great, O deities, is (the guild) of the sinner, but to the sinless is happiness;Ādityas, you are void ofsin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)
