verses.sanskrit: मा नः सेतुः सिषेदयं महे वृणक्तु नस्परि ।इंद्र इद्धि श्रुतो वशी ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sétuḥ ǀ siset ǀ ayám ǀ mahé ǀ vṛṇaktu ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀíndraḥ ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ vaśī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not the snare bind us; may Indra, the renowned, the subduer of all, deliver us for a glorious act.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not the snare bind us; may Indra, the renowned, the subduer of all, deliver us for a glorious act.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो मृचा रिपूणां वृजिनानामविष्यवः ।देवा अभि प्र मृक्षत ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛcā́ ǀ ripūṇā́m ǀ vṛjinā́nām ǀ aviṣyavaḥ ǀdévāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ mṛkṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: O deities, ready to protect, move us not with the destructive net of our wicked enemieṣ
verses.wilson_translation: O deities, ready to protect, move us not with the destructive net of our wicked enemieṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्वामदिते मह्यहं देव्युप ब्रुवे ।सुमृळीकामभिष्टये ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā́m ǀ adite ǀ mahi ǀ ahám ǀ devi ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀsu-mṛḷīkā́m ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I address you, who give abundant delight, the great goddess,Aditi, for the attainment of my desire.
verses.wilson_translation: I address you, who give abundant delight, the great goddess,Aditi, for the attainment of my desire.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पर्षि दीने गभीर आँ उग्रपुत्रे जिघांसतः ।माकिस्तोकस्य नो रिषत् ॥
verses.transliteration: párṣi ǀ dīné ǀ gabhīré ǀ ā́ ǀ úgra-putre ǀ jíghāṃsataḥ ǀmā́kiḥ ǀ tokásya ǀ naḥ ǀ riṣat ǁ
verses.english_translation: You protect on every side; let not (the net) of the destroyer hurt our children, in this shallow water full ofmighhty offspring.
verses.wilson_translation: You protect on every side; let not (the net) of the destroyer hurt our children, in this shallow water full ofmighhty offspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनेहो न उरुव्रज उरूचि वि प्रसर्तवे ।कृधि तोकाय जीवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: aneháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uru-vraje ǀ úrūci ǀ ví ǀ prá-sartave ǀkṛdhí ǀ tokā́ya ǀ jīváse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wide-traversing, far-reaching goddess, put forth your power to come to us, innocent ones, that ourchildren may live.
verses.wilson_translation: Wide-traversing, far-reaching goddess, put forth your power to come to us, innocent ones, that ourchildren may live.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये मूर्धानः क्षितीनामदब्धासः स्वयशसः ।व्रता रक्षंते अद्रुहः ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ mūrdhā́naḥ ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ ádabdhāsaḥ ǀ svá-yaśasaḥ ǀvratā́ ǀ rákṣante ǀ adrúhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who are the heads of men, unharming, and of self-sustained glory, who, benevolent ones, protectour rites.
verses.wilson_translation: You who are the heads of men, unharming, and of self-sustained glory, who, benevolent ones, protectour rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते न आस्नो वृकाणामादित्यासो मुमोचत ।स्तेनं बद्धमिवादिते ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ āsnáḥ ǀ vṛ́kāṇām ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ mumócata ǀstenám ǀ baddhám-iva ǀ adite ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ādityas, deliver us from the jaws of the destroyers like a bound thief; OAditi, (deliver us).
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityas, deliver us from the jaws of the destroyers like a bound thief; OAditi, (deliver us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपो षु ण इयं शरुरादित्या अप दुर्मतिः ।अस्मदेत्वजघ्नुषी ॥
verses.transliteration: ápo íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ iyám ǀ śáruḥ ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ duḥ-matíḥ ǀasmát ǀ etu ǀ ájaghnuṣī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ādityas, let this net, let the malevolent design turn away from us innocuous.
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityas, let this net, let the malevolent design turn away from us innocuous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शश्वद्धि वः सुदानव आदित्या ऊतिभिर्वयं ।पुरा नूनं बुभुज्महे ॥
verses.transliteration: śáśvat ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ vayám ǀpurā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ bubhujmáhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: BounteousĀdityas, by your protections we have continually possessed enjoyments from of old.
verses.wilson_translation: BounteousĀdityas, by your protections we have continually possessed enjoyments from of old.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शश्वंतं हि प्रचेतसः प्रतियंतं चिदेनसः ।देवाः कृणुथ जीवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: śáśvantam ǀ hí ǀ pra-cetasaḥ ǀ prati-yántam ǀ cit ǀ énasaḥ ǀdévāḥ ǀ kṛṇuthá ǀ jīváse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise deities, keep away from us, that we may live, the many doers of sin who come against us.
verses.wilson_translation: Wise deities, keep away from us, that we may live, the many doers of sin who come against us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्सु नो नव्यं सन्यस आदित्या यन्मुमोचति ।बंधाद्बद्धमिवादिते ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ návyam ǀ sányase ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ yát ǀ múmocati ǀbandhā́t ǀ baddhám-iva ǀ adite ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ādityasand Aditi, let that which releases us as a prisoner from his bond, be ever the object of ourpraise and worship.
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityasand Aditi, let that which releases us as a prisoner from his bond, be ever the object of ourpraise and worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नास्माकमस्ति तत्तर आदित्यासो अतिष्कदे ।यूयमस्मभ्यं मृळत ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ asmā́kam ǀ asti ǀ tát ǀ táraḥ ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ ati-skáde ǀyūyám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ mṛḷata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Not to us is there strength enough to burst from this (net); OĀdityas, do you grant us your favour.
verses.wilson_translation: Not to us is there strength enough to burst from this (net); OĀdityas, do you grant us your favour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो हेतिर्विवस्वत आदित्याः कृत्रिमा शरुः ।पुरा नु जरसो वधीत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ hetíḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ kṛtrímā ǀ śáruḥ ǀpurā́ ǀ nú ǀ jarásaḥ ǀ vadhīt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not this weapon of Vivasvat, this net made withhands,Ādityas, destroy us before old age.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not this weapon of Vivasvat, this net made withhands,Ādityas, destroy us before old age.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि षु द्वेषो व्यंहतिमादित्यासो वि संहितं ।विष्वग्वि वृहता रपः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ sú ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ aṃhatím ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ ví ǀ sám-hitam ǀvíṣvak ǀ ví ǀ vṛhata ǀ rápaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ādityas, utterly destroy our enemies, destroy wickedness, destroy the closely drawn net, destroy evileverywhere.
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityas, utterly destroy our enemies, destroy wickedness, destroy the closely drawn net, destroy evileverywhere.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVIII. Soma.
hymns.anukramani: १९ प्रियमेध आङ्गिरस: । इन्द्र:; १४-१९ ऋक्षाश्वमेधौ । गायत्री , अनुष्टुम्मुख: प्रगाथ:= ( अनुष्टुप् + गायत्र्यौ ) १,४,७,१० अनुष्टुप् , १६ शंकुमती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS here is Soma, ne’er restrained, active, all-conquering bursting forth,Ṛṣi and Sage by sapience, All that is bare he covers o’er, all that is sick he medicines;The blind man sees, the cripple walks. Thou, Soma, givest wide defence against the hate of alien men,Hatreds that waste and weaken us. Thou by thine insight and thy skill, Impetuous One, from heaven and earthDrivest the sinner's enmity. When to their task they come with zeal, may they obtain the Giver's grace,And satisfy his wish who thirsts. So may he find what erst was lost, so may be speed the pious man,And lengthen his remaining life. Gracious, displaying tender love, unconquered, gentle in thy thoughts,Be sweet, O Soma, to our heart. O Soma, terrify us not; strike us not with alarm, O King:Wound not our heart with dazzling flame. When in my dwelling-place I see the wicked enemies of Gods,King, chase their hatred far away, thou Bounteous One, dispel our foes.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि ।तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिंद्र शविष्ठ सत्पते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ rátham ǀ yáthā ǀ ūtáye ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ vartayāmasi ǀtuvi-kūrmím ǀ ṛti-sáham ǀ índra ǀ śáviṣṭha ǀ sát-pate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most powerful Indra, protector of the good, we brin you here, rich in achievement and subduer ofenemies, as a car for our protection and weal.
verses.wilson_translation: Most powerful Indra, protector of the good, we brin you here, rich in achievement and subduer ofenemies, as a car for our protection and weal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुविशुष्म तुविक्रतो शचीवो विश्वया मते ।आ पप्राथ महित्वना ॥
verses.transliteration: túvi-śuṣma ǀ túvikrato íti túvi-krato ǀ śácī-vaḥ ǀ víśvayā ǀ mate ǀā́ ǀ paprātha ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Great in power, rich in deeds, might one, adorable, you have filled (all things) with your universalmajesy.
verses.wilson_translation: Great in power, rich in deeds, might one, adorable, you have filled (all things) with your universalmajesy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते महिना महः परि ज्मायंतमीयतुः ।हस्ता वज्रं हिरण्ययं ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ mahinā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ pári ǀ jmāyántam ǀ īyátuḥ ǀhástā ǀ vájram ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: You mighty one, whosehandsin your might grasp the all-pervading golden thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: You mighty one, whosehandsin your might grasp the all-pervading golden thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानरस्य वस्पतिमनानतस्य शवसः ।एवैश्च चर्षणीनामूती हुवे रथानां ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvā́narasya ǀ vaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ ánānatasya ǀ śávasaḥ ǀévaiḥ ǀ ca ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ ūtī́ ǀ huve ǀ ráthānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke (Indra) the lord of that might which subdues allenemiesand bow to none-- (I invoke him)followed by your onsets as hissoldiersand (surrounded) by the protection of yourchariots(OMaruts).
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke (Indra) the lord of that might which subdues allenemiesand bow to none-- (I invoke him)followed by your onsets as hissoldiersand (surrounded) by the protection of yourchariots(OMaruts).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभिष्टये सदावृधं स्वर्मीळ्हेषु यं नरः ।नाना हवंत ऊतये ॥
verses.transliteration: abhíṣṭaye ǀ sadā́-vṛdham ǀ sváḥ-mīḷheṣu ǀ yám ǀ náraḥ ǀnā́nā ǀ hávante ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I invoke him) to come to our help, whose might ever waxes more and more-- to whom men appeal foraid in various ways in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: (I invoke him) to come to our help, whose might ever waxes more and more-- to whom men appeal foraid in various ways in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परोमात्रमृचीषममिंद्रमुग्रं सुराधसं ।ईशानं चिद्वसूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: paráḥ-mātram ǀ ṛ́cīṣamam ǀ índram ǀ ugrám ǀ su-rā́dhasam ǀī́śānam ǀ cit ǀ vásūnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I invoke)Indra, the unlimited, worthy of praise, the mighty, possessing excellent wealth, the lord oftreasures (for his votaries).
verses.wilson_translation: (I invoke)Indra, the unlimited, worthy of praise, the mighty, possessing excellent wealth, the lord oftreasures (for his votaries).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तंतमिद्राधसे मह इंद्रं चोदामि पीतये ।यः पूर्व्यामनुष्टुतिमीशे कृष्टीनां नृतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám-tam ǀ ít ǀ rā́dhase ǀ mahé ǀ índram ǀ codāmi ǀ pītáye ǀyáḥ ǀ pūrvyā́m ǀ ánu-stutim ǀ ī́śe ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ nṛtúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him, to him,Indra, do I direct my praise, that he may quaff the Somato my great gain-- to him, thebringer of success, who rules over the praises of the offerers at the opening of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: To him, to him,Indra, do I direct my praise, that he may quaff the Somato my great gain-- to him, thebringer of success, who rules over the praises of the offerers at the opening of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य ते शवसान सख्यमानंश मर्त्यः ।नकिः शवांसि ते नशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ śavasāna ǀ sakhyám ǀ ānáṃśa ǀ mártyaḥ ǀnákiḥ ǀ śávāṃsi ǀ te ǀ naśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: You mighty one, whose friendship no mortal reaches, whose might no one attains.
verses.wilson_translation: You mighty one, whose friendship no mortal reaches, whose might no one attains.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वोतासस्त्वा युजाप्सु सूर्ये महद्धनं ।जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ tvā́ ǀ yujā́ ǀ ap-sú ǀ sū́rye ǀ mahát ǀ dhánam ǀjáyema ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protected by you, O thunderer, with you as our ally, may we win great wealth in battles, that we maybathe in the water and behold he sun.
verses.wilson_translation: Protected by you, O thunderer, with you as our ally, may we win great wealth in battles, that we maybathe in the water and behold he sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा यज्ञेभिरीमहे तं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणस्तम ।इंद्र यथा चिदाविथ वाजेषु पुरुमाय्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ tám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ girvaṇaḥ-tama ǀíndra ǀ yáthā ǀ cit ǀ ā́vitha ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ puru-mā́yyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We address you with sacrificial gifts, (we address you) with songs, OIndramost worthy of song, as youhave protected me, the offerer of many praises, in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: We address you with sacrificial gifts, (we address you) with songs, OIndramost worthy of song, as youhave protected me, the offerer of many praises, in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते स्वादु सख्यं स्वाद्वी प्रणीतिरद्रिवः ।यज्ञो वितंतसाय्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ svādú ǀ sakhyám ǀ svādvī́ ǀ prá-nītiḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀyajñáḥ ǀ vitantasā́yyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, the thunderer, whose friendship is sweet, sweet too is your liberality, and your sacrificepre-eminently to be performed.
verses.wilson_translation: You, the thunderer, whose friendship is sweet, sweet too is your liberality, and your sacrificepre-eminently to be performed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरु णस्तन्वे तन उरु क्षयाय नस्कृधि ।उरु णो यंधि जीवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: urú ǀ naḥ ǀ tanvé ǀ táne ǀ urú ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀurú ǀ naḥ ǀ yandhi ǀ jīváse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give ample (wealth) to our own selves, give ample (wealth) to our children, give ample (wealth) to ourdwelling, gran us (our desire) that we may live.
verses.wilson_translation: Give ample (wealth) to our own selves, give ample (wealth) to our children, give ample (wealth) to ourdwelling, gran us (our desire) that we may live.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरुं नृभ्य उरुं गव उरुं रथाय पंथां ।देववीतिं मनामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: urúm ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ urúm ǀ gáve ǀ urúm ǀ ráthāya ǀ pánthām ǀdevá-vītim ǀ manāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit a spacious (road) for our servants, a spacious (road) for our cattle, a spacious road for ourchariot, and (an abundant) sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit a spacious (road) for our servants, a spacious (road) for our cattle, a spacious road for ourchariot, and (an abundant) sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप मा षड्द्वाद्वा नरः सोमस्य हर्ष्या ।तिष्ठंति स्वादुरातयः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ mā ǀ ṣáṭ ǀ dvā́-dvā ǀ náraḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ hárṣyā ǀtíṣṭhanti ǀ svādu-rātáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Six princes come to me in pairs, bearing plural asant gifts, in the exhilaration of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Six princes come to me in pairs, bearing plural asant gifts, in the exhilaration of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋज्राविंद्रोत आ ददे हरी ऋक्षस्य सूनवि ।आश्वमेधस्य रोहिता ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛjráu ǀ indroté ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀ hárī íti ǀ ṛ́kṣasya ǀ sūnávi ǀāśva-medhásya ǀ róhitā ǁ
verses.english_translation: I receive two straight-going steeds from Indrota, two from the son ofṚkṣa, two from the son of Aśvamedha.
verses.wilson_translation: I receive two straight-going steeds from Indrota, two from the son ofṚkṣa, two from the son of Aśvamedha.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुरथाँ आतिथिग्वे स्वभीशूँरार्क्षे ।आश्वमेधे सुपेशसः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-ráthān ǀ ātithi-gvé ǀ su-abhīśū́n ǀ ārkṣé ǀāśva-medhé ǀ su-péśasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I receive) two steeds with excellent chariots from the son of Atithigva, two with excellent reins from theson ofṚkṣa, two with excellent ornaments from the son of Aśvamedha.
verses.wilson_translation: (I receive) two steeds with excellent chariots from the son of Atithigva, two with excellent reins from theson ofṚkṣa, two with excellent ornaments from the son of Aśvamedha.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: षळश्वाँ आतिथिग्व इंद्रोते वधूमतः ।सचा पूतक्रतौ सनं ॥
verses.transliteration: ṣáṭ ǀ áśvān ǀ ātithi-gvé ǀ indroté ǀ vadhū́-mataḥ ǀsácā ǀ pūtá-kratau ǀ sanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I have received together (with my other gifts) six horses with their mares from te pious Indrota, the sonof Atithigva.
verses.wilson_translation: I have received together (with my other gifts) six horses with their mares from te pious Indrota, the sonof Atithigva.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऐषु चेतद्वृषण्वत्यंतर्ऋज्रेष्वरुषी ।स्वभीशुः कशावती ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ cetat ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇ-vatī ǀ antáḥ ǀ ṛjréṣu ǀ áruṣī ǀsu-abhīśúḥ ǀ káśā-vatī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Among these straight-going steeds is numbered a mature mare with excellent reins and whip.
verses.wilson_translation: Among these straight-going steeds is numbered a mature mare with excellent reins and whip.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न युष्मे वाजबंधवो निनित्सुश्चन मर्त्यः ।अवद्यमधि दीधरत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yuṣmé íti ǀ vāja-bandhavaḥ ǀ ninitsúḥ ǀ caná ǀ mártyaḥ ǀavadyám ǀ ádhi ǀ dīdharat ǁ
verses.english_translation: O princes, givers of food, even the lover of calumny has thrown no censure on you.
verses.wilson_translation: O princes, givers of food, even the lover of calumny has thrown no censure on you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIX. Indra
hymns.anukramani: १८ प्रियमेध आङ्गिरस: । इन्द्र:, ११ ( अर्धर्चस्य ) विश्वे  देवा :, ११
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O Sarakratu! truely I have made none else my Comforter.Indra; be gracious unto us. Thou who hast ever aided us kindly of old to win the spoil,As such, O Indra, favour us. What now? As prompter of the poor thou helpest him who sheds the juice.Wilt thou not, Indra, strengthen us? O Indra, help our chariot on, yea, Thunderer, though it lag behind:Give this my car the foremost place. Ho there! why sittest thou at case? Make thou my chariot to be firstAnd bring the fame of victory near. Assist our car that seeks the prize. What can be easier for thee?So make thou us victorious. Indra, be firm: a fort art thou. To thine appointed place proceedsThe auspicious hymn in season due. Let not our portion be disgrace. Broad is the course, the prize is set,The barriers are opened wide. This thing we wish. that thou mayst take thy fourth, thy sacrificial name.So art thou held to be our Lord. Ekadyu hath exalted you, Immortals: both Goddesses and Gods hath he delighted.Bestow upon him bounty meet for praises. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sanskrit: प्रप्र वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मंदद्वीरायेंदवे ।धिया वो मेधसातये पुरंध्या विवासति ॥
verses.transliteration: prá-pra ǀ vaḥ ǀ tri-stúbham ǀ íṣam ǀ mandát-vīrāya ǀ índave ǀdhiyā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ medhá-sātaye ǀ púram-dhyā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Present your sacrificial food with a three-fold song of praise to Indu, gladdener of heroes; he will blessyou in your religious rites to the accompaniment of your sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Present your sacrificial food with a three-fold song of praise to Indu, gladdener of heroes; he will blessyou in your religious rites to the accompaniment of your sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनां ।पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration: nadám ǀ vaḥ ǀ ódatīnām ǀ nadám ǀ yóyuvatīnām ǀpátim ǀ vaḥ ǀ ághnyānām ǀ dhenūnā́m ǀ iṣudhyasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Invoke) for yourselves the author of the dawns, (I invoke) for you the roarer of the rivers; (I invoke) foryou the lord of the inviolable ones; (O sacrificer), you desire kine.
verses.wilson_translation: (Invoke) for yourselves the author of the dawns, (I invoke) for you the roarer of the rivers; (I invoke) foryou the lord of the inviolable ones; (O sacrificer), you desire kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता अस्य सूददोहसः सोमं श्रीणंति पृश्नयः ।जन्मंदेवानां विशस्त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ sū́da-dohasaḥ ǀ sómam ǀ śrīṇanti ǀ pṛ́śnayaḥ ǀjánman ǀ devā́nām ǀ víśaḥ ǀ triṣú ǀ ā́ ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These white kine, giving milk wells, mix the Somafor him at the three oblations, rising (in consequece tothe brilliant home of the sun, the birthplace of the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: These white kine, giving milk wells, mix the Somafor him at the three oblations, rising (in consequece tothe brilliant home of the sun, the birthplace of the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेंद्रमर्च यथा विदे ।सूनुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ prá ǀ gó-patim ǀ girā́ ǀ índram ǀ arca ǀ yáthā ǀ vidé ǀsūnúm ǀ satyásya ǀ sát-patim ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worship with your praise, as he himself knows-- that lord of kine,Indra, the son of Satya, the protectorof the good.
verses.wilson_translation: Worship with your praise, as he himself knows-- that lord of kine,Indra, the son of Satya, the protectorof the good.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि ।यत्राभि संनवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ sasṛjrire ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀyátra ǀ abhí ǀ sam-návāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the brilliant bay (horses) drop him down on the cut grass, where we will hymn his praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the brilliant bay (horses) drop him down on the cut grass, where we will hymn his praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु ।यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ā-śíram ǀ duduhré ǀ vajríṇe ǀ mádhu ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ upa-hvaré ǀ vidát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The cows have milked the intoxicating draught for Indra, the thunderer, when he finds it near him.
verses.wilson_translation: The cows have milked the intoxicating draught for Indra, the thunderer, when he finds it near him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उद्यद्ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गृहमिंद्रश्च गन्वहि ।मध्वः पीत्वा सचेवहि त्रिः सप्त सख्युः पदे ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ yát ǀ bradhnásya ǀ viṣṭápam ǀ gṛhám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ gánvahi ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ pītvā́ ǀ sacevahi ǀ tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ padé ǁ
verses.english_translation: When Indra, and I ascend to our home, the world of the sun, then, having drunk the sweet (Soma), letus be united in the twenty-first sphere of the (universal) friend.
verses.wilson_translation: When Indra, and I ascend to our home, the world of the sun, then, having drunk the sweet (Soma), letus be united in the twenty-first sphere of the (universal) friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्चत प्रार्चत प्रियमेधासो अर्चत ।अर्चंतु पुत्रका उत पुरं न धृष्ण्वर्चत ॥
verses.transliteration: árcata ǀ prá ǀ arcata ǀ príya-medhāsaḥ ǀ árcata ǀárcantu ǀ putrakā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ púram ǀ ná ǀ dhṛṣṇú ǀ arcata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worship Indra, worship him pre-eminently, worship him, you of the family of Priyamedha; let your sonsalso worship him; worship him as a strong city.
verses.wilson_translation: Worship Indra, worship him pre-eminently, worship him, you of the family of Priyamedha; let your sonsalso worship him; worship him as a strong city.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव स्वराति गर्गरो गोधा परि सनिष्वणत् ।पिंगा परि चनिष्कददिंद्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतं ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ svarāti ǀ gárgaraḥ ǀ godhā́ ǀ pári ǀ sanisvanat ǀpíṅgā ǀ pári ǀ caniskadat ǀ índrāya ǀ bráhma ǀ út-yatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The drum utters its sound, the leathern guard twangs, the tawny bowstring leaps to and fro; let thehymn be raised to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The drum utters its sound, the leathern guard twangs, the tawny bowstring leaps to and fro; let thehymn be raised to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यत्पतंत्येन्यः सुदुघा अनपस्फुरः ।अपस्फुरं गृभायत सोममिंद्राय पातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ pátanti ǀ enyáḥ ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ ánapa-sphuraḥ ǀapa-sphúram ǀ gṛbhāyata ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the bright fertilizing rivers flow with diminished waters, then take the overflowing Somafor Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: When the bright fertilizing rivers flow with diminished waters, then take the overflowing Somafor Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपादिंद्रो अपादग्निर्विश्वे देवा अमत्सत ।वरुण इदिह क्षयत्तमापो अभ्यनूषत वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव ॥
verses.transliteration: ápāt ǀ índraḥ ǀ ápāt ǀ agníḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amatsata ǀváruṇaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ihá ǀ kṣayat ǀ tám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀ vatsám ǀ saṃśíśvarīḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indradrank (the Soma),Agnidrank it, the Viśve Devāswere gladdened; let Varuṇafix his dwellinghere, the waters have praised him as cows (low) meeting their calves.
verses.wilson_translation: Indradrank (the Soma),Agnidrank it, the Viśve Devāswere gladdened; let Varuṇafix his dwellinghere, the waters have praised him as cows (low) meeting their calves.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुदेवो असि वरुण यस्य ते सप्त सिंधवः ।अनुक्षरंति काकुदं सूर्म्यं सुषिरामिव ॥
verses.transliteration: su-deváḥ ǀ asi ǀ varuṇa ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ saptá ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀanu-kṣáranti ǀ kākúdam ǀ sūrmyám ǀ suṣirā́m-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are a glorious god,Varuṇa, across whose palate the seven rivers keep pouring as a fair-flowing(stream) into an abyss.
verses.wilson_translation: You are a glorious god,Varuṇa, across whose palate the seven rivers keep pouring as a fair-flowing(stream) into an abyss.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो व्यतीँरफाणयत्सुयुक्ताँ उप दाशुषे ।तक्वो नेता तदिद्वपुरुपमा यो अमुच्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vyátīn ǀ áphāṇayat ǀ sú-yuktān ǀ úpa ǀ dāśúṣe ǀtakváḥ ǀ netā́ ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ vápuḥ ǀ upa-mā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ámucyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: He ho directs towards the worshiper his well-yoked prancing steeds-- he, (Indra), the swift bearer ofblessing, (produces) rain-- he, who being comparable only to himself is delivered (from all his enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: He ho directs towards the worshiper his well-yoked prancing steeds-- he, (Indra), the swift bearer ofblessing, (produces) rain-- he, who being comparable only to himself is delivered (from all his enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतीदु शक्र ओहत इंद्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ।भिनत्कनीन ओदनं पच्यमानं परो गिरा ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śakráḥ ǀ ohate ǀ índraḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀbhinát ǀ kanī́naḥ ǀ odanám ǀ pacyámānam ǀ paráḥ ǀ girā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Śakraverily overpowers,Indraoverpowers all his enemies; he, worthy of love, abiding beyond, cleavesthe cloud smitten by his thunder-voice.
verses.wilson_translation: Śakraverily overpowers,Indraoverpowers all his enemies; he, worthy of love, abiding beyond, cleavesthe cloud smitten by his thunder-voice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्भको न कुमारकोऽधि तिष्ठन्नवं रथं ।स पक्षन्महिषं मृगं पित्रे मात्रे विभुक्रतुं ॥
verses.transliteration: arbhakáḥ ǀ ná ǀ kumārakáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhat ǀ návam ǀ rátham ǀsáḥ ǀ pakṣat ǀ mahiṣám ǀ mṛgám ǀ pitré ǀ mātré ǀ vibhu-krátum ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indra), like a young boy, has mounted his splendid chariot; he makes ready for his father and motherthe great deer-like many-functioned cloud.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra), like a young boy, has mounted his splendid chariot; he makes ready for his father and motherthe great deer-like many-functioned cloud.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ तू सुशिप्र दंपते रथं तिष्ठा हिरण्ययं ।अध द्युक्षं सचेवहि सहस्रपादमरुषं स्वस्तिगामनेहसं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ su-śipra ǀ dam-pate ǀ rátham ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀádha ǀ dyukṣám ǀ sacevahi ǀ sahásra-pādam ǀ aruṣám ǀ svasti-gā́m ǀ anehásam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Handsome-jawed (Indra), householder, mount your golden chariot; then let us meet mounted togetheron that bright thousand-footed brilliant auspiciously moving sinless (car).
verses.wilson_translation: Handsome-jawed (Indra), householder, mount your golden chariot; then let us meet mounted togetheron that bright thousand-footed brilliant auspiciously moving sinless (car).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते ।अर्थं चिदस्य सुधितं यदेतव आवर्तयंति दावने ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ gha ǀ īm ǀ itthā́ ǀ namasvínaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sva-rā́jam ǀ āsate ǀártham ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ yát ǀ étave ǀ ā-vartáyanti ǀ dāváne ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The priests), presenting praise, thus worship that self-resplendent (Indra); they obtain his well-storedwealth, when (his horsesk) bring him on his way for the offering.
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests), presenting praise, thus worship that self-resplendent (Indra); they obtain his well-storedwealth, when (his horsesk) bring him on his way for the offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसः प्रियमेधास एषां ।पूर्वामनु प्रयतिं वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आशत ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ pratnásya ǀ ókasaḥ ǀ priyá-medhāsaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀpū́rvām ǀ ánu ǀ prá-yatim ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ hitá-prayasaḥ ǀ āśata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Priyamedhashave reached the ancient dwelling plural ce of these deities, having strewn the sacredgrass and plural ced their oblations after the manner of a pre-eminent offering.
verses.wilson_translation: The Priyamedhashave reached the ancient dwelling plural ce of these deities, having strewn the sacredgrass and plural ced their oblations after the manner of a pre-eminent offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXX. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १५ पुरुहन्मा आङ्गिरस: । इन्द्र: । बृहती ;  १-६ प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती )  १२ शंकुमती, १३ उष्णिक् , १४ अनुष्टुप् , १५ पुरउष्णिक् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INDRA, God of the mighty arm, gather for us with thy right handManifold and nutritious spoil. We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth,Mighty in measure, prompt to aid. Hero, when thou art fain to give, neither may Gods nor mortal menRestrain thee like a fearful Bull. Come, let us glorify Indra, Lord supreme of wealth, Self-ruling King:In bounty may he harm us not. Let prelude sound and following chant so let him hear the Sāman sung,And with his bounty answer us. O Indra, with thy right hand bring, and with thy left remember us.Let us not lose our share of wealth. Come nigh, O Bold One, boldly bring hither the riches of the churlWho giveth least of all the folk. Indra, the booty which thou hast with holy singers to receive,Even that booty win with us. Indra, thy swiftly-coming spoil, the booty which rejoices all,Sounds quick in concert with our hopes.

verses.sanskrit: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः ।विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठो यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ yā́tā ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ ádhri-guḥ ǀvíśvāsām ǀ tarutā́ ǀ pṛ́tanānām ǀ jyéṣṭhaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ gṛṇé ǁ
verses.english_translation: I praise that Indrawho is the lord of men, who proceeds irresistible in his chariots, the breaker-throughof all armies, the pre-eminent one, the slayer of Vṛtra.
verses.wilson_translation: I praise that Indrawho is the lord of men, who proceeds irresistible in his chariots, the breaker-throughof all armies, the pre-eminent one, the slayer of Vṛtra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं तं शुंभ पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्तरि ।हस्ताय वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महो दिवे न सूर्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ tám ǀ śumbha ǀ puru-hanman ǀ ávase ǀ yásya ǀ dvitā́ ǀ vi-dhartári ǀhástāya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ práti ǀ dhāyi ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ divé ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Puruhanman, honour that Indrafor your protection, for in your upholder there is a two-fold might; heholds in hishand(to smite his enemies) the glorious thunderbolt great as the sun in heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Puruhanman, honour that Indrafor your protection, for in your upholder there is a two-fold might; heholds in hishand(to smite his enemies) the glorious thunderbolt great as the sun in heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधं ।इंद्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्ण्वोजसं ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ tám ǀ kármaṇā ǀ naśat ǀ yáḥ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ sadā́-vṛdham ǀíndram ǀ ná ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ viśvá-gūrtam ǀ ṛ́bhvasam ǀ ádhṛṣṭam ǀ dhṛṣṇú-ojasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: None can touch him by his deeds, who has made Indrahis friend by sacrifices-- (Indra) ever givingfresh strength, to be hymned by all, great, unconquered, of ever-daring might.
verses.wilson_translation: None can touch him by his deeds, who has made Indrahis friend by sacrifices-- (Indra) ever givingfresh strength, to be hymned by all, great, unconquered, of ever-daring might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अषाळ्हमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन्महीरुरुज्रयः ।सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामो अनोनवुः ॥
verses.transliteration: áṣāḷham ǀ ugrám ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sasahím ǀ yásmin ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ uru-jráyaḥ ǀsám ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ jā́yamāne ǀ anonavuḥ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ kṣā́maḥ ǀ anonavuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (I laud) him who is not to be withstood, the mighty, the conqueror in hostile hosts; whom, when he wasborn, the strong rushing cows welcomed and the heavens and the earths praised.
verses.wilson_translation: (I laud) him who is not to be withstood, the mighty, the conqueror in hostile hosts; whom, when he wasborn, the strong rushing cows welcomed and the heavens and the earths praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्द्याव इंद्र ते शतं शतं भूमीरुत स्युः ।न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ śatám ǀ śatám ǀ bhū́mīḥ ǀ utá ǀ syúríti syúḥ ǀná ǀ tvā ǀ vajrin ǀ sahásram ǀ sū́ryāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ ná ǀ jātám ǀ aṣṭa ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, were there a hundred heavens to compare with you, or were there a hundred earths-- Othunderer, not even a thousand suns woudl reveal you-- yes, no created thing would fill you, nor heaven andearth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, were there a hundred heavens to compare with you, or were there a hundred earths-- Othunderer, not even a thousand suns woudl reveal you-- yes, no created thing would fill you, nor heaven andearth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा ।अस्माँ अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिंचित्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paprātha ǀ mahinā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyā ǀ vṛṣan ǀ víśvā ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ śávasā ǀasmā́n ǀ ava ǀ magha-van ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǀ vájrin ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mightiest showerer (of blessings), you have filled all (our hosts) with your vast bountiful power; OMaghavan, thunderer, guard us with your manifold protections, (when we march) against the well-stockedcowpen of our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: Mightiest showerer (of blessings), you have filled all (our hosts) with your vast bountiful power; OMaghavan, thunderer, guard us with your manifold protections, (when we march) against the well-stockedcowpen of our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न सीमदेव आपदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः ।एतग्वा चिद्य एतशा युयोजते हरी इंद्रो युयोजते ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ sīm ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ āpat ǀ íṣam ǀ dīrghāyo íti dīrgha-āyo ǀ mártyaḥ ǀéta-gvā ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ étaśā ǀ yuyójate ǀ hárī íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ yuyójate ǁ
verses.english_translation: O long-lived Indra, the mortal who has not you as his deity obtains no food; (he who praises not) thatsteed-borne Indra, who yokes to his car the two variegated, who yokes the two bay steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: O long-lived Indra, the mortal who has not you as his deity obtains no food; (he who praises not) thatsteed-borne Indra, who yokes to his car the two variegated, who yokes the two bay steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं वो महो महाय्यमिंद्रं दानाय सक्षणिं ।यो गाधेषु य आरणेषु हव्यो वाजेष्वस्ति हव्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahā́yyam ǀ índram ǀ dānā́ya ǀ sakṣáṇim ǀyáḥ ǀ gādhéṣu ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā-áraṇeṣu ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ ásti ǀ hávyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Great (priests), worship that Indrawho is propitiated by gifts; who is to be invoked in the shallows andin the depths, and who is to be invoked in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: Great (priests), worship that Indrawho is propitiated by gifts; who is to be invoked in the shallows andin the depths, and who is to be invoked in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदू षु णो वसो महे मृशस्व शूर राधसे ।उदू षु मह्यै मघवन्मघत्तय उदिंद्र श्रवसे महे ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ mahé ǀ mṛśásva ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhase ǀút ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ mahyái ǀ magha-van ǀ magháttaye ǀ út ǀ indra ǀ śrávase ǀ mahé ǁ
verses.english_translation: O hero, giver of dwellings, raise up to enjoy abundant food; raise us up,Maghavan, for abundantwealth; raise us up,Indra, for abundant fame.
verses.wilson_translation: O hero, giver of dwellings, raise up to enjoy abundant food; raise us up,Maghavan, for abundantwealth; raise us up,Indra, for abundant fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न इंद्र ऋतयुस्त्वानिदो नि तृंपसि ।मध्ये वसिष्व तुविनृम्णोर्वोर्नि दासं शिश्नथो हथैः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ ṛta-yúḥ ǀ tvā-nídaḥ ǀ ní ǀ tṛmpasi ǀmádhye ǀ vasiṣva ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇa ǀ ūrvóḥ ǀ ní ǀ dāsám ǀ śiśnathaḥ ǀ háthaiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who delights in offerings, you satisfy us abundantly with (the possession of him) who despisesyou; O you possessed of vast wealth, shelter us between your thighs; you smite down the Dāsawith yourblows.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who delights in offerings, you satisfy us abundantly with (the possession of him) who despisesyou; O you possessed of vast wealth, shelter us between your thighs; you smite down the Dāsawith yourblows.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अन्यव्रतममानुषमयज्वानमदेवयुं ।अव स्वः सखा दुधुवीत पर्वतः सुघ्नाय दस्युं पर्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: anyá-vratam ǀ ámānuṣam ǀ áyajvānam ǀ ádeva-yum ǀáva ǀ sváḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ dudhuvīta ǀ párvataḥ ǀ su-ghnā́ya ǀ dásyum ǀ párvataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your friend,Parvata, hurl down from heaven him who follows other rites, the enemy of men, himwho offers no sacrifice and who worships not the gods; may Parvata hurl the Dasyudown to the storm smiter(death).
verses.wilson_translation: May your friend,Parvata, hurl down from heaven him who follows other rites, the enemy of men, himwho offers no sacrifice and who worships not the gods; may Parvata hurl the Dasyudown to the storm smiter(death).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न इंद्रासां हस्ते शविष्ठ दावने ।धानानां न सं गृभायास्मयुर्द्विः सं गृभायास्मयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ āsām ǀ háste ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ dāváne ǀdhānā́nām ǀ ná ǀ sám ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ dvíḥ ǀ sám ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most powerful Indra, in your favour towards us, take these cows in yourhand, as fried grain, to give tous; yes, take them twice in your favour towards us.
verses.wilson_translation: Most powerful Indra, in your favour towards us, take these cows in yourhand, as fried grain, to give tous; yes, take them twice in your favour towards us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सखायः क्रतुमिच्छत कथा राधाम शरस्य ।उपस्तुतिं भोजः सूरिर्यो अह्रयः ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ krátum ǀ icchata ǀ kathā́ ǀ rādhāma ǀ śarásya ǀúpa-stutim ǀ bhojáḥ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ áhrayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associated priests, give good heed to the sacrifice, for how can we (worthily) perform the praise of(Indra) the destroyer, who is the recompenser of enemies, the sender of reward, the unvanquished?
verses.wilson_translation: Associated priests, give good heed to the sacrifice, for how can we (worthily) perform the praise of(Indra) the destroyer, who is the recompenser of enemies, the sender of reward, the unvanquished?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भूरिभिः समह ऋषिभिर्बर्हिष्मद्भिः स्तविष्यसे ।यदित्थमेकमेकमिच्छर वत्सान्पराददः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhū́ri-bhiḥ ǀ samaha ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ barhíṣmat-bhiḥ ǀ staviṣyase ǀyát ǀ itthám ǀ ékam-ekam ǀ ít ǀ śára ǀ vatsā́n ǀ parā-dádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the common object of our worship, you are praised by many sacrificing Ṛṣis; for it is you,destroyer of foes, who thus give calves in succession to your worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the common object of our worship, you are praised by many sacrificing Ṛṣis; for it is you,destroyer of foes, who thus give calves in succession to your worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कर्णगृह्या मघवा शौरदेव्यो वत्सं नस्त्रिभ्य आनयत् ।अजां सूरिर्न धातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: karṇa-gṛ́hya ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śaura-devyáḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ naḥ ǀ tri-bhyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ anayat ǀajā́m ǀ sūríḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Maghavan, taking them by the ears, lead the cows with their calves from our three (destructiveenemies), as the owner leads a goat to drink.
verses.wilson_translation: May Maghavan, taking them by the ears, lead the cows with their calves from our three (destructiveenemies), as the owner leads a goat to drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १५ सुदीति- पुरुमीळहावाङ्गिरसौ, तयोर्वान्यतर: । अग्नि: । गायत्री, १०-१५ प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HASTE forward to us from afar, or, Vṛtra-slayer, from anear,To meet the offering to the meath. Strong are the Soma-draughts; come nigh: the juices fill thee with delight:Drink boldly even as thou art wont'. Joy, Indra, in the strengthening food et it content thy wish and thought,And be delightful to thine heart. Come to us thou who hast no foe: we call thee down to hymns of praise,In heaven's sublimest realm of light. This Soma here expressed with stones and dressed with milk for thy carouse,Indra, is offered up to thee. Graciously, Indra, hear my call. Come and obtain the draught, and sateThyself with juices blent with milk. The Soma, Indra, which is shed in chalices and vats for thee,Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof. The Soma seen within the vats, as in the flood the Moon is seen,Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof. That which the Hawk brought in his claw, inviolate, through the air to thee,Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः ।उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ víśvasyāḥ ǀ árāteḥ ǀutá ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ mártyasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, do you protect us by great wealh from every niggard and mortal foe.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, do you protect us by great wealh from every niggard and mortal foe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि मन्युः पौरुषेय ईशे हि वः प्रियजात ।त्वमिदसि क्षपावान् ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ manyúḥ ǀ páuruṣeyaḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ priya-jāta ǀtvám ǀ ít ǀ asi ǀ kṣápā-vān ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you who was born loved, no human anger can hrm you-- you only are the lord of night.
verses.wilson_translation: O you who was born loved, no human anger can hrm you-- you only are the lord of night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरूर्जो नपाद्भद्रशोचे ।रयिं देहि विश्ववारं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ bhádra-śoce ǀrayím ǀ dehi ǀ viśvá-vāram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength, auspicious in brilliance, associated with all the gods, give us all desirable wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength, auspicious in brilliance, associated with all the gods, give us all desirable wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न तमग्ने अरातयो मर्तं युवंत रायः ।यं त्रायसे दाश्वांसं ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ agne ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ mártam ǀ yuvanta ǀ rāyáḥ ǀyám ǀ trā́yase ǀ dāśvā́ṃsam ǁ
verses.english_translation: That sacrificing mortal whom you,Agni, protect the niggardly cannot separate from wealht.
verses.wilson_translation: That sacrificing mortal whom you,Agni, protect the niggardly cannot separate from wealht.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं त्वं विप्र मेधसातावग्ने हिनोषि धनाय ।स तवोती गोषु गंता ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ tvám ǀ vipra ǀ medhá-sātau ǀ ágne ǀ hinóṣi ǀ dhánāya ǀsáḥ ǀ táva ǀ ūtī́ ǀ góṣu ǀ gántā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise (Agni), he whom in his performance of the sacrifice you incite to attain wealth, by your protectionwalks (lord) among crowds of cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Wise (Agni), he whom in his performance of the sacrifice you incite to attain wealth, by your protectionwalks (lord) among crowds of cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरमग्ने दाशुषे मर्ताय ।प्र णो नय वस्यो अच्छ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ rayím ǀ puru-vī́ram ǀ ágne ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártāya ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ naya ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Agnigive to the offerer wealth comprehending manymaledescendants; conduct us to affluence.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agnigive to the offerer wealth comprehending manymaledescendants; conduct us to affluence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उरुष्या णो मा परा दा अघायते जातवेदः ।दुराध्ये मर्ताय ॥
verses.transliteration: uruṣyá ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǀ agha-yaté ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀduḥ-ādhyé ǀ mártāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Defend us,Jātavedas; deliver us not over to the malevolent, to the man whose thoughts are evil.
verses.wilson_translation: Defend us,Jātavedas; deliver us not over to the malevolent, to the man whose thoughts are evil.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने माकिष्टे देवस्य रातिमदेवो युयोत ।त्वमीशिषे वसूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ te ǀ devásya ǀ rātím ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ yuyota ǀtvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ vásūnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, let not the godless take away the wealth which you, the divine, have given, for you are the lord oftreasures.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, let not the godless take away the wealth which you, the divine, have given, for you are the lord oftreasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो वस्व उप मास्यूर्जो नपान्माहिनस्य ।सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ māsi ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ mā́hinasya ǀsákhe ǀ vaso íti ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength, the friend, the giver of dwellings, you get our abundant treasure to us your praisers.
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength, the friend, the giver of dwellings, you get our abundant treasure to us your praisers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यंतु दर्शतं ।अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ śīrá-śociṣam ǀ gíraḥ ǀ yantu ǀ darśatám ǀáccha ǀ yajñā́saḥ ǀ námasā ǀ puru-vásum ǀ puru-praśastám ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let our voices come near the beautiful (Agni) him who bears devouring flames; let our sacrifices withour oblations come near him, for our protection, who is rich in wealth and rich in praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Let our voices come near the beautiful (Agni) him who bears devouring flames; let our sacrifices withour oblations come near him, for our protection, who is rich in wealth and rich in praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणां ।द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मंद्रतमो विशि ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ sūnúm ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ dānā́ya ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀdvitā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ hótā ǀ mandrá-tamaḥ ǀ viśí ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Let them come near)Agni,Jātavedas, son of strength, for the giving of all desirable good things, whois doubly immortal as (perpetually burning) among priests, among the sacrificers.
verses.wilson_translation: (Let them come near)Agni,Jātavedas, son of strength, for the giving of all desirable good things, whois doubly immortal as (perpetually burning) among priests, among the sacrificers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं वो देवयज्ययाग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।अग्निं धीषु प्रथममग्निमर्वत्यग्निं क्षैत्राय साधसे ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ deva-yajyáyā ǀ agním ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀagním ǀ dhīṣú ǀ prathamám ǀ agním ǀ árvati ǀ agním ǀ kṣáitrāya ǀ sā́dhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: I praise Agni, (O sacrificers), for the inauguration of your divine offering; (I praise him) when thesacrifice is proceeding; (I praise) Agni first of the gods, at our rites; (I praise) Agni when the enemy approaches; (Ipraise) Agni for the attainment of land.
verses.wilson_translation: I praise Agni, (O sacrificers), for the inauguration of your divine offering; (I praise him) when thesacrifice is proceeding; (I praise) Agni first of the gods, at our rites; (I praise) Agni when the enemy approaches; (Ipraise) Agni for the attainment of land.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरिषां सख्ये ददातु न ईशे यो वार्याणां ।अग्निं तोके तनये शश्वदीमहे वसुं संतं तनूपां ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ iṣā́m ǀ sakhyé ǀ dadātu ǀ naḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀagním ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ śáśvat ǀ īmahe ǀ vásum ǀ sántam ǀ tanū-pā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Agniin his friendship give us food for he is the lord of all desirable things; we solicit abundance forour sons and grandsons from Agni, who is the giver of dwellings and the protector of our bodies.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agniin his friendship give us food for he is the lord of all desirable things; we solicit abundance forour sons and grandsons from Agni, who is the giver of dwellings and the protector of our bodies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमीळिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषं ।अग्निं राये पुरुमीळ्ह श्रुतं नरोऽग्निं सुदीतये छर्दिः ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ īḷiṣva ǀ ávase ǀ gā́thābhiḥ ǀ śīrá-śociṣam ǀagním ǀ rāyé ǀ puru-mīḷha ǀ śrutám ǀ náraḥ ǀ agním ǀ su-dītáye ǀ chardíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Land with your hymns for our protection,Agni, whose splendour lie outspread; laud Agni for wealth, OPurumīḷha, for other offerers are lauding that far famed one on their own behalf; solicit of Agni a house for (me)Sudīti.
verses.wilson_translation: Land with your hymns for our protection,Agni, whose splendour lie outspread; laud Agni for wealth, OPurumīḷha, for other offerers are lauding that far famed one on their own behalf; solicit of Agni a house for (me)Sudīti.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं द्वेषो योतवै नो गृणीमस्यग्निं शं योश्च दातवे ।विश्वासु विक्ष्ववितेव हव्यो भुवद्वस्तुर्ऋषूणां ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ yótavái ǀ naḥ ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǀ agním ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ ca ǀ dā́tave ǀvíśvāsu ǀ vikṣú ǀ avitā́-iva ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ bhúvat ǀ vástuḥ ǀ ṛṣūṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: We praise Agnithat he may keep off our enemies; we praise Agni that he may give us joy and security;he may be worshipped as the giver of dwellings to the ṛṣis; he who is as it were the protector of all men.
verses.wilson_translation: We praise Agnithat he may keep off our enemies; we praise Agni that he may give us joy and security;he may be worshipped as the giver of dwellings to the ṛṣis; he who is as it were the protector of all men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: १८ हर्यत: प्रागाथ: । अग्नि: हवींषि वा । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE choose unto ourselves that high protection of the Mighty GodsThat it may help and succour us. May they be ever our allies, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman,Far-seeing Gods who prosper us. Ye furtherers of holy Law, transport us safe o’er many woes,As over water-floods in ships. Dear wealth be Aryaman to us, Varuṇa dear wealth meet for praise:Dear wealth we choose unto ourselves. For Sovrans of dear wealth are ye, Ādityas, not of sinner's wealth,Ye sapient Gods who slay the foe. We in our homes, ye Bounteous Ones, and while we journey on the road,Invoke you, Gods, to prosper us. Regard us, Indra, Viṣṇu, here, ye Aśvins and the Marut host,Us who are kith and kin to you. Ye Bounteous Ones, from time of old we here set forth our brotherhood,Our kinship in. the Mother's womb. Then come with Indra for your chief, as early day, ye Bounteous GodsYea,  address you now for this.

verses.sanskrit: हविष्कृणुध्वमा गमदध्वर्युर्वनते पुनः ।विद्वाँ अस्य प्रशासनं ॥
verses.transliteration: havíḥ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ vanate ǀ púnaríti ǀvidvā́n ǀ asya ǀ pra-śā́sanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: ()Priests), present the oblation, for (Agni) has come; the Adhvaryuagain offers (the sacrifice),well-skilled in its offering.
verses.wilson_translation: ()Priests), present the oblation, for (Agni) has come; the Adhvaryuagain offers (the sacrifice),well-skilled in its offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि तिग्ममभ्यंशुं सीदद्धोता मनावधि ।जुषाणो अस्य सख्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ tigmám ǀ abhí ǀ aṃśúm ǀ sī́dat ǀ hótā ǀ manáu ǀ ádhi ǀjuṣāṇáḥ ǀ asya ǀ sakhyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Hotāsits down by (Agni's) hot flame, rejoicing in his friendship towards the offerer.
verses.wilson_translation: The Hotāsits down by (Agni's) hot flame, rejoicing in his friendship towards the offerer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंतरिच्छंति तं जने रुद्रं परो मनीषया ।गृभ्णंति जिह्वया ससं ॥
verses.transliteration: antáḥ ǀ icchanti ǀ tám ǀ jáne ǀ rudrám ǀ paráḥ ǀ manīṣáyā ǀgṛbhṇánti ǀ jihváyā ǀ sasám ǁ
verses.english_translation: For the sake of the offerer, they seek by their skill to plural ce Rudrain the fore-front; they seize, as hesleeps, with their tongues.
verses.wilson_translation: For the sake of the offerer, they seek by their skill to plural ce Rudrain the fore-front; they seize, as hesleeps, with their tongues.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जाम्यतीतपे धनुर्वयोधा अरुहद्वनं ।दृषदं जिह्वयावधीत् ॥
verses.transliteration: jāmí ǀ atītape ǀ dhánuḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ aruhat ǀ vánam ǀdṛṣádam ǀ jihváyā ǀ ā́ ǀ avadhīt ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Agni), the giver of food, scorches the vast bow (Of the sky); he mounts the water; he smites the cloudwith his tongue.
verses.wilson_translation: (Agni), the giver of food, scorches the vast bow (Of the sky); he mounts the water; he smites the cloudwith his tongue.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चरन्वत्सो रुशन्निह निदातारं न विंदते ।वेति स्तोतव अंब्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: cáran ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ rúśan ǀ ihá ǀ ni-dātā́ram ǀ ná ǀ vindate ǀvéti ǀ stótave ǀ ambyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Roaming like a calf and bright-shining, he finds here no hinderer; he seeks a chanter to praise hiṃ
verses.wilson_translation: Roaming like a calf and bright-shining, he finds here no hinderer; he seeks a chanter to praise hiṃ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य यन्महदश्वावद्योजनं बृहद् ।दामा रथस्य ददृशे ॥
verses.transliteration: utó íti ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ yát ǀ mahát ǀ áśva-vat ǀ yójanam ǀ bṛhát ǀdāmā́ ǀ ráthasya ǀ dádṛśe ǁ
verses.english_translation: As soon as the great stout harness of his horses is seen (in the sky), the traces of his chariot.
verses.wilson_translation: As soon as the great stout harness of his horses is seen (in the sky), the traces of his chariot.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दुहंति सप्तैका���ुप द्वा पंच सृजतः ।तीर्थे सिंधोरधि स्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: duhánti ǀ saptá ǀ ékām ǀ úpa ǀ dvā́ ǀ páñca ǀ sṛjataḥ ǀtīrthé ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ svaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: Seven milk one (cow), the two direct the five, on the resounding shore of the river.
verses.wilson_translation: Seven milk one (cow), the two direct the five, on the resounding shore of the river.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ दशभिर्विवस्वत इंद्रः कोशमचुच्यवीत् ।खेदया त्रिवृता दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ kóśam ǀ acucyavīt ǀkhédayā ǀ tri-vṛ́tā ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invoked by the ten (fingers) of the worshipper,Indrahas caused the cloud to fall from heaven by histhree-fold ray.
verses.wilson_translation: Invoked by the ten (fingers) of the worshipper,Indrahas caused the cloud to fall from heaven by histhree-fold ray.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि त्रिधातुरध्वरं जूर्णिरेति नवीयसी ।मध्वा होतारो अंजते ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ tri-dhā́tuḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ jūrṇíḥ ǀ eti ǀ návīyasī ǀmádhvā ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ añjate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The three-hued fresh impetuous (blaze) goes swiftly round the sacrifice, the priests anoint it with butteṛ
verses.wilson_translation: The three-hued fresh impetuous (blaze) goes swiftly round the sacrifice, the priests anoint it with butteṛ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सिंचंति नमसावतमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानं ।नीचीनबारमक्षितं ॥
verses.transliteration: siñcánti ǀ námasā ǀ avatám ǀ uccā́-cakram ǀ pári-jmānam ǀnīcī́na-bāram ǀ ákṣitam ǁ
verses.english_translation: They pour out with reverence the inexhaustible cauldron, as it goes round circular above and with anopening below:
verses.wilson_translation: They pour out with reverence the inexhaustible cauldron, as it goes round circular above and with anopening below:
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु ।अवतस्य विसर्जने ॥
verses.transliteration: abhi-ā́ram ǀ ít ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ ní-siktam ǀ púṣkare ǀ mádhu ǀavatásya ǀ vi-sárjane ǁ
verses.english_translation: The reverent priests drawing near pour the superfluous butter into the large (spoon), where hey set thecauldron down.
verses.wilson_translation: The reverent priests drawing near pour the superfluous butter into the large (spoon), where hey set thecauldron down.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा ।उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥
verses.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ avata ǀ avatám ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ yajñásya ǀ rapsúdā ǀubhā́ ǀ kárṇā ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Draw near, you cows, to the cauldron; (the two kinds of milk) in the sacrifice are plural ntiful and fruitgiving; both ears (of the vessel) are golden.
verses.wilson_translation: Draw near, you cows, to the cauldron; (the two kinds of milk) in the sacrifice are plural ntiful and fruitgiving; both ears (of the vessel) are golden.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सुते सिंचत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियं ।रसा दधीत वृषभं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ suté ǀ siñcata ǀ śríyam ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ abhi-śríyam ǀrasā́ ǀ dadhīta ǀ vṛṣabhám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drop into the milked (stream) the admixture, which reaches, (as it boils), heaven and earth; set the bullin the liquor.
verses.wilson_translation: Drop into the milked (stream) the admixture, which reaches, (as it boils), heaven and earth; set the bullin the liquor.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते जानत स्वमोक्यं सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः ।मिथो नसंत जामिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ jānata ǀ svám ǀ okyám ǀ sám ǀ vatsā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀmitháḥ ǀ nasanta ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They know their own abode; as calves with their mothers, so they severally assemble with their kiṇ
verses.wilson_translation: They know their own abode; as calves with their mothers, so they severally assemble with their kiṇ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि ।इंद्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ srákveṣu ǀ bápsataḥ ǀ kṛṇvaté ǀ dharúṇam ǀ diví ǀíndre ǀ agnā́ ǀ námaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The priests) minister in the sky the supporting (milk) to (Agni) who devours with his jaws; they ministerall the food to Indraand Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests) minister in the sky the supporting (milk) to (Agni) who devours with his jaws; they ministerall the food to Indraand Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधुक्षत्पिप्युषीमिषमूर्जं सप्तपदीमरिः ।सूर्यस्य सप्त रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhukṣat ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ saptá-padīm ǀ aríḥ ǀsū́ryasya ǀ saptá ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wind by means of the sun's seven rays milks the nourishing food and drink from the seven-steppedone.
verses.wilson_translation: The wind by means of the sun's seven rays milks the nourishing food and drink from the seven-steppedone.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य मित्रावरुणोदिता सूर आ ददे ।तदातुरस्य भेषजं ॥
verses.transliteration: sómasya ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́re ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀtát ǀ ā́turasya ǀ bheṣajám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, I take the Somawhen the sun is risen; it ismedicineto the sick.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, I take the Somawhen the sun is risen; it ismedicineto the sick.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य यत्पदं हर्यतस्य निधान्यं ।परि द्यां जिह्वयातनत् ॥
verses.transliteration: utó íti ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ yát ǀ padám ǀ haryatásya ǀ ni-dhānyám ǀpári ǀ dyā́m ǀ jihváyā ǀ atanat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni-- standing in the plural ce which I, the eager offerer, choose as the spot for presenting the oblations--fills the sky on every side with his blaze.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni-- standing in the plural ce which I, the eager offerer, choose as the spot for presenting the oblations--fills the sky on every side with his blaze.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXIII. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AGNI, your dearest Guest, I laud, him who is loving as a friend,Who brings us riches like a car. Whom as a far-foreseeing Sage the Gods have, from the olden time,Established among mortal men. Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs,And of thyself preserve their seed. What is the praise wherewith, O God, Aṅgiras, Agni, Son of Strength,We, after thine own wish and thought, May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan?What prayer shall I now speak to thee? Our God, make all of us to dwell in happy habitations, andReward our songs with spoil and wealth. Lord of the house, what plenty fills the songs which thou inspirest now,Thou whose hymn helps to win the kine? Hirn Wise and Strong they glorify, the foremost Champion in the fray,And mighty in his dwelling-place. Agni, he dwells in rest and peace who smites and no one smites again:With hero sons he prospers well

verses.sanskrit: उदीराथामृतायते युंजाथामश्विना रथं ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ īrāthām ǀ ṛta-yaté ǀ yuñjā́thām ǀ aśvinā ǀ rátham ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rise,Aśvins, on my behalf, as I prepare to sacrifice; yoke your ear; let your protection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Rise,Aśvins, on my behalf, as I prepare to sacrifice; yoke your ear; let your protection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निमिषश्चिज्जवीयसा रथेना यातमश्विना ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ni-míṣaḥ ǀ cit ǀ jávīyasā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Aśvins, in your chariot which moves quicker than the twinkling of an eye; let your protectionabide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Aśvins, in your chariot which moves quicker than the twinkling of an eye; let your protectionabide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप स्तृणीतमत्रये हिमेन घर्ममश्विना ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ stṛṇītam ǀ átraye ǀ hiména ǀ gharmám ǀ aśvinā ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, you covered the hot (fire) with cold (water) for Atri; let your protection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, you covered the hot (fire) with cold (water) for Atri; let your protection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कुह स्थः कुह जग्मथुः कुह श्येनेव पेतथुः ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: kúha ǀ sthaḥ ǀ kúha ǀ jagmathuḥ ǀ kúha ǀ śyenā́-iva ǀ petathuḥ ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where are you? Whither are you gone? Wither have you flown like hawks? Let your protection abidenear me.
verses.wilson_translation: Where are you? Whither are you gone? Wither have you flown like hawks? Let your protection abidenear me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य कर्हि कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवं ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ kárhi ǀ kárhi ǀ cit ǀ śuśruyā́tam ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: If today, at some time, in some plural ce, you would but hear my invocation-- let your protection abide nearme.
verses.wilson_translation: If today, at some time, in some plural ce, you would but hear my invocation-- let your protection abide nearme.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना यामहूतमा नेदिष्ठं याम्याप्यं ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvínā ǀ yāma-hū́tamā ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ yāmi ǀ ā́pyam ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Aśvinsare earnestly to be invoked in emergency; I enter into close friendshipwith them; let yourprotection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: The Aśvinsare earnestly to be invoked in emergency; I enter into close friendshipwith them; let yourprotection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवंतमत्रये गृहं कृणुतं युवमश्विना ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ávantam ǀ átraye ǀ gṛhám ǀ kṛṇutám ǀ yuvám ǀ aśvinā ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, you made a sheltering house for Atri; let your protection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, you made a sheltering house for Atri; let your protection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वरेथे अग्निमातपो वदते वल्ग्वत्रये ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: várethe íti ǀ agním ǀ ā-tápaḥ ǀ vádate ǀ valgú ǀ átraye ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You stayed the fire from its fierceness for Atri, while he praied you acceptably; let your protection abidenear me.
verses.wilson_translation: You stayed the fire from its fierceness for Atri, while he praied you acceptably; let your protection abidenear me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सप्तवध्रिराशसा धारामग्नेरशायत ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ saptá-vadhriḥ ǀ ā-śásā ǀ dhā́rām ǀ agnéḥ ǀ aśāyata ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Through his praise of you Saptavadhri set the fire's flame-point (to his basket); let your protection abidenear me.
verses.wilson_translation: Through his praise of you Saptavadhri set the fire's flame-point (to his basket); let your protection abidenear me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इहा गतं वृषण्वसू शृणुतं म इमं हवं ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ śṛṇutám ǀ me ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come hither, lords of abundan wealth, hear this my invocation; let your protection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Come hither, lords of abundan wealth, hear this my invocation; let your protection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: किमिदं वां पुराणवज्जरतोरिव शस्यते ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: kím ǀ idám ǀ vām ǀ purāṇa-vát ǀ járatoḥ-iva ǀ śasyate ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Why is this (repeated invocation) addressed to you as if you were decrepit like old men? Let yourprotection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Why is this (repeated invocation) addressed to you as if you were decrepit like old men? Let yourprotection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समानं वां सजात्यं समानो बंधुरश्विना ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: samānám ǀ vām ǀ sa-jātyám ǀ samānáḥ ǀ bándhuḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, your relationship is common and you have a common kinsman; let your protection abide nearme.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, your relationship is common and you have a common kinsman; let your protection abide nearme.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो वां रजांस्यश्विना रथो वियाति रोदसी ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ aśvinā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vi-yā́ti ǀ ródasī íti ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your chariot,Aśvins, moves swifty through the worlds, through heaven and earth; let your protectionabide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Your chariot,Aśvins, moves swifty through the worlds, through heaven and earth; let your protectionabide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रैरुप गच्छतं ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávyebhiḥ ǀ áśvyaiḥ ǀ sahásraiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ gacchatam ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us with thousands of herds of cattle and horses; let your protection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us with thousands of herds of cattle and horses; let your protection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रेभिरति ख्यतं ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávyebhiḥ ǀ áśvyaiḥ ǀ sahásrebhiḥ ǀ áti ǀ khyatam ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pass us not by with your thousands of herds of cattle and horses; let your protection abide near uṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Pass us not by with your thousands of herds of cattle and horses; let your protection abide near uṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरुणप्सुरुषा अभूदकर्ज्योतिर्ऋतावरी ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: aruṇá-psuḥ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ abhūt ǀ ákaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ṛtá-varī ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purple-tinted Dawn has appeared, the mistress of the sacrifice spreads her light; le tyour protectionabide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: The purple-tinted Dawn has appeared, the mistress of the sacrifice spreads her light; le tyour protectionabide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना सु विचाकशद्वृक्षं परशुमाँ इव ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvínā ǀ sú ǀ vi-cā́kaśat ǀ vṛkṣám ǀ paraśumā́n-iva ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, the splendidly-brilliant (sun cleaves the darkness) as the woodman with his axe a tree; let yourprotection abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, the splendidly-brilliant (sun cleaves the darkness) as the woodman with his axe a tree; let yourprotection abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरं न धृष्णवा रुज कृष्णया बाधितो विशा ।अंति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.transliteration: púram ǀ ná ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ruja ǀ kṛṣṇáyā ǀ bādhitáḥ ǀ viśā́ ǀánti ǀ sát ǀ bhūtu ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O bold Saptavadhri, distressed by the entangling and detaining (basket), break through it as through acity; let your protection (Aśvins) abide near me.
verses.wilson_translation: O bold Saptavadhri, distressed by the entangling and detaining (basket), break through it as through acity; let your protection (Aśvins) abide near me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXIV. Aśvins.
hymns.anukramani: १५ गोपवन आत्रेय: ।अग्नि:, १३-१५ आर्क्ष: श्रुतर्वा ।१-१२ अनुष्टुम्मुख: प्रगाथ:= ( अनुष्टुप् + गायत्र्यौ ) १३-१५ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To this mine invocation, O ye Aśvins, ye Nāsatyas, come,To drink the savoury Soma juice. This laud of mine, ye Aśvins Twain, and this mine invitation hear,To drink the savoury Soma juice. Here Kṛṣṇa is invoking you, O Aśvins, Lords of ample wealth.To drink the savoury Soma juice. List, Heroes, to the singer's call, the call of Kṛṣṇa lauding you,To drink the savoury Soma juice. Chiefs, to the sage who sings your praise grant an inviolable home,To drink the savoury Soma juice. Come to the worshipper's abode, Aśvins, who here is lauding you,To drink the savoury Soma juice. Yoke to the firmly jointed car the ass which draws you, Lords of wealth.To drink the savoury Soma juice. Come hither, Aśvins, on your car of triple form with triple seat,To drink the savoury Soma juice. O Aśvins, O Nāsatyas, now accept with favouring grace my songs,To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sanskrit: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयंतः पुरुप्रियं ।अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: viśáḥ-viśaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ puru-priyám ǀagním ǀ vaḥ ǀ dúryam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ stuṣé ǀ śūṣásya ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Food-desiring (priests, worship)Agni, who is the guest of all mankind, beloved of many; I address tohim in your behalf a domestic homage with hymns, for the attainment of happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Food-desiring (priests, worship)Agni, who is the guest of all mankind, beloved of many; I address tohim in your behalf a domestic homage with hymns, for the attainment of happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं जनासो हविष्मंतो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिं ।प्रशंसंति प्रशस्तिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ sarpíḥ-āsutim ǀpra-śáṃsanti ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (That Agni), to whom clarified butter is offered, whom man, bearing oblations, worship with praises as afriend.
verses.wilson_translation: (That Agni), to whom clarified butter is offered, whom man, bearing oblations, worship with praises as afriend.
