verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पन्यांसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता ।हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: pányāṃsam ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ yáḥ ǀ devá-tāti ǀ út-yatā ǀhavyā́ni ǀ áirayat ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: Jātavedaqs, the earnest praiser of his worshipper, who sends to heaven the oblations presented inthe sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Jātavedaqs, the earnest praiser of his worshipper, who sends to heaven the oblations presented inthe sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आगन्म वृत्रहंतमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवं ।यस्य श्रुतर्वा बृहन्नार्क्षो अनीक एधते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ aganma ǀ vṛtrahán-tamam ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ agním ǀ ā́navam ǀyásya ǀ śrutárvā ǀ bṛhán ǀ ārkṣáḥ ǀ ánīke ǀ édhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have come to that most excellent Agni, mightiest destroyer of the wicked, the benefactor of men, inwhose army (O rays) Śruvavān, the mighty son ofṚkṣa, waxes great.
verses.wilson_translation: We have come to that most excellent Agni, mightiest destroyer of the wicked, the benefactor of men, inwhose army (O rays) Śruvavān, the mighty son ofṚkṣa, waxes great.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमृतं जातवेदसं तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतं ।घृताहवनमीड्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: amṛ́tam ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ tiráḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ darśatám ǀghṛtá-āhavanam ǀ ī́ḍyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We have come) to the immortal Jātavedas, who shows light across the darkness, well worthy ofpraise, and receiving the offering of ghī.
verses.wilson_translation: (We have come) to the immortal Jātavedas, who shows light across the darkness, well worthy ofpraise, and receiving the offering of ghī.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सबाधो यं जना इमेऽग्निं हव्येभिरीळते ।जुह्वानासो यतस्रुचः ॥
verses.transliteration: sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ yám ǀ jánāḥ ǀ imé ǀ agním ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀjúhvānāsaḥ ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: That Agni, whom these crowding worshippers honour with oblations, offering to him with up-lifted ladles.
verses.wilson_translation: That Agni, whom these crowding worshippers honour with oblations, offering to him with up-lifted ladles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं ते नव्यसी मतिरग्ने अधाय्यस्मदा ।मंद्र सुजात सुक्रतोऽमूर दस्मातिथे ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ te ǀ návyasī ǀ matíḥ ǀ ágne ǀ ádhāyi ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀmándra ǀ sú-jāta ǀ súkrato íti sú-krato ǀ ámūra ǀ dásma ǀ átithe ǁ
verses.english_translation: This new hymn has been made by us for you, O joyful, well-born Agni, glorious in deeds, unbewildered,beautiful, the guest (of man).
verses.wilson_translation: This new hymn has been made by us for you, O joyful, well-born Agni, glorious in deeds, unbewildered,beautiful, the guest (of man).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सा ते अग्ने शंतमा चनिष्ठा भवतु प्रिया ।तया वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ śám-tamā ǀ cániṣṭhā ǀ bhavatu ǀ priyā́ ǀtáyā ǀ vardhasva ǀ sú-stutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, may it be dear to you, most plural asant and most agreeable-- well praised by it, to you wax greaṭ
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, may it be dear to you, most plural asant and most agreeable-- well praised by it, to you wax greaṭ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सा द्युम्नैर्द्युम्निनी बृहदुपोप श्रवसि श्रवः ।दधीत वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: sā́ ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ dyumnínī ǀ bṛhát ǀ úpa-upa ǀ śrávasi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀdádhīta ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǁ
verses.english_translation: May this (hymn) the rich source of wealth, heap abundance on our abundance (with stores won fromour enemies) in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: May this (hymn) the rich source of wealth, heap abundance on our abundance (with stores won fromour enemies) in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमिद्गां रथप्रां त्वेषमिंद्रं न सत्पतिं ।यस्य श्रवांसि तूर्वथ पन्यंपन्यं च कृष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvam ǀ ít ǀ gā́m ǀ ratha-prā́m ǀ tveṣám ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ sát-patim ǀyásya ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ tū́rvatha ǀ pányam-panyam ǀ ca ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Worship), you men, the bright (Agni), who goes like a horse and fills our chariots (with spoil), whoprotects the good like Indra, and by whose might you ravage the stores (of your enemies) and all their wonderful(wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: (Worship), you men, the bright (Agni), who goes like a horse and fills our chariots (with spoil), whoprotects the good like Indra, and by whose might you ravage the stores (of your enemies) and all their wonderful(wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा चनिष्ठदग्ने अंगिरः ।स पावक श्रुधी हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ gopávanaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀ cániṣṭhat ǀ agne ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ śrudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, Aṅirasa, whom Gopavana by his praise has made the especial giver of food-- O purifier, hear thisprayer.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, Aṅirasa, whom Gopavana by his praise has made the especial giver of food-- O purifier, hear thisprayer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं त्वा जनास ईळते सबाधो वाजसातये ।स बोधि वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀsáḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you whom the crowding worshippers praise for the obtainment of food, attend to them for thedestruction of their enemiess.
verses.wilson_translation: O you whom the crowding worshippers praise for the obtainment of food, attend to them for thedestruction of their enemiess.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहं हुवान आर्क्षे श्रुतर्वणि मदच्युति ।शर्धांसीव स्तुकाविनां मृक्षा शीर्षा चतुर्णां ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ ārkṣé ǀ śrutárvaṇi ǀ mada-cyúti ǀśárdhāṃsi-iva ǀ stukā-vínām ǀ mṛkṣā́ ǀ śīrṣā́ ǀ caturṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Summoned before Śrutarvān, the son ofṚkṣa, the humbler of the pride of his enemies, (I stroke) withmyhandthe heads of the four horses (which he has given me), as (men stroke) the longwoolof rams.
verses.wilson_translation: Summoned before Śrutarvān, the son ofṚkṣa, the humbler of the pride of his enemies, (I stroke) withmyhandthe heads of the four horses (which he has given me), as (men stroke) the longwoolof rams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मां चत्वार आशवः शविष्ठस्य द्रवित्नवः ।सुरथासो अभि प्रयो वक्षन्वयो न तुग्र्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́m ǀ catvā́raḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ śáviṣṭhasya ǀ dravitnávaḥ ǀsu-ráthāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀ vákṣan ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ túgryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Four swift horses of that most mighty king, yoked to a splendid car, bear me forth to seize thesubstance (of my enemies), as the ships bore home the son of Tugra.
verses.wilson_translation: Four swift horses of that most mighty king, yoked to a splendid car, bear me forth to seize thesubstance (of my enemies), as the ships bore home the son of Tugra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमित्त्वा महेनदि परुष्ण्यव देदिशं ।नेमापो अश्वदातरः शविष्ठादस्ति मर्त्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: satyám ǀ ít ǀ tvā ǀ mahe-nadi ǀ páruṣṇi ǀ áva ǀ dediśam ǀná ǀ īm ǀ āpaḥ ǀ aśva-dā́taraḥ ǀ śáviṣṭhāt ǀ asti ǀ mártyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily I address you, O great river Paruṣṇi, O waters, there is no mortal who gives horses moreliberally than this most mighty (monarch).
verses.wilson_translation: Verily I address you, O great river Paruṣṇi, O waters, there is no mortal who gives horses moreliberally than this most mighty (monarch).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXV. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YE Twain are wondrous strong, well-skilled in arts that heal, both bringers of delight, ye both won Dakṣa's praise.Viśvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free. How shall he praise you now who is distraught in mind? Ye Twain give wisdom for the gainof what is good.Viśvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free. Already have ye Twain, possessors of great wealth, prospered Viṣṇāpū thus for gain of what is good.Viśvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free. And that Impetuous Hero, winner of the spoil, though he is far away, we call to succour us,Whose gracious favour, like a father's, is most sweet. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free. About the holy Law toils Savitar the God the horn of holy Law hath he spread far and wide.The holy Law hath quelled even mighty men of war. Break ye not off our ftiendship, come and act me free.

verses.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ अश्वाँ अग्ने रथीरिव ।नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ deva-hū́tamān ǀ áśvān ǀ agne ǀ rathī́ḥ-iva ǀní ǀ hótā ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, like a charioteer yoke your god-invoking steeds; eat thyself first, the invoker.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, like a charioteer yoke your god-invoking steeds; eat thyself first, the invoker.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो देव देवाँ अच्छा वोचो विदुष्टरः ।श्रद्विश्वा वार्या कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ vocaḥ ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀśrát ǀ víśvā ǀ vā́ryā ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine (Agni), proclaim us to the gods as profoundly killed; assure to us all desirable things.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine (Agni), proclaim us to the gods as profoundly killed; assure to us all desirable things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह यद्यविष्ठ्य सहसः सूनवाहुत ।ऋतावा यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ ā-huta ǀṛtá-vā ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since you are truthful and worthy of sacrifice, O most youthful, son of strength and everywherehonoured with offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: Since you are truthful and worthy of sacrifice, O most youthful, son of strength and everywherehonoured with offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः ।मूर्धा कवी रयीणां ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ śatínaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀmūrdhā́ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Agniis the lord of hundredfold and thousandfold food; he is the head, the seer, (the lord) of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: This Agniis the lord of hundredfold and thousandfold food; he is the head, the seer, (the lord) of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं नेमिमृभवो यथा नमस्व सहूतिभिः ।नेदीयो यज्ञमंगिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ nemím ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ ā́ ǀ namasva ǀ sáhūti-bhiḥ ǀnédīyaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OAṅgirasa, with the deities associated in the invocation draw this offering near you as theṚbhus(bend) the circumference of a wheel.
verses.wilson_translation: OAṅgirasa, with the deities associated in the invocation draw this offering near you as theṚbhus(bend) the circumference of a wheel.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै नूनमभिद्यवे वाचा विरूप नित्यया ।वृष्णे चोदस्व सुष्टुतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: tásmai ǀ nūnám ǀ abhí-dyave ǀ vācā́ ǀ vi-rūpa ǀ nítyayā ǀvṛ́ṣṇe ǀ codasva ǀ su-stutím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Virūpa, with constant voice address your praise to this well-plural ased showerer (of blessings).
verses.wilson_translation: Virūpa, with constant voice address your praise to this well-plural ased showerer (of blessings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कमु ष्विदस्य सेनयाग्नेरपाकचक्षसः ।पणिं गोषु स्तरामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: kám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svit ǀ asya ǀ sénayā ǀ agnéḥ ǀ ápāka-cakṣasaḥ ǀpaṇím ǀ góṣu ǀ starāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: What strong enemy shall we overthrow, to win kine, by the help of the host of this Agniof unmeasuredradiance?
verses.wilson_translation: What strong enemy shall we overthrow, to win kine, by the help of the host of this Agniof unmeasuredradiance?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो देवानां विशः प्रस्नातीरिवोस्राः ।कृशं न हासुरघ्न्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ víśaḥ ǀ prasnātī́ḥ-iva ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀkṛśám ǀ ná ǀ hāsuḥ ǀ ághnyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May he not (forasake) us, the liegemen of the gods, as the milk- streaming cows (forsake not); the kineabandon not a little (calf).
verses.wilson_translation: May he not (forasake) us, the liegemen of the gods, as the milk- streaming cows (forsake not); the kineabandon not a little (calf).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नः समस्य दूढ्यः परिद्वेषसो अंहतिः ।ऊर्मिर्न नावमा वधीत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ samasya ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ pári-dveṣasaḥ ǀ aṃhatíḥ ǀūrmíḥ ǀ ná ǀ nā́vam ǀ ā́ ǀ vadhīt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not the onset of any evil-minded adversary harm us as the wave (overwhelms) a ship.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not the onset of any evil-minded adversary harm us as the wave (overwhelms) a ship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणंति देव कृष्टयः ।अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥
verses.transliteration: námaḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ójase ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ deva ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀámaiḥ ǀ amítram ǀ ardaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, men utter your praises for the attainment of strength; by strength destroy the enemy.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, men utter your praises for the attainment of strength; by strength destroy the enemy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिं ।उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: kuvít ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-iṣṭaye ǀ ágne ǀ sam-véṣiṣaḥ ǀ rayím ǀúru-kṛt ǀ urú ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, send us abundance of wealth to satisfy our desires; giver of free space, grant us abundant rooṃ
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, send us abundance of wealth to satisfy our desires; giver of free space, grant us abundant rooṃ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा ।संवर्गं सं रयिं जय ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ asmín ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ párā ǀ vark ǀ bhāra-bhṛ́t ǀ yathā ǀsam-várgam ǀ sám ǀ rayím ǀ jaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leave us not in this conflict as a bearer his burden win for us the plural ndered wealth of our foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Leave us not in this conflict as a bearer his burden win for us the plural ndered wealth of our foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अन्यमस्मद्भिया इयमग्ने सिषक्तु दुच्छुना ।वर्धा नो अमवच्छवः ॥
verses.transliteration: anyám ǀ asmát ǀ bhiyái ǀ iyám ǀ ágne ǀ sísaktu ǀ ducchúnā ǀvárdha ǀ naḥ ǀ áma-vat ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, may your plural gues pursue some other to terrify him; increase our vigorous strength in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, may your plural gues pursue some other to terrify him; increase our vigorous strength in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्याजुषन्नमस्विनः शमीमदुर्मखस्य वा ।तं घेदग्निर्वृधावति ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ ájuṣat ǀ namasvínaḥ ǀ śámīm ǀ áduḥ-makhasya ǀ vā ǀtám ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ vṛdhā́ ǀ avati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agniespecially protects (in battle) that praiser or zealous sacrificer whose offerings he has attendeḍ
verses.wilson_translation: Agniespecially protects (in battle) that praiser or zealous sacrificer whose offerings he has attendeḍ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परस्या अधि संवतोऽवराँ अभ्या तर ।यत्राहमस्मि ताँ अव ॥
verses.transliteration: párasyāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sam-vátaḥ ǀ ávarān ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ tara ǀyátra ǀ ahám ǀ ásmi ǀ tā́n ǀ ava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deliver us wholly from the hostile army, shield those among whom I am (lord).
verses.wilson_translation: Deliver us wholly from the hostile army, shield those among whom I am (lord).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा हि ते पुरा वयमग्ने पितुर्यथावसः ।अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ purā́ ǀ vayám ǀ ágne ǀ pitúḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ ávasaḥ ǀádha ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We know your protection,Agni, as of a father in former times, therefore we (again) desire of you thathappiness.
verses.wilson_translation: We know your protection,Agni, as of a father in former times, therefore we (again) desire of you thathappiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXVI. Aśvins.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SPLENDID, O Aśvins, is your praise. Come fountain-like, to pour the stream.Of the sweet juice effused-dear is it, Chiefs, in heaven-drink like two wild bulls at a pool. Drink the libation rich in sweets, O Aśvins Twain: sit. Heroes, on the sacred grass.Do ye with joyful heart in the abode of man preserve his life by means of wealth. The Priyamedhas bid you come with all the succours that are yours.Come to his house whose holy grass is trimmed, to dear sacrifice at the morning rites. Drink ye the Soma rich in meath, ye Aśvins Twain: sit gladly on the sacred grass.So, waxen mighty, to our eulogy from heaven come ye as wild-bulls to the pool. Come to us, O ye Aśvins, now with steeds of many a varied hue,Ye Lords of splendour, wondrous, borne on paths of gold, drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law. For we the priestly singers, fain tohymn your praise, invoke you for the gain of strength.So, wondrous, fair, and famed for great deeds come to us, through our hymn, Aśvins, when ye hear.

verses.sanskrit: इमं नु मायिनं हुव इंद्रमीशानमोजसा ।मरुत्वंतं न वृंजसे ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ nú ǀ māyínam ǀ huve ǀ índram ǀ ī́śānam ǀ ójasā ǀmarútvantam ǀ ná ǀ vṛñjáse ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke now for the destruction of my enemies the wise Indraattended by the Maruts, ruling all by hispower.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke now for the destruction of my enemies the wise Indraattended by the Maruts, ruling all by hispower.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयमिंद्रो मरुत्सखा वि वृत्रस्याभिनच्छिरः ।वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ índraḥ ǀ marút-sakhā ǀ ví ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ abhinat ǀ śíraḥ ǀvájreṇa ǀ śatá-parvaṇā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, attended by the Maruts, has cleft the head of Vṛtrawith his hundred-jointed thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, attended by the Maruts, has cleft the head of Vṛtrawith his hundred-jointed thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वावृधानो मरुत्सखेंद्रो वि वृत्रमैरयत् ।सृजन्त्समुद्रिया अपः ॥
verses.transliteration: vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ marút-sakhā ǀ índraḥ ǀ ví ǀ vṛtrám ǀ airayat ǀsṛján ǀ samudríyāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraincreasing in might, attended by the Maruts, has torn Vṛtraasunder, letting loose the waters ofthe firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraincreasing in might, attended by the Maruts, has torn Vṛtraasunder, letting loose the waters ofthe firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं ह येन वा इदं स्वर्मरुत्वता जितं ।इंद्रेण सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ ha ǀ yéna ǀ vái ǀ idám ǀ sváḥ ǀ marútvatā ǀ jitám ǀíndreṇa ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: This is that Indra, by whom assisted by the Maruts, yonder heaven was conquered, to quaff the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: This is that Indra, by whom assisted by the Maruts, yonder heaven was conquered, to quaff the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वंतमृजीषिणमोजस्वंतं विरप्शिनं ।इंद्रं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: marútvantam ǀ ṛjīṣíṇam ǀ ójasvantam ǀ vi-rapśínam ǀíndram ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke with our praises the mighty Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, the vigorous accepter of theresidue of the Somaoblation.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke with our praises the mighty Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, the vigorous accepter of theresidue of the Somaoblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं प्रत्नेन मन्मना मरुत्वंतं हवामहे ।अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ pratnéna ǀ mánmanā ǀ marútvantam ǀ havāmahe ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: With an ancient hymn we invoke Indrawith the Maruts, to drink tis Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: With an ancient hymn we invoke Indrawith the Maruts, to drink tis Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वाँ इंद्र मीढ्वः पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो ।अस्मिन्यज्ञे पुरुष्टुत ॥
verses.transliteration: marútvān ǀ indra ǀ mīḍhvaḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀasmín ǀ yajñé ǀ puru-stuta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra,Śatakratu, showerer (of blessings), drink the Somaat this offering, accompanied by the Maruts,O invoked of many.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra,Śatakratu, showerer (of blessings), drink the Somaat this offering, accompanied by the Maruts,O invoked of many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्येदिंद्र मरुत्वते सुताः सोमासो अद्रिवः ।हृदा हूयंत उक्थिनः ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhya ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ marútvate ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀhṛdā́ ǀ hūyante ǀ ukthínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thunderer Indra, to you with the Marutsare these Soma-libations effused-- they are offered to you infaith, with recited hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: Thunderer Indra, to you with the Marutsare these Soma-libations effused-- they are offered to you infaith, with recited hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबेदिंद्र मरुत्सखा सुतं सोमं दिविष्टिषु ।वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: píba ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ marút-sakhā ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǀvájram ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink,Indra, with your friends the Maruts, this Somaeffused on the recurring sacred days, and sharpenyour thunderbolt with (renewed) vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink,Indra, with your friends the Maruts, this Somaeffused on the recurring sacred days, and sharpenyour thunderbolt with (renewed) vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः ।सोममिंद्र चमू सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ut-tíṣṭhan ǀ ójasā ǀ sahá ǀ pītvī́ ǀ śípre íti ǀ avepayaḥ ǀsómam ǀ indra ǀ camū́ íti ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rising up in your strength,Indra, you did shake your jaws, when you had quaffed the Somapressedbetween the two boards.
verses.wilson_translation: Rising up in your strength,Indra, you did shake your jaws, when you had quaffed the Somapressedbetween the two boards.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे क्रक्षमाणमकृपेतां ।इंद्र यद्दस्युहाभवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ tvā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ krákṣamāṇam ǀ akṛpetām ǀíndra ǀ yát ǀ dasyu-hā́ ǀ ábhavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let heaven and earth follow you,Indra, as you smile, when you beat down the Dasyu.
verses.wilson_translation: Let heaven and earth follow you,Indra, as you smile, when you beat down the Dasyu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतस्पृशं ।इंद्रात्परि तन्वं ममे ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́cam ǀ aṣṭā́-padīm ǀ ahám ǀ náva-sraktim ǀ ṛta-spṛ́śam ǀíndrāt ǀ pári ǀ tanvám ǀ mame ǁ
verses.english_translation: I make this sacrificial hymn, reaching to the eight points (of the sky) and rising to a ninth (the sun in thezenith), though it is less than (the dimensions of)Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: I make this sacrificial hymn, reaching to the eight points (of the sky) and rising to a ninth (the sun in thezenith), though it is less than (the dimensions of)Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXVII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ११ कुरुसुति: काण्व:। इन्द्र: ।गायत्री, १० -११ प्रगाथ:= ( बृहती,   सतोबृहती) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorifyThis Indra, even your Wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice. Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things,Him swift we seek. for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold. Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way.None stay that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise. A Warrior thou by strength, wisdom, and wondrous deed, in might excellest all that is.Hither may this our hymn attract thee to our help, the hymn which Gotamas have made. For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the boundaries of heaven.The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. After thy Godhead hast thou waxed. When, Maghavan, thou honourest the worshipper, no one is there to stay thy wealth.Most liberal Giver thou, do thou inspire our song of praise, that we may win the spoil.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञानो नु शतक्रतुर्वि पृच्छदिति मातरं ।क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
verses.transliteration: jajñānáḥ ǀ nú ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀ ví ǀ pṛcchat ǀ íti ǀ mātáram ǀké ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǀ ké ǀ ha ǀ śṛṇvire ǁ
verses.english_translation: As soon as he was bornŚatakratuasked his mother, who are the mgihty, who are renowned?
verses.wilson_translation: As soon as he was bornŚatakratuasked his mother, who are the mgihty, who are renowned?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदीं शवस्यब्रवीदौर्णवाभमहीशुवं ।ते पुत्र संतु निष्टुरः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ śavasī́ ǀ abravīt ǀ aurṇa-vābhám ǀ ahīśúvam ǀté ǀ putra ǀ santu ǀ niḥ-túraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: His strong mother answered, -- Aurṇavābha and Ahiṣuva, be these, my son the foes who you shallovercome.
verses.wilson_translation: His strong mother answered, -- Aurṇavābha and Ahiṣuva, be these, my son the foes who you shallovercome.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समित्तान्वृत्रहाखिदत्खे अराँ इव खेदया ।प्रवृद्धो दस्युहाभवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ít ǀ tā́n ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ akhidat ǀ khé ǀ arā́n-iva ǀ khédayā ǀprá-vṛddhaḥ ǀ dasyu-hā́ ǀ abhavat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The slayer of Vṛtradragged them along as spokes (are tied fast) with a rope in the nave of a chariotwheel; he swelled in vigour, the slayer of enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: The slayer of Vṛtradragged them along as spokes (are tied fast) with a rope in the nave of a chariotwheel; he swelled in vigour, the slayer of enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एकया प्रतिधापिबत्साकं सरांसि त्रिंशतं ।इंद्रः सोमस्य काणुका ॥
verses.transliteration: ékayā ǀ prati-dhā́ ǀ apibat ǀ sākám ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ triṃśátam ǀíndraḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ kāṇukā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: At one draught Indradrank at once thirty lakes filled wiḥSoma.
verses.wilson_translation: At one draught Indradrank at once thirty lakes filled wiḥSoma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि गंधर्वमतृणदबुध्नेषु रजस्स्वा ।इंद्रो ब्रह्मभ्य इद्वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ gandharvám ǀ atṛṇat ǀ abudhnéṣu ǀ rájaḥ-su ǀ ā́ ǀíndraḥ ǀ brahmá-bhyaḥ ǀ ít ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: In the realms (of the sky) where the foot finds no resting-plural ce,Indrashattered the cloud to bringincrease to thebrāhmaṇas.
verses.wilson_translation: In the realms (of the sky) where the foot finds no resting-plural ce,Indrashattered the cloud to bringincrease to thebrāhmaṇas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निराविध्यद्गिरिभ्य आ धारयत्पक्वमोदनं ।इंद्रो बुंदं स्वाततं ॥
verses.transliteration: níḥ ǀ avidhyat ǀ girí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhāráyat ǀ pakvám ǀ odanám ǀíndraḥ ǀ bundám ǀ sú-ātatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indrasmote (rain) from the clouds with his far-stretched arrow, he secured boiled rice (for men).
verses.wilson_translation: Indrasmote (rain) from the clouds with his far-stretched arrow, he secured boiled rice (for men).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतब्रध्न इषुस्तव सहस्रपर्ण एक इत् ।यमिंद्र चकृषे युजं ॥
verses.transliteration: śatá-bradhnaḥ ǀ íṣuḥ ǀ táva ǀ sahásra-parṇaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀyám ǀ indra ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ yújam ǁ
verses.english_translation: That single shaft of yours,Indra, which you make your ally, is hundred-pointed, thousand-feathered.
verses.wilson_translation: That single shaft of yours,Indra, which you make your ally, is hundred-pointed, thousand-feathered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तेन स्तोतृभ्य आ भर नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो अत्तवे ।सद्यो जात ऋभुष्ठिर ॥
verses.transliteration: téna ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ nā́ri-bhyaḥ ǀ áttave ǀsadyáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ṛbhu-sthira ǁ
verses.english_translation: Forthwith increased (by our offerings), do you, mighty and firm, by that (weapon) brin (wealth) forsustenance to us your praisers, our children, and our wives.
verses.wilson_translation: Forthwith increased (by our offerings), do you, mighty and firm, by that (weapon) brin (wealth) forsustenance to us your praisers, our children, and our wives.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एता च्यौत्नानि ते कृता वर्षिष्ठानि परीणसा ।हृदा वीड्वधारयः ॥
verses.transliteration: etā́ ǀ cyautnā́ni ǀ te ǀ kṛtā́ ǀ várṣiṣṭhāni ǀ párīṇasā ǀhṛdā́ ǀ vīḷú ǀ adhārayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These gigantic far-reaching efforts were put forth by you; you did fix them firm in your thought.
verses.wilson_translation: These gigantic far-reaching efforts were put forth by you; you did fix them firm in your thought.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेत्ता विष्णुराभरदुरुक्रमस्त्वेषितः ।शतं महिषान्क्षीरपाकमोदनं वराहमिंद्र एमुषं ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abharat ǀ uru-kramáḥ ǀ tvā́-iṣitaḥ ǀśatám ǀ mahiṣā́n ǀ kṣīra-pākám ǀ odanám ǀ varāhám ǀ índraḥ ǀ emuṣám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wide-traversing Sun, despatched by you, brings (to the world) all these (waters which you create);he brings hundreds of cattle and rice boiled in milk; it is Indrawho slays the water-stealing boar.
verses.wilson_translation: The wide-traversing Sun, despatched by you, brings (to the world) all these (waters which you create);he brings hundreds of cattle and rice boiled in milk; it is Indrawho slays the water-stealing boar.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुविक्षं ते सुकृतं सूमयं धनुः साधुर्बुंदो हिरण्ययः ।उभा ते बाहू रण्या सुसंस्कृत ऋदूपे चिदृदूवृधा ॥
verses.transliteration: tuvi-kṣám ǀ te ǀ sú-kṛtam ǀ su-máyam ǀ dhánuḥ ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ bundáḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ te ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ ráṇyā ǀ sú-saṃskṛtā ǀ ṛdu-pé ǀ cit ǀ ṛdu-vṛ́dhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Far-darting is your well-made auspicious bow, unfailing is your golden arrow; your two warlike arms areready equipped, destructively overthrowing, destructively piercing.
verses.wilson_translation: Far-darting is your well-made auspicious bow, unfailing is your golden arrow; your two warlike arms areready equipped, destructively overthrowing, destructively piercing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXVIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts that slays the Vṛtras best.Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes. Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us.Indra, refulgent with thy Marut host! the Gods strove eagerly to win thy love. Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise.Let Śatakratu, Vṛtra-slayer, kill the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt. Aim and fetch boldly forth, O thou whose heart is bold: great glory will be thine thereby.In rapid torrent let the mother waters spread. Slay Vṛtra, win the light of heaven. When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vṛtras dead,Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens. Theri was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy,Thou in thy might surpassest all, all that now is and yet shall be. Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Sūrya rise to heaven.,Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sāma hymns, great joy to him who loves the song.

verses.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं नो अंधस इंद्र सहस्रमा भर ।शता च शूर गोनां ॥
verses.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ naḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ índra ǀ sahásram ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀśatā́ ǀ ca ǀ śūra ǀ gónām ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Accepting) our offering of sacrificial viands, O hero Indra, bring us thousands and hundreds of cows.
verses.wilson_translation: (Accepting) our offering of sacrificial viands, O hero Indra, bring us thousands and hundreds of cows.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो भर व्यंजनं गामश्वमभ्यंजनं ।सचा मना हिरण्यया ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ vi-áñjanam ǀ gā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ abhi-áñjanam ǀsácā ǀ manā́ ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us condiments, cows, horses, and oil, (bring us) with them precious golden (vessels).
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us condiments, cows, horses, and oil, (bring us) with them precious golden (vessels).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नः कर्णशोभना पुरूणि धृष्णवा भर ।त्वं हि शृण्विषे वसो ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ karṇa-śóbhanā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ śṛṇviṣé ǀ vaso íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: O resolute one, bring us many ear-ornaments; giver of dwellings, you are renowned.
verses.wilson_translation: O resolute one, bring us many ear-ornaments; giver of dwellings, you are renowned.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकीं वृधीक इंद्र ते न सुषा न सुदा उत ।नान्यस्त्वच्छूर वाघतः ॥
verses.transliteration: nákīm ǀ vṛdhīkáḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ná ǀ su-sā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ su-dā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀná ǀ anyáḥ ǀ tvát ǀ śūra ǀ vāghátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: There is no prosperer other than you, no divider of the spoil, no giver of boons; O hero, there is no(leader) of the sacrificer other than you.
verses.wilson_translation: There is no prosperer other than you, no divider of the spoil, no giver of boons; O hero, there is no(leader) of the sacrificer other than you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकीमिंद्रो निकर्तवे न शक्रः परिशक्तवे ।विश्वं शृणोति पश्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: nákīm ǀ índraḥ ǀ ní-kartave ǀ ná ǀ śakráḥ ǀ pári-śaktave ǀvíśvam ǀ śṛṇoti ǀ páśyati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indracannot be brought low, he cannot be over-powered-- he hears, he sees all.
verses.wilson_translation: Indracannot be brought low, he cannot be over-powered-- he hears, he sees all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मन्युं मर्त्यानामदब्धो नि चिकीषते ।पुरा निदश्चिकीषते ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ manyúm ǀ mártyānām ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ ní ǀ cikīṣate ǀpurā́ ǀ nidáḥ ǀ cikīṣate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Unharmed he brings low the wrath of mortals; ere any one can reproach him, he brings him low.
verses.wilson_translation: Unharmed he brings low the wrath of mortals; ere any one can reproach him, he brings him low.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रत्व इत्पूर्णमुदरं तुरस्यास्ति विधतः ।वृत्रघ्नः सोमपाव्नः ॥
verses.transliteration: krátvaḥ ǀ ít ǀ pūrṇám ǀ udáram ǀ turásya ǀ asti ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀvṛtra-ghnáḥ ǀ soma-pā́vnaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The belly of the Soma-drinker, the eager slayer of Vṛtra, is filled by the sacrificer's offering.
verses.wilson_translation: The belly of the Soma-drinker, the eager slayer of Vṛtra, is filled by the sacrificer's offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वे वसूनि संगता विश्वा च सोम सौभगा ।सुदात्वपरिह्वृता ॥
verses.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ vásūni ǀ sám-gatā ǀ víśvā ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ sáubhagā ǀsu-dā́tu ǀ ápari-hvṛtā ǁ
verses.english_translation: In you, O drinker of the Soma, are treasures stored, and all precious things and unblemished giftṣ
verses.wilson_translation: In you, O drinker of the Soma, are treasures stored, and all precious things and unblemished giftṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिद्यवयुर्मम कामो गव्युर्हिरण्ययुः ।त्वामश्वयुरेषते ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ yava-yúḥ ǀ máma ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ hiraṇya-yúḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ aśva-yúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǁ
verses.english_translation: To you my desire astens, seeking barley, cows and gold-- to you it hastens seeking horses.
verses.wilson_translation: To you my desire astens, seeking barley, cows and gold-- to you it hastens seeking horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवेदिंद्राहमाशसा हस्ते दात्रं चना ददे ।दिनस्य वा मघवन्त्संभृतस्य वा पूर्धि यवस्य काशिना ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ ahám ǀ ā-śásā ǀ háste ǀ dā́tram ǀ caná ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀdinásya ǀ vā ǀ magha-van ǀ sám-bhṛtasya ǀ vā ǀ pūrdhí ǀ yávasya ǀ kāśínā ǁ
verses.english_translation: I take my sickle also inhand,Indra, with a prayer to you; fill it,Maghavan, with a handful of barleyalready cut or piled.
verses.wilson_translation: I take my sickle also inhand,Indra, with a prayer to you; fill it,Maghavan, with a handful of barleyalready cut or piled.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXIX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY Indra, who in every fight must be invoked, be near to us.May the most mighty Vṛtra-slayer, meet for praise, come to libations and to hymns. Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gifts, true art thou, lordly in thine act.We claim alliance with the very Glorious One, yea, with the Mighty Son of Strength. Prayers unsurpassed are offered up to thee the Lover of the Song.Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, accept these fitting hymns, hymns which we have thought out for thee. For thou, O Maghavan, art truthful, ne’er subdued and bringest many a Vṛtra low.As such, O Mightiest Lord, Wielder of Thunder, send wealth hither to the worshipper. O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous, O Lord of Strength.Alone thou slayest with the guardian of mankind resistless never-conquered foes. As such we seek thee now, O Asura, thee most wise, craving thy bounty as our share.Thy sheltering defence is like a mighty cloak. So may thy glories reach to us.

verses.sanskrit: अयं कृत्नुरगृभीतो विश्वजिदुद्भिदित्सोमः ।ऋषिर्विप्रः काव्येन ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ kṛtnúḥ ǀ ágṛbhītaḥ ǀ viśva-jít ǀ ut-bhít ǀ ít ǀ sómaḥ ǀṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ kā́vyena ǁ
verses.english_translation: This all-creating Soma, obstructed by none, the conqueror of all, the producer of fruit, the seer, thewise, (is to be praised) with a hymn.
verses.wilson_translation: This all-creating Soma, obstructed by none, the conqueror of all, the producer of fruit, the seer, thewise, (is to be praised) with a hymn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यूर्णोति यन्नग्नं भिषक्ति विश्वं यत्तुरं ।प्रेमंधः ख्यन्निः श्रोणो भूत् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ ūrṇoti ǀ yát ǀ nagnám ǀ bhiṣákti ǀ víśvam ǀ yát ǀ turám ǀprá ǀ īm ǀ andháḥ ǀ khyat ǀ níḥ ǀ śroṇáḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
verses.english_translation: He covers what is naked, he heals all that is sick, the blind sees, the lame walks.
verses.wilson_translation: He covers what is naked, he heals all that is sick, the blind sees, the lame walks.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्योऽन्यकृतेभ्यः ।उरु यंतासि वरूथं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ tanūkṛ́t-bhyaḥ ǀ dvéṣaḥ-bhyaḥ ǀ anyá-kṛtebhyaḥ ǀurú ǀ yantā́ ǀ asi ǀ várūtham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, you offer us a wide shelter from the wasting enmities wrought by our foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, you offer us a wide shelter from the wasting enmities wrought by our foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं चित्ती तव दक्षैर्दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन् ।यावीरघस्य चिद्द्वेषः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ cittī́ ǀ táva ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀyā́vīḥ ǀ aghásya ǀ cit ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Ṛjīṣin, by you wisdom and might drive away the enmity of our oppressor from the heaven andearth.
verses.wilson_translation: O Ṛjīṣin, by you wisdom and might drive away the enmity of our oppressor from the heaven andearth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्थिनो यंति चेदर्थं गच्छानिद्ददुषो रातिं ।ववृज्युस्तृष्यतः कामं ॥
verses.transliteration: arthínaḥ ǀ yánti ǀ ca ǀ ít ǀ ártham ǀ gácchān ǀ ít ǀ dadúṣaḥ ǀ rātím ǀvavṛjyúḥ ǀ tṛ́ṣyataḥ ǀ kā́mam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The petitioners seek for wealth, they attend the bounty of the liberal; (by you) men pour out the desireof the thirsty.
verses.wilson_translation: The petitioners seek for wealth, they attend the bounty of the liberal; (by you) men pour out the desireof the thirsty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विदद्यत्पूर्व्यं नष्टमुदीमृतायुमीरयत् ।प्रेमायुस्तारीदतीर्णं ॥
verses.transliteration: vidát ǀ yát ǀ pūrvyám ǀ naṣṭám ǀ út ǀ īm ǀ ṛta-yúm ǀ īrayat ǀprá ǀ īm ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ tārīt ǀ átīrṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma) urges him on when the sacrificer obtains (by offerings) him old lost wealth, he lengthen out hisunending life.
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma) urges him on when the sacrificer obtains (by offerings) him old lost wealth, he lengthen out hisunending life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुशेवो नो मृळयाकुरदृप्तक्रतुरवातः ।भवा नः सोम शं हृदे ॥
verses.transliteration: su-śévaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷayā́kuḥ ǀ ádṛpta-kratuḥ ǀ avātáḥ ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ śám ǀ hṛdé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most gracious and conferring joy, void of pride in your acts, and never failing, dwell,Soma, auspiciouslyin our hearts.
verses.wilson_translation: Most gracious and conferring joy, void of pride in your acts, and never failing, dwell,Soma, auspiciouslyin our hearts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नः सोम सं वीविजो मा वि बीभिषथा राजन् ।मा नो हार्दि त्विषा वधीः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ sám ǀ vīvijaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ bībhiṣathāḥ ǀ rājan ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ hā́rdi ǀ tviṣā́ ǀ vadhīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OSoma, cause us not to tremble, frighten us not, O king; smite not our hearts with your brightness.
verses.wilson_translation: OSoma, cause us not to tremble, frighten us not, O king; smite not our hearts with your brightness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव यत्स्वे सधस्थे देवानां दुर्मतीरीक्षे ।राजन्नप द्विषः सेध मीढ्वो अप स्रिधः सेध ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ yát ǀ své ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ devā́nām ǀ duḥ-matī́ḥ ǀ ī́kṣe ǀrā́jan ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ sedha ǀ mī́ḍhvaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǀ sedha ǁ
verses.english_translation: ���When in my house I watch against the enemies of the gods, then, O kind, drive away those who hateus-- O showerer of blessings, drive away those who would harm us.
verses.wilson_translation: ���When in my house I watch against the enemies of the gods, then, O kind, drive away those who hateus-- O showerer of blessings, drive away those who would harm us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . DOWN to the stream a maiden came, and found the Soma by the way.Bearing it to her home she said, For Indra will I press thee out, for Śakra will I press thee out. Thou roaming yonder, little man, beholding every house in turn,Drink thou this Soma pressed with teeth, accompanied with grain and curds, with cake of meal and song of praise. Fain would we learn to know thee well, nor yet can we attain to thee.Still slowly and in gradual drops, O Indu, unto Indra flow. Will he not help and work for us? Will he not make us wealthier?Shall we not, hostile to our lord, unite ourselves to Indra now? O Indra, cause to sprout again three places, these which I declare,—My father's head, his cultured field, and this the part below my waist. Make all of these grow crops of hair, you cultivated field of ours,My body, and my father's head. Cleansing Apala, Indra! thrice, thou gavest sunlike skin to her,Drawn, Śatakratu! through the hole of car, of wagon, and of yoke.

verses.sanskrit: नह्यन्यं बळाकरं मर्डितारं शतक्रतो ।त्वं न इंद्र मृळय ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ anyám ǀ baḷā́ ǀ ákaram ǀ marḍitā́ram ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Other than you,Śatakratu, I know no bestower of happiness;Indra, do you make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Other than you,Śatakratu, I know no bestower of happiness;Indra, do you make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो नः शश्वत्पुराविथामृध्रो वाजसातये ।स त्वं न इंद्र मृळय ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śáśvat ǀ purā́ ǀ ā́vitha ǀ ámṛdhraḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you, the invulnerable, who have always in former times protected us for the battle, do you,Indra,make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: O you, the invulnerable, who have always in former times protected us for the battle, do you,Indra,make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: किमंग रध्रचोदनः सुन्वानस्यावितेदसि ।कुवित्स्विंद्र णः शकः ॥
verses.transliteration: kím ǀ aṅgá ǀ radhra-códanaḥ ǀ sunvānásya ǀ avitā́ ǀ ít ǀ asi ǀkuvít ǀ sú ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ śákaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Director of the worshipper, you are the guardian of the offerer; help us mightily.
verses.wilson_translation: Director of the worshipper, you are the guardian of the offerer; help us mightily.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र प्र णो रथमव पश्चाच्चित्संतमद्रिवः ।पुरस्तादेनं मे कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ava ǀ paścā́t ǀ cit ǀ sántam ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀpurástāt ǀ enam ǀ me ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, protect our chariot; though now left behind, set it in the front, O thunderer.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, protect our chariot; though now left behind, set it in the front, O thunderer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हंतो नु किमाससे प्रथमं नो रथं कृधि ।उपमं वाजयु श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: hánto íti ǀ nú ǀ kím ǀ āsase ǀ prathamám ǀ naḥ ǀ rátham ǀ kṛdhi ǀupa-mám ǀ vāja-yú ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Up, why sit you still? Make our chariot the first; our food-seeking offering is near you.
verses.wilson_translation: Up, why sit you still? Make our chariot the first; our food-seeking offering is near you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवा नो वाजयुं रथं सुकरं ते किमित्परि ।अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ naḥ ǀ vāja-yúm ǀ rátham ǀ su-káram ǀ te ǀ kím ǀ ít ǀ pári ǀasmā́n ǀ sú ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect our food-seeking chariot, everything is easy for you to do; make us completely victorious.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect our food-seeking chariot, everything is easy for you to do; make us completely victorious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र दृह्यस्व पूरसि भद्रा त एति निष्कृतं ।इयं धीर्ऋत्वियावती ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ dṛ́hyasva ǀ pū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ te ǀ eti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀiyám ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ ṛtvíya-vatī ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, be firm (in battle), you are (strong as) a city; to you, the repeller (of enemies), comes thisauspicious sacrifice, offered in due season.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, be firm (in battle), you are (strong as) a city; to you, the repeller (of enemies), comes thisauspicious sacrifice, offered in due season.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा सीमवद्य आ भागुर्वी काष्ठा हितं धनं ।अपावृक्ता अरत्नयः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ sīm ǀ avadyé ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāk ǀ urvī́ ǀ kā́ṣṭhā ǀ hitám ǀ dhánam ǀapa-ā́vṛktāḥ ǀ aratnáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let not reproach reach us; far off is the goal; there is the wealth stored; may our enemies be excluded.
verses.wilson_translation: Let not reproach reach us; far off is the goal; there is the wealth stored; may our enemies be excluded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुरीयं नाम यज्ञियं यदा करस्तदुश्मसि ।आदित्पतिर्न ओहसे ॥
verses.transliteration: turī́yam ǀ nā́ma ǀ yajñíyam ǀ yadā́ ǀ káraḥ ǀ tát ǀ uśmasi ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ pátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ohase ǁ
verses.english_translation: When you assume your sacrificial fourth name, we long for it; then you forthwith carry us as a protectoṛ
verses.wilson_translation: When you assume your sacrificial fourth name, we long for it; then you forthwith carry us as a protectoṛ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवीवृधद्वो अमृता अमंदीदेकद्यूर्देवा उत याश्च देवीः ।तस्मा उ राधः कृणुत प्रशस्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration: ávīvṛdhat ǀ vaḥ ǀ amṛtāḥ ǀ ámandīt ǀ eka-dyū́ḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ devīḥ ǀtásmai ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ kṛṇuta ǀ pra-śastám ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: O immortal gods and all you goddesses, Ekadyū has honoured you (with his praise) and rejoiced you(with his Soma-offering); make his substance abundant; and may (Indra), who rewards pious acts wtiḥ wealth,come speedily in the morning.
verses.wilson_translation: O immortal gods and all you goddesses, Ekadyū has honoured you (with his praise) and rejoiced you(with his Soma-offering); make his substance abundant; and may (Indra), who rewards pious acts wtiḥ wealth,come speedily in the morning.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXI. Indra
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INVITE ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice,All-conquering Śatakratu, most munificent of all who live. Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song, renowned of old:His name is Indra, tell it forth. Indra the Dancer be to us the giver of abundant strength:May he, the mighty, bring it near. Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksa's draught,The Soma juice with barley mixt. Call Indra loudly with your songs of praise to drink the Soma juice.For this is what augments his stiength. When he hath drqnk its gladdening drops, the God with vigour of a GodHath far surpassed all things that are. Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours,Him who is drawn to all our songs The Warrior not to he restrained, the Soma-drinker ne’er o’erthrown,The Chieftain of resistless might. O Indra, send us riches, thou Omniscient, worthy of our praise:Help us in the decisive fray. Even thence, O Indra, come to us with food that gives a hundred powers,With food that gives a thousand powers. We sought the wisdom of the wise. Śakra, Kine-giver, Thunder-armed!May we with steeds o’ercome in fight. We make thee, Śatakratu, find enjoyment in the songs we sing.Like cattle in the pasture lands. For, Śatakratu, Thunder-armed, all that we craved, as men are wont,All that we hoped, have we attained. Those, Son of Strength, are come to thee who cherish wishes in their heartsO Indra, none excelleth thee. So, Hero, guard us with thy care, with thy most liberal providence,Speedy, and terrible to foes. O Śatakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thineWhich is most splendid of them all Even, Indra, that carouse which slays the Vṛtras best, most widely famed,Best giver of thy power and might. For that which is thy gift we know, true Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed,Mighty One, amid all the folk. For Indra, Lover of Carouse, loud be our songs about the juice:Let poets sing the song of praise. We summon Indra to the draught, irl whom all glories rest, in whomThe seven communities rejoice. At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind:Let our songs aid and prosper it. Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea:O fndra, naught excelleth thee. Thou, wakeful Hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice,Which, Indra, is within thee now. O Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw,The drops be ready for thy forms. Now Srutakaksa sings his song that cattle and the steed may come,That Indra's very self may come. Here, Indra, thou art ready by our Soma juices shed for thee,Śakra, at hand that thou mayst give. Even from far away our songs reach thee, O Caster of the Stone:May we come very close to thee. For so thou art the hero's Friend, a Hero, too, art thou, and strong:So may thine heart be won to us. So hath the offering, wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers:So dwell thou, Indra, even with me. Be not thou like a slothfid priest, O Lord of spoil and wealth: rejoiceIn the pressed Soma blent with milk. O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light:This may we gain with thee for Friend. With thee to help us, Indra, let us answer all our enemies:For thou art ours and we are thine. Indra, the poets and thy friends, faithful to thee, shall loudly singThy praises as they follow thee.

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न इंद्र क्षुमंतं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय ।महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ kṣu-mántam ǀ citrám ǀ grābhám ǀ sám ǀ gṛbhāya ǀmahā-hastī́ ǀ dákṣiṇena ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, lord of the mightyhand, do you seize for us with your right hand marvellous praise-exciting(riches), worthy to be seized.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, lord of the mightyhand, do you seize for us with your right hand marvellous praise-exciting(riches), worthy to be seized.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघं ।तुविमात्रमवोभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ tuvi-kūrmím ǀ tuví-deṣṇam ǀ tuví-magham ǀtuvi-mātrám ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We know you the achiever of many great deeds, the bestower of many gifts, the lord of much wealth,vast in size, and full of protection (for your worshippeers).
verses.wilson_translation: We know you the achiever of many great deeds, the bestower of many gifts, the lord of much wealth,vast in size, and full of protection (for your worshippeers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्संतं ।भीमं न गां वारयंते ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ tvā ǀ śūra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ dítsantam ǀbhīmám ǀ ná ǀ gā́m ǀ vāráyante ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hero, when you desire to give, neither gods nor men can stay you, as (they cannot stay) a terrible bull.
verses.wilson_translation: Hero, when you desire to give, neither gods nor men can stay you, as (they cannot stay) a terrible bull.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतो न्विंद्रं स्तवामेशानं वस्वः स्वराजं ।न राधसा मर्धिषन्नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ita ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ índram ǀ stávāma ǀ ī́śānam ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ sva-rā́jam ǀná ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ mardhiṣat ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten here, let us glorify Indrathe lord of wealth, the self- resplendent, let none vex, us by his wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten here, let us glorify Indrathe lord of wealth, the self- resplendent, let none vex, us by his wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र स्तोषदुप गासिषच्छ्रवत्साम गीयमानं ।अभि राधसा जुगुरत् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ stoṣat ǀ úpa ǀ gāsiṣat ǀ śrávat ǀ sā́ma ǀ gīyámānam ǀabhí ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ jugurat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (Indra) sing the prelude, may he sing the accompaniment, may he listen to our hymn as it ischanted; may he, endowed with wealth, accept us favourably.
verses.wilson_translation: May (Indra) sing the prelude, may he sing the accompaniment, may he listen to our hymn as it ischanted; may he, endowed with wealth, accept us favourably.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो भर दक्षिणेनाभि सव्येन प्र मृश ।इंद्र मा नो वसोर्निर्भाक् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ dákṣiṇena ǀ abhí ǀ savyéna ǀ prá ǀ mṛśa ǀíndra ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vásoḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ bhāk ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us (gifts) with your righthand, and with your left bestow them on us; exclude us not,Indra, fromwealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us (gifts) with your righthand, and with your left bestow them on us; exclude us not,Indra, fromwealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप क्रमस्वा भर धृषता धृष्णो जनानां ।अदाशूष्टरस्य वेदः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ kramasva ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ jánānām ǀádāśūḥ-tarasya ǀ védaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come here, and bring us, daring one, with your resolute (mind), the wealth of him who is pre-eminentlya niggard among men.
verses.wilson_translation: Come here, and bring us, daring one, with your resolute (mind), the wealth of him who is pre-eminentlya niggard among men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र य उ नु ते अस्ति वाजो विप्रेभिः सनित्वः ।अस्माभिः सु तं सनुहि ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ yáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ sánitvaḥ ǀasmā́bhiḥ ǀ sú ǀ tám ǀ sanuhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: OIndra, give us abundantly that wealth is yours, and which is to be obtained by the wise (worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: OIndra, give us abundantly that wealth is yours, and which is to be obtained by the wise (worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजुवस्ते वाजा अस्मभ्यं विश्वश्चंद्राः ।वशैश्च मक्षू जरंते ॥
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ-júvaḥ ǀ te ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ viśvá-candrāḥ ǀváśaiḥ ǀ ca ǀ makṣú ǀ jarante ǁ
verses.english_translation: May your all-rejoicing riches speedily come to us; full of desires, men immediately offer their praises.
verses.wilson_translation: May your all-rejoicing riches speedily come to us; full of desires, men immediately offer their praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SURYA, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth,Who hurls the bolt and works for man Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down,Slew Vṛtra and smote Ahi dead. This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad streamRiches in horses, kine, and corn. Whatever, Vṛtra-slayer! thou, Sūrya, hast risen upon to-day,Tbat, Indra, all is in thy power. When, Mighty One, Lord of the brave, thou thinkest thus, I shall not die,That thought of thine is true indeed. Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee,Both far away and near at hand. We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vṛtra dead:A vigorous Hero shall he be. Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty, o’er the joyous draught.Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song. By song as ’twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was preparedLofty, invincible he grew. Indra, Song-lover, lauded, make even in the wilds fair ways for us,Whenever, Maghavan, thou wilt. Thou whose commandment and behest of sovran sway none disregards,Neither audacious man nor God. And both these Goddesses, Earth, Heaven, Lord of the beauteous helm! revereThy might which no one may resist. Thou in the black cows and the red and in the cows with spotted skinThis white milk hast deposited. When in their terror all the Gods shrank from the Dragon's furious might,Fear of the monster fell on them. Then he was my Defender, then, Invincible, whose foe is not,The Vṛtra-slayer showed his might. Him your best Vṛtra-slayer, him the famous Champion of mankindI urge to great munificence, To come, Much-lauded! Many-named with this same thought that longs for milk,Whene’er the Soma juice is shed. Much-honoured by libations, may the Vṛtra-slayer wake for us:May Śakra listen to our prayers. O Hero, with that aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bringRiches to those who worship thee? With whose libation joys the Strong, the Hero with his team who quellsThe foe, to drink the Soma juice? Rejoicing in thy spirit bring thousandfold opulence to us:Enrich thy votary with gifts. These juices with their wedded wives flow to enjoyment lovingly:To waters speeds the restless one. Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice,With might, onto the cleansing bath. These two who share his feast, Bay Steeds with golden manes, shall bring him toThe banquet that is laid for him. For thee, O Lord of Light, are shed these Soma-drops, and grass is strewnBring Indra to his worshippers. May Indra give thee skill, and lights of heaven, wealth to his votaryAnd priests who praise him: laud ye him. O Śatakratu, wondrous strength and all our lauds I bring to thee:Be gracious to thy worshippers. Bring to us all things excellent, O Śatakratu, food and strength:For, Indra, thou art kind to us.§ O Śatakratu, bring to us all blessings, all felicity:Fbr, Indra, thou art kind to us. Bearing the Soma juice we call, best Vṛtra-slayer, unto thee:For, Indra, thou art kind to us. Come, Lord of rapturous, joys, to our libation with thy Bay Steeds, comeTo our libation with thy Steeds. Known as best Vṛtra-slayer erst, as Indra Śatakratu, comeWith Bay Steeds to the juice we shed. O Vṛtra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma: comeWith Bay Steeds to the juice we shed. May Indra give, to aid us, wealth handy that rules the Skilful Ones:Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth.

verses.sanskrit: आ प्र द्रव परावतोऽर्वावतश्च वृत्रहन् ।मध्वः प्रति प्रभर्मणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ prá ǀ drava ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ arvā-vátaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ práti ǀ prá-bharmaṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten, slayer of Vṛtra, from afar or from near to the exhilarating (Soma-libations) in the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten, slayer of Vṛtra, from afar or from near to the exhilarating (Soma-libations) in the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तीव्राः सोमास आ गहि सुतासो मादयिष्णवः ।पिबा दधृग्यथोचिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: tīvrā́ḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ mādayiṣṇávaḥ ǀpíba ǀ dadhṛ́k ǀ yáthā ǀ ociṣé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come here, the strong intoxicating Somais effused; drink, since you are boldly devoted to it.
verses.wilson_translation: Come here, the strong intoxicating Somais effused; drink, since you are boldly devoted to it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इषा मंदस्वादु तेऽरं वराय मन्यवे ।भुवत्त इंद्र शं हृदे ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣā́ ǀ mandasva ǀ ā́t ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ áram ǀ várāya ǀ manyáve ǀbhúvat ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ śám ǀ hṛdé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rejoice yourself with this food-- may it forthwith avail to (quench) your foe-restraining anger, may itproduce happiness,Indra, in your heart.
verses.wilson_translation: Rejoice yourself with this food-- may it forthwith avail to (quench) your foe-restraining anger, may itproduce happiness,Indra, in your heart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वशत्रवा गहि न्युक्थानि च हूयसे ।उपमे रोचने दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ aśatro íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ ní ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ ca ǀ hūyase ǀupa-mé ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you who have no enemies, come here; you are summoned from the resplendent heaven to the hymnsat this our rite near athandin this world illumined (by the sacred rites).
verses.wilson_translation: O you who have no enemies, come here; you are summoned from the resplendent heaven to the hymnsat this our rite near athandin this world illumined (by the sacred rites).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यायमद्रिभिः सुतो गोभिः श्रीतो मदाय कं ।प्र सोम इंद्र हूयते ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhya ǀ ayám ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ śrītáḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀprá ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ hūyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, this Soma, effused for you by the stones and mixed with milk, is offered auspiciously (in the fire)for your exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, this Soma, effused for you by the stones and mixed with milk, is offered auspiciously (in the fire)for your exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र श्रुधि सु मे हवमस्मे सुतस्य गोमतः ।वि पीतिं तृप्तिमश्नुहि ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ śrudhí ǀ sú ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ asmé íti ǀ sutásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀví ǀ pītím ǀ tṛptím ǀ aśnuhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hear with favour my call; be present at the drinking of this our libation mixed with milk and besatisfied.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hear with favour my call; be present at the drinking of this our libation mixed with milk and besatisfied.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य इंद्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः ।पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ camaséṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ te ǀ sutáḥ ǀpíba ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever Somahas been poured into the cups and the bowls for you, drink it,Indra-- you are thesovereign.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever Somahas been poured into the cups and the bowls for you, drink it,Indra-- you are thesovereign.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो अप्सु चंद्रमा इव सोमश्चमूषु ददृशे ।पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ candrámāḥ-iva ǀ sómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ dádṛśe ǀpíba ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever Somais seen in the vessels like the moon (reflected) in the waters, drink it-- you are thesovereign.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever Somais seen in the vessels like the moon (reflected) in the waters, drink it-- you are thesovereign.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यं ते श्येनः पदाभरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतं ।पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ te ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ padā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ ábharat ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ áspṛtam ǀpíba ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever Somathe hawk bore for you with its feet, having won it, till then inviolate, from the (guardiansof the) upper worlds, drink it-- you are the sovereign.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever Somathe hawk bore for you with its feet, having won it, till then inviolate, from the (guardiansof the) upper worlds, drink it-- you are the sovereign.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXIII. Maruts.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Cow, the famous Mother of the wealthy Maruts, pours her milk:Both horses of the cars are yoked,— She in whose bosom all the Gods, and Sun and Moon for men to see,Maintain their everlasting Laws. This all the pious sing to us, and sacred poets evermore:The Maruts to the Soma-draught Here is the Soma ready pressed of this the Maruts drink, of thisSelf-luminous the Aśvins drink. Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant,Drink Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman. And Indra, like the Herald Priest, desirous of the milky juice,At early morn will quaff thereof. When have the Princes gleamed and shone through waters as through troops of foes'?When hasten they whose might ispure? What favour do I claim this day of yougreat Deities, you who areWondrously splendid in yourselves? call, to drink the Soma, those Maruts who spread all realms of earthAnd luminous regions of the sky. You, even such, pure in your might, you, O ye Maruts, I invokeFrom heaven to drink this Somajuice. The Maruts, those who have sustained and propped the heavens and earth apart,I call to drink this Soma juice. That vigorous band of Maruts that abidetb in the mountains, IInvoke to drink this Soma juice.

verses.english_translation: We solicit that might protection of the desire-raining deities in our own behalf, for our own help.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit that might protection of the desire-raining deities in our own behalf, for our own help.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: May those (deities)Varuṇa,Mitraand Aryaman, be ever our allies and supremeley wise helpers.
verses.wilson_translation: May those (deities)Varuṇa,Mitraand Aryaman, be ever our allies and supremeley wise helpers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Charioteers of the sacrifice, do you conduct us through the many wide- spread (forces of our enemies)as in ships across the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Charioteers of the sacrifice, do you conduct us through the many wide- spread (forces of our enemies)as in ships across the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Be wealth ours,Aryaman-- wealth worthy to be praised,Varuṇa; it is wealth which we ask.
verses.wilson_translation: Be wealth ours,Aryaman-- wealth worthy to be praised,Varuṇa; it is wealth which we ask.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Mighty in wisdom, repellers of enemies, you are the lords of wealth; be not mine the wealth,Ādityas,which belongs to sin.
verses.wilson_translation: Mighty in wisdom, repellers of enemies, you are the lords of wealth; be not mine the wealth,Ādityas,which belongs to sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Bounteous deities, whether we dwell at home or go abroad on the road, we invoke you only to benourished by our oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: Bounteous deities, whether we dwell at home or go abroad on the road, we invoke you only to benourished by our oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Come to us,Indra,Viṣṇu,Maruts, andĀdityas, from the midst of these your brethren.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Indra,Viṣṇu,Maruts, andĀdityas, from the midst of these your brethren.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Bounteous (deities), we forthwith proclaim aloud that brotherhood of yours in mother's womb, (first) incommon union, then as born in diverse manner.
verses.wilson_translation: Bounteous (deities), we forthwith proclaim aloud that brotherhood of yours in mother's womb, (first) incommon union, then as born in diverse manner.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.english_translation: Bounteous (deities) with Indraas your chief, be present here in your radiance; again and again I praiseyou.
verses.wilson_translation: Bounteous (deities) with Indraas your chief, be present here in your radiance; again and again I praiseyou.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXIV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SONG-LOVER! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows.O Indra, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves. Bright juices bitherward have sped thee, Indra, Lover of the Song.Drink, Indra, of this flowing sap: in every house ’tis set for thee. Drink Soma to inspirit thee, juice, Indra, which the Falcon brought:For thou art King and Sovran Lord of all the families of men. O Indra, hear Tirasci's call, the call of him who serveth thee.Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring: Great art thou. For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song,A hymn that springs from careful thought, ancient, and full of sacred truth. That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified.Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might. Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sāma hymns.Let the pure milky draught delight him strengthened by pure songs of praise. O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance, pure thyself.Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma, pure, be glad. O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure, enrich the worshipper.Pure, thou dost strike the Vṛtras dead, and strivest, pure, to win the spoil.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियं ।अग्निं रथं न वेद्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: préṣṭham ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ stuṣé ǀ mitrám-iva ǀ priyám ǀagním ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ védyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I praise Agniyour most beloved guest, dear as a friend, who brings wealth as a chariot.
verses.wilson_translation: I praise Agniyour most beloved guest, dear as a friend, who brings wealth as a chariot.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कविमिव प्रचेतसं यं देवासो अध द्विता ।नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ॥
verses.transliteration: kavím-iva ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ yám ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǀní ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā-dadhúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whom he gods have set like a wise seer in a two-fold function among mortals.
verses.wilson_translation: Whom he gods have set like a wise seer in a two-fold function among mortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँः पाहि शृणुधी गिरः ।रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ pāhi ǀ śṛṇudhí ǀ gíraḥ ǀrákṣa ǀ tokám ǀ utá ǀ tmánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ever-youthful (Agni), protect your offerers, hear our praises, and thyself guard our offspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Ever-youthful (Agni), protect your offerers, hear our praises, and thyself guard our offspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कया ते अग्ने अंगिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिं ।वराय देव मन्यवे ॥
verses.transliteration: káyā ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ úpa-stutim ǀvárāya ǀ deva ǀ manyáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni Aṅgirasa, son of food, with what voice (shall I utter) my praise to you, most excellentscorner of enemies?
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni Aṅgirasa, son of food, with what voice (shall I utter) my praise to you, most excellentscorner of enemies?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो ।कदु वोच इदं नमः ॥
verses.transliteration: dā́śema ǀ kásya ǀ mánasā ǀ yajñásya ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀkát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ voce ǀ idám ǀ námaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Son of strength, what worshipper's (offerings) shall we present to you with devoted mind, and whenshall I utter to you this praise?
verses.wilson_translation: Son of strength, what worshipper's (offerings) shall we present to you with devoted mind, and whenshall I utter to you this praise?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः ।वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ káraḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ su-kṣitī́ḥ ǀvā́ja-draviṇasaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Cause all our praises to bring to us excellent dwellings and abundance of wealth in food.
verses.wilson_translation: Cause all our praises to bring to us excellent dwellings and abundance of wealth in food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कस्य नूनं परीणसो धियो जिन्वसि दंपते ।गोषाता यस्य ते गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: kásya ǀ nūnám ǀ párīṇasaḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ jinvasi ǀ dam-pate ǀgó-sātā ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose many offerings do you gladden,Agni, you who are the lord of the house, and whose praisesbring wealth of kine?
verses.wilson_translation: Whose many offerings do you gladden,Agni, you who are the lord of the house, and whose praisesbring wealth of kine?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं मर्जयंत सुक्रतुं पुरोयावानमाजिषु ।स्वेषु क्षयेषु वाजिनं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ marjayanta ǀ su-krátum ǀ puraḥ-yā́vānam ǀ ājíṣu ǀsvéṣu ǀ kṣáyeṣu ǀ vājínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: They keep him bright in their houses, (Agni) famed for glorious deeds, the mighty one who pressesforward in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: They keep him bright in their houses, (Agni) famed for glorious deeds, the mighty one who pressesforward in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्षेति क्षेमेभिः साधुभिर्नकिर्यं घ्नंति हंति यः ।अग्ने सुवीर एधते ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣéti ǀ kṣémebhiḥ ǀ sādhú-bhiḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ yám ǀ ghnánti ǀ hánti ǀ yáḥ ǀágne ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀ edhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who dwells at home with all-efficient protections, whom none can harm, but who himself harms (hisenemies)-- he,Agni, (your worshipper), waxes strong with heroic offspring.
verses.wilson_translation: He who dwells at home with all-efficient protections, whom none can harm, but who himself harms (hisenemies)-- he,Agni, (your worshipper), waxes strong with heroic offspring.
