verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FOR him the Mornings made their courses longer, and Nights with pleasant voices spake to Indra.For him the Floods stood still, the Seven Mothers, Streams easy for the heroes to pass over. The Darter penetrated, though in trouble, thrice-seven close-pressed ridges of the mountains.Neither might God nor mortal man accomplish what the Strong Hero wrought in full-grown vigour. The mightiest force is Indra's bolt of iron when firmly grasped in both the arms of Indra.His head and mouth have powers that pass all others, and all his people hasten near to listen. count thee as the Holiest of the Holy, the caster-down of what hath ne’er been shaken.I count thee as the Banner of the heroes, I count thee as the Chief of all men living. What time, O Indra, in thine arms thou tookest thy wildly rushing bolt to Slay the Dragon,The mountains roared, the cattle loudly bellowed, the Brahmans with their hymns drew nigh to Indra. Let us praise him who made these worlds and creatures, all things that after him sprang into being.May we win Mitra with our songs, and Indra, and. wait upon our Lord with adoration. Flying in terror from the snort of Vṛtra, all Deities who were thy friends forsook thee.So, Indra, be thy friendship with the Maruts: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor. Thrice-sixty Maruts, waxing strong, were with thee, like piles of beaming light, worthy of worship.We come to thee: grant us a happy portion. Let us adore thy might with this oblation. A sharpened weapon is the host of Maruts. Who, Indra, dares withstand thy bolt of thunder?Weaponless are the Asuras, the godless: scatter them with thy wheel, Impetuous Hero. To him the Strong and Mighty, most auspicious, send up the beAuteous hymn for sake of cattle.Lay oa his body many songs for Indra invoked with song, for will not he regard. them? To him, the Mighty, who accepts laudation, send forth thy thought as by a boat o’er rivers,Stir with thy hymn the body of the Famous and Dearest One, for will not he regard it? Serve him with gifts of thine which Indra welcomes: praise with fair praise, invite him with thine homage.Draw near, O singer, and refrain from outcry. Make thy voice heard, for will not he regard it? The Black Drop sank in Amsumati's bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it.Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted laid aside his weapons. saw the Drop in the far distance moving, on the slope bank of Amsumati's river,Like a black cloud that sank into the water. Heroes, I send you forth. Go, fight in battle. And then the Drop in Amsumati's bosom, splendid with light, assumed its proper body;And Indra, with Bṛhaspati to aid him, conquered the godless tribes that came against him. Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne’er had met a rival.The hidden Pair, the Heaven and Earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure. So, Thunder-armed! thou with thy bolt of thunder didst boldly smite that power which none might equal;With weapons broughtest low the migbt of Śuṣṇa, and, Indra, foundest by thy strength the cattle. Then wast thou, Chieftain of all living mortals, the very mighty slayer of the Vṛtras.Then didst thou set the obstructed rivers flowing, and win the floods that were enthralled by Dāsas. Most wise is he, rejoicing in libations, splendid as day, resistless in his anger.He only doth great deeds, the only Hero, sole Vṛtra-slayer he, with none beside him. Indra is Vṛtra's slayer, man's sustainer: he must be called; with fair praise let us call him.Maghavan is our Helper, our Protector, giver of spoil and wealth to make us famous. This Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, this Ṛbhukṣan, even at his birth, was meet for invocation.Doer of many deeds for man's advantage, like Soma quaffed, for friends we must invoke him.

verses.sanskrit: आ मे हवं नासत्याश्विना गच्छतं युवं ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ áśvinā ǀ gácchatam ǀ yuvám ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Nāsatyās,Aśvins, come you to my invocation that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Nāsatyās,Aśvins, come you to my invocation that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमं मे स्तोममश्विनेमं मे शृणुतं हवं ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ me ǀ stómam ǀ aśvinā ǀ imám ǀ me ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávam ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, hear this my hymn, this my invocation that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, hear this my hymn, this my invocation that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं वां कृष्णो अश्विना हवते वाजिनीवसू ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ kṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ hávate ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Kṛṣṇainvokes you,Aśvinsrich in sacrifices, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Kṛṣṇainvokes you,Aśvinsrich in sacrifices, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवं कृष्णस्य स्तुवतो नरा ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṇutám ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ hávam ǀ kṛ́ṣṇasya ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ narā ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders (of all), hear the invocation of Kṛṣṇa, the hymner, who praises you-- that you may drink theexhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders (of all), hear the invocation of Kṛṣṇa, the hymner, who praises you-- that you may drink theexhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: छर्दिर्यंतमदाभ्यं विप्राय स्तुवते नरा ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: chardíḥ ǀ yantam ǀ ádābhyam ǀ víprāya ǀ stuvaté ǀ narā ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leaders, give to the sage who praises you an unassailable dwelling that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Leaders, give to the sage who praises you an unassailable dwelling that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गच्छतं दाशुषो गृहमित्था स्तुवतो अश्विना ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: gácchatam ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǀ itthā́ ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, come to the house of the offerer who thus praises you, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, come to the house of the offerer who thus praises you, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युंजाथां रासभं रथे वीड्वंगे वृषण्वसू ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjā́thām ǀ rā́sabham ǀ ráthe ǀ vīḷú-aṅge ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who possess showering wealth, yoke the ass to your firmly built chariot, that you may drink theexhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: You who possess showering wealth, yoke the ass to your firmly built chariot, that you may drink theexhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवंधुरेण त्रिवृता रथेना यातमश्विना ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tri-vandhuréṇa ǀ tri-vṛ́tā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, come here with your three-seated triangular car, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, come here with your three-seated triangular car, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू मे गिरो नासत्याश्विना प्रावतं युवं ।मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ gíraḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ áśvinā ǀ prá ǀ avatam ǀ yuvám ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Nāsatyās,Aśvins, hasten quickly to my praises, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Nāsatyās,Aśvins, hasten quickly to my praises, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXVI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ५  कृष्ण आङ्गिरस:, विश्वको वा कार्षि्ण:। अश्विनौ । जगती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O INDRA, Lord of Light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras,Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee. The unwasting share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured,Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl. The riteless, godless man who sleeps, O Indra, his unbroken steep,—May he by following his own devices die. Hide from him wealth that nourishes. Whether, O Śakra, thou be far, or, Vṛtra-slayer, near at hand,Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who hath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned Steeds. Whether thou art in heaven's bright sphere, or in the basin of the sea;Whether, chief Vṛtra-slayer, in some place on earth, or in the firmament, approach. Thou Soma-drinker, Lord of Strength, beside our flowing Soma juiceDelight us with thy bounty rich in pleasantness, O Indra, with abundant wealth. O Indra, turn us not away: be the companion of our feast.For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away. Sit down with us, O Indra, sit beside the juice to drink the meath.Show forth great favour to the Singer, Maghavan; Indra, with us, beside the juice. O Caster of the Stone, nor Gods nor mortals have attained to thee.Thou in thy might surpassest all that hath been made: the Gods have not attained to thee. Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh,Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour. Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice,The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives. Tle holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram.Inciters, full of vigour, not to he deceived, are with the chanters, nigh to bear. Loudly I call that Indra, Maghavan the Mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless.Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, Thunder-armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us. Thou knowest well, O Śakra, thou Most Potent, with thy strength, Indra, to destroy these castles.Before thee, Thunder-armed! all beings tremble: the heavens and earth before thee shake with terror, May thy truth, Indra, Wondrous Hero be my guard: bear me o’er much woe, Thunderer! as over floods.When, Indra, wilt thou honour us with opulence, all-nourishing and much-to-be. desired, O King?

verses.sanskrit: उभा हि दस्रा भिषजा मयोभुवोभा दक्षस्य वचसो बभूवथुः ।ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष���टं सख्या मुमोचतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ hí ǀ dasrā́ ǀ bhiṣájā ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ ubhā́ ǀ dákṣasya ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ babhūváthuḥ ǀtā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvakaḥ ǀ havate ǀ tanū-kṛthé ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ yauṣṭam ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ mumócatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Dasras, physicians, sources of happiness, you both were (the objects) of Dakṣa's praise;Viśvakanowinvokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallop here).
verses.wilson_translation: Dasras, physicians, sources of happiness, you both were (the objects) of Dakṣa's praise;Viśvakanowinvokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallop here).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कथा नूनं वां विमना उप स्तवद्युवं धियं ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये ।ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतं ॥
verses.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ vām ǀ ví-manāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ stavat ǀ yuvám ǀ dhíyam ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ vásyaḥ-iṣṭaye ǀtā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvakaḥ ǀ havate ǀ tanū-kṛthé ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ yauṣṭam ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ mumócatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: How Vimanasonce praised you, and you gave him understanding for the attainment of excellent wealth!Viśvakanow invokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallophere).
verses.wilson_translation: How Vimanasonce praised you, and you gave him understanding for the attainment of excellent wealth!Viśvakanow invokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallophere).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं हि ष्मा पुरुभुजेममेधतुं विष्णाप्वे ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये ।ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ imám ǀ edhatúm ǀ viṣṇāpvé ǀ dadáthuḥ ǀ vásyaḥ-iṣṭaye ǀtā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvakaḥ ǀ havate ǀ tanū-kṛthé ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ yauṣṭam ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ mumócatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Gladdeners of many, you have given to Viśṇāpu this prosperity for the attainment of excellent wealth!Viśvakanow invokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallophere).
verses.wilson_translation: Gladdeners of many, you have given to Viśṇāpu this prosperity for the attainment of excellent wealth!Viśvakanow invokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallophere).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्यं वीरं धनसामृजीषिणं दूरे चित्संतमवसे हवामहे ।यस्य स्वादिष्ठा सुमतिः पितुर्यथा मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतं ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ vīrám ǀ dhana-sā́m ǀ ṛjīṣíṇam ǀ dūré ǀ cit ǀ sántam ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǀyásya ǀ svā́diṣṭhā ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ yathā ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ yauṣṭam ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ mumócatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We summon that hero to our protection, (the enjoyer) of wealth, the possessor of the Soma, who nowdwells afar off and whose hymn is most plural asing (to the gods) like his father's, sever not our friendships, but flingloose (your reins and gallop here).
verses.wilson_translation: We summon that hero to our protection, (the enjoyer) of wealth, the possessor of the Soma, who nowdwells afar off and whose hymn is most plural asing (to the gods) like his father's, sever not our friendships, but flingloose (your reins and gallop here).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतेन देवः सविता शमायत ऋतस्य शृंगमुर्विया वि पप्रथे ।ऋतं सासाह महि चित्पृतन्यतो मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ śam-āyate ǀ ṛtásya ǀ śṛ́ṅgam ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ paprathe ǀṛtám ǀ sasāha ǀ máhi ǀ cit ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ yauṣṭam ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ mumócatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sun-god by truth extinguishes his beams (in the evening); he spreads abroad (in the morning) thehorn of truth; truth verily overcomes the might of the eager assailant; therefore sever not our friendships, but flingloose (your reins and gallop here).
verses.wilson_translation: The sun-god by truth extinguishes his beams (in the evening); he spreads abroad (in the morning) thehorn of truth; truth verily overcomes the might of the eager assailant; therefore sever not our friendships, but flingloose (your reins and gallop here).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXVII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ६ कृष्ण आङ्गिरसो, वासिष्ठो वा द्युम्नीक:, प्रियमेध आङ्गिरसो वा।अश्विनौ । प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Indra sing a Sāma hymn, a lofty song to Lofty Sage,To him who guards the Law, inspired, and fain for praise. Thou, Indra, art the Conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun.Maker of all things, thou art Mighty and All-God. Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of heaven.ne Deities, Indra strove to win thee for their Friend. Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable,Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of Heaven. O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds.Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of Heaven. For thou art he, O Indra, wiio stormeth all castles of the foe,Slayer of Dasyus, man's Supporter, Lord of Heaven. Now have we, Indra, Friend of Song, sent our great wishes forth to thee,Coming like floods that follow floods. As rivers swell the ocean, so, Hero, our prayers increase thy might,Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day. With holy song mey bind to the broad wide-yoked car the Bay Steeds of the rapid God,Bearers of Indra, yoked by word. O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Śatakratu, thou most active, bringA hero conquering in war. For, gracious Śatakratu, thou hast ever been a Mother and a Sire to us,So now for bliss we pray to thee. To thee, Strong, Much-invoked, who showest forth thy strength, O Śatakratu, do I speak:So grant thou us heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: द्युम्नी वां स्तोमो अश्विना क्रिविर्न सेक आ गतं ।मध्वः सुतस्य स दिवि प्रियो नरा पातं गौराविवेरिणे ॥
verses.transliteration: dyumnī́ ǀ vām ǀ stómaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ kríviḥ ǀ ná ǀ séke ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ sáḥ ǀ diví ǀ priyáḥ ǀ narā ǀ pātám ǀ gauráu-iva ǀ íriṇe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, your praise is filled with plural nty as a well (with water) in time of rain; hasten here; it is especiallydear to the Somawhen it is effused in the brilliant (offering); drink, leaders (of rites), as two Gauras(drink), at apool.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, your praise is filled with plural nty as a well (with water) in time of rain; hasten here; it is especiallydear to the Somawhen it is effused in the brilliant (offering); drink, leaders (of rites), as two Gauras(drink), at apool.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबतं घर्मं मधुमंतमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं नरा ।ता मंदसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ नि पातं वेदसा वयः ॥
verses.transliteration: píbatam ǀ gharmám ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sīdatam ǀ narā ǀtā́ ǀ mandasānā́ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ pātam ǀ védasā ǀ váyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink,Aśvins, the exhilarating (Soma) as it drops (into the vessels)- - seat yourselves, leaders, on thesacrificial grass; rejoicing in the house of the worshipper, drink the sacred Soma with the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink,Aśvins, the exhilarating (Soma) as it drops (into the vessels)- - seat yourselves, leaders, on thesacrificial grass; rejoicing in the house of the worshipper, drink the sacred Soma with the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत ।ता वर्तिर्यातमुप वृक्तबर्हिषो जुष्टं यज्ञं दिविष्टिषु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ priyá-medhāḥ ǀ ahūṣata ǀtā́ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ júṣṭam ǀ yajñám ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: The worshippers have invoked you with all protections; come in the early mornings to the dwelling ofhim who has clipped the sacred grass, to the offering loved (by all the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: The worshippers have invoked you with all protections; come in the early mornings to the dwelling ofhim who has clipped the sacred grass, to the offering loved (by all the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबतं सोमं मधुमंतमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं सुमत् ।ता वावृधाना उप सुष्टुतिं दिवो गंतं गौराविवेरिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: píbatam ǀ sómam ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sīdatam ǀ su-mát ǀtā́ ǀ vavṛdhānáu ǀ úpa ǀ su-stutím ǀ diváḥ ǀ gantám ǀ gauráu-iva ǀ íriṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aśvins, drink the exhilarating Soma, sit down in your radiance on the sacrificial grass; waxing strong(through the libation), come from heaven to our praises as two Gadras to a pool.
verses.wilson_translation: Aśvins, drink the exhilarating Soma, sit down in your radiance on the sacrificial grass; waxing strong(through the libation), come from heaven to our praises as two Gadras to a pool.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विनाश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः ।दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ áśvebhiḥ ǀ pruṣitápsu-bhiḥ ǀdásrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ pātám ǀ sómam ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Aśvins, with your glossy steeds,Dasras, riding in golden chariots, lords of good fortune,upholders of truth, drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Aśvins, with your glossy steeds,Dasras, riding in golden chariots, lords of good fortune,upholders of truth, drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं हि वां हवामहे विपन्यवो विप्रासो वाजसातये ।ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुदंससा धियाश्विना श्रुष्ट्या गतं ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ hávāmahe ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀtā́ ǀ valgū́ íti ǀ dasrā́ ǀ puru-dáṃsasā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ áśvinā ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, your wise praisers, invoke you to the enjoyment of the sacrificial viands; come quickly,Dasras, atthe sound of our praise,Aśvins, graceful in your movements, abounding in mighty deeds.
verses.wilson_translation: We, your wise praisers, invoke you to the enjoyment of the sacrificial viands; come quickly,Dasras, atthe sound of our praise,Aśvins, graceful in your movements, abounding in mighty deeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXVIII. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ६ नोधा गौतम: । इन्द्र: । प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O THUNDERER, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday.So, Indra, listen here to those who bring the laud: come near unto our dwellingplace. Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: this we crave. Here the disposers wait on thee.Thy loftiest glories claim our lauds beside the juice, O Indra, Lover of the Song. Turning, as ’twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things.When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage. Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none: good are the gifts which Indra. grants.He is not worth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to giving boons. Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands.Father art thou, aIl-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher. The Earth and Heaven clung close to thy victorious might as to their calf two mother-cows.When thou attackest Vṛtra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath. Bring to your aid the Eternal One, who shoots and none may shoot at him,Inciter, swift, victorious, best of Charioteers. Tugrya's unvanquished Strengthener; Arranger of things unarranged, e’en Śatakratu, source of might,Indra, the Friend of all, for succour we invoke, Guardian of treasure, sendjng wealth.

verses.sanskrit: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मंदानमंधसः ।अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इंद्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ dasmám ǀ ṛti-sáham ǀ vásoḥ ǀ mandānám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀabhí ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ svásareṣu ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ índram ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ navāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We offer praise with our hymns, as cows (low) to their calf in the stalls, to that handsome Indraof yours,(O priests), the overcomer of enemies, who rejoices in the excellent Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: We offer praise with our hymns, as cows (low) to their calf in the stalls, to that handsome Indraof yours,(O priests), the overcomer of enemies, who rejoices in the excellent Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसं ।क्षुमंतं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमंतमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: dyukṣám ǀ su-dā́num ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ ā́-vṛtam ǀ girím ǀ ná ǀ puru-bhójasam ǀkṣu-mántam ǀ vā́jam ǀ śatínam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ makṣú ǀ gó-mantam ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit the radiant bounteous (Indra), surrounded by powers as a mountain (by clouds), thesupporter of many-- (we solicit him) speedily for renowned food, rich in cattle, and multiplied a hundred and athousand-fold.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit the radiant bounteous (Indra), surrounded by powers as a mountain (by clouds), thesupporter of many-- (we solicit him) speedily for renowned food, rich in cattle, and multiplied a hundred and athousand-fold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा बृहंतो अद्रयो वरंत इंद्र वीळवः ।यद्दित्ससि स्तुवते मावते वसु नकिष्टदा मिनाति ते ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ bṛhántaḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ várante ǀ indra ǀ vīḷávaḥ ǀyát ǀ dítsasi ǀ stuvaté ǀ mā́-vate ǀ vásu ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ mināti ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vast firm mountains cannot stop you,Indra, whatever wealth you would give to a worshipper suchas I none can hinder you therein.
verses.wilson_translation: The vast firm mountains cannot stop you,Indra, whatever wealth you would give to a worshipper suchas I none can hinder you therein.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: योद्धासि क्रत्वा शवसोत दंसना विश्वा जाताभि मज्मना ।आ त्वायमर्क ऊतये ववर्तति यं गोतमा अजीजनन् ॥
verses.transliteration: yóddhā ǀ asi ǀ krátvā ǀ śávasā ǀ utá ǀ daṃsánā ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ ǀ abhí ǀ majmánā ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ ayám ǀ arkáḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ vavartati ǀ yám ǀ gótamāḥ ǀ ájījanan ǁ
verses.english_translation: By your exploits and might you are a warrior you overpower all beings by your deeds and prowess, thishymn which the Gotamashave made, causes you to turn here for their protection.
verses.wilson_translation: By your exploits and might you are a warrior you overpower all beings by your deeds and prowess, thishymn which the Gotamashave made, causes you to turn here for their protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र हि रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवो अंतेभ्यस्परि ।न त्वा विव्याच रज इंद्र पार्थिवमनु स्वधां ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ hí ǀ ririkṣé ǀ ójasā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántebhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀná ǀ tvā ǀ vivyāca ǀ rájaḥ ǀ indra ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ vavakṣitha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, by your might you extend beyond the limits of heaven, the region of the earth cannot contain you;design to bring us food.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, by your might you extend beyond the limits of heaven, the region of the earth cannot contain you;design to bring us food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नकिः परिष्टिर्मघवन्मघस्य ते यद्दाशुषे दशस्यसि ।अस्माकं बोध्युचथस्य चोदिता मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
verses.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ páriṣṭiḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ maghásya ǀ te ǀ yát ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ daśasyási ǀasmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ ucáthasya ǀ coditā́ ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: None can hinder your bounty,Maghavan, when you give wealth to your votary, most liberal sender (ofwealth), listen to our praise for the attainment of food.
verses.wilson_translation: None can hinder your bounty,Maghavan, when you give wealth to your votary, most liberal sender (ofwealth), listen to our praise for the attainment of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXXIX Indra. Vāk.
hymns.anukramani: ७ नृमेध-पुरुमेधावाङ्गिरसौ । इन्द्र: । १-४ प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) । ५-६ अनुष्टुप्
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I MOVE before thee here present in person, and all the Deities follow behind me.When, Indra, thou securest me my portion, with me thou shalt perform heroic actions. The food of meath in foremost place I give thee, thy Soma shall be pressed, thy share appointed.Thou on my right shalt be my friend and comrade: then shall we two smite dead full many a foeman. Striving for strength bring forth a laud to Indra, a truthful hymn if he in truth existeth.One and another say, There is no Indra. Who hath beheld him? Whom then shall we honour? Here am I, look upon me here, O singer. All that existeth  surpass in greatness.The Holy Law's commandments make me mighty. Rending with strength I rend the worlds asunder. When the Law's lovers mounted and ap. proached me as  sate lone upon the dear sky's summit.Then spake my spirit to the heart within me, My friends have cried unto me with their children. All these thy deeds must be declared at Soma-feasts, wrought, Indra, Bounteous Lord, for him who sheds the juice,When thou didst open wealth heaped up by many, brought from far away to Sarablia, the Ṛṣi's kin. Now run ye forth your several ways: he is not here who kept you back.For hath not Indra sunk his bolt deep down in Vṛtra's vital part? On-rushing with the speed of thought within the iron fort he pressed:The Falcon went to heaven and brought the Soma to the Thunderer. Deep in the ocean lies the bolt with waters compassed round about,And in continuous onward flow the floods their tribute bring to it. When, uttering words which no one comprehended, Vāk, Queen of Gods, the Gladdener, was seated,The heaven's four regions drew forth drink and vigour: now whither hath her noblest portion vanished? The Deities generated Vāk the Goddess, and animals of every figure speak her.May she, the Gladdener, yielding food and vigour, the Milch-cow Vāk, approach us meetly lauded. Step forth with wider stride, my comrade Viṣṇu; make room, Dyaus, for the leaping of the lightning.Let us slay Vṛtra, let us free the rivers let them flow loosed at the command of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: बृहदिंद्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहंतमं ।येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ índrāya ǀ gāyata ǀ márutaḥ ǀ vṛtrahám-tamam ǀyéna ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ájanayan ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ devám ǀ devā́ya ǀ jā́gṛvi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Priests sing to Indrathe most sin-destroying Bṛhat-sāman, by which the upholders of truth producedthe divine all-waking luminary for the god.
verses.wilson_translation: Priests sing to Indrathe most sin-destroying Bṛhat-sāman, by which the upholders of truth producedthe divine all-waking luminary for the god.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेंद्रो द्युम्न्याभवत् ।देवास्त इंद्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ adhamat ǀ abhí-śastīḥ ǀ aśasti-hā́ ǀ átha ǀ índraḥ ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ ā́ ǀ abhavat ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ yemire ǀ bṛ́hadbhāno íti bṛ́hat-bhāno ǀ márut-gaṇa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the destroyer of those who offer not praise, has driven away the malevolent and has becomeglorious; I indra of mighty splendour, lord of the troops of Maruts, the gods press you for your friendship.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the destroyer of those who offer not praise, has driven away the malevolent and has becomeglorious; I indra of mighty splendour, lord of the troops of Maruts, the gods press you for your friendship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र व इंद्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत ।वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ bṛhaté ǀ márutaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ arcata ǀvṛtrám ǀ hanati ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ śatá-parvaṇā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Priests, utter forth the hymn to your great Indra; letŚatakratu, the slayer of Vṛtra, smite Vṛtra with hishundred-edged thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: Priests, utter forth the hymn to your great Indra; letŚatakratu, the slayer of Vṛtra, smite Vṛtra with hishundred-edged thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र भर धृषता धृषन्मनः श्रवश्चित्ते असद्बृहत् ।अर्षंत्वापो जवसा वि मातरो हनो वृत्रं जया स्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ prá ǀ bhara ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ dhṛṣat-manaḥ ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ asat ǀ bṛhát ǀárṣantu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ jávasā ǀ ví ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ hánaḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jáya ǀ sváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Daring-souled (Indra), there is abundance of food with you-- boldly bring it to us; let our mothers (thewaters) impetuously spread over the earth; smite Vṛtra, and conquer all.
verses.wilson_translation: Daring-souled (Indra), there is abundance of food with you-- boldly bring it to us; let our mothers (thewaters) impetuously spread over the earth; smite Vṛtra, and conquer all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय ।तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उत द्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ jā́yathāḥ ǀ apūrvya ǀ mágha-van ǀ vṛtra-hátyāya ǀtát ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ aprathayaḥ ǀ tát ǀ astabhnāḥ ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Maghavan, who had none before you, when you were born for the slaying of Vṛtra, then you did spreadabroad the earth, then you did prop up the heavens.
verses.wilson_translation: Maghavan, who had none before you, when you were born for the slaying of Vṛtra, then you did spreadabroad the earth, then you did prop up the heavens.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः ।तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जंत्वं ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ te ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ ajāyata ǀ tát ǀ arkáḥ ǀ utá ǀ háskṛtiḥ ǀtát ǀ víśvam ǀ abhi-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ yát ǀ jātám ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ jántvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then was the sacrifice produced for you, then too the joyous hymn; then did you surpass all, whateverhas been or will be born.
verses.wilson_translation: Then was the sacrifice produced for you, then too the joyous hymn; then did you surpass all, whateverhas been or will be born.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ।घर्मं न सामंतपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: āmā́su ǀ pakvám ǀ áirayaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ rohayaḥ ǀ diví ǀgharmám ǀ ná ǀ sā́man ǀ tapata ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ júṣṭam ǀ gírvaṇase ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: In the immature (cows) you produced the mature (milk), you caused the sun to arise in heaven,(priests), excite (Indra) with your praises as men heat thegharmawithsāmanhymns. (sing) the acceptable Bṛhat sāman to him who is to be honoure dby song.
verses.wilson_translation: In the immature (cows) you produced the mature (milk), you caused the sun to arise in heaven,(priests), excite (Indra) with your praises as men heat thegharmawithsāmanhymns. (sing) the acceptable Bṛhat sāman to him who is to be honoure dby song.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XC. Various.
hymns.anukramani: ६ नृमेध-पुरुमेधावाङ्गिरसौ । इन्द्र: । १-४ प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YEA, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods,Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuṇa. to share his sacrificial gifts. Supreme in sovran power, far-sighted, Chiefs and Kings, most swift to hear from far away,Both, wondrously, set them in motion as with arms, in company with Sūrya's beams. The rapid messenger who runs before you, Mitra-Varuṇa, with iron head, swift to the draught, He whom no man may question, none may summon back, who stands not still for colloquy,—From hostile clash with him keep ye us safe this day: keep us in safety with your arms. To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one,A pleasant hymn that shall protect to Varuṇa: sing forth a laud unto the Kings. The true, Red Treasure they have sent, one only Son born of the Three.They, the Immortal Ones, never deceived, survey the families of mortal men. My songs are lifted up, and acts most splendid are to be performed.Come hither, ye Nāsatyas, with accordant mind, to meet and to enjoy my gifts. Lords of great wealth, when we invoke your bounty which no demon checks,Both of you, furthering our eastward-offcred praise, come, Chiefs whom Jamadagni lauds! Come, Vāyu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven.Poured on the middle of the strainingcloth, and cooked, this bright drink hath been offered ilice. He comes by straightest paths, as ministering Priest, to taste the sacrificial gifts.Then, Lord of harnessed teams I drink of the twofold draught, bright Soma mingled with the milk. Verily, Sūrya, thou art great; truly, Āditya, thou art great.As thou art great indeed, thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, thou, God, art great. Yea, Sūrya, thou art great in fame thou evermore, O God, art great.Thou by thy greatness art the Gods’ High Priest, divine, far-spread unconquerable light. She yonder, bending lowly down, clothed in red hues and rich in rays,Is seen, advancing as it were with various tints, amid the ten surrounding arms. Past and gone are three mortal generations: the fourth and last into the Sun hath entered.He mid the worlds his lofty place hath taken. Into green plants is gone the Purifying. The Rudras' Mother, Daughter of the Vasus, centre of nectar, the Ādityas’ Sister-To folk who understand will  proclaim it-injure not Aditi, the Cow, the sinless. Weak-minded men have as a cow adopted me who came hither from the Gods, a Goddess,Who, skilled in eloquence, her voice uplifteth, who standeth near at hand with all devotions.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इंद्रः समत्सु भूषतु ।उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहा परमज्या ऋचीषमः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāsu ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ samát-su ǀ bhūṣatu ǀúpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ sávanāni ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ parama-jyā́ḥ ǀ ṛ́cīṣamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra, who is to be invoked in all battles regard our hykns and our libationsl he the slayer of Vṛtra,who crushes the mightiest (foes), who is worthy of his praise.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, who is to be invoked in all battles regard our hykns and our libationsl he the slayer of Vṛtra,who crushes the mightiest (foes), who is worthy of his praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् ।तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ dātā́ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ rā́dhasām ǀ asi ǀ ási ǀ satyáḥ ǀ īśāna-kṛ́t ǀtuvi-dyumnásya ǀ yújyā ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ putrásya ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are the chief giver of wealth, you are truthful and make your worshippers rulers; we solicit(blessings) worthy of you, lord of vast riches, mighty son of strength.
verses.wilson_translation: You are the chief giver of wealth, you are truthful and make your worshippers rulers; we solicit(blessings) worthy of you, lord of vast riches, mighty son of strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा त इंद्र गिर्वणः क्रियंते अनतिद्भुता ।इमा जुषस्व हर्यश्व योजनेंद्र या ते अमन्महि ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhma ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ kriyánte ǀ ánatidbhutā ǀimā́ ǀ juṣasva ǀ hari-aśva ǀ yójanā ǀ índra ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ ámanmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, who are the object of hymns, unexaggerated praises are offered by us; lord of bay steeds, acceptthese fitting hymns, which we have meditated for you.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, who are the object of hymns, unexaggerated praises are offered by us; lord of bay steeds, acceptthese fitting hymns, which we have meditated for you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सत्यो मघवन्ननानतो वृत्रा भूरि न्यृंजसे ।स त्वं शविष्ठ वज्रहस्त दाशुषेऽर्वांचं रयिमा कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ satyáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ ánānataḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ ni-ṛñjáse ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ arvā́ñcam ǀ rayím ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are truthful,Maghavan, unhumbled yourself, you humble many enemies; most mighty thunderer,cause wealth to meet your worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: You are truthful,Maghavan, unhumbled yourself, you humble many enemies; most mighty thunderer,cause wealth to meet your worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पते ।त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इदनुत्ता चर्षणीधृता ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ yaśā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀtvám ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ haṃsi ǀ apratī́ni ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ánuttā ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́tā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, lord of strength, are the glorious possessor of the offered Soma, alone with (yourthunderbolt), that protector of men, you smite the enemies that none else could oppose or drive away.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, lord of strength, are the glorious possessor of the offered Soma, alone with (yourthunderbolt), that protector of men, you smite the enemies that none else could oppose or drive away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे ।महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इंद्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ nūnám ǀ asura ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ bhāgám-iva ǀ īmahe ǀmahī́-iva ǀ kṛ́ttiḥ ǀ śaraṇā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ sumnā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ aśnavan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Living one, who possess supreme knowledge, we verily ask you for wealth as though it were aninheritance your abode (in heaven),Indra, is vast like your glory; may your blessings fill us.
verses.wilson_translation: Living one, who possess supreme knowledge, we verily ask you for wealth as though it were aninheritance your abode (in heaven),Indra, is vast like your glory; may your blessings fill us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XCI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LORD of the house, Sage, ever young, high power of life, O Agni, God,Thou givest to thy worshipper. So with our song that prays and serves, attentive, Lord of spreading light,Agni, bring hitherward the Gods. For, Ever-Youthful One, with thee, best Furtherer, as our ally,We overcome, to win the spoil. As Aurva Bhṛgu used, as Apnavāna used, I call the pureAgni who clothes him with the sea. call the Sage who sounds like wind, the Might that like Parjanya roars,Agni who clothes him with the sea. As Savitar's productive Power, as him who sends down bliss, I callAgni who clothes him with the sea. Hither, for powerful kirship, I call Agni, him Who prospers you,Most frequent at our solemn rites That through this famed One's power, he may stand by us even as Tvaṣṭar comesUnto the forms that must he shaped. This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories mid the Gods:May he come nigh to us with strength. Here praise ye him the most renowned of all the ministering Priests,Agni, the Chief at sacrifice; Piercing, with purifying flame, enkindled in our homes, most high,Swiftest to hear from far away. Sage, laud the Mighty One who wins the spoil of victory like a steed,And, Mitra like, unites the folk. Still turning to their aim in thee, the oblation-bearer's sister hymnsHave come to thee before the wind. The waters find their place in him, for whom the threefold sacred grassIs spread unbound, unlimited. The station of the Bounteous God hath, through his aid which none impair,A pleasant aspect like the Sun. Blazing with splendour, Agni, God, through pious gifts of sacred oil,Bring thou the Gods and worship them. The Gods as mothers brought thee forth, the Immortal Sage, O Aṅgiras,The bearer of our gifts to heaven. Wise Agni, Gods established thee, the Seer, noblest messenger,As bearer of our sacred gifts. No cow have I to call mine own, no axe at hand wherewith to work,Yet what is here I bring to thee. O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay for thee,Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God That which the white-ant cats away, that over which the emmet crawls-May all of this be oil to thee. When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song:I with the priests have kindled him.

verses.sanskrit: कन्या वारवायती सोममपि स्रुताविदत् ।अस्तं भरंत्यब्रवीदिंद्राय सुनवै त्वा शक्राय सुनवै त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: kanyā́ ǀ vā́ḥ ǀ ava-yatī́ ǀ sómam ǀ ápi ǀ srutā́ ǀ avidat ǀástam ǀ bhárantī ǀ abravīt ǀ índrāya ǀ sunavai ǀ tvā ǀ śakrā́ya ǀ sunavai ǀ tvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: A young woman going to the water found Somain the path; as she carried it home she said, I will pressyou for Indra, I will you forŚakra.
verses.wilson_translation: A young woman going to the water found Somain the path; as she carried it home she said, I will pressyou for Indra, I will you forŚakra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असौ य एषि वीरको गृहंगृहं विचाकशद् ।इमं जंभसुतं पिब धानावंतं करंभिणमपूपवंतमुक्थिनं ॥
verses.transliteration: asáu ǀ yáḥ ǀ éṣi ǀ vīrakáḥ ǀ gṛhám-gṛham ǀ vi-cā́kaśat ǀimám ǀ jámbha-sutam ǀ piba ǀ dhānā́-vantam ǀ karambhíṇam ǀ apūpá-vantam ǀ ukthínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who go from house to house a hero bright in your splendour, drink this Somapressed by my teethtogether with fried grains of barley, thekarambha, cakes and hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: You who go from house to house a hero bright in your splendour, drink this Somapressed by my teethtogether with fried grains of barley, thekarambha, cakes and hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ चन त्वा चिकित्सामोऽधि चन त्वा नेमसि ।शनैरिव शनकैरिवेंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ caná ǀ tvā ǀ cikitsāmaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ caná ǀ tvā ǀ ná ǀ imasi ǀśánaiḥ-iva ǀ śanakáiḥ-iva ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: We wish to know you, but here we know you not, OSoma, flow forth for Indrafirst slowly, then quickly.
verses.wilson_translation: We wish to know you, but here we know you not, OSoma, flow forth for Indrafirst slowly, then quickly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कुविच्छकत्कुवित्करत्कुविन्नो वस्यसस्करत् ।कुवित्पतिद्विषो यतीरिंद्रेण संगमामहै ॥
verses.transliteration: kuvít ǀ śákat ǀ kuvít ǀ kárat ǀ kuvít ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kárat ǀkuvít ǀ pati-dvíṣaḥ ǀ yatī́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ sam-gámāmahai ǁ
verses.english_translation: May (Indra) repeatedly make us powerful, may he do abundantly for us, may he repeatedly make usvery rich; often hated by our husband and forced to leave hi, may we be united to Indra.]
verses.wilson_translation: May (Indra) repeatedly make us powerful, may he do abundantly for us, may he repeatedly make usvery rich; often hated by our husband and forced to leave hi, may we be united to Indra.]
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इमानि त्रीणि विष्टपा तानींद्र वि रोहय ।शिरस्ततस्योर्वरामादिदं म उपोदरे ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ni ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ viṣṭápā ǀ tā́ni ǀ indra ǀ ví ǀ rohaya ǀśíraḥ ǀ tatásya ǀ urvárām ǀ ā́t ǀ idám ǀ me ǀ úpa ǀ udáre ǁ
verses.english_translation: These hree plural ces-- do you cause them all to grow-- my father's (bald) head, his (barren) field, and mybody.
verses.wilson_translation: These hree plural ces-- do you cause them all to grow-- my father's (bald) head, his (barren) field, and mybody.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असौ च या न उर्वरादिमां तन्वं मम ।अथो ततस्य यच्छिरः सर्वा ता रोमशा कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: asáu ǀ ca ǀ yā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ urvárā ǀ ā́t ǀ imā́m ǀ tanvám ǀ máma ǀátho íti ǀ tatásya ǀ yát ǀ śíraḥ ǀ sárvā ǀ tā́ ǀ romaśā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: This field which is our (father's), and this my body and he head of my father-- do you make all thesebear a crop.
verses.wilson_translation: This field which is our (father's), and this my body and he head of my father-- do you make all thesebear a crop.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो ।अपालामिंद्र त्रिष्पूत्व्यकृणोः सूर्यत्वचं ॥
verses.transliteration: khé ǀ ráthasya ǀ khé ǀ ánasaḥ ǀ khé ǀ yugásya ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀapālā́m ǀ indra ǀ tríḥ ǀ pūtvī́ ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ sū́rya-tvacam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thice,Śatakratu, did you purify Apālā, in the hole of the chariot, in the hole of the cart, and in thehole of the yoke, and you did make here with a skin splendent like the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: Thice,Śatakratu, did you purify Apālā, in the hole of the chariot, in the hole of the cart, and in thehole of the yoke, and you did make here with a skin splendent like the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XCII. Agni
hymns.anukramani: ३३ श्रुतकक्ष: सुकक्षो वा आङ्गिरस: ।इन्द्र: । गायत्री , १ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THAT noblest Furtherer hath appeared, to whom men bring their holy works.Our songs of praise have risen aloft to Agni who was barn to give the Ārya strength. Agni of Divodāsa turned, as ’twere in majesty, to the Gods.Onward he sped along the mother earth, and took his station in the height of heaven. Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds,Him who wins thousands at the worship of the Gods, himself, that Agni, serve with son s. The mortal man whom thou wouldst lead to opulence, O Vasu, he who brings thee gifts.He, Agni, wins himself a hero singing lauds, yea, one who feeds a thousand men. He with the steed wins spoil even in the fenced fort, and gains imperishable fame.In thee, O Lord of wealth, continually we lay all precious offerings to the Gods. To him who dealeth out all wealth, who is the cheerful Priest of men,To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni go the songs of praise. Votaries, richly-gifted, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car.On both, Strong Lord of men! on child and grandson pour the bounties which our nobles give. Sing forth to him, the Holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow,To Agni, ye Upastutas. Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame.And will not his most newly shown benevolence come to us with abundant strength? Priest, presser of the juice! praise now the dearest Guest of all our friends,Agni, the driver of the cars. Who, finder-out of treasures open and concealed, bringeth them hither, Holy One;Whose waves, as in a cataract, are hard to pass, when he, through song, would win him strength. Let not the noble Guest, Agni, be wroth with us: by many a man his praise is sung,Good Herald, skilled in sacrifice. O Vasu, Agni, let not them be harmed who come in any way with lauds to thee.Even the lowly, skilled in rites, with offered gifts, seeketh thee for the envoy's task. Friend of the Maruts, Agni, come with Rudras to the Soma-draught,To Sobhar's fair song of praise, and be thou joyful in the light.VALAKHILYA

verses.sanskrit: पांतमा वो अंधस इंद्रमभि प्र गायत ।विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: pā́ntam ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ índram ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀviśva-sáham ǀ śatá-kratum ǀ máṃhiṣṭham ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing priests, that Indra, who drinks your offered Soma-- the foe- subduingŚatakratu, most liberal ofmen.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing priests, that Indra, who drinks your offered Soma-- the foe- subduingŚatakratu, most liberal ofmen.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्यं सनश्रुतं ।इंद्र इति ब्रवीतन ॥
verses.transliteration: puru-hūtám ǀ puru-stutám ǀ gāthānyám ǀ sána-śrutam ǀíndraḥ ǀ íti ǀ bravītana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Proclaim that deity as Indra, who is invoked by many, who is praised by many, who is worthy of songsand renowned as eternal.
verses.wilson_translation: Proclaim that deity as Indra, who is invoked by many, who is praised by many, who is worthy of songsand renowned as eternal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र इन्नो महानां दाता वाजानां नृतुः ।महाँ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत् ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ít ǀ naḥ ǀ mahā́nām ǀ datā́ ǀ vā́jānām ǀ nṛtúḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ abhi-jñú ǀ ā́ ǀ yamat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indrawho causes all to rejoice, be the giver of plural ntiful food to us; may be, the mighty, bring us(riches) up to our knees.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indrawho causes all to rejoice, be the giver of plural ntiful food to us; may be, the mighty, bring us(riches) up to our knees.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपादु शिप्र्यंधसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः ।इंदोरिंद्रो यवाशिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: ápāt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śiprī́ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ su-dákṣasya ǀ pra-hoṣíṇaḥ ǀíndoḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ yáva-āśiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, the handsome-jawed, has drunk of th dropping Somacooked with barley, (the offering) of Sudakṣa assiduous in sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, the handsome-jawed, has drunk of th dropping Somacooked with barley, (the offering) of Sudakṣa assiduous in sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तम्वभि प्रार्चतेंद्रं सोमस्य पीतये ।तदिद्ध्यस्य वर्धनं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ arcata ǀ índram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǀtát ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ várdhanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Loudly praise that Indrathat he may drink the Soma-- it is this which gives him strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Loudly praise that Indrathat he may drink the Soma-- it is this which gives him strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा मदानां देवो देवस्यौजसा ।विश्वाभि भुवना भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ pītvā́ ǀ mádānām ǀ deváḥ ǀ devásya ǀ ójasā ǀvíśvā ǀ abhí ǀ bhúvanā ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The god, having quaffed its exhilarations, by the strength of the divine (Soma) has conquered allworlds.
verses.wilson_translation: The god, having quaffed its exhilarations, by the strength of the divine (Soma) has conquered allworlds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतं ।आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tyám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ satrā-sáham ǀ víśvāsu ǀ gīrṣú ǀ ā́-yatam ǀā́ ǀ cyavayasi ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring here for our protection Indrathe conqueror of many, who pervades all your praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring here for our protection Indrathe conqueror of many, who pervades all your praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युध्मं संतमनर्वाणं सोमपामनपच्युतं ।नरमवार्यक्रतुं ॥
verses.transliteration: yudhmám ǀ sántam ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀ soma-pā́m ǀ ánapa-cyutam ǀnáram ǀ avāryá-kratum ǁ
verses.english_translation: The warrior, whom none oppose and none can harm, the quaffer of the Soma, the leader whose deedscannot be hindered.
verses.wilson_translation: The warrior, whom none oppose and none can harm, the quaffer of the Soma, the leader whose deedscannot be hindered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षा ण इंद्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाँ ऋचीषम ।अवा नः पार्ये धने ॥
verses.transliteration: śíkṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ purú ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ṛcīṣama ǀáva ǀ naḥ ǀ pā́rye ǀ dháne ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you worthy of our praise, you who know all things, repeatedly give us riches, protect us by the wealthour enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: O you worthy of our praise, you who know all things, repeatedly give us riches, protect us by the wealthour enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतश्चिदिंद्र ण उपा याहि शतवाजया ।इषा सहस्रवाजया ॥
verses.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ úpa ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ śatá-vājayā ǀiṣā́ ǀ sahásra-vājayā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us,Indra, from there with food of a hundred-fold strength, of a thousand-fold strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Indra, from there with food of a hundred-fold strength, of a thousand-fold strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयाम धीवतो धियोऽर्वद्भिः शक्र गोदरे ।जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: áyāma ǀ dhī́-vataḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ árvat-bhiḥ ǀ śakra ǀ go-dare ǀjáyema ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Śakra, let us go, proved in deeds, to deeds; thunderer, cleaver of mountains, let us conquer in battlesby your steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Śakra, let us go, proved in deeds, to deeds; thunderer, cleaver of mountains, let us conquer in battlesby your steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा शतक्रतो गावो न यवसेष्वा ।उक्थेषु रणयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávaseṣu ǀ ā́ ǀukthéṣu ǀ raṇayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: We refresh you,Śatakratu, with our praises, as (the herdsman) the cattle with (different kinds of)paasture.
verses.wilson_translation: We refresh you,Śatakratu, with our praises, as (the herdsman) the cattle with (different kinds of)paasture.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वा हि मर्त्यत्वनानुकामा शतक्रतो ।अगन्म वज्रिन्नाशसः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvā ǀ hí ǀ martya-tvanā́ ǀ anu-kāmā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀáganma ǀ vajrin ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All mortal natures,Śatakratu, are moved by desire; we feel wishes, O thunderer.
verses.wilson_translation: All mortal natures,Śatakratu, are moved by desire; we feel wishes, O thunderer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वे सु पुत्र शवसोऽवृत्रन्कामकातयः ।न त्वामिंद्राति रिच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ sú ǀ putra ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ ávṛtran ǀ kā́ma-kātayaḥ ǀná ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ áti ǀ ricyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: O son of strength, men, uttering their desires, abide happily in you, none,Indra, surpasses you.
verses.wilson_translation: O son of strength, men, uttering their desires, abide happily in you, none,Indra, surpasses you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो वृषन्त्सनिष्ठया सं घोरया द्रवित्न्वा ।धियाविड्ढि पुरंध्या ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣan ǀ sániṣṭhayā ǀ sám ǀ ghoráyā ǀ dravitnvā́ ǀdhiyā́ ǀ aviḍḍhi ǀ púram-dhyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer (of blessings), protect us by your action, which is most bounteous yet awful, foe-terrifying yetmany-cherishing.
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer (of blessings), protect us by your action, which is most bounteous yet awful, foe-terrifying yetmany-cherishing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते नूनं शतक्रतविंद्र द्युम्नितमो मदः ।तेन नूनं मदे मदेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ nūnám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ índra ǀ dyumní-tamaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀténa ǀ nūnám ǀ máde ǀ maderíti madeḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rejoice us,Indra,Śatakratu, as you rejoice in that most glorious exhilaration of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Rejoice us,Indra,Śatakratu, as you rejoice in that most glorious exhilaration of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते चित्रश्रवस्तमो य इंद्र वृत्रहंतमः ।य ओजोदातमो मदः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ citráśravaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ vṛtrahán-tamaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ojaḥ-dā́tamaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaof yours,Indra, which is most widely renowned, most destrucive of your enemies, and mostrenovating to your strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaof yours,Indra, which is most widely renowned, most destrucive of your enemies, and mostrenovating to your strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा हि यस्ते अद्रिवस्त्वादत्तः सत्य सोमपाः ।विश्वासु दस्म कृष्टिषु ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ tvā́-dattaḥ ǀ satya ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀvíśvāsu ǀ dasma ǀ kṛṣṭíṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thunderer, smiter of enemies, truthful drinker of the Soma, we know (the wealth) which is given by youto all your votaries.
verses.wilson_translation: Thunderer, smiter of enemies, truthful drinker of the Soma, we know (the wealth) which is given by youto all your votaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभंतु नो गिरः ।अर्कमर्चंतु कारवः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ mádvane ǀ sutám ǀ pári ǀ stobhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀarkám ǀ arcantu ǀ kārávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let our voices praise on every side the (Soma) effused to the exhilarated Indra; let the priests dohonour to the (Soma) honoured of all.
verses.wilson_translation: Let our voices praise on every side the (Soma) effused to the exhilarated Indra; let the priests dohonour to the (Soma) honoured of all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणंति सप्त संसदः ।इंद्रं सुते हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmin ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ ráṇanti ǀ saptá ǀ sam-sádaḥ ǀíndram ǀ suté ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invoke, now that the Somais effused, that Indrain whom all graces are at their height, and in whomthe seven associated priests rejoice.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke, now that the Somais effused, that Indrain whom all graces are at their height, and in whomthe seven associated priests rejoice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत ।तमिद्वर्धंतु नो गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: trí-kadrukeṣu ǀ cétanam ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ atnata ǀtám ǀ ít ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods extended the heaven-revealing sacrifice in the Trikadruka days-- may our praise prosper iṭ
verses.wilson_translation: The gods extended the heaven-revealing sacrifice in the Trikadruka days-- may our praise prosper iṭ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा विशंत्विंदवः समुद्रमिव सिंधवः ।न त्वामिंद्राति रिच्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ viśantu ǀ índavaḥ ǀ samudrám-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀná ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ áti ǀ ricyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the Soma-drops enter you as the rivers the sea: none,Indrasurpasses you.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the Soma-drops enter you as the rivers the sea: none,Indrasurpasses you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षं सोमस्य जागृवे ।य इंद्र जठरेषु ते ॥
verses.transliteration: vivyáktha ǀ mahinā́ ǀ vṛṣan ǀ bhakṣám ǀ sómasya ǀ jāgṛve ǀyáḥ ǀ indra ǀ jaṭháreṣu ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, showerer (of blessings), wakeful one, you have attained by your might the drinking of the Somawhich enters your belly.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, showerer (of blessings), wakeful one, you have attained by your might the drinking of the Somawhich enters your belly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरं त इंद्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् ।अरं धामभ्य इंदवः ॥
verses.transliteration: áram ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ kukṣáye ǀ sómaḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ vṛtra-han ǀáram ǀ dhā́ma-bhyaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, slayer of Vṛtra,may the Somabe enough for your belly, may the drops be enough for your(various) bodies.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, slayer of Vṛtra,may the Somabe enough for your belly, may the drops be enough for your(various) bodies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरमश्वाय गायति श्रुतकक्षो अरं गवे ।अरमिंद्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
verses.transliteration: áram ǀ áśvāya ǀ gāyati ǀ śrutá-kakṣaḥ ǀ áram ǀ gáve ǀáram ǀ índrasya ǀ dhā́mne ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṣrutakakṣa sings enough for a horse, enough for a cow, enough for a house of Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṣrutakakṣa sings enough for a horse, enough for a cow, enough for a house of Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरं हि ष्म सुतेषु णः सोमेष्विंद्र भूषसि ।अरं ते शक्र दावने ॥
verses.transliteration: áram ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ sutéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ sómeṣu ǀ indra ǀ bhū́ṣasi ǀáram ǀ te ǀ śakra ǀ dāváne ǁ
verses.english_translation: When our Soma-libations are effused, you are abundantly able (to drink them)-- may they be enough foryou, the bounteous.
verses.wilson_translation: When our Soma-libations are effused, you are abundantly able (to drink them)-- may they be enough foryou, the bounteous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पराकात्ताच्चिदद्रिवस्त्वां नक्षंत नो गिरः ।अरं गमाम ते वयं ॥
verses.transliteration: parākā́ttāt ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ nakṣanta ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀáram ǀ gamāma ǀ te ǀ vayám ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our praises reach you, thunderer, even from afar; may we obtain your (wealth) abundantly.
verses.wilson_translation: May our praises reach you, thunderer, even from afar; may we obtain your (wealth) abundantly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः ।एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ vīra-yúḥ ǀ evá ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ utá ǀ sthiráḥ ǀevá ǀ te ǀ rā́dhyam ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You verily love to smite the mighty, you are a hero and firm (in battle), yourmind is to be propitiated (bypraise).
verses.wilson_translation: You verily love to smite the mighty, you are a hero and firm (in battle), yourmind is to be propitiated (bypraise).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः ।अधा चिदिंद्र मे सचा ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ rātíḥ ǀ tuvi-magha ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ dhāyi ǀ dhātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀádha ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ me ǀ sácā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of great wealth, your bounty is possessed by all your worshippers; therefore,Indra, be also myally.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of great wealth, your bounty is possessed by all your worshippers; therefore,Indra, be also myally.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तंद्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते ।मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ॥
verses.transliteration: mó ��ti ǀ sú ǀ brahmā́-iva ǀ tandrayúḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ vājānām ǀ pate ǀmátsva ǀ sutásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be not like a lazybrāhmaṇa, O lord of food; rejoice thyself by drinking the effused Somamixed withmilk.
verses.wilson_translation: Be not like a lazybrāhmaṇa, O lord of food; rejoice thyself by drinking the effused Somamixed withmilk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा न इंद्राभ्यादिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमन् ।त्वा युजा वनेम तत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ ā-díśaḥ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ aktúṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ yaman ǀtvā́ ǀ yujā́ ǀ vanema ǀ tát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra,let not the threatening prowling (demons) obstruct us at night, let us smite them with you as ourhelper.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra,let not the threatening prowling (demons) obstruct us at night, let us smite them with you as ourhelper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वयेदिंद्र युजा वयं प्रति ब्रुवीमहि स्पृधः ।त्वमस्माकं तव स्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: tváyā ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ yujā́ ǀ vayám ǀ práti ǀ bruvīmahi ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀtvám ǀ asmā́kam ǀ táva ǀ smasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: With you,Indra, as our helper, let us answer our enemies; you are ours, we are yours.
verses.wilson_translation: With you,Indra, as our helper, let us answer our enemies; you are ours, we are yours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि त्वायवोऽनुनोनुवतश्चरान् ।सखाय इंद्र कारवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ tvā-yávaḥ ǀ anu-nónuvataḥ ǀ cárān ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ kārávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, may your friends, the chanters, worship you, devoted to your service and again and againreciting your praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, may your friends, the chanters, worship you, devoted to your service and again and againreciting your praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN I. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . TO you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know;The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold. As with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes.As from a mountain flow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one. The drops effused, the gladdening draughts, O Indra, Lover of the SonAs waters seek the lake where they are wont to rest, fill thee, for bounty, Thunderer. The matchless draught that strengthens and gives eloquence, the sweetest of the meath drink thou,That in thy joy thou maysi scatter thy gifts o’er us, plenteously, even as the dust. Come quickly to our laud, urged on by Soma-pressers like a horse-Laud, Godlike Indra, which milch-kine make sweet for thee: with Kaṇva's sons are gifts for thee. With homage have we sought thee as a Hero, strong, preeminent, with unfailing wealth.O Thunderer, as a plenteous spring pours forth its stream, so, Indra, flow our songs to thee. If now thou art at sacrifice, or if thou art upon the earth,Come thence, high-thoughted! to our sacrifice with the Swift, come, Mighty with the Mighty Ones. The active, fleet-foot, tawny Coursers that are thine are swift to victory, like the Wind,Wherewith thou goest round to visit Manus' seed, wherewith all heaven is visible. Indra, from thee so great we crave prosperity in wealth of kine,As, Maghavan, thou favouredst Medhyātithi, and, in the fight, Nipatithi. As, Maghavan, to Kaṇva, Trasadasyu, and to Paktha and Dasavraja;As, Indra, to Gosarya and Ṛjiśvan, thou vouchsafedst wealth in kine and gold.

verses.sanskrit: उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसं ।अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ abhí ǀ śrutá-magham ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ nárya-apasam ǀástāram ǀ eṣi ǀ sūrya ǁ
verses.english_translation: You rise, O sun, on (the sacrifice of Indra) the showerer (of blessings), the bountiful giver, famed for hiswealth, the benefactor of men.
verses.wilson_translation: You rise, O sun, on (the sacrifice of Indra) the showerer (of blessings), the bountiful giver, famed for hiswealth, the benefactor of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा ।अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत् ॥
verses.transliteration: náva ǀ yáḥ ǀ navatím ǀ púraḥ ǀ bibhéda ǀ bāhú-ojasā ǀáhim ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ avadhīt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Who cleft the ninety-nine cities by the strength of his arm, and, slayeer of Vṛtra, smote Ahi.
verses.wilson_translation: Who cleft the ninety-nine cities by the strength of his arm, and, slayeer of Vṛtra, smote Ahi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स न इंद्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् ।उरुधारेव दोहते ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ áśva-vat ǀ gó-mat ǀ yáva-mat ǀurúdhārā-iva ǀ dohate ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra, our auspicious friend, milk for us, like a richly-streaming (cow), wealth of horses, kine andbarley.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, our auspicious friend, milk for us, like a richly-streaming (cow), wealth of horses, kine andbarley.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य ।सर्वं तदिंद्र ते वशे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ kát ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ ut-ágāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sūrya ǀsárvam ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ váśe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatsoever, O Sun, slayr of Vṛtra, you have risen upon today-- it is all,Indra, under your power.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatsoever, O Sun, slayr of Vṛtra, you have risen upon today-- it is all,Indra, under your power.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा प्रवृद्ध सत्पते न मरा इति मन्यसे ।उतो तत्सत्यमित्तव ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ pra-vṛddha ǀ sat-pate ǀ ná ǀ marai ǀ íti ǀ mányase ǀutó íti ǀ tát ǀ satyám ǀ ít ǀ táva ǁ
verses.english_translation: When, swelling in your might, lord of the good, you think, 'I shall not die', that thought of yours is indeedtrue.
verses.wilson_translation: When, swelling in your might, lord of the good, you think, 'I shall not die', that thought of yours is indeedtrue.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे ।सर्वांस्ताँ इंद्र गच्छसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ parā-váti ǀ yé ǀ arvā-váti ǀ sunviré ǀsárvān ǀ tā́n ǀ indra ǀ gacchasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You go at once,Indra, to all those Soma-libations which are effused afar or effused near.
verses.wilson_translation: You go at once,Indra, to all those Soma-libations which are effused afar or effused near.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमिंद्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हंतवे ।स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ índram ǀ vājayāmasi ǀ mahé ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǀsáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invigorate that (great)Indrafor the slaying of mighty Vṛtra, may he be a bounteous showerer (ofwealth).
verses.wilson_translation: We invigorate that (great)Indrafor the slaying of mighty Vṛtra, may he be a bounteous showerer (ofwealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः ।द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ dā́mane ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ máde ǀ hitáḥ ǀdyumnī́ ǀ ślokī́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ somyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indrawas created for giving; he, the most mighty was set over the exhilarating Soma; he, the gloriousone the lord of praise, is worthy of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrawas created for giving; he, the most mighty was set over the exhilarating Soma; he, the gloriousone the lord of praise, is worthy of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरा वज्रो न संभृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः ।ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: girā́ ǀ vájraḥ ǀ ná ǀ sám-bhṛtaḥ ǀ sá-balaḥ ǀ ánapa-cyutaḥ ǀvavakṣé ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ ástṛtaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty (Indra), unassailed by his foes, hastens to confer wealth on his worshippers-- renderedkeen by their praises as a weapon, full of strength and invincible.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty (Indra), unassailed by his foes, hastens to confer wealth on his worshippers-- renderedkeen by their praises as a weapon, full of strength and invincible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गे चिन्नः सुगं कृधि गृणान इंद्र गिर्वणः ।त्वं च मघवन्वशः ॥
verses.transliteration: duḥ-gé ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ su-gám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀtvám ǀ ca ǀ magha-van ǀ váśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, worthy of our praise, do you, hymned by us, make our path plural in even in the midst of difficulties,(hear us),Maghavan, if you love us.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, worthy of our praise, do you, hymned by us, make our path plural in even in the midst of difficulties,(hear us),Maghavan, if you love us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते नू चिदादिशं न मिनंति स्वराज्यं ।न देवो नाध्रिगुर्जनः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ ā-díśam ǀ ná ǀ minánti ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǀná ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ ádhri-guḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You whose command and rightful empire neither god nor irresistible hero can harm.
verses.wilson_translation: You whose command and rightful empire neither god nor irresistible hero can harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा ते अप्रतिष्कुतं देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः ।उभे सुशिप्र रोदसी ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ te ǀ áprati-skutam ǀ devī́ íti ǀ śúṣmam ǀ saparyataḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ su-śipra ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yes, deity of the handsome jaw, the two goddesses, heaven and earth, both worship your resistlessconsuming might.
verses.wilson_translation: Yes, deity of the handsome jaw, the two goddesses, heaven and earth, both worship your resistlessconsuming might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेतदधारयः कृष्णासु रोहिणीषु च ।परुष्णीषु रुशत्पयः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ etát ǀ adhārayaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇā́su ǀ róhiṇīṣu ǀ ca ǀpáruṣṇīṣu ǀ rúśat ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: It is you that keep this bright milk in the black, red, and spotted cows.
verses.wilson_translation: It is you that keep this bright milk in the black, red, and spotted cows.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि यदहेरध त्विषो विश्वे देवासो अक्रमुः ।विदन्मृगस्य ताँ अमः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ yát ǀ áheḥ ǀ ádha ǀ tviṣáḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ákramuḥ ǀvidát ǀ mṛgásya ǀ tā́n ǀ ámaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When all the gods fled in various directions from the splendour of the demon Ahi, and when fear of thedeer seized them.
verses.wilson_translation: When all the gods fled in various directions from the splendour of the demon Ahi, and when fear of thedeer seized them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदु मे निवरो भुवद्वृत्रहादिष्ट पौंस्यं ।अजातशत्रुरस्तृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ me ǀ ni-varáḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ adiṣṭa ǀ páuṃsyam ǀájāta-śatruḥ ǀ ástṛtaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then was my Indrathe repeller; then did the smiter of Vṛtraput forth his might, he who has no existentenemies, the invincible.
verses.wilson_translation: Then was my Indrathe repeller; then did the smiter of Vṛtraput forth his might, he who has no existentenemies, the invincible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहंतमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनां ।आ शुषे राधसे महे ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutám ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛtrahán-tamam ǀ prá ǀ śárdham ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀā́ ǀ śuṣe ǀ rā́dhase ǀ mahé ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Priests), I bring to you men, for great wealth, that renowned and mighty one who utterly destroyed Vṛtra.
