verses.wilson_translation: (Priests), I bring to you men, for great wealth, that renowned and mighty one who utterly destroyed Vṛtra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत ।यत्सोमेसोम आभवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ ca ǀ gavya-yā́ ǀ púru-nāman ǀ púru-stuta ǀyát ǀ sóme-some ǀ ā́ ǀ ábhavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you bearing many names and praised by many, when you are present at our various Soma-libations,may we be endowed with a kine-desiring mind.
verses.wilson_translation: O you bearing many names and praised by many, when you are present at our various Soma-libations,may we be endowed with a kine-desiring mind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बोधिन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः ।शृणोतु शक्र आशिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: bodhít-manāḥ ǀ ít ǀ astu ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ bhū́ri-āsutiḥ ǀśṛṇótu ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ā-śíṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the slayer of Vṛtra, to whom many libations are offered, know our desires-- mayŚakrahear ourpraises.
verses.wilson_translation: May the slayer of Vṛtra, to whom many libations are offered, know our desires-- mayŚakrahear ourpraises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मंदसे वृषन् ।कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: káyā ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtyā́ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ mandase ǀ vṛṣan ǀkáyā ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showerer (of blessings), with what coming of yours do you gladden us, with what coming bring you(wealth) to your worshippers?
verses.wilson_translation: Showerer (of blessings), with what coming of yours do you gladden us, with what coming bring you(wealth) to your worshippers?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कस्य वृषा सुते सचा नियुत्वान्वृषभो रणत् ।वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: kásya ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ niyútvān ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ raṇat ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: At whose hymn-accompanied libations does the showerer, the lord of the Niyuts, the slayer of Vṛtra,rejoice to drink the Soma?
verses.wilson_translation: At whose hymn-accompanied libations does the showerer, the lord of the Niyuts, the slayer of Vṛtra,rejoice to drink the Soma?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभी षु णस्त्वं रयिं मंदसानः सहस्रिणं ।प्रयंता बोधि दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ rayím ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǀpra-yantā́ ǀ bodhi ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rejoicing (in our oblations), bring us wealth a thousandfold; remember that you are the giver to yourvotary.
verses.wilson_translation: Rejoicing (in our oblations), bring us wealth a thousandfold; remember that you are the giver to yourvotary.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पत्नीवंतः सुता इम उशंतो यंति वीतये ।अपां जग्मिर्निचुंपुणः ॥
verses.transliteration: pátnī-vantaḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ uśántaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ vītáye ǀapā́m ǀ jágmiḥ ǀ ni-cumpuṇáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These Soma-libations with their wives proceed (to Indra) longing to be drunk; the stale Soma, plural asingto the taste, goes to the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: These Soma-libations with their wives proceed (to Indra) longing to be drunk; the stale Soma, plural asingto the taste, goes to the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेंद्रं वृधासो अध्वरे ।अच्छावभृथमोजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭā́ḥ ǀ hótrāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀ índram ǀ vṛdhā́saḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀáccha ǀ ava-bhṛthám ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sacrificing priests, invigorating (Indra) by their offerings at the sacrifice, have by their mightdismissed him to theavabhṛtha.
verses.wilson_translation: The sacrificing priests, invigorating (Indra) by their offerings at the sacrifice, have by their mightdismissed him to theavabhṛtha.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या ।वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितं ॥
verses.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ sadha-mā́dyā ǀ hárī íti ǀ híraṇya-keśyā ǀvoḷhā́m ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀ hitám ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those two golden-maned steeds together exulting bring him to our wholesome offering.
verses.wilson_translation: May those two golden-maned steeds together exulting bring him to our wholesome offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं सोमाः सुता इमे स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो ।स्तोतृभ्य इंद्रमा वह ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ sómāḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ stīrṇám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ vibhāvaso íti vibhā-vaso ǀstotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Resplendent (Agni), these Soma-libations are effused for you, the clipped grass is spread; bring Indrahere for his worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: Resplendent (Agni), these Soma-libations are effused for you, the clipped grass is spread; bring Indrahere for his worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं वि रोचना दधद्रत्ना वि दाशुषे ।स्तोतृभ्य इंद्रमर्चत ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ dákṣam ǀ ví ǀ rocanā́ ǀ dádhat ǀ rátnā ǀ ví ǀ dāśúṣe ǀstotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ índram ǀ arcata ǁ
verses.english_translation: May he give strength and his brilliant heaven and precious things to you his worshipper, and to hispraising priests; worship Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: May he give strength and his brilliant heaven and precious things to you his worshipper, and to hispraising priests; worship Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते दधामींद्रियमुक्था विश्वा शतक्रतो ।स्तोतृभ्य इंद्र मृळय ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ dadhāmi ǀ indriyám ǀ ukthā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀstotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: I prepare,Śatakratu, your strong (Soma) and all your praises; be gracious,Indra, to your hymners.
verses.wilson_translation: I prepare,Śatakratu, your strong (Soma) and all your praises; be gracious,Indra, to your hymners.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भद्रंभद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जं शतक्रतो ।यदिंद्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhadrám-bhadram ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyát ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáyāsi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us what is most auspicious,Śatakratu, (bring us) food and strength, if you have favour to us,Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us what is most auspicious,Śatakratu, (bring us) food and strength, if you have favour to us,Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो विश्वान्या भर सुवितानि शतक्रतो ।यदिंद्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ suvitā́ni ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyát ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáyāsi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us all blessings,Śatakratu, if you have favour to us,Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us all blessings,Śatakratu, if you have favour to us,Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृत्रहंतम सुतावंतो हवामहे ।यदिंद्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ sutá-vantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀyát ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáyāsi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bearing the effused libation, we invoke you, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, if you have favour to us,Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearing the effused libation, we invoke you, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, if you have favour to us,Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते ।उप नो हरिभिः सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ yāhí ǀ madānām ǀ pate ǀúpa ǀ naḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come with your steeds to our effused libation, lord of the Soma-- come with your steds to our effusedlibation.
verses.wilson_translation: Come with your steeds to our effused libation, lord of the Soma-- come with your steds to our effusedlibation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्विता यो वृत्रहंतमो विद इंद्रः शतक्रतुः ।उप नो हरिभिः सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: dvitā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vṛtrahán-tamaḥ ǀ vidé ǀ índraḥ ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀúpa ǀ naḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra,Śatakratu, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, you whose power is known in a two-fold way, come withyour steeds to our effused libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra,Śatakratu, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, you whose power is known in a two-fold way, come withyour steeds to our effused libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि ।उप नो हरिभिः सुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ eṣām ǀ pātā́ ǀ sómānām ǀ ási ǀúpa ǀ naḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the drinker of these Somajuices, come with your steeds to our effused libation.
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the drinker of these Somajuices, come with your steeds to our effused libation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुं रयिं ।वाजी ददातु वाजिनं ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ iṣé ǀ dadātu ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣáṇam ǀ ṛbhúm ǀ rayím ǀvājī́ ǀ dadātu ǀ vājínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indrabring to us the bounteousṚbhuṚbhukṣaṇa to partake of our sacrificial viands; may he,the mighty, bring the mighty (Vāja).
verses.wilson_translation: May Indrabring to us the bounteousṚbhuṚbhukṣaṇa to partake of our sacrificial viands; may he,the mighty, bring the mighty (Vāja).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN II. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १२ बिन्दु: पूतदक्षो वा आङ्गिरस: । मरुत: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SAKRA I praise, to win his aid, far-famed, exceeding bountiful,Who gives, as ’twere in thousands, precious wealth to him who sheds the juice and worships him. Arrows with hundred points, unconquerable, are this Indra's n-dghty arms in war.He streams on liberal worshippers like a hill with springs, when juices poured have gladdened him. What time the flowing Soma-drops have gladdened with their taste the Friend,Like water, gracious Lord! were my libations made, like milch-kine to the worshipper. To him the peerless, who is calling you to give you aid, forth flow the drops of pleasant meath.The Soloa-drops which call on thee, O gracious Lord, have brought thee to our hymn of praise. He rushes hurrying like a steed to Soma that adorns our rite,Which hymns make sweet to thee, lover of pleasant food. The call to Paura thou dost love. Praise the strong, grasping Hero, winner of the spoil, ruling supreme oer mighty wealth.Like a full spring, O Thunderer, from thy store hast thou poured on the worshipper evermore. Now whether thou be far away, or in the heavens, or on the earth,O Indra, mighty- thoughted, harnessing thy Bays, come Lofty with the Lofty Ones. The Bays who draw thy chariot, Steeds who injure none, surpass the wind's impetuous strength-With whom thou silencest the enemy of man, with whon; thou goest round the sky. O gracious Hero, may we learn anew to know thee as thou art:As in decisive fight thou holpest Etaśa, or Vaśa 'gainst Dasavraja, As, Maghavan, to Kaṇva at the sacred feast, to Dirghanitha thine home-friend,As to Gosarya thou, Stone-darter, gavest wealth, give me a gold-bright stall of kine.

verses.sanskrit: गौर्धयति मरुतां श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनां ।युक्ता वह्नी रथानां ॥
verses.transliteration: gáuḥ ǀ dhayati ǀ marútām ǀ śravasyúḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ maghónām ǀyuktā́ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ráthānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: The cow (Pṛs;ni), the food-desiring mother of the wealthy Maruts, drinks (the Soma)-- she is worthy ofall honour, who yokes (the mares) to their chariots.
verses.wilson_translation: The cow (Pṛs;ni), the food-desiring mother of the wealthy Maruts, drinks (the Soma)-- she is worthy ofall honour, who yokes (the mares) to their chariots.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्या देवा उपस्थे व्रता विश्वे धारयंते ।सूर्यामासा दृशे कं ॥
verses.transliteration: yásyāḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ vratā́ ǀ víśve ǀ dhāráyante ǀsū́ryāmā́sā ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǁ
verses.english_translation: She, in whose presence all the gods observe their functions, and the sun and moon move in peace toenlighten the world.
verses.wilson_translation: She, in whose presence all the gods observe their functions, and the sun and moon move in peace toenlighten the world.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणंति कारवः ।मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sádā ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ kārávaḥ ǀmarútaḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Therefore all our priests in their worship always sing the Marutsthat they may drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Therefore all our priests in their worship always sing the Marutsthat they may drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबंत्यस्य मरुतः ।उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: ásti ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ayám ǀ sutáḥ ǀ píbanti ǀ asya ǀ marútaḥ ǀutá ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somais effused (by us); the self-resplendent Marutsdrink of it, and the Aśvins.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somais effused (by us); the self-resplendent Marutsdrink of it, and the Aśvins.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबंति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः ।त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः ॥
verses.transliteration: píbanti ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ tánā ǀ pūtásya ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀtri-sadhasthásya ǀ jā́-vataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra,Aryamanand Varuṇadrink (the Soma), purified by the straining cloth, abiding in three plural ces,and granting posterity.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitra,Aryamanand Varuṇadrink (the Soma), purified by the straining cloth, abiding in three plural ces,and granting posterity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य जोषमाँ इंद्रः सुतस्य गोमतः ।प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति ॥
verses.transliteration: utó íti ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ jóṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀprātáḥ ǀ hótā-iva ǀ matsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraalso is eager in the morning to drink this effused (Soma) mixed with milk, as a priest (to praise thegods).
verses.wilson_translation: Indraalso is eager in the morning to drink this effused (Soma) mixed with milk, as a priest (to praise thegods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कदत्विषंत सूरयस्तिर आप इव स्रिधः ।अर्षंति पूतदक्षसः ॥
verses.transliteration: kát ǀ atviṣanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ ā́paḥ-iva ǀ srídhaḥ ǀárṣanti ǀ pūtá-dakṣasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When do the sages flash like waters across (to sky)? When do the Maruts, pure in vigour, destroyers ofenemies, come to our offering?
verses.wilson_translation: When do the sages flash like waters across (to sky)? When do the Maruts, pure in vigour, destroyers ofenemies, come to our offering?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कद्वो अद्य महानां देवानामवो वृणे ।त्मना च दस्मवर्चसां ॥
verses.transliteration: kát ǀ vaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ mahā́nām ǀ devā́nām ǀ ávaḥ ǀ vṛṇe ǀtmánā ǀ ca ǀ dasmá-varcasām ǁ
verses.english_translation: O shall I today possess your protection, mighty deities, beautiful bright in yourselves (thoughunadorned)?
verses.wilson_translation: O shall I today possess your protection, mighty deities, beautiful bright in yourselves (thoughunadorned)?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ये विश्वा पार्थिवानि पप्रथन्रोचना दिवः ।मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yé ǀ víśvā ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ papráthan ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀmarútaḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We invoke) thosemarutsto drink our Soma, who have spread our all the things of earth and theluminaries of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: (We invoke) thosemarutsto drink our Soma, who have spread our all the things of earth and theluminaries of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्यान्नु पूतदक्षसो दिवो वो मरुतो हुवे ।अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tyā́n ǀ nú ǀ pūtá-dakṣasaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ huve ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: OMaruts, I invoke you, resplendent, of pure vigour, to drink this Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: OMaruts, I invoke you, resplendent, of pure vigour, to drink this Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्यान्नु ये वि रोदसी तस्तभुर्मरुतो हुवे ।अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tyā́n ǀ nú ǀ yé ǀ ví ǀ ródasī íti ǀ tastabhúḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ huve ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke those Marutsto drink this Soma, who have established heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke those Marutsto drink this Soma, who have established heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्यं नु मारुतं गणं गिरिष्ठां वृषणं हुवे ।अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tyám ǀ nú ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǀ giri-sthā́m ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ huve ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke that band of the Maruts, abiding in the clouds, the showerers, to drink this Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke that band of the Maruts, abiding in the clouds, the showerers, to drink this Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN III. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . As with Manu Samvarani, Indra, thou drankest Soma juice,And, Maghavan, with Nipatithi, Medbyatithi, with Pustigu and Srustigu,— T'he son of Prsadvana was Praskaniva's host, who lay decrepit and forlorn.Aided by thee the Ṛṣi Dasyave-vrka strove to obtain thousands of kine. Call hither with thy newest song Indra who lacks not hymns of praise,Him who observes and knows, inspirer of the sage, him who seems eager to enjoy. He unto whom they sang the seven-headed hymn, three-parted, in the loftiest place,He sent his thunder down on all these living things, and so displayed heroic might. We invocate that Indra who bestoweth precious things on us.Now do we know his newest favour; may we gain a stable that is full of kine. He whom thou aidest, gracious Lord, to give again, obtains great wealth to nourish him.We with our Soma ready, Lover of the Song! call, Indra Maghavan, on thee. Ne’er art thou fruitless, Indra ne’er dost thou desert the worshipperBut now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more. He who hath. overtaken Krvi with his might, and silenced Śuṣṇa with deathbolts,—When he supported yonder heaven and spread it out, then first the son of earth was born. Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Āryas, Dāsas here belong.Directly unto thee, the pious Ruśama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh. In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling oil and rich in sweets.Riches have spread among us and heroic strength, with us are flowing Soma-drops.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः ।अभि त्वा समनूषतेंद्र वत्सं न मातरः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ gíraḥ ǀ rathī́ḥ-iva ǀ ásthuḥ ǀ sutéṣu ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀabhí ǀ tvā ǀ sám ǀ anūṣata ǀ índra ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OIndra, worthy of praise when the Somais effused our songs hasten to you as charioteer, they lowtowards you as cows towards their calves.
verses.wilson_translation: OIndra, worthy of praise when the Somais effused our songs hasten to you as charioteer, they lowtowards you as cows towards their calves.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा शुक्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतास इंद्र गिर्वणः ।पिबा त्वस्यांधस इंद्र विश्वासु ते हितं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ acucyavuḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀpíba ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ índra ǀ víśvāsu ǀ te ǀ hitám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraworthy of praise, let the bright Soma-libations come to you; drink your portion of the Soma; Indra,in all plural ces it is fit for you.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraworthy of praise, let the bright Soma-libations come to you; drink your portion of the Soma; Indra,in all plural ces it is fit for you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबा सोमं मदाय कमिंद्र श्येनाभृतं सुतं ।त्वं हि शश्वतीनां पती राजा विशामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ índra ǀ śyená-ābhṛtam ǀ sutám ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ pátiḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ vi��ā́m ǀ ási ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drink to your fill,Indra, the effused Somabrought, by the hawk, you are the lord of all the divine hosts,you are the self-resplendent.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink to your fill,Indra, the effused Somabrought, by the hawk, you are the lord of all the divine hosts,you are the self-resplendent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इंद्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति ।सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि ॥
verses.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ tiraścyā́ḥ ǀ índra ǀ yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ saparyáti ǀsu-vī́ryasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ pūrdhi ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hear,Indra, the prayer of Tiraści who worships you, and satisfy him with wealth bringing gallantoffspring and cattle-- for you are mighty.
verses.wilson_translation: Hear,Indra, the prayer of Tiraści who worships you, and satisfy him with wealth bringing gallantoffspring and cattle-- for you are mighty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र यस्ते नवीयसीं गिरं मंद्रामजीजनत् ।चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीं ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ návīyasīm ǀ gíram ǀ mandrā́m ǀ ájījanat ǀcikitvít-manasam ǀ dhíyam ǀ pratnā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pipyúṣīm ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him who has made for you this newest joy-giving hymn, do you,Indra, (extend) your ancient truthfulprovidence to which all hearts are known.
verses.wilson_translation: To him who has made for you this newest joy-giving hymn, do you,Indra, (extend) your ancient truthfulprovidence to which all hearts are known.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इंद्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः ।पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासंतो वनामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stavāma ǀ yám ǀ gíraḥ ǀ índram ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyā ǀ sísāsantaḥ ǀ vanāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us praise that Indrawhom our chants and hymns have magnified; we worship him, desirous tohonour his many deeds of might.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us praise that Indrawhom our chants and hymns have magnified; we worship him, desirous tohonour his many deeds of might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतो न्विंद्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना ।शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्ध आशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥
verses.transliteration: éto íti ǀ nú ǀ índram ǀ stavāma ǀ śuddhám ǀ śuddhéna ǀ sā́mnā ǀśuddháiḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ vavṛdhvā́ṃsam ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ āśī́ḥ-vān ǀ mamattu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come let us praise the purified Indrawith a pure Sāmanand with pure recited hymns; let the pure(Soma) mixed with milk gladden him waxing strong.
verses.wilson_translation: Come let us praise the purified Indrawith a pure Sāmanand with pure recited hymns; let the pure(Soma) mixed with milk gladden him waxing strong.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः ।शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ śuddhā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀśuddháḥ ǀ rayím ǀ ní ǀ dhāraya ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ mamaddhi ǀ somyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us,Indra, purified; purified with your pure protecting hosts; purified establish wealth in us;purified and now worthy of the Soma, rejoice.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Indra, purified; purified with your pure protecting hosts; purified establish wealth in us;purified and now worthy of the Soma, rejoice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे ।शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
verses.transliteration: índra ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǀśuddháḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnase ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sisāsasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified,Indra, give us wealth; purified give to your worshipper precious things; purified you smite yourenemies; purified you desire to give us food.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified,Indra, give us wealth; purified give to your worshipper precious things; purified you smite yourenemies; purified you desire to give us food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IV. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: २१ तिरश्चीराङ्गिरसो, द्युतानो वा मारुत: । इन्द्र:, १४ इन्द्रामरुत: १५ इन्द्राबृहस्पती । त्रिष्टुप् , ४ विराट् , २१ पुरस्ताज्ज्योति: ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . As, Śakra, thou with Manu called Vivasvān drankest Soma juice,As, Indra, thou didst love the hymn by Trita's side, so dost thou joy with Āyu now. As thou with Mātariśvan, Medhya, Prsadhra, hast cheered thee Indra, with pressed juice,Drunk Soma with Rjunas, Syūmaraśmi, by Dasonya's Dasasipra's side. ’Tis he who made the lauds his own and boldly drank the Soma juice,He to whom Viṣṇu came striding his three wide steps, as Mitra's statutes ordered it. In whose laud thou didst joy, Indra, at the great deed, O Śatakratu, Mighty One!Seeking renown we call thee as the milkers call the cow who yields abundant milk. He is our Sire who gives to us, Great, Mighty, ruling as he wills.Unsought, may he the Strong, Rich, Lord of ample wealth, give us of horses and of kine. He to whom thou, Good Lord, givest that he may give increases wealth that nourishes.Eager for wealth we call on Indra, Lord of wealth, on Śatakratu with our lauds. Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care.The call on Indra, fourth Āditya! is thine own. Amṛta is stablished in the heavens. The offercr whom thou, Indra, Lover of the Song, liberal Maghavan, favourest,—As at the call of Kaṇva so, O gracious Lord, hear, thou our songs and eulogy. Sung is the song of ancient time: to Indra have ye said the prayer.They have sung many a Brhati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper's many thoughts. Indra hath tossed together mighty stores of wealth, and both the worlds, yea, and the Sun.Pure, brightly-shining, mingled with the milk, the draughts of Soma have made Indra glad.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मा उषास आतिरंत याममिंद्राय नक्तमूर्म्याः सुवाचः ।अस्मा आपो मातरः सप्त तस्थुर्नृभ्यस्तराय सिंधवः सुपाराः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmái ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ atiranta ǀ yā́mam ǀ índrāya ǀ náktam ǀ ū́rmyāḥ ǀ su-vā́caḥ ǀasmái ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ saptá ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ tárāya ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ su-pārā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For him the dawns prolonged their rising; for Indrathe nights uttered auspicious voices by night; for himthe waters, the mothers, the seven rivers, stood, offering an easy passage for men to cross over.
verses.wilson_translation: For him the dawns prolonged their rising; for Indrathe nights uttered auspicious voices by night; for himthe waters, the mothers, the seven rivers, stood, offering an easy passage for men to cross over.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतिविद्धा विथुरेणा चिदस्त्रा त्रिः सप्त सानु संहिता गिरीणां ।न तद्देवो न मर्त्यस्तुतुर्याद्यानि प्रवृद्धो वृषभश्चकार ॥
verses.transliteration: áti-viddhā ǀ vithuréṇa ǀ cit ǀ ástrā ǀ tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ sā́nu ǀ sám-hitā ǀ girīṇā́m ǀná ǀ tát ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ tuturyāt ǀ yā́ni ǀ prá-vṛddhaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ cakā́ra ǁ
verses.english_translation: By him the thrower, unaided, were pierced asunder the thrice seven table-lands of the mountainheaped together; neither god nor mortal could do what he, the showerer, in his full-grown strength has done.
verses.wilson_translation: By him the thrower, unaided, were pierced asunder the thrice seven table-lands of the mountainheaped together; neither god nor mortal could do what he, the showerer, in his full-grown strength has done.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्य वज्र आयसो निमिश्ल इंद्रस्य बाह्वोर्भूयिष्ठमोजः ।शीर्षन्निंद्रस्य क्रतवो निरेक आसन्नेषंत श्रुत्या उपाके ॥
verses.transliteration: índrasya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ āyasáḥ ǀ ní-miślaḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ bhū́yiṣṭham ǀ ójaḥ ǀśīrṣán ǀ índrasya ǀ krátavaḥ ǀ nireké ǀ āsán ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣanta ǀ śrútyai ǀ upāké ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra's iron thunderbolt is grasped firmly in hishand, enormous strength resides in his arms; when hegoes forth (to battle), there is ample employment for his head and his mouth, and (his followers) rush near him tohear his commands.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra's iron thunderbolt is grasped firmly in hishand, enormous strength resides in his arms; when hegoes forth (to battle), there is ample employment for his head and his mouth, and (his followers) rush near him tohear his commands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मन्ये त्वा यज्ञियं यज्ञियानां मन्ये त्वा च्यवनमच्युतानां ।मन्ये त्वा सत्वनामिंद्र केतुं मन्ये त्वा वृषभं चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: mánye ǀ tvā ǀ yajñíyam ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ mánye ǀ tvā ǀ cyávanam ǀ ácyutānām ǀmánye ǀ tvā ǀ sátvanām ǀ indra ǀ ketúm ǀ mánye ǀ tvā ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: I think you the most worthy among those worthy of sacrifice; I think you the overthrower of theimperishable (mountains); I think you,Indra, the banner of warriors; I think you the showerer (of blessings) tomen.
verses.wilson_translation: I think you the most worthy among those worthy of sacrifice; I think you the overthrower of theimperishable (mountains); I think you,Indra, the banner of warriors; I think you the showerer (of blessings) tomen.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिंद्र धत्से मदच्युतमहये हंतवा उ ।प्र पर्वता अनवंत प्र गावः प्र ब्रह्माणो अभिनक्षंत इंद्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ indra ǀ dhátse ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ áhaye ǀ hántavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀprá ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ ánavanta ǀ prá ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ prá ǀ brahmā́ṇaḥ ǀ abhi-nákṣantaḥ ǀ índram ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indra, you grasp in your arms your pride humbling thunderbolt to smite Ahi, when the mountainclouds loudly roar and the cows loudly bellow, then thebrāhmaṇasoffer their worship to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indra, you grasp in your arms your pride humbling thunderbolt to smite Ahi, when the mountainclouds loudly roar and the cows loudly bellow, then thebrāhmaṇasoffer their worship to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम य इमा जजान विश्वा जातान्यवराण्यस्मात् ।इंद्रेण मित्रं दिधिषेम गीर्भिरुपो नमोभिर्वृषभं विशेम ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stavāma ǀ yáḥ ǀ imā́ ǀ jajā́na ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ ávarāṇi ǀ asmāt ǀíndreṇa ǀ mitrám ǀ didhiṣema ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ úpo íti ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ viśema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us praise that Indrawho produced all the things, to him all beings are subsequent; may we maintainfriendship with Indra by our hymns, let us bring the showerer (of blessings) near us by our praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us praise that Indrawho produced all the things, to him all beings are subsequent; may we maintainfriendship with Indra by our hymns, let us bring the showerer (of blessings) near us by our praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः ।मरुद्भिरिंद्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛtrásya ǀ tvā ǀ śvasáthāt ǀ ī́ṣamāṇāḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ajahuḥ ǀ yé ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ sakhyám ǀ te ǀ astu ǀ átha ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ jayāsi ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the gods who were your friends forsook you, flying away at the snorting of Vṛtra; OIndra, let therebe friendship to you with the Maruts; then do you conquer all these hostile armies.
verses.wilson_translation: All the gods who were your friends forsook you, flying away at the snorting of Vṛtra; OIndra, let therebe friendship to you with the Maruts; then do you conquer all these hostile armies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिः षष्टिस्त्वा मरुतो वावृधाना उस्रा इव राशयो यज्ञियासः ।उप त्वेमः कृधि नो भागधेयं शुष्मं त एना हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ ṣaṣṭíḥ ǀ tvā ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vavṛdhānā́ḥ ǀ usrā́ḥ-iva ǀ rāśáyaḥ ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀúpa ǀ tvā ǀ ā́ ǀ imaḥ ǀ kṛdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ bhāga-dhéyam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ te ǀ enā́ ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
verses.english_translation: These sixty-three Marutswere worthy of sacrifice nourishing your vigour like cows gathered together;we come to you, do you grant us our portion; so will we produce strength in you by this offering.
verses.wilson_translation: These sixty-three Marutswere worthy of sacrifice nourishing your vigour like cows gathered together;we come to you, do you grant us our portion; so will we produce strength in you by this offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तिग्ममायुधं मरुतामनीकं कस्त इंद्र प्रति वज्रं दधर्ष ।अनायुधासो असुरा अदेवाश्चक्रेण ताँ अप वप ऋजीषिन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tigmám ǀ ā́yudham ǀ marútām ǀ ánīkam ǀ káḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ práti ǀ vájram ǀ dadharṣa ǀanāyudhā́saḥ ǀ ásurāḥ ǀ adevā́ḥ ǀ cakréṇa ǀ tā́n ǀ ápa ǀ vapa ǀ ṛjīṣin ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your sharp bow, the host of Maruts, and your thunderbolt who,Indra, has ever withstood? The asurasare weaponless and abandoned by the gods, drive them away by your discus, O Ṛjīṣin.
verses.wilson_translation: Your sharp bow, the host of Maruts, and your thunderbolt who,Indra, has ever withstood? The asurasare weaponless and abandoned by the gods, drive them away by your discus, O Ṛjīṣin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मह उग्राय तवसे सुवृक्तिं प्रेरय शिवतमाय पश्वः ।गिर्वाहसे गिर इंद्राय पूर्वीर्धेहि तन्वे कुविदंग वेदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mahé ǀ ugrā́ya ǀ taváse ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ prá ǀ īraya ǀ śivá-tamāya ǀ paśváḥ ǀgírvāhase ǀ gíraḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ dhehí ǀ tanvé ǀ kuvít ǀ aṅgá ǀ védat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Send forth an excellent hymn to great (Indra), the strong, might and most fortunate, (that he mayprosper) my cattle; utter many praises to Indra who is borne by praise, may he speedily give much wealth to me.
verses.wilson_translation: Send forth an excellent hymn to great (Indra), the strong, might and most fortunate, (that he mayprosper) my cattle; utter many praises to Indra who is borne by praise, may he speedily give much wealth to me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उक्थवाहसे विभ्वे मनीषां द्रुणा न पारमीरया नदीनां ।नि स्पृश धिया तन्वि श्रुतस्य जुष्टतरस्य कुविदंग वेदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ukthá-vāhase ǀ vi-bhvé ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ drúṇā ǀ ná ǀ pārám ǀ īraya ǀ nadī́nām ǀní ǀ spṛśa ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ tanví ǀ śrutásya ǀ júṣṭa-tarasya ǀ kuvít ǀ aṅgá ǀ védat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Send forth your praise to mighty Indrawho is borne by hymns, as (a sailor sends a traveller) in a shipacross the rivers; bring to me by your rites that wealth which belongs to him renowned and beneficent; may hespeedily give much wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Send forth your praise to mighty Indrawho is borne by hymns, as (a sailor sends a traveller) in a shipacross the rivers; bring to me by your rites that wealth which belongs to him renowned and beneficent; may hespeedily give much wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तद्विविड्ढि यत्त इंद्रो जुजोषत्स्तुहि सुष्टुतिं नमसा विवास ।उप भूष जरितर्मा रुवण्यः श्रावया वाचं कुविदंग वेदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ viviḍḍhi ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ índraḥ ǀ jújoṣat ǀ stuhí ǀ su-stutím ǀ námasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsa ǀúpa ǀ bhūṣa ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ruvaṇyaḥ ǀ śraváya ǀ vā́cam ǀ kuvít ǀ aṅgá ǀ védat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Perform those rites of yours that Indramay accept them; praise him to whom praise belongs, worshiphim with your service; O priest, adorn thyself, grieve not (for poverty); let Indra hear your praise, may he speedilygive much wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Perform those rites of yours that Indramay accept them; praise him to whom praise belongs, worshiphim with your service; O priest, adorn thyself, grieve not (for poverty); let Indra hear your praise, may he speedilygive much wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदियानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः ।आवत्तमिंद्रः शच्या धमंतमप स्नेहितीर्नृमणा अधत्त ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ aṃśu-mátīm ǀ atiṣṭhat ǀ iyānáḥ ǀ kṛṣṇáḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ sahásraiḥ ǀā́vat ǀ tám ǀ índraḥ ǀ śácyā ǀ dhámantam ǀ ápa ǀ snéhitīḥ ǀ nṛ-mánāḥ ǀ adhatta ǁ
verses.english_translation: The swift-moving Kṛṣṇawith ten thousand (demons) stood on the Aṃśumatī; by his might Indracaught him snorting (in the water); he, benevolent to man, smote his malicious (bands).
verses.wilson_translation: The swift-moving Kṛṣṇawith ten thousand (demons) stood on the Aṃśumatī; by his might Indracaught him snorting (in the water); he, benevolent to man, smote his malicious (bands).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्रप्समपश्यं विषुणे चरंतमुपह्वरे नद्यो अंशुमत्याः ।नभो न कृष्णमवतस्थिवांसमिष्यामि वो वृषणो युध्यताजौ ॥
verses.transliteration: drapsám ǀ apaśyam ǀ víṣuṇe ǀ cárantam ǀ upa-hvaré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ aṃśu-mátyāḥ ǀnábhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ avatasthi-vā́ṃsam ǀ íṣyāmi ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ yúdhyata ǀ ājáu ǁ
verses.english_translation: "I have seen the swift-moving (demon) lurking in an inaccessible plural ce, in the depths of the river Aṃśumatī, (I have seen)Kṛṣṇastanding there as (the sun) in a cloud; I appeal to you, showerers; conquerhim in battle".
verses.wilson_translation: "I have seen the swift-moving (demon) lurking in an inaccessible plural ce, in the depths of the river Aṃśumatī, (I have seen)Kṛṣṇastanding there as (the sun) in a cloud; I appeal to you, showerers; conquerhim in battle".
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध द्रप्सो अंशुमत्या उपस्थेऽधारयत्तन्वं तित्विषाणः ।विशो अदेवीरभ्याचरंतीर्बृहस्पतिना युजेंद्रः ससाहे ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ aṃśu-mátyāḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ ádhārayat ǀ tanvám ǀ titviṣāṇáḥ ǀvíśaḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ā-cárantīḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátinā ǀ yujā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sasahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then the swift-moving one, shining forth assumed his own body by the Aṃśumatī, and Indrawith Bṛhaspati as his ally smote the godless hosts as they drew near.
verses.wilson_translation: Then the swift-moving one, shining forth assumed his own body by the Aṃśumatī, and Indrawith Bṛhaspati as his ally smote the godless hosts as they drew near.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिंद्र ।गूळ्हे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविंदो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ saptá-bhyaḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ aśatrú-bhyaḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ śátruḥ ǀ indra ǀgūḷhé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ánu ǀ avindaḥ ǀ vibhumát-bhyaḥ ǀ bhúvanebhyaḥ ǀ ráṇam ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As soon as you were born,Indra, you were an enemy to those seven who had no enemy; yourecovered the heavens and earth when concealed (in darkness); you cause joy to the mighty worlds.
verses.wilson_translation: As soon as you were born,Indra, you were an enemy to those seven who had no enemy; yourecovered the heavens and earth when concealed (in darkness); you cause joy to the mighty worlds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदप्रतिमानमोजो वज्रेण वज्रिंधृषितो जघंथ ।त्वं शुष्णस्यावातिरो वधत्रैस्त्वं गा इंद्र शच्येदविंदः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ aprati-mānám ǀ ójaḥ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ vajrin ǀ dhṛṣitáḥ ǀ jaghantha ǀtvám ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ áva ǀ atiraḥ ǀ vádhatraiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ śácyā ǀ ít ǀ avindaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thunderer, you, the resolute one, did smite that unrivalled might with your bolt; you destroyed Śuṣṇawith your weapons, you recovered the cows,Indra, by your wisdom.
verses.wilson_translation: Thunderer, you, the resolute one, did smite that unrivalled might with your bolt; you destroyed Śuṣṇawith your weapons, you recovered the cows,Indra, by your wisdom.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यद्वृषभ चर्षणीनां घनो वृत्राणां तविषो बभूथ ।त्वं सिंधूँरसृजस्तस्तभानांत्वमपो अजयो दासपत्नीः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ ghanáḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇām ǀ taviṣáḥ ǀ babhūtha ǀtvám ǀ síndhūn ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ tastabhānā́n ǀ tvám ǀ apáḥ ǀ ajayaḥ ǀ dāsá-patnīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, showerer, were the mighty destroyer of the hindrances of your worshippers; you did set free theobstructed rivers, you did win the waters which the Dāsashad mastered.
verses.wilson_translation: You, showerer, were the mighty destroyer of the hindrances of your worshippers; you did set free theobstructed rivers, you did win the waters which the Dāsashad mastered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सुक्रतू रणिता यः सुतेष्वनुत्तमन्युर्यो अहेव रेवान् ।य एक इन्नर्यपांसि कर्ता स वृत्रहा प्रतीदन्यमाहुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ ráṇitā ǀ yáḥ ǀ sutéṣu ǀ ánutta-manyuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ áhā-iva ǀ revā́n ǀyáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nári ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ kártā ǀ sáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ práti ǀ ít ǀ anyám ǀ āhuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who noble in his exploits rejoices in the Soma-libations, he whose wrath cannot be repelled and whois wealthy as the days, he who alone performs the rites for his worshipper-- he, the slayer of Vṛtra, men say, is amatch for all others.
verses.wilson_translation: He who noble in his exploits rejoices in the Soma-libations, he whose wrath cannot be repelled and whois wealthy as the days, he who alone performs the rites for his worshipper-- he, the slayer of Vṛtra, men say, is amatch for all others.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वृत्रहेंद्रश्चर्षणीधृत्तं सुष्टुत्या हव्यं हुवेम ।स प्राविता मघवा नोऽधिवक्ता स वाजस्य श्रवस्यस्य दाता ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́t ǀ tám ǀ su-stutyā́ ǀ hávyam ǀ huvema ǀsáḥ ǀ pra-avitā́ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ naḥ ǀ adhi-vaktā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ śravasyásya ǀ dātā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indrais the slayer of Vṛtra, the cherisher of men; let us invoke him worthy of invocation, with anexcellent hymn; he is Maghavan, our protector, our encourager, he is the bestower of food that brings fame.
verses.wilson_translation: Indrais the slayer of Vṛtra, the cherisher of men; let us invoke him worthy of invocation, with anexcellent hymn; he is Maghavan, our protector, our encourager, he is the bestower of food that brings fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वृत्रहेंद्र ऋभुक्षाः सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूव ।कृण्वन्नपांसि नर्या पुरूणि सोमो न पीतो हव्यः सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ babhūva ǀkṛṇván ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ náryā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pītáḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As soon as he was born, he,Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, the chief of theṚbhus, was worthy to beinvoked; he, performing many sacred acts for men, is worthy to be invoked for his friends like the quaffed Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: As soon as he was born, he,Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, the chief of theṚbhus, was worthy to beinvoked; he, performing many sacred acts for men, is worthy to be invoked for his friends like the quaffed Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN V. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १५ रेभ: काश्यप: । इन्द्र: । बृहती , १०, १३ अतिजगती, ११-१२ उपरिष्टाद्बृहती, १४ त्रिष्टुप् , १५ जगती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . As highest of the Maghavans, preeminent among the Bulls,Best breaker-down of forts, kine-winner, Lord of wealth, we seek thee, Indra Maghavan. Thou who subduedst Āyu, Kutsa, Atithigva, waxing daily in thy might,As such, rousing thy power, we invocate thee now, thee Śatakratu, Lord of Bays. The pressing-stones shall pour for us the essence of the meath of all,Drops that have been pressed out afar among the folk, and those that have been pressed near us. Repel all enmities and keep thern far away: let all win treasure for their own.Even among Sistas are the stalks that make thee glad, where thou with Soma satest thee. Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve;Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help, good Kinsman, with good kinsmen, come! Bless thou with progeny the chief of men, the lord of heroes, victor in the fray.Aid with thy powers the men who sing thee lauds and keep their spirits ever pure and bright. May we be such in battle as are surest to obtain thy grace:With holy offerings and invocations of the Gods, we mean, that we may win the spoil. Thine, Lord of Bays, am I. Prayer longeth for the spoil. Still with thy help I seek the fight.So, at the raiders' head, I, craving steeds and kine, unite myself with thee alone.

verses.sanskrit: या इंद्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाँ असुरेभ्यः ।स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ bhújaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ábharaḥ ǀ sváḥ-vān ǀ ásurebhyaḥ ǀstotā́ram ǀ ít ǀ magha-van ǀ asya ǀ vardhaya ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ tvé íti ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, lord of heaven, with those good things which you have carried off from theasurasdo youprosper, OMaghavan, your praiser and those who have spread for you the clipped grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, lord of heaven, with those good things which you have carried off from theasurasdo youprosper, OMaghavan, your praiser and those who have spread for you the clipped grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यमिंद्र दधिषे त्वमश्वं गां भागमव्ययं ।यजमाने सुन्वति दक्षिणावति तस्मिंतं धेहि मा पणौ ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ indra ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ tvám ǀ áśvam ǀ gā́m ǀ bhāgám ǀ ávyayam ǀyájamāne ǀ sunvatí ǀ dákṣiṇā-vati ǀ tásmin ǀ tám ǀ dhehi ǀ mā́ ǀ paṇáu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those horses, those cows, that imperishable wealth which you have seized (from your enemies)--bestow them on the sacrificer who offers the Somaand is liberal to the priests-- not on the niggard.
verses.wilson_translation: Those horses, those cows, that imperishable wealth which you have seized (from your enemies)--bestow them on the sacrificer who offers the Somaand is liberal to the priests-- not on the niggard.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य इंद्र सस्त्यव्रतोऽनुष्वापमदेवयुः ।स्वैः ष एवैर्मुमुरत्पोष्यं रयिं सनुतर्धेहि तं ततः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ sásti ǀ avratáḥ ǀ anu-svā́pam ǀ ádeva-yuḥ ǀsváiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ mumurat ǀ póṣyam ǀ rayím ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ tám ǀ tátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let him,Indra, who sleeps away careless of the gods and offering no sacrifices-- let him lose hisprecious wealth by his own evil courses, and then do you stow him away in some hidden plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: Let him,Indra, who sleeps away careless of the gods and offering no sacrifices-- let him lose hisprecious wealth by his own evil courses, and then do you stow him away in some hidden plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् ।अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिंद्र केशिभिः सुतावाँ आ विवासति ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ śakra ǀ ási ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ arvā-váti ǀ vṛtra-han ǀátaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ dyu-gát ǀ indra ǀ keśí-bhiḥ ǀ sutá-vān ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whether,Śakra, you are in the far-distant region, or whether, slayer of Vṛtra, you are in the lower-- thesacrificeer longs to being you,Indra, from thence by his hymns as by heaven-going steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether,Śakra, you are in the far-distant region, or whether, slayer of Vṛtra, you are in the lower-- thesacrificeer longs to being you,Indra, from thence by his hymns as by heaven-going steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वासि रोचने दिवः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि ।यत्पार्थिवे सदने वृत्रहंतम यदंतरिक्ष आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ ási ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǀ samudrásya ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápi ǀyát ǀ pā́rthive ǀ sádane ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ yát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or whether you are in the brightness of heaven, or whether in some region in the midst of the sea, orwhether, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, in some abode in the earth, or whether in the firmament, -- come to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Or whether you are in the brightness of heaven, or whether in some region in the midst of the sea, orwhether, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, in some abode in the earth, or whether in the firmament, -- come to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः सोमेषु सोमपाः सुतेषु शवसस्पते ।मादयस्व राधसा सूनृतावतेंद्र राया परीणसा ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sómeṣu ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ sutéṣu ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀmādáyasva ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ sūnṛ́tā-vatā ǀ índra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ párīṇasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, drinker of the Soma, lord of strength, now that our Soma- libations have been effused, do yougladden us with wholesome food and ample wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, drinker of the Soma, lord of strength, now that our Soma- libations have been effused, do yougladden us with wholesome food and ample wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा न इंद्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्यः ।त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इंद्र परा वृणक् ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ párā ǀ vṛṇak ǀ bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ sadha-mā́dyaḥ ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ tvám ǀ ít ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ párā ǀ vṛṇak ǁ
verses.english_translation: Leave us not,Indra, but share our joy; you are our protection, you are our kindred; Indra, leave us not.
verses.wilson_translation: Leave us not,Indra, but share our joy; you are our protection, you are our kindred; Indra, leave us not.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे इंद्र सचा सुते नि षदा पीतये मधु ।कृधी जरित्रे मघवन्नवो महदस्मे इंद्र सचा सुते ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ indra ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǀ ní ǀ sada ǀ pītáye ǀ mádhu ǀkṛdhí ǀ jaritré ǀ magha-van ǀ ávaḥ ǀ mahát ǀ asmé íti ǀ indra ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sit with us,Indra, at the oblation to drink the Soma;Maghavan, perform a mighty protection for yourworshipper, (seated) with us at the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Sit with us,Indra, at the oblation to drink the Soma;Maghavan, perform a mighty protection for yourworshipper, (seated) with us at the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा देवास आशत न मर्त्यासो अद्रिवः ।विश्वा जातानि शवसाभिभूरसि न त्वा देवास आशत ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ āśata ǀ ná ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ śávasā ǀ abhi-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ āśata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thunderer, neither gods nor mortals equal you by their acts; you surpass all beings by your might, thegods equal you not.
verses.wilson_translation: Thunderer, neither gods nor mortals equal you by their acts; you surpass all beings by your might, thegods equal you not.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरं सजूस्ततक्षुरिंद्रं जजनुश्च राजसे ।क्रत्वा वरिष्ठं वर आमुरिमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तवसं तरस्विनं ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvāḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhi-bhū́taram ǀ náram ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǀ índram ǀ jajanúḥ ǀ ca ǀ rājáse ǀkrátvā ǀ váriṣṭham ǀ váre ǀ ā-múrim ǀ utá ǀ ugrám ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ tavásam ǀ tarasvínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The assembled (priests) have roused Indra, the leader, the conqueror in all battles; they have createdhim (by their hymns) to shine-- him the mightiest in his acts, the smiter of enemies for spoil, the terrible, the mostpowerful, the stalwart, the furious.
verses.wilson_translation: The assembled (priests) have roused Indra, the leader, the conqueror in all battles; they have createdhim (by their hymns) to shine-- him the mightiest in his acts, the smiter of enemies for spoil, the terrible, the mostpowerful, the stalwart, the furious.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समीं रेभासो अस्वरन्निंद्रं सोमस्य पीतये ।स्वर्पतिं यदीं वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ īm ǀ rebhā́saḥ ǀ asvaran ǀ índram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǀsváḥ-patim ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ vṛdhé ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ hí ǀ ójasā ǀ sám ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Rebhas have together praised Indrathat he may drink the Soma; when (they praise) the lord ofheaven that he may wax strong (by the oblations), then he, observant of pious rites, is united to his strength andhis protecting guards.
verses.wilson_translation: The Rebhas have together praised Indrathat he may drink the Soma; when (they praise) the lord ofheaven that he may wax strong (by the oblations), then he, observant of pious rites, is united to his strength andhis protecting guards.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नेमिं नमंति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरा ।सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: nemím ǀ namanti ǀ cákṣasā ǀ meṣám ǀ víprāḥ ǀ abhi-svárā ǀsu-dītáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ ápi ǀ kárṇe ǀ tarasvínaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: At the first sight (the Rebhas) bow to him who is the circumferene of the wheel, the priests (worship)with their praise (Indra) the ram; radiant and unharming, do you also, full of earnestness, sing in his ear with yourhymns.
verses.wilson_translation: At the first sight (the Rebhas) bow to him who is the circumferene of the wheel, the priests (worship)with their praise (Indra) the ram; radiant and unharming, do you also, full of earnestness, sing in his ear with yourhymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमिंद्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं शवांसि ।मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्तद्राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ índram ǀ johavīmi ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ ugrám ǀ satrā́ ǀ dádhānam ǀ áprati-skutam ǀ śávāṃsi ǀmáṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ vavártat ǀ rāyé ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ su-páthā ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ vajrī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Again and again I invoke the strong Indra,Maghavan, who alone really possesses might, the irresistible;may he draw near through our songs, most bounteous and worthy of sacrifice; may he, the thunderer, make allthings prosperous for our wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Again and again I invoke the strong Indra,Maghavan, who alone really possesses might, the irresistible;may he draw near through our songs, most bounteous and worthy of sacrifice; may he, the thunderer, make allthings prosperous for our wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं पुर इंद्र चिकिदेना व्योजसा शविष्ठ शक्र नाशयध्यै ।त्वद्विश्वानि भुवनानि वज्रिंद्यावा रेजेते पृथिवी च भीषा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ púraḥ ǀ indra ǀ cikít ǀ enāḥ ǀ ví ǀ ójasā ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ śakra ǀ nāśayádhyai ǀtvát ǀ víśvāni ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ vajrin ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rejete íti ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ ca ǀ bhīṣā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, mightiestŚakra, you know how to destroy those cities (ofŚambara) by your strength at you allworlds tremble, thunderer-- heaven and earth (tremble) with fear.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, mightiestŚakra, you know how to destroy those cities (ofŚambara) by your strength at you allworlds tremble, thunderer-- heaven and earth (tremble) with fear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तन्म ऋतमिंद्र शूर चित्र पात्वपो न वज्रिंदुरिताति पर्षि भूरि ।कदा न इंद्र राय आ दशस्येर्विश्वप्स्न्यस्य स्पृहयाय्यस्य राजन् ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ mā ǀ ṛtám ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ citra ǀ pātu ǀ apáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vajrin ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ áti ǀ parṣi ǀ bhū́ri ǀkadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ daśasyeḥ ǀ viśvá-psnyasya ǀ spṛhayā́yyasya ǀ rājan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, hero assuming many forms, may that truthfulness of you protect me; bear us, thunderer, over ourmany sins as over waters; when, radiant Indra, will you give us some wealth, desirable to all, manifold in itskinds?
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, hero assuming many forms, may that truthfulness of you protect me; bear us, thunderer, over ourmany sins as over waters; when, radiant Indra, will you give us some wealth, desirable to all, manifold in itskinds?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: १२ नृमेध आङ्गिरस: । इन्द्र: । उष्णिक् ; ७, १०-११ ककुप् ; ९,१२ पुरउष्णिक् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INDRA, the poets with. their hymns extol this hero might of thine:They strengthened, loud in song, thy power that droppeth oil. With hymns the Pauras came to thee. Through piety they came to Indra for his aid, they whose libations give theejoy.As thou with, Krsa and Samvarta hast rejoiced, so, Indra, be thou glad with us. Agreeing in your spirit, all ye Deities, come nigh to us.Vasus and Rudras shall come near to give us aid, and Maruts listen to our call. May Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, and Sarasvatī befriend, and the Seven Streams, this call of mine:May Waters, Wind, the Mountains, and the Forest-Lord, and Earth give ear unto my cry. Indra, with thine own bounteous gift, most liberal of the Mighty Ones,Be our boon benefactor, Vṛtra-slayer, be our feast-companion for our weal. Leader of heroes, Lord of battle, lead thou us to combat, thou Most Sapient One.High fame is theirs who win by invocations, feasts and entertainment of the Gods. Our hopes rest on the Faithful One: in Indra is the people's life.O Maghavan, come nigh that thou mayst give us aid: make plenteous food stream forth for us. Thee would we worship, Indra, with our songs of praise: O Śatakratu, be thou ours.Pour down upon Praskaṇva bounty vast and firm, exuberant, that shall never fail.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् ।धर्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ sā́ma ǀ gāyata ǀ víprāya ǀ bṛhaté ǀ bṛhát ǀdharma-kṛ́te ǀ vipaḥ-cíte ǀ panasyáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing a Sāmanto Indra, a Bṛhatto the mighty sage, to the performer, of religious rites, the all-knowingone who longs for praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing a Sāmanto Indra, a Bṛhatto the mighty sage, to the performer, of religious rites, the all-knowingone who longs for praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः ।विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाँ असि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ abhi-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayaḥ ǀviśvá-karmā ǀ viśvá-devaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are the conqueror,Indra; you have lighted in the sun; you are the maker of all, the lord of all thegods, the mighty.
verses.wilson_translation: You are the conqueror,Indra; you have lighted in the sun; you are the maker of all, the lord of all thegods, the mighty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विभ्राजंज्योतिषा स्वरगच्छो रोचनं दिवः ।देवास्त इंद्र सख्याय येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-bhrā́jan ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ sváḥ ǀ ágacchaḥ ǀ rocanám ǀ diváḥ ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ yemire ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have pervaded the light of the sky, illumining heaven by your splendour; the gods,Indra,submissively solicit your friendship.
verses.wilson_translation: You have pervaded the light of the sky, illumining heaven by your splendour; the gods,Indra,submissively solicit your friendship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एंद्र नो गधि प्रियः सत्राजिदगोह्यः ।गिरिर्न विश्वतस्पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ gadhi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ satrā-jít ǀ ágohyaḥ ǀgiríḥ ǀ ná ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come to us,Indra, beloved one, triumphant, and whom, none can conceal- - lord of heaven, vast on allsides as a mountain.
verses.wilson_translation: Come to us,Indra, beloved one, triumphant, and whom, none can conceal- - lord of heaven, vast on allsides as a mountain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी ।इंद्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ hí ǀ satya ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ babhū́tha ǀ ródasī íti ǀíndra ǀ ási ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Truthful drinker of the Soma, you surpass heaven and earth; OIndra, you are the fosterer of him whoprepares the libation, you are the lord of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Truthful drinker of the Soma, you surpass heaven and earth; OIndra, you are the fosterer of him whoprepares the libation, you are the lord of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिंद्र दर्ता पुरामसि ।हंता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ índra ǀ dartā́ ǀ purā́m ǀ ási ǀhantā́ ǀ dásyoḥ ǀ mánoḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indra, are the stormer of many hostile cities, the slayer of the Dasyu, the fosterer of man, the lordof heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, are the stormer of many hostile cities, the slayer of the Dasyu, the fosterer of man, the lordof heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा हींद्र गिर्वण उप त्वा कामान्महः ससृज्महे ।उदेव यंत उदभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tvā ǀ kā́mān ǀ maháḥ ǀ sasṛjmáhe ǀudā́-iva ǀ yántaḥ ǀ udá-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indraworthy of hymns, we send our earnest praises to you as men going by water (splash their friends)with handfuls.
verses.wilson_translation: Indraworthy of hymns, we send our earnest praises to you as men going by water (splash their friends)with handfuls.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धंति शूर ब्रह्माणि ।वावृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.transliteration: vā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ yavyā́bhiḥ ǀ várdhanti ǀ śūra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀvavṛdhvā́ṃsam ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ divé-dive ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the lake (swells) with the rivers, so our praises, O hero, O thunderer, augment you as you growmore and more day by day.
verses.wilson_translation: As the lake (swells) with the rivers, so our praises, O hero, O thunderer, augment you as you growmore and more day by day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युंजंति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे ।इंद्रवाहा वचोयुजा ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjánti ǀ hárī íti ǀ iṣirásya ǀ gā́thayā ǀ uráu ǀ ráthe ǀ urú-yuge ǀindra-vā́hā ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The priests) by their hymn yoke in the swift deity's yoked at a word.
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests) by their hymn yoke in the swift deity's yoked at a word.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न इंद्रा भरँ ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे ।आ वीरं पृतनाषहं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ ójaḥ ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀā́ ǀ vīrám ǀ pṛtanā-sáham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, all-beholding Maghavan, bring us strength and wealth; (we solicit you) the host-overpoweringchampion.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, all-beholding Maghavan, bring us strength and wealth; (we solicit you) the host-overpoweringchampion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ ।अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ tvám ǀ mātā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ babhū́vitha ǀádha ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have been our father, O giver of dwellings, you our mother OŚatakratu; we pray for thathappiness which is yours.
verses.wilson_translation: You have been our father, O giver of dwellings, you our mother OŚatakratu; we pray for thathappiness which is yours.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयंतमुप ब्रुवे शतक्रतो ।स नो रास्व सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ śuṣmin ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vāja-yántam ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: MightyŚatakratu, invoked by many, I praise you desirous of offerings; do you give us wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: MightyŚatakratu, invoked by many, I praise you desirous of offerings; do you give us wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VII. Praskaṇva's Gift.
hymns.anukramani: ८  नृमेध आङ्गिरस: । इन्द्र: । प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GREAT, verily, is Indra's might. I have beheld, and hither comesThy bounty, Dasyave-vrka! A hundred oxen white of hue are shining like the stars in heaven,So tall, they seem to prop the sky. Bamboos a hundred, a hundred dogs, a hundred skins of beasts well-tanned,A hundred tufts of Balbaja, four hundred red-hued mares are mine. Blest by the Gods, Kinvayanas! be ye who spread through life on life:Like horses have ye stridden forth. Then men extolled the team of seven not yet full-grown, its fame is great.The dark mares rushed along the paths, so that no eye could follow them.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः ।स इंद्र स्तोमवाहसामिह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ idā́ ǀ hyáḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ápīpyan ǀ vajrin ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ indra ǀ stóma-vāhasām ǀ ihá ǀ śrudhi ǀ úpa ǀ svásaram ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thunderer, your worshippers, ready with their oblations, have today and yesterday made you drink (the Soma); listen,Indra, here to us who offer you praise and come you to our dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: Thunderer, your worshippers, ready with their oblations, have today and yesterday made you drink (the Soma); listen,Indra, here to us who offer you praise and come you to our dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र हरिवस्तदीमहे त्वे आ भूषंति वेधसः ।तव श्रवांस्युपमान्युक्थ्या सुतेष्विंद्र गिर्वणः ॥
verses.transliteration: mátsva ǀ su-śipra ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ tát ǀ īmahe ǀ tvé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhūṣanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀtáva ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ upa-mā́ni ǀ ukthyā́ ǀ sutéṣu ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Handsome-jawed lord of steeds, rejoice (in the libation); we pray to you, your votaries come to you Indra, worthy of praise, may your food be a pattern and excellent.
verses.wilson_translation: Handsome-jawed lord of steeds, rejoice (in the libation); we pray to you, your votaries come to you Indra, worthy of praise, may your food be a pattern and excellent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: श्रायंत इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिंद्रस्य भक्षत ।वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम ॥
verses.transliteration: śrā́yantaḥ-iva ǀ sū́ryam ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ bhakṣata ǀvásūni ǀ jāté ǀ jánamāne ǀ ójasā ǀ práti ǀ bhāgám ǀ ná ǀ dīdhima ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the gathering (rays) proceed to the son, so (the Marutsproceed) to Indra, and by their power divideall his treasures among those who have been or will be born; may we meditate on our share.
verses.wilson_translation: As the gathering (rays) proceed to the son, so (the Marutsproceed) to Indra, and by their power divideall his treasures among those who have been or will be born; may we meditate on our share.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनर्शरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इंद्रस्य रातयः ।सो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ánarśa-rātim ǀ vasu-dā́m ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ ��ndrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ asya ǀ kā́mam ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ roṣati ǀ mánaḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ codáyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise him the bestower of wealth, whose gifts are never evil;Indra's gifts are fortunate; he directs hismind to the gift andmarsnot the desire of his worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise him the bestower of wealth, whose gifts are never evil;Indra's gifts are fortunate; he directs hismind to the gift andmarsnot the desire of his worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः ।अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ prá-tūrtiṣu ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ asi ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀaśasti-hā́ ǀ janitā́ ǀ viśva-tū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ tūrya ǀ taruṣyatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, you conquer in battles all opposing hosts; O opposer who beat down those who would opposeyou are the smiter of the wicked, the bringer (of evil to your enemies), and the destroyer of all.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, you conquer in battles all opposing hosts; O opposer who beat down those who would opposeyou are the smiter of the wicked, the bringer (of evil to your enemies), and the destroyer of all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयंतमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा ।विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयंत मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिंद्र तूर्वसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ turáyantam ǀ īyatuḥ ǀ kṣoṇī́ íti ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ mātárā ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ te ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ śnathayanta ǀ manyáve ǀ vṛtrám ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ tū́rvasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Heaven and earth follow your destructive energy as mothers their child; since you smite Vṛtra, all thehostile hosts,Indra, faint at your wrath.
verses.wilson_translation: Heaven and earth follow your destructive energy as mothers their child; since you smite Vṛtra, all thehostile hosts,Indra, faint at your wrath.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितं ।आशुं जेतारं हेतारं रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्र्यावृधं ॥
verses.transliteration: itáḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ajáram ǀ pra-hetā́ram ǀ ápra-hitam ǀāśúm ǀ jétāram ǀ hétāram ǀ rathí-tamam ǀ átūrtam ǀ tugrya-vṛ́dham ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Worshippers), summon here for protecting him who never grows old, the repeller (of enemies), himselfnever expelled, the swift conqueror, the driver, the best of charioteers, unharmed of any, the augmenter of water.
verses.wilson_translation: (Worshippers), summon here for protecting him who never grows old, the repeller (of enemies), himselfnever expelled, the swift conqueror, the driver, the best of charioteers, unharmed of any, the augmenter of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इष्कर्तारमनिष्कृतं सहस्कृतं शतमूतिं शतक्रतुं ।समानमिंद्रमवसे हवामहे वसवानं वसूजुवं ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣkartā́ram ǀ ániḥ-kṛtam ǀ sáhaḥ-kṛtam ǀ śatám-ūtim ǀ śatá-kratum ǀsamānám ǀ índram ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǀ vásavānam ǀ vasu-júvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit for our protection Indra, the consecrator of others but himself consecrated by none, producedby strength, possessing a hundred-fold protection, possessing hundred-fold knowledge, a common deity tomany, hiding treasures in his store-house and sending wealth (to his votaries).
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit for our protection Indra, the consecrator of others but himself consecrated by none, producedby strength, possessing a hundred-fold protection, possessing hundred-fold knowledge, a common deity tomany, hiding treasures in his store-house and sending wealth (to his votaries).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII Praskaṇva's Go.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THY bounty, Dasyave-vrka, exhaustless hath displayed itself:Its fulness is as broad as heaven. Ten thousand Dasyave-vrka, the son of Putakrata, hathFrom his own wealth bestowed on me. A hundred asses hath he given, a hundred head of fleecy sheep,A hundred slaves, and wreaths besides. There also was a mare led forth, picked out for Putakrata's sake,Not of the horses of the herd. Observant Agni hath appeared, oblation-bearer with his car.Agni with his resplendent flame hath shone on high as shines the Sun, hath shone like Sūrya in theheavens.

verses.sanskrit: अयं त एमि तन्वा पुरस्ताद्विश्वे देवा अभि मा यंति पश्चात् ।यदा मह्यं दीधरो भागमिंद्रादिन्मया कृणवो वीर्याणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ emi ǀ tanvā́ ǀ purástāt ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ mā ǀ yanti ǀ paścā́t ǀyadā́ ǀ máhyam ǀ dī́dharaḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ indra ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ máyā ǀ kṛṇavaḥ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: I here go before you with my son, the Viśve devāsfollow after me; if,Indra, you keep wealth for me,then put forth your strength on my side.
verses.wilson_translation: I here go before you with my son, the Viśve devāsfollow after me; if,Indra, you keep wealth for me,then put forth your strength on my side.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दधामि ते मधुनो भक्षमग्रे हितस्ते भागः सुतो अस्तु सोमः ।असश्च त्वं दक्षिणतः सखा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जंघनाव भूरि ॥
verses.transliteration: dádhāmi ǀ te ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ bhakṣám ǀ ágre ǀ hitáḥ ǀ te ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ astu ǀ sómaḥ ǀásaḥ ǀ ca ǀ tvám ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ me ǀ ádha ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jaṅghanāva ǀ bhū́ri ǁ
verses.english_translation: I offer the exhilarating Somafirst toyou, let the effused enjoyable Soma be plural ced within you; be you afriend on my righthand, then will we two smite our many enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: I offer the exhilarating Somafirst toyou, let the effused enjoyable Soma be plural ced within you; be you afriend on my righthand, then will we two smite our many enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सु स्तोमं भरत वाजयंत इंद्राय सत्यं यदि सत्यमस्ति ।नेंद्रो अस्तीति नेम उ त्व आह क ईं ददर्श कमभि ष्टवाम ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ stómam ǀ bharata ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ satyám ǀ yádi ǀ satyám ǀ ásti ǀná ǀ índraḥ ǀ asti ǀ íti ǀ némaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvaḥ ǀ āha ǀ káḥ ǀ īm ǀ dadarśa ǀ kám ǀ abhí ǀ stavāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offer fervently, may war-loving companions, true praise to Indra, if he truly exists;Nemasays, "verilythere is no Indra", who has ever seen him? Whom shall we praise?
verses.wilson_translation: Offer fervently, may war-loving companions, true praise to Indra, if he truly exists;Nemasays, "verilythere is no Indra", who has ever seen him? Whom shall we praise?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयमस्मि जरितः पश्य मेह विश्वा जातान्यभ्यस्मि मह्ना ।ऋतस्य मा प्रदिशो वर्धयंत्यादर्दिरो भुवना दर्दरीमि ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ asmi ǀ jaritaríti ǀ páśya ǀ mā ǀ ihá ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ abhí ǀ asmi ǀ mahnā́ ǀṛtásya ǀ mā ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ vardhayanti ǀ ā-dardiráḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ dardarīmi ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Indraspeaks): "here I am, worshipper, behold me here; I overpower all beings by my might; the offerersof sacrifice magnify me by their praises; I, the shatterer, shatter the worlds".
verses.wilson_translation: (Indraspeaks): "here I am, worshipper, behold me here; I overpower all beings by my might; the offerersof sacrifice magnify me by their praises; I, the shatterer, shatter the worlds".
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यन्मा वेना अरुहन्नृतस्यँ एकमासीनं हर्यतस्य पृष्ठे ।मनश्चिन्मे हृद आ प्रत्यवोचदचिक्रदंछिशुमंतः सखायः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ áruhan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ ékam ǀ ā́sīnam ǀ haryatásya ǀ pṛṣṭhé ǀmánaḥ ǀ cit ǀ me ǀ hṛdé ǀ ā́ ǀ práti ǀ avocat ǀ ácikradan ǀ śíśu-mantaḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: "When the lovers of sacrifice ascended to me sitting alone on the back of my well-loved (formament),then my mind verily proclaimed to my heart, ' my friends with their children are crying to me' ".
verses.wilson_translation: "When the lovers of sacrifice ascended to me sitting alone on the back of my well-loved (formament),then my mind verily proclaimed to my heart, ' my friends with their children are crying to me' ".
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या या चकर्थ मघवन्निंद्र सुन्वते ।पारावतं यत्पुरुसंभृतं वस्वपावृणोः शरभाय ऋषिबंधवे ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ pra-vā́cyā ǀ yā́ ǀ cakártha ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ sunvaté ǀpā́rāvatam ǀ yát ǀ puru-sambhṛtám ǀ vásu ǀ apa-ávṛṇoḥ ǀ śarabhā́ya ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bandhave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily all those deeds of yours,Maghavan, are to be proclaimed, which you have achieved for him whooffers libations in the sacrifice; that wealth of Pārāvat, collected by many; you have opened toŚarabha, thekinsman of the Ṛṣi.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily all those deeds of yours,Maghavan, are to be proclaimed, which you have achieved for him whooffers libations in the sacrifice; that wealth of Pārāvat, collected by many; you have opened toŚarabha, thekinsman of the Ṛṣi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र नूनं धावता पृथङ्नेह यो वो अवावरीत् ।नि षीं वृत्रस्य मर्मणि वज्रमिंद्रो अपीपतत् ॥
