verses.transliteration: prá ǀ nūnám ǀ dhāvata ǀ pṛ́thak ǀ ná ǀ ihá ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ávāvarīt ǀní ǀ sīm ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ mármaṇi ǀ vájram ǀ índraḥ ǀ apīpatat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Haste now severally forward; he is not here who stopped your way-- has not Indralet fall histhunderbolt in the very vitals of that enemy?
verses.wilson_translation: Haste now severally forward; he is not here who stopped your way-- has not Indralet fall histhunderbolt in the very vitals of that enemy?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मनोजवा अयमान आयसीमतरत्पुरं ।दिवं सुपर्णो गत्वाय सोमं वज्रिण आभरत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mánaḥ-javāḥ ǀ áyamānaḥ ǀ āyasī́m ǀ atarat ǀ púram ǀdívam ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ gatvā́ya ǀ sómam ǀ vajríṇaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abharat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Suparṇa, rushing swift as thought, passed through the metal city; then having gone to heaven hebrought the Somato the thunderer.
verses.wilson_translation: Suparṇa, rushing swift as thought, passed through the metal city; then having gone to heaven hebrought the Somato the thunderer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रे अंतः शयत उद्ना वज्रो अभीवृतः ।भरंत्यस्मै संयतः पुरःप्रस्रवणा बलिं ॥
verses.transliteration: samudré ǀ antáríti ǀ śayate ǀ udnā́ ǀ vájraḥ ǀ abhí-vṛtaḥ ǀbháranti ǀ asmai ǀ sam-yátaḥ ǀ puráḥ-prasravaṇāḥ ǀ balím ǁ
verses.english_translation: The thunderbolt lies in the midst of the sea, covered with the waters; (the foes) flying in front of thebattle bring offerings of submission to it.
verses.wilson_translation: The thunderbolt lies in the midst of the sea, covered with the waters; (the foes) flying in front of thebattle bring offerings of submission to it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वाग्वदंत्यविचेतनानि राष्ट्री देवानां निषसाद मंद्रा ।चतस्र ऊर्जं दुदुहे पयांसि क्व स्विदस्याः परमं जगाम ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ vā́k ǀ vádantī ǀ avi-cetanā́ni ǀ rā́ṣṭrī ǀ devā́nām ǀ ni-sasā́da ǀ mandrā́ ǀcátasraḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ duduhe ǀ páyāṃsi ǀ kvá ǀ svit ǀ asyāḥ ǀ paramám ǀ jagāma ǁ
verses.english_translation: When Vāk, thequeen, the gladdener of the gods, sits down (in the sacrifice) uttering things not to beunderstood, she milks water and food for the four quarters (of the earth); whither now is her best portion gone?
verses.wilson_translation: When Vāk, thequeen, the gladdener of the gods, sits down (in the sacrifice) uttering things not to beunderstood, she milks water and food for the four quarters (of the earth); whither now is her best portion gone?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवीं वाचमजनयंत देवास्तां विश्वरूपाः पशवो वदंति ।सा नो मंद्रेषमूर्जं दुहाना धेनुर्वागस्मानुप सुष्टुतैतु ॥
verses.transliteration: devī́m ǀ vā́cam ǀ ajanayanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tā́m ǀ viśvá-rūpāḥ ǀ paśávaḥ ǀ vadanti ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mandrā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ dúhānā ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ vā́k ǀ asmā́n ǀ úpa ǀ sú-stutā ǀ ā́ ǀ etu ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods produced the goddess Vāk; her do animals of every kind utter; may she, Vāk, theall-gladdening cow, yielding meat and drink, come to us, worthily praised.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods produced the goddess Vāk; her do animals of every kind utter; may she, Vāk, theall-gladdening cow, yielding meat and drink, come to us, worthily praised.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व द्यौर्देहि लोकं वज्राय विष्कभे ।हनाव वृत्रं रिणचाव सिंधूनिंद्रस्य यंतु प्रसवे विसृष्टाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhe ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ kramasva ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ dehí ǀ lokám ǀ vájrāya ǀ vi-skábhe ǀhánāva ǀ vṛtrám ǀ riṇácāva ǀ síndhūn ǀ índrasya ǀ yantu ǀ pra-savé ǀ ví-sṛṣṭāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OViṣṇumy friends, stride forth lustily; O heaven, give room to contain the thunderbolt; let us smite Vṛtra, let us open the rivers; let them flow, set free, at the command of Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: OViṣṇumy friends, stride forth lustily; O heaven, give room to contain the thunderbolt; let us smite Vṛtra, let us open the rivers; let them flow, set free, at the command of Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Aśvins.
hymns.anukramani: १६ जमदग्निर्भार्गव:  । मित्रावरुणौ , ५ मित्रावरुणादित्या:, ६आदित्या:, ७-८ अश्विनौ, ९-१० वायु:, ११-१२ सूर्य:, १३ उषा: सूर्यप्रभा वा, १४ पवमानः, १५-१६ गौ: । १-२  प्रगाथ: = ( बृहती, सतोबृहती ), ३ गायत्री , ४ सतोबृहती , ५-१३   प्रगाथ: = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती, ) १४-१६ त्रिष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ENDOWED, O Gods, with your primeval wisdom, come quickly with your chariot, O ye Holy.Come with your mighty powers, O ye Nāsatyas; come hither, drink ye this the third libation. The truthful Deities, the Three-and-Thirty, saw you approach before the Ever-Truthful.Accepting this our worship and libation, O Aśvins bright with fire, drink ye the Soma. Aśvins, that work of yours deserves our wonder,—the Bull of heaven and earth and air's mid region;Yea, and your thousand promises in battle, -to all of these come near and drink beside us. Here is your portion laid for you, ye Holy: come to these songs of ours, O ye Nāsatyas.Drink among us the Soma full of sweetness, and with your powers assist the man who worships.

verses.sanskrit: ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये ।यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टय आचक्रे हव्यदातये ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛ́dhak ǀ itthā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ śaśamé ǀ devá-tātaye ǀyáḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ mitrā́váruṇau ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ ā-cakré ǀ havyá-dātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: That man verily consecrates the oblation for the sacrifice, who brings quickly Mitraand Varuṇato theofferer for the attainment of his desires.
verses.wilson_translation: That man verily consecrates the oblation for the sacrifice, who brings quickly Mitraand Varuṇato theofferer for the attainment of his desires.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वर्षिष्ठक्षत्रा उरुचक्षसा नरा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा ।ता बाहुता न दंसना रथर्यतः साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: várṣiṣṭha-kṣatrau ǀ uru-cákṣasā ǀ nárā ǀ rā́jānā ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamā ǀtā́ ǀ bāhútā ǀ ná ǀ daṃsánā ǀ ratharyataḥ ǀ sākám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those two leaders of rites, great in mite, far-seeing, resplendent, and most far-hearing, perform theirdeeds like two arms, by the help of the rays of the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: Those two leaders of rites, great in mite, far-seeing, resplendent, and most far-hearing, perform theirdeeds like two arms, by the help of the rays of the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र यो वां मित्रावरुणाजिरो दूतो अद्रवत् ।अयःश���र्षा मदेरघुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ajiráḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ádravat ǀáyaḥ-śīrṣā ǀ máde-raghuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, he who hastens to appear before you, becomes the messenger of the gods; hewears a metal helment, he exults in his wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitraand Varuṇa, he who hastens to appear before you, becomes the messenger of the gods; hewears a metal helment, he exults in his wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न यः संपृच्छे न पुनर्हवीतवे न संवादाय रमते ।तस्मान्नो अद्य समृतेरुरुष्यतं बाहुभ्यां न उरुष्यतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ sam-pṛ́cche ǀ ná ǀ púnaḥ ǀ hávītave ǀ ná ǀ sam-vādā́ya ǀ rámate ǀtásmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sám-ṛteḥ ǀ uruṣyatam ǀ bāhú-bhyām ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who has no plural asure in questioning, nor in repeated calling nor in dialogue-- defend us today fromhim and from his encounter, defend us from his arms.
verses.wilson_translation: He who has no plural asure in questioning, nor in repeated calling nor in dialogue-- defend us today fromhim and from his encounter, defend us from his arms.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो ।वरूथ्यं वरुणे छंद्यं वचः स्तोत्रं राजसु गायत ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ prá ǀ aryamṇé ǀ sacathyám ǀ ṛtavaso ítyṛta-vaso ǀvarūthyám ǀ váruṇe ǀ chándyam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ stotrám ǀ rā́ja-su ǀ gāyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you rich in offerings, sing to Mitra, sing to Aryaman, a reverential hymn produced in the sacrificialchamber; sing a propitiating address to Varuṇa; sing a hymn of praise to the kings.
verses.wilson_translation: O you rich in offerings, sing to Mitra, sing to Aryaman, a reverential hymn produced in the sacrificialchamber; sing a propitiating address to Varuṇa; sing a hymn of praise to the kings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते हिन्विरे अरुणं जेन्यं वस्वेकं पुत्रं तिसॄणां ।ते धामान्यमृता मर्त्यानामदब्धा अभि चक्षते ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hinvire ǀ aruṇám ǀ jényam ǀ vásu ǀ ékam ǀ putrám ǀ tisṝṇā́m ǀté ǀ dhā́māni ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mártyānām ǀ ádabdhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ cakṣate ǁ
verses.english_translation: It was these who sent the red victory-giving Vasu, the one son of the three (worlds); they, the invincible,the immortal, overlook the abodes of men.
verses.wilson_translation: It was these who sent the red victory-giving Vasu, the one son of the three (worlds); they, the invincible,the immortal, overlook the abodes of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ मे वचांस्युद्यता द्युमत्तमानि कर्त्वा ।उभा यातं नासत्या सजोषसा प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ me ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ út-yatā ǀ dyumát-tamāni ǀ kártvā ǀubhā́ ǀ yātam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: O associated Nāsatyās, come both of you to my uplifted glorious praises and my rites, come topartake of my offering.
verses.wilson_translation: O associated Nāsatyās, come both of you to my uplifted glorious praises and my rites, come topartake of my offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रातिं यद्वामरक्षसं हवामहे युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू ।प्राचीं होत्रां प्रतिरंतावितं नरा गृणाना जमदग्निना ॥
verses.transliteration: rātím ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ arakṣásam ǀ hávāmahe ǀ yuvā́bhyām ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀprā́cīm ǀ hótrām ǀ pra-tirántau ǀ itam ǀ narā ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀ jamát-agninā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Deities rich in food, when we solicit your bounty, that (wealth) which demons cannot thwart-- then,helping our praise directed to the east, come, leaders of rites, worshipped by Jamadagni.
verses.wilson_translation: Deities rich in food, when we solicit your bounty, that (wealth) which demons cannot thwart-- then,helping our praise directed to the east, come, leaders of rites, worshipped by Jamadagni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः ।अंतः पवित्र उपरि श्रीणानोऽयं शुक्रो अयामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ divi-spṛ́śam ǀ vā́yo íti ǀ yāhí ǀ sumánma-bhiḥ ǀantáríti ǀ pavítre ǀ upári ǀ śrīṇānáḥ ǀ ayám ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ayāmi ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come,Vāyu, to our heaven-reaching sacrifice with its beautiful hymns of praise, this bright Somahasbeen kept for you, poured out upon the middle of the straining cloth.
verses.wilson_translation: Come,Vāyu, to our heaven-reaching sacrifice with its beautiful hymns of praise, this bright Somahasbeen kept for you, poured out upon the middle of the straining cloth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वेत्यध्वर्युः पथिभी रजिष्ठैः प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ।अधा नियुत्व उभयस्य नः पिब शुचिं सोमं गवाशिरं ॥
verses.transliteration: véti ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ rájiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vītáye ǀádha ǀ niyutvaḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ naḥ ǀ piba ǀ śúcim ǀ sómam ǀ gó-āśiram ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ministrant priest comes by the straighter paths, he brings the oblations for your enjoyment; thenlord of the Niyutsteeds, drink of both kinds, the Somapure and that mixed with milk.
verses.wilson_translation: The ministrant priest comes by the straighter paths, he brings the oblations for your enjoyment; thenlord of the Niyutsteeds, drink of both kinds, the Somapure and that mixed with milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बळादित्य महाँ असि ।महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ असि ॥
verses.transliteration: báṭ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ sūrya ǀ báṭ ǀ āditya ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀmaháḥ ǀ te ǀ satáḥ ǀ mahimā́ ǀ panasyate ǀ addhā́ ǀ deva ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily you are great, O Sun; verily,Āditya, you are great; the greatness of you, the greatone,ispraised; verily you are great, O god.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily you are great, O Sun; verily,Āditya, you are great; the greatness of you, the greatone,ispraised; verily you are great, O god.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि ।मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: báṭ ǀ sūrya ǀ śrávasā ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ satrā́ ǀ deva ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀmahnā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ asuryáḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ vi-bhú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ádābhyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily, O sun, you are great in fame; O god, you are indeed mighty among the gods in might; you arethe slayer of theasuras, and the preceptor (of the gods); your glory is widespread and to be marred by none.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily, O sun, you are great in fame; O god, you are indeed mighty among the gods in might; you arethe slayer of theasuras, and the preceptor (of the gods); your glory is widespread and to be marred by none.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इयं या नीच्यर्किणी रूपा रोहिण्या कृता ।चित्रेव प्रत्यदर्श्यायत्यंतर्दशसु बाहुषु ॥
verses.transliteration: iyám ǀ yā́ ǀ nī́cī ǀ arkíṇī ǀ rūpā́ ǀ róhiṇyā ǀ kṛtā́ ǀcitrā́-iva ǀ práti ǀ adarśi ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀ antáḥ ǀ daśá-su ǀ bāhúṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: She who was created beautiful and bright, bending downwards and receiving all praise, has been seenwithin (the world), like a bridled cow, advancing to the ten regions (spread out) like arms.
verses.wilson_translation: She who was created beautiful and bright, bending downwards and receiving all praise, has been seenwithin (the world), like a bridled cow, advancing to the ten regions (spread out) like arms.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रजा ह तिस्रो अत्यायमीयुर्न्यन्या अर्कमभितो विविश्रे ।बृहद्ध तस्थौ भुवनेष्वंतः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-jā́ḥ ǀ ha ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ati-ā́yam ǀ īyuḥ ǀ ní ǀ anyā́ḥ ǀ arkám ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ viviśre ǀbṛhát ǀ ha ǀ tasthau ǀ bhúvaneṣu ǀ antáríti ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Three kinds of creatures went to destruction; the others came before Agni; the mighty one (the Sun)stood within the worlds; (Vāyu), the purifier, entered the quarters of the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Three kinds of creatures went to destruction; the others came before Agni; the mighty one (the Sun)stood within the worlds; (Vāyu), the purifier, entered the quarters of the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः ।प्र नु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट ॥
verses.transliteration: mātā́ ǀ rudrā́ṇām ǀ duhitā́ ǀ vásūnām ǀ svásā ǀ ādityā́nām ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀprá ǀ nú ǀ vocam ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ jánāya ǀ mā́ ǀ gā́m ǀ ánāgām ǀ áditim ǀ vadhiṣṭa ǁ
verses.english_translation: (She who is) the mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of theĀdityas, the homeof ambrosia-- I have spoken to men of understqanding-- kill not her, the sinless inviolate cow.
verses.wilson_translation: (She who is) the mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of theĀdityas, the homeof ambrosia-- I have spoken to men of understqanding-- kill not her, the sinless inviolate cow.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वचोविदं वाचमुदीरयंतीं विश्वाभिर्धीभिरुपतिष्ठमानां ।देवीं देवेभ्यः पर्येयुषीं गामा मावृक्त मर्त्यो दभ्रचेताः ॥
verses.transliteration: vacaḥ-vídam ǀ vā́cam ǀ ut-īráyantīm ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ upa-tíṣṭhamānām ǀdevī́m ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā-īyúṣīm ǀ gā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ mā ǀ avṛkta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ dabhrá-cetāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine cow, who herself utters, speech and gives speech to others, who comes attended by everykind of utterance, who helps me for my worship of the gods-- it is only the fool who abandons her.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine cow, who herself utters, speech and gives speech to others, who comes attended by everykind of utterance, who helps me for my worship of the gods-- it is only the fool who abandons her.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: २२ भार्गव: प्रयोग:, अग्निर्बार्हस्पत्य:, पावको वा, सहस: पुत्रौ गृहपति-यविष्ठौ तयोर्वान्यतर: । अग्नि: ।  गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HE whom the priests in sundry ways arranging the sacrifice, of one accord, bring hither,Who was appointed as a learned Brahman, -what is the sacrificer's knowledge of him? Kindled in many a spot, still One is Agni; Silrya is One though high o’er all he shineth.Illumining this All, still One is usas. That which is One hath into All developed. The chariot bright and radiant, treasure-laden, three-wheeled, with easy seat, and lightly rolling,Which She of Wondrous Wealth was born to harness,—this car of yours I call. Drink what remaineth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने बृहद्वयो दधासि देव दाशुषे ।कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dádhāsi ǀ deva ǀ dāśúṣe ǀkavíḥ ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ yúvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, the ever young, the wise, the protector of the household, it is you who give abundant foodto the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, the ever young, the wise, the protector of the household, it is you who give abundant foodto the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स न ईळानया सह देवाँ अग्ने दुवस्युवा ।चिकिद्विभानवा वह ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ī́ḷānayā ǀ sahá ǀ devā́n ǀ agne ǀ duvasyúvā ǀcikít ǀ vibhāno íti vi-bhāno ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Resplendent one, do you, the all-knower, bring the gods here with this our reverential hymn of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Resplendent one, do you, the all-knower, bring the gods here with this our reverential hymn of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं चोदिष्ठेन यविष्ठ्य ।अभि ष्मो वाजसातये ॥
verses.transliteration: tváyā ǀ ha ǀ svit ǀ yujā́ ǀ vayám ǀ códiṣṭhena ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀabhí ǀ smaḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: O ever youthful one, with you as our ally, the sender of wealth, we overcome (our enemies) fo rtheattainemnt of food.
verses.wilson_translation: O ever youthful one, with you as our ally, the sender of wealth, we overcome (our enemies) fo rtheattainemnt of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे ।अग्निं समुद्रवाससं ॥
verses.transliteration: aurvabhṛgu-vát ǀ śúcim ǀ apnavāna-vát ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀagním ǀ samudrá-vāsasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like Aurva Bhṛguand like Apanvān, I invoke the pure Agni, dwelling in the midst of the sea.
verses.wilson_translation: Like Aurva Bhṛguand like Apanvān, I invoke the pure Agni, dwelling in the midst of the sea.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हुवे वातस्वनं कविं पर्जन्यक्रंद्यं सहः ।अग्निं समुद्रवाससं ॥
verses.transliteration: huvé ǀ vā́ta-svanam ǀ kavím ǀ parjánya-krandyam ǀ sáhaḥ ǀagním ǀ samudrá-vāsasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke Agni, dwelling in the midst of the sea, the wise one, roaring like the wind, might, with a voicelike Parjanya's.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke Agni, dwelling in the midst of the sea, the wise one, roaring like the wind, might, with a voicelike Parjanya's.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सवं सवितुर्यथा भगस्येव भुजिं हुवे ।अग्निं समुद्रवाससं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ savám ǀ savitúḥ ǀ yathā ǀ bhágasya-iva ǀ bhujím ǀ huve ǀagním ǀ samudrá-vāsasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke Agnidwelling in th emidst of the sea, like the energy of Savitā, like the enjoyments granted by Bhaga.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke Agnidwelling in th emidst of the sea, like the energy of Savitā, like the enjoyments granted by Bhaga.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं वो वृधंतमध्वराणां पुरूतमं ।अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛdhántam ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ puru-támam ǀáccha ǀ náptre ǀ sáhasvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Draw) near to Agnithe strong, the mightiest, him who expands (with his flames), the grandson of theinvincible ones.
verses.wilson_translation: (Draw) near to Agnithe strong, the mightiest, him who expands (with his flames), the grandson of theinvincible ones.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या ।अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ ā-bhúvat ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ rūpā́-iva ǀ tákṣyā ǀasyá ǀ krátvā ǀ yáśasvataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Draw near) that he may deal with us as a carpenter (TVaṣṭā) deals with the timber he has to cut;may we become renowned by his skill.
verses.wilson_translation: (Draw near) that he may deal with us as a carpenter (TVaṣṭā) deals with the timber he has to cut;may we become renowned by his skill.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते ।आ वाजैरुप नो गमत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ patyate ǀā́ ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ gamat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Among the gods Agnihas to do with all the successes (of men); may he come to us with abundance offood.
verses.wilson_translation: Among the gods Agnihas to do with all the successes (of men); may he come to us with abundance offood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेषामिह स्तुहि होतॄणां यशस्तमं ।अग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ ihá ǀ stuhi ǀ hótṝṇām ǀ yaśáḥ-tamam ǀagním ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise at our rite Agni, the most glorious of all ministrant priests, the foremost in the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise at our rite Agni, the most glorious of all ministrant priests, the foremost in the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शीरं पावकशोचिषं ज्येष्ठो यो दमेष्वा ।दीदाय दीर्घश्रुत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: śīrám ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀ jyéṣṭhaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dámeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀdīdā́ya ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Praise him) the dweller in the sacrifice, of purifying radiance, who shines, the chief of the gods andomniscient, in the house (of the sacrificers).
verses.wilson_translation: (Praise him) the dweller in the sacrifice, of purifying radiance, who shines, the chief of the gods andomniscient, in the house (of the sacrificers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमर्वंतं न सानसिं गृणीहि विप्र शुष्मिणं ।मित्रं न यातयज्जनं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ árvantam ǀ ná ǀ sānasím ǀ gṛṇīhí ǀ vipra ǀ śuṣmíṇam ǀmitrám ǀ ná ǀ yātayát-janam ǁ
verses.english_translation: O priest, glorify him, who is welcome and strong as a horse, and who like a friend conquers all foes.
verses.wilson_translation: O priest, glorify him, who is welcome and strong as a horse, and who like a friend conquers all foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः ।वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ dédiśatīḥ ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀvāyóḥ ǀ ánīke ǀ asthiran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sister praises of the worshipper rise to you, proclaiming your glories; they stand kindling you in thepresence of Vāyu.
verses.wilson_translation: The sister praises of the worshipper rise to you, proclaiming your glories; they stand kindling you in thepresence of Vāyu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसंदिनं ।आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदं ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ ávṛtam ǀ barhíḥ ǀ tastháu ǀ ásam-dinam ǀā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ dadha ǀ padám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The waters find their plural ce in him, for whom the triple-jointed grass is spread unlimited and untied (inthe sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: The waters find their plural ce in him, for whom the triple-jointed grass is spread unlimited and untied (inthe sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पदं देवस्य मीळ्हुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः ।भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक् ॥
verses.transliteration: padám ǀ devásya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ ánādhṛṣṭābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀbhadrā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ-iva ǀ upa-dṛ́k ǁ
verses.english_translation: Auspicious is the plural ce of the god who pours forth all desires with his inviolable protections; auspiciousis his appearance like the Sun's.
verses.wilson_translation: Auspicious is the plural ce of the god who pours forth all desires with his inviolable protections; auspiciousis his appearance like the Sun's.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने घृतस्य धीतिभिस्तेपानो देव शोचिषा ।आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ tepānáḥ ǀ deva ǀ śocíṣā ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ vakṣi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Agni, blazing with radiance, through our oblations of ghī, bear (our sacrifice) to the gods andoffer it.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Agni, blazing with radiance, through our oblations of ghī, bear (our sacrifice) to the gods andoffer it.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वाजनंत मातरः कविं देवासो अंगिरः ।हव्यवाहममर्त्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ ajananta ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ kavím ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ ámartyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods, as mothers, have borne you Aṅgirasa, the seer, the immortal, the bearer of the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods, as mothers, have borne you Aṅgirasa, the seer, the immortal, the bearer of the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रचेतसं त्वा कवेऽग्ने दूतं वरेण्यं ।हव्यवाहं नि षेदिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá-cetasam ǀ tvā ǀ kave ǀ ágne ǀ dūtám ǀ váreṇyam ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods seat you in your plural ce, O wise Agni, the seer, the messenger, the most excellent the bearerof the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods seat you in your plural ce, O wise Agni, the seer, the messenger, the most excellent the bearerof the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नहि मे अस्त्यघ्न्या न स्वधितिर्वनन्वति ।अथैतादृग्भरामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: nahí ǀ me ǀ ásti ǀ ághnyā ǀ ná ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ vánan-vati ǀátha ǀ etādṛ́k ǀ bharāmi ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: No cow is mine, and no axe is athandto cleave wood, but yet I bring both these to you.
verses.wilson_translation: No cow is mine, and no axe is athandto cleave wood, but yet I bring both these to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि ।ता जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ agne ǀ kā́ni ǀ kā́ni ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ dā́rūṇi ǀ dadhmási ǀtā́ ǀ juṣasva ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most youthful (Agni), when we offer any kinds of timber trees to burn, you accept them all.
verses.wilson_translation: Most youthful (Agni), when we offer any kinds of timber trees to burn, you accept them all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रो अतिसर्पति ।सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ átti ǀ upa-jíhvikā ǀ yát ǀ vamráḥ ǀ ati-sárpati ǀsárvam ǀ tát ǀ astu ǀ te ǀ ghṛtám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever timber the ant has gnawed, whatever the emmet has infested-- may it all be welcome to youas ghī.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever timber the ant has gnawed, whatever the emmet has infested-- may it all be welcome to youas ghī.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमिंधानो मनसा धियं सचेत मर्त्यः ।अग्निमीधे विवस्वभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ índhānaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ dhíyam ǀ saceta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀagním ǀ īdhe ǀ vivásva-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let a man, when he kindles Agni, perform the ceremony with a (devout) mind; he kindles him with thepriests.
verses.wilson_translation: Let a man, when he kindles Agni, perform the ceremony with a (devout) mind; he kindles him with thepriests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XI. Indra-Varuṇa.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . IN offerings poured to you, O Indra-Varuṇa, these shares of yours stream forth to glorify your state.Ye haste to the libations at each sacrifice when ye assist the worshipper who sheds the juice. The waters and the plants, O Indra-Varuṇa, had efficacious vigour, and attained to might:Ye who have gone beyond the path of middle air,—no godless man is worthy to be called your foe. True is your Krsa's word, Indra and Varuṇa: The seven holy voices pour a wave of meath.For their sake, Lords of splendour! aid the pious man who, unbewildered, keeps you ever in his thoughts. Dropping oil, sweet with Soma, pouring forth their stream, are the Seven Sisters in the seat of sacrifice.These, dropping oil, are yours, O Indra-Varuṇa: with these enrich with gifts and help the worshipper. To our great happiness have we ascribed to these Two Bright Ones truthfulness, great strength, and majesty.O Lords of splendour, aid us through the Three-times-Seven, as we pour holy oil, O Indra-Varuṇa. What ye in time of old Indra and Varuṇa, gave Ṛṣis revelation, thought, and power of song,And places which the wise made, weaving sacrifice,—these through my spirit's fervid glow have I beheld., O Indra-Varuṇa, grant to the worshippers cheerfulness void of pride, and wealth to nourish them.

verses.sanskrit: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः ।उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षंत नो गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádarśi ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ā-dadhúḥ ǀúpo íti ǀ sú ǀ jātám ǀ ā́ryasya ǀ várdhanam ǀ agním ǀ nakṣanta ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, in whom they offer the sacrifices, has appeared-- he who knows all ways; our praises rise to Agni,auspiciously born, the helpeer of theĀrya.
verses.wilson_translation: He, in whom they offer the sacrifices, has appeared-- he who knows all ways; our praises rise to Agni,auspiciously born, the helpeer of theĀrya.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देवाँ अच्छा न मज्मना ।अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य सानवि ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ dáivaḥ-dāsaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ ná ǀ majmánā ǀánu ǀ mātáram ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ ví ǀ vavṛte ǀ tastháu ǀ nā́kasya ǀ sā́navi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, when invoked by Divodāsa, ran along the mother Earth as with might, towards the gods; he tookhis plural ce in the height of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, when invoked by Divodāsa, ran along the mother Earth as with might, towards the gods; he tookhis plural ce in the height of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्रेजंत कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः ।सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: yásmāt ǀ réjanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ carkṛ́tyāni ǀ kṛṇvatáḥ ǀsahasra-sā́m ǀ medhásātau-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ agním ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ saparyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since men tremble before those who perform the sacred sacrifices, therefore, do you devoutly worshipin the solemn rite Agnithe bestower of thousands of kine.
verses.wilson_translation: Since men tremble before those who perform the sacred sacrifices, therefore, do you devoutly worshipin the solemn rite Agnithe bestower of thousands of kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र यं राये निनीषसि मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् ।स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशंसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yám ǀ rāyé ǀ nínīṣasi ǀ mártaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ vaso íti ǀ dā́śat ǀsáḥ ǀ vīrám ǀ dhatte ǀ agne ǀ uktha-śaṃsínam ǀ tmánā ǀ sahasra-poṣíṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, bestower of dwellings, that mortal whom you wish to lead to wealth, and who gives offerings toyou possess of himself a strong son, a reciter of hymns and a lord of great wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, bestower of dwellings, that mortal whom you wish to lead to wealth, and who gives offerings toyou possess of himself a strong son, a reciter of hymns and a lord of great wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स दृळ्हे चिदभि तृणत्ति वाजमर्वता स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः ।त्वे देवत्रा सदा पुरूवसो विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ dṛḷhé ǀ cit ǀ abhí ǀ tṛṇatti ǀ vā́jam ǀ árvatā ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ ákṣiti ǀ śrávaḥ ǀtvé íti ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ sádā ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ víśvā ǀ vāmā́ni ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of vast wealth, he (your worshipper) spoils with his steed food laid up even in strongholds, hepossesses imperishable wealth; in you divine we ever possess all desirable treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of vast wealth, he (your worshipper) spoils with his steed food laid up even in strongholds, hepossesses imperishable wealth; in you divine we ever possess all desirable treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मंद्रो जनानां ।मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यंत्यग्नये ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dáyate ǀ vásu ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ jánānām ǀmádhoḥ ǀ ná ǀ pā́trā ǀ prathamā́ni ǀ asmai ǀ prá ǀ stómāḥ ǀ yanti ǀ agnáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: To him the invoker of the gods, who ever rejoicing distributes all wealth to men-- to Agniproceed ourpraises like the principal cups of the exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: To him the invoker of the gods, who ever rejoicing distributes all wealth to men-- to Agniproceed ourpraises like the principal cups of the exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वं न गीर्भी रथ्यं सुदानवो मर्मृज्यंते देवयवः ।उभे तोके तनये दस्म विश्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनां ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvam ǀ ná ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ rathyám ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ marmṛjyánte ǀ deva-yávaḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ toké íti ǀ tánaye ǀ dasma ǀ viśpate ǀ párṣi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ maghónām ǁ
verses.english_translation: The liberal worshippers with their hymns honour you harnessed to the car like a horse; graceful lord ofmen, grant wealth to us rich in children and grandchildren.
verses.wilson_translation: The liberal worshippers with their hymns honour you harnessed to the car like a horse; graceful lord ofmen, grant wealth to us rich in children and grandchildren.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे ।उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ máṃhiṣṭhāya ǀ gāyata ǀ ṛtá-vne ǀ bṛhaté ǀ śukrá-śociṣe ǀúpa-stutāsaḥ ǀ agnáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Singers of hymns, sing aloud to the mighty Agni, most bounteous, observant of truth an dradiant withbrightness.
verses.wilson_translation: Singers of hymns, sing aloud to the mighty Agni, most bounteous, observant of truth an dradiant withbrightness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वंसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः ।कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्नवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaṃsate ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ naḥ ǀ asya ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ návīyasī ǀ áccha ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ ā-gámat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wealthy and glorious (Agni), when invoked and kindled, pours forth on his votaries abundance offood with children; may his ever fresh favour continually come to us with all kinds of food.
verses.wilson_translation: The wealthy and glorious (Agni), when invoked and kindled, pours forth on his votaries abundance offood with children; may his ever fresh favour continually come to us with all kinds of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठमु प्रियाणां स्तुह्यासावातिथिं ।अग्निं रथानां यमं ॥
verses.transliteration: préṣṭham ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyā́ṇām ǀ stuhí ǀ āsāva ǀ átithim ǀagním ǀ ráthānām ǀ yámam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praise, singer of hymns, the guest,Agni, the dearest of the dear, the driver of chariots.
verses.wilson_translation: Praise, singer of hymns, the guest,Agni, the dearest of the dear, the driver of chariots.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदिता यो निदिता वेदिता वस्वा यज्ञियो ववर्तति ।दुष्टरा यस्य प्रवणे नोर्मयो धिया वाजं सिषासतः ॥
verses.transliteration: út-itā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ní-ditā ǀ véditā ǀ vásu ǀ ā́ ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ vavártati ǀdustárāḥ ǀ yásya ǀ pravaṇé ǀ ná ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sísāsataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Praise him) the knower, worthy of the sacrifice, who brings to us treasures which have come up (fromthe depths) and are far-renowned-- whose (flames), as he hastend to wage the battle by means of our sacred riteand hard to be passed through as waves rushing down a declivity.
verses.wilson_translation: (Praise him) the knower, worthy of the sacrifice, who brings to us treasures which have come up (fromthe depths) and are far-renowned-- whose (flames), as he hastend to wage the battle by means of our sacred riteand hard to be passed through as waves rushing down a declivity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मा नो हृणीतामतिथिर्वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एषः ।यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ hṛṇītām ǀ átithiḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ puru-praśastáḥ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ su-hótā ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May none hinder Agnifrom coming to us, our guest, the giver of dwellings, praised by many-- (Agni)who is the excellent invoker of the gods, who offers an excellent sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: May none hinder Agnifrom coming to us, our guest, the giver of dwellings, praised by many-- (Agni)who is the excellent invoker of the gods, who offers an excellent sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मो ते रिषन्ये अच्छोक्तिभिर्वसोऽग्ने केभिश्चिदेवैः ।कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामीट्टे दूत्याय रातहव्यः स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.transliteration: mó íti ǀ té ǀ riṣan ǀ yé ǀ ácchokti-bhiḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ ágne ǀ kébhiḥ ǀ cit ǀ évaiḥ ǀkīríḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ ī́ṭṭe ǀ dūtyā́ya ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, giver of dwellings, let not those come to harm, who approach you in whatever manner with hymnsof praise; the worshipper who offers his libation and duly performs the rite praises you that you may be thebearer of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, giver of dwellings, let not those come to harm, who approach you in whatever manner with hymnsof praise; the worshipper who offers his libation and duly performs the rite praises you that you may be thebearer of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आग्ने याहि मरुत्सखा रुद्रेभिः सोमपीतये ।सोभर्या उप सुष्टुतिं मादयस्व स्वर्णरे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agne ǀ yāhi ǀ marút-sakhā ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀsóbharyāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ su-stutím ǀ mādáyasva ǀ sváḥ-nare ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who have the Marutsas your friends, come with the Rudrasto drinkt he Soma; come to thepraises of Sobhari; delight yourself at our solemn rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who have the Marutsas your friends, come with the Rudrasto drinkt he Soma; come to thepraises of Sobhari; delight yourself at our solemn rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN I. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . In sweetest and most gladdening streamflow pure, O Soma, on thy way,Pressed out for Indra, for his drink. Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath with the wood attained untoHis place, his iron-fashioned home. Be thou best Vṛtra-slayer, best granter of bliss, most liberal:Promote our wealthy princes' gifts. Flow onward with thy juice unto the banquet of the Mighty Gods:Flow hither for our strength and fame. O Indu, we draw nigh to thee, with this one object day by day:To thee alone our prayers are said By means of this eternal fleece may Sūrya's Daughter purifyThy Soma that is foaming forth. Ten sister maids of slender form seize him within the press and holdHim firmly on the final day. The virgins send him forth: they blow the the skin musician-like and fuseThe triple foe-repelling meath. Inviolable milch-kine round about him blend for Indra's drink,The fresh young Soma with their milk. In the wild raptures of this draught, Indra slays all the Vṛtras: he,The Hero, pours his wealth on us.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया ।इंद्राय पातवे सुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: svā́diṣṭhayā ǀ mádiṣṭhayā ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀíndrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, in a most sweet and exhilarating stream, effused for Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, in a most sweet and exhilarating stream, effused for Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहतं ।द्रुणा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣaḥ-hā́ ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yónim ǀ áyaḥ-hatam ǀdrúṇā ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The all-beholding destroyer ofrākṣasashas stepped upon his gold-smitten birthplace, united with the wooden cask.
verses.wilson_translation: The all-beholding destroyer ofrākṣasashas stepped upon his gold-smitten birthplace, united with the wooden cask.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वरिवोधातमो भव मंहिष्ठो वृत्रहंतमः ।पर्षि राधो मघोनां ॥
verses.transliteration: varivaḥ-dhā́tamaḥ ǀ bhava ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vṛtrahán-tamaḥ ǀpárṣi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ maghónām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be the lavish giver of wealth, most bounteous, the destroyer of enemies; bestow on us the riches of the affluent.
verses.wilson_translation: Be the lavish giver of wealth, most bounteous, the destroyer of enemies; bestow on us the riches of the affluent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष महानां देवानां वीतिमंधसा ।अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ mahā́nām ǀ devā́nām ǀ vītím ǀ ándhasā ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come with food to the sacrifice of the mighty gods, and bring to us strength and sustenance.
verses.wilson_translation: Come with food to the sacrifice of the mighty gods, and bring to us strength and sustenance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामच्छा चरामसि तदिदर्थं दिवेदिवे ।इंदो त्वे न आशसः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ áccha ǀ carāmasi ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ ártham ǀ divé-dive ǀíndo íti ǀ tvé íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To you we come, O dropping (Soma); for you only is this our worship day by day, our prayers are to you, none other.
verses.wilson_translation: To you we come, O dropping (Soma); for you only is this our worship day by day, our prayers are to you, none other.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता ।वारेण शश्वता तना ॥
verses.transliteration: punā́ti ǀ te ǀ pari-srútam ǀ sómam ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ duhitā́ ǀvā́reṇa ǀ śáśvatā ǀ tánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The daughter of the Sun purifies your gushing streams through the eternal outstretched hair.
verses.wilson_translation: The daughter of the Sun purifies your gushing streams through the eternal outstretched hair.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमीमण्वीः समर्य आ गृभ्णंति योषणो दश ।स्वसारः पार्ये दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ īm ǀ áṇvīḥ ǀ sa-maryé ǀ ā́ ǀ gṛbhṇánti ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀsvásāraḥ ǀ pā́rye ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten sister-fingers seize you in the sacrifice, on the final day (of the oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: The ten sister-fingers seize you in the sacrifice, on the final day (of the oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमीं हिन्वंत्यग्रुवो धमंति बाकुरं दृतिं ।त्रिधातु वारणं मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ īm ǀ hinvanti ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ dhámanti ǀ bākurám ǀ dṛ́tim ǀtri-dhā́tu ǀ vāraṇám ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fingers press the Soma, they squeeze it glittering like a water-skin; its juice becomes threefold, enemy-averting.
verses.wilson_translation: The fingers press the Soma, they squeeze it glittering like a water-skin; its juice becomes threefold, enemy-averting.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभीममघ्न्या उत श्रीणंति धेनवः शिशुं ।सोममिंद्राय पातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ imám ǀ ághnyāḥ ǀ utá ǀ śrīṇánti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ śíśum ǀsómam ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: The inviolable kine mingle this fresh Somawith their milk for Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: The inviolable kine mingle this fresh Somawith their milk for Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्येदिंद्रो मदेष्वा विश्वा वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ।शूरो मघा च मंहते ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ mádeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnate ǀśū́raḥ ǀ maghā́ ǀ ca ǀ maṃhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: In the exhilaration of this draught the hero Indrasmites all his enemies and bestows wealth (on his worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: In the exhilaration of this draught the hero Indrasmites all his enemies and bestows wealth (on his worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN II. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Soma, flow on, inviting Gods, speed to the purifying cloth:Pass into Indra, as a Bull. As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid Steer:Sit in thy place as one with strength. The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juicene Sage drew waters to himself. The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee Mighty One,When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk. The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our Friend, heaven's prop and stay,Falls on the purifying cloth. The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold:He shines together with the Sun. Songs, Indu, active in their might are beautified for thee, wherewithThou deckest thee for our delight. To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the joyous draught:Great are the praise& due to thee. Indu as, Indra's Friend, on us pour with a stream of sweetness, likeParjanya sender of the rain. Winner of kine, Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and strengthPrimeval Soul of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या ।इंद्रमिंदो वृषा विश ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ deva-vī́ḥ ǀ áti ǀ pavítram ǀ soma ǀ ráṃhyā ǀíndram ǀ indo íti ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow on,Soma, seeking the gods, hastening on in your purifying course; enter Indra, OIndu, the showerer.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow on,Soma, seeking the gods, hastening on in your purifying course; enter Indra, OIndu, the showerer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेंदो द्युम्नवत्तमः ।आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vacyasva ǀ máhi ǀ psáraḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ indo íti ǀ dyumnávat-tamaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yónim ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OIndu, do you, the mighty showerer (of blessings) most glorious upholder, send us food, and sit down in yours own plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: OIndu, do you, the mighty showerer (of blessings) most glorious upholder, send us food, and sit down in yours own plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः ।अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhukṣata ǀ priyám ǀ mádhu ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ vasiṣṭa ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The stream of effused creative Somamilks out the joy-giving ambrosia; the accomplisher of holy rites veils itself in the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: The stream of effused creative Somamilks out the joy-giving ambrosia; the accomplisher of holy rites veils itself in the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महांतं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षंति सिंधवः ।यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́ntam ǀ tvā ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀyát ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vāsayiṣyáse ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Som), when you will veil yourself in the milk, the mighty streaming waters flow to you, the mighty one.
verses.wilson_translation: (Som), when you will veil yourself in the milk, the mighty streaming waters flow to you, the mighty one.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टंभो धरुणो दिवः ।सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: samudráḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ mamṛje ǀ viṣṭambháḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The juice-distilling Soma, the sustainer, the supporter of heaven, is purified in the water-- favouring us, (it is poured) into the straining cloth.
verses.wilson_translation: The juice-distilling Soma, the sustainer, the supporter of heaven, is purified in the water-- favouring us, (it is poured) into the straining cloth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः ।सं सूर्येण रोचते ॥
verses.transliteration: ácikradat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ darśatáḥ ǀsám ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ rocate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty golden-hued showerer of blessings utters a sound as it drops, beautiful as a friend; it shines (in the heavens) with the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty golden-hued showerer of blessings utters a sound as it drops, beautiful as a friend; it shines (in the heavens) with the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरस्त इंद ओजसा मर्मृज्यंते अपस्युवः ।याभिर्मदाय शुंभसे ॥
verses.transliteration: gíraḥ ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ ójasā ǀ marmṛjyánte ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ śúmbhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: OIndu, by the power the busy voices are hallowed which adorn you as you drop for our exhilaratioṇ
verses.wilson_translation: OIndu, by the power the busy voices are hallowed which adorn you as you drop for our exhilaratioṇ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे ।तव प्रशस्तयो महीः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ loka-kṛtnúm ǀ īmahe ǀtáva ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We ask you for exhilaration, you the giver of the highest world to your foe-crushing worshipper-- great are your praises.
verses.wilson_translation: We ask you for exhilaration, you the giver of the highest world to your foe-crushing worshipper-- great are your praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यमिंदविंद्रयुर्मध्वः पवस्व धारया ।पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव ॥
verses.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ indo íti ǀ indra-yúḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀparjányaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭimā́n-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, do you, longing for Indra, stream upon us with a shower of ambrosia, like a raining cloud.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, do you, longing for Indra, stream upon us with a shower of ambrosia, like a raining cloud.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गोषा इंदो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत ।आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: go-sā́ḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ nṛ-sā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ aśva-sā́ḥ ǀ vāja-sā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀātmā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, you are the giver of kine, of children, of horses, and of food; you are the primevalsoulof the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, you are the giver of kine, of children, of horses, and of food; you are the primevalsoulof the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN III. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: १० आजीगर्ति: शुन: शेप :, कृत्रिमो वैश्वामित्रो देवरात: । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HERE present this Immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings,To settle in the vats of wood. This God, made ready with the hymn, runs swiftly through the winding ways,Inviolable as he flows. This God while flowing is adorned, like a bay steed for war, by menDevout and skilled in holy songs. He, like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows alongIs fain to win all precious boons. This God, as he is flowing on, speeds like a car and gives his gifts:He lets his voice be heard of all Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestowsRich gifts upon the worshipper. Away he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven,And roars as he is flowing on. While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven acrossThe regions, irresistible. After the 'way of ancient time, this God, pressed out for Deities,Flows tawny to the straining-cloth. This Lord of many Holy Laws, even at his birth engendering strength,Effused, flows onward in a stream.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयति ।अभि द्रोणान्यासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ parṇavī́ḥ-iva ǀ dīyati ǀabhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: This divine immortal (Soma) hastens as a bird to settle on the sacrificial vessels.
verses.wilson_translation: This divine immortal (Soma) hastens as a bird to settle on the sacrificial vessels.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वरांसि धावति ।पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ vipā́ ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ áti ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ dhāvati ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This divine (Soma), expressed by the fingers, and dropping inviolable, rushes against the enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: This divine (Soma), expressed by the fingers, and dropping inviolable, rushes against the enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः ।हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ vipanyú-bhiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ṛtayú-bhiḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ mṛjyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: This divine (Soma), as it drops, is adorned (with hymns) by the sacrifice-desiring priests as a horse for battle.
verses.wilson_translation: This divine (Soma), as it drops, is adorned (with hymns) by the sacrifice-desiring priests as a horse for battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः ।पवमानः सिषासति ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ yán-iva ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sisāsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: This strong one, as it drops, seems to encompass all desirable things with its power and seeks to bestow them upon us.
verses.wilson_translation: This strong one, as it drops, seems to encompass all desirable things with its power and seeks to bestow them upon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दशस्यति ।आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुं ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ratharyati ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ daśasyati ǀāvíḥ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ vagvanúm ǁ
verses.english_translation: This divine (Soma), as it drops, prepares its chariot (to come to us); it flings us our boons, it utters a sound.
verses.wilson_translation: This divine (Soma), as it drops, prepares its chariot (to come to us); it flings us our boons, it utters a sound.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते ।दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vípraiḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǀdádhat ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: This divine (Soma), praised by the priests and giving wealth to the worshipper, plural nges into the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: This divine (Soma), praised by the priests and giving wealth to the worshipper, plural nges into the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया ।पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ dívam ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ dhā́rayā ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ kánikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Making a sound as it drops in a continued stream it rushes across the worlds into heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Making a sound as it drops in a continued stream it rushes across the worlds into heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतः ।पवमानः स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ dívam ǀ ví ǀ ā́ ǀ asarat ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ áspṛtaḥ ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As it drops, completing the sacrifice, it passes across the worlds in inviolable to heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: As it drops, completing the sacrifice, it passes across the worlds in inviolable to heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pratnéna ǀ jánmanā ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine and expressed for the gods by an ancient birth, the golden-hued (Soma) flows in the straining cloth.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine and expressed for the gods by an ancient birth, the golden-hued (Soma) flows in the straining cloth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः ।धारया पवते सुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ puru-vratáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ íṣaḥ ǀdhā́rayā ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Produced at our rite and producing abundant food the Soma, efficacious in sacrifices, flows effused in a stream.
verses.wilson_translation: Produced at our rite and producing abundant food the Soma, efficacious in sacrifices, flows effused in a stream.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O Soma flowing on thy way, win thou and conquer high renown;And make us better than we are. Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities;And make us better than we are. Win skilful strength and mental power. O Soma, drive away our foes;And make us better than we are. Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink:Make thou us better than we are. Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids;And make us better than we are. Through thine own mental power and aid long may we look upon the Sun;Make thou us better than we are. Well-weaponed Soma, pour to usa stream of riches doubly great;And make us better than we are. As one victorious unsubdued in battle pour forth wealth to us;And make us better than we are. By worship, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee to prop the Law:Make thou us better than we are. O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds, manifold. quickening all life;And mate us better than we are.

verses.sanskrit: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: sána ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ jéṣi ǀ ca ǀ pávamāna ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure-dropping (Soma), bounteous food, welcome (the gods at our rite) and overcome (the demons); and make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure-dropping (Soma), bounteous food, welcome (the gods at our rite) and overcome (the demons); and make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सना ज्योतिः सना स्वर्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: sána ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ sána ǀ sváḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ sáubhagā ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, give us brightness, give us heaven, give us all good things; and make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, give us brightness, give us heaven, give us all good things; and make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: sána ǀ dákṣam ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀ ápa ǀ soma ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, give us strength, give us wisdom, drive away our enemies; and make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, give us strength, give us wisdom, drive away our enemies; and make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिंद्राय पातवे ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: pávitāraḥ ǀ punītána ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Priests, press out the Somafor Indrato drink; (O Soma), make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Priests, press out the Somafor Indrato drink; (O Soma), make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ sū́rye ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhaja ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you, (OSoma), by your power and your protections bring us to the sun, and make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, (OSoma), by your power and your protections bring us to the sun, and make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यं ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ krátvā ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ jyók ǀ paśyema ǀ sū́ryam ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिं ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ su-āyudha ǀ sóma ǀ dvi-bárhasam ǀ rayím ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bright-weaponed Soma, shower upon us wealth abundant for both worlds; and make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Bright-weaponed Soma, shower upon us wealth abundant for both worlds; and make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्षानपच्युतो रयिं समत्सु सासहिः ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ ánapa-cyutaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ samát-su ǀ sasahíḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you who are unvanquished in battle, smitter of enemies, shower wealth upon us, and make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: O you who are unvanquished in battle, smitter of enemies, shower wealth upon us, and make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ avīvṛdhan ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure-dropping (Soma), they glorify you with the holy rites for their own upholding make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure-dropping (Soma), they glorify you with the holy rites for their own upholding make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिंदो विश्वायुमा भर ।अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: rayím ǀ naḥ ǀ citrám ǀ aśvínam ǀ índo íti ǀ viśvá-āyum ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, bring to us varied wealth, abundant in horses and all-reaching, and make us happy.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, bring to us varied wealth, abundant in horses and all-reaching, and make us happy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN V Āprīs.
hymns.anukramani: ११   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ENKINDLED, Pavamana, Lord, sends forth his light on, every sideIn friendly show, the bellowing Bull. He, Pavamana, Self-produced, speeds onward sharpening his horns:He glitters through the firmament. Brilliant like wealth, adorable, with splendour Pavamana shines,Mightily with the streams of meath. The tawny Pavamana, who strews from of old the grass with might,Is worshipped, God amid the Gods. The golden, the Celestial Doors are lifted with their frames on high,By Pavamana glorified. With passion Pavamana longs for the great lofty pair, well-formedLike beauteous maidens, Night and Dawn Both Gods who look on men I call, Celestial Heralds: Indra's SelfIs Pavamana, yea, the Bull. This, Pavamana's sacrifice, shall the three beauteous Goddesses,Sarasvatī and Bhāratī and Iḷā, Mighty One, attend. summon Tvaṣṭar hither, our protector, champion, earliest-born,Indu is Indra, tawny Steer; Pavamana is Prajāpati. O Pavamana, with the meath in streams anoint Vanaspati,The ever-green. the golden-hued, refulgent, with a thousand boughs. Come to the consecrating rite of Pavamana, all ye Gods,—Vāyu, Sūrya, Bṛhaspati, Indra, and Agni, in accord.

verses.sanskrit: समिद्धो विश्वतस्पतिः पवमानो वि राजति ।प्रीणन्वृषा कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǀprīṇán ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ kánikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure-flowing (Soma) shines forth in its brightness, the universal lord, the showerer of blessings, the rejoicer, uttering a loud sound.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure-flowing (Soma) shines forth in its brightness, the universal lord, the showerer of blessings, the rejoicer, uttering a loud sound.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तनूनपात्पवमानः शृंगे शिशानो अर्षति ।अंतरिक्षेण रारजत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tanū́-nápāt ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀantárikṣeṇa ǀ rā́rajat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure-flowing Tanūnapāt, rushes sharpening its splendour on the height and hastens through the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure-flowing Tanūnapāt, rushes sharpening its splendour on the height and hastens through the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ईळेन्यः पवमानो रयिर्वि राजति द्युमान् ।मधोर्धाराभिरोजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: īḷényaḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀmádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure-flowing bright (Soma), the bounteous giver, worthy of all praise, shines forth in its might with the streams of water.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure-flowing bright (Soma), the bounteous giver, worthy of all praise, shines forth in its might with the streams of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बर्हिः प्राचीनमोजसा पवमानः स्तृणन्हरिः ।देवेषु देव ईयते ॥
verses.transliteration: barhíḥ ǀ prācī́nam ǀ ójasā ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ stṛṇán ǀ háriḥ ǀdevéṣu ǀ deváḥ ǀ īyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bright golden-hued pure-flowing one rushes in its might, strewing the sacred grass in the sacrifice with its points towards the cast.
verses.wilson_translation: The bright golden-hued pure-flowing one rushes in its might, strewing the sacred grass in the sacrifice with its points towards the cast.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उदातैर्जिहते बृहद्द्वारो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः ।पवमानेन सुष्टुताः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ ā́taiḥ ǀ jihate ǀ bṛhát ǀ dvā́raḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyīḥ ǀpávamānena ǀ sú-stutāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bright golden doors, praised by the priests together with the Soma, rise up from the vast horizon.
verses.wilson_translation: The bright golden doors, praised by the priests together with the Soma, rise up from the vast horizon.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुशिल्पे बृहती मही पवमानो वृषण्यति ।नक्तोषासा न दर्शते ॥
verses.transliteration: suśilpé íti su-śilpé ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇyati ǀnáktoṣásā ǀ ná ǀ darśaté íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उभा देवा नृचक्षसा होतारा दैव्या हुवे ।पवमान इंद्रो वृषा ॥
verses.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ devā́ ǀ nṛ-cákṣasā ǀ hótārā ǀ dáivyā ǀ huve ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
verses.english_translation: I  invoke the two divine priests, the two deities who behold men-- the pure-flowing (Soma) is radiant and the showerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: I  invoke the two divine priests, the two deities who behold men-- the pure-flowing (Soma) is radiant and the showerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भारती पवमानस्य सरस्वतीळा मही ।इमं नो यज्ञमा गमंतिस्रो देवीः सुपेशसः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhā́ratī ǀ pávamānasya ǀ sárasvatī ǀ íḷā ǀ mahī́ ǀimám ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ gaman ǀ tisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ su-péśasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the three beautiful goddesses,Bhāratī,Sarasvatī, and mighty Iḷā, come to this our offering of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: May the three beautiful goddesses,Bhāratī,Sarasvatī, and mighty Iḷā, come to this our offering of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टारमग्रजां गोपां पुरोयावानमा हुवे ।इंदुरिंद्रो वृषा हरिः पवमानः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tváṣṭāram ǀ agra-jā́m ǀ gopā́m ǀ puraḥ-yā́vānam ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀínduḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ prajā́-patiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I invoke Tvaṣṭā, the first-born, the protector, the leader; the golden-coloured pure-flowing Induis Indra, the showerer, the lord of all creatures.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke Tvaṣṭā, the first-born, the protector, the leader; the golden-coloured pure-flowing Induis Indra, the showerer, the lord of all creatures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वनस्पतिं पवमान मध्वा समंग्धि धारया ।सहस्रवल्शं हरितं भ्राजमानं हिरण्ययं ॥
verses.transliteration: vánaspátim ǀ pavamāna ǀ mádhvā ǀ sám ǀ aṅgdhi ǀ dhā́rayā ǀsahásra-valśam ǀ háritam ǀ bhrā́jamānam ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure Soma, consecrate with your streaming ambrosia the green bright golden-hued Vanaspatiwith its thousand branches.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure Soma, consecrate with your streaming ambrosia the green bright golden-hued Vanaspatiwith its thousand branches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे देवाः स्वाहाकृतिं पवमानस्या गत ।वायुर्बृहस्पतिः सूर्योऽग्निरिंद्रः सजोषसः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ devāḥ ǀ svā́hā-kṛtim ǀ pávamānasya ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀvāyúḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O all ye gods, come together to the consecration of the Soma--Vāyu,Bṛhaspati,Sūrya,Agniand Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: O all ye gods, come together to the consecration of the Soma--Vāyu,Bṛhaspati,Sūrya,Agniand Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९ काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SOMA, flow on with pleasant stream, a Bull devoted to the Gods,Our Friend, unto the woollen sieve. Pour hitherward, as Indra's Self, Indu, that gladdening stream of thine,And send us coursers full of strength. Flow to the filter hitherward, pouring that ancient gladdening juice,Streaming forth power and high renown. Hither the sparkling drops have flowed, like waters down a steep descentThey have reached Indra purified. Whom, having passed the filter, ten dames cleanse, as ’twere a vigorous steed,While he disports him in the wood,— The steer-strong juice with milk pour forth, for feast and service of the Gods,To him who bears away the draught.. Effused, the God flows onward with his stream to Indra, to the God,So that his milk may strengthen him. Soul of the sacrifice, the juice effused flows quickly on: he keepsHis ancient wisdom of a Sage. So pouring forth, as Indra's Friend, strong drink, best Gladdener! for the feast,Thou, even in secret, storest hymns.

verses.sanskrit: मंद्रया सोम धारया वृषा पवस्व देवयुः ।अव्यो वारेष्वस्मयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: mandráyā ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ pavasva ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́reṣu ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who is the showerer (of benefits), devoted to the gods, favourable to us, flow with your exhilarating stream into the woollen sieve.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who is the showerer (of benefits), devoted to the gods, favourable to us, flow with your exhilarating stream into the woollen sieve.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्यं मद्यं मदमिंदविंद्र इति क्षर ।अभि वाजिनो अर्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ mádyam ǀ mádam ǀ índo íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ íti ǀ kṣara ǀabhí ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ árvataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu,do you, as sovereign, effuse that exhilarating juice, and pour forth vigorous steeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu,do you, as sovereign, effuse that exhilarating juice, and pour forth vigorous steeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्यं पूर्व्यं मदं सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ।अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ pūrvyám ǀ mádam ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rain out through the filter, while pressed that ancient exhilarating fluid, and pour us forth strength and food.
verses.wilson_translation: Rain out through the filter, while pressed that ancient exhilarating fluid, and pour us forth strength and food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु द्रप्सास इंदव आपो न प्रवतासरन् ।पुनाना इंद्रमाशत ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ drapsā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-vátā ǀ asaran ǀpunānā́ḥ ǀ índram ǀ āśata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The quickly-falling drops, as they filter, follow Indraand reach him, like waters rushing down a declivity.
verses.wilson_translation: The quickly-falling drops, as they filter, follow Indraand reach him, like waters rushing down a declivity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यमत्यमिव वाजिनं मृजंति योषणो दश ।वने क्रीळंतमत्यविं ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ átyam-iva ǀ vājínam ǀ mṛjánti ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀváne ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ áti-avim ǁ
verses.english_translation: That which sporting in the wood and spurting beyond the sieve, the ten sisters press, as (men rub down) a strong horse.
verses.wilson_translation: That which sporting in the wood and spurting beyond the sieve, the ten sisters press, as (men rub down) a strong horse.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं गोभिर्वृषणं रसं मदाय देववीतये ।सुतं भराय सं सृज ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rásam ǀ mádāya ǀ devá-vītaye ǀsutám ǀ bhárāya ǀ sám ǀ sṛja ǁ
verses.english_translation: That desire-showring liquor, effused for the drink of the gods and for our exhilaration, mix with milk for prowess in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: That desire-showring liquor, effused for the drink of the gods and for our exhilaration, mix with milk for prowess in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवो देवाय धारयेंद्राय पवते सुतः ।पयो यदस्य पीपयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ devā́ya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀpáyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ pīpáyat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine Soma, when effused, flows to the divine Indrain a stream, since its milk flattens him.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine Soma, when effused, flows to the divine Indrain a stream, since its milk flattens him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा यज्ञस्य रंह्या सुष्वाणः पवते सुतः ।प्रत्नं नि पाति काव्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ātmā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ ráṃhyā ǀ susvānáḥ ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀpratnám ǀ ní ǀ pāti ǀ kā́vyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thesoulof the sacrifice, the effused Soma, flows; with speed bringing blessings, and maintains his ancient seer-hood.
verses.wilson_translation: Thesoulof the sacrifice, the effused Soma, flows; with speed bringing blessings, and maintains his ancient seer-hood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा पुनान इंद्रयुर्मदं मदिष्ठ वीतये ।गुहा चिद्दधिषे गिरः ॥
