verses.transliteration: evá ǀ punānáḥ ǀ indra-yúḥ ǀ mádam ǀ madiṣṭha ǀ vītáye ǀgúhā ǀ cit ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most exciting (Soma), devoted to Indra, as you pour forth the exhilarating juice for his drinking, you emit sounds in the secret (hall of sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Most exciting (Soma), devoted to Indra, as you pour forth the exhilarating juice for his drinking, you emit sounds in the secret (hall of sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९ काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FORTH on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law,Knowing this sacrifice's course. Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of meath, most excellent,Oblation best of all in worth. About the holy place, the Steer true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forthContinuous voices in the wood. When, clothed in manly strength, the Sage flows in celestial wisdom round,The Strong would win the light of heaven. When purified, he sits as King above the hosts, among his folk,What time the sages bring him nigh. Dear, golden-coloured, in the fleece he sinks and settles in the wood:The Singer shows his zeal in hymns. He goes to Indra, Vāyu, to the Aśvins, as his custom is,With gladdening juice which gives them joy. Tle streams of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra-Varuṇa,—Well-knowing through his mighty powers.Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth:Gain for us treasures and renown.

verses.sanskrit: असृग्रमिंदवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः ।विदाना अस्य योजनं ॥
verses.transliteration: ásṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀ pathā́ ǀ dhárman ǀ ṛtásya ǀ su-śríyaḥ ǀvidānā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ yójanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The excellent streams (of the Soma), feeling a union with Indra, flow forth in the ceremony by the path of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The excellent streams (of the Soma), feeling a union with Indra, flow forth in the ceremony by the path of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र धारा मध्वो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते ।हविर्हविष्षु वंद्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ dhā́rā ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǀhavíḥ ǀ havíṣṣu ǀ vándyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: That which is to be praised as the oblation among oblations is immersed in the great (holy) waters, the stream of honey, the pre-eminent.
verses.wilson_translation: That which is to be praised as the oblation among oblations is immersed in the great (holy) waters, the stream of honey, the pre-eminent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र युजो वाचो अग्रियो वृषाव चक्रदद्वने ।सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yujáḥ ǀ vācáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ áva ǀ cakradat ǀ váne ǀsádma ǀ abhí ǀ satyáḥ ǀ adhvaráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pre-eminent (Soma), the showerer of benefits, the truthful, the indestructible, utters continuous sounds in the water, towards the sacrificial hall.
verses.wilson_translation: The pre-eminent (Soma), the showerer of benefits, the truthful, the indestructible, utters continuous sounds in the water, towards the sacrificial hall.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा वसानो अर्षति ।स्वर्वाजी सिषासति ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ yát ǀ kā́vyā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ árṣati ǀsváḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ sisāsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the seer (Soma), wearing ample treasures, goes round the praises (of his worshippers), then the mighty (Indra) in heaven is eager to repair to the oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: When the seer (Soma), wearing ample treasures, goes round the praises (of his worshippers), then the mighty (Indra) in heaven is eager to repair to the oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति ।यदीमृण्वंति वेधसः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ sīdati ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ ṛṇvánti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the priests excite it, the flowing Somalike a king destroys opposing (demons and) men.
verses.wilson_translation: When the priests excite it, the flowing Somalike a king destroys opposing (demons and) men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति ।रेभो वनुष्यते मती ॥
verses.transliteration: ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ sīdati ǀrebháḥ ǀ vanuṣyate ǀ matī́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The green-tinted (Soma), dear to the gods, commingled with the water, sits down upon the woollen sieve, uttering a sound it is greeted by praise.
verses.wilson_translation: The green-tinted (Soma), dear to the gods, commingled with the water, sits down upon the woollen sieve, uttering a sound it is greeted by praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वायुमिंद्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति ।रणा यो अस्य धर्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ índram ǀ aśvínā ǀ sākám ǀ mádena ǀ gacchati ǀráṇa ǀ yáḥ ǀ asya ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is assiduous in the functions of (providing and preparing) the Soma, goes with exhilaration to Vāyu,Indraand the Aśvins.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is assiduous in the functions of (providing and preparing) the Soma, goes with exhilaration to Vāyu,Indraand the Aśvins.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ मित्रावरुणा भगं मध्वः पवंत ऊर्मयः ।विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ bhágam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pavante ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀvidānā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ śákma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The streams of the sweet Somaflow to Mitraand Varuṇaand to Bhaga; the worshippers knowing its (virtues are rewarded) with happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: The streams of the sweet Somaflow to Mitraand Varuṇaand to Bhaga; the worshippers knowing its (virtues are rewarded) with happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये ।श्रवो वसूनि सं जितं ॥
verses.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ rodasī íti ǀ rayím ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáye ǀśrávaḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ sám ǀ jitam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Heaven and earth, for the acquisition of this exhilarating Somafood, win for us wealth, food and treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: Heaven and earth, for the acquisition of this exhilarating Somafood, win for us wealth, food and treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN VIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९ काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . OBEYING Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth,Increasing his heroic might. Laid in the bowl, pure-flowing on to Vāyu and the Aśvins, mayThese give us great heroic strength. Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart,To sit in place of sacrifice. The ten swift fingers deck thee forth, seven ministers impel thee on:The sages have rejoiced in thee. When through the filter thou art poured, we clothe thee with a robe of milkTo be a gladdening draught for Gods. When purified within the jars, Soma, brightred and golden-hued,Hath clothed him with a robe of milk. Flow on to us and make us rich. Drive all our enemies away.O Indu, flow into thy Friend.Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us,O Soma, victory in war. May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light,Gain thee, and progeny and food.

verses.sanskrit: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिंद्रस्य काममक्षरन् ।वर्धंतो अस्य वीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ priyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́mam ǀ akṣaran ǀvárdhantaḥ ǀ asya ǀ vīryám ǁ
verses.english_translation: These Somajuices distil the dear desire of Indra, increasing his vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: These Somajuices distil the dear desire of Indra, increasing his vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छंतो वायुमश्विना ।ते नो धांतु सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: punānā́saḥ ǀ camū-sádaḥ ǀ gácchantaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ aśvínā ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ dhāntu ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure-flowing, filling the ladles, and proceeding to Vāyuand the Aśvins, may they sustain our energy.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure-flowing, filling the ladles, and proceeding to Vāyuand the Aśvins, may they sustain our energy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय ।ऋतस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrasya ǀ soma ǀ rā́dhase ǀ punānáḥ ǀ hā́rdi ǀ codaya ǀṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, pure-flowing, desired for the gratification of Indra, do you impel him to sit in the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, pure-flowing, desired for the gratification of Indra, do you impel him to sit in the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मृजंति त्वा दश क्षिपो हिन्वंति सप्त धीतयः ।अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ॥
verses.transliteration: mṛjánti ǀ tvā ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ hinvánti ǀ saptá ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀánu ǀ víprāḥ ǀ amādiṣuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers strain you, the seven priests caress you, the worshippers gladden you.
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers strain you, the seven priests caress you, the worshippers gladden you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कं सृजानमति मेष्यः ।सं गोभिर्वासयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: devébhyaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ s���jānám ǀ áti ǀ meṣyáḥ ǀsám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vāsayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: As you stream on the water and the woollen sieve, we wrap you up with milk for the exhilaration of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: As you stream on the water and the woollen sieve, we wrap you up with milk for the exhilaration of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः ।परि गव्यान्यव्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ vástrāṇi ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀpári ǀ gávyāni ǀ avyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified in the pitchers, radiant and green-tinted, the Somaputs on the raiment derived from the cow.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified in the pitchers, radiant and green-tinted, the Somaputs on the raiment derived from the cow.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः ।इंदो सखायमा विश ॥
verses.transliteration: maghónaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ naḥ ǀ jahí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ sákhāyam ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow to us, your wealthy (worshippers); destoy all our enemies;Indu, enter your friend.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow to us, your wealthy (worshippers); destoy all our enemies;Indu, enter your friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि ।सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ dyumnám ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀsáhaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour down rain from heaven, and abundance upon the earth; uphold our strength,Soma, in battles.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour down rain from heaven, and abundance upon the earth; uphold our strength,Soma, in battles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिंद्रपीतं स्वर्विदं ।भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषं ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛ-cákṣasam ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ índra-pītam ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀbhakṣīmáhi ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ íṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Adoring) you, the contemplator of men, the beverage of Indraand the knower of all things, may we be blessed with progeny and food.
verses.wilson_translation: (Adoring) you, the contemplator of men, the beverage of Indraand the knower of all things, may we be blessed with progeny and food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN IX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९ काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Sage of Heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands and pressed,Sends us delightful powers of life. On, onward to a glorious home; dear to the people void of guile,With excellent enjoyment, flow. He, the bright Son, when born illumed his Parents who had sprung to life,Great Son great Strengtheners of Law. Urged by the seven devotions he hath stirred the guileless rivers whichHave magnified the Single Eye. These helped to might theYouthful One, high over all, invincible,Even Indu, Indra! in thy law. The immortal Courser, good to draw, looks down upon the Seven: the fountHath satisfied the Goddesses Aid us in holy rites, O Man: O Pavamana, drive awayDark shades that must be met in fight. Make the paths ready for a hymn newer and newer evermore:Make the lights shine as erst they shone. Give, Pavamana, high renown, give kine and steeds and hero sons:Win for us wisdom, win the light.

verses.sanskrit: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयांसि नप्त्योर्हितः ।सुवानो याति कविक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ priyā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ váyāṃsi ǀ naptyóḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀsuvānáḥ ǀ yāti ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The seer (Soma) having wise designs, when plural ced between the two boards and effused, proceeds to the stones which are most dear to heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The seer (Soma) having wise designs, when plural ced between the two boards and effused, proceeds to the stones which are most dear to heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहे ।वीत्यर्ष चनिष्ठया ॥
verses.transliteration: prá-pra ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ pányase ǀ jánāya ǀ júṣṭaḥ ǀ adrúhe ǀvītī́ ǀ arṣa ǀ cániṣṭhayā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Go forth in a most abundant stream, ample for his sustenance, to the guileless man, your own, who praises you
verses.wilson_translation: Go forth in a most abundant stream, ample for his sustenance, to the guileless man, your own, who praises you
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् ।महान्मही ऋतावृधा ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ śúciḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ jāté íti ǀ arocayat ǀmahā́n ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: That mighty and pure son, when born, illumines his mighty parents (heaven and earth), the progenitors (of all things), the augmenters of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: That mighty and pure son, when born, illumines his mighty parents (heaven and earth), the progenitors (of all things), the augmenters of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सप्त धीतिभिर्हितो नद्यो अजिन्वदद्रुहः ।या एकमक्षि वावृधुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ saptá ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ajinvat ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀyā́ḥ ǀ ékam ǀ ákṣi ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effused by the fingers, (Soma) gladdens the seven guileless rivers, who have magnified him one and undecaying.
verses.wilson_translation: Effused by the fingers, (Soma) gladdens the seven guileless rivers, who have magnified him one and undecaying.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ता अभि संतमस्तृतं महे युवानमा दधुः ।इंदुमिंद्र तव व्रते ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sántam ǀ ástṛtam ǀ mahé ǀ yúvānam ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhuḥ ǀíndum ǀ indra ǀ táva ǀ vraté ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra, at your worship, they (the fingers) have provided the present, indestructible, and ever-youthful Indu, for your solemn service.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, at your worship, they (the fingers) have provided the present, indestructible, and ever-youthful Indu, for your solemn service.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वह्निरमर्त्यः सप्त पश्यति वावहिः ।क्रिविर्देवीरतर्पयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ paśyati ǀ vā́vahiḥ ǀkríviḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ atarpayat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The immortal bearer (of the oblation), the conveyer (of content to the gods), beholds the seven rivers, full as a well, he has satisfied the divine streams.
verses.wilson_translation: The immortal bearer (of the oblation), the conveyer (of content to the gods), beholds the seven rivers, full as a well, he has satisfied the divine streams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवा कल्पेषु नः पुमस्तमांसि सोम योध्या ।तानि पुनान जंघनः ॥
verses.transliteration: áva ǀ kálpeṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ pumaḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ soma ǀ yódhyā ǀtā́ni ǀ punāna ǀ jaṅghanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect us, manly Soma, in the days of sacrifice purifier, destroy those powers of darkness against which we must contend.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us, manly Soma, in the days of sacrifice purifier, destroy those powers of darkness against which we must contend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू नव्यसे नवीयसे सूक्ताय साधया पथः ।प्रत्नवद्रोचया रुचः ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ návyase ǀ návīyase ǀ su-uktā́ya ǀ sādhaya ǀ patháḥ ǀpratna-vát ǀ rocaya ǀ rúcaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Quickly speed on the road for our new praiseworthy hymn; as of old, display your radiance.
verses.wilson_translation: Quickly speed on the road for our new praiseworthy hymn; as of old, display your radiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान महि श्रवो गामश्वं रासि वीरवत् ।सना मेधां सना स्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ rāsi ǀ vīrá-vat ǀsána ǀ medhā́m ǀ sána ǀ sváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purifier (Soma), you grant us abundant food withmaleoff-spring, and cattle and horses; give us understanding, give us all (we desire).
verses.wilson_translation: Purifier (Soma), you grant us abundant food withmaleoff-spring, and cattle and horses; give us understanding, give us all (we desire).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN X. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९ काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LIKE cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown,Have Soma-drops flowed forth for wealth. Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed,Like joyful songs of singing-men. The Somas deck themselves with milk, as Kings are graced with eulogies,And, with seven priests, the sacrifice. Pressed for the gladdening draught, the drops flow forth abundantly with song,The Soma juices in a stream. Winning Vivasvān's glory and producing Morning's light, the SunsPass through the openings of the cloth. The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs,—Men, for the mighty to accept. Combined in close society sit the seven priests, the brother-hood,Filling the station of the One. He gives us kinship with the Gods, and with the Sun unites our eye:The Sage's ofrspring hath appeared. The Sun with his dear eye beholds that quarter of the heavens which priestsHave placed within the sacred cell.

verses.sanskrit: प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वंतो न श्रवस्यवः ।सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ svānā́saḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀsómāsaḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ akramuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Longing for food the Somajuices, uttering a sound like chariots or like horses, have come for the sake of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Longing for food the Somajuices, uttering a sound like chariots or like horses, have come for the sake of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ।भरासः कारिणामिव ॥
verses.transliteration: hinvānā́saḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ dadhanviré ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀbhárāsaḥ ǀ kāríṇām-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Coming like chariots (to the sacrifice), they are upheld in the arms (of the priests) as burdens (in the arms) of labourers.
verses.wilson_translation: Coming like chariots (to the sacrifice), they are upheld in the arms (of the priests) as burdens (in the arms) of labourers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरंजते ।यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: rā́jānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjate ǀyajñáḥ ǀ ná ǀ saptá ǀ dhātṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The libations are anointed with milk as kings with praises, and (tended) as a sacrifice by seven priests.
verses.wilson_translation: The libations are anointed with milk as kings with praises, and (tended) as a sacrifice by seven priests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि सुवानास इंदवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा ।सुता अर्षंति धारया ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ barháṇā ǀ girā́ ǀsutā́ḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somajuices, when poured forth, are effused with loud praise, and proceed in a stream to excite exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somajuices, when poured forth, are effused with loud praise, and proceed in a stream to excite exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आपानासो विवस्वतो जनंत उषसो भगं ।सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: āpānā́saḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ jánantaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ bhágam ǀsū́rāḥ ǀ áṇvam ǀ ví ǀ tanvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The beverages of Vivasvatand producing the glory of the dawn, the issuing juices spread their sound.
verses.wilson_translation: The beverages of Vivasvatand producing the glory of the dawn, the issuing juices spread their sound.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वंति कारवः ।वृष्णो हरस आयवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ dvā́rā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ pratnā́ḥ ǀ ṛṇvanti ǀ kārávaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ hárase ǀ āyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The old makers of hymns, men the offerers of the Soma, throw open the doors (of the sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: The old makers of hymns, men the offerers of the Soma, throw open the doors (of the sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समीचीनास आसते होतारः सप्तजामयः ।पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-īcīnā́saḥ ǀ āsate ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ saptá-jāmayaḥ ǀpadám ǀ ékasya ǀ píprataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The seven associated ministers like so many kinsmen filling the receptacle of the single (Soma), sit down (at the sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: The seven associated ministers like so many kinsmen filling the receptacle of the single (Soma), sit down (at the sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुश्चित्सूर्ये सचा ।कवेरपत्यमा दुहे ॥
verses.transliteration: nā́bhā ǀ nā́bhim ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ cit ǀ sū́rye ǀ sácā ǀkavéḥ ǀ ápatyam ǀ ā́ ǀ duhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: I take into my navel the navel of the sacrifice, my becomes associated with the sun, I fill the offspring of the sage.
verses.wilson_translation: I take into my navel the navel of the sacrifice, my becomes associated with the sun, I fill the offspring of the sage.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितं ।सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ padám ǀ adhvaryú-bhiḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀsū́raḥ ǀ paśyati ǀ cákṣasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The powerful (Indra) looks with the eye of his own resplendent self on the acceptable plural ce of the Soma, fixed by the priests in the heart.
verses.wilson_translation: The powerful (Indra) looks with the eye of his own resplendent self on the acceptable plural ce of the Soma, fixed by the priests in the heart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XL Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who is purified,Fain to pay worship to the Gods. Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled milk,Divine, devoted to the God. Bring, by thy flowing, weal to kine, weal to the people, weal to steeds.Weal, O thou King, to growing plants Sing a praise-song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might.The Red, who reaches up to heaven. Purify Soma when effused with stones which bands move rapidly,And pour the sweet milk in the meath. With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds:To Indra offer Indu up. Soma, foe-que chief o’er men, doing the will of pour forthProsperity upon our kine. Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, that Indra may drink thee and rejoice. O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength,—Indu! with. Indra for ally.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेंदवे ।अभि देवाँ इयक्षते ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ asmai ǀ gāyata ǀ naraḥ ǀ pávamānāya ǀ índave ǀabhí ǀ devā́n ǀ íyakṣate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing, leaders of rites, to this pure-flowing,Indu, who is desirous of offering worship to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing, leaders of rites, to this pure-flowing,Indu, who is desirous of offering worship to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः ।देवं देवाय देवयु ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ te ǀ mádhunā ǀ páyaḥ ǀ átharvāṇaḥ ǀ aśiśrayuḥ ǀdevám ǀ devā́ya ǀ deva-yú ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Atharvāṇahave mixed with sweet milk for the deity (Indra) your divine and god-devoted (juice).
verses.wilson_translation: The Atharvāṇahave mixed with sweet milk for the deity (Indra) your divine and god-devoted (juice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते ।शं राजन्नोषधीभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ śám ǀ gáve ǀ śám ǀ jánāya ǀ śám ǀ árvate ǀśám ǀ rājan ǀ óṣadhībhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Radiant (Soma), do you pour prosperity upon our cattle, upon our people, upon our horses, and upon our plural nts.
verses.wilson_translation: Radiant (Soma), do you pour prosperity upon our cattle, upon our people, upon our horses, and upon our plural nts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे ।सोमाय गाथमर्चत ॥
verses.transliteration: babhráve ǀ nú ǀ svá-tavase ǀ aruṇā́ya ǀ divi-spṛ́śe ǀsómāya ǀ gāthám ǀ arcata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Recite praises to the brown-coloured self-vigorous (at times) red heaven-touching Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Recite praises to the brown-coloured self-vigorous (at times) red heaven-touching Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पुनीतन ।मधावा धावता मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: hásta-cyutebhiḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ punītana ǀmádhau ǀ ā́ ǀ dhāvata ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purify the Somawhich has been effused by the stones whirled by thehands; mix the sweet (milk) in the inebriating juice.
verses.wilson_translation: Purify the Somawhich has been effused by the stones whirled by thehands; mix the sweet (milk) in the inebriating juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन ।इंदुमिंद्रे दधातन ॥
verses.transliteration: námasā ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǀ sīdata ǀ dadhnā́ ǀ ít ǀ abhí ǀ śrīṇītana ǀíndum ǀ índre ǀ dadhātana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Approach with reverence, mix (the libation) with the curds, offer the Somato Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Approach with reverence, mix (the libation) with the curds, offer the Somato Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे ।देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत् ॥
verses.transliteration: amitra-hā́ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ śám ǀ gáve ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ anukāma-kṛ́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, slayer of our enemies, the wise one, the fulfiller of the desires of the gods, do you shed prosperity on our cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, slayer of our enemies, the wise one, the fulfiller of the desires of the gods, do you shed prosperity on our cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे ।मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pā́tave ǀ mádāya ǀ pári ǀ sicyase ǀmanaḥ-cít ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are cognizant of the mind, lord of the mind, you are poured forth for Indrato drink for his exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are cognizant of the mind, lord of the mind, you are poured forth for Indrato drink for his exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः ।इंदविंद्रेण नो युजा ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ rayím ǀ soma ǀ rirīhi ǀ naḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índreṇa ǀ naḥ ǀ yujā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure-dropping Soma, grant us wealth with excellentmaleoffspring, grant it to us,Indu, with Indraas our ally.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure-dropping Soma, grant us wealth with excellentmaleoffspring, grant it to us,Indu, with Indraas our ally.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Indra have the Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, been poured,Shed in the seat of sacrifice. As mother kine low to their calves, to Indra have the sages called,Called him to drink the Soma juice. In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his seat,Resting upon a wiId-cow's hide. Far-sighted Soma, Sage and Seer, is worshipped in the central pointOf heaven, the straining-cloth of wool. In close embraces Indu holds Soma whenpoured within the jars.And on the. purifying sieve. Indu sends forth a voice on high to regions of the sea of air,Shaking the vase that drops with meath. The Tree whose praises never fail yields heavenly milk among our hymns,Urging men's generations on. The Wise One, with the Sage's stream, the Soma urged to speed, flows onTo the dear places of the sky. O Pavamana, bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours. Yea.O Indu, give us ready help.

verses.sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमिंदवः सुता ऋतस्य सादने ।इंद्राय मधुमत्तमाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sómāḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sádane ǀíndrāya ǀ mádhumat-tamāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The most sweet-flavoured Somalibations are poured forth to Indrain the hall of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The most sweet-flavoured Somalibations are poured forth to Indrain the hall of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न मातरः ।इंद्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ víprāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātáraḥ ǀíndram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise (priests) call upon Indrato drink the Somaas the mother low to their calves.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise (priests) call upon Indrato drink the Somaas the mother low to their calves.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिंधोरूर्मा विपश्चित् ।सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः ॥
verses.transliteration: mada-cyút ǀ kṣeti ǀ sádane ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrmā́ ǀ vipaḥ-cít ǀsómaḥ ǀ gaurī́ íti ǀ ádhi ǀ śritáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wisesoma, the bestower of exhilaration, dwells in the hall of (sacrifice), mixed with the waves of the river to a chant in the middle tone.
verses.wilson_translation: The wisesoma, the bestower of exhilaration, dwells in the hall of (sacrifice), mixed with the waves of the river to a chant in the middle tone.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते ।सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ nā́bhā ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ mahīyate ǀsómaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, the observant, who is the wise seer, is worshipped in the navel of the sky, the woollen filter.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, the observant, who is the wise seer, is worshipped in the navel of the sky, the woollen filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः सोमः कलशेष्वाँ अंतः पवित्र आहितः ।तमिंदुः परि षस्वजे ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ antáríti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́-hitaḥ ǀtám ǀ índuḥ ǀ pári ǀ sasvaje ǁ
verses.english_translation: Induhas embraced that Somawhich is collected in the sewers and has been passed through the filter.
verses.wilson_translation: Induhas embraced that Somawhich is collected in the sewers and has been passed through the filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वाचमिंदुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि ।जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vā́cam ǀ índuḥ ǀ iṣyati ǀ samudrásya ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápi ǀjínvan ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Induemits a sound, abiding in the firmament of the sky, and delighting the nectar-shedding cloud.
verses.wilson_translation: Induemits a sound, abiding in the firmament of the sky, and delighting the nectar-shedding cloud.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धीनामंतः सबर्दुघः ।हिन्वानो मानुषा युगा ॥
verses.transliteration: nítya-stotraḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ antáríti ǀ sabaḥ-dúghaḥ ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, whose praise is eternal, the lord of forests, the shedder of nectar, and rejoicing the genitive rations of men, (is present) in the midst of our sacred rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, whose praise is eternal, the lord of forests, the shedder of nectar, and rejoicing the genitive rations of men, (is present) in the midst of our sacred rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदा सोमो हिन्वानो अर्षति ।विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ padā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀvíprasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage Soma, urged from heaven, flows in a stream to the beloved abodes of his devout (worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: The sage Soma, urged from heaven, flows in a stream to the beloved abodes of his devout (worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसं ।अस्मे इंदो स्वाभुवं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ dhāraya ǀ rayím ǀ sahásra-varcasam ǀasmé íti ǀ indo íti ǀ su-ābhúvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purifying Indu, bestow upon us wealth of a thousand radiances, excelent in its nature.
verses.wilson_translation: Purifying Indu, bestow upon us wealth of a thousand radiances, excelent in its nature.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ९   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . PASSED through, the fleece in thousand streams the Soma, purified, flows onTo Indra's, Viyu's special place. Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage,Effused to entertain the Gods. The Soma-drops with thousand powers are purified for victory,Hymned to become the feast of Gods. Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win the spoilIndu, bring splendid manly might. May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,—These Godlike Soma-drops effused. Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, for victory,Swift through the woollen straining-cloth. Noisily flow the Soma-drops, like milch-kine lowing to their calves:They have run forth from both the hands. As Gladdener whom Indra loves, O Pavamana, with a roarDrive all our enemies away. O Pavamamas, driving off the godless, looking on the light,Sit in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः ।वायोरिंद्रस्य निष्कृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ áti-aviḥ ǀvāyóḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purifying Soma, flowing in a thousand streams and passing through the woollen filter, proceeds to the prepared vessel for Vāyuand Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The purifying Soma, flowing in a thousand streams and passing through the woollen filter, proceeds to the prepared vessel for Vāyuand Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत ।सुष्वाणं देववीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānam ǀ avasyavaḥ ǀ vípram ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀsusvānám ǀ devá-vītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing aloud, you who are desirous of (divine) protection to he purifying wise Soma, effused for the beverage of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing aloud, you who are desirous of (divine) protection to he purifying wise Soma, effused for the beverage of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवंते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ।गृणाना देववीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: pávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ sómāḥ ǀ sahásra-pājasaḥ ǀgṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somajuices flow for the attainment of food, giving abundance of strength and hymned (to become) the beverage of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somajuices flow for the attainment of food, giving abundance of strength and hymned (to become) the beverage of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः ।द्युमदिंदो सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ pávasva ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀdyu-mát ǀ indo íti ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indu, for our attainment of food pour forth abundant streams, and splendid and excellent vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indu, for our attainment of food pour forth abundant streams, and splendid and excellent vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवंतामा सुवीर्यं ।सुवाना देवास इंदवः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ pávantām ǀ ā́ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀsuvānā́ḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those divine libations, when effused, bring to us thousandfold wealth and excellent vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: May those divine libations, when effused, bring to us thousandfold wealth and excellent vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये ।वि वारमव्यमाशवः ॥
verses.transliteration: átyāḥ ǀ hiyānā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ hetṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ásṛgram ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀví ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǀ āśávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like horses urged to battle by their drivers, the swift-flowing juices have (flown) through the woollen fleece.
verses.wilson_translation: Like horses urged to battle by their drivers, the swift-flowing juices have (flown) through the woollen fleece.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाश्रा अर्षंतींदवोऽभि वत्सं न धेनवः ।दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.transliteration: vāśrā́ḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ índavaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀdadhanviré ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Making a loud noise, the libations flow (to the vessel) like cows lowing to their calves; they are held in the arms (of the priests).
verses.wilson_translation: Making a loud noise, the libations flow (to the vessel) like cows lowing to their calves; they are held in the arms (of the priests).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुष्ट इंद्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् ।विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
verses.transliteration: júṣṭaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ kánikradat ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Acceptable and giving delight to Indra, pure (Soma), do you, as you utter a sound, destroy all our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: Acceptable and giving delight to Indra, pure (Soma), do you, as you utter a sound, destroy all our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपघ्नंतो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः ।योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
verses.transliteration: apa-ghnántaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀ pávamānāḥ ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀyónau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure (libations), beholding all things and destroying those who worship not, sit down in the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure (libations), beholding all things and destroying those who worship not, sit down in the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ८   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . REPOSING on the river's wave the Sage hath widely flowed around,Bearing the hymn which many love. When the Five kindred Companies, active in duty, with the songEstablish him, the Powerful, Then in his juice whose strength is great, have all the Gods rejoiced themselves,When he hath clothed him in the milk. Freeing himself he flows away, leaving his body's severed limbs,And meets his own Companion here. He by the daughters of the priest, like a fair youth, hath been adorned,Making the milk, as ’twere, his robe. O'er the fine fingers, through desire of milk, in winding course he goes,And utters voice which he hath found. The nimble fingers have approached, adorning him the Lord of Strength:They grasp the vigorous Courser's back. Comprising all the treasures that are in the heavens and on the earth,Come, Soma, as our faithful Friend.

verses.sanskrit: परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिंधोरूर्मावधि श्रितः ।कारं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ prá ǀ asisyadat ǀ kavíḥ ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrmáu ǀ ádhi ǀ śritáḥ ǀkārám ǀ bíbhrat ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise (Soma) flows widely round, be taking itself to the waves of the river, and uttering a sound desired by many.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise (Soma) flows widely round, be taking itself to the waves of the river, and uttering a sound desired by many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरा यदी सबंधवः पंच व्राता अपस्यवः ।परिष्कृण्वंति धर्णसिं ॥
verses.transliteration: girā́ ǀ yádi ǀ sá-bandhavaḥ ǀ páñca ǀ vrā́tāḥ ǀ apasyávaḥ ǀpari-kṛṇvánti ǀ dharṇasím ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the five kindred sacrificing races, desirous of accomplishing pious rites, honour the sustaining (Soma) with their praise.
verses.wilson_translation: When the five kindred sacrificing races, desirous of accomplishing pious rites, honour the sustaining (Soma) with their praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदस्य शुष्मिणो रसे विश्वे देवा अमत्सत ।यदी गोभिर्वसायते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ asya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀ ráse ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amatsata ǀyádi ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vasāyáte ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then all the gods rejoice in the juice of this powerful (libation), when it is enveloped with milk and curds.
verses.wilson_translation: Then all the gods rejoice in the juice of this powerful (libation), when it is enveloped with milk and curds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: निरिणानो वि धावति जहच्छर्याणि तान्वा ।अत्रा सं जिघ्नते युजा ॥
verses.transliteration: ni-riṇānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀ jáhat ǀ śáryāṇi ǀ tā́nvā ǀátra ǀ sám ǀ jighnate ǀ yujā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Descending from the filters (into the vessel), and passing through the cloth's interstices, it becomes united in this (sacrifice) with its friend (Indra).
verses.wilson_translation: Descending from the filters (into the vessel), and passing through the cloth's interstices, it becomes united in this (sacrifice) with its friend (Indra).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नप्तीभिर्यो विवस्वतः शुभ्रो न मामृजे युवा ।गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजं ॥
verses.transliteration: naptī́bhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ śubhráḥ ǀ ná ǀ mamṛjé ǀ yúvā ǀgā́ḥ ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ ná ǀ niḥ-níjam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is rubbed down by the grandchildren of the sacrificer like a handsome young (horse), and renders his form like the produce of the kine.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is rubbed down by the grandchildren of the sacrificer like a handsome young (horse), and renders his form like the produce of the kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अति श्रिती तिरश्चता गव्या जिगात्यण्व्या ।वग्नुमियर्ति यं विदे ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ śritī́ ǀ tiraścátā ǀ gavyā́ ǀ jigāti ǀ áṇvyā ǀvagnúm ǀ iyarti ǀ yám ǀ vidé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Expressed by the finger, he proceeds obliquely to the produce of the cow to mix with it; it utters a sound which (the worshipper) recognizes.
verses.wilson_translation: Expressed by the finger, he proceeds obliquely to the produce of the cow to mix with it; it utters a sound which (the worshipper) recognizes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि क्षिपः समग्मत मर्जयंतीरिषस्पतिं ।पृष्ठा गृभ्णत वाजिनः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ sám ǀ agmata ǀ marjáyantīḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pátim ǀpṛṣṭhā́ ǀ gṛbhṇata ǀ vājínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fingers combine expressing the lord of food (i.e.,Soma), and they grasp the back of the vigorous (Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: The fingers combine expressing the lord of food (i.e.,Soma), and they grasp the back of the vigorous (Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि दिव्यानि मर्मृशद्विश्वानि सोम पार्थिवा ।वसूनि याह्यस्मयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ divyā́ni ǀ mármṛśat ǀ víśvāni ǀ soma ǀ pā́rthivā ǀvásūni ǀ yāhi ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who hols all the treasures of heaven and earth, come favourably disposed to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who hols all the treasures of heaven and earth, come favourably disposed to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ८   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THROUGH the fine fingers, with the song, this Hero comes with rapid ears,Going to Indra's special place. In holy thought he ponders much for the great worship of the Gods.Where the Immortals have their seat. Like a good horse is he led out, when on the path that shines with lightThe mettled steeds exert their strength. He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them Bull who leads the herd,Doing with might heroic deeds. He moves, a vigorous Steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold,Becoming Sovran of the streams. He, over places rough to pass, bringing rich treasures closely packed.Descends into the reservoirs. Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified,Him who brings forth abundant food. Him, even him, the fingers ten and the seven songs make beautiful,Well-weaponed, best of gladdeners.

verses.sanskrit: एष धिया यात्यण्व्या शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः ।गच्छन्निंद्रस्य निष्कृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ yāti ǀ áṇvyā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀgácchan ǀ índrasya ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
verses.english_translation: This heroic Somaexpressed by the fingers proceeds by the sacrifice, hastening with swift chariots to Indra's above.
verses.wilson_translation: This heroic Somaexpressed by the fingers proceeds by the sacrifice, hastening with swift chariots to Indra's above.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये ।यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ purú ǀ dhiyā-yate ǀ bṛhaté ǀ devá-tātaye ǀyátra ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somaengages in many holy rites for the great sacrifice where the immortals sit.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somaengages in many holy rites for the great sacrifice where the immortals sit.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष हितो वि नीयतेऽंतः शुभ्रावता पथा ।यदी तुंजंति भूर्णयः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyate ǀ antáríti ǀ śubhrá-vatā ǀ pathā́ ǀyádi ǀ tuñjánti ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: plural ced (in the cart) he is brought by a brilliant path when the offerers of the libation present him.
verses.wilson_translation: plural ced (in the cart) he is brought by a brilliant path when the offerers of the libation present him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष शृंगाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो वृषा ।नृम्णा दधान ओजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ śṛ́ṅgāṇi ǀ dódhuvat ǀ śíśīte ǀ yūthyáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀnṛmṇā́ ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: He tosses his horns as a bull, the lord of the herd, sharpens his, bearing treasures (for us) by his might.
verses.wilson_translation: He tosses his horns as a bull, the lord of the herd, sharpens his, bearing treasures (for us) by his might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजी शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः ।पतिः सिंधूनां भवन् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ rukmí-bhiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ vājī́ ǀ śubhrébhiḥ ǀ aṃśú-bhiḥ ǀpátiḥ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ bhávan ǁ
verses.english_translation: He proceeds along impetuous with goldenbrilliant rays, the lord of streams.
verses.wilson_translation: He proceeds along impetuous with goldenbrilliant rays, the lord of streams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष वसूनि पिब्दना परुषा ययिवाँ अति ।अव शादेषु गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ pibdanā́ ǀ páruṣā ǀ yayi-vā́n ǀ áti ǀáva ǀ śā́deṣu ǀ gacchati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Overpowering at the juncture of time the discomfited concealers (therākṣasas), he descends upon those doomed to destruction.
verses.wilson_translation: Overpowering at the juncture of time the discomfited concealers (therākṣasas), he descends upon those doomed to destruction.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतं मृजंति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः ।प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ mṛjanti ǀ márjyam ǀ úpa ǀ dróṇeṣu ǀ āyávaḥ ǀpra-cakrāṇám ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests express into the vessels this juice which is to be purified, the bestower of abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: The priests express into the vessels this juice which is to be purified, the bestower of abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजंति सप्त धीतयः ।स्वायुधं मदिंतमं ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ mṛjánti ǀ saptá ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀsu-āyudhám ǀ madín-tamam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers, the seven priests, express this (juice), well-weaponed, and yielding great exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers, the seven priests, express this (juice), well-weaponed, and yielding great exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ८   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE pressers from the Soma-press send forth thy juice for rapturous joyThe speckled sap runs like a flood. With strength we follow through the sieve him who brings might and wins the kine,Enrobed in water with his juice. Pour on the sieve the Soma, ne’er subdued in waters, waterless,And make it pure for Indra's drink. Moved by the purifier's thought, the Soma flows into the sieve:By wisdom it hath gained its home. With humble homage, Indra, have the Soma-drops flowed forth to thee,Contending for the glorious prize. Purified in his fleecy garb, attaining every beauty, heStands, hero-like, amid the kine. Swelling, as ’twere, to heights of heaven, the stream of the creative juiceFalls lightly on the cleansing sieve. Thus, Soma, purifying himwho knoweth song mid living men,Thou wanderest through the cloth of wool.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते सोतार ओण्यो रसं मदाय घृष्वये ।सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ sotā́raḥ ǀ oṇyóḥ ǀ rásam ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǀsárgaḥ ǀ ná ǀ takti ǀ étaśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They who express you, the juice of heaven and earth do it for the foe-destroying exhilaration (of Indra); your flow rushes as a swift horse.
verses.wilson_translation: They who express you, the juice of heaven and earth do it for the foe-destroying exhilaration (of Indra); your flow rushes as a swift horse.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रत्वा दक्षस्य रथ्यमपो वसानमंधसा ।गोषामण्वेषु सश्चिम ॥
verses.transliteration: krátvā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ rathyám ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānam ǀ ándhasā ǀgo-sā́m ǀ áṇveṣu ǀ saścima ǁ
verses.english_translation: In pious rite by our fingers we mix with the milk (the Soma), the bringer of strength, the sender of kine, who envelopes the water.
verses.wilson_translation: In pious rite by our fingers we mix with the milk (the Soma), the bringer of strength, the sender of kine, who envelopes the water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनप्तमप्सु दुष्टरं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज ।पुनीहींद्राय पातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ánaptam ǀ ap-sú ǀ dustáram ǀ sómam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛja ǀpunīhí ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Cast into the filter the unassailable invincible (Soma), abiding in the waters (of the firmament) purify it for the drinking of Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Cast into the filter the unassailable invincible (Soma), abiding in the waters (of the firmament) purify it for the drinking of Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र पुनानस्य चेतसा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति ।क्रत्वा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ punānásya ǀ cétasā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀkrátvā ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaof him who is purified by worship flows upon the filter and settles in the plural ce common with the ceremony.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaof him who is purified by worship flows upon the filter and settles in the plural ce common with the ceremony.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र त्वा नमोभिरिंदव इंद्र सोमा असृक्षत ।महे भराय कारिणः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ tvā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ índra ǀ sómāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀmahé ǀ bhárāya ǀ kāríṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somajuices flow to you,Indra, with praises, giving you vigour for the great conflict.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somajuices flow to you,Indra, with praises, giving you vigour for the great conflict.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानो रूपे अव्यये विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः ।शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ rūpé ǀ avyáye ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ árṣan ǀ abhí ǀ śríyaḥ ǀśū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ góṣu ǀ tiṣṭhati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified in his woollen robe, and attaining all honours he stands as a hero amidst the kine.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified in his woollen robe, and attaining all honours he stands as a hero amidst the kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो न सानु पिप्युषी धारा सुतस्य वेधसः ।वृथा पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sā́nu ǀ pipyúṣī ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀvṛ́thā ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the lofty rain from heaven, the nutritious strream of the invogorating Somafalls easily upon the straining cloth.
verses.wilson_translation: As the lofty rain from heaven, the nutritious strream of the invogorating Somafalls easily upon the straining cloth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं तना पुनान आयुषु ।अव्यो वारं वि धावसि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ tánā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ āyúṣu ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ví ǀ dhāvasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, (process) the worshipper among men, and purified by the cloth you wander through the woollen filter.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, (process) the worshipper among men, and purified by the cloth you wander through the woollen filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ८   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LIKE rivers down a steep descent, slaying the Vṛtras, full of zeal,The rapid Soma-streams have flowed. The drops of Soma juice effused fall like the rain upon the earth:To Indra flow the Soma-streams. With swelling wave the gladdening drink, the Soma, flows intoṭhe sieve,Loving the Gods and slaying fiends. It hastens to the pitchers, poured upon the sieve it waxes strongAt sacrifices through the lauds. Soma, thou shinest mounting heaven as ’twere above light's triple realm,And moving secm'st to speed the Sun. To him, the head of sacnfice, singers and bards have sung their songs,Offering what he loves to see. The men, the sages with their hymns, eager for help, deck thee strong &teed,Deck thee for service of the Gods. Flow onward to the stream of meath rest efficacious in thy home,Fair, to be drunk at sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: प्र निम्नेनेव सिंधवो घ्नंतो वृत्राणि भूर्णयः ।सोमा असृग्रमाशवः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ nimnéna-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ghnántaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǀsómāḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ āśávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like rivers falling down a steep plural ce, so that rapid foe-destroying pervading Soma-streams hurry (to the pitcher).
verses.wilson_translation: Like rivers falling down a steep plural ce, so that rapid foe-destroying pervading Soma-streams hurry (to the pitcher).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि सुवानास इंदवो वृष्टयः पृथिवीमिव ।इंद्रं सोमासो अक्षरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m-iva ǀíndram ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ akṣaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Soma-drops, as they are expressed, flow to Indralike the rains falling upon the earth.
verses.wilson_translation: The Soma-drops, as they are expressed, flow to Indralike the rains falling upon the earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्यूर्मिर्मत्सरो मदः सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति ।विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: áti-ūrmiḥ ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀvi-ghnán ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, with swelling waves, exhilarating, inebriating, flows to the straining-cloth, destroying therākṣasas, and devoted to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, with swelling waves, exhilarating, inebriating, flows to the straining-cloth, destroying therākṣasas, and devoted to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परि षिच्यते ।उक्थैर्यज्ञेषु वर्धते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ dhāvati ǀ pavítre ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀuktháiḥ ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ vardhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: It flows to the pitchers, it is poured out upon the straining-cloth, it is magnified at sacrifices by praises.
verses.wilson_translation: It flows to the pitchers, it is poured out upon the straining-cloth, it is magnified at sacrifices by praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अति त्री सोम रोचना रोहन्न भ्राजसे दिवं ।इष्णन्त्सूर्यं न चोदयः ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ trī́ ǀ soma ǀ rocanā́ ǀ róhan ǀ ná ǀ bhrājase ǀ dívam ǀiṣṇán ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ná ǀ codayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, mounting beyond thethree worlds, you illumine heaven, and moving, you urge on the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, mounting beyond thethree worlds, you illumine heaven, and moving, you urge on the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य कारवः ।दधानाश्चक्षसि प्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ víprāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ mūrdhán ǀ yajñásya ǀ kārávaḥ ǀdádhānāḥ ǀ cákṣasi ǀ priyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage performers (of pious rites) glorify (the Soma) at the head of the sacrifice, entertaining affection for him the all-beholding.
verses.wilson_translation: The sage performers (of pious rites) glorify (the Soma) at the head of the sacrifice, entertaining affection for him the all-beholding.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमु त्वा वाजिनं नरो धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः ।मृजंति देवतातये ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ vājínam ǀ náraḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀmṛjánti ǀ devá-tātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sages, leaders of rites, desirous of sustenance, purify you who are the giver of food, with pious rites for the offering.
verses.wilson_translation: Sages, leaders of rites, desirous of sustenance, purify you who are the giver of food, with pious rites for the offering.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मधोर्धारामनु क्षर तीव्रः सधस्थमासदः ।चारुर्ऋताय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rām ǀ ánu ǀ kṣara ǀ tīvráḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadaḥ ǀcā́ruḥ ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour forth the stream of the sweet beverage; sit down, sharp-flavoured in the receptacle, alert for drinking at the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour forth the stream of the sweet beverage; sit down, sharp-flavoured in the receptacle, alert for drinking at the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XVIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ७   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU, Soma, dweller on the hills, effused, hast flowed into the sieve,:All-bounteous art thou in carouse. Thou art a sacred Bard, a Sage; the meath is offipring of thy sap:All-bountcous art thou in carouse. All Deities of one accord have come that they may drink of thee:All-bounteous art thou in carouse. He who containeth in his hands all treasures much to be desired:All-bounteous art thou in carouse. Who milketh out this mighty Pair, the Earth and Heaven, like mother kineAll-bounteous art thou in carouse. Who in a moment mightily floweth around these two world-halvcs:All-bounteous art thou in carouse. The Strong One, being purified, hath in the pitchers cried aloud:All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sanskrit: परि सुवानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षाः ।मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ giri-sthā́ḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ sómaḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effused while pressed between the stones, the Somaflows upon the straining cloth; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: Effused while pressed between the stones, the Somaflows upon the straining cloth; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमंधसः ।मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ vípraḥ ǀ tvám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ prá ǀ jātám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are wise, you are a seer; you bestow the sweet (beverage) produced from the Soma; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: You are wise, you are a seer; you bestow the sweet (beverage) produced from the Soma; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत ।मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ víśve ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ pītím ǀ āśata ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: All the gods together plural ased enjoy your drinking; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: All the gods together plural ased enjoy your drinking; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यो विश्वानि वार्या वसूनि हस्तयोर्दधे ।मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ vásūni ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ dadhé ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You are he) who plural ces in thehands(of the worshipper) all desirable riches, you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: (You are he) who plural ces in thehands(of the worshipper) all desirable riches, you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य इमे रोदसी मही सं मातरेव दोहते ।मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ imé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ sám ǀ mātárā-iva ǀ dóhate ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You are he) who milks this great heaven and earth like two mothers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: (You are he) who milks this great heaven and earth like two mothers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि यो रोदसी उभे सद्यो वाजेभिरर्षति ।मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ yáḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ árṣati ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You are he) who at once supplies both heaven and earth with viands; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: (You are he) who at once supplies both heaven and earth with viands; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स शुष्मी कलशेष्वा पुनानो अचिक्रदत् ।मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ acikradat ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: This vigorous Soma, while being purified, murmurs in the pitchers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.wilson_translation: This vigorous Soma, while being purified, murmurs in the pitchers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XIX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ७   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O SOMA, being purified bring us the wondrous treasure, meetFor lauds, that is in earth and heaven. For ye Twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of the light, Lords of the kine:Great Rulers, prosper ye our songs. The tawny Steer, while cleansed among the living, bellowing on the grass,Hath sunk and settled in his home. Over the Steer's productive flow the sacred songs were resonant,The mothers of the darling Son. Hath he not, purified, impregned the kine whb long to meet their Lord,The kine who yield the shining milk? Bring near us those who stand aloof strike fear into our enemies:O Pavamana, find us wealth. Soma, bring down the foeman's might, his vigorous strength and vital powe'r,Whether he be afar or near.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु ।तन्नः पुनान आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ soma ǀ citrám ǀ ukthyám ǀ divyám ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ vásu ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever wonderful glorious wealth there be in heaven or in earth, do you,Soma, being purified, bring it to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever wonderful glorious wealth there be in heaven or in earth, do you,Soma, being purified, bring it to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: युवं हि स्थः स्वर्पती इंद्रश्च सोम गोपती ।ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvám ǀ hí ǀ stháḥ ǀ sváḥpatī íti svaḥ-patī ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ gópatī íti gó-patī ǀīśānā́ ǀ pipyatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Somaand Indra, are the lords of all the lords of cattle, do you, the rulers, prosper our rites.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Somaand Indra, are the lords of all the lords of cattle, do you, the rulers, prosper our rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा पुनान आयुषु स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि ।हरिः सन्योनिमासदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ āyúṣu ǀ stanáyan ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀháriḥ ǀ sán ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer (of benefits) being purified among men (lies) murmuring upon the sacred grass, green-tinted he sits down in his proper plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of benefits) being purified among men (lies) murmuring upon the sacred grass, green-tinted he sits down in his proper plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अवावशंत धीतयो वृषभस्याधि रेतसि ।सूनोर्वत्सस्य मातरः ॥
verses.transliteration: ávāvaśanta ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ ádhi ǀ rétasi ǀsūnóḥ ǀ vatsásya ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mothers of themalecalf, which are sucked by him, long to cherish the bull with their strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The mothers of themalecalf, which are sucked by him, long to cherish the bull with their strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कुविद्वृषण्यंतीभ्यः पुनानो गर्भमादधत् ।याः शुक्रं दुहते पयः ॥
verses.transliteration: kuvít ǀ vṛṣaṇyántībhyaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ ā-dádhat ǀyā́ḥ ǀ śukrám ǀ duhaté ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified Somahas implanted many a germ in those (waters) desirous of conception, which yield bright milk.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified Somahas implanted many a germ in those (waters) desirous of conception, which yield bright milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रुषु ।पवमान विदा रयिं ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ śikṣa ǀ apa-tasthúṣaḥ ǀ bhiyásam ǀ ā́ ǀ dhehi ǀ śátruṣu ǀpávamāna ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ rayím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring near to us those who stand aloof, strike terror into our fores; pure-flowing one, you do transfer to us their riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring near to us those who stand aloof, strike terror into our fores; pure-flowing one, you do transfer to us their riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि शत्रोः सोम वृष्ण्यं नि शुष्मं नि वयस्तिर ।दूरे वा सतो अंति वा ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ śátroḥ ǀ soma ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ ní ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ní ǀ váyaḥ ǀ tira ǀdūré ǀ vā ǀ satáḥ ǀ ánti ǀ vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroy,Soma, the vigour, the energy, the subsistence of our enemy, whether he be far off or nigh.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroy,Soma, the vigour, the energy, the subsistence of our enemy, whether he be far off or nigh.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XX Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ७   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FORTH through the straining-cloth the Sage flows to the banquet of the Gods,Subduing all our enemies. For he, as Pavamana, sends thousandfold treasure in the shapeOf cattle to the singing-men. Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughtsAs such, O Soma, find us fame. Pour lofty glory on us, send sure riches to our liberal lords,Bring food to those who sing thy praise. As thou art cleansed, O Wondrous Steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, likeA pious King, into the songs. He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made cleanWith hands, is resting in the jars. Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest, Soma, to the sieve,Lending the laud a Hero's strength.

verses.sanskrit: प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति ।साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ kavíḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ arṣati ǀsahvā́n ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The seer passes through the woollen fleece for the beverage of the gods, triumphing over all adversaries.
verses.wilson_translation: The seer passes through the woollen fleece for the beverage of the gods, triumphing over all adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमंतमिन्वति ।पवमानः सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ ínvati ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Verily he, the pure-flowing, bestows upon his praisers thousands of victuals with cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily he, the pure-flowing, bestows upon his praisers thousands of victuals with cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृशसे पवसे मती ।स नः सोम श्रवो विदः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ víśvāni ǀ cétasā ǀ mṛśáse ǀ pávase ǀ matī́ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ vidaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By the favour you give to us all kinds of wealth, you flow at our praise; grant us, OSoma, food.
verses.wilson_translation: By the favour you give to us all kinds of wealth, you flow at our praise; grant us, OSoma, food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं रयिं ।इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ bṛhát ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ dhruvám ǀ rayím ǀíṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us great renown, grant durable riches to those who profuse in their libations, bring food to your praisers.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us great renown, grant durable riches to those who profuse in their libations, bring food to your praisers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमा विवेशिथ ।पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ su-vratáḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ soma ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśitha ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vahne ǀ adbhuta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified one, doer of good deeds, you,Soma, enter our praises like a king, O wonderful bearer (of our offerings).
verses.wilson_translation: Purified one, doer of good deeds, you,Soma, enter our praises like a king, O wonderful bearer (of our offerings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः ।सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ dustáraḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ sīdati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, the bearer (of oblations), abiding in the waters of the firmament, difficult to be surpassed, being cleansed by ourhandsreposes in the vessels.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, the bearer (of oblations), abiding in the waters of the firmament, difficult to be surpassed, being cleansed by ourhandsreposes in the vessels.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रीळुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि ।दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: krīḷúḥ ǀ makháḥ ǀ ná ǀ maṃhayúḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ soma ǀ gacchasi ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, you proceed to the straining-cloth, sportive and genitive rous, like a gift, giving excellent vigour to him who praises you.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, you proceed to the straining-cloth, sportive and genitive rous, like a gift, giving excellent vigour to him who praises you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ७   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Indra flow these running drops, these Somas frolicsome in mood.Exhilarating, finding light; Driving off foes, bestowing room upon the presser, willinglyBringing their praiser vitalforce. Lightly disporting them, the drops flow to one common reservoir,And fall into the river's wave. These Pavamanas have obtained all blessings much to be desired,Like coursers harnessed to a car. With view to us, O Soma-drops, bestow his manifold desireOn him who yet hath given us naught. Bring us our wish with this design, as a wright brings his new-wrought wheel:Flow pure and shining with the stream. These drops have cried with resonant voice: like swift steeds they have run the course,And roused the good man's hymn to life.

verses.sanskrit: एते धावंतींदवः सोमा इंद्राय घृष्वयः ।मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ dhāvanti ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvayaḥ ǀmatsarā́saḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These flowing Soma-juices, foe-destroying, exhilarating, heaven-conferring, have gone to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: These flowing Soma-juices, foe-destroying, exhilarating, heaven-conferring, have gone to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृण्वंतो अभियुजः सुष्वये वरिवोविदः ।स्वयं स्तोत्रे वयस्कृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-vṛṇvántaḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ súsvaye ǀ varivaḥ-vídaḥ ǀsvayám ǀ stotré ǀ vayaḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Showing favour, assailing foes, giving wealth to him who rightly effuses them, and bestowing food spontaneously on their praiser.
verses.wilson_translation: Showing favour, assailing foes, giving wealth to him who rightly effuses them, and bestowing food spontaneously on their praiser.
