verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृथा क्रीळंत इंदवः सधस्थमभ्येकमित् ।सिंधोरूर्मा व्यक्षरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́thā ǀ krī́ḷantaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ abhí ǀ ékam ǀ ít ǀsíndhoḥ ǀ ūrmā́ ǀ ví ǀ akṣaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The effused juices come sporting lightly to the common receptacle, they drop into the wave of the river.
verses.wilson_translation: The effused juices come sporting lightly to the common receptacle, they drop into the wave of the river.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते विश्वानि वार्या पवमानास आशत ।हिता न सप्तयो रथे ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ āśata ǀhitā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ ráthe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like horses harnessed to a car these pure juices bring (to us) all desirable blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: Like horses harnessed to a car these pure juices bring (to us) all desirable blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आस्मिन्पिशंगमिंदवो दधाता वेनमादिशे ।यो अस्मभ्यमरावा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ asmin ǀ piśáṅgam ǀ indavaḥ ǀ dádhāta ǀ venám ǀ ā-díśe ǀyáḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ árāvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effused Soma-juices, at our indication, bestow manifold blessings on this (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), who (at present) has given us nothing.
verses.wilson_translation: Effused Soma-juices, at our indication, bestow manifold blessings on this (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), who (at present) has given us nothing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुर्न रथ्यं नवं दधाता केतमादिशे ।शुक्राः पवध्वमर्णसा ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ráthyam ǀ návam ǀ dádhāta ǀ kétam ǀ ā-díśe ǀśukrā́ḥ ǀ pavadhvam ǀ árṇasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: As a great man sets before him a commendable charioteer, so do you grant knowledge to our lord, and flow glistening with water.
verses.wilson_translation: As a great man sets before him a commendable charioteer, so do you grant knowledge to our lord, and flow glistening with water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एत उ त्ये अवीवशन्काष्ठां वाजिनो अक्रत ।सतः प्रासाविषुर्मतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ avīvaśan ǀ kā́ṣṭhām ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ akrata ǀsatáḥ ǀ prá ǀ asāviṣuḥ ǀ matím ǁ
verses.english_translation: These effused juices have desired (the sacrifice); powerful they have made for themselves an abiding-plural ce; they have animated the intellect of the pious instrumental tutor of the rite.
verses.wilson_translation: These effused juices have desired (the sacrifice); powerful they have made for themselves an abiding-plural ce; they have animated the intellect of the pious instrumental tutor of the rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ७   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THESE rapid Soma-streams have stirred themselves to motion like strong steeds,Like cars, like armies hurried forth. Swift as wide winds they lightly move, like rain-storms of Parjanya, likeThe flickering flames of burning fire. These Soma juices, blent with curds, purified, skilled in sacred hymns,Have gained by song their hearts'desire. Immortal, cleansed, these drops, since first they flowed, have never wearied, fainTo reach the regions and their paths. Advancing they have travelled o’er the ridges of the earth and heaven,And this the highest realm of all. Over the heights have they attained the highest thread that is spun out,And this which must be deemed most high. Thou, Soma, boldest wealth in kine which thou hast seized from niggard churls:Thou calledst forth the outspun thread.

verses.sanskrit: एते सोमास आशवो रथा इव प्र वाजिनः ।सर्गाः सृष्टा अहेषत ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ vājínaḥ ǀsárgāḥ ǀ sṛṣṭā́ḥ ǀ aheṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: These Soma-jices, when let out, neigh as they leap swiftly forth like chariots or rapid steeds let loose.
verses.wilson_translation: These Soma-jices, when let out, neigh as they leap swiftly forth like chariots or rapid steeds let loose.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते वाता इवोरवः पर्जन्यस्येव वृष्टयः ।अग्नेरिव भ्रमा वृथा ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ vā́tāḥ-iva ǀ urávaḥ ǀ parjányasya-iva ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀagnéḥ-iva ǀ bhramā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like strong winds, like the rains of Parjanya, like the swift-whiring (flames) of fire.
verses.wilson_translation: Like strong winds, like the rains of Parjanya, like the swift-whiring (flames) of fire.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।विपा व्यानशुर्धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ pūtā́ḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀvipā́ ǀ ví ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These pure Soma-juices, sagacious, mixed with curds, easily pervade our cermonies with their intelligence.
verses.wilson_translation: These pure Soma-juices, sagacious, mixed with curds, easily pervade our cermonies with their intelligence.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते मृष्टा अमर्त्याः ससृवांसो न शश्रमुः ।इयक्षंतः पथो रजः ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ mṛṣṭā́ḥ ǀ ámartyāḥ ǀ sasṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śaśramuḥ ǀíyakṣantaḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified, immortal, issuing from the vessels, eager to traverse their (assigned) paths and the universe, they are never wearied.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified, immortal, issuing from the vessels, eager to traverse their (assigned) paths and the universe, they are never wearied.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते पृष्ठानि रोदसोर्विप्रयंतो व्यानशुः ।उतेदमुत्तमं रजः ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ pṛṣṭhā́ni ǀ ródasoḥ ǀ vi-prayántaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀutá ǀ idám ǀ ut-tamám ǀ rájaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Spreading in various directions, they pervade the surface of earth and sky, you and this highest heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Spreading in various directions, they pervade the surface of earth and sky, you and this highest heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तंतुं तन्वानमुत्तममनु प्रवत आशत ।उतेदमुत्तमाय्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tántum ǀ tanvānám ǀ ut-tamám ǀ ánu ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ āśata ǀutá ǀ idám ǀ uttamā́yyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Descending rivers follow this excellent (Soma) as it spreads out the sacrifice; this rits is glorified thereby.
verses.wilson_translation: Descending rivers follow this excellent (Soma) as it spreads out the sacrifice; this rits is glorified thereby.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम पणिभ्य आ वसु गव्यानि धारयः ।ततं तंतुमचिक्रदः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ paṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vásu ǀ gávyāni ǀ dhārayaḥ ǀtatám ǀ tántum ǀ acikradaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, hold the wealth of kine which you have won from the Paṇis, you have called aloud at the outspread sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, hold the wealth of kine which you have won from the Paṇis, you have called aloud at the outspread sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ७   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SWIFT Soma drops have been effused in streams of meath, the gladdening drink,For sacred lore of every kind. Hither to newer. resting-place the ancient Living Ones are come.They made the Sun that he might shine. O Pavamana, bring to us the unsacrificing foeman's wealth,And give us food with progeny. The living Somas being cleansed diffuse exhilarating drink,Turned to the vat which drips with meath. Soma gows on intelligent, possessing sap and mighty strength,Brave Hero who repels the curse. For Indra, Soma! thou art cleansed, a feast-companion for the Gods:ndu, thou fain wilt win us strength When he had drunken draughts of this, Indra smote down resistless foes:Yea, smote them, and shall smite them still.

verses.sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमाशवो मधोर्मदस्य धारया ।अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.transliteration: sómāḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ mádasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀabhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The swift-flowing Soma-juices have issued in a stream of the sweet exhilarating (beverage), at (the recital of) all the praise (of the sages).
verses.wilson_translation: The swift-flowing Soma-juices have issued in a stream of the sweet exhilarating (beverage), at (the recital of) all the praise (of the sages).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः ।रुचे जनंत सूर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ padám ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ akramuḥ ǀrucé ǀ jananta ǀ sū́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ancient swift-going (horses), they (the juices) have traversed anew field-- they have a genitive rated a sun to give light.
verses.wilson_translation: Ancient swift-going (horses), they (the juices) have traversed anew field-- they have a genitive rated a sun to give light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवमान नो भरार्यो अदाशुषो गयं ।कृधि प्रजावतीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ádāśuṣaḥ ǀ gáyam ǀkṛdhí ǀ prajā́-vatīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to us, purifier, the house of our enemy who presents no libations-- bestow upon us progeny-abounding food.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to us, purifier, the house of our enemy who presents no libations-- bestow upon us progeny-abounding food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवंते मद्यं मदं ।अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ pávante ǀ mádyam ǀ mádam ǀabhí ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The swift-flowing Soma-juices diffuse exhilarating wine-- they flow to the honey-shedding receptacle.
verses.wilson_translation: The swift-flowing Soma-juices diffuse exhilarating wine-- they flow to the honey-shedding receptacle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमो अर्षति धर्णसिर्दधान इंद्रियं रसं ।सुवीरो अभिशस्तिपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ indriyám ǀ rásam ǀsu-vī́raḥ ǀ abhiśasti-pā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaflows, the sustainer (of the world), bearing a sense-invigorating essence-- heroic-- a protector against calumny.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaflows, the sustainer (of the world), bearing a sense-invigorating essence-- heroic-- a protector against calumny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय सोम पवसे देवेभ्यः सधमाद्यः ।इंदो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pavase ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sadha-mā́dyaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ vā́jam ǀ sisāsasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are worthy of the sacrifice, you flow to Indraand to the gods; you,Indu, vouchsafe to give us food.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are worthy of the sacrifice, you flow to Indraand to the gods; you,Indu, vouchsafe to give us food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा मदानामिंद्रो वृत्राण्यप्रति ।जघान जघनच्च नु ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ pītvā́ ǀ mádānām ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ apratí ǀjaghā́na ǀ jaghánat ǀ ca ǀ nú ǁ
verses.english_translation: Having drunk of this chief of exhilarating draughts,Indrairresistible has slain his foes, and may he ever slay them.
verses.wilson_translation: Having drunk of this chief of exhilarating draughts,Indrairresistible has slain his foes, and may he ever slay them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIVṢoma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ७   काश्यपोऽसितो देवलो वा । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HITHERWARD have the Soma streamed,the drops while they are purified:When bIent, in waters they are rinsed. The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice:They come to Indra, being cleansed. O Soma Pavamana, thou art flowing to be Indra's drink:The men have seized and lead thee forth. Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow, delighting men,To him who ruleth o’er mankind. Thou, Indu, when, effused by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art,Ready for Indra's high decree. Flow on, best Vṛtra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds.Pure, purifying, wonderful. Pure, purifying is he called the Soma of the meath eflused,Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इंदवः ।श्रीणाना अप्सु मृंजत ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ adhanviṣuḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀśrīṇānā́ḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ mṛñjata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified effused Soma-juices have flowed forth-- mixing (with curds and milk) they are cleansed in the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified effused Soma-juices have flowed forth-- mixing (with curds and milk) they are cleansed in the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः ।पुनाना इंद्रमाशत ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ adhanviṣuḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-vátā ǀ yatī́ḥ ǀpunānā́ḥ ǀ índram ǀ āśata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The flowing juices rush (to the filter), like waters flowing down a declivity; purified they gratify Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The flowing juices rush (to the filter), like waters flowing down a declivity; purified they gratify Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेंद्राय पातवे ।नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ pavamāna ǀ dhanvasi ǀ sóma ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purifier,Soma, you proceed to Indrafor his drinking-- thence are you brought by the priests.
verses.wilson_translation: Purifier,Soma, you proceed to Indrafor his drinking-- thence are you brought by the priests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीसहे ।सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ nṛ-mā́danaḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ carṣaṇi-sáhe ǀsásniḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ anu-mā́dyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, who are the exhilarator of men, flow to (Indra), the conqueror of enemies, you who are pure and to be worshipped.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, who are the exhilarator of men, flow to (Indra), the conqueror of enemies, you who are pure and to be worshipped.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिधावसि ।अरमिंद्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
verses.transliteration: índo íti ǀ yát ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ pari-dhā́vasi ǀáram ǀ índrasya ǀ dhā́mne ǁ
verses.english_translation: When,Indu, effused by the stones, you have flowed to the filtering-cloth, you are an ample portion for Indra's belly.
verses.wilson_translation: When,Indu, effused by the stones, you have flowed to the filtering-cloth, you are an ample portion for Indra's belly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वृत्रहंतमोक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः ।शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ anu-mā́dyaḥ ǀśúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Utter destroyer of enemies, flow forth, to be propitiated by praises, pure, purifying, wonderful.
verses.wilson_translation: Utter destroyer of enemies, flow forth, to be propitiated by praises, pure, purifying, wonderful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतस्य मध्वः ।देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ucyate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ aghaśaṃsa-hā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, (the yielder) of the exhilarating effusion, is called the pure, the purifier, the gratifier of the gods, the slayer of the wicked.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, (the yielder) of the exhilarating effusion, is called the pure, the purifier, the gratifier of the gods, the slayer of the wicked.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GREEN-HUED! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draughtFor Vāyu and the Marut host. O Pavamana, sent by song, roaring about thy dwelling-place,Pass into Vāyu as Law bids. The Steer shines with the Deities, dear Sage in his appointed home,Foe-Slayer, most beloved by Gods. Taking each beauteous form, he goes, desirable, while purified,Thither where- the Immortals sit. To Indra Soma flows, the Red, engendering song, exceeding wise,The visitor of living men. Flow, best exhilarator, Sage, flow to the filter in a streamTo seat thee in the place of song.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे ।मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pītáye ǀ hare ǀmarút-bhyaḥ ǀ vāyáve ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Green-tinted (Soma), do you who are the bestower of strength, the exhilarating, flow as a beverage for the gods, for the Marutsand for Vāyu.
verses.wilson_translation: Green-tinted (Soma), do you who are the bestower of strength, the exhilarating, flow as a beverage for the gods, for the Marutsand for Vāyu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान धिया हितोऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ।धर्मणा वायुमा विश ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yónim ǀ kánikradat ǀdhármaṇā ǀ vāyúm ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purifying (Soma), plural ced suitably by the sacred rite, (enter) uttering a cry the (appointed) plural ce, enter by the sacred function into Vāyu.
verses.wilson_translation: Purifying (Soma), plural ced suitably by the sacred rite, (enter) uttering a cry the (appointed) plural ce, enter by the sacred function into Vāyu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः ।वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ deváiḥ ǀ śobhate ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ yónau ǀ ádhi ǀ priyáḥ ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Soma, the showerer (of benefits), the seer, the beloved, the destroyer of foes,t he most devout, shines in its appointed plural ce along with the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: This Soma, the showerer (of benefits), the seer, the beloved, the destroyer of foes,t he most devout, shines in its appointed plural ce along with the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन्पुनानो याति हर्यतः ।यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvā ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ ā-viśán ǀ punānáḥ ǀ yāti ǀ haryatáḥ ǀyátra ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pervading all forms, the pure, the desirable goes to the plural ce where the immortals abide.
verses.wilson_translation: Pervading all forms, the pure, the desirable goes to the plural ce where the immortals abide.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरुषो जनयन्गिरः सोमः पवत आयुषक् ।इंद्रं गच्छन्कविक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: aruṣáḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavate ǀ āyuṣák ǀíndram ǀ gácchan ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Endowed with wisdom of the past, the brilliant Soma, genitive rating sounds, flows forth continually proceeding to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Endowed with wisdom of the past, the brilliant Soma, genitive rating sounds, flows forth continually proceeding to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिंतम पवित्रं धारया कवे ।अर्कस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ pavítram ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kave ǀarkásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most exhilarating and sage (Soma), flow through the filter in a stream, to attain the station of the adorable Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Most exhilarating and sage (Soma), flow through the filter in a stream, to attain the station of the adorable Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE sages with the fingers' art have dressed and decked that vigorous SteedUpon the lap of Aditi, The kine have called aloud to him exhaustless with a thousand streams,To Indu who supporteth heaven. Him, nourisher of many, Sage, creative Pavamana, theyHave sent, by wisdom, to the sky. Him, dweller with Vivasvān, they with use of both arms have sent forth,The Lord of Speech infallible. Him, green, beloved, many eyed, the Sisters with prosing stonesSend down to ridges of the sieve. O Pavamana, Indu, priests hurry thee on to Indra, theeWho aidest song and cheerest him.

verses.sanskrit: तममृक्षंत वाजिनमुपस्थे अदितेरधि ।विप्रासो अण्व्या धिया ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ amṛkṣanta ǀ vājínam ǀ upá-sthe ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ádhi ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ áṇvyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests have cleansed that Soma(swift as) horse, on the lap of Aditiwith fingers and with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: The priests have cleansed that Soma(swift as) horse, on the lap of Aditiwith fingers and with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं गावो अभ्यनूषत सहस्रधारमक्षितं ।इंदुं धर्तारमा दिवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀ sahásra-dhāram ǀ ákṣitam ǀíndum ǀ dhartā́ram ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The chants celebrate that Induflowing in a thousand streams, inexhaustible, the supporter of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The chants celebrate that Induflowing in a thousand streams, inexhaustible, the supporter of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं वेधां मेधयाह्यन्पवमानमधि द्यवि ।धर्णसिं भूरिधायसं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vedhā́m ǀ medháyā ǀ ahyan ǀ pávamānam ǀ ádhi ǀ dyávi ǀdharṇasím ǀ bhū́ri-dhāyasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: They have elevated to heaven by their praise that creative purifying (Soma), the sustainer, the maker of many.
verses.wilson_translation: They have elevated to heaven by their praise that creative purifying (Soma), the sustainer, the maker of many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमह्यन्भुरिजोर्धिया संवसानं विवस्वतः ।पतिं वाचो अदाभ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ahyan ǀ bhuríjoḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sam-vásānam ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀpátim ǀ vācáḥ ǀ ádābhyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The worshippers have elevated by the fingers of their arms that unconquerable lord of praise abiding (in the vessels).
verses.wilson_translation: The worshippers have elevated by the fingers of their arms that unconquerable lord of praise abiding (in the vessels).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं सानावधि जामयो हरिं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ।हर्यतं भूरिचक्षसं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ sā́nau ǀ ádhi ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀharyatám ǀ bhū́ri-cakṣasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sister-fingers in a raised plural ce press out by the grinding stones that green-tinted (Soma), desirable and far-beholding.
verses.wilson_translation: The sister-fingers in a raised plural ce press out by the grinding stones that green-tinted (Soma), desirable and far-beholding.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा हिन्वंति वेधसः पवमान गिरावृधं ।इंदविंद्राय मत्सरं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ hinvanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ girā-vṛ́dham ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The worshippers offer you to Indra, purifier,Indu, filled with praise and bestowing exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: The worshippers offer you to Indra, purifier,Indu, filled with praise and bestowing exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS Sage, exalted by our lauds, flows to the purifying cloth,Scattering foes as he is cleansed. As giving power and winning light, for Indra and for Vāyu heIs poured upon the filtering-cloth. The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, Omniscient, and the Head of Heaven,Effused into the vats of wood. Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana lowed,Still Conqueror, never overcome. This Pavamana, gladdening draught, drops on the filtering cloth, and thenMounts up with Sūrya to the sky. To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed,This Indu, being purified.

verses.sanskrit: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते ।पुनानो घ्नन्नप स्रिधः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ ádhi ǀ tośate ǀpunānáḥ ǀ ghnán ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This seer, the purifying (Soma), lauded by us, passes through the filter, driving away foes.
verses.wilson_translation: This seer, the purifying (Soma), lauded by us, passes through the filter, driving away foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष इंद्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते ।पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ svaḥ-jít ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀpavítre ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This invigorating heaven-conquering Somais poured upon the filter for Indraand Vāyu.
verses.wilson_translation: This invigorating heaven-conquering Somais poured upon the filter for Indraand Vāyu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः ।सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyate ǀ diváḥ ǀ mūrdhā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ viśva-vít ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Soma, the showerer (of benefits), the summit of heaven, the all-knowing, being expressed is brought by the priests into the wooden vessels.
verses.wilson_translation: This Soma, the showerer (of benefits), the summit of heaven, the all-knowing, being expressed is brought by the priests into the wooden vessels.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः ।इंदुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ acikradat ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ hiraṇya-yúḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ satrā-jít ǀ ástṛtaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Induresounds as it drops, yearning to give us cattle and gold, the conqueror of foes, the irresistible.
verses.wilson_translation: This Induresounds as it drops, yearning to give us cattle and gold, the conqueror of foes, the irresistible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष सूर्येण हासते पवमानो अधि द्यवि ।पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ hāsate ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dyávi ǀpavítre ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This pure-flowing exhilarating Somais abandoned by the sun in the filter, the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: This pure-flowing exhilarating Somais abandoned by the sun in the filter, the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददंतरिक्षे वृषा हरिः ।पुनान इंदुरिंद्रमा ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ asisyadat ǀ antárikṣe ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This powerful and purifying showerer (of benefits), the green-tinted Indu, flows through the firmament to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: This powerful and purifying showerer (of benefits), the green-tinted Indu, flows through the firmament to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXVIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . URGED by the men, this vigorous Steed, Lord of the mind, Omniscient,Runs to the woollen straining-cloth. Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused,Entering all their essences. He shines in beauty there, this God Immortal in his dwelling-place,Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods. Directed by the Sisters ten, bellowing on his way this SteerRuns onward to the wooden vats. This Pavamana, swiftand strong, Omniscient, gave spleudour toThe Sun and all his forms of light. This Soma being purified, flows mighty and infallible,Slayer of sinners, dear toGods.

verses.sanskrit: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः ।अव्यो वारं वि धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ viśva-vít ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: This swift-flowing (Soma) plural ced (in the vessels) by the priests, all-knowing, the lord of praise, has to the woollen (filter).
verses.wilson_translation: This swift-flowing (Soma) plural ced (in the vessels) by the priests, all-knowing, the lord of praise, has to the woollen (filter).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।विश्वा धामान्याविशन् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ akṣarat ǀ sómaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ā-viśán ǁ
verses.english_translation: This (Soma), effused for the gods, flows into the filter, penetrating all the (divine) forms.
verses.wilson_translation: This (Soma), effused for the gods, flows into the filter, penetrating all the (divine) forms.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः ।वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ śubhāyate ǀ ádhi ǀ yónau ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This divine immortal (Soma) is brilliant in his own plural ce, the slayer of enemies, the most devoted to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: This divine immortal (Soma) is brilliant in his own plural ce, the slayer of enemies, the most devoted to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः ।अभि द्रोणानि धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ kánikradat ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀabhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ dhāvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: This showerer (of desire), expressed by the ten fingers, has uttered a sound ot the pitchers.
verses.wilson_translation: This showerer (of desire), expressed by the ten fingers, has uttered a sound ot the pitchers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो विचर्षणिः ।विश्वा धामानि विश्ववित् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayat ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ dhā́māni ǀ viśva-vít ǁ
verses.english_translation: This purified, all-contemplating, all-knowing (Soma) gives radiance to the sun and all the spheres (of light).
verses.wilson_translation: This purified, all-contemplating, all-knowing (Soma) gives radiance to the sun and all the spheres (of light).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ।देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ aghaśaṃsa-hā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This powerful invincible purifying Somaproceeds the protector of the gods, the destroyer of the wicked.
verses.wilson_translation: This powerful invincible purifying Somaproceeds the protector of the gods, the destroyer of the wicked.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXIX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FORWARD with mighty force have flowed the currents of this Steer effused,Of him who sets him by the Gods. The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the Steed,Brought forth as light that merits laud. These things thou winnest lightly while purified, Soma, Lord of wealth:Fill full the sea that claims our praise. Winning all precious things at once, flow on, O Soma, with thy streamDrive to one place our enemies. Preserve us from the godless, from ill-omened voice of one and all,That so we may be freed from blame. O Indu, as thou flowest on bring us the wealth of earth and heaven,And splendid vigour, in thy stream.

verses.sanskrit: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा ।देवाँ अनु प्रभूषतः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ asya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ akṣaran ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ ójasā ǀdevā́n ǀ ánu ǀ pra-bhū́ṣataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The streams of this effused (Soma), the showerer (of benefits), flow forth, as it seeks to surpass the gods in strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The streams of this effused (Soma), the showerer (of benefits), flow forth, as it seeks to surpass the gods in strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सप्तिं मृजंति वेधसो गृणंतः कारवो गिरा ।ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáptim ǀ mṛjanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀjyótiḥ ǀ jajñānám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pious performers (of holy rites), the utterers of praise, purify by their laudation the radiant courser (the Soma) as soon as genitive rated and meriting to be hymned.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious performers (of holy rites), the utterers of praise, purify by their laudation the radiant courser (the Soma) as soon as genitive rated and meriting to be hymned.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो ।वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: su-sáhā ǀ soma ǀ tā́ni ǀ te ǀ punānā́ya ǀ prabhuvaso íti prabhu-vaso ǀvárdha ǀ samudrám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, distributor of abundant wealth, those radiances of yours when you are purified are over-powering; fill therefore the praiseworthy ocean-like (pitcher).
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, distributor of abundant wealth, those radiances of yours when you are purified are over-powering; fill therefore the praiseworthy ocean-like (pitcher).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वा वसूनि संजयन्पवस्व सोम धारया ।इनु द्वेषांसि सध्र्यक् ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ sam-jáyan ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀinú ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ sadhryák ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, in a full stream, conquering for us all treasures-- drive our enemies away together.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, in a full stream, conquering for us all treasures-- drive our enemies away together.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रक्षा सु नो अररुषः स्वनात्समस्य कस्य चित् ।निदो यत्र मुमुच्महे ॥
verses.transliteration: rákṣa ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ svanā́t ǀ samasya ǀ kásya ǀ cit ǀnidáḥ ǀ yátra ǀ mumucmáhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Preserve us from the reproach of every one who makes offerings, who utters a blame-- that we may be free.
verses.wilson_translation: Preserve us from the reproach of every one who makes offerings, who utters a blame-- that we may be free.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एंदो पार्थिवं रयिं दिव्यं पवस्व धारया ।द्युमंतं शुष्ममा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indo íti ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rayím ǀ divyám ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, pour to us in a stream terrestrial and celestial riches, bring brilliant vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, pour to us in a stream terrestrial and celestial riches, bring brilliant vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . STREAMS of this Potent One have flowed easily to the straining-cloth:While he is cleansed he lifts his voice. Indu, by pressers urged to speed, bellowing out while beautified.Sends forth a very mighty sound. Pour on us, Soma, with thy stream manconquering might which many crave,Accompanied with hero sons. Hither hath Pavamana flowed, Soma flowed hither in a stream,To settle in the vats of wood. To waters with the stones they drive thee tawny-hued, most rich in sweets,O Indu, to be Indra's drink. For Indra, for the Thunderer press the Soma very rich in sweets,Lovely, inspiriting, for strength.

verses.sanskrit: प्र धारा अस्य शुष्मिणो वृथा पवित्रे अक्षरन् ।पुनानो वाचमिष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ pavítre ǀ akṣaran ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣyati ǁ
verses.english_translation: The streams of this strong Somaflow without effort into the filter; purified, he excites praise.
verses.wilson_translation: The streams of this strong Somaflow without effort into the filter; purified, he excites praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुर्हियानः सोतृभिर्मृज्यमानः कनिक्रदत् ।इयर्ति वग्नुमिंद्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ kánikradat ǀíyarti ǀ vagnúm ǀ indriyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Indu, urged by the priests, and purified with a sound in the filter, utters loud voice (in the oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: This Indu, urged by the priests, and purified with a sound in the filter, utters loud voice (in the oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नः शुष्मं नृषाह्यं वीरवंतं पुरुस्पृहं ।पवस्व सोम धारया ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śúṣmam ǀ nṛ-sáhyam ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀpávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour upon us in a stream,Soma, foe-subduing strength, associated withmaleoffspring and desired by many.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour upon us in a stream,Soma, foe-subduing strength, associated withmaleoffspring and desired by many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमो अति धारया पवमानो असिष्यदत् ।अभि द्रोणान्यासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sómaḥ ǀ áti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ asisyadat ǀabhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: This purified Somaflows out in a stream to take its plural ce in the pitchers.
verses.wilson_translation: This purified Somaflows out in a stream to take its plural ce in the pitchers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु त्वा मधुमत्तमं हरिं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ।इंदविंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ap-sú ǀ tvā ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, they press you forth by the stories, most sweet-flavoured and green-tinted, into the waters for Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, they press you forth by the stories, most sweet-flavoured and green-tinted, into the waters for Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुनोता मधुमत्तमं सोममिंद्राय वज्रिणे ।चारुं शर्धाय मत्सरं ॥
verses.transliteration: sunóta ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀcā́rum ǀ śárdhāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Priests) express the most sweet-flavoured beautiful exhilarating Somafor Indrathe thunderer, and for our invigoration.
verses.wilson_translation: (Priests) express the most sweet-flavoured beautiful exhilarating Somafor Indrathe thunderer, and for our invigoration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE, Soma-drops, benevolent, come forth as they are purified,Bestowing wealth which all may see. O Indu, high o’er heaven and earth be thou, increaser of our might:The Master of all strength be thou. The winds are gracious in their love to thee, the rivers flow to theeSoma, they multiply thy power. Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee:Be in the gathering-Place of strength. For thee, brown-hued! the kine have poured imperishable oil and milk.Aloft on the sublimest height. Friendship, O Indu, we desire with thee who bearest noble arms,With thee, O Lord of all that is.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमासः स्वाध्यः पवमानासो अक्रमुः ।रयिं कृण्वंति चेतनं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ akramuḥ ǀrayím ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ cétanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The benevolent juices being purified flow forth, they confer intellectual wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: The benevolent juices being purified flow forth, they confer intellectual wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवस्पृथिव्या अधि भवेंदो द्युम्नवर्धनः ।भवा वाजानां पतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ bháva ǀ indo íti ǀ dyumna-várdhanaḥ ǀbháva ǀ vā́jānām ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, be (to us) the augmenter of the riches of heaven and earth, be the lord of food.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, be (to us) the augmenter of the riches of heaven and earth, be the lord of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं वाता अभिप्रियस्तुभ्यमर्षंति सिंधवः ।सोम वर्धंति ते महः ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ vā́tāḥ ǀ abhi-príyaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀsóma ǀ várdhanti ǀ te ǀ máhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you,Soma, the winds are gracious, for you the rivers flow, they magnify your greatness.
verses.wilson_translation: For you,Soma, the winds are gracious, for you the rivers flow, they magnify your greatness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यं ।भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pyāyasva ǀ sám ǀ etu ǀ te ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ soma ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀbháva ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sam-gathé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be well nourished,Soma; may vigour come to you from all sides, be (the giver) of strength in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Be well nourished,Soma; may vigour come to you from all sides, be (the giver) of strength in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं गावो घृतं पयो बभ्रो दुदुह्रे अक्षितं ।वर्षिष्ठे अधि सानवि ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ bábhro íti ǀ duduhré ǀ ákṣitam ǀvárṣiṣṭhe ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Tawny-tinted (Soma), the cows yield butter and milk inexhaustible for you (set) on the highest summit.
verses.wilson_translation: Tawny-tinted (Soma), the cows yield butter and milk inexhaustible for you (set) on the highest summit.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वायुधस्य ते सतो भुवनस्य पते वयं ।इंदो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: su-āyudhásya ǀ te ǀ satáḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ pate ǀ vayám ǀíndo íti ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ uśmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, lord of beings, we desire the friendship of you, the well-armed.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, lord of beings, we desire the friendship of you, the well-armed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE rapture-shedding Soma-drops, effused in our assembly, haveFlowed forth to glorify our prince. Then Trita's Maidens onward urge the Tawny-coloured with the stones,Indu for Indra, for his drink. Now like a swan he maketh all the company sing each his hymn:He, like a steed, is bathed in milk. O Soma, viewing heaven and earth, thou runncst like a darting deerSet in the place of sacrifice. The cows have sung with joy to him, even as a woman to her loveHe came as to a settled race. Bestow illustrious fame on us, both on our liberal lords and me,Glory, intelligence, and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनः ।सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ mada-cyútaḥ ǀ śrávase ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀsutā́ḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ akramuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somajuices, diffusing exhilaration, rush forth effused at the sacrifice for the sustenance of us abounding in oblations.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somajuices, diffusing exhilaration, rush forth effused at the sacrifice for the sustenance of us abounding in oblations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ।इंदुमिंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ tritásya ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: And the fingers of Tritaexpress this green-tinted Somawith the stones for Indra's drinking.
verses.wilson_translation: And the fingers of Tritaexpress this green-tinted Somawith the stones for Indra's drinking.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिं ।अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ haṃsáḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ gaṇám ǀ víśvasya ǀ avīvaśat ǀ matím ǀátyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ajyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: And like a swan entering its own flock, the Somaexcites the praise of all, like a horse, it is bathed with milk.
verses.wilson_translation: And like a swan entering its own flock, the Somaexcites the praise of all, like a horse, it is bathed with milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उभे सोमावचाकशन्मृगो न तक्तो अर्षसि ।सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ soma ǀ ava-cā́kaśat ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ taktáḥ ǀ arṣasi ǀsī́dan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Beholding both worlds,Soma, you hurry, swift as a deer, taking your seat on the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Beholding both worlds,Soma, you hurry, swift as a deer, taking your seat on the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि गावो अनूषत योषा जारमिव प्रियं ।अगन्नाजिं यथा हितं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ yóṣā ǀ jārám-iva ǀ priyám ǀágan ǀ ājím ǀ yáthā ǀ hitám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Praises commend you (Soma) as a woman praises a dear lover; (you hasten to the vessel) as a hero hastens to the welcome contest.
verses.wilson_translation: Praises commend you (Soma) as a woman praises a dear lover; (you hasten to the vessel) as a hero hastens to the welcome contest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे धेहि द्युमद्यशो मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च ।सनिं मेधामुत श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ dyu-mát ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ máhyam ǀ ca ǀsaním ǀ medhā́m ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give to us who are affluent (in oblations), and also to me, brilliant fame, wealth, intelligence, and glory.
verses.wilson_translation: Give to us who are affluent (in oblations), and also to me, brilliant fame, wealth, intelligence, and glory.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LIKE waves of waters, skilled in song the juices of the Soma speedOnward, as buffaloes to woods. With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in storeOf kine into the wooden vats. To Indra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, to Viṣṇu, and the Maruts, flowThe drops of Soma juice effused. Three several words are uttered: kine are ]owing, cows who give their milk:The Tawny-hued goes bellowing on. The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise:They decorate the Child of Heaven. From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seasFilled full of riches thousandfold.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपां न यंत्यूर्मयः ।वनानि महिषा इव ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ná ǀ yanti ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀvánāni ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: The intelligent Somajuices rush along like waves of water, like buffaloes to the forests.
verses.wilson_translation: The intelligent Somajuices rush along like waves of water, like buffaloes to the forests.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया ।वाजं गोमंतमक्षरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ babhrávaḥ ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀvā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ akṣaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The tawny-coloured bright juices hasten to the pitchers with a stream of ambrosia, they pour forth sustenance accompanied with cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: The tawny-coloured bright juices hasten to the pitchers with a stream of ambrosia, they pour forth sustenance accompanied with cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुता इंद्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।सोमा अर्षंति विष्णवे ॥
verses.transliteration: sutā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀsómāḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ víṣṇave ǁ
verses.english_translation: The libations effused proceed to Indra, to Vāyu, to Varuṇa, to the Maruts, to Viṣṇu
verses.wilson_translation: The libations effused proceed to Indra, to Vāyu, to Varuṇa, to the Maruts, to Viṣṇu
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमंति धेनवः ।हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ út ǀ īrate ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ mimanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ eti ǀ kánikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests utter the three sacred texts, the kine low (on being milked),, the green-tinted Somagoes sounding (to the vessels).
verses.wilson_translation: The priests utter the three sacred texts, the kine low (on being milked),, the green-tinted Somagoes sounding (to the vessels).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीर्ऋतस्य मातरः ।मर्मृज्यंते दिवः शिशुं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ bráhmīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mātáraḥ ǀmarmṛjyánte ǀ diváḥ ǀ śíśum ǁ
verses.english_translation: The many sacred hymns, the mothers of the sacrifice, give praise, they purify (the Soma), the infant of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The many sacred hymns, the mothers of the sacrifice, give praise, they purify (the Soma), the infant of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रायः समुद्रांश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ॥
verses.transliteration: rāyáḥ ǀ samudrā́n ǀ catúraḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: From every side,Soma, pour upon us four oceans of riches, grant us thousands (of desires).
verses.wilson_translation: From every side,Soma, pour upon us four oceans of riches, grant us thousands (of desires).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIV. Some Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE drop of Soma juice effused flows onward with this stream impelled.Rending strong places with its might. Poured forth to Indra, Varuṇa, to Vāyu and the Marut hosts,To Viṣṇu, flows the Soma juice. With stones they press the Soma forth, the Strong conducted by the strong:They milk the liquor out with skill. ’Tis he whom Trita must refine, ’tis he who shall make Indra glad:The Tawny One is decked with tints. Him do the Sons of Pṛśni milk, the dwelling-place of sacrifice,Oblation lovely and most dear. To him in one unitcd stream th-,se songs flow on straight forward. he,Loud voiced, hath made the milch-kine low.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सुवानो धारया तनेंदुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति ।रुजद्दृळ्हा व्योजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ tánā ǀ índuḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀruját ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ ví ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, when effused and expressed (by the priests) flows in a stream to the filter, breaking down strong plural ces by its strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, when effused and expressed (by the priests) flows in a stream to the filter, breaking down strong plural ces by its strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुत इं��्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
verses.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ víṣṇave ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaeffused proceeds to Indra, to Vāyu, to Varuṇa, to Maruts, to Viṣṇu.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaeffused proceeds to Indra, to Vāyu, to Varuṇa, to Maruts, to Viṣṇu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषाणं वृषभिर्यतं सुन्वंति सोममद्रिभिः ।दुहंति शक्मना पयः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣāṇam ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ yatám ǀ sunvánti ǀ sómam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀduhánti ǀ śákmanā ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They press the crushed Somaas it pours forth its juice between the effusing stones, they milk out its juice by their acts.
verses.wilson_translation: They press the crushed Somaas it pours forth its juice between the effusing stones, they milk out its juice by their acts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: भुवत्त्रितस्य मर्ज्यो भुवदिंद्राय मत्सरः ।सं रूपैरज्यते हरिः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhúvat ǀ tritásya ǀ márjyaḥ ǀ bhúvat ǀ índrāya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀsám ǀ rūpáiḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ háriḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The exhilarating Somais to be cleansed (for the sacrifice) of Trita, and for the drinking of Indra; the green-tinted (juice) is mixed with the ingredients.
verses.wilson_translation: The exhilarating Somais to be cleansed (for the sacrifice) of Trita, and for the drinking of Indra; the green-tinted (juice) is mixed with the ingredients.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभीमृतस्य विष्टपं दुहते पृश्निमातरः ।चारु प्रियतमं हविः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ īm ǀ ṛtásya ǀ viṣṭápam ǀ duhaté ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǀcā́ru ǀ priyá-tamam ǀ havíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The son fof Pṛśnimilk this Somaat the plural ce of sacrifice, the most beautiful and grateful oblation (to the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: The son fof Pṛśnimilk this Somaat the plural ce of sacrifice, the most beautiful and grateful oblation (to the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समेनमह्रुता इमा गिरो अर्षंति सस्रुतः ।धेनूर्वाश्रो अवीवशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ enam ǀ áhrutāḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ sa-srútaḥ ǀdhenū́ḥ ǀ vāśráḥ ǀ avīvaśan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our sincere smooth-flowing praises approach him, and he, uttering a sound, welcomes the kine.
verses.wilson_translation: Our sincere smooth-flowing praises approach him, and he, uttering a sound, welcomes the kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Pour forth on us abundant wealth, O Pavamana, with thy stream.Wherewith thou mayest find us light O Indu, swayer of the sea, shaker of all things, flow thou on,Bearer of wealth to us with might. With thee for Hero, Valiant One! may we subdue our enemies:Let what is precious flow to us. Indu arouses strength the Sage who strives for victory, winning power,Discovering holy works and means. Mover of speech, we robe him with our songs as he is purifiedSoma, the Guardian of the folk; On whose way, Lord of Holy Law, most richi as he is purified.The people all have set their hearts.

verses.sanskrit: आ नः पवस्व धारया पवमान रयिं पृथुं ।यया ज्योतिर्विदासि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pávamāna ǀ rayím ǀ pṛthúm ǀyáyā ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ vidā́si ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour upon us, purifier, ample riches with that stream wherewith you bestow upon us light.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour upon us, purifier, ample riches with that stream wherewith you bestow upon us light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदो समुद्रमींखय पवस्व विश्वमेजय ।रायो धर्ता न ओजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: índo íti ǀ samudram-īṅkhaya ǀ pávasva ǀ viśvam-ejaya ǀrāyáḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, impeller of the waters, confounder of all (our foes), flow forth by your power as the supporter of wealth to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, impeller of the waters, confounder of all (our foes), flow forth by your power as the supporter of wealth to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वया वीरेण वीरवोऽभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः ।क्षरा णो अभि वार्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tváyā ǀ vīréṇa ǀ vīra-vaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǀkṣára ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: With you, heroic (Soma), as our hero, may we overcome our enemies, pour upon the desirable (riches).
verses.wilson_translation: With you, heroic (Soma), as our hero, may we overcome our enemies, pour upon the desirable (riches).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वाजमिंदुरिष्यति सिषासन्वाजसा ऋषिः ।व्रता विदान आयुधा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vā́jam ǀ índuḥ ǀ iṣyati ǀ sísāsan ǀ vāja-sā́ḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀvratā́ ǀ vidānáḥ ǀ ā́yudhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, the bestower of food, the seer sends food to the worshipper, showing his favour, acquainted with sacred rites and arms.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, the bestower of food, the seer sends food to the worshipper, showing his favour, acquainted with sacred rites and arms.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं गीर्भिर्वाचमींखयं पुनानं वासयामसि ।सोमं जनस्य गोपतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vācam-īṅkhayám ǀ punānám ǀ vāsayāmasi ǀsómam ǀ jánasya ǀ gó-patim ǁ
verses.english_translation: We clothe with praise that Somawho is the inspirer of praise, the purified, the shepherd of men.
verses.wilson_translation: We clothe with praise that Somawho is the inspirer of praise, the purified, the shepherd of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वो यस्य व्रते जनो दाधार धर्मणस्पतेः ।पुनानस्य प्रभूवसोः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ vraté ǀ jánaḥ ǀ dādhā́ra ǀ dhármaṇaḥ ǀ páteḥ ǀpunānásya ǀ prabhú-vasoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: On the worship of whom all men fix their thoughts-- the lord of pious acts, the purified, the possessor of abundant wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: On the worship of whom all men fix their thoughts-- the lord of pious acts, the purified, the possessor of abundant wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FORTH from the mortar is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve:The Steed steps forward to the goal. Thus, Soma, watchful, bearing well, cheering the Gods, flow past the sieve,Turned to the vat that drops with meath. Excellent Pavamana, make the lights shine brightly out for us.Speed us to mental power and skill. He, beautified by pious men, and coming from their hands adorned,Flows through the fleecy straining-cloth. May Soma pour all treasures of the heavens, the earth, the firmamentUpon the liberal worshipper. Thou mountest to the height of heaven, O Soma, seeking steeds and kine,And seeking heroes, Lord of Strength!

verses.sanskrit: असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः ।कार्ष्मन्वाजी न्यक्रमीत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ásarji ǀ ráthyaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ pavítre ǀ camvóḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀkā́rṣman ǀ vājī́ ǀ ní ǀ akramīt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pressed between the boards, (the Soma) has been let loose, like a chariot-horse, upon the straining-cloth-- the courser steps out on the field.
verses.wilson_translation: Pressed between the boards, (the Soma) has been let loose, like a chariot-horse, upon the straining-cloth-- the courser steps out on the field.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वह्निः सोम जागृविः पवस्व देववीरति ।अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ soma ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ deva-vī́ḥ ǀ áti ǀabhí ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, bearer (of oblation), vigilant, devoted to the gods, flow past the honey-dropping filter (into the vessel).
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, bearer (of oblation), vigilant, devoted to the gods, flow past the honey-dropping filter (into the vessel).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो ज्योतींषि पूर्व्य पवमान वि रोचय ।क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ pūrvya ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví ǀ rocaya ǀkrátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ naḥ ǀ hinu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ancient purifier, illume for us the luminaries (of heaven), animate us for strength-bestowing sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Ancient purifier, illume for us the luminaries (of heaven), animate us for strength-bestowing sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुंभमान ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः ।पवते वारे अव्यये ॥
verses.transliteration: śumbhámānaḥ ǀ ṛtayú-bhiḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀpávate ǀ vā́re ǀ avyáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Beautified by the ministers of the rite, expressed by theirhands, (the Soma) flows through the woollen filter.
verses.wilson_translation: Beautified by the ministers of the rite, expressed by theirhands, (the Soma) flows through the woollen filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमो दिव्यानि पार्थिवा ।पवतामांतरिक्ष्या ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásu ǀ sómaḥ ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀpávatām ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that Somabestow upon the donor (of the libation) all treasures, whether of heaven or earth or the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: May that Somabestow upon the donor (of the libation) all treasures, whether of heaven or earth or the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ दिवस्पृष्ठमश्वयुर्गव्ययुः सोम रोहसि ।वीरयुः शवसस्पते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ aśva-yúḥ ǀ gavya-yúḥ ǀ soma ǀ rohasi ǀvīra-yúḥ ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, lord of food, you ascend to the summit of the sky, desirous of horses, kine, andmaleprogeny.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, lord of food, you ascend to the summit of the sky, desirous of horses, kine, andmaleprogeny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SOMA, the Steer, effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve,Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods. Far-sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve, intelligent,Bellowing, to his place of rest. This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven,Fiend-slayer, through the fleecy sieve. This Payamana up above Trita's high ridge hath made the Sun,Together with the Sisters, shine. This Vṛtra-slaying Steer, effused, Soma room-giver, ne’er deceived,Hath gone, as ’twere, to win the spoil. Urged onward by the sage, the God speeds forward to the casks of wood,Indu to Indra willingly.

verses.sanskrit: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति ।विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pītáye ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀvi-ghnán ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, the showerer (of benefits), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes to the filter, destroying therākṣas, devoted to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, the showerer (of benefits), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes to the filter, destroying therākṣas, devoted to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः ।अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀabhí ǀ yónim ǀ kánikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The all-beholding Soma, green-tinted, all-sustaining rush to the filter (and thence) crying aloud to the pitcher.
verses.wilson_translation: The all-beholding Soma, green-tinted, all-sustaining rush to the filter (and thence) crying aloud to the pitcher.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति ।रक्षोहा वारमव्ययं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀrakṣaḥ-hā́ ǀ vā́ram ǀ avyáyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Fleet as) a horse, the pure Soma, the illume of heaven, hastens, the destroyer ofrākṣasas, past the woollen fleece.
verses.wilson_translation: (Fleet as) a horse, the pure Soma, the illume of heaven, hastens, the destroyer ofrākṣasas, past the woollen fleece.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् ।जामिभिः सूर्यं सह ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tritásya ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ arocayat ǀjāmí-bhiḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ sahá ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure Somaupon the high plural ce (of the sacrifice) of Trita, attended by its kindred rays, has lighted up the Sun.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure Somaupon the high plural ce (of the sacrifice) of Trita, attended by its kindred rays, has lighted up the Sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः ।सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ varivaḥ-vít ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ vā́jam-iva ǀ asarat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The slayer of Vṛtra, the showerer of benefits, the giver of wealth, the invincible, the effused Somaproceeds (to the pitcher) as (a horse) to battle.
verses.wilson_translation: The slayer of Vṛtra, the showerer of benefits, the giver of wealth, the invincible, the effused Somaproceeds (to the pitcher) as (a horse) to battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स देवः कविनेषितोऽभि द्रोणानि धावति ।इंदुरिंद्राय मंहना ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ kavínā ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ dhāvati ǀínduḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ maṃhánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine Soma, when effused by the priest, hastens in his might to the pitchers for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine Soma, when effused by the priest, hastens in his might to the pitchers for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXVIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS Steer, this Chariot, rushes through the woollen filter, as he goesTo war that wins a thousand spoils. The Dames of Trita with the stones onward impel this Tawny OneIndu to Indra for his drink. Ten active fingers carefully adorn him here; they make him brightAnd beauteous for the gladdening draught. He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men.Speeding like lover to his love. This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven,This Soma-drop that pierced the sieve. Poured for the draught, this tawny juiceflows forth, intelligent, crying out,Unto the well-beloved place.

verses.sanskrit: एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति ।गच्छन्वाजं सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ arṣati ǀgácchan ǀ vā́jam ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Soma, the showerer of benefits, the chariot, dashes through the woollen fleece, bearing (to the worshipper) thousandfold food.
verses.wilson_translation: This Soma, the showerer of benefits, the chariot, dashes through the woollen fleece, bearing (to the worshipper) thousandfold food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ।इंदुमिंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ tritásya ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fingers of Tritaeffuse by the stones this green-tinted juice for Indra's drinking.
verses.wilson_translation: The fingers of Tritaeffuse by the stones this green-tinted juice for Indra's drinking.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतं त्यं हरितो दश मर्मृज्यंते अपस्युवः ।याभिर्मदाय शुंभते ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ tyám ǀ harítaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ marmṛjyánte ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ śúmbhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers, eager in the work, express that (Soma), and by them it is purified for the exhilaration (of Indra).
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers, eager in the work, express that (Soma), and by them it is purified for the exhilaration (of Indra).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति ।गच्छंजारो न योषितं ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vik��ú ǀ sīdati ǀgácchan ǀ jāráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yoṣítam ǁ
verses.english_translation: That Somasits down among human beings like a falcon, hastening as a gallant to his mistress.
verses.wilson_translation: That Somasits down among human beings like a falcon, hastening as a gallant to his mistress.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः ।य इंदुर्वारमाविशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ mádyaḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ áva ǀ caṣṭe ǀ diváḥ ǀ śíśuḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ā́ ǀ áviśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: That exhilarating juice beholds all,Indu, the child of heaven, that percolates through the fleece.
verses.wilson_translation: That exhilarating juice beholds all,Indu, the child of heaven, that percolates through the fleece.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः ।क्रंदन्योनिमभि प्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ pītáye ǀ sutáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀkrándan ǀ yónim ǀ abhí ǀ priyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: That green-tinted, all-sustaining (Soma), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes crying aloud to its beloved plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: That green-tinted, all-sustaining (Soma), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes crying aloud to its beloved plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XXXIX Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FLOW On, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form,Saying, I go where dwell the Gods. Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man,Make thou the rain descend from heaven. With might, bestowing power, thejuice enters the purifying sieve,Far-seeing, sending forth its light. This is it which in rapid course hath with the river's wave flowed downFrom heaven upon the straining cloth. Inviting him frorh far away, and even from near at hand, the juiceFor Indra is poured forth as meath. In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the Tawny One.Sit in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना ।यत्र देवा इति ब्रवन् ॥
verses.transliteration: āśúḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ bṛhat-mate ǀ pári ǀ priyéṇa ǀ dhā́mnā ǀyátra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ íti ǀ brávan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Great-minded Soma, go swift with your body that is most dear (to the gods), saying, 'Where are the gods?'
verses.wilson_translation: Great-minded Soma, go swift with your body that is most dear (to the gods), saying, 'Where are the gods?'
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः ।वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: pari-kṛṇván ǀ ániḥ-kṛtam ǀ jánāya ǀ yātáyan ǀ íṣaḥ ǀvṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sanctifying the unconsecrated (worshipper) bringing food for the offerer, pour down rain from heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Sanctifying the unconsecrated (worshipper) bringing food for the offerer, pour down rain from heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा ।विचक्षाणो विरोचयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ eti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ tvíṣim ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀvi-cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ vi-rocáyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The Soma) when effused enters the filter with force, giving forth light, beholding and illuminating (all things).
verses.wilson_translation: (The Soma) when effused enters the filter with force, giving forth light, beholding and illuminating (all things).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ ।सिंधोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ raghu-yā́mā ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀsíndhoḥ ǀ ūrmā́ ǀ ví ǀ ákṣarat ǁ
verses.english_translation: This (Soma), who light of movement (mounts) toheaven, through the filter in a stream of water.
verses.wilson_translation: This (Soma), who light of movement (mounts) toheaven, through the filter in a stream of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः ।इंद्राय सिच्यते मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā-vívāsan ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ átho íti ǀ arvā-vátaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ sicyate ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: The effused (Soma) honouring (the gods) whether he is far off or nigh, is poured out (as)madhufor Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The effused (Soma) honouring (the gods) whether he is far off or nigh, is poured out (as)madhufor Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ।योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
verses.transliteration: sam-īcīnā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀyónau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The united (worshippers) praise (him), they squeeze (him) forth green-tinted with the stones; sit down (O gods) at the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The united (worshippers) praise (him), they squeeze (him) forth green-tinted with the stones; sit down (O gods) at the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XL. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Very Active hath assailed, while purified, all enemies:They deck the Sage with holy songs. The Red hath mounted to his place; to India, goes the mighty juice:He settles in his firm abode. O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side, Pour on us treasures thousandfold. O Soma Pavamana, bring, Indu, all splcndours hitherward:Find for us food in boundless store. As thou art cleansed, bring hero strength and riches to thy worshipper,And prosper thou the singer's hymns. O Indu, Soma, being cleansed, bring hither riches doublypiled,Wealth, mighty Indu, meet for lauds.

verses.sanskrit: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः ।शुंभंति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ akramīt ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀśumbhánti ǀ vípram ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure all-seeing (Soma) has overcome all enemies; (the worshippers) grace the sage (Soma) with their praises.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure all-seeing (Soma) has overcome all enemies; (the worshippers) grace the sage (Soma) with their praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिंद्रं वृषा सुतः ।ध्रुवे सदसि सीदति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yónim ǀ aruṇáḥ ǀ ruhat ǀ gámat ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀdhruvé ǀ sádasi ǀ sīdati ǁ
verses.english_translation: The tawny-hued showerer (of benefits) when effused ascends to his plural ce; he goes to Indra; he dwells in the fixed abode (of heaven).
verses.wilson_translation: The tawny-hued showerer (of benefits) when effused ascends to his plural ce; he goes to Indra; he dwells in the fixed abode (of heaven).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू नो रयिं महामिंदोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ mahā́m ǀ indo íti ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: OIndu, OSoma, quickly pour upon us from all quarters vast and infinite riches.
verses.wilson_translation: OIndu, OSoma, quickly pour upon us from all quarters vast and infinite riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वा सोम पवमान द्युम्नानींदवा भर ।विदाः सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvā ǀ soma ǀ pavamāna ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀvidā́ḥ ǀ sahasríṇīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O purified Soma, OIndu, bring all sorts of wealth bestow unlimited food.
verses.wilson_translation: O purified Soma, OIndu, bring all sorts of wealth bestow unlimited food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ।जरितुर्वर्धया गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ rayím ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀjaritúḥ ǀ vardhaya ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: OSoma, being purified, bring us your worshippers wealth withmaleoffspring, recompense the praises of him who glorifies you.
verses.wilson_translation: OSoma, being purified, bring us your worshippers wealth withmaleoffspring, recompense the praises of him who glorifies you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनान इंदवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिं ।वृषन्निंदो न उक्थ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ sóma ǀ dvi-bárhasam ǀ rayím ǀvṛ́ṣan ǀ indo íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ukthyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu,Soma, being purified, bring us wealth from both worlds; Indu, showerer (of benefits), (bring us) glorious (wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: Indu,Soma, being purified, bring us wealth from both worlds; Indu, showerer (of benefits), (bring us) glorious (wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ACTIVE and bright have they come forth, impetuous in speed like bulls,Driving the black skin far away. Quelling the riteless Dasyu, may we think upon the bridge of bliss,Leaving the bridge of woe behind. The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as ’twere the rush of rainLightnings are flashing to the sky.
