Pour out on us abundant food, when thou art pressed, O Indu wealthIn kine and gold and steeds and spoil. Flow on thy way, Most Active, thou. fill full the mighty heavens and earth,As Dawn, as Sūrya with his beams. On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream,As Rasā flows around the world.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ये गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः ।घ्नंतः कृष्णामप त्वचं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǀ tveṣā́ḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǀ ákramuḥ ǀghnántaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇā́m ǀ ápa ǀ tvácam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Praise the Soma-juices) which descend like streams of water, swift, brilliant, rapid driving off the black skinned (rākṣasa).
verses.wilson_translation: (Praise the Soma-juices) which descend like streams of water, swift, brilliant, rapid driving off the black skinned (rākṣasa).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराव्यं ।साह्वांसो दस्युमव्रतं ॥
verses.transliteration: suvitásya ǀ manāmahe ǀ áti ǀ sétum ǀ duḥ-āvyám ǀsahvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ dásyum ǀ avratám ǁ
verses.english_translation: We praise the auspicious Soma's imprisonment (of therākṣasas) and hostile (intent against them), while we triumph over the enemy who performs no riteṣ
verses.wilson_translation: We praise the auspicious Soma's imprisonment (of therākṣasas) and hostile (intent against them), while we triumph over the enemy who performs no riteṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः ।चरंति विद्युतो दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṇvé ǀ vṛṣṭéḥ-iva ǀ svanáḥ ǀ pávamānasya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀcáranti ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sound of the purified, powerful Somais heard like that of rain; (his) lightning moves in the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: The sound of the purified, powerful Somais heard like that of rain; (his) lightning moves in the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिंदो हिरण्यवत् ।अश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǀ gó-mat ǀ indo íti ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀáśva-vat ǀ vā́ja-vat ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When effused,Indu, pour forth much food with cows, gold, horses, and strength.
verses.wilson_translation: When effused,Indu, pour forth much food with cows, gold, horses, and strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पवस्व विचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण ।उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀ ā́ ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pṛṇa ǀuṣā́ḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow, all-seeing (Soma), fill the vast heaven and earth as the sun (fills) the days with his beams.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow, all-seeing (Soma), fill the vast heaven and earth as the sun (fills) the days with his beams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि णः शर्मयंत्या धारया सोम विश्वतः ।सरा रसेव विष्टपं ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ śarma-yántyā ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀsára ǀ rasā́-iva ǀ viṣṭápam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow round us,Soma, on all sides in a bliss-bestowing stream, like a river down a steep plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow round us,Soma, on all sides in a bliss-bestowing stream, like a river down a steep plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ENGENDERING the Sun in floods, engendering heaven's lights, green-hued,Robed in the waters and the milk, According to primeval plan this Soma, with his stream, effusedFlows purely on, a God for Gods. For him victorious, waxen great, the juices with a thousand powersAre purified for winning spoil. Shedding the ancient fluid he is poured into the cleansing sieve:He, thundering, hath produced the Gods. Soma, while purifying, sends hither all things to be desired,He sends the Gods who strengthen Law. Soma, effused, pour on us wealth in kine, in heroes, steeds, and spoil,Send us abundant store of food.

verses.sanskrit: जनयन्रोचना दिवो जनयन्नप्सु सूर्यं ।वसानो गा अपो हरिः ॥
verses.transliteration: janáyan ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ ap-sú ǀ sū́ryam ǀvásānaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The green-tinted (Soma) genitive rating the luminaries of heaven, genitive rating the sun in the firmament, clothing himself with the descending water.
verses.wilson_translation: The green-tinted (Soma) genitive rating the luminaries of heaven, genitive rating the sun in the firmament, clothing himself with the descending water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि ।धारया पवते सुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pratnéna ǀ mánmanā ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀdhā́rayā ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He with ancient praise when effused flows in a stream, a god for the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: He with ancient praise when effused flows in a stream, a god for the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वावृधानाय तूर्वये पवंते वाजसातये ।सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ॥
verses.transliteration: vavṛdhānā́ya ǀ tū́rvaye ǀ pávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀsómāḥ ǀ sahásra-pājasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somajuices of unbounded vigour flow for the increasing, rapid acquisition of food.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somajuices of unbounded vigour flow for the increasing, rapid acquisition of food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यते ।क्रंदंदेवाँ अजीजनत् ॥
verses.transliteration: duhānáḥ ǀ pratnám ǀ ít ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀkrándan ǀ devā́n ǀ ajījanat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Milking forth the ancient fluid, the Somais poured into the filter and crying out genitive rates the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Milking forth the ancient fluid, the Somais poured into the filter and crying out genitive rates the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि विश्वानि वार्याभि देवाँ ऋतावृधः ।सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ abhí ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, being purified hastens towards all desirable (wealth), towards the gods who favour the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, being purified hastens towards all desirable (wealth), towards the gods who favour the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गोमन्नः सोम वीरवदश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः ।पवस्व बृहतीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: gó-mat ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ vā́ja-vat ǀ sutáḥ ǀpávasva ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, being effused pour down to us (wealth) consisting of kine,maleoffspring, horses, and strength, and abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, being effused pour down to us (wealth) consisting of kine,maleoffspring, horses, and strength, and abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE will enrobe with sacred song the Lovely One who, as a Steed,Is decked with milk for rapturous joy. All songs of ours desiring grace adorn him in the ancient way,Indu for Indra, for his drink. Soma flows on when purified, beloved and adorned with songs,Songs of the sage Medhyātithi. O Soma Pavamana, find exceeding glorious wealth for us,Wealth, Indu, fraught with boundless might. Like courser racing to the prize Indu, the lover of the Gods,Roars, as he passes, in the sieve. Flow on thy way to win us strength, to speed the sage who praises thee:Soma, bestow heroic power.

verses.sanskrit: यो अत्य इव मृज्यते गोभिर्मदाय हर्यतः ।तं गीर्भिर्वासयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ átyaḥ-iva ǀ mṛjyáte ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ haryatáḥ ǀtám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vāsayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: We invest with praises that Somawho, beloved, is cleansed like a horse with milk for the exhilaration (of the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: We invest with praises that Somawho, beloved, is cleansed like a horse with milk for the exhilaration (of the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं नो विश्वा अवस्युवो गिरः शुंभंति पूर्वथा ।इंदुमिंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ avasyúvaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śumbhanti ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Induall our praises desiring protection, beautify (new) as of old for Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: This Induall our praises desiring protection, beautify (new) as of old for Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानो याति हर्यतः सोमो गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः ।विप्रस्य मेध्यातिथेः ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ yāti ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀvíprasya ǀ médhya-atitheḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pure flows the beloved Soma, beautified by the praises of the sage Medhyātithi.
verses.wilson_translation: Pure flows the beloved Soma, beautified by the praises of the sage Medhyātithi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम सुश्रियं ।इंदो सहस्रवर्चसं ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ rayím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ su-śríyam ǀíndo íti ǀ sahásra-varcasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified Soma, grant us auspicious wealth, with infinite splendour, OIndu.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified Soma, grant us auspicious wealth, with infinite splendour, OIndu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुरत्यो न वाजसृत्कनिक्रंति पवित्र आ ।यदक्षारति देवयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-sṛ́t ǀ kánikranti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀyát ǀ ákṣāḥ ǀ áti ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Rushing into battle, sounds in the rough, beloved of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Rushing into battle, sounds in the rough, beloved of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातये विप्रस्य गृणतो वृधे ।सोम रास्व सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ víprasya ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀsóma ǀ rā́sva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow for the acquisition of food, for the prosperity of the sage who praise you; OSoma, grant (me) excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow for the acquisition of food, for the prosperity of the sage who praise you; OSoma, grant (me) excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . INDU, to us for this great rite, bearing as ’twere thy wave to Gods,Unwearied, thou art flowing forQh. Pleased with the hymn, impelled by prayer, Soma is hurried far away,The Wise One in the Singer's stream., Watchful among the. gods, this juice advances to the cleansing sieveSoma, most active, travels on. Flow onward, seeking strength for us, embellishing the sacrifice:The priest with trimmed grass calleth thee. May Soma, ever bringing power to Bhaga and to Vāyu, SageAnd Hero, lead us to the Gods. So, to increase our wealth to-day, Inspirer, best of Furtherers,Win for us strength and high renown.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ण इंदो महे तन ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि ।अभि देवाँ अयास्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mahé ǀ táne ǀ ūrmím ǀ ná ǀ bíbhrat ǀ arṣasi ǀabhí ǀ devā́n ǀ ayā́syaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, you advance to give us abundant wealth;Ayāsyabearing your waves (go) towards the gods (to sacrifice).
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, you advance to give us abundant wealth;Ayāsyabearing your waves (go) towards the gods (to sacrifice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मती जुष्टो धिया हितः सोमो हिन्वे परावति ।विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
verses.transliteration: matī́ ǀ juṣṭáḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ hinve ǀ parā-váti ǀvíprasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage Somagratified by the praise of the pious (worshipper) prepared for the sacrifice is sent in a stream at a distance (from the filter).
verses.wilson_translation: The sage Somagratified by the praise of the pious (worshipper) prepared for the sacrifice is sent in a stream at a distance (from the filter).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं देवेषु जागृविः सुत एति पवित्र आ ।सोमो याति विचर्षणिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ devéṣu ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ eti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀsómaḥ ǀ yāti ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This vigilant Somaeffused for the gods, approaches, all-beholding he goes to the filter.
verses.wilson_translation: This vigilant Somaeffused for the gods, approaches, all-beholding he goes to the filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पवस्व वाजयुश्चक्राणश्चारुमध्वरं ।बर्हिष्माँ आ विवासति ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ cakrāṇáḥ ǀ cā́rum ǀ adhvarám ǀbarhíṣmān ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow for us food-desiring, making (our) sacrifice auspicious; (OSoma, whom) the priest with the sacred grass adores.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow for us food-desiring, making (our) sacrifice auspicious; (OSoma, whom) the priest with the sacred grass adores.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो भगाय वायवे विप्रवीरः सदावृधः ।सोमो देवेष्वा यमत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhágāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ vípra-vīraḥ ǀ sadā́-vṛdhaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ yamat ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Somawho is pressed forth by the seers for Bhagaand Vāyu, ever prosper in, grant us (wealth plural ced) among the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May Somawho is pressed forth by the seers for Bhagaand Vāyu, ever prosper in, grant us (wealth plural ced) among the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो अद्य वसुत्तये क्रतुविद्गातुवित्तमः ।वाजं जेषि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vásuttaye ǀ kratu-vít ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀvā́jam ǀ jeṣi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Receiver of sacrifices, knower of (pious), give us this day abundant food and strength for the acquisition of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Receiver of sacrifices, knower of (pious), give us this day abundant food and strength for the acquisition of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FLOW, thou who viewest men, to give delight, to entertain the Gods,Indu, to Indra for his drink. Stream to thine embassy for us: thou hastenest, for Indra, toThe Gods, O better than our friends. We balm thee, red of hue, with milk to fit thee for the rapturous joy:Unbar for us the doors of wealth. He through the sieve hath passed, as comes a courser to the pole, to runIndu belongs unto the Gods. All friends have lauded him as he sports in the wood, beyond the fleece:Singers have chanted Indu's praise. Flow, Indu, with that stream wherein steeped thou announcest to the manWho worships thee heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: स पवस्व मदाय कं नृचक्षा देववीतये ।इंदविंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, do you the beholder of men flow plural asantly for the banquet of the gods, for Indra's drinking and exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, do you the beholder of men flow plural asantly for the banquet of the gods, for Indra's drinking and exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो अर्षाभि दूत्यं त्वमिंद्राय तोशसे ।देवान्त्सखिभ्य आ वरं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ abhí ǀ dūtyám ǀ tvám ǀ índrāya ǀ tośase ǀdevā́n ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Approach the office of the messenger for us; you who are drunk for Indra, (pour) on the gods wealth for (us their) friends.
verses.wilson_translation: Approach the office of the messenger for us; you who are drunk for Indra, (pour) on the gods wealth for (us their) friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्वामरुणं वयं गोभिरंज्मो मदाय कं ।वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā́m ǀ aruṇám ǀ vayám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjmaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀví ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ dúraḥ ǀ vṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: And we adorn you, the purple-tinted with milk and curd for the purpose of exhilaration open the doors for our riches.
verses.wilson_translation: And we adorn you, the purple-tinted with milk and curd for the purpose of exhilaration open the doors for our riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अत्यू पवित्रमक्रमीद्वाजी धुरं न यामनि ।इंदुर्देवेषु पत्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pavítram ǀ akramīt ǀ vājī́ ǀ dhúram ǀ ná ǀ yā́mani ǀínduḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ patyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indupasses the filter as a horse in going passes the shaft (of the chariot); he proceeds to the midst of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Indupasses the filter as a horse in going passes the shaft (of the chariot); he proceeds to the midst of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समी सखायो अस्वरन्वने क्रीळंतमत्यविं ।इंदुं नावा अनूषत ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ īmíti ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ asvaran ǀ váne ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ áti-avim ǀíndum ǀ nāvā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: His friends praise Indusporting in the water and passing through the fleece; their hymns glorify him.
verses.wilson_translation: His friends praise Indusporting in the water and passing through the fleece; their hymns glorify him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया पीतो विचक्षसे ।इंदो स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: táyā ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yáyā ǀ pītáḥ ǀ vi-cákṣase ǀíndo íti ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow Indu, with that stream wherewith when drunk you bestow much vigour on your discerning worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow Indu, with that stream wherewith when drunk you bestow much vigour on your discerning worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LIKE able coursers they have been sent forth to be the feast of Gods,joying in mountains, flowing on. To Vāyu flow the Soma-streams, the drops of juice made beautifulLike a bride dowered by her sire. Pressed in the mortar, these, the drops ofjuice, the Somas rich in food,Give strength to Indra with their work. Deft-handed men, run hither, seize the brilliant juices blent with meal,And cook with milk the gladdening draught. Thus, Soma, Conqueror of wealth! flow, finding furtherance for us,Giver oF ample opulence. This Pavamana, meet to be adorned, the fingers ten adorn,The draught that shall make Indra glad.

verses.sanskrit: असृग्रंदेववीतयेऽत्यासः कृत्व्या इव ।क्षरंतः पर्वतावृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásṛgran ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ átyāsaḥ ǀ kṛ́tvyāḥ-iva ǀkṣárantaḥ ǀ parvata-vṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Begotten by the stones the flowing (Soma-juices) are effused for the banquet of the gods' active horses.
verses.wilson_translation: Begotten by the stones the flowing (Soma-juices) are effused for the banquet of the gods' active horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परिष्कृतास इंदवो योषेव पित्र्यावती ।वायुं सोमा असृक्षत ॥
verses.transliteration: pári-kṛtāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ yóṣā-iva ǀ pítrya-vatī ǀvāyúm ǀ sómāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Soma-juices pressed (at the sacrifice), adorned like a bride who has a father, flow to Vāyu.
verses.wilson_translation: The Soma-juices pressed (at the sacrifice), adorned like a bride who has a father, flow to Vāyu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते सोमास इंदवः प्रयस्वंतश्चमू सुताः ।इंद्रं वर्धंति कर्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ camū́ íti ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀíndram ǀ vardhanti ǀ kárma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These brilliang Soma-juices, bestowing plural asant food, expressed into the vessel, gratify Indrawith the ceremonies.
verses.wilson_translation: These brilliang Soma-juices, bestowing plural asant food, expressed into the vessel, gratify Indrawith the ceremonies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ धावता सुहस्त्यः शुक्रा गृभ्णीत मंथिना ।गोभिः श्रीणीत मत्सरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhāvata ǀ su-hastyaḥ ǀ śukrā́ ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ manthínā ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ śrīṇīta ǀ matsarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Dexterous (priests) have (to me), taken with the ladle the pure (Soma), mix the exhilarating (Soma) with milk and curds.
verses.wilson_translation: Dexterous (priests) have (to me), taken with the ladle the pure (Soma), mix the exhilarating (Soma) with milk and curds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पवस्व धनंजय प्रयंता राधसो महः ।अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhanam-jaya ǀ pra-yantā́ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ gātu-vít ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, conqueror of wealth, who know the way (to fulfil my desires), flow forth the bestower of vast wealth upon us.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, conqueror of wealth, who know the way (to fulfil my desires), flow forth the bestower of vast wealth upon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतं मृजंति मर्ज्यं पवमानं दश क्षिपः ।इंद्राय मत्सरं मदं ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ mṛjanti ǀ márjyam ǀ pávamānam ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ matsarám ǀ mádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers purify this purifiable pure-flowing exhilarating juice for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers purify this purifiable pure-flowing exhilarating juice for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GREAT as he was, Soma hath gained strength by this high solemnity:joyous he riseth like a bull. His task is done: his crushings of the Dasyus are made manifest:He sternly reckoneth their debts. Soon as his song of praise is born, the Soma, Indra's juice, becomesA thousand-winning thunderbolt. Seer and Sustainer, he himself desireth riches for the sageWhen he embellisheth his songs. Fain would they both win riches as in races of the steeds. In warThou art upon the conquerors' side.

verses.sanskrit: अया सोमः सुकृत्यया महश्चिदभ्यवर्धत ।मंदान उद्वृषायते ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀ maháḥ ǀ cit ǀ abhí ǀ avardhata ǀmandānáḥ ǀ út ǀ vṛṣa-yate ǁ
verses.english_translation: By this sacred solemnity the Somais magnified before the mighty (gods); exulting he moves like a bull.
verses.wilson_translation: By this sacred solemnity the Somais magnified before the mighty (gods); exulting he moves like a bull.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कृतानीदस्य कर्त्वा चेतंते दस्युतर्हणा ।ऋणा च धृष्णुश्चयते ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtā́ni ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ kártvā ǀ cétante ǀ dasyu-tárhaṇā ǀṛṇā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ cayate ǁ
verses.english_translation: They publish his exploits, his acts of Dasyu-crushing; resolute he acquite the debts (of the worshipper).
verses.wilson_translation: They publish his exploits, his acts of Dasyu-crushing; resolute he acquite the debts (of the worshipper).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आत्सोम इंद्रियो रसो वज्रः सहस्रसा भुवत् ।उक्थं यदस्य जायते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indriyáḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ vájraḥ ǀ sahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀukthám ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ jā́yate ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the praise of Indrais recited, then the juice dear to him, vigorous as a thunderbolt, give us unlimited wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: When the praise of Indrais recited, then the juice dear to him, vigorous as a thunderbolt, give us unlimited wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं कविर्विधर्तरि विप्राय रत्नमिच्छति ।यदी मर्मृज्यते धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: svayám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ vi-dhartári ǀ víprāya ǀ rátnam ǀ icchati ǀyádi ǀ marmṛjyáte ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the sage Somais cleansed by the fingers, he of his own accord desires wealth for the pious worshipper in (Indra), the granter of wishes.
verses.wilson_translation: When the sage Somais cleansed by the fingers, he of his own accord desires wealth for the pious worshipper in (Indra), the granter of wishes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सिषासतू रयीणां वाजेष्वर्वतामिव ।भरेषु जिग्युषामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: sisāsátuḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ árvatām-iva ǀbháreṣu ǀ jigyúṣām ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You desire to give wealth to those who conquer in combat as (men offer fodder) to horses in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: You desire to give wealth to those who conquer in combat as (men offer fodder) to horses in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH sacrifice we seek to thee kind Cherisher of manly mightIn mansions of the lofty heavens; Gladdening crusher of the bold, ruling with very mighty sway,Destroyer of a hundred forts. Hence, Sapient One! the Falcon, strong of wing, unwearied, brought thee down,Lord over riches, from the sky. That each may see the light, the Bird brought us the guard of Law, the FriendOf all, the speeder through the air. And now, sent forth, it hath attained to mighty power and majesty,Most active, ready to assist.

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः ।चारुं सुकृत्ययेमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ nṛmṇā́ni ǀ víbhratam ǀ sadhá-stheṣu ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀcā́rum ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: By sacred rites we solicit (wealth) of you, auspicious, bearing wealth, abiding in the regions of the vast heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: By sacred rites we solicit (wealth) of you, auspicious, bearing wealth, abiding in the regions of the vast heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदं ।शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáṃvṛkta-dhṛṣṇum ǀ ukthyám ǀ mahā́-mahivratam ǀ mádam ǀśatám ǀ púraḥ ǀ rurukṣáṇim ǁ
verses.english_translation: The overthrower of the resolute (foe), the praiseworthy, to whom many solemn observances are addressed, the exhilarator, the destroyer of a hundred cities (of theasuras).
verses.wilson_translation: The overthrower of the resolute (foe), the praiseworthy, to whom many solemn observances are addressed, the exhilarator, the destroyer of a hundred cities (of theasuras).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वा रयिमभि राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः ।सुपर्णो अव्यथिर्भरत् ॥
verses.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ rayím ǀ abhí ǀ rā́jānam ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ diváḥ ǀsu-parṇáḥ ǀ avyathíḥ ǀ bharat ǁ
verses.english_translation: O (Soma), doer of good deeds, the unwearied hawk brought you, king over riches, from this heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: O (Soma), doer of good deeds, the unwearied hawk brought you, king over riches, from this heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणं रजस्तुरं ।गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत् ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvasmai ǀ ít ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀ sā́dhāraṇam ǀ rajaḥ-túram ǀgopā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ víḥ ǀ bharat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bird brought you, the showerer of water, the protector of the sacrifice, the common property of every god.
verses.wilson_translation: The bird brought you, the showerer of water, the protector of the sacrifice, the common property of every god.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अधा हिन्वान इंद्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे ।अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ indriyám ǀ jyā́yaḥ ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ ānaśe ǀabhiṣṭi-kṛ́t ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The contemplator of all, the granter of desires, putting forth his energy obtains superior greatness.
verses.wilson_translation: The contemplator of all, the granter of desires, putting forth his energy obtains superior greatness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Poust down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky,And plenteous store of wholesome fbod. Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us,The kine of strangers to our home. Chief Friend of Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream,Ppur down on us a flood of rain. To give us vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-clothFor verily the Gods will bear. Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Rākṣasas,Flashing out splendour as of old.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि ।अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ ā́ ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ūrmím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀayakṣmā́ḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour down upon us a shower from heaven, a stream of waters, wholesome and abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour down upon us a shower from heaven, a stream of waters, wholesome and abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् ।जन्यास उप नो गृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: táyā ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yáyā ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ā-gáman ǀjányāsaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow in such a stream that the cattle belonging to the (enemy's) nation may come here to our dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow in such a stream that the cattle belonging to the (enemy's) nation may come here to our dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः ।अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव ॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛtám ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ ā́ ǀ pava ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who are most dear to the gods at sacrifice, shower down water in a stream, pour your rain upon us.
verses.wilson_translation: You who are most dear to the gods at sacrifice, shower down water in a stream, pour your rain upon us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स न ऊर्जे व्यव्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया ।देवासः शृणवन्हि कं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjé ǀ ví ǀ avyáyam ǀ pavítram ǀ dhāva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ śṛṇávan ǀ hí ǀ kam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you for our sustenance hasten to the woollen filter with your stream; let the gods hear your sound.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you for our sustenance hasten to the woollen filter with your stream; let the gods hear your sound.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षांस्यपजंघनत् ।प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ asisyadat ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ apa-jáṅghanat ǀpratna-vát ǀ rocáyan ǀ rúcaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purifier (the Soma) flows forth destroying therākṣasas, flashing out brilliance as of old.
verses.wilson_translation: The purifier (the Soma) flows forth destroying therākṣasas, flashing out brilliance as of old.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN L. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LOUD as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves:Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point. At thine effusion upward rise three voices full of joy, when thouFlowest upon the fleecy ridge. On to the fleece they urge with stone the tawny well-beloved One,Even Pavamana, dropping meath. Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage most powerful to cheer,To seat thee in the place of song. Flow, Most Exhilarating! flow anointed with the milk for balm,Indu, for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिंधोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः ।वाणस्य चोदया पविं ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ śúṣmāsaḥ ǀ īrate ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrméḥ-iva ǀ svanáḥ ǀvāṇásya ǀ codaya ǀ pavím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Forth flow your mystery (streams), like the roar (issuing) from the ocean wave; emit your sound like that of a (rushing) arrow.
verses.wilson_translation: Forth flow your mystery (streams), like the roar (issuing) from the ocean wave; emit your sound like that of a (rushing) arrow.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः ।यदव्य एषि सानवि ॥
verses.transliteration: pra-savé ǀ te ǀ út ǀ īrate ǀ tisráḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ makhasyúvaḥ ǀyát ǀ ávye ǀ éṣi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
verses.english_translation: At your birth the three voices of the worshipper are uttered when you go to the summit of the fleece.
verses.wilson_translation: At your birth the three voices of the worshipper are uttered when you go to the summit of the fleece.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियं हरिं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ।पवमानं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyám ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀpávamānam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The priests) effuse with the stones into the fleece the beloved green-tinted purifying honey-dropping (Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests) effuse with the stones into the fleece the beloved green-tinted purifying honey-dropping (Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिंतम पवित्रं धारया कवे ।अर्कस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ pavítram ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kave ǀarkásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most exhilarating sage (Soma), flow in a stream to the filter to sit on Indra'slap.
verses.wilson_translation: Most exhilarating sage (Soma), flow in a stream to the filter to sit on Indra'slap.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पवस्व मदिंतम गोभिरंजानो अक्तुभिः ।इंदविंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjānáḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Most exhilarating Indu, being anointed with the unguents of milk and curds flow forth for Indra's drinking.
verses.wilson_translation: Most exhilarating Indu, being anointed with the unguents of milk and curds flow forth for Indra's drinking.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ADHVARYU, on the filter pour the Soma juice expressed with stones,And make it pure for Indra's drink. Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven,, the Soma's juice,Most excellent, most rich in sweets. These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu enjoy this juice of thine,This Pavamana's flowing meath. For, Soma, thou hast been effused, strengthening for the wild carouse,O Steer, the singer, for our help. Flow with thy stream, Far-sighted One, effused, into the cleansing sieve:Flow on to give us strength and fame.

verses.sanskrit: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज ।पुनीहींद्राय पातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ádhvaryo íti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛja ǀpunīhí ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Adhvaryu, pour upon the filter the Somathat has been expressed with the stones, purify it for Indra's drinking.
verses.wilson_translation: Adhvaryu, pour upon the filter the Somathat has been expressed with the stones, purify it for Indra's drinking.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिंद्राय वज्रिणे ।सुनोता मधुमत्तमं ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ ut-tamám ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀsunóta ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Adhvaryus), effuse the most sweet-flavoured Soma, the best ambrosia of heaven for Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: (Adhvaryus), effuse the most sweet-flavoured Soma, the best ambrosia of heaven for Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव त्य इंदो अंधसो देवा मधोर्व्यश्नते ।पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ indo íti ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnate ǀpávamānasya ǀ marútaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, the gods and the Marutspartake your sweet purifying beverage.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, the gods and the Marutspartake your sweet purifying beverage.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सोम वर्धयन्त्सुतो मदाय भूर्णये ।वृषन्त्स्तोतारमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ soma ǀ vardháyan ǀ sutáḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ bhū́rṇaye ǀvṛ́ṣan ǀ stotā́ram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you,Soma, being effused, approach the worshipper for speedy exhilaration and protection.
verses.wilson_translation: For you,Soma, being effused, approach the worshipper for speedy exhilaration and protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष विचक्षण पवित्रं धारया सुतः ।अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǀ pavítram ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten, sagacious (Soma), when you are effused, to the filter in a stream; bestow upon us food and fame.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten, sagacious (Soma), when you are effused, to the filter in a stream; bestow upon us food and fame.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WEALTH-WINNER, dwelling in the sky, bringing us vigour with the juice,Flow to the filter when effused. So, in thine ancient ways, may he, beloved, with a thousand streamsRun o’er the fleecy straining-cloth. Him who is like a caldron shake: O Indu, shake thy gift to usShake it, armed Warrior! with thine arms. Indu, invoked with many a prayer, bring down the vigour of these men,Of him who threatens us with war. Indu, Wealth-giver, with thine help pour out for us a hundred, yea,A thousand of thy pure bright streams.

verses.sanskrit: परि द्युक्षः सनद्रयिर्भरद्वाजं नो अंधसा ।सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ dyukṣáḥ ǀ sanát-rayiḥ ǀ bhárat ǀ vā́jam ǀ naḥ ǀ ándhasā ǀsuvānáḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the glittering (Soma), the acquirer of wealth; bestow upon us strength together with food; hasten when effused to the filter.
verses.wilson_translation: May the glittering (Soma), the acquirer of wealth; bestow upon us strength together with food; hasten when effused to the filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव प्रत्नेभिरध्वभिरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः ।सहस्रधारो यात्तना ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ pratnébhiḥ ǀ ádhva-bhiḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyáḥ ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ yāt ǀ tánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your juice dear (to the gods), flowing in a thousand streams, proceeds by ancient paths to the fleecy filter.
verses.wilson_translation: Your juice dear (to the gods), flowing in a thousand streams, proceeds by ancient paths to the fleecy filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: चरुर्न यस्तमींखयेंदो न दानमींखय ।वधैर्वधस्नवींखय ॥
verses.transliteration: carúḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ tám ǀ īṅkhaya ǀ índo íti ǀ ná ǀ dā́nam ǀ īṅkhaya ǀvadháiḥ ǀ vadhasno íti vadha-sno ǀ īṅkhaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma), send (us) him who is like a pot;Indu, send us now wealth; swift-flowing (Soma), send it with blows (of stones).
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma), send (us) him who is like a pot;Indu, send us now wealth; swift-flowing (Soma), send it with blows (of stones).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नि शुष्ममिंदवेषां पुरुहूत जनानां ।यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ śúṣmam ǀ indo íti ǀ eṣām ǀ púru-hūta ǀ jánānām ǀyáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ ā-dídeśati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, the invoked of many, overthrow the strength of those people who challenge us.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, the invoked of many, overthrow the strength of those people who challenge us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतं न इंद ऊतिभिः सहस्रं वा शुचीनां ।पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
verses.transliteration: śatám ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ vā ǀ śúcīnām ǀpávasva ǀ maṃhayát-rayiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, do you who are the distributor of riches, pour forth for our protection a hundred or a thousand of your pure (streams).
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, do you who are the distributor of riches, pour forth for our protection a hundred or a thousand of your pure (streams).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O THOU with stones for arms, thy powers, crushing the fiends, have raised themselves:Chase thou the foes who compass us. Thou conquerest thus with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked:With fearless heart will I sing praise. No one with evil thought assails this Pavamana's holy laws:Crush him who fain would fight with thee. For Indra to the streams they drive the tawny rapture-dropping Steed,Indu the bringer of delight.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिंदंतो अद्रिवः ।नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ śúṣmāsaḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ bhindántaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀnudásva ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ pari-spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma) armed with the stones, your powerful streams rise up scattering therākṣasas; drive away those who are our adversaries.
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma) armed with the stones, your powerful streams rise up scattering therākṣasas; drive away those who are our adversaries.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसंगे धने हिते ।स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ ni-jaghníḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ ratha-saṅgé ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀstávai ǀ ábibhyuṣā ǀ hṛdā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You are) by this strength the discomfited (of foes), I praise you with a fearless heart for the sake of (our) line of chariots ranged (against the foe) and for the sake of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: (You are) by this strength the discomfited (of foes), I praise you with a fearless heart for the sake of (our) line of chariots ranged (against the foe) and for the sake of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या ।रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: ásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ná ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǀ pávamānasya ǀ duḥ-dhyā́ ǀrujá ǀ yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ pṛtanyáti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The prowess of you (Soma) as you are poured forth is irresistible against the malignant (rākṣasas); destroy him who defies you to battle.
verses.wilson_translation: The prowess of you (Soma) as you are poured forth is irresistible against the malignant (rākṣasas); destroy him who defies you to battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं हिन्वंति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनं ।इंदुमिंद्राय मत्सरं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ hinvanti ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ hárim ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ vājínam ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The priests) plural nge Indu, honey-dropping, green-tinted, vigorous, exhilarating, into the waters for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests) plural nge Indu, honey-dropping, green-tinted, vigorous, exhilarating, into the waters for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LIV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . AFTER his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk fromThe Sage who wins a thousand gifts. In aspect he is like the Sun; he runneth forward to the lakes,Seven currents flowing through the sky. He, shining in his splendour, stands high over all things that exist-Soma, a God as Sūrya is. Thou, Indu, in thy brilliancy, pourest on us, as Indra's Friend,Wealth from the kine to feast the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः ।पयः सहस्रसामृषिं ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ pratnā́m ǀ ánu ǀ dyútam ǀ śukrám ǀ duduhre ǀ áhrayaḥ ǀpáyaḥ ǀ sahasra-sā́m ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǁ
verses.english_translation: Towards Soma's ancient body the seers milk the flashing fluid, the sage who grants a thousand boons.
verses.wilson_translation: Towards Soma's ancient body the seers milk the flashing fluid, the sage who grants a thousand boons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं सूर्य इवोपदृगयं सरांसि धावति ।सप्त प्रवत आ दिवं ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ sū́ryaḥ-iva ǀ upa-dṛ́k ǀ ayám ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ dhāvati ǀsaptá ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dívam ǁ
verses.english_translation: He like the sun is the supervisor (of all acts); he hastens to the lakes, he unites with the seven down-descending rivers from heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: He like the sun is the supervisor (of all acts); he hastens to the lakes, he unites with the seven down-descending rivers from heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि ।सोमो देवो न सूर्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ víśvāni ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀ punānáḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ upári ǀsómaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified Soma, like the divine sun, abides above all regions.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified Soma, like the divine sun, abides above all regions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि णो देववीतये वाजाँ अर्षसि गोमतः ।पुनान इंदविंद्रयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ vā́jān ǀ arṣasi ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ indra-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified Indu, who are devoted to Indra, pour down for our sacrifice, food with milk and curds.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified Indu, who are devoted to Indra, pour down for our sacrifice, food with milk and curds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . POUR on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment,And, Soma, all felicities. As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from the juice,Seat thee on the dear sacred grass. And, finding for us kine and steeds, O Soma, with thy juice flow onThrough days that fly most rapidly. As one who conquers, ne’er subdued, attacks and stays the enemy,Thus, Vanquisher of thousands! flow.

verses.sanskrit: यवंयवं नो अंधसा पुष्टंपुष्टं परि स्रव ।सोम विश्वा च सौभगा ॥
verses.transliteration: yávam-yavam ǀ naḥ ǀ ándhasā ǀ puṣṭám-puṣṭam ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀsóma ǀ víśvā ǀ ca ǀ sáubhagā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, pour forth (in a stream of) food, abundant soft-collected (juice), and all good things.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, pour forth (in a stream of) food, abundant soft-collected (juice), and all good things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमंधसः ।नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः ॥
verses.transliteration: índo íti ǀ yáthā ǀ táva ǀ stávaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ te ǀ jātám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ priyé ǀ sadaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, since the praise of you as food, since your birth (has appeared), sit down upon the grass that plural ases (you).
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, since the praise of you as food, since your birth (has appeared), sit down upon the grass that plural ases (you).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमांधसा ।मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ go-vít ǀ aśva-vít ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ ándhasā ǀmakṣú-tamebhiḥ ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: And Soma, do you who are the giver of cattle, the giver of horses, flow to us in (a stream of) food as the days quickly pass.
verses.wilson_translation: And Soma, do you who are the giver of cattle, the giver of horses, flow to us in (a stream of) food as the days quickly pass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो जिनाति न जीयते हंति शत्रुमभीत्य ।स पवस्व सहस्रजित् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ jinā́ti ǀ ná ǀ jī́yate ǀ hánti ǀ śátrum ǀ abhi-ítya ǀsáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasra-jit ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow forth, O conqueror of thousands, who conquers and is not conquered, and attacking slays his foe.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow forth, O conqueror of thousands, who conquers and is not conquered, and attacking slays his foe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SWIFT to the purifying sieve flows Soma as exalted Law,Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods. When Soma pours the strengthening food a hundred ever-active streamsTo Indra's friendship win theirway. Ten Dames have sung to welcome thee, even as a maiden greets her love:O Soma, thou art decked to win. Flow hitherward, O Indu, sweet to Indra and to Viṣṇu: guardThe men, the singers, from distress.

verses.sanskrit: परि सोम ऋतं बृहदाशुः पवित्रे अर्षति ।विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǀ āśúḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀvi-ghnán ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The swift Somadevoted to the gods destroying therākṣasasin the filter, bestows abundant food (on us).
verses.wilson_translation: The swift Somadevoted to the gods destroying therākṣasasin the filter, bestows abundant food (on us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्सोमो वाजमर्षति शतं धारा अपस्युवः ।इंद्रस्य सख्यमाविशन् ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ árṣati ǀ śatám ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀíndrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ ā-viśán ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the hundred rite-loving streams (of the Soma) obtain the friendship of Indra, then the Soma brings us food.
verses.wilson_translation: When the hundred rite-loving streams (of the Soma) obtain the friendship of Indra, then the Soma brings us food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा योषणो दश जारं न कन्यानूषत ।मृज्यसे सोम सातये ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ jārám ǀ ná ǀ kanyā́ ǀ anūṣata ǀmṛjyáse ǀ soma ǀ sātáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers commend you,Soma, as a maiden her lover, you are cleansed in order to bestow (wealth on us).
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers commend you,Soma, as a maiden her lover, you are cleansed in order to bestow (wealth on us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्राय विष्णवे स्वादुरिंदो परि स्रव ।नॄन्त्स्तोतॄन्पाह्यंहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ índrāya ǀ víṣṇave ǀ svādúḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀnṝ́n ǀ stotṝ́n ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Indu, who are sweet-flavoured flow for Indraand Viṣṇupreserve the worshippers, your praisers, from sin.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Indu, who are sweet-flavoured flow for Indraand Viṣṇupreserve the worshippers, your praisers, from sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THY streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven,To bring a thousand stores of strength. He flows beholding on his way all wellbeloved sacred lore,Green-tinted, brandishing his, arms. He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants.Sits as a falcon in the, wood. So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified,All treasures both of heaven and earth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यंति वृष्टयः ।अच्छा वाजं सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yanti ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀáccha ǀ vā́jam ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your unconnected streams advance towards infinite food (for us) like the showers from heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Your unconnected streams advance towards infinite food (for us) like the showers from heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति ।हरिस्तुंजान आयुधा ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ kā́vyā ǀ víśvā ǀ cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀháriḥ ǀ tuñjānáḥ ǀ ā́yudhā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The green-tinted Somacontemplating all the holy acts that are plural asing to the gods rushes (to the sacrifice) brandishing his weapons (against therākṣasas).
verses.wilson_translation: The green-tinted Somacontemplating all the holy acts that are plural asing to the gods rushes (to the sacrifice) brandishing his weapons (against therākṣasas).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः ।श्येनो न वंसु षीदति ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ marmṛjānáḥ ǀ āyú-bhiḥ ǀ íbhaḥ ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ su-vratáḥ ǀśyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ váṃsu ǀ sīdati ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, the object of pious observances, cleansed by the priests, fearless as a king, sits on the waters like a hawk.
verses.wilson_translation: He, the object of pious observances, cleansed by the priests, fearless as a king, sits on the waters like a hawk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि ।पुनान इंदवा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ diváḥ ǀ vásu ǀ utó íti ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀpunānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, when you are purified, bring us all the treasures that are in heaven and upon earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, when you are purified, bring us all the treasures that are in heaven and upon earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LVIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SWIFT runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice:Swift runs this giver of delight. The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man:Swift runs this giver of delight. We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Puruṣanti's hands:Swift runs this giver of delight. From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three times ten beside:Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sanskrit: तरत्स मंदी धावति धारा सुतस्यांधसः ।तरत्स मंदी धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: tárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: He the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin); the stream of the effused beverage (flows); he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.wilson_translation: He the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin); the stream of the effused beverage (flows); he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः ।तरत्स मंदी धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: usrā́ ǀ veda ǀ vásūnām ǀ mártasya ǀ devī́ ǀ ávasaḥ ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: The brilliant (stream), the bestower of riches, knows how to protect the worshipper; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.wilson_translation: The brilliant (stream), the bestower of riches, knows how to protect the worshipper; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषंत्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे ।तरत्स मंदी धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: dhvasráyoḥ ǀ puru-sántyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ dadmahe ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have received thousands from Dhvasra and Puruṣanti; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.wilson_translation: We have received thousands from Dhvasra and Puruṣanti; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे ।तरत्स मंदी धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ triṃśátam ǀ tánā ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ ca ǀ dádmahe ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have received from those two three hundred thousand garments; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.wilson_translation: We have received from those two three hundred thousand garments; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LIX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FLOW onward, Soma, winning kine, and steeds, and all that gives delight:Bring hither wealth with progeny. Flow onward from the waters, flow, inviolable, from the plants:Flow onward from the pressing-boards. Soma, as Pavamana, pass over all trouble and distress:Sit on the sacred grass, a Sage. Thou, Pavamana, foundest light; thou at thy birth becamest great:O Indu, thou art over all.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व गोजिदश्वजिद्विश्वजित्सोम रण्यजित् ।प्रजावद्रत्नमा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ go-jít ǀ aśva-jít ǀ viśva-jít ǀ soma ǀ raṇya-jít ǀprajā́-vat ǀ rátnam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, conqueror of cattle, of horses, of all things, of desirable wealth; bring us riches withmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, conqueror of cattle, of horses, of all things, of desirable wealth; bring us riches withmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्वाद्भ्यो अदाभ्यः पवस्वौषधीभ्यः ।पवस्व धिषणाभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ óṣadhībhyaḥ ǀpávasva ǀ dhiṣáṇābhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow with waters and with filaments, flow with herbs, flow with the stones.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow with waters and with filaments, flow with herbs, flow with the stones.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम पवमानो विश्वानि दुरिता तर ।कविः सीद नि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tara ǀkavíḥ ǀ sīda ǀ ní ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, do you who are the purifier, the sage, overcome all hindrances; sit down on the sacred grass.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, do you who are the purifier, the sage, overcome all hindrances; sit down on the sacred grass.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान स्वर्विदो जायमानोऽभवो महान् ।इंदो विश्वाँ अभीदसि ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ sváḥ ǀ vidaḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀíndo íti ǀ víśvān ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: O purifying Soma, grant all boons; as soon as you are born you are great;Indu, you overcome all (foes).
verses.wilson_translation: O purifying Soma, grant all boons; as soon as you are born you are great;Indu, you overcome all (foes).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ४ अवत्सार: काश्यपः । पवमान: सोम: । गायत्री ।३ पुरउष्णिक ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING forth and laud with sacred song most active Pavamana, laudIndu who sees with thousand eyes. Thee who hast thousand eyes to see, bearer of thousand burthens, theyHave filtered through the fleecy cloth. He, Pavamana, hath streamed through the fleece then: he runs into the jars,Finding his way to Indra's heart. That Indra may be bounteous, flow, most active Soma, for our weal:Bring genial seed with progeny.

verses.sanskrit: प्र गायत्रेण गायत पवमानं विचर्षणिं ।इंदुं सहस्रचक्षसं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ gāyatréṇa ǀ gāyata ǀ pávamānam ǀ ví-carṣaṇim ǀíndum ǀ sahásra-cakṣasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hymn with agāyatrīhymn,Induthe purifier, the all-beholding, the thousand-eyed.
verses.wilson_translation: Hymn with agāyatrīhymn,Induthe purifier, the all-beholding, the thousand-eyed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा सहस्रचक्षसमथो सहस्रभर्णसं ।अति वारमपाविषुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ tvā ǀ sahásra-cakṣasam ǀ átho íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǀáti ǀ vā́ram ǀ apāviṣuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, the thousand-eyed, and the supporter of thousands, they make to flow through the filter.
verses.wilson_translation: You, the thousand-eyed, and the supporter of thousands, they make to flow through the filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अति वारान्पवमानो असिष्यदत्कलशाँ अभि धावति ।इंद्रस्य हार्द्याविशन् ॥
verses.transliteration: áti ǀ vā́rān ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ asisyadat ǀ kaláśān ǀ abhí ǀ dhāvati ǀíndrasya ǀ hā́rdi ǀ ā-viśán ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purifier trickles through the hairs of the filter; he hastens to the pitchers, entering Indra's heart.
verses.wilson_translation: The purifier trickles through the hairs of the filter; he hastens to the pitchers, entering Indra's heart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्य सोम राधसे शं पवस्व विचर्षणे ।प्रजावद्रेत आ भर ॥
verses.transliteration: índrasya ǀ soma ǀ rā́dhase ǀ śám ǀ pavasva ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀprajā́-vat ǀ rétaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: All-beholding Soma, flow plural asantly for Indra's gratification; bring (us) food withmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: All-beholding Soma, flow plural asantly for Indra's gratification; bring (us) food withmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FLOW onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delightBattered the nine-and-ninety down, Smote swiftly forts, and gambara, then Yadu and that Turvaga,For pious Divodāsa's sake. Finder of horses, pour on us horses andwealth in kine and gold,And, Indu, food in boundless store. We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana's flowing o’erThe limit of the cleansing sieve. With those same waves which in their stream oyerflow the purifying sieve,Soma; be gracious unto us. O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides,—for thou canst,—Riches and food with hero sons. Him here, the Child whom streams have borne, the ten swift fingers beautifyWith the Ādityas is he seen. With Indra and with Vāyu he, effused, flows onward with,the beamsOf Sūrya to the cleansing sieve. Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vāyu, Pūṣan flowFor Mitra and for Varuṇa. High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtainedStrong sheltering power and great renown. Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth from the ungodly man,Yea, all the glories of mankind. Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore,For Varuṇa and the Marut host. The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk,The active crusher of the foe. Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him,Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart. Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milkIncrease the sea that merits laud. From heaven hath Pavamana made, as ’twere, the marvellous thunder, andThe lofty light of all mankind. The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, of Pavamana, King!Flows o’er the woollen straining-cloth. Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad like splendid skill,Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see. Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight,Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods. Killing the foeman and his hate, and winning booty every day,Gainer art thou of steeds and kine. Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast,Falcon-like resting in thine home. Flow onward thou who strengthenedst Indra to slaughter Vṛtra whoCompassed and stayed the mighty floods. Soma who rainest gifts, may we win riches with our hero sons:Strengthen, as thou art cleansed, our hymns. Aided by thee, and through thy grace, may we be slayers when we war:Watch, Soma, at our solemn rites. Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma flowcth on,Going to Indra's special place. O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes:O Indu, grant heroic fame. A hundred obstacles have ne’er checkedthee when fain to give thy boons,When, being cleansed, thou combatest. Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk:Drive all our enemies away. Indu, in this thy friendship most lofty and glorious may weSubdue all those who war with us. Those awful weapons that thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down-Guard us therewith from every foe.

verses.sanskrit: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इंदो मदेष्वा ।अवाहन्नवतीर्नव ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ vītī́ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ mádeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀava-áhan ǀ navatī́ḥ ǀ náva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Indu, for (Indra's) food with that (juice) of yours which in battles overthrow ninety and nine (cities of the foe).
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Indu, for (Indra's) food with that (juice) of yours which in battles overthrow ninety and nine (cities of the foe).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शंबरं ।अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुं ॥
verses.transliteration: púraḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ itthā́-dhiye ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ śámbaram ǀádha ǀ tyám ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Which overturned) the cities in a moment, and for the sake of the devout Divodāsa(subdued)Śambara, and then that Turvaśaand Yadu.
verses.wilson_translation: (Which overturned) the cities in a moment, and for the sake of the devout Divodāsa(subdued)Śambara, and then that Turvaśaand Yadu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि णो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिंदो हिरण्यवत् ।क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ áśvam ǀ aśva-vít ǀ gó-mat ǀ indo íti ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀkṣára ǀ sahasríṇīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, conqueror of horses, shower forth horses with cattle and gold and unbounded food.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, conqueror of horses, shower forth horses with cattle and gold and unbounded food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युंदतः ।सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ pavítram ǀ abhi-undatáḥ ǀsakhi-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We solicit your friendship as you drop flowing over the filter.
verses.wilson_translation: We solicit your friendship as you drop flowing over the filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरंति धारया ।तेभिर्नः सोम मृळय ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ pavítram ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ abhi-kṣáranti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀtébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Delight us,Soma, with those your undulations what flow over the filter in a stream.
verses.wilson_translation: Delight us,Soma, with those your undulations what flow over the filter in a stream.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषं ।ईशानः सोम विश्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ rayím ǀ vīrá-vatīm ǀ íṣam ǀī́śānaḥ ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are lord over all, the purifier, bring us riches and food withmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are lord over all, the purifier, bring us riches and food withmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजंति सिंधुमातरं ।समादित्येभिरख्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ mṛjánti ǀ síndhu-mātaram ǀsám ǀ ādityébhiḥ ǀ akhyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers cleanse this Soma, whose parents are the rivers; he is associated with theĀdityas.
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers cleanse this Soma, whose parents are the rivers; he is associated with theĀdityas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समिंद्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ ।सं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ índreṇa ǀ utá ǀ vāyúnā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ eti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀsám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When effused he proceeds to the filter, with Indraand Vāyu, and with the sun's rays.
verses.wilson_translation: When effused he proceeds to the filter, with Indraand Vāyu, and with the sun's rays.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् ।चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhágāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ pūṣṇé ǀ pavasva ǀ mádhu-mān ǀcā́ruḥ ǀ mitré ǀ váruṇe ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you who are sweet-flavoured and beautiful flow (at) our (sacrifice) for Bhaga,Vāyu,Pūṣaṇ,Mitraand Varuṇa
verses.wilson_translation: Do you who are sweet-flavoured and beautiful flow (at) our (sacrifice) for Bhaga,Vāyu,Pūṣaṇ,Mitraand Varuṇa
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उच्चा ते जातमंधसो दिवि षद्भूम्या ददे ।उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: uccā́ ǀ te ǀ jātám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ diví ǀ sát ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀugrám ǀ śárma ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The birth of your juice is on high; the earth has received (your) intense happiness and abundant food, though (these) exist (naturally) in heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The birth of your juice is on high; the earth has received (your) intense happiness and abundant food, though (these) exist (naturally) in heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणां ।सिषासंतो वनामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: enā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀsísāsantaḥ ǀ vanāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: By this (Soma) obtaining and desiring to enjoy all the good things that belong to men we enjoy (them).
verses.wilson_translation: By this (Soma) obtaining and desiring to enjoy all the good things that belong to men we enjoy (them).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स न इंद्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।वरिवोवित्परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ yájyave ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀvarivaḥ-vít ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: O you who are the possessor of wealth flow for us, for the adorable Indra, for Varuṇaand the Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: O you who are the possessor of wealth flow for us, for the adorable Indra, for Varuṇaand the Maruts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भंगं परिष्कृतं ।इंदुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ sú ǀ jātám ǀ ap-túram ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ bhaṅgám ǀ pári-kṛtam ǀíndum ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ayāsiṣuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gods approach Indu, (who is) completely genitive rated, sent forth by the waters, the demolisher (of foes), adorned with milk and curds.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods approach Indu, (who is) completely genitive rated, sent forth by the waters, the demolisher (of foes), adorned with milk and curds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमिद्वर्धंतु नो गिरो वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव ।य इंद्रस्य हृदंसनिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ saṃśíśvarīḥ-iva ǀyáḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ hṛdam-sániḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May our praises foster him who wins the heart of Indra, as cows who have young ones (foster) their calf.
verses.wilson_translation: May our praises foster him who wins the heart of Indra, as cows who have young ones (foster) their calf.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्षा णः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषं ।वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: árṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ śám ǀ gáve ǀ dhukṣásva ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀ íṣam ǀvárdha ǀ samudrám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, pour prosperity upon our cattle, milk forth (for us) nutritious food; augment the laudable water.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, pour prosperity upon our cattle, milk forth (for us) nutritious food; augment the laudable water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुं ।ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ajījanat ǀ diváḥ ǀ citrám ǀ ná ǀ tanyatúm ǀjyótiḥ ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure (Soma) has genitive rated in heaven the great Vaiśvānaralight like the wonderful thunder.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure (Soma) has genitive rated in heaven the great Vaiśvānaralight like the wonderful thunder.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते रसो मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः ।वि वारमव्यमर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ te ǀ rásaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ rājan ǀ aducchunáḥ ǀví ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǀ arṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bright shining Soma, the juice of you, when your flow enters the woollen filter, exhilarating free from evil.
verses.wilson_translation: Bright shining Soma, the juice of you, when your flow enters the woollen filter, exhilarating free from evil.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान रसस्तव दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् ।ज्योतिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ rásaḥ ǀ táva ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀjyótiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified Soma, your juice as it increases shines bright; it (makes) a pervading universal light to be seen.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified Soma, your juice as it increases shines bright; it (makes) a pervading universal light to be seen.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वांधसा ।देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ téna ǀ pavasva ǀ ándhasā ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ aghaśaṃsa-hā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow forth with that juice of yours which is exhilarating, the best gratifying the gods, the slayer ofrākṣasas.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow forth with that juice of yours which is exhilarating, the best gratifying the gods, the slayer ofrākṣasas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियं सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे ।गोषा उ अश्वसा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: jághniḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ amitríyam ǀ sásniḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ divé-dive ǀgo-sā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ aśva-sā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are the slayer of the hostile Vṛtra, the enjoyed of battle day by day, the giver of kine and the giver of horses.
verses.wilson_translation: You are the slayer of the hostile Vṛtra, the enjoyed of battle day by day, the giver of kine and the giver of horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भव सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभिः ।सीदंछ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
verses.transliteration: sám-miślaḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ bhava ǀ su-upasthā́bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǀsī́dan ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be now resplendent, mixed with the supporting (products of the) kine, alighting like a falcon on your plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: Be now resplendent, mixed with the supporting (products of the) kine, alighting like a falcon on your plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पवस्व य आविथेंद्रं वृत्राय हंतवे ।वव्रिवांसं महीरपः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́vitha ǀ índram ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǀvavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow you who did help Indrato slay Vṛtra, who obstructed the great waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow you who did help Indrato slay Vṛtra, who obstructed the great waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुवीरासो वयं धना जयेम सोम मीढ्वः ।पुनानो वर्ध नो गिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ dhánā ǀ jáyema ǀ soma ǀ mīḍhvaḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vardha ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, possessed of excellentmaleoffspring, conquer the wealth (of our enemies), OSoma, the sprinkler; being purified, accept our praises.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, possessed of excellentmaleoffspring, conquer the wealth (of our enemies), OSoma, the sprinkler; being purified, accept our praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वोतासस्तवावसा स्याम वन्वंत आमुरः ।सोम व्रतेषु जागृहि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ syā́ma ǀ vanvántaḥ ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀsóma ǀ vratéṣu ǀ jāgṛhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protected by you, through your protection may we be victorious, slaying (our enemies); be vigilant Soma, at our sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: Protected by you, through your protection may we be victorious, slaying (our enemies); be vigilant Soma, at our sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः ।गच्छन्निंद्रस्य निष्कृतं ॥
