verses.transliteration: apa-ghnán ǀ pavate ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ sómaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀgácchan ǀ índrasya ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaflows, slaying the malignant, slaying the withholders (of wealth), proceeding to Indra's consecrated (station).
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaflows, slaying the malignant, slaying the withholders (of wealth), proceeding to Indra's consecrated (station).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः ।रास्वेंदो वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ pávamāna ǀ jahí ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀrā́sva ǀ indo íti ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us, purifier, much wealth; conquer our foes; grant us,Indu, fame andmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us, purifier, much wealth; conquer our foes; grant us,Indu, fame andmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा शतं चन ह्रुतो राधो दित्संतमा मिनन् ।यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ śatám ǀ caná ǀ hrútaḥ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ dítsantam ǀ ā́ ǀ minan ǀyát ǀ punānáḥ ǀ makhasyáse ǁ
verses.english_translation: A hundred foes harm you not, purposing to give wealth when being purified you are benevolently inclined.
verses.wilson_translation: A hundred foes harm you not, purposing to give wealth when being purified you are benevolently inclined.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्वेंदो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने ।विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ indo íti ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ kṛdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ jáne ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Indu, when effused, the showerer (of benefits) make us celebrated among men; slay all our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indu, when effused, the showerer (of benefits) make us celebrated among men; slay all our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य ते सख्ये वयं तवेंदो द्युम्न उत्तमे ।सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásya ǀ te ǀ sakhyé ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǀ indo íti ǀ dyumné ǀ ut-tamé ǀsasahyā́ma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Enjoying) the friendship of you here and you excellent food,Indu, may we overcome our assailants.
verses.wilson_translation: (Enjoying) the friendship of you here and you excellent food,Indu, may we overcome our assailants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि संति धूर्वणे ।रक्षा समस्य नो निदः ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ bhīmā́ni ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ tigmā́ni ǀ sánti ǀ dhū́rvaṇe ǀrákṣa ǀ samasya ǀ naḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With your weapons which are formidable and sharp for slaying (the foe), defend us from the scorn (of our enemies).
verses.wilson_translation: With your weapons which are formidable and sharp for slaying (the foe), defend us from the scorn (of our enemies).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THESE rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieveTo bring us all felicities. Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser's progeny,Yea, and the warrior steed, success. Bringing prosperity to kine, they make perpetual Iḷā flowTo us for noble eulogy. Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath beenpressed in the streams for rapturous joy:Hawk-like he settles in his home. Fair is the God-loved juice; the plant is washed in waters, pressed by menThe milch-kine sweeten it with milk. As drivers deck a courser, so have they adorned the meath's juice forAmbrosia, for the festival. Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured forhelp,Hast settled in the cleansing sieve. So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow, to be his drink,Finding thine home in vats of wood. As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk,O Indu, for the Aṅgirases. Most active and benevolent, this Pavamana, sent to usFor lofty friendship, meditates. Queller of curses, mighty, with strong sway, this Pavamana shallBring treasures to the worshipper. Pour thou upon us thousandfold possessions, both of kine and steeds,Exceeding glorious, much-desired. Wandering far, with wise designs, the juice here present is effused,Made beautiful by living men. For Indra flows the gladdening drink, the measurer of the region, Sage,With countless wealth and endless help. Born on the inountain, lauded here, Indu for Indra is set down,As in her sheltering nest a bird. Pressed by the men, as ’twere to war hath Soma Pavamana sped,To test with might within the vats. That he may move, they yoke him to the three-backed triple-seated carBy the Seven Ṛṣis’ holy songs. Drive ye that Tawny Courser, O ye pressers, on his way to war,Swift Steed who carries off the spoil. Pouring all glories hither, he, effused and entering the jar,Stands like a hero mid the kine. Indu, the living men milk out the juice to make the rapturous draught:Gods for the Gods milk out the meath. Pour for the Gods into the sieve our Soma very rich in sweets,Him whom the Gods most gladly hear. Into his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured,Lauded with songs for lofty fame. Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being cleansed:Winning the spoil flow hitherward. And, hymned by Jamadagnis, let all nourishment that kine supply,And general praises, flow to us. Soma, as leader of the song flow onward with thy wondrous aids,For holy lore of every kind. Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea,Flow onward, thou who movest all. O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to attest thy might:For thy behoof the rivers flow. Like showers of rain that fall from heaven thy streams perpetually flowTo the bright fleece spread under them. For potent Indra purify Indu effectual and strong,Enjoyment-giver, Mighty Lord. Soma, true, Pavamana, Sage, is seated in the cleansing sieve,Giving his praiser hero strength.

verses.sanskrit: एते असृग्रमिंदवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः ।विश्वान्यभि सौभगा ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ asṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀvíśvāni ǀ abhí ǀ sáubhagā ǁ
verses.english_translation: These rapid Somajuices have directed through the filter (to obtain) all good things.
verses.wilson_translation: These rapid Somajuices have directed through the filter (to obtain) all good things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नंतो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः ।तना कृण्वंतो अर्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-ghnántaḥ ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ purú ǀ su-gā́ ǀ tokā́ya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀtánā ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ árvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Powerful, repelling evils, bestowing happiness and riches upon our sons and horses.
verses.wilson_translation: Powerful, repelling evils, bestowing happiness and riches upon our sons and horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कृण्वंतो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षंति सुष्टुतिं ।इळामस्मभ्यं संयतं ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ gáve ǀ abhí ǀ arṣanti ǀ su-stutím ǀíḷām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ sam-yátam ǁ
verses.english_translation: They advance towards our fair praise, granting to (us and) our cattle sustaining wealth and food.
verses.wilson_translation: They advance towards our fair praise, granting to (us and) our cattle sustaining wealth and food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असाव्यंशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः ।श्येनो न योनिमासदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ásāvi ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ ap-sú ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ giri-sthā́ḥ ǀśyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mountain-born Somaflows for exhilaration, mighty in the (vasatīvarī) waters; he alights like a falcon on his own plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: The mountain-born Somaflows for exhilaration, mighty in the (vasatīvarī) waters; he alights like a falcon on his own plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुभ्रमंधो देववातमप्सु धूतो नृभिः सुतः ।स्वदंति गावः पयोभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: śubhrám ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ devá-vātam ǀ ap-sú ǀ dhūtáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀsvádanti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ páyaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The cattle sweeten with their milk the beautiful food that is asked for by the gods; the Somawhen effused by the priests is cleansed in the water.
verses.wilson_translation: The cattle sweeten with their milk the beautiful food that is asked for by the gods; the Somawhen effused by the priests is cleansed in the water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदीमश्वं न हेतारोऽशूशुभन्नमृताय ।मध्वो रसं सधमादे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ hétāraḥ ǀ áśūśubhan ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ rásam ǀ sadha-mā́de ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then the ministering priests in the assembly beautify the dice of exhilarating (Soma) like a horse, for the sake of immortality.
verses.wilson_translation: Then the ministering priests in the assembly beautify the dice of exhilarating (Soma) like a horse, for the sake of immortality.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतोऽसृग्रमिंद ऊतये ।ताभिः पवित्रमासदः ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ madhu-ścútaḥ ǀ ásṛgram ǀ indo íti ǀ ūtáye ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ ā́ ǀ asadaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sit down,Indu, on the filter with those streams the shedders of sweet (juice), which are let fall for our protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Sit down,Indu, on the filter with those streams the shedders of sweet (juice), which are let fall for our protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सो अर्षेंद्राय पीतये तिरो रोमाण्यव्यया ।सीदन्योना वनेष्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rómāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀsī́dan ǀ yónā ǀ váneṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Passing obliquely through the sheep's hairs, hasten for Indra's drinking, sitting in your plural ce in the wooden vessels.
verses.wilson_translation: Passing obliquely through the sheep's hairs, hasten for Indra's drinking, sitting in your plural ce in the wooden vessels.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंदो परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अंगिरोभ्यः ।वरिवोविद्घृतं पयः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ svā́diṣṭhaḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ ǀvarivaḥ-vít ǀ ghṛtám ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, who are most sweet-flavoured, the bestower of riches, drop for the Aṅgirasasbutter and milk.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, who are most sweet-flavoured, the bestower of riches, drop for the Aṅgirasasbutter and milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं विचर्षणिर्हितः पवमानः स चेतति ।हिन्वान आप्यं बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ cetati ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: This all-seeing Pavamāna Somadeposited (in the vessels), sending forth abundant (food), the product of the waters, is known (by all).
verses.wilson_translation: This all-seeing Pavamāna Somadeposited (in the vessels), sending forth abundant (food), the product of the waters, is known (by all).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष वृषा वृषव्रतः पवमानो अशस्तिहा ।करद्वसूनि दाशुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣa-vrataḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ aśasti-hā́ ǀkárat ǀ vásūni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Pavamāna Soma, the sprinkler (of benefits), engaged in sprinkling, the destroyer ofrākṣasas, bestows riches upon the donor (of the oblation).
verses.wilson_translation: This Pavamāna Soma, the sprinkler (of benefits), engaged in sprinkling, the destroyer ofrākṣasas, bestows riches upon the donor (of the oblation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमंतमश्विनं ।पुरुश्चंद्रं पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀpuru-candrám ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour forth thousand-fold wealth, together with cattle and horses, delighting many, desired by many.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour forth thousand-fold wealth, together with cattle and horses, delighting many, desired by many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य परि षिच्यते मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः ।उरुगायः कविक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀ marmṛjyámānaḥ ǀ āyú-bhiḥ ǀuru-gāyáḥ ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This (Soma) the many-hymned, having wise designs being cleansed by the priests, is sprinkled forth.
verses.wilson_translation: This (Soma) the many-hymned, having wise designs being cleansed by the priests, is sprinkled forth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रोतिः शतामघो विमानो रजसः कविः ।इंद्राय पवते मदः ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásra-ūtiḥ ǀ śatá-maghaḥ ǀ vi-mā́naḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ pavate ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Offering thousand-fold protection, having hundred-fold wealth, the meawsurer of the world, the sage, the exhilarating (Soma) flows for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Offering thousand-fold protection, having hundred-fold wealth, the meawsurer of the world, the sage, the exhilarating (Soma) flows for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गिरा जात इह स्तुत इंदुरिंद्राय धीयते ।विर्योना वसताविव ॥
verses.transliteration: girā́ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ihá ǀ stutáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ dhīyate ǀvíḥ ǀ yónā ǀ vasatáu-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: genitive rated and praised by song,Induat this sacrifice is deposited in his plural ce for Indra, like a bird on its nest.
verses.wilson_translation: genitive rated and praised by song,Induat this sacrifice is deposited in his plural ce for Indra, like a bird on its nest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानः सुतो नृभिः सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ।चमूषु शक्मनासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vā́jam-iva ǀ asarat ǀcamū́ṣu ǀ śákmanā ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The pure Somaeffused by the priests rushes forth as if to battle, to alight vigorously upon the ladles.
verses.wilson_translation: The pure Somaeffused by the priests rushes forth as if to battle, to alight vigorously upon the ladles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्रिपृष्ठे त्रिवंधुरे रथे युंजंति यातवे ।ऋषीणां सप्त धीतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tri-pṛṣṭhé ǀ tri-vandhuré ǀ ráthe ǀ yuñjanti ǀ yā́tave ǀṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ saptá ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They attach him by seven ceremonies to the three-backed three-benched chariot of the ṛṣis to go to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: They attach him by seven ceremonies to the three-backed three-benched chariot of the ṛṣis to go to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं सोता���ो धनस्पृतमाशुं वाजाय यातवे ।हरिं हिनोत वाजिनं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ sotāraḥ ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ āśúm ǀ vā́jāya ǀ yā́tave ǀhárim ǀ hinota ǀ vājínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effused of the Soma, urge forward that wealth bestowing rapid vigorous steed to go to the battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Effused of the Soma, urge forward that wealth bestowing rapid vigorous steed to go to the battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आविशन्कलशं सुतो विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः ।शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā-viśán ǀ kaláśam ǀ sutáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ árṣan ǀ abhí ǀ śríyaḥ ǀśū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ góṣu ǀ tiṣṭhati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Entering when effused into the pitcher bringing us all success like a hero, he stands among the cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Entering when effused into the pitcher bringing us all success like a hero, he stands among the cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ त इंदो मदाय कं पयो दुहंत्यायवः ।देवा देवेभ्यो मधु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ duhanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhu ǁ
verses.english_translation: The devout priests milk forth your sweet juice Indu, for the gods for the purpose of exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: The devout priests milk forth your sweet juice Indu, for the gods for the purpose of exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नः सोमं पवित्र आ सृजता मधुमत्तमं ।देवेभ्यो देवश्रुत्तमं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sómam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛjáta ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ devaśrút-tamam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour upon the filter for us for the sake of the gods the most sweet-flavoured Soma, most audible to the godṣ
verses.wilson_translation: Pour upon the filter for us for the sake of the gods the most sweet-flavoured Soma, most audible to the godṣ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः श्रवसे महे ।मदिंतमस्य धारया ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀ gṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ śrávase ǀ mahé ǀmadín-tamasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
verses.english_translation: These lauded Somajuices are let flow for the sake of abundant food in a stream for the most exhilarating (juice).
verses.wilson_translation: These lauded Somajuices are let flow for the sake of abundant food in a stream for the most exhilarating (juice).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि ।सनद्वाजः परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ gávyāni ǀ vītáye ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣasi ǀsanát-vājaḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Being purified you have the treasures of the kine to enjoy (them); flow forth you who grants food.
verses.wilson_translation: Being purified you have the treasures of the kine to enjoy (them); flow forth you who grants food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः ।गृणानो जमदग्निना ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pari-stúbhaḥ ǀgṛṇānáḥ ǀ jamát-agninā ǁ
verses.english_translation: And have for us towards all widely renowned food with cattle, being hymned by Jamadagni.
verses.wilson_translation: And have for us towards all widely renowned food with cattle, being hymned by Jamadagni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः ।अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vācáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ sóma ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀabhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are most excellent, flow with your marvellous protection towards our praises, towards all hymns (of praise).
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are most excellent, flow with your marvellous protection towards our praises, towards all hymns (of praise).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् ।पवस्व विश्वमेजय ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ samudríyāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ īráyan ǀpávasva ǀ viśvam-ejaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agitator of all, do you who are the most excellent raising your voice, pour forth the waters of the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Agitator of all, do you who are the most excellent raising your voice, pour forth the waters of the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे ।तुभ्यमर्षंति सिंधवः ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhya ǀ imā́ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ kave ǀ mahimné ǀ soma ǀ tasthire ǀtúbhyam ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O sage (Soma) in your might do these worlds stand; to you the rivers hasten.
verses.wilson_translation: O sage (Soma) in your might do these worlds stand; to you the rivers hasten.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते दिवो न वृष्टयो धारा यंत्यसश्चतः ।अभि शुक्रामुपस्तिरं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ yanti ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀabhí ǀ śukrā́m ǀ upa-stíram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your unconnected streams descend like the rian from heaven upon the white outspread (fleece).
verses.wilson_translation: Your unconnected streams descend like the rian from heaven upon the white outspread (fleece).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रायेंदुं पुनीतनोग्रं दक्षाय साधनं ।ईशानं वीतिराधसं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ índum ǀ punītana ǀ ugrám ǀ dákṣāya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀīśānám ǀ vītí-rādhasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purify for Indrathe fierce Indu, the means of strength, the lord (of wealth), the giver of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Purify for Indrathe fierce Indu, the means of strength, the lord (of wealth), the giver of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान ऋतः कविः सोमः पवित्रमासदत् ।दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ṛtáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The truthful seer, Pavamaāna Soma, sits down upon the filter, giving great energy to the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: The truthful seer, Pavamaāna Soma, sits down upon the filter, giving great energy to the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIII. Soma Pavanana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . POUR hitherward, O Soma, wealth in thousands and heroic strength,And keep renown secure for us. Thou makest food and vigour swell for Indra, best of gladdeners!Within the cups thou seatest thee. For Indra and for Viṣṇu poured, Soma hath flowed into the jar:May Vāyu find it rich in sweets. These Somas swift and brown of hue, in stream of solemn sacrificeHave flowed through twisted obstacles, Performing every noble work, active, augmenting Indra's strength,Driving away the godless ones. Brown Soma-drops, effused that seek Indra, to their appropriate placeFlow through the region hitherward. Flow onward with that stream of thine wherewith thou gavest Sūrya light,Urging on waters good to men. He, Pavamana, high o’er man yoked the Sun's courser EtaśaTo travel through the realm of air. And those ten Coursers, tawny-hued, he harnessed that the Sun might comeIndu, he said, is Indra's self. Hence, singers, pour the gladdeningjuice to Vāyu and to Indra, pourThe drops upon the fleecy cloth. O Soma Pavamana, find wealth for us not to be assailed,Wealth which the foeman may not win. Send riches hither with thy stream in thousands, both of steeds and kine,Send spoil of war and high renown. Soma the God, expressed with stones, like Sūrya, floweth on his way,Pouring the juice within the jar. These brilliant drops have poured for us, in stream of solemn sacrifice,Worshipful laws and strength in kine. Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Somas, blent with curdled milk,Effused for Indra Thunder-armed. Soma, do thou most rich in sweets, a gladdening drink most dear to Gods,Flow to the sieve to bring us wealth. For Indra, living men adorn the Tawny Courser in the streams, Indu, the giver of delight. Pour for us, Soma, wealth in gold, in horses and heroic sons,Bring hither strength in herds of kine. For Indra pour ye on the fleece him very sweet to taste, who longs.For battle as it were in war. The singers, seeking help, adorn the Sage who must be decked with songs:Loud bellowing the Steer comes on, The singers with their thoughts and hymns have, in the stream of sacrifice,Caused Soma, active Steer, to roar. God, working with mankind, flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice:To Vāyu mount as Law commands O Soma, Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that brings renown:Enter the lake, as one we love. Soma thou flowest chasing foes and bringing wisdom and delight:Drive off the folk who love not Gods. The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice,For holy lore of every kind. The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautiful swift Soma-drops,Driving all enemies afar. From, heaven, from out the firmament, hath Pavamana been effusedUpon the summit of the earth. O Soma, Indu, very wise, drive, being purified, with thy streamAll foes, all Rākṣasas away. Driving the Rākṣasas afar, O Soma, bellowing, pour for usMost excellent and splendid strength. Soma, do thou secure for us the treasures of the earih and heaven,Indu, all boons to be desired.

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं सोम सुवीर्यं ।अस्मे श्रवांसि धारय ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ soma ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀasmé íti ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ dhāraya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour (upon us),Soma, thousand-fold wealth, with excellentmaleprogeny, secure to us ample food.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour (upon us),Soma, thousand-fold wealth, with excellentmaleprogeny, secure to us ample food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इषमूर्जं च पिन्वस इंद्राय मत्सरिंतमः ।चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ॥
verses.transliteration: íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ ca ǀ pinvase ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarín-tamaḥ ǀcamū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who are most exhilarating effuse food and drink for Indra; you sit on the ladles.
verses.wilson_translation: You who are most exhilarating effuse food and drink for Indra; you sit on the ladles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुत इंद्राय विष्णवे सोमः कलशे अक्षरत् ।मधुमाँ अस्तु वायवे ॥
verses.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ víṣṇave ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kaláśe ǀ akṣarat ǀmádhu-mān ǀ astu ǀ vāyáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: Somaeffused for Indraand Viṣṇuand Vāyudrops into the pitcher; may he be sweet-flavoured.
verses.wilson_translation: Somaeffused for Indraand Viṣṇuand Vāyudrops into the pitcher; may he be sweet-flavoured.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते असृग्रमाशवोऽति ह्वरांसि बभ्रवः ।सोमा ऋतस्य धारया ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ asṛgram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ áti ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ babhrávaḥ ǀsómāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
verses.english_translation: These swift-flowing tawny-coloured Somajuices, with a stream of water are let loose upon therākṣasas.
verses.wilson_translation: These swift-flowing tawny-coloured Somajuices, with a stream of water are let loose upon therākṣasas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रं वर्धंतो अप्तुरः कृण्वंतो विश्वमार्यं ।अपघ्नंतो अराव्णः ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ várdhantaḥ ǀ ap-túraḥ ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ryam ǀapa-ghnántaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Augmenting Indra, urging the waters, making all our acts prosperous, destroying the withholders (of oblations).
verses.wilson_translation: Augmenting Indra, urging the waters, making all our acts prosperous, destroying the withholders (of oblations).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुता अनु स्वमा रजोऽभ्यर्षंति बभ्रवः ।इंद्रं गच्छंत इंदवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sutā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svám ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣanti ǀ babhrávaḥ ǀíndram ǀ gácchantaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The effused tawny-coloured Soma-juices going to Indrahave to their own plural ce.
verses.wilson_translation: The effused tawny-coloured Soma-juices going to Indrahave to their own plural ce.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः ।हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yáyā ǀ sū́ryam ǀ árocayaḥ ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow with that stream with which you,Soma, light up the sun, urging on the waters beneficial to man.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow with that stream with which you,Soma, light up the sun, urging on the waters beneficial to man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि ।अंतरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: áyukta ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ étaśam ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manáu ǀ ádhi ǀantárikṣeṇa ǀ yā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified (Soma) harnesses the horse of the sun to travel through the firmament to man.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified (Soma) harnesses the horse of the sun to travel through the firmament to man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उत त्या हरितो दश सूरो अयुक्त यातवे ।इंदुरिंद्र इति ब्रुवन् ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ harítaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ayukta ǀ yā́tave ǀínduḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ íti ǀ bruván ǁ
verses.english_translation: And Induexclaiming 'Indra!' harnesses the (horse of the) sun to go towards these ten regions.
verses.wilson_translation: And Induexclaiming 'Indra!' harnesses the (horse of the) sun to go towards these ten regions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परीतो वायवे सुतं गिर इंद्राय मत्सरं ।अव्यो वारेषु सिंचत ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ itáḥ ǀ vāyáve ǀ sutám ǀ gíraḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́reṣu ǀ siñcata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sprinkle worshipper, upon the woollen fleece the exhilarating (Soma) that has been effused in all directions for Vāyuand for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Sprinkle worshipper, upon the woollen fleece the exhilarating (Soma) that has been effused in all directions for Vāyuand for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम दुष्टरं ।यो दूणाशो वनुष्यता ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ rayím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ dustáram ǀyáḥ ǀ duḥ-náśaḥ ǀ vanuṣyatā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified Soma, grant us wealth unassailable (by our foes), and which cannot be destroyed by the enemy.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified Soma, grant us wealth unassailable (by our foes), and which cannot be destroyed by the enemy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमंतमश्विनं ।अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to us thousandfold wealth with cattle and horses; bring vigour and food.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to us thousandfold wealth with cattle and horses; bring vigour and food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमो देवो न सूर्योऽद्रिभिः पवते सुतः ।दधानः कलशे रसं ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀdádhānaḥ ǀ kaláśe ǀ rásam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, like the radiant sun, when effused flows forth, depositing its juice in the pitcher.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, like the radiant sun, when effused flows forth, depositing its juice in the pitcher.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते धामान्यार्या शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया ।वाजं गोमंतमक्षरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ā́ryā ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀvā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ akṣaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: These brilliang Soma-juices (flowing) towards the dwellings of respectable (worshippers), effuse food and cattle in a stream of water.
verses.wilson_translation: These brilliang Soma-juices (flowing) towards the dwellings of respectable (worshippers), effuse food and cattle in a stream of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुता इंद्राय वज्रिणे सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।पवित्रमत्यक्षरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sutā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀpavítram ǀ áti ǀ akṣaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Soma-juices mixed with curds effused for Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, flow through the filter.
verses.wilson_translation: The Soma-juices mixed with curds effused for Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, flow through the filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोम मधुमत्तमो राये अर्ष पवित्र आ ।मदो यो देववीतमः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀmádaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, pour into the filter to bring us wealth (your juice), which is most sweet-flavoured, exhilarating and most desired by the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, pour into the filter to bring us wealth (your juice), which is most sweet-flavoured, exhilarating and most desired by the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमी मृजंत्यायवो हरिं नदीषु वाजिनं ।इंदुमिंद्राय मत्सरं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ īmíti ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ vājínam ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests cleanse in the (vasatīvarī) waters the green-tinted powerful exhilarating Indufor Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The priests cleanse in the (vasatīvarī) waters the green-tinted powerful exhilarating Indufor Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व हिरण्यवदश्वावत्सोम वीरवत् ।वाजं गोमंतमा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ soma ǀ vīrá-vat ǀvā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, pour forth wealth of gold, horses andmaleoffspring; bring us food and cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, pour forth wealth of gold, horses andmaleoffspring; bring us food and cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि वाजे न वाजयुमव्यो वारेषु सिंचत ।इंद्राय मधुमत्तमं ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ vā́je ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúm ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́reṣu ǀ siñcata ǀíndrāya ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sprinkle upon the woollen fleece for Indrathe most sweet (Soma), desiring battle as if in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Sprinkle upon the woollen fleece for Indrathe most sweet (Soma), desiring battle as if in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कविं मृजंति मर्ज्यं धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः ।वृषा कनिक्रदर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: kavím ǀ mṛjanti ǀ márjyam ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ kánikrat ǀ arṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: The (worshippers) desiring protection, cleanse with their fingers the purifiable (Soma) the sage; with a noise the sprinkler (of benefits) flows forth.
verses.wilson_translation: The (worshippers) desiring protection, cleanse with their fingers the purifiable (Soma) the sage; with a noise the sprinkler (of benefits) flows forth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषणं धीभिरप्तुरं सोममृतस्य धारया ।मती विप्राः समस्वरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ ap-túram ǀ sómam ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀmatī́ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise (priests) in a stream of water send forth with their fingers, and with praise the sprinkler (of benefits), the shedder of water.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise (priests) in a stream of water send forth with their fingers, and with praise the sprinkler (of benefits), the shedder of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व देवायुषगिंद्रं गच्छतु ते मदः ।वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ deva ǀ āyuṣák ǀ índram ǀ gacchatu ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀvāyúm ǀ ā́ ǀ roha ǀ dhármaṇā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow, (Soma), let your exhilarating juice proceed in continuous order to Indra, rise with your supporting (juice to Vāyu).
verses.wilson_translation: Flow, (Soma), let your exhilarating juice proceed in continuous order to Indra, rise with your supporting (juice to Vāyu).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिं सोम श्रवाय्यं ।प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ ní ǀ tośase ǀ rayím ǀ soma ǀ śravā́yyam ǀpriyáḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified Soma, you squeeze forth the celebrated riches (of the enemy); do you who are beloved enter the ocean.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified Soma, you squeeze forth the celebrated riches (of the enemy); do you who are beloved enter the ocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः ।नुदस्वादेवयुं जनं ॥
verses.transliteration: apa-ghnán ǀ pavase ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ kratu-vít ǀ soma ǀ matsaráḥ ǀnudásva ǀ ádeva-yum ǀ jánam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, you who are exhilarating flow defeating the enemies, bestowing knowledge (on us); drive off the people who love not the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, you who are exhilarating flow defeating the enemies, bestowing knowledge (on us); drive off the people who love not the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इंदवः ।अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀ sómāḥ ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀabhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The brilliant purified Soma-juices are let fall amidst all praises.
verses.wilson_translation: The brilliant purified Soma-juices are let fall amidst all praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिंदवः ।घ्नंतो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀghnántaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified Soma-juices flow swift and bright destroying all enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified Soma-juices flow swift and bright destroying all enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमाना दिवस्पर्यंतरिक्षादसृक्षत ।पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānāḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ asṛkṣata ǀpṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified (juices) are poured forth from heaven and from the firmament upon the summit of the ground.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified (juices) are poured forth from heaven and from the firmament upon the summit of the ground.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयेंदो विश्वा अप स्रिधः ।जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ índo íti ǀ víśvā ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǀjahí ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brilliant Soma, do you, purified in a stream, achieving great acts, destroy all foes and therākṣasas.
verses.wilson_translation: Brilliant Soma, do you, purified in a stream, achieving great acts, destroy all foes and therākṣasas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्त्सोम रक्षसोऽभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् ।द्युमंतं शुष्ममुत्तमं ॥
verses.transliteration: apa-ghnán ǀ soma ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ kánikradat ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ut-tamám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroying therākṣasas, pour forth,Soma, with a noise, brilliant and excellent vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroying therākṣasas, pour forth,Soma, with a noise, brilliant and excellent vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मे वसूनि धारय सोम दिव्यानि पार्थिवा ।इंदो विश्वानि वार्या ॥
verses.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ vásūni ǀ dhāraya ǀ sóma ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀíndo íti ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestow upon us,Soma, celestial and terrestrial treasures; (bestow),Indu, all desirable things.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow upon us,Soma, celestial and terrestrial treasures; (bestow),Indu, all desirable things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . Soma, thou art a splendid Steer, a Steer, O God, with steerlike sway:Thou as a Steer ordainest laws. Steer-strong thy might is as a steer's, steerstrong thywood, steer-like thy drinkA Steer indeed, O Steer, art thou. Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine:Unbar for us the doors to wealth. Out of desire of cows and steeds and horses. potent Soma-drops,Brilliant and swift, have been effused. They purified in both the hands, made beautiful by holy men,Flow onward to the fleecy cloth. These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipperFrom heaven and earth and firmament. The streams of Pavamana, thine, Finder of all, have been effused,Even as Sūrya's rays of light. Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every formSoma, thou swellest like a sea. Urged on thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana; thou hast moved,Like the God Sūrya, to the sieve. Indu, Enlightener, Friend, hath been purified by the sages' hymns:So starts the charioteer his steed- Thy God-delighting wave which hath flowed to purifying seive,Alighting in the home of Law. Flow to our sieve, a gladdening draught that hath most intercourse with Gods,Indu, to Indra for his drink. Flow onward with a stream for food, made beautiful by sapient men:Indu with sheen approach the milk. While thou art cleansed, Song-Lover, bring comfort and vigour to the folk,Poured, Tawny One! on milk and curds. Purified for the feast of Gods, go thou to Indra's special place,Resplendent, guided by the strong. Accelerated by the hymn, the rapid drops of Soma juiceHave flowed, urged onward, to the lake. Easily have the living drops, made beautiful, approached the lake,Yea, to the place of sacrifice. Compass about, our faithful Friend, all our possessions with thy might:Guard, hero like, our sheltering home. Loud neighs the Courser Etaśa, with singers, harnessed for the place,Guided for travel to the lake. What time the Swift One resteth in the golden place of sacrifice,He leaves the foolish far away. The friends have sung in unison, the prudent wish to sacrifice:Down sink the unintelligent. For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in sweets,To sit in place of sacrifice. Controlling priests and sages skilled in holy song adorn thee well:The living make thee beautiful. Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa drink Pavamana's juice, yea, thine:O Sage, the Maruts drink thereof. O Soma, Indu, thou while thou art purified urgest onward speech.Thousandfold, with the lore of hymns. Yea, Soma, Indu, while thou art purified do thou bring to usSpeech thousandfold that longs for war. O Indu, Much-invoked, while thou art purifying, as the Friend.Of these men enter thou the lake. Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly. And form that utters loud acclaim. Led by his drivers, and sent forth, the Strong Steed hath come nigh for spoil,Like warriors when they stand arrayed. Specially, Soma, coming as a Sage from heaven to prosper us,Flow like the Sun for us to see.

verses.sanskrit: वृषा सोम द्युमाँ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः ।वृषा धर्माणि दधिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ soma ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ asi ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ deva ǀ vṛ́ṣa-vrataḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ dhármāṇi ǀ dadhiṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, are the bright sprinkler; you shining (Soma) are the sprinkler whose occupation is sprinkling; you, the sprinkler, sustain the rites (of men and gods).
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, are the bright sprinkler; you shining (Soma) are the sprinkler whose occupation is sprinkling; you, the sprinkler, sustain the rites (of men and gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यं शवो वृषा वनं वृषा मदः ।सत्यं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ śávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vánam ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǀsatyám ǀ vṛṣan ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ít ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: O sprinkler, the strengh of you the sprinkler consists in sprinkling, your worship consists in sprinkling,  your juice consists in sprinkling; you truly are always the sprinkler.
verses.wilson_translation: O sprinkler, the strengh of you the sprinkler consists in sprinkling, your worship consists in sprinkling,  your juice consists in sprinkling; you truly are always the sprinkler.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इंदो समर्वतः ।वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakradaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ sám ǀ árvataḥ ǀví ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ dúraḥ ǀ vṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, the sprinkler, you nigh like a horse; you give us cattle, you give us horses; open the doors for our wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, the sprinkler, you nigh like a horse; you give us cattle, you give us horses; open the doors for our wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया ।शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásṛkṣata ǀ prá ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ gavyā́ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ aśva-yā́ ǀśukrā́saḥ ǀ vīra-yā́ ǀ āśávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The powerful, brilliant, rapid Soma-juices are effused in the hope of obtaining cattle, horses, andmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: The powerful, brilliant, rapid Soma-juices are effused in the hope of obtaining cattle, horses, andmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुंभमाना ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः ।पवंते वारे अव्यये ॥
verses.transliteration: śumbhámānāḥ ǀ ṛtayú-bhiḥ ǀ mṛjyámānāḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀpávante ǀ vā́re ǀ avyáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The (Soma-juices) beautified by those desirous of sacrifice, cleansed by theirhands, flow through the woollen fleece.
verses.wilson_translation: The (Soma-juices) beautified by those desirous of sacrifice, cleansed by theirhands, flow through the woollen fleece.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा ।पवंतामांतरिक्ष्या ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ víśvā ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásu ǀ sómāḥ ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀpávantām ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those Soma-juices pour forth for the offerer (of libations) all the treasures of heaven and earth and of the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: May those Soma-juices pour forth for the offerer (of libations) all the treasures of heaven and earth and of the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत ।सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ viśva-vit ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀsū́ryasya-iva ǀ ná ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All-beholding Soma, your streams as you are being purified are sent forth like the rays of the sun at present.
verses.wilson_translation: All-beholding Soma, your streams as you are being purified are sent forth like the rays of the sun at present.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वंदिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि ।समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ketúm ǀ kṛṇván ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ víśvā ǀ rūpā́ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣasi ǀsamudráḥ ǀ soma ǀ pinvase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, you who are the ocean, bestowing knowledge, have from heaven to all our various forms, and bestow (variouskinds of wealth on us).
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, you who are the ocean, bestowing knowledge, have from heaven to all our various forms, and bestow (variouskinds of wealth on us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हिन्वानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि ।अक्रांदेवो न सूर्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: hinvānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣyasi ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǀákrān ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified Soma, when sent forth you utter a cry (when your juice) like the sun god passed through the supporting (filter).
verses.wilson_translation: Purified Soma, when sent forth you utter a cry (when your juice) like the sun god passed through the supporting (filter).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुः पविष्ट चेतनः प्रियः कवीनां मती ।सृजदश्वं रथीरिव ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ paviṣṭa ǀ cétanaḥ ǀ priyáḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ matī́ ǀsṛját ǀ áśvam ǀ rathī́ḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Induthe enlightener, beloved (of the gods), flows forth at the praise of the sages; he lets loose (his wave) as a charioteer his horse.
verses.wilson_translation: Induthe enlightener, beloved (of the gods), flows forth at the praise of the sages; he lets loose (his wave) as a charioteer his horse.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्मिर्यस्ते पवित्र आ देवावीः पर्यक्षरत् ।सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrmíḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ deva-avī́ḥ ǀ pari-ákṣarat ǀsī́dan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your wave which, devoted to the gods flows to the filter, alighting upon the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Your wave which, devoted to the gods flows to the filter, alighting upon the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो अर्ष पवित्र आ मदो यो देववीतमः ।इंदविंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, who are exhilarating and most devoted to the gods, hasten to the filter for Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, who are exhilarating and most devoted to the gods, hasten to the filter for Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः ।इंदो रुचाभि गा इहि ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣé ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ manīṣí-bhiḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ rucā́ ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ihi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Cleansed by the priests,Indu, flow in a stream for (our) food; approach the cattle with food.
verses.wilson_translation: Cleansed by the priests,Indu, flow in a stream for (our) food; approach the cattle with food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः ।हरे सृजान आशिरं ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ ū́rjam ǀ jánāya ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀháre ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ ā-śíram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Green-tinted (Soma) lauded by hymns,being dropped into the curds and milk and being purified, bestow wealth and food upon the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Green-tinted (Soma) lauded by hymns,being dropped into the curds and milk and being purified, bestow wealth and food upon the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानो देववीतय इंद्रस्य याहि निष्कृतं ।द्युतानो वाजिभिर्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ índrasya ǀ yāhi ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀdyutānáḥ ǀ vājí-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified for the banquet of the gods, go to Indra's station radiant, collected together by the vigorous (worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: Purified for the banquet of the gods, go to Indra's station radiant, collected together by the vigorous (worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र हिन्वानास इंदवोऽच्छा समुद्रमाशवः ।धिया जूता असृक्षत ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ hinvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ samudrám ǀ āśávaḥ ǀdhiyā́ ǀ jūtā́ḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The rapid Soma-juices being sent towards the firmament, are poured forth expressed by the fingers.
verses.wilson_translation: The rapid Soma-juices being sent towards the firmament, are poured forth expressed by the fingers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मर्मृजानास आयवो वृथा समुद्रमिंदवः ।अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.transliteration: marmṛjānā́saḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ samudrám ǀ índavaḥ ǀágman ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The swift Soma-juices being cleansed (go to) the firmament without an effort; they go to the abode of the water.
verses.wilson_translation: The swift Soma-juices being cleansed (go to) the firmament without an effort; they go to the abode of the water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि णो याह्यस्मयुर्विश्वा वसून्योजसा ।पाहि नः शर्म वीरवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ ójasā ǀpāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ vīrá-vat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are devoted to us, guard all our treasures with your might; protect our home and offspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are devoted to us, guard all our treasures with your might; protect our home and offspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मिमाति वह्निरेतशः पदं युजान ऋक्वभिः ।प्र यत्समुद्र आहितः ॥
verses.transliteration: mímāti ǀ váhniḥ ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ padám ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ samudré ǀ ā́-hitaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The horse of burden neighs, yoked to the sacrifice by the priests, when plural ced in the ocean.
verses.wilson_translation: The horse of burden neighs, yoked to the sacrifice by the priests, when plural ced in the ocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययमाशुर्ऋतस्य सीदति ।जहात्यप्रचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ yónim ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ āśúḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sī́dati ǀjáhāti ǀ ápra-cetasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the swift (Soma) takes his plural ce on the golden seat of sacrifice, he abandons (the sacrifice) of the foolish man.
verses.wilson_translation: When the swift (Soma) takes his plural ce on the golden seat of sacrifice, he abandons (the sacrifice) of the foolish man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वेना अनूषतेयक्षंति प्रचेतसः ।मज्जंत्यविचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ íyakṣanti ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀmájjanti ǀ ávi-cetasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devoted (worshippers) glorify Soma; the well-disposed desire to sacrifice; the perverse-minded sink (into hell).
verses.wilson_translation: Devoted (worshippers) glorify Soma; the well-disposed desire to sacrifice; the perverse-minded sink (into hell).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रायेंदो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ।ऋतस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ marútvate ǀ pávasva ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Indu, for Indraassociated with the Maruts, you who are most sweet-flavoured, and take your seat on the plural ce of the sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Indu, for Indraassociated with the Maruts, you who are most sweet-flavoured, and take your seat on the plural ce of the sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परि ष्कृण्वंति वेधसः ।सं त्वा मृजंत्यायवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vacaḥ-vídaḥ ǀ pári ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀsám ǀ tvā ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise who are the performers of pious acts, who are acquainted with holy texts, adorn you; men purify you.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise who are the performers of pious acts, who are acquainted with holy texts, adorn you; men purify you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबंति वरुणः कवे ।पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: rásam ǀ te ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ píbanti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ kave ǀpávamānasya ǀ marútaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇaand the Marutsdrink, sage (Soma), your juice as you drop.
verses.wilson_translation: Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇaand the Marutsdrink, sage (Soma), your juice as you drop.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं पुनानो वाचमिष्यसि ।इंदो सहस्रभर्णसं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ punānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣyasi ǀíndo íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brilliant Soma, when purified you utter a sapient speech, feeding thousands.
verses.wilson_translation: Brilliant Soma, when purified you utter a sapient speech, feeding thousands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उतो सहस्रभर्णसं वाचं सोम मखस्युवं ।पुनान इंदवा भर ॥
verses.transliteration: utó íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǀ vā́cam ǀ soma ǀ makhasyúvam ǀpunānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brilliant Soma, when purified bring (us) a voice, feeding thousands and desiring wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Brilliant Soma, when purified bring (us) a voice, feeding thousands and desiring wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनान इंदवेषां पुरुहूत जनानां ।प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ eṣām ǀ púru-hūta ǀ jánānām ǀpriyáḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, invoked by many, do you, being purified and being loved by these your worshippers, enter the ocean.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, invoked by many, do you, being purified and being loved by these your worshippers, enter the ocean.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभंत्या कृपा ।सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: dávidyutatyā ǀ rucā́ ǀ pari-stóbhantyā ǀ kṛpā́ ǀsómāḥ ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ gó-āśiraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bright Soma-juices with their shining radiance and resounding stream are mixed with the milk and the curds.
verses.wilson_translation: The bright Soma-juices with their shining radiance and resounding stream are mixed with the milk and the curds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हिन्वानो हेतृभिर्यत आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत् ।सीदंतो वनुषो यथा ॥
verses.transliteration: hinvānáḥ ǀ hetṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ vājī́ ǀ akramīt ǀsī́dantaḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ yathā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The powerful Somaurged by the urging (worshippers) goes collected to the battle like warriors entering (the battle-field).
verses.wilson_translation: The powerful Somaurged by the urging (worshippers) goes collected to the battle like warriors entering (the battle-field).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋधक्सोम स्वस्तये संजग्मानो दिवः कविः ।पवस्व सूर्यो दृशे ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛdhák ǀ soma ǀ svastáye ǀ sam-jagmānáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀpávasva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are a sage mighty and prospering approaching flow from heaven for our prosperity and view.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are a sage mighty and prospering approaching flow from heaven for our prosperity and view.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE, glittering maids send Sūra forth, the glorious sisters, close-allied,Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord. Pervade, O Pavamana, all our treasures with repeated light,God, coming hither from the Gods. Pour on us, Pavamana, rain, as service and rain praise for Gods:Pour all to be our nourishment. Thou art a Steer by lustre: we, O Pavamana, faithfullyCall upon thee the Splendid One. Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength:O Indu, come thou bitherward. When thou art cleansed with both the hands and dipped in waters, with the wood.Thou comest to the gathering-place. Sing forth your songs, as Vyaśva sang, to Soma Pavamana, to,The Mighty One with thousand eyes; Whose coloured sap they drive with stones, the yellow meath-distilling juice,Indu for Indra, for his drink. We seek to gain the friendly love of thee that Strong and Mighty One,Of thee the winner of all wealth. Flow onward with thy stream, a Steer, inspiriting the Maruts’ Lord,Winning all riches by thy might. I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamana, Strong,Sustainer, looker on the light. Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawny-coloured, with thy streamIncite to battle thine ally. O Indu, visible to all pour out for us abundant food:Soma, be thou our prosperer. The pitchers, Indu, with thy streams have sung aloud in vigorous mightEnter them, and let Indra drink. O thou whose potent gladdening juice they milk out with the stones, flow on,Destroyer of our enemies. King Pavamana is implored with holy songs, on man's behalf,To travel through the firmament. Bring us, O Indu, hundredfold increase of kine, and noble steeds,The gift of fortune for our help. Pressed for the banquet of the Gods, O Soma, bring us might, and speed,Like beauty for a brilliant show. Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the wooden vats,Falcon-like resting in thine home. Soma, the Water-winner flows to Indra, Vāyu, Varuṇa,To Viṣṇu and the Marut host. Soma , bestowing food upon our progeny, from every sides,Pour on us riches thousandfold The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand,Or there on Śaryaṇāvān's bank, Those pressed among Arjikas, pressed among the active, in men's homes,Or pressed among the Races Five- May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow,Rain from the heavens apd hero strength. Urged forward o’er the ox-hide flows the Lovely One of tawny hue,Lauded by Jamadagni's song. Like horses urged to speed, the drops, bright, stirring vital power, when blentWith milk, are beautified in streams. So they who toil with juices send thee forward for the Gods’ repast:So with this splendour flow thou on. We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the Strong, that brings us bliss,The Guardian, the desire of all, The Excellent, the Gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands,The Guardian, the desire of all; Who for ourselves, O thou Most Wise, is wealth and fair intelligence,The Guardian, the desire of all.

verses.sanskrit: हिन्वंति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिं ।महामिंदुं महीयुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: hinvánti ǀ sū́ram ǀ úsrayaḥ ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ pátim ǀmahā́m ǀ índum ǀ mahīyúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The kindred fingers diligently operating, eager to squeeze you forth, send out the invigorating the lord (of all), the mighty Indu.
verses.wilson_translation: The kindred fingers diligently operating, eager to squeeze you forth, send out the invigorating the lord (of all), the mighty Indu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यस्परि ।विश्वा वसून्या विश ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ rucā́-rucā ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀvíśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Filtered Soma, who with reiterated radiance shine in the presence of the gods, obtain all boons (for us).
verses.wilson_translation: Filtered Soma, who with reiterated radiance shine in the presence of the gods, obtain all boons (for us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः ।इषे पवस्व संयतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ su-stutím ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǀiṣé ǀ pavasva ǀ sam-yátam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour, purified (Soma), a well-praised shower for the worship of the gods; (pour) a continual shower for our food.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour, purified (Soma), a well-praised shower for the worship of the gods; (pour) a continual shower for our food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमंतं त्वा हवामहे ।पवमान स्वाध्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ bhānúnā ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǀpávamāna ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We who perform good works praise you, purified Soma, brilliant with radiance, for you are the showerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: We who perform good works praise you, purified Soma, brilliant with radiance, for you are the showerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मंदमानः स्वायुध ।इहो ष्विंदवा गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ mándamānaḥ ǀ su-āyudha ǀihó íti ǀ sú ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Well-armed (Soma) who does exhilarate (the gods) pour forth for usmaleoffspring; come,Indu, favourably to our sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: Well-armed (Soma) who does exhilarate (the gods) pour forth for usmaleoffspring; come,Indu, favourably to our sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदद्भिः परिषिच्यसे मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः ।द्रुणा सधस्थमश्नुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ pari-sicyáse ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀdrúṇā ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ aśnuṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: When cleansed by thehandsyou are sprinkled with the water, (taken up) with the wooden vessel you attain your abode.
verses.wilson_translation: When cleansed by thehandsyou are sprinkled with the water, (taken up) with the wooden vessel you attain your abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमाय व्यश्ववत्पवमानाय गायत ।महे सहस्रचक्षसे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāya ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀ pávamānāya ǀ gāyata ǀmahé ǀ sahásra-cakṣase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing, as Vyaśvadid, to the filtered Somathe great, the all-beholding.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing, as Vyaśvadid, to the filtered Somathe great, the all-beholding.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य वर्णं मधुश्चुतं हरिं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ।इंदुमिंद्राय पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ várṇam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀ hárim ǀ hinvánti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: (That Soma) whose juice they squeeze out with the stones, foe-repelling, honey-dropping, green-tinted, for Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: (That Soma) whose juice they squeeze out with the stones, foe-repelling, honey-dropping, green-tinted, for Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते वाजिनो वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः ।सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tásya ǀ te ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ víśvā ǀ dhánāni ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀsakhi-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: We, who have heaped up oblations, solicit his friendship, (the friendship) of you who have won all the riches (of the foe).
verses.wilson_translation: We, who have heaped up oblations, solicit his friendship, (the friendship) of you who have won all the riches (of the foe).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः ।विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ marútvate ǀ ca ǀ matsaráḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow in a stream, you who are the showerer (of benefits); and (be) exhilarating to the lord of the Marutsgranting us all (wealth) by your power.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow in a stream, you who are the showerer (of benefits); and (be) exhilarating to the lord of the Marutsgranting us all (wealth) by your power.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा धर्तारमोण्योः पवमान स्वर्दृशं ।हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ dhartā́ram ǀ oṇyóḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śam ǀhinvé ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vājínam ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, the supporter of heaven and earth, O purified (Soma), the beholder of heaven, the powerful one, I send forth to battle.
verses.wilson_translation: You, the supporter of heaven and earth, O purified (Soma), the beholder of heaven, the powerful one, I send forth to battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया ।युजं वाजेषु चोदय ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ cittáḥ ǀ vipā́ ǀ anáyā ǀ háriḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀyújam ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ codaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Expressed by these flexible fingers (of mine), do you who are green-tinted flow forth in a stream; excite (Indra) our ally to battle.
verses.wilson_translation: Expressed by these flexible fingers (of mine), do you who are green-tinted flow forth in a stream; excite (Indra) our ally to battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ न इंदो महीमिषं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः ।अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǀ pávasva ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ gātu-vít ǁ
verses.english_translation: Swift-flowing Soma, who are the illuminator of the universe, pour down upon us abundant food, (and be) to us the revealer to the path (to heaven).
verses.wilson_translation: Swift-flowing Soma, who are the illuminator of the universe, pour down upon us abundant food, (and be) to us the revealer to the path (to heaven).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ कलशा अनूषतेंदो धाराभिरोजसा ।एंद्रस्य पीतये विश ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kaláśāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ índo íti ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǀā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ pītáye ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, they praise the vessels together with your streams (who are endowed) with strength; enter for Indra's drinking.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, they praise the vessels together with your streams (who are endowed) with strength; enter for Indra's drinking.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते मद्यं रसं तीव्रं दुहंत्यद्रिभिः ।स पवस्वाभिमातिहा ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ mádyam ǀ rásam ǀ tīvrám ǀ duhánti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ abhimāti-hā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you whose, sharp exhilarating juice the priests express with the stones, flow the destroyer of the evil-minded.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you whose, sharp exhilarating juice the priests express with the stones, flow the destroyer of the evil-minded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि ।अंतरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: rā́jā ǀ medhā́bhiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manáu ǀ ádhi ǀantárikṣeṇa ǀ yā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: The king (Soma) purified at the sacrifice is urged by the priests to pass through the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: The king (Soma) purified at the sacrifice is urged by the priests to pass through the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ न इंदो शतग्विनं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यं ।वहा भगत्तिमूतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ śata-gvínam ǀ gávām ǀ póṣam ǀ su-áśvyam ǀváha ǀ bhágattim ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to us,Indu, for our protection increase of kine with hundreds, of cattle and a gift of fortune with beautiful horses.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to us,Indu, for our protection increase of kine with hundreds, of cattle and a gift of fortune with beautiful horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर ।सुष्वाणो देववीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ júvaḥ ǀ rūpám ǀ ná ǀ várcase ǀ bhara ǀsusvānáḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Be) expressed for the banquet of the gods;bestow on us,Soma, strength, speed and a form for brilliance.
verses.wilson_translation: (Be) expressed for the banquet of the gods;bestow on us,Soma, strength, speed and a form for brilliance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् ।सीदंछ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
verses.transliteration: árṣa ǀ soma ǀ dyumát-tamaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ róruvat ǀsī́dan ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten,Soma, who are most radiant, with a roar to the wooden vessels; as a hawk flying to its nest.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten,Soma, who are most radiant, with a roar to the wooden vessels; as a hawk flying to its nest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अप्सा इंद्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
verses.transliteration: apsā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ víṣṇave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, the enjoyer of the water, hasten (to vessels) for Indra,Vāyu,Varuṇa, the Marut,Viṣṇu.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, the enjoyer of the water, hasten (to vessels) for Indra,Vāyu,Varuṇa, the Marut,Viṣṇu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: íṣam ǀ tokā́ya ǀ naḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bestowing food upon our offspring,Soma, pour from all quarters thousand-fold (wealth).
verses.wilson_translation: Bestowing food upon our offspring,Soma, pour from all quarters thousand-fold (wealth).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे ।ये वादः शर्यणावति ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ parā-váti ǀ yé ǀ arvā-váti ǀ sunviré ǀyé ǀ vā ǀ adáḥ ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those Somajuices which are effused at a distance of nigh or on this Śaryaṇāvat (lake).
verses.wilson_translation: May those Somajuices which are effused at a distance of nigh or on this Śaryaṇāvat (lake).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानां ।ये वा जनेषु पंचसु ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ ārjīkéṣu ǀ kṛ́tva-su ǀ yé ǀ mádhye ǀ pastyā́nām ǀyé ǀ vā ǀ jáneṣu ǀ pañcá-su ǁ
verses.english_translation: Or among the Ṛjikas, or the Kṛtvas, or in the neighbourhood of the rivers Sarasvatī, or in the five castes.
verses.wilson_translation: Or among the Ṛjikas, or the Kṛtvas, or in the neighbourhood of the rivers Sarasvatī, or in the five castes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवंतामा सुवीर्यं ।सुवाना देवास इंदवः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ pávantām ǀ ā́ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀsuvānā́ḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those brilliant Soma-juices when expressed pour down upon us from heaven rain withmaleprogeny.
verses.wilson_translation: May those brilliant Soma-juices when expressed pour down upon us from heaven rain withmaleprogeny.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिर्गृणानो जमदग्निना ।हिन्वानो गोरधि त्वचि ॥
verses.transliteration: pávate ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ jamát-agninā ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǁ
verses.english_translation: The delightful green-tinted Soma, praised by Jamadagni, urged on the cow-hide flows (to the vessels).
verses.wilson_translation: The delightful green-tinted Soma, praised by Jamadagni, urged on the cow-hide flows (to the vessels).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र शुक्रासो वयोजुवो हिन्वानासो न सप्तयः ।श्रीणाना अप्सु मृंजत ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ vayaḥ-júvaḥ ǀ hinvānā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀśrīṇānā́ḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ mṛñjata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bright Soma-juices, the dispensers of food, being mixed with the curds and milk, are cleansed in the waters like horses urged (by the charioteers).
verses.wilson_translation: The bright Soma-juices, the dispensers of food, being mixed with the curds and milk, are cleansed in the waters like horses urged (by the charioteers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा सुतेष्वाभुवो हिन्विरे देवतातये ।स पवस्वानया रुचा ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ sutéṣu ǀ ā-bhúvaḥ ǀ hinviré ǀ devá-tātaye ǀsáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ anáyā ǀ rucā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The priests who are present send you forth at the rites at which you are effused for the whole of the gods; do you flow with this splendour.
verses.wilson_translation: The priests who are present send you forth at the rites at which you are effused for the whole of the gods; do you flow with this splendour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे ।पांतमा पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ dákṣam ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvam ǀ váhnim ǀ adyá ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀpā́ntam ǀ ā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
verses.english_translation: We have recourse today to your strength, the source of happiness, the bearer (of good things), the defender (against foes), the desired of many.
verses.wilson_translation: We have recourse today to your strength, the source of happiness, the bearer (of good things), the defender (against foes), the desired of many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ मंद्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणं ।पांतमा पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mandrám ǀ ā́ ǀ váreṇyam ǀ ā́ ǀ vípram ǀ ā́ ǀ manīṣíṇam ǀpā́ntam ǀ ā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The exhilarating, the desirable, the wise, the intelligent, the defender (of all), the desired of many.
verses.wilson_translation: The exhilarating, the desirable, the wise, the intelligent, the defender (of all), the desired of many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा ।पांतमा पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rayím ǀ ā́ ǀ su-cetúnam ǀ ā́ ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀpā́ntam ǀ ā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
verses.english_translation: (We have recourse) to your wealth and intelligence for our posterity, O you to whom fair sacrifices are offered, and to you the defender (of all), the desired of many.
verses.wilson_translation: (We have recourse) to your wealth and intelligence for our posterity, O you to whom fair sacrifices are offered, and to you the defender (of all), the desired of many.
