verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ३० शतं वैखानसा: । पवमान: सोम:, १९-२१ अग्नि: पवमान: । गायत्री,१८ अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FOR holy lore of every sort, flow onward thou whom all men love.A Friend to be besought by friends. O'er all thou rulest with these Two which, Soma Pavamana, stand,Turned, as thy stations, hitherward. Wise Soma Pavamana, thou encompassest on every sideThy stations as the seasons come. Flow onward, generating food, for precious boons of every kind,A Friend for friends, to be our help. Upon the lofty ridge of heaven thy bright rays with their essences,Soma, spread purifying power. O Soma, these Seven Rivers flow, as being thine, to give command:The Streams of milk run forth to thee. Flow onward, Soma in a stream, effused to gladden Indra's heart,Bringing imperishable fame. Driving thee in Vivasvān's course, the Seven Sisters with their hymnsMade melody round thee the Sage. The virgins deck thee o’er fresh streams to drive thee to the sieve when thou,A singer, bathest in the wood. The streams of Pavamana, thine, Sage, Mighty One, have pouredthem forth.Like coursers eager for renown. They have been poured upon the fleece towards the meath-distilling vat:The holy songs have sounded forth. Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake,Have reached the place of sacrifice. O Indu, to our great delight the running waters flow to us,When thou wilt robe thyself in milk. In this thy friendship, and with thee to help us, fain to sacrifice,Indu, we crave thy friendly love. Flow on, O Soma, for the great Viewer of men, for gain of IdneEnter thou into Indra's throat. Best art thou, Soma, of the great, Strongest of strong ones, Indu: thouAs Warrior ever hast prevailed. Mightier even than the strong, more valiant even than the brave,More libpral than the bountiful, Soma, as Sūra, bring us food, win offspring of our bodies: weElect thee for our friendship, we elect thee for companionship. Agni, thou pourest life; send down upon us food and vigorous strength;Drive thou misfortune far away, Agni is Pavamana, Sage, Chief Priest of all the Races Five:To him whose wealth is great we pray. Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us,Granting me wealth that nourishes. Beyond his enemies away to sweet praise Pavamana flows,Like Sūrya visible to all. Adorned by living men, set forth for entertainment, rich in food,Far-sighted Indu is a Steed. He, Pavamana, hath produced the lofty Law, the brilliant light,Destroying darkness black of hue. From tawny Pavamana, the Destroyer, radiant streams have sprung,Quick streams from him whose gleams are swift. Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise mid beauteous ones,Gold-gleaming with the Marut host, May Pavamana, best to win the booty, penetrate with rays,Giving the singer hero strength. Over the fleecy sieve hath flowed the drop effused: to Indra comesIndu while he is purified This Soma, through the pressing-stones, is sporting on the oxhide, andSummoning Indra to the draught. O Pavamana, bless us, so that we may live, with that bright milkOf thine which hath been brought from heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व विश्वचर्षणेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या ।सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀsákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: All-seeing (Soma), who are the adorable friend (of the worshippers), flow for (us your) friends towards all (our) hymns of praise.
verses.wilson_translation: All-seeing (Soma), who are the adorable friend (of the worshippers), flow for (us your) friends towards all (our) hymns of praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां विश्वस्य राजसि ये पवमान धामनी ।प्रतीची सोम तस्थतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā́bhyām ǀ víśvasya ǀ rājasi ǀ yé íti ǀ pavamāna ǀ dhā́manī íti ǀpratīcī́ íti ǀ soma ǀ tasthátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You, purified Soma, rule the universe by those two halves (of thelunar month) which stand facing you.
verses.wilson_translation: You, purified Soma, rule the universe by those two halves (of thelunar month) which stand facing you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि धामानि यानि ते त्वं सोमासि विश्वतः ।पवमान ऋतुभिः कवे ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ dhā́māni ǀ yā́ni ǀ te ǀ tvám ǀ soma ǀ asi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀpávamāna ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ kave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since your splendour abounds, you purified sage,Soma, are everywhere (associated) with the seasons.
verses.wilson_translation: Since your splendour abounds, you purified sage,Soma, are everywhere (associated) with the seasons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व जनयन्निषोऽभि विश्वानि वार्या ।सखा सखिभ्य ऊतये ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ janáyan ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀsákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are a friend, do you for the sake of all our desirable (praises) approach genitive rating food for (us your) friends for our support.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are a friend, do you for the sake of all our desirable (praises) approach genitive rating food for (us your) friends for our support.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव शुक्रासो अर्चयो दिवस्पृष्ठे वि तन्वते ।पवित्रं सोम धामभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhé ǀ ví ǀ tanvate ǀpavítram ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, the shining rays of you who are accompanied by brilliance, spread the purifying (water) over the surface of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, the shining rays of you who are accompanied by brilliance, spread the purifying (water) over the surface of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवेमे सप्त सिंधवः प्रशिषं सोम सिस्रते ।तुभ्यं धावंति धेनवः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ imé ǀ saptá ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pra-śíṣam ǀ soma ǀ sisrate ǀtúbhyam ǀ dhāvanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These your seven rivers flow,Soma, at your command; the kine hasten to you.
verses.wilson_translation: These your seven rivers flow,Soma, at your command; the kine hasten to you.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोम याहि धारया सुत इंद्राय मत्सरः ।दधानो अक्षिति श्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ yāhi ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀdádhānaḥ ǀ ákṣiti ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Proceed,Soma, in a stream when effused, giving exhilaration to Indra, bestowing (upon us) inexhaustible food.
verses.wilson_translation: Proceed,Soma, in a stream when effused, giving exhilaration to Indra, bestowing (upon us) inexhaustible food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समु त्वा धीभिरस्वरन्हिन्वतीः सप्त जामयः ।विप्रमाजा विवस्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ asvaran ǀ hinvatī́ḥ ǀ saptá ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀvípram ǀ ājā́ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The seven kindred (priests) uttering (praises) and worshipping (the gods with oblations) invoked you the sage at the sacrifice with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: The seven kindred (priests) uttering (praises) and worshipping (the gods with oblations) invoked you the sage at the sacrifice with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मृजंति त्वा समग्रुवोऽव्ये जीरावधि ष्वणि ।रेभो यदज्यसे वने ॥
verses.transliteration: mṛjánti ǀ tvā ǀ sám ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ ávye ǀ jīráu ǀ ádhi ǀ sváni ǀrebháḥ ǀ yát ǀ ajyáse ǀ váne ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fingers cleanse you in the quickly made loud-sounding (woollen) filter, when with a noise you are sprinkled with the water.
verses.wilson_translation: The fingers cleanse you in the quickly made loud-sounding (woollen) filter, when with a noise you are sprinkled with the water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन्त्सर्गा असृक्षत ।अर्वंतो न श्रवस्यवः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ te ǀ kave ǀ vā́jin ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀárvantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sage Soma, possessor of food, your food-desiring streams when you are filtered are let loose like horses.
verses.wilson_translation: Sage Soma, possessor of food, your food-desiring streams when you are filtered are let loose like horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतमसृग्रं वारे अव्यये ।अवावशंत धीतयः ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀ ásṛgram ǀ vā́re ǀ avyáye ǀávāvaśanta ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They are let loose in the woollen filter (to go) towards the honey-dropping vessel; our fingers have desired them.
verses.wilson_translation: They are let loose in the woollen filter (to go) towards the honey-dropping vessel; our fingers have desired them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा समुद्रमिंदवोऽस्तं गावो न धेनवः ।अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.transliteration: áccha ǀ samudrám ǀ índavaḥ ǀ ástam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀágman ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Soma-juices go to the ocean, as kine to their stall; they go the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: The Soma-juices go to the ocean, as kine to their stall; they go the plural ce of sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ण इंदो महे रण आपो अर्षंति सिंधवः ।यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mahé ǀ ráṇe ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀyát ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vāsayiṣyáse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, the flowing waters hasten to our great sacrifices when you are mixed with the curds and milk.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, the flowing waters hasten to our great sacrifices when you are mixed with the curds and milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य ते सख्ये वयमियक्षंतस्त्वोतयः ।इंदो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ásya ǀ te ǀ sakhyé ǀ vayám ǀ íyakṣantaḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtayaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ uśmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, we abiding in your friendship, desiring to sacrifice, depending on your protection, desire your friendship.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, we abiding in your friendship, desiring to sacrifice, depending on your protection, desire your friendship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व गविष्टये महे सोम नृचक्षसे ।एंद्रस्य जठरे विश ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ gó-iṣṭaye ǀ mahé ǀ soma ǀ nṛ-cákṣase ǀā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ jaṭháre ǀ viśa ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, for the mighty cattle-seeker, the beholder of men, enter Indra's belly.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, for the mighty cattle-seeker, the beholder of men, enter Indra's belly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महाँ असि सोम ज्येष्ठ उग्राणामिंद ओजिष्ठः ।युध्वा संछश्वज्जिगेथ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ soma ǀ jyéṣṭhaḥ ǀ ugrā́ṇām ǀ indo íti ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀyúdhvā ǀ sán ǀ śáśvat ǀ jigetha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, you are great, most worthy to be praised;Indu, (you are) the most vigorous of the mighty; engaged in battle you ever triumph.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, you are great, most worthy to be praised;Indu, (you are) the most vigorous of the mighty; engaged in battle you ever triumph.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य उग्रेभ्यश्चिदोजीयांछूरेभ्यश्चिच्छूरतरः ।भूरिदाभ्यश्चिन्मंहीयान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ugrébhyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ójīyān ǀ śū́rebhyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ śū́ra-taraḥ ǀbhūri-dā́bhyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ máṃhīyān ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You) who (are) mightier than the mighty, braver than the brave, more genitive rous than the genitive rous.
verses.wilson_translation: (You) who (are) mightier than the mighty, braver than the brave, more genitive rous than the genitive rous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोम सूर एषस्तोकस्य साता तनूनां ।वृणीमहे सख्याय वृणीमहे युज्याय ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ tokásya ǀ sātā́ ǀ tanū́nām ǀvṛṇīmáhe ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ vṛṇīmáhe ǀ yújyāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, who are a hero (bestow) upon (us) food, (be) the giver of sons (to us); we choose you for your friendship, (we choose you) for your alliance.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, who are a hero (bestow) upon (us) food, (be) the giver of sons (to us); we choose you for your friendship, (we choose you) for your alliance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्न आयूंषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः ।आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनां ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ pavase ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǀ ū́rjam ǀ íṣam ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀāré ǀ bādhasva ǀ ducchúnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, you support our lives, send us nutriment and food, drive far off therākṣasas.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, you support our lives, send us nutriment and food, drive far off therākṣasas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्ऋषिः पवमानः पांचजन्यः पुरोहितः ।तमीमहे महागयं ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyaḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀtám ǀ īmahe ǀ mahā-gayám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the all-beholding, who is in the form of the Pavamāna, the benefactor of the five orders, the preceder at sacrifice; him we solicit, who is hymned by the great.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the all-beholding, who is in the form of the Pavamāna, the benefactor of the five orders, the preceder at sacrifice; him we solicit, who is hymned by the great.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यं ।दधद्रयिं मयि पोषं ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ pávasva ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ várcaḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀdádhat ǀ rayím ǀ máyi ǀ póṣam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, who are the doer of good, pour upon us brightness and fair-offspring; may he make me wealth and plural nty.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who are the doer of good, pour upon us brightness and fair-offspring; may he make me wealth and plural nty.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो अति स्रिधोऽभ्यर्षति सुष्टुतिं ।सूरो न विश्वदर्शतः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣati ǀ su-stutím ǀsū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified (Soma) hastens past the adversaries towards the fair praise of the worshippers, visible to all like the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified (Soma) hastens past the adversaries towards the fair praise of the worshippers, visible to all like the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिः प्रयस्वान्प्रयसे हितः ।इंदुरत्यो विचक्षणः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ marmṛjānáḥ ǀ āyú-bhiḥ ǀ práyasvān ǀ práyase ǀ hitáḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Repeatedly purified by the priests,Indu, abounding with food, plural ced for food, the beholder of all continually goes (to the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Repeatedly purified by the priests,Indu, abounding with food, plural ced for food, the beholder of all continually goes (to the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान ऋतं बृहच्छुक्रं ज्योतिरजीजनत् ।कृष्णा तमांसि जंघनत् ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǀ śukrám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ajījanat ǀkṛṣṇā́ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ jáṅghanat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified (Soma) genitive rated the veracious all-pervading bright-shining light, destroying the black darkness.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified (Soma) genitive rated the veracious all-pervading bright-shining light, destroying the black darkness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य जंघ्नतो हरेश्चंद्रा असृक्षत ।जीरा अजिरशोचिषः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ jáṅghnataḥ ǀ háreḥ ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀjīrā́ḥ ǀ ajirá-śociṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The gladsome swift-moving streams of the purified, green-tinted, unfadingly radiant (Soma), the destroyer (of darkness), have been let forth.
verses.wilson_translation: The gladsome swift-moving streams of the purified, green-tinted, unfadingly radiant (Soma), the destroyer (of darkness), have been let forth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः ।हरिश्चंद्रो मरुद्गणः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ rathí-tamaḥ ǀ śubhrébhiḥ ǀ śubhráśaḥ-tamaḥ ǀhári-candraḥ ǀ marút-gaṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified (Soma) possessing many chariots, most radiant with beauteous splendours, having green-tinted streams, attended by the Maruts.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified (Soma) possessing many chariots, most radiant with beauteous splendours, having green-tinted streams, attended by the Maruts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो व्यश्नवद्रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः ।दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnavat ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ vāja-sā́tamaḥ ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the purified Soma, the most liberal dispenser of food, pervade (the world) with his rays, granting excellentmaleoffspring to the worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: May the purified Soma, the most liberal dispenser of food, pervade (the world) with his rays, granting excellentmaleoffspring to the worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सुवान इंदुरक्षाः पवित्रमत्यव्ययं ।पुनान इंदुरिंद्रमा ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ avyáyam ǀpunānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Induwhen effused drops through the fleecy filter (into the vessel); being filtered Indu (enters) into Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Induwhen effused drops through the fleecy filter (into the vessel); being filtered Indu (enters) into Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष सोमो अधि त्वचि गवां क्रीळत्यद्रिभिः ।इंद्रं मदाय जोहुवत् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀ gávām ǀ krīḷati ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndram ǀ mádāya ǀ jóhuvat ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somasports with the stones upon the cowhide, calling Indrafor exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somasports with the stones upon the cowhide, calling Indrafor exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते द्युम्नवत्पयः पवमानाभृतं दिवः ।तेन नो मृळ जीवसे ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ dyumná-vat ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ ā́-bhṛtam ǀ diváḥ ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷa ǀ jīváse ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified (Soma),bless us with long life by means of that your nutritious milk which has been brought from heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified (Soma),bless us with long life by means of that your nutritious milk which has been brought from heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVII. Soma and Others.
hymns.anukramani: (१-३२) १-३ भरद्वाजो बार्हस्पत्य:, ४-६ कश्यपो मारीच:, ७-९ गोतमो राहूगण:, १०-१२ अत्रिर्भौम:, १३-१५ विश्वामित्रो गाथिन:, १६-१८ जमदग्निर्भार्गव:, १९-२१ वसिष्ठो मैत्रावरुणि:,२२-३२ पवित्र आङ्गिरसो  वा वसिष्ठो वा उभौ वा । पवमानः सोम:, १०-१२ पवमानः पूषा वा, २३-२७ पवमानोऽग्नि:, २५ पवमानः सविता वा, २६ पवमानाग्निसवितार:, २७ विश्वे देवा वा , ३१-३२ पवमान्यध्येता ।गायत्री, १६ -१८ नित्यद्विपदा गायत्री , ३० पुरउष्णिक्; २७ ,३१ ,३२, अनुष्टुप् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU, Soma, hast a running stream, joyous, most strong at sacrifice:Flow bounteously bestowing wealth. Effused as cheerer of the men, flowing best gladdener, thou artA Prince to Indra with thy juice. Poured forth by pressing-stones, do thou with loud roar send us in a streamMost excellent illustrious might. Indu, urged forward, floweth through the fleecy cloth: the Tawny OneWith his loud roar hath brought as strength. Indu, thou flowest through the fleece, bringing felicities and fame,And, Soma, spoil and wealth in kine. Hither, O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds and cattle hundredfold:Bring wealth, O Soma, thousandfold. In purifying, through the sieve the rapid drops of'Soma juiceCome nigh to Indra in their course. For Indra floweth excellent Indu, the noblest Soma juiceThe Living for the Living One. The glittering maids send Sūra forth they with their song have sung aloudTo Pavamana dropping meath. May Pūṣan, drawn by goats, be our protector, and on all his pathsBestow on us our share of maids. This Soma flows like gladdening oil for him who wears the braided locks:He shall give us our share of maids. This Soma juice, O glowing God, flows like pure oil, effused for thee:He shall give us our share of maids. Flow onward, Soma, in thy stream, begetter of the sages' speech:Wealth-giver among Gods art thou. The Falcon dips within the jars: he wrapḥim in his robe and goesLoud roaring to the vats of wood. Soma, thy juice hath been effused and poured into the pitcher: likeA rapid hawk it rushes on. For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight. They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots that display their strength. Brilliant, best givers of delight, these juices have sent Vāyu forth. Bruised by the press-stones and extolled, Soma, thou goest to the sieve,Giving the worshipper hero strength. This juice bruised by the pressing-stones and lauded passes through the sieve,Slayer of demons, through the fleece. O Pavamana, drive away the danger, whether near at handOr far remote, that finds me here. This day may Pavamana cleanse us with his purifying power,Most active purifying Priest. O Agni, with the cleansing light diffused through all thy fiery glow,Purify thou this prayer of ours. Cleanse us with thine own cleansing power, O Agni, that is bright with flame,And by libations poured to thee. Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power,Purify me on every side. Cleanse us, God Savitar, with Three, O Soma, with sublimest forms,Agni, with forms of power and might. May the Gods’ company make me clean, and Vasus make rue pure by song.Purify me, ye General Gods; O Jātavedas, make me pure. Fill thyself full of juice, flow forth, O Soma, thou with all thy stalks,The best oblation to the Gods. We with our homage have approached the Friend who seeks our wondering praise,Young, strengthener of the solemn rite. Lost is Alayya's axe. O Soma, God do thou send it back hither in thy flowEven, Soma, God, if ’twere a mole. The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns,Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Mātariśvan's touch. Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns,Sarasvatī draws forth for him water and butter, milk and meath.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सोमासि धारयुर्मंद्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे ।पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ asi ǀ dhārayúḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀpávasva ǀ maṃhayát-rayiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You,Soma, who are most exhilarating, most powerful, are disposed to shed your stream at our sacrifice; flow then you who are the giver or riches.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Soma, who are most exhilarating, most powerful, are disposed to shed your stream at our sacrifice; flow then you who are the giver or riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सुतो नृमादनो दधन्वान्मत्सरिंतमः ।इंद्राय सूरिरंधसा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ sutáḥ ǀ nṛ-mā́danaḥ ǀ dadhanvā́n ǀ matsarín-tamaḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ sūríḥ ǀ ándhasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who are the exhilarator o fthe priests, bestowing (wealth upon them) and intelligent, do you when effused together with food be the especial cause of exhilaration to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: You who are the exhilarator o fthe priests, bestowing (wealth upon them) and intelligent, do you when effused together with food be the especial cause of exhilaration to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् ।द्युमंतं शुष्ममुत्तमं ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ susvānáḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ kánikradat ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ut-tamám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you when effused by the stones proceed resounding (to the vessel); (grant) bright excellent strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you when effused by the stones proceed resounding (to the vessel); (grant) bright excellent strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति तिरो वाराण्यव्यया ।हरिर्वाजमचिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ tiráḥ ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀháriḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ acikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indueffused (by the stones) passes through the woollen filter; green-tinted he roars forth food.
verses.wilson_translation: Indueffused (by the stones) passes through the woollen filter; green-tinted he roars forth food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदो व्यव्यमर्षसि वि श्रवांसि वि सौभगा ।वि वाजान्त्सोम गोमतः ॥
verses.transliteration: índo íti ǀ ví ǀ ávyam ǀ arṣasi ǀ ví ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ ví ǀ sáubhagā ǀví ǀ vā́jān ǀ soma ǀ gó-mataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, you have flowed through the fleece, you grant us food and wealth; (therefore grant us),Soma, strength of flocks.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, you have flowed through the fleece, you grant us food and wealth; (therefore grant us),Soma, strength of flocks.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ न इंदो शतग्विनं रयिं गोमंतमश्विनं ।भरा सोम सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ śata-gvínam ǀ rayím ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀbhára ǀ soma ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu,Soma, bring us thousand-fold wealth, consisting of hundreds of cows, having excellent cows and horses.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu,Soma, bring us thousand-fold wealth, consisting of hundreds of cows, having excellent cows and horses.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानास इंदवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः ।इंद्रं यामेभिराशत ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀíndram ǀ yā́mebhiḥ ǀ āśata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified swift-flowing Soma-juices passing hrough the filter reach Indraby their own paths.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified swift-flowing Soma-juices passing hrough the filter reach Indraby their own paths.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ककुहः सोम्यो रस इंदुरिंद्राय पूर्व्यः ।आयुः पवत आयवे ॥
verses.transliteration: kakuháḥ ǀ somyáḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀāyúḥ ǀ pavate ǀ āyáve ǁ
verses.english_translation: The excellent juice of the Somadropping (into the vessels) poured forth by men of old, the goer (to Indra), is filtered for Indra the goer.
verses.wilson_translation: The excellent juice of the Somadropping (into the vessels) poured forth by men of old, the goer (to Indra), is filtered for Indra the goer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हिन्वंति सूरमुस्रयः पवमानं मधुश्चुतं ।अभि गिरा समस्वरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: hinvánti ǀ sū́ram ǀ úsrayaḥ ǀ pávamānam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀabhí ǀ girā́ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: The fingers express the purified honey-dropping heroic Soma; (the worshippers) hail him with praise.
verses.wilson_translation: The fingers express the purified honey-dropping heroic Soma; (the worshippers) hail him with praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अविता नो अजाश्वः पूषा यामनियामनि ।आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: avitā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ajá-aśvaḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ yā́mani-yāmani ǀā́ ǀ bhakṣat ǀ kanyā́su ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the goat-borne Pūṣanin all his paths be our protector; may he bestow maidens on us.
verses.wilson_translation: May the goat-borne Pūṣanin all his paths be our protector; may he bestow maidens on us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं सोमः कपर्दिने घृतं न पवते मधु ।आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kapardíne ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pavate ǀ mádhu ǀā́ ǀ bhakṣat ǀ kanyā́su ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somaflows to Pūṣan, who wears a beautiful tiara like exhilarating ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somaflows to Pūṣan, who wears a beautiful tiara like exhilarating ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं त आघृणे सुतो घृतं न पवते शुचि ।आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ sutáḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pavate ǀ śúci ǀā́ ǀ bhakṣat ǀ kanyā́su ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somapoured for you, shining (Pūṣan) flows like pure ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somapoured for you, shining (Pūṣan) flows like pure ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वाचो जंतुः कवीनां पवस्व सोम धारया ।देवेषु रत्नधा असि ॥
verses.transliteration: vācáḥ ǀ jantúḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀdevéṣu ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, genitive rator of the praises of the wise, flow in a stream; you are the dispenser of treasure among the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, genitive rator of the praises of the wise, flow in a stream; you are the dispenser of treasure among the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ कलशेषु धावति श्येनो वर्म वि गाहते ।अभि द्रोणा कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ dhāvati ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ várma ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǀabhí ǀ dróṇā ǀ kánikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: He has flowed to the vessels as a falcon enters its nest and enters the wooden (vessels) with a cry.
verses.wilson_translation: He has flowed to the vessels as a falcon enters its nest and enters the wooden (vessels) with a cry.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि प्र सोम ते रसोऽसर्जि कलशे सुतः ।श्येनो न तक्तो अर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ prá ǀ soma ǀ te ǀ rásaḥ ǀ ásarji ǀ kaláśe ǀ sutáḥ ǀśyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ taktáḥ ǀ arṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your juice,Soma, spreads around when effused into the vessel as a swift falcon rushes along.
verses.wilson_translation: Your juice,Soma, spreads around when effused into the vessel as a swift falcon rushes along.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम मंदयन्निंद्राय मधुमत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ mandáyan ǀ índrāya ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, who are most sweet-flavoured, giving exhilaration to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, who are most sweet-flavoured, giving exhilaration to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असृग्रंदेववीतये वाजयंतो रथा इव ॥
verses.transliteration: ásṛgran ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The Soma-juices) are let loose for the banquet of the gods like chariots desiring the wealth (of the enemy).
verses.wilson_translation: (The Soma-juices) are let loose for the banquet of the gods like chariots desiring the wealth (of the enemy).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते सुतासो मदिंतमाः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ madín-tamāḥ ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ asṛkṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: These effused (Soma-juices), brilliant and extremely exhilarating, are let forth for Vāyu.
verses.wilson_translation: These effused (Soma-juices), brilliant and extremely exhilarating, are let forth for Vāyu.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ग्राव्णा तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि ।दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: grā́vṇā ǀ tunnáḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ soma ǀ gacchasi ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bruised with the stones and effused (by the worshippers), you,Soma; enter the filter, bestowing upon your praiser (wealth), accompanied with excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Bruised with the stones and effused (by the worshippers), you,Soma; enter the filter, bestowing upon your praiser (wealth), accompanied with excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रमति गाहते ।रक्षोहा वारमव्ययं ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ tunnáḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ gāhate ǀrakṣaḥ-hā́ ǀ vā́ram ǀ avyáyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: This (Soma), bruised (with the stones), and praised by (all), the slayer ofrākṣasas, plural nge through the woollen filter (into the vessel).
verses.wilson_translation: This (Soma), bruised (with the stones), and praised by (all), the slayer ofrākṣasas, plural nge through the woollen filter (into the vessel).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यदंति यच्च दूरके भयं विंदति मामिह ।पवमान वि तज्जहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ ánti ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ dūraké ǀ bhayám ǀ vindáti ǀ mā́m ǀ ihá ǀpávamāna ǀ ví ǀ tát ǀ jahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whatever fear seizes me, near, afar off, or here, purified (Soma) dispel that (fear).
verses.wilson_translation: Whatever fear seizes me, near, afar off, or here, purified (Soma) dispel that (fear).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमानः सो अद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः ।यः पोता स पुनातु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ adyá ǀ naḥ ǀ pavítreṇa ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ potā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ punātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May that purified Soma, the beholder of all, who is the purifier, purify us now by his purifying (might).
verses.wilson_translation: May that purified Soma, the beholder of all, who is the purifier, purify us now by his purifying (might).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमंतरा ।ब्रह्म तेन पुनीहि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ pavítram ǀ arcíṣi ǀ ágne ǀ ví-tatam ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀbráhma ǀ téna ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purify,Agni, our divine (body) with your purifying (light), which is diffused in the midst of the light.
verses.wilson_translation: Purify,Agni, our divine (body) with your purifying (light), which is diffused in the midst of the light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिवदग्ने तेन पुनीहि नः ।ब्रह्मसवैः पुनीहि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ pavítram ǀ arci-vát ǀ ágne ǀ téna ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǀbrahma-saváiḥ ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purify us,Agni, with your purifying (light) which possesses the light; purify us with the effusion of the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Purify us,Agni, with your purifying (light) which possesses the light; purify us with the effusion of the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च ।मां पुनीहि विश्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ubhā́bhyām ǀ deva ǀ savitaḥ ǀ pavítreṇa ǀ savéna ǀ ca ǀmā́m ǀ punīhi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Shining (Soma), urger of all things, purify me by both, by your purifying (light) and by the effusion (of the Soma); purify me in every way
verses.wilson_translation: Shining (Soma), urger of all things, purify me by both, by your purifying (light) and by the effusion (of the Soma); purify me in every way
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिष्ट्वं देव सवितर्वर्षिष्ठैः सोम धामभिः ।अग्ने दक्षैः पुनीहि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tri-bhíḥ ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ savitaḥ ǀ várṣiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀágne ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purify us, shining Agni Pavamāna, urger of all things, with your three most mighty powerful forms.
verses.wilson_translation: Purify us, shining Agni Pavamāna, urger of all things, with your three most mighty powerful forms.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनंतु मां देवजनाः पुनंतु वसवो धिया ।विश्वे देवाः पुनीत मा जातवेदः पुनीहि मा ॥
verses.transliteration: punántu ǀ mā́m ǀ deva-janā́ḥ ǀ punántu ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀvíśve ǀ devāḥ ǀ punītá ǀ mā ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ punīhí ǀ mā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the worshippers purify me, may the Vasuspurify (me) by their acts; purify me, all you gods, (Agni) the intelligent purify me.
verses.wilson_translation: May the worshippers purify me, may the Vasuspurify (me) by their acts; purify me, all you gods, (Agni) the intelligent purify me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र प्यायस्व प्र स्यंदस्व सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः ।देवेभ्य उत्तमं ह���िः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ pyāyasva ǀ prá ǀ syandasva ǀ sóma ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ aṃśú-bhiḥ ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ ut-tamám ǀ havíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, nourish (us), pour forth for the gods with all your juices the most excellent oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, nourish (us), pour forth for the gods with all your juices the most excellent oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप प्रियं पनिप्नतं युवानमाहुतीवृधं ।अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ priyám ǀ pánipnatam ǀ yúvānam ǀ āhuti-vṛ́dham ǀáganma ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀ námaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let us approach bearing the beloved loud-sounding youthful oblation fostered by our offerings.
verses.wilson_translation: Let us approach bearing the beloved loud-sounding youthful oblation fostered by our offerings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अलाय्यस्य परशुर्ननाश तमा पवस्व देव सोम ।आखुं चिदेव देव सोम ॥
verses.transliteration: alā́yyasya ǀ paraśúḥ ǀ nanāśa ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ deva ǀ soma ǀākhúm ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ deva ǀ soma ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the battle-axe of the foe destroy the foe; alone flow tous, bright Soma; (slay) the villain only, bright Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: May the battle-axe of the foe destroy the foe; alone flow tous, bright Soma; (slay) the villain only, bright Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः संभृतं रसं ।सर्वं स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ pāvamānī́ḥ ǀ adhi-éti ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ rásam ǀsárvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ pūtám ǀ aśnāti ǀ svaditám ǀ mātaríśvanā ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who reads the hymns to Pavamāna, the essence (of the Veda) collected by the ṛṣis, enjoys all (his food) purified, sweetened by Mātariśvan.
verses.wilson_translation: He who reads the hymns to Pavamāna, the essence (of the Veda) collected by the ṛṣis, enjoys all (his food) purified, sweetened by Mātariśvan.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः संभृतं रसं ।तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकं ॥
verses.transliteration: pāvamānī́ḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ adhi-éti ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ rásam ǀtásmai ǀ sárasvatī ǀ duhe ǀ kṣīrám ǀ sarpíḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ udakám ǁ
verses.english_translation: For him who reads the hymns to Pavamāna, the essence (of the Veda) collected by the ṛṣis,Sarasvatīmilks milk,gheeand exhilarating Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: For him who reads the hymns to Pavamāna, the essence (of the Veda) collected by the ṛṣis,Sarasvatīmilks milk,gheeand exhilarating Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE drops of Soma juice like cows who yield their milk have flowed forth, rich in meath, unto the Shining One,And, seated on the grass, raising their voice, assumed the milk, the covering robe wherewith the udders stream. He bellows with a roar arourd the highest twigs: the Tawny One is sweetened as he breaks them up.Then passing through the sieve into the ample room, the God throws off the dregs according to his wish. The gladdening drink that measured out the meeting Twins fills full with milk the Eternal Ever-waxing Pair.Bringing to light the Two great Regions limitless, moving above them he gained sheen that never fades. Wandering through, the Parents, strengthening the floods, the Sage makes his place swell with his own native might.The stalk is mixed with grain: he comes led by the men together with the sisters, and preserves the Head. With energetic intellect the Sage is born, deposited as germ of Law, far from the Twins.They being young at first showed visibly distinct the Creature that is half-concealed and half-exposed. The sages knew the form of him the Gladdener, what time the Falcon brought the plant from far away.Him who assures success they beautified in streams, the stalk who yearned therefor, mighty and meet for praise. Together with the Ṛṣis, with their prayers and hymns ten women deck thee, Soma, friendly when effused.Led by the men, with invocations of the Gods, through the fleece, thou hast given us strength to win the spoil. Songs resonant with praise have celebrated him. Soma, Friend, springing forth with his fair company.Even him who rich in meath, with undulating stream, Winnner of Wealth, Immortal, sends his voice from heaven, He sends it into all the region forth from heaven. Soma, while he is filtcred, settles in the jars.With milk and waters is he decked when pressed with stones: Indu, when purified, shall find sweet rest and room. Even thus poured forth How on thy way, O Soma, vouchsafing us most manifold lively vigour.We will invoke benevolent Earth and Heaven. Give us, ye Gods, riches with noble heroes.

verses.sanskrit: प्र देवमच्छा मधुमंत इंदवोऽसिष्यदंत गाव आ न धेनवः ।बर्हिषदो वचनावंत ऊधभिः परिस्रुतमुस्रिया निर्णिजं धिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ devám ǀ áccha ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ ásisyadanta ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀbarhi-sádaḥ ǀ vacanā́-vantaḥ ǀ ū́dha-bhiḥ ǀ pari-srútam ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ dhire ǁ
verses.english_translation: The exhilarating Soma-juices flow towards the shining (Indra), as kine (have to their calves); the lowing kine sitting on thebarhisgrass hold in their udders the pure (juice) welling up.
verses.wilson_translation: The exhilarating Soma-juices flow towards the shining (Indra), as kine (have to their calves); the lowing kine sitting on thebarhisgrass hold in their udders the pure (juice) welling up.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स रोरुवदभि पूर्वा अचिक्रददुपारुहः श्रथयन्त्स्वादते हरिः ।तिरः पवित्रं परियन्नुरु ज्रयो नि शर्याणि दधते देव आ वरं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ róruvat ǀ abhí ǀ pū́rvāḥ ǀ acikradat ǀ upa-ārúhaḥ ǀ śratháyan ǀ svādate ǀ háriḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ pari-yán ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ ní ǀ śáryāṇi ǀ dadhate ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǁ
verses.english_translation: He with a noise re-echoes the principal (praises), separating the growing herbs, the green-tinted (Soma) sweetens them; passing through the filter, (he exerts) great speed, he annihilates therākṣasas, the shining (Soma) bestows wealth (upon the worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: He with a noise re-echoes the principal (praises), separating the growing herbs, the green-tinted (Soma) sweetens them; passing through the filter, (he exerts) great speed, he annihilates therākṣasas, the shining (Soma) bestows wealth (upon the worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वि यो ममे यम्या संयती मदः साकंवृधा पयसा पिन्वदक्षिता ।मही अपारे रजसी विवेविददभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाज आ ददे ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ mamé ǀ yamyā́ ǀ saṃyatī́ íti sam-yatī́ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ sākam-vṛ́dhā ǀ páyasā ǀ pinvat ǀ ákṣitā ǀmahī́ íti ǀ apāré íti ǀ rájasī íti ǀ vi-vévidat ǀ abhi-vrájan ǀ ákṣitam ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
verses.english_translation: The exhilarating (Soma) who constructed the twin united (heaven and earth) does by means of his juice maintain them growing together, imperishable; he has distinguished these two great unbounded worlds, wandering everywhere, he has assumed imperishable strength.
verses.wilson_translation: The exhilarating (Soma) who constructed the twin united (heaven and earth) does by means of his juice maintain them growing together, imperishable; he has distinguished these two great unbounded worlds, wandering everywhere, he has assumed imperishable strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मातरा विचरन्वाजयन्नपः प्र मेधिरः स्वधया पिन्वते पदं ।अंशुर्यवेन पिपिशे यतो नृभिः सं जामिभिर्नसते रक्षते शिरः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ vi-cáran ǀ vājáyan ǀ apáḥ ǀ prá ǀ médhiraḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ pinvate ǀ padám ǀaṃśúḥ ǀ yávena ǀ pipiśe ǀ yatáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǀ násate ǀ rákṣate ǀ śíraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise (Soma) wandering through the two worlds, sending forth the waters, flattens his station with food; the Soma-juice collected by the priests is mixed with the barley; it is united by the fingers; it protects the head.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise (Soma) wandering through the two worlds, sending forth the waters, flattens his station with food; the Soma-juice collected by the priests is mixed with the barley; it is united by the fingers; it protects the head.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सं दक्षेण मनसा जायते कविर्ऋतस्य गर्भो निहितो यमा परः ।यूना ह संता प्रथमं वि जज्ञतुर्गुहा हितं जनिम नेममुद्यतं ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ dákṣeṇa ǀ mánasā ǀ jāyate ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ yamā́ ǀ paráḥ ǀyū́nā ǀ ha ǀ sántā ǀ prathamám ǀ ví ǀ jajñatuḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ jánima ǀ némam ǀ út-yatam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sage (Soma) is born with developed mind; having his plural ce in the womb of the water, he is deposited (by the gods) by rule from far off; even when young these two were distinct; the birth (of one half) was plural ced in secret, the (other) half was visible.
verses.wilson_translation: The sage (Soma) is born with developed mind; having his plural ce in the womb of the water, he is deposited (by the gods) by rule from far off; even when young these two were distinct; the birth (of one half) was plural ced in secret, the (other) half was visible.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मंद्रस्य रूपं विविदुर्मनीषिणः श्येनो यदंधो अभरत्परावतः ।तं मर्जयंत सुवृधं नदीष्वाँ उशंतमंशुं परियंतमृग्मियं ॥
verses.transliteration: mandrásya ǀ rūpám ǀ vividuḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ yát ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ ábharat ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀtám ǀ marjayanta ǀ su-vṛ́dham ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ uśántam ǀ aṃśúm ǀ pari-yántam ǀ ṛgmíyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The wise (worshippers) know the form of the exhilarating Soma-juice, the food that the falcon brought from afar; they cleanse in the waters the fostering (Soma) delighting (the gods), flowing around, and deserving laudation.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise (worshippers) know the form of the exhilarating Soma-juice, the food that the falcon brought from afar; they cleanse in the waters the fostering (Soma) delighting (the gods), flowing around, and deserving laudation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां मृजंति दश योषणः सुतं सोम ऋषिभिर्मतिभिर्धीतिभिर्हितं ।अव्यो वारेभिरुत देवहूतिभिर्नृभिर्यतो वाजमा दर्षि सातये ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ mṛjanti ǀ dáśa ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sóma ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ hitám ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ deváhūti-bhiḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ā́ ǀ darṣi ǀ sātáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ten fingers cleanse you,Soma, when effused and plural ced in the vessels by the ṛṣis, with praises, religious rites and woollen filters; and collected by the priests with oblations to the gods you bestow food (upon the worshippers) for a gift.
verses.wilson_translation: The ten fingers cleanse you,Soma, when effused and plural ced in the vessels by the ṛṣis, with praises, religious rites and woollen filters; and collected by the priests with oblations to the gods you bestow food (upon the worshippers) for a gift.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परिप्रयंतं वय्यं सुषंसदं सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभः ।यो धारया मधुमाँ ऊर्मिणा दिव इयर्ति वाचं रयिषाळमर्त्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: pari-prayántam ǀ vayyám ǀ su-saṃsádam ǀ sómam ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀ stúbhaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ūrmíṇā ǀ diváḥ ǀ íyarti ǀ vā́cam ǀ rayiṣā́ṭ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Intelligent praises celebrate the wide-flowing (god) delighting Somawho sits in good company, who exhilarating (falls) in a stream with his water from the sky (and) wealth-conquering, immortal, sends out his voice.
verses.wilson_translation: Intelligent praises celebrate the wide-flowing (god) delighting Somawho sits in good company, who exhilarating (falls) in a stream with his water from the sky (and) wealth-conquering, immortal, sends out his voice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं दिव इयर्ति विश्वमा रजः सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति ।अद्भिर्गोभिर्मृज्यते अद्रिभिः सुतः पुनान इंदुर्वरिवो विदत्प्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ diváḥ ǀ iyarti ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ sīdati ǀat-bhíḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ mṛjyate ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ vidat ǀ priyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somasends from heaven all water; bring filtered he settles in the vessels; effused with the stones, he is cleansed with water and milk; the filtered Indubestow delightful wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somasends from heaven all water; bring filtered he settles in the vessels; effused with the stones, he is cleansed with water and milk; the filtered Indubestow delightful wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमानो वयो दधच्चित्रतमं पवस्व ।अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरं ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ pari-sicyámānaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ citrá-tamam ǀ pavasva ǀadveṣé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ huvema ǀ dévāḥ ǀ dhattá ǀ rayím ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Somaoffering (wealth) as soon as you are sprinkled (with the water and milk), pour various kinds of food (upon us); let us invoke the friendly heaven and earth; do you, O gods, grant us wealth with excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: Somaoffering (wealth) as soon as you are sprinkled (with the water and milk), pour various kinds of food (upon us); let us invoke the friendly heaven and earth; do you, O gods, grant us wealth with excellentmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LAID like an arrow on the bow the hymn hath been loosed like a young calf to the udder of its dam.As one who cometh first with full stream she is milked the Soma is impelled to this man's holy rites. The thought is deeply fixed; the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth;And Pavamana, like the shout of combatants, the drop rising in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece. He flows about the sheep-skin, longing for a bride: he looses Aditi's Daughters for the worshipper.The sacred drink hath come, gold-tinted, well-restrained: like a strong Bull he shines, whetting his manly might. The Bull is bellowing; the Cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God's own resting-place.Onward hath Soma passed through the sheep's fair bright fleece, and hath, as ’twere, endued a garment newly washed. The golden-hued, Immortal, newly bathed, puts on a brightly shining vesture that is never harmed.He made the ridge of heaven to be his radiant robe, by sprinkling of the bowls from moisture of the sky. Even as the beams of Sūrya, urging men to speed, that cheer and send to sleep, together rush they forth,These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure. As down the steep slope of a river to the vale, drawn from the Steer the swift strong draughts have found a way.Well be it with the men and cattle in our home. May powers, O Soma, may the people stay with us. Pour out upon us wealth in goods, in gold, in steeds, in cattle and in corn, and great heroic strength.Ye, Soma, are my Fathers, lifted up on high as heads of heaven and makers of the strength of life. These Pavamanas here, these drops of Soma, to Indra have sped forth like cars to booty.Effused, they pass the cleansing fleece, while, gold-hued, they cast their covering off to pour the rain down. O Indu, flow thou on for lofty Indra, flow blameless, very gracious, foe-destroyer.Bring splendid treasures to the man who lauds thee. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect. us.

verses.sanskrit: इषुर्न धन्वन्प्रति धीयते मतिर्वत्सो न मातुरुप सर्ज्यूधनि ।उरुधारेव दुहे अग्र आयत्यस्य व्रतेष्वपि सोम इष्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: íṣuḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhánvan ǀ práti ǀ dhīyate ǀ matíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ ná ǀ mātúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sarji ǀ ū́dhani ǀurúdhārā-iva ǀ duhe ǀ ágre ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀ ásya ǀ vratéṣu ǀ ápi ǀ sómaḥ ǀ iṣyate ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Our) praise is attached (to Indra) as an arrow to the bow; (the Soma-juice) is let loose to (Indra) the fosterer as a calf to the udder to its mother; (Indra sheds blessings) as a cow having a copious stream of milk yields it when coming into the presence (of the calf); in Indra's sacrifices the Soma is stimulated.
verses.wilson_translation: (Our) praise is attached (to Indra) as an arrow to the bow; (the Soma-juice) is let loose to (Indra) the fosterer as a calf to the udder to its mother; (Indra sheds blessings) as a cow having a copious stream of milk yields it when coming into the presence (of the calf); in Indra's sacrifices the Soma is stimulated.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मंद्राजनी चोदते अंतरासनि ।पवमानः संतनिः प्रघ्नतामिव मधुमांद्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ matíḥ ǀ pṛcyáte ǀ sicyáte ǀ mádhu ǀ mandra-ájanī ǀ codate ǀ antáḥ ǀ āsáni ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sam-taníḥ ǀ praghnatā́m-iva ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ pári ǀ vā́ram ǀ arṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: The praise is united (to Indra); the excellent (Soma) is sprinkled; (the Soma stream) emitting plural asant juice is driven into (Indra's) mouth; the filtered diffused exhilarating swift-flowing (Soma) hastens to the fleece like the arrow of the combatants.
verses.wilson_translation: The praise is united (to Indra); the excellent (Soma) is sprinkled; (the Soma stream) emitting plural asant juice is driven into (Indra's) mouth; the filtered diffused exhilarating swift-flowing (Soma) hastens to the fleece like the arrow of the combatants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव्ये वधूयुः पवते परि त्वचि श्रथ्नीते नप्तीरदितेर्ऋतं यते ।हरिरक्रान्यजतः संयतो मदो नृम्णा शिशानो महिषो न शोभते ॥
verses.transliteration: ávye ǀ vadhū-yúḥ ǀ pavate ǀ pári ǀ tvací ǀ śrathnīté ǀ naptī́ḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ yaté ǀháriḥ ǀ akrān ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ sam-yatáḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śobhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma) seeking his spouse is filtered in the sheep-skin; he separates his grand-daughter on the earth for the sacrificer; green-tinted, adorable, collected (in the ladles), exhilarating, he overcomes (his foes); sharpening his vigour he shines like one of might.
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma) seeking his spouse is filtered in the sheep-skin; he separates his grand-daughter on the earth for the sacrificer; green-tinted, adorable, collected (in the ladles), exhilarating, he overcomes (his foes); sharpening his vigour he shines like one of might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उक्षा मिमाति प्रति यंति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यंति निष्कृतं ।अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: ukṣā́ ǀ mimāti ǀ práti ǀ yanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀáti ǀ akramīt ǀ árjunam ǀ vā́ram ǀ avyáyam ǀ átkam ǀ ná ǀ niktám ǀ pári ǀ sómaḥ ǀ avyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bull lows, the cows flow around him; the divine (praises) gather round the station of the radiant (Soma); Soma passes through the white sheep-skin; he clothes himself with it as it were a burnished armouṛ
verses.wilson_translation: The bull lows, the cows flow around him; the divine (praises) gather round the station of the radiant (Soma); Soma passes through the white sheep-skin; he clothes himself with it as it were a burnished armouṛ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अमृक्तेन रुशता वाससा हरिरमर्त्यो निर्णिजानः परि व्यत ।दिवस्पृष्ठं बर्हणा निर्णिजे कृतोपस्तरणं चम्वोर्नभस्मयं ॥
verses.transliteration: ámṛktena ǀ rúśatā ǀ vā́sasā ǀ háriḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ niḥ-nijānáḥ ǀ pári ǀ vyata ǀdiváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ barháṇā ǀ niḥ-níje ǀ kṛta ǀ upa-stáraṇam ǀ camvóḥ ǀ nabhasmáyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The immortal green-tinted Somawhen purified is arranged in an uncleaned shining vestment; he ahs created (Āditya) who stands on the back of the sky for the destruction (of sin) and purification, (and has created) Āditya's brilliance, the cover of the two worlds.
verses.wilson_translation: The immortal green-tinted Somawhen purified is arranged in an uncleaned shining vestment; he ahs created (Āditya) who stands on the back of the sky for the destruction (of sin) and purification, (and has created) Āditya's brilliance, the cover of the two worlds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुपः साकमीरते ।तंतुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेंद्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन ॥
verses.transliteration: sū́ryasya-iva ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ dravayitnávaḥ ǀ matsarā́saḥ ǀ pra-súpaḥ ǀ sākám ǀ īrate ǀtántum ǀ tatám ǀ pári ǀ sárgāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ índrāt ǀ ṛté ǀ pavate ǀ dhā́ma ǀ kím ǀ caná ǁ
verses.english_translation: The rushing exhilarating foe-slaying Soma-juices when let loose flow together round the extended cloth like the sun's rays; they flow to no other person n except Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The rushing exhilarating foe-slaying Soma-juices when let loose flow together round the extended cloth like the sun's rays; they flow to no other person n except Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सिंधोरिव प्रवणे निम्न आशवो वृषच्युता मदासो गातुमाशत ।शं नो निवेशे द्विपदे चतुष्पदेऽस्मे वाजाः सोम तिष्ठंतु कृष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration: síndhoḥ-iva ǀ pravaṇé ǀ nimné ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-cyutāḥ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ āśata ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ ni-veśé ǀ dvi-páde ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǀ asmé íti ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ soma ǀ tiṣṭhantu ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The exhilarating (Soma-juices) poured forth by the sprinklers effect their way to Indraas in a waterfall of a river the percvading (waters find their way) to dry ground; bless on our return our two-footed and four-footed things; may food and offspring ever abide with us.
verses.wilson_translation: The exhilarating (Soma-juices) poured forth by the sprinklers effect their way to Indraas in a waterfall of a river the percvading (waters find their way) to dry ground; bless on our return our two-footed and four-footed things; may food and offspring ever abide with us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवदश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत्सुवीर्यं ।यूयं हि सोम पितरो मम स्थन दिवो मूर्धानः प्रस्थिता वयस्कृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vásu-mat ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ gó-mat ǀ yáva-mat ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ soma ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ máma ǀ sthána ǀ diváḥ ǀ mūrdhā́naḥ ǀ prá-sthitāḥ ǀ vayaḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour upon us (wealth) comprising treasure, gold, horses, cattle, barley, and excellentmaleoffspring; you,Somaare my progenitors, the chiefs of heaven, plural ced (for sacrificial), the offerers of oblation.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour upon us (wealth) comprising treasure, gold, horses, cattle, barley, and excellentmaleoffspring; you,Somaare my progenitors, the chiefs of heaven, plural ced (for sacrificial), the offerers of oblation.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते सोमाः पवमानास इंद्रं रथा इव प्र ययुः सातिमच्छ ।सुताः पवित्रमति यंत्यव्यं हित्वी वव्रिं हरितो वृष्टिमच्छ ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ yayuḥ ǀ sātím ǀ áccha ǀsutā́ḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ yanti ǀ ávyam ǀ hitvī́ ǀ vavrím ǀ harítaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ áccha ǁ
verses.english_translation: These filtered Soma-juices advance to Indraworthy of honour, as (Indra's) chariots advance to battle; expressed (with the stones) they pass through the woollen filter, casting off infirmity the horses go towards the rain.
verses.wilson_translation: These filtered Soma-juices advance to Indraworthy of honour, as (Indra's) chariots advance to battle; expressed (with the stones) they pass through the woollen filter, casting off infirmity the horses go towards the rain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदविंद्राय बृहते पवस्व सुमृळीको अनवद्यो रिशादाः ।भरा चंद्राणि गृणते वसूनि देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः ॥
verses.transliteration: índo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ bṛhaté ǀ pavasva ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ anavadyáḥ ǀ riśā́dāḥ ǀbhára ǀ candrā́ṇi ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ vásūni ǀ deváiḥ ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ prá ǀ avatam ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, who do make (men) very happy, the blameless one, the destroyer of foes, flow for mighty Indra; bring to (me) your worshipper gratifying riches; heaven and earth, protect us with auspicious (riches).
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, who do make (men) very happy, the blameless one, the destroyer of foes, flow for mighty Indra; bring to (me) your worshipper gratifying riches; heaven and earth, protect us with auspicious (riches).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE three times seven Milch-kine in the eastern heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught.Four other beauteous Creatures hath he made for his adornment, when he waxed in strength through holy rites. Longing for lovely Amṛta, by his wisdom he divided, each apart from other, earth and heaven.He gladly wrapped himself in the most lucid floods, when through their glory they found the God's resting-place. May those his brilliant rays he ever free from death, inviolate, for both classes of created things,—Rays wherewith powers of men and Gods are purified. Yea, even for this have sageswelcomed him as King. He, while he is adorned by the ten skilful ones, that he too in the Midmost Mothers may create,While he is watching o’er the lovely Amṛta's ways, looks on both races as Beholder of mankind. He, while he is adorned to stream forth mighty strength, rejoices in his place between the earth and heaven.The Steer dispels the evil-hearted with his might, aiming at offerings as an archer at the game. Beholding, as it were, Two Mother Cows, the Steer goes roaring on his way even as the Maruts roar.Knowing Eternal Law, the earliest light of heaven, he, passing wise, was chosen out to tell it forth. The fearful Bull is bellowing with violent might, far-sighted, sharpening his yellowcoloured horns.Soma assumes his seat in the well-fashioned place: the cowhide and the sheepskin are his ornament. Bright, making pure his body free from spot and stain, on the sheep's back the Golden-coloured hath flowed down.Acceptable to Mitra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, he is prepared as threefold meal by skilful men. Flow on for the God's banquet, Soma, as a Steer, and enter Indra's heart, the Soma's reservoir.Bear us beyond misfortune ere we be oppres. sed. the man who knows the land directs the man who asks. Urged like a car-steed flow to strength, O Soma: Indu, flow onward to the throat of Indra.Skilled, bear us past, as in a boat o’er water: as battling Hero save us from the foeman.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रे सत्यामाशिरं पूर्व्ये व्योमनि ।चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ asmai ǀ saptá ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ duduhre ǀ satyā́m ǀ ā-śíram ǀ pūrvyé ǀ ví-omani ǀcatvā́ri ǀ anyā́ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ niḥ-níje ǀ cā́rūṇi ǀ cakre ǀ yát ǀ ṛtáiḥ ǀ ávardhata ǁ
verses.english_translation: For him in the ancient sacrifice thrice seven kine milk forth the right mixture; he makes four other beautiful waters for purification when he is nourished with the sacrifices.
verses.wilson_translation: For him in the ancient sacrifice thrice seven kine milk forth the right mixture; he makes four other beautiful waters for purification when he is nourished with the sacrifices.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स भिक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे ।तेजिष्ठा अपो मंहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ bhíkṣamāṇaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ dyā́vā ǀ kā́vyena ǀ ví ǀ śaśrathe ǀtéjiṣṭhāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ maṃhánā ǀ pári ǀ vyata ǀ yádi ǀ devásya ǀ śrávasā ǀ sádaḥ ǀ vidúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He being solicited for auspicious ambrosia opens both heaven and earth by his intelligence, he covers the lustrious waters with his greatness, when (the priests) with the oblation recognize the station of the radiant (Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: He being solicited for auspicious ambrosia opens both heaven and earth by his intelligence, he covers the lustrious waters with his greatness, when (the priests) with the oblation recognize the station of the radiant (Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते अस्य संतु केतवोऽमृत्यवोऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु ।येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ asya ǀ santu ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ ámṛtyavaḥ ǀ ádābhyāsaḥ ǀ janúṣī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ánu ǀyébhiḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ ca ǀ devyā́ ǀ ca ǀ punaté ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ rā́jānam ǀ manánāḥ ǀ agṛbhṇata ǁ
verses.english_translation: May those his immortal, inviolable rays protect both classes of beings, wherewith he stimulates human (strength) and divine (food); thereupon praises reach the royal (Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: May those his immortal, inviolable rays protect both classes of beings, wherewith he stimulates human (strength) and divine (food); thereupon praises reach the royal (Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मृज्यमानो दशभिः सुकर्मभिः प्र मध्यमासु मातृषु प्रमे सचा ।व्रतानि पानो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे नृचक्षा अनु पश्यते विशौ ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ sukárma-bhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ madhyamā́su ǀ mātṛ́ṣu ǀ pra-mé ǀ sácā ǀvratā́ni ǀ pānáḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ paśyate ǀ víśau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Cleansed by the ten well-working (fingers), the companion (of the waters) stands among the midmost mothers to measure (the worlds); the beholder of men protecting sacred rites (for the sake) of auspicious ambrosia looks after both races.
verses.wilson_translation: Cleansed by the ten well-working (fingers), the companion (of the waters) stands among the midmost mothers to measure (the worlds); the beholder of men protecting sacred rites (for the sake) of auspicious ambrosia looks after both races.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मर्मृजान इंद्रियाय धायस ओभे अंता रोदसी हर्षते हितः ।वृषा शुष्मेण बाधते वि दुर्मतीरादेदिशानः शर्यहेव शुरुधः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ marmṛjānáḥ ǀ indriyā́ya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ ā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ antáríti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ harṣate ǀ hitáḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ śúṣmeṇa ǀ bādhate ǀ ví ǀ duḥ-matī́ḥ ǀ ādédiśānaḥ ǀ śaryahā́-iva ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Being filtered for Indra's world-supporting strength, stationed in the midst of both worlds he goes (everywhere); the showerer destroys the evil-minded by his vigour, challenging theasuraslike an archer.
verses.wilson_translation: Being filtered for Indra's world-supporting strength, stationed in the midst of both worlds he goes (everywhere); the showerer destroys the evil-minded by his vigour, challenging theasuraslike an archer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मातरा न ददृशान उस्रियो नानददेति मरुतामिव स्वनः ।जानन्नृतं प्रथमं यत्स्वर्णरं प्रशस्तये कमवृणीत सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ ná ǀ dádṛśānaḥ ǀ usríyaḥ ǀ nā́nadat ǀ eti ǀ marútām-iva ǀ svanáḥ ǀjānán ǀ ṛtám ǀ prathamám ǀ yát ǀ sváḥ-naram ǀ prá-śastaye ǀ kám ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He repeatedly beholding his parents (heaven and earth) proceeds with a loud noise, like cows (looking at their calves and lowing), and with a roar (like the troop) of Maruts; knowing that water to be the best which is good for all men, the intelligent (pavamāna) chose man to be the offerer of his praise.
verses.wilson_translation: He repeatedly beholding his parents (heaven and earth) proceeds with a loud noise, like cows (looking at their calves and lowing), and with a roar (like the troop) of Maruts; knowing that water to be the best which is good for all men, the intelligent (pavamāna) chose man to be the offerer of his praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रुवति भीमो वृषभस्तविष्यया शृंगे शिशानो हरिणी विचक्षणः ।आ योनिं सोमः सुकृतं नि षीदति गव्ययी त्वग्भवति निर्णिगव्ययी ॥
verses.transliteration: ruváti ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ taviṣyáyā ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ háriṇī íti ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀā́ ǀ yónim ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sú-kṛtam ǀ ní ǀ sīdati ǀ gavyáyī ǀ tvák ǀ bhavati ǀ niḥ-ník ǀ avyáyī ǁ
verses.english_translation: The formidable showerer, the contemplator of all through desire for strength roars, sharpening his green-tinted horns; the Somasettles on his well-prepared station; the cowhide is his cleanser and the sheep-skin (too).
verses.wilson_translation: The formidable showerer, the contemplator of all through desire for strength roars, sharpening his green-tinted horns; the Somasettles on his well-prepared station; the cowhide is his cleanser and the sheep-skin (too).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुचिः पुनानस्तन्वमरेपसमव्ये हरिर्न्यधाविष्ट सानवि ।जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे त्रिधातु मधु क्रियते सुकर्मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ arepásam ǀ ávye ǀ háriḥ ǀ ní ǀ adhāviṣṭa ǀ sā́navi ǀjúṣṭaḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ mádhu ǀ kriyate ǀ sukárma-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brilliant cleansing his sinless body, the green-tinted (Soma) is plural ced on the high-plural ced fleece; sufficient for Mitra,Varuṇa, and Vāyuthe exhilarating (Soma) mixed with the three ingredients is prepared by the performers of good rites.
verses.wilson_translation: Brilliant cleansing his sinless body, the green-tinted (Soma) is plural ced on the high-plural ced fleece; sufficient for Mitra,Varuṇa, and Vāyuthe exhilarating (Soma) mixed with the three ingredients is prepared by the performers of good rites.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम देववीतये वृषेंद्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश ।पुरा नो बाधाद्दुरिताति पारय क्षेत्रविद्धि दिश आहा विपृच्छते ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ índrasya ǀ hā́rdi ǀ soma-dhā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀpurā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bādhā́t ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ áti ǀ pāraya ǀ kṣetra-vít ǀ hí ǀ díśaḥ ǀ ā́ha ǀ vi-pṛcchaté ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow Soma, the showerer, for the banquet for the gods; enter the Soma-vessel dear to Indra; bring us safe past the hostile (rākṣasas) before the oppress us; for he who knows the country tells the direction to him who asks (the way).
verses.wilson_translation: Flow Soma, the showerer, for the banquet for the gods; enter the Soma-vessel dear to Indra; bring us safe past the hostile (rākṣasas) before the oppress us; for he who knows the country tells the direction to him who asks (the way).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: हितो न सप्तिरभि वाजमर्षेंद्रस्येंदो जठरमा पवस्व ।नावा न सिंधुमति पर्षि विद्वांछूरो न युध्यन्नव नो निदः स्पः ॥
verses.transliteration: hitáḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ arṣa ǀ ��ndrasya ǀ indo íti ǀ jaṭháram ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀnāvā́ ǀ ná ǀ síndhum ǀ áti ǀ parṣi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ yúdhyan ǀ áva ǀ naḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǀ sparíti spaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten (to the vessel) as a horse when urged (hastens) to the battle; flow Induinto Indra's belly; all knowing (Soma) bear us (safe) across, as (boatmen bear people) across a river in a boat; fighting like a hero, defend us from the reviling (of the foe).
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten (to the vessel) as a horse when urged (hastens) to the battle; flow Induinto Indra's belly; all knowing (Soma) bear us (safe) across, as (boatmen bear people) across a river in a boat; fighting like a hero, defend us from the reviling (of the foe).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN LXXI. Soma Pavamana,
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE guerdon is bestowed: the Mighty takes his Seat, and, ever-Watchful, guards from fiend and evil sprite.Gold-hued, he makes the cloud his diadem, the milk his carpet in both worlds, and prayer his robe of state. Strong, bellowing, he goes, like one who slays the folk; he lets this hue of Asuras flow off from him,Throws off his covering, seeks his father's meeting-place, and thus makes for himself the bright robe he assumes. Onward he flows, from both the hands, pressed out with stones: excited by the prayer, the water makes him wild.He frolics and draws near, completes his work with song, and bathes in streams to satisfy the worshipper. They pour out meath around the Master of the house, Celestial Strengthener of the mountain that gives might;In whom, through his great powers, oblation-eating cows in their uplifted udder mix their choicest milk. They, the ten sisters, on the lap of Aditi, have sent him forward like a car from both the arms.He wanders and comes near the Cow's mysterious place, even the place which his inventions have produced. Like as a falcon to his home, so speeds the God to his own golden wisely-tashioned place to rest.With song they urge the darling to the sacred grass: the Holy One goes like a courser to the Gods. From far away, from heaven, the redhued noted Sage, Steer of the triple height, hath sung unto the kine.With thousand guidings he, leading this way and that, shines, as a singer, splendidly through many a morn. His covering assumes a radiant hue; where’er he comes into the fight he drives the foe afar.The Winner of the Floods, with food he seeks the host of heaven, he comes to praises glorified with milk. Like a bull roaming round the herds he bellows: he hath assumed the brilliancy of Sūrya.Down to the earth hath looked the heavenly Falcon: Soma with wisdom views all living creatures.

verses.sanskrit: आ दक्षिणा सृज्यते शुष्म्यासदं वेति द्रुहो रक्षसः पाति जागृविः ।हरिरोपशं कृणुते नभस्पय उपस्तिरे चम्वोर्ब्रह्म निर्णिजे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ sṛjyate ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ ā-sádam ǀ véti ǀ druháḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ pāti ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ opaśám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ upa-stíre ǀ camvóḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ niḥ-níje ǁ
verses.english_translation: The donation is given; the vigorous (Soma) enters his resting-plural ce, and, vigilant, guards (his worshippers) against the malignantrākṣasas; the green-tinted (Soma) produces the all-sustaining water of the sun; (he plural ces) the mighty sun to cover the two worlds, to purify (created things).
verses.wilson_translation: The donation is given; the vigorous (Soma) enters his resting-plural ce, and, vigilant, guards (his worshippers) against the malignantrākṣasas; the green-tinted (Soma) produces the all-sustaining water of the sun; (he plural ces) the mighty sun to cover the two worlds, to purify (created things).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र कृष्टिहेव शूष एति रोरुवदसुर्यं वर्णं नि रिणीते अस्य तं ।जहाति वव्रिं पितुरेति निष्कृतमुपप्रुतं कृणुते निर्णिजं तना ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ kṛṣṭihā́-iva ǀ śūṣáḥ ǀ eti ǀ róruvat ǀ asuryám ǀ várṇam ǀ ní ǀ riṇīte ǀ asya ǀ tám ǀjáhāti ǀ vavrím ǀ pitúḥ ǀ eti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ upa-prútam ǀ kṛṇute ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ tánā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The powerful (Soma) advances with a roar like a slayer of men; he puts forth thatasura-slaying tint of his; he abandons bodily infirmity; the food goes to the prepared (altar); he assumes a form advancing to the outstretched (filter).
verses.wilson_translation: The powerful (Soma) advances with a roar like a slayer of men; he puts forth thatasura-slaying tint of his; he abandons bodily infirmity; the food goes to the prepared (altar); he assumes a form advancing to the outstretched (filter).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अद्रिभिः सुतः पवते गभस्त्योर्वृषायते नभसा वेपते मती ।स मोदते नसते साधते गिरा नेनिक्ते अप्सु यजते परीमणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pavate ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ vṛṣa-yáte ǀ nábhasā ǀ vépate ǀ matī́ ǀsáḥ ǀ modate ǀ násate ǀ sā́dhate ǀ girā́ ǀ nenikté ǀ ap-sú ǀ yájate ǀ párīmaṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Expressed with the stones by thehands(the Soma) flows; he moves like a bull; (worshipped) with praise he wanders through the firmament; he rejoices, he is embraced; (praised) with a hymn he fulfills (the desire of the worshippers), he is cleansed in the waters, he is honoured at the (god) protected (sacrifice).
