verses.sanskrit: समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे ।अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyáḥ ǀ mṛjyate ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀ yaśáḥ-taraḥ ǀ yaśásām ǀ kṣáitaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀabhí ǀ svara ǀ dhánva ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma), the most famous of the famous, the earht-born, the conciliator, is cleansed for us in the elevated fleece; sound aloud in the firmament when purified; do you ever protect us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma), the most famous of the famous, the earht-born, the conciliator, is cleansed for us in the elevated fleece; sound aloud in the firmament when purified; do you ever protect us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र गायताभ्यर्चाम देवान्त्सोमं हिनोत महते धनाय ।स्वादुः पवाते अति वारमव्यमा सीदाति कलशं देवयुर्नः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ gāyata ǀ abhí ǀ arcāma ǀ devā́n ǀ sómam ǀ hinota ǀ mahaté ǀ dhánāya ǀsvādúḥ ǀ pavāte ǀ áti ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǀ ā́ ǀ sīdāti ǀ kaláśam ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sing (to the Soma), let us praise the gods; send forth the Soma for (the acquisition of) great wealth. He passes sweet-flavoured pure through the fleecy filter; our (Soma) devoted to the gods alights on the pitcher.
verses.wilson_translation: Sing (to the Soma), let us praise the gods; send forth the Soma for (the acquisition of) great wealth. He passes sweet-flavoured pure through the fleecy filter; our (Soma) devoted to the gods alights on the pitcher.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुर्देवानामुप सख्यमायन्त्सहस्रधारः पवते मदाय ।नृभिः स्तवानो अनु धाम पूर्वमगन्निंद्रं महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ úpa ǀ sakhyám ǀ ā-yán ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ pavate ǀ mádāya ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dhā́ma ǀ pū́rvam ǀ ágan ǀ índram ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inducoming to obtain the friendship of the god; flows in a thousand streams for (their) exhilaration, glorified by the priests (he proceeds) to his ancient station, he proceeds to Indrafor the sake of great prosperity (to the worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: Inducoming to obtain the friendship of the god; flows in a thousand streams for (their) exhilaration, glorified by the priests (he proceeds) to his ancient station, he proceeds to Indrafor the sake of great prosperity (to the worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रे राये हरिरर्षा पुनान इंद्रं मदो गच्छतु ते भराय ।देवैर्याहि सरथं राधो अच्छा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: stotré ǀ rāyé ǀ háriḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ punānáḥ ǀ índram ǀ mádaḥ ǀ gacchatu ǀ te ǀ bhárāya ǀdeváiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ sa-rátham ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma), when our praise is offered, flow green-tinted and purified, to (bring us) riches, may your exhilarating beverage animate Indrato battle. Go in the same car with the gods to (procure us) wealth; do you ever protect us with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma), when our praise is offered, flow green-tinted and purified, to (bring us) riches, may your exhilarating beverage animate Indrato battle. Go in the same car with the gods to (procure us) wealth; do you ever protect us with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति ।महिव्रतः शुचिबंधुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ kā́vyam ǀ uśánā-iva ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánima ǀ vivakti ǀmáhi-vrataḥ ǀ śúci-bandhuḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ padā́ ǀ varāháḥ ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ rébhan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Reciting sacred praise like Uṣanas the praiser (Vṛṣagaṇa) proclaims the births of the gods; assiduous in pious observances, of brilliant radiance, purifying (from sin), he approaches the filter making a noise (as) a wild boar (makes a noise) with its foot.
verses.wilson_translation: Reciting sacred praise like Uṣanas the praiser (Vṛṣagaṇa) proclaims the births of the gods; assiduous in pious observances, of brilliant radiance, purifying (from sin), he approaches the filter making a noise (as) a wild boar (makes a noise) with its foot.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र हंसासस्तृपलं मन्युमच्छामादस्तं वृषगणा अयासुः ।आंगूष्यं पवमानं सखायो दुर्मर्षं साकं प्र वदंति वाणं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ haṃsā́saḥ ǀ tṛpálam ǀ manyúm ǀ áccha ǀ amā́t ǀ ástam ǀ vṛ́ṣa-gaṇāḥ ǀ ayāsuḥ ǀāṅgūṣyám ǀ pávamānam ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ duḥ-márṣam ǀ sākám ǀ prá ǀ vadanti ǀ vāṇám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Vṛṣagaṇas (walking like) swans, (alarmed) at the strength (of the foe), having repaired to the house of sacrifice, to the swift-shooting foe-despising (Soma), the friends sound the flut to the praiseworthy irresistble Pavamāna.
verses.wilson_translation: The Vṛṣagaṇas (walking like) swans, (alarmed) at the strength (of the foe), having repaired to the house of sacrifice, to the swift-shooting foe-despising (Soma), the friends sound the flut to the praiseworthy irresistble Pavamāna.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स रंहत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वृथा क्रीळंतं मिमते न गावः ।परीणसं कृणुते तिग्मशृंगो दिवा हरिर्ददृशे नक्तमृज्रः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ raṃhate ǀ uru-gāyásya ǀ jūtím ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ mimate ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀparīṇasám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ tigmá-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ dívā ǀ háriḥ ǀ dádṛśe ǀ náktam ǀ ṛjráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He moves rapidly (following) the path of (him) the much-praised, (other) goers cannot overtake him (though he is) moving easily; sharp-horned he displays manifold (radiance); the Somaappears green-tinted by day, and clearly visible at night.
verses.wilson_translation: He moves rapidly (following) the path of (him) the much-praised, (other) goers cannot overtake him (though he is) moving easily; sharp-horned he displays manifold (radiance); the Somaappears green-tinted by day, and clearly visible at night.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इंद्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय ।हंति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातीर्वरिवः कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ pavate ǀ gó-nyoghāḥ ǀ índre ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ ínvan ǀ mádāya ǀhánti ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ bā́dhate ǀ pári ǀ árātīḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇván ǀ vṛjánasya ǀ rā́jā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The powerful, flowing Somahaving quantities o fjuice flowing down, streams forth infusing strength into Indrafor his exhilaration; conferring wealth the king of strength slays therākṣasasand harasses the enemy.
verses.wilson_translation: The powerful, flowing Somahaving quantities o fjuice flowing down, streams forth infusing strength into Indrafor his exhilaration; conferring wealth the king of strength slays therākṣasasand harasses the enemy.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध धारया मध्वा पृचानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः ।इंदुरिंद्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mádhvā ǀ pṛcānáḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ róma ǀ pavate ǀ ádri-dugdhaḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devásya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ mádāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Milked forth by the stones the Somaflows through the (sheep's) hair coming into contact (with the gods) with its sweet-flavoured stream; the divine exhilarating Indudesiring the friendship of Indraflows for the exhilaration of the deity.
verses.wilson_translation: Milked forth by the stones the Somaflows through the (sheep's) hair coming into contact (with the gods) with its sweet-flavoured stream; the divine exhilarating Indudesiring the friendship of Indraflows for the exhilaration of the deity.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान्त्स्वेन रसेन पृंचन् ।इंदुर्धर्माण्यृतुथा वसानो दश क्षिपो अव्यत सानो अव्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ pavate ǀ punānáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ svéna ǀ rásena ǀ pṛñcán ǀínduḥ ǀ dhármāṇi ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ avyata ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Clothed in plural asant radiance suited to the season, the sportive Induflows purified, reaching the gods with its juice; the ten fingers guide it to the elevated fleece.
verses.wilson_translation: Clothed in plural asant radiance suited to the season, the sportive Induflows purified, reaching the gods with its juice; the ten fingers guide it to the elevated fleece.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेति पृथिवीमुत द्यां ।इंद्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचेतयन्नर्षति वाचमेमां ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ śóṇaḥ ǀ abhi-kánikradat ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ nadáyan ǀ eti ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀíndrasya-iva ǀ vagnúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śṛṇve ǀ ājáu ǀ pra-cetáyan ǀ arṣati ǀ vā́cam ǀ ā́ ǀ imā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Calling out for the praises like) a red bull bellowing after the kine; the Somagoes with a roar through heaven and earth; (his voice) is heard as the voice of Indra, manifesting (himself) he raises this voice.
verses.wilson_translation: (Calling out for the praises like) a red bull bellowing after the kine; the Somagoes with a roar through heaven and earth; (his voice) is heard as the voice of Indra, manifesting (himself) he raises this voice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमंतमंशुं ।पवमानः संतनिमेषि कृण्वन्निंद्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः ॥
verses.transliteration: rasā́yyaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ pínvamānaḥ ǀ īráyan ǀ eṣi ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ aṃśúm ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sam-taním ǀ eṣi ǀ kṛṇván ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pari-sicyámānaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: plural asant to the taste, dripping with milk, you flow pouring forth the sweet-flavoured juice.Soma, when purified and sprinkled, you flow for Indrain a continuous stream.
verses.wilson_translation: plural asant to the taste, dripping with milk, you flow pouring forth the sweet-flavoured juice.Soma, when purified and sprinkled, you flow for Indrain a continuous stream.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नैः ।परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशंतं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ pavasva ǀ madiráḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ uda-grābhásya ǀ namáyan ǀ vadha-snáiḥ ǀpári ǀ várṇam ǀ bháramāṇaḥ ǀ rúśantam ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pári ǀ soma ǀ siktáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus flow, the exhilarator, for Indra's exhilaration bowing down the rain-holder with (your) weapons, assuming brilliant colour, desirous of our cattle, flow,Soma, sprinkled (into the filter).
verses.wilson_translation: Thus flow, the exhilarator, for Indra's exhilaration bowing down the rain-holder with (your) weapons, assuming brilliant colour, desirous of our cattle, flow,Soma, sprinkled (into the filter).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुष्ट्वी न इंदो सुपथा सुगान्युरौ पवस्व वरिवांसि कृण्वन् ।घनेव विष्वग्दुरितानि विघ्नन्नधि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: juṣṭvī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ su-páthā ǀ su-gā́ni ǀ uráu ǀ pavasva ǀ várivāṃsi ǀ kṛṇván ǀghanā́-iva ǀ víṣvak ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ vi-ghnán ǀ ádhi ǀ snúnā ǀ dhanva ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Gratified (with our praises),Indu, flow into the large (vessel), granting us riches coming by holy paths and easily acquired; beating down therākṣasason every side as with a club, flow in a stream upon the elevated fleece.
verses.wilson_translation: Gratified (with our praises),Indu, flow into the large (vessel), granting us riches coming by holy paths and easily acquired; beating down therākṣasason every side as with a club, flow in a stream upon the elevated fleece.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृष्टिं नो अर्ष दिव्यां जिगत्नुमिळावतीं शंगयीं जीरदानुं ।स्तुकेव वीता धन्वा विचिन्वन्बंधूँरिमाँ अवराँ इंदो वायून् ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṭím ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ divyā́m ǀ jigatnúm ǀ íḷā-vatīm ǀ śam-gáyīm ǀ jīrá-dānum ǀstúkā-iva ǀ vītā́ ǀ dhanva ǀ vi-cinván ǀ bándhūn ǀ imā́n ǀ ávarān ǀ indo íti ǀ vāyū́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sending us rain from heaven, quick-falling, food-giving, giving health to our home, promptly munificent; flow,Indu, seeking these lower winds your kinsmen as (one seeking his) beloved infants.
verses.wilson_translation: Sending us rain from heaven, quick-falling, food-giving, giving health to our home, promptly munificent; flow,Indu, seeking these lower winds your kinsmen as (one seeking his) beloved infants.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ग्रंथिं न वि ष्य ग्रथितं पुनान ऋजुं च गातुं वृजिनं च सोम ।अत्यो न क्रदो हरिरा सृजानो मर्यो देव धन्व पस्त्यावान् ॥
verses.transliteration: granthím ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ sya ǀ grathitám ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ṛjúm ǀ ca ǀ gātúm ǀ vṛjinám ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀátyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kradaḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ máryaḥ ǀ deva ǀ dhanva ǀ pastyá-vān ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma), when filtered loose (me) bound (by sin) as (one loose) a knot; (grant me) a straight path and strength. You, green-tinted, neigh like a horse (when you are) let loose; proceed divine (Soma) who are friendly to man, and have a dwelling.
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma), when filtered loose (me) bound (by sin) as (one loose) a knot; (grant me) a straight path and strength. You, green-tinted, neigh like a horse (when you are) let loose; proceed divine (Soma) who are friendly to man, and have a dwelling.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जुष्टो मदाय देवतात इंदो परि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये ।सहस्रधारः सुरभिरदब्धः परि स्रव वाजसातौ नृषह्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: júṣṭaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ devá-tāte ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ snúnā ǀ dhanva ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ su-rabhíḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu, who are adequate for exhilaration flow in a stream to the elevated fleece at the sacrifice; thousand- streaming, fragrant, irresistible, flow for the acquisition of food in the combat.
verses.wilson_translation: Indu, who are adequate for exhilaration flow in a stream to the elevated fleece at the sacrifice; thousand- streaming, fragrant, irresistible, flow for the acquisition of food in the combat.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अरश्मानो येऽरथा अयुक्ता अत्यासो न ससृजानास आजौ ।एते शुक्रासो धन्वंति सोमा देवासस्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: araśmā́naḥ ǀ yé ǀ arathā́ḥ ǀ áyuktāḥ ǀ átyāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sasṛjānā́saḥ ǀ ājáu ǀeté ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ dhanvanti ǀ sómāḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yāta ǀ píbadhyai ǁ
verses.english_translation: These brilliant Somajuices flow like horses let loose inbattle without reins, without chariots, unharnessed; approach them, you gods, to drink.
verses.wilson_translation: These brilliant Somajuices flow like horses let loose inbattle without reins, without chariots, unharnessed; approach them, you gods, to drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा न इंदो अभि देववीतिं परि स्रव नभो अर्णश्चमूषु ।सोमो अस्मभ्यं काम्यं बृहंतं रयिं ददातु वीरवंतमुग्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ abhí ǀ devá-vītim ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀsómaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ kā́myam ǀ bṛhántam ǀ rayím ǀ dadātu ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ ugrám ǁ
verses.english_translation: So,Indu, at our sacrifice pour the water from the firmament into the vessels; may Somabestow upon us desirable riches in abundance withmaleoffspring and strength.
verses.wilson_translation: So,Indu, at our sacrifice pour the water from the firmament into the vessels; may Somabestow upon us desirable riches in abundance withmaleoffspring and strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तक्षद्यदी मनसो वेनतो वाग्ज्येष्ठस्य वा धर्मणि क्षोरनीके ।आदीमायन्वरमा वावशाना जुष्टं पतिं कलशे गाव इंदुं ॥
verses.transliteration: tákṣat ǀ yádi ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ vénataḥ ǀ vā́k ǀ jyéṣṭhasya ǀ vā ǀ dhármaṇi ǀ kṣóḥ ǀ ánīke ǀā́t ǀ īm ǀ āyan ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ júṣṭam ǀ pátim ǀ kaláśe ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ índum ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the praise of the zealous worshipper sanctiies him as that of a noisy (crowd) in front (praises) a distinguished (prince) for the support (he affords); then the cows come to the excellent exhilarating Indu, the lord (of all, abiding) in the pitcher, eager to gratify him (with their milk).
verses.wilson_translation: When the praise of the zealous worshipper sanctiies him as that of a noisy (crowd) in front (praises) a distinguished (prince) for the support (he affords); then the cows come to the excellent exhilarating Indu, the lord (of all, abiding) in the pitcher, eager to gratify him (with their milk).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र दानुदो दिव्यो दानुपिन्व ऋतमृताय पवते सुमेधाः ।धर्मा भुवद्वृजन्यस्य राजा प्र रश्मिभिर्दशभिर्भारि भूम ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ dānu-dáḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ dānu-pinváḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ pavate ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀdharmā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ vṛjanyásya ǀ rā́jā ǀ prá ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ bhāri ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine benefactor of givers, poured (boons) on givers, the intelligent (Soma) distils his true beverage for true (Indra); the radiant (Soma) is the upholder of strength, he is entirely restrained by the ten fingers.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine benefactor of givers, poured (boons) on givers, the intelligent (Soma) distils his true beverage for true (Indra); the radiant (Soma) is the upholder of strength, he is entirely restrained by the ten fingers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रेभिः पवमानो नृचक्षा राजा देवानामुत मर्त्यानां ।द्विता भुवद्रयिपती रयीणामृतं भरत्सुभृतं चार्विंदुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pavítrebhiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ devā́nām ǀ utá ǀ mártyānām ǀdvitā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ rayi-pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ ṛtám ǀ bharat ǀ sú-bhṛtam ǀ cā́ru ǀ índuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified by the filters the observers of man, the sovereign of both gods and mortals, the lord of abundant wealth (Soma), is twofold;Indubears the auspicious collected water.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified by the filters the observers of man, the sovereign of both gods and mortals, the lord of abundant wealth (Soma), is twofold;Indubears the auspicious collected water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाँ इव श्रवसे सातिमच्छेंद्रस्य वायोरभि वीतिमर्ष ।स नः सहस्रा बृहतीरिषो दा भवा सोम द्रविणोवित्पुनानः ॥
verses.transliteration: árvān-iva ǀ śrávase ǀ sātím ǀ áccha ǀ índrasya ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vītím ǀ arṣa ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásrā ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ dāḥ ǀ bháva ǀ soma ǀ draviṇaḥ-vít ǀ punānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten (Soma) to give food to Indraand Vāyulike a horse, for (the sake of giving us) food, to acquire wealth; give us abundant thousand-fold food; Soma, when filtered become the dispenser of riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten (Soma) to give food to Indraand Vāyulike a horse, for (the sake of giving us) food, to acquire wealth; give us abundant thousand-fold food; Soma, when filtered become the dispenser of riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवाव्यो नः परिषिच्यमानाः क्षयं सुवीरं धन्वंतु सोमाः ।आयज्यवः सुमतिं विश्ववारा होतारो न दिवियजो मंद्रतमाः ॥
verses.transliteration: deva-avyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pari-sicyámānāḥ ǀ kṣáyam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ dhanvantu ǀ sómāḥ ǀā-yajyávaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ viśvá-vārāḥ ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ ná ǀ divi-yájaḥ ǀ mandrá-tamāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May the Somajuices which are gratifying to the gods when poured around (into the vessels) bring us a dwelling andmaleoffspring-- (the juice) endeavouring to gain the favour (of the gods), desired by all offering (to the gods) in heaven like the ministrant priests, most exhilarating.
verses.wilson_translation: May the Somajuices which are gratifying to the gods when poured around (into the vessels) bring us a dwelling andmaleoffspring-- (the juice) endeavouring to gain the favour (of the gods), desired by all offering (to the gods) in heaven like the ministrant priests, most exhilarating.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम प्सरसे देवपानः ।महश्चिद्धि ष्मसि हिताः समर्ये कृधि सुष्ठाने रोदसी पुनानः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ deva ǀ devá-tāte ǀ pavasva ǀ mahé ǀ soma ǀ psárase ǀ deva-pā́naḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ smási ǀ hitā́ḥ ǀ sa-maryé ǀ kṛdhí ǀ susthāné íti su-sthāné ǀ ródasī íti ǀ punānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Soma, who are the beverage of the gods, flow at the sacrifice for (their) abundant food; urged on (by you) may we overcome even mighty (foes) in battle; purified do you render heaven and earth happy abodes (for us).
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Soma, who are the beverage of the gods, flow at the sacrifice for (their) abundant food; urged on (by you) may we overcome even mighty (foes) in battle; purified do you render heaven and earth happy abodes (for us).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वो नो क्रदो वृषभिर्युजानः सिंहो न भीमो मनसो जवीयान् ।अर्वाचीनैः पथिभिर्ये रजिष्ठा आ पवस्व सौमनसं न इंदो ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kradaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ siṃháḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ jávīyān ǀarvācī́naiḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ rájiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ saumanasám ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yoked by the priests, you neigh like a horse, (you are) terrible as a lion, swifter than thought;Indu, pour happiness upon us by those which are the most direct of the paths leading hitherward.
verses.wilson_translation: Yoked by the priests, you neigh like a horse, (you are) terrible as a lion, swifter than thought;Indu, pour happiness upon us by those which are the most direct of the paths leading hitherward.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शतं धारा देवजाता असृग्रन्सहस्रमेनाः कवयो मृजंति ।इंदो सनित्रं दिव आ पवस्व पुरएतासि महतो धनस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: śatám ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ devá-jātāḥ ǀ asṛgran ǀ sahásram ǀ enāḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ mṛjanti ǀíndo íti ǀ sanítram ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ asi ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ dhánasya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your hundred streams manifested for the gods are loose; the sages cleanse those thousand (streams); pour wealth upon us,Indu, from heaven; you are the precursor of abundant riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Your hundred streams manifested for the gods are loose; the sages cleanse those thousand (streams); pour wealth upon us,Indu, from heaven; you are the precursor of abundant riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो न सर्गा अससृग्रमह्नां राजा न मित्रं प्र मिनाति धीरः ।पितुर्न पुत्रः क्रतुभिर्यतान आ पवस्व विशे अस्या अजीतिं ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ asasṛgram ǀ áhnām ǀ rā́jā ǀ ná ǀ mitrám ǀ prá ǀ mināti ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀpitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ yatānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ viśé ǀ asyái ǀ ájītim ǁ
verses.english_translation: As the rays of the days of the sun are let loose (so are the streams of the Soma); a prudent king does not abandon his friend; as a son preserving in pious acts (wins) his father's (safety), do you pour upon this people immunity from defeat.
verses.wilson_translation: As the rays of the days of the sun are let loose (so are the streams of the Soma); a prudent king does not abandon his friend; as a son preserving in pious acts (wins) his father's (safety), do you pour upon this people immunity from defeat.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते धारा मधुमतीरसृग्रन्वारान्यत्पूतो अत्येष्यव्यान् ।पवमान पवसे धाम गोनां जज्ञानः सूर्यमपिन्वो अर्कैः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ mádhu-matīḥ ǀ asṛgran ǀ vā́rān ǀ yát ǀ pūtáḥ ǀ ati-éṣi ǀ ávyān ǀpávamāna ǀ pávase ǀ dhā́ma ǀ gónām ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ apinvaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your exhilarating streams are let loose when you pass purified through the woollen fleece;Pavamānayou flow to the supporting (milk) of the kine, as soon as genitive rated you fill the sun with your radiance.
verses.wilson_translation: Your exhilarating streams are let loose when you pass purified through the woollen fleece;Pavamānayou flow to the supporting (milk) of the kine, as soon as genitive rated you fill the sun with your radiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कनिक्रददनु पंथामृतस्य शुक्रो वि भास्यमृतस्य धाम ।स इंद्राय पवसे मत्सरवान्हिन्वानो वाचं मतिभिः कवीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: kánikradat ǀ ánu ǀ pánthām ǀ ṛtásya ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāsi ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀsáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pavase ǀ matsará-vān ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The Soma) cries repeatedly upon the path of the sacrifice; you shine (being) the abode of immortality; possessing exhilaration you flow for Indra, sending forth your voice with the praises of the sages.
verses.wilson_translation: (The Soma) cries repeatedly upon the path of the sacrifice; you shine (being) the abode of immortality; possessing exhilaration you flow for Indra, sending forth your voice with the praises of the sages.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यः सुपर्णोऽव चक्षि सोम पिन्वंधाराः कर्मणा देववीतौ ।एंदो विश कलशं सोमधानं क्रंदन्निहि सूर्यस्योप रश्मिं ॥
verses.transliteration: divyáḥ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ áva ǀ cakṣi ǀ soma ǀ pínvan ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ kármaṇā ǀ devá-vītau ǀā́ ǀ indo íti ǀ viśa ǀ kaláśam ǀ soma-dhā́nam ǀ krándan ǀ ihi ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ úpa ǀ raśmím ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are celestial, well-winged, you look down from heaven, pouring forth your streams by the pious rite at the sacrifice;Indu, enter into the pitcher the receptacle of the Soma; crying aloud approach the sun's rays.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are celestial, well-winged, you look down from heaven, pouring forth your streams by the pious rite at the sacrifice;Indu, enter into the pitcher the receptacle of the Soma; crying aloud approach the sun's rays.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निर्ऋतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषां ।गावो यंति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यंति मतयो वावशानाः ॥
verses.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ īrayati ǀ prá ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhītím ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀgā́vaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ gó-patim ǀ pṛcchámānāḥ ǀ sómam ǀ yanti ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The bearer (of the oblation) utters the three praises, the thought of Brahmathat sustains the sacrifice; the kine come to the cowherd asking (to be milked), the praisers proceed to the Somawith eagerness.
verses.wilson_translation: The bearer (of the oblation) utters the three praises, the thought of Brahmathat sustains the sacrifice; the kine come to the cowherd asking (to be milked), the praisers proceed to the Somawith eagerness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः ।सोमः सुतः पूयते अज्यमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवंते ॥
verses.transliteration: sómam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ sómam ǀ víprāḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ pṛcchámānāḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pūyate ǀ ajyámānaḥ ǀ sóme ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ tri-stúbhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ navante ǁ
verses.english_translation: The kine (are) longing for the Soma; wise men (are) inquiring for him with praises; Soma being effused is purified blended (with milk), our adorations in thetriṣṭubhmetre are united in the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: The kine (are) longing for the Soma; wise men (are) inquiring for him with praises; Soma being effused is purified blended (with milk), our adorations in thetriṣṭubhmetre are united in the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति ।इंद्रमा विश बृहता रवेण वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरंधिं ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ pari-sicyámānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ svastí ǀíndram ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ráveṇa ǀ vardháya ǀ vā́cam ǀ janáya ǀ púram-dhim ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus poured around (into the vessels),Soma, do you when purified flow for our welfare, enter with a great noise into Indra, foster our praise, genitive rate abundant knowledge in us.
verses.wilson_translation: Thus poured around (into the vessels),Soma, do you when purified flow for our welfare, enter with a great noise into Indra, foster our praise, genitive rate abundant knowledge in us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋता मतीनां सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु ।सपंति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ṛtā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ asadat ǀ camū́ṣu ǀsápanti ǀ yám ǀ mithunā́saḥ ǀ ní-kāmāḥ ǀ adhvaryávaḥ ǀ rathirā́saḥ ǀ su-hástāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vigilant Soma, the knower of true praises, being purified, has sat down in the vessels-- (the Soma) whom theadhvaryustouch, combined, emulous, leaders of the sacrifice, auspicious-handed.
verses.wilson_translation: The vigilant Soma, the knower of true praises, being purified, has sat down in the vessels-- (the Soma) whom theadhvaryustouch, combined, emulous, leaders of the sacrifice, auspicious-handed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पुनान उप सूरे न धातोभे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः ।प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती स तू धनं कारिणे न प्र यंसत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sū́re ǀ ná ǀ dhā́tā ǀ ā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ aprāḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ví ǀ sáḥ ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǀpriyā́ ǀ cit ǀ yásya ǀ priyasā́saḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ dhánam ǀ kāríṇe ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
verses.english_translation: The purified (Soma) approaches (Indra) as the year (approaches) the sun, he fills both heaven and earth (with his radiance), he opens (the darkness with his light); may he, the beloved (Soma), whose beloved (streams) are for (our) preservation, bestow upon us wealth like (wages given) to a labourer.
verses.wilson_translation: The purified (Soma) approaches (Indra) as the year (approaches) the sun, he fills both heaven and earth (with his radiance), he opens (the darkness with his light); may he, the beloved (Soma), whose beloved (streams) are for (our) preservation, bestow upon us wealth like (wages given) to a labourer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वाँ अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् ।येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमुष्णन् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vardhitā́ ǀ várdhanaḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ mīḍhvā́n ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ āvīt ǀyéna ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ pada-jñā́ḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ uṣṇán ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Somathe augmenter (of the gods), self-augmenting, being purified, the showerer (of benefits), protect us by his radiance; through whom our forefathers, tracing the footmarks, cognizant of all things, stole the cattle from the rock.
verses.wilson_translation: May Somathe augmenter (of the gods), self-augmenting, being purified, the showerer (of benefits), protect us by his radiance; through whom our forefathers, tracing the footmarks, cognizant of all things, stole the cattle from the rock.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मंजनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य राजा ।वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे सुवान इंदुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ákrān ǀ samudráḥ ǀ prathamé ǀ ví-dharman ǀ janáyan ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rā́jā ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ pavítre ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀ bṛhát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The ocean, the royal (Soma), genitive rating progeny in the outstretched (firmament, the) supporter of the water traverses the universe; the showerer (of benefits), the brilliant Soma when effused increases abundantly in the elevated woollen filter.
verses.wilson_translation: The ocean, the royal (Soma), genitive rating progeny in the outstretched (firmament, the) supporter of the water traverses the universe; the showerer (of benefits), the brilliant Soma when effused increases abundantly in the elevated woollen filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् ।अदधादिंद्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिंदुः ॥
verses.transliteration: mahát ǀ tát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ cakāra ǀ apā́m ǀ yát ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ávṛṇīta ǀ devā́n ǀádadhāt ǀ índre ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ájanayat ǀ sū́rye ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The mighty Somahas achieved this mighty (work) that, being the germ of the waters, he has nourished the gods; purified he has given strength to Indra;Induhas genitive rated the light in the sun.
verses.wilson_translation: The mighty Somahas achieved this mighty (work) that, being the germ of the waters, he has nourished the gods; purified he has given strength to Indra;Induhas genitive rated the light in the sun.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम ॥
verses.transliteration: mátsi ǀ vāyúm ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ rā́dhase ǀ ca ǀ mátsi ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀmátsi ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ mátsi ǀ devā́n ǀ mátsi ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ deva ǀ soma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Exhilarate Vāyufor (our) food and wealth, exhilarate Mitraand Varuṇaas soon as you are filtered; exhilarate the company of the Maruts, exhilarate the gods, exhilarate heaven and earth, divine Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: Exhilarate Vāyufor (our) food and wealth, exhilarate Mitraand Varuṇaas soon as you are filtered; exhilarate the company of the Maruts, exhilarate the gods, exhilarate heaven and earth, divine Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋजुः पवस्व वृजिनस्य हंतापामीवां बाधमानो मृधश्च ।अभिश्रीणन्पयः पयसाभि गोनामिंद्रस्य त्वं तव वयं सखायः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛjúḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vṛjinásya ǀ hantā́ ǀ ápa ǀ ámīvām ǀ bā́dhamānaḥ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ca ǀabhi-śrīṇán ǀ páyaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ abhí ǀ gónām ǀ índrasya ǀ tvám ǀ táva ǀ vayám ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow you who are straight going, the slayer of the crooked-goer, driving away disease and enemies; mixing your juice with thejuice of the kine (you go to the cups); (you are)Indra's (friend), we (are) your friends.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow you who are straight going, the slayer of the crooked-goer, driving away disease and enemies; mixing your juice with thejuice of the kine (you go to the cups); (you are)Indra's (friend), we (are) your friends.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मध्वः सूदं पवस्व वस्व उत्सं वीरं च न आ पवस्वा भगं च ।स्वदस्वेंद्राय पवमान इंदो रयिं च न आ पवस्वा समुद्रात् ॥
verses.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ sū́dam ǀ pavasva ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ útsam ǀ vīrám ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ bhágam ǀ ca ǀsvádasva ǀ índrāya ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ rayím ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ samudrā́t ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour forth a fountain of wealth distilling sweet juice, pour upon usmaleoffspring and riches; flow sweet for Indra, OIndu, when purified; and pour riches upon us from the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour forth a fountain of wealth distilling sweet juice, pour upon usmaleoffspring and riches; flow sweet for Indra, OIndu, when purified; and pour riches upon us from the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमः सुतो धारयात्यो न हित्वा सिंधुर्न निम्नमभि वाज्यक्षाः ।आ योनिं वन्यमसदत्पुनानः समिंदुर्गोभिरसरत्समद्भिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hítvā ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ nimnám ǀ abhí ǀ vājī́ ǀ akṣāríti ǀā́ ǀ yónim ǀ ványam ǀ asadat ǀ punānáḥ ǀ sám ǀ índuḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ asarat ǀ sám ǀ at-bhíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaeffused in a stream, going like a horse flows powerful like a river down a descent; purified he alights on the wooden abode;Indumixes with the milk and curds, (mixes) with the water.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaeffused in a stream, going like a horse flows powerful like a river down a descent; purified he alights on the wooden abode;Indumixes with the milk and curds, (mixes) with the water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य ते पवत इंद्र सोमश्चमूषु धीर उशते तवस्वान् ।स्वर्चक्षा रथिरः सत्यशुष्मः कामो न यो देवयतामसर्जि ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ te ǀ pavate ǀ indra ǀ sómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ uśaté ǀ távasvān ǀsváḥ-cakṣāḥ ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ satyá-śuṣmaḥ ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ deva-yatā́m ǀ ásarji ǁ
verses.english_translation: The following sagacious Somaflows into the cups,Indra, for you, who long (for him)--all-seeing, car-borne, of adequate vigour, who has been sent forth like the wish of the god-desiring (worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: The following sagacious Somaflows into the cups,Indra, for you, who long (for him)--all-seeing, car-borne, of adequate vigour, who has been sent forth like the wish of the god-desiring (worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन वयसा पुनानस्तिरो वर्पांसि दुहितुर्दधानः ।वसानः शर्म त्रिवरूथमप्सु होतेव याति समनेषु रेभन् ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pratnéna ǀ váyasā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ várpāṃsi ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀvásānaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ ap-sú ǀ hótā-iva ǀ yāti ǀ sámaneṣu ǀ rébhan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flowing with (his) ancient food, enveloping the forms of the earth, covering the house of sacrifice which has a threefold protection, (plural ced) in the waters he advances calling aloud at the oblations like a ministrant priest.
verses.wilson_translation: Flowing with (his) ancient food, enveloping the forms of the earth, covering the house of sacrifice which has a threefold protection, (plural ced) in the waters he advances calling aloud at the oblations like a ministrant priest.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नू नस्त्वं रथिरो देव सोम परि स्रव चम्वोः पूयमानः ।अप्सु स्वादिष्ठो मधुमाँ ऋतावा देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा ॥
verses.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ deva ǀ soma ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ camvóḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀap-sú ǀ svā́diṣṭhaḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ satyá-manmā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine Soma, who are car-borne, being filtered (at) our (sacrifice), flow quickly into the cups; most sweet-flavoured in the waters, full of delight, offered at the sacrifice, stimulator of all, who like a god are the object of true praise.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine Soma, who are car-borne, being filtered (at) our (sacrifice), flow quickly into the cups; most sweet-flavoured in the waters, full of delight, offered at the sacrifice, stimulator of all, who like a god are the object of true praise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानोऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।अभी नरं धीजवनं रथेष्ठामभींद्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ vāyúm ǀ vītī́ ǀ arṣa ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀabhí ǀ náram ǀ dhī-jávanam ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ abhí ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vájra-bāhum ǁ
verses.english_translation: Being eulogized, hasten to Vāyu, for (him to) drink; being purified, hasten to Mitraand Varuṇa; (hasten) to the leader, who is quick as thought, mounted on a car, to Indra, the showerer, the wielder of the thunderbolt.
verses.wilson_translation: Being eulogized, hasten to Vāyu, for (him to) drink; being purified, hasten to Mitraand Varuṇa; (hasten) to the leader, who is quick as thought, mounted on a car, to Indra, the showerer, the wielder of the thunderbolt.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः ।अभि चंद्रा भर्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ vástrā ǀ su-vasanā́ni ǀ arṣa ǀ abhí ǀ dhenū́ḥ ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀabhí ǀ candrā́ ǀ bhártave ǀ naḥ ǀ híraṇyā ǀ abhí ǀ áśvān ǀ rathínaḥ ǀ deva ǀ soma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us handsome garments, bring us, when you are purified, cows easily milked; bring for our maintenance gratifying gold; divine Soma, bring us horses fit for chariots.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us handsome garments, bring us, when you are purified, cows easily milked; bring for our maintenance gratifying gold; divine Soma, bring us horses fit for chariots.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XCVIII. Soma Pavamana
hymns.anukramani: १२ अम्बरीषो वार्षागिर:, ऋजिश्वा भारद्वाजश्च । पवमान: सोम: ।अनुष्टुप् , ११ बृहती ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . STREAM on us riches that are sought by many, best at winning strengthRiches, O Indu, thousandfold, glorious, conquering the great. Effused, he hath, as on a car, invested him in fleecy mail:Onward hath Indu flowed in streams, impelled, surrounded by the wood. Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece:He goes erect, as seeking kine in stream, with light, to sacrifice. For thou thyself, O Indu, God, to every mortal worshipperAttractest riches thousandfold, made manifest in hundred forms. Good Vṛtra-slayer, may we be still nearest to this wealth of thineWhich many crave, nearest to food and happiness, Resistless One! Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the pair of pressingstones-The wavy Friend whom Indra loves-the twice-five sisters dip and bathe, Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all,Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the Deities. Through longing for this sap of yours ye drink what brings ability,Even him who, dear as heaven's own light, gives to our princes high renown. Indu at holy rites produced you, Heaven and Earth, the Friends of men,Hill-haunting God the Goddesses. They bruised him where the roar was loud. For Vṛtra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink,Poured for the guerdon-giving man, poured for the God who sitteth there. These ancient Somas, at the break of day, have flowed into the sieve,Snorting away at early morn these foolish evil-hearted ones. Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this Most Resplendent One.Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength.

verses.sanskrit: अभि नो वाजसातमं रयिमर्ष पुरुस्पृहं ।इंदो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभ्वासहं ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ vāja-sā́tamam ǀ rayím ǀ arṣa ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀíndo íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǀ tuvi-dyumnám ǀ vibhva-sáham ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us,Indu, strength-bestowing riches, desired bymany, supporting many, far-celebrated and overcoming mighty (foes).
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us,Indu, strength-bestowing riches, desired bymany, supporting many, far-celebrated and overcoming mighty (foes).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि ष्य सुवानो अव्ययं रथे न वर्माव्यत ।इंदुरभि द्रुणा हितो हियानो धाराभिरक्षाः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ syáḥ ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ avyáyam ǀ ráthe ǀ ná ǀ várma ǀ avyata ǀínduḥ ǀ abhí ǀ drúṇā ǀ hitáḥ ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: When effused the Somajuice flows to the woollen (filter) as (a warrior) in a chariot is covered in mail; fitted into the wooden (cask), hurrying forth, it flows in streams.
verses.wilson_translation: When effused the Somajuice flows to the woollen (filter) as (a warrior) in a chariot is covered in mail; fitted into the wooden (cask), hurrying forth, it flows in streams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि ष्य सुवानो अक्षा इंदुरव्ये मदच्युतः ।धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा नैति गव्ययुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ syáḥ ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ índuḥ ǀ ávye ǀ máda-cyutaḥ ǀdhā́rā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ bhrājā́ ǀ ná ǀ éti ǀ gavya-yúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somajuice being effused flows through the fleece diffusing exhilaration; who, being exalted goes to the sacrifice in a stream desiring the milk and curds as (he goes to the firmament) with radiance.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somajuice being effused flows through the fleece diffusing exhilaration; who, being exalted goes to the sacrifice in a stream desiring the milk and curds as (he goes to the firmament) with radiance.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स हि त्वं देव शश्वते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे ।इंदो सहस्रिणं रयिं शतात्मानं विवाससि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ śáśvate ǀ vásu ǀ mártāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀíndo íti ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ śatá-ātmānam ǀ vivāsasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you, divine Indu, grant riches to every man who offers libations, thousand-fold and hundred-fold treasure.
verses.wilson_translation: For you, divine Indu, grant riches to every man who offers libations, thousand-fold and hundred-fold treasure.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्वसो वस्वः पुरुस्पृहः ।नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्नस्याध्रिगो ॥
verses.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ asyá ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ váso íti ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀní ǀ nédiṣṭha-tamāḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ sumnásya ǀ adhrigo ítyadhri-go ǁ
verses.english_translation: Slayer of enemies, may we by your (people);Vasu, (may we be) extremely near your much-coveted wealth; irresistible (Soma), may we be near happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Slayer of enemies, may we by your (people);Vasu, (may we be) extremely near your much-coveted wealth; irresistible (Soma), may we be near happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: द्विर्यं पंच स्वयशसं स्वसारो अद्रिसंहतं ।प्रियमिंद्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयंत्यूर्मिणं ॥
verses.transliteration: dvíḥ ǀ yám ǀ páñca ǀ svá-yaśasam ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ ádri-saṃhatam ǀpriyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myam ǀ pra-snāpáyanti ǀ ūrmíṇam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whom, celebrated, expressed by the stones, dear to Indra, beloved (by all) moving in streams, the twice fiver sister (fingers) bathe (in the sacred waters).
verses.wilson_translation: Whom, celebrated, expressed by the stones, dear to Indra, beloved (by all) moving in streams, the twice fiver sister (fingers) bathe (in the sacred waters).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि त्यं हर्यतं हरिं बभ्रुं पुनंति वारेण ।यो देवान्विश्वाँ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ tyám ǀ haryatám ǀ hárim ǀ babhrúm ǀ punanti ǀ vā́reṇa ǀyáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ víśvān ǀ ít ǀ pári ǀ mádena ǀ sahá ǀ gácchati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him, coveted (by all), green-tinted, brown, they purify with the filter; who goes to all the gods with (his) exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: Him, coveted (by all), green-tinted, brown, they purify with the filter; who goes to all the gods with (his) exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य वो ह्यवसा पांतो दक्षसाधनं ।यः सूरिषु श्रवो बृहद्दधे स्वर्ण हर्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ vaḥ ǀ hí ǀ ávasā ǀ pā́ntaḥ ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanam ǀyáḥ ǀ sūríṣu ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ dadhé ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ haryatáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you by his protection have drunk the strengthening (juice of that Soma) who, beloved (by all) like the sun, has bestowed abundant food upon his worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: For you by his protection have drunk the strengthening (juice of that Soma) who, beloved (by all) like the sun, has bestowed abundant food upon his worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वां यज्ञेषु मानवी इंदुर्जनिष्ट रोदसी ।देवो देवी गिरिष्ठा अस्रेधंतं तुविष्वणि ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vām ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mānavī íti ǀ índuḥ ǀ janiṣṭa ǀ rodasī íti ǀdeváḥ ǀ devī íti ǀ giri-sthā́ḥ ǀ ásredhan ǀ tám ǀ tuvi-sváni ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine heaven and earth the progeny of Manu, the Somajuice is genitive rated at your sacrifices, radiant, abiding in the grinding stones; (the priests) bruise him at the loud-sounding ceremony.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine heaven and earth the progeny of Manu, the Somajuice is genitive rated at your sacrifices, radiant, abiding in the grinding stones; (the priests) bruise him at the loud-sounding ceremony.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे ।नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pā́tave ǀ vṛtra-ghné ǀ pári ǀ sicyase ǀnáre ǀ ca ǀ dákṣiṇā-vate ǀ devā́ya ǀ sadana-sáde ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are poured forth,Soma, for Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, to drink; and for the munificent worshipper who sits in the halls of sacrifice (to give oblations) to god.
verses.wilson_translation: You are poured forth,Soma, for Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, to drink; and for the munificent worshipper who sits in the halls of sacrifice (to give oblations) to god.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ते प्रत्नासो व्युष्टिषु सोमाः पवित्रे अक्षरन् ।अपप्रोथंतः सनुतर्हुरश्चितः प्रातस्ताँ अप्रचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀ sómāḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ akṣaran ǀapa-próthantaḥ ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ huraḥ-cítaḥ ǀ prātáríti ǀ tā́n ǀ ápra-cetasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Those ancient Somajuices flow into the filter at the dawn, driving away in the early morning the concealed and ignorant thieves.
verses.wilson_translation: Those ancient Somajuices flow into the filter at the dawn, driving away in the early morning the concealed and ignorant thieves.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं सखायः पुरोरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः ।अश्याम वाजगंध्यं सनेम वाजपस्त्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ puraḥ-rúcam ǀ yūyám ǀ vayám ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀaśyā́ma ǀ vā́ja-gandhyam ǀ sanéma ǀ vā́ja-pastyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May you and we, intelligent friends, eat the bright Somafragrant and invigorating, may we obtain food and dwellings.
verses.wilson_translation: May you and we, intelligent friends, eat the bright Somafragrant and invigorating, may we obtain food and dwellings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XCIX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THEY for the Bold and Lovely One ply manly vigour like a bow:joyous, in front of songs they weave bright raiment for the Lord Divine. And he, made beautiful by night, dips forward into strengthening food',What time the sacrificer's thoughts speed on his way the Golden-hued. We cleanse this gladdening drink of his the juice which Indra chiefly drinks—-That which kine took into their mouths, of old, and princes take it now. To him, while purifying, they have raised the ancient psalm of praise:And sacred songs which bear the names of Gods have supplicated him. They purify him as he drops, courageous, in the fleecy sieve.Him they instruct as messenger to bear the sage's morning prayer. Soma, best Cheerer, takes his seat, the while they cleanse him in the bowls.He as it were impregns the cow, and babbles on, the Lord of Song. He is effused and beautified, a God for Gods, by skilful men.He penetrates the mighty floods collecting all he knows therein. Pressed, Indu, guided by the men, thou art led to the cleaning sieve.Thou, yielding Indra highest joy, takest thy seat within the bowls.

verses.sanskrit: आ हर्यताय धृष्णवे धनुस्तन्वंति पौंस्यं ।शुक्रां वयंत्यसुराय निर्णिजं विपामग्रे महीयुवः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ haryatā́ya ǀ dhṛṣṇáve ǀ dhánuḥ ǀ tanvanti ǀ páuṃsyam ǀśukrā́m ǀ vayanti ǀ ásurāya ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ vipā́m ǀ ágre ǀ mahīyúvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They stretch the bow of manhood for the beloved courageous (Soma); (the priests) wishing to worship spread out the white filter for the mighty (Soma) in the presence of the sage (deities).
verses.wilson_translation: They stretch the bow of manhood for the beloved courageous (Soma); (the priests) wishing to worship spread out the white filter for the mighty (Soma) in the presence of the sage (deities).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजाँ अभि प्र गाहते ।यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिं हिन्वंति यातवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ kṣapā́ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀ vā́jān ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāhate ǀyádi ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvánti ǀ yā́tave ǁ
verses.english_translation: Consecrated at the end of the night (the Soma) plural nges into the viands, when the fingers of the worshipper press out the green-tinted (juice) to go (to the vessels).
verses.wilson_translation: Consecrated at the end of the night (the Soma) plural nges into the viands, when the fingers of the worshipper press out the green-tinted (juice) to go (to the vessels).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इंद्रपातमः ।यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ asya ǀ marjayāmasi ǀ mádaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ indra-pā́tamaḥ ǀyám ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ āsá-bhiḥ ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: We purify the juice that Somawhich is exhilarating and fit for Indra's drinking; which the approaching worshippers both now and of old take up in their mluths.
verses.wilson_translation: We purify the juice that Somawhich is exhilarating and fit for Indra's drinking; which the approaching worshippers both now and of old take up in their mluths.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत ।उतो कृपंत धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ gā́thayā ǀ purāṇyā́ ǀ punānám ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀutó íti ǀ kṛpanta ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ nā́ma ǀ bíbhratīḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They celebrate the purified Somajuice with an ancient hymn of praise, and the fingers exercising their pressure are able (to prepare the oblation) for the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: They celebrate the purified Somajuice with an ancient hymn of praise, and the fingers exercising their pressure are able (to prepare the oblation) for the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तमुक्षमाणमव्यये वारे पुनंति धर्णसिं ।दूतं न पूर्वचित्तय आ शासते मनीषिणः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ ukṣámāṇam ǀ avyáye ǀ vā́re ǀ punanti ǀ dharṇasím ǀdūtám ǀ ná ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǀ ā́ ǀ śāsate ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him sprinkled (with water) the supporter (of all things) they purify in the woollen filter; the wise (worshippers) instrumental uct him as a messenger to proclaim (their prayers) beforehand (to the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Him sprinkled (with water) the supporter (of all things) they purify in the woollen filter; the wise (worshippers) instrumental uct him as a messenger to proclaim (their prayers) beforehand (to the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पुनानो मदिंतमः सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ।पशौ न रेत आदधत्पतिर्वचस्यते धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ sīdati ǀpaśáu ǀ ná ǀ rétaḥ ǀ ā-dádhat ǀ pátiḥ ǀ vacasyate ǀ dhiyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The most exhilarating Soma, being purified, alights on the vessels; putting his seed (in the vessels) as in a heifer, the protector of the rite is worshipped.
verses.wilson_translation: The most exhilarating Soma, being purified, alights on the vessels; putting his seed (in the vessels) as in a heifer, the protector of the rite is worshipped.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मृज्यते सुकर्मभिर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।विदे यदासु संददिर्महीरपो वि गाहते ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mṛjyate ǀ sukárma-bhiḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀvidé ǀ yát ǀ āsu ǀ sam-dadíḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effused for the gods, the god Somais cleansed by the skilful (priests); when he is recognized among these (people) as the giver (of riches), he plural nges into the mighty waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Effused for the gods, the god Somais cleansed by the skilful (priests); when he is recognized among these (people) as the giver (of riches), he plural nges into the mighty waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुत इंदो पवित्र आ नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ।इंद्राय मत्सरिंतमश्चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ॥
verses.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyase ǀíndrāya ǀ matsarín-tamaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: When effused,Indu, and collected by the priests, you are guided to the filter; you alight on the cups for Indra, exciting exceeding exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: When effused,Indu, and collected by the priests, you are guided to the filter; you alight on the cups for Indra, exciting exceeding exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN C. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Guileless Ones are singing praise to Indra's well beloved Friend,As, in the morning of its life, the mothers lick the new-born calf. O Indu, while they cleanse thee bring, O Soma, doubly-waxing wealthThou in the worshipper's abode causest all treasures to increase. Set free the. song which mind hath yoked, even as thunder frees the rain:All treasures of the earth and heaven, O Soma, thou dost multiply. Thy stream when thou art pressed runs on like some victorious warrior's steedHastening onward through the fleece like a fierce horse who wins the prize. Flow on, Sage Soma, with thy stream to give us mental power and strength,Effused for Indra, for his drink, for Mitra and for Varuṇa. Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, best winner, thou, of spoil,O Soma, as most rich in sweets for Indra, Viṣṇu, and the Gods. The mothers, void of guiles, caress thee Golden-coloured, in the sieve,As cows, O Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands. Thou, Pavamana, movest on with wondrous rays to great renown.Striving within the votary's house thou drivest all the glooms away. Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth.Thou, Pavamana hast assumed thy coat of mail in majesty.

verses.sanskrit: अभी नवंते अद्रुहः प्रियमिंद्रस्य काम्यं ।वत्सं न पूर्व आयुनि जातं रिहंति मातरः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ navante ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ priyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myam ǀvatsám ǀ ná ǀ pū́rve ǀ ā́yuni ǀ jātám ǀ rihanti ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The innocent waters repair to Somadear to Indraand beloved (of all), as the material kine lick the new-born calf at the beginning of its life.
verses.wilson_translation: The innocent waters repair to Somadear to Indraand beloved (of all), as the material kine lick the new-born calf at the beginning of its life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनान इंदवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिं ।त्वं वसूनि पुष्यसि विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ sóma ǀ dvi-bárhasam ǀ rayím ǀtvám ǀ vásūni ǀ puṣyasi ǀ víśvāni ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indu,Soma, when purified bring us the riches of both worlds; you foster all treasures in the house of the donor (of the libation).
verses.wilson_translation: Indu,Soma, when purified bring us the riches of both worlds; you foster all treasures in the house of the donor (of the libation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं धियं मनोयुजं सृजा वृष्टिं न तन्यतुः ।त्वं वसूनि पार्थिवा दिव्या च सोम पुष्यसि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ dhíyam ǀ manaḥ-yújam ǀ sṛjá ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ ná ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀtvám ǀ vásūni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ divyā́ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ puṣyasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let loose your stream which is as rapid as thought; as the cloud (let loose) the rain; you Somafoster terrestrial and celestial treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: Let loose your stream which is as rapid as thought; as the cloud (let loose) the rain; you Somafoster terrestrial and celestial treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि ते जिग्युषो यथा धारा सुतस्य धावति ।रंहमाणा व्यव्ययं वारं वाजीव सानसिः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ te ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ dhāvati ǀráṃhamāṇā ǀ ví ǀ avyáyam ǀ vā́ram ǀ vājī́-iva ǀ sānasíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your stream when you are effused, swift-flowing bountiful, rushes through the sheep's hair like the horse of a victorious (hero).
verses.wilson_translation: Your stream when you are effused, swift-flowing bountiful, rushes through the sheep's hair like the horse of a victorious (hero).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रत्वे दक्षाय नः कवे पवस्व सोम धारया ।इंद्राय पातवे सुतो मित्राय वरुणाय च ॥
verses.transliteration: krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ naḥ ǀ kave ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀíndrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀ sutáḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sage Somaflow in a stream for our enlightenment and invigoration, poured forth for Indra,Mitraand Varuṇato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: Sage Somaflow in a stream for our enlightenment and invigoration, poured forth for Indra,Mitraand Varuṇato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातमः पवित्रे धारया सुतः ।इंद्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vāja-sā́tamaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ soma ǀ víṣṇave ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, who are the giver of food in a stream, when effused, to the filter; (flow) Soma who are most sweet for Indra, for Viṣṇu, for the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, who are the giver of food in a stream, when effused, to the filter; (flow) Soma who are most sweet for Indra, for Viṣṇu, for the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वां रिहंति मातरो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः ।वत्सं जातं न धेनवः पवमान विधर्मणि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ rihanti ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ hárim ǀ pavítre ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀvatsám ǀ jātám ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The innocent maternal (waters) caress you, the green-tinted, upon the filter, OPavamāna, at the sacrifice, as kine caress their new-born calf.
verses.wilson_translation: The innocent maternal (waters) caress you, the green-tinted, upon the filter, OPavamāna, at the sacrifice, as kine caress their new-born calf.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमान महि श्रवश्चित्रेभिर्यासि रश्मिभिः ।शर्धंतमांसि जिघ्नसे विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ citrébhiḥ ǀ yāsi ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀśárdhan ǀ támāṃsi ǀ jighnase ǀ víśvāni ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pavamāna, you traverse the vast firmament with various rays, hastening on you dispel allrākṣasasat the house of the donor (of the libation).
verses.wilson_translation: Pavamāna, you traverse the vast firmament with various rays, hastening on you dispel allrākṣasasat the house of the donor (of the libation).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं द्यां च महिव्रत पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे ।प्रति द्रापिममुंचथाः पवमान महित्वना ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ dyā́m ǀ ca ǀ mahi-vrata ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ ca ǀ áti ǀ jabhriṣe ǀpráti ǀ drāpím ǀ amuñcathāḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Observer of manifold rites, you support both heaven and earth; OPavamāna, (who are endowed) with greatness, you put on your coat of mail.
verses.wilson_translation: Observer of manifold rites, you support both heaven and earth; OPavamāna, (who are endowed) with greatness, you put on your coat of mail.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CI. Soma Pavamana
hymns.anukramani: (१६) १-३अन्धीगु: श्यावाश्वि:,४-६ यायातिर्नाहुष:,७-९ नहुषो मानव:,१०-१२ मनु: सांवरण:, १३-१६ वैश्वामित्रो वाच्यो वा प्रजापति: । पवमान: सोम: । अनुष्टुप् , २-३  गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FOR first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink,Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away. He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward,Indu, is like an able steed. The men with all-pervading song send unassailable Soma forth,By pressing-stones, to sacrifice. The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is destined, flow,Effused, the source of Indra's joy: may your strong juices reach the Gods. Indu flows on for Indra's sake: thus have the Deities declared.The Lord of Speech exerts himself, Ruler of all, because of might. Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows,Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the Friend of Indra, day by day. As Pūṣan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure.He, Lord of the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven. The dear cows lowed in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink.The drops as they were purified, the Soma juices, made then paths. O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed,Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence. For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of our weal,Effused as friends without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light. Effused by means of pressing-stones, upon the ox-hide visible,They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side. Tlese Soma juices, skilled in song, purified, blent with milk and curd,When moving and when firmly laid in oil, resemble lovely Suns. Let not the power of men restrain the voice of the outpouring juice:As Bhṛgu's sons chased Makha, so drive ye the greedy hound away. The Friend hath wrapped him in his robe, as in his parents arms, a son.He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like. That Hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart,Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve, to settle, priest-like, in his place. Soma upon the ox's skin through the sheep's wool flows purified.Bellowing out, the Tawny Steer goes on to Indra's special place.

verses.sanskrit: पुरोजिती वो अंधसः सुताय मादयित्नवे ।अप श्वानं श्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: puráḥ-jitī ǀ vaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ sutā́ya ǀ mādayitnáve ǀápa ǀ śvā́nam ǀ śnathiṣṭana ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ dīrgha-jihvyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: For (the drinking of) the effused exhilarating (juice) of the Somawho has plural ced victory before you, do you friends destroy the long-tongued dog.
verses.wilson_translation: For (the drinking of) the effused exhilarating (juice) of the Somawho has plural ced victory before you, do you friends destroy the long-tongued dog.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यंदते सुतः ।इंदुरश्वो न कृत्व्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pāvakáyā ǀ pari-prasyándate ǀ sutáḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṛ́tvyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Indugood for sacred rites which when effused flows forth in a purifying stream, (swift) as a horse.
verses.wilson_translation: The Indugood for sacred rites which when effused flows forth in a purifying stream, (swift) as a horse.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया ।यज्ञं हिन्वंत्यद्रिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ duróṣam ǀ abhí ǀ náraḥ ǀ sómam ǀ viśvā́cyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀyajñám ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him, the Somaunassailable, adorable, the priests, with all comprehending intelligence, express with the stones.
verses.wilson_translation: Him, the Somaunassailable, adorable, the priests, with all comprehending intelligence, express with the stones.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इंद्राय मंदिनः ।पवित्रवंतो अक्षरंदेवान्गच्छंतु वो मदाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sutā́saḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamāḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ mandínaḥ ǀpavítra-vantaḥ ǀ akṣaran ǀ devā́n ǀ gacchantu ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The sweet-flavoured exhilarating Somajuices effused (and) filtered flow for Indra; do you, exhilarating (juices) proceed to the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The sweet-flavoured exhilarating Somajuices effused (and) filtered flow for Indra; do you, exhilarating (juices) proceed to the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुरिंद्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् ।वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ íti ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ abruvan ǀvācáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ makhasyate ǀ víśvasya ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The devout (worshippers) say 'Induflows forth for Indra'; the lord of speech (Soma) soverign of all by his might desires (our) worship.
verses.wilson_translation: The devout (worshippers) say 'Induflows forth for Indra'; the lord of speech (Soma) soverign of all by his might desires (our) worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमींखयः ।सोमः पती रयीणां सखेंद्रस्य दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ pavate ǀ samudráḥ ǀ vācam-īṅkhayáḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ sákhā ǀ índrasya ǀ divé-dive ǁ
verses.english_translation: The thousand-streamed ocean,Somathe stimulator of praise, the lord of riches, the friend of Indraflows day by day.
verses.wilson_translation: The thousand-streamed ocean,Somathe stimulator of praise, the lord of riches, the friend of Indraflows day by day.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ।पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀpátiḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhū́manaḥ ǀ ví ǀ akhyat ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somabeing purified hastens (to the pitcher) fostering, wealth-giving, to be enjoyed (by all); the lord of all beings, he has illuminated both heaven and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somabeing purified hastens (to the pitcher) fostering, wealth-giving, to be enjoyed (by all); the lord of all beings, he has illuminated both heaven and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः ।सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इंदवः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvayaḥ ǀsómāsaḥ ǀ kṛṇvate ǀ patháḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The affectionate emulous cows celebrate (Soma) for his exhilaration; the brilliant filtered (Soma) juices make paths (for themselves to flow).
verses.wilson_translation: The affectionate emulous cows celebrate (Soma) for his exhilaration; the brilliant filtered (Soma) juices make paths (for themselves to flow).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यं ।यः पंच चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहै ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ pávamāna ǀ śravā́yyam ǀyáḥ ǀ páñca ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rayím ǀ yéna ǀ vánāmahai ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring to us, filtered (Soma), that celebrated (beverage) which is most potent, which (waits) upon the fiver orders of beings and by which we may obtain riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring to us, filtered (Soma), that celebrated (beverage) which is most potent, which (waits) upon the fiver orders of beings and by which we may obtain riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमाः पवंत इंदवोऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः ।मित्राः सुवाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.transliteration: sómāḥ ǀ pavante ǀ índavaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ gātuvít-tamāḥ ǀmitrā́ḥ ǀ suvānā́ḥ ǀ arepásaḥ ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The brilliant Somajuices flow for us knowing the right path, friendly (to the gods), effused sinless, contemplative, all-knowing.
verses.wilson_translation: The brilliant Somajuices flow for us knowing the right path, friendly (to the gods), effused sinless, contemplative, all-knowing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सुष्वाणासो व्यद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि त्वचि ।इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन्वसुविदः ॥
verses.transliteration: susvānā́saḥ ǀ ví ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ cítānāḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀíṣam ǀ asmábhyam ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǀ vasu-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effused by the stones, recognized upon the cowhide acquirers of wealth they bestow food upon us from all sides.
verses.wilson_translation: Effused by the stones, recognized upon the cowhide acquirers of wealth they bestow food upon us from all sides.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।सूर्यासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते ॥
verses.transliteration: eté ǀ pūtā́ḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀsū́ryāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ darśatā́saḥ ǀ jigatnávaḥ ǀ dhruvā́ḥ ǀ ghṛté ǁ
verses.english_translation: These filtered Somajuices, intelligent, mixed with curds, swift-moving, firm in the water (are) brilliant as suns.
verses.wilson_translation: These filtered Somajuices, intelligent, mixed with curds, swift-moving, firm in the water (are) brilliant as suns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सुन्वानस्यांधसो मर्तो न वृत तद्वचः ।अप श्वानमराधसं हता मखं न भृगवः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ sunvānásya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛta ǀ tát ǀ vácaḥ ǀápa ǀ śvā́nam ǀ arādhásam ǀ hatá ǀ makhám ǀ ná ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let no mortal hear the sound of the effused Soma; drive off the dog that sacrifices not as the Bhṛgusdrove off Makha.
verses.wilson_translation: Let no mortal hear the sound of the effused Soma; drive off the dog that sacrifices not as the Bhṛgusdrove off Makha.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः ।सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jāmíḥ ǀ átke ǀ avyata ǀ bhujé ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ oṇyóḥ ǀsárat ǀ jāráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣaṇām ǀ varáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma) the kinsman (of the gods) is enveloped in the investing filter like a child in the arms of its protecting parents; he hastens like a gallant to a mistress, like a bridegroom (to the bride) to sit upon his station (the pitcher).
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma) the kinsman (of the gods) is enveloped in the investing filter like a child in the arms of its protecting parents; he hastens like a gallant to a mistress, like a bridegroom (to the bride) to sit upon his station (the pitcher).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तंभ रोदसी ।हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदं ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ tastámbha ǀ ródasī íti ǀháriḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ avyata ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The green-tinted (Soma), the implement of strength, the hero, who has upheld heaven and earth, is enveloped in the filter like the sacrificer (in his house) to sit upon his station.
verses.wilson_translation: The green-tinted (Soma), the implement of strength, the hero, who has upheld heaven and earth, is enveloped in the filter like the sacrificer (in his house) to sit upon his station.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अव्यो वारेभिः पवते सोमो गव्ये अधि त्वचि ।कनिक्रदद्वृषा हरिरिंद्रस्याभ्येति निष्कृतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ pavate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ gávye ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀkánikradat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háríḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somaflows purified by the sheep's hairs; crying aloud upon the cowhide for the showerer (of benefits), green-tinted he goes to Indra's prepared station.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somaflows purified by the sheep's hairs; crying aloud upon the cowhide for the showerer (of benefits), green-tinted he goes to Indra's prepared station.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CIL Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE Child, when blended with the streams, speeding the plan of sacrifice,Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old. The place, near the two pressing-stones of Trita, hath he occupied,Secret and dear through seven lights of sacrifice. Urge to three courses, on the heights of Trita, riches in a stream.He who is passing wise measures his courses out. Even at his birth the Mothers Seven taught him, for glory, like a sage,So that he, firm and sure, hath set his mind on wealth. Under his sway, of one accord, are all the guileless Deities:Warriors to be envied, they, when they are pleased. The Babe whom they who strengthen Law have generated fair to see,Much longed for at the sacrifice, most liberal Sage,— To him, united, of themselves, come the young Parents of the rite,When they adorn him, duly weaving sacrifice. With wisdom and with radiant eyes unbar to us the stall of heaven,Speeding at solemn rite the plan of Holy Law.

verses.sanskrit: क्राणा शिशुर्महीनां हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिं ।विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता ॥
verses.transliteration: krāṇā́ ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ mahī́nām ǀ hinván ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dī́dhitim ǀvíśvā ǀ pári ǀ priyā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Performing (sacred rites) the child of the great (waters) sending forth the lustre of the sacrifice (Soma) produces all acceptable (oblations) and (abides) in the two worlds.
