verses.wilson_translation: Performing (sacred rites) the child of the great (waters) sending forth the lustre of the sacrifice (Soma) produces all acceptable (oblations) and (abides) in the two worlds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उप त्रितस्य पाष्योरभक्त यद्गुहा पदं ।यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध प्रियं ॥
verses.transliteration: úpa ǀ tritásya ǀ pāṣyóḥ ǀ ábhakta ǀ yát ǀ gúhā ǀ padám ǀyajñásya ǀ saptá ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ ádha ǀ priyám ǁ
verses.english_translation: When the Somahas been taken the secret station of the grinding stones (at the sacrifice) of Trita, then with the seven supports of the sacrifice (the priests praise) the conciliating (Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: When the Somahas been taken the secret station of the grinding stones (at the sacrifice) of Trita, then with the seven supports of the sacrifice (the priests praise) the conciliating (Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि त्रितस्य धारया पृष्ठेष्वेरया रयिं ।मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ tritásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pṛṣṭhéṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ īraya ǀ rayím ǀmímīte ǀ asya ǀ yójanā ǀ ví ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Support,Soma) with your stream Trita's three (oblations); cause the giver of riches (Indra) to come to the sacred songs. The intelligent (praiser) of this (Indra) measures out hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: (Support,Soma) with your stream Trita's three (oblations); cause the giver of riches (Indra) to come to the sacred songs. The intelligent (praiser) of this (Indra) measures out hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञानं सप्त मातरो वेधामशासत श्रिये ।अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेत यत् ॥
verses.transliteration: jajñānám ǀ saptá ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ vedhā́m ǀ aśāsata ǀ śriyé ǀayám ǀ dhruváḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ cíketa ǀ yát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The seven mothers instrumental uct the (Soma) the instrumental tutor (of the sacrifice) when born for the prosperity (of the worshippers) to that this firm Soma is cognizant of riches. [
verses.wilson_translation: The seven mothers instrumental uct the (Soma) the instrumental tutor (of the sacrifice) when born for the prosperity (of the worshippers) to that this firm Soma is cognizant of riches. [
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य व्रते सजो���सो विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः ।स्पार्हा भवंति रंतयो जुषंत यत् ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ vraté ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀspārhā́ḥ ǀ bhavanti ǀ rántayaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀ yát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The universal gods, devoid of malice, assembled together at his rite, are to be envied if being delighted they take plural asure (in the Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: The universal gods, devoid of malice, assembled together at his rite, are to be envied if being delighted they take plural asure (in the Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यमी गर्भमृतावृधो दृशे चारुमजीजनन् ।कविं मंहिष्ठमध्वरे पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ īmíti ǀ gárbham ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀ cā́rum ǀ ájījanan ǀkavím ǀ máṃhiṣṭham ǀ adhvaré ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The germ which the augmenters of the rite brought forth at the sacrifice lovely to look upon intelligent, most adorable, desired by many.
verses.wilson_translation: The germ which the augmenters of the rite brought forth at the sacrifice lovely to look upon intelligent, most adorable, desired by many.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समीचीने अभि त्मना यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा ।तन्वाना यज्ञमानुषग्यदंजते ॥
verses.transliteration: samīcīné íti sam-īcīné ǀ abhí ǀ tmánā ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mātárā ǀtanvānā́ḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ānuṣák ǀ yát ǀ añjaté ǁ
verses.english_translation: He of his own will approaches the great united parents of the sacrifice (heaven and earth) when (the priests) conducting the ceremony anoint him in due order with the sacred waters.
verses.wilson_translation: He of his own will approaches the great united parents of the sacrifice (heaven and earth) when (the priests) conducting the ceremony anoint him in due order with the sacred waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: क्रत्वा शुक्रेभिरक्षभिर्ऋणोरप व्रजं दिवः ।हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिं प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.transliteration: krátvā ǀ śukrébhiḥ ǀ akṣá-bhiḥ ǀ ṛṇóḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vrajám ǀ diváḥ ǀhinván ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dī́dhitim ǀ prá ǀ adhvaré ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, by your act drive away with your brilliant organs the darkness from the sky, effusing into the sacrifice (your juice) the lustre of the rite.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, by your act drive away with your brilliant organs the darkness from the sky, effusing into the sacrifice (your juice) the lustre of the rite.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Soma who is purified as ordering Priest the song is raised:Bring meed, as ’twere, to one who makes thee glad with hymns. Blended with milk and curds he flows on through the long wool of the sheep.The Gold-hued, purified, makes him three seats for rest. On through the long wool of the sheep to the meath-dropping vat he flows:The Ṛṣis’ sevenfold quire hath sung aloud to him. Shared by all Gods, Infallible, the Leader of our holy hymns,Golden-hued Soma, being cleansed, hath reached the bowls. After thy Godlike qualities, associate with Indra, go,As a Priest purified by priests, Immortal One. Like a car-horse who shows his strength, a God effused for Deities.The penetrating Pavamana flows along.

verses.sanskrit: प्र पुनानाय वेधसे सोमाय वच उद्यतं ।भृतिं न भरा मतिभिर्जुजोषते ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ punānā́ya ǀ vedháse ǀ sómāya ǀ vácaḥ ǀ út-yatam ǀbhṛtím ǀ ná ǀ bhara ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ jújoṣate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Raise a loud voice to Somathe instrumental tutor (of the rite), purified, gratified by praises, as (men pay) wages (to a labourer).
verses.wilson_translation: Raise a loud voice to Somathe instrumental tutor (of the rite), purified, gratified by praises, as (men pay) wages (to a labourer).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि वाराण्यव्यया गोभिरंजानो अर्षति ।त्री षधस्था पुनानः कृणुते हरिः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀtrī́ ǀ sadhá-sthā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ kṛṇute ǀ háriḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Blending with the curds and milk the Somarushes through the woollen fleece; the green-tinted Soma being purified takes up three stations.
verses.wilson_translation: Blending with the curds and milk the Somarushes through the woollen fleece; the green-tinted Soma being purified takes up three stations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि कोशं मधुश्चुतमव्यये वारे अर्षति ।अभि वाणीर्ऋषीणां सप्त नूषत ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀ avyáye ǀ vā́re ǀ arṣati ǀabhí ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ saptá ǀ nūṣata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somasends forth (its juice) through the woollen fleece to the honey-dripping receptacle; the seven metres of the ṛṣis praise (it).
verses.wilson_translation: The Somasends forth (its juice) through the woollen fleece to the honey-dripping receptacle; the seven metres of the ṛṣis praise (it).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि णेता मतीनां विश्वदेवो अदाभ्यः ।सोमः पुनानश्चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ netā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ viśvá-devaḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ camvóḥ ǀ viśat ǀ háriḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, the leader of praises, in whom all the gods are comprehended, unassailable, green-tinted when filtered, enters the cups.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, the leader of praises, in whom all the gods are comprehended, unassailable, green-tinted when filtered, enters the cups.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि दैवीरनु स्वधा इंद्रेण याहि सरथं ।पुनानो वाघद्वाघद्भिरमर्त्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ dáivīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ yāhi ǀ sa-rátham ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vāghát ǀ vāghát-bhiḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Proceed in the same chariot with Indrato the celestial hosts, a priest purified by priests, immortal.
verses.wilson_translation: Proceed in the same chariot with Indrato the celestial hosts, a priest purified by priests, immortal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि सप्तिर्न वाजयुर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।व्यानशिः पवमानो वि धावति ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀvi-ānaśíḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like a charger eager for the combat the divine (Soma) effused for the gods hastens when purified spreading widely into the vessels.
verses.wilson_translation: Like a charger eager for the combat the divine (Soma) effused for the gods hastens when purified spreading widely into the vessels.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CIV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: ६ पर्वतनारदौ काण्वौ, काश्यप्यौ शिखण्डिन्यावप्सरसौ वा । पवमान: सोम: । उष्णिक् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SIT down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself:Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites. Unite him bringing household wealth, even as a calf, with mother kine,Him who hath double strength, the God, delighting juice. Purify him who gives us power, that he, most Blessed One, may beA banquet for the Troop, Mitra, and Varuṇa. Voices have sung aloud to thee as finderout of wealth for us:We clothe the hue thou wearest with a robe of milk. Thou, Indu, art the food of Gods, O Sovran of all gladdening drinks:As Friend for friend, be thou best finder of success. Drive utterly away from us each demon, each voracious fiend,The godless and the false: keep sorrow far away.

verses.sanskrit: सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्र गायत ।शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये ॥
verses.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǀ punānā́ya ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀśíśum ǀ ná ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ pári ǀ bhūṣata ǀ śriyé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sit down, friends, sing to the filtered Soma, decorate him with offerings to beautify him as (parents decorate) a child.
verses.wilson_translation: Sit down, friends, sing to the filtered Soma, decorate him with offerings to beautify him as (parents decorate) a child.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: समी वत्सं न मातृभिः सृजता गयसाधनं ।देवाव्यं मदमभि द्विशवसं ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ īmíti ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sṛjáta ǀ gaya-sā́dhanam ǀdeva-avyám ǀ mádam ǀ abhí ǀ dví-śavasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Associate him the support of the mansion with the maternal (waters) as the calf (with the mother) the protector of the gods, the exhilarator, endowed with twofold strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Associate him the support of the mansion with the maternal (waters) as the calf (with the mother) the protector of the gods, the exhilarator, endowed with twofold strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये ।यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शंतमः ॥
verses.transliteration: punā́ta ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanam ǀ yáthā ǀ śárdhāya ǀ vītáye ǀyáthā ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ śám-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purify the bestower of strength so that he may make for invigoration for the banquet (of the gods) and may grant much happiness to Mitraand Varuṇa.
verses.wilson_translation: Purify the bestower of strength so that he may make for invigoration for the banquet (of the gods) and may grant much happiness to Mitraand Varuṇa.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं त्वा वसुविदमभि वाणीरनूषत ।गोभिष्टे वर्णमभि वासयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ tvā ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ abhí ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ te ǀ várṇam ǀ abhí ǀ vāsayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: For us do the hymns glorify you the giver of wealth; we clothe your form with the (products of the) kine.
verses.wilson_translation: For us do the hymns glorify you the giver of wealth; we clothe your form with the (products of the) kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो मदानां पत इंदो देवप्सरा असि ।सखेव सख्ये गातुवित्तमो भव ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ madānām ǀ pate ǀ índo íti ǀ devá-psarāḥ ǀ asi ǀsákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of our exhilaration,Indu, you are of brilliant form; be our true guide as a friend is to a friend.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of our exhilaration,Indu, you are of brilliant form; be our true guide as a friend is to a friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनेमि कृध्यस्मदा रक्षसं कं चिदत्रिणं ।अपादेवं द्वयुमंहो युयोधि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: sánemi ǀ kṛdhí ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ rakṣásam ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ atríṇam ǀápa ǀ ádevam ǀ dvayúm ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ yuyodhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Show us (your) ancient (friendship); (drive off) the voraciousrākṣasa, the impious, the double dealer-- drive away our sin.
verses.wilson_translation: Show us (your) ancient (friendship); (drive off) the voraciousrākṣasa, the impious, the double dealer-- drive away our sin.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CV. Soma Pavamana
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SING; ye aloud, O friends, to him who makes him pure for gladdening drink:They shall make sweet the Child with sacrifice and laud. Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent,Glorified by our hymns, the God-delighting juice. Effectual means of power is he, he is a banquet for the Troop,He who hath been effused, most rich in meath, for Gods. Flow to us, Indu, passing, strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds:I will spread forth above the milk thy radiant hue. Lord of the tawny, Indu thou who art the God's most special food,As Friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men. Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious foe.O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar.

verses.sanskrit: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत ।शिशुं न यज्ञैः स्वदयंत गूर्तिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ punānám ǀ abhí ǀ gāyata ǀśíśum ǀ ná ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ svadayanta ǀ gūrtí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hymn, friends, the Somapurified for the exhilaration (of the gods), gratify him with oblations and praises as (men gratify) a child (with ornaments).
verses.wilson_translation: Hymn, friends, the Somapurified for the exhilaration (of the gods), gratify him with oblations and praises as (men gratify) a child (with ornaments).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सं वत्स इव मातृभिरिंदुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते ।देवावीर्मदो मतिभिः परिष्कृतः ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ vatsáḥ-iva ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ ajyate ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indubeing set forth is sprinkled (with the waters) as a calf (is nourished) by its mother-- the protector of the deities, the exhilarator, graced by praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Indubeing set forth is sprinkled (with the waters) as a calf (is nourished) by its mother-- the protector of the deities, the exhilarator, graced by praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं दक्षाय साधनोऽयं शर्धाय वीतये ।अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः सुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ dákṣāya ǀ sā́dhanaḥ ǀ ayám ǀ śárdhāya ǀ vītáye ǀayám ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This (Soma) is an instrumental ument for invigoration; he (is useful) for speed (and) for the banquet of your gods; he is effused most sweet-flavoured for the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: This (Soma) is an instrumental ument for invigoration; he (is useful) for speed (and) for the banquet of your gods; he is effused most sweet-flavoured for the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: गोमन्न इंदो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धन्व ।शुचिं ते वर्णमधि गोषु दीधरं ॥
verses.transliteration: gó-mat ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ áśva-vat ǀ sutáḥ ǀ su-dakṣa ǀ dhanva ǀśúcim ǀ te ǀ várṇam ǀ ádhi ǀ góṣu ǀ dīdharam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Powerful Induwho are effused, pour upon us (wealth) comprising cattle and horses; I mix the pure juice with the curds and milk.
verses.wilson_translation: Powerful Induwho are effused, pour upon us (wealth) comprising cattle and horses; I mix the pure juice with the curds and milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स नो हरीणां पत इंदो देवप्सरस्तमः ।सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ harīṇām ǀ pate ǀ índo íti ǀ devápsaraḥ-tamaḥ ǀsákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ náryaḥ ǀ rucé ǀ bhava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of our bay-coloured (cattle),Indu, who have a most brilliant form, do you who are kind to the priests be for a light to us as a friend (gives light) to a friend.
verses.wilson_translation: Lord of our bay-coloured (cattle),Indu, who have a most brilliant form, do you who are kind to the priests be for a light to us as a friend (gives light) to a friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सनेमि त्वमस्मदाँ अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणं ।साह्वाँ इंदो परि बाधो अप द्वयुं ॥
verses.transliteration: sánemi ǀ tvám ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ ádevam ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ atríṇam ǀsahvā́n ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ bā́dhaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvayúm ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you (show) us your ancient (friendship), drive away the impious voracious (rākṣasa);Induwho are victorious overcome those who oppress us, (drive) off the double-dealing (rākṣas).
verses.wilson_translation: Do you (show) us your ancient (friendship), drive away the impious voracious (rākṣasa);Induwho are victorious overcome those who oppress us, (drive) off the double-dealing (rākṣas).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CVI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To Indra, to the Mighty Steer, may these gold-coloured juices go,Drops rapidly produced, that find the light of heaven. Effused, this juice victorious flows for Indra, for his maintenance.Soma bethinks him of the Conqueror, as he knows. May Indra in his raptures gain from him the grasp that gathers spoil,And, winning waters, wield the steerstrong thunderbolt. Flow vigilant for Indra, thou Soma, yea, Indu, run thou on:Bring hither splendid strength that finds the light of heaven. Do thou, all-beautiful, purify for Indra's sake the mighty juice,Path-maker thou, far seeing, with a thousand ways. Best finder of prosperity for us, most rich in sweets for Gods,Proceed thou loudly roaring on a thousand paths. O Indu, with thy streams, in might, flow for the banquet of the Gods:Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy place. Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight:The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality. Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified,Pouring down rain from heaven in hoods, and finding light. Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep,Shouting while purified before the voice of song. With songs they send the Mighty forth, sporting in wood, above the fleece:Our psalms have glorified him of the triple height. Into the jars hath he been loosed, like an impetuous steed for war,And lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on. Gold-hued and lovely in his course, througb tangles of the wool he flows,And pours heroic fame upon the worshippers. Flow thus, a faithful votary: the streams of meath have been effused.Thou comest to the filter, singing, from each side.

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यंतु हरयः ।श्रुष्टी जातास इंदवः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.transliteration: índram ǀ áccha ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ yantu ǀ hárayaḥ ǀśruṣṭī́ ǀ jātā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May these effused green-tinted Somajuices quickly genitive rated, all-knowing, proceed to Indrathe showerer (of benefits).
verses.wilson_translation: May these effused green-tinted Somajuices quickly genitive rated, all-knowing, proceed to Indrathe showerer (of benefits).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अयं भराय सानसिरिंद्राय पवते सुतः ।सोमो जैत्रस्य चेतति यथा विदे ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ bhárāya ǀ sānasíḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ jáitrasya ǀ cetati ǀ yáthā ǀ vidé ǁ
verses.english_translation: This effused Somaadorable for battle, is filtered for Indra; Soma thinks of the victorious (Indra) as he is known (in the world).
verses.wilson_translation: This effused Somaadorable for battle, is filtered for Indra; Soma thinks of the victorious (Indra) as he is known (in the world).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्येदिंद्रो मदेष्वा ग्राभं गृभ्णीत सानसिं ।वज्रं च वृषणं भरत्समप्सुजित् ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ mádeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ grābhám ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ sānasím ǀvájram ǀ ca ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ bharat ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǁ
verses.english_translation: In the Soma's exhilaration may Indraseize hold of wealth to be enjoyed (by all) and conquering Vṛtrain the waters may he wield the thunderbolt the showerer (of blessings).
verses.wilson_translation: In the Soma's exhilaration may Indraseize hold of wealth to be enjoyed (by all) and conquering Vṛtrain the waters may he wield the thunderbolt the showerer (of blessings).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र धन्वा सोम जागृविरिंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ।द्युमंतं शुष्ममा भरा स्वर्विदं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ dhanva ǀ soma ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow Somawho are vigilant;Induspread around for Indra; bring brilliant overpowering all-obtaining (strength).
verses.wilson_translation: Flow Somawho are vigilant;Induspread around for Indra; bring brilliant overpowering all-obtaining (strength).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय वृषणं मदं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः ।सहस्रयामा पथिकृद्विचक्षणः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ mádam ǀ pávasva ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǀsahásra-yāmā ǀ pathi-kṛ́t ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour forth for Indrathe exhilarating (juice) showering (benefits), you who are very beautiful, who have many paths, the finder of the (right) path, the observer (of all).
verses.wilson_translation: Pour forth for Indrathe exhilarating (juice) showering (benefits), you who are very beautiful, who have many paths, the finder of the (right) path, the observer (of all).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमो देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः ।सहस्रं याहि पथिभिः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀsahásram ǀ yāhi ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ kánikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who are the best finder of paths for us, the sweet beverage for the gods, come by a thousand paths crying aloud.
verses.wilson_translation: You who are the best finder of paths for us, the sweet beverage for the gods, come by a thousand paths crying aloud.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व देववीतय इंदो धाराभिरोजसा ।आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ índo íti ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǀā́ ǀ kaláśam ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Indu, in your strength with your streams for the banquet of the gods; sit down,Soma, who are sweet-flavoured, in our pitcher.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Indu, in your strength with your streams for the banquet of the gods; sit down,Soma, who are sweet-flavoured, in our pitcher.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इंद्रं मदाय वावृधुः ।त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ drapsā́ḥ ǀ uda-prútaḥ ǀ índram ǀ mádāya ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ kám ǀ papuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your drops, goint to the water, have exalted Indrato exhilaration; the gods have quaffed you, the delighter, for immortality.
verses.wilson_translation: Your drops, goint to the water, have exalted Indrato exhilaration; the gods have quaffed you, the delighter, for immortality.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ नः सुतास इंदवः पुनाना धावता रयिं ।वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sutāsaḥ ǀ indavaḥ ǀ punānā́ḥ ǀ dhāvata ǀ rayím ǀvṛṣṭí-dyāvaḥ ǀ rīti-āpaḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring us wealth, bright Somajuices effused, filtered, filling the sky with rain, shedding water (upon the earth) acquiring all things.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us wealth, bright Somajuices effused, filtered, filling the sky with rain, shedding water (upon the earth) acquiring all things.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यो वारं वि धावति ।अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ūrmíṇā ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀágre ǀ vācáḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ kánikradat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Some being filtered flows in a stream through the woollen fleece, crying aloud when filtered in advance of the voice (of praise).
verses.wilson_translation: Some being filtered flows in a stream through the woollen fleece, crying aloud when filtered in advance of the voice (of praise).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: धीभिर्हिन्वंति वाजिनं वने क्रीळंतमत्यविं ।अभि त्रिपृष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: dhībhíḥ ǀ hinvanti ǀ vājínam ǀ váne ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ áti-avim ǀabhí ǀ tri-pṛṣṭhám ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: They send forth with their fingers the powerful Somasporting in the water, passing through the fleece; praises celebrate him abiding in the three receptacles.
verses.wilson_translation: They send forth with their fingers the powerful Somasporting in the water, passing through the fleece; praises celebrate him abiding in the three receptacles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असर्जि कलशाँ अभि मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः ।पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ásarji ǀ kaláśān ǀ abhí ǀ mīḷhé ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ janáyan ǀ asisyadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desiring (to give the worshipper) food he has been let loose into the pitchers like a charger in battle; being filtered, raising a cry he flows (into the vessels).
verses.wilson_translation: Desiring (to give the worshipper) food he has been let loose into the pitchers like a charger in battle; being filtered, raising a cry he flows (into the vessels).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वरांसि रंह्या ।अभ्यर्षन्त्स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávate ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ áti ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ ráṃhyā ǀabhi-árṣan ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The delightful green-tinted (juice) flows with rapidity into the crooked (pitchers); bringing the worshippers, food andmaleoffspring.
verses.wilson_translation: The delightful green-tinted (juice) flows with rapidity into the crooked (pitchers); bringing the worshippers, food andmaleoffspring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अया पवस्व देवयुर्मधोर्धारा असृक्षत ।रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀrébhan ǀ pavítram ǀ pári ǀ eṣi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Devoted to the gods flow with that (stream); (your) streams of exhilarating beverage are let loose; with a roar you pass through the filter in all directions.
verses.wilson_translation: Devoted to the gods flow with that (stream); (your) streams of exhilarating beverage are let loose; with a roar you pass through the filter in all directions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CVII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: २६ सप्तर्षय: ( १ भरद्वाजो बार्हस्पत्य: , २ कश्यपो मारीच:, ३ गोतमो राहूगण:, ४ भौमोऽत्रि:, ५ विश्वामित्रो गाथिन:, ६ जमदग्निर्भार्गव:, ७  मैत्रावरुणिर्वसिष्ठ: ) ।पवमान: सोम: । प्रगाथ:= (१,४,६,८,९,१०,१२,१४,१७ बृहती; २,५,७,११,१३,१५,१८ सतोबृहती, ) ३,१६ द्विपदा विराट् ; १९-२६ प्रगाथ:= ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ) ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: I., HENCE sprinkle forth the juice effused,. Soma, the best of sacred gifts,Who, friend of man, hath run amid the water-streams. He hath pressed Soma out with stones. Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece inviolate and most odorous.We ladden thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk. Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu, Far-sighted One, is mental power. Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in a watery robe:Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold. Milking the heavenly udder for dear meath, he hath sat in the ancient gatheringplace.Washed by the men, the Strong Farseeing One streams forth nutriti us food that all desire. O Soma, while they cleanse thee, dear and watchful in the sheep's long wool,Thou hast become a Singer most like Aṅgiras: thou madest Sūrya mount to heaven. Bountiful, best of furtherers, Soma floweth on, Ṛṣi and Singer, keen of sight.Thou hast become a Sage most welcome to the Gods: thou madest Sūrya mount to heaven. Pressed out by pressers, Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep,Goes, even as with a mare, in tawnycoloured stream, goes in exhilarating stream. Down to the water-Soma, rich in kine hath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked.They have approached the mixing-vessel as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse. Effused by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep,Thou, entering the saucers as a man the fort, gold-hued hast settled in the wood. He beautifies himself through the sheep's long fine wool, like an impetuous steed in war,Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards. O Soma,—for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge,With the stalk's juice, exhilarating, resting not, into the vat that drops with meath. Like a dear son who must be decked, the Lovely One hath clad him in a shining robe.Men skilful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their bands. The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow, the gladdening drink,Intelligent drops above the basin of the sea, exhilarating, finding light. May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite:May he by Mitra's and by Varuṇa's decree flow furthering the lofty rite. Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose home is in the sea- Soma, the gladdening juice, flows pressed for Indra with his Marut host:He hastens o’er the fleece with all his thousand streams: men make him bright and beautiful. Purified in the bowl and gendering the hymn, wise Soma joys among the Gods.Robed in the flood, the Mighty One hath clad himself with milk and settled in the vats. O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight.Many fiends follow me; help me, thou Tawny-hued; pass on beyond these barriers. Close to thy bosom am I, Soma, day and night. O Tawny-hued, for friendship sake.Sūrya himself refulgent with his glow have we o’ertaken in his course like birds. Deft-handcd! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea.Thou, Pavamana, makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desifed. Making thee pure and bright in the sheep's long wool, thou hast bellowed, steerlike, in the wood.Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana, balmed with milk unto the special place of Gods. Flow on to win us strength, flow on to lofty lore of every kind.Thou, Soma, as Exhilarator wast the first to spread the sea abroad for Gods. Flow to the realm of earth, flow to the realm of heaven, O Soma, in thy righteous ways.Fair art thou whom the sages, O Far-seeing One, urge onward with their songs and hymns. Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Pavamanas in a stream,Girt by the Maruts, gladdening, Steeds with Indra's stiength, for wisdom and for dainty food. Urged onward by the pressers, clad in watery robes, Indu is speeding to the vat.He gendering light, hath made the glad Cows low, while he takes them as his garb of state.

verses.sanskrit: परीतो षिंचता सुतं सोमो य उत्तमं हविः ।दधन्वाँ यो नर्यो अप्स्वंतरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ itáḥ ǀ siñcata ǀ sutám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ut-tamám ǀ havíḥ ǀdadhanvā́n ǀ yáḥ ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ susā́va ǀ sómam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sprinkle from hence the effused Soma-juice which is the best oblation (to the gods), and which, good for man, is going into the midst of the firmament; (the priest) has expressed the Soma with the stones.
verses.wilson_translation: Sprinkle from hence the effused Soma-juice which is the best oblation (to the gods), and which, good for man, is going into the midst of the firmament; (the priest) has expressed the Soma with the stones.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नूनं पुनानोऽविभिः परि स्रवादब्धः सुरभिंतरः ।सुते चित्त्वाप्सु मदामो अंधसा श्रीणंतो गोभिरुत्तरं ॥
verses.transliteration: nūnám ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ávi-bhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ surabhím-taraḥ ǀsuté ǀ cit ǀ tvā ǀ ap-sú ǀ madāmaḥ ǀ ándhasā ǀ śrīṇántaḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ út-taram ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Soma) who are unassailable, who are most fragrant, flow around now being purified by the fleece; being effused we praise you eminent in the waters mixing you with food and the (products of the) kind.
verses.wilson_translation: (Soma) who are unassailable, who are most fragrant, flow around now being purified by the fleece; being effused we praise you eminent in the waters mixing you with food and the (products of the) kind.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: परि सुवानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः क्रतुरिंदुर्विचक्षणः ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ cákṣase ǀ deva-mā́danaḥ ǀ krátuḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Being effused the Induflows so as to be seen (of all)-- the exhilarator of the gods, the agent (in holy acts), the observer of all.
verses.wilson_translation: Being effused the Induflows so as to be seen (of all)-- the exhilarator of the gods, the agent (in holy acts), the observer of all.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि ।आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ arṣasi ǀā́ ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ yónim ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdasi ǀ útsaḥ ǀ deva ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Undergoing purification you flow Somain a stream clothed in the (consecrated) waters; the giver of wealth you sit on the plural ce of sacrifice, divine (Soma), who flow forth, who are the origin of gold.
verses.wilson_translation: Undergoing purification you flow Somain a stream clothed in the (consecrated) waters; the giver of wealth you sit on the plural ce of sacrifice, divine (Soma), who flow forth, who are the origin of gold.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु प्रियं प्रत्नं सधस्थमासदत् ।आपृच्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षति नृभिर्धूतो विचक्षणः ॥
verses.transliteration: duhānáḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ divyám ǀ mádhu ǀ priyám ǀ pratnám ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǀā-pṛ́cchyam ǀ dharúṇam ǀ vājī́ ǀ arṣati ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ dhūtáḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Milking the exhilarating agreeable celestial udder (the Soma) sits down on its ancient plural ce of aggregation (the firmament); food-giving, cleansed by the priests, observant it flows to the commendable worshipper.
verses.wilson_translation: Milking the exhilarating agreeable celestial udder (the Soma) sits down on its ancient plural ce of aggregation (the firmament); food-giving, cleansed by the priests, observant it flows to the commendable worshipper.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानः सोम जागृविरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः ।त्वं विप्रो अभवोऽंगिरस्तमो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्ष नः ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ soma ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyáḥ ǀtvám ǀ vípraḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ ǀ mádhvā ǀ yajñám ǀ mimikṣa ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are purified, vigilant, agreeable (you flow) through the woollen fleece; you are intelligent, the chief of the Aṅgirasas, sprinkle our oblation with your exhilarating juice.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are purified, vigilant, agreeable (you flow) through the woollen fleece; you are intelligent, the chief of the Aṅgirasas, sprinkle our oblation with your exhilarating juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमो मीढ्वान्पवते गातुवित्तम ऋषिर्विप्रो विचक्षणः ।त्वं कविरभवो देववीतम आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ mīḍhvā́n ǀ pavate ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀtvám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ rohayaḥ ǀ diví ǁ
verses.english_translation: Somaflows forth the showerer of benefits, the best of path-finders, a ṛṣi, a sage, all-discriminating; you are a seer, most devoted to the gods; you have made the sun to mount the sky.
verses.wilson_translation: Somaflows forth the showerer of benefits, the best of path-finders, a ṛṣi, a sage, all-discriminating; you are a seer, most devoted to the gods; you have made the sun to mount the sky.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोम उ षुवाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनां ।अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मंद्रया याति धारया ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ snú-bhiḥ ǀ ávīnām ǀáśvayā-iva ǀ harítā ǀ yāti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mandráyā ǀ yāti ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Effused by the effusers Somais poured out upon the elevated fleeces; and proceeds with its green-tinted stream, as on a mare, proceeds with its exhilarating streams.
verses.wilson_translation: Effused by the effusers Somais poured out upon the elevated fleeces; and proceeds with its green-tinted stream, as on a mare, proceeds with its exhilarating streams.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनूपे गोमान्गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः ।समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन्मंदी मदाय तोशते ॥
verses.transliteration: anūpé ǀ gó-mān ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ sómaḥ ǀ dugdhā́bhiḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀsamudrám ǀ ná ǀ sam-váraṇāni ǀ agman ǀ mandī́ ǀ mádāya ǀ tośate ǁ
verses.english_translation: Somacombined with the produce of the kine flows with the kine into the pitcher, he flows with the milked kine; his enjoyable juices go (to the pitcher as waters) to the ocean, the exhilarating (Soma) is expressed for the exhilaration (of the gods).
verses.wilson_translation: Somacombined with the produce of the kine flows with the kine into the pitcher, he flows with the milked kine; his enjoyable juices go (to the pitcher as waters) to the ocean, the exhilarating (Soma) is expressed for the exhilaration (of the gods).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सोम सुवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया ।जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दधिषे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ soma ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀjánaḥ ǀ ná ǀ purí ǀ camvóḥ ǀ viśat ǀ háriḥ ǀ sádaḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ dadhiṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Expressed by the stones,Soma, (passing) through the sheep's hairs, green-tinted, entering the cups as a man (enters) a city, you take your seat in the wooden (vessels).
verses.wilson_translation: Expressed by the stones,Soma, (passing) through the sheep's hairs, green-tinted, entering the cups as a man (enters) a city, you take your seat in the wooden (vessels).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः ।अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिर्ऋक्वभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mamṛje ǀ tiráḥ ǀ áṇvāni ǀ meṣyáḥ ǀ mīḷhé ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀanu-mā́dyaḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manīṣí-bhiḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Desirous of (bestowing) food, passing through the interstices of the fleece the Somais adorned like a horse in the battle; the Pavamāna, to be rejoiced in (by all, praised) by the intelligent, the sages, the reciters of sacred songs.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of (bestowing) food, passing through the interstices of the fleece the Somais adorned like a horse in the battle; the Pavamāna, to be rejoiced in (by all, praised) by the intelligent, the sages, the reciters of sacred songs.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोम देववीतये सिंधुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा ।अंशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ pipye ǀ árṇasā ǀaṃśóḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ madiráḥ ǀ ná ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ áccha ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are fed with water,Soma, like a river, for the banquet of the gods; with the juice of your filament you go to the honey-dropping receptacle, exhilarating, vigilant.
verses.wilson_translation: You are fed with water,Soma, like a river, for the banquet of the gods; with the juice of your filament you go to the honey-dropping receptacle, exhilarating, vigilant.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ हर्यतो अर्जुने अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः ।तमीं हिन्वंत्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ árjune ǀ átke ǀ avyata ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ ná ǀ márjyaḥ ǀtám ǀ īm ǀ hinvanti ǀ apásaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ rátham ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agreeable affectionate like a son about to be decorated, the Somais clad in a shining robe; they send him with thei rarms into the streams as active (warriors and their) chariot into (battle).
verses.wilson_translation: Agreeable affectionate like a son about to be decorated, the Somais clad in a shining robe; they send him with thei rarms into the streams as active (warriors and their) chariot into (battle).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवंते मद्यं मदं ।समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि मनीषिणो मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ pávante ǀ mádyam ǀ mádam ǀsamudrásya ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápi ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ matsarā́saḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The swift Somasend forth their inebriating juice upon the uplifted (filter) of the firmament, intelligent, exhilarating, all-acquiring.
verses.wilson_translation: The swift Somasend forth their inebriating juice upon the uplifted (filter) of the firmament, intelligent, exhilarating, all-acquiring.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ।अर्षन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: tárat ǀ samudrám ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ūrmíṇā ǀ rā́jā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǀárṣat ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ prá ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine royal (Soma) vast and true, undergoing purification traverses the firmament in a stream; vast and true, being sent forth he flows for the support of Mitraand Varuṇa
verses.wilson_translation: The divine royal (Soma) vast and true, undergoing purification traverses the firmament in a stream; vast and true, being sent forth he flows for the support of Mitraand Varuṇa
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नृभिर्येमानो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्रियः ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ deváḥ ǀ samudríyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Regulated by the priests, the divine royal Soma, agreeable, intelligent, abiding in the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Regulated by the priests, the divine royal Soma, agreeable, intelligent, abiding in the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय पवते मदः सोमो मरुत्वते सुतः ।सहस्रधारो अत्यव्यमर्षति तमी मृजंत्यायवः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ mádaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ marútvate ǀ sutáḥ ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ áti ǀ ávyam ǀ arṣati ǀ tám ǀ īmíti ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Exhilarating, flows, when effused, for Indraattended by the Maruts; thousand-streamed he passes through the fleece; men cleanse him.
verses.wilson_translation: Exhilarating, flows, when effused, for Indraattended by the Maruts; thousand-streamed he passes through the fleece; men cleanse him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पुनानश्चमू जनयन्मतिं कविः सोमो देवेषु रण्यति ।अपो वसानः परि गोभिरुत्तरः सीदन्वनेष्वव्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ camū́ íti ǀ janáyan ǀ matím ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ raṇyati ǀapáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ út-taraḥ ǀ sī́dan ǀ váneṣu ǀ avyata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Purified in the cups, exciting laudation, the sage Somarejoices among the gods; clothed with the waters sitting in the wooden bowls, he is surrounded with the curds and milk.
verses.wilson_translation: Purified in the cups, exciting laudation, the sage Somarejoices among the gods; clothed with the waters sitting in the wooden bowls, he is surrounded with the curds and milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तवाहं सोम रारण सख्य इंदो दिवेदिवे ।पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरंति मामव परिधीँरति ताँ इहि ॥
verses.transliteration: táva ǀ ahám ǀ soma ǀ raraṇa ǀ sakhyé ǀ indo íti ǀ divé-dive ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ babhro íti ǀ ní ǀ caranti ǀ mā́m ǀ áva ǀ pari-dhī́n ǀ áti ǀ tā́n ǀ ihi ǁ
verses.english_translation: In your friendship,Indu Soma, I have rejoiced day by day; many (rākṣasas) assail me, tawny-coloured (Soma); overcome these who surround me.
verses.wilson_translation: In your friendship,Indu Soma, I have rejoiced day by day; many (rākṣasas) assail me, tawny-coloured (Soma); overcome these who surround me.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: उताहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा सख्याय बभ्र ऊधनि ।घृणा तपंतमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ ahám ǀ náktam ǀ utá ǀ soma ǀ te ǀ dívā ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ babhro íti ǀ ū́dhani ǀghṛṇā́ ǀ tápantam ǀ áti ǀ sū́ryam ǀ paráḥ ǀ śakunā́ḥ-iva ǀ paptima ǁ
verses.english_translation: I (delight) in your presence, tawny-coloured Soma, both day and night, for the sake of your friendship may we soar like birds far beyond the sun blazing with your light.
verses.wilson_translation: I (delight) in your presence, tawny-coloured Soma, both day and night, for the sake of your friendship may we soar like birds far beyond the sun blazing with your light.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्य समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि ।रयिं पिशंगं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि ॥
verses.transliteration: mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ su-hastya ǀ samudré ǀ vā́cam ǀ invasi ǀrayím ǀ piśáṅgam ǀ bahulám ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ pávamāna ǀ abhí ǀ arṣasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Fair-fingered (Soma) being cleansed you utter a sound in the pitcher; you bring,Pavamāna, ample golden-hued much-coveted wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Fair-fingered (Soma) being cleansed you utter a sound in the pitcher; you bring,Pavamāna, ample golden-hued much-coveted wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: मृजानो वारे पवमानो अव्यये वृषाव चक्रदो वने ।देवानां सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरंजानो अर्षसि ॥
verses.transliteration: mṛjānáḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ avyáye ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ áva ǀ cakradaḥ ǀ váne ǀdevā́nām ǀ soma ǀ pavamāna ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjānáḥ ǀ arṣasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer of benefits, cleansed and filtered in the woollen fleece, you cried aloud in the water;Soma Pavamāna, mixed with the curds and milk, you go to the prepared (station) of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer of benefits, cleansed and filtered in the woollen fleece, you cried aloud in the water;Soma Pavamāna, mixed with the curds and milk, you go to the prepared (station) of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातयेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या ।त्वं समुद्रं प्रथमो वि धारयो देवेभ्यः सोम मत्सरः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀtvám ǀ samudrám ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhārayaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ soma ǀ matsaráḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, to all praises to procure food (for us); you, the exhilarator of the gods, are the chief supporter of the firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, to all praises to procure food (for us); you, the exhilarator of the gods, are the chief supporter of the firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रजो दिव्या च सोम धर्मभिः ।त्वां विप्रासो मतिभिर्विचक्षण शुभ्रं हिन्वंति धीतिभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ pavasva ǀ pári ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rájaḥ ǀ divyā́ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǀ śubhrám ǀ hinvanti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow quickly,Soma, with your supports, to the terrestrial and celestial worlds; the sages express you radiant, O observer of all, with praises and with their fingers.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow quickly,Soma, with your supports, to the terrestrial and celestial worlds; the sages express you radiant, O observer of all, with praises and with their fingers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत पवित्रमति धारया ।मरुत्वंतो मत्सरा इंद्रिया हया मेधामभि प्रयांसि च ॥
verses.transliteration: pávamānāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀmarútvantaḥ ǀ matsarā́ḥ ǀ indriyā́ḥ ǀ háyāḥ ǀ medhā́m ǀ abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Your purified juices are let flow through the filter in a stream accompanied by the Maruts, exhilarating plural asing Indra, swift-moving, bringing praise and food.
verses.wilson_translation: Your purified juices are let flow through the filter in a stream accompanied by the Maruts, exhilarating plural asing Indra, swift-moving, bringing praise and food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अपो वसानः परि कोशमर्षतींदुर्हियानः सोतृभिः ।जनयंज्योतिर्मंदना अवीवशद्गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजं ॥
verses.transliteration: apáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ kóśam ǀ arṣati ǀ índuḥ ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀjanáyan ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ mandánāḥ ǀ avīvaśat ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ ná ǀ niḥ-níjam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Induclothed with waters effused by the worshippers rushes to the receptacle, genitive rating light, identifying its form with the (products of the) kine, he covets now (our) praises.
verses.wilson_translation: Induclothed with waters effused by the worshippers rushes to the receptacle, genitive rating light, identifying its form with the (products of the) kine, he covets now (our) praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CVIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: (१-१६ ) १-२ गौरिवीति: शाक्त्य:; ३,१४-१६ शक्तिर्वासिष्ठ:,४-५ ऊरूराङ्गिरस:,६-७ ऋजिश्वा भारद्वाज:, ८-९ ऊर्ध्वसद्मा आङ्गिरस:, १०-११ कृतयशा आङ्गिरस:,१२-१३ ऋणचयो राजर्षि: । पवमान: सोम: । काकुभ: प्रगाथ:=( विषमा ककुप् , समा सतोबृहती ) , १३ यवमध्या गायत्री ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FOR Indra, flow thou Soma on, as gladdening juice most sweet, intelligent,Great, cheering, dwelling most in heaven. Thou, of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer. drinking of this that finds the light,He, Excellently Wise, is come to strengthening food, to spoil and wealth like Etaśa. For, verily, Pavamana, thou hast, splendidest, called all the generations ofThe Gods to immortality. By whom Dadhyac Navagva opens fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish,By whom they won the fame of lovely Amṛta in the felicity of Gods. Effused, he floweth in a stream, best rapture-giver, in the long wool of the sheep,Sporting, as ’twere the waters' wave. He who from out the rocky cavern took with might the redmrefulgent watery Cows,Thou masterest the stable full of kine and steeds: burst it, brave Lord, like one in mail. Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laudworthy, speeding through the region and the flood,Who swims in water, roan in wood; Increaser of the water, Steer with thousand streams, dear to the race of Deities;Who born in Law hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty Ordinance. Make splendid glory shine on us, thou Lord of strengthening food, God, as the Friend of Gods:Unclose the fount of middle air. Roll onward to the bowls, O Mighty One, effused, as Prince supporter of the tribes.Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the waters' flow: incite our thoughts to win the spoil. They have drained him the Steer of heaven, him with a thousand streams, distilling rapturous joy,Him who brings all things excellent. The Mighty One was born Immortal, giving life, lightening darkness with his shine.Wcll-praised by. sages he hath. by his wondrous power assumed the Threefold as his robe. Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us bounteous gifts and sweet refreshing food,Soma who brings us quiet homes: He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryarnan,By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuṇa and Indra for our great defence. Soma, for Indra's drink do thou, led by the men, well-wcaponcd and most gladdening,Flow on with greatest store of sweets. Enter the Soma-holder, even Indra's heart, as rivers pass into the sea,Acceptable to Mitra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, the noblest Pillar of the heavens.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व मधुमत्तम इंद्राय सोम क्रतुवित्तमो मदः ।महि द्युक्षतमो मदः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ kratuvít-tamaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀmáhi ǀ dyukṣá-tamaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma,who are most sweet-flavoured, most intelligent, the exhilarator, flow for Indra, the great, the most brilliant,the exhilarator.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma,who are most sweet-flavoured, most intelligent, the exhilarator, flow for Indra, the great, the most brilliant,the exhilarator.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते पीत्वा वृषभो वृषायतेऽस्य पीता स्वर्विदः ।स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिषोऽच्छा वाजं नैतशः ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ pītvā́ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vṛṣa-yáte ǀ asyá ǀ pītā́ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ su-práketaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ akramīt ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ vā́jam ǀ ná ǀ étaśaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: By drinking whom the showerer Indrais invigorated, by drinking you who are the beholder of everything, the intelligent (Indra) reaches the viands (of the enemy) as a horse (reaches) the battle.
verses.wilson_translation: By drinking whom the showerer Indrais invigorated, by drinking you who are the beholder of everything, the intelligent (Indra) reaches the viands (of the enemy) as a horse (reaches) the battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह्यंग दैव्या पवमान जनिमानि द्युमत्तमः ।अमृतत्वाय घोषयः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ aṅgá ǀ dáivyā ǀ pávamāna ǀ jánimāni ǀ dyumát-tamaḥ ǀamṛta-tvā́ya ǀ ghoṣáyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For you,Pavamāna, who aremost brilliant quickly shout to the races of the gods for (the sake of their) immortality.
verses.wilson_translation: For you,Pavamāna, who aremost brilliant quickly shout to the races of the gods for (the sake of their) immortality.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: येना नवग्वो दध्यङ्ङपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे ।देवानां सुम्ने अमृतस्य चारुणो येन श्रवांस्यानशुः ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ náva-gvaḥ ǀ dadhyáṅ ǀ apa-ūrṇuté ǀ yéna ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ āpiré ǀdevā́nām ǀ sumné ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ ānaśúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: (You) through whom Dadhyañc tthe offerer of the nine days' rites opened (the cave), through whom the ṛṣis recovered (the stolen cows), through whom under the protection of the gods the worshippers obtained the sustenance of the delicious (ambrosial water).
verses.wilson_translation: (You) through whom Dadhyañc tthe offerer of the nine days' rites opened (the cave), through whom the ṛṣis recovered (the stolen cows), through whom under the protection of the gods the worshippers obtained the sustenance of the delicious (ambrosial water).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य धारया सुतोऽव्यो वारेभिः पवते मदिंतमः ।क्रीळन्नूर्मिरपामिव ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ pavate ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀkrī́ḷan ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ apā́m-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: This (Soma) when effused flows most exhilarating through the woollen fleece, sporting like a wave of water.
verses.wilson_translation: This (Soma) when effused flows most exhilarating through the woollen fleece, sporting like a wave of water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: य उस्रिया अप्या अंतरश्मनो निर्गा अकृंतदोजसा ।अभि व्रजं तत्निषे गव्यमश्व्यं वर्मीव धृष्णवा रुज ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ áśmanaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ákṛntat ǀ ójasā ǀabhí ǀ vrajám ǀ tatniṣe ǀ gávyam ǀ áśvyam ǀ varmī́-iva ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ruja ǁ
verses.english_translation: You who by your might extricated from the rock the quick-moving kine abiding in the waters, you have spread out a pasturage for cattle and horses; like a mailed (warrior) slay (theasuras), brave (Soma).
verses.wilson_translation: You who by your might extricated from the rock the quick-moving kine abiding in the waters, you have spread out a pasturage for cattle and horses; like a mailed (warrior) slay (theasuras), brave (Soma).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ सोता परि षिंचताश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरं रजस्तुरं ।वनक्रक्षमुदप्रुतं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sota ǀ pári ǀ siñcata ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ stómam ǀ ap-túram ǀ rajaḥ-túram ǀvana-krakṣám ǀ uda-prútam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pour forth (the Soma), sprinkle it round like a horse, adorable, dispenser of rain, dispenser of light, showerer of fluid, swimming in water.
verses.wilson_translation: Pour forth (the Soma), sprinkle it round like a horse, adorable, dispenser of rain, dispenser of light, showerer of fluid, swimming in water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोवृधं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने ।ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásra-dhāram ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ payaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ priyám ǀ devā́ya ǀ jánmane ǀṛténa ǀ yáḥ ǀ ṛtá-jātaḥ ǀ vi-vavṛdhé ǀ rā́jā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thousand-streamed, showererof benefits, augmenter of water, affectionate; (pour it forth) for the race of the gods which water-born is fostered by the water, the king, the god, the true, the great.
verses.wilson_translation: Thousand-streamed, showererof benefits, augmenter of water, affectionate; (pour it forth) for the race of the gods which water-born is fostered by the water, the king, the god, the true, the great.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभि द्युम्नं बृहद्यश इषस्पते दिदीहि देव देवयुः ।वि कोशं मध्यमं युव ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ dyumnám ǀ bṛhát ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ pate ǀ didīhí ǀ deva ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀví ǀ kóśam ǀ madhyamám ǀ yuva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Divine (Soma) lord of viands, who are devoted to the gods, bestow upon us brilliant and abundant food; separate the mid-aerial receptacle.
verses.wilson_translation: Divine (Soma) lord of viands, who are devoted to the gods, bestow upon us brilliant and abundant food; separate the mid-aerial receptacle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः ।वृष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपां जिन्वा गविष्टये धियः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vacyasva ǀ su-dakṣa ǀ camvóḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ná ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀvṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ rītím ǀ apā́m ǀ jínva ǀ gó-iṣṭaye ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come, powerful (Soma) effused into the cups, like a prince the sustainer of the people; pour the course of the waters, the rain fromheaven; accomplish the rites for the worshipper who seeks cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: Come, powerful (Soma) effused into the cups, like a prince the sustainer of the people; pour the course of the waters, the rain fromheaven; accomplish the rites for the worshipper who seeks cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एतमु त्यं मदच्युतं सहस्रधारं वृषभं दिवो दुहुः ।विश्वा वसूनि बिभ्रतं ॥
verses.transliteration: etám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ sahásra-dhāram ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ dívaḥ ǀ duhuḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ bíbhratam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Him have they milked from heaven, the shedder of exhilarating juice, the thousand-streamed, the showerer (of benefits), bearing all treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: Him have they milked from heaven, the shedder of exhilarating juice, the thousand-streamed, the showerer (of benefits), bearing all treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा वि जज्ञे जनयन्नमर्त्यः प्रतपंज्योतिषा तमः ।स सुष्टुतः कविभिर्निर्णिजं दधे त्रिधात्वस्य दंससा ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ ví ǀ jajñe ǀ janáyan ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ pra-tápan ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ sú-stutaḥ ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ dadhe ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ asya ǀ dáṃsasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The showerer (of benefits) is manifested begetting (light) immortal, destroying the darkness with (his) radiance; glorified by the wise he has assumed his shining robe; the triple (oblation is supported) by his act.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of benefits) is manifested begetting (light) immortal, destroying the darkness with (his) radiance; glorified by the wise he has assumed his shining robe; the triple (oblation is supported) by his act.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इळानां ।सोमो यः सुक्षितीनां ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sunve ǀ yáḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ yáḥ ǀ rāyā́m ǀ ā-netā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ íḷānām ǀsómaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-kṣitīnā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somahas been effused who is the bringer of treasures, the bringer of riches, the bringer of food, the bringer of fair homes.
verses.wilson_translation: The Somahas been effused who is the bringer of treasures, the bringer of riches, the bringer of food, the bringer of fair homes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यस्य न इंद्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः ।आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एंद्रमवसे महे ॥
verses.transliteration: yásya ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ píbāt ǀ yásya ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ vā ǀ aryamáṇā ǀ bhágaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yéna ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ kárāmahe ǀ ā́ ǀ índram ǀ ávase ǀ mahé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our (Soma) which Indradrinks, which the Marutsdrink and Bhagawith Aryaman; through which we propitiate Mitraand Varuṇaand Indra, to obtain his powerful protection.
verses.wilson_translation: Our (Soma) which Indradrinks, which the Marutsdrink and Bhagawith Aryaman; through which we propitiate Mitraand Varuṇaand Indra, to obtain his powerful protection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राय सोम पातवे नृभिर्यतः स्वायुधो मदिंतमः ।पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pā́tave ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ su-āyudháḥ ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀpávasva ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, collected by the priests, well-armed, most exhilarating, most sweet-flavoured, flow for Indrato drink.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, collected by the priests, well-armed, most exhilarating, most sweet-flavoured, flow for Indrato drink.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश समुद्रमिव सिंधवः ।जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे दिवो विष्टंभ उत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: índrasya ǀ hā́rdi ǀ soma-dhā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀ samudrám-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀjúṣṭaḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ diváḥ ǀ viṣṭambháḥ ǀ ut-tamáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, enter the Somadhāna,Indra's heart, as the rivers (enter) the sea agreeable to Mitra,Varuṇaand Vāyu, the chief stay of heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, enter the Somadhāna,Indra's heart, as the rivers (enter) the sea agreeable to Mitra,Varuṇaand Vāyu, the chief stay of heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CIX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: २२ अग्नयो धिष्ण्या ऐश्वरय: । पवमान: सोम: ।द्विपदा विराट् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . PLEASANT to Indra's Mitra's, Pūṣan's Bhaga's taste, sped onward, Soma, with thy flowing stream. Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all Deities for strength. So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast, immortal dwelling-place. Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods to every form. Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods and Heaven and Earth and bless our progeny. Thou, bright Juice, art Sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true Law. Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream through the great fleece as in the olden time. Bom, led by men, joyous, and purified, let the Light-finder make all blessings flow: Indu, while cleansed, keeping the people safe, shall give us all possessions for our own. Flow on for wisdom, Soma, and for power, as a strong courser bathed, to win the prize. The pressers purify this juice of thine, the Soma, for delight, and lofty fame They deck the Gold-hued Infant, newlyborn, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve for Gods. Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, Sage for good fortune in the waters' lap. He bears the beauteous name of Indra, that wherewith he overcame all demon foes. All Deities are wont to drink of him, pressed by the men and blent with milk and curds. He hath flowed forth with thousand streams effused, flowed ihsough the filter and the sheep's long wool. With endless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk. Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go fortli, O Soma, into Indra's throat. The mighty Soma with a thousand streams is poured to Indra through the cleansing sieve. Indu they balm with pleasant milky juice for Indra, for the Steer, for his delight. Lightly, for sheen, they cleanse thee for the Gods, gold-coloured, wearing water as thy robe. Indu to Indra streams, yea, downward streams, Strong, flowing to the floods, and mingling -there.

verses.sanskrit: परि प्र धन्वेंद्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ prá ǀ dhanva ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ svādúḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ pūṣṇé ǀ bhágāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Somawho are sweet-flavoured, for Indra,Mitra,Pūṣan, and Bhaga.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Somawho are sweet-flavoured, for Indra,Mitra,Pūṣan, and Bhaga.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयाः क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ te ǀ soma ǀ sutásya ǀ peyāḥ ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ víśve ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, let Indraand all the gods drink of you when effused for intelligence and strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, let Indraand all the gods drink of you when effused for intelligence and strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ mahé ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ sáḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ divyáḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: So do you who are pure, divine, the beverage of all the gods, flow for immortality and a spacious abode.
verses.wilson_translation: So do you who are pure, divine, the beverage of all the gods, flow for immortality and a spacious abode.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ mahā́n ǀ samudráḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ víśvā ǀ abhí ǀ dhā́ma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, who are mighty, the shedder of juice the parent of the gods, towards all bodies.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, who are mighty, the shedder of juice the parent of the gods, towards all bodies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजायै ॥
verses.transliteration: śukráḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ soma ǀ divé ǀ pṛthivyái ǀ śám ǀ ca ǀ pra-jā́yai ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, who are brilliant, flow for the gods and (give) joy to heaven and earth and all creatures.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, who are brilliant, flow for the gods and (give) joy to heaven and earth and all creatures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवो धर्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ asi ǀ śukráḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣaḥ ǀ satyé ǀ ví-dharman ǀ vājī́ ǀ pavasva ǁ
verses.english_translation: You are the upholder of heaven, radiant and good to drink; flow you who are strong, at the truthful sacrifice.
verses.wilson_translation: You are the upholder of heaven, radiant and good to drink; flow you who are strong, at the truthful sacrifice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम द्युम्नी सुधारो महामवीनामनु पूर्व्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ su-dhāráḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ ávīnām ǀ ánu ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Do you,Soma, who are possessed of food, who have a copious stream, flow through the great sheep's hairs in due succession.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Soma, who are possessed of food, who have a copious stream, flow through the great sheep's hairs in due succession.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: नृभिर्येमानो जज्ञानः पूतः क्षरद्विश्वानि मंद्रः स्वर्वित् ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ pūtáḥ ǀ kṣárat ǀ víśvāni ǀ mandráḥ ǀ svaḥ-vít ǁ
verses.english_translation: May, the Somaregulated by the priests, engendered, purified, exhilarating, all-knowing bring us all (riches).
verses.wilson_translation: May, the Somaregulated by the priests, engendered, purified, exhilarating, all-knowing bring us all (riches).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुः पुनानः प्रजामुराणः करद्विश्वानि द्रविणानि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ urāṇáḥ ǀ kárat ǀ víśvāni ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indu, purified, extolling (the gods) bestow on us progeny and all kinds of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indu, purified, extolling (the gods) bestow on us progeny and all kinds of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम क्रत्वे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥
verses.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ niktáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ dhánāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, for intelligence, for strength, for wealth, strong and cleansed like a horse.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, for intelligence, for strength, for wealth, strong and cleansed like a horse.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: तं ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनंति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय ॥
verses.transliteration: tám ǀ te ǀ sotā́raḥ ǀ rásam ǀ mádāya ǀ punánti ǀ sómam ǀ mahé ǀ dyumnā́ya ǁ
verses.english_translation: (The priests) who press you purify your juice for exhilaration; (they purify) the Somafor abundant food.
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests) who press you purify your juice for exhilaration; (they purify) the Somafor abundant food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: शिशुं जज्ञानं हरिं मृजंति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इंदुं ॥
verses.transliteration: śíśum ǀ jajñānám ǀ hárim ǀ mṛjanti ǀ pavítre ǀ sómam ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ índum ǁ
verses.english_translation: They cleanse the new-born infant, the green-tinted shining Soma, on the filter for the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: They cleanse the new-born infant, the green-tinted shining Soma, on the filter for the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुः पविष्ट चारुर्मदायापामुपस्थे कविर्भगाय ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ paviṣṭa ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ kavíḥ ǀ bhágāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: The auspicious sage Induflows upon the lap of the waters for exhilaration and for wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: The auspicious sage Induflows upon the lap of the waters for exhilaration and for wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: बिभर्ति चार्विंद्रस्य नाम येन विश्वानि वृत्रा जघान ॥
verses.transliteration: bíbharti ǀ cā́ru ǀ índrasya ǀ nā́ma ǀ yéna ǀ víśvāni ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ jaghā́na ǁ
verses.english_translation: The auspicious (Soma) sustains Indra's body, by which he has slain allrākṣasas.
verses.wilson_translation: The auspicious (Soma) sustains Indra's body, by which he has slain allrākṣasas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पिबंत्यस्य विश्वे देवासो गोभिः श्रीतस्य नृभिः सुतस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: píbanti ǀ asya ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ śrītásya ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sutásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: The universal gods drink of it, effused by the priests, mixed with milk and curds.
verses.wilson_translation: The universal gods drink of it, effused by the priests, mixed with milk and curds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सुवानो अक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ ví ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Being effused the Somain a thousand streams flows through the sheep's-hair filter.
verses.wilson_translation: Being effused the Somain a thousand streams flows through the sheep's-hair filter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ sahásra-retāḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ mṛjānáḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ śrīṇānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vigorous Somaflows in a thousand streams cleansed by the waters and mixing with the curds and milk.
verses.wilson_translation: The vigorous Somaflows in a thousand streams cleansed by the waters and mixing with the curds and milk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोम याहींद्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ yāhi ǀ índrasya ǀ kukṣā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Guided by the priests and effused with the stones go,Soma, to Indra's belly.
verses.wilson_translation: Guided by the priests and effused with the stones go,Soma, to Indra's belly.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: असर्जि वाजी तिरः पवित्रमिंद्राय सोमः सहस्रधारः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásarji ǀ vājī́ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ índrāya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The vigorous thousand-streamed Somahas been sent through, the filter for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The vigorous thousand-streamed Somahas been sent through, the filter for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अंजंत्येनं मध्वो रसेनेंद्राय वृष्ण इंदुं मदाय ॥
verses.transliteration: añjánti ǀ enam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ rásena ǀ índrāya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ índum ǀ mádāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: They mix the Somawith the liquid of the sweet (milk) for Indra, the showerer (of benefits) for his exhilaration.
verses.wilson_translation: They mix the Somawith the liquid of the sweet (milk) for Indra, the showerer (of benefits) for his exhilaration.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्त्वा वृथा पाजसेऽपो वसानं हरिं मृजंति ॥
verses.transliteration: devébhyaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ pā́jase ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānam ǀ hárim ǀ mṛjanti ǁ
verses.english_translation: They cleanse you readily, clothed with water, green-tinted, for the invigoration of the gods.
verses.wilson_translation: They cleanse you readily, clothed with water, green-tinted, for the invigoration of the gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: इंदुरिंद्राय तोशते नि तोशते श्रीणन्नुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥
verses.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ tośate ǀ ní ǀ tośate ǀ śrīṇán ǀ ugráḥ ǀ riṇán ǀ apáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Induis effused for Indra's, is effused downward-- fierce, mixing (with the milk), flowing (into) the water.
verses.wilson_translation: Induis effused for Indra's, is effused downward-- fierce, mixing (with the milk), flowing (into) the water.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CX. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.anukramani: १२ त्र्यरुणस्त्रैवृष्ण:,त्रसदस्यु: पौरुकुत्स्य: । पवमान: सोम: ।१-३ पिपीलिकमध्या अनुष्टुप् , ४-९ ऊर्ध्वबृहती,१०-१२ विराट् ।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O'ERPOWERING Vṛtras, forward run to win great strength:Thou speedest to subdue like one exacting debts. In thee, effused, O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight.Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds, O Pavamana, thou didst generate the Sun, and spread the moisture out with power,Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.
