Thou didst produce him, Deathless God mid mortal men for maintenance of Law and lovely Amṛta:Thou evermore hast moved making strength flow to us. All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as ’twere a never-failing well for men to drink,Borne on thy way in fragments from the presser's arms. Then, beautifully radiant, certain Heavenly Ones, have sung to him their kinship as they looked thereon,And Savitar the God opens as ’twere a stall. Soma, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown:So, Hero, urge us onward to heroic power. They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old primeval milk of heaven that claims the laud:They lifted up their voice to Indra athis birth. As long as thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might,Thou standest like a Bull the chief amid the herd. In the sheep's wool hath Soma Pavamana flowed, while they cleanse him, like a playful infant,Indu with hundred powers and hundred currents. Holy and sweet, while purified, this Indu flows on, a wave of pleasant taste, to Indra,—Strength-winner, Treasure-finder, Life. bestower. So flow thou on, subduing our assailants, chasing the demons hard to beencountered,Well-armed and conquering our foes, O Soma.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः ।द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईयसे ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ prá ǀ dhanva ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ pári ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sakṣáṇiḥ ǀdviṣáḥ ǀ tarádhyai ǀ ṛṇa-yā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ īyase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Hasten,Soma, to bring us sustenance; gifted with endurance (attack our) foes; the acquitter of our debts, you approach to disperse our enemies.
verses.wilson_translation: Hasten,Soma, to bring us sustenance; gifted with endurance (attack our) foes; the acquitter of our debts, you approach to disperse our enemies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अनु हि त्वा सुतं सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये ।वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ sutám ǀ soma ǀ mádāmasi ǀ mahé ǀ samarya-rā́jye ǀvā́jān ǀ abhí ǀ pavamāna ǀ prá ǀ gāhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: In turn we glorify you,Soma, when effused; you attack the (hostile) forces, OPavamāna, to (defend) your great sovereignty over men.
verses.wilson_translation: In turn we glorify you,Soma, when effused; you attack the (hostile) forces, OPavamāna, to (defend) your great sovereignty over men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः ।गोजीरया रंहमाणः पुरंध्या ॥
verses.transliteration: ájījanaḥ ǀ hí ǀ pavamāna ǀ sū́ryam ǀ vi-dhā́re ǀ śákmanā ǀ páyaḥ ǀgó-jīrayā ǀ ráṃhamāṇaḥ ǀ púram-dhyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pavamāna, by your might you ahve genitive rated the sun in (the firmament), the support of the water, hastening on with abundant wisdom that procures cattle (for your worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: Pavamāna, by your might you ahve genitive rated the sun in (the firmament), the support of the water, hastening on with abundant wisdom that procures cattle (for your worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्येष्वाँ ऋतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः ।सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ájījanaḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhárman ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀsádā ǀ asaraḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ áccha ǀ sánisyadat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Immortal Soma, you have genitive rated (the sun) among mortals in (the firmament), the suppor tof the truthful auspicious ambrosia; streaming forth you goe to battle continually.
verses.wilson_translation: Immortal Soma, you have genitive rated (the sun) among mortals in (the firmament), the suppor tof the truthful auspicious ambrosia; streaming forth you goe to battle continually.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितं ।शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí-abhi ǀ hí ǀ śrávasā ǀ tatárditha ǀ útsam ǀ ná ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ jana-pā́nam ǀ ákṣitam ǀśáryābhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ bháramāṇaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: You have burst open (the filter) with (your) food as (one bursts open) an inexhaustible fountain giving drink to the nation, like one taking up (water) with the fingers of his twohands.
verses.wilson_translation: You have burst open (the filter) with (your) food as (one bursts open) an inexhaustible fountain giving drink to the nation, like one taking up (water) with the fingers of his twohands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत ।वारं न देवः सविता व्यूर्णुते ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ páśyamānāsaḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ vasu-rúcaḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀvā́ram ǀ ná ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ ví ǀ ūrṇute ǁ
verses.english_translation: Beholding him certain celestial Vasurucas praise him as a kinsman before the shining Savitādrives away the obstructing (darkness).
verses.wilson_translation: Beholding him certain celestial Vasurucas praise him as a kinsman before the shining Savitādrives away the obstructing (darkness).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियं दधुः ।स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय ॥
verses.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ soma ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ śrávase ǀ dhíyam ǀ dadhuḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ vīra ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ codaya ǁ
verses.english_translation: The chief (of men) having cut the sacred grass have fixed their minds,Soma, on you for abundant strength and food; do you, O hero, excite us to heroism.
verses.wilson_translation: The chief (of men) having cut the sacred grass have fixed their minds,Soma, on you for abundant strength and food; do you, O hero, excite us to heroism.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: दिवः पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहाद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत ।इंद्रमभि जायमानं समस्वरन् ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ pūrvyám ǀ yát ǀ ukthyám ǀ maháḥ ǀ gāhā́t ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ níḥ ǀ adhukṣata ǀíndram ǀ abhí ǀ jā́yamānam ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
verses.english_translation: They have milked from heaven from the mighty deep the ancient Soma, the beverage (of the gods) of heaven, which is worthy of praise; they have praised it when genitive rated for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: They have milked from heaven from the mighty deep the ancient Soma, the beverage (of the gods) of heaven, which is worthy of praise; they have praised it when genitive rated for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना ।यूथे न निष्ठा वृषभो वि तिष्ठसे ॥
verses.transliteration: ádha ǀ yát ǀ imé íti ǀ pavamāna ǀ ródasī íti ǀ imā́ ǀ ca ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ majmánā ǀyūthé ǀ ná ǀ niḥ-sthā́ḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhase ǁ
verses.english_translation: Since,Pavamāna, you by your might are chief over these two worlds and all these living beings, as a bull is ruler in a herd of kine.
verses.wilson_translation: Since,Pavamāna, you by your might are chief over these two worlds and all these living beings, as a bull is ruler in a herd of kine.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सोमः पुनानो अव्यये वारे शिशुर्न क्रीळन्पवमानो अक्षाः ।सहस्रधारः शतवाज इंदुः ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ avyáye ǀ vā́re ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ ná ǀ krī́ḷan ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ śatá-vājaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pavamāna Somasporting like a child drops filtered through the woollen fleece, thousand-streamed, having the might of a hundred, radiant.
verses.wilson_translation: Pavamāna Somasporting like a child drops filtered through the woollen fleece, thousand-streamed, having the might of a hundred, radiant.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: एष पुनानो मधुमाँ ऋतावेंद्रायेंदुः पवते स्वादुरूर्मिः ।वाजसनिर्वरिवोविद्वयोधाः ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ índrāya ǀ índuḥ ǀ pavate ǀ svādúḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀvāja-sániḥ ǀ varivaḥ-vít ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This Somajuice undergoing purification, sweet-flavoured, holy, dropping; flows for Indraa sweet stream, bestowing food, dispensing wealth and life.
verses.wilson_translation: This Somajuice undergoing purification, sweet-flavoured, holy, dropping; flows for Indraa sweet stream, bestowing food, dispensing wealth and life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: स पवस्व सहमानः पृतन्यून्त्सेधन्रक्षांस्यप दुर्गहाणि ।स्वायुधः सासह्वान्त्सोम शत्रून् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ sáhamānaḥ ǀ pṛtanyū́n ǀ sédhan ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ ápa ǀ duḥ-gáhāni ǀsu-āyudháḥ ǀ sasahvā́n ǀ soma ǀ śátrūn ǁ
verses.english_translation: Flow,Soma, overcoming (our) enemies, driving away therākṣasaswho are difficult to approach, well-armed, triumphing over foes.
verses.wilson_translation: Flow,Soma, overcoming (our) enemies, driving away therākṣasaswho are difficult to approach, well-armed, triumphing over foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CXI. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WITH this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies, as Sara with his own allies.Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with the praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths. That treasure of the Paṇis thou discoveredst; thou with thy mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with songs of worship in thine home.As ’twere from far, the hymn is heard, where holy songs resound in joy. He with the ruddy-hued, threefold hath won life-power, he, glittering, hath won life-power. He moves intelligent, directed to the East. The very beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car.Hymns, lauding manly valour, came, inciting Indra to success, that ye may be unconquered, both thy bolt and thou, both be unconquered in the war.

verses.sanskrit: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि तरति स्वयुग्वभिः सूरो न स्वयुग्वभिः ।धारा सुतस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः ।विश्वा यद्रूपा परियात्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिर्ऋक्वभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ rucā́ ǀ háriṇyā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ tarati ǀ svayúgva-bhiḥ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ svayúgva-bhiḥ ǀdhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ rocate ǀ punānáḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ yát ǀ rūpā́ ǀ pari-yā́ti ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ saptá-āsyebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With this bright green-tinted stream Somabeing filtered overcomes all enemies with the (juices) yoked to it, as the sun (overcomes the darkness) with the (rays) yoked to it; the stream of the effused (Soma) shines, the filtered green-tinted (Soma) is resplendent, which pervade all constellations, with the ṛkvans, with the seven-mouthed ṛkvans.
verses.wilson_translation: With this bright green-tinted stream Somabeing filtered overcomes all enemies with the (juices) yoked to it, as the sun (overcomes the darkness) with the (rays) yoked to it; the stream of the effused (Soma) shines, the filtered green-tinted (Soma) is resplendent, which pervade all constellations, with the ṛkvans, with the seven-mouthed ṛkvans.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे ।परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणंति धीतयः ।त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ tyát ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ vidaḥ ǀ vásu ǀ sám ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ marjayasi ǀ své ǀ ā́ ǀ dáme ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ dáme ǀparā-vátaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sā́ma ǀ tát ǀ yátra ǀ ráṇanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀtridhā́tu-bhiḥ ǀ áruṣībhiḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ rócamānaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǁ
verses.english_translation: You did discover the wealth of the Paṇis, and are washed in your own house at the sacrifice by the mothers, the supporters of the sacrifice; as the hymn (is heard) from afar, so it (is heard by all, the hymn) in which the supporters (of the rite) rejoice; the shining (Soma) with its brilliant (waters), the supporters of the three (worlds), gives food, gives food (to the worshippers).
verses.wilson_translation: You did discover the wealth of the Paṇis, and are washed in your own house at the sacrifice by the mothers, the supporters of the sacrifice; as the hymn (is heard) from afar, so it (is heard by all, the hymn) in which the supporters (of the rite) rejoice; the shining (Soma) with its brilliant (waters), the supporters of the three (worlds), gives food, gives food (to the worshippers).
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वामनु प्रदिशं याति चेकितत्सं रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः ।अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौंस्येंद्रं जैत्राय हर्षयन् ।वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता ॥
verses.transliteration: pū́rvām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-díśam ǀ yāti ǀ cékitat ǀ sám ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ yatate ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀágman ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ páuṃsyā ǀ índram ǀ jáitrāya ǀ harṣayan ǀvájraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ bhávathaḥ ǀ ánapa-cyutā ǀ samát-su ǀ ánapa-cyutā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The intelligent Somaproceeds to the eastern quarter; (your) beautiful chariot, (your) celestial beautiful chariot meets the sun's rays; the manly praises advance to Indraand stimulate him to victory; (his) thunderbolt too (advances to him); so that you are invincible, invincible in battle.
verses.wilson_translation: The intelligent Somaproceeds to the eastern quarter; (your) beautiful chariot, (your) celestial beautiful chariot meets the sun's rays; the manly praises advance to Indraand stimulate him to victory; (his) thunderbolt too (advances to him); so that you are invincible, invincible in battle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CXII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE all have various thoughts and plans, and diverse are the ways of men.The Brahman seeks the worshipper, wright seeks the cracked, and leech the maimed. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. The smith with ripe and seasoned plants, with feathers of the birds of air,With stones, and with enkindled flames, seeks him who hath a store of gold. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. A bard am I, my dad's a leech, mammy lays corn upon the stones.Striving for wealth, with varied plans, we follow our desires like kine. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. The horse would draw an easy car, gay hosts attract the laugh and jest.The male desires his mate's approach, the frog is eager for the flood, Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sanskrit: नानानं वा उ नो धियो वि व्रतानि जनानां ।तक्षा रिष्टं रुतं भिषग्ब्रह्मा सुन्वंतमिच्छतींद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: nānānám ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vratā́ni ǀ jánānām ǀtákṣā ǀ riṣṭám ǀ rutám ǀ bhiṣák ǀ brahmā́ ǀ sunvántam ǀ icchati ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Various are our acts, (various) are the occupations of men; the carpenter desires timber, the physician disease, thebrāhmaṇaa worshipper who effuses Soma; flow,Indufor Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Various are our acts, (various) are the occupations of men; the carpenter desires timber, the physician disease, thebrāhmaṇaa worshipper who effuses Soma; flow,Indufor Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: जरतीभिरोषधीभिः पर्णेभिः शकुनानां ।कार्मारो अश्मभिर्द्युभिर्हिरण्यवंतमिच्छतींद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: járatībhiḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ parṇébhiḥ ǀ śakunā́nām ǀkārmāráḥ ǀ áśma-bhiḥ ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ híraṇya-vantam ǀ icchati ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: With dried plural nts (are arrows made), with the feathers of birds (and) with glistening stones; the smith seeks a man who has gold; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: With dried plural nts (are arrows made), with the feathers of birds (and) with glistening stones; the smith seeks a man who has gold; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: कारुरहं ततो भिषगुपलप्रक्षिणी नना ।नानाधियो वसूयवोऽनु गा इव तस्थिमेंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: kārúḥ ǀ ahám ǀ tatáḥ ǀ bhiṣák ǀ upala-prakṣíṇī ǀ nanā́ ǀnā́nā-dhiyaḥ ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gā́ḥ-iva ǀ tasthima ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: I am the singer;papais the physician, mamma throws the corn upon the grinding stones; having various occupations, desiring riches we remain (in the world) like cattle (in the stall); flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: I am the singer;papais the physician, mamma throws the corn upon the grinding stones; having various occupations, desiring riches we remain (in the world) like cattle (in the stall); flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वो वोळ्हा सुखं रथं हसनामुपमंत्रिणः ।शेपो रोमण्वंतौ भेदौ वारिन्मंडूक इच्छतींद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ vóḷhā ǀ su-khám ǀ rátham ǀ hasanā́m ǀ upa-mantríṇaḥ ǀśépaḥ ǀ rómaṇ-vantau ǀ bhedáu ǀ vā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ maṇḍū́kaḥ ǀ icchati ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: The draught horse (desire) a cart easy (to draw); those who invite guests (desire) merriment; the frog desires water; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The draught horse (desire) a cart easy (to draw); those who invite guests (desire) merriment; the frog desires water; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CXIII. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LET Vṛtra-slaying Indra drink Soma by Śaryaṇāvān's side,Storing up vigour in his heart, prepared to do heroic deeds. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Lord of the Quarters, flow thou on, boon Soma, from Arjika land,Effused with ardour and with faith, and the true hymn of sacrifice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Hither hath Sūrya's Daughter brought the wild Steer whom Parjanya nursed.Gandharvas have seized bold of him, and in the Soma laid the juice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Splendid by Law! declaring Law, truthspeaking, truthful in thy works,Enouncing faith, King Soma! thou, O Soma, whom thy maker decks. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Together flow the meeting streams of him the Great and truly Strong.The juices of the juicy meet. Made pure by prayer, O Golden-hued, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. O Pavamana, where the priest, as he recites the rhythmic prayer,Lords it o’er Soma with the stone, with Soma bringing forth delight, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. O Pavarnana, place me in that deathless, undecaying worldWherein the light of heaven is set, and everlasting lustre shines. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Make me immortal in that realm where dwells the King, Vivasvān's Son,Where is the secret shrine of heaven, where are those waters young and fresh. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Make me immortal in that realm where they move even as they list,In the third sphere of inmost heaven where lucid worlds are full of light. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Make me immortal in that realm of eager wish and strong desire,The region of the radiant Moon, where food and full delight are found. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake: Make me immortal in that realm where happiness and transports, whereJoys and felicities combine, and longing wishes are fulfilled. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sanskrit: शर्यणावति सोममिंद्रः पिबतु वृत्रहा ।बलं दधान आत्मनि करिष्यन्वीर्यं महदिंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: śaryaṇā́-vati ǀ sómam ǀ índraḥ ǀ pibatu ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀbálam ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ātmáni ǀ kariṣyán ǀ vīryám ǀ mahát ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, quaff the Somaon the Śaryaṇāvat, infusing strength into himself, about to show great prowess; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Let Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, quaff the Somaon the Śaryaṇāvat, infusing strength into himself, about to show great prowess; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व दिशां पत आर्जीकात्सोम मीढ्वः ।ऋतवाकेन सत्येन श्रद्धया तपसा सुत इंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ diśām ǀ pate ǀ ārjīkā́t ǀ soma ǀ mīḍhvaḥ ǀṛta-vākéna ǀ satyéna ǀ śraddháyā ǀ tápasā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, lord of the four regions, sprinkler (of benefits) flow from Ārjikā effused by a truth-speaking truthful (man) with faith and devotion; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, lord of the four regions, sprinkler (of benefits) flow from Ārjikā effused by a truth-speaking truthful (man) with faith and devotion; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: पर्जन्यवृद्धं महिषं तं सूर्यस्य दुहिताभरत् ।तं गंधर्वाः प्रत्यगृभ्णंतं सोमे रसमादधुरिंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: parjánya-vṛddham ǀ mahiṣám ǀ tám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ duhitā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ abharat ǀtám ǀ gandharvā́ḥ ǀ práti ǀ agṛbhṇan ǀ tám ǀ sóme ǀ rásam ǀ ā́ ǀ adadhuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: The daughter of Sūryabrought the vast Somalarge as a rain-cloud; thegandharvaseized upon it and plural ced the juice in the Soma; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The daughter of Sūryabrought the vast Somalarge as a rain-cloud; thegandharvaseized upon it and plural ced the juice in the Soma; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतं वदन्नृतद्युम्न सत्यं वदन्त्सत्यकर्मन् ।श्रद्धां वदन्त्सोम राजंधात्रा सोम परिष्कृत इंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ vádan ǀ ṛta-dyumna ǀ satyám ǀ vádan ǀ satya-karman ǀśraddhā́m ǀ vádan ǀ soma ǀ rājan ǀ dhātrā́ ǀ soma ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Soma, the utterer of truth, radiant with truth, truth-speaking, truthful in act, speaking faith; lord (of worshippers), you are decorated by the upholder (of the rite); flow,Indufor Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Soma, the utterer of truth, radiant with truth, truth-speaking, truthful in act, speaking faith; lord (of worshippers), you are decorated by the upholder (of the rite); flow,Indufor Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमुग्रस्य बृहतः सं स्रवंति संस्रवाः ।सं यंति रसिनो रसाः पुनानो ब्रह्मणा हर इंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: satyám-ugrasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ sám ǀ sravanti ǀ sam-sravā́ḥ ǀsám ǀ yanti ǀ rasínaḥ ǀ rásāḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ hare ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: The united streams of you who are vast and truly formidable flow united; the juices of you the juicy one meet together; green-tinted (Soma), purified by holy prayer,Indu, flow for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: The united streams of you who are vast and truly formidable flow united; the juices of you the juicy one meet together; green-tinted (Soma), purified by holy prayer,Indu, flow for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्र ब्रह्मा पवमान च्छंदस्यां वाचं वदन् ।ग्राव्णा सोमे महीयते सोमेनानंदं जनयन्निंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ brahmā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ chandasyā́m ǀ vā́cam ǀ vádan ǀgrā́vṇā ǀ sóme ǀ mahīyáte ǀ sómena ǀ ā-nandám ǀ janáyan ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wherever the Brahman, O purified (Soma), reciting the holy rhythmical text, engendering the delight (of the gods) by the Soma (expressed) with the grinding-stone, is reverenced, flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Wherever the Brahman, O purified (Soma), reciting the holy rhythmical text, engendering the delight (of the gods) by the Soma (expressed) with the grinding-stone, is reverenced, flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्र ज्योतिरजस्रं यस्मिँल्लोके स्वर्हितं ।तस्मिन्मां धेहि पवमानामृते लोके अक्षित इंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ájasram ǀ yásmin ǀ loké ǀ sváḥ ǀ hitám ǀtásmin ǀ mā́m ǀ dhehi ǀ pavamāna ǀ amṛ́te ǀ loké ǀ ákṣite ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where light is perpetual, in the world in which the sun is plural ced, in that immortal imperishable world plural ce me,Pavamāna; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Where light is perpetual, in the world in which the sun is plural ced, in that immortal imperishable world plural ce me,Pavamāna; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्र राजा वैवस्वतो यत्रावरोधनं दिवः ।यत्रामूर्यह्वतीरापस्तत्र माममृतं कृधींद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ rā́jā ǀ vaivasvatáḥ ǀ yátra ǀ ava-ródhanam ǀ diváḥ ǀyátra ǀ amū́ḥ ǀ yahvátīḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where Vivasvat's son is king, where the inner chamber of the sun (is), where these great waters (are), there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Where Vivasvat's son is king, where the inner chamber of the sun (is), where these great waters (are), there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्रानुकामं चरणं त्रिनाके त्रिदिवे दिवः ।लोका यत्र ज्योतिष्मंतस्तत्र माममृतं कृधींद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ anu-kāmám ǀ cáraṇam ǀ tri-nāké ǀ tri-divé ǀ diváḥ ǀlokā́ḥ ǀ yátra ǀ jyótiṣmantaḥ ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where in the third heaven, in the third sphere, the sun wanders at will, where the regions are filled with light, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Where in the third heaven, in the third sphere, the sun wanders at will, where the regions are filled with light, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्र कामा निकामाश्च यत्र ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं ।स्वधा च यत्र तृप्तिश्च तत्र माममृतं कृधींद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ ni-kāmā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ yátra ǀ bradhnásya ǀ viṣṭápam ǀsvadhā́ ǀ ca ǀ yátra ǀ tṛ́ptiḥ ǀ ca ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where wishes and desires (are), where the region of the sun (is), where food and delight (are) found, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Where wishes and desires (are), where the region of the sun (is), where food and delight (are) found, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्रानंदाश्च मोदाश्च मुदः प्रमुद आसते ।कामस्य यत्राप्ताः कामास्तत्र माममृतं कृधींद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ ānandā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ módāḥ ǀ ca ǀ múdaḥ ǀ pra-múdaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǀkā́masya ǀ yátra ǀ āptā́ḥ ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Where there is happiness, plural asure, joy and enjoyment, where the wishes of the wishers are obtained, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Where there is happiness, plural asure, joy and enjoyment, where the wishes of the wishers are obtained, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN CXIV. Soma Pavamana.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THE man who waIketh as the Laws of Indu Pavamana bid,—Men call him rich in children, him, O Soma, who hath met thy thought. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Kasyapa, Ṛṣi, lifting up thy voice with hymn-composers' lauds,Pav reverence to King Soma born the Sovran Ruler of the plants. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Seven regions have their several Suns; the ministering priests are seven;Seven are the Āditya Deities,—with these, O Soma, guard thou us. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake. Guard us with this oblation which, King Soma, hath been dressed for thee.

verses.sanskrit: य इंदोः पवमानस्यानु धामान्यक्रमीत् ।तमाहुः सुप्रजा इति यस्ते सोमाविधन्मन इंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ índoḥ ǀ pávamānasya ǀ ánu ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ákramīt ǀtám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ su-prajā́ḥ ǀ íti ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ soma ǀ ávidhat ǀ mánaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: (Thebrāhmaṇa) who attends to the stations of the filtered Soma-juice-- him men call rich in children, who applies his mind to you, Soma; flow,Indufor Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: (Thebrāhmaṇa) who attends to the stations of the filtered Soma-juice-- him men call rich in children, who applies his mind to you, Soma; flow,Indufor Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: ऋषे मंत्रकृतां स्तोमैः कश्यपोद्वर्धयन्गिरः ।सोमं नमस्य राजानं यो जज्ञे वीरुधां पतिरिंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛ́ṣe ǀ mantra-kṛ́tām ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ káśyapa ǀ ut-vardháyan ǀ gíraḥ ǀsómam ǀ namasya ǀ rā́jānam ǀ yáḥ ǀ jajñé ǀ vīrúdhām ǀ pátiḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ṛṣi Kaśyapa, raising your voice with the praises of the hymn-makers, adore the royal Somawho is born the lord of the growing (vīrūdhām); flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Ṛṣi Kaśyapa, raising your voice with the praises of the hymn-makers, adore the royal Somawho is born the lord of the growing (vīrūdhām); flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: सप्त दिशो नानासूर्याः सप्त होतार ऋत्विजः ।देवा आदित्या ये सप्त तेभिः सोमाभि रक्ष न इंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: saptá ǀ díśaḥ ǀ nā́nā-sūryāḥ ǀ saptá ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ ṛtvíjaḥ ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ ādityā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ saptá ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ soma ǀ abhí ǀ rakṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Seven (are) the quarters of the world with different suns, seven (are) the ministrant priests, seven are the divineĀdityas-- with these,Soma, protect us; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Seven (are) the quarters of the world with different suns, seven (are) the ministrant priests, seven are the divineĀdityas-- with these,Soma, protect us; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते राजंछृतं हविस्तेन सोमाभि रक्ष नः ।अरातीवा मा नस्तारीन्मो च नः किं चनाममदिंद्रायेंदो परि स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ rājan ǀ śṛtám ǀ havíḥ ǀ téna ǀ soma ǀ abhí ǀ rakṣa ǀ naḥ ǀarāti-vā́ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tārīt ǀ mó íti ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ āmamat ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
verses.english_translation: Protect us, royal Soma, with the oblation which has been cooked for you; let no enemy assail us, or harm anything of ours; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: Protect us, royal Soma, with the oblation which has been cooked for you; let no enemy assail us, or harm anything of ours; flow,Indu, for Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN I. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HIGH hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness.Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations. Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni!The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers. Here, being manifested, lofty Viṣṇu, full wise, protects his own supremest station.When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises. Thence bearing food the Mothers come to meet thee, with food for thee who givest food its increase.These in their altered form again thou meetest. Thou art Invoking Priest in homes of mortals. Priest of the holy rite, with car that glitters, refulgent Banner of each act of worship,Sharinging every God through might and glory, even Agni Guest of men I summon hither. So Agni stands on earth's most central station, invested in well-decorated garments.Born, red of hue, where men pour out libations, O King, as great High Priest bring the Gods hither. Over the earth and over heaven, O Agni, thou, Son, hast ever spread above thy Parents.Come, Youthfullest! to those who long to meet thee, and hither bring the Gods, O Mighty Victor.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे बृहन्नुषसामूर्ध्वो अस्थान्निर्जगन्वांतमसो ज्योतिषागात् ।अग्निर्भानुना रुशता स्वंग आ जातो विश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágre ǀ bṛhán ǀ uṣásām ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ niḥ-jaganvā́n ǀ támasaḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀagníḥ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ rúśatā ǀ su-áṅgaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ sádmāni ǀ aprāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: HIGH hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.
verses.wilson_translation: The great fire from beginning of dawn has sprung aloft, and coming forth from the darkness has comewith radiance.Agni, the bright-bodied, as soon as born, fills all dwellings with shining light.
verses.griffith_verse: HIGH hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभृत ओषधीषु ।चित्रः शिशुः परि तमांस्यक्तून्प्र मातृभ्यो अधि कनिक्रदद्गाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ gárbha��� ǀ asi ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ ágne ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ ví-bhṛtaḥ ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀcitráḥ ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ pári ǀ támāṃsi ǀ aktū́n ǀ prá ǀ mātṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ kánikradat ǀ gāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni! The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers.
verses.wilson_translation: When born, you, OAgni, are the embryo of heaven and earth, beautiful, borne about in the plural nts;variegated, infantine, you disperse the noctural glooms; you issue roaring loudly from the maternal (sources).
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni! The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरित्था परममस्य विद्वांजातो बृहन्नभि पाति तृतीयं ।आसा यदस्य पयो अक्रत स्वं सचेतसो अभ्यर्चंत्यत्र ॥
verses.transliteration: víṣṇuḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ paramám ǀ asya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ jātáḥ ǀ bṛhán ǀ abhí ǀ pāti ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀāsā́ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ páyaḥ ǀ ákrata ǀ svám ǀ sá-cetasaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ átra ǁ
verses.english_translation: Here, being manifested, lofty Viṣṇu, full wise, protects his own supremest station. When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises.
verses.wilson_translation: May he, who as soon as manifested is vast and wise, and thus (universally) pervading, defend (me),his third (manifestation); and when (the worshippers) ask with their mouths for his own water, animated by onepurpose, they praise him in this world.
verses.griffith_verse: Here, being manifested, lofty Viṣṇu, full wise, protects his own supremest station. When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अत उ त्वा पितुभृतो जनित्रीरन्नावृधं प्रति चरंत्यन्नैः ।ता ईं प्रत्येषि पुनरन्यरूपा असि त्वं विक्षु मानुषीषु होता ॥
verses.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ pitu-bhṛ́taḥ ǀ jánitrīḥ ǀ anna-vṛ́dham ǀ práti ǀ caranti ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ práti ǀ eṣi ǀ púnaḥ ǀ anyá-rūpāḥ ǀ ási ǀ tvám ǀ vikṣú ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ hótā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thence bearing food the Mothers come to meet thee, with food for thee who givest food its increase. These in their altered form again thou meetest. Thou art Invoking Priest in homes of mortals.
verses.wilson_translation: Therefore, the genitive trices (of all things, the herbs), the cherishers (of all) with food, wait on you whoare the augmenter of food, with (sacrificial) viands; you visit them again, when they have assumed other forms,you among human beings the invoker (of the gods).
verses.griffith_verse: Thence bearing food the Mothers come to meet thee, with food for thee who givest food its increase. These in their altered form again thou meetest. Thou art Invoking Priest in homes of mortals.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: होतारं चित्ररथमध्वरस्य यज्ञस्ययज्ञस्य केतुं रुशंतं ।प्रत्यर्धिं देवस्यदेवस्य मह्ना श्रिया त्वग्निमतिथिं जनानां ॥
verses.transliteration: hótāram ǀ citrá-ratham ǀ adhvarásya ǀ yajñásya-yajñasya ǀ ketúm ǀ rúśantam ǀpráti-ardhim ǀ devásya-devasya ǀ mahnā́ ǀ śriyā́ ǀ tvám ǀ agním ǀ átithim ǀ jánānām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Priest of the holy rite, with car that glitters, refulgent Banner of each act of worship, Sharinging every God through might and glory, even Agni Guest of men I summon hither.
verses.wilson_translation: (We worship)Agnifor prosperity, you, who are the invoker of the gods, the many-colouredconveyance of the saacrifice, the brilliant banner of every offering, the surpasser of every other deity in might, theguest of men.
verses.griffith_verse: Priest of the holy rite, with car that glitters, refulgent Banner of each act of worship, Sharinging every God through might and glory, even Agni Guest of men I summon hither.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स तु वस्त्राण्यध पेशनानि वसानो अग्निर्नाभा पृथिव्याः ।अरुषो जातः पद इळायाः पुरोहितो राजन्यक्षीह देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ vástrāṇi ǀ ádha ǀ péśanāni ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀaruṣáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ padé ǀ íḷāyāḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ rājan ǀ yakṣi ǀ ihá ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: So Agni stands on earth's most central station, invested in well-decorated garments. Born, red of hue, where men pour out libations, O King, as great High Priest bring the Gods hither.
verses.wilson_translation: Arrayed in splendid garments, that Agni(abides) on the navel of the earth; do you, royal (Agni), whoare radiant, born on the foot-mark of Iḷā, offer worship here as Purohitato the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: So Agni stands on earth's most central station, invested in well-decorated garments. Born, red of hue, where men pour out libations, O King, as great High Priest bring the Gods hither.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ हि द्यावापृथिवी अग्न उभे सदा पुत्रो न मातरा ततंथ ।प्र याह्यच्छोशतो यविष्ठाथा वह सहस्येह देवान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hí ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ agne ǀ ubhé íti ǀ sádā ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ mātárā ǀ tatántha ǀprá ǀ yāhi ǀ áccha ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ átha ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sahasya ǀ ihá ǀ devā́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Over the earth and over heaven, O Agni, thou, Son, hast ever spread above thy Parents. Come, Youthfullest! to those who long to meet thee, and hither bring the Gods, O Mighty Victor.
verses.wilson_translation: You have, ever sustained,Agni, both heaven and earth, as a son (supports) his parents; come,youngest (of the gods), to the presence of those desiring (you); son of strength, bring here the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Over the earth and over heaven, O Agni, thou, Son, hast ever spread above thy Parents. Come, Youthfullest! to those who long to meet thee, and hither bring the Gods, O Mighty Victor.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN II. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . GLADDEN the yearning Gods, O thou Most Youthful: bring them, O Lord of Seasons, knowing seasons,With all the Priests Celestial, O Agni. Best worshipper art thou of all Invokers. Thine is the Herald's, thine the Cleanser's office, thinker art thou, wealth-giver, true to Order.Let us with Svāhā offer up oblations, and Agni, worthy God, pay the Gods worship. To the Gods’ pathway have we travelled, ready to execute what work we may accomplish.Let Agni, for he knows, complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons. When we most ignorant neglect the statutes of you, O Deities with whom is knowledge,Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, skilled to assign each God his fitting season. When, weak in mind, of feeble understanding, mortals bethink them not of sacrificing,Then shall the prudent and discerning Agni worship the Gods, best worshipper, in season. Because the Father hath produced thee, Leader of all our solemn rites, their brilliant Banner:So win by worship pleasant homes abounding in heroes, and rich food to nourish all men. Thou whom the Heaven and Earth, thou whom the Waters, and Tvaṣṭar, maker of fair things, created,Well knowing, all along the Fathers' pathway, shine with resplendent light, enkindled, Agni.

verses.sanskrit: पिप्रीहि देवाँ उशतो यविष्ठ विद्वाँ ऋतूँर्ऋतुपते यजेह ।ये दैव्या ऋत्विजस्तेभिरग्ने त्वं होतॄणामस्यायजिष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration: piprīhí ǀ devā́n ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ ṛtu-pate ǀ yaja ǀ ihá ǀyé ǀ dáivyāḥ ǀ ṛtvíjaḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ tvám ǀ hótṝṇām ǀ asi ǀ ā́-yajiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: GLADDEN the yearning Gods, O thou Most Youthful: bring them, O Lord of Seasons, knowing seasons, With all the Priests Celestial, O Agni. Best worshipper art thou of all Invokers.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, youngest (of the deities), propitiate the desiring gods; lord of seasons, cognizant of seasons,here offer worship; worship with those who are the priests of the celestials; among the ministrant priests you arethe best offerer.
verses.griffith_verse: GLADDEN the yearning Gods, O thou Most Youthful: bring them, O Lord of Seasons, knowing seasons, With all the Priests Celestial, O Agni. Best worshipper art thou of all Invokers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं जनानां मंधातासि द्रविणोदा ऋतावा ।स्वाहा वयं कृणवामा हवींषि देवो देवान्यजत्वग्निरर्हन् ॥
verses.transliteration: véṣi ǀ hotrám ǀ utá ǀ potrám ǀ jánānām ǀ mandhātā́ ǀ asi ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀsvā́hā ǀ vayám ǀ kṛṇávāma ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ yajatu ǀ agníḥ ǀ árhan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thine is the Herald's, thine the Cleanser's office, thinker art thou, wealth-giver, true to Order. Let us with Svāhā offer up oblations, and Agni, worthy God, pay the Gods worship.
verses.wilson_translation: Whether,Agni, you prefer the office ofhotāorpotāamong men, you are wise, the giver of wealth,the observer of truth, let us offer the oblations with the (sacred)svāhā, and may the most excellent and divine Agni present them to the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Thine is the Herald's, thine the Cleanser's office, thinker art thou, wealth-giver, true to Order. Let us with Svāhā offer up oblations, and Agni, worthy God, pay the Gods worship.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ देवानामपि पंथामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनु प्रवोळ्हुं ।अग्निर्विद्वान्त्स यजात्सेदु होता सो अध्वरान्त्स ऋतून्कल्पयाति ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ pánthām ǀ aganma ǀ yát ǀ śaknávāma ǀ tát ǀ ánu ǀ prá-voḷhum ǀagníḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ yajāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hótā ǀ sáḥ ǀ adhvarā́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ kalpayāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: To the Gods’ pathway have we travelled, ready to execute what work we may accomplish. Let Agni, for he knows, complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons.
verses.wilson_translation: May we pursue the path that leads to the gods to convey that (worship) which we may be able (tooffer). May that wise Agniminister, for he verily is the ministrant priest, and let him prescribe the ceremonies andthe seasons.
verses.griffith_verse: To the Gods’ pathway have we travelled, ready to execute what work we may accomplish. Let Agni, for he knows, complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यद्वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि विदुषां देवा अविदुष्टरासः ।अग्निष्टद्विश्वमा पृणाति विद्वान्येभिर्देवाँ ऋतुभिः कल्पयाति ॥
verses.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ pra-minā́ma ǀ vratā́ni ǀ vidúṣām ǀ devāḥ ǀ áviduḥ-tarāsaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tát ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇāti ǀ vidvā́n ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ kalpáyāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: When we most ignorant neglect the statutes of you, O Deities with whom is knowledge, Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, skilled to assign each God his fitting season.
verses.wilson_translation: O gods, when we who are most ignorant neglect the offices addressed to you who are wise, may thewise Agnicomplete the whole by (appointing) those seasons by which he regulates the worship of the godṣ
verses.griffith_verse: When we most ignorant neglect the statutes of you, O Deities with whom is knowledge, Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, skilled to assign each God his fitting season.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यत्पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा न यज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्त्यासः ।अग्निष्टद्धोता क्रतुविद्विजानन्यजिष्ठो देवाँ ऋतुशो यजाति ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ pāka-trā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ dīná-dakṣāḥ ǀ ná ǀ yajñásya ǀ manvaté ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tát ǀ hótā ǀ kratu-vít ǀ vi-jānán ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛtu-śáḥ ǀ yajāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: When, weak in mind, of feeble understanding, mortals bethink them not of sacrificing, Then shall the prudent and discerning Agni worship the Gods, best worshipper, in season.
verses.wilson_translation: Since men of feeble energies, with mind yet immature, are unacquainted with (the ritual of) thesacrifice, may Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the skilled in rites, well-knowing (what is to be done), the bestofferer, offer worship according to the fit season to the gods.
verses.griffith_verse: When, weak in mind, of feeble understanding, mortals bethink them not of sacrificing, Then shall the prudent and discerning Agni worship the Gods, best worshipper, in season.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेषां ह्यध्वराणामनीकं चित्रं केतुं जनिता त्वा जजान ।स आ यजस्व नृवतीरनु क्षाः स्पार्हा इषः क्षुमतीर्विश्वजन्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ hí ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ ánīkam ǀ citrám ǀ ketúm ǀ jánitā ǀ tvā ǀ jajā́na ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yajasva ǀ nṛ-vátīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ kṣā́ḥ ǀ spārhā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ kṣu-mátīḥ ǀ viśvá-janyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Because the Father hath produced thee, Leader of all our solemn rites, their brilliant Banner: So win by worship pleasant homes abounding in heroes, and rich food to nourish all men.
verses.wilson_translation: The progenitor has engendered you the chief of all sacrifices, variegated, illuminating (all); do youoffer (to the gods) the desirable all- sustaining praise-accompanied viands growing upon man-occupied earth.
verses.griffith_verse: Because the Father hath produced thee, Leader of all our solemn rites, their brilliant Banner: So win by worship pleasant homes abounding in heroes, and rich food to nourish all men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यं त्वा द्यावापृथिवी यं त्वापस्त्वष्टा यं त्वा सुजनिमा जजान ।पंथामनु प्रविद्वान्पितृयाणं द्युमदग्ने समिधानो वि भाहि ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ yám ǀ tvā ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ yám ǀ tvā ǀ su-jánimā ǀ jajā́na ǀpánthām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-vidvā́n ǀ pitṛ-yā́nam ǀ dyu-mát ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou whom the Heaven and Earth, thou whom the Waters, and Tvaṣṭar, maker of fair things, created, Well knowing, all along the Fathers' pathway, shine with resplendent light, enkindled, Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you,Agni, whom the earth and heaven, whom the waters, whom Tvaṣṭā, the glorious creator,engendered, who are cognizant of the path, the road of the Pitṛs, shine brilliantly, being kindled.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou whom the Heaven and Earth, thou whom the Waters, and Tvaṣṭar, maker of fair things, created, Well knowing, all along the Fathers' pathway, shine with resplendent light, enkindled, Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN III. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . O KING, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty.He shines, all-knowing, with his lotty splendour: chasing black Night he comes with white-rayed Morning. Having o’ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the dame the Great Sire's Daughter,Holding aloft the radiant light of Sūrya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures. Attendant on the Blessed Dame the Blessed hath come: the Lover followeth his Sister.Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath compassed Night with whitelyshining garments. His goings-forth kindle as ’twere high voices the goings of the auspicious Friend of Agni.The rays, the bright beams of the strong-jawed, mighty, adorable Steer are visible as he cometh. Whose radiant splendours flow, like sounds, about us, his who is lofty, brilliant, and effulgent,Who reaches heaven with best and brightest lustres, sportive and piercing even to the summit. His powers, whose chariot fellies gleam and glitter have loudly roared while, as with teams, he hasted.He, the most Godlike, far-extending envoy, shines with flames ancient, resonant, whitely-shining. So bring us ample wealth: seat thee as envoy of the two youthful Matrons, Earth and Heaven.Let Agni rapid with his rapid, horses, impetuous with impetuous Steeds, come hither.

verses.sanskrit: इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाँ अदर्शि ।चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ináḥ ǀ rājan ǀ aratíḥ ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ ráudraḥ ǀ dákṣāya ǀ susu-mā́n ǀ adarśi ǀcikít ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ásiknīm ǀ eti ǀ rúśatīm ǀ apa-ájan ǁ
verses.english_translation: O KING, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty. He shines, all-knowing, with his lotty splendour: chasing black Night he comes with white-rayed Morning.
verses.wilson_translation: Royal Agni, (you are) the lord (of all). He who is the conveyer of the oblation, the radiant, theformidable, the recipient of the Soma, is manifested for the benefaction (of the worshipper); all-knowing, heshines forth with great lustre; he proceeds, scattering the glimmering darkness.
verses.griffith_verse: O KING, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty. He shines, all-knowing, with his lotty splendour: chasing black Night he comes with white-rayed Morning.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसा भूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जां ।ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सूर्यस्य स्तभायंदिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇā́m ǀ yát ǀ énīm ǀ abhí ǀ várpasā ǀ bhū́t ǀ janáyan ǀ yóṣām ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ jā́m ǀūrdhvám ǀ bhānúm ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ stabhāyán ǀ diváḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Having o’ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the dame the Great Sire's Daughter, Holding aloft the radiant light of Sūrya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.
verses.wilson_translation: When he has overcome the dark departing (night) by his radiance, then, begetting the damsel, thedaughter of the great father, he shines in his course with the treasures of heaven, establishing above the light ofthe sun.
verses.griffith_verse: Having o’ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the dame the Great Sire's Daughter, Holding aloft the radiant light of Sūrya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् ।सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात् ॥
verses.transliteration: bhadráḥ ǀ bhadráyā ǀ sácamānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ svásāram ǀ jāráḥ ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ paścā́t ǀsu-praketáiḥ ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vi-tíṣṭhan ǀ rúśat-bhiḥ ǀ várṇaiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rāmám ǀ asthāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Attendant on the Blessed Dame the Blessed hath come: the Lover followeth his Sister. Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath compassed Night with whitelyshining garments.
verses.wilson_translation: He has come auspicious, waited on by the auspicious (light); he afterwards approaches his sister(dawn) like a gallant;Agni, spreading everywhere, with omniscient rays overpowers the dark (night) the brilliantbeams.
verses.griffith_verse: Attendant on the Blessed Dame the Blessed hath come: the Lover followeth his Sister. Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath compassed Night with whitelyshining garments.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य यामासो बृहतो न वग्नूनिंधाना अग्नेः सख्युः शिवस्य ।ईड्यस्य वृष्णो बृहतः स्वासो भामासो यामन्नक्तवश्चिकित्रे ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ yā́māsaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vagnū́n ǀ índhānāḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ śivásya ǀī́ḍyasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ su-ā́saḥ ǀ bhā́māsaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ aktávaḥ ǀ cikitre ǁ
verses.english_translation: His goings-forth kindle as ’twere high voices the goings of the auspicious Friend of Agni. The rays, the bright beams of the strong-jawed, mighty, adorable Steer are visible as he cometh.
verses.wilson_translation: The blazing flames of that mighty Agnido not (deter) his adorers; the fierce flames of the friendlyauspicious adorable (Agni), the showerer of (benefits), the vast, the strong-mouthed, are visible in the sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: His goings-forth kindle as ’twere high voices the goings of the auspicious Friend of Agni. The rays, the bright beams of the strong-jawed, mighty, adorable Steer are visible as he cometh.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्वना न यस्य भामासः पवंते रोचमानस्य बृहतः सुदिवः ।ज्येष्ठेभिर्यस्तेजिष्ठैः क्रीळुमद्भिर्वर्षिष्ठेभिर्भानुभिर्नक्षति द्यां ॥
verses.transliteration: svanā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ bhā́māsaḥ ǀ pávante ǀ rócamānasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ su-dívaḥ ǀjyéṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ téjiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ krīḷumát-bhiḥ ǀ várṣiṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ nákṣati ǀ dyā́m ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whose radiant splendours flow, like sounds, about us, his who is lofty, brilliant, and effulgent, Who reaches heaven with best and brightest lustres, sportive and piercing even to the summit.
verses.wilson_translation: The flames of whom, radiant, vast, bright-shining, go roaring like the winds; who covers the sky withmost excellent, most lustrous, most sportive and most mighty rays.
verses.griffith_verse: Whose radiant splendours flow, like sounds, about us, his who is lofty, brilliant, and effulgent, Who reaches heaven with best and brightest lustres, sportive and piercing even to the summit.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अस्य शुष्मासो ददृशानपवेर्जेहमानस्य स्वनयन्नियुद्भिः ।प्रत्नेभिर्यो रुशद्भिर्देवतमो वि रेभद्भिररतिर्भाति विभ्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ śúṣmāsaḥ ǀ dadṛśāná-paveḥ ǀ jéhamānasya ǀ svanayan ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀpratnébhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ rúśat-bhiḥ ǀ devá-tamaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rébhat-bhiḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ bhā́ti ǀ ví-bhvā ǁ
verses.english_translation: His powers, whose chariot fellies gleam and glitter have loudly roared while, as with teams, he hasted. He, the most Godlike, far-extending envoy, shines with flames ancient, resonant, whitely-shining.
verses.wilson_translation: Of him, bright-blazing and hastening (towards the gods), the fierce- burning flames roar with the horses(of Maruts); who shines mighty in his course, most divine, with ancient, brilliant, and loud-sounding (flames).
verses.griffith_verse: His powers, whose chariot fellies gleam and glitter have loudly roared while, as with teams, he hasted. He, the most Godlike, far-extending envoy, shines with flames ancient, resonant, whitely-shining.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स आ वक्षि महि न आ च सत्सि दिवस्पृथिव्योररतिर्युवत्योः ।अग्निः सुतुकः सुतुकेभिरश्वै रभस्वद्भी रभस्वाँ एह गम्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ máhi ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ satsi ǀ diváḥpṛthivyóḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ yuvatyóḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ su-túkaḥ ǀ su-túkebhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ rábhasvat-bhiḥ ǀ rábhasvān ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gamyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: So bring us ample wealth: seat thee as envoy of the two youthful Matrons, Earth and Heaven. Let Agni rapid with his rapid, horses, impetuous with impetuous Steeds, come hither.
verses.wilson_translation: Do you, great Agni, bring the gods to our (sacrifice); do you, the messenger of the young heaven andearth, sit down (at our sacrifice). Agni, who are easily found, who are rapid in movement, do you come with yourdocile and rapid steeds (to our rite).
verses.griffith_verse: So bring us ample wealth: seat thee as envoy of the two youthful Matrons, Earth and Heaven. Let Agni rapid with his rapid, horses, impetuous with impetuous Steeds, come hither.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN IV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . To thee will send praise and bring oblation, as thou hast merited lauds when we invoked thee.A fountain in the desert art thou, Agni, O Ancient King, to man who fain would worship, Thou unto whom resort the gathered people, as the kine seek the warm stall, O Most Youthful.Thou art the messenger of Gods and mortals, and goest glorious with thy light between them. Making thee grow as ’twere some noble infant, thy Mother nurtures thee with sweet affection.Over the desert slopes thou passest longing, and seekest, like some beast set free, thy fodder. Foolish are we, O Wise and free from error: verily, Agni, thou dost know thy grandeur.There lies the form: he moves and licks, and swallows, and, as House-Lord, kisses the Youthful Maiden. He rises ever fresh in ancient fuel: smoke-bannered, gray, he makes the wood his dwelling.No swimmer, Steer, he presses through the waters, and to his place accordant mortals bear him. Like thieves who risk their lives and haunt the forest, the twain with their ten girdles have secured him.This is a new hymn meant for thee, O Agni: yoke as it were thy car with parts that glitter. Homage and prayer are thine, O Jātavedas, and this my song shall evermore exalt thee.Agni, protect our children and descendants, and guard with ever-watcliful care our bodies.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते यक्षि प्र त इयर्मि मन्म भुवो यथा वंद्यो नो हवेषु ।धन्वन्निव प्रपा असि त्वमग्न इयक्षवे पूरवे प्रत्न राजन् ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ yakṣi ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ iyarmi ǀ mánma ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vándyaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ háveṣu ǀdhánvan-iva ǀ pra-pā́ ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ iyakṣáve ǀ pūráve ǀ pratna ǀ rājan ǁ
verses.english_translation: To thee will send praise and bring oblation, as thou hast merited lauds when we invoked thee. A fountain in the desert art thou, Agni, O Ancient King, to man who fain would worship,
verses.wilson_translation: To you,Agni, I present the oblation; you repeat praise; that you, who are deserving of laudation maybe present at our invocations; ancient sovereign Agni, you are like a well of water in a desert, to the mandesirous of offering sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: To thee will send praise and bring oblation, as thou hast merited lauds when we invoked thee. A fountain in the desert art thou, Agni, O Ancient King, to man who fain would worship,
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यं त्वा जनासो अभि संचरंति गाव उष्णमिव व्रजं यविष्ठ ।दूतो देवानामसि मर्त्यानामंतर्महाँश्चरसि रोचनेन ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sam-cáranti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ uṣṇám-iva ǀ vrajám ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀdūtáḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ asi ǀ mártyānām ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ carasi ǀ rocanéna ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou unto whom resort the gathered people, as the kine seek the warm stall, O Most Youthful. Thou art the messenger of Gods and mortals, and goest glorious with thy light between them.
verses.wilson_translation: Men have recourse to you,Agni, youngest (of the gods), as cattle hasten to the warm stall. You arethe messenger of the gods and of mortals; mighty, you proceed by the firmament between (heaven and earth). sustains you. You come, eager from above the firmament, by a downward path, and when released (after theoblation is offered), you desire to go back like cattle (to their stall).
verses.griffith_verse: Thou unto whom resort the gathered people, as the kine seek the warm stall, O Most Youthful. Thou art the messenger of Gods and mortals, and goest glorious with thy light between them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: शिशुं न त्वा जेन्यं वर्धयंती माता बिभर्ति सचनस्यमाना ।धनोरधि प्रवता यासि हर्यंजिगीषसे पशुरिवावसृष्टः ॥
verses.transliteration: śíśum ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ jényam ǀ vardháyantī ǀ mātā́ ǀ bibharti ǀ sacanasyámānā ǀdhánoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ pra-vátā ǀ yāsi ǀ háryan ǀ jígīṣase ǀ paśúḥ-iva ǀ áva-sṛṣṭaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Making thee grow as ’twere some noble infant, thy Mother nurtures thee with sweet affection. Over the desert slopes thou passest longing, and seekest, like some beast set free, thy fodder.
verses.griffith_verse: Making thee grow as ’twere some noble infant, thy Mother nurtures thee with sweet affection. Over the desert slopes thou passest longing, and seekest, like some beast set free, thy fodder.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मूरा अमूर न वयं चिकित्वो महित्वमग्ने त्वमंग वित्से ।शये वव्रिश्चरति जिह्वयादन्रेरिह्यते युवतिं विश्पतिः सन् ॥
verses.transliteration: mūrā́ḥ ǀ amūra ǀ ná ǀ vayám ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ agne ǀ tvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ vitse ǀśáye ǀ vavríḥ ǀ cárati ǀ jihváyā ǀ adán ǀ rerihyáte ǀ yuvatím ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ sán ǁ
verses.english_translation: Foolish are we, O Wise and free from error: verily, Agni, thou dost know thy grandeur. There lies the form: he moves and licks, and swallows, and, as House-Lord, kisses the Youthful Maiden.
verses.wilson_translation: We, who are perplexed, know not, O unperplexed, intelligent one, your greatness; but you,Agni, verilyknow it. Wearing a form he reposes; he moves about devouring (the offering) with his tongue (of flame); beinglord of men, he licks up the mixed oblation.
verses.griffith_verse: Foolish are we, O Wise and free from error: verily, Agni, thou dost know thy grandeur. There lies the form: he moves and licks, and swallows, and, as House-Lord, kisses the Youthful Maiden.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: कूचिज्जायते सनयासु नव्यो वने तस्थौ पलितो धूमकेतुः ।अस्नातापो वृषभो न प्र वेति सचेतसो यं प्रणयंत मर्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: kū́-cit ǀ jāyate ǀ sánayāsu ǀ návyaḥ ǀ váne ǀ tasthau ǀ palitáḥ ǀ dhūmá-ketuḥ ǀasnātā́ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ veti ǀ sá-cetasaḥ ǀ yám ǀ pra-náyanta ǀ mártāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He rises ever fresh in ancient fuel: smoke-bannered, gray, he makes the wood his dwelling. No swimmer, Steer, he presses through the waters, and to his place accordant mortals bear him.
verses.wilson_translation: Where is the new (Agni) born? He is present in the old (plural nt) and in the wood, grey-haired,smoke-bannered; though not needing ablution, he hastens to the water like a (thirsty) bull, he whom men withone consent propitiate.
verses.griffith_verse: He rises ever fresh in ancient fuel: smoke-bannered, gray, he makes the wood his dwelling. No swimmer, Steer, he presses through the waters, and to his place accordant mortals bear him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तनूत्यजेव तस्करा वनर्गू रशनाभिर्दशभिरभ्यधीतां ।इयं ते अग्ने नव्यसी मनीषा युक्ष्वा रथं न शुचयद्भिरंगैः ॥
verses.transliteration: tanūtyájā-iva ǀ táskarā ǀ vanargū́ íti ǀ raśanā́bhiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ adhītām ǀiyám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ návyasī ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ yukṣvá ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ śucáyat-bhiḥ ǀ áṅgaiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like thieves who risk their lives and haunt the forest, the twain with their ten girdles have secured him. This is a new hymn meant for thee, O Agni: yoke as it were thy car with parts that glitter.
verses.wilson_translation: As two daring robbers lurking in a forest seize (upon a traveller) with ten cords, (so the two handsseize upon the touchwood, with the ten fingers). This new praise,Agni, is addressed to you; attach thyself (to mysacrifice) with your radiant members; as (they harness horses) to a car.
verses.griffith_verse: Like thieves who risk their lives and haunt the forest, the twain with their ten girdles have secured him. This is a new hymn meant for thee, O Agni: yoke as it were thy car with parts that glitter.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म च ते जातवेदो नमश्चेयं च गीः सदमिद्वर्धनी भूत् ।रक्षा णो अग्ने तनयानि तोका रक्षोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhma ǀ ca ǀ te ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ ca ǀ iyám ǀ ca ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ várdhanī ǀ bhūt ǀrákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ tánayāni ǀ tokā́ ǀ rákṣa ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Homage and prayer are thine, O Jātavedas, and this my song shall evermore exalt thee. Agni, protect our children and descendants, and guard with ever-watcliful care our bodies.
verses.wilson_translation: May this oblation,Jātavedas, this reverence, this praise, ever magnify you. Protect,Agni, our sons,our grandsons, and diligently defend our person ns.
verses.griffith_verse: Homage and prayer are thine, O Jātavedas, and this my song shall evermore exalt thee. Agni, protect our children and descendants, and guard with ever-watcliful care our bodies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN V. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . HE only is the Sea, holder of treasures: born many a time he views the hearts within us.He hides him in the secret couple's bosom. The Bird dwells in the middle of the fountain. Inhabiting one dwelling-place in common, strong Stallions and the Mares have come together.The sages guard the seat of Holy Order, and keep the highest names concealed within them. The Holy Pair, of wondrous power, have coupled: they formed the Infant, they who bred produced him.The central point of all that moves and moves not, the while they wove the Sage's thread with insight For tracks of Order and refreshing viands attend from ancient times the goodly Infant.Wearing him as a mantle, Earth and Heaven grow strong by food of pleasant drink and fatness. He, calling loudly to the Seven red Sisters, hath, skilled in sweet drink, brought them to be looked on.He, born of old, in middle air hath halted, and sought and found the covering robe of Pūṣan. Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned; to one of these may come the troubled mortal.He standeth in the dwelling of the Highest, a Pillar, on sure ground where paths are parted. Not Being, Being in the highest heaven, in Aditi's bosom and in Dakṣa's birthplace,Is Agni, our first-born of Holy Order, the Milch-cow and the Bull in life's beginning.

verses.sanskrit: एकः समुद्रो धरुणो रयीणामस्मद्धृदो भूरिजन्मा वि चष्टे ।सिषक्त्यूधर्निण्योरुपस्थ उत्सस्य मध्ये निहितं पदं वेः ॥
verses.transliteration: ékaḥ ǀ samudráḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ asmát ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ bhū́ri-janmā ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǀsísakti ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ niṇyóḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ útsasya ǀ mádhye ǀ ní-hitam ǀ padám ǀ véríti véḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: HE only is the Sea, holder of treasures: born many a time he views the hearts within us. He hides him in the secret couple's bosom. The Bird dwells in the middle of the fountain.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the sole capacious ocean of riches who is of many births beholds our hearts; he waits on thecloud in the neighbourhood of the hidden (firmament); go, Agni, to the appointed plural ce in the midst of the waterṣ
verses.griffith_verse: HE only is the Sea, holder of treasures: born many a time he views the hearts within us. He hides him in the secret couple's bosom. The Bird dwells in the middle of the fountain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: समानं नीळं वृषणो वसानाः सं जग्मिरे महिषा अर्वतीभिः ।ऋतस्य पदं कवयो नि पांति गुहा नामानि दधिरे पराणि ॥
verses.transliteration: samānám ǀ nīḷám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ vásānāḥ ǀ sám ǀ jagmire ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ árvatībhiḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ padám ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ ní ǀ pānti ǀ gúhā ǀ nā́māni ǀ dadhire ǀ párāṇi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Inhabiting one dwelling-place in common, strong Stallions and the Mares have come together. The sages guard the seat of Holy Order, and keep the highest names concealed within them.
verses.wilson_translation: Great (worshippers), showerers (of oblations) enveloping with their hymns the common dark (fire),have associated (him) with his horses (to come to the sacrifice). Sages preserve (by oblations) the plural ce of thewater and support the divine rains in the vault (of heaven).
verses.griffith_verse: Inhabiting one dwelling-place in common, strong Stallions and the Mares have come together. The sages guard the seat of Holy Order, and keep the highest names concealed within them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतायिनी मायिनी सं दधाते मित्वा शिशुं जज्ञतुर्वर्धयंती ।विश्वस्य नाभिं चरतो ध्रुवस्य कवेश्चित्तंतुं मनसा वियंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtayínī ítyṛta-yínī ǀ māyínī íti ǀ sám ǀ dadhāte íti ǀ mitvā́ ǀ śíśum ǀ jajñatuḥ ǀ vardháyantī íti ǀvíśvasya ǀ nā́bhim ǀ cárataḥ ǀ dhruvásya ǀ kavéḥ ǀ cit ǀ tántum ǀ mánasā ǀ vi-yántaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Holy Pair, of wondrous power, have coupled: they formed the Infant, they who bred produced him. The central point of all that moves and moves not, the while they wove the Sage's thread with insight
verses.wilson_translation: The two observers of truth, the two possessors of wisdom, (heaven and earth) sustain (this Agni);measuring the time, they have brought forth and reared a son; and (men), pondering in their minds on that navelof the universe, movable and immovable, the thread of the sage (Agni, are blessed with happiness).
verses.griffith_verse: The Holy Pair, of wondrous power, have coupled: they formed the Infant, they who bred produced him. The central point of all that moves and moves not, the while they wove the Sage's thread with insight
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतस्य हि वर्तनयः सुजातमिषो वाजाय प्रदिवः सचंते ।अधीवासं रोदसी वावसाने घृतैरन्नैर्वावृधाते मधूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ hí ǀ vartanáyaḥ ǀ sú-jātam ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ sácante ǀadhīvāsám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vavasāné íti ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀ vavṛdhāte íti ǀ mádhūnām ǁ
verses.english_translation: For tracks of Order and refreshing viands attend from ancient times the goodly Infant. Wearing him as a mantle, Earth and Heaven grow strong by food of pleasant drink and fatness.
verses.wilson_translation: The ancient celebrators of the rite desiring (boons) wait on (Agni), rightly born, for the sake of food;the all-comprising heaven and earth cherish him, who abodes above the heavens, with the sacrificial butter andfood (produced) from the water.
verses.griffith_verse: For tracks of Order and refreshing viands attend from ancient times the goodly Infant. Wearing him as a mantle, Earth and Heaven grow strong by food of pleasant drink and fatness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सप्त स्वसॄररुषीर्वावशानो विद्वान्मध्व उज्जभारा दृशे कं ।अंतर्येमे अंतरिक्षे पुराजा इच्छन्वव्रिमविदत्पूषणस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: saptá ǀ svásṝḥ ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ út ǀ jabhāra ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǀantáḥ ǀ yeme ǀ antárikṣe ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǀ icchán ǀ vavrím ǀ avidat ǀ pūṣaṇásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: He, calling loudly to the Seven red Sisters, hath, skilled in sweet drink, brought them to be looked on. He, born of old, in middle air hath halted, and sought and found the covering robe of Pūṣan.
verses.wilson_translation: The wise Agniglorified (by his worshippers) has from the sacrifice raised aloft, for the readymanifestation of (all things), the seven radiant sister (flames); which when formerly engendered he restrained inthe firmament, until desirous of (adorers) he bestowed form upon the region of the earth.
verses.griffith_verse: He, calling loudly to the Seven red Sisters, hath, skilled in sweet drink, brought them to be looked on. He, born of old, in middle air hath halted, and sought and found the covering robe of Pūṣan.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस्ततक्षुस्तासामेकामिदभ्यंहुरो गात् ।आयोर्ह स्कंभ उपमस्य नीळे पथां विसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ ॥
verses.transliteration: saptá ǀ maryā́dāḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǀ tā́sām ǀ ékām ǀ ít ǀ abhí ǀ aṃhuráḥ ǀ gāt ǀāyóḥ ǀ ha ǀ skambháḥ ǀ upa-másya ǀ nīḷé ǀ pathā́m ǀ vi-sargé ǀ dharúṇeṣu ǀ tasthau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned; to one of these may come the troubled mortal. He standeth in the dwelling of the Highest, a Pillar, on sure ground where paths are parted.
verses.wilson_translation: The ise have established seven rules of conduct; he is a sinner who deviates from any one of theṃAgni is the obstructor of (that) man, he abides in the dwelling of his neighbour, in the region of the scattering ofthe rays, and in the recipient (waters).
verses.griffith_verse: Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned; to one of these may come the troubled mortal. He standeth in the dwelling of the Highest, a Pillar, on sure ground where paths are parted.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: असच्च सच्च परमे व्योमंदक्षस्य जन्मन्नदितेरुपस्थे ।अग्निर्ह नः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य पूर्व आयुनि वृषभश्च धेनुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ásat ǀ ca ǀ sát ǀ ca ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀ dákṣasya ǀ jánman ǀ áditeḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀagníḥ ǀ ha ǀ naḥ ǀ prathama-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pū́rve ǀ ā́yuni ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhenúḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Not Being, Being in the highest heaven, in Aditi's bosom and in Dakṣa's birthplace, Is Agni, our first-born of Holy Order, the Milch-cow and the Bull in life's beginning.
verses.wilson_translation: Non-existent, and existent (is Agni) in the supreme heaven, in the birth-plural ce of Dakṣa, and in thepresence of Aditi; Agni is elder born to us (who enjoy the fruit) of the sacrifice; in the olden time he was the bulland the cow.
verses.griffith_verse: Not Being, Being in the highest heaven, in Aditi's bosom and in Dakṣa's birthplace, Is Agni, our first-born of Holy Order, the Milch-cow and the Bull in life's beginning.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN VI Agni
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS is that Agni, he by whose protection, favour, and help. the singer is successful;Who with the noblest flames of glowing fuel comes forth encompassed with far-spreading lustre. Agni, the Holy One, the everlasting, who shines far beaming with celestial splendours;He who hath come unto his friends with friendship, like a fleet steed who never trips or stumbles. He who is Lord of all divine oblation, shared by all living men at break of morning,Agni to whom our offerings are devoted, in whom rests he whose car, through might, is scatheless. Increasing by his strength. while lauds content him, with easy flight unto the Gods he travels.Agni the cheerful Priest, best Sacrificer, balms with his tongue the Gods with whom he mingles. With songs and adorations bring ye hither Agni who stirs himself at dawn like Indra,Whom sages laud with hymns as Jātavedas of those who wield the sacrificial ladle. In whom all goodly treasures meet together, even as steeds and riders for the booty.Inclining hither bring us help, O Agni, even assistance most desired by Indra. Yea, at thy birth, when thou hadst sat in glory, thou, Agni, wast the aim of invocations.The Gods came near, obedient to thy sunimons, and thus attained their rank as chief Protectors.

verses.sanskrit: अयं स यस्य शर्मन्नवोभिरग्नेरेधते जरिताभिष्टौ ।ज्येष्ठेभिर्यो भानुभिर्ऋषूणां पर्येति परिवीतो विभावा ॥
verses.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yásya ǀ śárman ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ édhate ǀ jaritā́ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǀjyéṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ ṛṣūṇā́m ǀ pari-éti ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǁ
verses.english_translation: THIS is that Agni, he by whose protection, favour, and help. the singer is successful; Who with the noblest flames of glowing fuel comes forth encompassed with far-spreading lustre.
verses.wilson_translation: This is that Agniby whose protections the worshipper (diligent) in sacrifice prospers in his dwelling;who is radiant, travels everywhere invested with the excellent splendours of his rays.
verses.griffith_verse: THIS is that Agni, he by whose protection, favour, and help. the singer is successful; Who with the noblest flames of glowing fuel comes forth encompassed with far-spreading lustre.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यो भानुभिर्विभावा विभात्यग्निर्देवेभिर्ऋतावाजस्रः ।आ यो विवाय सख्या सखिभ्योऽपरिह्वृतो अत्यो न सप्तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ agníḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ ájasraḥ ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vivā́ya ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ápari-hvṛtaḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the Holy One, the everlasting, who shines far beaming with celestial splendours; He who hath come unto his friends with friendship, like a fleet steed who never trips or stumbles.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, the observer of truth, the eternal who shines resplendent with celestial splendours, who comesuntiring like a swift horse, (bringing) friendly gifts to his friends.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni, the Holy One, the everlasting, who shines far beaming with celestial splendours; He who hath come unto his friends with friendship, like a fleet steed who never trips or stumbles.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ईशे यो विश्वस्या देववीतेरीशे विश्वायुरुषसो व्युष्टौ ।आ यस्मिन्मना हवींष्यग्नावरिष्टरथः स्कभ्नाति शूषैः ॥
verses.transliteration: ī́śe ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvasyāḥ ǀ devá-vīteḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ manā́ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ agnáu ǀ áriṣṭa-rathaḥ ǀ skabhnā́ti ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He who is Lord of all divine oblation, shared by all living men at break of morning, Agni to whom our offerings are devoted, in whom rests he whose car, through might, is scatheless.
verses.wilson_translation: Who rules over every oblation to the gods, who all pervading rules at the opening of the dawn, and inwhom (the sacrificer), whose sacrifice is undisturbed by his foes, throws his choice oblations.
