verses.wilson_translation: Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.
verses.griffith_verse: O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।इंद्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ paścā́t ǀ utá ǀ út-tarasmāt ǀ ádharāt ǀ agha-yóḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ utá ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bṛhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
verses.wilson_translation: May Bṛhaspatidefend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; may Indra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.
verses.griffith_verse: Bṛhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIV. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY Sovran Indra come to the carousal, he who by Holy Law is strong and active,The overcomer of all conquering forces with his great steer-like power that hath no limit. Firm-seated is thy car, thy Steeds are docile; thy hand, O King, holds, firmly grasped, the thunder.On thy fair path, O Lord of men, come quickly: we will increase thy powers when thou hast drunken. Let strong and mighty Steeds who bear this Mighty Indra, the Lord of men, whose arm wields thunder,Bring unto us, as sharers of our banquet, the Steer of conquering might, of real vigour. So like a Bull thou rushest to the Lord who loves the trough, the Sage, the prop of vigour, in the vat,Prepare thine energies, collect them in thyself: be for our profit as the Master of the wise. May precious treasures come to us-so will I pray. Come to the votary's gift offered with beauteous laud.Thou art the Lord, as such sit on this holy grass: thy vessels are inviolate as Law commands. Far went our earlist invocation of the Gods, and won us glories that can never be surpassed.They who could not ascend the ship of sacrifice, sink down in desolation, trembling with alarm. So be the others, evil-hearted, far away, whose horses, difficult to harness, have been yoked.Here in advance men stand anear to offer gifts, by whom full many a work that brings reward is done. He firmly fixed the plains and mountains as they shook. Dyaus thundered forth and made the air's mid-region quake.He stays apart the two confronting bowls; he sings lauds in the potent Soma's joy when he hath drunk. I bear this deftly-fashioned goad of thine, wherewith thou, Maghavan, shalt break the strikers with the hoof.At this libation mayst thou be well satisfied. Partake the juice, partake the worship, Maghavan. O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle.May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion. Bṛhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners.May Indra from the front and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sanskrit: आ यात्विंद्रः स्वपतिर्मदाय यो धर्मणा तूतुजानस्तुविष्मान् ।प्रत्वक्षाणो अति विश्वा सहांस्यपारेण महता वृष्ण्येन ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ índraḥ ǀ svá-patiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ tūtujānáḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀpra-tvakṣāṇáḥ ǀ áti ǀ víśvā ǀ sáhāṃsi ǀ apāréṇa ǀ mahatā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyena ǁ
verses.english_translation: MAY Sovran Indra come to the carousal, he who by Holy Law is strong and active, The overcomer of all conquering forces with his great steer-like power that hath no limit.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, the lord of wealth, come here with his chariot for his exhilaration; he who is rapid, strong,who, overcoming all the forces (of the enemy) by his great insuperable might, (passes) through them.
verses.griffith_verse: MAY Sovran Indra come to the carousal, he who by Holy Law is strong and active, The overcomer of all conquering forces with his great steer-like power that hath no limit.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सुष्ठामा रथः सुयमा हरी ते मिम्यक्ष वज्रो नृपते गभस्तौ ।शीभं राजन्त्सुपथा याह्यर्वाङ्वर्धाम ते पपुषो वृष्ण्यानि ॥
verses.transliteration: su-sthā́mā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ su-yámā ǀ hárī íti ǀ te ǀ mimyákṣa ǀ vájraḥ ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ gábhastau ǀśī́bham ǀ rājan ǀ su-páthā ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ várdhāma ǀ te ǀ papúṣaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǁ
verses.english_translation: Firm-seated is thy car, thy Steeds are docile; thy hand, O King, holds, firmly grasped, the thunder. On thy fair path, O Lord of men, come quickly: we will increase thy powers when thou hast drunken.
verses.wilson_translation: King of men, your chariot is well stationed; your horses are well trained; the thunderbolt is grasped inyourhands; come quickly towards us, lord of all, by a good path, we will augment your energies when you drinkthe Soma.
verses.griffith_verse: Firm-seated is thy car, thy Steeds are docile; thy hand, O King, holds, firmly grasped, the thunder. On thy fair path, O Lord of men, come quickly: we will increase thy powers when thou hast drunken.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एंद्रवाहो नृपतिं वज्रबाहुमुग्रमुग्रासस्तविषास एनं ।प्रत्वक्षसं वृषभं सत्यशुष्ममेमस्मत्रा सधमादो वहंतु ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra-vā́haḥ ǀ nṛ-pátim ǀ vájra-bāhum ǀ ugrám ǀ ugrā́saḥ ǀ taviṣā́saḥ ǀ enam ǀprá-tvakṣasam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ satyá-śuṣmam ǀ ā́ ǀ īm ǀ asma-trā́ ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ vahantu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let strong and mighty Steeds who bear this Mighty Indra, the Lord of men, whose arm wields thunder, Bring unto us, as sharers of our banquet, the Steer of conquering might, of real vigour.
verses.wilson_translation: May the fierce, vigorous, exulting horses of Indrabring him here to us, the king of men, armed with thethunderbolt, fierce, the reducer of foes, the showerer (of benefits), whose strength is real.
verses.griffith_verse: Let strong and mighty Steeds who bear this Mighty Indra, the Lord of men, whose arm wields thunder, Bring unto us, as sharers of our banquet, the Steer of conquering might, of real vigour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा पतिं द्रोणसाचं सचेतसमूर्जः स्कंभं धरुण आ वृषायसे ।ओजः कृष्व सं गृभाय त्वे अप्यसो यथा केनिपानामिनो वृधे ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ pátim ǀ droṇa-sā́cam ǀ sá-cetasam ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ skambhám ǀ dharúṇe ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣa-yase ǀójaḥ ǀ kṛṣva ǀ sám ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ tvé íti ǀ ápi ǀ ásaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ ke-nipā́nām ǀ ináḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
verses.english_translation: So like a Bull thou rushest to the Lord who loves the trough, the Sage, the prop of vigour, in the vat, Prepare thine energies, collect them in thyself: be for our profit as the Master of the wise.
verses.wilson_translation: Verily,Indra, you pour into your capacious (stomach) the protecting (Soma), serving the woodentrough, intelligent, holding strength; bestow (upon us) vigour; take us into yourself, for you are the lord for theexaltation of the wise.
verses.griffith_verse: So like a Bull thou rushest to the Lord who loves the trough, the Sage, the prop of vigour, in the vat, Prepare thine energies, collect them in thyself: be for our profit as the Master of the wise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: गमन्नस्मे वसून्या हि शंसिषं स्वाशिषं भरमा याहि सोमिनः ।त्वमीशिषे सास्मिन्ना सत्सि बर्हिष्यनाधृष्या तव पात्राणि धर्मणा ॥
verses.transliteration: gáman ǀ asmé íti ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ śáṃsiṣam ǀ su-āśíṣam ǀ bháram ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ somínaḥ ǀtvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ sáḥ ǀ asmín ǀ ā́ ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǀ anādhṛṣyā́ ǀ táva ǀ pā́trāṇi ǀ dhármaṇā ǁ
verses.english_translation: May precious treasures come to us-so will I pray. Come to the votary's gift offered with beauteous laud. Thou art the Lord, as such sit on this holy grass: thy vessels are inviolate as Law commands.
verses.wilson_translation: Let the wealth (to be given by you) come quickly to me, for verily I have glorified you; come to theblessed sacrifice of the offerer of the Soma; for you are the lord; sit down upon this sacred grass; these yourcups (of Soma) are not to be insulted by the act (of evil spirits).
verses.griffith_verse: May precious treasures come to us-so will I pray. Come to the votary's gift offered with beauteous laud. Thou art the Lord, as such sit on this holy grass: thy vessels are inviolate as Law commands.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पृथक्प्रायन्प्रथमा देवहूतयोऽकृण्वत श्रवस्यानि दुष्टरा ।न ये शेकुर्यज्ञियां नावमारुहमीर्मैव ते न्यविशंत केपयः ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛ́thak ǀ prá ǀ āyan ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ devá-hūtayaḥ ǀ ákṛṇvata ǀ śravasyā́ni ǀ dustárā ǀná ǀ yé ǀ śekúḥ ǀ yajñíyām ǀ nā́vam ǀ ā-rúham ǀ īrmā́ ǀ evá ǀ té ǀ ní ǀ aviśanta ǀ képayaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Far went our earlist invocation of the Gods, and won us glories that can never be surpassed. They who could not ascend the ship of sacrifice, sink down in desolation, trembling with alarm.
verses.wilson_translation: They go separately (to the worlds of the gods); first those who offer oblations to the gods haveattained reputation difficult to surpass; those who have not been able to ascend the ship of sacrifice, have gonedown (in the world), wretches (plural nged) in debt.
verses.griffith_verse: Far went our earlist invocation of the Gods, and won us glories that can never be surpassed. They who could not ascend the ship of sacrifice, sink down in desolation, trembling with alarm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवैवापागपरे संतु दूढ्योऽश्वा येषां दुर्युज आयुयुज्रे ।इत्था ये प्रागुपरे संति दावने पुरूणि यत्र वयुनानि भोजना ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ evá ǀ ápāk ǀ ápare ǀ santu ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ yéṣām ǀ duḥ-yújaḥ ǀ ā-yuyujré ǀitthā́ ǀ yé ǀ prā́k ǀ úpare ǀ sánti ǀ dāváne ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ yátra ǀ vayúnāni ǀ bhójanā ǁ
verses.english_translation: So be the others, evil-hearted, far away, whose horses, difficult to harness, have been yoked. Here in advance men stand anear to offer gifts, by whom full many a work that brings reward is done.
verses.griffith_verse: So be the others, evil-hearted, far away, whose horses, difficult to harness, have been yoked. Here in advance men stand anear to offer gifts, by whom full many a work that brings reward is done.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: गिरीँरज्रान्रेजमानाँ अधारयद्द्यौः क्रंददंतरिक्षाणि कोपयत् ।समीचीने धिषणे वि ष्कभायति वृष्णः पीत्वा मद उक्थानि शंसति ॥
verses.transliteration: girī́n ǀ ájrān ǀ réjamānān ǀ adhārayat ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ krandat ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ kopayat ǀsamīcīné íti sam-īcīné ǀ dhiṣáṇe íti ǀ ví ǀ skabhāyati ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ pītvā́ ǀ máde ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ śaṃsati ǁ
verses.english_translation: He firmly fixed the plains and mountains as they shook. Dyaus thundered forth and made the air's mid-region quake. He stays apart the two confronting bowls; he sings lauds in the potent Soma's joy when he hath drunk.
verses.wilson_translation: (Indra) has arrested the wandering tremulous clouds; the heaven cries out (in alarm); he agitates thefirmament; he fixes the combined heaven and earth; having drunk of the effused Soma, he repeats praises in hisexhilaration.
verses.griffith_verse: He firmly fixed the plains and mountains as they shook. Dyaus thundered forth and made the air's mid-region quake. He stays apart the two confronting bowls; he sings lauds in the potent Soma's joy when he hath drunk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमं बिभर्मि सुकृतं ते अंकुशं येनारुजासि मघवंछफारुजः ।अस्मिन्त्सु ते सवने अस्त्वोक्यं सुत इष्टौ मघवन्बोध्याभगः ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ bibharmi ǀ sú-kṛtam ǀ te ǀ aṅkuśám ǀ yéna ǀ ā-rujā́si ǀ magha-van ǀ śapha-ārújaḥ ǀasmín ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ sávane ǀ astu ǀ okyám ǀ suté ǀ iṣṭáu ǀ magha-van ǀ bodhi ǀ ā́-bhagaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I bear this deftly-fashioned goad of thine, wherewith thou, Maghavan, shalt break the strikers with the hoof. At this libation mayst thou be well satisfied. Partake the juice, partake the worship, Maghavan.
verses.wilson_translation: I bear this your well-made goad, (excited) by which, Maghavat, you urge on the slayers of powerfulfoes. Let your abode be at this my sacrifice. Accept, Maghavat, who are to be adored, (my praise) at the sacrificeat which (the Soma) is effused.
verses.griffith_verse: I bear this deftly-fashioned goad of thine, wherewith thou, Maghavan, shalt break the strikers with the hoof. At this libation mayst thou be well satisfied. Partake the juice, partake the worship, Maghavan.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: गोभ���ष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वां ।वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम ॥
verses.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ tarema ǀ ámatim ǀ duḥ-évām ǀ yávena ǀ kṣúdham ǀ puru-hūta ǀ víśvām ǀvayám ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ dhánāni ǀ asmā́kena ǀ vṛjánena ǀ jayema ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.
verses.griffith_verse: O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।इंद्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ paścā́t ǀ utá ǀ út-tarasmāt ǀ ádharāt ǀ agha-yóḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ utá ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bṛhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
verses.wilson_translation: May Bṛhaspatidefend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; may Indra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.
verses.griffith_verse: Bṛhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XLV. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FIRST Agni sprang to life from out of Heaven: the second time from us came Jātavedas.Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him the Eternal. Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided.We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded. The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven,There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Steers increased thee in the water's bosom. Agni roared out, like Dyaus what time he thunders: he licked the ground about the plants he flickered.At once, when born, he looked around enkindled, and lightened heaven and earth within with splendour. The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma,Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled. Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, be sprang to life and filled the earth and heavens.Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni. So among mortals was Immortal Agni stablished as holy wise and willing envoy.He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heavens with radiant lustre. Like gold to look on, far he shone refulgent, beaming imperishable life for glory,Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him. Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, prepares a cake, O Agni, mixt with butter,Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful. Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every song of praise sung forth enrich him.Dear let him be to Sūrya, dear to Agni, preeminent with son and children's children. While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing.Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle. Agni, the Friend of men, the Soma's keeper, Vaiśvānara, hath been lauded by the Ṛṣis.We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.

verses.sanskrit: दिवस्परि प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निरस्मद्द्वितीयं परि जातवेदाः ।तृतीयमप्सु नृमणा अजस्रमिंधान एनं जरते स्वाधीः ॥
verses.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ prathamám ǀ jajñe ǀ agníḥ ǀ asmát ǀ dvitī́yam ǀ pári ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀtṛtī́yam ǀ ap-sú ǀ nṛ-mánāḥ ǀ ájasram ǀ índhānaḥ ǀ enam ǀ jarate ǀ su-ādhī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: FIRST Agni sprang to life from out of Heaven: the second time from us came Jātavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him the Eternal.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniwas first born above the sky; as Ja-tavedas he was born the second time among us; the friend ofman, he was born the third time in the watters; the sage kindlin him eternally praises him.
verses.griffith_verse: FIRST Agni sprang to life from out of Heaven: the second time from us came Jātavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him the Eternal.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा ते अग्ने त्रेधा त्रयाणि विद्मा ते धाम विभृता पुरुत्रा ।विद्मा ते नाम परमं गुहा यद्विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आजगंथ ॥
verses.transliteration: vidmá ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ tredhā́ ǀ trayā́ṇi ǀ vidmá ǀ te ǀ dhā́ma ǀ ví-bhṛtā ǀ puru-trā́ ǀvidmá ǀ te ǀ nā́ma ǀ paramám ǀ gúhā ǀ yát ǀ vidmá ǀ tám ǀ útsam ǀ yátaḥ ǀ ā-jagántha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.
verses.wilson_translation: We recognize your threefold station,Agni, and your three (forms); we recognize the many stationsoccupied by you; we know what your supreme secret appellation (is); we know the source, whence you haveproceeded.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रे त्वा नृमणा अप्स्वंतर्नृचक्षा ईधे दिवो अग्न ऊधन् ।तृतीये त्वा रजसि तस्थिवांसमपामुपस्थे महिषा अवर्धन् ॥
verses.transliteration: samudré ǀ tvā ǀ nṛ-mánāḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ īdhe ǀ diváḥ ǀ agne ǀ ū́dhan ǀtṛtī́ye ǀ tvā ǀ rájasi ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsam ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ avardhan ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven, There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Steers increased thee in the water's bosom.
verses.wilson_translation: He who is well disposed towards men illumines the Agniin the ocean (as submarine fire), in the midstof the waters; the beholder of men (illumines) you in the centre of the sky; the mighty (maruts) magnify youabiding in the third region (the firmament), on the lap of the waters.
verses.griffith_verse: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven, There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Steers increased thee in the water's bosom.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अक्रंददग्निः स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समंजन् ।सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ákrandat ǀ agníḥ ǀ stanáyan-iva ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ kṣā́ma ǀ rérihat ǀ vīrúdhaḥ ǀ sam-añján ǀsadyáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ īm ǀ iddháḥ ǀ ákhyat ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bhānúnā ǀ bhāti ǀ antáríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni roared out, like Dyaus what time he thunders: he licked the ground about the plants he flickered. At once, when born, he looked around enkindled, and lightened heaven and earth within with splendour.
verses.wilson_translation: Agnicries aloud like the thundering heaven; he licks the earth burning the plural nts; as soon asgenerated, he contemplates this (conflagration); when kindled he blazes with his (own) radiance between heavenand earth.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni roared out, like Dyaus what time he thunders: he licked the ground about the plants he flickered. At once, when born, he looked around enkindled, and lightened heaven and earth within with splendour.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: श्रीणामुदारो धरुणो रयीणां मनीषाणां प्रार्पणः सोमगोपाः ।वसुः सूनुः सहसो अप्सु राजा वि भात्यग्र उषसामिधानः ॥
verses.transliteration: śrīṇā́m ǀ ut-āráḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ manīṣā́ṇām ǀ pra-árpaṇaḥ ǀ sóma-gopāḥ ǀvásuḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ rā́jā ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ ágre ǀ uṣásām ǀ idhānáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma, Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.
verses.wilson_translation: Liberal, exciter of splendours, depositary of riches, granter of desires, preserver of the Soma, theinhabiter (of the world), the son of strength, (plural ced) in the waters, the king (Agni) blazes, kindled at thecommencement of dawn.
verses.griffith_verse: The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma, Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्य केतुर्भुवनस्य गर्भ आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः ।वीळुं चिदद्रिमभिनत्परायंजना यदग्निमयजंत पंच ॥
verses.transliteration: víśvasya ǀ ketúḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāt ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀvīḷúm ǀ cit ǀ ádrim ǀ abhinat ǀ parā-yán ǀ jánāḥ ǀ yát ǀ agním ǀ áyajanta ǀ páñca ǁ
verses.english_translation: Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, be sprang to life and filled the earth and heavens. Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: The manifester of all, the germ of the world,Agni, as soon as born fills heaven and earth (with light);he fractures as he advances the solid cloud, for which the classes of men praise him.
verses.griffith_verse: Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, be sprang to life and filled the earth and heavens. Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उशिक्पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि ।इयर्ति धूममरुषं भरिभ्रदुच्छुक्रेण शोचिषा द्यामिनक्षन् ॥
verses.transliteration: uśík ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ márteṣu ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhāyi ǀíyarti ǀ dhūmám ǀ aruṣám ǀ bháribhrat ǀ út ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ dyā́m ǀ ínakṣan ǁ
verses.english_translation: So among mortals was Immortal Agni stablished as holy wise and willing envoy. He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heavens with radiant lustre.
verses.wilson_translation: Desiring (oblations), purifying, moving quickly, sagacious, immortal,Agnihas been stationed amongmortals; he sends forth the smoke, and goes wearing a radiant (form), and percading the heaven with brilliantlustre.
verses.griffith_verse: So among mortals was Immortal Agni stablished as holy wise and willing envoy. He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heavens with radiant lustre.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: दृशानो रुक्म उर्विया व्यद्यौद्दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः ।अग्निरमृतो अभवद्वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौर्जनयत्सुरेताः ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛśānáḥ ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǀ duḥ-márṣam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ śriyé ǀ rucānáḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ váyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ enam ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ janáyat ǀ su-rétāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like gold to look on, far he shone refulgent, beaming imperishable life for glory, Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.
verses.wilson_translation: Conspicuous, glorious,Agnishines with great splendour, moving everywhere, and blazingunsurpassingly with glory; Agni became immortal through the food (of sacrifice) when the prolific heavenengendered him.
verses.griffith_verse: Like gold to look on, far he shone refulgent, beaming imperishable life for glory, Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते अद्य कृणवद्भद्रशोचेऽपूपं देव घृतवंतमग्ने ।प्र तं नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छाभि सुम्नं देवभक्तं यविष्ठ ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ bhadra-śoce ǀ apūpám ǀ deva ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ agne ǀprá ǀ tám ǀ naya ǀ pra-tarám ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ abhí ǀ sumnám ǀ devá-bhaktam ǀ yaviṣṭha ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, prepares a cake, O Agni, mixt with butter, Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.
verses.wilson_translation: Auspiciously radiant and divine Agni, youngest (of the gods), grant ample wealth to the eminent(worshipper), who presents to you today cakes dressed with butter, and confer happiness upon one devoted tothe gods.
verses.griffith_verse: Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, prepares a cake, O Agni, mixt with butter, Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आ तं भज सौश्रवसेष्वग्न उक्थौक्थ आ भज शस्यमाने ।प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवात्युज्जातेन भिनददुज्जनित्वैः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tám ǀ bhaja ǀ sauśravaséṣu ǀ agne ǀ ukthé-ukthe ǀ ā́ ǀ bhaja ǀ śasyámāne ǀpriyáḥ ǀ sū́rye ǀ priyáḥ ǀ agnā́ ǀ bhavāti ǀ út ǀ jāténa ǀ bhinádat ǀ út ǀ jáni-tvaiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every song of praise sung forth enrich him. Dear let him be to Sūrya, dear to Agni, preeminent with son and children's children.
verses.wilson_translation: Prosper the worshipper,Agni, when beautiful sacrificial viands (are being offered), when sacredpraises are being recited (by him). May he be dear to Sūrya, dear to Agni; may he by a son born, or sons to beborn, overcome (his foes).
verses.griffith_verse: Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every song of praise sung forth enrich him. Dear let him be to Sūrya, dear to Agni, preeminent with son and children's children.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने यजमाना अनु द्यून्विश्वा वसु दधिरे वार्याणि ।त्वया सह द्रविणमिच्छमाना व्रजं गोमंतमुशिजो वि वव्रुः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ yájamānāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ víśvā ǀ vásu ǀ dadhire ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀtváyā ǀ sahá ǀ dráviṇam ǀ icchámānāḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vavruḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing. Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.
verses.wilson_translation: To you,Agni, the worshippers offer daily all desirable treasures; (abiding) with you, desirous of wealth,the sages have set open the pasturage frequented by cattle.
verses.griffith_verse: While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing. Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अस्ताव्यग्निर्नरां सुशेवो वैश्वानर ऋषिभिः सोमगोपाः ।अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ástāvi ǀ agníḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sóma-gopāḥ ǀadveṣé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ huvema ǀ dévāḥ ǀ dhattá ǀ rayím ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ram ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, the Friend of men, the Soma's keeper, Vaiśvānara, hath been lauded by the Ṛṣis. We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who are very dear to men,Vaiśvānara, the guardian of the Soma, has been glorified by the
verses.griffith_verse: Agni, the Friend of men, the Soma's keeper, Vaiśvānara, hath been lauded by the Ṛṣis. We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . STABLISHED for thee, to lend thee vital forces, Giver of wealth, Guard of his servant's body.The Great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, Abider with men, is seated in the lap of waters. Worshipping, seeking him with adoration like some lost creature followed by its footprints,Wise Bhṛgus, yearning in their hearts, pursued him, and found him lurking where the floods are gathered. On the Cow's forehead, with laborious searching, Trita, the offspring of Vibhiavas, found him.Born in our houses, Youthful, joy-bestower, he now becomes the central point of brightness. Yearning, with homage, they have set and made him blithe Priest among mankind, oblation-bearer,Leader of rites and Purifier, envoy of men, as sacrifice that still advances. The foolish brought the ne’er-bewildered forward, great, Victor, Song-inspirer, Fort-destroyer.Leading the Youth gold-bearded, like a courser gleaming with wealth, they turned their hymn to profit. Holding his station firmly in the houses, Trita sat down within his home surroundedThence, as Law bids, departs the Tribes' Companion having collected men with no compulsion. His are the fires, eternal, purifying, that make the houses move, whose smoke is shining,White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and sitting in the wood; like winds are Somas. The tongue of Agni bears away the praisesong, and, through his care for Earth, her operations.Him, bright and radiant, living men have stablished as their blithe Priest, the Chief of Sacrificers. That Agni, him whom Heaven and Earth engendered, the Waters. Tvaṣṭar, and with might, the Bhṛgus,Him Mātariśvan and the Gods have fashioned holy for man and first to be entreated. Agni, whom Gods have made oblationbearer, and much-desiring men regard as holy,Give life to him who lauds thee when he worships, and then shall glorious men in troops adore thee.

verses.sanskrit: प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्वा सीददपामुपस्थे ।दधिर्यो धायि स ते वयांसि यंता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ hótā ǀ jātáḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ nabhaḥ-vít ǀ nṛ-sádvā ǀ sīdat ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀdádhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhā́yi ǀ sáḥ ǀ te ǀ váyāṃsi ǀ yantā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ vidhaté ǀ tanū-pā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: STABLISHED for thee, to lend thee vital forces, Giver of wealth, Guard of his servant's body. The Great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, Abider with men, is seated in the lap of waters.
verses.wilson_translation: A mighty ministrant priest, one cognizant of heaven, though abiding with men, having been born, isseated on the lap of the waters; may he, the upholder (of sacrifice), who has been stationed (on the altar), be toyou when offering worship, the giver of food and riches, the protector of your person n.
verses.griffith_verse: STABLISHED for thee, to lend thee vital forces, Giver of wealth, Guard of his servant's body. The Great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, Abider with men, is seated in the lap of waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमं विधंतो अपां सधस्थे पशुं न नष्टं पदैरनु ग्मन् ।गुहा चतंतमुशिजो नमोभिरिच्छंतो धीरा भृगवोऽविंदन् ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ vidhántaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ paśúm ǀ ná ǀ naṣṭám ǀ padáiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǀgúhā ǀ cátantam ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ icchántaḥ ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ avindan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Worshipping, seeking him with adoration like some lost creature followed by its footprints, Wise Bhṛgus, yearning in their hearts, pursued him, and found him lurking where the floods are gathered.
verses.griffith_verse: Worshipping, seeking him with adoration like some lost creature followed by its footprints, Wise Bhṛgus, yearning in their hearts, pursued him, and found him lurking where the floods are gathered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमं त्रितो भूर्यविंददिच्छन्वैभूवसो मूर्धन्यघ्न्यायाः ।स शेवृधो जात आ हर्म्येषु नाभिर्युवा भवति रोचनस्य ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ tritáḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ avindat ǀ icchán ǀ vaibhu-vasáḥ ǀ mūrdháni ǀ ághnyāyāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ śé-vṛdhaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ harmyéṣu ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ bhavati ǀ rocanásya ǁ
verses.english_translation: On the Cow's forehead, with laborious searching, Trita, the offspring of Vibhiavas, found him. Born in our houses, Youthful, joy-bestower, he now becomes the central point of brightness.
verses.wilson_translation: Trita, the son of Vibhuvas, searching (for him), found mighty Agnion the head of the cow; he theaugmenter of happiness manifested in the dwellings (of the pious), the youthful (connecting) bond of theresplendent (Sun).
verses.griffith_verse: On the Cow's forehead, with laborious searching, Trita, the offspring of Vibhiavas, found him. Born in our houses, Youthful, joy-bestower, he now becomes the central point of brightness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मंद्रं होतारमुशिजो नमोभिः प्रांचं यज्ञं नेतारमध्वराणां ।विशामकृण्वन्���रतिं पावकं हव्यवाहं दधतो मानुषेषु ॥
verses.transliteration: mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ prā́ñcam ǀ yajñám ǀ netā́ram ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀviśā́m ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ aratím ǀ pāvakám ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ dádhataḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yearning, with homage, they have set and made him blithe Priest among mankind, oblation-bearer, Leader of rites and Purifier, envoy of men, as sacrifice that still advances.
verses.wilson_translation: (The priests) desirous (to propitiate him), detaining him among men, have by their adoration made himlord over all people, him the exhilarator, the presenteer of burnt offerings, the migrator, the object of sacrifice, theleader of rites, the purifier, the bearer of oblations.
verses.griffith_verse: Yearning, with homage, they have set and made him blithe Priest among mankind, oblation-bearer, Leader of rites and Purifier, envoy of men, as sacrifice that still advances.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्र भूर्जयंतं महां विपोधां मूरा अमूरं पुरां दर्माणं ।नयंतो गर्भं वनां धियं धुर्हिरिश्मश्रुं नार्वाणं धनर्चं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ bhūḥ ǀ jáyantam ǀ mahā́n ǀ vipaḥ-dhā́m ǀ mūrā́ḥ ǀ ámūram ǀ purā́m ǀ darmā́ṇam ǀnáyantaḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ vanā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ dhuḥ ǀ híri-śmaśrum ǀ ná ǀ árvāṇam ǀ dhána-arcam ǁ
verses.english_translation: The foolish brought the ne’er-bewildered forward, great, Victor, Song-inspirer, Fort-destroyer. Leading the Youth gold-bearded, like a courser gleaming with wealth, they turned their hymn to profit.
verses.wilson_translation: Be competent, (priest, to glorify) the victorious mighty Agni, the sustainer of the wise, (even) fools(adore) him, the exempt from folly, the demolisher of cities; conducting the embryo of touchwood, (Agni). Like agolden- haired, swift-moving (horse), loving praise and wealth, they bring him to the sacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: The foolish brought the ne’er-bewildered forward, great, Victor, Song-inspirer, Fort-destroyer. Leading the Youth gold-bearded, like a courser gleaming with wealth, they turned their hymn to profit.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नि पस्त्यासु त्रितः स्तभूयन्परिवीतो योनौ सीददंतः ।अतः संगृभ्या विशां दमूना विधर्मणायंत्रैरीयते नॄन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ní ǀ pastyā́su ǀ tritáḥ ǀ stabhu-yán ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ yónau ǀ sīdat ǀ antáríti ǀátaḥ ǀ sam-gṛ́bhya ǀ viśā́m ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ ví-dharmaṇā ǀ ayantráiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: Holding his station firmly in the houses, Trita sat down within his home surrounded Thence, as Law bids, departs the Tribes' Companion having collected men with no compulsion.
verses.wilson_translation: Occupying three (satations), consolidation (the dwelling of the worshipper), surrounded (by flames),he sits down upon the altar in the chambers (of sacrifice); from there, having accepted (the oblations) of thepeople, with intent to give (them to the gods), in various ways, he (Agni) goes to the gods holding (his foes) incheck.
verses.griffith_verse: Holding his station firmly in the houses, Trita sat down within his home surrounded Thence, as Law bids, departs the Tribes' Companion having collected men with no compulsion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अस्याजरासो दमामरित्रा अर्चद्धूमासो अग्नयः पावकाः ।श्वितीचयः श्वात्रासो भुरण्यवो वनर्षदो वायवो न सोमाः ॥
verses.transliteration: asyá ǀ ajárāsaḥ ǀ damā́m ǀ arítrāḥ ǀ arcát-dhūmāsaḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǀśvitīcáyaḥ ǀ śvātrā́saḥ ǀ bhuraṇyávaḥ ǀ vana-sádaḥ ǀ vāyávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sómāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: His are the fires, eternal, purifying, that make the houses move, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and sitting in the wood; like winds are Somas.
verses.wilson_translation: The undecaying fires of the worshipper, the rescuers from the humiliated (spirits of ill), havingadorable smoke, purifying, becoming white, swift, bearing (the oblation), sitting in the wood, (are) like thefast-flowing Soma.
verses.griffith_verse: His are the fires, eternal, purifying, that make the houses move, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and sitting in the wood; like winds are Somas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्र जिह्वया भरते वेपो अग्निः प्र वयुनानि चेतसा पृथिव्याः ।तमायवः शुचयंतं पावकं मंद्रं होतारं दधिरे यजिष्ठं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ jihváyā ǀ bharate ǀ vépaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ prá ǀ vayúnāni ǀ cétasā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀtám ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ śucáyantam ǀ pāvakám ǀ mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ dadhire ǀ yájiṣṭham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The tongue of Agni bears away the praisesong, and, through his care for Earth, her operations. Him, bright and radiant, living men have stablished as their blithe Priest, the Chief of Sacrificers.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, who bears off (the oblation) with his tongue (of flames), who bears off the hymns of praise with(favourable) mind (for the preservation) of the earth; him men appointed as the shining, purifying, exultinghotā,the most entitled to worship.
verses.griffith_verse: The tongue of Agni bears away the praisesong, and, through his care for Earth, her operations. Him, bright and radiant, living men have stablished as their blithe Priest, the Chief of Sacrificers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: द्यावा यमग्निं पृथिवी जनिष्टामापस्त्वष्टा भृगवो यं सहोभिः ।ईळेन्यं प्रथमं मातरिश्वा देवास्ततक्षुर्मनवे यजत्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: dyā́vā ǀ yám ǀ agním ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ jániṣṭām ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ yám ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀīḷényam ǀ prathamám ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǀ mánave ǀ yájatram ǁ
verses.english_translation: That Agni, him whom Heaven and Earth engendered, the Waters. Tvaṣṭar, and with might, the Bhṛgus, Him Mātariśvan and the Gods have fashioned holy for man and first to be entreated.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni, whom heaven and earth engendered, (whom) the waters and Tvaṣṭā, and the Bṛghus by theirpowers (begot),; the adorable one, whom Mātariśvanfirst, and the gods fabricated as the object of worship of Manu.
verses.griffith_verse: That Agni, him whom Heaven and Earth engendered, the Waters. Tvaṣṭar, and with might, the Bhṛgus, Him Mātariśvan and the Gods have fashioned holy for man and first to be entreated.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यं त्वा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहं पुरुस्पृहो मानुषासो यजत्रं ।स यामन्नग्ने स्तुवते वयो धाः प्र देवयन्यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀ mā́nuṣāsaḥ ǀ yájatram ǀsáḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ agne ǀ stuvaté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ prá ǀ deva-yán ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, whom Gods have made oblationbearer, and much-desiring men regard as holy, Give life to him who lauds thee when he worships, and then shall glorious men in troops adore thee.
verses.wilson_translation: You, whom the gods appointed as the bearer of oblations, whom men, desiring manifold blessings,regard as the object of worship; do you,Agni, bestow food upon him who praises you at the sacrifice; for thedevout worshipper verily obtains great renown.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni, whom Gods have made oblationbearer, and much-desiring men regard as holy, Give life to him who lauds thee when he worships, and then shall glorious men in troops adore thee.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVII. Indra Vaikuntha.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THY right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing for treasure, Treasure-Lord of treasures!Because we know thee, Hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches. Wealth, fully armed, good guard and kind protector, sprung from four seas, the prop and stay of treasures,Fraught with great bounties, meet for praise and glory; vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches. Wealth, with good Brahmans, Indra! God-attended, high, wide, and deep, arid based on broad foundations,Strong, with famed Ṛṣis, conquering our foemen: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches. Victorious, winning strength, with hero sages, confirmed in power, most useful, wealth-attracting,True, Indra! crushing forts and slaying Dasyus: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches. Wealthy in heroes and in cars and horses, strength hundredfold and thousandfold, O Indra,With manly sages, happy troops, Iight-winning: vouchsafe us mighty and resplentdent riches. To Saptagu the sage, the holy-minded, to him, Bṛhaspati, the song approaches,Aṅgiras' Son who must be met with homage: vouchsafe us mighty and reslendent riches. My lauds, like envoys, craving loving-kindness, go forth to Indra with their strong entreaty,Moving his heart and uttered by my spirit: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches. Grant us the boon for which I pray, O Indra, a spacious home unmatched among the people.To this may Heaven and Earth accord approval: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sanskrit: जगृभ्मा ते दक्षिणमिंद्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनां ।विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिं शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: jagṛbhmá ǀ te ǀ dákṣiṇam ǀ indra ǀ hástam ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ vasu-pate ǀ vásūnām ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ gó-patim ǀ śūra ǀ gónām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: THY right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing for treasure, Treasure-Lord of treasures! Because we know thee, Hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, lord of abundant wealth, we, desiring wealth, seize hold of your righthand; we know you, hero,lord of abundant cattle, give us various fertilizing riches.
verses.griffith_verse: THY right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing for treasure, Treasure-Lord of treasures! Because we know thee, Hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्वायुधं स्ववसं सुनीथं चतुःसमुद्रं धरुणं रयीणां ।चर्कृत्यं शंस्यं भूरिवारमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-āyudhám ǀ su-ávasam ǀ su-nīthám ǀ cátuḥ-samudram ǀ dharúṇam ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀcarkṛ́tyam ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ bhū́ri-vāram ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wealth, fully armed, good guard and kind protector, sprung from four seas, the prop and stay of treasures, Fraught with great bounties, meet for praise and glory; vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: (We know you to be) well armed, a sure protector, a safe guide, (renowned throughout) the fouroceans, the depositary of riches, deserving of repeated worship, adorable, the preventer of many (ills); grant usvarious fertilizing riches.
verses.griffith_verse: Wealth, fully armed, good guard and kind protector, sprung from four seas, the prop and stay of treasures, Fraught with great bounties, meet for praise and glory; vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सुब्रह्माणं देववंतं बृहंतमुरुं गभीरं पृथुबुध्नमिंद्र ।श्रुतऋषिमुग्रमभिमातिषाहमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-bráhmāṇam ǀ devá-vantam ǀ bṛhántam ǀ urúm ǀ gabhīrám ǀ pṛthú-budhnam ǀ indra ǀśrutá-ṛṣim ǀ ugrám ǀ abhimāti-sáham ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wealth, with good Brahmans, Indra! God-attended, high, wide, and deep, arid based on broad foundations, Strong, with famed Ṛṣis, conquering our foemen: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us,Indra, various fertilizing riches, the fit object of prayer, honoured by the gods, large, vast,
verses.griffith_verse: Wealth, with good Brahmans, Indra! God-attended, high, wide, and deep, arid based on broad foundations, Strong, with famed Ṛṣis, conquering our foemen: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सनद्वाजं विप्रवीरं तरुत्रं धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षं ।दस्युहनं पूर्भिदमिंद्र सत्यमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: sanát-vājam ǀ vípra-vīram ǀ tárutram ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ su-dákṣam ǀdasyuhánam ǀ pūḥ-bhídam ǀ indra ǀ satyám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Victorious, winning strength, with hero sages, confirmed in power, most useful, wealth-attracting, True, Indra! crushing forts and slaying Dasyus: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us,Indra, various fertilizing riches, dispensing food, comprising intelligentmaleoffspring, theprotector, filling men with wealth, the granter of increase, the very powerful, the slayer of the Dasyus, thedestroyer of cities, the observer of truth.
verses.griffith_verse: Victorious, winning strength, with hero sages, confirmed in power, most useful, wealth-attracting, True, Indra! crushing forts and slaying Dasyus: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वावंतं रथिनं वीरवंतं सहस्रिणं शतिनं वाजमिंद्र ।भद्रव्रातं विप्रवीरं स्वर्षामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: áśva-vantam ǀ rathínam ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ śatínam ǀ vā́jam ǀ indra ǀbhadrá-vrātam ǀ vípra-vīram ǀ svaḥ-sā́m ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wealthy in heroes and in cars and horses, strength hundredfold and thousandfold, O Indra, With manly sages, happy troops, Iight-winning: vouchsafe us mighty and resplentdent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Grant us,Indra, various fettilizing wealth, consisting of horses, of chariots, of valiant followers, ofthousands, of hundreds (of cattle), surrounded by beautiful attendants, endowed with sages and heroes, theenjoyer of all (benefits).
verses.griffith_verse: Wealthy in heroes and in cars and horses, strength hundredfold and thousandfold, O Indra, With manly sages, happy troops, Iight-winning: vouchsafe us mighty and resplentdent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्र सप्तगुमृतधीतिं सुमेधां बृहस्पतिं मतिरच्छा जिगाति ।य आंगिरसो नमसोपसद्योऽस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ saptá-gum ǀ ṛtá-dhītim ǀ su-medhā́m ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ matíḥ ǀ áccha ǀ jigāti ǀyáḥ ǀ āṅgirasáḥ ǀ námasā ǀ upa-sádyaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To Saptagu the sage, the holy-minded, to him, Bṛhaspati, the song approaches, Aṅgiras' Son who must be met with homage: vouchsafe us mighty and reslendent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: The praise (addressed to the gods) comes to the presence of Saptagu, the observer of the truth, theintelligent, the lord of much (praise), who, being of the family of Aṅgirasa, has approached (the gods) withoblations; do you, (Indra) grant me various fertilizing riches.
verses.griffith_verse: To Saptagu the sage, the holy-minded, to him, Bṛhaspati, the song approaches, Aṅgiras' Son who must be met with homage: vouchsafe us mighty and reslendent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वनीवानो मम दूतास इंद्रं स्तोमाश्चरंति सुमतीरियानाः ।हृदिस्पृशो मनसा वच्यमाना अस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: vánīvānaḥ ǀ máma ǀ dūtā́saḥ ǀ índram ǀ sómāḥ ǀ caranti ǀ su-matī́ḥ ǀ iyānā́ḥ ǀhṛdi-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ vacyámānāḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: My lauds, like envoys, craving loving-kindness, go forth to Indra with their strong entreaty, Moving his heart and uttered by my spirit: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: My praises, (my) messengers soliciting ((audience), come to Indra, praying (his) favourable (thoughts),heart-touching, spoken from thesoul; (therefore, Indra) grant me various fertilizing riches.
verses.griffith_verse: My lauds, like envoys, craving loving-kindness, go forth to Indra with their strong entreaty, Moving his heart and uttered by my spirit: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वा यामि दद्धि तन्न इंद्र बृहंतं क्षयमसमं जनानां ।अभि तद्द्यावापृथिवी गृणीतामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ yā́mi ǀ daddhí ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ bṛhántam ǀ kṣáyam ǀ ásamam ǀ jánānām ǀabhí ǀ tát ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ gṛṇītām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Grant us the boon for which I pray, O Indra, a spacious home unmatched among the people. To this may Heaven and Earth accord approval: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.wilson_translation: Bestow,Indra, that which I solicit of you; a large mansion, not held in common with other men; andmay heaven and earth approve of it; grant us, (Indra), various fertilizing riches.
verses.griffith_verse: Grant us the boon for which I pray, O Indra, a spacious home unmatched among the people. To this may Heaven and Earth accord approval: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN XLVIII. Indra Vaikuntha.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I WAS the first possessor of all precious gear: the wealth of every man I win and gather up.On me as on a Father living creatures call; I deal enjoyment to tho. man who offers gifts. I, Indra, am Atharvan's stay and firm support: I brought forth kine to Trita from the Dragon's grasp.I stripped the Dasyus of their manly might, and gave the cattle-stalls to Matarigvan and Dadhyac. For me hath Tvaṣṭar forged the iron thunderbolt: in me the Gods have centred intellectual power.My sheen is like the Sun's insufferably bright: men honour me as Lord for past and future deeds. I won myself these herdi of cattle, steeds and kine, and gold in ample store, with my destructive bolt.I give full many a thousand to the worshipper, what time the Somas and the lauds have made me glad. Indra am I none ever wins my wealth from me never at any time am I a thrall to death.Pressing the Soma, ask riches from me alone: ye, Pūrus, in my friendship shall not suffer harm. These, breathing loud in fury, two and two, who caused Indra to bring his bolt of thunder to the fray,The challengers, I struck with deadly weapon down: firm stand what words the God speaks to his worshippers.This One by stronger might I conquered singly; yea, also two: shall three prevail against me?Like many sheaves upon the floor I thrash them. How can my foes, the Indraless, revile me? Against the Gungus I made Atithigva strong, and kept him mid the folk like Vṛtra-conquering strength,When I won glory in the great foe-slaying fight, in battle where Karanja fell, and Parṇaya. With food for mine enjoyment Sapya Nami came: he joined me as a friend of old in search of kine.As I bestowed on him an arrow for the fight I made him worthy of the song apd hymn of praise. One of the two hath Soma, seen within it; the Herdsman with the bone shows forth the other.He, fain to fight the Bull whose horns were sharpened, stood fettered in the demon's ample region. I, as a God, ne’er violate the statutes of Gods, of Vasus, Rudriyas, Ādityas.These Gods have formed me for auspicious vigour, unconquered and invincible for ever.

verses.sanskrit: अहं भुवं वसुनः पूर्व्यस्पतिरहं धनानि सं जयामि शश्वतः ।मां हवंते पितरं न जंतवोऽहं दाशुषे वि भजामि भोजनं ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ bhuvam ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ ahám ǀ dhánāni ǀ sám ǀ jayāmi ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀmā́m ǀ havante ǀ pitáram ǀ ná ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ ahám ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ví ǀ bhajāmi ǀ bhójanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I WAS the first possessor of all precious gear: the wealth of every man I win and gather up. On me as on a Father living creatures call; I deal enjoyment to tho. man who offers gifts.
verses.wilson_translation: I am the principal lord of wealth; I conquer the treasure of many (adversaries); living beings call uponme as (sons call upon) a father; I bestow food on the donor of oblations.
verses.griffith_verse: I WAS the first possessor of all precious gear: the wealth of every man I win and gather up. On me as on a Father living creatures call; I deal enjoyment to tho. man who offers gifts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहमिंद्रो रोधो वक्षो अथर्वणस्त्रिताय गा अजनयमहेरधि ।अहं दस्युभ्यः परि नृम्णमा ददे गोत्रा शिक्षंदधीचे मातरिश्वने ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ródhaḥ ǀ vákṣaḥ ǀ átharvaṇaḥ ǀ tritā́ya ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ajanayam ǀ áheḥ ǀ ádhi ǀahám ǀ dásyu-bhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀ gotrā́ ǀ śíkṣan ǀ dadhīcé ǀ mātaríśvane ǁ
verses.english_translation: I, Indra, am Atharvan's stay and firm support: I brought forth kine to Trita from the Dragon's grasp. I stripped the Dasyus of their manly might, and gave the cattle-stalls to Matarigvan and Dadhyac.
verses.wilson_translation: I,Indra, amd the strtiker off of the head of the son of Atharvan, I genitive rated the waters from above thecloud for the sake of Trita. I carried off their wealth from the Dasyus; taming the clouds for Dadhyañc, the son of Mātariśvan.
verses.griffith_verse: I, Indra, am Atharvan's stay and firm support: I brought forth kine to Trita from the Dragon's grasp. I stripped the Dasyus of their manly might, and gave the cattle-stalls to Matarigvan and Dadhyac.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मह्यं त्वष्टा वज्रमतक्षदायसं मयि देवासोऽवृजन्नपि क्रतुं ।ममानीकं सूर्यस्येव दुष्टरं मामार्यंति कृतेन कर्त्वेन च ॥
verses.transliteration: máhyam ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ vájram ǀ atakṣat ǀ āyasám ǀ máyi ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ avṛjan ǀ ápi ǀ krátum ǀmáma ǀ ánīkam ǀ sū́ryasya-iva ǀ dustáram ǀ mā́m ǀ ā́ryanti ǀ kṛténa ǀ kártvena ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: For me hath Tvaṣṭar forged the iron thunderbolt: in me the Gods have centred intellectual power. My sheen is like the Sun's insufferably bright: men honour me as Lord for past and future deeds.
verses.wilson_translation: For me Tvaṣṭāfabricated the metal thunderbolt; in me the gods have concentrated pious acts; mylustre is insurmountable, like that of the Sun; men acknowledge me as lord in consequence of what I have done,and of what I shall do.
verses.griffith_verse: For me hath Tvaṣṭar forged the iron thunderbolt: in me the Gods have centred intellectual power. My sheen is like the Sun's insufferably bright: men honour me as Lord for past and future deeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहमेतं गव्ययमश्व्यं पशुं पुरीषिणं सायकेना हिरण्ययं ।पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि दाशुषे यन्मा सोमास उक्थिनो अमंदिषुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ etám ǀ gavyáyam ǀ áśvyam ǀ paśúm ǀ purīṣíṇam ǀ sā́yakena ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀpurú ǀ sahásrā ǀ ní ǀ śiśāmi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀ ámandiṣuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I won myself these herdi of cattle, steeds and kine, and gold in ample store, with my destructive bolt. I give full many a thousand to the worshipper, what time the Somas and the lauds have made me glad.
verses.wilson_translation: (I conquered) by my shaft this (wealth) comprehending kine, horses, herds, water, and gold; I givemany thousands to the donor (of the oblation) when libations and praises have afforded me delight.
verses.griffith_verse: I won myself these herdi of cattle, steeds and kine, and gold in ample store, with my destructive bolt. I give full many a thousand to the worshipper, what time the Somas and the lauds have made me glad.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहमिंद्रो न परा जिग्य इद्धनं न मृत्यवेऽव तस्थे कदा चन ।सोममिन्मा सुन्वंतो याचता वसु न मे पूरवः सख्ये रिषाथन ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ná ǀ párā ǀ jigye ǀ ít ǀ dhánam ǀ ná ǀ mṛtyáve ǀ áva ǀ tasthe ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǀsómam ǀ ít ǀ mā ǀ sunvántaḥ ǀ yācata ǀ vásu ǀ ná ǀ me ǀ pūravaḥ ǀ sakhyé ǀ riṣāthana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra am I none ever wins my wealth from me never at any time am I a thrall to death. Pressing the Soma, ask riches from me alone: ye, Pūrus, in my friendship shall not suffer harm.
verses.wilson_translation: I,Indra, am not surpassed in affluence; I never yield to death; pouring forth the Somalibation, ask ofme wealth; O men, forfeit not my friendship.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra am I none ever wins my wealth from me never at any time am I a thrall to death. Pressing the Soma, ask riches from me alone: ye, Pūrus, in my friendship shall not suffer harm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहमेतांछाश्वसतो द्वाद्वेंद्रं ये वज्रं युधयेऽकृण्वत ।आह्वयमानाँ अव हन्मनाहनं दृळ्हा वदन्ननमस्युर्नमस्विनः ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ etā́n ǀ śā́śvasataḥ ǀ dvā́-dvā ǀ índram ǀ yé ǀ vájram ǀ yudháye ǀ ákṛṇvata ǀā-hváyamānān ǀ áva ǀ hánmanā ǀ ahanam ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ vádan ǀ ánamasyuḥ ǀ namasvínaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: These, breathing loud in fury, two and two, who caused Indra to bring his bolt of thunder to the fray, The challengers, I struck with deadly weapon down: firm stand what words the God speaks to his worshippers. This One by stronger might I conquered singly; yea, also two: shall three prevail against me? Like many sheaves upon the floor I thrash them. How can my foes, the Indraless, revile me? 8 Against the Gungus I made Atithigva strong, and kept him mid the folk like Vṛtra-conquering strength, When I won glory in the great foe-slaying fight, in battle where Karanja fell, and Parṇaya. 9 With food for mine enjoyment Sapya Nami came: he joined me as a friend of old in search of kine. As I bestowed on him an arrow for the fight I made him worthy of the song apd hymn of praise. 10 One of the two hath Soma, seen within it; the Herdsman with the bone shows forth the other. He, fain to fight the Bull whose horns were sharpened, stood fettered in the demon's ample region. 11 I, as a God, ne’er violate the statutes of Gods, of Vasus, Rudriyas, Ādityas. These Gods have formed me for auspicious vigour, unconquered and invincible for ever.
verses.wilson_translation: I destroy those powerful (enemies) two by two who defy the (wielder of the) thunderbolt,Indra, tobattle, I slew them challenging (me to fight) with (great) slaughter, the unbending (slaying) the bending, theuttering stern (menaces).
verses.griffith_verse: These, breathing loud in fury, two and two, who caused Indra to bring his bolt of thunder to the fray, The challengers, I struck with deadly weapon down: firm stand what words the God speaks to his worshippers. This One by stronger might I conquered singly; yea, also two: shall three prevail against me? Like many sheaves upon the floor I thrash them. How can my foes, the Indraless, revile me? 8 Against the Gungus I made Atithigva strong, and kept him mid the folk like Vṛtra-conquering strength, When I won glory in the great foe-slaying fight, in battle where Karanja fell, and Parṇaya. 9 With food for mine enjoyment Sapya Nami came: he joined me as a friend of old in search of kine. As I bestowed on him an arrow for the fight I made him worthy of the song apd hymn of praise. 10 One of the two hath Soma, seen within it; the Herdsman with the bone shows forth the other. He, fain to fight the Bull whose horns were sharpened, stood fettered in the demon's ample region. 11 I, as a God, ne’er violate the statutes of Gods, of Vasus, Rudriyas, Ādityas. These Gods have formed me for auspicious vigour, unconquered and invincible for ever.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अभीदमेकमेको अस्मि निष्षाळभी द्वा किमु त्रयः करंति ।खले न पर्षान्प्रति हन्मि भूरि किं मा निंदंति शत्रवोऽनिंद्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: abhí ǀ idám ǀ ékam ǀ ékaḥ ǀ asmi ǀ niṣṣā́ṭ ǀ abhí ǀ dvā́ ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ karanti ǀkhále ǀ ná ǀ parṣā́n ǀ práti ǀ hanmi ǀ bhū́ri ǀ kím ǀ mā ǀ nindanti ǀ śátravaḥ ǀ anindrā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Single, I overcome my single (adversary); (over-powering them) I overcome two foes; what can threeenemies who know not Indrarevile me?
verses.wilson_translation: Single, I overcome my single (adversary); (over-powering them) I overcome two foes; what can threeenemies who know not Indrarevile me?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: अहं गुंगुभ्यो अतिथिग्वमिष्करमिषं न वृत्रतुरं विक्षु धारयं ।यत्पर्णयघ्न उत वा करंजहे प्राहं महे वृत्रहत्ये अशुश्रवि ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ guṅgú-bhyaḥ ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ íṣkaram ǀ íṣam ǀ ná ǀ vṛtra-túram ǀ vikṣú ǀ dhārayam ǀyát ǀ parṇaya-ghné ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ karañja-hé ǀ prá ǀ ahám ǀ mahé ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ áśuśravi ǁ
verses.english_translation: I prepared Atithigvafor (the protection of) the Guṅgus, I upheld him, the destroyer of enemies, assustenance among the people; when I gained renown in the great Vṛtra-battle, in which Parṇayaand Karañja= hospitable; guṅgus = name of a people; parṇaya and karañja = names ofasuras].
verses.wilson_translation: I prepared Atithigvafor (the protection of) the Guṅgus, I upheld him, the destroyer of enemies, assustenance among the people; when I gained renown in the great Vṛtra-battle, in which Parṇayaand Karañja= hospitable; guṅgus = name of a people; parṇaya and karañja = names ofasuras].
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र मे नमी साप्य इषे भुजे भूद्गवामेषे सख्या कृणुत द्विता ।दिद्युं यदस्य समिथेषु मंहयमादिदेनं शंस्यमुक्थ्यं करं ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ me ǀ námī ǀ sāpyáḥ ǀ iṣé ǀ bhujé ǀ bhūt ǀ gávām ǀ éṣe ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ kṛṇuta ǀ dvitā́ ǀdidyúm ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ maṃháyam ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ enam ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ ukthyám ǀ karam ǁ
verses.english_translation: My praiser, the refuge (of all), was food to enjoy; (him, men) use in two ways, to search for their cattle,and to be their freiend, when I bestow upon him a weapon in his battles, and make him worthy of celebrity andpraise.
verses.wilson_translation: My praiser, the refuge (of all), was food to enjoy; (him, men) use in two ways, to search for their cattle,and to be their freiend, when I bestow upon him a weapon in his battles, and make him worthy of celebrity andpraise.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: प्र नेमस्मिंददृशे सोमो अंतर्गोपा नेममाविरस्था कृणोति ।स तिग्मशृंगं वृषभं युयुत्संद्रुहस्तस्थौ बहुले बद्धो अंतः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ némasmin ǀ dadṛśe ǀ sómaḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ némam ǀ āvíḥ ǀ asthā́ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀsáḥ ǀ tigmá-śṛṅgam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ yúyutsan ǀ druháḥ ǀ tasthau ǀ bahulé ǀ baddháḥ ǀ antáríti ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Somais seen in one of the two (combatants); the cowherd (Indra) manifests the other with histhunderbolt; the latter warring against the sharp- horned bull, remains in great (darkness) bound by the victoṛ
verses.wilson_translation: The Somais seen in one of the two (combatants); the cowherd (Indra) manifests the other with histhunderbolt; the latter warring against the sharp- horned bull, remains in great (darkness) bound by the victoṛ
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यानां वसूनां रुद्रियाणां देवो देवानां न मिनामि धाम ।ते मा भद्राय शवसे ततक्षुरपराजितमस्तृतमषाळ्हं ॥
verses.transliteration: ādityā́nām ǀ vásūnām ǀ rudríyāṇām ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ná ǀ mināmi ǀ dhā́ma ǀté ǀ mā ǀ bhadrā́ya ǀ śávase ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǀ áparā-jitam ǀ ástṛtam ǀ áṣāḷham ǁ
verses.english_translation: The divine (Indra) abandons not the abode of the deities, theĀdityas, the Vasus, and the Rudriyas;may they fashion me for auspicious vigour, undefeated, unharmed, unconquered.
verses.wilson_translation: The divine (Indra) abandons not the abode of the deities, theĀdityas, the Vasus, and the Rudriyas;may they fashion me for auspicious vigour, undefeated, unharmed, unconquered.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896) / H. H. Wilson (1866)

hymns.title: HYMN XLIX.Indra Vaikuntha.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I HAVE enriched the singer with surpassing wealth; I have allowed the holy hymn to strengthen me.I, furtherer of him who offers sacrifice, have conquered in each fight the men who worship not. The People of the heavens, the waters, and the earth have stablished me among the Gods with Indra's name.I took unto myself the two swift vigorous Bays that speed on divers paths, and the fierce bolt for strength. With deadly blows I smote Atka for Kavi's sake; I guarded Kutsa well with these saving helps.As Śuṣṇa's slayer I brandished the dart of death: I gave not up the Āryan name to Dasyu foes. Smadibha, Tugra, and the Vetasus I gave as prey to Kutsa, father-like, to succour him.I was a worthy King to rule the worshipper, when I gave Tuji dear inviolable gifts. I gave up Mṛgaya to Srutarvan as his prey because he ever followed me and kept my laws.For Āyu's sake I caused Veta to bend and bow, and into Savya's hand delivered Padgrbhi., I crushed Navavāstva of the lofty car, the Dāsa, as the Vṛtra-slayer kills the fiends;When straightway on the region's farthest edge I brought the God who makes the lights to broaden and increase. I travel round about borne onward in my might by the fleet-footed dappled Horses of the Sun.When man's libation calls me to the robe of state I soon repel the powerful Dasyu with my blows. Stronger am I than Nabus, I who slew the seven: I glorified with might Yadu and Turvaga.I brought another low, with strength I bent his strength: I let the mighty nine-and-ninety wax in power. Bull over all the streams that flow along the earth, I took the Seven Rivers as mine own domain.I, gifted with great wisdom, spread the floods abroad: by war I found for man the way to high success. I set within these cows the white milk which no God, not even Tvaṣṭar's self, had there deposited,—Much-longed-for, in the breasts, the udders of the kine, the savoury sweets of meath, the milk and Soma juice. Even thus hath Indra Maghavan, truly bounteous, sped Gods and men with mighty operation.The pious glorify all these thine exploits, Lord of Bay Coursers, Strong, and Selfresplendent.

verses.sanskrit: अहं दां गृणते पूर्व्यं वस्वहं ब्रह्म कृणवं मह्यं वर्धनं ।अहं भुवं यजमानस्य चोदितायज्वनः साक्षि विश्वस्मिन्भरे ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ dām ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ pū́rvyam ǀ vásu ǀ ahám ǀ bráhma ǀ kṛṇavam ǀ máhyam ǀ várdhanam ǀahám ǀ bhuvam ǀ yájamānasya ǀ coditā́ ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ sākṣi ǀ víśvasmin ǀ bháre ǁ
verses.english_translation: I HAVE enriched the singer with surpassing wealth; I have allowed the holy hymn to strengthen me. I, furtherer of him who offers sacrifice, have conquered in each fight the men who worship not.
verses.wilson_translation: I give excellent treasure to him who praises me, I render sacred prayer (a source) of greatness tomyself, I am the instrumental gator of the worshipper; I am the discomfiter in every battle of him who does not worship.
verses.griffith_verse: I HAVE enriched the singer with surpassing wealth; I have allowed the holy hymn to strengthen me. I, furtherer of him who offers sacrifice, have conquered in each fight the men who worship not.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मां धुरिंद्रं नाम देवता दिवश्च ग्मश्चापां च जंतवः ।अहं हरी वृषणा विव्रता रघू अहं वज्रं शवसे धृष्ण्वा ददे ॥
verses.transliteration: mā́m ǀ dhuḥ ǀ índram ǀ nā́ma ǀ devátā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀ gmáḥ ǀ ca ǀ apā́m ǀ ca ǀ jantávaḥ ǀahám ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ ví-vratā ǀ raghū́ íti ǀ ahám ǀ vájram ǀ śávase ǀ dhṛṣṇú ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
verses.english_translation: The People of the heavens, the waters, and the earth have stablished me among the Gods with Indra's name. I took unto myself the two swift vigorous Bays that speed on divers paths, and the fierce bolt for strength.
verses.wilson_translation: Those born in heaven, in earth, and in the firmament, support me, whose name is Indraamong thedeities (by their offerings). I (harness to my car) two bay steeds vigorous, many-functioned, rapid; I wield for mystrength the fearful thunderbolt.
verses.griffith_verse: The People of the heavens, the waters, and the earth have stablished me among the Gods with Indra's name. I took unto myself the two swift vigorous Bays that speed on divers paths, and the fierce bolt for strength.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहमत्कं कवये शिश्नथं हथैरहं कुत्समावमाभिरूतिभिः ।अहं शुष्णस्य श्नथिता वधर्यमं न यो रर आर्यं नाम दस्यवे ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ átkam ǀ kaváye ǀ śiśnatham ǀ háthaiḥ ǀ ahám ǀ kútsam ǀ āvam ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀahám ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ śnáthitā ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ yamam ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ raré ǀ ā́ryam ǀ nā́ma ǀ dásyave ǁ
verses.english_translation: With deadly blows I smote Atka for Kavi's sake; I guarded Kutsa well with these saving helps. As Śuṣṇa's slayer I brandished the dart of death: I gave not up the Āryan name to Dasyu foes.
verses.wilson_translation: I smote Atka with many weapons for the defence of the sage; with those protections I preserved Kutsa;I am the slayer ofŚuṣṇa; I grasped the thunderbolt I who have not given the water (nāma) of theĀryasto the Dasyu.
verses.griffith_verse: With deadly blows I smote Atka for Kavi's sake; I guarded Kutsa well with these saving helps. As Śuṣṇa's slayer I brandished the dart of death: I gave not up the Āryan name to Dasyu foes.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं पितेव वेतसूँरभिष्टये तुग्रं कुत्साय स्मदिभं च रंधयं ।अहं भुवं यजमानस्य राजनि प्र यद्भरे तुजये न प्रियाधृषे ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ vetasū́n ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ túgram ǀ kútsāya ǀ smát-ibham ǀ ca ǀ randhayam ǀahám ǀ bhuvam ǀ yájamānasya ǀ rājáni ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ bhare ǀ tújaye ǀ ná ǀ priyā́ ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Smadibha, Tugra, and the Vetasus I gave as prey to Kutsa, father-like, to succour him. I was a worthy King to rule the worshipper, when I gave Tuji dear inviolable gifts.
verses.wilson_translation: Like a father (for a son), I brought under subjection to Kutsa, at his desire, the Vetasūs and Tugraand Smadibha I have been in plural ce of a sovereign to the worshipper when I bring (to him) as to a son acceptable(gifts) for assailing (his enemies).
verses.griffith_verse: Smadibha, Tugra, and the Vetasus I gave as prey to Kutsa, father-like, to succour him. I was a worthy King to rule the worshipper, when I gave Tuji dear inviolable gifts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं रंधयं मृगयं श्रुतर्वणे यन्माजिहीत वयुना चनानुषक् ।अहं वेशं नम्रमायवेऽकरमहं सव्याय पड्गृभिमरंधयं ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ randhayam ǀ mṛ́gayam ǀ śrutárvaṇe ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ ájihīta ǀ vayúnā ǀ caná ǀ ānuṣák ǀahám ǀ veśám ǀ namrám ǀ āyáve ǀ akaram ǀ ahám ǀ sávyāya ǀ páṭ-gṛbhim ǀ arandhayam ǁ
verses.english_translation: I gave up Mṛgaya to Srutarvan as his prey because he ever followed me and kept my laws. For Āyu's sake I caused Veta to bend and bow, and into Savya's hand delivered Padgrbhi.
verses.wilson_translation: I have brought Mṛgayaunder subjection to Śrutarvan; when he came to me, (he was) earnestlyengaged in supplication. I humiliated Veśafor Āyu; I subjugated Padgṛbhi for Savya.
verses.griffith_verse: I gave up Mṛgaya to Srutarvan as his prey because he ever followed me and kept my laws. For Āyu's sake I caused Veta to bend and bow, and into Savya's hand delivered Padgrbhi.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं स यो नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं सं वृत्रेव दासं वृत्रहारुजं ।यद्वर्धयंतं प्रथयंतमानुषग्दूरे पारे रजसो रोचनाकरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ náva-vāstvam ǀ bṛhát-ratham ǀ sám ǀ vṛtrā́-iva ǀ dā́sam ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ árujam ǀyát ǀ vardháyantam ǀ pratháyantam ǀ ānuṣák ǀ dūré ǀ pāré ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ ákaram ǁ
verses.english_translation: 1, I crushed Navavāstva of the lofty car, the Dāsa, as the Vṛtra-slayer kills the fiends; When straightway on the region's farthest edge I brought the God who makes the lights to broaden and increase.
verses.wilson_translation: I, the slayer of Vṛtra, am he who crushed Navavāstva and Bṛhadratha, (who crushed)Dāsalike a Vṛtra, when I drove to the distant shore of the shining world, (both) my augmenting and outstretched (foes) oneafter the other.
verses.griffith_verse: 1, I crushed Navavāstva of the lofty car, the Dāsa, as the Vṛtra-slayer kills the fiends; When straightway on the region's farthest edge I brought the God who makes the lights to broaden and increase.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं सूर्यस्य परि याम्याशुभिः प्रैतशेभिर्वहमान ओजसा ।यन्मा सावो मनुष आह निर्णिज ऋधक्कृषे दासं कृत्व्यं हथैः ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ pári ǀ yāmi ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ etaśébhiḥ ǀ váhamānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀyát ǀ mā ǀ sāváḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ā́ha ǀ niḥ-níje ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ kṛṣe ǀ dā́sam ǀ kṛ́tvyam ǀ háthaiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I travel round about borne onward in my might by the fleet-footed dappled Horses of the Sun. When man's libation calls me to the robe of state I soon repel the powerful Dasyu with my blows.
verses.wilson_translation: Conveyed by the swift white horses of Sūrya, I hasten forth by my power; when the effused libation ofa man invokes me to the brilliant form of the sacrifice, I drive off with my weapons the destroyer who is to beslain.
verses.griffith_verse: I travel round about borne onward in my might by the fleet-footed dappled Horses of the Sun. When man's libation calls me to the robe of state I soon repel the powerful Dasyu with my blows.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं सप्तहा नहुषो नहुष्टरः प्राश्रावयं शवसा तुर्वशं यदुं ।अहं न्यन्यं सहसा सहस्करं नव व्राधतो नवतिं च वक्षयं ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ sapta-hā́ ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ náhuḥ-taraḥ ǀ prá ǀ aśravayam ǀ śávasā ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀahám ǀ ní ǀ anyám ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ karam ǀ náva ǀ vrā́dhataḥ ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ vakṣayam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Stronger am I than Nabus, I who slew the seven: I glorified with might Yadu and Turvaga. I brought another low, with strength I bent his strength: I let the mighty nine-and-ninety wax in power.
verses.wilson_translation: I am the slayer of seven (asuras); I am the especial bond of bonds; I have made Turvaśaand Yadufamous through prowess; I have strengthened another (worshipper) with strength; I have demolished ninety andnine powerful (foes).
verses.griffith_verse: Stronger am I than Nabus, I who slew the seven: I glorified with might Yadu and Turvaga. I brought another low, with strength I bent his strength: I let the mighty nine-and-ninety wax in power.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं सप्त स्रवतो धारयं वृषा द्रवित्न्वः पृथिव्यां सीरा अधि ।अहमर्णांसि वि तिरामि सुक्रतुर्युधा विदं मनवे गातुमिष्टये ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ saptá ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ dhārayam ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ dravitnváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ sīrā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀahám ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ ví ǀ tirāmi ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ yudhā́ ǀ vidam ǀ mánave ǀ gātúm ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bull over all the streams that flow along the earth, I took the Seven Rivers as mine own domain. I, gifted with great wisdom, spread the floods abroad: by war I found for man the way to high success.
verses.wilson_translation: The showerer (of rain), I supported the seven rivers flowing and meandering over the earth; doer ofgood deeds, I spread out the waters; I found by war a path for man to go in.
verses.griffith_verse: Bull over all the streams that flow along the earth, I took the Seven Rivers as mine own domain. I, gifted with great wisdom, spread the floods abroad: by war I found for man the way to high success.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं तदासु धारयं यदासु न देवश्चन त्वष्टाधारयद्रुशत् ।स्पार्हं गवामूधस्सु वक्षणास्वा मधोर्मधु श्वात्र्यं सोममाशिरं ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ tát ǀ āsu ǀ dhārayam ǀ yát ǀ āsu ǀ ná ǀ deváḥ ǀ caná ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ádhārayat ǀ rúśat ǀspārhám ǀ gávām ǀ ū́dhaḥ-su ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀ ā́ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ śvā́tryam ǀ sómam ǀ ā-śíram ǁ
verses.english_translation: I set within these cows the white milk which no God, not even Tvaṣṭar's self, had there deposited,— Much-longed-for, in the breasts, the udders of the kine, the savoury sweets of meath, the milk and Soma juice.
verses.wilson_translation: I have kept up in them that which no deity, not even Tvaṣṭā, has maintained, bright, desirable,(contained) in the udders of the cows; in the rivers (I uphold) the water up to the (source of the) water, thedelightful Somaand the milk and curds.
verses.griffith_verse: I set within these cows the white milk which no God, not even Tvaṣṭar's self, had there deposited,— Much-longed-for, in the breasts, the udders of the kine, the savoury sweets of meath, the milk and Soma juice.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा देवाँ इंद्रो विव्ये नॄन्प्र च्यौत्नेन मघवा सत्यराधाः ।विश्वेत्ता ते हरिवः शचीवोऽभि तुरासः स्वयशो गृणंति ॥
