verses.english_translation: Who offereth to you the laud that ye accept, O ye All-Gods of Manu, many as ye are? Who, Mighty Ones, will prepare for you the sacrifice to bear us over trouble to felicity?
verses.wilson_translation: Who offers you the praise which you like, you wise universal deities, however many you may be?Deities from whom many are born, who can prepare for you such worship as may bear the safe beyond iniquityfor our well-being?
verses.griffith_verse: Who offereth to you the laud that ye accept, O ye All-Gods of Manu, many as ye are? Who, Mighty Ones, will prepare for you the sacrifice to bear us over trouble to felicity?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: येभ्यो होत्रां प्रथमामायेजे मनुः समिद्धाग्निर्मनसा सप्त होतृभिः ।त आदित्या अभयं शर्म यच्छत सुगा नः कर्त सुपथा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: yébhyaḥ ǀ hótrām ǀ prathamā́m ǀ ā-yejé ǀ mánuḥ ǀ sámiddha-agniḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ saptá ǀ hótṛ-bhiḥ ǀté ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ su-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ karta ǀ su-páthā ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Ye to whom Manu, by seven priests, with kindled fire, offered the first oblation with his heart and soul, Vouchsafe us, ye Ādityas, sheitcr free from fear, and make us good and easy paths to happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Ādityas, to whom,Manu, having kindled the fire, offered the first sacrifice with (reverent) mind,(aided) by the seven ministrant priests, do you bestow upon us prosperity, free from peril; provide for us plural asantpaths easy to travel for our well-being.
verses.griffith_verse: Ye to whom Manu, by seven priests, with kindled fire, offered the first oblation with his heart and soul, Vouchsafe us, ye Ādityas, sheitcr free from fear, and make us good and easy paths to happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: य ईशिरे भुवनस्य प्रचेतसो विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च मंतवः ।ते नः कृतादकृतादेनसस्पर्यद्या देवासः पिपृता स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ ī́śire ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ ca ǀ mántavaḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛtā́t ǀ ákṛtāt ǀ énasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ adyá ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ pipṛta ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Wise Deities, who have dominion o’er the world, ye thinkers over all that moves not and that moves, Save us from uncommitted and committed sin, preserve us from all sin to-day for happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May the wise and omniscient deities, who rule over the whole world both stationary and moveable,deliver us today from committed and uncommitted sin, for our well-being.
verses.griffith_verse: Wise Deities, who have dominion o’er the world, ye thinkers over all that moves not and that moves, Save us from uncommitted and committed sin, preserve us from all sin to-day for happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: भरेष्विंद्रं सुहवं हवामहेऽंहोमुचं सुकृतं दैव्यं जनं ।अग्निं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं द्यावापृथिवी मरुतः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: bháreṣu ǀ índram ǀ su-hávam ǀ havāmahe ǀ aṃhaḥ-múcam ǀ su-kṛ́tam ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀagním ǀ mitrám ǀ váruṇam ǀ sātáye ǀ bhágam ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: In battles we invoke Indra still swift to hear, and all the holy Host of Heaven who banish grief, Agni, Mitra, and Varuṇa that we may gain, Dyays, Bhaga, Maruts, Prthivi for happiness:
verses.wilson_translation: We call in battles upon the well-invoked Indra, the liberator from sin, and upon the virtuous folk ofheaven,Agni,Mitra,Varuṇa,Bhaga, Heaven and Earth, the Maruts, for the acquisition (of food), for well-being.
verses.griffith_verse: In battles we invoke Indra still swift to hear, and all the holy Host of Heaven who banish grief, Agni, Mitra, and Varuṇa that we may gain, Dyays, Bhaga, Maruts, Prthivi for happiness:
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिं ।दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवंतीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: su-trā́māṇam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ anehásam ǀ su-śármāṇam ǀ áditim ǀ su-pránītim ǀdáivīm ǀ nā́vam ǀ su-aritrā́m ǀ ánāgasam ǀ ásravantīm ǀ ā́ ǀ ruhema ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Mightily-saving Earth, incomparable Heaven the good guide Aditi who gives secure defence The well-oared heavenly Ship that lets no waters in, free from defect, will we ascend for happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: May we for our well-being ascend the well-oared, defectless, unyielding, divine vessel, thesafe-sheltering expansive heaven, exempt from evil, replete with happiness, exalted and right-directing.
verses.griffith_verse: Mightily-saving Earth, incomparable Heaven the good guide Aditi who gives secure defence The well-oared heavenly Ship that lets no waters in, free from defect, will we ascend for happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे यजत्रा अधि वोचतोतये त्रायध्वं नो दुरेवाया अभिह्रुतः ।सत्यया वो देवहूत्या हुवेम शृण्वतो देवा अवसे स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀ ūtáye ǀ trā́yadhvam ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-évāyāḥ ǀ abhi-hrútaḥ ǀsatyáyā ǀ vaḥ ǀ devá-hūtyā ǀ huvema ǀ śṛṇvatáḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bless us, all Holy Ones, that we may have your help, guard and protect us from malignant injury. With fruitful invocation may we call on you, Gods, who give ear to us for grace, for happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Adorable, universal gods, advocate our cause for our protection; preserve us from malignant adversity,may we with since invocation invoke you, gods, who listen (to our praise) for our protection, for our well-being.
verses.griffith_verse: Bless us, all Holy Ones, that we may have your help, guard and protect us from malignant injury. With fruitful invocation may we call on you, Gods, who give ear to us for grace, for happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अपामीवामप विश्वामनाहुतिमपारातिं दुर्विदत्रामघायतः ।आरे देवा द्वेषो अस्मद्युयोतनोरु णः शर्म यच्छता स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ ámīvām ǀ ápa ǀ víśvām ǀ ánāhutim ǀ ápa ǀ árātim ǀ duḥ-vidátrām ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀāré ǀ devāḥ ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ asmát ǀ yuyotana ǀ urú ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Keep all disease afar and sordid sacrifice, keep off the wicked man's malicious enmity. Keep far away from us all hatred, O ye Gods, and give us ample shelter for our happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: (Remove far) from us disease, remove all neglect of oblations, remove illiberality, the malevolence ofthose who wish to do us harm; remove far from us, gods, those who hate us; grant us ample happiness for ourwell-being.
verses.griffith_verse: Keep all disease afar and sordid sacrifice, keep off the wicked man's malicious enmity. Keep far away from us all hatred, O ye Gods, and give us ample shelter for our happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टः स मर्तो विश्व एधते प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि ।यमादित्यासो नयथा सुनीतिभिरति विश्वानि दुरिता स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: áriṣṭaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ edhate ǀ prá ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ dhármaṇaḥ ǀ pári ǀyám ǀ ādityāsaḥ ǀ náyatha ǀ sunītí-bhiḥ ǀ áti ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Untouched by any evil, every mortal thrives, and, following the Law, spreads in his progeny. Whom ye with your good guidance, O Ādityas, lead safely through all his pain and grief to happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Unharmed prospers every mortal, after performing his duties, he flourishes with posterity, whom youĀdityas guide with good counsels safe over all misfortunes to well-being.
verses.griffith_verse: Untouched by any evil, every mortal thrives, and, following the Law, spreads in his progeny. Whom ye with your good guidance, O Ādityas, lead safely through all his pain and grief to happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं शूरसाता मरुतो हिते धने ।प्रातर्यावाणं रथमिंद्र सानसिमरिष्यंतमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ávatha ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ yám ǀ śū́ra-sātā ǀ marutaḥ ǀ hité ǀ dháne ǀprātaḥ-yā́vānam ǀ rátham ǀ indra ǀ sānasím ǀ áriṣyantam ǀ ā́ ǀ ruhema ǀ svastáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: That which ye guard and grace in battle, O ye Gods, ye Maruts, where the prize is wealth, where heroes win, That conquering Car, O Indra, that sets forth at dawn, that never breaks, may we ascend for happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: (The chariot) which, deities, you protect for the supply of food; that which,Maruts, (you protect) inbattle for the sake of the deposited spoil; may we mount,Indra, the early-moving desirable irresistible chariot forour well- being.
verses.griffith_verse: That which ye guard and grace in battle, O ye Gods, ye Maruts, where the prize is wealth, where heroes win, That conquering Car, O Indra, that sets forth at dawn, that never breaks, may we ascend for happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्ति नः पथ्यासु धन्वसु स्वस्त्यप्सु वृजने स्वर्वति ।स्वस्ति नः पुत्रकृथेषु योनिषु स्वस्ति राये मरुतो दधातन ॥
verses.transliteration: svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ pathyā́su ǀ dhánva-su ǀ svastí ǀ ap-sú ǀ vṛjáne ǀ sváḥ-vati ǀsvastí ǀ naḥ ǀ putra-kṛthéṣu ǀ yóniṣu ǀ svastí ǀ rāyé ǀ marutaḥ ǀ dadhātana ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vouchsafe us blessing in our paths and desert tracts, blessing in waters and in battle, for the light; Blessing upon the wombs that bring male children forth, and blessing, O ye Maruts, for the gain of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, secure to us well-being on roads, in deserts, well-being in waters, midst the might of assailinghosts; well-being in the son-bearing wombs (of our wives); well-being for (the acquisition of) riches.
verses.griffith_verse: Vouchsafe us blessing in our paths and desert tracts, blessing in waters and in battle, for the light; Blessing upon the wombs that bring male children forth, and blessing, O ye Maruts, for the gain of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्तिरिद्धि प्रपथे श्रेष्ठा रेक्णस्वत्यभि या वाममेति ।सा नो अमा सो अरणे नि पातु स्वावेशा भवतु देवगोपा ॥
verses.transliteration: svastíḥ ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ prá-pathe ǀ śréṣṭhā ǀ rékṇasvatī ǀ abhí ǀ yā́ ǀ vāmám ǀ éti ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ amā́ ǀ só íti ǀ áraṇe ǀ ní ǀ pātu ǀ su-āveśā́ ǀ bhavatu ǀ devá-gopā ǁ
verses.english_translation: The noblest Svasti with abundant riches, who comes to what is good by distant pathway,— May she at home and far away preserve us, and dwell with us under the Gods’ protection
verses.wilson_translation: May (pṛthivī), who secures well-being to the excellent path, who, abounding with wealth, goes to thedesirable (plural ce of sacrifice), preserve our home, may she protect us on the path we have to travel; cherished bythe gods, may she be to us a plural asant abode.
verses.griffith_verse: The noblest Svasti with abundant riches, who comes to what is good by distant pathway,— May she at home and far away preserve us, and dwell with us under the Gods’ protection
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ platéḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ avīvṛdhat ǀ vaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ adite ǀ manīṣī́ ǀīśānā́saḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ámartyena ǀ ástāvi ǀ jánaḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ gáyena ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus hatb the thoughtful sage, the son of Plati, praised you, O Aditi and all Ādityas, Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.
verses.wilson_translation: Universal deities and Aditi, thus has the prudent son of plural ti magnified you; the celestial people, theimmortal (company of the gods) through whom (when praised) men become the lords (of wealth) have beengloried by Gaya.
verses.griffith_verse: Thus hatb the thoughtful sage, the son of Plati, praised you, O Aditi and all Ādityas, Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN LXIV. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHAT God, of those who hear, is he whose well-praised name we may record in this our sacrifice; and how?Who will be gracious? Who of many give us bliss? Who out of all the Host will come to lend us aid? The will and thoughts within my breast exert their power: they yearn with love, and fly to all the regions round.None other comforter is found save only these: my longings and my hopes are fixt upon the Gods. To Narāśaṁsa and to Pūṣan I sing forth, unconcealable Agni kindied by the Gods.To Sun and Moon, two Moons, to Yama in the heaven, to Trita, Vāta, Dawn, Night, and the Atvins Twain. How is the Sage extolled whom the loud singers praise? What voice, what hymn is used to laud Bṛhaspati?May Aja-Ekapād with Rkvans swift to hear, and Ahi of the Deep listen unto our call. Aditi, to the birth of Dakṣa and the vow thou summonest the Kings Mitra and Varuṇa.With course unchecked, with many chariots Aryaman comes with the seven priests to tribes of varied sort. May all those vigorous Coursers listen to our cry, hearers of invocation, speeding on their way;Winners of thousands where the priestly meed is won, who gather of themselves great wealth in every race. Bring ye Purandbi, bring Vāyu who yokes his steeds, for friendship bring ye Pūṣan with your songs of praise:They with one mind, one thought attend the sacrifice, urged by the favouring aid of Savitar the God. The thrice-seven wandering Rivers, yea, the mighty floods, the forest trees, the mountains, Agni to our aid,Kṛśānu, Tisya, archers to our gathering-place, and Rudra strong amid the Rudras we invoke. Let the great Streams come hither with their mighty help, Sindhu, Sarasvatī, and Sarayu with waves.Ye Goddess Floods, ye Mothers, animating all, promise us water rich in fatness and in balm. And let Brhaddiva, the Mother, hear our call, and Tvaṣṭar, Father, with the Goddesses and Dames.Ṛbhukṣan, Vāja, Bhaga, and Rathaspati, and the sweet speech of him who labours guard us well! Pleasant to look on as a dwelling rich in food is the blest favour of the Maruts, Rudra's Sons.May we be famed among the folk for wealth in kine. and ever come to you, ye Gods, with sacred food. The thought which ye, O Maruts, Indra and ye Gods have given to me, and ye, Mitra and Varuṇa,—Cause this to grow and swell like a milchcow with milk. Will ye not bear away my songs upon your car? O Maruts, do ye never, never recollect and call again to mind this our relationship?When next we meet together at the central point, even there shall Aditi confirm our brotherhood. The Mothers, Heaven and Earth, those mighty Goddesses, worthy of sacrifice, ecune with the race of Gods.These Two with their support uphold both Gods and men, and with the Fathers pour the copious genial stream. This invocation wins all good that we desire Bṛhaspati, highly-praised Aramati, are here,Even where the stone that presses meath rings loudly out, and where the sages make their voices heard with hymns. Thus hath the sage, skilled in loud singers' duties, desiring riches, yearning after treasure,Gaya, the priestly singer, with his praises and hymns contented the Celestial people. Thus hath the thoughtful sage the son of Plati, praised you, O Aaiti and all Ādityas.Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: कथा देवानां कतमस्य यामनि सुमंतु नाम शृण्वतां मनामहे ।को मृळाति कतमो नो मयस्करत्कतम ऊती अभ्या ववर्तति ॥
verses.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ katamásya ǀ yā́mani ǀ su-mántu ǀ nā́ma ǀ śṛṇvatā́m ǀ manāmahe ǀkáḥ ǀ mṛḷāti ǀ katamáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ máyaḥ ǀ karat ǀ katamáḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ vavartati ǁ
verses.english_translation: WHAT God, of those who hear, is he whose well-praised name we may record in this our sacrifice; and how? Who will be gracious? Who of many give us bliss? Who out of all the Host will come to lend us aid?
verses.wilson_translation: In what manner, and of which of the gods, who hear (our praises) at the sacrifice, may we enunciatethe venerable name? Who will show us compassion? Which of them will grant us happiness? Which of themcomes for our protection?
verses.griffith_verse: WHAT God, of those who hear, is he whose well-praised name we may record in this our sacrifice; and how? Who will be gracious? Who of many give us bliss? Who out of all the Host will come to lend us aid?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: क्रतूयंति क्रतवो हृत्सु धीतयो वेनंति वेनाः पतयंत्या दिशः ।न मर्डिता विद्यते अन्य एभ्यो देवेषु मे अधि कामा अयंसत ॥
verses.transliteration: kratu-yánti ǀ krátavaḥ ǀ hṛt-sú ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ vénanti ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ patáyanti ǀ ā́ ǀ díśaḥ ǀná ǀ marḍitā́ ǀ vidyate ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ me ǀ ádhi ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ ayaṃsata ǁ
verses.english_translation: The will and thoughts within my breast exert their power: they yearn with love, and fly to all the regions round. None other comforter is found save only these: my longings and my hopes are fixt upon the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: The desires cherished in my heart strive to offer worship; (our) wishes long for (the gods) andexpressed (by us) go forth to (the gods); no other bestower of happiness exists except them; upon the gods aremy desire concentrated.
verses.griffith_verse: The will and thoughts within my breast exert their power: they yearn with love, and fly to all the regions round. None other comforter is found save only these: my longings and my hopes are fixt upon the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: नरा वा शंसं पूषणमगोह्यमग्निं देवेद्धमभ्यर्चसे गिरा ।सूर्यामासा चंद्रमसा यमं दिवि त्रितं वातमुषसमक्तुमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration: nárāśáṃsam ǀ vā ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ ágohyam ǀ agním ǀ devá-iddham ǀ abhí ǀ arcase ǀ girā́ ǀsū́ryāmā́sā ǀ candrámasā ǀ yamám ǀ diví ǀ tritám ǀ vā́tam ǀ uṣásam ǀ aktúm ǀ aśvínā ǁ
verses.english_translation: To Narāśaṁsa and to Pūṣan I sing forth, unconcealable Agni kindied by the Gods. To Sun and Moon, two Moons, to Yama in the heaven, to Trita, Vāta, Dawn, Night, and the Atvins Twain.
verses.wilson_translation: Adore with praises Nārāśaṃsa and Pūṣan, and the unapproachable Agnikindled by the devout Aśvins.
verses.griffith_verse: To Narāśaṁsa and to Pūṣan I sing forth, unconcealable Agni kindied by the Gods. To Sun and Moon, two Moons, to Yama in the heaven, to Trita, Vāta, Dawn, Night, and the Atvins Twain.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: कथा कविस्तुवीरवान्कया गिरा बृहस्पतिर्वावृधते सुवृक्तिभिः ।अज एकपात्सुहवेभिर्ऋक्वभिरहिः शृणोतु बुध्न्यो हवीमनि ॥
verses.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ tuvi-rávān ǀ káyā ǀ girā́ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ vavṛdhate ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ su-hávebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ hávīmani ǁ
verses.english_translation: How is the Sage extolled whom the loud singers praise? What voice, what hymn is used to laud Bṛhaspati? May Aja-Ekapād with Rkvans swift to hear, and Ahi of the Deep listen unto our call.
verses.wilson_translation: How is the sage(Agni) adored by multitudes, and by what praises?Bṛhaspatiis magnified with sacredhymns; Aja, walking alone, is magnified with solemn invocations and prayers; may Ahirbudhnyahear us at theseason of invocation.
verses.griffith_verse: How is the Sage extolled whom the loud singers praise? What voice, what hymn is used to laud Bṛhaspati? May Aja-Ekapād with Rkvans swift to hear, and Ahi of the Deep listen unto our call.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य वादिते जन्मनि व्रते राजाना मित्रावरुणा विवाससि ।अतूर्तपंथाः पुरुरथो अर्यमा सप्तहोता विषुरूपेषु जन्मसु ॥
verses.transliteration: dákṣasya ǀ vā ǀ adite ǀ jánmani ǀ vraté ǀ rā́jānā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsasi ǀátūrta-panthāḥ ǀ puru-ráthaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ saptá-hotā ǀ víṣu-rūpeṣu ǀ jánma-su ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aditi, to the birth of Dakṣa and the vow thou summonest the Kings Mitra and Varuṇa. With course unchecked, with many chariots Aryaman comes with the seven priests to tribes of varied sort.
verses.wilson_translation: At the birth of Dakṣa, at his sacred rite, you,Aditi, worshipped the royal Mitraand Varuṇaat thesacred rite.Aryaman, whose course is not hurried, the giver of delight to many, having seven ministering (rays),(proceeds) in his multiform births.
verses.griffith_verse: Aditi, to the birth of Dakṣa and the vow thou summonest the Kings Mitra and Varuṇa. With course unchecked, with many chariots Aryaman comes with the seven priests to tribes of varied sort.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ते नो अर्वंतो हवनश्रुतो हवं विश्वे शृण्वंतु वाजिनो मितद्रवः ।सहस्रसा मेधसाताविव त्मना महो ये धनं समिथेषु जभ्रिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ havana-śrútaḥ ǀ hávam ǀ víśve ǀ śṛṇvantu ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ mitá-dravaḥ ǀsahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ medhásātau-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ maháḥ ǀ yé ǀ dhánam ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ jabhriré ǁ
verses.english_translation: May all those vigorous Coursers listen to our cry, hearers of invocation, speeding on their way; Winners of thousands where the priestly meed is won, who gather of themselves great wealth in every race.
verses.wilson_translation: May those universal horses (of the deities), who listen to invocations, who are vigorous, swiftroadsters, hear our summons; they who spontaneously are the givers of thousands, as if at sacrifice; they whohave won great wealth in battles.
verses.griffith_verse: May all those vigorous Coursers listen to our cry, hearers of invocation, speeding on their way; Winners of thousands where the priestly meed is won, who gather of themselves great wealth in every race.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो वायुं रथयुजं पुरंधिं स्तोमैः कृणुध्वं सख्याय पूषणं ।ते हि देवस्य सवितुः सवीमनि क्रतुं सचंते सचितः सचेतसः ॥
verses.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ ratha-yújam ǀ púram-dhim ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀté ǀ hí ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ sávīmani ǀ krátum ǀ sácante ǀ sa-cítaḥ ǀ sá-cetasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring ye Purandbi, bring Vāyu who yokes his steeds, for friendship bring ye Pūṣan with your songs of praise: They with one mind, one thought attend the sacrifice, urged by the favouring aid of Savitar the God.
verses.wilson_translation: Importune, (worshippers), with praises,Vāyu, harnessing his chariot, and Purandhi and Pūṣanfortheir friendship, for these considerate and consentient deities, attend the sacrifice upon the birth of Savitā.
verses.griffith_verse: Bring ye Purandbi, bring Vāyu who yokes his steeds, for friendship bring ye Pūṣan with your songs of praise: They with one mind, one thought attend the sacrifice, urged by the favouring aid of Savitar the God.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्रिः सप्त सस्रा नद्यो महीरपो वनस्पतीन्पर्वताँ अग्निमूतये ।कृशानुमस्तॄंतिष्यं सधस्थ आ रुद्रं रुद्रेषु रुद्रियं हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ sasrā́ḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ párvatān ǀ agním ǀ ūtáye ǀkṛśā́num ǀ ástṝn ǀ tiṣyám ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǀ rudrám ǀ rudréṣu ǀ rudríyam ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: The thrice-seven wandering Rivers, yea, the mighty floods, the forest trees, the mountains, Agni to our aid, Kṛśānu, Tisya, archers to our gathering-place, and Rudra strong amid the Rudras we invoke.
verses.wilson_translation: We invoke for protection the thrice seven flowing rivers, (their) great waters, the trees, the mountains,Agni,Kṛśānu, the archers, and Tiṣya, to the assembly; (we invoke)Rudra, worthy of the praise of the Rudras,for the good of the praisers.
verses.griffith_verse: The thrice-seven wandering Rivers, yea, the mighty floods, the forest trees, the mountains, Agni to our aid, Kṛśānu, Tisya, archers to our gathering-place, and Rudra strong amid the Rudras we invoke.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वती सरयुः सिंधुरूर्मिभिर्महो महीरवसा यंतु वक्षणीः ।देवीरापो मातरः सूदयित्न्वो घृतवत्पयो मधुमन्नो अर्चत ॥
verses.transliteration: sárasvatī ǀ saráyuḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ūrmí-bhiḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ yantu ǀ vákṣaṇīḥ ǀdevī́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ sūdayitnváḥ ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ páyaḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ naḥ ǀ arcata ǁ
verses.english_translation: Let the great Streams come hither with their mighty help, Sindhu, Sarasvatī, and Sarayu with waves. Ye Goddess Floods, ye Mothers, animating all, promise us water rich in fatness and in balm.
verses.wilson_translation: May the very great rivers,Sarasvatī,Sarayu,Sindhu, come with their waves for (our) protection; maythe divine maternal animating waters grant us their water mixed with butter and honey.
verses.griffith_verse: Let the great Streams come hither with their mighty help, Sindhu, Sarasvatī, and Sarayu with waves. Ye Goddess Floods, ye Mothers, animating all, promise us water rich in fatness and in balm.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: उत माता बृहद्दिवा शृणोतु नस्त्वष्टा देवेभिर्जनिभिः पिता वचः ।ऋभुक्षा वाजो रथस्पतिर्भगो रण्वः शंसः शशमानस्य पातु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: utá ǀ mātā́ ǀ bṛhat-divā́ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ naḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ vácaḥ ǀṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ráthaḥpátiḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ pātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: And let Brhaddiva, the Mother, hear our call, and Tvaṣṭar, Father, with the Goddesses and Dames. Ṛbhukṣan, Vāja, Bhaga, and Rathaspati, and the sweet speech of him who labours guard us well!
verses.wilson_translation: May the bright shining mother (of the gods) hear us; may father Tvaṣṭā, with the gods, and theirwives, (hear our) words; may Ṛbhukṣan,Vāja, Rathaspati,Bhaga, may the joyous adorable (company of the Maruts) protect us their praisers.
verses.griffith_verse: And let Brhaddiva, the Mother, hear our call, and Tvaṣṭar, Father, with the Goddesses and Dames. Ṛbhukṣan, Vāja, Bhaga, and Rathaspati, and the sweet speech of him who labours guard us well!
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: रण्वः संदृष्टौ पितुमाँ इव क्षयो भद्रा रुद्राणां मरुतामुपस्तुतिः ।गोभिः ष्याम यशसो जनेष्वा सदा देवास इळया सचेमहि ॥
verses.transliteration: raṇváḥ ǀ sám-dṛṣṭau ǀ pitumā́n-iva ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ rudrā́ṇām ǀ marútām ǀ úpa-stutiḥ ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ syāma ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ sádā ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ íḷayā ǀ sacemahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Pleasant to look on as a dwelling rich in food is the blest favour of the Maruts, Rudra's Sons. May we be famed among the folk for wealth in kine. and ever come to you, ye Gods, with sacred food.
verses.wilson_translation: plural asant of aspect (is troop of Maruts), like a house well stored with provisions; fortunate is the favourof the Maruts, the sons of Rudra; may we (thereby) be famed among men for cattle, and so, gods, ever approach(you) with sacrificial food.
verses.griffith_verse: Pleasant to look on as a dwelling rich in food is the blest favour of the Maruts, Rudra's Sons. May we be famed among the folk for wealth in kine. and ever come to you, ye Gods, with sacred food.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यां मे धियं मरुत इंद्र देवा अददात वरुण मित्र यूयं ।तां पीपयत पयसेव धेनुं कुविद्गिरो अधि रथे वहाथ ॥
verses.transliteration: yám ǀ me ǀ dhíyam ǀ márutaḥ ǀ índra ǀ dévāḥ ǀ ádadāta ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ yūyám ǀtā́m ǀ pīpayata ǀ páyasā-iva ǀ dhenúm ǀ kuvít ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ráthe ǀ váhātha ǁ
verses.english_translation: The thought which ye, O Maruts, Indra and ye Gods have given to me, and ye, Mitra and Varuṇa,— Cause this to grow and swell like a milchcow with milk. Will ye not bear away my songs upon your car?
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts,Indra, gods,Varuṇaand Mitra, reward the worship, which you have given as (men fatten) the(newly-delivered) cow with milk, you have repeatedly put my praises on your car.
verses.griffith_verse: The thought which ye, O Maruts, Indra and ye Gods have given to me, and ye, Mitra and Varuṇa,— Cause this to grow and swell like a milchcow with milk. Will ye not bear away my songs upon your car?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: कुविदंग प्रति यथा चिदस्य नः सजात्यस्य मरुतो बुबोधथ ।नाभा यत्र प्रथमं संनसामहे तत्र जामित्वमदितिर्दधातु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: kuvít ǀ aṅgá ǀ práti ǀ yáthā ǀ cit ǀ asyá ǀ naḥ ǀ sa-jātyásya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ búbodhatha ǀnā́bhā ǀ yátra ǀ prathamám ǀ sam-násāmahe ǀ tátra ǀ jāmi-tvám ǀ áditiḥ ǀ dadhātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Maruts, do ye never, never recollect and call again to mind this our relationship? When next we meet together at the central point, even there shall Aditi confirm our brotherhood.
verses.wilson_translation: Maruts, repeatedly acknowledge us, so that (you may make us the objects) of this relationship; andmay Aditigrant us affinity (with men) on the navel of the earth, where we first assemble (to offer oblations).
verses.griffith_verse: O Maruts, do ye never, never recollect and call again to mind this our relationship? When next we meet together at the central point, even there shall Aditi confirm our brotherhood.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ते हि द्यावापृथिवी मातरा मही देवी देवांजन्मना यज्ञिये इतः ।उभे बिभृत उभयं भरीमभिः पुरू रेतांसि पितृभिश्च सिंचतः ॥
verses.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ mātárā ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ devī́ íti ǀ devā́n ǀ jánmanā ǀ yajñíye íti ǀ itáḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ bibhṛtaḥ ǀ ubháyam ǀ bhárīma-bhiḥ ǀ purú ǀ rétāṃsi ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ siñcataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Mothers, Heaven and Earth, those mighty Goddesses, worthy of sacrifice, ecune with the race of Gods. These Two with their support uphold both Gods and men, and with the Fathers pour the copious genial stream.
verses.wilson_translation: They, two, the maternal heaven and earth, mighty, divine, adorable, attain to the gods upon their birth;they both cherish the two (races, human and divine) (gods), they shed abundant moisture.
verses.griffith_verse: The Mothers, Heaven and Earth, those mighty Goddesses, worthy of sacrifice, ecune with the race of Gods. These Two with their support uphold both Gods and men, and with the Fathers pour the copious genial stream.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वि षा होत्रा विश्वमश्नोति वार्यं बृहस्पतिररमतिः पनीयसी ।ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदवीवशंत मतिभिर्मनीषिणः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ sā́ ǀ hótrā ǀ víśvam ǀ aśnoti ǀ vā́ryam ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ arámatiḥ ǀ pánīyasī ǀgrā́vā ǀ yátra ǀ madhu-sút ǀ ucyáte ǀ bṛhát ǀ ávīvaśanta ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: This invocation wins all good that we desire Bṛhaspati, highly-praised Aramati, are here, Even where the stone that presses meath rings loudly out, and where the sages make their voices heard with hymns.
verses.wilson_translation: That voice of invocation, the protectress of the mighty, never ceasing, the panegyrist (of the gods),the pious, by their praises, make the god desirous (of the sacrifice).
verses.griffith_verse: This invocation wins all good that we desire Bṛhaspati, highly-praised Aramati, are here, Even where the stone that presses meath rings loudly out, and where the sages make their voices heard with hymns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा कविस्तुवीरवाँ ऋतज्ञा द्रविणस्युर्द्रविणसश्चकानः ।उक्थेभिरत्र मतिभिश्च विप्रोऽपीपयद्गयो दिव्यानि जन्म ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ kavíḥ ǀ tuvi-rávān ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀ draviṇasyúḥ ǀ dráviṇasaḥ ǀ cakānáḥ ǀukthébhiḥ ǀ átra ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ápīpayat ǀ gáyaḥ ǀ divyā́ni ǀ jánma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus hath the sage, skilled in loud singers' duties, desiring riches, yearning after treasure, Gaya, the priestly singer, with his praises and hymns contented the Celestial people.
verses.wilson_translation: The pious sage,Gaya, eloquent in laudation, conversant with sacred rites, wishing for wealth, eagerfor wealth, propitiates the celestial people with prayers and praises.
verses.griffith_verse: Thus hath the sage, skilled in loud singers' duties, desiring riches, yearning after treasure, Gaya, the priestly singer, with his praises and hymns contented the Celestial people.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन ॥
verses.transliteration: evá ǀ platéḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ avīvṛdhat ǀ vaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ adite ǀ manīṣī́ ǀīśānā́saḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ámartyena ǀ ástāvi ǀ jánaḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ gáyena ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus hath the thoughtful sage the son of Plati, praised you, O Aaiti and all Ādityas. Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.
verses.wilson_translation: Universal deities and Aditi, thus has the prudent son of plural ti magnified you; the celestial people, theimmortal (company of the gods) through whom (when praised) men become the bonds (of wealth), have beenglorified by Gaya.
verses.griffith_verse: Thus hath the thoughtful sage the son of Plati, praised you, O Aaiti and all Ādityas. Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN LXV. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY Agni, Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa consent, Aryaman, Vāyu, Pūṣan, and Sarasvatī,Ādityas, Maruts, Viṣṇu, Soma, lofty Sky, Rudra and Aditi, and Brahmaṇaspati. Indra and Agni, Hero-lords when Vṛtra fell, dwelling together, speeding emulously on,And Soma blent with oil, putting his greatness forth, have with their power filled full the mighty firmament. Skilled in the Law I lift the hymn of praise to these, Law-strengtheners, unassailed, and great in majesty.These in their wondrous bounty send the watery sea: may they as kindly Friends send gifts to make us great. They with their might have stayed Heaven, Earth, and Prthivi, the Lord of Light, the firmament, -the lustrous spheres.Even as fleet-foot steeds who make their masters glad, the princely Gods are praised, most bountiful to man. Bring gifts to Mitra and to Varuṇa who, Lords of all, in spirit never fail the worshipper,Whose statute shines on high through everlasting Law, whose places of sure refuge are the heavens and earth. The cow who yielding milk goes her appointed way hither to us as leader of holy rites,Speaking aloud to Varuṇa and the worshipper, shall with oblation serve Vivasvān and the Gods. The Gods whose tongue is Agni dwell in heaven, and sit, aiders of Law, reflecting, in the seat of Law.They propped up heaven and then brought waters with their might, got sacrifice and in a body made it fair. Born in the oldest time, the Parents dwelling round are sharers of one mansion in the home of Law.Bound by their common vow Dyaus, Prthivi stream forth the moisture rich in oil to Varuṇa the Steer. Parjanya, Vāta, mighty, senders of the rain, Indra and Vāyu, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman:We call on Aditi, Ādityas, and the Gods, those who are on the earth, in waters, and in heaven. Tvaṣṭar and Vāyu, those who count as Ṛbhus, both celestial Hotar-priests, and Dawn for happiness,Winners of wealth, we call, and wise Bṛhaspati, destroyer of our foes, and Soma Indra's Friend. They generated prayer, the cow, the horse, the plants, the forest trees, the earth, the waters, and the hills.These very bounteous Gods made the Sun mount to heaven, and spread the righteous laws of Āryas o’er the land. O Aśvins, ye delivered Bhujyu from distress, ye animated Śyāva, Vadhrmati's son.To Vimada ye brought his consort Kamadyu, and gave his lost Viṣṇāpū back to Viśvaka. Thunder, the lightning's daughter, Aja-Ekapād, heaven's bearer, Sindhu, and the waters of the sea:Hear all the Gods my words, Sarasvatī give ear together with Purandhi and with Holy Thoughts. With Holy Thoughts and with Purandhi may all Gods, knowing the Law immortal, Manu's Holy Ones,Boon-givers, favourers, finders of light, and Heaven, with gracious love accept my songs, my prayer, my hymn. Immortal Gods have I, Vasiṣṭha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings.May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरिंद्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा वायुः पूषा सरस्वती सजोषसः ।आदित्या विष्णुर्मरुतः स्वर्बृहत्सोमो रुद्रो अदितिर्ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀādityā́ḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: MAY Agni, Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa consent, Aryaman, Vāyu, Pūṣan, and Sarasvatī, Ādityas, Maruts, Viṣṇu, Soma, lofty Sky, Rudra and Aditi, and Brahmaṇaspati.
verses.wilson_translation: Agni,Inda,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman,Vāyu,Pūṣan,Sarasvatī, theĀdityas,Viṣṇu, the Maruts,the mighty heaven,Soma,Rudra,Aditi,Brahmaṇaspatiwith one consent.
verses.griffith_verse: MAY Agni, Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa consent, Aryaman, Vāyu, Pūṣan, and Sarasvatī, Ādityas, Maruts, Viṣṇu, Soma, lofty Sky, Rudra and Aditi, and Brahmaṇaspati.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्राग्नी वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पती मिथो हिन्वाना तन्वा समोकसा ।अंतरिक्षं मह्या पप्रुरोजसा सोमो घृतश्रीर्महिमानमीरयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: indrāgnī́ íti ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ sátpatī íti sát-patī ǀ mitháḥ ǀ hinvānā́ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ sám-okasā ǀantárikṣam ǀ máhi ǀ ā́ ǀ papruḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ghṛta-śrī́ḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ īráyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Indra and Agni, Hero-lords when Vṛtra fell, dwelling together, speeding emulously on, And Soma blent with oil, putting his greatness forth, have with their power filled full the mighty firmament.
verses.wilson_translation: Indra, and Agni, the lords of the virtuous, standing in the same plural ce, mutually invigorating each otherwith might in the Vṛtra-slaying battles, and the ghī-glorified Somaputting forth his greatness have filled the vastfirmament with their strength.
verses.griffith_verse: Indra and Agni, Hero-lords when Vṛtra fell, dwelling together, speeding emulously on, And Soma blent with oil, putting his greatness forth, have with their power filled full the mighty firmament.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तेषां हि मह्ना महतामनर्वणां स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यृतज्ञा ऋतावृधां ।ये अप्सवमर्णवं चित्रराधसस्ते नो रासंतां महये सुमित्र्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: téṣām ǀ hí ǀ mahnā́ ǀ mahatā́m ǀ anarváṇām ǀ stómān ǀ íyarmi ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhām ǀyé ǀ apsavám ǀ arṇavám ǀ citrá-rādhasaḥ ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsantām ǀ maháye ǀ su-mitryā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Skilled in the Law I lift the hymn of praise to these, Law-strengtheners, unassailed, and great in majesty. These in their wondrous bounty send the watery sea: may they as kindly Friends send gifts to make us great.
verses.wilson_translation: Skilled in pious rites, I recite the praises of these (deities), mighty through (their own) might,unassailable, exalted by sacrifice; may those (gods) who possessed of various wealth, (rain down) the beautifulwater-cloud, acting in friendly wise, grant us (wealth) for our honour (among men).
verses.griffith_verse: Skilled in the Law I lift the hymn of praise to these, Law-strengtheners, unassailed, and great in majesty. These in their wondrous bounty send the watery sea: may they as kindly Friends send gifts to make us great.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्णरमंतरिक्षाणि रोचना द्यावाभूमी पृथिवीं स्कंभुरोजसा ।पृक्षा इव महयंतः सुरातयो देवाः स्तवंते मनुषाय सूरयः ॥
verses.transliteration: sváḥ-naram ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ rocanā́ ǀ dyā́vābhū́mī íti ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ skambhuḥ ǀ ójasā ǀpṛkṣā́ḥ-iva ǀ maháyantaḥ ǀ su-rātáyaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ stavante ǀ mánuṣāya ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: They with their might have stayed Heaven, Earth, and Prthivi, the Lord of Light, the firmament, -the lustrous spheres. Even as fleet-foot steeds who make their masters glad, the princely Gods are praised, most bountiful to man.
verses.wilson_translation: They have sustained by their strength the leader of all (the sun), the luminaries of the firmament,heaven and earth, the outstretched (firmament), honouring (their worshippers) like those who give food (to thepoor), the genitive rous gods bestowing wealth on man are glorified (at this sacrifice).
verses.griffith_verse: They with their might have stayed Heaven, Earth, and Prthivi, the Lord of Light, the firmament, -the lustrous spheres. Even as fleet-foot steeds who make their masters glad, the princely Gods are praised, most bountiful to man.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मित्राय शिक्ष वरुणाय दाशुषे या सम्राजा मनसा न प्रयुच्छतः ।ययोर्धाम धर्मणा रोचते बृहद्ययोरुभे रोदसी नाधसी वृतौ ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrā́ya ǀ śikṣa ǀ váruṇāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ yā́ ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ mánasā ǀ ná ǀ pra-yúcchataḥ ǀyáyoḥ ǀ dhā́ma ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ rócate ǀ bṛhát ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ nā́dhasī íti ǀ vṛ́tau ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bring gifts to Mitra and to Varuṇa who, Lords of all, in spirit never fail the worshipper, Whose statute shines on high through everlasting Law, whose places of sure refuge are the heavens and earth.
verses.wilson_translation: Worship the liberal Mitraand Varuṇa, the two royal deities who are never negligent in their thoughts,whose vast body is resplendent through their functions, upon whom the two solicitous worlds (heaven and earth)remain (dependent).
verses.griffith_verse: Bring gifts to Mitra and to Varuṇa who, Lords of all, in spirit never fail the worshipper, Whose statute shines on high through everlasting Law, whose places of sure refuge are the heavens and earth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: या गौर्वर्तनिं पर्येति निष्कृतं पयो दुहाना व्रतनीरवारतः ।सा प्रब्रुवाणा वरुणाय दाशुषे देवेभ्यो दाशद्धविषा विवस्वते ॥
verses.transliteration: yā́ ǀ gáuḥ ǀ vartaním ǀ pari-éti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ dúhānā ǀ vrata-nī́ḥ ǀ avārátaḥ ǀsā́ ǀ pra-bruvāṇā́ ǀ váruṇāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ dāśat ǀ havíṣā ǀ vivásvate ǁ
verses.english_translation: The cow who yielding milk goes her appointed way hither to us as leader of holy rites, Speaking aloud to Varuṇa and the worshipper, shall with oblation serve Vivasvān and the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: May that cow, the leader of the rite, which yielding her milk proceeds uncalled to the consecratedplace (of sacrifice), may she, propitiated by me, yield her milk to (me), the offerer of oblations to liberal Varuṇaand the (other) gods.
verses.griffith_verse: The cow who yielding milk goes her appointed way hither to us as leader of holy rites, Speaking aloud to Varuṇa and the worshipper, shall with oblation serve Vivasvān and the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: दिवक्षसो अग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृध ऋतस्य योनिं विमृशंत आसते ।द्यां स्कभित्व्यप आ चक्रुरोजसा यज्ञं जनित्वी तन्वी नि मामृजुः ॥
verses.transliteration: divákṣasaḥ ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ vi-mṛśántaḥ ǀ āsate ǀdyā́m ǀ skabhitvī́ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cakruḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ yajñám ǀ janitvī́ ǀ tanví ǀ ní ǀ mamṛjuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Gods whose tongue is Agni dwell in heaven, and sit, aiders of Law, reflecting, in the seat of Law. They propped up heaven and then brought waters with their might, got sacrifice and in a body made it fair.
verses.wilson_translation: Pervading heaven (with their radiance), having Agnias their tongue, the augmenters of sacrifice,(these deities) sit contemplating the plural ce of sacrifice; sustaining heaven they have produced the waters by theirpower; having genitive rated sacrifice, they have decorated their person ns (with it).
verses.griffith_verse: The Gods whose tongue is Agni dwell in heaven, and sit, aiders of Law, reflecting, in the seat of Law. They propped up heaven and then brought waters with their might, got sacrifice and in a body made it fair.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: परिक्षिता पितरा पूर्वजावरी ऋतस्य योना क्षयतः समोकसा ।द्यावापृथिवी वरुणाय सव्रते घृतवत्पयो महिषाय पिन्वतः ॥
verses.transliteration: pari-kṣítā ǀ pitárā ǀ pūrvajā́varī íti pūrva-jā́varī ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónā ǀ kṣayataḥ ǀ sám-okasā ǀdyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ váruṇāya ǀ sávrate íti sá-vrate ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ páyaḥ ǀ mahiṣā́ya ǀ pinvataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Born in the oldest time, the Parents dwelling round are sharers of one mansion in the home of Law. Bound by their common vow Dyaus, Prthivi stream forth the moisture rich in oil to Varuṇa the Steer.
verses.wilson_translation: The encompassing parents (heaven and earth), born of old, having a common dwelling, sit down uponthe plural ce of sacrifice; engaged in a common observance they sprinkle upon the adorable Varuṇawater mixedwith butter.
verses.griffith_verse: Born in the oldest time, the Parents dwelling round are sharers of one mansion in the home of Law. Bound by their common vow Dyaus, Prthivi stream forth the moisture rich in oil to Varuṇa the Steer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पर्जन्यावाता वृषभा पुरीषिणेंद्रवायू वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।देवाँ आदित्याँ अदितिं हवामहे ये पार्थिवासो दिव्यासो अप्सु ये ॥
verses.transliteration: parjányāvā́tā ǀ vṛṣabhā́ ǀ purīṣíṇā ǀ indravāyū́ íti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀdevā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ áditim ǀ havāmahe ǀ yé ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀ divyā́saḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ yé ǁ
verses.english_translation: Parjanya, Vāta, mighty, senders of the rain, Indra and Vāyu, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman: We call on Aditi, Ādityas, and the Gods, those who are on the earth, in waters, and in heaven.
verses.wilson_translation: The two showerers (of desires),Parjanyaand Vāta, the two senders of water,Indraand Vāyu,Varuṇa,m Mitra,Aryaman; we invoke the divineĀdityas,Aditi, and the gods, who dwell on the earth, or inheaven, or in the waters.
verses.griffith_verse: Parjanya, Vāta, mighty, senders of the rain, Indra and Vāyu, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman: We call on Aditi, Ādityas, and the Gods, those who are on the earth, in waters, and in heaven.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टारं वायुमृभवो य ओहते दैव्या होतारा उषसं स्वस्तये ।बृहस्पतिं वृत्रखादं सुमेधसमिंद्रियं सोमं धनसा उ ईमहे ॥
verses.transliteration: tváṣṭāram ǀ vāyúm ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ óhate ǀ dáivyā ǀ hótārau ǀ uṣásam ǀ svastáye ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ vṛtra-khādám ǀ su-medhásam ǀ indriyám ǀ sómam ǀ dhana-sā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ īmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Tvaṣṭar and Vāyu, those who count as Ṛbhus, both celestial Hotar-priests, and Dawn for happiness, Winners of wealth, we call, and wise Bṛhaspati, destroyer of our foes, and Soma Indra's Friend.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of wealth, we solicit that Soma, the fried of Indra, who for your welfare,Ṛbhus, brings(hither)Tvaṣṭā,Vāyu, the two divine sacrificers (the Aśvins), Dawn,Bṛhaspati, and the wise slayer of Vṛtra.
verses.griffith_verse: Tvaṣṭar and Vāyu, those who count as Ṛbhus, both celestial Hotar-priests, and Dawn for happiness, Winners of wealth, we call, and wise Bṛhaspati, destroyer of our foes, and Soma Indra's Friend.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म गामश्वं जनयंत ओषधीर्वनस्पतीन्पृथिवीं पर्वताँ अपः ।सूर्यं दिवि रोहयंतः सुदानव आर्या व्रता विसृजंतो अधि क्षमि ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhma ǀ gā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ janáyantaḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ párvatān ǀ apáḥ ǀsū́ryam ǀ diví ǀ roháyantaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ ā́ryā ǀ vratā́ ǀ vi-sṛjántaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǁ
verses.english_translation: They generated prayer, the cow, the horse, the plants, the forest trees, the earth, the waters, and the hills. These very bounteous Gods made the Sun mount to heaven, and spread the righteous laws of Āryas o’er the land.
verses.wilson_translation: genitive rating food, cows, horses, plural nts, trees, the earth, mountains and waters, elevating the sun inheaven, munificent, promoting sacred observances upon the earth, (they abide everywhere).
verses.griffith_verse: They generated prayer, the cow, the horse, the plants, the forest trees, the earth, the waters, and the hills. These very bounteous Gods made the Sun mount to heaven, and spread the righteous laws of Āryas o’er the land.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: भुज्युमंहसः पिपृथो निरश्विना श्यावं पुत्रं वध्रिमत्या अजिन्वतं ।कमद्युवं विमदायोहथुर्युवं विष्णाप्वं विश्वकायाव सृजथः ॥
verses.transliteration: bhujyúm ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ pipṛthaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ śyā́vam ǀ putrám ǀ vadhri-matyā́ḥ ǀ ajinvatam ǀkama-dyúvam ǀ vi-madā́ya ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ viṣṇāpvám ǀ víśvakāya ǀ áva ǀ sṛjathaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Aśvins, ye delivered Bhujyu from distress, ye animated Śyāva, Vadhrmati's son. To Vimada ye brought his consort Kamadyu, and gave his lost Viṣṇāpū back to Viśvaka.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Aśvins, extricated Bhujyufrom calamity, you gave to Vadhrimatīher sonŚyāva; you gave Kamadyu (as a wife) to Vimada; you restored (the lost) Viṣṇāpu to Viśvaka.
verses.griffith_verse: O Aśvins, ye delivered Bhujyu from distress, ye animated Śyāva, Vadhrmati's son. To Vimada ye brought his consort Kamadyu, and gave his lost Viṣṇāpū back to Viśvaka.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पावीरवी तन्यतुरेकपादजो दिवो धर्ता सिंधुरापः समुद्रियः ।विश्वे देवासः शृणवन्वचांसि मे सरस्वती सह धीभिः पुरंध्या ॥
verses.transliteration: pā́vīravī ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ ajáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ samudríyaḥ ǀvíśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ śṛṇavan ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ me ǀ sárasvatī ǀ sahá ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ púram-dhyā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thunder, the lightning's daughter, Aja-Ekapād, heaven's bearer, Sindhu, and the waters of the sea: Hear all the Gods my words, Sarasvatī give ear together with Purandhi and with Holy Thoughts.
verses.wilson_translation: May the armed and thundering (voice of mid-heaven), the upholder of heaven, Aja Ekapād, theocean, the waters of the firmament, the universal gods and Sarasvatī, accompanied by sacred rites, andabundant wisdom, hear my words.
verses.griffith_verse: Thunder, the lightning's daughter, Aja-Ekapād, heaven's bearer, Sindhu, and the waters of the sea: Hear all the Gods my words, Sarasvatī give ear together with Purandhi and with Holy Thoughts.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे देवाः सह धीभिः पुरंध्या मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।रातिषाचो अभिषाचः स्वर्विदः स्वर्गिरो ब्रह्म सूक्तं जुषेरत ॥
verses.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sahá ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ púram-dhyā ǀ mánoḥ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀrāti-sā́caḥ ǀ abhi-sā́caḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ su-uktám ǀ juṣerata ǁ
verses.english_translation: With Holy Thoughts and with Purandhi may all Gods, knowing the Law immortal, Manu's Holy Ones, Boon-givers, favourers, finders of light, and Heaven, with gracious love accept my songs, my prayer, my hymn.
verses.wilson_translation: May the universal gods, accompanied by sacred rites and abundant wisdom, adorable (at thesacrifice) of men, immortal, the knowers of truth, waiting on the oblation to be given, arriving together (at thesacrifice), omniscient, graciously accept all our praises and abundant food with well-sung hymns.
verses.griffith_verse: With Holy Thoughts and with Purandhi may all Gods, knowing the Law immortal, Manu's Holy Ones, Boon-givers, favourers, finders of light, and Heaven, with gracious love accept my songs, my prayer, my hymn.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववंदे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।ते नो रासंतामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: devā́n ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ vavande ǀ yé ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ pra-tasthúḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsantām ǀ uru-gāyám ǀ adyá ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Immortal Gods have I, Vasiṣṭha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings. May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: (Descendant of)Vasiṣṭha, I have glorified the immortal gods who preside over all worlds; may theythis day bestow upon us widely-famed food; do you always cherish us with blessings.
verses.griffith_verse: Immortal Gods have I, Vasiṣṭha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings. May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVI. Viśvedevas.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . I CALL the Gods of lofty glory for our weal, the makers of the light, well-skilled in sacrifice;Those who have waxen mightily, Masters of all wealth, Immortal, strengthening Law, the Gods whom Indra leads. For the strong band of Maruts will we frame a hymn: the chiefs shall bring forth sacrifice for Indra's troop,Who, sent by Indra and advised by Varuṇa, have gotten for themselves a share of Sūrya's light May Indra with the Vasus keep our dwelling safe, and Aditi with Ādityas lend us sure defence.May the God Rudra with the Rudras favour us, and Tvaṣṭar with the Dames further us to success. Aditi, Heaven and Earth, the great eternal Law, Indra, Viṣṇu, the Maruts, and the lofty Sky.We call upon Ādityas, on the Gods, for help, on Vasus, Rudras, Savitar of wondrous deeds. With Holy Thoughts Sarasvān, firm-lawed Varuṇa, great Vāyu, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, and the Aśvins Twain,Lords of all wealth, Immortal, furtherers of prayer, grant us a triply-guarding refuge from distress. Strong be the sacrifice, strong be the Holy Ones, strong the preparers of oblation, strong the Gods.Mighty be Heaven and Earth, true to eternal Law, strong be Parjanya, strong be they who laud the Strong. To win us strength I glorify the Mighty Twain, Agni and Soma, Mighty Ones whom many laud.May these vouchsafe us shelter with a triple guard, these whom the strong have served in worship of the Gods. Potent, with firm-fixt laws, arranging sacrifice, visiting solemn rites in splendour of the day,Obeying Order, these whose priest is Agni, free from falsehood, poured the waters out when Vṛtra died. The Holy Ones engendered, for their several laws, the heavens and earth, the waters, and the plants and trees.They filled the firmament with heavenly light for help: the Gods embodied Wish and made it beautiful. May they who bear up heaven, the Ṛbhus deft of hand, and Vāta and Parjanya of the thundering Bull,The waters and the plants, promote the songs we sing: come Bhaga, Rati, and the Vaijns to my call. Sindhu, the sea, the region, and the firmament, the thunder, and the ocean, Aja-Ekapād,The Dragon of the Deep, shall listen to my words, and all the Deities and Princes shall give ear. May we, be yours, we men, to entertain the Gods: further our sacrifice and give it full success.Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, givers of good gifts, quicken the holy hymns which we are singing now I follow with success upon the path of Law the two celestial Hotars, Priests of oldest time.We pray to him who dwelleth near, Guard of the Field, to all Immortal Gods who never are remiss. Vasiṣṭha's sons have raised their voices, like their sire. Ṛṣi-like praying to the Gods for happiness.Like friendly-minded kinsmen, come at our desire, O Gods, and shake down treasures on us from above. Immortal Gods have I, Vasiṣṭha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings.May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: देवान्हुवे बृहच्छ्रवसः स्वस्तये ज्योतिष्कृतो अध्वरस्य प्रचेतसः ।ये वावृधुः प्रतरं विश्ववेदस इंद्रज्येष्ठासो अमृता ऋतावृधः ॥
verses.transliteration: devā́n ǀ huve ǀ bṛhát-śravasaḥ ǀ svastáye ǀ jyotiḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀyé ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ índra-jyeṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I CALL the Gods of lofty glory for our weal, the makers of the light, well-skilled in sacrifice; Those who have waxen mightily, Masters of all wealth, Immortal, strengthening Law, the Gods whom Indra leads.
verses.wilson_translation: I invoke for the success of the sacrifice the gods, who bestow abundant food, the diffusers of light, theextremely wise who flourish mightily, abounding in all riches, having Indraas their chief, immortal, augmented bysacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: I CALL the Gods of lofty glory for our weal, the makers of the light, well-skilled in sacrifice; Those who have waxen mightily, Masters of all wealth, Immortal, strengthening Law, the Gods whom Indra leads.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रप्रसूता वरुणप्रशिष्टा ये सूर्यस्य ज्योतिषो भागमानशुः ।मरुद्गणे वृजने मन्म धीमहि माघोने यज्ञं जनयंत सूरयः ॥
verses.transliteration: índra-prasūtāḥ ǀ váruṇa-praśiṣṭāḥ ǀ yé ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ jyótiṣaḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ ānaśúḥ ǀmarút-gaṇe ǀ vṛjáne ǀ mánma ǀ dhīmahi ǀ mā́ghone ǀ yajñám ǀ janayanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: For the strong band of Maruts will we frame a hymn: the chiefs shall bring forth sacrifice for Indra's troop, Who, sent by Indra and advised by Varuṇa, have gotten for themselves a share of Sūrya's light
verses.wilson_translation: We offer praise to the company of the Maruts, the attendants upon Maghavan, who, encouraged by Indra, and instrumental ucted by Varuṇa, have acquired a portion of the light of the sun; the wise worshippers beget thesacrifice.
verses.griffith_verse: For the strong band of Maruts will we frame a hymn: the chiefs shall bring forth sacrifice for Indra's troop, Who, sent by Indra and advised by Varuṇa, have gotten for themselves a share of Sūrya's light
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो वसुभिः परि पातु नो गयमादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्देवो मृळयाति नस्त्वष्टा नो ग्नाभिः सुविताय जिन्वतु ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ naḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǀrudráḥ ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mṛḷayāti ǀ naḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ naḥ ǀ gnā́bhiḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ jinvatu ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Indra with the Vasus keep our dwelling safe, and Aditi with Ādityas lend us sure defence. May the God Rudra with the Rudras favour us, and Tvaṣṭar with the Dames further us to success.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indrawith the Vasusguard our dwelling; may Aditiwith theĀdityasgrant us felicity; may thedivine Rudrawith the Rudrasmake us happy;may Tvaṣṭāwith the wives of the gods be favourable to us forour prosperity.
verses.griffith_verse: May Indra with the Vasus keep our dwelling safe, and Aditi with Ādityas lend us sure defence. May the God Rudra with the Rudras favour us, and Tvaṣṭar with the Dames further us to success.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्द्यावापृथिवी ऋतं महदिंद्राविष्णू मरुतः स्वर्बृहत् ।देवाँ आदित्याँ अवसे हवामहे वसून्रुद्रान्त्सवितारं सुदंससं ॥
verses.transliteration: áditiḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ṛtám ǀ mahát ǀ índrāvíṣṇū íti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀdevā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǀ vásūn ǀ rudrā́n ǀ savitā́ram ǀ su-dáṃsasam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Aditi, Heaven and Earth, the great eternal Law, Indra, Viṣṇu, the Maruts, and the lofty Sky. We call upon Ādityas, on the Gods, for help, on Vasus, Rudras, Savitar of wondrous deeds.
verses.wilson_translation: Aditi, heaven and earth, the mighty Truth (Agni),Indra,Viṣṇu, the Maruts, the great sun-- (these) weinvoke for our protection, as well as the divineĀdityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and Savitā, the accomplisher ofgood works.
verses.griffith_verse: Aditi, Heaven and Earth, the great eternal Law, Indra, Viṣṇu, the Maruts, and the lofty Sky. We call upon Ādityas, on the Gods, for help, on Vasus, Rudras, Savitar of wondrous deeds.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वांधीभिर्वरुणो धृतव्रतः पूषा विष्णुर्महिमा वायुरश्विना ।ब्रह्मकृतो अमृता विश्ववेदसः शर्म नो यंसंत्रिवरूथमंहसः ॥
verses.transliteration: sárasvān ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mahimā́ ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀbrahma-kṛ́taḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ naḥ ǀ yaṃsan ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: With Holy Thoughts Sarasvān, firm-lawed Varuṇa, great Vāyu, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, and the Aśvins Twain, Lords of all wealth, Immortal, furtherers of prayer, grant us a triply-guarding refuge from distress.
verses.wilson_translation: May Sarasvatī, (endowed) with intelligences,Varuṇathe observer of oblations,Pūṣan,Viṣṇu, themighty Vāyu, the Aśvins, (may these) the bestowers of food upon worshippers, immortal, the possessors of allwealth, grant us a habitation triply-guarded from evil.
verses.griffith_verse: With Holy Thoughts Sarasvān, firm-lawed Varuṇa, great Vāyu, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, and the Aśvins Twain, Lords of all wealth, Immortal, furtherers of prayer, grant us a triply-guarding refuge from distress.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वृषा यज्ञो वृषणः संतु यज्ञिया वृषणो देवा वृषणो हविष्कृतः ।वृषणा द्यावापृथिवी ऋतावरी वृषा पर्जन्यो वृषणो वृषस्तुभः ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ santu ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀvṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ṛtávarī ítyṛtá-varī ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ vṛṣa-stúbhaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Strong be the sacrifice, strong be the Holy Ones, strong the preparers of oblation, strong the Gods. Mighty be Heaven and Earth, true to eternal Law, strong be Parjanya, strong be they who laud the Strong.
verses.wilson_translation: May our sacrifice be the showerer (of benefits); may the gods who are worthy of sacrifice be theshowerers (of benefits); may the priest, may the presenters of the oblation, be the showerers (of benefits); mayheaven and earth receiving adoration be the showerers (of benefits); may Parjanyabe the showerer (of rain);may those who praise (the gods) with showers be showerers.
verses.griffith_verse: Strong be the sacrifice, strong be the Holy Ones, strong the preparers of oblation, strong the Gods. Mighty be Heaven and Earth, true to eternal Law, strong be Parjanya, strong be they who laud the Strong.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा वृषणा वाजसातये पुरुप्रशस्ता वृषणा उप ब्रुवे ।यावीजिरे वृषणो देवयज्यया ता नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसतः ॥
verses.transliteration: agnī́ṣómā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ puru-praśastā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇau ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀyáu ǀ ījiré ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ deva-yajyáyā ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ ví ǀ yaṃsataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: To win us strength I glorify the Mighty Twain, Agni and Soma, Mighty Ones whom many laud. May these vouchsafe us shelter with a triple guard, these whom the strong have served in worship of the Gods.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify for the obtaining of food the two showerers (of benefits),Agniand Soma, the many-laudedshowerers (of benefits), may these two whom the priests have worshipped with divine worship bestow upon us atriply-guarded dwelling.
verses.griffith_verse: To win us strength I glorify the Mighty Twain, Agni and Soma, Mighty Ones whom many laud. May these vouchsafe us shelter with a triple guard, these whom the strong have served in worship of the Gods.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: धृतव्रताः क्षत्रिया यज्ञनिष्कृतो बृहद्दिवा अध्वराणामभिश्रियः ।अग्निहोतार ऋतसापो अद्रुहोऽपो असृजन्ननु वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: dhṛtá-vratāḥ ǀ kṣatríyāḥ ǀ yajñaniḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀ bṛhat-divā́ḥ ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ abhi-śríyaḥ ǀagní-hotāraḥ ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ asṛ́jan ǀ ánu ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Potent, with firm-fixt laws, arranging sacrifice, visiting solemn rites in splendour of the day, Obeying Order, these whose priest is Agni, free from falsehood, poured the waters out when Vṛtra died.
verses.wilson_translation: The (gods) observing obligations endowed with vigour, developers of sacrifice, possessed ofabundant brightness, the defenders of sacrifices, having Agnifor their priest, enjoying truth, unassailable, setfree the waters at the combat with the Vṛtra.
verses.griffith_verse: Potent, with firm-fixt laws, arranging sacrifice, visiting solemn rites in splendour of the day, Obeying Order, these whose priest is Agni, free from falsehood, poured the waters out when Vṛtra died.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: द्यावापृथिवी जनयन्नभि व्रताप ओषधीर्वनिनानि यज्ञिया ।अंतरिक्षं स्वरा पप्रुरूतये वशं देवासस्तन्वी नि मामृजुः ॥
verses.transliteration: dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ janayan ǀ abhí ǀ vratā́ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínāni ǀ yajñíyā ǀantárikṣam ǀ sváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ papruḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ váśam ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ tanví ǀ ní ǀ mamṛjuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: The Holy Ones engendered, for their several laws, the heavens and earth, the waters, and the plants and trees. They filled the firmament with heavenly light for help: the Gods embodied Wish and made it beautiful.
verses.wilson_translation: The gods engendered the heaven and earth with their respective functions, the waters, the plural nts, thesacred trees; they filled the whole firmament (with lustre) for its protection; they graced the desirable (sacrifice) intheir own person ns.
verses.griffith_verse: The Holy Ones engendered, for their several laws, the heavens and earth, the waters, and the plants and trees. They filled the firmament with heavenly light for help: the Gods embodied Wish and made it beautiful.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: धर्तारो दिव ऋभवः सुहस्ता वातापर्जन्या महिषस्य तन्यतोः ।आप ओषधीः प्र तिरंतु नो गिरो भगो रातिर्वाजिनो यंतु मे हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: dhartā́raḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ su-hástāḥ ǀ vātāparjanyā́ ǀ mahiṣásya ǀ tanyatóḥ ǀā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ prá ǀ tirantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ rātíḥ ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ me ǀ hávam ǁ
verses.english_translation: May they who bear up heaven, the Ṛbhus deft of hand, and Vāta and Parjanya of the thundering Bull, The waters and the plants, promote the songs we sing: come Bhaga, Rati, and the Vaijns to my call.
verses.wilson_translation: May the upholders of the sky, the radiant with truth, the well-armed deities,Vātaand Parjanya, (theutterers) of the mighty thunder, the waters, the plural nts, amplify our praises; may the liberal Bhagaand Vājinscome to my invocation.
verses.griffith_verse: May they who bear up heaven, the Ṛbhus deft of hand, and Vāta and Parjanya of the thundering Bull, The waters and the plants, promote the songs we sing: come Bhaga, Rati, and the Vaijns to my call.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रः सिंधू रजो अंतरिक्षमज एकपात्तनयित्नुरर्णवः ।अहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणवद्वचांसि मे विश्वे देवास उत सूरयो मम ॥
verses.transliteration: samudráḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ ajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ tanayitnúḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀáhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ śṛṇavat ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ me ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ utá ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ máma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sindhu, the sea, the region, and the firmament, the thunder, and the ocean, Aja-Ekapād, The Dragon of the Deep, shall listen to my words, and all the Deities and Princes shall give ear.
verses.wilson_translation: May the flowing Sindhu, the atmosphere, the firmament, Aja Ekapād, the rain-bearing thunder-cloud,and Ahirbudhnyahear my words; may the wise universal gods (listen to) my (praises).
verses.griffith_verse: Sindhu, the sea, the region, and the firmament, the thunder, and the ocean, Aja-Ekapād, The Dragon of the Deep, shall listen to my words, and all the Deities and Princes shall give ear.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्याम वो मनवो देववीतये प्रांचं नो यज्ञं प्र णयत साधुया ।आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुदानव इमा ब्रह्म शस्यमानानि जिन्वत ॥
verses.transliteration: syā́ma ǀ vaḥ ǀ mánavaḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ prā́ñcam ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ prá ǀ nayata ǀ sādhu-yā́ ǀā́dityāḥ ǀ rúdrāḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ sú-dānavaḥ ǀ imā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ śasyámānāni ǀ jinvata ǁ
verses.english_translation: May we, be yours, we men, to entertain the Gods: further our sacrifice and give it full success. Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, givers of good gifts, quicken the holy hymns which we are singing now
verses.wilson_translation: May we men be (diligent in providing) for your food, (O gods); conduct our ancient sacrifice to asuccessful end,Ādityas,Rudras, and genitive rous Vasus, graciously accept these hymns which are being recited.
verses.griffith_verse: May we, be yours, we men, to entertain the Gods: further our sacrifice and give it full success. Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, givers of good gifts, quicken the holy hymns which we are singing now
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा पुरोहित ऋतस्य पंथामन्वेमि साधुया ।क्षेत्रस्य पतिं प्रतिवेशमीमहे विश्वांदेवाँ अमृताँ अप्रयुच्छतः ॥
verses.transliteration: dáivyā ǀ hótārā ǀ prathamā́ ǀ puráḥ-hitā ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pánthām ǀ ánu ǀ emi ǀ sādhu-yā́ ǀkṣétrasya ǀ pátim ǀ práti-veśam ǀ īmahe ǀ víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ ápra-yucchataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: I follow with success upon the path of Law the two celestial Hotars, Priests of oldest time. We pray to him who dwelleth near, Guard of the Field, to all Immortal Gods who never are remiss.
verses.wilson_translation: I follow the two chief priests the divine offerers of burnt sacrifices, (I follow) successfully the path ofsacrifice; we solicit (wealth of) the contiguous lord of the field, and the immortal and not unheeding universaldeities.
verses.griffith_verse: I follow with success upon the path of Law the two celestial Hotars, Priests of oldest time. We pray to him who dwelleth near, Guard of the Field, to all Immortal Gods who never are remiss.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठासः पितृवद्वाचमक्रत देवाँ ईळाना ऋषिवत्स्वस्तये ।प्रीता इव ज्ञातयः काममेत्यास्मे देवासोऽव धूनुता वसु ॥
verses.transliteration: vásiṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ pitṛ-vát ǀ vā́cam ǀ akrata ǀ devā́n ǀ ī́ḷānāḥ ǀ ṛṣi-vát ǀ svastáye ǀprītā́ḥ-iva ǀ jñātáyaḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ā-ítya ǀ asmé íti ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ áva ǀ dhūnuta ǀ vásu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Vasiṣṭha's sons have raised their voices, like their sire. Ṛṣi-like praying to the Gods for happiness. Like friendly-minded kinsmen, come at our desire, O Gods, and shake down treasures on us from above.
verses.griffith_verse: Vasiṣṭha's sons have raised their voices, like their sire. Ṛṣi-like praying to the Gods for happiness. Like friendly-minded kinsmen, come at our desire, O Gods, and shake down treasures on us from above.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववंदे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।ते नो रासंतामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.transliteration: devā́n ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ vavande ǀ yé ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ pra-tasthúḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsantām ǀ uru-gāyám ǀ adyá ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Immortal Gods have I, Vasiṣṭha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings. May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.wilson_translation: (Descendant of)Vasiṣṭha, I have glorified the immortal gods who preside over all the worlds; maythey this day bestow upon us widely-famed food; do you always cherish us with blessings.
verses.griffith_verse: Immortal Gods have I, Vasiṣṭha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings. May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN LXVII. Bṛhaspati.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THIS holy hymn, sublime and sevenheaded, sprung from eternal Law, our sire discovered.Ayasya, friend of all men, hath engendered the fourth hymn as he sang his laud to Indra. Thinking aright, praising eternal Order, the sons of Dyaus the Asura, those heroes,Aṅgirases, holding the rank of sages, first honoured sacrifice's holy statute. Girt by his friends who cried with swanlike voices, bursting the stony barriers of the prison,Bṛhaspati spake in thunder to the cattle, and uttered praise and song when he had found them. Apart from one, away from two above him, he drave the kine that stood in bonds of falsehood.Bṛhaspati, seeking light amid the darkness, drave forth the bright cows: three he made apparent. When he had cleft the lairs and western castle, he cut off three from him who held the waters.Bṛhaspati discovered, while he thundered like Dyaus, the dawn, the Sun, the cow, the lightning. As with a hand, so with his roaring Indra cleft Vala through, the guardian of the cattle.Seeking the milk-draught with sweatshining comrades he stole the Paṇi's kine and left him weeping. He with bright faithful Friends, winners of booty, hath rent the milker of the cows asunder.Bṛhaspati with wild boars strong and mighty, sweating with heat, hath gained a rich possession. They, longing for the kine, with faithful spirit incited with their hymns the Lord of cattle.Bṛhaspati freed the radiant cows with comrades self-yoked, averting shame from one another. In our assembly with auspicious praises exalting him who roareth like a lion,Maywe, in every fight where heroes conquer, rejoice in strong Bṛhaspati the Victor. When he had won him every sort of booty and gone to heaven and its most lofty mansions,Men praised Bṛhaspati the Mighty, bringing the light within their mouths from sundry places. Fulfil the prayer that begs for vital vigour: aid in your wonted manner even the humble.Let all our foes be turned and driven backward. Hear this, O Heaven and Earth, ye All-producers. Indra with mighty strength cleft asunder the head of Arbuda the watery monster,Slain Ahi, and set free the Seven Rivers. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect us.

verses.sanskrit: इमां धियं सप्तशीर्ष्णीं पिता न ऋतप्रजातां बृहतीमविंदत् ।तुरीयं स्विज्जनयद्विश्वजन्योऽयास्य उक्थमिंद्राय शंसन् ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ saptá-śīrṣṇīm ǀ pitā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛtá-prajātām ǀ bṛhatī́m ǀ avindat ǀturī́yam ǀ svit ǀ janayat ǀ viśvá-janyaḥ ǀ ayā́syaḥ ǀ ukthám ǀ índrāya ǀ śáṃsan ǁ
verses.english_translation: THIS holy hymn, sublime and sevenheaded, sprung from eternal Law, our sire discovered. Ayasya, friend of all men, hath engendered the fourth hymn as he sang his laud to Indra.
verses.wilson_translation: This great seven-headed ceremony, born of truth our father (Aṅgirasa) discovered;Ayāsya, thefrined of all races, engendered the fourth (genitive ration), reciting a hymn to Indra.
verses.griffith_verse: THIS holy hymn, sublime and sevenheaded, sprung from eternal Law, our sire discovered. Ayasya, friend of all men, hath engendered the fourth hymn as he sang his laud to Indra.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ऋतं शंसंत ऋजु दीध्याना दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः ।विप्रं पदमंगिरसो दधाना यज्ञस्य धाम प्रथमं मनंत ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ śáṃsantaḥ ǀ ṛjú ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ putrā́saḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀvípram ǀ padám ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ prathamám ǀ mananta ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thinking aright, praising eternal Order, the sons of Dyaus the Asura, those heroes, Aṅgirases, holding the rank of sages, first honoured sacrifice's holy statute.
verses.wilson_translation: Reciting sincere praise, reflecting correctly, the Aṅgirasas, the pious sons of the brilliant and powerful(Agni), upholding the intelligent base, the supporter of the sacrifice, praise from the beginning.
verses.griffith_verse: Thinking aright, praising eternal Order, the sons of Dyaus the Asura, those heroes, Aṅgirases, holding the rank of sages, first honoured sacrifice's holy statute.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: हंसैरिव सखिभिर्वावदद्भिरश्मन्मयानि नहना व्यस्यन् ।बृहस्पतिरभिकनिक्रदद्गा उत प्रास्तौदुच्च विद्वाँ अगायत् ॥
verses.transliteration: haṃsáiḥ-iva ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ vā́vadat-bhiḥ ǀ aśman-máyāni ǀ náhanā ǀ vi-ásyan ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ abhi-kánikradat ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ prá ǀ astaut ǀ út ǀ ca ǀ vidvā́n ǀ agāyat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Girt by his friends who cried with swanlike voices, bursting the stony barriers of the prison, Bṛhaspati spake in thunder to the cattle, and uttered praise and song when he had found them.
verses.wilson_translation: With his friends (the Maruts) clamouring like geese, throwing open the (asuras') cattle-folds made ofstone,Bṛhaspaticalling aloud (desires to carry off) the cows; knowing all things he praises (the gods) andchants (their laudation).
verses.griffith_verse: Girt by his friends who cried with swanlike voices, bursting the stony barriers of the prison, Bṛhaspati spake in thunder to the cattle, and uttered praise and song when he had found them.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अवो द्वाभ्यां पर एकया गा गुहा तिष्ठंतीरनृतस्य सेतौ ।बृहस्पतिस्तमसि ज्योतिरिच्छन्नुदुस्रा आकर्वि हि तिस्र आवः ॥
verses.transliteration: aváḥ ǀ dvā́bhyām ǀ paráḥ ǀ ékayā ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ tíṣṭhantīḥ ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ sétau ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ támasi ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ icchán ǀ út ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ akaḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ā́varítyāvaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Apart from one, away from two above him, he drave the kine that stood in bonds of falsehood. Bṛhaspati, seeking light amid the darkness, drave forth the bright cows: three he made apparent.
verses.wilson_translation: Bṛhaspatipurposing to bring light into the darkness drove out the cows standing in the cave in theplace of darkness below by two (ways), and those above by one (way); he opened the three (doors of the
verses.griffith_verse: Apart from one, away from two above him, he drave the kine that stood in bonds of falsehood. Bṛhaspati, seeking light amid the darkness, drave forth the bright cows: three he made apparent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: विभिद्या पुरं शयथेमपाचीं निस्त्रीणि साकमुदधेरकृंतत् ।बृहस्पतिरुषसं सूर्यं गामर्कं विवेद स्तनयन्निव द्यौः ॥
verses.transliteration: vi-bhídya ǀ púram ǀ śayáthā ǀ īm ǀ ápācīm ǀ níḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ sākám ǀ uda-dhéḥ ǀ akṛntat ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ sū́ryam ǀ gā́m ǀ arkám ǀ viveda ǀ stanáyan-iva ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When he had cleft the lairs and western castle, he cut off three from him who held the waters. Bṛhaspati discovered, while he thundered like Dyaus, the dawn, the Sun, the cow, the lightning.
verses.wilson_translation: Resting near it, demolishing the western city,Bṛhaspatiwrested at once from Valathe three, thedawn, the sun, the cow; thundering like the heaven, he proclaimed the adorable (Sun).
verses.griffith_verse: When he had cleft the lairs and western castle, he cut off three from him who held the waters. Bṛhaspati discovered, while he thundered like Dyaus, the dawn, the Sun, the cow, the lightning.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इंद्रो वलं रक्षितारं दुघानां करेणेव वि चकर्ता रवेण ।स्वेदांजिभिराशिरमिच्छमानोऽरोदयत्पणिमा गा अमुष्णात् ॥
verses.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ valám ǀ rakṣitā́ram ǀ dúghānām ǀ karéṇa-iva ǀ ví ǀ cakarta ǀ ráveṇa ǀsvédāñji-bhiḥ ǀ ā-śíram ǀ icchámānaḥ ǀ árodayat ǀ paṇím ǀ ā́ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ amuṣṇāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: As with a hand, so with his roaring Indra cleft Vala through, the guardian of the cattle. Seeking the milk-draught with sweatshining comrades he stole the Paṇi's kine and left him weeping.
