verses.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ sú-bhṛtasya ǀ cākanat ǀ mádam ǀ yáḥ ǀ asya ǀ ráṃhyam ǀ cíketati ǀtvā́-vṛdhaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ dāśú-adhvaraḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ sáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ bharate ǀ dhánā ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: That man shall find delight in well-protected wealth whose care provides for him the quick-sought joyous draught. Bringing oblations, strengthened Maghavan, by thee, he swiftly wins the spoil with heroes in the fight.
verses.wilson_translation: He obtains well-procured riches, who studies to promote Indra's rapid exhilaration. Exalted by (yourfavour), OMaghavan, (the worshipper), celebrating the sacrifice, speedily obtains through the officiating priestsfood and wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: That man shall find delight in well-protected wealth whose care provides for him the quick-sought joyous draught. Bringing oblations, strengthened Maghavan, by thee, he swiftly wins the spoil with heroes in the fight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वं शर्धाय महिना गृणान उरु कृधि मघवंछग्धि रायः ।त्वं नो मित्रो वरुणो न मायी पित्वो न दस्म दयसे विभक्ता ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ śárdhāya ǀ mahinā́ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ urú ǀ kṛdhi ǀ magha-van ǀ śagdhí ǀ rāyáḥ ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ná ǀ māyī́ ǀ pitváḥ ǀ ná ǀ dasma ǀ dayase ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Now for our band, O Maghavan, when lauded, make ample room with might, and grant us riches. Magician thou, our Varuṇa and Mitra, deal food to us, O Wondrous, as Dispenser.
verses.wilson_translation: Glorified by great (praise),Maghavan, spread forth your might, bestow riches (upon us); beautiful Indra who are wise like Mitraand Varuṇathe distributer (of riches), you give us food now.
verses.griffith_verse: Now for our band, O Maghavan, when lauded, make ample room with might, and grant us riches. Magician thou, our Varuṇa and Mitra, deal food to us, O Wondrous, as Dispenser.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CXLVIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WHEN we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, and when, Most Valorous we have won the booty.Bring us prosperity, as each desires it under thine own protection may we conquer. Sublime from birth, mayst thou O Indra, Hero, with Sūrya overcome the Dāsa races.As by a fountain's side, we bring the Soma that lay concealed, close-hidden in the waters. Answer the votary's hymns, for these thou knowest, craving the Ṛṣis’ prayer, thyself a SingerMay we be they who take delight in Somas: these with sweet food for thee, O Chariot-rider. These holy prayers, O Indra, have I sung thee: grant to the men the strength of men, thou Hero.Be of one mind with those in whom thou joyest: keep thou the singers safe and their companions. Listen to Pṛthi's call, heroic Indra, and be thou lauded by the hymns of Venya,Him who hath sung thee to thine oil-rich dwelling, whose rolling songs have sped thee like a torrent.

verses.sanskrit: सुष्वाणास इंद्र स्तुमसि त्वा ससवांसश्च तुविनृम्ण वाजं ।आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य चाकंत्मना तना सनुयाम त्वोताः ॥
verses.transliteration: susvānā́saḥ ǀ indra ǀ stumási ǀ tvā ǀ sasa-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇa ǀ vā́jam ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ suvitám ǀ yásya ǀ cākán ǀ tmánā ǀ tánā ǀ sanuyāma ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: WHEN we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, and when, Most Valorous we have won the booty. Bring us prosperity, as each desires it under thine own protection may we conquer.
verses.wilson_translation: Having poured out the libation, we praise you,Indra; having presented the sacrificial food, we (praiseyou), granter of abundant wealth; bring us the wealth which one longs for; protected by you may we acquireriches through yourself alone.
verses.griffith_verse: WHEN we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, and when, Most Valorous we have won the booty. Bring us prosperity, as each desires it under thine own protection may we conquer.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ऋष्वस्त्वमिंद्र शूर जातो दासीर्विशः सूर्येण सह्याः ।गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्सु बिभृमसि प्रस्रवणे न सोमं ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣváḥ ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ jātáḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ sahyāḥ ǀgúhā ǀ hitám ǀ gúhyam ǀ gūḷhám ǀ ap-sú ǀ bibhṛmási ǀ pra-srávaṇe ǀ ná ǀ sómam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Sublime from birth, mayst thou O Indra, Hero, with Sūrya overcome the Dāsa races. As by a fountain's side, we bring the Soma that lay concealed, close-hidden in the waters.
verses.wilson_translation: Hero Indra, who are mighty, may you as soon as you are born overcome with Sūryathe races of the Dāsas, and the fugitive (Vala) lurking in secrecy, hidden in the waters; we now present to you the Somain acopious stream. your praisers; may we be of those who gratify (you) with Soma libations; to you, O car-borne indra, these(praises are offered) with sacrificial viands.
verses.griffith_verse: Sublime from birth, mayst thou O Indra, Hero, with Sūrya overcome the Dāsa races. As by a fountain's side, we bring the Soma that lay concealed, close-hidden in the waters.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अर्यो वा गिरो अभ्यर्च विद्वानृषीणां विप्रः सुमतिं चकानः ।ते स्याम ये रणयंत सोमैरेनोत तुभ्यं रथोळ्ह भक्षैः ॥
verses.transliteration: aryáḥ ǀ vā ǀ gíraḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arca ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ vípraḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ cakānáḥ ǀté ǀ syāma ǀ yé ǀ raṇáyanta ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ utá ǀ túbhyam ǀ ratha-oḷha ǀ bhakṣáiḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Answer the votary's hymns, for these thou knowest, craving the Ṛṣis’ prayer, thyself a Singer May we be they who take delight in Somas: these with sweet food for thee, O Chariot-rider.
verses.griffith_verse: Answer the votary's hymns, for these thou knowest, craving the Ṛṣis’ prayer, thyself a Singer May we be they who take delight in Somas: these with sweet food for thee, O Chariot-rider.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमा ब्रह्मेंद्र तुभ्यं शंसि दा नृभ्यो नृणां शूर शवः ।तेभिर्भव सक्रतुर्येषु चाकन्नुत त्रायस्व गृणत उत स्तीन् ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ śaṃsi ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ śūra ǀ śávaḥ ǀtébhiḥ ǀ bhava ǀ sá-kratuḥ ǀ yéṣu ǀ cākán ǀ utá ǀ trāyasva ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ utá ǀ stī́n ǁ
verses.english_translation: These holy prayers, O Indra, have I sung thee: grant to the men the strength of men, thou Hero. Be of one mind with those in whom thou joyest: keep thou the singers safe and their companions.
verses.wilson_translation: To you,Indra, have these prayers been addressed grant, O hero, strength to the leaders of men; be ofone mind with those in whom you delight, and protect those who praise you, and the worshippers who standround about.
verses.griffith_verse: These holy prayers, O Indra, have I sung thee: grant to the men the strength of men, thou Hero. Be of one mind with those in whom thou joyest: keep thou the singers safe and their companions.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवमिंद्र शूर पृथ्या उत स्तवसे वेन्यस्यार्कैः ।आ यस्ते योनिं घृतवंतमस्वारूर्मिर्न निम्नैर्द्रवयंत वक्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ pṛ́thyāḥ ǀ utá ǀ stavase ǀ venyásya ǀ arkáiḥ ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ yónim ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ ásvāḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ ná ǀ nimnáiḥ ǀ dravayanta ǀ vákvāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Listen to Pṛthi's call, heroic Indra, and be thou lauded by the hymns of Venya, Him who hath sung thee to thine oil-rich dwelling, whose rolling songs have sped thee like a torrent.
verses.wilson_translation: Hear, hero Indra, the invocation of Pṛthu; you are glorified by the praises of the son of Vena, whocelebrated your hall of sacrifice, full of ghī; your praisers rush to you like a torrent through precipitous banks.
verses.griffith_verse: Listen to Pṛthi's call, heroic Indra, and be thou lauded by the hymns of Venya, Him who hath sung thee to thine oil-rich dwelling, whose rolling songs have sped thee like a torrent.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CXLIX. Savitar.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SAVITAR fixed the earth with bands to bind it, and made heaven stedfast where no prop supported.Savitar milked, as ’twere a restless courser, air, sea bound fast to what no foot had trodden. Well knoweth Savitar, O Child of Waters, where ocean, firmly fixt, o’erflowed its limit.Thence sprang the world, from that uprose the region: thence heaven spread out and the wide earth expanded. Then, with a full crowd of Immortal Beings, this other realm came later, high and holy.First, verily, Savitar's strong-pinioned Eagle was born: and he obeys his law for ever. As warriors to their steeds, kine to their village, as fond milk giving cows approach their youngling,As man to wife, let Savitar come downward to us, heaven's bearer, Lord of every blessing. Like the Aṅgirasa Hiranvastupa, I call thee, Savitar, to this achievement:So worshipping and lauding thee for favour I watch for thee as for the stalk of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: सविता यंत्रैः पृथिवीमरम्णादस्कंभने सविता द्यामदृंहत् ।अश्वमिवाधुक्षद्धुनिमंतरिक्षमतूर्ते बद्धं सविता समुद्रं ॥
verses.transliteration: savitā́ ǀ yantráiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ aramṇāt ǀ askambhané ǀ savitā́ ǀ dyā́m ǀ adṛṃhat ǀáśvam-iva ǀ adhukṣat ǀ dhúnim ǀ antárikṣam ǀ atū́rte ǀ baddhám ǀ savitā́ ǀ samudrám ǁ
verses.english_translation: SAVITAR fixed the earth with bands to bind it, and made heaven stedfast where no prop supported. Savitar milked, as ’twere a restless courser, air, sea bound fast to what no foot had trodden.
verses.wilson_translation: Savitāhas fixed the earth with fetters; Savitā has made the heaven firm in a plural ce where there wasno support; Savitā has milked the cloud of the firmament bound to the indestructible (ether) like a tremblinghorse.
verses.griffith_verse: SAVITAR fixed the earth with bands to bind it, and made heaven stedfast where no prop supported. Savitar milked, as ’twere a restless courser, air, sea bound fast to what no foot had trodden.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यत्रा समुद्रः स्कभितो व्यौनदपां नपात्सविता तस्य वेद ।अतो भूरत आ उत्थितं रजोऽतो द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेतां ॥
verses.transliteration: yátra ǀ samudráḥ ǀ skabhitáḥ ǀ ví ǀ áunat ǀ ápām ǀ napāt ǀ savitā́ ǀ tásya ǀ veda ǀátaḥ ǀ bhū́ḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ āḥ ǀ útthitam ǀ rájaḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ aprathetām ǁ
verses.english_translation: Well knoweth Savitar, O Child of Waters, where ocean, firmly fixt, o’erflowed its limit. Thence sprang the world, from that uprose the region: thence heaven spread out and the wide earth expanded.
verses.wilson_translation: Where the cloud thus arrested shed moisture (on the earth)Savitā, O grandson of the waters, knewthat (plural ce); from thence proceeded the earth, thence arose the firmament, thence the heaven and earth werespread out.
verses.griffith_verse: Well knoweth Savitar, O Child of Waters, where ocean, firmly fixt, o’erflowed its limit. Thence sprang the world, from that uprose the region: thence heaven spread out and the wide earth expanded.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: पश्चेदमन्यदभवद्यजत्रममर्त्यस्य भुवनस्य भूना ।सुपर्णो अंग सवितुर्गरुत्मान्पूर्वो जातः स उ अस्यानु धर्म ॥
verses.transliteration: paścā́ ǀ idám ǀ anyát ǀ abhavat ǀ yájatram ǀ ámartyasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ bhūnā́ ǀsu-parṇáḥ ǀ aṅgá ǀ savitúḥ ǀ garútmān ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǁ
verses.english_translation: Then, with a full crowd of Immortal Beings, this other realm came later, high and holy. First, verily, Savitar's strong-pinioned Eagle was born: and he obeys his law for ever.
verses.wilson_translation: Afterwards arose this other adorable (deity), together with the host of the immortal world, thebrightwinged Garutmat, born before Savitāobeyed his law.
verses.griffith_verse: Then, with a full crowd of Immortal Beings, this other realm came later, high and holy. First, verily, Savitar's strong-pinioned Eagle was born: and he obeys his law for ever.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: गाव इव ग्रामं यूयुधिरिवाश्वान्वाश्रेव वत्सं सुमना दुहाना ।पतिरिव जायामभि नो न्येतु धर्ता दिवः सविता विश्ववारः ॥
verses.transliteration: gā́vaḥ-iva ǀ grā́mam ǀ yúyudhiḥ-iva ǀ áśvān ǀ vāśrā́-iva ǀ vatsám ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ dúhānā ǀpátiḥ-iva ǀ jāyā́m ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ ní ǀ etu ǀ dhartā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ viśvá-vāraḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As warriors to their steeds, kine to their village, as fond milk giving cows approach their youngling, As man to wife, let Savitar come downward to us, heaven's bearer, Lord of every blessing.
verses.wilson_translation: As cattle hasten to the village, as the warrior to his horses, as affectionate milk-giving cows to the calf,as a husband to his wife, so may Savitā, the upholder of the sky, the desired of all, hasten to us.
verses.griffith_verse: As warriors to their steeds, kine to their village, as fond milk giving cows approach their youngling, As man to wife, let Savitar come downward to us, heaven's bearer, Lord of every blessing.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यस्तूपः सवितर्यथा त्वांगिरसो जुह्वे वाजे अस्मिन् ।एवा त्वार्चन्नवसे वंदमानः सोमस्येवांशुं प्रति जागराहं ॥
verses.transliteration: híraṇya-stūpaḥ ǀ savitaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ tvā ǀ āṅgirasáḥ ǀ juhvé ǀ vā́je ǀ asmín ǀevá ǀ tvā ǀ árcan ǀ ávase ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ sómasya-iva ǀ aṃśúm ǀ práti ǀ jāgara ǀ ahám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Like the Aṅgirasa Hiranvastupa, I call thee, Savitar, to this achievement: So worshipping and lauding thee for favour I watch for thee as for the stalk of Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: As Hiraṇyastūpa, the Aṅgirasa, summoned you to this food, so I, praising you for your protection,watch before you as (worshippers) watch before the filament of the Soma.
verses.griffith_verse: Like the Aṅgirasa Hiranvastupa, I call thee, Savitar, to this achievement: So worshipping and lauding thee for favour I watch for thee as for the stalk of Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CL. Agni.
hymns.anukramani: ५ मृळीको वासिष्ठः। अग्निः। बृहती, ४-५ उपरिष्टाज्ज्योतिः, ४ जगती वा।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . THOU, bearer of oblations, though kindled, art kindled for the Gods.With the Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, come to us: to show us favour come to us. Come hither and accept with joy this sacrifice and hymn of ours.O kindled God, we mortals are invoking thee, calling on thee to show us grace. I laud thee Jātavedas, thee Lord of all blessings, with my song.Agni, bring hitherward the Gods whose Laws we love, whose laws we love, to show us grace. Agni the God was made the great High-Priest of Gods, Ṛṣis have kindled Agni, men of mortal mould.Agni I invocate for winning ample wealth. kindly disposed for winning wealth. Atri and Bharadvāja and Gavisthira, Kaṇva and Trasadasyu, in our fight he helped.On Agni calls Vasiṣṭha, even the household priest, the household priest to win his grace.

verses.sanskrit: समिद्धश्चित्समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन ।आदित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिर्न आ गहि मृळीकाय न आ गहि ॥
verses.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ cit ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havya-vāhana ǀādityáiḥ ǀ rudráiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
verses.english_translation: THOU, bearer of oblations, though kindled, art kindled for the Gods. With the Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, come to us: to show us favour come to us.
verses.wilson_translation: Bearer of oblations, being kindled you burn for the gods; come to us with theĀdityas, the Rudras, the
verses.griffith_verse: THOU, bearer of oblations, though kindled, art kindled for the Gods. With the Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, come to us: to show us favour come to us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि ।मर्तासस्त्वा समिधान हवामहे मृळीकाय हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ upa-ā́gahi ǀmártāsaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ sam-idhāna ǀ havāmahe ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
verses.english_translation: Come hither and accept with joy this sacrifice and hymn of ours. O kindled God, we mortals are invoking thee, calling on thee to show us grace.
verses.wilson_translation: Being gratified by this sacrifice, this praise, approach; we mortals invoke you, blazing (Agni), weinvoke you for felicity.
verses.griffith_verse: Come hither and accept with joy this sacrifice and hymn of ours. O kindled God, we mortals are invoking thee, calling on thee to show us grace.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वामु जातवेदसं विश्ववारं गृणे धिया ।अग्ने देवाँ आ वह नः प्रियव्रतान्मृळीकाय प्रियव्रतान् ॥
verses.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ gṛṇe ǀ dhiyā́ ǀágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ naḥ ǀ priyá-vratān ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ priyá-vratān ǁ
verses.english_translation: I laud thee Jātavedas, thee Lord of all blessings, with my song. Agni, bring hitherward the Gods whose Laws we love, whose laws we love, to show us grace.
verses.wilson_translation: I glorify with my praise you,Jātavedas, desired by akll; bring hither,Agni, to us the gods who aregratified by offerings, (bring) those gratified by offerings for our felicity. invoke Agni for the acquisition of abundant wealth, (may he make me) happy for the acquisition of wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: I laud thee Jātavedas, thee Lord of all blessings, with my song. Agni, bring hitherward the Gods whose Laws we love, whose laws we love, to show us grace.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्देवो देवानामभवत्पुरोहितोऽग्निं मनुष्या ऋषयः समीधिरे ।अग्निं महो धनसातावहं हुवे मृळीकं धनसातये ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavat ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ agním ǀ manuṣyā́ḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀagním ǀ maháḥ ǀ dhána-sātau ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ mṛḷīkám ǀ dhána-sātaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni the God was made the great High-Priest of Gods, Ṛṣis have kindled Agni, men of mortal mould. Agni I invocate for winning ample wealth. kindly disposed for winning wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni the God was made the great High-Priest of Gods, Ṛṣis have kindled Agni, men of mortal mould. Agni I invocate for winning ample wealth. kindly disposed for winning wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरत्रिं भरद्वाजं गविष्ठिरं प्रावन्नः कण्वं त्रसदस्युमाहवे ।अग्निं वसिष्ठो हवते पुरोहितो मृळीकाय पुरोहितः ॥
verses.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ átrim ǀ bharát-vājam ǀ gáviṣṭhiram ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ naḥ ǀ káṇvam ǀ trasádasyum ǀ ā-havé ǀagním ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ havate ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Atri and Bharadvāja and Gavisthira, Kaṇva and Trasadasyu, in our fight he helped. On Agni calls Vasiṣṭha, even the household priest, the household priest to win his grace.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agniprotect in war Atri,Bhāradvāja,Gaviṣṭhira, ourselves,Kaṇva, and Trasadasyu;Vasiṣṭhaas thepurohitainvokes Agni, the Purohita for our felicity.
verses.griffith_verse: Atri and Bharadvāja and Gavisthira, Kaṇva and Trasadasyu, in our fight he helped. On Agni calls Vasiṣṭha, even the household priest, the household priest to win his grace.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLI. Faith.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . By Faith is Agni kindled, through Faith is oblation offered up.We celebrate with praises Faith upon the height of happiness. Bless thou the man who gives, O Faith; Faith, bless the man who fain would give.Bless thou the liberal worshippers: bless thou the word that I have said. Even as the Deities maintained Faith in the mighty Asuras,So make this uttered wish of mine true for the liberal worshippers. Guarded by Vāyu, Gods and men who sacrifice draw near to Faith.Man winneth Faith by yearnings of the heart, and opulence by Faith. Faith in the early morning, Faith at noonday will we invocate,Faith at the setting of the Sun. O Faith, endow us with belief.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धयाग्निः समिध्यते श्रद्धया हूयते हविः ।श्रद्धां भगस्य मूर्धनि वचसा वेदयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: śraddháyā ǀ agníḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyate ǀ śraddháyā ǀ hūyate ǀ havíḥ ǀśraddhā́m ǀ bhágasya ǀ mūrdháni ǀ vácasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vedayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: By Faith is Agni kindled, through Faith is oblation offered up. We celebrate with praises Faith upon the height of happiness.
verses.wilson_translation: Agniis kindled byŚraddhā, by Śraddhā is the oblation offered; with our praise we glorify Faith, of the family of Love; cf.Nirukta9.31].
verses.griffith_verse: By Faith is Agni kindled, through Faith is oblation offered up. We celebrate with praises Faith upon the height of happiness.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्रियं श्रद्धे ददतः प्रियं श्रद्धे दिदासतः ।प्रियं भोजेषु यज्वस्विदं म उदितं कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: priyám ǀ śraddhe ǀ dádataḥ ǀ priyám ǀ śraddhe ǀ dídāsataḥ ǀpriyám ǀ bhojéṣu ǀ yájva-su ǀ idám ǀ me ǀ uditám ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Bless thou the man who gives, O Faith; Faith, bless the man who fain would give. Bless thou the liberal worshippers: bless thou the word that I have said.
verses.wilson_translation: O Śraddhā_, grant the desire of the donor (of the oblation), grant, OŚraddhā, the desire of himwho wishes to give, grant this boon which I have mentioned to my sacrificers who solicit happiness.
verses.griffith_verse: Bless thou the man who gives, O Faith; Faith, bless the man who fain would give. Bless thou the liberal worshippers: bless thou the word that I have said.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवा असुरेषु श्रद्धामुग्रेषु चक्रिरे ।एवं भोजेषु यज्वस्वस्माकमुदितं कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: yáthā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ásureṣu ǀ śraddhā́m ǀ ugréṣu ǀ cakriré ǀevám ǀ bhojéṣu ǀ yájva-su ǀ asmā́kam ǀ uditám ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Even as the Deities maintained Faith in the mighty Asuras, So make this uttered wish of mine true for the liberal worshippers.
verses.wilson_translation: As the gods had faith in (their fight with) the Asuras, so grant the boon which has been asked for toour sacrificers who solicit happiness.
verses.griffith_verse: Even as the Deities maintained Faith in the mighty Asuras, So make this uttered wish of mine true for the liberal worshippers.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धां देवा यजमाना वायुगोपा उपासते ।श्रद्धां हृदय्ययाकूत्या श्रद्धया विंदते वसु ॥
verses.transliteration: śraddhā́m ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ yájamānāḥ ǀ vāyú-gopāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ āsate ǀśraddhā́m ǀ hṛdayyáyā ǀ ā́-kūtyā ǀ śraddháyā ǀ vindate ǀ vásu ǁ
verses.english_translation: Guarded by Vāyu, Gods and men who sacrifice draw near to Faith. Man winneth Faith by yearnings of the heart, and opulence by Faith.
verses.wilson_translation: Gods, worshippers, and those who are protected by Vāyu, solicitŚraddhā, (they cherish) Śraddhāwith heartfelt desire, through Śraddhā a man acquires wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: Guarded by Vāyu, Gods and men who sacrifice draw near to Faith. Man winneth Faith by yearnings of the heart, and opulence by Faith.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धां प्रातर्हवामहे श्रद्धां मध्यंदिनं परि ।श्रद्धां सूर्यस्य निम्रुचि श्रद्धे श्रद्धापयेह नः ॥
verses.transliteration: śraddhā́m ǀ prātáḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀ śraddhā́m ǀ madhyándinam ǀ pári ǀśraddhā́m ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ni-mrúci ǀ śráddhe ǀ śrát ǀ dhāpaya ǀ ihá ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Faith in the early morning, Faith at noonday will we invocate, Faith at the setting of the Sun. O Faith, endow us with belief.
verses.wilson_translation: We invokeŚraddhāat dawn, and again at midday, and also at the setting of the sun; inspire us inthis world, Śraddhā, with faith.
verses.griffith_verse: Faith in the early morning, Faith at noonday will we invocate, Faith at the setting of the Sun. O Faith, endow us with belief.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . A MIGHTY Governor art thou, Wondrous, Destroyer of the foe,Whose friend is never done to death, and never, never overcome. Lord of the clan, who brings us bliss, Strong, Warrior, Slayer of the fiend,May India, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull who gives us peace. Drive Rākṣasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vṛtra'sjaws:O Vṛtra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us. O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us:Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury. Baffle the foeman's plan, ward off his weapon who would conquer us.Give shelter from his furious wrath, and keep his murdering dart afar.

verses.sanskrit: शास इत्था महाँ अस्यमित्रखादो अद्भुतः ।न यस्य हन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन ॥
verses.transliteration: śāsáḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ amitra-khādáḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀná ǀ yásya ǀ hanyáte ǀ sákhā ǀ ná ǀ jī́yate ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǁ
verses.english_translation: A MIGHTY Governor art thou, Wondrous, Destroyer of the foe, Whose friend is never done to death, and never, never overcome.
verses.wilson_translation: Śāsathus (praise Indra); you are mighty, the destroyer of foes, the wonderful, (he) whose friend isnot killed nor ever overpowered.
verses.griffith_verse: A MIGHTY Governor art thou, Wondrous, Destroyer of the foe, Whose friend is never done to death, and never, never overcome.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी ।वृषेंद्रः पुर एतु नः सोमपा अभयंकरः ॥
verses.transliteration: svasti-dā́ḥ ǀ viśáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ vi-mṛdháḥ ǀ vaśī́ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ índraḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ etu ǀ naḥ ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ abhayam-karáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Lord of the clan, who brings us bliss, Strong, Warrior, Slayer of the fiend, May India, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull who gives us peace.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indra, the granter of prosperity, the lord of men, the slayer of Vṛtra, the warrior, the subduer, theshowerer, the drinker of the Soma, the assurer of safety, come to our presence.
verses.griffith_verse: Lord of the clan, who brings us bliss, Strong, Warrior, Slayer of the fiend, May India, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull who gives us peace.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज ।वि मन्युमिंद्र वृत्रहन्नमित्रस्याभिदासतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǀ ví ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ hánū íti ǀ ruja ǀví ǀ manyúm ǀ indra ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ amítrasya ǀ abhi-dā́sataḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Drive Rākṣasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vṛtra'sjaws: O Vṛtra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroy,Indra, therākṣasas, the enemies; fracture the jaws of Vṛtra; baffle, indra, slayer of Vṛtra,the wrath of (our) menacing foe.
verses.griffith_verse: Drive Rākṣasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vṛtra'sjaws: O Vṛtra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: वि न इंद्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः ।यो अस्माँ अभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǀ nīcā́ ǀ yaccha ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ abhi-dā́sati ǀ ádharam ǀ gamaya ǀ támaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury.
verses.wilson_translation: Destroy,Indra, our enemies; hunt down those who are in array against us; consign to lower darknesshim who seeks to harm us.
verses.griffith_verse: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अपेंद्र द्विषतो मनोऽप जिज्यासतो वधं ।वि मन्योः शर्म यच्छ वरीयो यवया वधं ॥
verses.transliteration: ápa ǀ indra ǀ dviṣatáḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ jíjyāsataḥ ǀ vadhám ǀví ǀ manyóḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ yavaya ǀ vadhám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Baffle the foeman's plan, ward off his weapon who would conquer us. Give shelter from his furious wrath, and keep his murdering dart afar.
verses.wilson_translation: Frustrate the purpose of him who hates us, (baffle) the weapon of him who seeks to overpower us,grant us entire security from his wrath of (his) weapon.
verses.griffith_verse: Baffle the foeman's plan, ward off his weapon who would conquer us. Give shelter from his furious wrath, and keep his murdering dart afar.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLIII. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . SWAYING about, the Active Ones came nigh to Indra at his birth,And shared his great heroic might. Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra is thy birth:Thou, Mighty One, art strong indeed. Thou art the Vṛtra-slayer, thou, Indra, hast spread the firmament:Thou hast with might upheld the heavens. Thou, Indra, bearest in thine arms the lightning that accords with thee,Whetting thy thunderbolt with might. Thou, Indra, art preeminent over all creatures in thy might:Thou hast pervaded every place.

verses.sanskrit: ईंखयंतीरपस्युव इंद्रं जातमुपासते ।भेजानासः सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.transliteration: īṅkháyantīḥ ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀ índram ǀ jātám ǀ úpa ǀ āsate ǀbhejānā́saḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
verses.english_translation: SWAYING about, the Active Ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, And shared his great heroic might.
verses.wilson_translation: Desirous of fulfilling their functions (the mothers of Indra) approaching, worship him as soon as born,and enjoy (affluence) together withmaleprogeny.
verses.griffith_verse: SWAYING about, the Active Ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, And shared his great heroic might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः ।त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ bálāt ǀ ádhi ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ójasaḥ ǀtvám ǀ vṛṣan ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ít ǀ asi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra is thy birth: Thou, Mighty One, art strong indeed.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, were born from overpowering strength and energy; you, O showerer, are indeed ashowerer (of blessings).
verses.griffith_verse: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra is thy birth: Thou, Mighty One, art strong indeed.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्रासि वृत्रहा व्यंतरिक्षमतिरः ।उद्द्यामस्तभ्ना ओजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ asi ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ ví ǀ antárikṣam ǀ atiraḥ ǀút ǀ dyā́m ǀ astabhnāḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou art the Vṛtra-slayer, thou, Indra, hast spread the firmament: Thou hast with might upheld the heavens.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, are the slayer of Vṛtra, you have spread out the firmament; you have upheld the heavenby your power.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou art the Vṛtra-slayer, thou, Indra, hast spread the firmament: Thou hast with might upheld the heavens.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्र सजोषसमर्कं बिभर्षि बाह्वोः ।वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ sa-jóṣasam ǀ arkám ǀ bibharṣi ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀvájram ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, Indra, bearest in thine arms the lightning that accords with thee, Whetting thy thunderbolt with might.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, bear your well-beloved and adorable thunderbolt in your arms, sharpening it with yourmight.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, Indra, bearest in thine arms the lightning that accords with thee, Whetting thy thunderbolt with might.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिंद्राभिभूरसि विश्वा जातान्योजसा ।स विश्वा भुव आभवः ॥
verses.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ abhi-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ ójasā ǀsáḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abhavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, Indra, art preeminent over all creatures in thy might: Thou hast pervaded every place.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Indra, overpower all beings by your might, you have reached all worlds.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, Indra, art preeminent over all creatures in thy might: Thou hast pervaded every place.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLIV. New Life.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FOR some is Soma purified, some sit by sacrificial oil:To those for whom the meath flows forth, even to those let him depart. Invincible through Fervour, those whom Fervour hath advanced to heaven,Who showed great Fervour in their lives, -even to those let him depart. The heroes who contend in war and boldly cast their lives away,Or who give guerdon thousandfold, -even to those let him depart. Yea, the first followers of Law, Law's pure and holy strengtheners,The Fathers, Yama! Fervour-moved,even to those let him depart. Skilled in a thousand ways and means, the sages who protect the Sun,The Ṛṣis, Yama! Fervour-moved,—even to those let him depart.

verses.sanskrit: सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घृतमेक उपासते ।येभ्यो मधु प्रधावति तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ ékebhyaḥ ǀ pavate ǀ ghṛtám ǀ éke ǀ úpa ǀ āsate ǀyébhyaḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ pra-dhā́vati ǀ tā́n ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ ápi ǀ gacchatāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: FOR some is Soma purified, some sit by sacrificial oil: To those for whom the meath flows forth, even to those let him depart.
verses.wilson_translation: Somais filtered for some (of the Pitrṣ), others accept clarified butter; go (O dead one) to those towhom the honey flows.
verses.griffith_verse: FOR some is Soma purified, some sit by sacrificial oil: To those for whom the meath flows forth, even to those let him depart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तपसा ये अनाधृष्यास्तपसा ये स्वर्ययुः ।तपो ये चक्रिरे महस्तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.transliteration: tápasā ǀ yé ǀ anādhṛṣyā́ḥ ǀ tápasā ǀ yé ǀ sváḥ ǀ yayúḥ ǀtápaḥ ǀ yé ǀ cakriré ǀ máhaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ ápi ǀ gacchatāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Invincible through Fervour, those whom Fervour hath advanced to heaven, Who showed great Fervour in their lives, -even to those let him depart.
verses.wilson_translation: To those who through penance are unassailable (by sin), to those who through penance have gone toheaven, to those who have performed abundant penance, do you (O dead one) go.
verses.griffith_verse: Invincible through Fervour, those whom Fervour hath advanced to heaven, Who showed great Fervour in their lives, -even to those let him depart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ये युध्यंते प्रधनेषु शूरासो ये तनूत्यजः ।ये वा सहस्रदक्षिणास्तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ yúdhyante ǀ pra-dháneṣu ǀ śū́rāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ tanū-tyájaḥ ǀyé ǀ vā ǀ sahásra-dakṣiṇāḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ ápi ǀ gacchatāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: The heroes who contend in war and boldly cast their lives away, Or who give guerdon thousandfold, -even to those let him depart.
verses.wilson_translation: To those who engage in battles, heroes who have given up their lives, or who have presentedthousands of offerings, to them (O dead one) go.
verses.griffith_verse: The heroes who contend in war and boldly cast their lives away, Or who give guerdon thousandfold, -even to those let him depart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ये चित्पूर्व ऋतसाप ऋतावान ऋतावृधः ।पितॄंतपस्वतो यम तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.transliteration: yé ǀ cit ǀ pū́rve ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀpitṝ́n ǀ tápasvataḥ ǀ yama ǀ tā́n ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ ápi ǀ gacchatāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yea, the first followers of Law, Law's pure and holy strengtheners, The Fathers, Yama! Fervour-moved,even to those let him depart.
verses.wilson_translation: Go,Yama, to those ascetic Pitaras, who are ancient, obsevers of truth, speakers of truth, andaugmenters of truth.
verses.griffith_verse: Yea, the first followers of Law, Law's pure and holy strengtheners, The Fathers, Yama! Fervour-moved,even to those let him depart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रणीथाः कवयो ये गोपायंति सूर्यं ।ऋषींतपस्वतो यम तपोजाँ अपि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.transliteration: sahásra-nīthāḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ gopāyánti ǀ sū́ryam ǀṛ́ṣīn ǀ tápasvataḥ ǀ yama ǀ tapaḥ-jā́n ǀ ápi ǀ gacchatāt ǁ
verses.english_translation: Skilled in a thousand ways and means, the sages who protect the Sun, The Ṛṣis, Yama! Fervour-moved,—even to those let him depart.
verses.wilson_translation: Go,Yama, to those ascetic Ṛṣis, the sons of penance, who protect the sun, being leaders ofthousands, and intelligent.
verses.griffith_verse: Skilled in a thousand ways and means, the sages who protect the Sun, The Ṛṣis, Yama! Fervour-moved,—even to those let him depart.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLV. Various.
hymns.anukramani: ५ शिरिम्बिठो भारद्वाजः। अलक्ष्मीघ्नम् , २-३ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः, ५ विश्वेदेवाः। अनुष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . ARAYI, one-eyed limping hag, fly, ever-screeching, to the hill.We frighten thee away with these, the heroes of Sirimbitha. Scared from this place and that is she, destroyer of each germ unborn.Go, sharp-horned Brāhmaṇaspti and drive Arayi far away. Yon log that floats without a man to guide it on the river's edge,—Seize it, thou thing with hideous jaws, and go thou far away thereon. When, foul with secret stain and spot, ye hastened onward to the breast,All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam. These men have led about the cow, have duly carried Agni round,And raised their glory tg the Gods. Who will attack them with success?

verses.sanskrit: अरायि काणे विकटे गिरिं गच्छ सदान्वे ।शिरिंबिठस्य सत्वभिस्तेभिष्ट्वा चातयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: árāyi ǀ kā́ṇe ǀ ví-kaṭe ǀ girím ǀ gaccha ǀ sadānve ǀśirímbiṭhasya ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ cātayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: ARAYI, one-eyed limping hag, fly, ever-screeching, to the hill. We frighten thee away with these, the heroes of Sirimbitha.
verses.wilson_translation: Miserable, ill-favoured, deformed, ever-railing (goddess), go to your mountain; with these exploits ofŚirimbiṭha we scare you away.
verses.griffith_verse: ARAYI, one-eyed limping hag, fly, ever-screeching, to the hill. We frighten thee away with these, the heroes of Sirimbitha.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: चत्तो इतश्चत्तामुतः सर्वा भ्रूणान्यारुषी ।अराय्यं ब्रह्मणस्पते तीक्ष्णशृण्गोदृषन्निहि ॥
verses.transliteration: cattó íti ǀ itáḥ ǀ cattā́ ǀ amútaḥ ǀ sárvā ǀ bhrūṇā́ni ǀ ārúṣī ǀarāyyám ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ tī́kṣṇa-śṛṅga ǀ ut-ṛṣán ǀ ihi ǁ
verses.english_translation: Scared from this place and that is she, destroyer of each germ unborn. Go, sharp-horned Brāhmaṇaspti and drive Arayi far away.
verses.wilson_translation: May she be scared away from this (world), scared away from the next (world), the destructress ofembryos; sharp-horned Bṛhaspatiapproach, driving away distress.
verses.griffith_verse: Scared from this place and that is she, destroyer of each germ unborn. Go, sharp-horned Brāhmaṇaspti and drive Arayi far away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अदो यद्दारु प्लवते सिंधोः पारे अपूरुषं ।तदा रभस्व दुर्हणो तेन गच्छ परस्तरं ॥
verses.transliteration: adáḥ ǀ yát ǀ dā́ru ǀ plávate ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ pāré ǀ apuruṣám ǀtát ǀ ā́ ǀ rabhasva ǀ durhano íti duḥ-hano ǀ téna ǀ gaccha ǀ paraḥ-tarám ǁ
verses.english_translation: Yon log that floats without a man to guide it on the river's edge,— Seize it, thou thing with hideous jaws, and go thou far away thereon.
verses.wilson_translation: The wood which floats be the sea-shore far off, remote from man, seize that, (O goddess), hard todestroy, and therewith go to a distant shore.
verses.griffith_verse: Yon log that floats without a man to guide it on the river's edge,— Seize it, thou thing with hideous jaws, and go thou far away thereon.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यद्ध प्राचीरजगंतोरो मंडूरधाणिकीः ।हता इंद्रस्य शत्रवः सर्वे बुद्बुदयाशवः ॥
verses.transliteration: yát ǀ ha ǀ prā́cīḥ ǀ ájaganta ǀ úraḥ ǀ maṇḍūra-dhāṇikīḥ ǀhatā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ śátravaḥ ǀ sárve ǀ budbudá-yāśavaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: When, foul with secret stain and spot, ye hastened onward to the breast, All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam.
verses.wilson_translation: Utterers of discordant sounds, when swiftly moving you departed, all the enemies of Indrawere slain,disappearing like bubbles.
verses.griffith_verse: When, foul with secret stain and spot, ye hastened onward to the breast, All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: परीमे गामनेषत पर्यग्निमहृषत ।देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमाँ आ दधर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: pári ǀ imé ǀ gā́m ǀ aneṣata ǀ pári �� agním ǀ ahṛṣata ǀdevéṣu ǀ akrata ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ imā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣati ǁ
verses.english_translation: These men have led about the cow, have duly carried Agni round, And raised their glory tg the Gods. Who will attack them with success?
verses.wilson_translation: These (Viśvedevās) have brought back the (stolen) cattle; they have built up the fire; they haveprovided food for the gods. Who will overcome them?
verses.griffith_verse: These men have led about the cow, have duly carried Agni round, And raised their glory tg the Gods. Who will attack them with success?
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLVI. Agni.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . LET songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race,And we will win each prize through him. Agni the dart whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,—That send us for the gain of wealth. O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine:Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel. O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, Eternal Star, to mount the sky,Bestowing light on living men. Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine:Watch for the singer, give him life.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं हिन्वंतु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु ।तेन जेष्म धनंधनं ॥
verses.transliteration: agním ǀ hinvantu ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ sáptim ǀ āśúm-iva ǀ ājíṣu ǀténa ǀ jeṣma ǀ dhánam-dhanam ǁ
verses.english_translation: LET songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race, And we will win each prize through him.
verses.wilson_translation: May our rites bring Agnihere like a swift charger in battle, may we through him acquire all wealth.
verses.griffith_verse: LET songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race, And we will win each prize through him.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यया गा आकरामहे सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या ।तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: yáyā ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ā-kárāmahe ǀ sénayā ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ ūtyā́ ǀtā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ hinva ǀ magháttaye ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni the dart whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,— That send us for the gain of wealth.
verses.wilson_translation: Send us,Agni, for the acquisition of wealth, that army with which we may acquire cattle through yourprotection
verses.griffith_verse: Agni the dart whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,— That send us for the gain of wealth.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आग्ने स्थूरं रयिं भर पृथुं गोमंतमश्विनं ।अंग्धि खं वर्तया पणिं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agne ǀ sthūrám ǀ rayím ǀ bhara ǀ pṛthúm ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀaṅgdhí ǀ khám ǀ vartáya ǀ paṇím ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine: Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel.
verses.wilson_translation: Bring us,Agni, substantial and extensive wealth, consisting of cattle and horses, sprinkle the sky (withrain), expel Paṇi.
verses.griffith_verse: O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine: Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ।दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ nákṣatram ǀ ajáram ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ rohayaḥ ǀ diví ǀdádhat ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ jánebhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, Eternal Star, to mount the sky, Bestowing light on living men.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, have elevated the imperishable plural net, the Sun, in the firmament, giving light to the people.
verses.griffith_verse: O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, Eternal Star, to mount the sky, Bestowing light on living men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् ।बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ágne ǀ ketúḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ asi ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ upastha-sát ǀbódha ǀ stotré ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dádhat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine: Watch for the singer, give him life.
verses.wilson_translation: You,Agni, are the best beloved and most excellent banner of the people; understand (our praise)giving food to the praiser.
verses.griffith_verse: Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine: Watch for the singer, give him life.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLVII. Viśvedevas.
hymns.anukramani: ५ भुवन आप्त्यः, साधनो वा भौवनः।विश्वेदेवाः। द्विपदा त्रिष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . WE will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection. Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspr. let Indra form together with Ādityas. With the Ādityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be Protector of our bodies. As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature, Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead.

verses.sanskrit: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेंद्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: imā́ ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ bhúvanā ǀ sīsadhāma ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśve ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: WE will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection.
verses.wilson_translation: May we, along with Indraand the universal gods, possess all these worlds.
verses.griffith_verse: WE will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिंद्रः सह चीकॢपाति ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñám ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ ca ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ca ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sahá ǀ cīkḽpāti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspr. let Indra form together with Ādityas.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indrawith theĀdityasperfect our sacrifice and our bodies and our offspring.
verses.griffith_verse: Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspr. let Indra form together with Ādityas.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यैरिंद्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्माकं भूत्वविता तनूनां ॥
verses.transliteration: ādityáiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sá-gaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ bhūtu ǀ avitā́ ǀ tanū́nām ǁ
verses.english_translation: With the Ādityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be Protector of our bodies.
verses.wilson_translation: May Indrawith theĀdityas, and attended by the Maruts, be the protector of our bodies.
verses.griffith_verse: With the Ādityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be Protector of our bodies.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: हत्वाय देवा असुरान्यदायंदेवा देवत्वमभिरक्षमाणाः ॥
verses.transliteration: hatvā́ya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ásurān ǀ yát ǀ ā́yan ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ deva-tvám ǀ abhi-rákṣamāṇāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature,
verses.wilson_translation: When the gods returned (home), after slaying theasuras, (then were) the deities protecting theirdivinity.
verses.griffith_verse: As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature,
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यंचमर्कमनयंछचीभिरादित्स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration: pratyáñcam ǀ arkám ǀ anayan ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ svadhā́m ǀ iṣirā́m ǀ pári ǀ apaśyan ǁ
verses.english_translation: Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead.
verses.wilson_translation: When (the worshippers) with their pious acts offered praise in honour (of the gods), then (men) beheldaround them the swift descending rain.
verses.griffith_verse: Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLVIII. Sūrya.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY Sūrya guard us out of heaven, and Vāta from the firmament,And Agni from terrestrial spots. Thou Savitar whose flame deserves hundred libations, be thou pleased:From failing lightning keep us safe. May Savitar the God, and may Parvata also give us sight;May the Creator give us sight. Give sight unto our eye, give thou our bodies sight that they may see:May we survey, discern this world. Thus, Sūrya, may we look on thee, on thee most lovely to behold,See clearly with the eyes of men.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यो नो दिवस्पातु वातो अंतरिक्षात् ।अग्निर्नः पार्थिवेभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: sū́ryaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pātu ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀagníḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pā́rthivebhyaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: MAY Sūrya guard us out of heaven, and Vāta from the firmament, And Agni from terrestrial spots.
verses.wilson_translation: May Sūryaprotect us from (foes dwelling in) heaven,Vāyufrom (those dwelling in) the firmament,and Agnifrom those upon earth.
verses.griffith_verse: MAY Sūrya guard us out of heaven, and Vāta from the firmament, And Agni from terrestrial spots.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: जोषा सवितर्यस्य ते हरः शतं सवाँ अर्हति ।पाहि नो दिद्युतः पतंत्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: jóṣa ǀ savitaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ háraḥ ǀ śatám ǀ savā́n ǀ árhati ǀpāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ didyútaḥ ǀ pátantyāḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thou Savitar whose flame deserves hundred libations, be thou pleased: From failing lightning keep us safe.
verses.wilson_translation: Savitā, whose radiance merits a hundred acknowledgments, be propitiated (by our praises); protectus from the falling bolts (of our enemies).
verses.griffith_verse: Thou Savitar whose flame deserves hundred libations, be thou pleased: From failing lightning keep us safe.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः ।चक्षुर्धाता दधातु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: cákṣuḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ utá ǀ párvataḥ ǀcákṣuḥ ǀ dhātā́ ǀ dadhātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: May Savitar the God, and may Parvata also give us sight; May the Creator give us sight.
verses.wilson_translation: May the divine Savitāgrant us sight, may Parvata(grant) us sight; may Dhātā(grant) us sight.
verses.griffith_verse: May Savitar the God, and may Parvata also give us sight; May the Creator give us sight.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुर्नो धेहि चक्षुषे चक्षुर्विख्यै तनूभ्यः ।सं चेदं वि च पश्येम ॥
verses.transliteration: cákṣuḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ cákṣuṣe ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ vi-khyái ǀ tanū́bhyaḥ ǀsám ǀ ca ǀ idám ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ paśyema ǁ
verses.english_translation: Give sight unto our eye, give thou our bodies sight that they may see: May we survey, discern this world.
verses.wilson_translation: Give sight,Sūrya, to our eyes, (bestow) sight for the illumination of our bodies, so that we may lookupon and into this (world).
verses.griffith_verse: Give sight unto our eye, give thou our bodies sight that they may see: May we survey, discern this world.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं प्रति पश्येम सूर्य ।वि पश्येम नृचक्षसः ॥
verses.transliteration: su-sandṛ́śam ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ práti ǀ paśyema ǀ sūrya ǀví ǀ paśyema ǀ nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thus, Sūrya, may we look on thee, on thee most lovely to behold, See clearly with the eyes of men.
verses.wilson_translation: May we look upon you,Sūrya, the bright beholder (of all), may we look into the things which arevisible to mankind.
verses.griffith_verse: Thus, Sūrya, may we look on thee, on thee most lovely to behold, See clearly with the eyes of men.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLIX. Saci Paulomi.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . YON Sun hath mounted up, and this my happy fate hate mounted high.I knowing this, as conqueror have won my husband for mine own. I am the banner and the head, a mighty arbitress am I:I am victorious, and my Lord shall be submissive to my will. My Sons are slayers of the foe, my Daughter is a ruling Queen:I am victorious: o’er my Lord my song of triumph is supreme. Oblation, that which Indra gave and thus grew glorious and most high,—This have I offered, O ye Gods, and rid me of each rival wife. Destroyer of the rival wife, Sole Spouse, victorious, conqueror,The others' glory have I seized as ’twere the wealth of weaker Dames. I have subdued as conqueror these rivals, these my fellow-wives,That I may hold imperial sway over this Hero and the folk.

verses.sanskrit: उदसौ सूर्यो अगादुदयं मामको भगः ।अहं तद्विद्वला पतिमभ्यसाक्षि विषासहिः ॥
verses.transliteration: út ǀ asáu ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ agāt ǀ út ǀ ayám ǀ māmakáḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀahám ǀ tát ǀ vidvalā́ ǀ pátim ǀ abhí ǀ asākṣi ǀ vi-sasahíḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: YON Sun hath mounted up, and this my happy fate hate mounted high. I knowing this, as conqueror have won my husband for mine own.
verses.wilson_translation: The sun has risen; my good fortune has dawned; I, knowing this, have obtained my husbandtriumphing (over my rivals).
verses.griffith_verse: YON Sun hath mounted up, and this my happy fate hate mounted high. I knowing this, as conqueror have won my husband for mine own.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अहं केतुरहं मूर्धाहमुग्रा विवाचनी ।ममेदनु क्रतुं पतिः सेहानाया उपाचरेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ahám ǀ ketúḥ ǀ ahám ǀ mūrdhā́ ǀ ahám ǀ ugrā́ ǀ vi-vā́canī ǀmáma ǀ ít ǀ ánu ǀ krátum ǀ pátiḥ ǀ sehānā́yāḥ ǀ upa-ā́caret ǁ
verses.english_translation: I am the banner and the head, a mighty arbitress am I: I am victorious, and my Lord shall be submissive to my will.
verses.wilson_translation: I am the banner, I am the head, I am exalted, soothing (my lord); my husband must conform to my will,as I am victorious over my rivals.
verses.griffith_verse: I am the banner and the head, a mighty arbitress am I: I am victorious, and my Lord shall be submissive to my will.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मम पुत्राः शत्रुहणोऽथो मे दुहिता विराट् ।उताहमस्मि संजया पत्यौ मे श्लोक उत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration: máma ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ śatru-hánaḥ ǀ átho íti ǀ me ǀ duhitā́ ǀ virā́ṭ ǀutá ǀ ahám ǀ asmi ǀ sam-jayā́ ǀ pátyau ǀ me ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ ut-tamáḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: My Sons are slayers of the foe, my Daughter is a ruling Queen: I am victorious: o’er my Lord my song of triumph is supreme.
verses.wilson_translation: My sons are the destroyers of my enemies, my daughter is an empress; and I am victorious, my fameis most precious to my husband.
verses.griffith_verse: My Sons are slayers of the foe, my Daughter is a ruling Queen: I am victorious: o’er my Lord my song of triumph is supreme.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: येनेंद्रो हविषा कृत्व्यभवद्द्युम्न्युत्तमः ।इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्ना किलाभुवं ॥
verses.transliteration: yéna ǀ índraḥ ǀ havíṣā ǀ kṛtvī́ ǀ ábhavat ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ ut-tamáḥ ǀidám ǀ tát ǀ akri ǀ devāḥ ǀ asapatnā́ ǀ kíla ǀ abhuvam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Oblation, that which Indra gave and thus grew glorious and most high,— This have I offered, O ye Gods, and rid me of each rival wife.
verses.wilson_translation: That oblation, O gods, has been offered by which Indraoffering it has become renowned and mostpowerful; I freed myself from my rival wives.
verses.griffith_verse: Oblation, that which Indra gave and thus grew glorious and most high,— This have I offered, O ye Gods, and rid me of each rival wife.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: असपत्ना सपत्नघ्नी जयंत्यभिभूवरी ।आवृक्षमन्यासां वर्चो राधो अस्थेयसामिव ॥
verses.transliteration: asapatnā́ ǀ sapatna-ghnī́ ǀ jáyantī ǀ abhi-bhū́varī ǀā́ ǀ avṛkṣam ǀ anyā́sām ǀ várcaḥ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ ástheyasām-iva ǁ
verses.english_translation: Destroyer of the rival wife, Sole Spouse, victorious, conqueror, The others' glory have I seized as ’twere the wealth of weaker Dames.
verses.wilson_translation: Free from rivals, the destructress of rivals, victorious, triumphant, I cut up the brilliance and wealth ofthe other (wives of Indra) as if it were the wealth of (enemies) who do not endure long.
verses.griffith_verse: Destroyer of the rival wife, Sole Spouse, victorious, conqueror, The others' glory have I seized as ’twere the wealth of weaker Dames.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: समजैषमिमा अहं सपत्नीरभिभूवरी ।यथाहमस्य वीरस्य विराजानि जनस्य च ॥
verses.transliteration: sám ǀ ajaiṣam ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ahám ǀ sa-pátnīḥ ǀ abhi-bhū́varī ǀyáthā ǀ ahám ǀ asyá ǀ vīrásya ǀ vi-rā́jāni ǀ jánasya ǀ ca ǁ
verses.english_translation: I have subdued as conqueror these rivals, these my fellow-wives, That I may hold imperial sway over this Hero and the folk.
verses.wilson_translation: Triumphant, I conquered these my rivals so that I might rule this hero and his people.
verses.griffith_verse: I have subdued as conqueror these rivals, these my fellow-wives, That I may hold imperial sway over this Hero and the folk.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLX. Indra.
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . TASTE this strong draught enriched with offered viands: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy Coursers.Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra: these juices shed for thee are ready. Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee.O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all and drink the Soma. Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,—Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous. He looks with Ioving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma.Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion. We call on thee to come to us, desirous of goods and spoil, of cattle, and of horses.For thy new love and favour are we present: let us invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.

verses.sanskrit: तीव्रस्याभिवयसो अस्य पाहि सर्वरथा वि हरी इह मुंच ।इंद्र मा त्वा यजमानासो अन्ये नि रीरमंतुभ्यमिमे सुतासः ॥
verses.transliteration: tīvrásya ǀ abhí-vayasaḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pāhi ǀ sarva-rathā́ ǀ ví ǀ hárī íti ǀ ihá ǀ muñca ǀíndra ǀ mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ yájamānāsaḥ ǀ anyé ǀ ní ǀ rīraman ǀ túbhyam ǀ imé ǀ sutā́saḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: TASTE this strong draught enriched with offered viands: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy Coursers. Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra: these juices shed for thee are ready.
verses.wilson_translation: Drink,Indra, of this sharp (Soma, which is) combined with sacrificial food, unyoke here your bay
verses.griffith_verse: TASTE this strong draught enriched with offered viands: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy Coursers. Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra: these juices shed for thee are ready.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं सुतास्तुभ्यमु सोत्वासस्त्वां गिरः श्वात्र्या आ ह्वयंति ।इंद्रेदमद्य सवनं जुषाणो विश्वस्य विद्वाँ इह पाहि सोमं ॥
verses.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sótvāsaḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śvā́tryāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hvayanti ǀíndra ǀ idám ǀ adyá ǀ sávanam ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ihá ǀ pāhi ǀ sómam ǁ
verses.english_translation: Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee. O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all and drink the Soma.
verses.wilson_translation: For you are the libations that have been poured out, for you are those which are to be poured out; youdo our quickly uttered praises invoke;Indra, who are cognizant of all things, taking plural asure in this presentsacrifice, drink the Somahere.
verses.griffith_verse: Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee. O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all and drink the Soma.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: य उशता मनसा सोममस्मै सर्वहृदा देवकामः सुनोति ।न गा इंद्रस्तस्य परा ददाति प्रशस्तमिच्चारुमस्मै कृणोति ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ uśatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ sómam ǀ asmai ǀ sarva-hṛdā́ ǀ devá-kāmaḥ ǀ sunóti ǀná ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ tásya ǀ párā ǀ dadāti ǀ pra-śastám ǀ ít ǀ cā́rum ǀ asmai ǀ kṛṇoti ǁ
verses.english_translation: Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,— Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous.
verses.wilson_translation: He who devoted to the deity with a willing mind offers the Somato him with all his heart,Indra, doesnot destroy his cattloe, but gives him beautiful excellent (wealth).
verses.griffith_verse: Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,— Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अनुस्पष्टो भवत्येषो अस्य यो अस्मै रेवान्न सुनोति सोमं ।निररत्नौ मघवा तं दधाति ब्रह्मद्विषो हंत्यनानुदिष्टः ॥
verses.transliteration: ánu-spaṣṭaḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ asya ǀ yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ revā́n ǀ ná ǀ sunóti ǀ sómam ǀníḥ ǀ aratnáu ǀ maghá-vā ǀ tám ǀ dadhāti ǀ brahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ hanti ǀ ánanu-diṣṭaḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: He looks with Ioving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma. Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion.
verses.wilson_translation: He is mindful of him who, as a rich man, offers Somato him; possessed of riches (Indra) holds him inhishand, and unsolicited destroys (his enemies) who hate the Brāhmaṇa.
verses.griffith_verse: He looks with Ioving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma. Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अश्वायंतो गव्यंतो वाजयंतो हवामहे त्वोपगंतवा उ ।आभूषंतस्ते सुमतौ नवायां वयमिंद्र त्वा शुनं हुवेम ॥
verses.transliteration: aśva-yántaḥ ǀ gavyántaḥ ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀ hávāmahe ǀ tvā ǀ úpa-gantavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀā-bhū́ṣantaḥ ǀ te ǀ su-matáu ǀ návāyām ǀ vayám ǀ indra ǀ tvā ǀ śunám ǀ huvema ǁ
verses.english_translation: We call on thee to come to us, desirous of goods and spoil, of cattle, and of horses. For thy new love and favour are we present: let us invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.
verses.wilson_translation: Wishing for horses, for cattle, for food, we invoke you,Indra, that you may come; abiding within yournew favour we invoke you, Indra, the giver of happiness.
verses.griffith_verse: We call on thee to come to us, desirous of goods and spoil, of cattle, and of horses. For thy new love and favour are we present: let us invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLXI. Indra.
hymns.anukramani: ५ प्राजापत्यो यक्ष्मनाशनः।इन्द्राग्नी, राजयक्ष्मघ्नं वा। त्रिष्टुप् , ५ अनुष्टुप्।
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FOR life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from Consumption;Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni. Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already,Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns. With hundred-eyed oblation, hundred-autumned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him,That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune. Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters.Through hundred-lived oblation Indra, Agni, Bṛhaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred! So have I found and rescued thee thou hast returned with youth renewed.Whole in thy members! I have found thy sight and all thy life for thee.

verses.sanskrit: मुंचामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुत राजयक्ष्मात् ।ग्राहिर्जग्राह यदि वैतदेनं तस्या इंद्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तमेनं ॥
verses.transliteration: muñcā́mi ǀ tvā ǀ havíṣā ǀ jī́vanāya ǀ kám ǀ ajñāta-yakṣmā́t ǀ utá ǀ rāja-yakṣmā́t ǀgrā́hiḥ ǀ jagrā́ha ǀ yádi ǀ vā ǀ etát ǀ enam ǀ tásyāḥ ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ prá ǀ mumuktam ǀ enam ǁ
verses.english_translation: FOR life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from Consumption; Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni.
verses.wilson_translation: By means of the oblation I set you free to live safe from undeveloped consumption and from royalonsumption; and if the seizer has already seized him, then to you,Indra, and Agni, set him free.
verses.griffith_verse: FOR life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from Consumption; Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यदि क्षितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योरंतिकं नीत एव ।तमा हरामि निर्ऋतेरुपस्थादस्पार्षमेनं शतशारदाय ॥
verses.transliteration: yádi ǀ kṣitá-āyuḥ ǀ yádi ǀ vā ǀ párā-itaḥ ǀ yádi ǀ mṛtyóḥ ǀ antikám ǀ ní-itaḥ ǀ evá ǀtám ǀ ā́ ǀ harāmi ǀ níḥ-ṛteḥ ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ áspārṣam ǀ enam ǀ śatá-śāradāya ǁ
verses.english_translation: Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already, Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.
verses.griffith_verse: Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already, Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राक्षेण शतशारदेन शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनं ।शतं यथेमं शरदो नयातींद्रो विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारं ॥
verses.transliteration: sahasra-akṣéṇa ǀ śatá-śāradena ǀ śatá-āyuṣā ǀ havíṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ ahārṣam ǀ enam ǀśatám ǀ yáthā ǀ imám ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ náyāti ǀ índraḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ duḥ-itásya ǀ pārám ǁ
verses.english_translation: With hundred-eyed oblation, hundred-autumned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him, That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.
verses.griffith_verse: With hundred-eyed oblation, hundred-autumned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him, That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमंतांछतमु वसंतान् ।शतमिंद्राग्नी सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषेमं पुनर्दुः ॥
verses.transliteration: śatám ǀ jīva ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ várdhamānaḥ ǀ śatám ǀ hemantā́n ǀ śatám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vasantā́n ǀśatám ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ savitā́ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ śatá-āyuṣā ǀ havíṣā ǀ imám ǀ púnaḥ ǀ duḥ ǁ
verses.english_translation: Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters. Through hundred-lived oblation Indra, Agni, Bṛhaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred!
verses.griffith_verse: Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters. Through hundred-lived oblation Indra, Agni, Bṛhaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred!
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आहार्षं त्वाविदं त्वा पुनरागाः पुनर्नव ।सर्वांग सर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वमायुश्च तेऽविदं ॥
verses.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ahārṣam ǀ tvā ǀ ávidam ǀ tvā ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāḥ ǀ punaḥ-nava ǀsárva-aṅga ǀ sárvam ǀ te ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ sárvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ca ǀ te ǀ avidam ǁ
verses.english_translation: So have I found and rescued thee thou hast returned with youth renewed. Whole in thy members! I have found thy sight and all thy life for thee.
verses.griffith_verse: So have I found and rescued thee thou hast returned with youth renewed. Whole in thy members! I have found thy sight and all thy life for thee.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLXII. Agni
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . MAY Agni, yielding to our prayer, the Rakṣas-slayer, drive awayThe malady of evil name that hath beset thy labouring womb. Agni, concurring in the prayer, drive off the eater of the flesh,The malady of evil name that hath attacked thy babe and womb. That which destroys the sinking germ, the settled, moving embryo,That which will kill the babe at birth,—even this will we drive far away. That which divides thy legs that it may lie between the married pair,That penetrates and licks thy side,—even this will we exterminate. What rests by thee in borrowed form of brother, lover, or of lord,And would destroy thy Progeny,—even this will we exterminate. That which through sleep or darkness hath deceived thee and lies down by thee,And will destroy thy progeny,—even this will we exterminate.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणाग्निः संविदानो रक्षोहा बाधतामितः ।अमीवा यस्ते गर्भं दुर्णामा योनिमाशये ॥
verses.transliteration: bráhmaṇā ǀ agníḥ ǀ sam-vidānáḥ ǀ rakṣaḥ-hā́ ǀ bādhatām ǀ itáḥ ǀámīvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ gárbham ǀ duḥ-nā́mā ǀ yónim ǀ ā-śáye ǁ
verses.english_translation: MAY Agni, yielding to our prayer, the Rakṣas-slayer, drive away The malady of evil name that hath beset thy labouring womb.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, the destroyer of therākṣasas, consenting to our prayer, drive hence (the evil spirit) who(in the form of) sickness assails your embryo, who, as the diseasedurṇāman, assails your womb.
verses.griffith_verse: MAY Agni, yielding to our prayer, the Rakṣas-slayer, drive away The malady of evil name that hath beset thy labouring womb.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते गर्भममीवा दुर्णामा योनिमाशये ।अग्निष्टं ब्रह्मणा सह निष्क्रव्यादमनीनशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ gárbham ǀ ámīvā ǀ duḥ-nā́mā ǀ yónim ǀ ā-śáye ǀagníḥ ǀ tám ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ sahá ǀ níḥ ǀ kravya-ádam ǀ anīnaśat ǁ
verses.english_translation: Agni, concurring in the prayer, drive off the eater of the flesh, The malady of evil name that hath attacked thy babe and womb.
verses.wilson_translation: May Agni, concurring in our prayer, destroy the cannibal who, as sickness, assails your embryo, who,as the diseasedurṇāman, assails your womb.
verses.griffith_verse: Agni, concurring in the prayer, drive off the eater of the flesh, The malady of evil name that hath attacked thy babe and womb.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते हंति पतयंतं निषत्स्नुं यः सरीसृपं ।जातं यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ hánti ǀ patáyantam ǀ ni-satsnúm ǀ yáḥ ǀ sarīsṛpám ǀjātám ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀ tám ǀ itáḥ ǀ nāśayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: That which destroys the sinking germ, the settled, moving embryo, That which will kill the babe at birth,—even this will we drive far away.
verses.wilson_translation: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit) who destroys the impregnating energy, the germ as itsettles, the moving embryo, who seeks to destroy (the babe) when born.
verses.griffith_verse: That which destroys the sinking germ, the settled, moving embryo, That which will kill the babe at birth,—even this will we drive far away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्त ऊरू विहरत्यंतरा दंपती शये ।योनिं यो अंतरारेळ्हि तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ūrū́ íti ǀ vi-hárati ǀ antarā́ ǀ dámpatī íti dám-patī ǀ śáye ǀyónim ǀ yáḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā-réḷhi ǀ tám ǀ itáḥ ǀ nāśayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: That which divides thy legs that it may lie between the married pair, That penetrates and licks thy side,—even this will we exterminate.
verses.wilson_translation: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit)l who separates your things, who lies betweenhusband and wife, who, entering your womb, devours (the seed).
verses.griffith_verse: That which divides thy legs that it may lie between the married pair, That penetrates and licks thy side,—even this will we exterminate.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वा भ्राता पतिर्भूत्वा जारो भूत्वा निपद्यते ।प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ bhrā́tā ǀ pátiḥ ǀ bhūtvā́ ǀ jāráḥ ǀ bhūtvā́ ǀ ni-pádyate ǀpra-jā́m ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀ tám ǀ itáḥ ǀ nāśayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: What rests by thee in borrowed form of brother, lover, or of lord, And would destroy thy Progeny,—even this will we exterminate.
verses.wilson_translation: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit), who in the form of brother, husband, or paramour,approaches you, and seeks to destroy your offspring.
verses.griffith_verse: What rests by thee in borrowed form of brother, lover, or of lord, And would destroy thy Progeny,—even this will we exterminate.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वा स्वप्नेन तमसा मोहयित्वा निपद्यते ।प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ svápnena ǀ támasā ǀ mohayitvā́ ǀ ni-pádyate ǀpra-jā́m ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀ tám ǀ itáḥ ǀ nāśayāmasi ǁ
verses.english_translation: That which through sleep or darkness hath deceived thee and lies down by thee, And will destroy thy progeny,—even this will we exterminate.
verses.wilson_translation: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit), who, having beguiled you by sleep or darkness,approaches you, and seeks to destroy your offspring.
verses.griffith_verse: That which through sleep or darkness hath deceived thee and lies down by thee, And will destroy thy progeny,—even this will we exterminate.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

hymns.title: HYMN CLXIII
hymns.griffith_hymn_text: . FROM both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin,Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away. From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine,From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away. From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart,From kidneys, liver, and from spleen, I drive thy malady away. From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet,From hips from stomach, and from groin I drive thy malady away. From what is voided from within, and from thy hair, and from they nails,From all thyself from top to toe, I drive thy malady away. From every member, every hair, disease that comes in every joint,From all thyself, from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षीभ्यां ते नासिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां छुबुकादधि ।यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: akṣī́bhyām ǀ te ǀ nā́sikābhyām ǀ kárṇābhyām ǀ chúbukāt ǀ ádhi ǀyákṣmam ǀ śīrṣaṇyám ǀ mastíṣkāt ǀ jihvā́yāḥ ǀ ví ǀ vṛhāmi ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: FROM both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin, Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away.
verses.wilson_translation: I banish from your eyes, from your nose, from your ears, from your chin, from your head, from yourbrain, from your tongue.
verses.griffith_verse: FROM both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin, Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीवाभ्यस्त उष्णिहाभ्यः कीकसाभ्यो अनूक्यात् ।यक्ष्मं दोषण्यमंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: grīvā́bhyaḥ ǀ te ǀ uṣṇíhābhyaḥ ǀ kī́kasābhyaḥ ǀ anūkyā́t ǀyákṣmam ǀ doṣaṇyám ǀ áṃsābhyām ǀ bāhú-bhyām ǀ ví ǀ vṛhāmi ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine, From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away.
verses.wilson_translation: I banish disease from your neck, from your sinews, from your bones, from your joints, from your upperarms, from your shoulders, and from your fore- arms.
verses.griffith_verse: From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine, From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: आंत्रेभ्यस्ते गुदाभ्यो वनिष्ठोर्हृदयादधि ।यक्ष्मं मतस्नाभ्यां यक्नः प्लाशिभ्यो वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: āntrébhyaḥ ǀ te ǀ gúdābhyaḥ ǀ vaniṣṭhóḥ ǀ hṛ́dayāt ǀ ádhi ǀyákṣmam ǀ mátasnābhyām ǀ yaknáḥ ǀ plāśí-bhyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vṛhāmi ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart, From kidneys, liver, and from spleen, I drive thy malady away.
verses.wilson_translation: I banish disease from your entrails, from your anus, from your abdomen, and from your heart, fromyour kidneys, from your liver, from your (other) viscera.
verses.griffith_verse: From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart, From kidneys, liver, and from spleen, I drive thy malady away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: ऊरुभ्यां ते अष्ठीवद्भ्यां पार्ष्णिभ्यां प्रपदाभ्यां ।यक्ष्मं श्रोणिभ्यां भासदाद्भंससो वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrú-bhyām ǀ te ǀ aṣṭhīvát-bhyām ǀ pā́rṣṇi-bhyām ǀ prá-padābhyām ǀyákṣmam ǀ śróṇi-bhyām ǀ bhā́sadāt ǀ bháṃsasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vṛhāmi ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet, From hips from stomach, and from groin I drive thy malady away.
verses.wilson_translation: I banish disease from your thighs, from your knees, from your heels, from your toes, from your loins,from your buttocks, from your private parts.
verses.griffith_verse: From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet, From hips from stomach, and from groin I drive thy malady away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: मेहनाद्वनंकरणाल्लोमभ्यस्ते नखेभ्यः ।यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: méhanāt ǀ vanam-káraṇāt ǀ lóma-bhyaḥ ǀ te ǀ nakhébhyaḥ ǀyákṣmam ǀ sárvasmāt ǀ ātmánaḥ ǀ tám ǀ idám ǀ ví ǀ vṛhāmi ǀ te ǁ
verses.english_translation: From what is voided from within, and from thy hair, and from they nails, From all thyself from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.
verses.wilson_translation: I banish disease from your urethra, from your bladder, from your hair, from your nails, from your wholeperson.
verses.griffith_verse: From what is voided from within, and from thy hair, and from they nails, From all thyself from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.
verses.translator: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1896)

verses.sanskrit: अंगादंगाल्लोम्नोलोम्नो जातं पर्वणिपर्वणि ।यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration: áṅgāt-aṅgāt ǀ lómnaḥ-lomnaḥ ǀ jātám ǀ párvaṇi-parvaṇi ǀyákṣmam ǀ sárvasmāt ǀ ātmánaḥ ǀ tám ǀ idám ǀ ví ǀ vṛhāmi ǀ te ǁ
